/***************************************************************
 * PERF7 CORE ID NORMALIZER — 2026-08-19
 *
 * Deliberately lives at the very top-level and has no dependency on any
 * legacy helper. All hot validation/relation paths use this function directly
 * so a partial legacy helper block cannot produce:
 *   ReferenceError: normalizeValidateDateId_ is not defined
 ***************************************************************/
var RSC_CORE_ID_NORMALIZE_CACHE_20260819_ = Object.create(null);
var RSC_CORE_ID_NORMALIZE_CACHE_SIZE_20260819_ = 0;
var RSC_CORE_ID_NORMALIZE_CACHE_LIMIT_20260819_ = 20000;

function RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(value) {
  var raw = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
  if (!raw) return '';

  if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(RSC_CORE_ID_NORMALIZE_CACHE_20260819_, raw)) {
    return RSC_CORE_ID_NORMALIZE_CACHE_20260819_[raw];
  }

  var s = raw
    .replace(/[\u200B-\u200D\u2060\uFEFF]/g, '')
    .replace(/^'+/, '')
    .trim();

  var labelMatch = s.match(/^\s*([A-Za-z0-9]+)\s+(?:-|–|—|\|)\s+.+$/);
  if (labelMatch && labelMatch[1]) s = labelMatch[1];

  s = s.replace(/\s+/g, '');

  if (/^\d+\.0+$/.test(s)) s = s.replace(/\.0+$/, '');

  if (/^\d+(?:\.\d+)?[eE]\+?\d+$/.test(s)) {
    var n = Number(s);
    if (isFinite(n)) s = String(Math.round(n));
  }

  s = s.toUpperCase();

  if (RSC_CORE_ID_NORMALIZE_CACHE_SIZE_20260819_ < RSC_CORE_ID_NORMALIZE_CACHE_LIMIT_20260819_) {
    RSC_CORE_ID_NORMALIZE_CACHE_20260819_[raw] = s;
    RSC_CORE_ID_NORMALIZE_CACHE_SIZE_20260819_++;
  }

  return s;
}



/***************************************************************
 * PERF8 SOURCE INTEGRITY + SELF-CONTAINED m_bp_relation CORE
 * 2026-08-19
 *
 * This block intentionally has no dependency on legacy helper blocks.
 * All hot paths use the CORE reader below. Legacy reader function names
 * remain as compatibility wrappers later in the source.
 ***************************************************************/
var RSC_PERF8_SOURCE_HEAD_MARKER_20260819_ = 'PERF8_HEAD_OK';
var RSC_CORE_MBP_WARN_COUNT_20260819_ = 0;
var RSC_CORE_MBP_WARN_LIMIT_20260819_ = 20;

function RSC_CORE_MBP_HEADER_KEY_20260819_(value) {
  return String(value == null ? '' : value)
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[\s\-]+/g, '_');
}

function RSC_CORE_MBP_FIND_HEADER_COL_20260819_(row, aliases) {
  var wanted = Object.create(null);
  for (var i = 0; i < aliases.length; i++) {
    wanted[RSC_CORE_MBP_HEADER_KEY_20260819_(aliases[i])] = true;
  }
  for (var c = 0; c < row.length; c++) {
    if (wanted[RSC_CORE_MBP_HEADER_KEY_20260819_(row[c])]) return c + 1;
  }
  return 0;
}

function RSC_CORE_MBP_WARN_SKIP_20260819_(sheetRow, reason, raw) {
  if (RSC_CORE_MBP_WARN_COUNT_20260819_ >= RSC_CORE_MBP_WARN_LIMIT_20260819_) return;
  RSC_CORE_MBP_WARN_COUNT_20260819_++;
  var preview = String(raw == null ? '' : raw).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 240);
  console.warn('[m_bp_relation] Skip row ' + sheetRow + ': ' + reason + (preview ? ' | value=' + preview : ''));
}

function RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_PARSE_PAYLOAD_20260819_(value, sheetRow) {
  var raw = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
  if (!raw) return null;
  if (raw === '__UPDATING__' || raw.toLowerCase() === 'relation_payload') return null;

  var arr;
  try {
    arr = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (typeof arr === 'string') {
      var nested = arr.trim();
      if (nested.charAt(0) === '[') arr = JSON.parse(nested);
    }
    if (arr && !Array.isArray(arr) && typeof arr === 'object' &&
        Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(arr, 'relation_payload')) {
      arr = arr.relation_payload;
      if (typeof arr === 'string') arr = JSON.parse(arr);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    RSC_CORE_MBP_WARN_SKIP_20260819_(sheetRow, 'JSON tidak valid: ' + String(err && err.message ? err.message : err), raw);
    return null;
  }

  if (!Array.isArray(arr) || arr.length < 5) {
    RSC_CORE_MBP_WARN_SKIP_20260819_(sheetRow, 'bukan JSON array minimal 5 elemen', raw);
    return null;
  }

  return [
    arr[0] == null ? '' : String(arr[0]).trim(),
    arr[1] == null ? '' : String(arr[1]).trim(),
    arr[2] == null ? '' : String(arr[2]).trim(),
    arr[3] == null ? '' : String(arr[3]).trim(),
    arr[4] == null || String(arr[4]).trim() === '' ? '9999-12-31' : String(arr[4]).trim()
  ];
}

function RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_GET_LAYOUT_20260819_(sh) {
  if (!sh) throw new Error('m_bp_relation sheet null.');
  var lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  var lastCol = Math.max(1, sh.getLastColumn());
  if (lastRow < 1) return {mode:'EMPTY', headerRow:0, firstDataRow:1, payloadCol:1, hasHeader:false};

  var scanRows = Math.min(5, lastRow);
  var scanCols = Math.min(200, lastCol);
  var grid = sh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, scanCols).getDisplayValues();
  var r, c, raw, parsed;

  // Compact with relation_payload header.
  for (r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    c = RSC_CORE_MBP_FIND_HEADER_COL_20260819_(grid[r], ['relation_payload']);
    if (c) return {mode:'COMPACT_JSON', headerRow:r+1, firstDataRow:r+2, payloadCol:c, hasHeader:true};
  }

  // Headerless compact JSON. The first valid JSON row is data, not a header.
  for (r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    for (c = 0; c < grid[r].length; c++) {
      raw = String(grid[r][c] == null ? '' : grid[r][c]).trim();
      if (!raw || raw.charAt(0) !== '[') continue;
      try {
        parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (typeof parsed === 'string' && parsed.trim().charAt(0) === '[') parsed = JSON.parse(parsed.trim());
        if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length >= 5) {
          return {mode:'COMPACT_JSON', headerRow:0, firstDataRow:r+1, payloadCol:c+1, hasHeader:false};
        }
      } catch (ignoreProbe) {}
    }
  }

  // Legacy 5-column layout.
  for (r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    var cA = RSC_CORE_MBP_FIND_HEADER_COL_20260819_(grid[r], ['bp_id_rlt1']);
    var cB = RSC_CORE_MBP_FIND_HEADER_COL_20260819_(grid[r], ['relationship_cat_id']);
    var cC = RSC_CORE_MBP_FIND_HEADER_COL_20260819_(grid[r], ['bp_id_rlt2']);
    var cD = RSC_CORE_MBP_FIND_HEADER_COL_20260819_(grid[r], ['valid_from','Valid From']);
    var cE = RSC_CORE_MBP_FIND_HEADER_COL_20260819_(grid[r], ['valid_to','Valid To']);
    if (cA && cB && cC && cD) {
      return {mode:'LEGACY_COLUMNS', headerRow:r+1, firstDataRow:r+2, cA:cA, cB:cB, cC:cC, cD:cD, cE:cE||0, hasHeader:true};
    }
  }

  throw new Error('Format m_bp_relation tidak dikenali. Expected compact JSON 1-cell/row (header relation_payload opsional) atau legacy 5 kolom.');
}

function RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_READ_CANONICAL_20260819_(sh, startRow, count, layout) {
  layout = layout || RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_GET_LAYOUT_20260819_(sh);
  if (!count || count < 1) return [];

  if (layout.mode === 'COMPACT_JSON') {
    var vals = sh.getRange(startRow, layout.payloadCol, count, 1).getDisplayValues();
    var out = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
      var parsed = RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_PARSE_PAYLOAD_20260819_(vals[i][0], startRow + i);
      if (parsed) out.push(parsed);
    }
    return out;
  }

  if (layout.mode === 'LEGACY_COLUMNS') {
    var cols = [layout.cA, layout.cB, layout.cC, layout.cD];
    if (layout.cE) cols.push(layout.cE);
    var minCol = Math.min.apply(null, cols);
    var maxCol = Math.max.apply(null, cols);
    var width = maxCol - minCol + 1;
    var legacy = sh.getRange(startRow, minCol, count, width).getDisplayValues();
    var result = [];
    for (var j = 0; j < legacy.length; j++) {
      var vt = layout.cE ? legacy[j][layout.cE - minCol] : '';
      var row = [
        legacy[j][layout.cA - minCol],
        legacy[j][layout.cB - minCol],
        legacy[j][layout.cC - minCol],
        legacy[j][layout.cD - minCol],
        String(vt == null ? '' : vt).trim() || '9999-12-31'
      ];
      // Skip truly blank legacy rows.
      if (String(row[0]||'').trim() || String(row[1]||'').trim() || String(row[2]||'').trim()) result.push(row);
    }
    return result;
  }

  return [];
}

function RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_CANONICAL_INDEX_20260819_(headerName) {
  var h = RSC_CORE_MBP_HEADER_KEY_20260819_(headerName);
  if (h === 'bp_id_rlt1') return 0;
  if (h === 'relationship_cat_id') return 1;
  if (h === 'bp_id_rlt2') return 2;
  if (h === 'valid_from') return 3;
  if (h === 'valid_to') return 4;
  return -1;
}

/***************************************************************

/***************************************************************
 * SPREADSHEET ACCESS RESILIENCE PATCH V26 — 2026-08-14
 *
 * Menangani error transient Google Sheets seperti:
 * "Service Spreadsheets failed while accessing document with id ..."
 *
 * - Semua openById pada script ini diarahkan ke helper retry.
 * - Retry memakai exponential backoff.
 * - Jika file memang tidak bisa diakses / tidak ada, error dibuat lebih jelas.
 * - Tidak mengubah rule validasi Dummy Salesman V25.
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_PERF11_EXTRACT_SPREADSHEET_ID_20260819_(value) {
  const text = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
  if (!text) return '';
  const urlMatch = text.match(/\/spreadsheets\/d\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/i);
  if (urlMatch && urlMatch[1]) return urlMatch[1];
  const idMatch = text.match(/^([A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,})$/);
  return idMatch ? idMatch[1] : '';
}

function RSC_PERF11_EXECUTION_IDENTITY_20260819_() {
  let effectiveUser = '', activeUser = '', activeSpreadsheetId = '';
  try { effectiveUser = String(Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail() || ''); } catch (ignore1) {}
  try { activeUser = String(Session.getActiveUser().getEmail() || ''); } catch (ignore2) {}
  try {
    const active = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    activeSpreadsheetId = active ? String(active.getId() || '') : '';
  } catch (ignore3) {}
  return {
    effectiveUser: effectiveUser || '[hidden/unavailable]',
    activeUser: activeUser || '[hidden/unavailable]',
    activeSpreadsheetId: activeSpreadsheetId || '[none]'
  };
}

/**
 * PERF11 resilient spreadsheet opener.
 *
 * Why this exists:
 * Apps Script can occasionally throw "Document ... is missing" from
 * SpreadsheetApp.openById even when the file exists in the browser.  The most
 * common practical causes are execution identity/trigger access or a transient
 * Spreadsheet service resolution failure.  We therefore try several supported
 * access paths and force a lightweight metadata read before accepting a handle.
 */
function RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(fileIdOrUrl) {
  if (typeof RSC_PERF13_ASSERT_RUN_ALLOWED_20260819_ === 'function') RSC_PERF13_ASSERT_RUN_ALLOWED_20260819_('OPEN_SPREADSHEET');
  const id = RSC_PERF11_EXTRACT_SPREADSHEET_ID_20260819_(fileIdOrUrl);
  if (!id) throw new Error('[SPREADSHEET_ACCESS] Spreadsheet ID/URL kosong atau tidak valid.');

  if (typeof __RSC_PERF5_SPREADSHEET_CACHE_20260819__ !== 'undefined' &&
      Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(__RSC_PERF5_SPREADSHEET_CACHE_20260819__, id)) {
    const cached = __RSC_PERF5_SPREADSHEET_CACHE_20260819__[id];
    try {
      if (cached && String(cached.getId() || '') === id) {
        if (typeof RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_ === 'function') RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('spreadsheetCacheHit', 1);
        return cached;
      }
    } catch (ignoreCached) {
      delete __RSC_PERF5_SPREADSHEET_CACHE_20260819__[id];
    }
  }

  // If the requested DB happens to be the current container, never call openById.
  try {
    const active = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    if (active && String(active.getId() || '') === id) {
      if (typeof __RSC_PERF5_SPREADSHEET_CACHE_20260819__ !== 'undefined') __RSC_PERF5_SPREADSHEET_CACHE_20260819__[id] = active;
      if (typeof RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_ === 'function') RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('spreadsheetOpenActiveReuse', 1);
      return active;
    }
  } catch (ignoreActive) {}

  const canonicalUrl = 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/' + id + '/edit';
  const maxAttempts = 4;
  let lastErr = null;
  let driveReadable = null;
  const methodErrors = [];

  function accept_(ss, method) {
    if (!ss) throw new Error(method + ' returned null spreadsheet.');
    const openedId = String(ss.getId() || '');
    if (openedId && openedId !== id) throw new Error(method + ' returned different spreadsheet ID ' + openedId + '.');
    // Force backend resolution now, not later in getSheetByName/getRange.
    ss.getName();
    if (typeof __RSC_PERF5_SPREADSHEET_CACHE_20260819__ !== 'undefined') __RSC_PERF5_SPREADSHEET_CACHE_20260819__[id] = ss;
    if (typeof RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_ === 'function') {
      RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('spreadsheetOpen', 1);
      RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('spreadsheetOpen_' + method, 1);
    }
    return ss;
  }

  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
    // 1) Native ID open — fastest normal path.
    try {
      return accept_(SpreadsheetApp.openById(id), 'openById');
    } catch (err1) {
      lastErr = err1;
      methodErrors.push('attempt ' + attempt + ' openById: ' + String(err1 && err1.message ? err1.message : err1));
    }

    // 2) URL resolver — useful when ID resolver is temporarily stale.
    try {
      return accept_(SpreadsheetApp.openByUrl(canonicalUrl), 'openByUrl');
    } catch (err2) {
      lastErr = err2;
      methodErrors.push('attempt ' + attempt + ' openByUrl: ' + String(err2 && err2.message ? err2.message : err2));
    }

    // 3) Drive file resolver + SpreadsheetApp.open(File), when available.
    try {
      if (typeof DriveApp !== 'undefined' && typeof DriveApp.getFileById === 'function') {
        const file = DriveApp.getFileById(id);
        driveReadable = true;
        if (typeof SpreadsheetApp.open === 'function') return accept_(SpreadsheetApp.open(file), 'openDriveFile');
      }
    } catch (err3) {
      lastErr = err3;
      if (driveReadable === null) driveReadable = false;
      methodErrors.push('attempt ' + attempt + ' Drive/open: ' + String(err3 && err3.message ? err3.message : err3));
    }

    if (attempt < maxAttempts) Utilities.sleep(400 * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1));
  }

  const identity = RSC_PERF11_EXECUTION_IDENTITY_20260819_();
  const detail = String(lastErr && lastErr.message ? lastErr.message : lastErr || 'Unknown error');
  throw new Error(
    '[SPREADSHEET_ACCESS] Gagal membuka spreadsheet ' + id + '. File URL=' + canonicalUrl +
    '. File dapat tetap terlihat di browser tetapi Apps Script berjalan dengan execution identity yang berbeda (terutama installable trigger/background worker). ' +
    'effectiveUser=' + identity.effectiveUser + ', activeUser=' + identity.activeUser + ', activeSpreadsheet=' + identity.activeSpreadsheetId +
    ', driveReadable=' + String(driveReadable) + '. Detail terakhir=' + detail +
    '. Access attempts: ' + methodErrors.slice(-6).join(' | ')
  );
}


/***************************************************************
 * PERFORMANCE INTEGRATION V29 / PERF5 — 2026-08-19
 *
 * Shared acceleration layer for the whole project:
 * - execution-local spreadsheet/sheet/cache reuse
 * - ScriptCache read-through + write-through local cache
 * - fast cache keys (avoid MD5 for normal business keys)
 * - adaptive TextFinder candidate reduction
 * - regex filtering + prefix bucketing for numeric Customer IDs / S* IDs
 * - merged row-range reads (avoid one-cell-at-a-time reads)
 * - targeted m_bp_relation candidate reader
 * - telemetry counters for tuning
 *
 * Correctness rule:
 * Candidate reduction is NEVER the final matcher. Every candidate is
 * normalized and exact-matched in memory before it is accepted.
 ***************************************************************/
const RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819 = {
  version: 'PERF5_20260819',
  localMemoMaxPerBucket: 25000,
  textFinderMaxIds: 2500,
  textFinderMaxRegexChars: 16000,
  textFinderPrefixMinGroup: 10,
  numericPrefixLength: 6,
  salesmanPrefixLength: 7,
  mergeGapRows: 12,
  mergeMaxSpanRows: 800,
  fallbackRelationChunkRows: 8000,
  positiveCacheTtlSec: 1200,
  negativeCacheTtlSec: 120,
  workerPrefetchMaxFiles: 4,
  workerPrefetchMaxRows: 12000,
  workerPrefetchMaxCells: 180000
};

var __RSC_PERF5_SPREADSHEET_CACHE_20260819__ = Object.create(null);
var __RSC_PERF5_SHEET_CACHE_20260819__ = Object.create(null);
var __RSC_PERF5_LOCAL_CACHE_20260819__ = Object.create(null);
var __RSC_PERF5_MEMO_20260819__ = Object.create(null);
var __RSC_PERF5_MEMO_COUNT_20260819__ = Object.create(null);
var __RSC_PERF5_STATS_20260819__ = Object.create(null);
var __RSC_PERF5_MVS_LAYOUT_CACHE_20260819__ = Object.create(null);
var __RSC_PERF5_ROLLING_SNAPSHOT_CACHE_20260819__ = Object.create(null);

function RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_(name, amount) {
  const key = String(name || 'unknown');
  __RSC_PERF5_STATS_20260819__[key] = Number(__RSC_PERF5_STATS_20260819__[key] || 0) + Number(amount == null ? 1 : amount);
}

function RSC_PERF5_GET_STATS_20260819_() {
  const out = {};
  Object.keys(__RSC_PERF5_STATS_20260819__).sort().forEach(function (k) {
    out[k] = __RSC_PERF5_STATS_20260819__[k];
  });
  return out;
}

function RSC_PERF5_RESET_STATS_20260819_() {
  __RSC_PERF5_STATS_20260819__ = Object.create(null);
  return true;
}

function RSC_PERF5_MEMO_SCALAR_20260819_(bucketName, rawKey, computeFn) {
  const b = String(bucketName || 'GEN');
  let bucket = __RSC_PERF5_MEMO_20260819__[b];
  if (!bucket) {
    bucket = __RSC_PERF5_MEMO_20260819__[b] = Object.create(null);
    __RSC_PERF5_MEMO_COUNT_20260819__[b] = 0;
  }
  const key = typeof rawKey + '|' + String(rawKey == null ? '' : rawKey);
  if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(bucket, key)) {
    RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('memoHit.' + b, 1);
    return bucket[key];
  }
  const value = computeFn();
  if (Number(__RSC_PERF5_MEMO_COUNT_20260819__[b] || 0) < RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819.localMemoMaxPerBucket) {
    bucket[key] = value;
    __RSC_PERF5_MEMO_COUNT_20260819__[b] = Number(__RSC_PERF5_MEMO_COUNT_20260819__[b] || 0) + 1;
  }
  RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('memoMiss.' + b, 1);
  return value;
}

function RSC_PERF5_GET_SHEET_20260819_(ss, sheetName) {
  if (!ss) return null;
  const ssId = String(ss.getId ? ss.getId() : '');
  const name = String(sheetName || '');
  const key = ssId + '||' + name;
  if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(__RSC_PERF5_SHEET_CACHE_20260819__, key)) {
    RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('sheetCacheHit', 1);
    return __RSC_PERF5_SHEET_CACHE_20260819__[key];
  }
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
  __RSC_PERF5_SHEET_CACHE_20260819__[key] = sh || null;
  RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('sheetCacheMiss', 1);
  return sh;
}

function RSC_PERF5_ESCAPE_REGEX_20260819_(value) {
  return String(value == null ? '' : value).replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
}

function RSC_PERF5_FAST_HASH_20260819_(value) {
  const s = String(value == null ? '' : value);
  let h = 2166136261;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    h ^= s.charCodeAt(i);
    h = Math.imul(h, 16777619);
  }
  return (h >>> 0).toString(36);
}

function RSC_PERF5_IS_LOOKUP_ID_20260819_(value) {
  const s = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim().toUpperCase();
  return /^\d+$/.test(s) || /^S[A-Z0-9]+$/.test(s);
}

function RSC_PERF5_UNIQUE_NORMALIZED_IDS_20260819_(rawMap, normalizer) {
  const out = Object.create(null);
  Object.keys(rawMap || {}).forEach(function (raw) {
    const id = normalizer ? normalizer(raw) : String(raw || '').trim();
    if (id) out[id] = true;
  });
  return out;
}

function RSC_PERF5_BUILD_BUCKET_TOKENS_20260819_(ids) {
  const C = RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819;
  const groups = Object.create(null);
  const exact = [];
  (ids || []).forEach(function (raw) {
    const id = String(raw || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!id) return;
    let prefixLen = 0;
    if (/^\d+$/.test(id)) prefixLen = Math.min(C.numericPrefixLength, id.length);
    else if (/^S[A-Z0-9]+$/.test(id)) prefixLen = Math.min(C.salesmanPrefixLength, id.length);
    if (!prefixLen || id.length <= prefixLen) {
      exact.push(id);
      return;
    }
    const prefix = id.slice(0, prefixLen);
    if (!groups[prefix]) groups[prefix] = [];
    groups[prefix].push(id);
  });

  const tokens = [];
  Object.keys(groups).forEach(function (prefix) {
    const arr = groups[prefix];
    if (arr.length >= C.textFinderPrefixMinGroup) {
      const suffixClass = /^\d+$/.test(arr[0]) ? '\\d*' : '[A-Z0-9]*';
      tokens.push({ regex: RSC_PERF5_ESCAPE_REGEX_20260819_(prefix) + suffixClass, bucket: true, count: arr.length });
    } else {
      arr.forEach(function (id) {
        tokens.push({ regex: RSC_PERF5_ESCAPE_REGEX_20260819_(id), bucket: false, count: 1 });
      });
    }
  });
  exact.forEach(function (id) {
    tokens.push({ regex: RSC_PERF5_ESCAPE_REGEX_20260819_(id), bucket: false, count: 1 });
  });
  return tokens;
}

function RSC_PERF5_PACK_REGEX_TOKENS_20260819_(tokens) {
  const maxChars = RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819.textFinderMaxRegexChars;
  const batches = [];
  let current = [];
  let chars = 0;
  (tokens || []).forEach(function (t) {
    const len = String(t.regex || '').length + 1;
    if (current.length && chars + len > maxChars) {
      batches.push(current);
      current = [];
      chars = 0;
    }
    current.push(t);
    chars += len;
  });
  if (current.length) batches.push(current);
  return batches;
}

function RSC_PERF5_MERGE_ROWS_TO_BLOCKS_20260819_(rows, maxGap, maxSpan) {
  if (!rows || !rows.length) return [];
  const unique = Object.create(null);
  rows.forEach(function (r) {
    const n = Number(r || 0);
    if (n > 0) unique[n] = true;
  });
  const sorted = Object.keys(unique).map(Number).sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; });
  if (!sorted.length) return [];
  const gap = Math.max(0, Number(maxGap == null ? RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819.mergeGapRows : maxGap));
  const spanLimit = Math.max(1, Number(maxSpan == null ? RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819.mergeMaxSpanRows : maxSpan));
  const blocks = [];
  let start = sorted[0], end = sorted[0];
  for (let i = 1; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    const r = sorted[i];
    if (r - end <= gap + 1 && r - start + 1 <= spanLimit) {
      end = r;
    } else {
      blocks.push({ start: start, count: end - start + 1 });
      start = end = r;
    }
  }
  blocks.push({ start: start, count: end - start + 1 });
  return blocks;
}

/**
 * Server-side candidate finder. Returns null only when caller should use a
 * correctness-preserving sequential fallback (too many IDs / service error).
 */
function RSC_PERF5_FIND_ROWS_20260819_(sh, col, firstRow, lastRow, neededIds, options) {
  options = options || {};
  const ids = Object.keys(neededIds || {});
  if (!ids.length || lastRow < firstRow) return { rows: [], mode: 'EMPTY', finderCalls: 0 };
  if (ids.length > Number(options.maxIds || RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819.textFinderMaxIds)) return null;

  const eligible = ids.filter(function (id) { return RSC_PERF5_IS_LOOKUP_ID_20260819_(id); });
  // Unknown format should not silently disappear. Ask caller to fallback.
  if (eligible.length !== ids.length) return null;

  const tokens = RSC_PERF5_BUILD_BUCKET_TOKENS_20260819_(eligible);
  const batches = RSC_PERF5_PACK_REGEX_TOKENS_20260819_(tokens);
  const range = sh.getRange(firstRow, col, lastRow - firstRow + 1, 1);
  const rowSet = Object.create(null);
  let finderCalls = 0;

  try {
    batches.forEach(function (batch) {
      const body = batch.map(function (t) { return t.regex; }).join('|');
      const regex = options.compactJson
        ? '^\\s*\\[\\s*"(?:' + body + ')"\\s*,'
        : '^(?:' + body + ')$';
      const finder = range.createTextFinder(regex).useRegularExpression(true).matchCase(false);
      const matches = finder.findAll() || [];
      finderCalls++;
      RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('textFinderCalls', 1);
      RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('textFinderMatchRefs', matches.length);
      for (let i = 0; i < matches.length; i++) {
        const row = Number(matches[i].getRow() || 0);
        if (row >= firstRow && row <= lastRow) rowSet[row] = true;
      }
    });
  } catch (err) {
    RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('textFinderFallbacks', 1);
    console.warn('[PERF5] TextFinder fallback: ' + String(err && err.message ? err.message : err));
    return null;
  }

  return {
    rows: Object.keys(rowSet).map(Number).sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; }),
    mode: tokens.some(function (t) { return t.bucket; }) ? 'TEXTFINDER_BUCKET' : 'TEXTFINDER_EXACT',
    finderCalls: finderCalls
  };
}

function RSC_PERF5_READ_BLOCKS_20260819_(sh, rowNumbers, minCol, width, valueMode) {
  const blocks = RSC_PERF5_MERGE_ROWS_TO_BLOCKS_20260819_(rowNumbers);
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) {
    const b = blocks[i];
    const range = sh.getRange(b.start, minCol, b.count, width);
    const vals = valueMode === 'RAW' ? range.getValues() : range.getDisplayValues();
    for (let r = 0; r < vals.length; r++) out.push({ sheetRow: b.start + r, values: vals[r] });
  }
  RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('mergedReadBlocks', blocks.length);
  RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('mergedReadRows', out.length);
  return out;
}

function RSC_PERF5_COLLECT_RELATION_CUSTOMERS_20260819_(neededTriple, neededCustomer, neededR8) {
  const out = Object.create(null);
  Object.keys(neededCustomer || {}).forEach(function (k) {
    const id = RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(k);
    if (id) out[id] = true;
  });
  [neededTriple || {}, neededR8 || {}].forEach(function (map) {
    Object.keys(map).forEach(function (k) {
      const id = RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(String(k || '').split('||')[0]);
      if (id) out[id] = true;
    });
  });
  return out;
}

/**
 * Read only m_bp_relation rows whose first field can satisfy current needs.
 * Returns canonical relation rows. Falls back to sequential chunks only when
 * TextFinder cannot safely be used.
 */
function RSC_PERF5_READ_RELATION_CANDIDATES_20260819_(sh, layout, neededTriple, neededCustomer, neededR8) {
  layout = layout || RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_GET_LAYOUT_20260819_(sh);
  const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  const firstDataRow = layout.firstDataRow || (layout.headerRow + 1);
  const customers = RSC_PERF5_COLLECT_RELATION_CUSTOMERS_20260819_(neededTriple, neededCustomer, neededR8);
  if (!Object.keys(customers).length || lastRow < firstDataRow) {
    return { rows: [], scannedRows: 0, lookupMode: 'EMPTY', candidateRowRefs: 0 };
  }

  const idCol = layout.mode === 'COMPACT_JSON' ? layout.payloadCol : layout.cA;
  const finderResult = RSC_PERF5_FIND_ROWS_20260819_(
    sh, idCol, firstDataRow, lastRow, customers,
    { compactJson: layout.mode === 'COMPACT_JSON' }
  );

  if (finderResult) {
    const blocks = RSC_PERF5_MERGE_ROWS_TO_BLOCKS_20260819_(finderResult.rows);
    const rows = [];
    let physicalRowsRead = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) {
      const b = blocks[i];
      const canonical = RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_READ_CANONICAL_20260819_(sh, b.start, b.count, layout);
      physicalRowsRead += b.count;
      for (let r = 0; r < canonical.length; r++) {
        const cust = RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(canonical[r][0]);
        if (cust && customers[cust]) rows.push(canonical[r]);
      }
    }
    RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('relationCandidateRowsRead', physicalRowsRead);
    RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('relationCandidateRowsAccepted', rows.length);
    return {
      rows: rows,
      scannedRows: physicalRowsRead,
      lookupMode: finderResult.mode,
      candidateRowRefs: finderResult.rows.length,
      finderCalls: finderResult.finderCalls
    };
  }

  // Correctness fallback for very large or non-standard need sets.
  const out = [];
  let scanned = 0;
  const chunkRows = Math.max(500, Number(RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819.fallbackRelationChunkRows || 8000));
  for (let start = firstDataRow; start <= lastRow; start += chunkRows) {
    const count = Math.min(chunkRows, lastRow - start + 1);
    const canonical = RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_READ_CANONICAL_20260819_(sh, start, count, layout);
    scanned += count;
    for (let r = 0; r < canonical.length; r++) {
      const cust = RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(canonical[r][0]);
      if (cust && customers[cust]) out.push(canonical[r]);
    }
  }
  RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('relationFullScanRows', scanned);
  return { rows: out, scannedRows: scanned, lookupMode: 'FULL_SCAN_FALLBACK', candidateRowRefs: out.length };
}

/** Target exact IDs in a normal tabular DB column and read only merged blocks. */
function RSC_PERF5_READ_TABULAR_CANDIDATES_20260819_(sh, idCol, firstDataRow, lastRow, neededIds, minCol, width, valueMode) {
  const finderResult = RSC_PERF5_FIND_ROWS_20260819_(sh, idCol, firstDataRow, lastRow, neededIds, { compactJson: false });
  if (!finderResult) return null;
  const rows = RSC_PERF5_READ_BLOCKS_20260819_(sh, finderResult.rows, minCol, width, valueMode || 'DISPLAY');
  return { rows: rows, lookupMode: finderResult.mode, candidateRowRefs: finderResult.rows.length, finderCalls: finderResult.finderCalls };
}

/* ============================================================================
 * PERF23 — DIRECT RAW DB TARGETED READER
 * - Generated _rsc_* lookup sheets are OPTIONAL only.
 * - Primary source remains the canonical raw tabs in workbook 1ps...
 * - Large need sets are split into TextFinder-safe chunks; no full-table scan
 *   is allowed merely because > textFinderMaxIds are requested.
 * - Candidate reduction is followed by exact in-memory matching.
 * ========================================================================== */
const RSC_PERF23_DIRECT_RAW_DB_20260819 = {
  version: 'PERF23_DIRECT_RAW_DB_20260819',
  tabularChunkIds: 650,
  relationChunkIds: 350,
  finderRetryDepth: 5,
  finderRetrySleepMs: 180,
  allowGeneratedAccelerator: false
};

/* ============================================================================
 * PERF25 — DB CONTENTION / RETRY SEMANTICS
 * - Bulk DB contention is scheduler backpressure, NOT a validation attempt.
 * - Worker waits only briefly for the serialized m_bp_relation reader and then
 *   defers the task without consuming Attempts.
 * - RETRY rows can carry a future Lease Until as not-before/backoff time.
 * - Active/manual validation keeps the longer wait semantics.
 * ========================================================================== */
const RSC_PERF25_DB_CONTENTION_20260819 = {
  version: 'PERF25_DB_CONTENTION_PARITY_FIX_20260819',
  bulkDbWaitMs: 6500,
  dbRetryBackoffMs: 20000,
  dbRetryLaneSpreadMs: 2500
};

function RSC_PERF25_IS_DB_CONTENTION_ERROR_20260819_(err){
  const msg=String(err&&err.message?err.message:err||'');
  return msg.indexOf('[PERF19 DB BUSY]')!==-1 || msg.indexOf('[PERF25 DB DEFERRED]')!==-1;
}

function RSC_PERF25_DB_RETRY_DELAY_MS_20260819_(lane){
  const C=RSC_PERF25_DB_CONTENTION_20260819;
  const n=Math.max(1,Math.min(4,Number(lane||1)));
  return Number(C.dbRetryBackoffMs||20000)+(n-1)*Number(C.dbRetryLaneSpreadMs||2500);
}

function RSC_PERF23_MAP_FROM_KEYS_20260819_(keys) {
  const out=Object.create(null);
  (keys||[]).forEach(function(k){ if(k) out[String(k)]=true; });
  return out;
}

function RSC_PERF23_FIND_ROWS_CHUNKED_20260819_(sh,col,firstRow,lastRow,neededIds,options){
  options=options||{};
  const all=Object.keys(neededIds||{});
  if(!all.length)return{rows:[],mode:'EMPTY',finderCalls:0,chunks:0};
  const chunkSize=Math.max(20,Number(options.chunkSize||RSC_PERF23_DIRECT_RAW_DB_20260819.tabularChunkIds));
  const rowSet=Object.create(null);
  let finderCalls=0,chunks=0;

  function runKeys_(keys,depth){
    if(!keys.length)return;
    const map=RSC_PERF23_MAP_FROM_KEYS_20260819_(keys);
    const r=RSC_PERF5_FIND_ROWS_20260819_(
      sh,col,firstRow,lastRow,map,
      {compactJson:Boolean(options.compactJson),maxIds:Math.max(keys.length,chunkSize)}
    );
    if(r){
      (r.rows||[]).forEach(function(row){rowSet[Number(row)]=true;});
      finderCalls+=Number(r.finderCalls||0);chunks++;
      return;
    }
    // Service failure: split recursively instead of switching to a full scan.
    if(keys.length>1 && depth<Number(RSC_PERF23_DIRECT_RAW_DB_20260819.finderRetryDepth||5)){
      const mid=Math.ceil(keys.length/2);
      Utilities.sleep(Number(RSC_PERF23_DIRECT_RAW_DB_20260819.finderRetrySleepMs||180));
      runKeys_(keys.slice(0,mid),depth+1);
      runKeys_(keys.slice(mid),depth+1);
      return;
    }
    throw new Error(
      '[PERF23 TARGETED DB LOOKUP FAILED] TextFinder tidak dapat menyelesaikan targeted lookup pada sheet '+
      String(sh&&sh.getName?sh.getName():'[unknown]')+
      '. Tidak dilakukan full scan untuk mencegah Spreadsheet service timeout.'
    );
  }

  for(let start=0;start<all.length;start+=chunkSize){
    runKeys_(all.slice(start,start+chunkSize),0);
  }
  return{
    rows:Object.keys(rowSet).map(Number).filter(function(n){return n>0;}).sort(function(a,b){return a-b;}),
    mode:'TEXTFINDER_CHUNKED_EXACT',
    finderCalls:finderCalls,
    chunks:chunks
  };
}

function RSC_PERF23_READ_TABULAR_CANDIDATES_20260819_(sh,idCol,firstDataRow,lastRow,neededIds,minCol,width,valueMode){
  const finder=RSC_PERF23_FIND_ROWS_CHUNKED_20260819_(
    sh,idCol,firstDataRow,lastRow,neededIds,
    {compactJson:false,chunkSize:RSC_PERF23_DIRECT_RAW_DB_20260819.tabularChunkIds}
  );
  const rows=RSC_PERF5_READ_BLOCKS_20260819_(sh,finder.rows,minCol,width,valueMode||'DISPLAY');
  return{rows:rows,lookupMode:finder.mode,candidateRowRefs:finder.rows.length,finderCalls:finder.finderCalls,chunks:finder.chunks};
}

function RSC_PERF23_READ_RELATION_CANDIDATES_20260819_(sh,layout,neededCustomers){
  layout=layout||RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_GET_LAYOUT_20260819_(sh);
  const firstDataRow=layout.firstDataRow||(layout.headerRow+1),lastRow=sh.getLastRow();
  if(lastRow<firstDataRow||!Object.keys(neededCustomers||{}).length)
    return{rows:[],scannedRows:0,lookupMode:'EMPTY',candidateRowRefs:0,finderCalls:0};

  const idCol=layout.mode==='COMPACT_JSON'?layout.payloadCol:layout.cA;
  const finder=RSC_PERF23_FIND_ROWS_CHUNKED_20260819_(
    sh,idCol,firstDataRow,lastRow,neededCustomers,
    {compactJson:layout.mode==='COMPACT_JSON',chunkSize:RSC_PERF23_DIRECT_RAW_DB_20260819.relationChunkIds}
  );
  const blocks=RSC_PERF5_MERGE_ROWS_TO_BLOCKS_20260819_(finder.rows);
  const accepted=[],wanted=neededCustomers||Object.create(null);
  let physicalRowsRead=0;
  for(let i=0;i<blocks.length;i++){
    const b=blocks[i],canonical=RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_READ_CANONICAL_20260819_(sh,b.start,b.count,layout);
    physicalRowsRead+=b.count;
    for(let r=0;r<canonical.length;r++){
      const cust=RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(canonical[r][0]);
      if(cust&&wanted[cust])accepted.push(canonical[r]);
    }
  }
  return{
    rows:accepted,
    scannedRows:physicalRowsRead,
    lookupMode:'TEXTFINDER_CHUNKED_RELATION',
    candidateRowRefs:finder.rows.length,
    finderCalls:finder.finderCalls,
    chunks:finder.chunks
  };
}


function RSC_PERF5_ROLLING_SNAPSHOT_KEY_20260819_(sh) {
  if (!sh) return '';
  const ss = sh.getParent ? sh.getParent() : null;
  return String(ss && ss.getId ? ss.getId() : '') + '||' + String(sh.getSheetId ? sh.getSheetId() : sh.getName());
}

function RSC_PERF5_STORE_ROLLING_SNAPSHOT_20260819_(sh, snapshot) {
  const key = RSC_PERF5_ROLLING_SNAPSHOT_KEY_20260819_(sh);
  if (key && snapshot) __RSC_PERF5_ROLLING_SNAPSHOT_CACHE_20260819__[key] = snapshot;
  return snapshot;
}

function RSC_PERF5_TAKE_ROLLING_SNAPSHOT_20260819_(sh) {
  const key = RSC_PERF5_ROLLING_SNAPSHOT_KEY_20260819_(sh);
  if (!key || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(__RSC_PERF5_ROLLING_SNAPSHOT_CACHE_20260819__, key)) return null;
  const snapshot = __RSC_PERF5_ROLLING_SNAPSHOT_CACHE_20260819__[key];
  delete __RSC_PERF5_ROLLING_SNAPSHOT_CACHE_20260819__[key];
  RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('workerSnapshotReuse', 1);
  return snapshot;
}

function RSC_PERF5_NEW_UNION_NEEDS_20260819_() {
  return {
    neededBpIds:Object.create(null),neededSalesmanIds:Object.create(null),neededTriple:Object.create(null),
    neededCustomer:Object.create(null),neededR8:Object.create(null),neededPair:Object.create(null),neededMvsKeys:Object.create(null),
    needsTokoMvs:false,needsRelationshipMaster:false
  };
}

function RSC_PERF5_MERGE_SNAPSHOT_NEEDS_20260819_(union, snapshot) {
  if (!union || !snapshot) return union;
  ['neededBpIds','neededSalesmanIds','neededTriple','neededCustomer','neededR8','neededPair','neededMvsKeys'].forEach(function (name) {
    Object.keys(snapshot[name] || {}).forEach(function (k) { union[name][k] = true; });
  });
  union.needsTokoMvs = Boolean(union.needsTokoMvs || snapshot.needsTokoMvs);
  union.needsRelationshipMaster = Boolean(union.needsRelationshipMaster || snapshot.needsRelationshipMaster);
  return union;
}

/**
 * Validate-All worker prefetch. Builds each Rolling snapshot only once, unions
 * all master needs across the claim batch, and warms shared DB caches in one
 * batch before per-file validation. Falls back automatically for large bundles.
 */
function RSC_PERF5_PREFETCH_WORKER_BUNDLE_20260819_(tasks) {
  const C=RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819, list=tasks||[];
  if(!list.length||list.length>Number(C.workerPrefetchMaxFiles||4))return{enabled:false,reason:'FILE_LIMIT'};
  const opened=[],P0=VALIDATE_ALL_FINAL_LINKS_PARAMETERS;let totalRows=0,totalCells=0;
  for(let i=0;i<list.length;i++){
    const task=list[i];if(!task||!task.fileId)continue;
    try{
      const ss=RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(task.fileId),lookup=buildValidationSheetLookup_(ss),rolling=getOptionalValidationSheet_(ss,P0.rollingSheetName,/rolling/i,lookup);
      if(!rolling)continue;
      const last=RSC_GET_FSD_LAST_DATA_ROW_20260807_(rolling),rows=Math.max(0,last-RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807.firstDataRow+1),cells=rows*Number(RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807.columns.reason||14);
      totalRows+=rows;totalCells+=cells;opened.push({ss:ss,sh:rolling,rows:rows});
    }catch(err){RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('workerPrefetchOpenSkip',1);}
  }
  if(totalRows>Number(C.workerPrefetchMaxRows||12000)||totalCells>Number(C.workerPrefetchMaxCells||180000)){
    RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('workerPrefetchSizeFallback',1);return{enabled:false,reason:'SIZE_LIMIT',totalRows:totalRows,totalCells:totalCells};
  }
  const union=RSC_PERF5_NEW_UNION_NEEDS_20260819_();let snapshots=0,masterPrefetchError='';
  for(let i=0;i<opened.length;i++){
    try{
      const snap=RSC_V28_3_CREATE_ROLLING_SNAPSHOT_20260814_(opened[i].sh);
      RSC_PERF5_STORE_ROLLING_SNAPSHOT_20260819_(opened[i].sh,snap);RSC_PERF5_MERGE_SNAPSHOT_NEEDS_20260819_(union,snap);snapshots++;
    }catch(err){RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('workerPrefetchSnapshotSkip',1);}
  }
  if(snapshots){
    try{
      // Only global DB-backed masters are union-prefetched here. Employee/relationship
      // masters remain file-context aware and are resolved during each workbook run.
      // PERF25: relation is the only serialized/heavy raw master. Resolve it
      // first so a busy relation reader defers early instead of wasting BP/MVS work.
      RSC_STD_LOAD_RELATION_CONTEXT_20260814_(union.neededTriple,union.neededCustomer,union.neededR8,union.neededPair);
      RSC_LOAD_FSD_BP_MASTER_SUBSET_20260807_(union.neededBpIds,union.neededSalesmanIds);
      RSC_STD_LOAD_ACTIVE_SALESMAN_SUBSET_20260814_(union.neededSalesmanIds);
      if(union.needsTokoMvs)RSC_MVS_getIndexSubset_20260819_(union.neededMvsKeys);
      RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('workerUnionMasterPrefetch',1);
    }catch(err){masterPrefetchError=String(err&&err.message?err.message:err);console.warn('[PERF5] union master prefetch fallback: '+masterPrefetchError);RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('workerUnionMasterPrefetchError',1);}
  }
  RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('workerPrefetchedFiles',snapshots);RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('workerPrefetchedRows',totalRows);
  return{enabled:Boolean(snapshots),files:snapshots,totalRows:totalRows,totalCells:totalCells,
    uniqueBp:Object.keys(union.neededBpIds).length,uniqueSalesman:Object.keys(union.neededSalesmanIds).length,
    uniqueTriple:Object.keys(union.neededTriple).length,uniquePair:Object.keys(union.neededPair).length,uniqueMvs:Object.keys(union.neededMvsKeys).length,
    masterPrefetchError:masterPrefetchError};
}

  RSC_PERF5_RESET_STATS_20260819_();
  const snapshot=RSC_V28_3_CREATE_ROLLING_SNAPSHOT_20260814_(sh);
  const masterStart=Date.now(),masters=runWithTargetSpreadsheetContext_(ss,function(){return RSC_V28_3_LOAD_ROLLING_MASTERS_20260814_(snapshot);});
  const result={
    sheet:sh.getName(),rows:snapshot.records.length,dataRows:Object.keys(snapshot.rowHasData||{}).length,

  };

}

    ['S000005804', 'S000005804'],
    ['S0000M5BE0', 'S0000M5BE0'],

  for (let i = 0; i < cases.length; i++) {
    const got = RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(cases[i][0]);

      throw new Error('PERF7 core normalizer failed: input=' + cases[i][0] + ', got=' + got + ', expected=' + cases[i][1]);

  if (normalizeValidateDateId_('S091150001') !== 'S091150001') {

/**
 * Diagnostic manual untuk mengecek satu Spreadsheet ID yang error.
 * Jalankan dari Apps Script editor, lalu masukkan ID ketika diminta.
 * FIX4 2026-08-19 LOGIC CORRECTIONS:
 * - S* Customer + S* Salesman => Visit Category/Type/Schedule/Visit Valid dates are optional,
 *   including Toko Bangkrut m_visit_schedule checks.
 * - PERF6 Case 1 requires exact Customer+Relationship+Salesman+Valid To in m_bp_relation.
 * - PERF6 Case 2 allows blank Relationship and resolves by Customer+Salesman pair.
 * - Case 2 never backfills relation Valid From; Visit Valid From may follow Rolling date.
 * - Template Revamp blanks Relationship/Valid From/Valid To, writes Change Schedule Only=x,
 *   then distincts by visit-schedule identity.
 *
 */
function RSC_DIAGNOSE_SPREADSHEET_ACCESS_20260814() {
  const ui = SpreadsheetApp.getUi();
  const res = ui.prompt(
    'Diagnose Spreadsheet Access',
    'Masukkan Spreadsheet ID yang gagal diakses:',
    ui.ButtonSet.OK_CANCEL
  );
  if (res.getSelectedButton() !== ui.Button.OK) return;

  const id = String(res.getResponseText() || '').trim();
  if (!id) {
    ui.alert('Spreadsheet ID kosong.');
    return;
  }

  try {
    const ss = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(id);
    ui.alert(
      'ACCESS OK',
      'Nama file: ' + ss.getName() + '\nID: ' + ss.getId() + '\nURL: ' + ss.getUrl(),
      ui.ButtonSet.OK
    );
  } catch (err) {
    ui.alert(
      'ACCESS ERROR',
      String(err && err.message ? err.message : err),
      ui.ButtonSet.OK
    );
  }
}

const COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS = {

/* ============================================================
 * VALIDATE DATE IN TEMPLATE - m_bp_relation DATABASE
 * Integrasi dari add-on 20260619.
 *
 * Target:
 * - Baca semua link file FINAL di kolom E master.
 * - Buka sheet "Change Rolling & Change Schedule".
 * - Cari header secara dinamis:
 *   Customer ID, Relationship, Salesman ID,
 *   Valid From, Valid To, Visit Valid From, Visit Valid To, Reason.
 * - Cocokkan ke DB m_bp_relation:
 *   Customer ID + Relationship + Salesman ID
 *   = bp_id_rlt1 + relationship_cat_id + bp_id_rlt2.
 *
 * CASE:
 * A. Reason = Rolling (authoritative PERF11):
 *    Valid From = dateNew hardcoded, TIDAK boleh ditarik dari histori DB.
 *    Visit Valid From = dateNew.
 *    Exception PAIR_NO_RELATION: relation fields (termasuk Valid From) tetap AS IS/blank,
 *    hanya Visit Valid From = dateNew.
 * B. Exact DB relation masih dipakai untuk deteksi Change Schedule Only / R8 suppression,
 *    tetapi bukan sebagai sumber Valid From untuk Reason = Rolling.
 * C. Reason = Toko Bangkrut:
 *    Valid From = exact/fallback m_bp_relation
 *    Visit Valid From tetap AS IS dan divalidasi ke m_visit_schedule
 *    Valid To & Visit Valid To = dateClose
 * ========================================================== */
const M_BP_RELATION_DB_PARAMETERS = {
  spreadsheetId: '1psDMLLr98FuHjKhhfBTwg8p0kBA3w26xrdXb6_tu7CU',
  sheetName: 'm_bp_relation',
  sheetGid: 1379118174,
  compactPayloadHeader: 'relation_payload',
  colBpIdRlt1: 'bp_id_rlt1',
  colRelationshipCatId: 'relationship_cat_id',
  colBpIdRlt2: 'bp_id_rlt2',
  colValidFrom: 'valid_from',
  colValidTo: 'valid_to',
  readChunkRows: 100000
};


/***************************************************************
 * m_bp_relation COMPACT READER V1 — 2026-08-19
 *
 * Mendukung 2 format secara otomatis:
 * 1) COMPACT (baru): 1 cell per row, header = relation_payload
 *    contoh: ["110625404","ZWS014","S091110370","2026-03-01","2026-04-30"]
 * 2) LEGACY: 5 kolom bp_id_rlt1, relationship_cat_id, bp_id_rlt2,
 *    valid_from, valid_to.
 *
 * Semua consumer menerima canonical row:
 * [0] bp_id_rlt1
 * [1] relationship_cat_id
 * [2] bp_id_rlt2
 * [3] valid_from
 * [4] valid_to
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_MBP_RELATION_GET_LAYOUT_20260819_(sh) {
  if (!sh) throw new Error('m_bp_relation sheet null.');

  const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  const lastCol = Math.max(1, sh.getLastColumn());

  if (lastRow < 1) {
    return {
      mode: 'EMPTY',
      headerRow: 0,
      firstDataRow: 1,
      payloadCol: 1
    };
  }

  const scanRows = Math.min(5, lastRow);
  const scanCols = Math.min(200, lastCol);
  const grid = sh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, scanCols).getDisplayValues();

  /*
   * ==========================================================
   * 1. COMPACT WITH HEADER
   *
   * relation_payload
   * ["110625404","ZWS014","S091110370","2026-03-01","2026-04-30"]
   * ==========================================================
   */
  for (let r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    const payloadCol = findValidateDateCol_(grid[r], ['relation_payload']);
    if (payloadCol) {
      return {
        mode: 'COMPACT_JSON',
        headerRow: r + 1,
        firstDataRow: r + 2,
        payloadCol: payloadCol,
        hasHeader: true
      };
    }
  }

  /*
   * ==========================================================
   * 2. HEADERLESS COMPACT JSON
   *
   * Row 1 langsung:
   * ["110625404","ZWS014","S091110370","2026-03-01","2026-04-30"]
   *
   * Format ini sama dengan contoh aktual user.
   * Cari JSON array pertama pada 5 baris awal dan jangan skip row tersebut.
   * ==========================================================
   */
  for (let r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < grid[r].length; c++) {
      const raw = String(grid[r][c] == null ? '' : grid[r][c]).trim();
      if (!raw || raw.charAt(0) !== '[') continue;

      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length >= 5) {
          return {
            mode: 'COMPACT_JSON',
            headerRow: 0,
            firstDataRow: r + 1,
            payloadCol: c + 1,
            hasHeader: false
          };
        }
      } catch (ignoreJsonProbe) {
        // Bukan payload JSON valid; lanjut scan.
      }
    }
  }

  /*
   * ==========================================================
   * 3. LEGACY 5 COLUMNS
   * ==========================================================
   */
  for (let r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    const cA = findValidateDateCol_(grid[r], ['bp_id_rlt1']);
    const cB = findValidateDateCol_(grid[r], ['relationship_cat_id']);
    const cC = findValidateDateCol_(grid[r], ['bp_id_rlt2']);
    const cD = findValidateDateCol_(grid[r], ['valid_from', 'Valid From']);
    const cE = findValidateDateCol_(grid[r], ['valid_to', 'Valid To']);

    if (cA && cB && cC && cD) {
      return {
        mode: 'LEGACY_COLUMNS',
        headerRow: r + 1,
        firstDataRow: r + 2,
        cA: cA,
        cB: cB,
        cC: cC,
        cD: cD,
        cE: cE || 0,
        hasHeader: true
      };
    }
  }

  throw new Error(
    'Format m_bp_relation tidak dikenali. ' +
    'Gunakan compact JSON 1-cell per row (header relation_payload opsional) ' +
    'atau legacy 5 kolom.'
  );
}

var RSC_MBP_RELATION_INVALID_WARN_COUNT_20260819_ = 0;
var RSC_MBP_RELATION_INVALID_WARN_LIMIT_20260819_ = 20;

function RSC_MBP_RELATION_WARN_SKIP_20260819_(sheetRow, reason, raw) {
  if (RSC_MBP_RELATION_INVALID_WARN_COUNT_20260819_ >= RSC_MBP_RELATION_INVALID_WARN_LIMIT_20260819_) return;
  RSC_MBP_RELATION_INVALID_WARN_COUNT_20260819_++;
  const preview = String(raw == null ? '' : raw).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 240);
  console.warn(
    '[m_bp_relation] Skip row ' + sheetRow + ': ' + reason +
    (preview ? ' | value=' + preview : '')
  );
}

function RSC_MBP_RELATION_PARSE_PAYLOAD_20260819_(value, sheetRow) {
  const raw = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();

  // Blank / marker / repeated header bukan record relation.
  if (!raw) return null;
  if (raw === '__UPDATING__' || raw.toLowerCase() === 'relation_payload') {
    RSC_MBP_RELATION_WARN_SKIP_20260819_(sheetRow, 'marker/header, bukan data relation', raw);
    return null;
  }

  let arr;
  try {
    arr = JSON.parse(raw);

    // Toleransi payload yang tidak sengaja double-encoded, contoh:
    // "[\"110625404\",\"ZWS014\",... ]"
    if (typeof arr === 'string') {
      const nested = arr.trim();
      if (nested.charAt(0) === '[') {
        arr = JSON.parse(nested);
      }
    }

    // Toleransi object wrapper {relation_payload:[...]} / {relation_payload:"[...]"}.
    if (arr && !Array.isArray(arr) && typeof arr === 'object' &&
        Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(arr, 'relation_payload')) {
      arr = arr.relation_payload;
      if (typeof arr === 'string') arr = JSON.parse(arr);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    RSC_MBP_RELATION_WARN_SKIP_20260819_(
      sheetRow,
      'JSON tidak valid: ' + String(err && err.message ? err.message : err),
      raw
    );
    return null;
  }

  // Standard V28.3 hanya membutuhkan record array 5 elemen.
  // Record non-array / array pendek dilewati; satu row anomali tidak boleh
  // menggagalkan scan ratusan ribu record m_bp_relation yang valid.
  if (!Array.isArray(arr) || arr.length < 5) {
    RSC_MBP_RELATION_WARN_SKIP_20260819_(
      sheetRow,
      'bukan JSON array minimal 5 elemen',
      raw
    );
    return null;
  }

  return [
    arr[0] == null ? '' : String(arr[0]).trim(),
    arr[1] == null ? '' : String(arr[1]).trim(),
    arr[2] == null ? '' : String(arr[2]).trim(),
    arr[3] == null ? '' : String(arr[3]).trim(),
    arr[4] == null || String(arr[4]).trim() === '' ? '9999-12-31' : String(arr[4]).trim()
  ];
}

function RSC_MBP_RELATION_READ_CANONICAL_20260819_(sh, startRow, count, layout) {
  layout = layout || RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_GET_LAYOUT_20260819_(sh);
  if (!count || count < 1) return [];

  if (layout.mode === 'COMPACT_JSON') {
    const vals = sh.getRange(startRow, layout.payloadCol, count, 1).getDisplayValues();
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
      const parsed = RSC_MBP_RELATION_PARSE_PAYLOAD_20260819_(vals[i][0], startRow + i);
      if (parsed) out.push(parsed);
    }
    return out;
  }

  if (layout.mode === 'LEGACY_COLUMNS') {
    const cols = [layout.cA, layout.cB, layout.cC, layout.cD];
    if (layout.cE) cols.push(layout.cE);
    const minCol = Math.min.apply(null, cols);
    const maxCol = Math.max.apply(null, cols);
    const width = maxCol - minCol + 1;
    const vals = sh.getRange(startRow, minCol, count, width).getDisplayValues();
    const out = new Array(vals.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
      const vt = layout.cE ? vals[i][layout.cE - minCol] : '';
      out[i] = [
        vals[i][layout.cA - minCol],
        vals[i][layout.cB - minCol],
        vals[i][layout.cC - minCol],
        vals[i][layout.cD - minCol],
        String(vt == null ? '' : vt).trim() || '9999-12-31'
      ];
    }
    return out;
  }

  return [];
}

function RSC_MBP_RELATION_CANONICAL_INDEX_20260819_(headerName) {
  const h = String(headerName == null ? '' : headerName).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '_');
  if (h === 'bp_id_rlt1') return 0;
  if (h === 'relationship_cat_id') return 1;
  if (h === 'bp_id_rlt2') return 2;
  if (h === 'valid_from') return 3;
  if (h === 'valid_to') return 4;
  return -1;
}


/**
 * Manual smoke test untuk memastikan Apps Script aktif membaca DB yang benar
 * dan format compact JSON berhasil diparse.
 * Jalankan dari editor Apps Script: RSC_TEST_MBP_RELATION_COMPACT_20260819_
 */
function RSC_TEST_MBP_RELATION_COMPACT_20260819_() {
  const p = M_BP_RELATION_DB_PARAMETERS;

  const expectedSpreadsheetId = '1psDMLLr98FuHjKhhfBTwg8p0kBA3w26xrdXb6_tu7CU';
  const expectedSheetGid = 1379118174;

  if (String(p.spreadsheetId) !== expectedSpreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error(
      'CONFIG SALAH: m_bp_relation masih menunjuk spreadsheet ' +
      String(p.spreadsheetId) +
      '. Expected ' + expectedSpreadsheetId + '.'
    );
  }

  const ss = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(p.spreadsheetId);
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName(p.sheetName);

  if (!sh) {
    throw new Error('Sheet DB "' + p.sheetName + '" tidak ditemukan.');
  }

  if (Number(sh.getSheetId()) !== Number(expectedSheetGid)) {
    throw new Error(
      'GID m_bp_relation tidak sesuai. Actual=' + sh.getSheetId() +
      ', expected=' + expectedSheetGid + '.'
    );
  }

  const layout = RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_GET_LAYOUT_20260819_(sh);
  const firstDataRow = layout.firstDataRow || (layout.headerRow + 1);
  const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  const count = Math.max(0, Math.min(10, lastRow - firstDataRow + 1));
  const rows = count > 0
    ? RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_READ_CANONICAL_20260819_(sh, firstDataRow, count, layout)
    : [];

  const result = {
    spreadsheetId: ss.getId(),
    spreadsheetName: ss.getName(),
    sheetName: sh.getName(),
    sheetGid: sh.getSheetId(),
    mode: layout.mode,
    hasHeader: layout.hasHeader === true,
    payloadCol: layout.payloadCol || 0,
    firstDataRow: firstDataRow,
    lastRow: lastRow,
    sampleRows: rows
  };

  Logger.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}

/* ============================================================
 * MAIN ONEDIT DISPATCHER
 * ========================================================== */

function onEdit(e) {
  if (typeof RSC_PERF13_IS_HARD_STOP_ACTIVE_20260819_ === 'function' && RSC_PERF13_IS_HARD_STOP_ACTIVE_20260819_()) return;
  // 1) Realtime frontend validation dari Template UI.
  runSafelyWithOptionalRethrow_('Template UI onEdit', function () {
    if (typeof handleTemplateUiEdit_ === 'function') handleTemplateUiEdit_(e);
  }, false);

  // 2) Link validation kolom D sengaja TIDAK dijalankan dari simple onEdit.
  //    Jalankan menu: Rolling Sales Center > 3) Validasi Link & BP Exist >
  //    Aktifkan Auto Validasi Link Kolom D.
  //    Alasannya: validasi link perlu akses openById(), sehingga lebih stabil
  //    memakai installable onEdit trigger.

  // 3) Summary realtime dibuat optional supaya paste besar tidak lambat.
  if (isCrSummaryRefreshOnEditEnabled_()) {
    runSafelyWithOptionalRethrow_('CR Summary onEdit', function () {
      if (typeof handleCrVisitScheduleSummaryEdit_ === 'function') handleCrVisitScheduleSummaryEdit_(e);
    }, false);
  }
}


/* ============================================================
 * FRIENDLY WRAPPERS
 * ========================================================== */

function installRecommendedRollingSalesCenterTriggers() {
  const notes = [];

  // Remove legacy validation schedulers so there is only one validation engine.
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([
    COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS.localValidationJobHandler,
    COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS.autoValidateOnEditHandler,
    COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS.autoValidateWorkerHandler,
    'RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SCHEDULED_20260813',
    'RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_CONTINUE_20260813'
  ]);
  try { PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().setProperty('RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_ENABLED_20260813', 'FALSE'); } catch (ignore) {}

  runSafelyWithOptionalRethrow_('Auto Standard V28.3 validation onEdit', function () {
    installAutoStandardValidationOnEditForThisSpreadsheet_();
    notes.push('Auto Standard V28.3 validation onEdit aktif (debounced).');
  }, true);

  runSafelyWithOptionalRethrow_('Auto validasi link kolom D', function () {
    installAutoValidationTriggerForInputRollingLinks();
    notes.push('Auto validasi link kolom D aktif.');
  }, true);

  notes.push('Active/Bulk/Hourly validation memakai Standard V28.3 yang sama.');
  notes.push('Hourly validation dipasang terpisah dari menu Hourly Validation — Setup.');

  const message = 'Setup basic triggers selesai.\n\n' + notes.join('\n');
  try { SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(message, 'Rolling Sales Center', 10); } catch (ignoreToast) {}
  try { SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(message); } catch (ignoreUi) { console.log(message); }
}


function runLocalTemplateValidationAndRefreshSummary() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const errors = [];

  [
    ['Setup CR Change Sheets', function () { setupRollingChangeSheetsOnly(); }],
    ['Validate Change Rolling', function () { validateChangeRollingSheet(); }],
    ['Validate Change Sales Office', function () { validateChangeSalesOfficeSheet(); }],
    ['Validate Change Salesman Type', function () { validateChangeSalesmanTypeSheet(); }],
    ['Generate CR Summary', function () { generateCRVisitScheduleSummary(); }]
  ].forEach(function (job) {
    try {
      job[1]();
    } catch (err) {
      errors.push(job[0] + ': ' + formatScriptError_(err));
    }
  });

  if (errors.length) {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
      'Sebagian proses selesai, tetapi ada error:\n\n' + errors.join('\n')
    );
  } else {
    ss.toast('Local validation + summary selesai.', 'Rolling Sales Center', 7);
  }
}


function enableCrSummaryRefreshOnEdit() {
  PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties()
    .setProperty(ROLLING_SALES_CENTER_PARAMETERS.propCRRealtime, 'TRUE');
  SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet()
    .toast('CR Summary refresh on edit AKTIF. Gunakan untuk file kecil/sedang.', 'Rolling Sales Center', 7);
}


function disableCrSummaryRefreshOnEdit() {
  PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties()
    .setProperty(ROLLING_SALES_CENTER_PARAMETERS.propCRRealtime, 'FALSE');
  SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet()
    .toast('CR Summary refresh on edit NONAKTIF. Gunakan hourly/manual refresh.', 'Rolling Sales Center', 7);
}


function isCrSummaryRefreshOnEditEnabled_() {
  return String(PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties()
    .getProperty(ROLLING_SALES_CENTER_PARAMETERS.propCRRealtime) || '').toUpperCase() === 'TRUE';
}


function handleCopyAwareOpenAutomation_(e) {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const currentId = ss.getId();
  const lastBootstrappedId = props.getProperty(COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS.pLastAutoBootstrappedSpreadsheetId);
  const isFirstOpenForThisSpreadsheet = String(lastBootstrappedId || '') !== String(currentId);

  props.setProperty(ROLLING_SALES_CENTER_PARAMETERS.propSsId, currentId);

  if (COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS.enableCrSummaryRefreshOnEditOnFirstOpen && isFirstOpenForThisSpreadsheet) {
    props.setProperty(ROLLING_SALES_CENTER_PARAMETERS.propCRRealtime, 'TRUE');
  }

  if (COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS.removeAllProtectionsOnEveryOpen ||
      (COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS.removeAllProtectionsOnFirstOpenOfEachSpreadsheet && isFirstOpenForThisSpreadsheet)) {
    runSafelyWithOptionalRethrow_('Auto remove protections after Make a copy', function () {
      removeAllProtectionsInCurrentSpreadsheetNoUi_('ON_OPEN_COPY_AWARE');
    }, false);
  }

  if (COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS.runLocalValidationOnFirstOpenOfEachSpreadsheet && isFirstOpenForThisSpreadsheet) {
    runSafelyWithOptionalRethrow_('Auto local validation after Make a copy', function () {
      runCopyAwareLocalValidationNoUi_('ON_OPEN_FIRST_RUN');
      props.setProperty(COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS.pLastLocalValidationAt, new Date().toISOString());
    }, false);
  }

  props.setProperty(COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS.pLastAutoBootstrappedSpreadsheetId, currentId);

  if (COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS.tryInstallAuthorizedJobsOnOpen && isFirstOpenForThisSpreadsheet) {
    tryActivateAuthorizedJobsForThisCopy_(false);
  }
}


function activateCopyAwareAutomationForThisSpreadsheet() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.setProperty(ROLLING_SALES_CENTER_PARAMETERS.propSsId, ss.getId());

  removeAllProtectionsInCurrentSpreadsheetNoUi_('MANUAL_ACTIVATE');
  if (COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS.enableCrSummaryRefreshOnEditOnFirstOpen) {
    props.setProperty(ROLLING_SALES_CENTER_PARAMETERS.propCRRealtime, 'TRUE');
  }

  runCopyAwareLocalValidationNoUi_('MANUAL_ACTIVATE');
  tryActivateAuthorizedJobsForThisCopy_(true);

  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
    'Copy-aware automation sudah diaktifkan untuk file ini.\n\n' +
    'Yang aktif otomatis:\n' +
    '1. Semua sheet/range protection di file copy sudah dibersihkan jika owner bisa edit.\n' +
    '2. Local validation saat onEdit.\n' +
    '3. Validasi lokal berkala/job setiap ' +
      COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS.localValidationJobEveryHours + ' jam.\n' +
    '4. Auto validasi link kolom D.\n' +
    '5. Auto refresh CR Summary hourly.\n\n' +
    'Jika baru pertama kali, Google mungkin sudah meminta authorization.'
  );
}


function tryActivateAuthorizedJobsForThisCopy_(showToastOnSuccess) {
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  try {
    installAuthorizedJobsForThisCopyNoUi_();
    props.setProperty(COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS.pAuthorizedJobsStatus, 'ACTIVE');
    if (showToastOnSuccess) {
      SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
        'Authorized jobs aktif untuk copy ini.',
        'Rolling Sales Center',
        6
      );
    }
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    props.setProperty(COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS.pAuthorizedJobsStatus, 'NEEDS_MANUAL_ACTIVATION: ' + formatScriptError_(err));
    try {
      SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
        'Local validation aktif. Untuk job otomatis, klik menu: 🚀 Rolling Sales Center → 🔐 Activate Jobs for This Copy.',
        'Authorization needed',
        10
      );
    } catch (e) {}
    writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('Copy-aware authorized job activation failed: ' + formatScriptError_(err));
    return false;
  }
}


function installAuthorizedJobsForThisCopyNoUi_() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().setProperty(ROLLING_SALES_CENTER_PARAMETERS.propSsId, ss.getId());

  if (COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS.autoValidateOnEdit) {
    installAutoStandardValidationOnEditForThisSpreadsheet_();
  }

  // Installable trigger untuk validasi link kolom D.
  installAutoValidationTriggerForInputRollingLinksNoUi_();

  // Hourly summary refresh.
  installCrVisitScheduleSummaryHourlyRefreshNoUi_();

  // Scheduled local validation job.
  if (COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS.installScheduledLocalValidationJob) {
    installScheduledLocalValidationJobForThisSpreadsheet_();
  }
}


function installAutoStandardValidationOnEditForThisSpreadsheet_() {
  const P = COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS;
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.autoValidateOnEditHandler, P.autoValidateWorkerHandler]);
  RSC_PERF13_NEW_TRIGGER_20260819_(P.autoValidateOnEditHandler)
    .forSpreadsheet(ss)
    .onEdit()
    .create();
  PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().setProperty(P.pAutoValidateQueued, 'FALSE');
}


function RSC_V28_2_IS_RELEVANT_VALIDATION_EDIT_20260814_(e) {
  if (!e || !e.range) return false;
  const sh = e.range.getSheet();
  const kind = detectActiveSheetValidationKind_(sh);
  if (kind === 'UNKNOWN') return false;
  const firstCol = e.range.getColumn();
  const lastCol = firstCol + e.range.getNumColumns() - 1;
  if (firstCol > 14 || lastCol < 1) return false;
  return e.range.getRow() + e.range.getNumRows() - 1 >= 2;
}


function RSC_V28_2_MARK_EDITED_ROWS_VALIDATING_20260814_(sh, startRow, endRow) {
  ensureValidationStatusColumns_(sh);
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const cStatus = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.validationStatusHeader]);
  const cDetail = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.errorDetailHeader]);
  if (!cStatus || !cDetail) return;
  startRow = Math.max(2, Number(startRow || 2));
  endRow = Math.max(startRow, Number(endRow || startRow));
  const n = endRow - startRow + 1;
  const status = new Array(n), detail = new Array(n), statusBg = new Array(n), detailBg = new Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    status[i] = ['VALIDATING'];
    detail[i] = ['Standard V28.3 otomatis dijalankan setelah edit selesai.'];
    statusBg[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.warning];
    detailBg[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.warning];
  }
  sh.getRange(startRow, cStatus, n, 1).setValues(status).setBackgrounds(statusBg);
  sh.getRange(startRow, cDetail, n, 1).setValues(detail).setBackgrounds(detailBg);
}


function authorizedStandardValidationOnEditV282_(e) {
  if (!RSC_V28_2_IS_RELEVANT_VALIDATION_EDIT_20260814_(e)) return;
  const P = COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const now = Date.now();
  props.setProperty(P.pAutoValidateLastEditAt, String(now));
  props.setProperty(P.pAutoValidateSheetId, String(e.range.getSheet().getSheetId()));
  props.setProperty(P.pAutoValidateQueued, 'TRUE');

  const startRow = Math.max(2, e.range.getRow());
  const endRow = Math.max(startRow, e.range.getRow() + e.range.getNumRows() - 1);
  RSC_V28_2_MARK_EDITED_ROWS_VALIDATING_20260814_(e.range.getSheet(), startRow, endRow);
  RSC_STD_ENSURE_ONE_TIME_TRIGGER_20260814_(P.autoValidateWorkerHandler, P.autoValidateDebounceMs);
}


function autoStandardValidationWorkerV282_() {
  const P = COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.autoValidateWorkerHandler]);
  if (String(props.getProperty(P.pAutoValidateQueued) || '').toUpperCase() !== 'TRUE') return {skipped:true};

  const lastEditAt = Number(props.getProperty(P.pAutoValidateLastEditAt) || 0);
  const age = Date.now() - lastEditAt;
  if (lastEditAt && age < P.autoValidateDebounceMs) {
    RSC_STD_ENSURE_ONE_TIME_TRIGGER_20260814_(P.autoValidateWorkerHandler, P.autoValidateDebounceMs - age + 500);
    return {deferred:true,ageMs:age};
  }

  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(1000)) {
    RSC_STD_ENSURE_ONE_TIME_TRIGGER_20260814_(P.autoValidateWorkerHandler, 2500);
    return {deferred:true,reason:'LOCK_BUSY'};
  }

  const startedAt = Date.now();
  try {
    const ssId = String(props.getProperty(ROLLING_SALES_CENTER_PARAMETERS.propSsId) || '');
    const ss = ssId ? RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(ssId) : SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    const wantedSheetId = String(props.getProperty(P.pAutoValidateSheetId) || '');
    let sh = null;
    ss.getSheets().some(function(x){if(String(x.getSheetId())===wantedSheetId){sh=x;return true;}return false;});
    if (!sh) sh = ss.getSheetByName(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetRolling);
    if (!sh) throw new Error('Sheet validation hasil edit tidak ditemukan.');

    const result = runWithTargetSpreadsheetContext_(ss,function(){
      if(typeof __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__!=='undefined') __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__=null;
      return RSC_STD_VALIDATE_ONE_SHEET_20260814_(ss,sh);
    });
    props.setProperty(P.pAutoValidateLastResult,JSON.stringify({
      at:new Date().toISOString(),sheet:sh.getName(),kind:result.kind||'',
      checkedRows:Number(result.checkedRows||0),errorRows:Number(result.errorRows||0),
      elapsedMs:Date.now()-startedAt,version:RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814.version
    }));

    const newestEditAt = Number(props.getProperty(P.pAutoValidateLastEditAt) || 0);
    if (newestEditAt > startedAt) {
      props.setProperty(P.pAutoValidateQueued,'TRUE');
      RSC_STD_ENSURE_ONE_TIME_TRIGGER_20260814_(P.autoValidateWorkerHandler,P.autoValidateDebounceMs);
    } else {
      props.setProperty(P.pAutoValidateQueued,'FALSE');
    }
    return result;
  } catch (err) {
    props.setProperty(P.pAutoValidateQueued,'TRUE');
    props.setProperty(P.pAutoValidateLastResult,JSON.stringify({at:new Date().toISOString(),error:formatScriptError_(err)}));
    RSC_STD_ENSURE_ONE_TIME_TRIGGER_20260814_(P.autoValidateWorkerHandler,15000);
    throw err;
  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (ignore) {}
  }
}

    'Sheet protection terhapus: ' + result.sheetProtectionsRemoved + '\n' +
    'Range protection terhapus: ' + result.rangeProtectionsRemoved + '\n' +
    'Protection dilewati/tidak bisa diedit: ' + result.skippedProtections + '\n' +
    'Error: ' + result.errors.length +
    (result.errors.length ? '\n\nDetail error:\n' + result.errors.slice(0, 10).join('\n') : '')

function removeAllProtectionsInCurrentSpreadsheetNoUi_(reason) {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const result = {
    sheetProtectionsRemoved: 0,
    rangeProtectionsRemoved: 0,
    skippedProtections: 0,
    errors: []
  };

  ss.getSheets().forEach(function (sheet) {
    [
      { type: SpreadsheetApp.ProtectionType.SHEET, label: 'sheet' },
      { type: SpreadsheetApp.ProtectionType.RANGE, label: 'range' }
    ].forEach(function (protectionGroup) {
      let protections = [];
      try {
        protections = sheet.getProtections(protectionGroup.type);
      } catch (err) {
        result.errors.push(sheet.getName() + ' get ' + protectionGroup.label + ': ' + formatScriptError_(err));
        return;
      }

      protections.forEach(function (protection) {
        try {
          if (typeof protection.canEdit === 'function' && !protection.canEdit()) {
            result.skippedProtections++;
            return;
          }
          protection.remove();
          if (protectionGroup.type === SpreadsheetApp.ProtectionType.SHEET) {
            result.sheetProtectionsRemoved++;
          } else {
            result.rangeProtectionsRemoved++;
          }
        } catch (err) {
          result.errors.push(sheet.getName() + ' remove ' + protectionGroup.label + ': ' + formatScriptError_(err));
        }
      });
    });
  });

  const msg = 'Remove protections [' + reason + '] | sheet=' + result.sheetProtectionsRemoved +
    ', range=' + result.rangeProtectionsRemoved +
    ', skipped=' + result.skippedProtections +
    ', errors=' + result.errors.length;
  writeRollingSalesCenterLog_(msg);
  try {
    ss.toast(msg, 'Rolling Sales Center', 8);
  } catch (err) {}

  return result;
}

}

/* ============================================================
 * BACKGROUND VERSION: SYNC SALESMAN BP TYPE FROM m_bp_general_view
 * ============================================================
 * Master:
 * - Ambil semua link Google Sheet dari kolom E.
 *
 * Target tiap file:
 * - Buka sheet "Change Rolling & Change Schedule".
 * - Ambil Salesman ID di kolom E / header "Salesman ID".
 * - Lookup ke database m_bp_general_view:
 *     m_bp_general_view.bp_id = Salesman ID.
 * - Jika ketemu, replace Salesman BP Type kolom F / header
 *   "Salesman BP Type" dengan m_bp_general_view.bp_type_id.
 *
 * Optimized:
 * - Database m_bp_general_view dibaca sekali per run dan dicache.
 * - Link master dibaca batch.
 * - Tiap target sheet dibaca/tulis batch per kolom.
 * - Background job memakai checkpoint row + trigger lanjutan.
 * ========================================================== */

function startSyncSalesmanBpTypeFromFinalLinksInBackground() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const sh = ss.getActiveSheet();
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const P = SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_SYNC_PARAMETERS;

  props.setProperty(P.pSsId, ss.getId());
  props.setProperty(P.pSheetId, String(sh.getSheetId()));
  if (!props.getProperty(P.pHintRow)) {
    props.setProperty(P.pHintRow, String(resolveFirstDataRowForSalesmanBpTypeSync_(sh)));
  }

  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);
  continueSyncSalesmanBpTypeFromFinalLinksInBackground();
}

function continueSyncSalesmanBpTypeFromFinalLinksInBackground() {
  const started = Date.now();
  const P = SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_SYNC_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(1000)) {
    writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('Sync Salesman BP Type: proses lain sedang berjalan. Skip.');
    return;
  }

  try {
    const ss = getStoredSpreadsheetFromProperties_(P.pSsId);
    const sh = getStoredSheetFromProperties_(ss, P.pSheetId);
    const firstDataRow = resolveFirstDataRowForSalesmanBpTypeSync_(sh);
    const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();

    if (lastRow < firstDataRow) {
      finishSyncSalesmanBpTypeJob_('Tidak ada link FINAL di kolom E.');
      return;
    }

    let cursor = Number(props.getProperty(P.pHintRow) || firstDataRow);
    if (cursor < firstDataRow) cursor = firstDataRow;
    if (cursor > lastRow) {
      finishSyncSalesmanBpTypeJob_('Sync Salesman BP Type sudah SELESAI semua.');
      return;
    }

    const rowCount = lastRow - cursor + 1;
    const linkRange = sh.getRange(cursor, P.masterLinkCol, rowCount, 1);
    const displayValues = linkRange.getDisplayValues();
    const values = linkRange.getValues();
    const formulas = linkRange.getFormulas();
    const richTexts = linkRange.getRichTextValues();

    let chipMap = {};
    if (typeof getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_ === 'function') {
      try {
        chipMap = getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_(ss.getId(), sh.getName(), cursor, P.masterLinkCol, rowCount) || {};
      } catch (err) {
        writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('Sync Salesman BP Type: smart chip URL fallback. ' + formatScriptError_(err));
      }
    }

    const bpTypeByBpId = getSalesmanBpTypeIndexFromMbpGeneralView_();

    let fileOk = 0;
    let fileSkip = 0;
    let fileError = 0;
    let totalChecked = 0;
    let totalUpdated = 0;
    let totalNotFound = 0;
    let nextCursor = cursor;

    for (let i = 0; i < rowCount; i++) {
      const masterRow = cursor + i;

      if (Date.now() - started > P.softDeadlineMs || fileOk + fileError >= P.hardMaxFilesPerRun) {
        nextCursor = masterRow;
        props.setProperty(P.pHintRow, String(nextCursor));
        scheduleTimeDrivenTrigger_(P.fn, P.triggerDelayMs || ROLLING_SALES_CENTER_PARAMETERS.bgDelayMs);
        SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
          'Sync Salesman BP Type pause di row ' + nextCursor +
          '. File OK=' + fileOk + ', error=' + fileError +
          ', updated=' + totalUpdated + '. Lanjut otomatis.',
          'Rolling Sales Center',
          10
        );
        return;
      }

      nextCursor = masterRow + 1;

      const urlFromCell = getSpreadsheetUrlFromCellObject_({
        displayValue: displayValues[i][0],
        value: values[i][0],
        formula: formulas[i][0],
        richTextValue: richTexts[i][0]
      });
      const url = urlFromCell || chipMap[masterRow] || String(values[i][0] || displayValues[i][0] || '');
      const fileId = extractSpreadsheetIdForSalesmanBpTypeSync_(url);

      if (!fileId) {
        fileSkip++;
        continue;
      }

      try {
        const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(fileId);
        const targetSh = getSalesmanBpTypeSyncTargetSheet_(targetSs);
        if (!targetSh) {
          fileSkip++;
          sh.getRange(masterRow, P.masterLinkCol)
            .setBackground(P.colorSkip)
            .setNote('SKIP Sync Salesman BP Type: sheet target tidak ditemukan: ' + P.targetSheetName);
          continue;
        }

        const result = syncSalesmanBpTypeInOneTargetSheet_(targetSh, bpTypeByBpId);
        fileOk++;
        totalChecked += result.checked;
        totalUpdated += result.updated;
        totalNotFound += result.notFound;

        sh.getRange(masterRow, P.masterLinkCol)
          .setBackground(P.colorOk)
          .setNote('OK Sync Salesman BP Type. Checked=' + result.checked +
            ', Updated=' + result.updated +
            ', Not found=' + result.notFound +
            ', Blank=' + result.blank + '.');

      } catch (err) {
        fileError++;
        sh.getRange(masterRow, P.masterLinkCol)
          .setBackground(P.colorError)
          .setNote('ERROR Sync Salesman BP Type: ' + formatScriptError_(err));
        writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('Sync Salesman BP Type error row ' + masterRow + ': ' + formatScriptError_(err));
      }
    }

    props.setProperty(P.pHintRow, String(nextCursor));

    if (nextCursor <= lastRow) {
      scheduleTimeDrivenTrigger_(P.fn, P.triggerDelayMs || ROLLING_SALES_CENTER_PARAMETERS.bgDelayMs);
      SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
        'Sync Salesman BP Type batch selesai. File OK=' + fileOk +
        ', skip=' + fileSkip + ', error=' + fileError +
        ', updated=' + totalUpdated + '. Lanjut otomatis dari row ' + nextCursor + '.',
        'Rolling Sales Center',
        10
      );
      return;
    }

    finishSyncSalesmanBpTypeJob_(
      'Sync Salesman BP Type SELESAI. File OK=' + fileOk +
      ', skip=' + fileSkip +
      ', error=' + fileError +
      ', checked=' + totalChecked +
      ', updated=' + totalUpdated +
      ', not found=' + totalNotFound + '.'
    );
  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (err) {}
  }
}

function showSyncSalesmanBpTypeStatus() {
  const P = SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_SYNC_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const ss = getStoredSpreadsheetFromProperties_(P.pSsId);

    ' | done approx=' + done +

  SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(msg, 'Rolling Sales Center', 10);
}
