function resolveFirstDataRowForSalesmanBpTypeSync_(sh) {
  try {
    if (typeof findCopyControlHeader_ === 'function') {
      const h = findCopyControlHeader_(sh);
      if (h && h.headerRow) return h.headerRow + 1;
    }
  } catch (err) {}
  return SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_SYNC_PARAMETERS.firstDataRow;
}

function getSalesmanBpTypeIndexFromMbpGeneralView_() {
  if (__SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_SYNC_INDEX_CACHE__) return __SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_SYNC_INDEX_CACHE__;

  const P = SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_SYNC_PARAMETERS;
  const dbSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.dbSpreadsheetId);
  const dbSh = dbSs.getSheetByName(P.dbSheetName);
  if (!dbSh) throw new Error('Database sheet tidak ditemukan: ' + P.dbSheetName);

  const lastRow = dbSh.getLastRow();
  const lastCol = dbSh.getLastColumn();
  if (lastRow < 2 || lastCol < 1) {
    __SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_SYNC_INDEX_CACHE__ = Object.create(null);
    return __SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_SYNC_INDEX_CACHE__;
  }

  const headers = dbSh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0];
  const cBpId = findHeaderColumnInArrayForSalesmanBpTypeSync_(headers, [P.dbColBpId]);
  const cBpType = findHeaderColumnInArrayForSalesmanBpTypeSync_(headers, [P.dbColBpTypeId]);

  if (!cBpId) throw new Error('Database kolom tidak ditemukan: ' + P.dbColBpId);
  if (!cBpType) throw new Error('Database kolom tidak ditemukan: ' + P.dbColBpTypeId);

  const startCol = Math.min(cBpId, cBpType);
  const endCol = Math.max(cBpId, cBpType);
  const width = endCol - startCol + 1;

  // PATCH 2026-08-13:
  // Versi lama membaca ratusan ribu row sekaligus. Itu dapat gagal dengan
  // response-size / service timeout sehingga kolom F terlihat "kadang" tidak ter-replace.
  // Sekarang database dibaca per chunk dan map hanya menyimpan kandidat salesman.
  const maxCells = Math.max(width, Number(P.dbMaxCellsPerRead || 20000));
  const byCells = Math.max(1, Math.floor(maxCells / Math.max(1, width)));
  const chunkRows = Math.max(200, Math.min(Number(P.dbReadChunkRows || 5000), byCells));

  const map = Object.create(null);
  const duplicateConflict = Object.create(null);
  let scannedRows = 0;
  let acceptedRows = 0;

  for (let rowStart = 2; rowStart <= lastRow; rowStart += chunkRows) {
    const n = Math.min(chunkRows, lastRow - rowStart + 1);
    const rows = dbSh.getRange(rowStart, startCol, n, width).getDisplayValues();
    scannedRows += rows.length;

    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      const bpId = normalizeSalesmanBpTypeSyncId_(rows[i][cBpId - startCol]);
      const bpType = normalizeSalesmanBpTypeSyncBpType_(rows[i][cBpType - startCol]);
      if (!bpId || !bpType) continue;

      // Rolling FSD salesman ID memang memakai prefix S dan BP Type ZDnn.
      // Filter ini menurunkan memory map secara signifikan tanpa mengubah hasil valid salesman.
      if (bpId.charAt(0).toUpperCase() !== 'S') continue;
      if (P.preferSalesmanBpTypePrefix &&
          bpType.indexOf(String(P.preferSalesmanBpTypePrefix).toUpperCase()) !== 0) continue;

      acceptedRows++;

      if (!map[bpId]) {
        map[bpId] = bpType;
      } else if (map[bpId] !== bpType) {
        // Jangan silent overwrite nilai yang ambigu. Pertahankan nilai pertama yang
        // deterministik dan log ID conflict agar DB dapat dibersihkan.
        duplicateConflict[bpId] = (duplicateConflict[bpId] || [map[bpId]]);
        if (duplicateConflict[bpId].indexOf(bpType) === -1) duplicateConflict[bpId].push(bpType);
      }
    }
  }

  const conflictIds = Object.keys(duplicateConflict);
  if (conflictIds.length) {
    writeRollingSalesCenterLog_(
      'BP Type DB duplicate conflict=' + conflictIds.length +
      '. Contoh: ' + conflictIds.slice(0, 10).map(function (id) {
        return id + '=' + duplicateConflict[id].join('/');
      }).join(', ')
    );
  }

  writeRollingSalesCenterLog_(
    'BP Type DB index loaded chunk-safe. scanned=' + scannedRows +
    ', acceptedSalesman=' + acceptedRows +
    ', unique=' + Object.keys(map).length +
    ', conflicts=' + conflictIds.length + '.'
  );

  __SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_SYNC_INDEX_CACHE__ = map;
  return __SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_SYNC_INDEX_CACHE__;
}

function syncSalesmanBpTypeInOneTargetSheet_(targetSh, bpTypeByBpId) {
  const P = SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_SYNC_PARAMETERS;
  const sheetLastRow = targetSh.getLastRow();
  const lastCol = targetSh.getLastColumn();

  if (sheetLastRow < P.targetFirstDataRowFallback || lastCol < 1) {
    return { checked: 0, updated: 0, notFound: 0, blank: 0, chunks: 0 };
  }

  const meta = findSalesmanBpTypeTargetColumns_(targetSh);
  const firstDataRow = meta.firstDataRow;

  // PATCH 2026-08-13:
  // getLastRow() dapat terdorong jauh oleh O/P / helper output lama.
  // BP Type harus mengikuti data Salesman ID, jadi last-row dihitung authoritative
  // dari kolom Salesman ID agar write F tidak membengkak / timeout.
  let lastRow = firstDataRow - 1;
  try {
    const maxRows = Math.max(targetSh.getMaxRows(), firstDataRow);
    lastRow = targetSh.getRange(maxRows, meta.salesmanIdCol)
      .getNextDataCell(SpreadsheetApp.Direction.UP)
      .getRow();
  } catch (err) {
    lastRow = sheetLastRow;
  }

  if (lastRow < firstDataRow) {
    return { checked: 0, updated: 0, notFound: 0, blank: 0, chunks: 0 };
  }

  const chunkRows = 2000;
  let checked = 0;
  let updated = 0;
  let notFound = 0;
  let blank = 0;
  let chunks = 0;

  for (let startRow = firstDataRow; startRow <= lastRow; startRow += chunkRows) {
    const n = Math.min(chunkRows, lastRow - startRow + 1);
    const salesmanRange = targetSh.getRange(startRow, meta.salesmanIdCol, n, 1);
    const bpTypeRange = targetSh.getRange(startRow, meta.salesmanBpTypeCol, n, 1);

    const salesmanValues = salesmanRange.getDisplayValues();
    const currentBpTypeValues = bpTypeRange.getDisplayValues();
    const output = new Array(n);
    let chunkChanged = false;

    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const salesmanId = normalizeSalesmanBpTypeSyncId_(salesmanValues[i][0]);
      const currentRaw = currentBpTypeValues[i][0] || '';
      const currentBpType = normalizeSalesmanBpTypeSyncBpType_(currentRaw);

      if (!salesmanId) {
        blank++;
        output[i] = [currentRaw];
        continue;
      }

      checked++;
      const dbBpType = bpTypeByBpId[salesmanId];

      if (!dbBpType) {
        notFound++;
        output[i] = [currentRaw];
        continue;
      }

      output[i] = [dbBpType];
      if (currentBpType !== dbBpType) {
        updated++;
        chunkChanged = true;
      }
    }

    if (chunkChanged) {
      bpTypeRange.setNumberFormat('@');
      bpTypeRange.setValues(output);
    }
    chunks++;
  }

  if (updated > 0) SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  return { checked: checked, updated: updated, notFound: notFound, blank: blank, chunks: chunks };
}

function findSalesmanBpTypeTargetColumns_(targetSh) {
  const P = SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_SYNC_PARAMETERS;
  const lastRow = targetSh.getLastRow();
  const lastCol = targetSh.getLastColumn();
  const scanRows = Math.min(P.targetHeaderScanRows || 15, lastRow);

  if (scanRows > 0 && lastCol > 0) {
    const grid = targetSh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, lastCol).getDisplayValues();
    for (let r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
      const row = grid[r];
      const cSalesman = findHeaderColumnInArrayForSalesmanBpTypeSync_(row, ['Salesman ID', 'Salesman Id', 'SalesmanID']);
      const cBpType = findHeaderColumnInArrayForSalesmanBpTypeSync_(row, ['Salesman BP Type', 'Salesman BPType', 'BP Type']);
      if (cSalesman && cBpType) {
        return {
          headerRow: r + 1,
          firstDataRow: r + 2,
          salesmanIdCol: cSalesman,
          salesmanBpTypeCol: cBpType
        };
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    headerRow: 1,
    firstDataRow: P.targetFirstDataRowFallback,
    salesmanIdCol: P.targetSalesmanIdColFallback,
    salesmanBpTypeCol: P.targetSalesmanBpTypeColFallback
  };
}

function getSalesmanBpTypeSyncTargetSheet_(targetSs) {
  const wanted = SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_SYNC_PARAMETERS.targetSheetName;
  let sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(wanted);
  if (sh) return sh;

  sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(String(wanted).substring(0, 31));
  if (sh) return sh;

  const sheets = targetSs.getSheets();
  for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (/rolling/i.test(sheets[i].getName())) return sheets[i];
  }
  return null;
}

function findHeaderColumnInArrayForSalesmanBpTypeSync_(rowArray, names) {
  const wanted = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    wanted[normalizeSalesmanBpTypeSyncHeader_(names[i])] = true;
  }

  for (let c = 0; c < rowArray.length; c++) {
    const key = normalizeSalesmanBpTypeSyncHeader_(rowArray[c]);
    if (wanted[key]) return c + 1;
  }
  return 0;
}

function normalizeSalesmanBpTypeSyncHeader_(value) {
  return String(value == null ? '' : value)
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[\s_\-]+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}

function normalizeSalesmanBpTypeSyncId_(value) {
  let s = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
  if (!s) return '';

  // Terima bentuk dropdown/display seperti "S091170653 - Nama Salesman".
  s = s.split(' - ')[0].trim();
  s = s.split('|')[0].trim();
  s = s.replace(/\s+/g, '');

  if (/^\d+\.0+$/.test(s)) s = s.replace(/\.0+$/, '');
  if (/^\d+(\.\d+)?[eE]\+?\d+$/.test(s)) {
    const num = Number(s);
    if (isFinite(num)) s = String(Math.round(num));
  }

  return s.toUpperCase();
}

function normalizeSalesmanBpTypeSyncBpType_(value) {
  let s = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
  if (!s) return '';
  s = s.split(' - ')[0].trim();
  s = s.replace(/\s+/g, '');
  return s.toUpperCase();
}

function extractSpreadsheetIdForSalesmanBpTypeSync_(urlOrId) {
  const text = String(urlOrId == null ? '' : urlOrId).trim();
  if (!text) return '';

  let m = text.match(/\/spreadsheets\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);
  if (m) return m[1];

  m = text.match(/https?:\/\/docs\.google\.com\/spreadsheets\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/i);
  if (m) return m[1];

  if (/^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]{25,}$/.test(text) && text.indexOf('/') === -1) return text;
  return '';
}

function addLegacySalesmanBpTypeSyncMenuIfNeeded_() {
  try {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi()
      .createMenu('Sync Salesman BP Type')
      .addItem('Start / Lanjut Sync dari Kolom E', 'RSC_START_SYNC_SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_FROM_FINAL_LINKS_BG_20260622')
      .addItem('Status', 'RSC_SHOW_SYNC_SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_STATUS_20260622')
      .addItem('STOP', 'RSC_STOP_SYNC_SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_FROM_FINAL_LINKS_20260622')
      .addToUi();
  } catch (e) {}
}

/* ============================================================
 * BACKGROUND VERSION: FIX G & L WHEN REASON = ROLLING
 * ========================================================== */



function startFixRollingReasonDatesForFinalLinksInBackground() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const sh = ss.getActiveSheet();
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();

  props.setProperty(BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.pSsId, ss.getId());
  props.setProperty(BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.pSheetId, String(sh.getSheetId()));
  if (!props.getProperty(BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.pHintRow)) {
    props.setProperty(BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.pHintRow, String(BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.firstDataRow));
  }

  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.fn]);
  continueFixRollingReasonDatesForFinalLinksInBackground();
}


function continueFixRollingReasonDatesForFinalLinksInBackground() {
  const started = Date.now();
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(1000)) {
    writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('continueFixRollingReasonDatesForFinalLinksInBackground: proses lain sedang berjalan. Skip.');
    return;
  }

  try {
    const ss = getStoredSpreadsheetFromProperties_(BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.pSsId);
    const sh = getStoredSheetFromProperties_(ss, BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.pSheetId);
    const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();

    if (lastRow < BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.firstDataRow) {
      finishFixRollingReasonDatesJob_('Tidak ada data link di kolom E.');
      return;
    }

    let row = Number(props.getProperty(BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.pHintRow) || BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.firstDataRow);
    if (row < BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.firstDataRow) row = BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.firstDataRow;

    const n = lastRow - row + 1;
    const range = sh.getRange(row, BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.colLink, n, 1);
    const disp = range.getDisplayValues();
    const vals = range.getValues();
    const formulas = range.getFormulas();
    const rich = range.getRichTextValues();

    let processed = 0;
    let skipped = 0;
    let errors = 0;
    let checkedRows = 0;
    let updatedRows = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const currentRow = row + i;

      if (Date.now() - started > ROLLING_SALES_CENTER_PARAMETERS.softDeadlineMs ||
          processed >= BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.hardMaxFilesPerRun) {
        props.setProperty(BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.pHintRow, String(currentRow));
        scheduleTimeDrivenTrigger_(BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.fn, ROLLING_SALES_CENTER_PARAMETERS.bgDelayMs);
        SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
          'Fix G/L pause di row ' + currentRow + '. Akan lanjut otomatis.',
          'Rolling Sales Center',
          7
        );
        return;
      }

      const url = getSpreadsheetUrlFromCellObject_({
        displayValue: disp[i][0],
        value: vals[i][0],
        formula: formulas[i][0],
        richTextValue: rich[i][0]
      });

      if (!url) {
        skipped++;
        continue;
      }

      try {
        const fileId = extractRollingReasonDateFixSpreadsheetId_(url);
        if (!fileId) {
          skipped++;
          sh.getRange(currentRow, BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.colLink).setNote('SKIP: link Google Sheets tidak valid.');
          continue;
        }

        const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(fileId);
        const targetSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.targetCfg.TARGET_SHEET_NAME);
        if (!targetSh) {
          skipped++;
          sh.getRange(currentRow, BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.colLink).setNote(
            'SKIP: sheet target tidak ditemukan: ' + BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.targetCfg.TARGET_SHEET_NAME
          );
          continue;
        }

        const result = updateRollingReasonDatesInTargetSheet_(targetSh, BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.targetCfg);
        processed++;
        checkedRows += result.checked;
        updatedRows += result.updated;

        sh.getRange(currentRow, BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.colLink)
          .setBackground('#B7E1CD')
          .setNote('Fix G/L OK. Checked=' + result.checked + ', Updated=' + result.updated);

      } catch (err) {
        errors++;
        sh.getRange(currentRow, BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.colLink)
          .setBackground('#F4C7C3')
          .setNote('ERROR Fix G/L: ' + formatScriptError_(err));
      }
    }

    props.deleteProperty(BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.pHintRow);
    deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.fn]);

    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
      'Fix G/L selesai. File OK=' + processed +
      ', skip=' + skipped +
      ', error=' + errors +
      ', row dicek=' + checkedRows +
      ', row update=' + updatedRows,
      'Rolling Sales Center',
      12
    );
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}


function showFixRollingReasonDatesStatus() {
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const ss = getStoredSpreadsheetFromProperties_(BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.pSsId);
  const sh = getStoredSheetFromProperties_(ss, BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.pSheetId);
  const last = sh.getLastRow();
  const cur = Number(props.getProperty(BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.pHintRow) || BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.firstDataRow);
  const total = Math.max(0, last - BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.firstDataRow + 1);
  const done = Math.max(0, Math.min(total, cur - BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.firstDataRow));

  const msg = 'Fix G/L background | total row: ' + total +
    ' | done approx: ' + done +
    ' | cursor row: ' + cur +
    (cur > last ? ' (SELESAI)' : '');

  writeRollingSalesCenterLog_(msg);
  SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(msg, 'Rolling Sales Center', 10);
}

  PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().deleteProperty(BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.pHintRow);
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.fn]);
  try {
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
      'Fix G/L background dihentikan.',
      'Rolling Sales Center',
      5
    );
  } catch (err) {}
}


function finishFixRollingReasonDatesJob_(message) {
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.deleteProperty(BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.pHintRow);
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.fn]);
  SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(message, 'Rolling Sales Center', 8);
}




/* ============================================================
 * BACKGROUND VERSION: REPLACE DATES BASED ON m_bp_relation
 * ========================================================== */

function startValidateDateInTemplateForFinalLinksInBackground() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const sh = ss.getActiveSheet();
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const P = VALIDATE_DATE_IN_TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS;

  props.setProperty(P.pSsId, ss.getId());
  props.setProperty(P.pSheetId, String(sh.getSheetId()));
  if (!props.getProperty(P.pHintRow)) {
    props.setProperty(P.pHintRow, String(P.firstDataRow));
  }

  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);
  continueValidateDateInTemplateForFinalLinksInBackground();
}


function continueValidateDateInTemplateForFinalLinksInBackground() {
  const started = Date.now();
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const P = VALIDATE_DATE_IN_TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS;
  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(1000)) {
    writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('Validate Date in Template: proses lain sedang berjalan. Skip.');
    return;
  }

  try {
    const ss = getStoredSpreadsheetFromProperties_(P.pSsId);
    const sh = getStoredSheetFromProperties_(ss, P.pSheetId);
    const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();

    if (lastRow < P.firstDataRow) {
      finishValidateDateInTemplateJob_('Tidak ada link FINAL di kolom E.');
      return;
    }

    let cursor = Number(props.getProperty(P.pHintRow) || P.firstDataRow);
    if (cursor < P.firstDataRow) cursor = P.firstDataRow;
    if (cursor > lastRow) {
      finishValidateDateInTemplateJob_('Replace Dates by m_bp_relation sudah SELESAI semua.');
      return;
    }

    const n = lastRow - cursor + 1;
    const range = sh.getRange(cursor, P.masterLinkCol, n, 1);
    const disp = range.getDisplayValues();
    const vals = range.getValues();
    const formulas = range.getFormulas();
    const rich = range.getRichTextValues();

    let chipMap = {};
    if (typeof getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_ === 'function') {
      chipMap = getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_(ss.getId(), sh.getName(), cursor, P.masterLinkCol, n);
    }

    const plans = [];
    const neededTriple = {};
    const neededCustomer = {};
    const neededPair = {};
    const neededR8 = {};

    let processed = 0;
    let skipped = 0;
    let errors = 0;
    let nextCursor = cursor;

    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const masterRow = cursor + i;

      if (processed >= P.hardMaxFilesPerRun ||
          Date.now() - started > (P.phase1BudgetMs || P.softDeadlineMs || ROLLING_SALES_CENTER_PARAMETERS.softDeadlineMs)) {
        nextCursor = masterRow;
        break;
      }

      nextCursor = masterRow + 1;

      const urlFromCell = getSpreadsheetUrlFromCellObject_({
        displayValue: disp[i][0],
        value: vals[i][0],
        formula: formulas[i][0],
        richTextValue: rich[i][0]
      });
      const url = urlFromCell || chipMap[masterRow] || String(vals[i][0] || disp[i][0] || '');
      const fileId = extractValidateDateSpreadsheetId_(url);

      if (!fileId) {
        skipped++;
        continue;
      }

      try {
        const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(fileId);
        const targetSh = getValidateDateRollingSheet_(targetSs);
        if (!targetSh) {
          skipped++;
          sh.getRange(masterRow, P.masterLinkCol)
            .setBackground('#FCE8B2')
            .setNote('SKIP Replace Dates: sheet target tidak ditemukan: ' + P.rollingSheetName);
          continue;
        }

        const plan = readValidateDateRollingPlan_(targetSh, url);
        if (!plan) {
          skipped++;
          sh.getRange(masterRow, P.masterLinkCol)
            .setBackground('#FCE8B2')
            .setNote('SKIP Replace Dates: header target tidak lengkap. Wajib ada Customer ID, Relationship, Salesman ID, Valid From, Valid To, Visit Valid From, Visit Valid To, Reason.');
          continue;
        }

        plans.push(plan);
        processed++;

        for (let r = 0; r < plan.n; r++) {
          if (plan.isTokoBangkrut[r] && plan.keys[r]) neededTriple[plan.keys[r]] = true;
          if (plan.isTokoBangkrut[r] && plan.customers[r]) neededCustomer[plan.customers[r]] = true;
          if (!plan.relationships[r] && plan.customers[r] && plan.salesmen[r]) neededPair[plan.customers[r] + '||' + plan.salesmen[r]] = true;
          const planValidTo=RSC_NORMALIZE_FSD_DB_DATE_20260807_(plan.validToVals[r][0]);
          if(plan.keys[r]&&planValidTo)neededR8[plan.keys[r]+'||'+planValidTo]=true;
        }

        sh.getRange(masterRow, P.masterLinkCol)
          .setBackground('#D9EAD3')
          .setNote('Replace Dates: file dibaca. Rows=' + plan.n);

      } catch (err) {
        errors++;
        sh.getRange(masterRow, P.masterLinkCol)
          .setBackground('#F4C7C3')
          .setNote('ERROR Replace Dates read: ' + formatScriptError_(err));
        writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('Validate Date read error row ' + masterRow + ': ' + formatScriptError_(err));
      }
    }

    const maps = loadValidateDateMapsForKeys_(neededTriple, neededCustomer, neededPair, neededR8);
    const applied = applyAndWriteValidateDatePlans_(plans, maps);

    writeRollingSalesCenterLog_(
      'Validate Date batch | files=' + processed +
      ', skip=' + skipped +
      ', error=' + errors +
      ', A=' + applied.caseA +
      ', B=' + applied.caseB +
      ', C=' + applied.caseC
    );

    props.setProperty(P.pHintRow, String(nextCursor));

    if (nextCursor <= lastRow) {
      scheduleTimeDrivenTrigger_(P.fn, P.triggerDelayMs || ROLLING_SALES_CENTER_PARAMETERS.bgDelayMs);
      SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
        'Replace Dates pause. File=' + processed +
        ', A=' + applied.caseA +
        ', B=' + applied.caseB +
        ', C=' + applied.caseC +
        '. Lanjut otomatis dari row ' + nextCursor + '.',
        'Rolling Sales Center',
        10
      );
    } else {
      finishValidateDateInTemplateJob_(
        'Replace Dates by m_bp_relation SELESAI. File batch terakhir=' + processed +
        ', A=' + applied.caseA +
        ', B=' + applied.caseB +
        ', C=' + applied.caseC +
        ', skip=' + skipped +
        ', error=' + errors
      );
    }
  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (err) {}
  }
}

  const P = VALIDATE_DATE_IN_TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS;
  PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().deleteProperty(P.pHintRow);
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);
  try {
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
      'Replace Dates by m_bp_relation dihentikan + checkpoint dihapus.',
      'Rolling Sales Center',
      6
    );
  } catch (err) {}
}


function showValidateDateInTemplateStatus() {
  const P = VALIDATE_DATE_IN_TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const ss = getStoredSpreadsheetFromProperties_(P.pSsId);
  const sh = getStoredSheetFromProperties_(ss, P.pSheetId);
  const last = sh.getLastRow();
  const cur = Number(props.getProperty(P.pHintRow) || P.firstDataRow);
  const total = Math.max(0, last - P.firstDataRow + 1);
  const done = Math.max(0, Math.min(total, cur - P.firstDataRow));

  const msg = 'Replace Dates by m_bp_relation | total row E=' + total +
    ' | done approx=' + done +
    ' | cursor row=' + cur +
    (cur > last ? ' (SELESAI)' : '');

  writeRollingSalesCenterLog_(msg);
  SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(msg, 'Rolling Sales Center', 10);
}

function getValidateDateRollingSheet_(ss) {
  const wanted = VALIDATE_DATE_IN_TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS.rollingSheetName;
  let sh = ss.getSheetByName(wanted);
  if (sh) return sh;

  sh = ss.getSheetByName(String(wanted).substring(0, 31));
  if (sh) return sh;

  const sheets = ss.getSheets();
  for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (/rolling/i.test(sheets[i].getName())) return sheets[i];
  }
  return null;
}


function readValidateDateRollingPlan_(sh, url) {
  const P = VALIDATE_DATE_IN_TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS;
  const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  if (lastRow < 2 || lastCol < 1) return null;

  const scanRows = Math.min(P.headerScanRows || 15, lastRow);
  const grid = sh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, lastCol).getDisplayValues();

  let headerRowIndex = -1;
  let cCustomer = 0, cRelationship = 0, cSalesman = 0;
  let cValidFrom = 0, cValidTo = 0, cVisitValidFrom = 0, cVisitValidTo = 0, cReason = 0;

  for (let r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    const row = grid[r];
    const customerCol = findValidateDateCol_(row, ['customer id', 'customer']);
    const salesmanCol = findValidateDateCol_(row, ['salesman id', 'salesman']);
    if (!customerCol || !salesmanCol) continue;
    headerRowIndex = r;
    cCustomer = customerCol;
    cSalesman = salesmanCol;
    cRelationship = findValidateDateCol_(row, ['relationship', 'relationship type', 'relationship id']);
    cValidFrom = findValidateDateCol_(row, ['valid from']);
    cValidTo = findValidateDateCol_(row, ['valid to']);
    cVisitValidFrom = findValidateDateCol_(row, ['visit valid from']);
    cVisitValidTo = findValidateDateCol_(row, ['visit valid to']);
    cReason = findValidateDateCol_(row, ['reason']);
    break;
  }

  if (headerRowIndex < 0 || !cCustomer || !cRelationship || !cSalesman ||
      !cValidFrom || !cValidTo || !cVisitValidFrom || !cVisitValidTo || !cReason) return null;

  const firstDataRow = headerRowIndex + 2;
  if (firstDataRow > lastRow) return null;
  const n = lastRow - firstDataRow + 1;

  // PERF5: one contiguous read replaces 8 independent column reads.
  const cols = [cCustomer,cRelationship,cSalesman,cValidFrom,cValidTo,cVisitValidFrom,cVisitValidTo,cReason];
  const minCol = Math.min.apply(null, cols), maxCol = Math.max.apply(null, cols), width = maxCol - minCol + 1;
  const block = sh.getRange(firstDataRow, minCol, n, width);
  const raw = block.getValues();
  const display = block.getDisplayValues();
  RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('validateDatePlanBlockReads', 1);

  const relCustomer=cCustomer-minCol, relRelationship=cRelationship-minCol, relSalesman=cSalesman-minCol;
  const relValidFrom=cValidFrom-minCol, relValidTo=cValidTo-minCol, relVisitFrom=cVisitValidFrom-minCol, relVisitTo=cVisitValidTo-minCol, relReason=cReason-minCol;
  const keys=new Array(n), customers=new Array(n), relationships=new Array(n), salesmen=new Array(n), isTokoBangkrut=new Array(n), reasons=new Array(n);
  const validFromVals=new Array(n), validToVals=new Array(n), visitValidFromVals=new Array(n), visitValidToVals=new Array(n);

  for (let i=0;i<n;i++) {
    const customer=display[i][relCustomer], relationship=display[i][relRelationship], salesman=display[i][relSalesman], reason=display[i][relReason];
    keys[i]=buildValidateDateKey_(customer,relationship,salesman);
    customers[i]=RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(customer);
    relationships[i]=normalizeValidateDateRelationship_(relationship);
    salesmen[i]=RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(salesman);
    isTokoBangkrut[i]=isValidateDateTokoBangkrut_(reason);
    reasons[i]=[reason];
    validFromVals[i]=[raw[i][relValidFrom]];
    validToVals[i]=[raw[i][relValidTo]];
    visitValidFromVals[i]=[raw[i][relVisitFrom]];
    visitValidToVals[i]=[raw[i][relVisitTo]];
  }

  return {
    url:url,n:n,keys:keys,customers:customers,relationships:relationships,salesmen:salesmen,reasons:reasons,isTokoBangkrut:isTokoBangkrut,
    validFromVals:validFromVals,validToVals:validToVals,visitValidFromVals:visitValidFromVals,visitValidToVals:visitValidToVals,
    validFromRange:sh.getRange(firstDataRow,cValidFrom,n,1), validToRange:sh.getRange(firstDataRow,cValidTo,n,1),
    visitValidFromRange:sh.getRange(firstDataRow,cVisitValidFrom,n,1), visitValidToRange:sh.getRange(firstDataRow,cVisitValidTo,n,1)
  };
}



/**
 * PERF11 authoritative Rolling date policy.
 *
 * Latest business rule:
 * - Reason=Rolling always starts relation at hardcoded dateNew. Historical
 *   Customer/Salesman or triple Valid From must never pull it backwards.
 * - PAIR_NO_RELATION is intentionally visit-only: Relationship/Valid From/Valid To
 *   stay exactly as source (often blank); only Visit Valid From follows dateNew.
 * - Toko Bangkrut is handled before this helper and may legitimately use DB history.
 */
function RSC_PERF11_RESOLVE_ROLLING_DATE_POLICY_20260819_(reason, csoMode, sourceValidFrom, dateNew) {
  const rolling = /^rolling$/i.test(String(reason == null ? '' : reason).trim());
  const mode = String(csoMode || '');
  const source = sourceValidFrom == null ? '' : sourceValidFrom;
  const next = String(dateNew == null ? '' : dateNew);
  if (!rolling) return {rolling:false, validFrom:source, visitValidFrom:null, mode:mode};
  if (mode === 'PAIR_NO_RELATION') {
    return {rolling:true, validFrom:source, visitValidFrom:next, mode:mode, source:'PAIR_NO_RELATION_KEEP_RELATION'};
  }
  return {rolling:true, validFrom:next, visitValidFrom:next, mode:mode, source:'ROLLING_HARDCODED'};
}

function applyAndWriteValidateDatePlans_(plans, maps) {
  const P=VALIDATE_DATE_IN_TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS,exact=maps.exact||{},customerFallback=maps.customer||{};
  const relationCtx={exact:exact,customer:customerFallback,existingR8:maps.existingR8||{},pair:maps.pair||{},r8ValidFrom:maps.r8ValidFrom||{}};
  let caseA=0,caseB=0,caseC=0,casePairNoRel=0,rollingHardcoded=0;
  plans.forEach(function(plan){
    for(let i=0;i<plan.n;i++){
      const key=plan.keys[i],matchedValidFrom=key&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(exact,key)?exact[key]:null;
      const v={customerId:plan.customers[i],relationship:plan.relationships?plan.relationships[i]:'',salesmanId:plan.salesmen?plan.salesmen[i]:'',validTo:plan.validToVals[i][0]};
      const cso=RSC_STD_DETECT_CHANGE_SCHEDULE_ONLY_20260819_(v,relationCtx);
      if(plan.isTokoBangkrut[i]){
        const visitOnly=Boolean(cso.yes&&cso.mode==='PAIR_NO_RELATION');
        if(!visitOnly){
          if(matchedValidFrom)plan.validFromVals[i][0]=matchedValidFrom;
          else if(P.caseCValidFromSource==='CUSTOMER_FALLBACK'){
            const fallbackValidFrom=plan.customers[i]?customerFallback[plan.customers[i]]:null;
            if(fallbackValidFrom)plan.validFromVals[i][0]=fallbackValidFrom;
          }
          plan.validToVals[i][0]=P.dateClose;
        }else{
          casePairNoRel++;
        }
        plan.visitValidToVals[i][0]=P.dateClose;caseC++;continue;
      }

      const policy=RSC_PERF11_RESOLVE_ROLLING_DATE_POLICY_20260819_(
        plan.reasons[i][0],cso.yes?cso.mode:'',plan.validFromVals[i][0],P.dateNew
      );
      if(policy.rolling){
        if(cso.yes){caseA++;if(cso.mode==='PAIR_NO_RELATION')casePairNoRel++;}
        else caseB++;
        if(cso.mode!=='PAIR_NO_RELATION')plan.validFromVals[i][0]=policy.validFrom;
        plan.visitValidFromVals[i][0]=policy.visitValidFrom;
        if(cso.mode!=='PAIR_NO_RELATION')rollingHardcoded++;
        continue;
      }

      // Non-Rolling/non-Toko: keep relation dates as source. Change-schedule
      // detection is still used later by validation/converter, but no DB date backfill.
      if(cso.yes){caseA++;if(cso.mode==='PAIR_NO_RELATION')casePairNoRel++;}
    }
    plan.validFromRange.setValues(plan.validFromVals);plan.validToRange.setValues(plan.validToVals);plan.visitValidFromRange.setValues(plan.visitValidFromVals);plan.visitValidToRange.setValues(plan.visitValidToVals);
    writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('Replace Dates write OK: '+plan.url);
  });
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  return{caseA:caseA,caseB:caseB,caseC:caseC,casePairNoRel:casePairNoRel,rollingHardcoded:rollingHardcoded};
}


function loadValidateDateMapsForKeys_(neededTriple, neededCustomer, neededPair, neededR8) {
  const ctx=RSC_STD_LOAD_RELATION_CONTEXT_20260814_(neededTriple||Object.create(null),neededCustomer||Object.create(null),neededR8||Object.create(null),neededPair||Object.create(null));
  return{exact:ctx.exact||Object.create(null),customer:ctx.customer||Object.create(null),existingR8:ctx.existingR8||Object.create(null),pair:ctx.pair||Object.create(null),r8ValidFrom:ctx.r8ValidFrom||Object.create(null)};
}


function findValidateDateCol_(rowArr, names) {
  const aliasKey = (names || []).map(function (name) {
    return String(name || '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
  }).join('\u001f');
  const targets = RSC_PERF5_MEMO_SCALAR_20260819_('HDR_ALIAS', aliasKey, function () {
    const t = Object.create(null);
    (names || []).forEach(function (name) {
      t[String(name || '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ')] = true;
    });
    return t;
  });
  for (let c = 0; c < rowArr.length; c++) {
    const value = String(rowArr[c] == null ? '' : rowArr[c]).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
    if (targets[value]) return c + 1;
  }
  return 0;
}


function buildValidateDateKey_(bpIdRlt1, relationship, bpIdRlt2) {
  const a = RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(bpIdRlt1);
  const b = normalizeValidateDateRelationship_(relationship);
  const c = RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(bpIdRlt2);
  if (!a || !b || !c) return '';
  return a + '||' + b + '||' + c;
}


function normalizeValidateDateId_(value) {
  // PERF7 compatibility alias. New code calls the core normalizer directly.
  return RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(value);
}


function normalizeValidateDateRelationship_(value) {
  let s = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
  if (!s) return '';
  if (s.indexOf(' - ') > -1) s = s.split(' - ')[0];
  return s.replace(/\s+/g, '').toUpperCase();
}


function normalizeValidateDateForWrite_(value) {
  if (value instanceof Date && !isNaN(value.getTime())) {
    return Utilities.formatDate(value, Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
  }

  let s = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
  if (!s) return '';

  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s)) return s;

  // Handle epoch milliseconds, contoh: 1778630400000.
  if (/^\d{12,13}$/.test(s)) {
    const d = new Date(Number(s));
    if (!isNaN(d.getTime())) {
      return Utilities.formatDate(d, Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
    }
  }

  return s;
}


function isValidateDateRolling_(reason) {
  return String(reason == null ? '' : reason).trim().toUpperCase().indexOf('ROLLING') !== -1;
}


function isValidateDateTokoBangkrut_(reason) {
  return String(reason == null ? '' : reason).trim().toUpperCase().indexOf('TOKO BANGKRUT') !== -1;
}


function objectSizeValidateDate_(obj) {
  return obj ? Object.keys(obj).length : 0;
}


function extractValidateDateSpreadsheetId_(urlOrId) {
  if (typeof extractSpreadsheetFileIdFromUrlOrId_ === 'function') {
    const id = extractSpreadsheetFileIdFromUrlOrId_(urlOrId);
    if (id) return id;
  }

  const t = String(urlOrId == null ? '' : urlOrId).trim();
  if (!t) return '';

  let m = t.match(/\/spreadsheets\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);
  if (m) return m[1];

  if (/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{25,}$/.test(t) && t.indexOf('/') === -1) return t;

  return '';
}

function runSafelyWithOptionalRethrow_(label, fn, rethrow) {
  try {
    return fn();
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = label + ' ERROR: ' + formatScriptError_(err);
    writeRollingSalesCenterLog_(msg);
    try {
      SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(msg, 'Rolling Sales Center', 8);
    } catch (e) {}
    if (rethrow) throw err;
    return null;
  }
}


function formatScriptError_(err) {
  return String(err && err.message ? err.message : err);
}


function writeRollingSalesCenterLog_(message) {
  Logger.log('[Integrated] ' + message);
  try{RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_MIRROR_MESSAGE_20260819_(message);}catch(ignore){}
}


function deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_(fnNames) {
  const set = {};
  fnNames.forEach(function (n) { set[n] = true; });

  ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(function (trigger) {
    if (set[trigger.getHandlerFunction()]) {
      ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger);
    }
  });
}


function scheduleTimeDrivenTrigger_(functionName, delayMs) {
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([functionName]);
  RSC_PERF13_NEW_TRIGGER_20260819_(functionName)
    .timeBased()
    .after(delayMs || ROLLING_SALES_CENTER_PARAMETERS.bgDelayMs)
    .create();
}


function getStoredSpreadsheetFromProperties_(propKey) {
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const storedId = props.getProperty(propKey || ROLLING_SALES_CENTER_PARAMETERS.propSsId);
  if (storedId) {
    try { return RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(storedId); } catch (err) {}
  }
  return SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
}


function getStoredSheetFromProperties_(ss, propKey) {
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const sid = props.getProperty(propKey || ROLLING_SALES_CENTER_PARAMETERS.propSheetId);
  if (sid) {
    const sheets = ss.getSheets();
    for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
      if (String(sheets[i].getSheetId()) === String(sid)) return sheets[i];
    }
  }
  return ss.getActiveSheet();
}


function getSpreadsheetUrlFromCellObject_(cellObj) {
  if (typeof getSpreadsheetUrlFromCellData_ === 'function') {
    const url = getSpreadsheetUrlFromCellData_(cellObj);
    if (url) return url;
  }

  const rich = cellObj.richTextValue;
  if (rich) {
    const whole = rich.getLinkUrl();
    if (whole) return whole;
    const runs = rich.getRuns();
    for (let i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      const u = runs[i].getLinkUrl();
      if (u) return u;
    }
  }

  const texts = [
    cellObj.formula,
    cellObj.value,
    cellObj.displayValue
  ];

  for (let i = 0; i < texts.length; i++) {
    const m = String(texts[i] || '').match(
      /https:\/\/docs\.google\.com\/spreadsheets\/d\/[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+[^\s"',)]*/
    );
    if (m) return m[0];
  }

  return '';
}

 * - Change Salesman Type: tidak ada validasi wajib 9999-12-31; hanya validasi format tanggal dan Valid To > Valid From.
 *
 * V12 PATCH NOTES:
 * 1) [CRITICAL] FIX VALUE HILANG SETELAH DROPDOWN DIPILIH + NORMALISASI.
 *    Gejala (lihat video UAT): user pilih "STA1 - STA - CG Sales" di
 *    kolom Sales Organization. onEdit men-normalisasi cell ke "STA1".

 *

 *    visual jika value tidak persis cocok dengan salah satu list item.
 *    List berisi "STA1 - STA - CG Sales" — tidak ada "STA1" — sehingga
 *    chip render kosong. setAllowInvalid(true) hanya mencegah hard-reject
 *    pada saat input, tapi tidak mencegah perilaku chip ini.
 *
 *    Fix: setDropdownValidation_ sekarang otomatis menambahkan bare ID
 *    (hasil extractIdFromDropdownOptionText_) ke valid list di samping display
 *    options. Setelah normalisasi, "STA1" cocok dengan salah satu list
 *    item sehingga chip render normal dan validation tidak salah flag.
 *    Dropdown tetap menampilkan label deskriptif di posisi atas; bare ID
 *    di-append di posisi bawah sebagai opsi fallback yang valid.
 *
 *    Imbas perbaikan: berlaku untuk semua cascade dropdown — Sales Org,
 *    Distribution Channel, Division, Sales Office, Relationship, Sales
 *    Type, Risk Class, Check Rule, Credit Segment, Information Category,
 *    Company Code. Tidak perlu menyentuh setiap setup function.

 *    juga diterima" supaya operator paham kenapa ada dua bentuk di dalam

 * 2) Run: setupAllTopCreditAndRollingTemplates() (atau Setup / Refresh ALL dari
 *    menu Template UI) supaya semua row existing pick up validation rule
 *    yang baru.
 *
 * Semua patch dari V8/V9/V10/V11 tetap berlaku (UAT salesman-to-salesman,
 * Change Rolling 9999-12-31, R4-R12 frontend, batch read/write,
 * buildHeaderMap_ first-wins, sheet-name 31-char tolerance, dst).

function refreshValidationForSelectedRow() {
  const sh = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSheet();
  const row = sh.getActiveCell().getRow();
  if (row <= 1) return;
  const idx = getEmployeeMasterDataIndex_();
  if (sh.getName() === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetSales) applyTopSalesRowState_(sh, row, idx, true);
  if (sh.getName() === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetCredit) applyCreditLimitRowState_(sh, row, true);
  if (sh.getName() === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetRolling) applyRollingVisitSectionState_(sh, row, true);
  if (sh.getName() === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetSalesOfficeChange) applyChangeSalesOfficeRowState_(sh, row, idx, true);
  if (sh.getName() === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetSalesmanTypeChange) applyChangeSalesmanTypeRowState_(sh, row, idx, true);
  if (detectActiveSheetValidationKind_(sh) !== 'UNKNOWN') return standardValidateActiveSheet();
  SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast('Row UI state sudah di-refresh.', 'Template UI', 4);
}

/* =========================================================
 * ONEDIT (V10 realtime batch + V12 dropdown fix)
 * ========================================================= */

function RSC_STD_MARK_EDITED_ROWS_PENDING_20260814_(sh, startRow, endRow) {
  return RSC_V28_2_MARK_EDITED_ROWS_VALIDATING_20260814_(sh, startRow, endRow);
}

function handleTemplateUiEdit_(e) {
  if (!e || !e.range) return;

  const sh = e.range.getSheet();
  const sheetName = sh.getName();
  const supported = [
    TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetFinance,
    TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetSales,
    TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetCredit,
    TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetRolling,
    TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetSalesOfficeChange,
    TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetSalesmanTypeChange
  ];
  if (supported.indexOf(sheetName) === -1) return;

  const startRow = Math.max(2, e.range.getRow());
  const endRow = Math.min(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows, e.range.getRow() + e.range.getNumRows() - 1);
  if (startRow > endRow) return;

  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(500)) return;

  try {
    const rowCount = endRow - startRow + 1;
    const realtimeApplyLimit = TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.realtimeApplyRowLimit || 50;
    const isLargePaste = rowCount > realtimeApplyLimit;

    let idx = null;
    if ([TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetSales, TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetFinance, TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetSalesOfficeChange, TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetSalesmanTypeChange].indexOf(sheetName) !== -1) {
      idx = getEmployeeMasterDataIndex_();
    }

    if (sheetName === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetFinance) handleTopFinanceEditedRowsInBatch_(sh, e.range, idx, startRow, endRow);
    if (sheetName === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetSales) handleTopSalesEditedRowsInBatch_(sh, e.range, idx, startRow, endRow, isLargePaste);
    if (sheetName === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetCredit) handleCreditLimitEditedRowsInBatch_(sh, e.range, startRow, endRow, isLargePaste);
    if (sheetName === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetRolling) handleChangeRollingEditedRowsInBatch_(sh, e.range, idx, startRow, endRow, isLargePaste);
    if (sheetName === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetSalesOfficeChange) handleChangeSalesOfficeEditedRowsInBatch_(sh, e.range, idx, startRow, endRow, isLargePaste);
    if (sheetName === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetSalesmanTypeChange) handleChangeSalesmanTypeEditedRowsInBatch_(sh, e.range, idx, startRow, endRow, isLargePaste);

    if (isLargePaste && [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetRolling, TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetSalesOfficeChange, TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetSalesmanTypeChange].indexOf(sheetName) !== -1) {
      SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast('Large paste diproses batch. Standard V28.3 otomatis melanjutkan validasi full-sheet termasuk duplicate/cross-row.', 'Template UI', 6);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(String(err.message || err), 'Template UI error', 8);
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function setupTopCustomerFinanceSheet_(ss, idx) {
  const sh = getRequiredSheetByName_(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetFinance);
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();

  formatHeaderRow_(sh, lastCol);
  sh.setFrozenRows(1);
  setColumnWidthsByHeaderName_(sh, hm, {
    'BP Number Source': 190,
    'Company Code': 230,
    'Terms of Payment': 190
  });

  const companyCol = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Company Code', 'Company']);
  if (companyCol) {
    const r = sh.getRange(2, companyCol, TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows - 1, 1);
    setDropdownValidation_(r, idx.companyOptions, 'Pilih Company Code. Dropdown menampilkan ID + description, ID-only juga diterima setelah normalisasi.');
  }
}

function setupTopCustomerSalesSheet_(ss, idx) {
  const sh = getRequiredSheetByName_(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetSales);
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();

  formatHeaderRow_(sh, lastCol);
  sh.setFrozenRows(1);
  setColumnWidthsByHeaderName_(sh, hm, {
    'BP Number Source': 190,
    'Sales Organization': 230,
    'Distr. Channel': 230,
    'Distribution Channel': 230,
    'Division': 230,
    'Terms of Payment': 190
  });

  const salesOrgCol = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org']);
  const distCol = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Distr. Channel', 'Distribution Channel', 'Distribution channel']);
  const divCol = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Division']);

  if (salesOrgCol) {
    setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(2, salesOrgCol, TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows - 1, 1), idx.salesOrgOptions,
      'Pilih Sales Org. Setelah dipilih, Distribution Channel dan Division akan terfilter otomatis. ID-only juga diterima.');
  }

  if (distCol) applyLockedVisualStyle_(sh.getRange(2, distCol, TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows - 1, 1), true);
  if (divCol) applyLockedVisualStyle_(sh.getRange(2, divCol, TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows - 1, 1), true);

  // BATCH: baca SO column sekali, apply hanya untuk row yang ada datanya.
  const lastDataRow = Math.min(Math.max(sh.getLastRow(), 2), TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows);
  if (salesOrgCol && lastDataRow >= 2) {
    const soVals = sh.getRange(2, salesOrgCol, lastDataRow - 1, 1).getDisplayValues();
    for (let i = 0; i < soVals.length; i++) {
      if (cleanText_(soVals[i][0])) applyTopSalesRowState_(sh, i + 2, idx, false);
    }
  }
}

function setupCreditLimitSheet_(ss) {
  const sh = getRequiredSheetByName_(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetCredit);
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  const nRows = TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows - 1;

  formatHeaderRow_(sh, lastCol);
  sh.setFrozenRows(1);
  setColumnWidthsByHeaderName_(sh, hm, {
    'BP Number Source': 190,
    'Flag Extend': 120,
    'Credit Segment': 260,
    'Limit Not Define': 155,
    'Limit Defined': 150,
    'Limit': 140,
    'Limit Valid Date': 165,
    'Information Category': 260,
    'Information Type': 170,
    'Relevant': 120,
    'Additional Limit Amount': 210,
    'Currency': 120,
    'Additional Limit Valid From': 210,
    'Additional Limit Valid To': 210,
    'KK Attachment': 160,
    'Risk Class': 260,
    'Check Rule': 310,
    'Rules': 140
  });

  const colCreditSegment = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Credit Segment']);
  const colLimitNotDefine = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Limit Not Define']);
  const colLimitDefined = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Limit Defined']);
  const colLimit = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Limit']);
  const colLimitDate = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Limit Valid Date']);
  const colInfoCategory = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Information Category']);
  const colInfoType = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Information Type']);
  const colRelevant = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Relevant']);
  const colAddAmount = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Additional Limit Amount']);
  const colCurrency = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Currency']);
  const colAddFrom = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Additional Limit Valid From']);
  const colAddTo = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Additional Limit Valid To']);
  const colRisk = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Risk Class']);
  const colCheck = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Check Rule']);
  const colRules = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Rules']);

  if (!colCreditSegment || !colLimitNotDefine || !colLimitDefined || !colRules) {
    throw new Error('Header wajib di sheet Credit Limit belum lengkap. Pastikan ada: Credit Segment, Limit Not Define, Limit Defined, Rules.');
  }

  setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(2, colCreditSegment, nRows, 1), buildDropdownOptionList_(CREDIT_SEGMENTS),
    'Pilih Credit Segment. Dropdown menampilkan ID + description, ID-only juga diterima setelah normalisasi.');
  setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(2, colLimitNotDefine, nRows, 1), ['TRUE', 'FALSE'],
    'TRUE = limit tidak didefinisikan dan kolom kanan terkunci. FALSE = kolom kanan bisa diisi.');

  if (colInfoCategory) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(2, colInfoCategory, nRows, 1), buildDropdownOptionList_(INFO_CATEGORIES),
    'Additional Limit / collateral only. Ini bukan standard credit limit.');
  if (colRelevant) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(2, colRelevant, nRows, 1), ['TRUE', 'FALSE'], 'Pilih TRUE/FALSE.');
  if (colCurrency) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(2, colCurrency, nRows, 1), ['IDR', 'USD'], 'Pilih Currency.');
  if (colRisk) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(2, colRisk, nRows, 1), buildRiskClassDropdownOptions_(), 'Pilih Risk Class. Check Rule akan otomatis disamakan berdasarkan ID.');
  if (colCheck) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(2, colCheck, nRows, 1), buildCheckRuleDropdownOptions_(), 'Pilih Check Rule. Risk Class akan otomatis disamakan berdasarkan ID.');

  // Batch: kumpulkan semua date columns sekaligus.
  const dateCols = [colLimitDate, colAddFrom, colAddTo].filter(Boolean);
  const dateValRule = buildDateValidationRule_('Isi tanggal valid dengan format DD/MM/YYYY. Google Sheets akan menampilkan calendar picker.');
  for (let i = 0; i < dateCols.length; i++) {
    const r = sh.getRange(2, dateCols[i], nRows, 1);
    r.setNumberFormat('dd/MM/yyyy');
    r.setDataValidation(dateValRule);
  }

  const numCols = [colLimit, colAddAmount].filter(Boolean);
  for (let i = 0; i < numCols.length; i++) {
    sh.getRange(2, numCols[i], nRows, 1).setNumberFormat('#,##0');
  }

  applyLockedVisualStyle_(sh.getRange(2, colLimitDefined, nRows, colRules - colLimitDefined + 1), true);
  resetCreditLimitConditionalFormats_(sh, hm);

  sh.getRange(1, colLimitNotDefine).setNote('TRUE = kolom kanan terkunci. FALSE = kolom kanan bisa diisi.');
  if (colInfoCategory) sh.getRange(1, colInfoCategory).setNote('Section ini bukan standard limit. Isi hanya untuk collateral / additional adjustment.');
  if (colInfoType && colAddTo) sh.getRange(1, colInfoType, 1, colAddTo - colInfoType + 1).setNote('Hanya bisa diisi setelah Information Category diisi.');

  const lastDataRow = Math.min(Math.max(sh.getLastRow(), 2), TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows);
  if (lastDataRow >= 2) {
    const flags = sh.getRange(2, colLimitNotDefine, lastDataRow - 1, 1).getDisplayValues();
    for (let i = 0; i < flags.length; i++) {
      if (cleanText_(flags[i][0])) applyCreditLimitRowState_(sh, i + 2, false);
    }
  }
}

/* =========================================================
 * EDIT HANDLERS - TOP/CREDIT (V10)
 * ========================================================= */

function handleTopFinanceEditedRowsInBatch_(sh, editedRange, idx, startRow, endRow) {
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const companyCol = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Company Code', 'Company']);
  normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, companyCol, 'ID');
}

function handleTopSalesEditedRowsInBatch_(sh, editedRange, idx, startRow, endRow, isLargePaste) {
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const salesOrgCol = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org']);
  const distCol = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Distr. Channel', 'Distribution Channel', 'Distribution channel']);
  const divCol = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Division']);
  if (!salesOrgCol || !distCol || !divCol) return;

  if (doesEditedRangeTouchColumn_(editedRange, salesOrgCol)) {
    normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, salesOrgCol, 'ID');
    clearEditedColumnValues_(sh, startRow, endRow, distCol);
    clearEditedColumnValues_(sh, startRow, endRow, divCol);
  }
  if (doesEditedRangeTouchColumn_(editedRange, distCol)) {
    normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, distCol, 'ID');
    clearEditedColumnValues_(sh, startRow, endRow, divCol);
  }
  if (doesEditedRangeTouchColumn_(editedRange, divCol)) {
    normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, divCol, 'ID');
  }

  if (!isLargePaste) {
    for (let row = startRow; row <= endRow; row++) applyTopSalesRowState_(sh, row, idx, true);
  }
}

function handleCreditLimitEditedRowsInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, isLargePaste) {
  // Credit Limit has more conditional locking rules, so keep row logic,
  // but cap heavy realtime styling for very large paste.
  const maxRows = isLargePaste ? Math.min(endRow, startRow + 49) : endRow;
  for (let row = startRow; row <= maxRows; row++) handleCreditLimitRowEdit_(sh, row, editedRange);
  if (isLargePaste) {
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast('Credit large paste: 50 row pertama diproses realtime. Jalankan Setup Credit Limit untuk refresh full formatting.', 'Template UI', 6);
  }
}

function handleCreditLimitRowEdit_(sh, row, editedRange) {
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const cCreditSegment = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Credit Segment']);
  const cLimitNotDefine = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Limit Not Define']);
  const cLimitDefined = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Limit Defined']);
  const cInfoCategory = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Information Category']);
  const cInfoType = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Information Type']);
  const cAddTo = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Additional Limit Valid To']);
  const cRisk = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Risk Class']);
  const cCheck = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Check Rule']);
  const cRules = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Rules']);

  if (!cLimitNotDefine || !cLimitDefined || !cRules) return;

  if (cCreditSegment && doesEditedRangeTouchColumn_(editedRange, cCreditSegment)) {
    normalizeDropdownValueToIdOnly_(sh.getRange(row, cCreditSegment));
  }

  if (doesEditedRangeTouchColumn_(editedRange, cLimitNotDefine)) {
    normalizeBooleanTextValue_(sh.getRange(row, cLimitNotDefine));
  }

  if (cInfoCategory && doesEditedRangeTouchColumn_(editedRange, cInfoCategory)) {
    normalizeDropdownValueToIdOnly_(sh.getRange(row, cInfoCategory));
    const infoVal = cleanText_(sh.getRange(row, cInfoCategory).getDisplayValue());
    if (infoVal) {
      SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast('Information Category adalah Additional Limit / collateral adjustment, bukan standard credit limit.', 'Warning', 7);
    }
  }

  if (cRisk && doesEditedRangeTouchColumn_(editedRange, cRisk)) {
    const id = normalizeDropdownValueToIdOnly_(sh.getRange(row, cRisk));
    if (id && cCheck) sh.getRange(row, cCheck).setValue(id);
  }

  if (cCheck && doesEditedRangeTouchColumn_(editedRange, cCheck)) {
    const id = normalizeDropdownValueToIdOnly_(sh.getRange(row, cCheck));
    if (id && cRisk) sh.getRange(row, cRisk).setValue(id);
  }

  const colStart = editedRange.getColumn();
  const colEnd = colStart + editedRange.getNumColumns() - 1;
  const limitNotDefine = cleanText_(sh.getRange(row, cLimitNotDefine).getDisplayValue()).toUpperCase();
  if (colEnd >= cLimitDefined && limitNotDefine !== 'FALSE') {
    const blockStart = Math.max(colStart, cLimitDefined);
    const blockEnd = Math.min(colEnd, cRules);
    if (blockEnd >= blockStart) {
      sh.getRange(row, blockStart, 1, blockEnd - blockStart + 1).clearContent();
      SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast('Kolom kanan hanya bisa diisi jika Limit Not Define = FALSE.', 'Locked', 6);
    }
  }

  const infoVal = cInfoCategory ? cleanText_(sh.getRange(row, cInfoCategory).getDisplayValue()) : '';
  if (limitNotDefine === 'FALSE' && cInfoType && cAddTo && colEnd >= cInfoType && colStart <= cAddTo && !infoVal) {
    const blockStart = Math.max(colStart, cInfoType);
    const blockEnd = Math.min(colEnd, cAddTo);
    if (blockEnd >= blockStart) {
      sh.getRange(row, blockStart, 1, blockEnd - blockStart + 1).clearContent();
      SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast('Isi Information Category terlebih dahulu. Section ini bukan limit standard.', 'Additional Limit', 7);
    }
  }

  applyCreditLimitRowState_(sh, row, true);
}

/* =========================================================
 * ROW LOGIC - SALES / CREDIT
 * ========================================================= */

function applyTopSalesRowState_(sh, row, idx, cleanInvalid) {
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const salesOrgCol = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org']);
  const distCol = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Distr. Channel', 'Distribution Channel', 'Distribution channel']);
  const divCol = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Division']);
  if (!salesOrgCol || !distCol || !divCol) return;

  // BATCH: baca 3 cell sekaligus dalam 1 round-trip.
  const startCol = Math.min(salesOrgCol, distCol, divCol);
  const endCol = Math.max(salesOrgCol, distCol, divCol);
  const block = sh.getRange(row, startCol, 1, endCol - startCol + 1).getDisplayValues()[0];
  const so = cleanText_(block[salesOrgCol - startCol]);
  const dist = cleanText_(block[distCol - startCol]);

  setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(row, salesOrgCol), idx.salesOrgOptions, 'Pilih Sales Org. ID-only juga diterima.');

  if (!so) {
    sh.getRange(row, distCol, 1, 2).clearDataValidations();
    applyLockedVisualStyle_(sh.getRange(row, distCol, 1, 2), true);
    if (cleanInvalid) sh.getRange(row, distCol, 1, 2).clearContent();
    return;
  }

  const distOptions = idx.distOptionsBySalesOrg[so] || [];
  setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(row, distCol), distOptions, 'Distribution Channel terfilter berdasarkan Sales Org. ID-only juga diterima.');
  applyLockedVisualStyle_(sh.getRange(row, distCol), false);

  if (dist && !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(dist, distOptions)) {
    if (cleanInvalid) sh.getRange(row, distCol, 1, 2).clearContent();
    applyLockedVisualStyle_(sh.getRange(row, divCol), true);
    return;
  }

  if (!dist) {
    sh.getRange(row, divCol).clearDataValidations();
    applyLockedVisualStyle_(sh.getRange(row, divCol), true);
    if (cleanInvalid) sh.getRange(row, divCol).clearContent();
    return;
  }

  const divOptions = idx.divOptionsBySalesOrgDist[so + '|' + dist] || [];
  setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(row, divCol), divOptions, 'Division terfilter berdasarkan Sales Org + Distribution Channel. ID-only juga diterima.');
  applyLockedVisualStyle_(sh.getRange(row, divCol), false);

  if (cleanInvalid) {
    const div = cleanText_(block[divCol - startCol]);
    if (div && !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(div, divOptions)) sh.getRange(row, divCol).clearContent();
  }
}

function applyCreditLimitRowState_(sh, row, clearWhenLocked) {
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const cLimitNotDefine = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Limit Not Define']);
  const cLimitDefined = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Limit Defined']);
  const cInfoCategory = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Information Category']);
  const cInfoType = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Information Type']);
  const cAddTo = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Additional Limit Valid To']);
  const cRules = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Rules']);
  if (!cLimitNotDefine || !cLimitDefined || !cRules) return;

  const limitNotDefine = cleanText_(sh.getRange(row, cLimitNotDefine).getDisplayValue()).toUpperCase();
  const rightSide = sh.getRange(row, cLimitDefined, 1, cRules - cLimitDefined + 1);

  if (limitNotDefine !== 'FALSE') {
    if (clearWhenLocked) rightSide.clearContent();
    applyLockedVisualStyle_(rightSide, true);
    return;
  }

  applyLockedVisualStyle_(rightSide, false);
  setCreditLimitRowValidations_(sh, row);

  const infoVal = cInfoCategory ? cleanText_(sh.getRange(row, cInfoCategory).getDisplayValue()) : '';
  if (cInfoType && cAddTo) {
    const addRange = sh.getRange(row, cInfoType, 1, cAddTo - cInfoType + 1);
    if (!infoVal) {
      if (clearWhenLocked) addRange.clearContent();
      applyLockedVisualStyle_(addRange, true);
    } else {
      addRange.setBackground(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.warning).setFontColor(null);
    }
  }
}

function setCreditLimitRowValidations_(sh, row) {
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const n = 1;
  const cInfoCategory = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Information Category']);
  const cRelevant = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Relevant']);
  const cCurrency = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Currency']);
  const cRisk = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Risk Class']);
  const cCheck = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Check Rule']);
  const dateCols = ['Limit Valid Date', 'Additional Limit Valid From', 'Additional Limit Valid To'];

  if (cInfoCategory) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(row, cInfoCategory, n, 1), buildDropdownOptionList_(INFO_CATEGORIES), 'Additional Limit only. Ini bukan standard credit limit.');
  if (cRelevant) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(row, cRelevant, n, 1), ['TRUE', 'FALSE'], 'Pilih TRUE/FALSE.');
  if (cCurrency) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(row, cCurrency, n, 1), ['IDR', 'USD'], 'Pilih Currency.');
  if (cRisk) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(row, cRisk, n, 1), buildRiskClassDropdownOptions_(), 'Pilih Risk Class. Check Rule otomatis disamakan berdasarkan ID.');
  if (cCheck) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(row, cCheck, n, 1), buildCheckRuleDropdownOptions_(), 'Pilih Check Rule. Risk Class otomatis disamakan berdasarkan ID.');

  const dateRule = buildDateValidationRule_('Isi tanggal valid dengan format DD/MM/YYYY.');
  for (let i = 0; i < dateCols.length; i++) {
    const c = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [dateCols[i]]);
    if (c) sh.getRange(row, c).setNumberFormat('dd/MM/yyyy').setDataValidation(dateRule);
  }
}

function resetCreditLimitConditionalFormats_(sh, hm) {
  sh.clearConditionalFormatRules();

  const cLimitNotDefine = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Limit Not Define']);
  const cLimitDefined = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Limit Defined']);
  const cInfoCategory = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Information Category']);
  const cInfoType = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Information Type']);
  const cAddTo = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Additional Limit Valid To']);
  const cRules = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Rules']);
  if (!cLimitNotDefine || !cLimitDefined || !cRules) return;

  const rightRange = sh.getRange(2, cLimitDefined, TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows - 1, cRules - cLimitDefined + 1);
  const lockedRightFormula = '=' + columnNumberToLetter_(cLimitNotDefine) + '2<>"FALSE"';
  const openRightFormula = '=' + columnNumberToLetter_(cLimitNotDefine) + '2="FALSE"';

  const newRules = [];
  newRules.push(SpreadsheetApp.newConditionalFormatRule()
    .whenFormulaSatisfied(lockedRightFormula)
    .setBackground(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.locked)
    .setFontColor(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.lockedFont)
    .setRanges([rightRange])
    .build());

  newRules.push(SpreadsheetApp.newConditionalFormatRule()
    .whenFormulaSatisfied(openRightFormula)
    .setBackground(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.input)
    .setFontColor('#000000')
    .setRanges([rightRange])
    .build());

  if (cInfoCategory && cInfoType && cAddTo) {
    const addRange = sh.getRange(2, cInfoType, TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows - 1, cAddTo - cInfoType + 1);
    const lockedAddFormula = '=AND(' + columnNumberToLetter_(cLimitNotDefine) + '2="FALSE",' + columnNumberToLetter_(cInfoCategory) + '2="")';
    const openAddFormula = '=AND(' + columnNumberToLetter_(cLimitNotDefine) + '2="FALSE",' + columnNumberToLetter_(cInfoCategory) + '2<>"")';

    newRules.push(SpreadsheetApp.newConditionalFormatRule()
      .whenFormulaSatisfied(lockedAddFormula)
      .setBackground(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.locked)
      .setFontColor(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.lockedFont)
      .setRanges([addRange])
      .build());

    newRules.push(SpreadsheetApp.newConditionalFormatRule()
      .whenFormulaSatisfied(openAddFormula)
      .setBackground(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.warning)
      .setFontColor('#000000')
      .setRanges([addRange])
      .build());
  }

  sh.setConditionalFormatRules(newRules);
}

/* =========================================================
 * SETUP: CHANGE ROLLING & CHANGE SCHEDULE
 * ========================================================= */

function setupChangeRollingAndScheduleSheet_(ss, idx) {
  const sh = getRequiredSheetByName_(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetRolling);
  ensureValidationStatusColumns_(sh);
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();

  formatHeaderRow_(sh, lastCol);
  sh.setFrozenRows(1);
  setColumnWidthsByHeaderName_(sh, hm, {
    'Sales Office': 180,
    'Customer ID': 150,
    'Relationship': 150,
    'Salesman ID': 160,
    'Salesman BP Type': 165,
    'Sales Type': 260,
    'Valid From': 140,
    'Valid To': 140,
    'Visit Category': 150,
    'Visit Type': 120,
    'Schedule Visit': 190,
    'Visit Valid From': 160,
    'Visit Valid To': 160,
    'Reason': 340,
    'Validation Status': 150,
    'Error Detail': 520
  });

  const nRows = TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows - 1;
  const cSalesOffice = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Office']);
  const cCustomer = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Customer ID']);
  const cRel = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Relationship']);
  const cSalesman = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Salesman ID']);
  const cBpType = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Salesman BP Type']);
  const cSalesType = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Type']);
  const cValidFrom = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Valid From']);
  const cValidTo = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Valid To']);
  const cVisitCategory = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Visit Category']);
  const cVisitType = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Visit Type']);
  const cSchedule = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Schedule Visit']);
  const cVisitFrom = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Visit Valid From']);
  const cVisitTo = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Visit Valid To']);

  if (cSalesOffice) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(2, cSalesOffice, nRows, 1), idx.salesOfficeOptions || [], 'Pilih Sales Office dari master em. ID-only juga diterima.');
  if (cRel) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(2, cRel, nRows, 1), RELATIONSHIP_OPTIONS, 'Pilih Relationship. ID-only juga diterima setelah normalisasi.');
  if (cVisitCategory) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(2, cVisitCategory, nRows, 1), VISIT_CATEGORY_OPTIONS, 'Visit Category hanya F1, F2, F4, atau F8.');
  if (cVisitType) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(2, cVisitType, nRows, 1), VISIT_TYPE_OPTIONS, 'Visit Type hanya 01 sampai 12. Gunakan format 2 digit.');
  if (cSalesType) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(2, cSalesType, nRows, 1), SALES_TYPE_OPTIONS, 'Pilih Sales Type. ID-only juga diterima setelah normalisasi.');

  const dateCols = [cValidFrom, cValidTo, cVisitFrom, cVisitTo].filter(Boolean);
  const ymdRule = buildDateValidationRule_('Tanggal wajib format YYYY-MM-DD. Contoh: 2026-05-01. Nilai 9999-12-31 diperbolehkan.');
  for (let i = 0; i < dateCols.length; i++) {
    sh.getRange(2, dateCols[i], nRows, 1)
      .setNumberFormat('yyyy-mm-dd')
      .setDataValidation(ymdRule);
  }

  const textCols = [cCustomer, cRel, cSalesman, cBpType, cSalesType, cVisitType, cSchedule].filter(Boolean);
  for (let i = 0; i < textCols.length; i++) {
    sh.getRange(2, textCols[i], nRows, 1).setNumberFormat('@');
  }

  if (cCustomer) sh.getRange(1, cCustomer).setNote('Front-end: wajib numerik. Khusus relationship salesman-to-salesman, Customer ID boleh diawali S jika Salesman ID juga diawali S; kolom I-M tidak wajib. Validasi exist di master BP tetap backend.');
  if (cRel) sh.getRange(1, cRel).setNote('Relationship LOV: ZWS001-ZWS022 dan BUR001. Dropdown menampilkan ID + description, nilai akhir disimpan ID only.');
  if (cSalesman) sh.getRange(1, cSalesman).setNote('Front-end: S + digit atau BP Dummy S00000/S0000T/S0000S/S0000M + kode office 4 karakter. Validasi exist tetap backend.');
  if (cBpType) sh.getRange(1, cBpType).setNote('Front-end: format ZDnn. Validasi kecocokan BP Type dengan Salesman tetap backend.');
  if (cSalesType) sh.getRange(1, cSalesType).setNote('Sales Type LOV New code S4. Wajib untuk Customer-to-Salesman rolling; tidak wajib untuk Salesman-to-Salesman / ZWS011 Superior. Dropdown menampilkan ID + description, nilai akhir disimpan ID only.');
  if (cVisitType) sh.getRange(1, cVisitType).setNote('Visit Type hanya 01 sampai 12, wajib 2 digit.');
  if (cSchedule) sh.getRange(1, cSchedule).setNote('Schedule Visit otomatis terfilter berdasarkan Visit Category. Format token: W1M, W2M, W3TH, dst. Separator comma tanpa spasi.');

  const lastDataRow = Math.min(Math.max(sh.getLastRow(), 2), TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows);
  if (lastDataRow >= 2 && cCustomer && cSalesman) {
    const startCol = Math.min(cCustomer, cSalesman, cVisitCategory || cCustomer);
    const endCol = Math.max(cCustomer, cSalesman, cVisitCategory || cSalesman, cSchedule || cSalesman);
    const block = sh.getRange(2, startCol, lastDataRow - 1, endCol - startCol + 1).getDisplayValues();
    for (let i = 0; i < block.length; i++) {
      const r = i + 2;
      const customerVal = cleanText_(block[i][cCustomer - startCol]);
      const salesmanVal = cleanText_(block[i][cSalesman - startCol]);
      const customerId = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(customerVal);
      const salesmanId = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(salesmanVal);
      if (!customerId && !salesmanId) continue;
      const isSalesmanPair = isSalesmanToSalesmanRolling_(customerId, salesmanId);
      if (isSalesmanPair) {
        applyLockedStateToRollingVisitSection_(sh, r);
      } else if (cVisitCategory && cSchedule) {
        const cat = cleanText_(block[i][cVisitCategory - startCol]).toUpperCase();
        applyRollingScheduleValidationFromCategory_(sh, r, cat, false);
      }
    }
  }

  // Setup tidak lagi meninggalkan seluruh sheet dalam status PENDING.
  // Full status dihitung otomatis oleh worker V28.3 setelah edit berikutnya.
}

function handleChangeRollingEditedRowsInBatch_(sh, editedRange, idx, startRow, endRow, isLargePaste) {
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const cSalesOffice = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Office']);
  const cPlant = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Delivering Plant']);
  const cCustomer = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Customer ID']);
  const cVisitCategory = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Visit Category']);
  const cVisitType = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Visit Type']);
  const cSchedule = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Schedule Visit']);
  const cRel = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Relationship']);
  const cSalesman = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Salesman ID']);
  const cBpType = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Salesman BP Type']);
  const cSalesType = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Type']);

  normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, cSalesOffice, 'CODE');
  normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, cPlant, 'CODE');
  normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, cCustomer, 'BP_ID');
  normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, cVisitCategory, 'CODE');
  normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, cVisitType, 'VISIT_TYPE');
  normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, cSchedule, 'SCHEDULE');
  normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, cRel, 'CODE');
  normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, cSalesman, 'SALESMAN');
  normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, cBpType, 'CODE');
  normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, cSalesType, 'ID');

  if (!isLargePaste) {
    for (let row = startRow; row <= endRow; row++) applyRollingVisitSectionState_(sh, row, true);
  }

  RSC_V28_2_MARK_EDITED_ROWS_VALIDATING_20260814_(sh, startRow, endRow);
}

function RSC_IS_S_PREFIX_ID_20260819_(value) {
  const id = normalizeSalesmanIdForValidation_(value);
  return /^S[A-Z0-9]+$/.test(id);
}

function isSalesmanToSalesmanRolling_(customerId, salesmanId) {
  // Business rule 2026-08-19: bila Customer ID dan Salesman ID sama-sama S*,
  // seluruh section visit tidak wajib. Validasi master Salesman tetap terpisah.
  return RSC_IS_S_PREFIX_ID_20260819_(customerId) &&
    RSC_IS_S_PREFIX_ID_20260819_(salesmanId);
}

/**
 * Normalisasi Salesman ID untuk seluruh validator.
 * Tetap menggunakan extractor existing supaya value seperti
 * "S091160257 - Nama" / value hasil dropdown tetap dibaca sebagai ID.
 */
function normalizeSalesmanIdForValidation_(value) {
  return normalizeRscCodeToken_(value);
}

/**
 * Salesman normal: huruf S diikuti digit.
 * Contoh: S091160257
 */
function isStandardSalesmanId_(value) {
  const id = normalizeSalesmanIdForValidation_(value);
  return /^S\d+$/.test(id);
}

/**
 * BP Dummy Salesman sesuai Prefix Mapping Business Partner:
 *   S00000 + 4-char kode office  -> Dummy
 *   S0000T + 4-char kode office  -> Trader
 *   S0000S + 4-char kode office  -> Subdist
 *   S0000M + 4-char kode office  -> Motoris Vacant
 *
 * Contoh:
 *   S000002AA0
 *   S0000T2AA0
 *   S0000S5AW0
 *   S0000M2AA0
 */
function isSalesmanDummyId_(value) {
  const id = normalizeSalesmanIdForValidation_(value);
  return /^S0000[0TSM][A-Z0-9]{4}$/.test(id);
}

/**
 * Format Salesman ID yang diterima oleh frontend/FSD.
 */
function isAllowedSalesmanId_(value) {
  return isStandardSalesmanId_(value) || isSalesmanDummyId_(value);
}

function getSalesmanIdValidationMessage_() {
  return 'Salesman ID harus berupa S + digit (contoh S091160257) ' +
    'atau BP Dummy: S00000/S0000T/S0000S/S0000M + kode office 4 karakter ' +
    '(contoh S000002AA0, S0000T2AA0, S0000S5AW0, S0000M2AA0).';
}

function isSalesmanIdLike_(value) {
  return isAllowedSalesmanId_(value);
}

function isSalesmanToSalesmanRollingRow_(sh, row) {
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const cCustomer = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Customer ID']);
  const cSalesman = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Salesman ID']);
  if (!cCustomer || !cSalesman) return false;
  const startCol = Math.min(cCustomer, cSalesman);
  const endCol = Math.max(cCustomer, cSalesman);
  const block = sh.getRange(row, startCol, 1, endCol - startCol + 1).getDisplayValues()[0];
  const customerId = cleanText_(block[cCustomer - startCol]);
  const salesmanId = cleanText_(block[cSalesman - startCol]);
  return isSalesmanToSalesmanRolling_(customerId, salesmanId);
}

function applyRollingVisitSectionState_(sh, row, clearWhenLocked) {
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const cols = getChangeRollingColumnIndexes_(hm);
  const visitColsArr = [
    cols.visitCategory,
    cols.visitType,
    cols.scheduleVisit,
    cols.visitValidFrom,
    cols.visitValidTo
  ].filter(Boolean);

  if (!visitColsArr.length) return;

  const isSalesmanPair = isSalesmanToSalesmanRollingRow_(sh, row);
  const startCol = Math.min.apply(null, visitColsArr);
  const endCol = Math.max.apply(null, visitColsArr);
  const visitRange = sh.getRange(row, startCol, 1, endCol - startCol + 1);

  if (isSalesmanPair) {
    if (clearWhenLocked) visitRange.clearContent();
    visitRange.clearDataValidations();
    applyLockedVisualStyle_(visitRange, true);
    visitRange.setNote('Tidak wajib diisi karena Customer ID dan Salesman ID sama-sama BP Salesman / diawali S.');
    return;
  }

  applyLockedVisualStyle_(visitRange, false);
  visitRange.clearNote();

  if (cols.visitCategory) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(row, cols.visitCategory), VISIT_CATEGORY_OPTIONS, 'Visit Category hanya F1, F2, F4, atau F8.');
  if (cols.visitType) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(row, cols.visitType), VISIT_TYPE_OPTIONS, 'Visit Type hanya 01 sampai 12. Gunakan format 2 digit.');
  const visitDateRule = buildDateValidationRule_('Tanggal wajib format YYYY-MM-DD. Contoh: 2026-05-01.');
  const dateCols = [cols.visitValidFrom, cols.visitValidTo].filter(Boolean);
  for (let i = 0; i < dateCols.length; i++) {
    sh.getRange(row, dateCols[i])
      .setNumberFormat('yyyy-mm-dd')
      .setDataValidation(visitDateRule);
  }
  applyRollingScheduleValidation_(sh, row, false);
}

function applyLockedStateToRollingVisitSection_(sh, row) {
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const cols = getChangeRollingColumnIndexes_(hm);
  const visitColsArr = [
