    cols.visitCategory,
    cols.visitType,
    cols.scheduleVisit,
    cols.visitValidFrom,
    cols.visitValidTo
  ].filter(Boolean);
  if (!visitColsArr.length) return;
  const startCol = Math.min.apply(null, visitColsArr);
  const endCol = Math.max.apply(null, visitColsArr);
  const visitRange = sh.getRange(row, startCol, 1, endCol - startCol + 1);
  visitRange.clearDataValidations();
  applyLockedVisualStyle_(visitRange, true);
  visitRange.setNote('Tidak wajib diisi karena Customer ID dan Salesman ID sama-sama BP Salesman / diawali S.');
}

function applyRollingScheduleValidation_(sh, row, cleanInvalid) {
  if (isSalesmanToSalesmanRollingRow_(sh, row)) return;
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const cVisitCategory = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Visit Category']);
  const cSchedule = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Schedule Visit']);
  if (!cVisitCategory || !cSchedule) return;

  const category = cleanText_(sh.getRange(row, cVisitCategory).getDisplayValue()).toUpperCase();
  applyRollingScheduleValidationFromCategory_(sh, row, category, cleanInvalid);
}

function applyRollingScheduleValidationFromCategory_(sh, row, category, cleanInvalid) {
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const cSchedule = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Schedule Visit']);
  if (!cSchedule) return;
  const scheduleCell = sh.getRange(row, cSchedule);
  const options = getScheduleVisitOptionsForCategory_(category);

  if (!category || !VISIT_CATEGORY_SET.has(category)) {
    scheduleCell.clearDataValidations();
    applyLockedVisualStyle_(scheduleCell, true);
    if (cleanInvalid) scheduleCell.clearContent();
    return;
  }

  setDropdownValidation_(scheduleCell, options, 'Schedule Visit terfilter berdasarkan Visit Category ' + category + '. Contoh token: W1M, W2M, W3TH.');
  applyLockedVisualStyle_(scheduleCell, false);

  if (cleanInvalid) {
    const current = normalizeScheduleForComparison_(scheduleCell.getDisplayValue());
    const optSet = getScheduleVisitOptionSetForCategory_(category);
    if (current && !optSet.has(current)) scheduleCell.clearContent();
  }
}

/* =========================================================
 * SETUP: CHANGE SALES OFFICE
 * ========================================================= */

function setupChangeSalesOfficeSheet_(ss, idx) {
  const sh = getRequiredSheetByName_(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetSalesOfficeChange);
  ensureValidationStatusColumns_(sh);
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  const nRows = TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows - 1;

  formatHeaderRow_(sh, lastCol);
  sh.setFrozenRows(1);
  setColumnWidthsByHeaderName_(sh, hm, {
    'BP Number Source': 180,
    'Delivering Plant': 160,
    'Distr. Channel': 230,
    'Distribution Channel': 230,
    'Division': 230,
    'Sales Organization': 230,
    'Sales Office': 230,
    'Validation Status': 150,
    'Error Detail': 520
  });

  const cBp = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['BP Number Source']);
  const cPlant = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Delivering Plant']);
  const cSalesOrg = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org']);
  const cDist = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Distr. Channel', 'Distribution Channel', 'Distribution channel']);
  const cDiv = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Division']);
  const cSalesOffice = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Office']);

  if (cBp) sh.getRange(2, cBp, nRows, 1).setNumberFormat('@');
  if (cPlant) sh.getRange(2, cPlant, nRows, 1).setNumberFormat('@');
  if (cSalesOrg) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(2, cSalesOrg, nRows, 1), idx.salesOrgOptions, 'Pilih Sales Org. Distribution Channel, Division, dan Sales Office akan terfilter otomatis. ID-only juga diterima.');

  const lockCols = [cDist, cDiv, cSalesOffice].filter(Boolean);
  for (let i = 0; i < lockCols.length; i++) {
    applyLockedVisualStyle_(sh.getRange(2, lockCols[i], nRows, 1), true);
  }

  const lastDataRow = Math.min(Math.max(sh.getLastRow(), 2), TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows);
  if (lastDataRow >= 2 && cSalesOrg && cDist && cDiv && cSalesOffice) {
    const startCol = Math.min(cSalesOrg, cDist, cDiv, cSalesOffice);
    const endCol = Math.max(cSalesOrg, cDist, cDiv, cSalesOffice);
    const block = sh.getRange(2, startCol, lastDataRow - 1, endCol - startCol + 1).getDisplayValues();
    for (let i = 0; i < block.length; i++) {
      const so = cleanText_(block[i][cSalesOrg - startCol]);
      const dist = cleanText_(block[i][cDist - startCol]);
      const div = cleanText_(block[i][cDiv - startCol]);
      const off = cleanText_(block[i][cSalesOffice - startCol]);
      if (!so && !dist && !div && !off) continue;
      applyChangeSalesOfficeRowState_(sh, i + 2, idx, false);
    }
  }

  validateSalesOfficeChangeSheet_(sh, idx, false);
}

function handleChangeSalesOfficeEditedRowsInBatch_(sh, editedRange, idx, startRow, endRow, isLargePaste) {
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const cSalesOrg = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org']);
  const cDist = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Distr. Channel', 'Distribution Channel', 'Distribution channel']);
  const cDiv = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Division']);
  const cSalesOffice = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Office']);
  const cPlant = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Delivering Plant']);

  normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, cPlant, 'CODE');

  if (doesEditedRangeTouchColumn_(editedRange, cSalesOrg)) {
    normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, cSalesOrg, 'ID');
    clearEditedColumnValues_(sh, startRow, endRow, cDist);
    clearEditedColumnValues_(sh, startRow, endRow, cDiv);
    clearEditedColumnValues_(sh, startRow, endRow, cSalesOffice);
  }
  if (doesEditedRangeTouchColumn_(editedRange, cDist)) {
    normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, cDist, 'ID');
    clearEditedColumnValues_(sh, startRow, endRow, cDiv);
    clearEditedColumnValues_(sh, startRow, endRow, cSalesOffice);
  }
  if (doesEditedRangeTouchColumn_(editedRange, cDiv)) {
    normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, cDiv, 'ID');
    clearEditedColumnValues_(sh, startRow, endRow, cSalesOffice);
  }
  normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, cSalesOffice, 'ID');

  if (!isLargePaste) {
    for (let row = startRow; row <= endRow; row++) applyChangeSalesOfficeRowState_(sh, row, idx, true);
  }

  RSC_STD_MARK_EDITED_ROWS_PENDING_20260814_(sh, startRow, endRow);
}

function applyChangeSalesOfficeRowState_(sh, row, idx, cleanInvalid) {
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const cSalesOrg = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org']);
  const cDist = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Distr. Channel', 'Distribution Channel', 'Distribution channel']);
  const cDiv = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Division']);
  const cSalesOffice = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Office']);
  if (!cSalesOrg || !cDist || !cDiv || !cSalesOffice) return;

  const startCol = Math.min(cSalesOrg, cDist, cDiv, cSalesOffice);
  const endCol = Math.max(cSalesOrg, cDist, cDiv, cSalesOffice);
  const block = sh.getRange(row, startCol, 1, endCol - startCol + 1).getDisplayValues()[0];
  const so = cleanText_(block[cSalesOrg - startCol]);
  const dist = cleanText_(block[cDist - startCol]);
  const div = cleanText_(block[cDiv - startCol]);

  setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(row, cSalesOrg), idx.salesOrgOptions, 'Pilih Sales Org. ID-only juga diterima.');

  if (!so) {
    sh.getRange(row, cDist, 1, 3).clearDataValidations();
    applyLockedVisualStyle_(sh.getRange(row, cDist, 1, 3), true);
    if (cleanInvalid) sh.getRange(row, cDist, 1, 3).clearContent();
    return;
  }

  // V12: lookup pakai bare ID (so might be "STA1" atau "STA1 - STA - CG Sales"
  // tergantung apakah cell sudah dinormalisasi). Pakai extractRollingRelationshipToken_
  // untuk dapat ID secara konsisten.
  const soId = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(so);
  const distOptions = idx.distOptionsBySalesOrg[soId] || idx.distOptionsBySalesOrg[so] || [];
  setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(row, cDist), distOptions, 'Distribution Channel terfilter berdasarkan Sales Org. ID-only juga diterima.');
  applyLockedVisualStyle_(sh.getRange(row, cDist), false);

  if (!dist || !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(dist, distOptions)) {
    sh.getRange(row, cDiv, 1, 2).clearDataValidations();
    applyLockedVisualStyle_(sh.getRange(row, cDiv, 1, 2), true);
    if (cleanInvalid && dist && !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(dist, distOptions)) sh.getRange(row, cDiv, 1, 2).clearContent();
    if (!dist) return;
    return;
  }

  const distId = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(dist);
  const divOptions = idx.divOptionsBySalesOrgDist[soId + '|' + distId] || idx.divOptionsBySalesOrgDist[so + '|' + dist] || [];
  setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(row, cDiv), divOptions, 'Division terfilter berdasarkan Sales Org + Distribution Channel. ID-only juga diterima.');
  applyLockedVisualStyle_(sh.getRange(row, cDiv), false);

  if (!div || !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(div, divOptions)) {
    sh.getRange(row, cSalesOffice).clearDataValidations();
    applyLockedVisualStyle_(sh.getRange(row, cSalesOffice), true);
    if (cleanInvalid && div && !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(div, divOptions)) sh.getRange(row, cSalesOffice).clearContent();
    return;
  }

  const divId = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(div);
  const soOptions = idx.salesOfficeOptionsBySoDistDiv[soId + '|' + distId + '|' + divId] || idx.salesOfficeOptionsBySoDistDiv[so + '|' + dist + '|' + div] || [];
  setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(row, cSalesOffice), soOptions, 'Sales Office terfilter berdasarkan Sales Org + Distribution Channel + Division. ID-only juga diterima.');
  applyLockedVisualStyle_(sh.getRange(row, cSalesOffice), false);

  if (cleanInvalid) {
    const salesOffice = cleanText_(block[cSalesOffice - startCol]);
    if (salesOffice && !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(salesOffice, soOptions)) sh.getRange(row, cSalesOffice).clearContent();
  }
}

/* =========================================================
 * SETUP: CHANGE SALESMAN TYPE
 * ========================================================= */

function setupChangeSalesmanTypeSheet_(ss, idx) {
  const sh = getRequiredSheetByName_(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetSalesmanTypeChange);
  ensureValidationStatusColumns_(sh);
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  const nRows = TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows - 1;

  formatHeaderRow_(sh, lastCol);
  sh.setFrozenRows(1);
  setColumnWidthsByHeaderName_(sh, hm, {
    'Salesman ID': 160,
    'Sales Organization': 230,
    'Sales Office': 230,
    'Sales Type': 310,
    'Coverage': 180,
    'Valid From': 140,
    'Valid To': 140,
    'Validation Status': 150,
    'Error Detail': 520
  });

  const cSalesman = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Salesman ID']);
  const cSalesOrg = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org']);
  const cSalesOffice = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Office']);
  const cSalesType = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Type']);
  const cCoverage = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Coverage']);
  const cValidFrom = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Valid From']);
  const cValidTo = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Valid To']);

  const textCols = [cSalesman, cSalesOrg, cSalesOffice, cSalesType, cCoverage].filter(Boolean);
  for (let i = 0; i < textCols.length; i++) {
    sh.getRange(2, textCols[i], nRows, 1).setNumberFormat('@');
  }

  if (cSalesOrg) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(2, cSalesOrg, nRows, 1), idx.salesOrgOptions, 'Pilih Sales Org. Sales Office akan terfilter otomatis. ID-only juga diterima.');
  if (cSalesType) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(2, cSalesType, nRows, 1), SALES_TYPE_OPTIONS, 'Pilih Sales Type. ID-only juga diterima setelah normalisasi.');
  if (cSalesOffice) applyLockedVisualStyle_(sh.getRange(2, cSalesOffice, nRows, 1), true);

  const dateCols = [cValidFrom, cValidTo].filter(Boolean);
  const ymdRule = buildDateValidationRule_('Tanggal wajib format YYYY-MM-DD. Contoh: 2026-05-01.');
  for (let i = 0; i < dateCols.length; i++) {
    sh.getRange(2, dateCols[i], nRows, 1)
      .setNumberFormat('yyyy-mm-dd')
      .setDataValidation(ymdRule);
  }

  if (cSalesman) sh.getRange(1, cSalesman).setNote('Front-end: S + digit atau BP Dummy S00000/S0000T/S0000S/S0000M + kode office 4 karakter. Validasi exist tetap backend.');
  if (cSalesType) sh.getRange(1, cSalesType).setNote('Sales Type LOV New code S4. Dropdown menampilkan ID + description, nilai akhir disimpan ID only.');
  if (cSalesOffice) sh.getRange(1, cSalesOffice).setNote('Sales Office terfilter berdasarkan Sales Organization dari sheet em.');

  const lastDataRow = Math.min(Math.max(sh.getLastRow(), 2), TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows);
  if (lastDataRow >= 2 && cSalesOrg && cSalesOffice) {
    const startCol = Math.min(cSalesOrg, cSalesOffice);
    const endCol = Math.max(cSalesOrg, cSalesOffice);
    const block = sh.getRange(2, startCol, lastDataRow - 1, endCol - startCol + 1).getDisplayValues();
    for (let i = 0; i < block.length; i++) {
      const so = cleanText_(block[i][cSalesOrg - startCol]);
      const off = cleanText_(block[i][cSalesOffice - startCol]);
      if (!so && !off) continue;
      applyChangeSalesmanTypeRowState_(sh, i + 2, idx, false);
    }
  }

  validateSalesmanTypeSheet_(sh, idx, false);
}

function handleChangeSalesmanTypeEditedRowsInBatch_(sh, editedRange, idx, startRow, endRow, isLargePaste) {
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const cSalesman = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Salesman ID']);
  const cSalesOrg = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org']);
  const cSalesOffice = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Office']);
  const cSalesType = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Type']);

  normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, cSalesman, 'SALESMAN');
  if (doesEditedRangeTouchColumn_(editedRange, cSalesOrg)) {
    normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, cSalesOrg, 'ID');
    clearEditedColumnValues_(sh, startRow, endRow, cSalesOffice);
  }
  normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, cSalesOffice, 'ID');
  normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, cSalesType, 'ID');

  if (!isLargePaste) {
    for (let row = startRow; row <= endRow; row++) applyChangeSalesmanTypeRowState_(sh, row, idx, true);
  }

  RSC_STD_MARK_EDITED_ROWS_PENDING_20260814_(sh, startRow, endRow);
}

function applyChangeSalesmanTypeRowState_(sh, row, idx, cleanInvalid) {
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const cSalesOrg = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org']);
  const cSalesOffice = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Office']);
  const cSalesType = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Type']);
  if (cSalesOrg) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(row, cSalesOrg), idx.salesOrgOptions, 'Pilih Sales Org. ID-only juga diterima.');
  if (cSalesType) setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(row, cSalesType), SALES_TYPE_OPTIONS, 'Pilih Sales Type. ID-only juga diterima.');
  if (!cSalesOrg || !cSalesOffice) return;

  const startCol = Math.min(cSalesOrg, cSalesOffice);
  const endCol = Math.max(cSalesOrg, cSalesOffice);
  const block = sh.getRange(row, startCol, 1, endCol - startCol + 1).getDisplayValues()[0];
  const salesOrg = cleanText_(block[cSalesOrg - startCol]);

  if (!salesOrg) {
    sh.getRange(row, cSalesOffice).clearDataValidations();
    applyLockedVisualStyle_(sh.getRange(row, cSalesOffice), true);
    if (cleanInvalid) sh.getRange(row, cSalesOffice).clearContent();
    return;
  }

  // V12: lookup pakai bare ID supaya match dengan em index key.
  const salesOrgId = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(salesOrg);
  const officeOptions = idx.salesOfficeOptionsBySalesOrg[salesOrgId] || idx.salesOfficeOptionsBySalesOrg[salesOrg] || [];
  setDropdownValidation_(sh.getRange(row, cSalesOffice), officeOptions, 'Sales Office terfilter berdasarkan Sales Organization. ID-only juga diterima.');
  applyLockedVisualStyle_(sh.getRange(row, cSalesOffice), false);

  if (cleanInvalid) {
    const currentOffice = cleanText_(block[cSalesOffice - startCol]);
    if (currentOffice && !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(currentOffice, officeOptions)) sh.getRange(row, cSalesOffice).clearContent();
  }
}

/* =========================================================
 * VALIDATION (BATCH): CHANGE SALESMAN TYPE
 * ========================================================= */

function validateSalesmanTypeSheet_(sh, idx, showToast) {
  ensureValidationStatusColumns_(sh);
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const cSalesman = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Salesman ID']);
  const cSalesOrg = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org']);
  const cSalesOffice = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Office']);
  const cSalesType = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Type']);
  const cCoverage = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Coverage']);
  const cValidFrom = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Valid From']);
  const cValidTo = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Valid To']);
  const cStatus = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.validationStatusHeader]);
  const cDetail = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.errorDetailHeader]);

  const lastRow = Math.min(Math.max(sh.getLastRow(), 2), TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows);
  if (lastRow < 2 || !cStatus || !cDetail) {
    if (showToast) SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast('Tidak ada data untuk divalidasi.', 'Change Salesman Type Validation', 4);
    return 0;
  }

  const dataLastCol = cStatus - 1;
  const dataValues = sh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, dataLastCol).getDisplayValues();
  const numRows = dataValues.length;

  const duplicateMap = {};
  const rowErrors = new Array(numRows);
  const rowHasData = new Array(numRows);
  let dataRows = 0;

  const idxSalesman = (cSalesman || 0) - 1;
  const idxSalesOrg = (cSalesOrg || 0) - 1;
  const idxSalesOffice = (cSalesOffice || 0) - 1;
  const idxSalesType = (cSalesType || 0) - 1;
  const idxCoverage = (cCoverage || 0) - 1;
  const idxValidFrom = (cValidFrom || 0) - 1;
  const idxValidTo = (cValidTo || 0) - 1;

  for (let i = 0; i < numRows; i++) {
    const r = dataValues[i];
    if (isRowCompletelyBlank_(r)) {
      rowErrors[i] = null;
      rowHasData[i] = false;
      continue;
    }
    rowHasData[i] = true;
    dataRows++;

    const salesmanId = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(r[idxSalesman] || '');
    const salesOrg = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(r[idxSalesOrg] || '');
    const salesOffice = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(r[idxSalesOffice] || '');
    const salesType = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(r[idxSalesType] || '');
    const coverage = idxCoverage >= 0 ? cleanText_(r[idxCoverage] || '') : '';
    const validFrom = cleanText_(r[idxValidFrom] || '');
    const validTo = cleanText_(r[idxValidTo] || '');
    const err = [];

    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, salesmanId, 'Salesman ID wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, salesOrg, 'Sales Organization wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, salesOffice, 'Sales Office wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, salesType, 'Sales Type wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, validFrom, 'Valid From wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, validTo, 'Valid To wajib diisi.');

    if (salesmanId && !isAllowedSalesmanId_(salesmanId)) err.push(getSalesmanIdValidationMessage_());
    if (salesOrg && !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(salesOrg, idx.salesOrgOptions || [])) err.push('Sales Organization tidak valid berdasarkan sheet em.');

    const officeOptions = idx.salesOfficeOptionsBySalesOrg[salesOrg] || [];
    if (salesOrg && salesOffice && !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(salesOffice, officeOptions)) err.push('Sales Office tidak relevan untuk Sales Organization yang dipilih.');
    if (salesType && !SALES_TYPE_ID_SET.has(salesType)) err.push('Sales Type harus dipilih dari LOV New code S4.');

    const dValidFrom = parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(validFrom);
    const dValidTo = parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(validTo);
    if (validFrom && !dValidFrom) err.push('Valid From harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
    if (validTo && !dValidTo) err.push('Valid To harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
    if (dValidFrom && dValidTo && dValidTo.getTime() <= dValidFrom.getTime()) err.push('Valid To harus lebih besar dari Valid From.');

    if (salesmanId && salesOrg && salesOffice && salesType && validTo) {
      const dupKey = [salesmanId, salesOrg, salesOffice, salesType, coverage, validTo].join('|').toUpperCase();
      if (!duplicateMap[dupKey]) duplicateMap[dupKey] = [];
      duplicateMap[dupKey].push(i);
    }
    rowErrors[i] = err;
  }

  const dupKeys = Object.keys(duplicateMap);
  for (let i = 0; i < dupKeys.length; i++) {
    const rows = duplicateMap[dupKeys[i]];
    if (rows.length > 1) {
      for (let j = 0; j < rows.length; j++) {
        rowErrors[rows[j]].push('Baris duplikat dalam template untuk Salesman + Sales Org + Sales Office + Sales Type + Coverage + Valid To yang sama.');
      }
    }
  }

  const errorRows = writeValidationStatusForFullSheet_(sh, cStatus, cDetail, rowErrors, rowHasData);

  if (showToast) {
    const msg = errorRows ? 'Validasi selesai: ' + errorRows + ' row error dari ' + dataRows + ' row berisi data.' : 'Validasi selesai: semua row front-end OK.';
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(msg, 'Change Salesman Type Validation', 8);
  }
  return errorRows;
}

/* =========================================================
 * VALIDATION (BATCH): CHANGE ROLLING
 * ========================================================= */

function validateRollingSheet_(sh, idx, showToast) {
  ensureValidationStatusColumns_(sh);
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const cols = getChangeRollingColumnIndexes_(hm);
  const cStatus = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.validationStatusHeader]);
  const cDetail = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.errorDetailHeader]);
  const lastRow = Math.min(Math.max(sh.getLastRow(), 2), TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows);

  if (lastRow < 2 || !cStatus || !cDetail) {
    if (showToast) SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast('Tidak ada data untuk divalidasi.', 'Change Rolling Validation', 4);
    return 0;
  }

  const dataLastCol = cStatus - 1;
  const dataValues = sh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, dataLastCol).getDisplayValues();
  const numRows = dataValues.length;

  const rowErrors = new Array(numRows);
  const rowHasData = new Array(numRows);
  const scheduleByCustomerSalesman = {};
  const compositeMap = {};
  let dataRows = 0;

  const colKeys = Object.keys(cols);
  const idxMap = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < colKeys.length; i++) {
    idxMap[colKeys[i]] = (cols[colKeys[i]] || 0) - 1;
  }

  const salesOfficeOptions = idx.salesOfficeOptions || [];

  for (let i = 0; i < numRows; i++) {
    const r = dataValues[i];
    if (isRowCompletelyBlank_(r)) {
      rowErrors[i] = null;
      rowHasData[i] = false;
      continue;
    }
    rowHasData[i] = true;
    dataRows++;

    const v = {
      salesOffice: extractRollingRelationshipToken_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.salesOffice)),
      customerId: extractRollingRelationshipToken_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.customerId)),
      relationship: extractRollingRelationshipToken_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.relationship)),
      salesmanId: extractRollingRelationshipToken_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.salesmanId)),
      salesmanBpType: extractRollingRelationshipToken_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.salesmanBpType)),
      salesType: extractRollingRelationshipToken_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.salesType)),
      validFrom: cleanText_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.validFrom)),
      validTo: cleanText_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.validTo)),
      visitCategory: cleanText_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.visitCategory)).toUpperCase(),
      visitType: cleanText_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.visitType)),
      scheduleVisit: cleanText_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.scheduleVisit)),
      visitValidFrom: cleanText_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.visitValidFrom)),
      visitValidTo: cleanText_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.visitValidTo)),
      reason: cleanText_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.reason))
    };

    const isSalesmanPair = isSalesmanToSalesmanRolling_(v.customerId, v.salesmanId);
    const err = [];

    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.salesOffice, 'Sales Office wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.customerId, 'Customer ID wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.relationship, 'Relationship wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.salesmanId, 'Salesman ID wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.salesmanBpType, 'Salesman BP Type wajib diisi.');
    if (!isSalesmanPair && cols.salesType) addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.salesType, 'Sales Type wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.validFrom, 'Valid From wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.validTo, 'Valid To wajib diisi.');

    if (!isSalesmanPair) {
      addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.visitCategory, 'Visit Category wajib diisi.');
      addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.visitType, 'Visit Type wajib diisi.');
      addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.scheduleVisit, 'Schedule Visit wajib diisi.');
      addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.visitValidFrom, 'Visit Valid From wajib diisi.');
      addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.visitValidTo, 'Visit Valid To wajib diisi.');
    }

    if (v.salesOffice && !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(v.salesOffice, salesOfficeOptions)) err.push('Sales Office tidak ada di master em.');

    if (v.customerId) {
      const customerNumeric = /^\d+$/.test(v.customerId);
      const customerIsSalesman = isAllowedSalesmanId_(v.customerId);
      if (!customerNumeric && !customerIsSalesman) {
        err.push('Customer ID harus numerik, kecuali jika Customer ID dan Salesman ID sama-sama diawali S.');
      } else if (customerIsSalesman && !isSalesmanPair) {
        err.push('Jika Customer ID diawali S, maka Salesman ID juga harus diawali S agar kolom I-M tidak wajib diisi.');
      }
    }

    if (v.relationship && !RELATIONSHIP_ID_SET.has(v.relationship.toUpperCase())) err.push('Relationship harus dipilih dari LOV: ZWS001-ZWS022 atau BUR001.');
    if (v.salesmanId && !isAllowedSalesmanId_(v.salesmanId)) err.push(getSalesmanIdValidationMessage_());
    if (v.salesmanBpType && !/^ZD\d{2}$/i.test(v.salesmanBpType)) err.push('Salesman BP Type harus format ZDnn, contoh ZD01.');
    if (v.salesType && !SALES_TYPE_ID_SET.has(v.salesType.toUpperCase())) err.push('Sales Type harus dipilih dari LOV New code S4.');

    if (!isSalesmanPair) {
      if (v.visitCategory && !VISIT_CATEGORY_SET.has(v.visitCategory)) err.push('Visit Category harus F1, F2, F4, atau F8.');
      if (v.visitType && !VISIT_TYPE_SET.has(v.visitType)) err.push("Visit Type harus 01 sampai 12 dan tetap 2 digit, contoh '03'.");
    }

    const dValidFrom = parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(v.validFrom);
    const dValidTo = parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(v.validTo);
    const dVisitFrom = isSalesmanPair ? null : parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(v.visitValidFrom);
    const dVisitTo = isSalesmanPair ? null : parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(v.visitValidTo);

    if (v.validFrom && !dValidFrom) err.push('Valid From harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
    if (v.validTo && !dValidTo) err.push('Valid To harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
    if (v.validTo && v.validTo !== '9999-12-31' && !isTokoBangkrutReason_(v.reason)) err.push('Valid To harus selalu 9999-12-31 untuk Change Rolling, kecuali Reason berisi Toko Bangkrut.');
    if (!isSalesmanPair) {
      if (v.visitValidFrom && !dVisitFrom) err.push('Visit Valid From harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
      if (v.visitValidTo && !dVisitTo) err.push('Visit Valid To harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
    }

    if (dValidFrom && dValidTo && dValidTo.getTime() <= dValidFrom.getTime()) err.push('Valid To harus lebih besar dari Valid From.');
    if (!isSalesmanPair && dVisitFrom && dVisitTo && dVisitTo.getTime() <= dVisitFrom.getTime()) err.push('Visit Valid To harus lebih besar dari Visit Valid From.');
    if (!isSalesmanPair && dValidFrom && dValidTo && dVisitFrom && dVisitTo) {
      if (dVisitFrom.getTime() < dValidFrom.getTime() || dVisitTo.getTime() > dValidTo.getTime()) {
        err.push('Periode Visit Valid harus berada di dalam Valid From - Valid To.');
      }
    }

    if (!isSalesmanPair && v.visitCategory && v.scheduleVisit) {
      const scheduleErrors = validateScheduleVisitValue_(v.visitCategory, v.scheduleVisit);
      for (let k = 0; k < scheduleErrors.length; k++) err.push(scheduleErrors[k]);
    }

    if (!isSalesmanPair && v.customerId && v.salesmanId && v.scheduleVisit) {
      const key = v.customerId + '|' + v.salesmanId;
      const sched = normalizeScheduleForComparison_(v.scheduleVisit);
      if (!scheduleByCustomerSalesman[key]) scheduleByCustomerSalesman[key] = {};
      if (!scheduleByCustomerSalesman[key][sched]) scheduleByCustomerSalesman[key][sched] = [];
      scheduleByCustomerSalesman[key][sched].push(i);
    }

    // Canonical composite key Change Rolling:
    // Customer ID + Relationship + Salesman ID + Valid From + Visit Type + Visit Valid From.
    // Visit Type dinormalisasi ke 2 digit agar 2, 02, dan 2.0 memakai key yang sama.
    if (v.customerId && v.relationship && v.salesmanId && v.validFrom) {
      const visitTypeKey = normalizeRollingTemplateVisitTypeKey_(v.visitType);
      const key = [
        v.customerId,
        v.relationship.toUpperCase(),
        v.salesmanId.toUpperCase(),
        v.validFrom,
        visitTypeKey,
        v.visitValidFrom
      ].join('|');
      if (!compositeMap[key]) compositeMap[key] = [];
      compositeMap[key].push(i);
    }

    rowErrors[i] = err;
  }

  const csKeys = Object.keys(scheduleByCustomerSalesman);
  for (let i = 0; i < csKeys.length; i++) {
    const schedules = Object.keys(scheduleByCustomerSalesman[csKeys[i]]);
    if (schedules.length > 1) {
      for (let s = 0; s < schedules.length; s++) {
        const rs = scheduleByCustomerSalesman[csKeys[i]][schedules[s]];
        for (let r = 0; r < rs.length; r++) {
          rowErrors[rs[r]].push('Customer ID + Salesman ID yang sama tidak boleh memiliki Schedule Visit berbeda di baris lain.');
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const compKeys = Object.keys(compositeMap);
  for (let i = 0; i < compKeys.length; i++) {
    const rows = compositeMap[compKeys[i]];
    if (rows.length > 1) {
      for (let j = 0; j < rows.length; j++) {
        rowErrors[rows[j]].push('Composite key Customer ID + Relationship + Salesman ID + Valid From + Visit Type + Visit Valid From duplikat dalam template.');
      }
    }
  }

  const errorRows = writeValidationStatusForFullSheet_(sh, cStatus, cDetail, rowErrors, rowHasData);

  if (showToast) {
    const msg = errorRows ? 'Validasi selesai: ' + errorRows + ' row error dari ' + dataRows + ' row berisi data.' : 'Validasi selesai: semua row front-end OK.';
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(msg, 'Change Rolling Validation', 8);
  }
  return errorRows;
}

function getChangeRollingColumnIndexes_(hm) {
  return {
    salesOffice: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Office']),
    customerId: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Customer ID', 'Customer Id', 'CustomerID']),
    relationship: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Relationship', 'Relationship Type', 'Relationship ID']),
    salesmanId: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Salesman ID', 'Salesman Id', 'SalesmanID']),
    salesmanBpType: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Salesman BP Type', 'Salesman BPType', 'BP Type']),
    salesType: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Type']),
    validFrom: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Valid From']),
    validTo: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Valid To']),
    visitCategory: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Visit Category']),
    visitType: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Visit Type']),
    scheduleVisit: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Schedule Visit']),
    visitValidFrom: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Visit Valid From']),
    visitValidTo: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Visit Valid To']),
    reason: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Reason'])
  };
}

function isTokoBangkrutReason_(reason) {
  return cleanText_(reason).toUpperCase().indexOf('TOKO BANGKRUT') !== -1;
}

/* =========================================================
 * VALIDATION (BATCH): CHANGE SALES OFFICE
 * ========================================================= */

function validateSalesOfficeChangeSheet_(sh, idx, showToast) {
  ensureValidationStatusColumns_(sh);
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const cBp = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['BP Number Source']);
  const cPlant = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Delivering Plant']);
  const cDist = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Distr. Channel', 'Distribution Channel', 'Distribution channel']);
  const cDiv = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Division']);
  const cSalesOrg = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org']);
  const cSalesOffice = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Office']);
  const cStatus = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.validationStatusHeader]);
  const cDetail = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.errorDetailHeader]);

  const lastRow = Math.min(Math.max(sh.getLastRow(), 2), TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows);
  if (lastRow < 2 || !cStatus || !cDetail) {
    if (showToast) SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast('Tidak ada data untuk divalidasi.', 'Change Sales Office Validation', 4);
    return 0;
  }

  const dataLastCol = cStatus - 1;
  const dataValues = sh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, dataLastCol).getDisplayValues();
  const numRows = dataValues.length;

  const duplicateMap = {};
  const rowErrors = new Array(numRows);
  const rowHasData = new Array(numRows);
  let dataRows = 0;

  const idxBp = (cBp || 0) - 1;
  const idxPlant = (cPlant || 0) - 1;
  const idxDist = (cDist || 0) - 1;
  const idxDiv = (cDiv || 0) - 1;
  const idxSalesOrg = (cSalesOrg || 0) - 1;
  const idxSalesOffice = (cSalesOffice || 0) - 1;

  const salesOrgOptions = idx.salesOrgOptions || [];

  for (let i = 0; i < numRows; i++) {
    const r = dataValues[i];
    if (isRowCompletelyBlank_(r)) {
      rowErrors[i] = null;
      rowHasData[i] = false;
      continue;
    }
    rowHasData[i] = true;
    dataRows++;

    const bp = cleanText_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxBp));
    const plant = cleanText_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxPlant)).toUpperCase();
    const dist = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxDist));
    const div = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxDiv));
    const so = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxSalesOrg));
    const salesOffice = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxSalesOffice));
    const err = [];

    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, bp, 'BP Number Source wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, plant, 'Delivering Plant wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, so, 'Sales Organization wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, dist, 'Distribution Channel wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, div, 'Division wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, salesOffice, 'Sales Office wajib diisi.');

    if (bp && !/^\d+$/.test(bp)) err.push('BP Number Source harus numerik.');
    if (plant && !/^[A-Z0-9]{4}$/.test(plant)) err.push('Delivering Plant harus 4 karakter alphanumeric, contoh J001.');
    if (so && !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(so, salesOrgOptions)) err.push('Sales Organization tidak valid berdasarkan sheet em.');

    const distOptions = idx.distOptionsBySalesOrg[so] || [];
    if (so && dist && !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(dist, distOptions)) err.push('Distribution Channel tidak relevan untuk Sales Organization yang dipilih.');

    const divOptions = idx.divOptionsBySalesOrgDist[so + '|' + dist] || [];
    if (so && dist && div && !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(div, divOptions)) err.push('Division tidak relevan untuk kombinasi Sales Org + Distribution Channel.');

    const salesOfficeOptions = idx.salesOfficeOptionsBySoDistDiv[so + '|' + dist + '|' + div] || [];
    if (so && dist && div && salesOffice && !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(salesOffice, salesOfficeOptions)) err.push('Sales Office tidak relevan untuk kombinasi Sales Org + Distribution Channel + Division.');

    if (bp && plant && so && dist && div && salesOffice) {
      const dupKey = [bp, plant, so, dist, div, salesOffice].join('|').toUpperCase();
      if (!duplicateMap[dupKey]) duplicateMap[dupKey] = [];
      duplicateMap[dupKey].push(i);
    }

    rowErrors[i] = err;
  }

  const dupKeys = Object.keys(duplicateMap);
  for (let i = 0; i < dupKeys.length; i++) {
    const rows = duplicateMap[dupKeys[i]];
    if (rows.length > 1) {
      for (let j = 0; j < rows.length; j++) {
        rowErrors[rows[j]].push('Baris duplikat dalam template untuk BP + Plant + Sales Area + Sales Office yang sama.');
      }
    }
  }

  const errorRows = writeValidationStatusForFullSheet_(sh, cStatus, cDetail, rowErrors, rowHasData);

  if (showToast) {
    const msg = errorRows ? 'Validasi selesai: ' + errorRows + ' row error dari ' + dataRows + ' row berisi data.' : 'Validasi selesai: semua row front-end OK.';
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(msg, 'Change Sales Office Validation', 8);
  }
  return errorRows;
}

/* =========================================================
 * EM INDEX (cached) with Sales Office
 * ========================================================= */

function getEmployeeMasterDataIndex_() {
  if (__EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__) return __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__;
  __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__ = buildEmployeeMasterDataIndex_();
  return __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__;
}

function buildEmployeeMasterDataIndex_() {
  const em = getRequiredSheetByName_(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetEm);
  const values = em.getDataRange().getDisplayValues();
  if (values.length < 2) throw new Error('Sheet em kosong. Import em.csv ke sheet bernama `em` terlebih dahulu.');

  const headers = values[0].map(cleanText_);
  const cSalesOrg = findRequiredColumnIndexByName_(headers, 'Sales Org', 1);
  const cSalesOrgDesc = findRequiredColumnIndexByName_(headers, 'Description', 1);
  const cDist = findRequiredColumnIndexByName_(headers, 'Distribution channel', 1);
  const cDistDesc = findRequiredColumnIndexByName_(headers, 'Distribution Channel Description', 1);
  const cDivision = findRequiredColumnIndexByName_(headers, 'Division', 1);
  const cDivisionDesc = findRequiredColumnIndexByName_(headers, 'Division Description', 1);
  const cCompany = findRequiredColumnIndexByName_(headers, 'Company', 1);
  const cCompanyCode = findRequiredColumnIndexByName_(headers, 'Company Code', 1);
  const cSalesOffice = findOptionalColumnIndexByName_(headers, 'Sales Office', 1);
  const cSalesOfficeDesc = findOptionalColumnIndexByName_(headers, 'Description', 2);

  const salesOrgMap = new Map();
  const companyMap = new Map();
  const salesOfficeMap = new Map();
  const salesOfficeBySalesOrg = {};
  const distBySo = {};
  const divBySoDist = {};
  const salesOfficeBySoDistDiv = {};

  for (let i = 1; i < values.length; i++) {
    const r = values[i];
    const so = cleanText_(r[cSalesOrg]);
    const soDesc = cleanText_(r[cSalesOrgDesc]);
    const dist = cleanText_(r[cDist]);
    const distDesc = cleanText_(r[cDistDesc]);
    const div = cleanText_(r[cDivision]);
    const divDesc = cleanText_(r[cDivisionDesc]);
    const company = cleanText_(r[cCompany]);
    const companyCode = cleanText_(r[cCompanyCode]);
    const salesOffice = cSalesOffice === null ? '' : cleanText_(r[cSalesOffice]);
    const salesOfficeDesc = cSalesOfficeDesc === null ? '' : cleanText_(r[cSalesOfficeDesc]);

    if (so) addDropdownOptionToMap_(salesOrgMap, so, soDesc);
    if (companyCode) addDropdownOptionToMap_(companyMap, companyCode, company);
    if (salesOffice) addDropdownOptionToMap_(salesOfficeMap, salesOffice, salesOfficeDesc);

    if (so && salesOffice) {
      if (!salesOfficeBySalesOrg[so]) salesOfficeBySalesOrg[so] = new Map();
      addDropdownOptionToMap_(salesOfficeBySalesOrg[so], salesOffice, salesOfficeDesc);
    }

    if (so && dist) {
      if (!distBySo[so]) distBySo[so] = new Map();
      addDropdownOptionToMap_(distBySo[so], dist, distDesc);
    }

    if (so && dist && div) {
      const key = so + '|' + dist;
      if (!divBySoDist[key]) divBySoDist[key] = new Map();
      addDropdownOptionToMap_(divBySoDist[key], div, divDesc);
    }

    if (so && dist && div && salesOffice) {
      const key = so + '|' + dist + '|' + div;
      if (!salesOfficeBySoDistDiv[key]) salesOfficeBySoDistDiv[key] = new Map();
      addDropdownOptionToMap_(salesOfficeBySoDistDiv[key], salesOffice, salesOfficeDesc);
    }
  }

  const distOptionsBySalesOrg = {};
  Object.keys(distBySo).forEach(function(k) { distOptionsBySalesOrg[k] = convertOptionMapToSortedList_(distBySo[k]); });

  const divOptionsBySalesOrgDist = {};
  Object.keys(divBySoDist).forEach(function(k) { divOptionsBySalesOrgDist[k] = convertOptionMapToSortedList_(divBySoDist[k]); });

  const salesOfficeOptionsBySalesOrg = {};
  Object.keys(salesOfficeBySalesOrg).forEach(function(k) { salesOfficeOptionsBySalesOrg[k] = convertOptionMapToSortedList_(salesOfficeBySalesOrg[k]); });

  const salesOfficeOptionsBySoDistDiv = {};
  Object.keys(salesOfficeBySoDistDiv).forEach(function(k) { salesOfficeOptionsBySoDistDiv[k] = convertOptionMapToSortedList_(salesOfficeBySoDistDiv[k]); });

  return {
    salesOrgOptions: convertOptionMapToSortedList_(salesOrgMap),
    companyOptions: convertOptionMapToSortedList_(companyMap),
    salesOfficeOptions: convertOptionMapToSortedList_(salesOfficeMap),
    salesOfficeOptionsBySalesOrg: salesOfficeOptionsBySalesOrg,
    distOptionsBySalesOrg: distOptionsBySalesOrg,
    divOptionsBySalesOrgDist: divOptionsBySalesOrgDist,
    salesOfficeOptionsBySoDistDiv: salesOfficeOptionsBySoDistDiv
  };
}

/* =========================================================
 * BATCH WRITE STATUS
 * ========================================================= */

function writeValidationStatusForFullSheet_(sh, cStatus, cDetail, rowErrors, rowHasData) {
  const numRows = rowErrors.length;
  const statusVals = new Array(numRows);
  const detailVals = new Array(numRows);
  const statusBg = new Array(numRows);
  const statusFg = new Array(numRows);
  const statusFw = new Array(numRows);
  const detailBg = new Array(numRows);
  const detailFg = new Array(numRows);
  const detailWrap = new Array(numRows);
  let errorRows = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < numRows; i++) {
    if (!rowHasData[i]) {
      statusVals[i] = [''];
      detailVals[i] = [''];
      statusBg[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.input];
      statusFg[i] = ['#000000'];
      statusFw[i] = ['normal'];
      detailBg[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.input];
      detailFg[i] = ['#000000'];
      detailWrap[i] = [false];
      continue;
    }
    const errs = rowErrors[i] || [];
    if (!errs.length) {
      statusVals[i] = ['OK'];
      detailVals[i] = [''];
      statusBg[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.ok];
      statusFg[i] = ['#166534'];
      statusFw[i] = ['bold'];
      detailBg[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.ok];
      detailFg[i] = ['#166534'];
      detailWrap[i] = [false];
    } else {
      errorRows++;
      const seen = {};
      const uniq = [];
      for (let j = 0; j < errs.length; j++) {
        if (!seen[errs[j]]) { seen[errs[j]] = true; uniq.push(errs[j]); }
      }
      statusVals[i] = ['ERROR'];
      detailVals[i] = [uniq.join(' | ')];
      statusBg[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.error];
      statusFg[i] = ['#991B1B'];
      statusFw[i] = ['bold'];
      detailBg[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.error];
      detailFg[i] = ['#991B1B'];
      detailWrap[i] = [true];
    }
  }

  const statusRange = sh.getRange(2, cStatus, numRows, 1);
  const detailRange = sh.getRange(2, cDetail, numRows, 1);

  statusRange.setValues(statusVals);
  statusRange.setBackgrounds(statusBg);
  statusRange.setFontColors(statusFg);
  statusRange.setFontWeights(statusFw);

  detailRange.setValues(detailVals);
  detailRange.setBackgrounds(detailBg);
  detailRange.setFontColors(detailFg);
  detailRange.setWraps(detailWrap);

  return errorRows;
}

function isRowCompletelyBlank_(rowArr) {
  for (let i = 0; i < rowArr.length; i++) {
    if (cleanText_(rowArr[i]) !== '') return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function getCellValueByIndex_(rowArr, idx) {
  if (idx < 0 || idx >= rowArr.length) return '';
  return rowArr[idx];
}

/* =========================================================
 * V10 REALTIME ROW VALIDATION
 * ========================================================= */

function validateChangeSalesmanTypeRows_(sh, idx, startRow, endRow, showToast) {
  ensureValidationStatusColumns_(sh);
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const cSalesman = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Salesman ID']);
  const cSalesOrg = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org']);
  const cSalesOffice = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Office']);
  const cSalesType = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Type']);
  const cCoverage = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Coverage']);
  const cValidFrom = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Valid From']);
  const cValidTo = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Valid To']);
  const cStatus = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.validationStatusHeader]);
  const cDetail = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.errorDetailHeader]);

  const lastRow = Math.min(Math.max(sh.getLastRow(), 2), TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows);
  startRow = Math.max(2, startRow);
  endRow = Math.min(lastRow, endRow);
  if (startRow > endRow || !cStatus || !cDetail) return 0;

  const dataLastCol = cStatus - 1;
  const dataValues = sh.getRange(startRow, 1, endRow - startRow + 1, dataLastCol).getDisplayValues();
  const numRows = dataValues.length;
  const rowErrors = new Array(numRows);
  const rowHasData = new Array(numRows);
  let dataRows = 0;

  const idxSalesman = (cSalesman || 0) - 1;
  const idxSalesOrg = (cSalesOrg || 0) - 1;
  const idxSalesOffice = (cSalesOffice || 0) - 1;
  const idxSalesType = (cSalesType || 0) - 1;
  const idxCoverage = (cCoverage || 0) - 1;
  const idxValidFrom = (cValidFrom || 0) - 1;
  const idxValidTo = (cValidTo || 0) - 1;

  for (let i = 0; i < numRows; i++) {
    const r = dataValues[i];
    if (isRowCompletelyBlank_(r)) { rowErrors[i] = null; rowHasData[i] = false; continue; }
    rowHasData[i] = true;
    dataRows++;

    const salesmanId = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(r[idxSalesman] || '');
    const salesOrg = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(r[idxSalesOrg] || '');
    const salesOffice = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(r[idxSalesOffice] || '');
    const salesType = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(r[idxSalesType] || '');
    const validFrom = cleanText_(r[idxValidFrom] || '');
    const validTo = cleanText_(r[idxValidTo] || '');
    const err = [];

    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, salesmanId, 'Salesman ID wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, salesOrg, 'Sales Organization wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, salesOffice, 'Sales Office wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, salesType, 'Sales Type wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, validFrom, 'Valid From wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, validTo, 'Valid To wajib diisi.');

    if (salesmanId && !isAllowedSalesmanId_(salesmanId)) err.push(getSalesmanIdValidationMessage_());
    if (salesOrg && !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(salesOrg, idx.salesOrgOptions || [])) err.push('Sales Organization tidak valid berdasarkan sheet em.');

    const officeOptions = idx.salesOfficeOptionsBySalesOrg[salesOrg] || [];
    if (salesOrg && salesOffice && !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(salesOffice, officeOptions)) err.push('Sales Office tidak relevan untuk Sales Organization yang dipilih.');
    if (salesType && !SALES_TYPE_ID_SET.has(salesType)) err.push('Sales Type harus dipilih dari LOV New code S4.');

    const dValidFrom = parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(validFrom);
    const dValidTo = parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(validTo);
    if (validFrom && !dValidFrom) err.push('Valid From harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
    if (validTo && !dValidTo) err.push('Valid To harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
    if (dValidFrom && dValidTo && dValidTo.getTime() <= dValidFrom.getTime()) err.push('Valid To harus lebih besar dari Valid From.');

    rowErrors[i] = err;
  }

  const errorRows = writeValidationStatusForEditedRows_(sh, cStatus, cDetail, rowErrors, rowHasData, startRow);
  if (showToast) SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast('Realtime validation selesai: ' + errorRows + ' row error dari ' + dataRows + ' row.', 'Change Salesman Type', 5);
  return errorRows;
}

function validateChangeSalesOfficeRows_(sh, idx, startRow, endRow, showToast) {
  ensureValidationStatusColumns_(sh);
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const cBp = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['BP Number Source']);
  const cPlant = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Delivering Plant']);
  const cDist = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Distr. Channel', 'Distribution Channel', 'Distribution channel']);
  const cDiv = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Division']);
  const cSalesOrg = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org']);
  const cSalesOffice = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Office']);
  const cStatus = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.validationStatusHeader]);
  const cDetail = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.errorDetailHeader]);

  const lastRow = Math.min(Math.max(sh.getLastRow(), 2), TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows);
  startRow = Math.max(2, startRow);
  endRow = Math.min(lastRow, endRow);
  if (startRow > endRow || !cStatus || !cDetail) return 0;

  const dataLastCol = cStatus - 1;
  const dataValues = sh.getRange(startRow, 1, endRow - startRow + 1, dataLastCol).getDisplayValues();
  const numRows = dataValues.length;
  const rowErrors = new Array(numRows);
  const rowHasData = new Array(numRows);
  let dataRows = 0;

  const idxBp = (cBp || 0) - 1;
  const idxPlant = (cPlant || 0) - 1;
  const idxDist = (cDist || 0) - 1;
  const idxDiv = (cDiv || 0) - 1;
  const idxSalesOrg = (cSalesOrg || 0) - 1;
  const idxSalesOffice = (cSalesOffice || 0) - 1;
  const salesOrgOptions = idx.salesOrgOptions || [];

  for (let i = 0; i < numRows; i++) {
    const r = dataValues[i];
    if (isRowCompletelyBlank_(r)) { rowErrors[i] = null; rowHasData[i] = false; continue; }
    rowHasData[i] = true;
    dataRows++;

    const bp = cleanText_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxBp));
    const plant = cleanText_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxPlant)).toUpperCase();
    const dist = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxDist));
    const div = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxDiv));
    const so = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxSalesOrg));
    const salesOffice = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxSalesOffice));
    const err = [];

    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, bp, 'BP Number Source wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, plant, 'Delivering Plant wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, so, 'Sales Organization wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, dist, 'Distribution Channel wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, div, 'Division wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, salesOffice, 'Sales Office wajib diisi.');

    if (bp && !/^\d+$/.test(bp)) err.push('BP Number Source harus numerik.');
    if (plant && !/^[A-Z0-9]{4}$/.test(plant)) err.push('Delivering Plant harus 4 karakter alphanumeric, contoh J001.');
    if (so && !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(so, salesOrgOptions)) err.push('Sales Organization tidak valid berdasarkan sheet em.');

    const distOptions = idx.distOptionsBySalesOrg[so] || [];
    if (so && dist && !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(dist, distOptions)) err.push('Distribution Channel tidak relevan untuk Sales Organization yang dipilih.');

    const divOptions = idx.divOptionsBySalesOrgDist[so + '|' + dist] || [];
    if (so && dist && div && !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(div, divOptions)) err.push('Division tidak relevan untuk kombinasi Sales Org + Distribution Channel.');

    const salesOfficeOptions = idx.salesOfficeOptionsBySoDistDiv[so + '|' + dist + '|' + div] || [];
    if (so && dist && div && salesOffice && !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(salesOffice, salesOfficeOptions)) err.push('Sales Office tidak relevan untuk kombinasi Sales Org + Distribution Channel + Division.');

    rowErrors[i] = err;
  }

  const errorRows = writeValidationStatusForEditedRows_(sh, cStatus, cDetail, rowErrors, rowHasData, startRow);
  if (showToast) SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast('Realtime validation selesai: ' + errorRows + ' row error dari ' + dataRows + ' row.', 'Change Sales Office', 5);
  return errorRows;
}

function validateChangeRollingRows_(sh, idx, startRow, endRow, showToast) {
  ensureValidationStatusColumns_(sh);
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const cols = getChangeRollingColumnIndexes_(hm);
  const cStatus = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.validationStatusHeader]);
  const cDetail = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.errorDetailHeader]);

  const lastRow = Math.min(Math.max(sh.getLastRow(), 2), TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows);
  startRow = Math.max(2, startRow);
  endRow = Math.min(lastRow, endRow);
  if (startRow > endRow || !cStatus || !cDetail) return 0;

  const dataLastCol = cStatus - 1;
  const dataValues = sh.getRange(startRow, 1, endRow - startRow + 1, dataLastCol).getDisplayValues();
  const numRows = dataValues.length;
  const rowErrors = new Array(numRows);
  const rowHasData = new Array(numRows);
  let dataRows = 0;

  const idxMap = {};
  Object.keys(cols).forEach(function(k) { idxMap[k] = (cols[k] || 0) - 1; });
  const salesOfficeOptions = idx.salesOfficeOptions || [];

  for (let i = 0; i < numRows; i++) {
    const r = dataValues[i];
    if (isRowCompletelyBlank_(r)) { rowErrors[i] = null; rowHasData[i] = false; continue; }
    rowHasData[i] = true;
    dataRows++;

    const v = {
      salesOffice: extractRollingRelationshipToken_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.salesOffice)),
      customerId: extractRollingRelationshipToken_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.customerId)),
      relationship: extractRollingRelationshipToken_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.relationship)),
      salesmanId: extractRollingRelationshipToken_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.salesmanId)),
      salesmanBpType: extractRollingRelationshipToken_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.salesmanBpType)),
      salesType: extractRollingRelationshipToken_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.salesType)),
      validFrom: cleanText_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.validFrom)),
      validTo: cleanText_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.validTo)),
      visitCategory: cleanText_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.visitCategory)).toUpperCase(),
      visitType: cleanText_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.visitType)),
      scheduleVisit: cleanText_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.scheduleVisit)),
      visitValidFrom: cleanText_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.visitValidFrom)),
      visitValidTo: cleanText_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.visitValidTo)),
      reason: cleanText_(getCellValueByIndex_(r, idxMap.reason))
    };

    const isSalesmanPair = isSalesmanToSalesmanRolling_(v.customerId, v.salesmanId);
    const err = [];

    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.salesOffice, 'Sales Office wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.customerId, 'Customer ID wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.relationship, 'Relationship wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.salesmanId, 'Salesman ID wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.salesmanBpType, 'Salesman BP Type wajib diisi.');
    if (!isSalesmanPair && cols.salesType) addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.salesType, 'Sales Type wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.validFrom, 'Valid From wajib diisi.');
    addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.validTo, 'Valid To wajib diisi.');

    if (!isSalesmanPair) {
      addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.visitCategory, 'Visit Category wajib diisi.');
      addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.visitType, 'Visit Type wajib diisi.');
      addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.scheduleVisit, 'Schedule Visit wajib diisi.');
      addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.visitValidFrom, 'Visit Valid From wajib diisi.');
      addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(err, v.visitValidTo, 'Visit Valid To wajib diisi.');
    }

    if (v.salesOffice && !idExistsInDropdownOptions_(v.salesOffice, salesOfficeOptions)) err.push('Sales Office tidak ada di master em.');

    if (v.customerId) {
      const customerNumeric = /^\d+$/.test(v.customerId);
      const customerIsSalesman = isAllowedSalesmanId_(v.customerId);
      if (!customerNumeric && !customerIsSalesman) err.push('Customer ID harus numerik, kecuali jika Customer ID dan Salesman ID sama-sama diawali S.');
      else if (customerIsSalesman && !isSalesmanPair) err.push('Jika Customer ID diawali S, maka Salesman ID juga harus diawali S agar kolom I-M tidak wajib diisi.');
    }

    if (v.relationship && !RELATIONSHIP_ID_SET.has(v.relationship.toUpperCase())) err.push('Relationship harus dipilih dari LOV: ZWS001-ZWS022 atau BUR001.');
    if (v.salesmanId && !isAllowedSalesmanId_(v.salesmanId)) err.push(getSalesmanIdValidationMessage_());
    if (v.salesmanBpType && !/^ZD\d{2}$/i.test(v.salesmanBpType)) err.push('Salesman BP Type harus format ZDnn, contoh ZD01.');
    if (v.salesType && !SALES_TYPE_ID_SET.has(v.salesType.toUpperCase())) err.push('Sales Type harus dipilih dari LOV New code S4.');

    if (!isSalesmanPair) {
      if (v.visitCategory && !VISIT_CATEGORY_SET.has(v.visitCategory)) err.push('Visit Category harus F1, F2, F4, atau F8.');
      if (v.visitType && !VISIT_TYPE_SET.has(v.visitType)) err.push("Visit Type harus 01 sampai 12 dan tetap 2 digit, contoh '03'.");
    }

    const dValidFrom = parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(v.validFrom);
    const dValidTo = parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(v.validTo);
    const dVisitFrom = isSalesmanPair ? null : parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(v.visitValidFrom);
    const dVisitTo = isSalesmanPair ? null : parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(v.visitValidTo);

    if (v.validFrom && !dValidFrom) err.push('Valid From harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
    if (v.validTo && !dValidTo) err.push('Valid To harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
    if (v.validTo && v.validTo !== '9999-12-31' && !isTokoBangkrutReason_(v.reason)) err.push('Valid To harus selalu 9999-12-31 untuk Change Rolling, kecuali Reason berisi Toko Bangkrut.');
    if (!isSalesmanPair) {
      if (v.visitValidFrom && !dVisitFrom) err.push('Visit Valid From harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
      if (v.visitValidTo && !dVisitTo) err.push('Visit Valid To harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
    }

    if (dValidFrom && dValidTo && dValidTo.getTime() <= dValidFrom.getTime()) err.push('Valid To harus lebih besar dari Valid From.');
    if (!isSalesmanPair && dVisitFrom && dVisitTo && dVisitTo.getTime() <= dVisitFrom.getTime()) err.push('Visit Valid To harus lebih besar dari Visit Valid From.');
    if (!isSalesmanPair && dValidFrom && dValidTo && dVisitFrom && dVisitTo) {
      if (dVisitFrom.getTime() < dValidFrom.getTime() || dVisitTo.getTime() > dValidTo.getTime()) err.push('Periode Visit Valid harus berada di dalam Valid From - Valid To.');
    }

    if (!isSalesmanPair && v.visitCategory && v.scheduleVisit) {
      const scheduleErrors = validateScheduleVisitValue_(v.visitCategory, v.scheduleVisit);
      for (let k = 0; k < scheduleErrors.length; k++) err.push(scheduleErrors[k]);
    }

    rowErrors[i] = err;
  }

  const errorRows = writeValidationStatusForEditedRows_(sh, cStatus, cDetail, rowErrors, rowHasData, startRow);
  if (showToast) SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast('Realtime validation selesai: ' + errorRows + ' row error dari ' + dataRows + ' row.', 'Change Rolling', 5);
  return errorRows;
}

function writeValidationStatusForEditedRows_(sh, cStatus, cDetail, rowErrors, rowHasData, startRow) {
  const numRows = rowErrors.length;
  const statusVals = new Array(numRows);
  const detailVals = new Array(numRows);
  const statusBg = new Array(numRows);
  const statusFg = new Array(numRows);
  const statusFw = new Array(numRows);
  const detailBg = new Array(numRows);
  const detailFg = new Array(numRows);
  const detailWrap = new Array(numRows);
  let errorRows = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < numRows; i++) {
    if (!rowHasData[i]) {
      statusVals[i] = [''];
      detailVals[i] = [''];
      statusBg[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.input];
      statusFg[i] = ['#000000'];
      statusFw[i] = ['normal'];
      detailBg[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.input];
      detailFg[i] = ['#000000'];
      detailWrap[i] = [false];
      continue;
    }
    const errs = rowErrors[i] || [];
    if (!errs.length) {
      statusVals[i] = ['OK'];
      detailVals[i] = [''];
      statusBg[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.ok];
      statusFg[i] = ['#166534'];
      statusFw[i] = ['bold'];
      detailBg[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.ok];
      detailFg[i] = ['#166534'];
      detailWrap[i] = [false];
    } else {
      errorRows++;
      const seen = {};
      const uniq = [];
      for (let j = 0; j < errs.length; j++) {
        if (!seen[errs[j]]) { seen[errs[j]] = true; uniq.push(errs[j]); }
      }
      statusVals[i] = ['ERROR'];
      detailVals[i] = [uniq.join(' | ')];
      statusBg[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.error];
      statusFg[i] = ['#991B1B'];
      statusFw[i] = ['bold'];
      detailBg[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.error];
      detailFg[i] = ['#991B1B'];
      detailWrap[i] = [true];
    }
  }

  const statusRange = sh.getRange(startRow, cStatus, numRows, 1);
  const detailRange = sh.getRange(startRow, cDetail, numRows, 1);
  statusRange.setValues(statusVals).setBackgrounds(statusBg).setFontColors(statusFg).setFontWeights(statusFw);
  detailRange.setValues(detailVals).setBackgrounds(detailBg).setFontColors(detailFg).setWraps(detailWrap);
  return errorRows;
}

/* =========================================================
 * V10 BATCH NORMALIZATION HELPERS
 * ========================================================= */

function normalizeEditedColumnValuesInBatch_(sh, editedRange, startRow, endRow, col, mode) {
  if (!col || !doesEditedRangeTouchColumn_(editedRange, col)) return;
  const n = endRow - startRow + 1;
  const r = sh.getRange(startRow, col, n, 1);
  const values = r.getDisplayValues();
  const out = new Array(n);
  let changed = false;

  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const original = cleanText_(values[i][0]);
    let next = original;
    if (mode === 'ID') next = original ? extractLeadingId_(original) : '';
    else if (mode === 'CODE') next = normalizeRscCodeToken_(original);
    else if (mode === 'BP_ID') next = normalizeBpExistenceId_(original);
    else if (mode === 'SALESMAN') next = normalizeSalesmanIdForValidation_(original);
    else if (mode === 'VISIT_TYPE') next = normalizeRscVisitTypeToken_(original);
    else if (mode === 'UPPER') next = original ? original.toUpperCase() : '';
    else if (mode === 'SCHEDULE') next = normalizeRscScheduleToken_(original);
    else if (mode === 'BOOLEAN') {
      const v = original.toUpperCase();
      if (['TRUE', 'YA', 'YES', 'Y', '1'].indexOf(v) !== -1) next = 'TRUE';
      else if (['FALSE', 'TIDAK', 'NO', 'N', '0'].indexOf(v) !== -1) next = 'FALSE';
      else next = original;
    }
    if (next !== original) changed = true;
    out[i] = [next];
  }

  if (changed) r.setValues(out);
}

function clearEditedColumnValues_(sh, startRow, endRow, col) {
  if (!col) return;
  sh.getRange(startRow, col, endRow - startRow + 1, 1).clearContent();
}

/* =========================================================
 * COMMON HELPERS
 * ========================================================= */

function buildHeaderMap_(sh) {
  const lastCol = Math.max(sh.getLastColumn(), 1);
  const headers = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0];

  let scanLimit = headers.length;
  for (let i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
    const k = cleanText_(headers[i]);
    if (k === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.validationStatusHeader || k === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.errorDetailHeader) {
      scanLimit = Math.max(scanLimit, i + 2);
      break;
    }
  }
  let mappedStatus = false;
  const map = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
    const key = cleanText_(headers[i]);
    if (!key) continue;
    if (key === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.validationStatusHeader || key === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.errorDetailHeader) {
      if (!map[key]) map[key] = i + 1;
      if (key === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.errorDetailHeader) mappedStatus = true;
      continue;
    }
    if (mappedStatus) break;
    if (!map[key]) map[key] = i + 1; // first-wins
  }
  return map;
}

function findColumnByHeaderNames_(headerMap, names) {
  for (let i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    if (headerMap[names[i]]) return headerMap[names[i]];
  }
  const keys = Object.keys(headerMap);
  for (let i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    const target = (names[i] || '').toLowerCase();
    for (let j = 0; j < keys.length; j++) {
      if (keys[j].toLowerCase() === target) return headerMap[keys[j]];
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function formatHeaderRow_(sh, lastCol) {
  const header = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol);
  header.setBackground(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.header)
    .setFontColor(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.headerFont)
    .setFontWeight('bold')
    .setHorizontalAlignment('center')
    .setVerticalAlignment('middle')
    .setWrap(true);
  sh.setRowHeight(1, 42);

  const body = sh.getRange(2, 1, TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows - 1, lastCol);
  body.setBorder(true, true, true, true, true, true, TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.border, SpreadsheetApp.BorderStyle.SOLID)
    .setVerticalAlignment('middle')
    .setWrap(false);
}

function setColumnWidthsByHeaderName_(sh, hm, widthsByHeader) {
  const localHm = hm || buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const keys = Object.keys(widthsByHeader);
  for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    const c = localHm[keys[i]];
    if (c) sh.setColumnWidth(c, widthsByHeader[keys[i]]);
  }
}

/**
 * V12 CRITICAL FIX: include bare IDs in dropdown validation list.
 *
 * Google Sheets chip-style dropdown (yang dipakai requireValueInList dengan
 * showDropdown=true) menyembunyikan value cell secara visual jika value
 * tidak persis cocok dengan salah satu list item. setAllowInvalid(true)
 * hanya mencegah hard-reject pada saat input, tapi tidak mencegah perilaku
 * chip ini.
 *
 * Konsekuensi tanpa fix: setelah onEdit men-normalisasi cell dari
 * "STA1 - STA - CG Sales" menjadi "STA1", chip render kosong dan validation
 * salah flag "Sales Organization wajib diisi".
 *
 * Fix: jika sebuah option mengandung format "ID - Description" (atau hanya
 * "ID"), kita ekstrak bare ID-nya dan tambahkan sebagai entry valid juga.
 * Display options (ID + description) tetap di urutan atas dropdown supaya
 * user melihat label deskriptif terlebih dahulu; bare IDs di-append di
 * bawah sebagai opsi fallback.
 */
function setDropdownValidation_(range, values, helpText) {
  const seen = {};
  const displayValues = [];
  const bareIdValues = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < (values || []).length; i++) {
    const v = cleanText_(values[i]);
    if (!v || seen[v]) continue;
    seen[v] = true;
    displayValues.push(v);

    const id = extractIdFromDropdownOptionText_(v);
    if (id && id !== v && !seen[id]) {
      seen[id] = true;
      bareIdValues.push(id);
    }
  }

  if (!displayValues.length) {
    range.clearDataValidations();
    return;
  }

  // Display options first (top of dropdown), bare IDs appended at the bottom
  // sebagai fallback yang valid setelah normalisasi.
  const allValues = displayValues.concat(bareIdValues);

  const rule = SpreadsheetApp.newDataValidation()
    .requireValueInList(allValues, true)
    .setAllowInvalid(true)
    .setHelpText(helpText || 'Pilih value dari dropdown. ID-only juga diterima.')
    .build();

  range.setDataValidation(rule);
}

function buildDateValidationRule_(helpText) {
  return SpreadsheetApp.newDataValidation()
    .requireDate()
    .setAllowInvalid(false)
    .setHelpText(helpText || 'Isi tanggal valid.')
    .build();
}

function applyLockedVisualStyle_(range, isLocked) {
  if (isLocked) {
    range.setBackground(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.locked).setFontColor(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.lockedFont);
  } else {
    range.setBackground(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.input).setFontColor(null);
  }
}

function normalizeDropdownValueToIdOnly_(range) {
  const value = cleanText_(range.getDisplayValue());
  if (!value) return '';
  const id = extractLeadingId_(value);
  if (id !== value) range.setValue(id);
  return id;
}

function normalizeBooleanTextValue_(range) {
  const value = cleanText_(range.getDisplayValue()).toUpperCase();
  if (!value) return '';
  if (['TRUE', 'YA', 'YES', 'Y', '1'].indexOf(value) !== -1) range.setValue('TRUE');
  else if (['FALSE', 'TIDAK', 'NO', 'N', '0'].indexOf(value) !== -1) range.setValue('FALSE');
  return cleanText_(range.getDisplayValue()).toUpperCase();
}

function extractLeadingId_(value) {
  const s = cleanText_(value);
  if (!s) return '';
  if (s.indexOf(' - ') > -1) return cleanText_(s.split(' - ')[0]).toUpperCase();
  const firstToken = cleanText_(s.split(/\s+/)[0]);
  if (/^[A-Za-z0-9]+$/.test(firstToken)) return firstToken.toUpperCase();
  return s.toUpperCase();
}

function extractRollingRelationshipToken_(value) {
  const s = cleanText_(value);
  if (!s) return '';
  const labelMatch = s.match(/^\s*([A-Za-z0-9]+)\s+(?:-|–|—|\|)\s+.+$/);
  if (labelMatch && labelMatch[1]) {
    return labelMatch[1].toUpperCase();
  }
  const m = s.match(/^[\(\s]*([A-Za-z0-9]+)/);
  if (m && m[1]) return m[1].toUpperCase();
  return s.toUpperCase();
}

/**
 * Canonical code normalizer untuk seluruh ID/code pada template Rolling.
 * Membersihkan label dropdown, leading apostrophe, whitespace biasa/NBSP,
 * serta karakter zero-width yang tidak terlihat di Google Sheets.
 * Tanda baca invalid tidak dibuang diam-diam agar tetap tertangkap validator.
 */
function normalizeRscCodeToken_(value) {
  return RSC_PERF5_MEMO_SCALAR_20260819_('NORM_CODE', value, function () {
    let s = cleanText_(value);
    if (!s) return '';
    s = s.replace(/^'+/, '');
    const labelMatch = s.match(/^\s*([A-Za-z0-9]+)\s+(?:-|–|—|\|)\s+.+$/);
    if (labelMatch && labelMatch[1]) s = labelMatch[1];
    return cleanText_(s).replace(/\s+/g, '').toUpperCase();
  });
}

function normalizeRscVisitTypeToken_(value) {
  return RSC_PERF5_MEMO_SCALAR_20260819_('NORM_VISIT_TYPE', value, function () {
    const s = cleanText_(value).replace(/^'+/, '');
    if (!s) return '';
    const m = s.match(/^(\d+)(?:\.0+)?$/);
    return m ? m[1].padStart(2, '0') : normalizeRscCodeToken_(s);
  });
}

function normalizeRscScheduleToken_(value) {
  return RSC_PERF5_MEMO_SCALAR_20260819_('NORM_SCHEDULE', value, function () {
    return cleanText_(value)
      .replace(/[，、]/g, ',')
      .replace(/\s+/g, '')
      .replace(/Th/gi, 'TH')
      .replace(/Su/gi, 'SU')
      .toUpperCase();
  });
}

function buildDropdownOptionList_(pairs) {
  const seen = {};
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < pairs.length; i++) {
    const id = cleanText_(pairs[i][0]);
    const desc = cleanText_(pairs[i][1]);
    if (!id || seen[id]) continue;
    seen[id] = true;
    out.push(formatDropdownDisplayOption_(id, desc));
  }
  return out.sort();
}

function buildCheckRuleDropdownOptions_() {
  return RISK_CHECK_RULES.map(function(r) { return formatDropdownDisplayOption_(r[0], r[1]); }).sort();
}

function buildRiskClassDropdownOptions_() {
  return RISK_CHECK_RULES.map(function(r) { return formatDropdownDisplayOption_(r[0], r[2]); }).sort();
}

function addDropdownOptionToMap_(map, id, desc) {
  id = cleanText_(id);
  desc = cleanText_(desc);
  if (!id || map.has(id)) return;
  map.set(id, formatDropdownDisplayOption_(id, desc));
}

function formatDropdownDisplayOption_(id, desc) {
  id = cleanText_(id);
  desc = cleanText_(desc);
  return desc ? id + ' - ' + desc : id;
}

function convertOptionMapToSortedList_(map) {
  return Array.from(map.entries())
    .sort(function(a, b) { return a[0].localeCompare(b[0], undefined, { numeric: true }); })
    .map(function(e) { return e[1]; });
}

function idExistsInDropdownOptions_(id, options) {
  id = cleanText_(id).toUpperCase();
  // V12: also match the bare id form (without description) so the cascade
  // works regardless of whether the cell value is "STA1" or
  // "STA1 - STA - CG Sales".
  const idAsToken = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(id);
  for (let i = 0; i < options.length; i++) {
    const optId = extractLeadingId_(options[i]);
    if (optId === id || optId === idAsToken) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function findRequiredColumnIndexByName_(headers, name, nth) {
  const target = cleanText_(name).toLowerCase();
  let count = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
    if (cleanText_(headers[i]).toLowerCase() === target) {
      count++;
      if (count === nth) return i;
    }
  }
  throw new Error('Kolom `' + name + '` tidak ditemukan di sheet em.');
}

function findOptionalColumnIndexByName_(headers, name, nth) {
  const target = cleanText_(name).toLowerCase();
  let count = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
    if (cleanText_(headers[i]).toLowerCase() === target) {
      count++;
      if (count === nth) return i;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function doesEditedRangeTouchColumn_(range, col) {
  const start = range.getColumn();
  const end = start + range.getNumColumns() - 1;
  return col >= start && col <= end;
}

function columnNumberToLetter_(col) {
  let temp = '';
  let letter = '';
  while (col > 0) {
    temp = (col - 1) % 26;
    letter = String.fromCharCode(temp + 65) + letter;
    col = (col - temp - 1) / 26;
  }
  return '$' + letter;
}

function cleanText_(v) {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return '';
  let s = String(v);
  try { s = s.normalize('NFKC'); } catch (ignore) {}
  return s
    .replace(/[\u200B-\u200D\u2060\uFEFF]/g, '')
    .replace(/[\u00A0\u1680\u180E\u2000-\u200A\u202F\u205F\u3000]/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

function ensureValidationStatusColumns_(sh) {
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  const headers = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, Math.max(lastCol, 1)).getDisplayValues()[0];
  let hasStatus = false;
  let hasDetail = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
    const k = cleanText_(headers[i]);
    if (k === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.validationStatusHeader) hasStatus = true;
    if (k === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.errorDetailHeader) hasDetail = true;
  }
  let nextCol = lastCol + 1;
  if (!hasStatus) {
    sh.getRange(1, nextCol).setValue(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.validationStatusHeader);
    nextCol++;
  }
  if (!hasDetail) {
    sh.getRange(1, nextCol).setValue(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.errorDetailHeader);
  }
}

function addRequiredFieldErrorIfBlank_(errors, value, message) {
  if (!cleanText_(value)) errors.push(message);
}

function parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(value) {
  const s = cleanText_(value);
  const m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(s);
  if (!m) return null;
  const y = Number(m[1]);
  const mo = Number(m[2]);
  const d = Number(m[3]);
  if (mo < 1 || mo > 12 || d < 1 || d > 31) return null;
  const dt = new Date(y, mo - 1, d);
  if (dt.getFullYear() !== y || dt.getMonth() !== mo - 1 || dt.getDate() !== d) return null;
  return dt;
}

function extractIdFromDropdownOptionText_(value) {
  const s = cleanText_(value);
  if (!s) return '';
  if (s.indexOf(' - ') > -1) return cleanText_(s.split(' - ')[0]).toUpperCase();
  return cleanText_(s.split(/\s+/)[0]).toUpperCase();
}

function getScheduleVisitOptionsForCategory_(category) {
  const cat = cleanText_(category).toUpperCase();
  if (__SCHEDULE_OPTIONS_CACHE__[cat]) return __SCHEDULE_OPTIONS_CACHE__[cat];

  const options = [];

  if (cat === 'F1') {
    for (let i = 0; i < VISIT_DAYS.length; i++) {
      for (let week = 1; week <= 4; week++) options.push('W' + week + VISIT_DAYS[i]);
    }
  } else if (cat === 'F2') {
    for (let i = 0; i < VISIT_DAYS.length; i++) {
      const d = VISIT_DAYS[i];
      options.push('W1' + d + ',W3' + d);
      options.push('W2' + d + ',W4' + d);
    }
  } else if (cat === 'F4') {
    for (let i = 0; i < VISIT_DAYS.length; i++) {
      const d = VISIT_DAYS[i];
      options.push('W1' + d + ',W2' + d + ',W3' + d + ',W4' + d);
    }
  } else if (cat === 'F8') {
    for (let i = 0; i < VISIT_DAYS.length; i++) {
      for (let j = i + 1; j < VISIT_DAYS.length; j++) {
        const dayA = VISIT_DAYS[i];
        const dayB = VISIT_DAYS[j];
        options.push('W1' + dayA + ',W2' + dayA + ',W3' + dayA + ',W4' + dayA + ',W1' + dayB + ',W2' + dayB + ',W3' + dayB + ',W4' + dayB);
      }
    }
  }

  __SCHEDULE_OPTIONS_CACHE__[cat] = options;
  return options;
}

function getScheduleVisitOptionSetForCategory_(category) {
  const cat = cleanText_(category).toUpperCase();
  if (__SCHEDULE_OPTIONS_SET_CACHE__[cat]) return __SCHEDULE_OPTIONS_SET_CACHE__[cat];
  const set = new Set(getScheduleVisitOptionsForCategory_(cat));
  __SCHEDULE_OPTIONS_SET_CACHE__[cat] = set;
  return set;
}

function validateScheduleVisitValue_(visitCategory, scheduleValue) {
