  return RSC_STD_VALIDATE_SCHEDULE_RULES_20260814_(visitCategory, scheduleValue);
}

function deduplicateArray_(arr) {
  const seen = {};
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
    if (!seen[arr[i]]) { seen[arr[i]] = true; out.push(arr[i]); }
  }
  return out;
}

function normalizeScheduleForComparison_(scheduleValue) {
  return normalizeRscScheduleToken_(scheduleValue);
}

function normalizeEditedTextToUppercase_(range) {
  const v = cleanText_(range.getDisplayValue());
  if (!v) return '';
  const upper = v.toUpperCase();
  if (upper !== v) range.setValue(upper);
  return upper;
}

function normalizeEditedScheduleText_(range) {
  const v = cleanText_(range.getDisplayValue());
  if (!v) return '';
  const normalized = v.replace(/Th/g, 'TH').toUpperCase();
  if (normalized !== v) range.setValue(normalized);
  return normalized;
}

/************************************************************
 * ROLLING SALES COPY AUTOMATION - FULL PATCH
 *
 * MAIN FUNCTION:
 * makeCopyRollingSales_OVERWRITE_FINAL_ONLY_FULL()
 *
 * Logic:
 * 1. Auto-detect header:
 *    Sales Office | Description | Template Rolling Sales | Template Rolling Sales FINAL
 * 2. Ambil source dari kolom "Template Rolling Sales"
 *    Support:
 *    - Plain URL
 *    - Hyperlink text
 *    - Formula =HYPERLINK()
 *    - Smart chip / file chip jika Google Sheets API service aktif
 *    - Fallback search Drive by exact file title
 * 3. Make copy file source
 * 4. Rename: Template Rolling Sales + Description
 * 5. Set akses: WINGS GROUP / domain with link / Editor
 * 6. Clear semua protected sheet dan protected range di file hasil copy
 * 7. Run setup + validate rolling sales dari script V14 jika function tersedia
 * 8. HANYA isi / timpa kolom "Template Rolling Sales FINAL"
 ************************************************************/


/************************************************************
 * CONFIG
 ************************************************************/



/***************************************************************
 * MODULE 2 - ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS BACKGROUND COPY
 ***************************************************************/

/************************************************************
 * FAST ROLLING SALES COPY v2 - BACKGROUND / IDEMPOTENT
 *
 * KENAPA v2:
 *  - v1 selalu reset checkpoint ke baris pertama tiap START
 *    -> setiap restart menimpa & menduplikat file.
 *  - v1 tidak cek apakah FINAL sudah terisi -> bikin ulang.
 *  - v1 catch block menulis ulang existingFinal -> bisa
 *    menimpa hasil yang benar.
 *  - v1 boros: setValue + flush per row, props.setProperty
 *    berkali-kali per row, openById+clearProtections berat.
 *
 * PRINSIP v2:
 *  1. SUMBER KEBENARAN = kolom FINAL di sheet.
 *     Kalau FINAL row X sudah berisi link Sheets valid -> SKIP.
 *     Aman walau Properties hilang / START diklik berulang.
 *  2. Properties hanya cache "mulai scan dari row N" (hint),
 *     bukan satu-satunya kebenaran.
 *  3. Berhenti berdasarkan SISA WAKTU (soft deadline),
 *     bukan jumlah file. Tahan timeout.
 *  4. Resumable via time-driven trigger. Trigger lama
 *     selalu dibersihkan sebelum jadwal baru -> tidak
 *     ada eksekusi paralel / race.
 *  5. Idempotent: jalankan ulang berapa kali pun, file
 *     yang sudah ada TIDAK dibuat ulang.
 *
 * CARA PAKAI (PATCH TERINTEGRASI 2026-07-16):
 *  - startCopyRollingTemplateFiles()          : COPY pending lalu FINALIZE existing FINAL.
 *  - showCopyAndTemplateValidationStatus()    : status fase, trigger, pending, dan error.
 *  - stopCopyAndTemplateValidationJobs()      : hentikan job terintegrasi.
 *  - resetIntegratedCopyFinalJob()            : reset checkpoint + retry COPY_ERROR.
 * Entry lama validate/cleanse tetap dipertahankan untuk kompatibilitas,
 * tetapi tidak lagi ditampilkan sebagai menu copy terpisah.
 *
 * Aktifkan: Apps Script > Services (+) > Google Sheets API
 ************************************************************/


let __ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_TARGET_SPREADSHEET_CACHE__ = null;
let __ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_DRIVE_NAME_CACHE__ = {};
let __RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_GENERATION__ = '';
let __RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_RUN_ID__ = '';

function startCopyRollingTemplateFiles() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const sh = ss.getActiveSheet();
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const P = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS;

  // START hanya boleh membuat generasi baru setelah lock berhasil didapat.
  // Ini mencegah klik berulang menghidupkan dua job pada generasi yang sama.
  const guard = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  if (!guard.tryLock(Number(P.integratedCopyLockWaitMs || 1000))) {
    showSpreadsheetToast_(
      'Masih ada execution COPY lama yang memegang lock. Jalankan EMERGENCY HARD STOP, lalu tunggu execution lama hilang sebelum START lagi.',
      'Copy FINAL V5',
      12
    );
    return;
  }

  try {
    const generation = incrementIntegratedCopyGeneration_(props);
    const runId = Utilities.getUuid();

    props.setProperty(P.pStopFlag, 'FALSE');
    props.setProperty(P.pRunId, runId);
    props.setProperty(P.pSpreadsheetId, ss.getId());
    props.setProperty(P.pSheetId, String(sh.getSheetId()));

    const header = findCopyControlHeader_(sh);
    const firstDataRow = header.headerRow + 1;

    // START baru selalu scan COPY dari awal. Aman karena kolom FINAL valid adalah
    // sumber kebenaran dan selalu di-skip, jadi tidak membuat copy ulang.
    props.setProperty(P.pIntegratedPhase, 'COPY');
    props.setProperty(P.pCopyHint, String(firstDataRow));
    props.deleteProperty(P.pFinalizeHint);
    props.deleteProperty(P.pRunning);

    deleteAllIntegratedCopyTriggers_();
    writeIntegratedCopyStatus_(props, {
      phase: 'COPY',
      state: 'START_REQUESTED_V5',
      generation: generation,
      runId: runId,
      message: 'Generasi baru dimulai. Existing FINAL valid akan di-skip.',
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    });
  } finally {
    try { guard.releaseLock(); } catch (e) {}
  }

  continueCopyRollingTemplateFilesInBackground();
}


function startValidateCopiedRollingTemplateFiles() {
  showSpreadsheetToast_(
    'Validasi FINAL sudah digabung ke fase FINALIZE pada Copy FINAL Cepat & Aman.',
    'Copy FINAL Cepat & Aman',
    8
  );
  return startCopyRollingTemplateFiles();
}

function showCopyAndTemplateValidationStatus() {
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const P = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS;
  const ss = getCopyMasterSpreadsheet_();
  const sh = getCopyTargetSheet_(ss);
  const header = findCopyControlHeader_(sh);
  const cols = header.cols;
  const firstDataRow = header.headerRow + 1;

  const lastRow = getLastCopyControlDataRow_(sh, firstDataRow,
    [cols.description, cols.source, cols.final]);

  if (lastRow < firstDataRow) {
    showSpreadsheetToast_('Tidak ada data.', 'Copy FINAL Cepat & Aman', 6);
    return;
  }

  const n = lastRow - firstDataRow + 1;
  const finalStatusRange = sh.getRange(firstDataRow, cols.final, n, 1);
  const finalVals = finalStatusRange.getDisplayValues();
  const finalNotes = finalStatusRange.getNotes();
  const descVals  = sh.getRange(firstDataRow, cols.description, n, 1).getDisplayValues();
  const srcVals   = sh.getRange(firstDataRow, cols.source, n, 1).getDisplayValues();

  let done = 0, pending = 0, blank = 0, error = 0, incomplete = 0;
  let finalized = 0, pendingFinalize = 0, finalizeError = 0;
  let firstPending = '';
  let firstError = '';

  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const rowNo = firstDataRow + i;
    const d = cleanTextValue_(descVals[i][0]);
    const s = cleanTextValue_(srcVals[i][0]);
    const f = cleanTextValue_(finalVals[i][0]);

    if (!d && !s) {
      blank++;
      continue;
    }
    if (!d || !s) {
      incomplete++;
      continue;
    }
    if (isValidGoogleSheetLinkText_(f)) {
      done++;
      const note = String(finalNotes[i][0] || '');
      if (parseRollingTemplateFinalizeSignature_(note)) finalized++;
      else if (note.indexOf('FINALIZE_ERROR') === 0) finalizeError++;
      else pendingFinalize++;
    } else if (isRollingTemplateCopyErrorText_(f)) {
      error++;
      if (!firstError) firstError = 'row ' + rowNo + ' / ' + (d || s);
    } else {
      pending++;
      if (!firstPending) firstPending = 'row ' + rowNo + ' / ' + (d || s);
    }
  }

  const phase = String(props.getProperty(P.pIntegratedPhase) || 'IDLE').toUpperCase();
  const copyHint = props.getProperty(P.pCopyHint) || '-';
  const finalizeHint = props.getProperty(P.pFinalizeHint) || '-';
  const triggerCount = countTriggersForHandler_(P.fnContinueCopy);
  const runningState = getIntegratedCopyRunningState_(props);
  const lastStatus = readIntegratedCopyLastStatus_(props);
  const journalCount = Object.keys(getRollingTemplateCopyJournal_(props)).length;

  let msg = 'Phase=' + phase +
    ' | Running=' + runningState.label +
    ' | Trigger=' + triggerCount +
    ' | LINK_FINAL=' + done +
    ' | FINALIZED=' + finalized +
    ' | WAIT_FINALIZE=' + pendingFinalize +
    ' | FINALIZE_ERROR=' + finalizeError +
    ' | PENDING_COPY=' + pending +
    ' | COPY_ERROR=' + error +
    ' | tidak lengkap=' + incomplete +
    ' | kosong=' + blank +
    ' | copyHint=' + copyHint +
    ' | finalizeHint=' + finalizeHint +
    ' | crashJournal=' + journalCount;

  if (firstPending) msg += ' | first pending: ' + firstPending;
  if (firstError) msg += ' | first error: ' + firstError;
  if (lastStatus && lastStatus.message) msg += ' | last: ' + lastStatus.message;

  Logger.log(msg);
  showSpreadsheetToast_(msg, 'Copy FINAL Cepat & Aman', 15);
}


function resetIntegratedCopyFinalJob() {
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const P = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS;
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const sh = ss.getActiveSheet();

  const stopResult = emergencyHardStopIntegratedCopyFinal_('RESET_CHECKPOINT', false, props);
  props.setProperty(P.pSpreadsheetId, ss.getId());
  props.setProperty(P.pSheetId, String(sh.getSheetId()));

  const header = findCopyControlHeader_(sh);
  const firstDataRow = header.headerRow + 1;
  const lastRow = getLastCopyControlDataRow_(sh, firstDataRow,
    [header.cols.description, header.cols.source, header.cols.final]);

  let clearedErrors = 0;
  if (lastRow >= firstDataRow) {
    const n = lastRow - firstDataRow + 1;
    const vals = sh.getRange(firstDataRow, header.cols.final, n, 1).getDisplayValues();
    for (let i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
      if (!isRollingTemplateCopyErrorText_(vals[i][0])) continue;
      const cell = sh.getRange(firstDataRow + i, header.cols.final);
      cell.clearContent();
      try { cell.setBackground(null).setNote(''); } catch (e) {}
      clearedErrors++;
    }
  }

  props.setProperty(P.pCopyHint, String(firstDataRow));
  props.deleteProperty(P.pFinalizeHint);
  props.setProperty(P.pIntegratedPhase, 'COPY');
  writeIntegratedCopyStatus_(props, {
    phase: 'STOPPED',
    state: 'RESET_READY_V5',
    message: 'Reset siap. COPY_ERROR dibersihkan=' + clearedErrors +
      '. Klik START hanya setelah execution lama tidak lagi Running.',
    deletedTriggers: stopResult.deletedTriggers,
    at: new Date().toISOString()
  });

  showSpreadsheetToast_(
    'Reset selesai. Trigger dihapus=' + stopResult.deletedTriggers +
    ', COPY_ERROR dibersihkan=' + clearedErrors +
    '. Jangan START selama execution lama masih Running.',
    'Copy FINAL V5',
    15
  );
}


function emergencyHardStopIntegratedCopyFinal() {
  const result = emergencyHardStopIntegratedCopyFinal_('EMERGENCY_MENU', false);
  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
    'EMERGENCY HARD STOP V5 selesai.\n\n' +
    'Trigger copy/validate/cleanse yang dihapus: ' + result.deletedTriggers + '\n' +
    'Generation baru: ' + result.generation + '\n\n' +
    'Penting: execution yang sudah berstatus Running berada di server Google dan tidak dapat dipaksa berhenti dari Apps Script. V5 memasang kill-switch sehingga trigger yang dibuat ulang oleh job lama akan langsung ditolak. Tunggu sampai daftar Running bersih sebelum klik START.'
  );
}


function emergencyHardStopIntegratedCopyFinal_(reason, clearJournal, props) {
  props = props || PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const P = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS;
  const generation = incrementIntegratedCopyGeneration_(props);

  props.setProperty(P.pStopFlag, 'TRUE');
  props.setProperty(P.pEmergencyResetAt, new Date().toISOString());
  props.deleteProperty(P.pRunId);
  props.deleteProperty(P.pRunning);
  props.deleteProperty(P.pCopyHint);
  props.deleteProperty(P.pFinalizeHint);
  props.deleteProperty(P.pValidateHint);
  props.deleteProperty(P.pCopyRetryMap);
  props.deleteProperty(P.pFinalizeRetryMap);
  props.deleteProperty(P.pIntegratedPhase);
  if (clearJournal) props.deleteProperty(P.pCopyJournal);

  const deletedTriggers = deleteAllIntegratedCopyTriggers_();
  writeIntegratedCopyStatus_(props, {
    phase: 'STOPPED',
    state: 'EMERGENCY_STOP_V5',
    generation: generation,
    reason: reason,
    message: 'Kill-switch aktif; semua continuation baru ditolak.',
    at: new Date().toISOString()
  });

  return { deletedTriggers: deletedTriggers, generation: generation };
}


function incrementIntegratedCopyGeneration_(props) {
  const P = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS;
  const current = Number(props.getProperty(P.pGeneration) || 0);
  const next = current >= 2147483000 ? 1 : current + 1;
  props.setProperty(P.pGeneration, String(next));
  return next;
}


function getIntegratedCopyGeneration_(props) {
  return String(props.getProperty(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pGeneration) || '0');
}


function isIntegratedCopyExecutionActive_(props) {
  const P = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS;
  if (String(props.getProperty(P.pStopFlag) || 'TRUE').toUpperCase() === 'TRUE') return false;
  if (!__RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_GENERATION__) return false;
  if (String(props.getProperty(P.pGeneration) || '0') !== String(__RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_GENERATION__)) return false;
  if (__RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_RUN_ID__ &&
      String(props.getProperty(P.pRunId) || '') !== String(__RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_RUN_ID__)) return false;
  return true;
}


function abortIntegratedCopyExecutionNoUi_(props, message) {
  const P = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS;
  writeIntegratedCopyStatus_(props, {
    phase: 'STOPPED',
    state: 'ABORTED_BY_GENERATION_V5',
    generation: __RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_GENERATION__,
    runId: __RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_RUN_ID__,
    message: message || 'Execution dibatalkan oleh kill-switch/generation baru.',
    at: new Date().toISOString()
  });
  props.deleteProperty(P.pRunning);
  return false;
}


function deleteAllIntegratedCopyTriggers_() {
  const keywords = [
    'RSC_CONTINUE_COPY_ROLLING_TEMPLATE_FILES_BG_20260611',
    'RSC_CONTINUE_VALIDATE_COPIED_ROLLING_TEMPLATES_BG_20260611',
    'RSC_CONTINUE_CLEANSE_EXISTING_FINAL_LINKS_ONLY_BG_20260622',
    'RSC_CLEAR_ALL_PROTECTIONS_FROM_FINAL_LINKS_BG_20260611',
    'continueCopyRollingTemplateFilesInBackground',
    'continueValidateCopiedRollingTemplateFilesInBackground',
    'CLN_continue'
  ];
  let deleted = 0;
  ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(function (trigger) {
    const fn = String(trigger.getHandlerFunction() || '');
    if (!keywords.some(function (key) { return fn === key || fn.indexOf(key) !== -1; })) return;
    try { ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger); deleted++; } catch (e) {}
  });
  return deleted;
}


/* ============================================================
 * OPTIMIZED CLEANSE EXISTING FINAL LINKS ONLY
 * Integrated CLN logic: this replaces old "start check existing".
 *
 * Flow:
 * 1. Ambil link dari sheet Rekap Approved kolom E / header Template Rolling Sales FINAL.
 * 2. Buka link satu per satu.
 * 3. Cari sheet target: Change Rolling & Change Schedule / Change Rolling & Change Schedul / versi 31 char / fallback rolling.
 * 4. Paksa kolom G dan L menjadi Plain Text.
 * 5. Normalize G dan L ke YYYY-MM-DD.
 * 6. Jika N = Rolling: G = 2026-08-01 dan L = 2026-08-01.
 * 7. Duplicate check setelah G/L dibetulkan.
 * 8. Duplicate key = concat kolom C..M.
 * 9. Jika key sama: row paling atas disimpan, duplicate bawah dihapus.
 * 10. Error format tanggal lama di O/P dibersihkan.
 * ========================================================== */

/**
 * PERF7 CLEANSE COMPATIBILITY HELPERS
 * These helpers were referenced by the integrated Cleanse module but were
 * missing from the merged source. Keep them dependency-light and batched.
 */
function rscCleanseResolveMasterStart_(sh) {
  const P = OPTIMIZED_FINAL_CLEANSE_PARAMETERS;
  const lastRow = Math.max(1, sh.getLastRow());
  const lastCol = Math.max(1, sh.getLastColumn());
  const scanRows = Math.min(30, lastRow);
  const grid = sh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, lastCol).getDisplayValues();

  let bestHeaderRow = 1;
  let finalCol = 0;

  for (let r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < grid[r].length; c++) {
      const h = String(grid[r][c] == null ? '' : grid[r][c])
        .trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').toUpperCase();
      if (!h) continue;
      if (h === 'TEMPLATE ROLLING SALES FINAL' ||
          (h.indexOf('TEMPLATE ROLLING SALES') !== -1 && h.indexOf('FINAL') !== -1)) {
        bestHeaderRow = r + 1;
        finalCol = c + 1;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (finalCol) break;
  }

  return {
    headerRow: bestHeaderRow,
    firstDataRow: bestHeaderRow + 1 || Number(P.firstDataRowFallback || 2),
    finalCol: finalCol || Number(P.finalLinkColFallback || 5)
  };
}


function rscCleanseGetSmartChipUrls_(spreadsheetId, sheetName, startRow, sourceCol, numRows) {
  if (typeof getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_ === 'function') {
    try {
      return getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_(
        spreadsheetId, sheetName, startRow, sourceCol, numRows
      ) || {};
    } catch (ignore) {}
  }
  if (typeof rscCompileGetSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRangeRobust_ === 'function') {
    try {
      return rscCompileGetSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRangeRobust_(
        spreadsheetId, sheetName, startRow, sourceCol, numRows
      ) || {};
    } catch (ignore2) {}
  }
  return {};
}


function rscCleanseGetUrlFromCell_(displayValue, rawValue, formula, richTextValue) {
  if (typeof getSpreadsheetUrlFromCellData_ === 'function') {
    try {
      const u = getSpreadsheetUrlFromCellData_({
        displayValue: displayValue,
        value: rawValue,
        formula: formula,
        richTextValue: richTextValue
      });
      if (u) return u;
    } catch (ignore) {}
  }

  try {
    if (richTextValue) {
      const whole = richTextValue.getLinkUrl();
      if (whole) return whole;
      const runs = richTextValue.getRuns ? richTextValue.getRuns() : [];
      for (let i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
        const u = runs[i].getLinkUrl();
        if (u) return u;
      }
    }
  } catch (ignoreRich) {}

  const f = String(formula == null ? '' : formula);
  let m = f.match(/HYPERLINK\s*\(\s*"([^"]+)"/i);
  if (m) return m[1];
  m = f.match(/HYPERLINK\s*\(\s*'([^']+)'/i);
  if (m) return m[1];

  const pieces = [rawValue, displayValue];
  for (let i = 0; i < pieces.length; i++) {
    const s = String(pieces[i] == null ? '' : pieces[i]).trim();
    const hit = s.match(/https?:\/\/docs\.google\.com\/spreadsheets\/d\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+[^\s"',)]*/i);
    if (hit) return hit[0];
  }
  return '';
}


function rscCleanseExtractSpreadsheetId_(urlOrId) {
  if (typeof rscCompileExtractSpreadsheetId_ === 'function') {
    const id = rscCompileExtractSpreadsheetId_(urlOrId);
    if (id) return id;
  }
  const text = String(urlOrId == null ? '' : urlOrId).trim();
  if (!text) return '';
  let m = text.match(/\/spreadsheets\/d\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/i);
  if (m) return m[1];
  if (/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{25,}$/.test(text) && text.indexOf('/') === -1) return text;
  return '';
}


function rscCleanseGetTargetSheet_(ss) {
  const P = OPTIMIZED_FINAL_CLEANSE_PARAMETERS;
  const candidates = P.targetSheetCandidates || [];
  for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
    const exact = ss.getSheetByName(candidates[i]);
    if (exact) return exact;
  }
  const sheets = ss.getSheets();
  for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    const name = String(sheets[i].getName() || '');
    const norm = name.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (norm.indexOf('change rolling') !== -1 ||
        (norm.indexOf('rolling') !== -1 && norm.indexOf('schedule') !== -1)) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }
  return null;
}


function rscCleanseFindHeader_(sh) {
  const lastRow = Math.max(1, sh.getLastRow());
  const lastCol = Math.max(1, sh.getLastColumn());
  const scanRows = Math.min(30, lastRow);
  const grid = sh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, lastCol).getDisplayValues();

  for (let r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    const row = grid[r];
    const customerCol = findValidateDateCol_(row, ['customer id', 'customer']);
    const salesmanCol = findValidateDateCol_(row, ['salesman id', 'salesman']);
    if (!customerCol || !salesmanCol) continue;
    return {
      headerRow: r + 1,
      customerCol: customerCol,
      salesmanCol: salesmanCol,
      reasonCol: findValidateDateCol_(row, ['reason']) || 14,
      statusCol: findValidateDateCol_(row, ['validation status', 'status']) || 15,
      detailCol: findValidateDateCol_(row, ['error detail', 'validation detail', 'detail']) || 16
    };
  }

  return {
    headerRow: 1,
    customerCol: 3,
    salesmanCol: 5,
    reasonCol: 14,
    statusCol: 15,
    detailCol: 16
  };
}


function rscCleanseIsBlankRow_(row) {
  if (!row || !row.length) return true;
  for (let i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    if (String(row[i] == null ? '' : row[i]).trim() !== '') return false;
  }
  return true;
}


function rscCleanseCleanErrorDetail_(detail) {
  const raw = String(detail == null ? '' : detail).trim();
  if (!raw) return '';

  const parts = raw.split(/\s*\|\s*/).filter(function (x) {
    return String(x || '').trim() !== '';
  });

  const kept = parts.filter(function (msg) {
    const s = String(msg || '').trim();
    // Cleanse only stale date-format errors. Never suppress business errors.
    if (/^\[R4\].*(?:Valid From|Valid To|Visit Valid From|Visit Valid To).*format YYYY-MM-DD/i.test(s)) return false;
    if (/tanggal.*(?:G|L).*format/i.test(s) && /YYYY-MM-DD/i.test(s)) return false;
    return true;
  });

  return kept.join(' | ');
}


function rscCleanseDeleteRowsBottomUp_(sh, rows) {
  if (!rows || !rows.length) return 0;

  const unique = Object.create(null);
  rows.forEach(function (r) {
    r = Number(r);
    if (isFinite(r) && r > 0) unique[r] = true;
  });

  const sorted = Object.keys(unique).map(Number).sort(function (a, b) { return b - a; });
  if (!sorted.length) return 0;

  // Merge descending contiguous rows into deleteRows(start,count) blocks.
  const groups = [];
  let hi = sorted[0], lo = sorted[0];
  for (let i = 1; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    const r = sorted[i];
    if (r === lo - 1) {
      lo = r;
    } else {
      groups.push({start: lo, count: hi - lo + 1});
      hi = lo = r;
    }
  }
  groups.push({start: lo, count: hi - lo + 1});

  let deleted = 0;
  groups.forEach(function (g) {
    sh.deleteRows(g.start, g.count);
    deleted += g.count;
  });
  return deleted;
}


function startCleanseExistingFinalLinksOnlyOptimizedInBackground() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const P = OPTIMIZED_FINAL_CLEANSE_PARAMETERS;
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName(P.masterSheetName || 'Rekap Approved');

  if (!sh) {
    throw new Error('Sheet master "' + (P.masterSheetName || 'Rekap Approved') + '" tidak ditemukan. Cleanse wajib ambil link dari sheet ini kolom E.');
  }

  const start = rscCleanseResolveMasterStart_(sh);

  props.setProperty(P.pSsId, ss.getId());
  props.setProperty(P.pSheetId, String(sh.getSheetId()));
  props.setProperty(P.pHintRow, String(start.firstDataRow));
  props.setProperty(P.pStats, JSON.stringify({
    startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    lastAt: '',
    processedFiles: 0,
    skippedRows: 0,
    errorFiles: 0,
    checkedRows: 0,
    normalizedRows: 0,
    deletedRows: 0,
    firstError: ''
  }));

  deleteTriggersForFunction_(P.fn);
  continueCleanseExistingFinalLinksOnlyOptimizedInBackground();
}


function continueCleanseExistingFinalLinksOnlyOptimizedInBackground() {
  const started = Date.now();
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const P = OPTIMIZED_FINAL_CLEANSE_PARAMETERS;
  // Gunakan script lock khusus job ini, bukan DocumentLock.
  // DocumentLock sering bentrok dengan job Rolling Sales Center lain (copy/validate),
  // sehingga cleanse terlihat "stuck/skip" padahal hanya menunggu job lain.
  // ScriptLock cukup untuk mencegah overlap sesama cleanse execution.
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();

  try {
    lock.waitLock(30000);
  } catch (lockErr) {
    Logger.log('Cleanse Existing FINAL Links ONLY: masih ada execution cleanse lain berjalan. Skip setelah tunggu 30 detik. ' + formatScriptError_(lockErr));
    showSpreadsheetToast_(
      'Cleanse belum mulai karena execution cleanse lain masih berjalan. Tunggu 1 menit atau klik FORCE RESET Cleanse Lock/Trigger.',
      'Cleanse FINAL',
      10
    );
    return;
  }

  try {
    const ss = getStoredSpreadsheetFromProperties_(P.pSsId);
    const sh = getStoredSheetFromProperties_(ss, P.pSheetId);
    const start = rscCleanseResolveMasterStart_(sh);
    const finalCol = start.finalCol;
    const firstDataRow = start.firstDataRow;
    const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();

    if (lastRow < firstDataRow) {
      finishCleanseExistingFinalLinksOnlyOptimized_('Tidak ada link FINAL di kolom E.');
      return;
    }

    let cursor = Number(props.getProperty(P.pHintRow) || firstDataRow);
    if (cursor < firstDataRow) cursor = firstDataRow;
    if (cursor > lastRow) {
      finishCleanseExistingFinalLinksOnlyOptimized_('Cleanse Existing FINAL Links ONLY selesai semua.');
      return;
    }

    const n = lastRow - cursor + 1;
    const rng = sh.getRange(cursor, finalCol, n, 1);
    const disp = rng.getDisplayValues();
    const vals = rng.getValues();
    const formulas = rng.getFormulas();
    const rich = rng.getRichTextValues();

    let chipMap = {};
    try {
      chipMap = rscCleanseGetSmartChipUrls_(ss.getId(), sh.getName(), cursor, finalCol, n);
    } catch (err) {
      chipMap = {};
    }

    const stats = getCleanseExistingFinalLinksOnlyStats_();
    let filesThisRun = 0;
    let processedFiles = 0;
    let skippedRows = 0;
    let errorFiles = 0;
    let checkedRows = 0;
    let normalizedRows = 0;
    let deletedRows = 0;
    let nextCursor = lastRow + 1;

    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const masterRow = cursor + i;
      nextCursor = masterRow + 1;

      if (filesThisRun >= (P.hardMaxFilesPerRun || 20) ||
          Date.now() - started > (P.softDeadlineMs || 285 * 1000)) {
        nextCursor = masterRow;
        break;
      }

      const url = rscCleanseGetUrlFromCell_(disp[i][0], vals[i][0], formulas[i][0], rich[i][0]) ||
        chipMap[masterRow] || String(vals[i][0] || disp[i][0] || '');
      const fileId = rscCleanseExtractSpreadsheetId_(url);

      if (!fileId) {
        skippedRows++;
        continue;
      }

      filesThisRun++;

      try {
        const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(fileId);
        const targetSh = rscCleanseGetTargetSheet_(targetSs);
        if (!targetSh) {
          skippedRows++;
          sh.getRange(masterRow, finalCol)
            .setBackground(P.colorSkip || '#FFF2CC')
            .setNote('SKIP: sheet target rolling tidak ditemukan.');
          continue;
        }

        const res = cleanseRollingTemplateSheetFast_(targetSh);
        processedFiles++;
        checkedRows += res.checkedRows || 0;
        normalizedRows += res.normalizedRows || 0;
        deletedRows += res.deletedRows || 0;

        sh.getRange(masterRow, finalCol)
          .setBackground(P.colorOk || '#B7E1CD')
          .setNote('OK cleanse. checked=' + (res.checkedRows || 0) +
            ', normalized=' + (res.normalizedRows || 0) +
            ', deletedDup=' + (res.deletedRows || 0) +
            ', at=' + new Date().toISOString());

      } catch (err) {
        errorFiles++;
        const msg = String(err && err.message ? err.message : err);
        if (!stats.firstError) stats.firstError = 'row ' + masterRow + ': ' + msg;
        sh.getRange(masterRow, finalCol)
          .setBackground(P.colorError || '#F4C7C3')
          .setNote('ERROR cleanse: ' + msg);
      }
    }

    stats.lastAt = new Date().toISOString();
    stats.processedFiles += processedFiles;
    stats.skippedRows += skippedRows;
    stats.errorFiles += errorFiles;
    stats.checkedRows += checkedRows;
    stats.normalizedRows += normalizedRows;
    stats.deletedRows += deletedRows;
    props.setProperty(P.pStats, JSON.stringify(stats));

    if (nextCursor <= lastRow) {
      props.setProperty(P.pHintRow, String(nextCursor));
      deleteTriggersForFunction_(P.fn);
      RSC_PERF13_NEW_TRIGGER_20260819_(P.fn)
        .timeBased()
        .after(P.triggerDelayMs || 20 * 1000)
        .create();

      showSpreadsheetToast_(
        'Cleanse pause. fileOK=' + processedFiles +
        ', skip=' + skippedRows +
        ', err=' + errorFiles +
        ', normalized=' + normalizedRows +
        ', dupDeleted=' + deletedRows +
        '. Lanjut otomatis dari row ' + nextCursor + '.',
        'Cleanse FINAL',
        10
      );
    } else {
      finishCleanseExistingFinalLinksOnlyOptimized_(
        'SELESAI. fileOK=' + stats.processedFiles +
        ', skip=' + stats.skippedRows +
        ', err=' + stats.errorFiles +
        ', checked=' + stats.checkedRows +
        ', normalized=' + stats.normalizedRows +
        ', dupDeleted=' + stats.deletedRows +
        (stats.firstError ? ' | firstError=' + stats.firstError : '')
      );
    }
  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (err) {}
  }
}


function showCleanseExistingFinalLinksOnlyOptimizedStatus() {
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const P = OPTIMIZED_FINAL_CLEANSE_PARAMETERS;
  const stats = getCleanseExistingFinalLinksOnlyStats_();
  const cursor = props.getProperty(P.pHintRow);

  const msg = 'Cleanse status | cursor=' + (cursor || '-') +
    ' | fileOK=' + (stats.processedFiles || 0) +
    ' skip=' + (stats.skippedRows || 0) +
    ' err=' + (stats.errorFiles || 0) +
    ' checked=' + (stats.checkedRows || 0) +
    ' normalized=' + (stats.normalizedRows || 0) +
    ' dupDeleted=' + (stats.deletedRows || 0) +
    (stats.firstError ? ' | firstError=' + stats.firstError : '');

  Logger.log(msg);
  showSpreadsheetToast_(msg, 'Cleanse FINAL', 12);
}


function stopCleanseExistingFinalLinksOnlyOptimized() {
  const P = OPTIMIZED_FINAL_CLEANSE_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.deleteProperty(P.pHintRow);
  deleteTriggersForFunction_(P.fn);
  // Hapus juga trigger/function lama CLN standalone jika pernah dipaste di project yang sama.
  deleteTriggersForFunction_('CLN_continue');
  deleteTriggersForFunction_('RSC_CONTINUE_CLEANSE_EXISTING_FINAL_LINKS_ONLY_BG_20260622');
  showSpreadsheetToast_('Cleanse dihentikan. Trigger lanjutan sudah dihapus. Jika masih skip, tunggu execution yang sedang Running selesai atau klik FORCE RESET.', 'Cleanse FINAL', 10);
}


function forceResetCleanseExistingFinalLinksOnlyOptimized() {
  const P = OPTIMIZED_FINAL_CLEANSE_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const allProps = props.getProperties();

  const handlerKeywords = [
    'CLEANSE_EXISTING_FINAL_LINKS',
    'RSC_CONTINUE_CLEANSE_EXISTING_FINAL_LINKS_ONLY_BG_20260622',
    'RSC_START_CLEANSE_EXISTING_FINAL_LINKS_ONLY_BG_20260622',
    'CLN_continue',
    'CLN_start'
  ];

  const propertyKeywords = [
    'OPTIMIZED_FINAL_CLEANSE',
    'CLEANSE_EXISTING_FINAL_LINKS',
    'CLEANSE_EXISTING_FINAL',
    'FINAL_LINKS_ONLY',
    'CLN_'
  ];

  let deletedTriggers = 0;
  ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(function(trigger) {
    const fn = String(trigger.getHandlerFunction() || '');
    const shouldDelete = handlerKeywords.some(function(keyword) {
      return fn.indexOf(keyword) !== -1;
    });
    if (shouldDelete) {
      try { ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger); deletedTriggers++; } catch (err) {}
    }
  });

  let deletedProps = 0;
  Object.keys(allProps).forEach(function(key) {
    const shouldDelete = propertyKeywords.some(function(keyword) {
      return String(key).indexOf(keyword) !== -1;
    });
    if (shouldDelete || key === P.pHintRow || key === P.pSsId || key === P.pSheetId || key === P.pStats) {
      try { props.deleteProperty(key); deletedProps++; } catch (err) {}
    }
  });

  showSpreadsheetToast_(
    'Force reset cleanse selesai. Trigger deleted=' + deletedTriggers +
    ', properties deleted=' + deletedProps +
    '. Tunggu ±1 menit jika masih ada execution Running, lalu Start Check Existing / Cleanse FINAL Links.',
    'Cleanse FINAL',
    12
  );
}


function finishCleanseExistingFinalLinksOnlyOptimized_(message) {
  const P = OPTIMIZED_FINAL_CLEANSE_PARAMETERS;
  PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().deleteProperty(P.pHintRow);
  deleteTriggersForFunction_(P.fn);
  Logger.log(message);
  showSpreadsheetToast_(message, 'Cleanse FINAL', 12);
}


function getCleanseExistingFinalLinksOnlyStats_() {
  const P = OPTIMIZED_FINAL_CLEANSE_PARAMETERS;
  const raw = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().getProperty(P.pStats);
  const base = {
    startedAt: '', lastAt: '', processedFiles: 0, skippedRows: 0, errorFiles: 0,
    checkedRows: 0, normalizedRows: 0, deletedRows: 0, firstError: ''
  };
  if (!raw) return base;
  try { return Object.assign(base, JSON.parse(raw) || {}); } catch (err) { return base; }
}


function cleanseRollingTemplateSheetFast_(sh) {
  const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  if (lastRow < 2 || lastCol < 1) return { checkedRows: 0, normalizedRows: 0, deletedRows: 0 };

  const hdr = rscCleanseFindHeader_(sh);
  const firstDataRow = hdr.headerRow + 1;
  if (lastRow < firstDataRow) return { checkedRows: 0, normalizedRows: 0, deletedRows: 0 };

  // Layout fixed sesuai template.
  // Canonical key V6: C Customer ID + D Relationship + E Salesman ID +
  // G Valid From + J Visit Type + L Visit Valid From.
  const COL_CUSTOMER = 3;
  const COL_RELATIONSHIP = 4;
  const COL_SALESMAN = 5;
  const COL_G = 7;
  const COL_J = 10;
  const COL_L = 12;
  const KEY_COLS = [
    COL_CUSTOMER,
    COL_RELATIONSHIP,
    COL_SALESMAN,
    COL_G,
    COL_J,
    COL_L
  ];
  const MAX_KEY_COL = Math.max.apply(null, KEY_COLS);

  if (lastCol < MAX_KEY_COL) return { checkedRows: 0, normalizedRows: 0, deletedRows: 0 };

  const cReason = hdr.reasonCol || 14;
  const cStatus = hdr.statusCol || 15;
  const cDetail = hdr.detailCol || 16;
  const maxCols = sh.getMaxColumns();
  const readCols = Math.min(Math.max(lastCol, MAX_KEY_COL, cReason, cStatus, cDetail), maxCols);
  const statusAvailable = cStatus <= readCols;
  const detailAvailable = cDetail <= readCols;

  const rowCount = lastRow - firstDataRow + 1;
  const rng = sh.getRange(firstDataRow, 1, rowCount, readCols);
  const disp = rng.getDisplayValues();
  const vals = rng.getValues();

  const rollingDate = String(OPTIMIZED_FINAL_CLEANSE_PARAMETERS.rollingDateText || '2026-08-01');
  const gOut = new Array(rowCount);
  const lOut = new Array(rowCount);
  const statusOut = statusAvailable ? new Array(rowCount) : null;
  const detailOut = detailAvailable ? new Array(rowCount) : null;

  const seen = {};
  const toDelete = [];
  let checkedRows = 0;
  let normalizedRows = 0;
  let statusChanged = false;

  for (let r = 0; r < rowCount; r++) {
    const dRow = disp[r];
    const vRow = vals[r];

    if (statusOut) statusOut[r] = [dRow[cStatus - 1] || ''];
    if (detailOut) detailOut[r] = [dRow[cDetail - 1] || ''];

    const blank = rscCleanseIsBlankRow_(dRow);

    // Normalize G & L to YYYY-MM-DD.
    const oldG = rscCleanseNormalizeDateText_(vRow[COL_G - 1], dRow[COL_G - 1]);
    const oldL = rscCleanseNormalizeDateText_(vRow[COL_L - 1], dRow[COL_L - 1]);
    let newG = oldG;
    let newL = oldL;

    // Jika N = Rolling: paksa ke 2026-08-01.
    const reason = String(dRow[cReason - 1] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (reason === 'ROLLING') {
      newG = rollingDate;
      newL = rollingDate;
    }

    // Output harus string text, bukan Date object.
    gOut[r] = [String(newG || '').replace(/^'/, '').trim()];
    lOut[r] = [String(newL || '').replace(/^'/, '').trim()];

    if (blank) continue;
    checkedRows++;

    const oldGdisp = String(dRow[COL_G - 1] || '').trim().replace(/^'/, '');
    const oldLdisp = String(dRow[COL_L - 1] || '').trim().replace(/^'/, '');
    if (oldG !== newG || oldL !== newL || oldGdisp !== newG || oldLdisp !== newL) {
      normalizedRows++;
    }

    // Bersihkan error format tanggal lama di O/P.
    if (statusOut && detailOut) {
      const before = String(detailOut[r][0] || '').trim();
      const after = rscCleanseCleanErrorDetail_(before);
      if (after !== before) {
        detailOut[r][0] = after;
        if (!after && String(statusOut[r][0] || '').trim().toUpperCase() === 'ERROR') {
          statusOut[r][0] = 'OK';
        }
        statusChanged = true;
      }
    }

    // Build canonical duplicate key setelah G/L dinormalisasi:
    // Customer ID + Relationship + Salesman ID + Valid From + Visit Type + Visit Valid From.
    const keyParts = [];
    for (let keyIndex = 0; keyIndex < KEY_COLS.length; keyIndex++) {
      const col = KEY_COLS[keyIndex];
      let keyText = '';
      if (col === COL_G) keyText = newG;
      else if (col === COL_L) keyText = newL;
      else keyText = dRow[col - 1];

      keyParts.push(
        col === COL_J
          ? normalizeRollingTemplateVisitTypeKey_(keyText)
          : rscCleanseKeyPart_(keyText)
      );
    }

    const key = keyParts.join('||');
    if (!key.replace(/\|/g, '')) continue;

    // Keep paling atas, duplicate bawah dihapus.
    if (seen[key]) toDelete.push(firstDataRow + r);
    else seen[key] = firstDataRow + r;
  }

  // Paksa G dan L Plain Text SEBELUM tulis string YYYY-MM-DD.
  const rangeG = sh.getRange(firstDataRow, COL_G, rowCount, 1);
  const rangeL = sh.getRange(firstDataRow, COL_L, rowCount, 1);
  rangeG.setNumberFormat('@').setValues(gOut);
  rangeL.setNumberFormat('@').setValues(lOut);

  if (statusChanged) {
    try {
      if (statusOut) sh.getRange(firstDataRow, cStatus, rowCount, 1).setValues(statusOut);
      if (detailOut) sh.getRange(firstDataRow, cDetail, rowCount, 1).setValues(detailOut);
    } catch (err) {}
  }

  // Delete duplicate dari bawah supaya index tidak bergeser.
  rscCleanseDeleteRowsBottomUp_(sh, toDelete);

  // Re-force format G/L di sisa row.
  const newLast = sh.getLastRow();
  if (newLast >= firstDataRow) {
    const newCount = newLast - firstDataRow + 1;
    sh.getRange(firstDataRow, COL_G, newCount, 1).setNumberFormat('@');
    sh.getRange(firstDataRow, COL_L, newCount, 1).setNumberFormat('@');
  }

  return { checkedRows: checkedRows, normalizedRows: normalizedRows, deletedRows: toDelete.length };
}


function rscCleanseNormalizeDateText_(rawValue, displayValue) {
  /**
   * IMPORTANT FIX 2026-06-22:
   * For mixed Google Sheet date cells, do NOT prioritize Date object first.
   * Some FINAL files show "3/1/2026" but the underlying Date object can be
   * interpreted differently depending on locale/timezone. The business rule
   * for this template is display-slash format = M/D/YYYY by default:
   *   3/1/2026 -> 2026-03-01
   *   7/1/2026 -> 2026-08-01
   * If first number > 12, fallback to D/M/YYYY:
   *   31/12/9999 -> 9999-12-31
   *
   * Therefore we parse display text first, then fallback to raw Date object.
   */
  let display = String(displayValue == null ? '' : displayValue).trim().replace(/^'/, '').trim();
  let rawText = String(rawValue == null ? '' : rawValue).trim().replace(/^'/, '').trim();
  let s = display || rawText;
  if (!s) return '';

  // Already YYYY-M-D / YYYY-MM-DD from display/text.
  let m = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})$/);
  if (m) {
    return rscCleansePad_(m[1], 4) + '-' + rscCleansePad_(m[2], 2) + '-' + rscCleansePad_(m[3], 2);
  }

  // Slash/dash/dot format. Business default is M/D/YYYY.
  // Fallback to D/M/YYYY only when first number cannot be month (>12).
  m = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})[\/\-.](\d{1,2})[\/\-.](\d{4})$/);
  if (m) {
    const a = Number(m[1]);
    const b = Number(m[2]);
    const y = Number(m[3]);
    let month = a;
    let day = b;

    if (a > 12 && b <= 12) {
      day = a;
      month = b;
    }

    const validMonth = month >= 1 && month <= 12;
    const validDay = day >= 1 && day <= 31;
    if (validMonth && validDay) {
      return rscCleansePad_(y, 4) + '-' + rscCleansePad_(month, 2) + '-' + rscCleansePad_(day, 2);
    }
  }

  // Epoch milliseconds.
  if (/^\d{12,13}$/.test(s)) {
    const dt2 = new Date(Number(s));
    if (!isNaN(dt2.getTime())) return Utilities.formatDate(dt2, Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
  }

  // Fallback to raw Date object only if display text did not already define
  // a recognizable date string.
  if (rawValue instanceof Date && !isNaN(rawValue.getTime())) {
    return Utilities.formatDate(rawValue, Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
  }

  // Fallback parse for Date-like strings, but only if it is not an ambiguous
  // slash format handled above.
  const dt = new Date(s);
  if (!isNaN(dt.getTime()) && !/^\d{1,2}[\/\-.]\d{1,2}[\/\-.]\d{4}$/.test(s)) {
    return Utilities.formatDate(dt, Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
  }

  return s;
}

function rscCleansePad_(value, len) {
  let s = String(value == null ? '' : value);
  while (s.length < len) s = '0' + s;
  return s;
}


function rscCleanseKeyPart_(value) {
  return normalizeRollingTemplateBusinessKeyPart_(value);
}


function rscCleanseColLetter_(col) {
  let n = Number(col);
  let out = '';
  while (n > 0) {
    const rem = (n - 1) % 26;
    out = String.fromCharCode(65 + rem) + out;
    n = Math.floor((n - rem - 1) / 26);
  }
  return out;
}


function normalizeRscCleanseDateTextStrict_(rawValue, displayValue) {
  // Backward-compatible alias for older helper references.
  return rscCleanseNormalizeDateText_(rawValue, displayValue);
}


function normalizeRscCleanseKeyPart_(value) {
  // Backward-compatible alias for older helper references.
  return rscCleanseKeyPart_(value);
}


function removeRollingDateFormatErrorsFromDetail_(detail) {
  // Backward-compatible alias for older helper references.
  return rscCleanseCleanErrorDetail_(detail);
}


function normalizeRollingTemplateSyncDateTextForFastKey_(rawValue, displayValue) {
  return rscCleanseNormalizeDateText_(rawValue, displayValue);
}


/* ============================================================
 * COPY ENGINE
 * ========================================================== */

function continueCopyRollingTemplateFilesInBackground() {
  const started = Date.now();
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const P = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS;

  // Gate pertama: trigger lama yang hidup kembali setelah hard reset harus berhenti
  // sebelum menyentuh spreadsheet atau membuat trigger baru.
  if (String(props.getProperty(P.pStopFlag) || 'TRUE').toUpperCase() === 'TRUE') {
    deleteAllIntegratedCopyTriggers_();
    return;
  }

  __RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_GENERATION__ = getIntegratedCopyGeneration_(props);
  __RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_RUN_ID__ = String(props.getProperty(P.pRunId) || '');
  if (!__RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_RUN_ID__) {
    deleteAllIntegratedCopyTriggers_();
    return;
  }

  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(Number(P.integratedCopyLockWaitMs || 1000))) {
    // Jangan menunggu 30 detik dan jangan membuat badai execution. Scheduler V5
    // diserialkan dan hanya menyisakan satu pending trigger.
    if (isIntegratedCopyExecutionActive_(props)) {
      ensureIntegratedCopyContinuationTrigger_();
      writeIntegratedCopyStatus_(props, {
        phase: String(props.getProperty(P.pIntegratedPhase) || 'COPY'),
        state: 'LOCK_BUSY_RETRY_V5',
        generation: __RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_GENERATION__,
        runId: __RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_RUN_ID__,
        message: 'Lock masih dipakai execution lain; satu retry dijadwalkan.',
        at: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    }
    return;
  }

  try {
    if (!isIntegratedCopyExecutionActive_(props)) {
      abortIntegratedCopyExecutionNoUi_(props, 'Dibatalkan setelah memperoleh lock.');
      return;
    }

    const ss = getCopyMasterSpreadsheet_();
    const sh = getCopyTargetSheet_(ss);
    const header = findCopyControlHeader_(sh);
    const cols = header.cols;
    const firstDataRow = header.headerRow + 1;
    const lastDataRow = getLastCopyControlDataRow_(sh, firstDataRow,
      [cols.description, cols.source, cols.final]);

    if (lastDataRow < firstDataRow) {
      finishCopyRollingTemplateFiles_(props, 'Tidak ada data untuk dicopy.');
      return;
    }

    let phase = String(props.getProperty(P.pIntegratedPhase) || 'COPY').toUpperCase();
    if (phase !== 'COPY' && phase !== 'FINALIZE') phase = 'COPY';
    props.setProperty(P.pIntegratedPhase, phase);
    props.setProperty(P.pRunning, JSON.stringify({
      phase: phase,
      generation: __RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_GENERATION__,
      runId: __RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_RUN_ID__,
      startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      leaseUntilMs: Date.now() + 4 * 60 * 1000
    }));

    if (phase === 'FINALIZE') {
      continueIntegratedFinalizeExistingFinalLinks_(
        started, props, ss, sh, header, firstDataRow, lastDataRow
      );
      return;
    }

    continueIntegratedCopyPendingRows_(
      started, props, ss, sh, header, firstDataRow, lastDataRow
    );

  } catch (err) {
    if (!isIntegratedCopyExecutionActive_(props)) {
      abortIntegratedCopyExecutionNoUi_(props, 'Execution dibatalkan saat error/cancel.');
      return;
    }
    writeIntegratedCopyStatus_(props, {
      phase: String(props.getProperty(P.pIntegratedPhase) || 'COPY'),
      state: 'GLOBAL_ERROR_RETRY_V5',
      generation: __RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_GENERATION__,
      runId: __RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_RUN_ID__,
      message: 'Global error; satu retry otomatis dijadwalkan.',
      error: shortenRollingTemplateCopyError_(err),
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    });
    ensureIntegratedCopyContinuationTrigger_();
    Logger.log('Copy FINAL V5 global error: ' +
      String(err && err.stack ? err.stack : err));
  } finally {
    // Jangan menghapus lease milik generasi baru yang mungkin sudah dimulai.
    try {
      const running = JSON.parse(props.getProperty(P.pRunning) || '{}');
      if (String(running.generation || '') === String(__RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_GENERATION__) &&
          String(running.runId || '') === String(__RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_RUN_ID__)) {
        props.deleteProperty(P.pRunning);
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (e) {}
  }
}


function continueIntegratedCopyPendingRows_(started, props, ss, sh, header, firstDataRow, lastDataRow) {
  const P = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS;
  const cols = header.cols;
  let cursor = Number(props.getProperty(P.pCopyHint) || firstDataRow);
  if (cursor < firstDataRow || cursor > lastDataRow) cursor = firstDataRow;

  const targetFolder = getActiveSpreadsheetFolder_();
  const retryMap = getRollingTemplateCopyRetryMap_(props);
  const journal = getRollingTemplateCopyJournal_(props);
  const chunkSize = Math.max(50, Number(P.copyReadChunkRows || 1000));
  const stopBeforeMs = Math.max(0, Number(P.softDeadlineMs || 270000) - Number(P.copyStartGuardMs || 20000));

  let copied = 0;
  let reusedJournal = 0;
  let skipped = 0;
  let errors = 0;
  let alreadyDone = 0;
  let markedCopyErrors = 0;
  const logs = [];

  function pauseCopy_(reason) {
    if (!isIntegratedCopyExecutionActive_(props)) {
      saveRollingTemplateCopyRetryMap_(props, retryMap);
      saveRollingTemplateCopyJournal_(props, journal);
      abortIntegratedCopyExecutionNoUi_(props, 'COPY dibatalkan sebelum pause.');
      return;
    }
    props.setProperty(P.pCopyHint, String(cursor));
    saveRollingTemplateCopyRetryMap_(props, retryMap);
    saveRollingTemplateCopyJournal_(props, journal);
    writeIntegratedCopyStatus_(props, {
      phase: 'COPY',
      state: 'PAUSED',
      message: reason + ' | copied=' + copied + ', reused=' + reusedJournal + ', error=' + errors + '.',
      nextRow: cursor,
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    });
    ensureIntegratedCopyContinuationTrigger_();
    Logger.log(logs.join('\n'));
    showSpreadsheetToast_(
      'COPY pause di row ' + cursor + '. Copy=' + copied + ' Reuse=' + reusedJournal +
      ' Skip=' + skipped + ' Err=' + errors + '. Lanjut otomatis.',
      'Copy FINAL Cepat & Aman',
      10
    );
  }

  while (cursor <= lastDataRow) {
    if (!isIntegratedCopyExecutionActive_(props)) {
      saveRollingTemplateCopyRetryMap_(props, retryMap);
      saveRollingTemplateCopyJournal_(props, journal);
      abortIntegratedCopyExecutionNoUi_(props, 'COPY dibatalkan pada checkpoint chunk.');
      return;
    }
    if (Date.now() - started >= stopBeforeMs || copied >= P.hardMaxCopiesPerRun) {
      pauseCopy_('Batas waktu/batch tercapai');
      return;
    }

    const chunkStart = cursor;
    const chunkCount = Math.min(chunkSize, lastDataRow - chunkStart + 1);
    const desc = sh.getRange(chunkStart, cols.description, chunkCount, 1).getDisplayValues();
    const srcRange = sh.getRange(chunkStart, cols.source, chunkCount, 1);
    const srcDisp = srcRange.getDisplayValues();
    const srcVals = srcRange.getValues();
    const srcForm = srcRange.getFormulas();
    const srcRich = srcRange.getRichTextValues();
    const finalRange = sh.getRange(chunkStart, cols.final, chunkCount, 1);
    const finalDisp = finalRange.getDisplayValues();
    const chipMap = getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_(
      ss.getId(), sh.getName(), chunkStart, cols.source, chunkCount);

    if (P.clearFinalColumnValidation) {
      try { finalRange.clearDataValidations(); } catch (e) {}
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < chunkCount; i++) {
      const row = chunkStart + i;
      cursor = row;

      if (!isIntegratedCopyExecutionActive_(props)) {
        saveRollingTemplateCopyRetryMap_(props, retryMap);
        saveRollingTemplateCopyJournal_(props, journal);
        abortIntegratedCopyExecutionNoUi_(props, 'COPY dibatalkan sebelum row ' + row + '.');
        return;
      }
      if (Date.now() - started >= stopBeforeMs || copied >= P.hardMaxCopiesPerRun) {
        pauseCopy_('Batas waktu/batch tercapai');
        return;
      }

      const description = cleanTextValue_(desc[i][0]);
      const sourceText = cleanTextValue_(srcDisp[i][0]);
      const existingFin = cleanTextValue_(finalDisp[i][0]);

      if (!description && !sourceText) {
        skipped++;
        cursor = row + 1;
        continue;
      }
      if (isRollingTemplateCopyErrorText_(existingFin)) {
        errors++;
        cursor = row + 1;
        continue;
      }
      if (isValidGoogleSheetLinkText_(existingFin)) {
        alreadyDone++;
        delete journal[String(row)];
        cursor = row + 1;
        continue;
      }
      if (!description || !sourceText) {
        skipped++;
        logs.push('Row ' + row + ': SKIP - Description/Source belum lengkap.');
        cursor = row + 1;
        continue;
      }

      try {
        const sourceFileId = resolveRollingTemplateSourceFileIdFromCachedRow_(
          row, sourceText, srcRich[i][0], srcForm[i][0], srcVals[i][0], chipMap
        );
        if (!sourceFileId) {
          throw new Error('File/link source tidak ditemukan dari: ' + sourceText);
        }

        const title = cleanFileNameForCopy_(P.fileTitlePrefix + description);
        let copiedFile = null;
        let copiedFileId = '';
        const j = journal[String(row)];

        if (j && String(j.sourceFileId || '') === String(sourceFileId) && j.copiedFileId) {
          try {
            copiedFile = DriveApp.getFileById(j.copiedFileId);
            if (!copiedFile.isTrashed()) {
              copiedFileId = copiedFile.getId();
              reusedJournal++;
            }
          } catch (journalErr) {
            copiedFile = null;
            copiedFileId = '';
          }
        }

        if (!copiedFileId) {
          if (!isIntegratedCopyExecutionActive_(props)) {
            saveRollingTemplateCopyJournal_(props, journal);
            abortIntegratedCopyExecutionNoUi_(props, 'COPY dibatalkan tepat sebelum makeCopy row ' + row + '.');
            return;
          }
          const srcFile = DriveApp.getFileById(sourceFileId);
          copiedFile = targetFolder
            ? srcFile.makeCopy(title, targetFolder)
            : srcFile.makeCopy(title);
          copiedFileId = copiedFile.getId();

          journal[String(row)] = {
            sourceFileId: sourceFileId,
            copiedFileId: copiedFileId,
            title: title,
            createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
          };
          saveRollingTemplateCopyJournal_(props, journal);
        }

        if (!isIntegratedCopyExecutionActive_(props)) {
          saveRollingTemplateCopyJournal_(props, journal);
          abortIntegratedCopyExecutionNoUi_(props, 'COPY dibatalkan setelah makeCopy row ' + row + '; journal dipertahankan agar file tidak diduplikasi.');
          return;
        }

        const url = 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/' + copiedFileId + '/edit';
        const cell = sh.getRange(row, cols.final);
        cell.setValue(url);
        try {
          cell.setBackground('#FFF2CC').setNote(
            'COPY CREATED - PENDING FINALIZE | ' + new Date().toISOString() +
            ' | source=' + sourceFileId + ' | final=' + copiedFileId
          );
        } catch (e) {}

        let permissionWarning = '';
        if (P.setDomainEditorAccess && copiedFile) {
          try {
            if (!safelySetFileDomainEditorAccess_(copiedFile)) {
              permissionWarning = ' | permission warning=domain sharing tidak dapat diubah';
            }
          } catch (permissionErr) {
            permissionWarning = ' | permission warning=' + shortenRollingTemplateCopyError_(permissionErr);
          }
        }

        delete retryMap[String(row)];
        delete journal[String(row)];
        copied++;
        logs.push('Row ' + row + ': COPY COMMITTED - ' + title + permissionWarning);

      } catch (err) {
        errors++;
        const markResult = markRollingTemplateCopyRowRetryOrError_(
          sh, row, cols.final, err, retryMap
        );
        if (markResult.permanentError) markedCopyErrors++;
        logs.push('Row ' + row + ': ERROR retry ' + markResult.retryCount + '/' +
          markResult.maxRetries + ' - ' + shortenRollingTemplateCopyError_(err));
      }
      cursor = row + 1;
    }
  }

  try { SpreadsheetApp.flush(); } catch (e) {}
  Logger.log(logs.join('\n'));
  saveRollingTemplateCopyJournal_(props, journal);

  const stillPending = countPendingRollingTemplateCopies_(
    sh, cols, firstDataRow, lastDataRow
  );

  if (stillPending > 0) {
    props.setProperty(P.pCopyHint, String(firstDataRow));
    saveRollingTemplateCopyRetryMap_(props, retryMap);
    writeIntegratedCopyStatus_(props, {
      phase: 'COPY',
      state: 'RETRY_PENDING',
      message: 'Satu scan selesai; pending=' + stillPending + ', retry otomatis.',
      copied: copied,
      reusedJournal: reusedJournal,
      errors: errors,
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    });
    ensureIntegratedCopyContinuationTrigger_();
    showSpreadsheetToast_(
      'Scan COPY selesai. Copy=' + copied + ' Reuse=' + reusedJournal +
      ' SudahAda=' + alreadyDone + ' Err=' + errors +
      ' COPY_ERROR=' + markedCopyErrors + ' | pending=' + stillPending + '.',
      'Copy FINAL Cepat & Aman',
      12
    );
    return;
  }

  props.deleteProperty(P.pCopyHint);
  props.deleteProperty(P.pCopyRetryMap);
  props.deleteProperty(P.pCopyJournal);

  if (P.finalizeExistingFinalLinksAfterCopy) {
    props.setProperty(P.pIntegratedPhase, 'FINALIZE');
    props.setProperty(P.pFinalizeHint, String(firstDataRow));
    writeIntegratedCopyStatus_(props, {
      phase: 'FINALIZE',
      state: 'PHASE_CHANGED',
      message: 'COPY cepat selesai; lanjut cleanup/sync/deduplicate FINAL.',
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    });

    // Tidak perlu menunggu trigger baru bila masih ada waktu aman pada execution ini.
    if (Date.now() - started < Number(P.softDeadlineMs || 270000) - Number(P.finalizeStartGuardMs || 60000)) {
      continueIntegratedFinalizeExistingFinalLinks_(
        started, props, ss, sh, header, firstDataRow, lastDataRow
      );
      return;
    }

    ensureIntegratedCopyContinuationTrigger_();
    showSpreadsheetToast_(
      'Fase COPY cepat selesai. Lanjut otomatis ke FINALIZE aman.',
      'Copy FINAL Cepat & Aman',
      10
    );
    return;
  }

  finishCopyRollingTemplateFiles_(props,
    'COPY SELESAI. Copy=' + copied + ' Reuse=' + reusedJournal +
    ' SudahAda=' + alreadyDone + ' Err=' + errors + '.');
}


function continueIntegratedFinalizeExistingFinalLinks_(started, props, ss, sh, header, firstDataRow, lastDataRow) {
  const P = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS;
  const cols = header.cols;
  let cursor = Number(props.getProperty(P.pFinalizeHint) || firstDataRow);
  if (cursor < firstDataRow) cursor = firstDataRow;

  if (cursor > lastDataRow) {
    finishCopyRollingTemplateFiles_(props, 'COPY + FINALIZE SELESAI SEMUA.');
    return;
  }

  const maxFiles = Number(P.finalizeHardMaxFilesPerRun || 10);
  const chunkSize = Math.max(25, Number(P.finalizeReadChunkRows || 250));
  const stopBeforeMs = Math.max(0, Number(P.softDeadlineMs || 270000) - Number(P.finalizeStartGuardMs || 60000));
  const retryMap = getRollingTemplateFinalizeRetryMap_(props);
  const sourceUpdatedCache = {};
  const finalUpdatedCache = {};
  const processedPairCache = {};

  let checked = 0;
  let heavyProcessed = 0;
  let finalized = 0;
  let unchangedSkipped = 0;
  let samePairSkipped = 0;
  let skipped = 0;
  let errors = 0;
  let permanentErrors = 0;
  let addedRows = 0;
  let normalizedRows = 0;
  let deletedRows = 0;
  let lowestRetryRow = lastDataRow + 1;
  const logs = [];

  function pauseFinalize_(reason) {
    if (!isIntegratedCopyExecutionActive_(props)) {
      saveRollingTemplateFinalizeRetryMap_(props, retryMap);
      abortIntegratedCopyExecutionNoUi_(props, 'FINALIZE dibatalkan sebelum pause.');
      return;
    }
    const nextRow = Math.min(cursor, lowestRetryRow);
    const checkpoint = nextRow > lastDataRow ? cursor : nextRow;
    props.setProperty(P.pFinalizeHint, String(checkpoint));
    saveRollingTemplateFinalizeRetryMap_(props, retryMap);
    writeIntegratedCopyStatus_(props, {
      phase: 'FINALIZE',
      state: 'PAUSED',
      message: reason + ' | heavy=' + heavyProcessed + ', unchanged=' + unchangedSkipped + ', error=' + errors + '.',
      nextRow: checkpoint,
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    });
    ensureIntegratedCopyContinuationTrigger_();
    Logger.log(logs.join('\n'));
    showSpreadsheetToast_(
      'FINALIZE pause di row ' + checkpoint + '. Heavy=' + heavyProcessed +
      ' OK=' + finalized + ' Unchanged=' + unchangedSkipped +
      ' PairReuse=' + samePairSkipped + ' Err=' + errors + '.',
      'Copy FINAL Cepat & Aman',
      10
    );
  }

  while (cursor <= lastDataRow) {
    if (!isIntegratedCopyExecutionActive_(props)) {
      saveRollingTemplateFinalizeRetryMap_(props, retryMap);
      abortIntegratedCopyExecutionNoUi_(props, 'FINALIZE dibatalkan pada checkpoint chunk.');
      return;
    }
    if (Date.now() - started >= stopBeforeMs || heavyProcessed >= maxFiles) {
      pauseFinalize_('Batas waktu/batch tercapai');
      return;
    }

    const chunkStart = cursor;
    const chunkCount = Math.min(chunkSize, lastDataRow - chunkStart + 1);
    const srcRange = sh.getRange(chunkStart, cols.source, chunkCount, 1);
    const srcDisp = srcRange.getDisplayValues();
    const srcVals = srcRange.getValues();
    const srcForm = srcRange.getFormulas();
    const srcRich = srcRange.getRichTextValues();
    const finalRange = sh.getRange(chunkStart, cols.final, chunkCount, 1);
    const finalDisp = finalRange.getDisplayValues();
    const finalNotes = finalRange.getNotes();
    const chipMap = getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_(
      ss.getId(), sh.getName(), chunkStart, cols.source, chunkCount);

    for (let i = 0; i < chunkCount; i++) {
      const row = chunkStart + i;
      cursor = row;

      if (!isIntegratedCopyExecutionActive_(props)) {
        saveRollingTemplateFinalizeRetryMap_(props, retryMap);
        abortIntegratedCopyExecutionNoUi_(props, 'FINALIZE dibatalkan sebelum row ' + row + '.');
        return;
      }
      if (Date.now() - started >= stopBeforeMs || heavyProcessed >= maxFiles) {
        pauseFinalize_('Batas waktu/batch tercapai');
        return;
      }

      const finalLink = cleanTextValue_(finalDisp[i][0]);
      const sourceText = cleanTextValue_(srcDisp[i][0]);
      const existingNote = String(finalNotes[i][0] || '');

      if (!isValidGoogleSheetLinkText_(finalLink)) {
        skipped++;
        cursor = row + 1;
        continue;
      }

      checked++;
      try {
        const finalFileId = extractSpreadsheetFileIdFromUrlOrId_(finalLink);
        if (!finalFileId) throw new Error('FINAL fileId tidak dapat dibaca.');

        let sourceFileId = '';
        if (sourceText) {
          sourceFileId = resolveRollingTemplateSourceFileIdFromCachedRow_(
            row, sourceText, srcRich[i][0], srcForm[i][0], srcVals[i][0], chipMap
          );
        }

        const sourceUpdatedMs = sourceFileId
          ? getDriveFileLastUpdatedMsCached_(sourceFileId, sourceUpdatedCache)
          : 0;
        const finalUpdatedMs = getDriveFileLastUpdatedMsCached_(finalFileId, finalUpdatedCache);
        const pairKey = String(sourceFileId || '') + '|' + String(finalFileId);

        if (processedPairCache[pairKey]) {
          const cached = processedPairCache[pairKey];
          try {
            sh.getRange(row, cols.final)
              .setBackground(cached.background)
              .setNote(cached.note);
          } catch (e) {}
          samePairSkipped++;
          delete retryMap[String(row)];
          cursor = row + 1;
          continue;
        }

        if (P.finalizeSkipUnchangedFiles &&
            isRollingTemplateFinalizeSignatureCurrent_(
              existingNote, sourceFileId, sourceUpdatedMs, finalUpdatedMs
            )) {
          unchangedSkipped++;
          delete retryMap[String(row)];
          cursor = row + 1;
          continue;
        }

        heavyProcessed++;
        if (!isIntegratedCopyExecutionActive_(props)) {
          saveRollingTemplateFinalizeRetryMap_(props, retryMap);
          abortIntegratedCopyExecutionNoUi_(props, 'FINALIZE dibatalkan sebelum membuka FINAL row ' + row + '.');
          return;
        }
        const finalSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(finalFileId);
        let protectionResult = { removed: 0 };
        if (P.finalizeClearProtections) {
          protectionResult = clearAllSheetProtectionsInSpreadsheet_(finalSs) || { removed: 0 };
        }

        let mergeResult = {
          checkedSourceRows: 0,
          addedRows: 0,
          normalizedRows: 0,
          deletedRows: 0
        };

        if (P.finalizeSyncMissingRows &&
            P.syncMissingSourceRowsIntoFinalWhenFinalExists &&
            sourceFileId && String(sourceFileId) !== String(finalFileId)) {
          const sourceSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(sourceFileId);
          mergeResult = syncMissingSourceRowsIntoExistingFinalTemplate_(
            sourceSs,
            finalSs,
            { finalAlreadyCleaned: false }
          );
        } else if (P.finalizeNormalizeAndDeduplicate) {
          const cleanup = normalizeAndDeduplicateRollingTemplateSpreadsheet_(finalSs);
          mergeResult.normalizedRows = Number(cleanup.normalizedRows || 0);
          mergeResult.deletedRows = Number(cleanup.deletedRows || 0);
        }

        // File unchanged sudah di-skip sebelum openById. Semua file yang masuk tahap
        // berat divalidasi karena berarti first run/source/FINAL/aturan telah berubah.
        let validationResult = 'Validation SKIP';
        if (P.validateExistingFinalDuringFinalize) {
          validationResult = runLocalValidationOnCopiedTarget_(finalSs);
        }

        const processedAtMs = Date.now();
        let finalUpdatedAfterMs = processedAtMs;
        try {
          finalUpdatedAfterMs = DriveApp.getFileById(finalFileId).getLastUpdated().getTime();
        } catch (e) {}
        const signature = buildRollingTemplateFinalizeSignature_(
          sourceFileId,
          sourceUpdatedMs,
          finalUpdatedAfterMs,
          processedAtMs
        );
        const note = signature + '\n' +
          'FINALIZED: ' + new Date(processedAtMs).toISOString() +
          ' | normalized=' + Number(mergeResult.normalizedRows || 0) +
          ' | deletedDuplicate=' + Number(mergeResult.deletedRows || 0) +
          ' | addedMissing=' + Number(mergeResult.addedRows || 0) +
          ' | protectionRemoved=' + Number(protectionResult.removed || 0) +
          ' | ' + validationResult;

        const finalBackground = String(validationResult).indexOf('ERROR') >= 0
          ? '#FCE8B2'
          : '#B7E1CD';
        try {
          sh.getRange(row, cols.final)
            .setBackground(finalBackground)
            .setNote(note);
        } catch (noteErr) {}
        processedPairCache[pairKey] = { note: note, background: finalBackground };

        finalized++;
        addedRows += Number(mergeResult.addedRows || 0);
        normalizedRows += Number(mergeResult.normalizedRows || 0);
        deletedRows += Number(mergeResult.deletedRows || 0);
        delete retryMap[String(row)];
        logs.push('Row ' + row + ': FINALIZED | added=' +
          Number(mergeResult.addedRows || 0) +
          ' duplicateDeleted=' + Number(mergeResult.deletedRows || 0) +
          ' | ' + validationResult);

      } catch (err) {
        errors++;
        const retryResult = markRollingTemplateFinalizeRetry_(
          sh, row, cols.final, err, retryMap
        );
        if (retryResult.permanentError) {
          permanentErrors++;
        } else if (row < lowestRetryRow) {
          lowestRetryRow = row;
        }
        logs.push('Row ' + row + ': ERROR FINALIZE retry ' +
          retryResult.retryCount + '/' + retryResult.maxRetries + ' - ' +
          shortenRollingTemplateCopyError_(err));
      }
      cursor = row + 1;
    }
  }

  Logger.log(logs.join('\n'));
  saveRollingTemplateFinalizeRetryMap_(props, retryMap);

  if (lowestRetryRow <= lastDataRow) {
    props.setProperty(P.pFinalizeHint, String(lowestRetryRow));
    writeIntegratedCopyStatus_(props, {
      phase: 'FINALIZE',
      state: 'RETRY_PENDING',
      message: 'Finalize transient error masih perlu retry mulai row ' + lowestRetryRow + '.',
      errors: errors,
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    });
    ensureIntegratedCopyContinuationTrigger_();
    showSpreadsheetToast_(
      'FINALIZE scan selesai, masih ada retry mulai row ' + lowestRetryRow +
      '. OK=' + finalized + ' Unchanged=' + unchangedSkipped +
      ' PairReuse=' + samePairSkipped + ' Err=' + errors + '.',
      'Copy FINAL Cepat & Aman',
      12
    );
    return;
  }

  props.deleteProperty(P.pFinalizeRetryMap);
  finishCopyRollingTemplateFiles_(props,
    'COPY + FINALIZE SELESAI. Finalized=' + finalized +
    ' UnchangedSkip=' + unchangedSkipped +
    ' PairReuse=' + samePairSkipped +
    ' Skip=' + skipped + ' Err=' + errors +
    ' PermanentErr=' + permanentErrors +
    ' AddedMissing=' + addedRows +
    ' Normalized=' + normalizedRows +
    ' DeletedDuplicate=' + deletedRows + '.');
}



function getSpreadsheetFromIdOrObject_(input) {
  if (!input) return null;
  if (typeof input === 'string') return RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(input);
  if (typeof input.getId === 'function' && typeof input.getSheets === 'function') return input;
  throw new Error('Spreadsheet input tidak valid.');
}


function normalizeRollingTemplateBusinessKeyPart_(value) {
  let s = String(value == null ? '' : value)
    .trim()
    .replace(/^'/, '')
    .toUpperCase()
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/[{}]/g, '');
  if (/^-?\d+\.0+$/.test(s)) s = s.replace(/\.0+$/, '');
  return s;
}


/**
 * Normalisasi khusus Visit Type untuk seluruh canonical key Rolling.
 * Contoh: 2, 02, dan 2.0 semuanya menjadi "02".
 */
function normalizeRollingTemplateVisitTypeKey_(value) {
  const text = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim().replace(/^'/, '');
  if (!text) return '';

  const numericMatch = text.match(/^(\d+)(?:\.0+)?$/);
  if (numericMatch) return numericMatch[1].padStart(2, '0');

  return normalizeRollingTemplateBusinessKeyPart_(text);
}


function getRollingTemplateCopyJournal_(props) {
  const key = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pCopyJournal;
  if (!key) return {};
  try {
    const raw = props.getProperty(key);
    return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) || {}) : {};
  } catch (err) {
    return {};
  }
}


function saveRollingTemplateCopyJournal_(props, journal) {
  const key = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pCopyJournal;
  if (!key) return;
  const clean = journal || {};
  if (!Object.keys(clean).length) {
    props.deleteProperty(key);
    return;
  }
  props.setProperty(key, JSON.stringify(clean));
}


function getRollingTemplateFinalizeRetryMap_(props) {
  const key = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pFinalizeRetryMap;
  if (!key) return {};
  try {
    const raw = props.getProperty(key);
    return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) || {}) : {};
  } catch (err) {
    return {};
  }
}


function saveRollingTemplateFinalizeRetryMap_(props, map) {
  const key = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pFinalizeRetryMap;
  if (!key) return;
  const clean = map || {};
  if (!Object.keys(clean).length) {
    props.deleteProperty(key);
    return;
  }
  props.setProperty(key, JSON.stringify(clean));
}


function markRollingTemplateFinalizeRetry_(sh, row, finalCol, err, retryMap) {
  const P = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS;
  const maxRetries = Number(P.finalizeRetryMax || 4);
  const key = String(row);
  const retryCount = Number(retryMap[key] || 0) + 1;
  retryMap[key] = retryCount;
  const permanentError = retryCount >= maxRetries;
  const msg = shortenRollingTemplateCopyError_(err);

  try {
    sh.getRange(row, finalCol)
      .setBackground(permanentError ? '#F4C7C3' : '#FFF2CC')
      .setNote(
        (permanentError ? 'FINALIZE_ERROR PERMANENT' : 'FINALIZE_ERROR RETRY') +
        ' ' + retryCount + '/' + maxRetries + ' | ' + msg
      );
  } catch (e) {}

  if (permanentError) delete retryMap[key];
  return {
    retryCount: retryCount,
    maxRetries: maxRetries,
    permanentError: permanentError
  };
}


function getDriveFileLastUpdatedMsCached_(fileId, cache) {
  if (!fileId) return 0;
  cache = cache || {};
  if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cache, fileId)) return Number(cache[fileId] || 0);
  const ms = DriveApp.getFileById(fileId).getLastUpdated().getTime();
  cache[fileId] = ms;
  return ms;
}


function buildRollingTemplateFinalizeSignature_(sourceFileId, sourceUpdatedMs, finalUpdatedMs, processedAtMs) {
  const P = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS;
  return [
    'RSC_FINALIZE_SIGNATURE',
    'V=' + String(P.finalizeSignatureVersion || 'RSC_FINALIZE_OPT_V4'),
    'SRC=' + String(sourceFileId || ''),
    'SRC_MS=' + String(Number(sourceUpdatedMs || 0)),
    'FIN_MS=' + String(Number(finalUpdatedMs || 0)),
    'AT_MS=' + String(Number(processedAtMs || Date.now()))
  ].join('|');
}


function parseRollingTemplateFinalizeSignature_(note) {
  const firstLine = String(note || '').split(/\r?\n/)[0].trim();
  if (firstLine.indexOf('RSC_FINALIZE_SIGNATURE|') !== 0) return null;
  const out = {};
  firstLine.split('|').slice(1).forEach(function (part) {
    const p = part.indexOf('=');
    if (p <= 0) return;
    out[part.substring(0, p)] = part.substring(p + 1);
  });
  return out;
}


function isRollingTemplateFinalizeSignatureCurrent_(note, sourceFileId, sourceUpdatedMs, finalUpdatedMs) {
  const P = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS;
  const sig = parseRollingTemplateFinalizeSignature_(note);
  if (!sig) return false;
  if (String(sig.V || '') !== String(P.finalizeSignatureVersion || '')) return false;
  if (String(sig.SRC || '') !== String(sourceFileId || '')) return false;
  if (Number(sourceUpdatedMs || 0) > Number(sig.SRC_MS || 0)) return false;

  const grace = Number(P.finalizeSignatureGraceMs || 15000);
  const finalizedFileMs = Number(sig.FIN_MS || 0);
  const processedAt = Number(sig.AT_MS || 0);
  if (!finalizedFileMs || !processedAt) return false;
  if (Number(finalUpdatedMs || 0) > finalizedFileMs + grace) return false;
  return true;
}

function ensureIntegratedCopyContinuationTrigger_() {
  const P = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  if (!isIntegratedCopyExecutionActive_(props)) return false;
  return scheduleCopyJobTrigger_(P.fnContinueCopy);
}


function countTriggersForHandler_(handlerName) {
  let count = 0;
  ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(function (trigger) {
    if (trigger.getHandlerFunction() === handlerName) count++;
  });
  return count;
}


function writeIntegratedCopyStatus_(props, status) {
  const key = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pLastStatus;
  if (!key) return;
  try {
    props.setProperty(key, JSON.stringify(status || {}));
  } catch (err) {}
}


function readIntegratedCopyLastStatus_(props) {
  try {
    const raw = props.getProperty(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pLastStatus);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
  } catch (err) {
    return null;
  }
}


function getIntegratedCopyRunningState_(props) {
  const raw = props.getProperty(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pRunning);
  if (!raw) return { active: false, label: 'NO' };
  try {
    const obj = JSON.parse(raw);
    const active = Number(obj.leaseUntilMs || 0) > Date.now();
    return {
      active: active,
      label: active ? ('YES/' + (obj.phase || '?')) : 'STALE'
    };
  } catch (err) {
    return { active: true, label: 'YES' };
  }
}


function finishCopyRollingTemplateFiles_(props, msg) {
  const P = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS;
  props.deleteProperty(P.pCopyHint);
  props.deleteProperty(P.pFinalizeHint);
  props.deleteProperty(P.pCopyRetryMap);
  props.deleteProperty(P.pCopyJournal);
  props.deleteProperty(P.pFinalizeRetryMap);
  props.deleteProperty(P.pIntegratedPhase);
  props.deleteProperty(P.pRunning);
  props.setProperty(P.pStopFlag, 'TRUE');
  incrementIntegratedCopyGeneration_(props);
  props.deleteProperty(P.pRunId);
  deleteAllIntegratedCopyTriggers_();

  writeIntegratedCopyStatus_(props, {
    phase: 'DONE',
    state: 'COMPLETED',
    message: msg,
    at: new Date().toISOString()
  });
  Logger.log(msg);
  showSpreadsheetToast_(msg, 'Copy FINAL Cepat & Aman', 15);
}


/* Resolve source fileId dari kolom Template Rolling Sales/D dengan mekanisme yang sama
 * seperti make copy: hyperlink/rich text, formula HYPERLINK, smart chip, plain URL,
 * atau fallback search Drive by exact file title. */
function resolveRollingTemplateSourceFileIdFromCachedRow_(row, sourceDisp, richTextValue, formula, value, chipMap) {
  let sourceUrl = getSpreadsheetUrlFromCellData_({
    richTextValue: richTextValue,
    formula: formula,
    value: value,
    displayValue: sourceDisp
  });
  if (!sourceUrl && chipMap && chipMap[row]) sourceUrl = chipMap[row];

  let fileId = extractSpreadsheetFileIdFromUrlOrId_(sourceUrl);
  if (!fileId) fileId = findSpreadsheetFileIdByName_(sourceDisp);
  return fileId || '';
}


/* PATCH 2026-06-19
 * Saat FINAL/E sudah punya link valid, isi file FINAL tetap dibandingkan dengan
 * source/D. Seluruh isi row source dijadikan key pembanding (dengan normalisasi).
 * Header output seperti Validation Status dan Error Detail diabaikan default agar
 * hasil validasi tidak membuat semua row terlihat berbeda. Row yang belum ada di
 * FINAL akan di-append ke FINAL dan diwarnai kuning. */
function syncMissingSourceRowsIntoExistingFinalTemplate_(sourceInput, finalInput, options) {
  options = options || {};
  const sourceSs = getSpreadsheetFromIdOrObject_(sourceInput);
  const finalSs = getSpreadsheetFromIdOrObject_(finalInput);
  if (!sourceSs || !finalSs) {
    return { checkedSourceRows: 0, addedRows: 0, normalizedRows: 0, deletedRows: 0 };
  }
  if (String(sourceSs.getId()) === String(finalSs.getId())) {
    const selfCleanup = options.finalAlreadyCleaned
      ? { normalizedRows: 0, deletedRows: 0 }
      : normalizeAndDeduplicateRollingTemplateSpreadsheet_(finalSs);
    return {
      checkedSourceRows: 0,
      addedRows: 0,
      normalizedRows: Number(selfCleanup.normalizedRows || 0),
      deletedRows: Number(selfCleanup.deletedRows || 0)
    };
  }

  const sourceSh = getRollingTemplateSyncSheet_(sourceSs);
  const finalSh = getRollingTemplateSyncSheet_(finalSs);
  if (!sourceSh || !finalSh) {
    throw new Error('Sheet untuk sync tidak ditemukan di source/FINAL. Target: ' +
      ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.syncMissingSourceRowsSheetName);
  }

  // Satu kali cleanup FINAL saja. Implementasi lama membersihkan FINAL sebelum sync,
