  // membuka ulang file, lalu membersihkan lagi sesudah append. Itu mahal dan redundan.
  const cleanup = options.finalAlreadyCleaned
    ? { normalizedRows: 0, deletedRows: 0 }
    : normalizeAndDeduplicateRollingTemplateSheet_(finalSh);

  const sourceData = readRollingTemplateSyncRows_(sourceSh);
  const finalData = readRollingTemplateSyncRows_(finalSh);
  if (!sourceData.rows.length) {
    return {
      checkedSourceRows: 0,
      addedRows: 0,
      normalizedRows: Number(cleanup.normalizedRows || 0),
      deletedRows: Number(cleanup.deletedRows || 0)
    };
  }

  const existingKeys = Object.create(null);
  for (let i = 0; i < finalData.keys.length; i++) {
    if (finalData.keys[i]) existingKeys[finalData.keys[i]] = true;
  }

  const missingRows = [];
  const seenSourceKeys = Object.create(null);
  for (let i = 0; i < sourceData.rows.length; i++) {
    const key = sourceData.keys[i];
    if (!key || seenSourceKeys[key]) continue;
    seenSourceKeys[key] = true;
    if (existingKeys[key]) continue;

    // Update existingKeys saat row dimasukkan ke queue. Dengan demikian satu batch
    // tidak mungkin menambahkan key yang sama dua kali walaupun source duplicate.
    existingKeys[key] = true;
    missingRows.push(sourceData.rows[i]);
  }

  if (missingRows.length) {
    appendMissingRowsToFinalTemplate_(finalSh, finalData, sourceData, missingRows);
  }

  // Tidak perlu cleanup kedua: FINAL telah deduplicate, source key telah unique,
  // dan setiap missing key dicek + dimasukkan ke existingKeys sebelum append.
  return {
    checkedSourceRows: sourceData.rows.length,
    addedRows: missingRows.length,
    normalizedRows: Number(cleanup.normalizedRows || 0),
    deletedRows: Number(cleanup.deletedRows || 0)
  };
}


function getRollingTemplateSyncSheet_(ss) {
  const candidates = [];

  function addCandidate_(name) {
    const s = String(name || '').trim();
    if (s && candidates.indexOf(s) === -1) candidates.push(s);
    const t31 = s.substring(0, 31);
    if (t31 && candidates.indexOf(t31) === -1) candidates.push(t31);
  }

  addCandidate_(OPTIMIZED_FINAL_CLEANSE_PARAMETERS && OPTIMIZED_FINAL_CLEANSE_PARAMETERS.targetSheetName);
  addCandidate_(OPTIMIZED_FINAL_CLEANSE_PARAMETERS && OPTIMIZED_FINAL_CLEANSE_PARAMETERS.targetSheetNameXlsx31);
  addCandidate_(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS && ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.syncMissingSourceRowsSheetName);
  addCandidate_(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS && TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetRolling);
  addCandidate_('Change Rolling & Change Schedule');
  addCandidate_('Change Rolling & Change Schedul');

  for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(candidates[i]);
    if (sh) return sh;
  }

  const sheets = ss.getSheets();
  for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    const name = String(sheets[i].getName() || '');
    if (/^Change Rolling & Change Schedul/i.test(name)) return sheets[i];
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (/rolling/i.test(sheets[i].getName())) return sheets[i];
  }
  return null;
}


function readRollingTemplateSyncRows_(sh) {
  const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  if (lastRow < 1 || lastCol < 1) {
    return { headerRow: 1, firstDataRow: 2, lastCol: lastCol || 1, rows: [], keys: [], keyCols: [] };
  }

  const headerInfo = findRollingTemplateSyncHeaderInfo_(sh);
  const firstDataRow = headerInfo.headerRow + 1;
  if (lastRow < firstDataRow) {
    return {
      headerRow: headerInfo.headerRow,
      firstDataRow: firstDataRow,
      lastCol: lastCol,
      rows: [],
      keys: [],
      keyCols: headerInfo.keyCols
    };
  }

  const n = lastRow - firstDataRow + 1;
  const displayRows = sh.getRange(firstDataRow, 1, n, lastCol).getDisplayValues();
  const valueRows = sh.getRange(firstDataRow, 1, n, lastCol).getValues();
  const rows = [];
  const keys = [];

  for (let r = 0; r < displayRows.length; r++) {
    if (isRollingTemplateSyncBlankRow_(displayRows[r])) continue;

    const normalized = normalizeRollingTemplateSyncRowForCompareAndWrite_(
      valueRows[r], displayRows[r], headerInfo
    );

    rows.push(normalized.writeRow);
    keys.push(buildRollingTemplateSyncRowKey_(normalized.keyRow, headerInfo.keyCols));
  }

  return {
    headerRow: headerInfo.headerRow,
    firstDataRow: firstDataRow,
    lastCol: lastCol,
    rows: rows,
    keys: keys,
    keyCols: headerInfo.keyCols,
    headerInfo: headerInfo
  };
}


function findRollingTemplateSyncHeaderInfo_(sh) {
  const scanRows = Math.min(
    ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.syncMissingSourceRowsHeaderScanRows || 15,
    sh.getLastRow()
  );
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();

  if (scanRows < 1 || lastCol < 1) {
    return { headerRow: 1, keyCols: [1], header: [], normalizedHeaders: [] };
  }

  const grid = sh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, lastCol).getDisplayValues();
  let headerRow = 1;
  let header = grid[0] || [];

  for (let r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    const normalized = grid[r].map(function (x) { return normalizeRollingTemplateSyncHeader_(x); });
    const hasCustomer = normalized.indexOf('CUSTOMER ID') !== -1 || normalized.indexOf('CUSTOMER') !== -1;
    const hasSalesman = normalized.indexOf('SALESMAN ID') !== -1 || normalized.indexOf('SALESMAN') !== -1;
    const hasRelationship = normalized.indexOf('RELATIONSHIP') !== -1 || normalized.indexOf('RELATIONSHIP ID') !== -1;
    const hasReason = normalized.indexOf('REASON') !== -1;
    if ((hasCustomer && hasSalesman && hasRelationship) || (hasCustomer && hasSalesman && hasReason)) {
      headerRow = r + 1;
      header = grid[r];
      break;
    }
  }

  const normalizedHeaders = header.map(function (x) { return normalizeRollingTemplateSyncHeader_(x); });

  // PATCH KEY V6 2026-07-22:
  // Canonical key menggunakan tepat 6 kolom. Kolom tambahan seperti BP Type,
  // Valid To, Visit Category, Schedule Visit, status, dan error tidak ikut key.
  const explicitHeaders = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.syncMissingSourceRowsExplicitKeyHeaders || [
    'Customer ID',
    'Relationship',
    'Salesman ID',
    'Valid From',
    'Visit Type',
    'Visit Valid From'
  ];

  const fallbackByHeader = {
    'CUSTOMER ID': 3,
    'RELATIONSHIP': 4,
    'SALESMAN ID': 5,
    'VALID FROM': 7,
    'VISIT TYPE': 10,
    'VISIT VALID FROM': 12
  };

  const keyCols = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < explicitHeaders.length; i++) {
    const wanted = normalizeRollingTemplateSyncHeader_(explicitHeaders[i]);
    let col = normalizedHeaders.indexOf(wanted) + 1;

    // Aliases untuk header yang kadang berubah sedikit.
    if (!col && wanted === 'SCHEDULE VISIT') col = normalizedHeaders.indexOf('VISIT SCHEDULE') + 1;
    if (!col && wanted === 'CUSTOMER ID') col = normalizedHeaders.indexOf('CUSTOMER') + 1;
    if (!col && wanted === 'SALESMAN ID') col = normalizedHeaders.indexOf('SALESMAN') + 1;

    // Fallback fixed template baru Change Rolling memakai canonical key:
    // C Customer ID, D Relationship, E Salesman ID, G Valid From,
    // J Visit Type, dan L Visit Valid From.
    if (!col && fallbackByHeader[wanted] && fallbackByHeader[wanted] <= lastCol) {
      col = fallbackByHeader[wanted];
    }

    if (col && keyCols.indexOf(col) === -1) keyCols.push(col);
  }

  // Minimal guard: jika header berubah dan keenam key belum lengkap,
  // gunakan posisi fixed canonical key selama kolom L tersedia.
  if (keyCols.length < 6 && lastCol >= 12) {
    keyCols.length = 0;
    [3, 4, 5, 7, 10, 12].forEach(function (col) { keyCols.push(col); });
  }

  if (!keyCols.length) keyCols.push(1);

  return { headerRow: headerRow, keyCols: keyCols, header: header, normalizedHeaders: normalizedHeaders };
}

function appendMissingRowsToFinalTemplate_(finalSh, finalData, sourceData, missingRows) {
  const targetColCount = Math.max(finalSh.getLastColumn(), sourceData.lastCol, finalData.lastCol || 0, 1);
  const currentMaxCols = finalSh.getMaxColumns();
  if (currentMaxCols < targetColCount) {
    finalSh.insertColumnsAfter(currentMaxCols, targetColCount - currentMaxCols);
  }

  const startRow = Math.max(finalSh.getLastRow(), finalData.headerRow) + 1;
  finalSh.insertRowsAfter(Math.max(finalSh.getLastRow(), 1), missingRows.length);

  const out = missingRows.map(function (row) {
    const copy = row.slice(0, targetColCount);
    while (copy.length < targetColCount) copy.push('');
    return copy;
  });

  const targetRange = finalSh.getRange(startRow, 1, out.length, targetColCount);

  // Copy format + data validation dari row data terakhir supaya dropdown/format tetap ikut.
  const templateRow = Math.max(finalData.firstDataRow, startRow - 1, finalData.headerRow || 1);
  try {
    finalSh.getRange(templateRow, 1, 1, targetColCount).copyTo(targetRange, { formatOnly: true });
  } catch (e) {}
  try {
    finalSh.getRange(templateRow, 1, 1, targetColCount)
      .copyTo(targetRange, SpreadsheetApp.CopyPasteType.PASTE_DATA_VALIDATION, false);
  } catch (e) {}

  targetRange.setValues(out);
  setRollingTemplateSyncDateColumnsFormat_(finalSh, sourceData.headerInfo || finalData.headerInfo, startRow, out.length);
  targetRange.setBackground(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.syncMissingSourceRowsAddedColor || '#FFF2CC');

  try {
    finalSh.getRange(startRow, 1, out.length, 1)
      .setNote(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.syncMissingSourceRowsNote || 'AUTO ADDED');
  } catch (e) {}
}



function normalizeAndDeduplicateRollingTemplateSpreadsheet_(ss) {
  const sh = getRollingTemplateSyncSheet_(ss);
  if (!sh) return { normalizedRows: 0, deletedRows: 0, checkedRows: 0 };
  return normalizeAndDeduplicateRollingTemplateSheet_(sh);
}


function normalizeAndDeduplicateRollingTemplateSheet_(sh) {
  // Unified logic: semua flow yang membuka FINAL existing sekarang memakai cleanse logic yang sama
  // dengan menu Cleanse Existing FINAL Links ONLY.
  // Ini memastikan G/L selalu text YYYY-MM-DD dan Reason Rolling selalu 2026-08-01.
  const result = cleanseRollingTemplateSheetFast_(sh);
  return {
    checkedRows: result.checkedRows || 0,
    normalizedRows: result.normalizedRows || 0,
    deletedRows: result.deletedRows || 0
  };
}


function normalizeRollingTemplateSyncRowForCompareAndWrite_(valueRow, displayRow, headerInfo) {
  const writeRow = valueRow.slice();
  const keyRow = displayRow.slice();
  let changed = false;

  const reasonCol = findRollingTemplateSyncColumnByHeaders_(headerInfo, ['Reason']);
  const reasonText = reasonCol ? cleanTextValue_(displayRow[reasonCol - 1]).toUpperCase() : '';
  const isRolling = reasonText === 'ROLLING';

  const dateCols = getRollingTemplateSyncDateColumns_(headerInfo);
  const forcedCols = getRollingTemplateSyncRollingForcedDateColumns_(headerInfo);
  const forcedDateText = getRollingTemplateSyncRollingDateText_();
  const forcedDateObj = parseRollingTemplateSyncYmdToDate_(forcedDateText);

  const forcedMap = {};
  // PATCH 2026-06-22C:
  // Reason = Rolling selalu memaksa Valid From dan Visit Valid From
  // ke tanggal target sebelum compare/dedup, tidak bergantung flag tambahan.
  if (isRolling) {
    for (let i = 0; i < forcedCols.length; i++) forcedMap[forcedCols[i]] = true;
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < dateCols.length; i++) {
    const col = dateCols[i];
    const idx = col - 1;

    let dateInfo = null;
    if (forcedMap[col] && forcedDateObj) {
      dateInfo = { text: forcedDateText, value: forcedDateObj };
    } else {
      dateInfo = normalizeRollingTemplateSyncDateForCompare_(valueRow[idx], displayRow[idx]);
    }

    if (!dateInfo || !dateInfo.text) continue;

    keyRow[idx] = dateInfo.text;
    // Valid From dan Visit Valid From wajib disimpan sebagai plain text YYYY-MM-DD
    // agar hasil append sama dengan hasil cleanse FINAL.
    writeRow[idx] = forcedCols.indexOf(col) !== -1
      ? dateInfo.text
      : (dateInfo.value || dateInfo.text);

    const beforeKey = normalizeRollingTemplateSyncCellForKey_(displayRow[idx]);
    if (beforeKey !== dateInfo.text.toUpperCase()) changed = true;
  }

  return { writeRow: writeRow, keyRow: keyRow, changed: changed };
}


function getRollingTemplateSyncDateColumns_(headerInfo) {
  const headers = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.syncMissingSourceRowsDateHeadersForFormat ||
    ['Valid From', 'Valid To', 'Visit Valid From', 'Visit Valid To'];
  const cols = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
    const col = findRollingTemplateSyncColumnByHeaders_(headerInfo, [headers[i]]);
    if (col && cols.indexOf(col) === -1) cols.push(col);
  }
  return cols;
}


function getRollingTemplateSyncRollingForcedDateColumns_(headerInfo) {
  const headers = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.syncMissingSourceRowsRollingDateHeadersToForce ||
    ['Valid From', 'Visit Valid From'];
  const cols = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
    const col = findRollingTemplateSyncColumnByHeaders_(headerInfo, [headers[i]]);
    if (col && cols.indexOf(col) === -1) cols.push(col);
  }
  return cols;
}


function findRollingTemplateSyncColumnByHeaders_(headerInfo, names) {
  if (!headerInfo || !headerInfo.normalizedHeaders) return 0;
  const wanted = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    wanted[normalizeRollingTemplateSyncHeader_(names[i])] = true;
  }
  for (let c = 0; c < headerInfo.normalizedHeaders.length; c++) {
    if (wanted[headerInfo.normalizedHeaders[c]]) return c + 1;
  }
  return 0;
}


function normalizeRollingTemplateSyncDateForCompare_(rawValue, displayValue) {
  const text = rscCleanseNormalizeDateText_(rawValue, displayValue);
  if (!text) return null;

  const parsed = parseRollingTemplateSyncYmdToDate_(text);
  return {
    text: text,
    value: parsed || text
  };
}


function getRollingTemplateSyncRollingDateText_() {
  return ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.syncMissingSourceRowsRollingDateText ||
    BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.targetCfg.TARGET_DATE_TEXT ||
    '2026-08-01';
}


function parseRollingTemplateSyncYmdToDate_(ymd) {
  const m = String(ymd || '').match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
  if (!m) return null;
  const y = Number(m[1]);
  const mo = Number(m[2]);
  const d = Number(m[3]);
  const dt = new Date(y, mo - 1, d);
  if (dt.getFullYear() !== y || dt.getMonth() !== mo - 1 || dt.getDate() !== d) return null;
  return dt;
}


function padRollingTemplateDatePart_(value, len) {
  let s = String(value == null ? '' : value);
  while (s.length < len) s = '0' + s;
  return s;
}


function setRollingTemplateSyncDateColumnsFormat_(sh, headerInfo, startRow, rowCount) {
  if (!headerInfo || !rowCount) return;
  const cols = getRollingTemplateSyncDateColumns_(headerInfo);
  const plainTextCols = getRollingTemplateSyncRollingForcedDateColumns_(headerInfo);
  for (let i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) {
    try {
      sh.getRange(startRow, cols[i], rowCount, 1)
        .setNumberFormat(plainTextCols.indexOf(cols[i]) !== -1 ? '@' : 'yyyy-mm-dd');
    } catch (err) {}
  }
}


function getRollingTemplateSyncKeepPriority_(keyRow, headerInfo) {
  const statusCol = findRollingTemplateSyncColumnByHeaders_(headerInfo, ['Validation Status']);
  if (!statusCol) return 50;

  const status = cleanTextValue_(keyRow[statusCol - 1]).toUpperCase();
  if (status === 'OK') return 100;
  if (!status) return 50;
  if (status === 'ERROR') return 0;
  return 25;
}


function deleteSheetRowsBottomUp_(sh, rows) {
  if (!rows || !rows.length) return;
  const unique = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) unique[rows[i]] = true;
  const arr = Object.keys(unique).map(function (x) { return Number(x); }).sort(function (a, b) { return b - a; });

  // Group contiguous rows supaya lebih hemat call. Karena delete bottom-up,
  // group [10,9,8] bisa dihapus sebagai deleteRows(8,3).
  let groupStart = arr[0];
  let groupEnd = arr[0];

  function flushGroup_() {
    const start = Math.min(groupStart, groupEnd);
    const end = Math.max(groupStart, groupEnd);
    sh.deleteRows(start, end - start + 1);
  }

  for (let i = 1; i < arr.length; i++) {
    const row = arr[i];
    if (row === groupEnd - 1) {
      groupEnd = row;
      continue;
    }
    flushGroup_();
    groupStart = row;
    groupEnd = row;
  }
  flushGroup_();
}


function buildRollingTemplateSyncIgnoredHeaderSet_() {
  const arr = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.syncMissingSourceRowsIgnoredHeadersForKey || [];
  const out = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
    const k = normalizeRollingTemplateSyncHeader_(arr[i]);
    if (k) out[k] = true;
  }
  return out;
}


function normalizeRollingTemplateSyncHeader_(v) {
  return String(v == null ? '' : v).trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').toUpperCase();
}


function buildRollingTemplateSyncRowKey_(displayRow, keyCols) {
  const parts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < keyCols.length; i++) {
    const col = keyCols[i];
    const idx = col - 1;
    parts.push(
      col === 10
        ? normalizeRollingTemplateVisitTypeKey_(displayRow[idx])
        : normalizeRollingTemplateSyncCellForKey_(displayRow[idx])
    );
  }
  const key = parts.join('||');
  return key.replace(/\|/g, '') ? key : '';
}


function normalizeRollingTemplateSyncCellForKey_(v) {
  return normalizeRollingTemplateBusinessKeyPart_(v);
}


function isRollingTemplateSyncBlankRow_(row) {
  for (let i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    if (cleanTextValue_(row[i])) return false;
  }
  return true;
}



function isRollingTemplateCopyErrorText_(value) {
  const prefix = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.copyErrorTextPrefix || 'COPY_ERROR:';
  return cleanTextValue_(value).toUpperCase().indexOf(String(prefix).toUpperCase()) === 0;
}


function getRollingTemplateCopyRetryMap_(props) {
  const key = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pCopyRetryMap;
  if (!key) return {};

  try {
    const raw = props.getProperty(key);
    if (!raw) return {};
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : {};
  } catch (err) {
    return {};
  }
}


function saveRollingTemplateCopyRetryMap_(props, retryMap) {
  const key = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pCopyRetryMap;
  if (!key) return;

  try {
    const keys = Object.keys(retryMap || {});
    if (!keys.length) {
      props.deleteProperty(key);
      return;
    }
    props.setProperty(key, JSON.stringify(retryMap));
  } catch (err) {
    Logger.log('saveRollingTemplateCopyRetryMap_ failed: ' + String(err && err.message ? err.message : err));
  }
}


function shortenRollingTemplateCopyError_(err) {
  let msg = String(err && err.message ? err.message : err || 'Unknown error');
  msg = msg.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  if (msg.length > 180) msg = msg.substring(0, 180) + '...';
  return msg;
}


function markRollingTemplateCopyRowRetryOrError_(sh, row, finalCol, err, retryMap) {
  const maxRetries = Number(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.copyPendingRetryMax || 3);
  const key = String(row);
  const retryCount = Number(retryMap[key] || 0) + 1;
  retryMap[key] = retryCount;

  const cell = sh.getRange(row, finalCol);
  const msg = shortenRollingTemplateCopyError_(err);

  if (retryCount >= maxRetries) {
    const prefix = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.copyErrorTextPrefix || 'COPY_ERROR:';
    cell
      .setValue(prefix + ' ' + msg)
      .setBackground(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.copyErrorStatusColor || '#F4C7C3')
      .setNote('COPY_ERROR after ' + retryCount + '/' + maxRetries + ' retries. Fix source/link/permission, then clear this FINAL cell and run Start / Lanjut Copy FINAL background again. Error: ' + msg);
    delete retryMap[key];
    return { retryCount: retryCount, maxRetries: maxRetries, permanentError: true };
  }

  cell
    .clearContent()
    .setBackground(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.copyRetryStatusColor || '#FFF2CC')
    .setNote('Copy retry ' + retryCount + '/' + maxRetries + '. Error terakhir: ' + msg);

  return { retryCount: retryCount, maxRetries: maxRetries, permanentError: false };
}


/* Hitung sisa baris yang belum punya FINAL valid (data only). */
function countPendingRollingTemplateCopies_(sh, cols, firstDataRow, lastDataRow) {
  const n = lastDataRow - firstDataRow + 1;
  const desc  = sh.getRange(firstDataRow, cols.description, n, 1).getDisplayValues();
  const src   = sh.getRange(firstDataRow, cols.source, n, 1).getDisplayValues();
  const final = sh.getRange(firstDataRow, cols.final, n, 1).getDisplayValues();

  let pending = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const d = cleanTextValue_(desc[i][0]);
    const s = cleanTextValue_(src[i][0]);
    if (!d && !s) continue;            // baris kosong
    if (!d || !s) continue;            // data tak lengkap -> bukan "pending"
    const f = cleanTextValue_(final[i][0]);
    if (isValidGoogleSheetLinkText_(f)) continue;
    if (isRollingTemplateCopyErrorText_(f)) continue;
    pending++;
  }
  return pending;
}


/* Urutan scan: hint -> lastDataRow, lalu firstDataRow -> hint-1. */
function buildRollingTemplateCopyScanOrder_(firstDataRow, lastDataRow, hint) {
  const order = [];
  for (let r = hint; r <= lastDataRow; r++) order.push(r);
  for (let r = firstDataRow; r < hint; r++) order.push(r);
  return order;
}


/* ============================================================
 * VALIDATE ENGINE
 * ========================================================== */

function continueValidateCopiedRollingTemplateFilesInBackground() {
  const started = Date.now();
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();

  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(1000)) {
    Logger.log('continueValidateCopiedRollingTemplateFilesInBackground: lock gagal, skip.');
    return;
  }

  try {
    const ss = getCopyMasterSpreadsheet_();
    const sh = getCopyTargetSheet_(ss);
    const header = findCopyControlHeader_(sh);
    const cols = header.cols;

    const firstDataRow = header.headerRow + 1;
    const lastDataRow = getLastCopyControlDataRow_(sh, firstDataRow, [cols.final]);

    if (lastDataRow < firstDataRow) {
      finishCopiedRollingTemplateValidation_(props, 'Tidak ada FINAL link untuk divalidasi.');
      return;
    }

    let nextRow = Number(props.getProperty(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pValidateHint) || firstDataRow);
    if (nextRow < firstDataRow) nextRow = firstDataRow;
    if (nextRow > lastDataRow) {
      finishCopiedRollingTemplateValidation_(props, 'Validasi FINAL link selesai semua.');
      return;
    }

    const totalRows = lastDataRow - firstDataRow + 1;
    const finalAll = sh.getRange(firstDataRow, cols.final, totalRows, 1).getDisplayValues();

    let validated = 0, skipped = 0, errors = 0;
    const logs = [];

    for (let row = nextRow; row <= lastDataRow; row++) {
      const i = row - firstDataRow;

      if (Date.now() - started > ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.softDeadlineMs) {
        props.setProperty(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pValidateHint, String(row));
        scheduleCopyJobTrigger_(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.fnContinueValidate);
        Logger.log(logs.join('\n'));
        showSpreadsheetToast_('Pause validasi. Lanjut otomatis dari row ' + row,
          'ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS Validate', 8);
        return;
      }

      const link = cleanTextValue_(finalAll[i][0]);
      if (!link) {
        skipped++;
        props.setProperty(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pValidateHint, String(row + 1));
        continue;
      }

      try {
        const fileId = extractSpreadsheetFileIdFromUrlOrId_(link);
        if (!fileId) {
          errors++;
          logs.push('Row ' + row + ': ERROR - FINAL link invalid: ' + link);
          props.setProperty(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pValidateHint, String(row + 1));
          continue;
        }

        const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(fileId);
        const result = runLocalValidationOnCopiedTarget_(targetSs);

        validated++;
        logs.push('Row ' + row + ': VALIDATED - ' + result);
        props.setProperty(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pValidateHint, String(row + 1));

      } catch (err) {
        errors++;
        logs.push('Row ' + row + ': ERROR - ' +
          String(err && err.message ? err.message : err));
        props.setProperty(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pValidateHint, String(row + 1));
      }
    }

    Logger.log(logs.join('\n'));
    finishCopiedRollingTemplateValidation_(props,
      'VALIDASI SELESAI. Validated=' + validated +
      ' Skip=' + skipped + ' Err=' + errors);

  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (e) {}
  }
}


function finishCopiedRollingTemplateValidation_(props, msg) {
  props.deleteProperty(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pValidateHint);
  deleteTriggersForFunction_(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.fnContinueValidate);
  Logger.log(msg);
  showSpreadsheetToast_(msg, 'ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS Validate', 10);
}


/* ============================================================
 * HEADER / SHEET HELPERS
 * ========================================================== */

function getCopyMasterSpreadsheet_() {
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const id = props.getProperty(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pSpreadsheetId);
  if (id) {
    try { return RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(id); } catch (e) {}
  }
  return SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
}


function getCopyTargetSheet_(ss) {
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const sheetId = props.getProperty(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pSheetId);
  if (sheetId) {
    const sheets = ss.getSheets();
    for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
      if (String(sheets[i].getSheetId()) === String(sheetId)) {
        return sheets[i];
      }
    }
  }
  return ss.getActiveSheet();
}


function findCopyControlHeader_(sh) {
  const scanRows = Math.min(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.headerScanRows, sh.getLastRow());
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  if (scanRows < 1 || lastCol < 1) {
    throw new Error('Sheet kosong / tidak ada kolom.');
  }

  const values = sh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, lastCol).getDisplayValues();

  for (let r = 0; r < values.length; r++) {
    const row = values[r].map(normalizeCopyControlHeader_);
    const so   = findCopyControlColumn_(row, ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.hSalesOffice);
    const desc = findCopyControlColumn_(row, ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.hDescription);
    const src  = findCopyControlColumn_(row, ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.hSource);
    const fin  = findCopyControlColumn_(row, ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.hFinal);

    if (desc && src && fin) {
      return {
        headerRow: r + 1,
        cols: { salesOffice: so, description: desc, source: src, final: fin }
      };
    }
  }
  throw new Error('Header tidak ditemukan. Wajib ada: Description, ' +
    'Template Rolling Sales, Template Rolling Sales FINAL.');
}


/* FINAL header mengandung kata SOURCE header sebagai prefix
 * ("Template Rolling Sales" vs "Template Rolling Sales FINAL").
 * Maka cocokkan FINAL dulu (lebih spesifik), lalu SOURCE
 * dengan syarat BUKAN final. */
function findCopyControlColumn_(normRow, headerName) {
  const target = normalizeCopyControlHeader_(headerName);
  const finalTarget = normalizeCopyControlHeader_(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.hFinal);
  const srcTarget = normalizeCopyControlHeader_(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.hSource);

  // exact match dulu
  for (let i = 0; i < normRow.length; i++) {
    if (normRow[i] === target) return i + 1;
  }
  // contains match, tapi hindari source ketiban final
  for (let i = 0; i < normRow.length; i++) {
    const cell = normRow[i];
    if (cell.indexOf(target) !== 0 && cell.indexOf(target) === -1) continue;
    if (target === srcTarget && cell.indexOf(finalTarget) !== -1) continue;
    if (cell.indexOf(target) !== -1) return i + 1;
  }
  return 0;
}


function normalizeCopyControlHeader_(v) {
  return String(v || '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').toUpperCase();
}


function getLastCopyControlDataRow_(sh, firstDataRow, cols) {
  const sheetLastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  if (sheetLastRow < firstDataRow) return firstDataRow - 1;

  const numRows = sheetLastRow - firstDataRow + 1;
  let maxLast = firstDataRow - 1;

  for (let c = 0; c < cols.length; c++) {
    if (!cols[c]) continue;
    const vals = sh.getRange(firstDataRow, cols[c], numRows, 1).getDisplayValues();
    for (let i = vals.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (cleanTextValue_(vals[i][0])) {
        maxLast = Math.max(maxLast, firstDataRow + i);
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  return maxLast;
}


/* ============================================================
 * URL / FILE ID  (FIX: getUrlFromCell_ is not defined)
 * ========================================================== */

function getSpreadsheetUrlFromCellData_(p) {
  const rich = p.richTextValue;
  const formula = cleanTextValue_(p.formula);
  const value = cleanTextValue_(p.value);
  const disp = cleanTextValue_(p.displayValue);

  if (rich) {
    const whole = rich.getLinkUrl();
    if (whole) return whole;
    const runs = rich.getRuns();
    for (let i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      const u = runs[i].getLinkUrl();
      if (u) return u;
    }
  }

  const f = getUrlFromHyperlinkFormula_(formula);
  if (f) return f;

  const v = extractSpreadsheetUrlFromText_(value);
  if (v) return v;

  const d = extractSpreadsheetUrlFromText_(disp);
  if (d) return d;

  return '';
}


function getUrlFromHyperlinkFormula_(formula) {
  if (!formula) return '';
  let m = formula.match(/HYPERLINK\s*\(\s*"([^"]+)"/i);
  if (m) return m[1];
  m = formula.match(/HYPERLINK\s*\(\s*'([^']+)'/i);
  if (m) return m[1];
  return '';
}


function extractSpreadsheetUrlFromText_(text) {
  const v = cleanTextValue_(text);
  if (!v) return '';
  const m = v.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s"'<>]+/i);
  if (m) return m[0];
  if (/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{25,}$/.test(v) && v.indexOf('/') === -1) return v;
  return '';
}


function extractSpreadsheetFileIdFromUrlOrId_(urlOrId) {
  const t = cleanTextValue_(urlOrId);
  if (!t) return '';
  if (/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{25,}$/.test(t) && t.indexOf('/') === -1) return t;

  const pats = [
    /\/spreadsheets\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/,
    /\/document\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/,
    /\/file\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/,
    /\/presentation\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/,
    /[?&]id=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/
  ];
  for (let i = 0; i < pats.length; i++) {
    const m = t.match(pats[i]);
    if (m) return m[1];
  }
  return '';
}


/* FINAL dianggap "sudah jadi" hanya kalau berupa link
 * Google Spreadsheet yang valid. Teks "ERROR"/"SKIP"
 * TIDAK dihitung valid -> akan dicoba lagi. */
function isValidGoogleSheetLinkText_(text) {
  const t = cleanTextValue_(text);
  if (!t) return false;
  if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(t)) return false;
  return /\/spreadsheets\/d\/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{20,}/.test(t);
}


/* ============================================================
 * SMART CHIP RANGE READER
 * ========================================================== */

function getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_(spreadsheetId, sheetName, startRow, sourceCol, numRows) {
  const map = {};
  try {
    if (typeof Sheets === 'undefined') return map;

    const a1 = quoteSheetNameForA1_(sheetName) + '!' +
      getColumnLetter_(sourceCol) + startRow + ':' +
      getColumnLetter_(sourceCol) + (startRow + numRows - 1);

    const res = Sheets.Spreadsheets.get(spreadsheetId, {
      ranges: [a1],
      includeGridData: true,
      fields: 'sheets(data(rowData(values(chipRuns))))'
    });

    const sheets = res.sheets || [];
    let rel = 0;
    for (let s = 0; s < sheets.length; s++) {
      const data = sheets[s].data || [];
      for (let dd = 0; dd < data.length; dd++) {
        const rowData = data[dd].rowData || [];
        for (let r = 0; r < rowData.length; r++) {
          const values = rowData[r].values || [];
          const cell = values[0];
          if (cell && cell.chipRuns) {
            for (let x = 0; x < cell.chipRuns.length; x++) {
              const chip = cell.chipRuns[x].chip;
              if (chip && chip.richLinkProperties && chip.richLinkProperties.uri) {
                map[startRow + rel] = chip.richLinkProperties.uri;
                break;
              }
            }
          }
          rel++;
        }
      }
    }
    return map;
  } catch (err) {
    return map;
  }
}


function quoteSheetNameForA1_(name) {
  return "'" + String(name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "'";
}


function getColumnLetter_(col) {
  let n = Number(col), out = '';
  while (n > 0) {
    const rem = (n - 1) % 26;
    out = String.fromCharCode(65 + rem) + out;
    n = Math.floor((n - rem - 1) / 26);
  }
  return out;
}


/* ============================================================
 * DRIVE SEARCH BY TITLE
 * ========================================================== */

function findSpreadsheetFileIdByName_(fileName) {
  const name = cleanTextValue_(fileName);
  if (!name || /^https?:\/\//i.test(name)) return '';
  if (__ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_DRIVE_NAME_CACHE__[name]) return __ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_DRIVE_NAME_CACHE__[name];

  let file = searchLatestDriveSpreadsheet_(
    "title = '" + escapeDriveQueryText_(name) + "' " +
    "and mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet' " +
    "and trashed = false");

  if (!file) {
    file = searchLatestDriveSpreadsheet_(
      "title contains '" + escapeDriveQueryText_(name) + "' " +
      "and mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet' " +
      "and trashed = false");
  }

  const id = file ? file.getId() : '';
  __ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_DRIVE_NAME_CACHE__[name] = id;
  return id;
}


function searchLatestDriveSpreadsheet_(query) {
  const files = DriveApp.searchFiles(query);
  let best = null, bestT = -1;
  while (files.hasNext()) {
    const f = files.next();
    const u = f.getLastUpdated() ? f.getLastUpdated().getTime() : 0;
    if (!best || u > bestT) { best = f; bestT = u; }
  }
  return best;
}


function escapeDriveQueryText_(s) {
  return String(s || '').replace(/\\/g, '\\\\').replace(/'/g, "\\'");
}


/* ============================================================
 * COPY SUPPORT
 * ========================================================== */

function getActiveSpreadsheetFolder_() {
  try {
    const f = DriveApp.getFileById(
      SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getId());
    const parents = f.getParents();
    return parents.hasNext() ? parents.next() : null;
  } catch (err) {
    return null;
  }
}


function safelySetFileDomainEditorAccess_(file) {
  try {
    file.setSharing(DriveApp.Access.DOMAIN_WITH_LINK,
      DriveApp.Permission.EDIT);
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    return false;
  }
}


function clearAllSheetProtectionsInSpreadsheet_(targetSs) {
  let removed = 0;
  let skipped = 0;
  const sp = targetSs.getProtections(SpreadsheetApp.ProtectionType.SHEET);
  for (let i = 0; i < sp.length; i++) {
    try {
      if (sp[i].canEdit()) {
        sp[i].remove();
        removed++;
      } else {
        skipped++;
      }
    } catch (e) { skipped++; }
  }
  const rp = targetSs.getProtections(SpreadsheetApp.ProtectionType.RANGE);
  for (let i = 0; i < rp.length; i++) {
    try {
      if (rp[i].canEdit()) {
        rp[i].remove();
        removed++;
      } else {
        skipped++;
      }
    } catch (e) { skipped++; }
  }
  return { removed: removed, skipped: skipped };
}


function cleanFileNameForCopy_(name) {
  return String(name || '')
    .replace(/[\r\n\t]+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}


/* ============================================================
 * VALIDATE TARGET (pakai V14 lama bila tersedia)
 * ========================================================== */

function runLocalValidationOnCopiedTarget_(targetSs) {
  try {
    return runWithTargetSpreadsheetContext_(targetSs, function () {
      if (typeof __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__ !== 'undefined') __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__ = null;
      const idx = getEmployeeMasterDataIndex_();
      setupChangeRollingAndScheduleSheet_(targetSs, idx);
      const result = RSC_STD_VALIDATE_WORKBOOK_20260814_(targetSs, { requireRolling: true });
      if ((result.systemErrors || []).length) throw new Error(result.systemErrors.join(' | '));
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      return 'Standard V28.3 ' + (Number(result.errorRows || 0) ? 'COMPLETE_ERROR' : 'COMPLETE_OK') + ' | ' +
        RSC_STD_FORMAT_WORKBOOK_SUMMARY_20260814_(result);
    });
  } catch (err) {
    return 'Validation ERROR: ' + String(err && err.message ? err.message : err);
  }
}


function runWithTargetSpreadsheetContext_(targetSs, cb) {
  const prev = __ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_TARGET_SPREADSHEET_CACHE__;
  try {
    __ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_TARGET_SPREADSHEET_CACHE__ = targetSs;
    if (typeof __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__ !== 'undefined') __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__ = null;
    return cb();
  } finally {
    __ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_TARGET_SPREADSHEET_CACHE__ = prev;
    if (typeof __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__ !== 'undefined') __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__ = null;
  }
}


/* Helper sheet lookup yang bisa bekerja pada spreadsheet aktif atau target copy. */
function getRequiredSheetByName_(name) {
  const ss = __ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_TARGET_SPREADSHEET_CACHE__ || SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const wanted = cleanTextValue_(name);
  if (!wanted) throw new Error('Nama sheet kosong.');

  let sh = ss.getSheetByName(wanted);
  if (sh) return sh;

  const t31 = wanted.substring(0, 31);
  if (t31 !== wanted) {
    sh = ss.getSheetByName(t31);
    if (sh) return sh;
  }

  const wLow = wanted.toLowerCase();
  const w31Low = t31.toLowerCase();
  const sheets = ss.getSheets();

  for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    const nm = sheets[i].getName().toLowerCase();
    if (nm === wLow || nm === w31Low) return sheets[i];
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    const nm = sheets[i].getName().toLowerCase();
    if (nm.indexOf(wLow) === 0 || wLow.indexOf(nm) === 0 ||
        nm.indexOf(w31Low) === 0 || w31Low.indexOf(nm) === 0) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }
  throw new Error('Sheet `' + wanted + '` tidak ditemukan di `' +
    ss.getName() + '`. Tersedia: ' +
    sheets.map(function (s) { return s.getName(); }).join(', '));
}


/* ============================================================
 * TRIGGER HELPERS
 * ========================================================== */

function scheduleCopyJobTrigger_(fnName) {
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const P = ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS;
  if (String(props.getProperty(P.pStopFlag) || 'TRUE').toUpperCase() === 'TRUE') return false;
  if (__RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_GENERATION__ &&
      String(props.getProperty(P.pGeneration) || '0') !== String(__RSC_COPY_EXECUTION_GENERATION__)) return false;

  // ScriptLock khusus scheduler menutup race: dua execution lama tidak dapat
  // sama-sama delete lalu create trigger pada waktu yang sama.
  const schedulerLock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!schedulerLock.tryLock(5000)) return false;
  try {
    if (String(props.getProperty(P.pStopFlag) || 'TRUE').toUpperCase() === 'TRUE') return false;
    deleteTriggersForFunction_(fnName);
    RSC_PERF13_NEW_TRIGGER_20260819_(fnName)
      .timeBased()
      .after(Number(P.triggerDelayMs || 60000))
      .create();
    return true;
  } finally {
    try { schedulerLock.releaseLock(); } catch (e) {}
  }
}


function deleteTriggersForFunction_(fnName) {
  const trs = ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers();
  for (let i = 0; i < trs.length; i++) {
    if (trs[i].getHandlerFunction() === fnName) {
      try { ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trs[i]); } catch (e) {}
    }
  }
}


/* ============================================================

function cleanTextValue_(v) {
  return String(v == null ? '' : v).trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}

  try {
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(msg, title || 'ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS', sec || 6);
  } catch (e) {
    Logger.log((title || 'ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS') + ': ' + msg);
  }
}

}

function clearAllProtectionsFromFinalLinksInBackground() {
  const started = Date.now();
  const FN = 'RSC_CLEAR_ALL_PROTECTIONS_FROM_FINAL_LINKS_BG_20260611';
  const P_HINT = 'ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS_CLEAR_PROT_E_HINT_ROW';

  const COL_E = 5;
  const FIRST_DATA_ROW = 2;
  const softDeadlineMs = (typeof ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS !== 'undefined' && ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.softDeadlineMs)
    ? ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.softDeadlineMs
    : 270 * 1000;

  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();

  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(1000)) {
    Logger.log(FN + ': proses lain sedang berjalan. Skip.');
    return;
  }

  try {
    const activeSs = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

    // Simpan target spreadsheet & sheet supaya aman saat lanjut via trigger
    if (activeSs) {
      props.setProperty(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pSpreadsheetId, activeSs.getId());
      props.setProperty(ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS.pSheetId, String(activeSs.getActiveSheet().getSheetId()));
    }

    const ss = getCopyMasterSpreadsheet_();
    const sh = getCopyTargetSheet_(ss);

    const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
    if (lastRow < FIRST_DATA_ROW) {
      props.deleteProperty(P_HINT);
      deleteTriggersForFunction_(FN);
      showSpreadsheetToast_('Tidak ada data link di kolom E.', 'Clear Protection', 6);
      return;
    }

    let startRow = Number(props.getProperty(P_HINT) || FIRST_DATA_ROW);
    if (startRow < FIRST_DATA_ROW) startRow = FIRST_DATA_ROW;
    if (startRow > lastRow) startRow = FIRST_DATA_ROW;

    const numRows = lastRow - startRow + 1;
    const range = sh.getRange(startRow, COL_E, numRows, 1);

    const disp = range.getDisplayValues();
    const vals = range.getValues();
    const formulas = range.getFormulas();
    const rich = range.getRichTextValues();

    // Support smart chip link kalau Google Sheets API sudah aktif
    const chipMap = getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_(
      ss.getId(),
      sh.getName(),
      startRow,
      COL_E,
      numRows
    );

    let ok = 0;
    let skipped = 0;
    let errors = 0;
    let removedSheetProtection = 0;
    let removedRangeProtection = 0;
    const logs = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < numRows; i++) {
      const row = startRow + i;

      if (Date.now() - started > softDeadlineMs) {
        props.setProperty(P_HINT, String(row));
        scheduleCopyJobTrigger_(FN);

        Logger.log(logs.join('\n'));
        showSpreadsheetToast_(
          'Pause mendekati limit waktu. Lanjut otomatis dari row ' + row +
          '. OK=' + ok + ' Skip=' + skipped + ' Err=' + errors,
          'Clear Protection',
          8
        );
        return;
      }

      try {
        const displayValue = cleanTextValue_(disp[i][0]);

        if (!displayValue && !chipMap[row]) {
          skipped++;
          continue;
        }

        let url = getSpreadsheetUrlFromCellData_({
          richTextValue: rich[i][0],
          formula: formulas[i][0],
          value: vals[i][0],
          displayValue: displayValue
        });

        if (!url && chipMap[row]) url = chipMap[row];

        const fileId = extractSpreadsheetFileIdFromUrlOrId_(url || displayValue);

        if (!fileId) {
          skipped++;
          logs.push('Row ' + row + ': SKIP - link/file ID tidak valid.');
          continue;
        }

        const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(fileId);

        const sheetProtections = targetSs.getProtections(SpreadsheetApp.ProtectionType.SHEET);
        for (let s = 0; s < sheetProtections.length; s++) {
          try {
            if (sheetProtections[s].canEdit()) {
              sheetProtections[s].remove();
              removedSheetProtection++;
            }
          } catch (e) {}
        }

        const rangeProtections = targetSs.getProtections(SpreadsheetApp.ProtectionType.RANGE);
        for (let r = 0; r < rangeProtections.length; r++) {
          try {
            if (rangeProtections[r].canEdit()) {
              rangeProtections[r].remove();
              removedRangeProtection++;
            }
          } catch (e) {}
        }

        ok++;
        logs.push(
          'Row ' + row + ': OK - protection cleared from ' + targetSs.getName()
        );

        props.setProperty(P_HINT, String(row + 1));

      } catch (err) {
        errors++;
        logs.push(
          'Row ' + row + ': ERROR - ' +
          String(err && err.message ? err.message : err)
        );
        props.setProperty(P_HINT, String(row + 1));
      }
    }

    props.deleteProperty(P_HINT);
    deleteTriggersForFunction_(FN);

    const msg =
      'Clear protection selesai. File OK=' + ok +
      ' | Skip=' + skipped +
      ' | Error=' + errors +
      ' | Sheet Protection removed=' + removedSheetProtection +
      ' | Range Protection removed=' + removedRangeProtection;

    Logger.log(logs.join('\n'));
    Logger.log(msg);
    showSpreadsheetToast_(msg, 'Clear Protection', 10);

  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (e) {}
  }
}


/***************************************************************
 * MODULE 3 - RS VALIDATE E
 ***************************************************************/

/************************************************************
 * RS VALIDATE COL E - BACKGROUND VALIDATOR
 *
 * Untuk SETIAP link di kolom E (Template Rolling Sales FINAL):
 *   1. Buka file rolling-nya.
 *   2. Jalankan validasi FINAL (V14 lama bila ada) +
 *      validasi BP exist vs Database.
 *   3. Warnai:
 *      - Sel kolom E di master  : MERAH bila ada error,
 *                                  HIJAU bila semua OK.
 *      - Baris di file rolling  : MERAH (BP tidak exist),
 *                                  HIJAU (OK) -> kolom
 *                                  Validation Status.
 *
 * Background:
 *   - Checkpoint Properties (FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_HINT_ROW), persis pola
 *     clearAllProtectionsFromFinalLinksInBackground.
 *   - Soft deadline -> pause -> time-driven trigger lanjut.
 *   - LockService -> tidak ada eksekusi paralel.
 *
 * KETERGANTUNGAN (sudah ada di project v2):
 *   ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS, getCopyMasterSpreadsheet_, getCopyTargetSheet_,
 *   getSpreadsheetUrlFromCellData_, extractSpreadsheetFileIdFromUrlOrId_,
 *   getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_, cleanTextValue_, scheduleCopyJobTrigger_,
 *   deleteTriggersForFunction_, showSpreadsheetToast_, runLocalValidationOnCopiedTarget_
 *   (opsional V14: TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS, validateRollingSheet_, dst).
 *
 * MENU:
 *   startValidateBpExistenceForFinalRollingLinksInBackground()  : mulai / lanjut validasi kolom E.
 *   stopValidateBpExistenceForFinalRollingLinks()   : hentikan + hapus trigger + checkpoint.
 *   showBpExistenceValidationStatus() : ringkasan progress.
 *
 * Aktifkan: Apps Script > Services (+) > Google Sheets API
 ************************************************************/


// Cache set ID Database per-eksekusi (hindari baca ulang).
let __BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_SALESMAN_SET_CACHE__ = null;
let __BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_CUSTOMER_BP_SET_CACHE__ = null;


/* ============================================================
 * ENTRYPOINTS
 * ========================================================== */

function startValidateBpExistenceForFinalRollingLinksInBackground() {
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const sh = ss.getActiveSheet();
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();

  props.setProperty(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.pSsId, ss.getId());
  props.setProperty(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.pSheetId, String(sh.getSheetId()));

  // Checkpoint: kalau belum ada, mulai dari baris data pertama.
  if (!props.getProperty(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.pHintRow)) {
    props.setProperty(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.pHintRow, String(resolveFirstDataRowForBpExistenceValidation_(sh)));
  }

  deleteTriggersForFunction_(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.fn);
  continueValidateBpExistenceForFinalRollingLinksInBackground();
}


function stopValidateBpExistenceForFinalRollingLinks() {
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.deleteProperty(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.pHintRow);
  deleteTriggersForFunction_(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.fn);
  showSpreadsheetToast_('Validasi kolom E dihentikan + checkpoint dihapus.',
    'BP Existence Validation for Final Links', 6);
}


function showBpExistenceValidationStatus() {
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const ss = getBpExistenceMasterSpreadsheet_();
  const sh = getBpExistenceMasterSheet_(ss);
  const first = resolveFirstDataRowForBpExistenceValidation_(sh);
  const last = sh.getLastRow();
  const cur = Number(props.getProperty(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.pHintRow) || first);

  const total = Math.max(0, last - first + 1);
  const done = Math.max(0, Math.min(total, cur - first));
  const msg = 'Kolom E: total ' + total + ' baris | sudah ' + done +
    ' | cursor row ' + cur + (cur > last ? ' (SELESAI)' : '');
  Logger.log(msg);
  showSpreadsheetToast_(msg, 'BP Existence Validation for Final Links Status', 12);
}


/* ============================================================
 * CONTINUE (background, checkpoint, deadline)
 * ========================================================== */

function continueValidateBpExistenceForFinalRollingLinksInBackground() {
  const started = Date.now();
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();

  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(1000)) {
    Logger.log('continueValidateBpExistenceForFinalRollingLinksInBackground: proses lain jalan. Skip.');
    return;
  }

  try {
    const ss = getBpExistenceMasterSpreadsheet_();
    const sh = getBpExistenceMasterSheet_(ss);

    const firstDataRow = resolveFirstDataRowForBpExistenceValidation_(sh);
    const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();

    if (lastRow < firstDataRow) {
      finishBpExistenceValidationJob_(props, 'Tidak ada link di kolom E.');
      return;
    }

    let cursor = Number(props.getProperty(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.pHintRow) || firstDataRow);
    if (cursor < firstDataRow) cursor = firstDataRow;
    if (cursor > lastRow) {
      finishBpExistenceValidationJob_(props, 'Validasi kolom E SELESAI (cursor di akhir).');
      return;
    }

    const numRows = lastRow - cursor + 1;
    const range = sh.getRange(cursor, FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colE, numRows, 1);
    const disp = range.getDisplayValues();
    const vals = range.getValues();
    const formulas = range.getFormulas();
    const rich = range.getRichTextValues();

    // Smart chip (kalau Sheets API aktif).
    const chipMap = (typeof getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_ === 'function')
      ? getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_(ss.getId(), sh.getName(),
          cursor, FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colE, numRows)
      : {};

    // Reset cache Database sekali per pemanggilan run.
    resetBpExistenceDatabaseCache_();

    let okFiles = 0, errFiles = 0, skipped = 0, hardErr = 0;
    const logs = [];

    let row = cursor;
    for (; row <= lastRow; row++) {
      const i = row - cursor;

      // Soft deadline -> simpan cursor di baris SEKARANG
      // (belum diproses) lalu jadwalkan lanjutan.
      if (Date.now() - started > FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.softDeadlineMs) {
        props.setProperty(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.pHintRow, String(row));
        scheduleCopyJobTrigger_(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.fn);
        Logger.log(logs.join('\n'));
        showSpreadsheetToast_('Pause (limit waktu). OK=' + okFiles +
          ' ERR=' + errFiles + ' Skip=' + skipped +
          '. Lanjut otomatis dari row ' + row + ' ~1 menit lagi.',
          'BP Existence Validation for Final Links', 8);
        return;
      }

      if (okFiles + errFiles >= FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.hardMaxFilesPerRun) {
        props.setProperty(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.pHintRow, String(row));
        scheduleCopyJobTrigger_(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.fn);
        Logger.log(logs.join('\n'));
        showSpreadsheetToast_('Batch cap (' + FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.hardMaxFilesPerRun +
          ' file). Lanjut otomatis dari row ' + row + ' ~1 menit lagi.',
          'BP Existence Validation for Final Links', 8);
        return;
      }

      const displayValue = cleanTextValue_(disp[i][0]);

      if (!displayValue && !chipMap[row]) {
        skipped++;
        props.setProperty(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.pHintRow, String(row + 1));
        continue;
      }

      let url = getSpreadsheetUrlFromCellData_({
        richTextValue: rich[i][0],
        formula: formulas[i][0],
        value: vals[i][0],
        displayValue: displayValue
      });
      if (!url && chipMap[row]) url = chipMap[row];

      const fileId = extractSpreadsheetFileIdFromUrlOrId_(url || displayValue);

      if (!fileId) {
        skipped++;
        logs.push('Row ' + row + ': SKIP - link/file ID tidak valid.');
        props.setProperty(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.pHintRow, String(row + 1));
        continue;
      }

      try {
        const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(fileId);

        // Jalankan validasi gabungan: V14 (kalau ada) + BP exist.
        const result = validateBpExistenceForOneFinalRollingFile_(targetSs);

        // Warnai sel kolom E sesuai hasil agregat file.
        const cellE = sh.getRange(row, FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colE);
        if (result.hasError) {
          cellE.setBackground(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colorError);
          errFiles++;
          logs.push('Row ' + row + ': ERROR - ' + result.summary);
        } else {
          cellE.setBackground(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colorOk);
          okFiles++;
          logs.push('Row ' + row + ': OK - ' + result.summary);
        }

        SpreadsheetApp.flush();
        props.setProperty(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.pHintRow, String(row + 1));

      } catch (err) {
        hardErr++;
        const msg = String(err && err.message ? err.message : err);
        logs.push('Row ' + row + ': HARD ERROR - ' + msg);
        // Tandai sel merah juga supaya kelihatan butuh perhatian.
        try {
          sh.getRange(row, FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colE).setBackground(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colorError);
        } catch (e) {}
        // Error buka file -> majukan checkpoint supaya tidak
        // menggantung di baris ini selamanya (beda dgn error
        // transien copy; di sini file mungkin memang inaccessible).
        props.setProperty(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.pHintRow, String(row + 1));
      }
    }

    Logger.log(logs.join('\n'));
    finishBpExistenceValidationJob_(props,
      'VALIDASI KOLOM E SELESAI. OK=' + okFiles +
      ' ERROR=' + errFiles + ' Skip=' + skipped +
      ' HardErr=' + hardErr);

  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (e) {}
  }
}


function finishBpExistenceValidationJob_(props, msg) {
  props.deleteProperty(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.pHintRow);
  deleteTriggersForFunction_(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.fn);
  Logger.log(msg);
  showSpreadsheetToast_(msg, 'BP Existence Validation for Final Links', 10);
}


/* ============================================================
 * VALIDASI 1 FILE: V14 (opsional) + BP EXIST + warnai baris
 * Return { hasError:bool, summary:string }
 * ========================================================== */

function validateBpExistenceForOneFinalRollingFile_(targetSs) {
  let parts = [];
  let hasError = false;

  // 1) V14 lama (kalau lengkap di project). Reuse fungsi yang
  //    sudah ada supaya konsisten. Tidak fatal kalau tidak ada.
  if (typeof runLocalValidationOnCopiedTarget_ === 'function') {
    try {
      const v14msg = runLocalValidationOnCopiedTarget_(targetSs);
      parts.push('V14: ' + v14msg);
      if (/ERROR/i.test(String(v14msg))) hasError = true;
    } catch (e) {
      parts.push('V14 ERROR: ' +
        String(e && e.message ? e.message : e));
      hasError = true;
    }
  }

  // 2) BP exist vs Database + warnai baris di file rolling.
  try {
    const rollingSheet = getRollingChangeSheetForBpExistValidation_(targetSs);
    if (!rollingSheet) {
      parts.push('BP: sheet rolling tak ketemu');
      hasError = true;
    } else {
      const bp = validateBpExistenceAndColorRows_(rollingSheet);
      parts.push('BP: ' + bp.summary);
      if (bp.errCount > 0) hasError = true;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    parts.push('BP ERROR: ' +
      String(e && e.message ? e.message : e));
    hasError = true;
  }

  return { hasError: hasError, summary: parts.join(' | ') };
}


function getRollingChangeSheetForBpExistValidation_(ss) {
  const want = (typeof TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS !== 'undefined' && TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetRolling)
    ? TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetRolling : FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.rollingSheetName;

  let sh = ss.getSheetByName(want);
  if (sh) return sh;

  // Apps Script truncate 31 char + fallback "contains rolling".
  const t31 = String(want).substring(0, 31);
  sh = ss.getSheetByName(t31);
  if (sh) return sh;

  const sheets = ss.getSheets();
  for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (/rolling/i.test(sheets[i].getName())) return sheets[i];
  }
  return null;
}


/* ============================================================
 * BP EXIST + COLORING (di dalam file rolling)
 * ========================================================== */

function validateBpExistenceAndColorRows_(rollingSheet) {
  const lastRow=rollingSheet.getLastRow(),lastCol=rollingSheet.getLastColumn();
  if(lastRow<2||lastCol<1)return{okCount:0,errCount:0,skip:0,summary:'tidak ada data'};
  const scan=Math.min(15,lastRow),grid=rollingSheet.getRange(1,1,scan,lastCol).getDisplayValues();
  let headerRowIdx=-1,cCustomer=0,cSalesman=0,cStatus=0,cDetail=0;
  for(let r=0;r<grid.length;r++){
    const cust=findValidateDateCol_(grid[r],['customer id','customer']),sales=findValidateDateCol_(grid[r],['salesman id','salesman']);
    if(!cust&&!sales)continue;
    headerRowIdx=r;cCustomer=cust;cSalesman=sales;
    const stHdr=findValidateDateCol_(grid[r],['validation status','status']),dtHdr=findValidateDateCol_(grid[r],['error detail','error']);
    if(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.preferHeaderOverFixed&&stHdr){cStatus=stHdr;cDetail=dtHdr||FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colDetail;}
    else{cStatus=FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colStatus;cDetail=FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colDetail;}
    break;
  }
  if(headerRowIdx<0)return{okCount:0,errCount:0,skip:0,summary:'header (Customer/Salesman ID) tak ketemu'};
  if(!cStatus)cStatus=FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colStatus;if(!cDetail)cDetail=FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colDetail;
  const firstDataRow=headerRowIdx+2;if(firstDataRow>lastRow)return{okCount:0,errCount:0,skip:0,summary:'tidak ada baris data'};
  const n=lastRow-firstDataRow+1;

  // PERF5: one contiguous input/status read; collect unique lookup IDs before touching DB.
  const cols=[cStatus,cDetail];if(cCustomer)cols.push(cCustomer);if(cSalesman)cols.push(cSalesman);
  const minCol=Math.min.apply(null,cols),maxCol=Math.max.apply(null,cols),width=maxCol-minCol+1;
  const block=rollingSheet.getRange(firstDataRow,minCol,n,width),raw=block.getValues();
  const rc=cCustomer?cCustomer-minCol:-1,rs=cSalesman?cSalesman-minCol:-1,rst=cStatus-minCol,rd=cDetail-minCol;
  const customerRaw=new Array(n),salesRaw=new Array(n),statusVals=new Array(n),detailVals=new Array(n);
  const bpWanted=Object.create(null),salesWanted=Object.create(null);
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const cv=rc>=0?raw[i][rc]:'',sv=rs>=0?raw[i][rs]:'';customerRaw[i]=cv;salesRaw[i]=sv;statusVals[i]=[raw[i][rst]];detailVals[i]=[raw[i][rd]];
    const cn=normalizeBpExistenceId_(cv),sn=normalizeBpExistenceId_(sv);
    if(cn)bpWanted[cn]=true;
    if(sn){if(isSalesmanDummyId_(sn))bpWanted[sn]=true;else if(isSalesmanIdForBpExistValidation_(sn))salesWanted[sn]=true;else bpWanted[sn]=true;}
  }
  const bpSubset=RSC_LOAD_FSD_BP_MASTER_SUBSET_20260807_(bpWanted,Object.create(null));
  const activeSales=RSC_STD_LOAD_ACTIVE_SALESMAN_SUBSET_20260814_(salesWanted);

  const statusBg=new Array(n),detailBg=new Array(n);let okCount=0,errCount=0,skip=0;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    statusBg[i]=[FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colorNeutral];detailBg[i]=[FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colorNeutral];
    const customerId=customerRaw[i],salesmanId=salesRaw[i];
    if(!cleanTextValue_(customerId)&&!cleanTextValue_(salesmanId)){skip++;continue;}
    const problems=[];
    if(cCustomer){const id=normalizeBpExistenceId_(customerId);if(id&&!bpSubset.exists[id])problems.push('Customer: BP tidak exist (BP '+id+' tidak ada di m_bp_general_view)');}
    if(cSalesman){
      const id=normalizeBpExistenceId_(salesmanId);
      if(id){
        if(isSalesmanDummyId_(id)){if(!bpSubset.exists[id])problems.push('Salesman: BP Dummy tidak exist ('+id+' tidak ada di m_bp_general_view)');}
        else if(isSalesmanIdForBpExistValidation_(id)){if(!activeSales[id])problems.push('Salesman: BP tidak exist (Salesman '+id+' tidak ada di m_sales_info)');}
        else if(!bpSubset.exists[id])problems.push('Salesman: BP tidak exist (BP '+id+' tidak ada di m_bp_general_view)');
      }
    }
    if(problems.length){statusVals[i][0]='ERROR';const prev=cleanTextValue_(detailVals[i][0]),add=problems.join(' | ');detailVals[i][0]=prev?(prev+' | '+add):add;statusBg[i][0]=FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colorError;detailBg[i][0]=FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colorError;errCount++;}
    else{const cur=cleanTextValue_(statusVals[i][0]).toUpperCase(),isErr=cur==='ERROR';if(!isErr)statusVals[i][0]='OK';const col=isErr?FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colorError:FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colorOk;statusBg[i][0]=col;detailBg[i][0]=col;okCount++;}
  }

  // PERF5: status/detail are normally adjacent O:P; write both together when possible.
  if(cDetail===cStatus+1){
    const out=new Array(n),bg=new Array(n);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){out[i]=[statusVals[i][0],detailVals[i][0]];bg[i]=[statusBg[i][0],detailBg[i][0]];}
    rollingSheet.getRange(firstDataRow,cStatus,n,2).setValues(out).setBackgrounds(bg);
  }else{
    rollingSheet.getRange(firstDataRow,cStatus,n,1).setValues(statusVals).setBackgrounds(statusBg);
    rollingSheet.getRange(firstDataRow,cDetail,n,1).setValues(detailVals).setBackgrounds(detailBg);
  }
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  return{okCount:okCount,errCount:errCount,skip:skip,summary:'OK='+okCount+' ERR='+errCount+' skip='+skip,lookup:{bpMode:bpSubset.lookupMode||'',bpRows:Number(bpSubset.scannedRows||0),salesmanUnique:Object.keys(salesWanted).length,bpUnique:Object.keys(bpWanted).length}};
}



/* ============================================================
 * DATABASE BP-EXIST (sama logika dgn modul sebelumnya)
 * ========================================================== */

function normalizeBpExistenceId_(v) {
  return RSC_PERF5_MEMO_SCALAR_20260819_('NORM_BP', v, function () {
    let s = cleanText_(v);
    if (!s) return '';
    s = s.replace(/^'+/, '');
    const labelMatch = s.match(/^\s*([A-Za-z0-9]+)\s+(?:-|–|—|\|)\s+.+$/);
    if (labelMatch && labelMatch[1]) s = labelMatch[1];
    s = s.replace(/\s+/g, '');
    if (/^\d+\.0+$/.test(s)) s = s.replace(/\.0+$/, '');
    if (/^\d+(\.\d+)?[eE]\+?\d+$/.test(s)) {
      const num = Number(s);
      if (isFinite(num)) s = String(Math.round(num));
    }
    return s.toUpperCase();
  });
}

function isSalesmanIdForBpExistValidation_(idNorm) {
  return /^S/i.test(idNorm);
}

function loadDatabaseKeySetForBpExistValidation_(sheetName, headerName) {
  const ss = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.dbSpreadsheetId);
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName(sheetName);
  if (!sh) throw new Error('Database: sheet "' + sheetName +
    '" tidak ditemukan.');

  const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  if (lastRow < 2) return {};

  const headerRow = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getValues()[0];
  let keyCol = 0;
  const want = String(headerName).trim().toLowerCase();
  for (let c = 0; c < headerRow.length; c++) {
    if (String(headerRow[c]).trim().toLowerCase() === want) {
      keyCol = c + 1; break;
    }
  }
  if (!keyCol) throw new Error('Database: kolom "' + headerName +
    '" tidak ada di "' + sheetName + '".');

  const values = sh.getRange(2, keyCol, lastRow - 1, 1).getValues();
  const set = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    const k = normalizeBpExistenceId_(values[i][0]);
    if (k) set[k] = true;
  }
  return set;
}

function getSalesmanIdSetForBpExistValidation_() {
  if (__BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_SALESMAN_SET_CACHE__) return __BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_SALESMAN_SET_CACHE__;
  __BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_SALESMAN_SET_CACHE__ = loadDatabaseKeySetForBpExistValidation_(
    FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.dbSheetSales, FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.dbColSalesman);
  return __BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_SALESMAN_SET_CACHE__;
}

function getCustomerBpIdSetForBpExistValidation_() {
  if (__BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_CUSTOMER_BP_SET_CACHE__) return __BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_CUSTOMER_BP_SET_CACHE__;
  __BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_CUSTOMER_BP_SET_CACHE__ = loadDatabaseKeySetForBpExistValidation_(
    FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.dbSheetBp, FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.dbColBp);
  return __BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_CUSTOMER_BP_SET_CACHE__;
}

function resetBpExistenceDatabaseCache_() {
  __BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_SALESMAN_SET_CACHE__ = null;
  __BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_CUSTOMER_BP_SET_CACHE__ = null;
}

function checkBpExistenceForRawId_(rawId) {
  const idNorm = normalizeBpExistenceId_(rawId);
  if (!idNorm) return { ok: true };

  // BP Dummy Salesman bukan NIK salesman aktif di m_sales_info.
  // Sesuai konsep "Business Partner - BP Dummy", existence-nya
  // divalidasi sebagai BP ke m_bp_general_view.bp_id.
  if (isSalesmanDummyId_(idNorm)) {
    const bpSet = getCustomerBpIdSetForBpExistValidation_();
    if (bpSet[idNorm]) return { ok: true };
    return {
      ok: false,
      reason: 'BP Dummy tidak exist (' + idNorm +
        ' tidak ada di m_bp_general_view)'
    };
  }

  // Salesman normal tetap authoritative ke m_sales_info.salesman_id.
  if (isSalesmanIdForBpExistValidation_(idNorm)) {
    const set = getSalesmanIdSetForBpExistValidation_();
    if (set[idNorm]) return { ok: true };
    return { ok: false,
      reason: 'BP tidak exist (Salesman ' + idNorm +
        ' tidak ada di m_sales_info)' };
  }

  const set = getCustomerBpIdSetForBpExistValidation_();
  if (set[idNorm]) return { ok: true };
  return { ok: false,
    reason: 'BP tidak exist (BP ' + idNorm +
      ' tidak ada di m_bp_general_view)' };
}

  const sid = props.getProperty(FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.pSheetId);
  if (sid) {
    const sheets = ss.getSheets();
    for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
      if (String(sheets[i].getSheetId()) === String(sid)) {
        return sheets[i];
      }
    }
  }
  return ss.getActiveSheet();
}
