/************************************************************
 * SET G & L TO 2026-08-01 WHEN REASON = ROLLING
 *
 * Master:
 * - Ambil semua link Google Sheet dari kolom E
 *
 * Target:
 * - Sheet: Change Rolling & Change Schedule
 * - Jika Reason = Rolling
 *   maka:
 *   - Valid From = 2026-08-01
 *   - Visit Valid From = 2026-08-01
 * - Jika kolom M bukan Rolling, biarkan AS IS
 *
 * Optimized:
 * - Link kolom E dibaca batch
 * - Target dibaca by header per file
 * - Kolom Valid From dan Visit Valid From ditulis batch
 ************************************************************/

function fixRollingReasonDatesForAllFinalLinksFast() {
  const rollingReasonDateFixConfig = BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.targetCfg;

  const masterSs = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const masterSh = masterSs.getActiveSheet();

  const lastRow = masterSh.getLastRow();

  if (lastRow < rollingReasonDateFixConfig.MASTER_START_ROW) {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Tidak ada data link di kolom E.');
    return;
  }

  const numRows = lastRow - rollingReasonDateFixConfig.MASTER_START_ROW + 1;

  const urls = getRollingReasonDateFixUrlsFromColumn_(
    masterSh,
    rollingReasonDateFixConfig.MASTER_START_ROW,
    rollingReasonDateFixConfig.MASTER_LINK_COL,
    numRows
  );

  if (urls.length === 0) {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Tidak ada link Google Sheet valid di kolom E.');
    return;
  }

  let processedFile = 0;
  let skippedFile = 0;
  let checkedRows = 0;
  let updatedRows = 0;

  urls.forEach(function(url, index) {
    try {
      const fileId = extractRollingReasonDateFixSpreadsheetId_(url);

      if (!fileId) {
        skippedFile++;
        Logger.log(`[${index + 1}] SKIP - Link tidak valid: ${url}`);
        return;
      }

      const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(fileId);
      const targetSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(rollingReasonDateFixConfig.TARGET_SHEET_NAME);

      if (!targetSh) {
        skippedFile++;
        Logger.log(`[${index + 1}] SKIP - Sheet "${rollingReasonDateFixConfig.TARGET_SHEET_NAME}" tidak ditemukan: ${url}`);
        return;
      }

      const result = updateRollingReasonDatesInTargetSheet_(targetSh, rollingReasonDateFixConfig);

      processedFile++;
      checkedRows += result.checked;
      updatedRows += result.updated;

      Logger.log(
        `[${index + 1}] DONE - ${url} | checked=${result.checked}, updated=${result.updated}`
      );

    } catch (err) {
      skippedFile++;
      Logger.log(`[ERROR] ${url} | ${err.message}`);
    }
  });

  Logger.log('======================================');
  Logger.log('SET G & L WHEN ROLLING SELESAI');
  Logger.log(`File berhasil diproses : ${processedFile}`);
  Logger.log(`File dilewati/error    : ${skippedFile}`);
  Logger.log(`Total row dicek        : ${checkedRows}`);
  Logger.log(`Total row updated      : ${updatedRows}`);
  Logger.log('======================================');

  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
    `Update selesai.\n\n` +
    `File OK: ${processedFile}\n` +
    `File skip/error: ${skippedFile}\n` +
    `Row dicek: ${checkedRows}\n` +
    `Row updated: ${updatedRows}`
  );
}


/**
 * Update target sheet.
 * Read by header sekali, write Valid From dan Visit Valid From batch.
 */
function updateRollingReasonDatesInTargetSheet_(targetSh, rollingReasonDateFixConfig) {
  const lastRow = targetSh.getLastRow();

  if (lastRow < rollingReasonDateFixConfig.TARGET_START_ROW) {
    return { checked: 0, updated: 0 };
  }

  const columns = resolveRollingReasonDateFixColumns_(targetSh, rollingReasonDateFixConfig);
  if (!columns.validFrom || !columns.visitValidFrom || !columns.reason) {
    throw new Error(
      'Header target tidak lengkap. Wajib ada: Valid From, Visit Valid From, Reason. ' +
      'Fallback column: Valid From=' + columns.validFrom +
      ', Visit Valid From=' + columns.visitValidFrom +
      ', Reason=' + columns.reason
    );
  }

  const maxNeededCol = Math.max(columns.validFrom, columns.visitValidFrom, columns.reason);
  if (targetSh.getMaxColumns() < maxNeededCol) {
    targetSh.insertColumnsAfter(targetSh.getMaxColumns(), maxNeededCol - targetSh.getMaxColumns());
  }

  const numRows = lastRow - rollingReasonDateFixConfig.TARGET_START_ROW + 1;
  const startCol = Math.min(columns.validFrom, columns.visitValidFrom, columns.reason);
  const endCol = Math.max(columns.validFrom, columns.visitValidFrom, columns.reason);
  const numCols = endCol - startCol + 1;

  const dataRange = targetSh.getRange(
    rollingReasonDateFixConfig.TARGET_START_ROW,
    startCol,
    numRows,
    numCols
  );

  const values = dataRange.getDisplayValues();

  const idxValidFrom = columns.validFrom - startCol;
  const idxVisitValidFrom = columns.visitValidFrom - startCol;
  const idxReason = columns.reason - startCol;

  const validFromOutput = [];
  const visitValidFromOutput = [];

  let checked = 0;
  let updated = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < numRows; i++) {
    let currentValidFrom = values[i][idxValidFrom];
    let currentVisitValidFrom = values[i][idxVisitValidFrom];

    const reason = String(values[i][idxReason] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    const isRolling = reason.indexOf(String(rollingReasonDateFixConfig.ROLLING_TEXT || 'ROLLING').toUpperCase()) !== -1;

    if (isRolling) {
      checked++;

      const needUpdate =
        String(currentValidFrom).trim() !== rollingReasonDateFixConfig.TARGET_DATE_TEXT ||
        String(currentVisitValidFrom).trim() !== rollingReasonDateFixConfig.TARGET_DATE_TEXT;

      currentValidFrom = rollingReasonDateFixConfig.TARGET_DATE_TEXT;
      currentVisitValidFrom = rollingReasonDateFixConfig.TARGET_DATE_TEXT;

      if (needUpdate) updated++;
    }

    validFromOutput.push([currentValidFrom]);
    visitValidFromOutput.push([currentVisitValidFrom]);
  }

  const validFromRange = targetSh.getRange(
    rollingReasonDateFixConfig.TARGET_START_ROW,
    columns.validFrom,
    numRows,
    1
  );

  const visitValidFromRange = targetSh.getRange(
    rollingReasonDateFixConfig.TARGET_START_ROW,
    columns.visitValidFrom,
    numRows,
    1
  );

  // Text format supaya pasti tampil yyyy-mm-dd, bukan date serial.
  validFromRange.setNumberFormat('@');
  visitValidFromRange.setNumberFormat('@');

  validFromRange.setValues(validFromOutput);
  visitValidFromRange.setValues(visitValidFromOutput);

  return { checked: checked, updated: updated };
}


function resolveRollingReasonDateFixColumns_(targetSh, rollingReasonDateFixConfig) {
  let hm = null;
  try {
    hm = buildHeaderMap_(targetSh);
  } catch (err) {
    hm = null;
  }

  const byHeader = function (names) {
    if (!hm) return 0;
    try {
      return findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, names) || 0;
    } catch (err) {
      return 0;
    }
  };

  return {
    validFrom: byHeader([rollingReasonDateFixConfig.VALID_FROM_HEADER || 'Valid From']) ||
      rollingReasonDateFixConfig.COL_VALID_FROM || rollingReasonDateFixConfig.COL_F || 7,
    visitValidFrom: byHeader([rollingReasonDateFixConfig.VISIT_VALID_FROM_HEADER || 'Visit Valid From']) ||
      rollingReasonDateFixConfig.COL_VISIT_VALID_FROM || rollingReasonDateFixConfig.COL_K || 12,
    reason: byHeader([rollingReasonDateFixConfig.REASON_HEADER || 'Reason']) ||
      rollingReasonDateFixConfig.COL_REASON || rollingReasonDateFixConfig.COL_M || 14
  };
}


/************************************************************
 * URL HELPERS - UNIQUE PREFIX
 ************************************************************/

function getRollingReasonDateFixUrlsFromColumn_(sheet, startRow, column, numRows) {
  const range = sheet.getRange(startRow, column, numRows, 1);

  const richTextValues = range.getRichTextValues();
  const displayValues = range.getDisplayValues();
  const formulas = range.getFormulas();

  const urlSet = new Set();

  for (let i = 0; i < numRows; i++) {
    let url = '';

    const richText = richTextValues[i][0];

    if (richText) {
      url = richText.getLinkUrl() || '';

      if (!url) {
        const runs = richText.getRuns();

        for (let r = 0; r < runs.length; r++) {
          const runUrl = runs[r].getLinkUrl();

          if (runUrl) {
            url = runUrl;
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (!url) {
      url = extractRollingReasonDateFixUrlFromText_(formulas[i][0]);
    }

    if (!url) {
      url = extractRollingReasonDateFixUrlFromText_(displayValues[i][0]);
    }

    if (url && isRollingReasonDateFixGoogleSheetUrl_(url)) {
      urlSet.add(url);
    }
  }

  return Array.from(urlSet);
}


function extractRollingReasonDateFixUrlFromText_(text) {
  const value = String(text || '').trim();

  if (!value) {
    return '';
  }

  const match = value.match(
    /https:\/\/docs\.google\.com\/spreadsheets\/d\/[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+[^\s"',)]*/
  );

  return match ? match[0] : '';
}


function isRollingReasonDateFixGoogleSheetUrl_(url) {
  return /^https:\/\/docs\.google\.com\/spreadsheets\/d\/[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+/.test(
    String(url || '').trim()
  );
}


function extractRollingReasonDateFixSpreadsheetId_(url) {
  const match = String(url || '').match(/\/spreadsheets\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);
  return match ? match[1] : '';
}

/************************************************************
 * FINAL OPTIMIZED V2 - MARK EXACT DATA WITH CURRENT
 *
 * Cara pakai:
 * 1. Di Apps Script editor, HAPUS seluruh blok lama mulai dari
 *    "FINAL OPTIMIZED - MARK EXACT DATA WITH CURRENT" sampai
 *    helper terakhir (assertBigQueryServiceForExactData_).
 * 2. Tempel ISI FILE INI sebagai gantinya.
 * 3. Pastikan Services (+) > BigQuery API sudah Add.
 * 4. Jalankan: markExactDataWithCurrentForAllFinalLinks
 *
 * Perbaikan utama vs V1:
 * - FIX syntax error "concatenated string literals..." dengan
 *   memindahkan SEMUA normalisasi ke JavaScript (tidak ada lagi
 *   SQL CONCAT bertingkat yang panjang dan rapuh).
 * - Parameterized BigQuery query (aman dari escaping).
 * - Batching 2000 bp_id per query (jauh lebih cepat).
 * - Pre-filter pakai bp_id (paling selektif), lalu match core_key
 *   di JS sebelum build exact_key (hemat memori).
 * - Handle BQ ARRAY<STRING> visit_schedule dengan benar.
 * - Handle BQ TIMESTAMP epoch dengan desimal (mis. "253402214400.0").
 ************************************************************/



/************************************************************
 * MAIN ENTRY
 ************************************************************/
function markExactDataWithCurrentForAllFinalLinks() {
  assertBigQueryServiceForExactData_();

  const masterSs = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const masterSh = masterSs.getActiveSheet();
  const lastRow = masterSh.getLastRow();

  if (lastRow < EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.MASTER_START_ROW) {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Tidak ada link untuk diproses.');
    return;
  }

  const numRows = lastRow - EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.MASTER_START_ROW + 1;
  const urls = getExactDataGoogleSheetUrlsFromColumn_(
    masterSh,
    EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.MASTER_START_ROW,
    EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.MASTER_LINK_COL,
    numRows
  );

  if (urls.length === 0) {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Tidak ada link Google Sheet valid di kolom E.');
    return;
  }

  const t0 = Date.now();
  Logger.log(`Jumlah unique link ditemukan: ${urls.length}`);

  // Resolve kolom BQ sekali (mapping internal -> nama kolom asli)
  const resolvedMapping = resolveExactDataBigQueryColumns_();
  Logger.log('Resolved BQ columns:');
  Object.keys(resolvedMapping).forEach(k =>
    Logger.log(`  ${k} -> ${resolvedMapping[k].columnName} (${resolvedMapping[k].dataType})`)
  );

  // ===== PHASE 1: Baca semua target sheet, kumpulkan keys + bp_ids =====
  const collectResult = collectExactDataTargetPlans_(urls);

  if (collectResult.plans.length === 0) {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Tidak ada target file yang berhasil dibaca.');
    return;
  }
  if (collectResult.allBpIds.size === 0) {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Tidak ada bp_id valid dari target sheet.');
    return;
  }

  Logger.log(`Unique bp_ids       : ${collectResult.allBpIds.size}`);
  Logger.log(`Unique target core  : ${collectResult.allTargetCoreKeySet.size}`);
  Logger.log(`Unique target exact : ${collectResult.allTargetExactKeySet.size}`);

  // ===== PHASE 2: Fetch BQ rows by bp_id batches, normalisasi di JS =====
  const matchedExactKeySet = buildMatchedExactDataKeySetFromBigQuery_(
    Array.from(collectResult.allBpIds),
    collectResult.allTargetCoreKeySet,
    resolvedMapping
  );

  Logger.log(`Matched exact keys: ${matchedExactKeySet.size}`);

  // ===== PHASE 3: Tulis hasil ke kolom R =====
  const writeResult = writeExactDataWithCurrentResult_(collectResult.plans, matchedExactKeySet);

  const elapsed = ((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1);

  Logger.log('======================================');
  Logger.log('MARK EXACT DATA SELESAI');
  Logger.log(`File berhasil dibaca : ${collectResult.plans.length}`);
  Logger.log(`File skip/error      : ${collectResult.skippedFile}`);
  Logger.log(`Total row dicek      : ${writeResult.checkedRows}`);
  Logger.log(`Total row exact      : ${writeResult.exactRows}`);
  Logger.log(`Elapsed              : ${elapsed}s`);
  Logger.log('======================================');

  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
    `Proses selesai (${elapsed}s).\n\n` +
    `File OK: ${collectResult.plans.length}\n` +
    `File skip/error: ${collectResult.skippedFile}\n` +
    `Row dicek: ${writeResult.checkedRows}\n` +
    `Row exact: ${writeResult.exactRows}`
  );
}


/************************************************************
 * PHASE 1: COLLECT TARGET PLANS
 ************************************************************/
function collectExactDataTargetPlans_(urls) {
  const plans = [];
  const allTargetExactKeySet = new Set();
  const allTargetCoreKeySet = new Set();
  const allBpIds = new Set();
  let skippedFile = 0;

  // Cari index kolom bp_id di FIELD_MAPPING (untuk extract bp_id per row)
  const bpIdMap = EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.FIELD_MAPPING.find(m => m.name === 'bp_id');
  const bpIdColIdx = bpIdMap.targetCol - 1; // 0-based

  urls.forEach(function(url) {
    try {
      const fileId = extractExactDataSpreadsheetId_(url);
      if (!fileId) {
        skippedFile++;
        Logger.log(`SKIP - Link tidak valid: ${url}`);
        return;
      }

      const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(fileId);
      const targetSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.TARGET_SHEET_NAME);
      if (!targetSh) {
        skippedFile++;
        Logger.log(`SKIP - Sheet "${EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.TARGET_SHEET_NAME}" tidak ditemukan: ${url}`);
        return;
      }

      const lastRow = targetSh.getLastRow();
      if (lastRow < EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.TARGET_START_ROW) {
        skippedFile++;
        Logger.log(`SKIP - Sheet target kosong: ${url}`);
        return;
      }

      const maxNeededCol = Math.max(
        EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.OUTPUT_COL_R,
        Math.max.apply(null, EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.FIELD_MAPPING.map(f => f.targetCol))
      );

      if (targetSh.getMaxColumns() < maxNeededCol) {
        targetSh.insertColumnsAfter(
          targetSh.getMaxColumns(),
          maxNeededCol - targetSh.getMaxColumns()
        );
      }

      const numRows = lastRow - EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.TARGET_START_ROW + 1;

      // Single batch read: A:R sekaligus
      const dataRange = targetSh.getRange(
        EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.TARGET_START_ROW,
        1,
        numRows,
        maxNeededCol
      );
      const rawValues = dataRange.getValues();
      const displayValues = dataRange.getDisplayValues();

      const outputRange = targetSh.getRange(
        EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.TARGET_START_ROW,
        EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.OUTPUT_COL_R,
        numRows,
        1
      );
      const outputValues = outputRange.getDisplayValues();

      const rowExactKeys = new Array(numRows);
      const rowCoreKeys = new Array(numRows);

      for (let i = 0; i < numRows; i++) {
        const exactKey = buildExactDataTargetKey_(rawValues[i], displayValues[i], false);
        const coreKey  = buildExactDataTargetKey_(rawValues[i], displayValues[i], true);

        rowExactKeys[i] = exactKey;
        rowCoreKeys[i]  = coreKey;

        if (exactKey) allTargetExactKeySet.add(exactKey);
        if (coreKey)  allTargetCoreKeySet.add(coreKey);

        const bpId = normalizeExactDataText_(displayValues[i][bpIdColIdx]);
        if (bpId) allBpIds.add(bpId);
      }

      plans.push({
        url: url,
        outputRange: outputRange,
        outputValues: outputValues,
        rowExactKeys: rowExactKeys,
        rowCoreKeys: rowCoreKeys
      });

      Logger.log(`OK - File dibaca: ${url} | rows=${numRows}`);

    } catch (err) {
      skippedFile++;
      Logger.log(`ERROR - Gagal baca file: ${url} | ${err.message}`);
    }
  });

  return {
    plans: plans,
    allTargetExactKeySet: allTargetExactKeySet,
    allTargetCoreKeySet: allTargetCoreKeySet,
    allBpIds: allBpIds,
    skippedFile: skippedFile
  };
}


/**
 * Build key dari row target sheet (raw + display values).
 * coreOnly=true -> hanya field isCore (sls_office, bp_id, relationship_cat_id, bp_id_rlt2).
 */
function buildExactDataTargetKey_(rawRow, displayRow, coreOnly) {
  const parts = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.FIELD_MAPPING.length; i++) {
    const map = EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.FIELD_MAPPING[i];
    if (coreOnly && !map.isCore) continue;

    const idx = map.targetCol - 1;
    const rawValue = rawRow[idx];
    const displayValue = displayRow[idx];

    const normalized = normalizeExactDataValueByType_(rawValue, displayValue, map.type);

    if (!normalized) {
      return ''; // kalau ada field kosong, skip baris ini
    }

    parts.push(`${map.name}=${normalized}`);
  }

  return parts.join('||');
}


/************************************************************
 * PHASE 2: FETCH BIGQUERY + BUILD MATCHED EXACT KEY SET
 *
 * Strategi:
 * - Filter BQ pakai bp_id IN UNNEST(@bp_ids) (paling selektif).
 * - Normalisasi semua field di JS.
 * - Untuk setiap baris BQ: build core_key, cek apakah ada di
 *   targetCoreKeySet. Kalau iya, build exact_key dan tambahkan
 *   ke matched set. Kalau tidak, skip (hemat waktu build exact).
 ************************************************************/
function buildMatchedExactDataKeySetFromBigQuery_(bpIdsArray, targetCoreKeySet, resolvedMapping) {
  const matchedExactKeySet = new Set();
  const batchSize = EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.BQ_BP_ID_BATCH_SIZE;
  const totalBatches = Math.ceil(bpIdsArray.length / batchSize);

  for (let start = 0; start < bpIdsArray.length; start += batchSize) {
    const chunk = bpIdsArray.slice(start, start + batchSize);
    const batchNum = Math.floor(start / batchSize) + 1;

    Logger.log(`BQ fetch batch ${batchNum}/${totalBatches} (bp_ids=${chunk.length})...`);
    const t0 = Date.now();

    const rows = fetchBigQueryRowsForExactDataByBpIds_(chunk, resolvedMapping);
    const fetchMs = Date.now() - t0;

    let matchedInBatch = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      const normalizedObj = normalizeExactDataBigQueryRow_(rows[i]);

      // Fast filter: cek core key dulu
      const coreKey = buildExactDataKeyFromNormalizedObject_(normalizedObj, true);
      if (!coreKey || !targetCoreKeySet.has(coreKey)) {
        continue;
      }

      // Lolos core filter -> build exact key
      const exactKey = buildExactDataKeyFromNormalizedObject_(normalizedObj, false);
      if (exactKey) {
        matchedExactKeySet.add(exactKey);
        matchedInBatch++;
      }
    }

    Logger.log(
      `  -> fetched=${rows.length} rows in ${fetchMs}ms, ` +
      `matched_exact_keys_in_batch=${matchedInBatch}`
    );
  }

  return matchedExactKeySet;
}


/**
 * Fetch baris BQ pakai parameterized query.
 * Return: Array of objects { fieldName: rawCellValue, ... } per row.
 * rawCellValue bisa berupa string (untuk skalar) atau array of strings (untuk ARRAY).
 */
function fetchBigQueryRowsForExactDataByBpIds_(bpIds, resolvedMapping) {
  // Build SELECT list pakai alias internal name supaya order konsisten
  const selectClauses = EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.FIELD_MAPPING.map(function(map) {
    const colName = resolvedMapping[map.name].columnName;
    return `\`${colName}\` AS \`${map.name}\``;
  }).join(',\n  ');

  const bpIdColName = resolvedMapping['bp_id'].columnName;

  const sql =
    `SELECT\n  ${selectClauses}\n` +
    `FROM \`${EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.BQ_PROJECT_ID}.${EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.BQ_DATASET_ID}.${EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.BQ_TABLE_ID}\`\n` +
    `WHERE CAST(\`${bpIdColName}\` AS STRING) IN UNNEST(@bp_ids)`;

  const queryParameters = [{
    name: 'bp_ids',
    parameterType: {
      type: 'ARRAY',
      arrayType: { type: 'STRING' }
    },
    parameterValue: {
      arrayValues: bpIds.map(function(id) {
        return { value: String(id) };
      })
    }
  }];

  const rawRows = runParameterizedBigQueryForExactData_(
    EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.BQ_PROJECT_ID,
    sql,
    queryParameters
  );

  // Convert ke object per row { fieldName: rawValue }
  return rawRows.map(function(row) {
    const obj = {};
    EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.FIELD_MAPPING.forEach(function(map, idx) {
      obj[map.name] = extractBigQueryCellValueForExactData_(row.f[idx]);
    });
    return obj;
  });
}


/**
 * Extract value dari BigQuery cell.
 * - Skalar: return string
 * - ARRAY: return array of strings
 * - NULL: return null
 */
function extractBigQueryCellValueForExactData_(cell) {
  if (!cell) return null;
  const v = cell.v;
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return null;

  // ARRAY type: v = [{v: "x"}, {v: "y"}]
  if (Array.isArray(v)) {
    return v
      .map(function(item) {
        if (item && typeof item === 'object' && 'v' in item) return item.v;
        return item;
      })
      .filter(function(x) { return x !== null && x !== undefined; });
  }

  return v;
}


/**
 * Normalisasi seluruh field dari raw BQ row object.
 * Return: object { fieldName: normalizedString }
 */
function normalizeExactDataBigQueryRow_(rawObj) {
  const normalized = {};

  EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.FIELD_MAPPING.forEach(function(map) {
    const rawValue = rawObj[map.name];
    normalized[map.name] = normalizeExactDataBigQueryValueByType_(rawValue, map.type);
  });

  return normalized;
}


/**
 * Normalisasi satu value BQ ke canonical string.
 * Catatan: untuk SCHEDULE, jika input array, langsung join.
 */
function normalizeExactDataBigQueryValueByType_(rawValue, type) {
  if (rawValue === null || rawValue === undefined) return '';

  if (type === 'DATE') {
    // BQ DATE -> "2026-03-01", BQ TIMESTAMP -> "1771891200.000000"
    return normalizeExactDataDate_(rawValue, String(rawValue));
  }

  if (type === 'SCHEDULE') {
    if (Array.isArray(rawValue)) {
      // ARRAY<STRING> dari BQ
      return normalizeExactDataSchedule_(rawValue.join(','));
    }
    // STRING repr seperti "{W2F,W1F,W4F,W3F}"
    return normalizeExactDataSchedule_(rawValue);
  }

  if (type === 'SALES_OFFICE') {
    return normalizeExactDataSalesOffice_(rawValue);
  }

  if (type === 'CODE') {
    return normalizeExactDataCode_(rawValue);
  }

  return normalizeExactDataText_(rawValue);
}


/**
 * Build key dari object normalized.
 */
function buildExactDataKeyFromNormalizedObject_(normalizedObj, coreOnly) {
  const parts = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.FIELD_MAPPING.length; i++) {
    const map = EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.FIELD_MAPPING[i];
    if (coreOnly && !map.isCore) continue;

    const val = normalizedObj[map.name];
    if (!val) return '';

    parts.push(`${map.name}=${val}`);
  }

  return parts.join('||');
}


/************************************************************
 * PHASE 3: WRITE RESULT TO COLUMN R
 ************************************************************/
function writeExactDataWithCurrentResult_(plans, matchedExactKeySet) {
  let checkedRows = 0;
  let exactRows = 0;

  plans.forEach(function(plan) {
    let fileExactRows = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < plan.rowExactKeys.length; i++) {
      const exactKey = plan.rowExactKeys[i];

      if (!exactKey) continue;

      checkedRows++;

      if (matchedExactKeySet.has(exactKey)) {
        plan.outputValues[i][0] = EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.OUTPUT_TEXT;
        exactRows++;
        fileExactRows++;
      } else if (EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.CLEAR_R_IF_NOT_MATCH) {
        plan.outputValues[i][0] = '';
      }
    }

    plan.outputRange.setValues(plan.outputValues);

    Logger.log(`WRITE DONE - ${plan.url} | exact=${fileExactRows}`);
  });

  return { checkedRows: checkedRows, exactRows: exactRows };
}


/************************************************************
 * RESOLVE BIGQUERY COLUMNS (kandidat nama -> nama asli)
 ************************************************************/
function resolveExactDataBigQueryColumns_() {
  const sql =
    `SELECT column_name, data_type ` +
    `FROM \`${EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.BQ_PROJECT_ID}.${EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.BQ_DATASET_ID}.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS\` ` +
    `WHERE table_name = @table_name ORDER BY ordinal_position`;

  const queryParameters = [{
    name: 'table_name',
    parameterType: { type: 'STRING' },
    parameterValue: { value: EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.BQ_TABLE_ID }
  }];

  const rows = runParameterizedBigQueryForExactData_(
    EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.BQ_PROJECT_ID,
    sql,
    queryParameters
  );

  const availableColumns = rows.map(function(row) {
    return {
      columnName: row.f[0].v,
      dataType: row.f[1].v
    };
  });

  if (availableColumns.length === 0) {
    throw new Error(
      `Tidak ada kolom ditemukan untuk BigQuery table ${EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.BQ_TABLE_ID}.`
    );
  }

  const availableByNorm = {};
  availableColumns.forEach(function(col) {
    availableByNorm[normalizeExactDataHeader_(col.columnName)] = col;
  });

  const resolved = {};

  EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS.FIELD_MAPPING.forEach(function(map) {
    let found = null;

    for (let i = 0; i < map.bqCandidates.length; i++) {
      const candidateNorm = normalizeExactDataHeader_(map.bqCandidates[i]);
      if (availableByNorm[candidateNorm]) {
        found = availableByNorm[candidateNorm];
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!found) {
      throw new Error(
        `Kolom BigQuery untuk "${map.name}" tidak ditemukan. ` +
        `Candidate: ${map.bqCandidates.join(', ')}. ` +
        `Available: ${availableColumns.map(c => c.columnName).join(', ')}`
      );
    }

    resolved[map.name] = {
      columnName: found.columnName,
      dataType: found.dataType
    };
  });

  return resolved;
}


/************************************************************
 * BIGQUERY RUNNER (PARAMETERIZED)
 ************************************************************/
function runParameterizedBigQueryForExactData_(projectId, sql, queryParameters) {
  const request = {
    query: sql,
    useLegacySql: false,
    timeoutMs: 60000,
    maxResults: 10000,
    parameterMode: 'NAMED',
    queryParameters: queryParameters || []
  };

  let queryResults = BigQuery.Jobs.query(request, projectId);
  const jobReference = queryResults.jobReference;

  if (!jobReference || !jobReference.jobId) {
    throw new Error('BigQuery jobReference/jobId tidak ditemukan.');
  }

  const jobId = jobReference.jobId;
  const location = jobReference.location;
  let sleepMs = 500;

  while (!queryResults.jobComplete) {
    Utilities.sleep(sleepMs);
    sleepMs = Math.min(sleepMs * 2, 5000);

    const options = { maxResults: 10000 };
    if (location) options.location = location;

    queryResults = BigQuery.Jobs.getQueryResults(projectId, jobId, options);
  }

  let rows = queryResults.rows || [];
  let pageToken = queryResults.pageToken;

  while (pageToken) {
    const options = { pageToken: pageToken, maxResults: 10000 };
    if (location) options.location = location;

    const page = BigQuery.Jobs.getQueryResults(projectId, jobId, options);
    rows = rows.concat(page.rows || []);
    pageToken = page.pageToken;
  }

  return rows;
}


/************************************************************
 * NORMALIZATION FUNCTIONS (DIPAKAI UNTUK SHEET DAN BQ)
 ************************************************************/

function normalizeExactDataValueByType_(rawValue, displayValue, type) {
  if (type === 'DATE') {
    return normalizeExactDataDate_(rawValue, displayValue);
  }
  if (type === 'SCHEDULE') {
    return normalizeExactDataSchedule_(displayValue || rawValue);
  }
  if (type === 'SALES_OFFICE') {
    return normalizeExactDataSalesOffice_(displayValue || rawValue);
  }
  if (type === 'CODE') {
    return normalizeExactDataCode_(displayValue || rawValue);
  }
  return normalizeExactDataText_(displayValue || rawValue);
}


function normalizeExactDataText_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase()
    .replace(/\s+/g, '');
}


/**
 * "2AZ0 - STA ABC" -> "2AZ0"
 * "2AZ0"           -> "2AZ0"
 */
function normalizeExactDataSalesOffice_(value) {
  const text = String(value || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!text) return '';
  const match = text.match(/^[A-Z0-9]+/);
  return match ? match[0] : '';
}


/**
 * "03" -> "3"
 * 3    -> "3"
 * "F4" -> "F4"
 */
function normalizeExactDataCode_(value) {
  const text = normalizeExactDataText_(value);
  if (!text) return '';
  if (/^\d+$/.test(text)) return String(Number(text));
  return text;
}


/**
 * "{W2F,W1F,W4F,W3F}" -> "W1F,W2F,W3F,W4F"
 * "W1F,W3F,W2F,W4F"   -> "W1F,W2F,W3F,W4F"
 * ["W2F","W1F"]       -> "W1F,W2F" (sebelumnya di-join)
 */
function normalizeExactDataSchedule_(value) {
  const text = String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase()
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/[{}\[\]"']/g, '');

  if (!text) return '';

  return text
    .split(',')
    .map(function(x) { return x.trim(); })
    .filter(Boolean)
    .sort()
    .join(',');
}


/**
 * Normalisasi tanggal ke "YYYY-MM-DD".
 * Handle:
 * - Date object
 * - "2026-03-01", "2026/03/01"
 * - "3/1/2026" (M/D/YYYY, default ambigu)
 * - "31/12/9999" (D/M/YYYY kalau hari > 12)
 * - Epoch milliseconds (e.g. 1776308665530)
 * - Epoch seconds (e.g. 1776308665)
 * - Epoch seconds with decimals (BQ TIMESTAMP, e.g. "1776308665.000000")
 * - Google Sheets serial date (e.g. 45444)
 */
function normalizeExactDataDate_(rawValue, displayValue) {
  const timezone = Session.getScriptTimeZone() || 'Asia/Jakarta';

  if (rawValue instanceof Date && !isNaN(rawValue.getTime())) {
    return Utilities.formatDate(rawValue, timezone, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
  }

  const rawText = String(rawValue || '').trim();
  const displayText = String(displayValue || '').trim();
  const sourceText = displayText || rawText;

  if (!sourceText) return '';

  // YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY/MM/DD (possibly with time suffix)
  let match = sourceText.match(/^(\d{4})[-\/](\d{1,2})[-\/](\d{1,2})/);
  if (match) {
    return `${match[1]}-${String(match[2]).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(match[3]).padStart(2,'0')}`;
  }

  // M/D/YYYY or D/M/YYYY
  match = sourceText.match(/^(\d{1,2})[-\/](\d{1,2})[-\/](\d{4})/);
  if (match) {
    const p1 = Number(match[1]);
    const p2 = Number(match[2]);
    const yyyy = match[3];

    let mm, dd;
    if (p1 > 12 && p2 <= 12) {
      // 31/12/9999 -> D/M/YYYY
      dd = String(p1).padStart(2, '0');
      mm = String(p2).padStart(2, '0');
    } else if (p2 > 12 && p1 <= 12) {
      // 12/31/9999 -> M/D/YYYY
      mm = String(p1).padStart(2, '0');
      dd = String(p2).padStart(2, '0');
    } else {
      // Ambigu: ikut format BigQuery Connected Sheet -> M/D/YYYY
      mm = String(p1).padStart(2, '0');
      dd = String(p2).padStart(2, '0');
    }
    return `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;
  }

  // Numeric handling
  const numericValue = Number(sourceText);
  if (!isNaN(numericValue) && numericValue > 0) {
    let dateObj = null;

    // BQ TIMESTAMP format: epoch detik dengan desimal ("1771891200.000000")
    // Termasuk year 9999 (~ 253402214400 detik) yang melebihi threshold ms,
    // jadi cek titik desimal lebih dulu agar tidak salah di-anggap ms.
    if (sourceText.indexOf('.') !== -1) {
      dateObj = new Date(numericValue * 1000);
    } else if (numericValue > 100000000000) {
      // Epoch milliseconds
      dateObj = new Date(numericValue);
    } else if (numericValue > 1000000000) {
      // Epoch seconds (post-2001)
      dateObj = new Date(numericValue * 1000);
    } else if (numericValue > 20000 && numericValue < 80000) {
      // Google Sheets serial date
      dateObj = new Date(Math.round((numericValue - 25569) * 86400 * 1000));
    }

    if (dateObj && !isNaN(dateObj.getTime())) {
      return Utilities.formatDate(dateObj, timezone, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
    }
  }

  // Fallback: normalisasi text biasa supaya tetap bisa dibandingkan
  return normalizeExactDataText_(sourceText);
}


/************************************************************
 * URL / SHEET HELPERS
 ************************************************************/
function getExactDataGoogleSheetUrlsFromColumn_(sheet, startRow, column, numRows) {
  const range = sheet.getRange(startRow, column, numRows, 1);
  const richTextValues = range.getRichTextValues();
  const displayValues = range.getDisplayValues();
  const formulas = range.getFormulas();

  const urlSet = new Set();

  for (let i = 0; i < numRows; i++) {
    let url = '';
    const richText = richTextValues[i][0];

    if (richText) {
      url = richText.getLinkUrl() || '';
      if (!url) {
        const runs = richText.getRuns();
        for (let r = 0; r < runs.length; r++) {
          const runUrl = runs[r].getLinkUrl();
          if (runUrl) { url = runUrl; break; }
        }
      }
    }

    if (!url) url = extractExactDataUrlFromText_(formulas[i][0]);
    if (!url) url = extractExactDataUrlFromText_(displayValues[i][0]);

    if (url && isExactDataGoogleSheetUrl_(url)) {
      urlSet.add(url);
    }
  }

  return Array.from(urlSet);
}

function extractExactDataUrlFromText_(text) {
  const value = String(text || '').trim();
  if (!value) return '';
  const match = value.match(
    /https:\/\/docs\.google\.com\/spreadsheets\/d\/[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+[^\s"',)]*/
  );
  return match ? match[0] : '';
}

function isExactDataGoogleSheetUrl_(url) {
  return /^https:\/\/docs\.google\.com\/spreadsheets\/d\/[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+/.test(
    String(url || '').trim()
  );
}

function extractExactDataSpreadsheetId_(url) {
  const match = String(url || '').match(/\/spreadsheets\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);
  return match ? match[1] : '';
}


/************************************************************
 * MISC HELPERS
 ************************************************************/
function normalizeExactDataHeader_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '');
}

function assertBigQueryServiceForExactData_() {
  if (typeof BigQuery === 'undefined') {
    throw new Error(
      'Advanced BigQuery API belum aktif. Aktifkan: Apps Script > Services (+) > BigQuery API > Add.'
    );
  }
}

/**
 * Jalankan 1x untuk membuat trigger otomatis.
 */
function installAutoValidationTriggerForInputRollingLinks() {
  var ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActive();

  var handlersToDelete = [
    'validasiLinkRollingOnEdit',
    'validasiLinkRollingOnEdit2026',
    'RSC_VALIDATE_INPUT_ROLLING_LINK_ON_EDIT_20260611'
  ];

  ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(function(trigger) {
    if (handlersToDelete.indexOf(trigger.getHandlerFunction()) !== -1) {
      ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger);
    }
  });

  RSC_PERF13_NEW_TRIGGER_20260819_('RSC_VALIDATE_INPUT_ROLLING_LINK_ON_EDIT_20260611')
    .forSpreadsheet(ss)
    .onEdit()
    .create();

  ss.toast('Trigger validasi link rolling sudah aktif.', 'Setup selesai', 5);
}


/**
 * Trigger utama.
 * Otomatis jalan ketika user paste/edit link di kolom D.
 */
function validateInputRollingLinkOnEdit(e) {
  if (!e || !e.range) return;

  var cfg = INPUT_ROLLING_LINK_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS;
  var editedRange = e.range;
  var sourceSs = e.source || SpreadsheetApp.getActive();
  var sourceSheet = editedRange.getSheet();

  if (cfg.CONTROL_SHEET_NAME && sourceSheet.getName() !== cfg.CONTROL_SHEET_NAME) return;

  var editedStartCol = editedRange.getColumn();
  var editedEndCol = editedStartCol + editedRange.getNumColumns() - 1;

  if (cfg.LINK_COL < editedStartCol || cfg.LINK_COL > editedEndCol) return;

  var startRow = editedRange.getRow();
  var numRows = editedRange.getNumRows();

  for (var i = 0; i < numRows; i++) {
    var row = startRow + i;
    if (row < cfg.START_ROW) continue;

    var linkCell = sourceSheet.getRange(row, cfg.LINK_COL);
    validateInputRollingLinkForOneRow_(sourceSs, sourceSheet, linkCell, row);
  }
}


/**
 * Proses validasi per row.
 */
function validateInputRollingLinkForOneRow_(sourceSs, sourceSheet, linkCell, row) {
  var cfg = INPUT_ROLLING_LINK_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS;

  var checkSalesOfficeCell = sourceSheet.getRange(row, cfg.CHECK_CHANGE_SALES_OFFICE_COL);
  var checkSalesmanTypeCell = sourceSheet.getRange(row, cfg.CHECK_CHANGE_SALESMAN_TYPE_COL);

  sourceSheet
    .getRange(row, cfg.CHECK_CHANGE_SALES_OFFICE_COL, 1, 2)
    .insertCheckboxes();

  var url = getUrlFromRollingInputLinkCell_(linkCell);

  if (!url) {
    checkSalesOfficeCell.setValue(false);
    checkSalesmanTypeCell.setValue(false);
    linkCell.clearNote();
    linkCell.setBackground(null);
    return;
  }

  var spreadsheetId = extractSpreadsheetIdFromRollingInputLink_(url);

  if (!spreadsheetId) {
    rejectRollingInputLink_(
      sourceSs,
      sourceSheet,
      linkCell,
      row,
      'Link yang dipaste di kolom D bukan link Google Spreadsheet yang valid.'
    );
    return;
  }

  var targetSs;

  try {
    targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(spreadsheetId);
  } catch (err) {
    rejectRollingInputLink_(
      sourceSs,
      sourceSheet,
      linkCell,
      row,
      'File tidak bisa dibuka. Pastikan link adalah Google Sheets dan owner script punya akses ke file tersebut.\n\nDetail: ' + err.message
    );
    return;
  }

  var errorList = findValidationStatusErrorsInRollingLinkFile_(targetSs);

  if (errorList.length > 0) {
    var maxShown = 15;
    var shownErrors = errorList.slice(0, maxShown).join('\n');
    var extra = errorList.length > maxShown ? '\n... dan ' + (errorList.length - maxShown) + ' error lainnya.' : '';

    rejectRollingInputLink_(
      sourceSs,
      sourceSheet,
      linkCell,
      row,
      'Link ditolak karena masih ada Validation Status = ERROR di file:\n' +
      targetSs.getName() +
      '\n\n' +
      shownErrors +
      extra
    );
    return;
  }

  var hasChangeSalesOffice = sheetHasRealDataForRollingLinkValidation_(targetSs, cfg.SHEET_CHANGE_SALES_OFFICE);
  var hasChangeSalesmanType = sheetHasRealDataForRollingLinkValidation_(targetSs, cfg.SHEET_CHANGE_SALESMAN_TYPE);

  checkSalesOfficeCell.setValue(hasChangeSalesOffice);
  checkSalesmanTypeCell.setValue(hasChangeSalesmanType);

  linkCell.setBackground(null);
  linkCell.setNote(
    'VALIDASI OK\n' +
    'File: ' + targetSs.getName() + '\n' +
    'Change Sales Office: ' + (hasChangeSalesOffice ? 'ADA ISI' : 'KOSONG') + '\n' +
    'Change Salesman Type: ' + (hasChangeSalesmanType ? 'ADA ISI' : 'KOSONG') + '\n' +
    'Last check: ' + Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')
  );

  sourceSs.toast(
    'Row ' + row + ' valid. Checklist kolom O/P sudah diperbarui.',
    'Validasi Link OK',
    5
  );
}


/**
 * Cek semua sheet target:
 * Jika ada header Validation Status dan ada row isi beneran dengan status ERROR,
 * maka link akan direject.
 */
function findValidationStatusErrorsInRollingLinkFile_(targetSs) {
  var cfg = INPUT_ROLLING_LINK_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS;
  var errors = [];

  cfg.TARGET_SHEETS_TO_VALIDATE.forEach(function(sheetName) {
    var sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(sheetName);
    if (!sh) return;

    var data = getSheetDisplayDataForRollingLinkValidation_(sh);
    if (!data) return;

    var values = data.values;
    var headerInfo = findHeaderCellForRollingLinkValidation_(values, cfg.VALIDATION_STATUS_HEADER);

    if (!headerInfo) return;

    var headerRowIdx = headerInfo.rowIdx;
    var validationColIdx = headerInfo.colIdx;
    var headerRow = values[headerRowIdx];

    for (var r = headerRowIdx + 1; r < values.length; r++) {
      var status = String(values[r][validationColIdx] || '').trim().toUpperCase();

      if (status.indexOf('ERROR') === -1) continue;

      if (!rowHasRealDataForRollingLinkValidation_(values[r], headerRow)) continue;

      var a1 = sh.getRange(r + 1, validationColIdx + 1).getA1Notation();
      errors.push(sheetName + ' - ' + a1 + ': ' + values[r][validationColIdx]);
    }
  });

  return errors;
}


/**
 * Cek apakah sheet ada isi beneran di bawah header.
 * Header tidak dihitung sebagai isi.
 */
function sheetHasRealDataForRollingLinkValidation_(targetSs, sheetName) {
  var sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(sheetName);
  if (!sh) return false;

  var data = getSheetDisplayDataForRollingLinkValidation_(sh);
  if (!data) return false;

  var values = data.values;
  var headerRowIdx = findHeaderRowForRollingLinkValidation_(values);

  if (headerRowIdx === -1) return false;
  if (headerRowIdx >= values.length - 1) return false;

  var headerRow = values[headerRowIdx];

  for (var r = headerRowIdx + 1; r < values.length; r++) {
    if (rowHasRealDataForRollingLinkValidation_(values[r], headerRow)) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}


function getSheetDisplayDataForRollingLinkValidation_(sh) {
  var lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  var lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();

  if (lastRow < 1 || lastCol < 1) return null;

  return {
    values: sh.getRange(1, 1, lastRow, lastCol).getDisplayValues()
  };
}


function findHeaderCellForRollingLinkValidation_(values, headerName) {
  var target = String(headerName).trim().toLowerCase();

  for (var r = 0; r < values.length; r++) {
    for (var c = 0; c < values[r].length; c++) {
      var cell = String(values[r][c] || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (cell === target) {
        return {
          rowIdx: r,
          colIdx: c
        };
      }
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function findHeaderRowForRollingLinkValidation_(values) {
  var cfg = INPUT_ROLLING_LINK_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS;
  var validationHeader = cfg.VALIDATION_STATUS_HEADER.toLowerCase();

  for (var r = 0; r < values.length; r++) {
    var hasValidationHeader = values[r].some(function(v) {
      return String(v || '').trim().toLowerCase() === validationHeader;
    });

    if (hasValidationHeader) return r;
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var hasAnyValue = values[i].some(function(v) {
      return String(v || '').trim() !== '';
    });

    if (hasAnyValue) return i;
  }

  return -1;
}


/**
 * Row dianggap punya isi beneran jika ada value pada kolom selain:
 * - Validation Status
 * - Error Detail
 * - Error
 * - Validation Message
 *
 * Jadi formula OK/ERROR pada baris kosong tidak akan dianggap sebagai isi.
 */
function rowHasRealDataForRollingLinkValidation_(rowValues, headerRow) {
  for (var c = 0; c < rowValues.length; c++) {
    var header = String(headerRow[c] || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    var value = String(rowValues[c] || '').trim();

    if (!value) continue;

    if (
      header === 'validation status' ||
      header === 'error detail' ||
      header === 'error' ||
      header === 'validation message'
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    if (value.toUpperCase() === 'FALSE') continue;

    return true;
  }

  return false;
}


/**
 * Ambil URL dari cell.
 * Support hyperlink dengan display text seperti:
 * "Template Rolling Sales STA Pasar Anyar Hub"
 */
function getUrlFromRollingInputLinkCell_(cell) {
  var richText = cell.getRichTextValue();

  if (richText) {
    var fullLink = richText.getLinkUrl();
    if (fullLink) return fullLink;

    var runs = richText.getRuns();
    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var runLink = runs[i].getLinkUrl();
      if (runLink) return runLink;
    }
  }

  var text = String(cell.getDisplayValue() || '').trim();
  var match = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/i);

  return match ? match[0] : '';
}


function extractSpreadsheetIdFromRollingInputLink_(url) {
  var text = String(url || '').trim();

  var match = text.match(/\/spreadsheets\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);
  if (match) return match[1];

  match = text.match(/[?&]id=([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);
  if (match) return match[1];

  match = text.match(/[-\w]{25,}/);
  if (match) return match[0];

  return '';
}


/**
 * Reject link:
 * - Link di kolom D dihapus
 * - Checklist O/P direset
 * - Note error ditaruh di cell D
 * - Muncul toast/popup error
 */
function rejectRollingInputLink_(sourceSs, sourceSheet, linkCell, row, message) {
  var cfg = INPUT_ROLLING_LINK_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS;

  linkCell.clearContent();
  linkCell.setBackground('#f4cccc');
  linkCell.setNote(message);

  sourceSheet
    .getRange(row, cfg.CHECK_CHANGE_SALES_OFFICE_COL, 1, 2)
    .insertCheckboxes()
    .setValues([[false, false]]);

  sourceSs.toast(message, 'Link ditolak', 10);

  try {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Link ditolak', message, SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK);
  } catch (err) {
    // Untuk trigger tertentu popup bisa tidak muncul, tapi toast tetap muncul.
  }
}

  try {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi()
      .createMenu('CR Summary')
      .addItem('Generate / Refresh Now', 'RSC_GENERATE_CR_VISIT_SCHEDULE_SUMMARY_20260611')
      .addSeparator()
      .addItem('Install Auto Refresh Hourly', 'RSC_INSTALL_CR_SUMMARY_HOURLY_REFRESH_20260611')
      .addItem('Remove Auto Refresh', 'RSC_REMOVE_CR_SUMMARY_HOURLY_REFRESH_20260611')
      .addToUi();

    registerCrVisitSummarySpreadsheetId_();

    // Auto generate saat file dibuka.
    // Ini ikut terbawa saat file di-Make a copy.
    generateCRVisitScheduleSummary();

  } catch (err) {

  }

function handleCrVisitScheduleSummaryEdit_(e) {
  try {
    if (!e || !e.range) return;

    var editedSheet = e.range.getSheet();
    if (editedSheet.getName() !== CR_VISIT_SCHEDULE_SUMMARY_PARAMETERS.sourceSheetName) return;

    var colStart = e.range.getColumn();
    var colEnd = colStart + e.range.getNumColumns() - 1;

    // Kolom yang dipantau:
    // A Sales Office
    // C Customer ID
    // E Salesman ID
    // F Salesman BP Type
    // K Schedule Visit
    // O Validation Status
    var watchedCols = [1, 3, 5, 6, 11, 15];

    var shouldRefresh = watchedCols.some(function (c) {
      return c >= colStart && c <= colEnd;
    });

    if (!shouldRefresh) return;

    generateCRVisitScheduleSummary();

  } catch (err) {
    Logger.log('onEdit error: ' + err);
  }
}


/***************************************************************
 * MAIN FUNCTIONS
 ***************************************************************/

function generateCRVisitScheduleSummary() {
  var ss = getCrVisitSummarySpreadsheet_();
  var sourceSheet = ss.getSheetByName(CR_VISIT_SCHEDULE_SUMMARY_PARAMETERS.sourceSheetName);

  if (!sourceSheet) {
    throw new Error('Sheet source tidak ditemukan: ' + CR_VISIT_SCHEDULE_SUMMARY_PARAMETERS.sourceSheetName);
  }

  var summaryData = buildCrVisitScheduleSummaryData_(sourceSheet);
  var outputSheetName = getCrVisitSummaryOutputSheetName_(ss);
  var outputSheet = getOrCreateCrVisitSummarySheet_(ss, outputSheetName);

  renderCrVisitScheduleSummarySheet_(outputSheet, summaryData, outputSheetName);

  try {
    ss.toast('Summary berhasil digenerate: ' + outputSheetName, 'CR Summary', 5);
  } catch (err) {
    Logger.log(err);
  }
}


function refreshCrVisitScheduleSummarySafely() {
  try {
    generateCRVisitScheduleSummary();
  } catch (err) {
    Logger.log('refreshCrVisitScheduleSummarySafely error: ' + err);
  }
}

  registerCrVisitSummarySpreadsheetId_();
  removeCrVisitSummaryTriggerByFunction_('RSC_REFRESH_CR_VISIT_SCHEDULE_SUMMARY_SAFE_20260611');

  RSC_PERF13_NEW_TRIGGER_20260819_('RSC_REFRESH_CR_VISIT_SCHEDULE_SUMMARY_SAFE_20260611')
    .timeBased()

    ' jam.\n\n' +
    'Catatan penting:\n' +
    '- onOpen dan onEdit ikut tercopy saat file di-Make a copy.\n' +
    '- Hourly trigger Google tidak ikut tercopy otomatis.\n' +
    '- Di file copy, klik CR Summary → Install Auto Refresh Hourly sekali.'
  );
}
