}


/***************************************************************
 * DATA BUILDING
 ***************************************************************/

function buildCrVisitScheduleSummaryData_(sourceSheet) {
  var lastRow = sourceSheet.getLastRow();
  var lastCol = sourceSheet.getLastColumn();

  if (lastRow < 2 || lastCol < 1) {
    return buildEmptyCrVisitScheduleSummary_();
  }

  var allValues = sourceSheet.getRange(1, 1, lastRow, lastCol).getDisplayValues();
  var headerInfo = findCrVisitSummaryHeaderInfo_(allValues);

  var headerRowIdx = headerInfo.headerRowIdx;
  var cols = headerInfo.cols;

  var salesmanGroups = {};
  var overallCustomers = {};
  var overallSalesmen = {};
  var overallSalesOffices = {};
  var allTokensFound = {};

  for (var r = headerRowIdx + 1; r < allValues.length; r++) {
    var row = allValues[r];

    var rawCustomerId = getCrVisitSummaryCell_(row, cols.customerId);
    var rawSalesmanId = getCrVisitSummaryCell_(row, cols.salesmanId);
    var rawSalesOffice = getCrVisitSummaryCell_(row, cols.salesOffice);
    var rawSalesmanType = getCrVisitSummaryCell_(row, cols.salesmanType);
    var rawScheduleVisit = getCrVisitSummaryCell_(row, cols.scheduleVisit);
    var rawValidationStatus = getCrVisitSummaryCell_(row, cols.validationStatus);
    var rawSalesmanName = getCrVisitSummaryCell_(row, cols.salesmanName);

    if (!CR_VISIT_SCHEDULE_SUMMARY_PARAMETERS.includeErrorRows) {
      if (String(rawValidationStatus).trim().toUpperCase() === 'ERROR') continue;
    }

    var customerId = cleanCrVisitSummaryCustomerId_(rawCustomerId);
    var salesmanId = cleanCrVisitSummarySalesmanId_(rawSalesmanId);
    var salesOffice = String(rawSalesOffice || '').trim();
    var salesmanType = String(rawSalesmanType || '').trim();
    var salesmanName = String(rawSalesmanName || '').trim();

    if (!customerId) continue;
    if (!salesmanId) continue;
    if (!salesOffice) continue;

    var scheduleTokens = parseCrVisitSummaryScheduleTokens_(rawScheduleVisit);
    if (scheduleTokens.length === 0) continue;

    if (!salesmanType) salesmanType = '-';
    if (!salesmanName) salesmanName = '-';

    var groupKey = [
      salesmanId,
      salesmanName,
      salesmanType,
      salesOffice
    ].join('||');

    if (!salesmanGroups[groupKey]) {
      salesmanGroups[groupKey] = {
        salesmanId: salesmanId,
        salesmanName: salesmanName,
        salesmanType: salesmanType,
        salesOffice: salesOffice,
        allCustomers: {},
        tokenCustomers: {}
      };
    }

    salesmanGroups[groupKey].allCustomers[customerId] = true;
    overallCustomers[customerId] = true;
    overallSalesmen[salesmanId] = true;
    overallSalesOffices[salesOffice] = true;

    scheduleTokens.forEach(function (token) {
      allTokensFound[token] = true;

      if (!salesmanGroups[groupKey].tokenCustomers[token]) {
        salesmanGroups[groupKey].tokenCustomers[token] = {};
      }

      salesmanGroups[groupKey].tokenCustomers[token][customerId] = true;
    });
  }

  var tokenOrder = getFinalCrVisitSummaryTokenOrder_(allTokensFound);

  var groupList = Object.keys(salesmanGroups).map(function (key) {
    return salesmanGroups[key];
  });

  groupList.sort(function (a, b) {
    var aKey = [a.salesOffice, a.salesmanType, a.salesmanId].join('|');
    var bKey = [b.salesOffice, b.salesmanType, b.salesmanId].join('|');
    return aKey.localeCompare(bKey);
  });

  var headers = [
    'Salesman ID',
    'Salesman Name',
    'Salesman Type',
    'Sales Office'
  ].concat(tokenOrder).concat(['Total Unique Customer']);

  var summaryRows = [];
  var tokenTotals = {};

  tokenOrder.forEach(function (token) {
    tokenTotals[token] = 0;
  });

  var grandTotalUniqueBySalesman = 0;

  groupList.forEach(function (g) {
    var row = [
      g.salesmanId,
      g.salesmanName,
      g.salesmanType,
      g.salesOffice
    ];

    tokenOrder.forEach(function (token) {
      var countToken = getCrVisitSummaryObjectSize_(g.tokenCustomers[token]);
      row.push(countToken);
      tokenTotals[token] += countToken;
    });

    var totalUniqueCustomer = getCrVisitSummaryObjectSize_(g.allCustomers);
    row.push(totalUniqueCustomer);

    grandTotalUniqueBySalesman += totalUniqueCustomer;
    summaryRows.push(row);
  });

  var summaryFooter = ['TOTAL', '', '', ''];

  tokenOrder.forEach(function (token) {
    summaryFooter.push(tokenTotals[token]);
  });

  summaryFooter.push(grandTotalUniqueBySalesman);

  var percentageRows = [];

  groupList.forEach(function (g, idx) {
    var sourceRow = summaryRows[idx];

    var pctRow = [
      g.salesmanId,
      g.salesmanName,
      g.salesmanType,
      g.salesOffice
    ];

    tokenOrder.forEach(function (token, tokenIdx) {
      var val = Number(sourceRow[4 + tokenIdx]) || 0;
      var total = Number(tokenTotals[token]) || 0;
      pctRow.push(total > 0 ? val / total : 0);
    });

    var rowTotalUnique = Number(sourceRow[sourceRow.length - 1]) || 0;
    pctRow.push(grandTotalUniqueBySalesman > 0 ? rowTotalUnique / grandTotalUniqueBySalesman : 0);

    percentageRows.push(pctRow);
  });

  var percentageFooter = ['TOTAL', '', '', ''];

  tokenOrder.forEach(function (token) {
    percentageFooter.push(tokenTotals[token] > 0 ? 1 : 0);
  });

  percentageFooter.push(grandTotalUniqueBySalesman > 0 ? 1 : 0);

  return {
    headers: headers,
    tokenOrder: tokenOrder,
    summaryRows: summaryRows,
    summaryFooter: summaryFooter,
    percentageRows: percentageRows,
    percentageFooter: percentageFooter,
    metrics: {
      totalCustomerSimulated: getCrVisitSummaryObjectSize_(overallCustomers),
      totalSalesmanInCr: getCrVisitSummaryObjectSize_(overallSalesmen),
      salesOfficeCovered: getCrVisitSummaryObjectSize_(overallSalesOffices),
      scheduleTokenUsed: getCrVisitSummaryObjectSize_(allTokensFound)
    }
  };
}


function buildEmptyCrVisitScheduleSummary_() {
  var tokenOrder = CR_VISIT_SCHEDULE_SUMMARY_PARAMETERS.baseScheduleTokens.slice();

  var headers = [
    'Salesman ID',
    'Salesman Name',
    'Salesman Type',
    'Sales Office'
  ].concat(tokenOrder).concat(['Total Unique Customer']);

  var footer = ['TOTAL', '', '', ''];

  tokenOrder.forEach(function () {
    footer.push(0);
  });

  footer.push(0);

  return {
    headers: headers,
    tokenOrder: tokenOrder,
    summaryRows: [],
    summaryFooter: footer,
    percentageRows: [],
    percentageFooter: footer,
    metrics: {
      totalCustomerSimulated: 0,
      totalSalesmanInCr: 0,
      salesOfficeCovered: 0,
      scheduleTokenUsed: 0
    }
  };
}


/***************************************************************
 * RENDERING
 ***************************************************************/

function renderCrVisitScheduleSummarySheet_(sheet, data, title) {
  var minCols = Math.max(data.headers.length, 18);
  ensureCrVisitSummarySheetSize_(sheet, 100, minCols);

  sheet.getRange(1, 1, sheet.getMaxRows(), sheet.getMaxColumns()).breakApart();
  sheet.clear();
  sheet.clearConditionalFormatRules();
  sheet.setHiddenGridlines(true);

  var lastCol = minCols;

  sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol)
    .merge()
    .setValue(title)
    .setFontWeight('bold')
    .setFontSize(16)
    .setFontColor('#0F172A')
    .setBackground('#FFFFFF')
    .setVerticalAlignment('middle');

  sheet.setRowHeight(1, 42);

  styleCrVisitScheduleSummaryCard_(sheet, 3, 1, '👥', 'Total Customer Simulated', data.metrics.totalCustomerSimulated, '#DDF7EA', '#059669');
  styleCrVisitScheduleSummaryCard_(sheet, 3, 6, '🧑‍💼', 'Total Salesman in CR', data.metrics.totalSalesmanInCr, '#EDE9FE', '#6D28D9');
  styleCrVisitScheduleSummaryCard_(sheet, 3, 11, '🏢', 'Sales Office Covered', data.metrics.salesOfficeCovered, '#DBEAFE', '#2563EB');
  styleCrVisitScheduleSummaryCard_(sheet, 3, 16, '📅', 'Schedule Token Used', data.metrics.scheduleTokenUsed, '#FFEDD5', '#EA580C');

  var row = 7;

  row = writeCrVisitScheduleSummaryTableBlock_(
    sheet,
    row,
    '1. Visit Schedule Summary',
    'Total simulated customer coverage by salesman. Existing master schedule is retained when there is no CR change.',
    data.headers,
    data.summaryRows,
    data.summaryFooter,
    {
      isPercentage: false,
      tokenCount: data.tokenOrder.length
    }
  );

  row += 2;

  writeCrVisitScheduleSummaryTableBlock_(
    sheet,
    row,
    '2. Percentage Visit Schedule',
    'Percentage contribution of each salesman against total simulated coverage per schedule token.',
    data.headers,
    data.percentageRows,
    data.percentageFooter,
    {
      isPercentage: true,
      tokenCount: data.tokenOrder.length
    }
  );

  applyCrVisitSummaryColumnWidths_(sheet, data.headers.length);
  sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
}


function styleCrVisitScheduleSummaryCard_(sheet, row, col, icon, label, value, iconBg, iconColor) {
  var cardRange = sheet.getRange(row, col, 3, 4);

  cardRange
    .setBackground('#FFFFFF')
    .setBorder(true, true, true, true, true, true, '#E5E7EB', SpreadsheetApp.BorderStyle.SOLID);

  sheet.getRange(row, col, 3, 1)
    .merge()
    .setValue(icon)
    .setFontSize(24)
    .setFontColor(iconColor)
    .setBackground(iconBg)
    .setHorizontalAlignment('center')
    .setVerticalAlignment('middle');

  sheet.getRange(row, col + 1, 1, 3)
    .merge()
    .setValue(label)
    .setFontSize(10)
    .setFontColor('#111827')
    .setVerticalAlignment('bottom');

  sheet.getRange(row + 1, col + 1, 2, 3)
    .merge()
    .setValue(value)
    .setFontSize(20)
    .setFontWeight('bold')
    .setFontColor('#0F172A')
    .setVerticalAlignment('top');

  sheet.setRowHeights(row, 3, 28);
}


function writeCrVisitScheduleSummaryTableBlock_(sheet, startRow, sectionTitle, subtitle, headers, bodyRows, footerRow, options) {
  var lastCol = headers.length;
  var tokenCount = options.tokenCount;
  var isPercentage = options.isPercentage;

  sheet.getRange(startRow, 1, 1, lastCol)
    .merge()
    .setValue(sectionTitle)
    .setFontWeight('bold')
    .setFontSize(12)
    .setFontColor('#0F172A')
    .setBackground('#FFFFFF');

  sheet.getRange(startRow + 1, 1, 1, lastCol)
    .merge()
    .setValue(subtitle)
    .setFontSize(10)
    .setFontColor('#374151')
    .setBackground('#FFFFFF');

  var tableHeaderRow = startRow + 3;
  var tableBodyStartRow = tableHeaderRow + 1;
  var footerSheetRow = tableBodyStartRow + bodyRows.length;

  sheet.getRange(tableHeaderRow, 1, 1, lastCol)
    .setValues([headers])
    .setFontWeight('bold')
    .setFontSize(8)
    .setFontColor('#111827')
    .setBackground('#F3F4F6')
    .setHorizontalAlignment('center')
    .setVerticalAlignment('middle')
    .setWrap(true)
    .setBorder(true, true, true, true, true, true, '#D1D5DB', SpreadsheetApp.BorderStyle.SOLID);

  if (bodyRows.length > 0) {
    sheet.getRange(tableBodyStartRow, 1, bodyRows.length, lastCol)
      .setValues(bodyRows)
      .setFontSize(8)
      .setFontColor('#111827')
      .setBackground('#FFFFFF')
      .setBorder(true, true, true, true, true, true, '#E5E7EB', SpreadsheetApp.BorderStyle.SOLID)
      .setVerticalAlignment('middle');

    sheet.getRange(tableBodyStartRow, 1, bodyRows.length, 1).setFontWeight('bold');
    sheet.getRange(tableBodyStartRow, 5, bodyRows.length, tokenCount + 1).setHorizontalAlignment('center');

    if (isPercentage) {
      sheet.getRange(tableBodyStartRow, 5, bodyRows.length, tokenCount + 1).setNumberFormat('0.00%');
    } else {
      sheet.getRange(tableBodyStartRow, 5, bodyRows.length, tokenCount + 1).setNumberFormat('0');
    }

    applyCrVisitSummarySalesmanTypeStyle_(sheet, tableBodyStartRow, bodyRows.length, 3);
  }

  sheet.getRange(footerSheetRow, 1, 1, lastCol)
    .setValues([footerRow])
    .setFontWeight('bold')
    .setFontSize(8)
    .setFontColor('#0052CC')
    .setBackground('#EFF6FF')
    .setBorder(true, true, true, true, true, true, '#D1D5DB', SpreadsheetApp.BorderStyle.SOLID)
    .setVerticalAlignment('middle');

  sheet.getRange(footerSheetRow, 1, 1, 4)
    .merge()
    .setValue('TOTAL')
    .setHorizontalAlignment('left');

  sheet.getRange(footerSheetRow, 5, 1, tokenCount + 1)
    .setHorizontalAlignment('center');

  if (isPercentage) {
    sheet.getRange(footerSheetRow, 5, 1, tokenCount + 1).setNumberFormat('0.00%');
  } else {
    sheet.getRange(footerSheetRow, 5, 1, tokenCount + 1).setNumberFormat('0');
  }

  sheet.setRowHeight(tableHeaderRow, 38);

  if (bodyRows.length > 0) {
    sheet.setRowHeights(tableBodyStartRow, bodyRows.length, 34);
  }

  sheet.setRowHeight(footerSheetRow, 34);

  return footerSheetRow + 1;
}


function applyCrVisitSummarySalesmanTypeStyle_(sheet, startRow, numRows, typeCol) {
  for (var i = 0; i < numRows; i++) {
    var cell = sheet.getRange(startRow + i, typeCol);
    var val = String(cell.getDisplayValue() || '').toLowerCase();

    if (val.indexOf('non') >= 0 && val.indexOf('food') >= 0) {
      cell.setBackground('#EDE9FE').setFontColor('#5B21B6').setFontWeight('bold');
    } else if (val.indexOf('cosmetic') >= 0 || val.indexOf('cosmetics') >= 0) {
      cell.setBackground('#DBEAFE').setFontColor('#1D4ED8').setFontWeight('bold');
    } else if (val.indexOf('food') >= 0) {
      cell.setBackground('#D1FAE5').setFontColor('#047857').setFontWeight('bold');
    } else if (val === 'zd01') {
      cell.setBackground('#D1FAE5').setFontColor('#047857').setFontWeight('bold');
    } else if (val === 'zd02') {
      cell.setBackground('#EDE9FE').setFontColor('#5B21B6').setFontWeight('bold');
    } else if (val === 'zd03') {
      cell.setBackground('#DBEAFE').setFontColor('#1D4ED8').setFontWeight('bold');
    } else {
      cell.setBackground('#F3F4F6').setFontColor('#374151').setFontWeight('bold');
    }
  }
}


function applyCrVisitSummaryColumnWidths_(sheet, headerLength) {
  sheet.setColumnWidth(1, 115);
  sheet.setColumnWidth(2, 150);
  sheet.setColumnWidth(3, 135);
  sheet.setColumnWidth(4, 90);

  for (var c = 5; c <= headerLength; c++) {
    sheet.setColumnWidth(c, 64);
  }

  sheet.setColumnWidth(headerLength, 120);
}


/***************************************************************
 * HEADER DETECTION + PARSING
 ***************************************************************/

function findCrVisitSummaryHeaderInfo_(values) {
  var maxScanRows = Math.min(values.length, 10);

  for (var r = 0; r < maxScanRows; r++) {
    var headerRow = values[r].map(function (h) {
      return normalizeCrVisitSummaryHeader_(h);
    });

    var cols = {
      salesOffice: findCrVisitSummaryHeaderColumn_(headerRow, ['sales office']),
      customerId: findCrVisitSummaryHeaderColumn_(headerRow, ['customer id']),
      salesmanId: findCrVisitSummaryHeaderColumn_(headerRow, ['salesman id']),
      salesmanType: findCrVisitSummaryHeaderColumn_(headerRow, ['salesman bp type', 'salesman type']),
      scheduleVisit: findCrVisitSummaryHeaderColumn_(headerRow, ['schedule visit']),
      validationStatus: findCrVisitSummaryHeaderColumn_(headerRow, ['validation status']),
      salesmanName: findCrVisitSummaryHeaderColumn_(headerRow, ['salesman name', 'salesman'])
    };

    if (
      cols.salesOffice >= 0 &&
      cols.customerId >= 0 &&
      cols.salesmanId >= 0 &&
      cols.scheduleVisit >= 0
    ) {
      return {
        headerRowIdx: r,
        cols: cols
      };
    }
  }

  throw new Error(
    'Header tidak ditemukan. Pastikan ada header: Sales Office, Customer ID, Salesman ID, Schedule Visit.'
  );
}


function findCrVisitSummaryHeaderColumn_(normalizedHeaderRow, aliases) {
  for (var i = 0; i < normalizedHeaderRow.length; i++) {
    for (var j = 0; j < aliases.length; j++) {
      if (normalizedHeaderRow[i] === aliases[j]) {
        return i;
      }
    }
  }

  return -1;
}


function normalizeCrVisitSummaryHeader_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();
}


function getCrVisitSummaryCell_(row, idx) {
  if (idx === undefined || idx === null || idx < 0) return '';
  return row[idx] || '';
}


function cleanCrVisitSummaryCustomerId_(value) {
  var raw = String(value || '').trim();

  if (!raw) return '';
  if (/^contoh$/i.test(raw)) return '';
  if (/isi\s+no/i.test(raw)) return '';

  // Customer ID customer biasanya numeric.
  // Row contoh seperti "S09100123 (Isi No BP Salesman/SPV)" tidak dihitung sebagai customer.
  if (!/^\d/.test(raw)) return '';

  var match = raw.match(/\d{4,}/);
  if (!match) return '';

  return match[0];
}


function cleanCrVisitSummarySalesmanId_(value) {
  var raw = String(value || '').trim();

  if (!raw) return '';

  var match = raw.match(/[A-Z]*\d{4,}/i);
  if (!match) return '';

  return match[0].toUpperCase();
}


function parseCrVisitSummaryScheduleTokens_(value) {
  var raw = String(value || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return [];

  // Remove spaces, normalize separator.
  raw = raw
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/;/g, ',')
    .replace(/\|/g, ',')
    .replace(/\//g, ',');

  var parts = raw.split(',');
  var unique = {};

  parts.forEach(function (part) {
    var token = canonicalizeCrVisitSummaryScheduleToken_(part);
    if (token) {
      unique[token] = true;
    }
  });

  // Fallback kalau value tidak pakai koma, misalnya W1MW1TW2F.
  if (Object.keys(unique).length === 0) {
    var upper = raw.toUpperCase();

    var regex = /W[1-4](THU|TH|MON|TUE|WED|FRI|SAT|M|T|W|F|S)/g;
    var matches = upper.match(regex);

    if (matches) {
      matches.forEach(function (m) {
        var token = canonicalizeCrVisitSummaryScheduleToken_(m);
        if (token) {
          unique[token] = true;
        }
      });
    }
  }

  var result = Object.keys(unique);

  result.sort(function (a, b) {
    return rankCrVisitSummaryScheduleToken_(a) - rankCrVisitSummaryScheduleToken_(b);
  });

  return result;
}


function canonicalizeCrVisitSummaryScheduleToken_(token) {
  var raw = String(token || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return '';

  raw = raw.toUpperCase();

  var m = raw.match(/^W([1-4])(THU|TH|MON|TUE|WED|FRI|SAT|M|T|W|F|S)$/);

  if (!m) return '';

  var week = m[1];
  var day = m[2];

  var dayMap = {
    M: 'M',
    MON: 'M',

    T: 'T',
    TUE: 'T',

    W: 'W',
    WED: 'W',

    TH: 'Th',
    THU: 'Th',

    F: 'F',
    FRI: 'F',

    S: 'S',
    SAT: 'S'
  };

  if (!dayMap[day]) return '';

  return 'W' + week + dayMap[day];
}


function getFinalCrVisitSummaryTokenOrder_(tokenObj) {
  var base = CR_VISIT_SCHEDULE_SUMMARY_PARAMETERS.baseScheduleTokens.slice();
  var baseMap = {};

  base.forEach(function (t) {
    baseMap[t] = true;
  });

  var extras = Object.keys(tokenObj).filter(function (t) {
    return !baseMap[t];
  });

  extras.sort(function (a, b) {
    return rankCrVisitSummaryScheduleToken_(a) - rankCrVisitSummaryScheduleToken_(b);
  });

  // Selalu tampilkan base token walaupun nilainya 0,
  // supaya format summary selalu konsisten.
  return base.concat(extras);
}


function rankCrVisitSummaryScheduleToken_(token) {
  var canonical = canonicalizeCrVisitSummaryScheduleToken_(token);
  if (!canonical) return 99999;

  var m = canonical.match(/^W([1-4])(.+)$/);
  if (!m) return 99999;

  var week = Number(m[1]);
  var day = m[2];

  var dayRankMap = {
    M: 1,
    T: 2,
    W: 3,
    Th: 4,
    F: 5,
    S: 6
  };

  var dayRank = dayRankMap[day] || 99;

  // Week-first:
  // W1M, W1T, W1W, W1Th, W1F, W1S,
  // W2M, W2T, ...
  return week * 100 + dayRank;
}


function getCrVisitSummaryObjectSize_(obj) {
  if (!obj) return 0;
  return Object.keys(obj).length;
}


/***************************************************************
 * SHEET + TRIGGER HELPERS
 ***************************************************************/

function getCrVisitSummarySpreadsheet_() {
  var ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  if (ss) return ss;

  var storedId = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().getProperty('CrVisitSummary_SPREADSHEET_ID');
  if (storedId) return RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(storedId);

  throw new Error('Spreadsheet tidak ditemukan. Jalankan script dari file Google Sheets.');
}


function registerCrVisitSummarySpreadsheetId_() {
  var ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  if (!ss) return;

  PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().setProperty('CrVisitSummary_SPREADSHEET_ID', ss.getId());
}


function getCrVisitSummaryOutputSheetName_(ss) {
  var name = ss.getName() || '';
  var match = name.match(/\b(CZB|NZB|EZB|CZ|NZ|EZ)[0-9]{6,}\b/i);

  if (match) {
    return 'Summary - CR ' + match[0].toUpperCase();
  }

  return CR_VISIT_SCHEDULE_SUMMARY_PARAMETERS.outputSheetFallbackName;
}


function getOrCreateCrVisitSummarySheet_(ss, sheetName) {
  var sheet = ss.getSheetByName(sheetName);

  if (!sheet) {
    sheet = ss.insertSheet(sheetName);
  }

  return sheet;
}


function ensureCrVisitSummarySheetSize_(sheet, minRows, minCols) {
  if (sheet.getMaxRows() < minRows) {
    sheet.insertRowsAfter(sheet.getMaxRows(), minRows - sheet.getMaxRows());
  }

  if (sheet.getMaxColumns() < minCols) {
    sheet.insertColumnsAfter(sheet.getMaxColumns(), minCols - sheet.getMaxColumns());
  }
}


function removeCrVisitSummaryTriggerByFunction_(functionName) {
  var triggers = ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers();

  triggers.forEach(function (trigger) {
    if (trigger.getHandlerFunction() === functionName) {
      ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger);
    }
  });
}



/* ============================================================
 * SYNC / COMPILE APPROVED LINKS TO TARGET SPREADSHEET
 * Source:
 * - Master sheet "Rekap Approved"
 * - Link FINAL kolom E saat ini
 *
 * Output:
 * - Spreadsheet target APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.targetSpreadsheetId
 * - 1 output sheet per template:
 *   1) Change Rolling & Change Schedule
 *   2) Change Sales Office
 *   3) Change Salesman Type
 *
 * Rules terbaru 2026-06-25B:
 * - Run ulang tidak append duplicate.
 * - Script membuat key per source-file + business key row.
 * - Data dari link aktif kolom E distaging, lalu target disinkronkan:
 *   insert / update / delete berdasarkan key yang aktif sekarang.
 * - Link yang dihapus dari kolom E otomatis menyebabkan row lama hilang
 *   dari output compile pada run berikutnya.
 * - Di akhir, output selalu cleansing:
 *   plain text, tanpa baris kosong, tanpa kolom kosong berlebihan,
 *   tanpa dropdown description seperti "11 - Modern Trade" atau
 *   "STA1 - STA - CG Sales".
 * ========================================================== */

function startCompileApprovedLinksAllToTargetInBackground() {
  startCompileApprovedLinksToTargetInBackground_(['ROLLING', 'SALES_OFFICE', 'SALESMAN_TYPE']);
}

function startCompileApprovedLinksRollingToTargetInBackground() {
  startCompileApprovedLinksToTargetInBackground_(['ROLLING']);
}

function startCompileApprovedLinksSalesOfficeToTargetInBackground() {
  startCompileApprovedLinksToTargetInBackground_(['SALES_OFFICE']);
}

function startCompileApprovedLinksSalesmanTypeToTargetInBackground() {
  startCompileApprovedLinksToTargetInBackground_(['SALESMAN_TYPE']);
}

function startCompileApprovedLinksToTargetInBackground_(keys) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const masterSh = ss.getSheetByName(P.masterSheetName);

  if (!masterSh) {
    throw new Error('Sheet master "' + P.masterSheetName + '" tidak ditemukan.');
  }

  const selectedConfigs = rscCompileGetConfigsByKeys_(keys);
  if (!selectedConfigs.length) {
    throw new Error('Tidak ada config compile yang valid untuk keys: ' + keys.join(', '));
  }

  const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
  const runId = rscCompileBuildRunId_();
  rscCompilePrepareDetailLogSheet_(targetSs);

  // Stage dibersihkan dari nol, tetapi output final tidak diappend.
  // Output final baru disync di fase finalization berdasarkan key.
  selectedConfigs.forEach(function (cfg) {
    const stg = rscCompileGetOrCreateStagingSheet_(targetSs, cfg);
    stg.clear();
    stg.hideSheet();
    stg.getRange(1, 1, Math.max(1, stg.getMaxRows()), Math.max(1, stg.getMaxColumns()))
      .setNumberFormat('@');
  });

  const firstDataRow = rscCompileResolveMasterFirstDataRow_(masterSh);
  const stats = {
    runId: runId,
    startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    finishedAt: '',
    targetSpreadsheetId: P.targetSpreadsheetId,
    masterSheetName: P.masterSheetName,
    masterLinkCol: P.masterLinkCol,
    mode: selectedConfigs.map(function (cfg) { return cfg.key; }).join(','),
    syncMode: 'KEY_BASED_UPSERT_DELETE',
    configs: {}
  };

  selectedConfigs.forEach(function (cfg) {
    stats.configs[cfg.key] = {
      label: cfg.menuLabel,
      filesOk: 0,
      skipped: 0,              // non-blank invalid link / source sheet/header not found
      blankRows: 0,            // blank Rekap Approved col E rows ignored silently
      errors: 0,
      sourceRows: 0,
      stagedRows: 0,
      outputRows: 0,
      inserted: 0,
      updated: 0,
      deleted: 0,
      unchanged: 0,
      duplicateKeysCollapsed: 0,
      headerWritten: false,
      firstError: ''
    };
  });

  const stagingRowByKey = {};
  const headerWrittenByKey = {};
  const outputColCountByKey = {};
  const activeSourceFileIdsByKey = {};

  selectedConfigs.forEach(function (cfg) {
    stagingRowByKey[cfg.key] = 1;
    headerWrittenByKey[cfg.key] = false;
    outputColCountByKey[cfg.key] = 0;
    activeSourceFileIdsByKey[cfg.key] = {};
  });

  const job = {
    masterSpreadsheetId: ss.getId(),
    masterSheetId: masterSh.getSheetId(),
    firstDataRow: firstDataRow,
    cursorRow: firstDataRow,
    configKeys: selectedConfigs.map(function (cfg) { return cfg.key; }),
    configIndex: 0,
    runId: runId,
    phase: 'STAGE',
    runChunks: 0,
    globalErrorCount: 0,
    lastHeartbeatAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    nextTriggerAtApprox: '',
    nextTriggerReason: '',
    stagingRowByKey: stagingRowByKey,
    headerWrittenByKey: headerWrittenByKey,
    outputColCountByKey: outputColCountByKey,
    activeSourceFileIdsByKey: activeSourceFileIdsByKey,
    stats: stats
  };

  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.setProperty(P.pJob, JSON.stringify(job));
  props.setProperty(P.pLastStats, JSON.stringify(stats));
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);

  rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'RUN_START', null, {
    targetSs: targetSs,
    status: 'STARTED',
    message: 'Compile/Sync Approved Links dimulai. Mode=' + job.configKeys.join(', ') +
      ', master=' + P.masterSheetName + ', linkCol=E, target=' + P.targetSpreadsheetId
  });

  selectedConfigs.forEach(function (cfg) {
    rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'CONFIG_INIT', cfg, {
      targetSs: targetSs,
      status: 'READY',
      message: 'Staging sheet cleared. Output target=' + cfg.outputSheetName
    });
  });

  continueCompileApprovedLinksToTargetInBackground();

  try {
    ss.toast(
      'Compile/Sync Approved Links dimulai. Mode=' + job.configKeys.join(', '),
      'Rolling Sales Center',
      8
    );
  } catch (err) {}
}

function continueCompileApprovedLinksToTargetInBackground() {
  const started = Date.now();
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const raw = props.getProperty(P.pJob);

  if (!raw) {
    try {
      SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
        'Tidak ada job Compile Approved Links yang sedang berjalan.',
        'Rolling Sales Center',
        6
      );
    } catch (err) {}
    deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);
    return;
  }

  let job = null;
  try {
    job = JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch (parseErr) {
    deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);
    throw new Error('Job Compile Approved Links corrupt/tidak bisa dibaca. STOP dulu lalu Start ulang. Detail: ' + formatScriptError_(parseErr));
  }

  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(1000)) {
    // Ada execution lain yang masih jalan. Jangan stop; schedule lagi.
    rscCompileScheduleContinuation_(job, 'LOCK_BUSY');
    return;
  }

  try {
    if (!job.phase) job.phase = 'STAGE';
    job.runChunks = Number(job.runChunks || 0) + 1;
    job.currentExecutionStartedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    job.lastHeartbeatAt = new Date().toISOString();
    rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);

    // Failsafe: kalau execution timeout keras sebelum sempat masuk pause block,
    // trigger ini akan mencoba continue lagi. Saat job selesai, trigger dihapus.
    rscCompileScheduleWatchdogContinuation_(job, 'WATCHDOG_RUN_' + job.runChunks);

    if (job.phase === 'FINALIZE') {
      rscCompileFinalizeSyncToTarget_(job, started);
      return;
    }

    const masterSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(job.masterSpreadsheetId);
    const masterSh = rscCompileGetSheetById_(masterSs, job.masterSheetId) ||
      masterSs.getSheetByName(P.masterSheetName);

    if (!masterSh) {
      throw new Error('Sheet master tidak ditemukan lagi: ' + P.masterSheetName);
    }

    const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
    const lastRow = masterSh.getLastRow();

    if (lastRow < job.firstDataRow) {
      // Tidak ada link aktif: kosongkan output terpilih.
      job.phase = 'FINALIZE';
      rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
      rscCompileFinalizeSyncToTarget_(job, started);
      return;
    }

    let filesTouchedThisRun = 0;

    while (job.configIndex < job.configKeys.length) {
      const cfg = rscCompileGetConfigByKey_(job.configKeys[job.configIndex]);
      if (!cfg) {
        job.configIndex++;
        job.cursorRow = job.firstDataRow;
        rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
        continue;
      }

      if (job.cursorRow > lastRow) {
        rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'CONFIG_STAGE_DONE', cfg, {
          targetSs: targetSs,
          status: 'STAGE_DONE',
          message: 'Finished staging all active master links for ' + cfg.menuLabel +
          '. Blank E rows ignored=' + ((job.stats.configs[cfg.key] && job.stats.configs[cfg.key].blankRows) || 0) +
            '. Blank E rows ignored=' + ((job.stats.configs[cfg.key] && job.stats.configs[cfg.key].blankRows) || 0)
        });
        job.configIndex++;
        job.cursorRow = job.firstDataRow;
        rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
        continue;
      }

      const rowCount = lastRow - job.cursorRow + 1;
      const linkRange = masterSh.getRange(job.cursorRow, P.masterLinkCol, rowCount, 1);
      const displayValues = linkRange.getDisplayValues();
      const values = linkRange.getValues();
      const formulas = linkRange.getFormulas();
      const richTexts = linkRange.getRichTextValues();

      let chipMap = {};
      if (typeof getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_ === 'function') {
        try {
          chipMap = getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_(
            masterSs.getId(),
            masterSh.getName(),
            job.cursorRow,
            P.masterLinkCol,
            rowCount
          ) || {};
        } catch (chipErr) {
          rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'WARN', 'SMART_CHIP_FALLBACK', cfg, {
            targetSs: targetSs,
            status: 'SMART_CHIP_UNAVAILABLE',
            message: formatScriptError_(chipErr)
          });
        }
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < rowCount; i++) {
        const masterRow = job.cursorRow + i;

        if (
          Date.now() - started > P.softDeadlineMs ||
          filesTouchedThisRun >= P.hardMaxFilesPerRun
        ) {
          job.cursorRow = masterRow;
          rscCompileScheduleContinuation_(job, 'STAGE_PAUSE_' + cfg.key + '_ROW_' + masterRow);
          rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'STAGE_PAUSE', cfg, {
            targetSs: targetSs,
            masterRow: masterRow,
            status: 'PAUSED',
            message: 'Pause karena soft deadline atau max files/run. Next cursor row=' + masterRow +
              '. Trigger continue sudah dibuat otomatis.'
          });
          rscCompileToast_(
            'Compile/Sync pause di config ' + cfg.menuLabel +
            ', row master ' + masterRow +
            '. Lanjut otomatis.'
          );
          return;
        }

        const masterCellInfo = {
          displayValue: displayValues[i][0],
          value: values[i][0],
          formula: formulas[i][0],
          richTextValue: richTexts[i][0]
        };

        const urlFromCell = getSpreadsheetUrlFromCellObject_(masterCellInfo);
        const chipUrl = chipMap[masterRow] || '';
        const rawMasterCellText = rscCompileGetMasterLinkCellText_(masterCellInfo);
        const url = urlFromCell || chipUrl || String(values[i][0] || displayValues[i][0] || '');
        const fileId = rscCompileExtractSpreadsheetId_(url);

        if (!fileId) {
          // Blank row di kolom E bukan error. Ini umum terjadi di Rekap Approved
          // karena data master sering sparse / ada grouping / ada row kosong.
          // Jangan dihitung skip, jangan warna kuning, jangan tulis log per row.
          if (rscCompileIsBlankMasterLinkRow_(rawMasterCellText, url, chipUrl)) {
            rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'blankRows', 1);
            job.cursorRow = masterRow + 1;
            if (Number(P.blankCheckpointEveryRows || 0) > 0 &&
                (masterRow - Number(job.firstDataRow || 2)) % Number(P.blankCheckpointEveryRows || 250) === 0) {
              rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
            }
            continue;
          }

          // Non-blank tapi bukan link: baru dihitung sebagai skip.
          const invalidReason = rscCompileBuildInvalidMasterLinkMessage_(rawMasterCellText, url);
          rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'skipped', 1);
          masterSh.getRange(masterRow, P.masterLinkCol)
            .setBackground(P.colorSkip)
            .setNote('SKIP compile/sync ' + cfg.menuLabel + ': ' + invalidReason);
          rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'WARN', 'STAGE_SKIP', cfg, {
            targetSs: targetSs,
            masterRow: masterRow,
            status: 'INVALID_LINK_NON_BLANK',
            message: invalidReason + ' | Raw=' + String(rawMasterCellText || url || '').slice(0, 300)
          });
          job.cursorRow = masterRow + 1;
          rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
          continue;
        }

        try {
          if (!job.activeSourceFileIdsByKey[cfg.key]) job.activeSourceFileIdsByKey[cfg.key] = {};
          job.activeSourceFileIdsByKey[cfg.key][fileId] = true;

          const sourceSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(fileId);
          const sourceSh = rscCompileGetSourceSheet_(sourceSs, cfg);
          if (!sourceSh) {
            rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'skipped', 1);
            masterSh.getRange(masterRow, P.masterLinkCol)
              .setBackground(P.colorSkip)
              .setNote('SKIP compile/sync ' + cfg.menuLabel + ': sheet source tidak ditemukan.');
            rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'WARN', 'STAGE_SKIP', cfg, {
              targetSs: targetSs,
              masterRow: masterRow,
              sourceFileId: fileId,
              sourceSpreadsheetName: sourceSs.getName(),
              status: 'SOURCE_SHEET_NOT_FOUND',
              message: 'Sheet source tidak ditemukan. Expected=' + cfg.sourceSheetName +
                ', available=' + sourceSs.getSheets().map(function (sh) { return sh.getName(); }).join(' | ')
            });
            job.cursorRow = masterRow + 1;
            filesTouchedThisRun++;
            rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
            continue;
          }

          const sourceData = rscCompileReadSourceSheet_(sourceSh, P.sourceHeaderScanRows, cfg);
          if (!sourceData || !sourceData.header.length) {
            rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'skipped', 1);
            masterSh.getRange(masterRow, P.masterLinkCol)
              .setBackground(P.colorSkip)
              .setNote('SKIP compile/sync ' + cfg.menuLabel + ': source kosong/header tidak ditemukan.');
            rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'WARN', 'STAGE_SKIP', cfg, {
              targetSs: targetSs,
              masterRow: masterRow,
              sourceFileId: fileId,
              sourceSpreadsheetName: sourceSs.getName(),
              sourceSheetName: sourceSh.getName(),
              headerRow: sourceData ? sourceData.headerRow : '',
              headerDetectMode: sourceData ? sourceData.headerDetectMode : '',
              status: 'HEADER_OR_DATA_NOT_FOUND',
              message: 'Source kosong atau header template tidak ditemukan. lastRow=' + sourceSh.getLastRow() +
                ', lastCol=' + sourceSh.getLastColumn()
            });
            job.cursorRow = masterRow + 1;
            filesTouchedThisRun++;
            rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
            continue;
          }

          const stageResult = rscCompileStageSourceData_(targetSs, cfg, sourceData, fileId, job);

          rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'STAGE_OK', cfg, {
            targetSs: targetSs,
            masterRow: masterRow,
            sourceFileId: fileId,
            sourceSpreadsheetName: sourceSs.getName(),
            sourceSheetName: sourceSh.getName(),
            headerRow: sourceData.headerRow || '',
            headerDetectMode: sourceData.headerDetectMode || '',
            sourceRows: sourceData.dataRows.length,
            stagedRows: stageResult.rowsStaged,
            status: 'STAGED',
            message: 'Source staged successfully. outputColCount=' + (job.outputColCountByKey[cfg.key] || '')
          });

          rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'filesOk', 1);
          rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'sourceRows', sourceData.dataRows.length);
          rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'stagedRows', stageResult.rowsStaged);
          if (stageResult.headerWritten) {
            job.stats.configs[cfg.key].headerWritten = true;
          }

          masterSh.getRange(masterRow, P.masterLinkCol)
            .setBackground(P.colorOk)
            .setNote(
              'OK stage compile/sync ' + cfg.menuLabel +
              '. Header row=' + (sourceData.headerRow || '-') +
              ', data rows=' + sourceData.dataRows.length +
              ', staged=' + stageResult.rowsStaged +
              ', key mode=source file + business key.'
            );

        } catch (err) {
          rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'errors', 1);
          if (!job.stats.configs[cfg.key].firstError) {
            job.stats.configs[cfg.key].firstError =
              'Master row ' + masterRow + ': ' + formatScriptError_(err);
          }

          masterSh.getRange(masterRow, P.masterLinkCol)
            .setBackground(P.colorError)
            .setNote('ERROR compile/sync ' + cfg.menuLabel + ': ' + formatScriptError_(err));

          rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'ERROR', 'STAGE_ERROR', cfg, {
            targetSs: targetSs,
            masterRow: masterRow,
            sourceFileId: fileId,
            status: 'ERROR',
            message: formatScriptError_(err)
          });

          writeRollingSalesCenterLog_(
            'Compile Approved Links error. Sheet=' + cfg.menuLabel +
            ', master row=' + masterRow +
            ', error=' + formatScriptError_(err)
          );
        }

        job.cursorRow = masterRow + 1;
        filesTouchedThisRun++;
        if (!P.checkpointEveryFiles || filesTouchedThisRun % P.checkpointEveryFiles === 0) {
          rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
        }
      }

      // This config reached end.
      rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'CONFIG_STAGE_DONE', cfg, {
        targetSs: targetSs,
        status: 'STAGE_DONE',
        message: 'Finished staging all active master links for ' + cfg.menuLabel +
          '. Blank E rows ignored=' + ((job.stats.configs[cfg.key] && job.stats.configs[cfg.key].blankRows) || 0)
      });
      job.configIndex++;
      job.cursorRow = job.firstDataRow;
      rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
    }

    job.phase = 'FINALIZE';
    job.finalizeIndex = 0;
    rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'STAGE_COMPLETE', null, {
      targetSs: targetSs,
      status: 'FINALIZE_READY',
      message: 'All selected configs finished staging. Begin finalize sync.'
    });
    rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
    rscCompileFinalizeSyncToTarget_(job, started);

  } catch (err) {
    const errText = formatScriptError_(err);
    try {
      job.globalErrorCount = Number(job.globalErrorCount || 0) + 1;
      job.lastErrorAt = new Date().toISOString();
      job.lastError = errText;
      if (job.stats) {
        job.stats.lastErrorAt = job.lastErrorAt;
        job.stats.lastError = errText;
        job.stats.globalErrorCount = job.globalErrorCount;
      }
      rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);

      let targetSsForLog = null;
      try { targetSsForLog = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId); } catch (openLogErr) {}
      if (targetSsForLog) {
        rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'ERROR', 'GLOBAL_ERROR_RETRY', null, {
          targetSs: targetSsForLog,
          status: 'GLOBAL_ERROR',
          message: 'Global error count=' + job.globalErrorCount + '. ' + errText
        });
      }
    } catch (safeErr) {}

    if (!job || Number(job.globalErrorCount || 0) <= Number(P.maxGlobalErrorRetries || 50)) {
      rscCompileScheduleContinuation_(job, 'GLOBAL_ERROR_RETRY');
      rscCompileToast_('Compile kena error sementara dan akan continue otomatis. Error: ' + errText.slice(0, 200));
      return;
    }

    deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);
    rscCompileToast_('Compile STOP karena error global berulang. Cek _RSC_COMPILE_DETAIL_LOG. Error: ' + errText.slice(0, 200));
    throw err;
  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (err) {}
  }
}


function rscCompileFinalizeSyncToTarget_(job, started) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);

  if (typeof job.finalizeIndex === 'undefined' || job.finalizeIndex === null) {
    job.finalizeIndex = 0;
  }

  while (job.finalizeIndex < job.configKeys.length) {
    const cfg = rscCompileGetConfigByKey_(job.configKeys[job.finalizeIndex]);
    if (!cfg) {
      job.finalizeIndex++;
      continue;
    }

    if (Date.now() - started > P.softDeadlineMs) {
      rscCompileScheduleContinuation_(job, 'FINALIZE_PAUSE_' + cfg.key);
      rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'FINALIZE_PAUSE', cfg, {
        targetSs: targetSs,
        status: 'PAUSED',
        message: 'Finalize paused by soft deadline. Continue trigger sudah dibuat otomatis.'
      });
      rscCompileToast_('Finalize compile/sync pause di ' + cfg.menuLabel + '. Lanjut otomatis.');
      return;
    }

    const syncResult = rscCompileSyncOneConfigFromStage_(targetSs, cfg, job);
    rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'outputRows', syncResult.outputRows);
    rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'inserted', syncResult.inserted);
    rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'updated', syncResult.updated);
    rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'deleted', syncResult.deleted);
    rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'unchanged', syncResult.unchanged);
    rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'duplicateKeysCollapsed', syncResult.duplicateKeysCollapsed);

    rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'FINALIZE_OK', cfg, {
      targetSs: targetSs,
      outputRows: syncResult.outputRows,
      inserted: syncResult.inserted,
      updated: syncResult.updated,
      deleted: syncResult.deleted,
      unchanged: syncResult.unchanged,
      duplicateKeysCollapsed: syncResult.duplicateKeysCollapsed,
      status: 'SYNCED',
      message: 'Output sheet rewritten and cleansed. Sheet=' + cfg.outputSheetName
    });

    job.finalizeIndex++;
    props.setProperty(P.pJob, JSON.stringify(job));
    props.setProperty(P.pLastStats, JSON.stringify(job.stats));
  }

  finishCompileApprovedLinksJob_(job, buildCompileApprovedLinksFinishMessage_(job));
}

function rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job) {
  if (!job) return;
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  job.lastHeartbeatAt = new Date().toISOString();
  props.setProperty(P.pJob, JSON.stringify(job));
  if (job.stats) {
    job.stats.lastHeartbeatAt = job.lastHeartbeatAt;
    job.stats.phase = job.phase || '';
    job.stats.configIndex = job.configIndex || 0;
    job.stats.cursorRow = job.cursorRow || '';
    job.stats.finalizeIndex = job.finalizeIndex || 0;
    job.stats.runChunks = job.runChunks || 0;
    job.stats.nextTriggerAtApprox = job.nextTriggerAtApprox || '';
    job.stats.nextTriggerReason = job.nextTriggerReason || '';
    props.setProperty(P.pLastStats, JSON.stringify(job.stats));
  }
}

function rscCompileScheduleContinuation_(job, reason) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const delay = Math.max(
    Number(P.minTriggerDelayMs || 60000),
    Number(P.triggerDelayMs || 60000)
  );
  if (job) {
    job.nextTriggerReason = String(reason || 'CONTINUE');
    job.nextTriggerAtApprox = new Date(Date.now() + delay).toISOString();
    rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
  }
  scheduleTimeDrivenTrigger_(P.fn, delay);
}

function rscCompileScheduleWatchdogContinuation_(job, reason) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const delay = Math.max(
    Number(P.minTriggerDelayMs || 60000),
    Number(P.watchdogDelayMs || (5 * 60 * 1000))
  );
  if (job) {
    job.nextTriggerReason = String(reason || 'WATCHDOG');
    job.nextTriggerAtApprox = new Date(Date.now() + delay).toISOString();
    rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
  }
  scheduleTimeDrivenTrigger_(P.fn, delay);
}


function showCompileApprovedLinksStatus() {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const raw = props.getProperty(P.pJob) || props.getProperty(P.pLastStats);

  if (!raw) {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Belum ada status Compile Approved Links.');
    return;
  }

  let obj = JSON.parse(raw);
  let stats = obj.stats || obj;
  let lines = [];
  lines.push('Started: ' + (stats.startedAt || '-'));
  lines.push('Finished: ' + (stats.finishedAt || 'masih berjalan / belum finish'));
  lines.push('Target: ' + (stats.targetSpreadsheetId || P.targetSpreadsheetId));
  lines.push('Mode: ' + (stats.syncMode || 'KEY_BASED_UPSERT_DELETE'));
  lines.push('Phase: ' + (stats.phase || obj.phase || '-'));
  lines.push('Config index: ' + (stats.configIndex != null ? stats.configIndex : (obj.configIndex != null ? obj.configIndex : '-')));
  lines.push('Cursor row: ' + (stats.cursorRow || obj.cursorRow || '-'));
  lines.push('Finalize index: ' + (stats.finalizeIndex != null ? stats.finalizeIndex : (obj.finalizeIndex != null ? obj.finalizeIndex : '-')));
  lines.push('Run chunks: ' + (stats.runChunks || obj.runChunks || 0));
  lines.push('Last heartbeat: ' + (stats.lastHeartbeatAt || obj.lastHeartbeatAt || '-'));
  lines.push('Next trigger approx: ' + (stats.nextTriggerAtApprox || obj.nextTriggerAtApprox || '-'));
  lines.push('Next trigger reason: ' + (stats.nextTriggerReason || obj.nextTriggerReason || '-'));
  if (stats.lastError || obj.lastError) lines.push('Last error: ' + (stats.lastError || obj.lastError));
  lines.push('');

  Object.keys(stats.configs || {}).forEach(function (key) {
    const s = stats.configs[key];
    lines.push(
      s.label +
      ' | file OK=' + s.filesOk +
      ' | skip=' + s.skipped +
      ' | blank E ignored=' + (s.blankRows || 0) +
      ' | error=' + s.errors +
      ' | source rows=' + s.sourceRows +
      ' | staged=' + (s.stagedRows || 0) +
      ' | output=' + (s.outputRows || 0) +
      ' | insert=' + (s.inserted || 0) +
      ' | update=' + (s.updated || 0) +
      ' | delete=' + (s.deleted || 0) +
      ' | unchanged=' + (s.unchanged || 0)
    );
    if (s.duplicateKeysCollapsed) lines.push('  Duplicate key collapsed: ' + s.duplicateKeysCollapsed);
    if (s.firstError) lines.push('  First error: ' + s.firstError);
  });

  if (obj.configKeys) {
    lines.push('');
    lines.push(
      'Progress: phase=' + (obj.phase || 'STAGE') +
      ', config index=' + obj.configIndex +
      '/' + obj.configKeys.length +
      ', cursor row=' + obj.cursorRow +
      ', finalize index=' + (obj.finalizeIndex || 0)
    );
  }

  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Status Compile Approved Links\n\n' + lines.join('\n'));
}

function stopCompileApprovedLinksJob() {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const raw = props.getProperty(P.pJob);
  if (raw) {
    props.setProperty(P.pLastStats, raw);
    try {
      const job = JSON.parse(raw);
      rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'WARN', 'JOB_STOP', null, {
        status: 'STOPPED_BY_USER',
        message: 'Compile Approved Links stopped manually. Last phase=' + (job.phase || '-') +
          ', cursorRow=' + (job.cursorRow || '-')
      });
    } catch (logErr) {}
  }

  props.deleteProperty(P.pJob);
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);

  SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
    'Compile Approved Links dihentikan. Checkpoint job dihapus.',
    'Rolling Sales Center',
    7
  );
}

function finishCompileApprovedLinksJob_(job, message) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  job.stats.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();

  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.setProperty(P.pLastStats, JSON.stringify(job.stats));
  props.deleteProperty(P.pJob);
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);

  try {
    const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
    job.configKeys.forEach(function (key) {
      const cfg = rscCompileGetConfigByKey_(key);
      if (!cfg) return;
      const stg = targetSs.getSheetByName(rscCompileGetStagingSheetName_(cfg));
      if (stg) stg.hideSheet();
    });
    const meta = targetSs.getSheetByName(rscCompileGetMetaSheetName_());
    if (meta) meta.hideSheet();
  } catch (err) {}

  try {
    const targetSsForLog = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
    rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'RUN_FINISH', null, {
      targetSs: targetSsForLog,
      status: 'FINISHED',
      message: message
    });
    rscCompilePruneDetailLog_(targetSsForLog);
  } catch (logErr) {}

  writeRollingSalesCenterLog_(message);
  rscCompileToast_(message);
}

function buildCompileApprovedLinksFinishMessage_(job) {
  const parts = [];
  Object.keys(job.stats.configs || {}).forEach(function (key) {
    const s = job.stats.configs[key];
    parts.push(
      s.label +
      ': file OK=' + s.filesOk +
      ', skip=' + s.skipped +
      ', blank E ignored=' + (s.blankRows || 0) +
      ', error=' + s.errors +
      ', source=' + s.sourceRows +
      ', output=' + (s.outputRows || 0) +
      ', insert=' + (s.inserted || 0) +
      ', update=' + (s.updated || 0) +
      ', delete=' + (s.deleted || 0) +
      ', unchanged=' + (s.unchanged || 0)
    );
  });
  return 'Compile/Sync Approved Links SELESAI. ' + parts.join(' | ');
}

  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
  const logSh = rscCompilePrepareDetailLogSheet_(targetSs);
