    'Target Spreadsheet ID: ' + P.targetSpreadsheetId + '\n' +
    'Sheet log: ' + logSh.getName() + '\n\n' +
    'Buka target spreadsheet lalu cek sheet tersebut untuk melihat master row, file ID, source sheet, header row, staged row, insert/update/delete, dan error detail.'
  );
}

function clearCompileApprovedLinksDetailLogSheet() {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
  const logSh = rscCompilePrepareDetailLogSheet_(targetSs);
  logSh.clear();
  rscCompileWriteDetailLogHeader_(logSh);
  try { logSh.showSheet(); } catch (err) {}

  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Detail log compile sudah dikosongkan di sheet: ' + logSh.getName());
}

function rscCompileBuildRunId_() {
  let tz = 'Asia/Jakarta';
  try { tz = Session.getScriptTimeZone() || tz; } catch (err) {}
  return Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), tz, 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss') + '-' +
    Math.floor(Math.random() * 10000);
}

function rscCompileGetDetailLogHeaders_() {
  return [
    'TIMESTAMP',
    'RUN_ID',
    'LEVEL',
    'PHASE',
    'CONFIG_KEY',
    'CONFIG_LABEL',
    'MASTER_ROW',
    'SOURCE_FILE_ID',
    'SOURCE_SPREADSHEET_NAME',
    'SOURCE_SHEET_NAME',
    'TARGET_SHEET_NAME',
    'HEADER_ROW',
    'HEADER_DETECT_MODE',
    'SOURCE_ROWS',
    'STAGED_ROWS',
    'OUTPUT_ROWS',
    'INSERTED',
    'UPDATED',
    'DELETED',
    'UNCHANGED',
    'DUPLICATE_KEYS_COLLAPSED',
    'STATUS',
    'MESSAGE'
  ];
}

function rscCompilePrepareDetailLogSheet_(targetSs) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const name = P.detailLogSheetName || '_RSC_COMPILE_DETAIL_LOG';
  let sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(name);
  if (!sh) sh = targetSs.insertSheet(name);
  rscCompileWriteDetailLogHeader_(sh);
  try { sh.setFrozenRows(1); } catch (err) {}
  // Jangan setNumberFormat ke seluruh log sheet setiap append agar logging tetap ringan.
  // Format plain text diterapkan pada header dan row baru saja.
  return sh;
}

function rscCompileWriteDetailLogHeader_(sh) {
  const headers = rscCompileGetDetailLogHeaders_();
  rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(sh, 1, headers.length);
  const current = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).getDisplayValues()[0].join('|');
  if (current !== headers.join('|')) {
    sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setNumberFormat('@').setValues([headers]);
  }
}

function rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, level, phase, cfg, detail) {
  try {
    const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
    detail = detail || {};
    const targetSs = detail.targetSs || RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
    const sh = rscCompilePrepareDetailLogSheet_(targetSs);
    const headers = rscCompileGetDetailLogHeaders_();
    const nextRow = sh.getLastRow() + 1;
    const row = [
      new Date().toISOString(),
      (job && (job.runId || (job.stats && job.stats.runId))) || '',
      level || '',
      phase || '',
      cfg ? cfg.key : (detail.configKey || ''),
      cfg ? cfg.menuLabel : (detail.configLabel || ''),
      detail.masterRow || '',
      detail.sourceFileId || '',
      detail.sourceSpreadsheetName || '',
      detail.sourceSheetName || '',
      cfg ? cfg.outputSheetName : (detail.targetSheetName || ''),
      detail.headerRow || '',
      detail.headerDetectMode || '',
      detail.sourceRows || '',
      detail.stagedRows || '',
      detail.outputRows || '',
      detail.inserted || '',
      detail.updated || '',
      detail.deleted || '',
      detail.unchanged || '',
      detail.duplicateKeysCollapsed || '',
      detail.status || '',
      detail.message || ''
    ].map(rscCompileNormalizeLogCell_);

    rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(sh, nextRow, headers.length);
    sh.getRange(nextRow, 1, 1, headers.length).setNumberFormat('@').setValues([row]);
  } catch (err) {
    try { writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('Compile detail log failed: ' + formatScriptError_(err)); } catch (e) {}
  }
}

function rscCompileNormalizeLogCell_(value) {
  let text = String(value == null ? '' : value);
  text = text.replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ');
  text = text.replace(/\t+/g, ' ');
  text = text.replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ');
  text = text.trim();
  if (text.length > 3000) text = text.slice(0, 3000) + ' ...[truncated]';
  return text;
}

function rscCompilePruneDetailLog_(targetSs) {
  try {
    const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
    const maxRows = Number(P.maxDetailLogRowsToKeep || 30000);
    if (!maxRows || maxRows < 1000) return;
    const sh = rscCompilePrepareDetailLogSheet_(targetSs);
    const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
    const maxWithHeader = maxRows + 1;
    if (lastRow > maxWithHeader) {
      const deleteCount = lastRow - maxWithHeader;
      sh.deleteRows(2, deleteCount);
    }
  } catch (err) {}
}

function rscCompileStageSourceData_(targetSs, cfg, sourceData, fileId, job) {
  const stg = rscCompileGetOrCreateStagingSheet_(targetSs, cfg);
  const metaCols = rscCompileGetStageMetaHeaders_();

  let colCount = Number(job.outputColCountByKey[cfg.key] || 0);
  if (!colCount) {
    colCount = rscCompileEffectiveColumnCount_(sourceData.header, sourceData.dataRows);
    if (!colCount) colCount = sourceData.header.length || 1;
    job.outputColCountByKey[cfg.key] = colCount;
  }

  let rowsToWrite = [];
  let headerWrittenNow = false;

  if (!job.headerWrittenByKey[cfg.key]) {
    rowsToWrite.push(metaCols.concat(rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(sourceData.header, colCount)));
    job.headerWrittenByKey[cfg.key] = true;
    headerWrittenNow = true;
  }

  const headerForKey = rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(sourceData.header, colCount);
  const headerMap = rscCompileBuildHeaderIndexMap_(headerForKey);

  sourceData.dataRows.forEach(function (row, idx) {
    const normalizedRow = rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(row, colCount);
    if (!rscCompileRowHasValue_(normalizedRow)) return;

    const businessKey = rscCompileBuildBusinessKeyFromRow_(cfg, headerForKey, headerMap, normalizedRow, idx + 1);
    const compileKey = rscCompileBuildCompileKey_(cfg, fileId, businessKey);
    const rowHash = rscCompileHashString_(normalizedRow.join('\u001f'));

    rowsToWrite.push([
      compileKey,
      fileId,
      businessKey,
      rowHash,
      String(idx + 1)
    ].concat(normalizedRow));
  });

  if (!rowsToWrite.length) {
    return { rowsStaged: 0, headerWritten: headerWrittenNow };
  }

  const startRow = Number(job.stagingRowByKey[cfg.key] || 1);
  const writeCols = metaCols.length + colCount;
  rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(stg, startRow + rowsToWrite.length - 1, writeCols);
  const writeRange = stg.getRange(startRow, 1, rowsToWrite.length, writeCols);
  writeRange.setNumberFormat('@');
  writeRange.setValues(rowsToWrite);
  stg.hideSheet();

  job.stagingRowByKey[cfg.key] = startRow + rowsToWrite.length;
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  return {
    rowsStaged: Math.max(0, rowsToWrite.length - (headerWrittenNow ? 1 : 0)),
    headerWritten: headerWrittenNow
  };
}

function rscCompileSyncOneConfigFromStage_(targetSs, cfg, job) {
  const outSh = rscCompileGetOrCreateOutputSheet_(targetSs, cfg.outputSheetName);
  const stg = rscCompileGetOrCreateStagingSheet_(targetSs, cfg);
  const metaSheet = rscCompileGetOrCreateMetaSheet_(targetSs);
  const previousIndex = rscCompileReadMetaIndex_(metaSheet, cfg);
  const staged = rscCompileReadStagingRows_(stg, cfg);

  const currentByKey = {};
  let duplicateKeysCollapsed = 0;

  staged.rows.forEach(function (item) {
    if (currentByKey[item.key]) duplicateKeysCollapsed++;
    currentByKey[item.key] = item; // last wins jika duplicate key dari active links.
  });

  const keys = Object.keys(currentByKey).sort();
  const header = staged.header.length ? staged.header : [];
  const colCount = header.length || Number(job.outputColCountByKey[cfg.key] || 0) || 1;

  const outputRows = [];
  if (header.length) {
    outputRows.push(rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(header, colCount));
    keys.forEach(function (key) {
      outputRows.push(rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(currentByKey[key].row, colCount));
    });
  }

  let inserted = 0;
  let updated = 0;
  let unchanged = 0;
  let deleted = 0;

  keys.forEach(function (key) {
    if (!previousIndex[key]) {
      inserted++;
    } else if (String(previousIndex[key].rowHash || '') !== String(currentByKey[key].rowHash || '')) {
      updated++;
    } else {
      unchanged++;
    }
  });

  Object.keys(previousIndex).forEach(function (key) {
    if (!currentByKey[key]) deleted++;
  });

  rscCompileRewriteOutputSheetClean_(outSh, outputRows, colCount);
  rscCompileRewriteMetaForConfig_(metaSheet, cfg, currentByKey);

  try { stg.hideSheet(); } catch (err) {}
  try { metaSheet.hideSheet(); } catch (err) {}

  return {
    outputRows: Math.max(0, outputRows.length - (header.length ? 1 : 0)),
    inserted: inserted,
    updated: updated,
    deleted: deleted,
    unchanged: unchanged,
    duplicateKeysCollapsed: duplicateKeysCollapsed
  };
}

function rscCompileRewriteOutputSheetClean_(sh, outputRows, colCount) {
  const rowsNeeded = Math.max(1, outputRows.length || 1);
  const colsNeeded = Math.max(1, colCount || 1);

  sh.clear();
  rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(sh, rowsNeeded, colsNeeded);

  // Hapus baris/kolom kosong berlebihan agar file tidak menyimpan format aneh.
  rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh, rowsNeeded, colsNeeded);

  const fullRange = sh.getRange(1, 1, rowsNeeded, colsNeeded);
  fullRange.setNumberFormat('@');
  fullRange.clearDataValidations();
  fullRange.clearNote();

  if (outputRows.length) {
    sh.getRange(1, 1, outputRows.length, colsNeeded).setValues(outputRows);
    try { sh.setFrozenRows(1); } catch (err) {}
  } else {
    sh.getRange(1, 1).setValue('');
    try { sh.setFrozenRows(0); } catch (err) {}
  }

  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
}

function rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh, rowsNeeded, colsNeeded) {
  rowsNeeded = Math.max(1, Number(rowsNeeded || 1));
  colsNeeded = Math.max(1, Number(colsNeeded || 1));

  const maxRows = sh.getMaxRows();
  if (maxRows > rowsNeeded) {
    sh.deleteRows(rowsNeeded + 1, maxRows - rowsNeeded);
  }

  const maxCols = sh.getMaxColumns();
  if (maxCols > colsNeeded) {
    sh.deleteColumns(colsNeeded + 1, maxCols - colsNeeded);
  }
}

function rscCompileReadSourceSheet_(sourceSh, headerScanRows, cfg) {
  const lastRow = sourceSh.getLastRow();
  const lastCol = sourceSh.getLastColumn();

  if (lastRow < 1 || lastCol < 1) {
    return { header: [], dataRows: [], headerRow: 0, headerDetectMode: 'EMPTY' };
  }

  const values = sourceSh.getRange(1, 1, lastRow, lastCol).getDisplayValues();

  // PATCH 2026-06-25C:
  // Jangan pakai "baris pertama yang ada isi" sebagai header, karena beberapa
  // template punya kode/top note seperti "2AA0" di atas header. Header harus
  // dicari berdasarkan nama kolom template yang expected untuk sheet terkait.
  const headerIdx = rscCompileFindSourceHeaderRowIndex_(values, cfg, headerScanRows);

  if (headerIdx < 0) {
    return { header: [], dataRows: [], headerRow: 0, headerDetectMode: 'NOT_FOUND' };
  }

  const rawHeader = values[headerIdx].map(function (v) { return rscCompileNormalizeCellValue_(v); });
  const firstWidth = rscCompileLastNonEmptyIndex_(rawHeader) + 1;
  const header = rawHeader.slice(0, Math.max(1, firstWidth));
  const headerKey = rscCompileBuildHeaderLikeKey_(header);
  const dataRows = [];

  for (let r = headerIdx + 1; r < values.length; r++) {
    const row = values[r].map(function (v) { return rscCompileNormalizeCellValue_(v); });
    if (!rscCompileRowHasValue_(row)) continue;

    const trimmed = row.slice(0, Math.max(header.length, rscCompileLastNonEmptyIndex_(row) + 1));

    // Jangan append header yang kebawa ulang di source.
    if (rscCompileBuildHeaderLikeKey_(trimmed.slice(0, header.length)) === headerKey) continue;

    dataRows.push(trimmed);
  }

  return {
    header: header,
    dataRows: dataRows,
    headerRow: headerIdx + 1,
    headerDetectMode: 'EXPECTED_TEMPLATE_HEADER'
  };
}

function rscCompileFindSourceHeaderRowIndex_(values, cfg, headerScanRows) {
  const scanLimit = Math.min(Math.max(Number(headerScanRows || 80), 30), values.length);
  const expectedGroups = rscCompileGetExpectedHeaderAliasGroups_(cfg);

  let bestIdx = -1;
  let bestScore = -1;

  for (let r = 0; r < scanLimit; r++) {
    const row = values[r] || [];
    if (!rscCompileRowHasValue_(row)) continue;

    const rowKeys = {};
    row.forEach(function (cell) {
      const k = rscCompileNormalizeHeaderKey_(cell);
      if (k) rowKeys[k] = true;
    });

    let score = 0;
    expectedGroups.forEach(function (group) {
      for (let i = 0; i < group.length; i++) {
        if (rowKeys[rscCompileNormalizeHeaderKey_(group[i])]) {
          score++;
          break;
        }
      }
    });

    if (score > bestScore) {
      bestScore = score;
      bestIdx = r;
    }
  }

  // Minimum score dibuat cukup ketat agar value seperti "2AA0" / "STA1" / "110143347"
  // tidak pernah dianggap header.
  const minScore = rscCompileGetMinimumHeaderScore_(cfg);
  if (bestIdx >= 0 && bestScore >= minScore) return bestIdx;

  // Fallback aman: cari row yang mengandung minimal salah satu anchor kuat.
  // Ini tetap lebih aman daripada first non-empty row.
  const anchors = rscCompileGetStrongHeaderAnchors_(cfg);
  for (let r = 0; r < scanLimit; r++) {
    const rowText = (values[r] || []).map(function (v) {
      return rscCompileNormalizeHeaderKey_(v);
    }).join('|');
    let hit = 0;
    anchors.forEach(function (a) {
      if (rowText.indexOf(rscCompileNormalizeHeaderKey_(a)) !== -1) hit++;
    });
    if (hit >= Math.min(2, anchors.length)) return r;
  }

  return -1;
}

function rscCompileGetExpectedHeaderAliasGroups_(cfg) {
  if (!cfg || cfg.key === 'ROLLING') {
    return [
      ['Sales Office', 'Sls Office'],
      ['Delivering Plant', 'Plant'],
      ['Customer ID', 'Customer', 'Cust ID', 'BP Number Source', 'BP ID'],
      ['Relationship', 'Relationship Cat', 'Relationship Cat ID'],
      ['Salesman ID', 'Salesman'],
      ['Salesman BP Type', 'BP Type'],
      ['Valid From'],
      ['Valid To'],
      ['Visit Category'],
      ['Visit Type'],
      ['Schedule Visit', 'Visit Schedule'],
      ['Visit Valid From'],
      ['Visit Valid To'],
      ['Reason'],
      ['Validation Status'],
      ['Error Detail']
    ];
  }

  if (cfg.key === 'SALES_OFFICE') {
    return [
      ['BP Number Source', 'Customer ID', 'BP ID'],
      ['Delivering Plant', 'Plant'],
      ['Distr. Channel', 'Distribution Channel', 'Dist Channel'],
      ['Division'],
      ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org', 'Sls Organization'],
      ['Sales Office', 'Sls Office'],
      ['Validation Status'],
      ['Error Detail']
    ];
  }

  if (cfg.key === 'SALESMAN_TYPE') {
    return [
      ['Salesman ID', 'BP Number Source', 'Salesman'],
      ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org', 'Sls Organization'],
      ['Sales Office', 'Sls Office'],
      ['Sales Type', 'Salesman Type'],
      ['Coverage'],
      ['Region'],
      ['Valid From'],
      ['Valid To'],
      ['Validation Status'],
      ['Error Detail']
    ];
  }

  return [
    ['Validation Status'],
    ['Error Detail']
  ];
}

function rscCompileGetMinimumHeaderScore_(cfg) {
  if (!cfg) return 4;
  if (cfg.key === 'ROLLING') return 6;
  if (cfg.key === 'SALES_OFFICE') return 4;
  if (cfg.key === 'SALESMAN_TYPE') return 4;
  return 3;
}

function rscCompileGetStrongHeaderAnchors_(cfg) {
  if (!cfg || cfg.key === 'ROLLING') {
    return ['Customer ID', 'Relationship', 'Salesman ID', 'Visit Type', 'Schedule Visit'];
  }
  if (cfg.key === 'SALES_OFFICE') {
    return ['BP Number Source', 'Delivering Plant', 'Sales Organization', 'Sales Office'];
  }
  if (cfg.key === 'SALESMAN_TYPE') {
    return ['Salesman ID', 'Sales Organization', 'Sales Office', 'Sales Type'];
  }
  return ['Validation Status', 'Error Detail'];
}

function rscCompileGetSourceSheet_(sourceSs, cfg) {
  let sh = sourceSs.getSheetByName(cfg.sourceSheetName);
  if (sh) return sh;

  sh = sourceSs.getSheetByName(String(cfg.sourceSheetName).substring(0, 31));
  if (sh) return sh;

  const wantedNorm = rscCompileNormalizeSheetName_(cfg.sourceSheetName);
  const sheets = sourceSs.getSheets();

  for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (rscCompileNormalizeSheetName_(sheets[i].getName()) === wantedNorm) return sheets[i];
  }

  const contains = cfg.fallbackContains || [];
  for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    const nameNorm = rscCompileNormalizeSheetName_(sheets[i].getName());
    for (let j = 0; j < contains.length; j++) {
      if (nameNorm.indexOf(rscCompileNormalizeSheetName_(contains[j])) !== -1) return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function rscCompileResolveMasterFirstDataRow_(masterSh) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const scanRows = Math.min(P.masterHeaderScanRows || 30, masterSh.getLastRow());
  const lastCol = masterSh.getLastColumn();

  if (scanRows < 1 || lastCol < 1) return P.firstDataRowFallback || 2;

  const grid = masterSh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, lastCol).getDisplayValues();
  for (let r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    const row = grid[r].map(function (v) {
      return String(v == null ? '' : v).trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
    });

    for (let c = 0; c < row.length; c++) {
      if (
        row[c] === 'TEMPLATE ROLLING SALES FINAL' ||
        row[c] === 'FINAL' ||
        row[c] === 'LINK FINAL'
      ) {
        // Tetap pakai kolom E sesuai request, tapi data row mengikuti posisi header.
        return r + 2;
      }
    }
  }

  return P.firstDataRowFallback || 2;
}

function rscCompileGetConfigsByKeys_(keys) {
  const map = {};
  APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.outputSheets.forEach(function (cfg) {
    map[cfg.key] = cfg;
  });

  return keys
    .map(function (key) { return map[key]; })
    .filter(function (cfg) { return !!cfg; });
}

function rscCompileGetConfigByKey_(key) {
  const list = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.outputSheets || [];
  for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
    if (list[i].key === key) return list[i];
  }
  return null;
}

function rscCompileGetOrCreateOutputSheet_(targetSs, sheetName) {
  let sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(sheetName);
  if (!sh) sh = targetSs.insertSheet(sheetName);
  return sh;
}

function rscCompileGetStageMetaHeaders_() {
  return ['__COMPILE_KEY', '__SOURCE_FILE_ID', '__BUSINESS_KEY', '__ROW_HASH', '__SOURCE_ROW_NO'];
}

function rscCompileGetStagingSheetName_(cfg) {
  return String('_RSC_STG_' + cfg.key).substring(0, 99);
}

function rscCompileGetMetaSheetName_() {
  return '_RSC_COMPILE_KEY_INDEX';
}

function rscCompileGetOrCreateStagingSheet_(targetSs, cfg) {
  const name = rscCompileGetStagingSheetName_(cfg);
  let sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(name);
  if (!sh) sh = targetSs.insertSheet(name);
  return sh;
}

function rscCompileGetOrCreateMetaSheet_(targetSs) {
  const name = rscCompileGetMetaSheetName_();
  let sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(name);
  if (!sh) {
    sh = targetSs.insertSheet(name);
    sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, 6).setValues([[
      'OUTPUT_SHEET', 'COMPILE_KEY', 'ROW_HASH', 'SOURCE_FILE_ID', 'BUSINESS_KEY', 'UPDATED_AT'
    ]]);
    sh.hideSheet();
  }
  return sh;
}

function rscCompileReadMetaIndex_(metaSheet, cfg) {
  const out = {};
  const lastRow = metaSheet.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow < 2) return out;

  const values = metaSheet.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, Math.max(6, metaSheet.getLastColumn())).getDisplayValues();
  values.forEach(function (r) {
    if (String(r[0] || '') !== cfg.outputSheetName) return;
    const key = String(r[1] || '');
    if (!key) return;
    out[key] = {
      rowHash: String(r[2] || ''),
      sourceFileId: String(r[3] || ''),
      businessKey: String(r[4] || '')
    };
  });
  return out;
}

function rscCompileRewriteMetaForConfig_(metaSheet, cfg, currentByKey) {
  const lastRow = metaSheet.getLastRow();
  const keep = [];

  if (lastRow >= 2) {
    const existing = metaSheet.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, Math.max(6, metaSheet.getLastColumn())).getDisplayValues();
    existing.forEach(function (r) {
      if (String(r[0] || '') !== cfg.outputSheetName) {
        keep.push(rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(r, 6));
      }
    });
  }

  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  Object.keys(currentByKey).sort().forEach(function (key) {
    const item = currentByKey[key];
    keep.push([
      cfg.outputSheetName,
      key,
      item.rowHash,
      item.sourceFileId,
      item.businessKey,
      now
    ]);
  });

  metaSheet.clear();
  rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(metaSheet, Math.max(1, keep.length + 1), 6);
  metaSheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, 6).setNumberFormat('@').setValues([[
    'OUTPUT_SHEET', 'COMPILE_KEY', 'ROW_HASH', 'SOURCE_FILE_ID', 'BUSINESS_KEY', 'UPDATED_AT'
  ]]);
  if (keep.length) {
    metaSheet.getRange(2, 1, keep.length, 6).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(keep);
  }
  rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(metaSheet, Math.max(1, keep.length + 1), 6);
  metaSheet.hideSheet();
}

function rscCompileReadStagingRows_(stg, cfg) {
  const metaCols = rscCompileGetStageMetaHeaders_().length;
  const lastRow = stg.getLastRow();
  const lastCol = stg.getLastColumn();
  if (lastRow < 1 || lastCol <= metaCols) return { header: [], rows: [] };

  const values = stg.getRange(1, 1, lastRow, lastCol).getDisplayValues();
  const header = values[0].slice(metaCols).map(function (v) { return rscCompileNormalizeCellValue_(v); });
  const effectiveCols = rscCompileEffectiveColumnCount_(header, values.slice(1).map(function (r) { return r.slice(metaCols); }));
  const finalHeader = rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(header, effectiveCols);
  const rows = [];

  for (let i = 1; i < values.length; i++) {
    const r = values[i];
    const key = String(r[0] || '');
    if (!key) continue;
    const dataRow = rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(r.slice(metaCols), effectiveCols);
    if (!rscCompileRowHasValue_(dataRow)) continue;
    rows.push({
      key: key,
      sourceFileId: String(r[1] || ''),
      businessKey: String(r[2] || ''),
      rowHash: String(r[3] || rscCompileHashString_(dataRow.join('\u001f'))),
      row: dataRow
    });
  }

  return { header: finalHeader, rows: rows };
}

function rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(sh, minRows, minCols) {
  minRows = Math.max(1, Number(minRows || 1));
  minCols = Math.max(1, Number(minCols || 1));
  if (sh.getMaxRows() < minRows) {
    sh.insertRowsAfter(sh.getMaxRows(), minRows - sh.getMaxRows());
  }
  if (sh.getMaxColumns() < minCols) {
    sh.insertColumnsAfter(sh.getMaxColumns(), minCols - sh.getMaxColumns());
  }
}

function rscCompileGetSheetById_(ss, sheetId) {
  const sheets = ss.getSheets();
  for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (String(sheets[i].getSheetId()) === String(sheetId)) return sheets[i];
  }
  return null;
}

function rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(row, width) {
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < width; i++) {
    out.push(rscCompileNormalizeCellValue_(row[i]));
  }
  return out;
}

function rscCompileNormalizeCellValue_(value) {
  let text = String(value == null ? '' : value);
  text = text.replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ');
  text = text.replace(/\t+/g, ' ');
  text = text.replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ');
  text = text.trim();
  text = rscCompileNormalizeDropdownDisplayValue_(text);
  return text;
}

function rscCompileNormalizeDropdownDisplayValue_(text) {
  text = String(text == null ? '' : text).trim();
  if (!text) return '';

  // Ubah dropdown display menjadi ID-only:
  // "11 - Modern Trade" -> "11"
  // "STA1 - STA - CG Sales" -> "STA1"
  // "ZWS003 - Sales Rep. Food" -> "ZWS003"
  const m = text.match(/^([A-Za-z0-9]+)\s+-\s+.+$/);
  if (m) return m[1];

  return text;
}

function rscCompileEffectiveColumnCount_(header, dataRows) {
  let maxIdx = rscCompileLastNonEmptyIndex_(header || []);
  (dataRows || []).forEach(function (row) {
    maxIdx = Math.max(maxIdx, rscCompileLastNonEmptyIndex_(row || []));
  });
  return Math.max(1, maxIdx + 1);
}

function rscCompileLastNonEmptyIndex_(row) {
  for (let i = row.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    if (String(row[i] == null ? '' : row[i]).trim() !== '') return i;
  }
  return -1;
}

function rscCompileRowHasValue_(row) {
  for (let i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    if (String(row[i] == null ? '' : row[i]).trim() !== '') return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function rscCompileBuildHeaderLikeKey_(row) {
  return row.map(function (v) {
    return String(v == null ? '' : v).trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
  }).join('|');
}

function rscCompileBuildHeaderIndexMap_(header) {
  const map = {};
  header.forEach(function (h, i) {
    const key = rscCompileNormalizeHeaderKey_(h);
    if (key && !map[key]) map[key] = i;
  });
  return map;
}

function rscCompileNormalizeHeaderKey_(value) {
  return String(value == null ? '' : value)
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase()
    .replace(/\./g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/[^A-Z0-9]+/g, '_')
    .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '');
}

function rscCompileBuildBusinessKeyFromRow_(cfg, header, headerMap, row, fallbackRowNo) {
  const keyHeaderGroups = rscCompileGetBusinessKeyHeaderGroups_(cfg);
  const pieces = [];
  let hasAnyKeyValue = false;

  keyHeaderGroups.forEach(function (group) {
    const idx = rscCompileFindHeaderIndexFromAliases_(headerMap, group);
    const val = idx >= 0 ? rscCompileNormalizeKeyValue_(row[idx]) : '';
    if (val) hasAnyKeyValue = true;
    pieces.push(val);
  });

  if (hasAnyKeyValue) {
    return keyHeaderGroups.map(function (group, i) {
      return rscCompileNormalizeHeaderKey_(group[0]) + '=' + pieces[i];
    }).join('|');
  }

  // Fallback kalau header template bergeser ekstrem: pakai seluruh row bersih.
  return 'ROW_HASH=' + rscCompileHashString_(row.join('\u001f')) + '|SRC_ROW=' + String(fallbackRowNo || '');
}

function rscCompileBuildCompileKey_(cfg, fileId, businessKey) {
  return cfg.key + '|FILE=' + String(fileId || '') + '|' + String(businessKey || '');
}

function rscCompileFindHeaderIndexFromAliases_(headerMap, aliases) {
  for (let i = 0; i < aliases.length; i++) {
    const key = rscCompileNormalizeHeaderKey_(aliases[i]);
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(headerMap, key)) return headerMap[key];
  }
  return -1;
}

function rscCompileGetBusinessKeyHeaderGroups_(cfg) {
  if (cfg.key === 'ROLLING') {
    return [
      ['Customer ID', 'Customer', 'Cust ID', 'BP Number Source'],
      ['Relationship', 'Relationship Cat', 'Relationship Cat ID'],
      ['Salesman ID', 'Salesman'],
      ['Valid From'],
      ['Valid To'],
      ['Visit Category'],
      ['Visit Type'],
      ['Schedule Visit', 'Visit Schedule'],
      ['Visit Valid From'],
      ['Visit Valid To']
    ];
  }

  if (cfg.key === 'SALES_OFFICE') {
    return [
      ['BP Number Source', 'Customer ID', 'BP ID'],
      ['Delivering Plant'],
      ['Distr. Channel', 'Distribution Channel'],
      ['Division'],
      ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org'],
      ['Sales Office']
    ];
  }

  if (cfg.key === 'SALESMAN_TYPE') {
    return [
      ['Salesman ID', 'BP Number Source', 'Salesman'],
      ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org'],
      ['Sales Office'],
      ['Sales Type', 'Salesman Type'],
      ['Coverage'],
      ['Valid From'],
      ['Valid To']
    ];
  }

  return [];
}

function rscCompileNormalizeKeyValue_(value) {
  return rscCompileNormalizeCellValue_(value)
    .toUpperCase()
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

function rscCompileHashString_(text) {
  text = String(text == null ? '' : text);
  let hash = 2166136261;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    hash ^= text.charCodeAt(i);
    hash += (hash << 1) + (hash << 4) + (hash << 7) + (hash << 8) + (hash << 24);
  }
  return ('00000000' + (hash >>> 0).toString(16)).slice(-8);
}

function rscCompileNormalizeSheetName_(value) {
  return String(value == null ? '' : value)
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/&/g, 'and')
    .replace(/[\s_\-]+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}


function rscCompileGetMasterLinkCellText_(cellObj) {
  const pieces = [];

  try {
    if (cellObj && cellObj.richTextValue && typeof cellObj.richTextValue.getText === 'function') {
      pieces.push(cellObj.richTextValue.getText());
    }
  } catch (err) {}

  if (cellObj) {
    pieces.push(cellObj.formula);
    pieces.push(cellObj.value);
    pieces.push(cellObj.displayValue);
  }

  return pieces
    .map(function (v) { return String(v == null ? '' : v).trim(); })
    .filter(function (v, idx, arr) { return v && arr.indexOf(v) === idx; })
    .join(' | ')
    .trim();
}

function rscCompileIsBlankMasterLinkRow_(rawText, url, chipUrl) {
  return !String(rawText || '').trim() &&
    !String(url || '').trim() &&
    !String(chipUrl || '').trim();
}

function rscCompileBuildInvalidMasterLinkMessage_(rawText, url) {
  const text = String(rawText || url || '').trim();
  if (!text) return 'Link kolom E kosong/tidak valid.';

  if (/template rolling sales final/i.test(text) || /gunakan link/i.test(text)) {
    return 'Cell kolom E berisi placeholder/header, bukan link Google Sheet.';
  }

  if (/docs\.google\.com/i.test(text) && !/\/spreadsheets\/d\//i.test(text)) {
    return 'Cell kolom E berisi URL Google, tetapi bukan URL Google Spreadsheet.';
  }

  if (!/https?:\/\//i.test(text) && !/^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]{25,}$/.test(text)) {
    return 'Cell kolom E berisi teks/file name tanpa URL yang bisa dibaca. Jika ini smart chip, aktifkan Advanced Sheets API atau ganti menjadi URL plain.';
  }

  return 'Cell kolom E non-blank tetapi Spreadsheet ID tidak bisa diekstrak.';
}

function rscCompileExtractSpreadsheetId_(urlOrId) {
  const text = String(urlOrId == null ? '' : urlOrId).trim();
  if (!text) return '';

  let m = text.match(/\/spreadsheets\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);
  if (m) return m[1];

  m = text.match(/https?:\/\/docs\.google\.com\/spreadsheets\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/i);
  if (m) return m[1];

  if (/^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]{25,}$/.test(text) && text.indexOf('/') === -1) return text;
  return '';
}

function rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, key, field, amount) {
  if (!job.stats.configs[key]) return;
  job.stats.configs[key][field] = Number(job.stats.configs[key][field] || 0) + Number(amount || 0);
}

function rscCompileToast_(message) {
  try {
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
      message,
      'Rolling Sales Center',
      12
    );
  } catch (err) {}
}

/* ============================================================
 * PATCH 2026-06-25E - LOSSLESS COMPILE BY SOURCE ROW KEY
 * ============================================================
 * Koreksi dari hasil compare:
 * - Source row yang business key-nya sama tetap HARUS terbawa semua.
 * - Key check hanya untuk mencegah row yang sama terbawa berkali-kali
 *   karena link yang sama ada dobel atau job di-run ulang.
 * - Header source selalu row 1 sesuai instruksi user.
 * - Data source selalu mulai row 2; hanya full blank row yang dibuang.
 * - Tidak ada collapse berdasarkan Customer/Salesman/Relationship/etc.
 * ========================================================== */

function rscCompilePadNumberForKey_(num, width) {
  let s = String(Math.max(0, Number(num || 0)));
  while (s.length < width) s = '0' + s;
  return s;
}

function rscCompileBuildSourceRowCompileKey_(cfg, fileId, sourceSheetName, sourceRowNo) {
  return [
    String(cfg && cfg.key ? cfg.key : ''),
    'FILE=' + String(fileId || ''),
    'SHEET=' + rscCompileNormalizeSheetName_(sourceSheetName || ''),
    'SRC_ROW=' + rscCompilePadNumberForKey_(sourceRowNo, 8)
  ].join('|');
}

function rscCompileReadSourceSheet_(sourceSh, headerScanRows, cfg) {
  const lastRow = sourceSh.getLastRow();
  const lastCol = sourceSh.getLastColumn();

  if (lastRow < 1 || lastCol < 1) {
    return {
      header: [],
      dataRows: [],
      sourceRowNumbers: [],
      headerRow: 0,
      headerDetectMode: 'EMPTY',
      sourceSheetName: sourceSh.getName()
    };
  }

  const values = sourceSh.getRange(1, 1, lastRow, lastCol).getDisplayValues();

  // Sesuai request final: header = row 1 fixed, bukan hasil detect.
  const rawHeader = (values[0] || []).map(function (v) { return rscCompileNormalizeCellValue_(v); });
  const headerWidth = Math.max(1, rscCompileLastNonEmptyIndex_(rawHeader) + 1);
  const header = rawHeader.slice(0, headerWidth);

  // Guard: kalau row 1 benar-benar kosong, baru fallback ke detector lama agar tidak crash.
  if (!rscCompileRowHasValue_(header)) {
    const headerIdx = rscCompileFindSourceHeaderRowIndex_(values, cfg, headerScanRows);
    if (headerIdx < 0) {
      return {
        header: [],
        dataRows: [],
        sourceRowNumbers: [],
        headerRow: 0,
        headerDetectMode: 'ROW_1_EMPTY_AND_FALLBACK_NOT_FOUND',
        sourceSheetName: sourceSh.getName()
      };
    }

    const fallbackHeaderRaw = (values[headerIdx] || []).map(function (v) { return rscCompileNormalizeCellValue_(v); });
    const fallbackWidth = Math.max(1, rscCompileLastNonEmptyIndex_(fallbackHeaderRaw) + 1);
    const fallbackHeader = fallbackHeaderRaw.slice(0, fallbackWidth);
    const fallbackRows = [];
    const fallbackRowNumbers = [];

    for (let r = headerIdx + 1; r < values.length; r++) {
      const row = (values[r] || []).map(function (v) { return rscCompileNormalizeCellValue_(v); });
      if (!rscCompileRowHasValue_(row)) continue;
      fallbackRows.push(row.slice(0, Math.max(fallbackHeader.length, rscCompileLastNonEmptyIndex_(row) + 1)));
      fallbackRowNumbers.push(r + 1);
    }

    return {
      header: fallbackHeader,
      dataRows: fallbackRows,
      sourceRowNumbers: fallbackRowNumbers,
      headerRow: headerIdx + 1,
      headerDetectMode: 'FALLBACK_EXPECTED_TEMPLATE_HEADER_ROW_1_EMPTY',
      sourceSheetName: sourceSh.getName()
    };
  }

  const dataRows = [];
  const sourceRowNumbers = [];

  // Data selalu start row 2. Hanya full blank row yang dibuang.
  for (let r = 1; r < values.length; r++) {
    const row = (values[r] || []).map(function (v) { return rscCompileNormalizeCellValue_(v); });
    if (!rscCompileRowHasValue_(row)) continue;

    const width = Math.max(header.length, rscCompileLastNonEmptyIndex_(row) + 1);
    dataRows.push(row.slice(0, width));
    sourceRowNumbers.push(r + 1); // nomor row asli di source sheet
  }

  return {
    header: header,
    dataRows: dataRows,
    sourceRowNumbers: sourceRowNumbers,
    headerRow: 1,
    headerDetectMode: 'ROW_1_FIXED_BY_REQUEST',
    sourceSheetName: sourceSh.getName()
  };
}

function rscCompileGetStageMetaHeaders_() {
  return [
    '__COMPILE_KEY',
    '__SOURCE_FILE_ID',
    '__SOURCE_SHEET_NAME',
    '__SOURCE_ROW_NO',
    '__ROW_HASH',
    '__SOURCE_ORDER',
    '__TRACE_KEY'
  ];
}

function rscCompileStageSourceData_(targetSs, cfg, sourceData, fileId, job) {
  const stg = rscCompileGetOrCreateStagingSheet_(targetSs, cfg);
  const metaCols = rscCompileGetStageMetaHeaders_();

  let colCount = Number(job.outputColCountByKey[cfg.key] || 0);
  const sourceColCount = rscCompileEffectiveColumnCount_(sourceData.header, sourceData.dataRows);

  if (!colCount) {
    colCount = sourceColCount || sourceData.header.length || 1;
    job.outputColCountByKey[cfg.key] = colCount;
  } else if (sourceColCount > colCount) {
    // Jangan truncate kalau file berikutnya ternyata punya kolom template tambahan.
    // Existing rows akan otomatis blank di extra column saat dibaca ulang.
    colCount = sourceColCount;
    job.outputColCountByKey[cfg.key] = colCount;
  }

  const rowsToWrite = [];
  let headerWrittenNow = false;

  if (!job.headerWrittenByKey[cfg.key]) {
    rowsToWrite.push(metaCols.concat(rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(sourceData.header, colCount)));
    job.headerWrittenByKey[cfg.key] = true;
    headerWrittenNow = true;
  }

  const sourceSheetName = String(sourceData.sourceSheetName || cfg.sourceSheetName || '');
  const expectedRows = (sourceData.dataRows || []).length;

  (sourceData.dataRows || []).forEach(function (row, idx) {
    const sourceRowNo = Number((sourceData.sourceRowNumbers || [])[idx] || (idx + 2));
    const normalizedRow = rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(row, colCount);

    // Double guard. ReadSource sudah membuang full blank row, tetapi jangan pernah
    // buang row karena duplicate business key.
    if (!rscCompileRowHasValue_(normalizedRow)) return;

    const compileKey = rscCompileBuildSourceRowCompileKey_(cfg, fileId, sourceSheetName, sourceRowNo);
    const traceKey = 'FILE=' + String(fileId || '') + '|SHEET=' + sourceSheetName + '|SRC_ROW=' + sourceRowNo;
    const rowHash = rscCompileHashString_(normalizedRow.join('\u001f'));
    const sourceOrder = String(fileId || '') + '|' + rscCompilePadNumberForKey_(sourceRowNo, 8);

    rowsToWrite.push([
      compileKey,
      fileId,
      sourceSheetName,
      String(sourceRowNo),
      rowHash,
      sourceOrder,
      traceKey
    ].concat(normalizedRow));
  });

  const stagedRows = Math.max(0, rowsToWrite.length - (headerWrittenNow ? 1 : 0));
  if (stagedRows !== expectedRows) {
    throw new Error(
      'ROW_COUNT_MISMATCH saat staging ' + cfg.menuLabel +
      '. Expected nonblank source rows=' + expectedRows +
      ', staged=' + stagedRows +
      '. Script hanya boleh membuang full blank row; tidak boleh collapse duplicate business row.'
    );
  }

  if (!rowsToWrite.length) {
    return { rowsStaged: 0, headerWritten: headerWrittenNow };
  }

  const startRow = Number(job.stagingRowByKey[cfg.key] || 1);
  const writeCols = metaCols.length + colCount;
  rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(stg, startRow + rowsToWrite.length - 1, writeCols);
  const writeRange = stg.getRange(startRow, 1, rowsToWrite.length, writeCols);
  writeRange.setNumberFormat('@');
  writeRange.setValues(rowsToWrite);
  stg.hideSheet();

  job.stagingRowByKey[cfg.key] = startRow + rowsToWrite.length;
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  return {
    rowsStaged: stagedRows,
    headerWritten: headerWrittenNow
  };
}

function rscCompileReadStagingRows_(stg, cfg) {
  const metaCols = rscCompileGetStageMetaHeaders_().length;
  const lastRow = stg.getLastRow();
  const lastCol = stg.getLastColumn();
  if (lastRow < 1 || lastCol <= metaCols) return { header: [], rows: [] };

  const values = stg.getRange(1, 1, lastRow, lastCol).getDisplayValues();
  const header = values[0].slice(metaCols).map(function (v) { return rscCompileNormalizeCellValue_(v); });
  const effectiveCols = rscCompileEffectiveColumnCount_(header, values.slice(1).map(function (r) { return r.slice(metaCols); }));
  const finalHeader = rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(header, effectiveCols);
  const rows = [];

  for (let i = 1; i < values.length; i++) {
    const r = values[i];
    const key = String(r[0] || '');
    if (!key) continue;

    const dataRow = rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(r.slice(metaCols), effectiveCols);
    if (!rscCompileRowHasValue_(dataRow)) continue;

    rows.push({
      key: key,
      sourceFileId: String(r[1] || ''),
      sourceSheetName: String(r[2] || ''),
      sourceRowNo: String(r[3] || ''),
      rowHash: String(r[4] || rscCompileHashString_(dataRow.join('\u001f'))),
      sourceOrder: String(r[5] || ''),
      businessKey: String(r[6] || ''),
      row: dataRow
    });
  }

  return { header: finalHeader, rows: rows };
}

function rscCompileSyncOneConfigFromStage_(targetSs, cfg, job) {
  const outSh = rscCompileGetOrCreateOutputSheet_(targetSs, cfg.outputSheetName);
  const stg = rscCompileGetOrCreateStagingSheet_(targetSs, cfg);
  const metaSheet = rscCompileGetOrCreateMetaSheet_(targetSs);
  const previousIndex = rscCompileReadMetaIndex_(metaSheet, cfg);
  const staged = rscCompileReadStagingRows_(stg, cfg);

  // Collapse hanya untuk exact same source-row key, misalnya link yang sama
  // muncul dua kali di Rekap Approved. Ini BUKAN business duplicate check.
  const currentByKey = {};
  const orderedKeys = [];
  let duplicateKeysCollapsed = 0;

  staged.rows.forEach(function (item) {
    if (currentByKey[item.key]) {
      duplicateKeysCollapsed++;
      return; // first wins; duplicate link/source-row tidak ditulis dua kali.
    }
    currentByKey[item.key] = item;
    orderedKeys.push(item.key);
  });

  const header = staged.header.length ? staged.header : [];
  const colCount = header.length || Number(job.outputColCountByKey[cfg.key] || 0) || 1;

  const outputRows = [];
  if (header.length) {
    outputRows.push(rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(header, colCount));
    orderedKeys.forEach(function (key) {
      outputRows.push(rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(currentByKey[key].row, colCount));
    });
  }

  let inserted = 0;
  let updated = 0;
  let unchanged = 0;
  let deleted = 0;

  orderedKeys.forEach(function (key) {
    if (!previousIndex[key]) {
      inserted++;
    } else if (String(previousIndex[key].rowHash || '') !== String(currentByKey[key].rowHash || '')) {
      updated++;
    } else {
      unchanged++;
    }
  });

  Object.keys(previousIndex).forEach(function (key) {
    if (!currentByKey[key]) deleted++;
  });

  rscCompileRewriteOutputSheetClean_(outSh, outputRows, colCount);
  rscCompileRewriteMetaForConfig_(metaSheet, cfg, currentByKey, orderedKeys);

  try { stg.hideSheet(); } catch (err) {}
  try { metaSheet.hideSheet(); } catch (err) {}

  return {
    outputRows: Math.max(0, outputRows.length - (header.length ? 1 : 0)),
    inserted: inserted,
    updated: updated,
    deleted: deleted,
    unchanged: unchanged,
    duplicateKeysCollapsed: duplicateKeysCollapsed
  };
}

function rscCompileRewriteMetaForConfig_(metaSheet, cfg, currentByKey, orderedKeys) {
  const lastRow = metaSheet.getLastRow();
  const keep = [];

  if (lastRow >= 2) {
    const existing = metaSheet.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, Math.max(6, metaSheet.getLastColumn())).getDisplayValues();
    existing.forEach(function (r) {
      if (String(r[0] || '') !== cfg.outputSheetName) {
        keep.push(rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(r, 6));
      }
    });
  }

  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const keys = orderedKeys && orderedKeys.length ? orderedKeys : Object.keys(currentByKey);
  keys.forEach(function (key) {
    const item = currentByKey[key];
    if (!item) return;
    keep.push([
      cfg.outputSheetName,
      key,
      item.rowHash,
      item.sourceFileId,
      item.businessKey || ('SRC_ROW=' + (item.sourceRowNo || '')),
      now
    ]);
  });

  metaSheet.clear();
  rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(metaSheet, Math.max(1, keep.length + 1), 6);
  metaSheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, 6).setNumberFormat('@').setValues([[
    'OUTPUT_SHEET', 'COMPILE_KEY', 'ROW_HASH', 'SOURCE_FILE_ID', 'SOURCE_ROW_TRACE', 'UPDATED_AT'
  ]]);
  if (keep.length) {
    metaSheet.getRange(2, 1, keep.length, 6).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(keep);
  }
  rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(metaSheet, Math.max(1, keep.length + 1), 6);
  metaSheet.hideSheet();
}

function rscCompileBuildCompileKey_(cfg, fileId, businessKey) {
  // Backward-compatible wrapper. New compile mode should call
  // rscCompileBuildSourceRowCompileKey_ directly, but this prevents old calls
  // from collapsing by business key only.
  return cfg.key + '|FILE=' + String(fileId || '') + '|TRACE=' + String(businessKey || '');
}



/* ============================================================
 * PATCH 2026-06-25F - MASTER LINK MANIFEST + LOSSLESS FULL RUN
 * ============================================================
 * Masalah yang diperbaiki:
 * 1) Job lama scan row master per config. Jika banyak row kosong / smart chip
 *    tidak terbaca, kelihatan sudah selesai lalu pindah config sebelum semua
 *    link aktif terproses.
 * 2) Jumlah link aktif harus dibekukan dulu di awal job. Semua config wajib
 *    memproses manifest link yang sama sampai habis.
 * 3) Duplicate business row TIDAK dibuang. Key tetap source file + sheet + row.
 * 4) Output column count mengikuti header row 1 dari file valid pertama, tidak
 *    melebar karena trailing formatted columns di file lain.
 * ========================================================== */

function rscCompileLogValue_(value) {
  return (value === 0 || value === '0') ? '0' : (value || '');
}

function rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, level, phase, cfg, detail) {
  try {
    const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
    detail = detail || {};
    const targetSs = detail.targetSs || RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
    const sh = rscCompilePrepareDetailLogSheet_(targetSs);
    const headers = rscCompileGetDetailLogHeaders_();
    const nextRow = sh.getLastRow() + 1;
    const row = [
      new Date().toISOString(),
      (job && (job.runId || (job.stats && job.stats.runId))) || '',
      level || '',
      phase || '',
      cfg ? cfg.key : (detail.configKey || ''),
      cfg ? cfg.menuLabel : (detail.configLabel || ''),
      rscCompileLogValue_(detail.masterRow),
      detail.sourceFileId || '',
      detail.sourceSpreadsheetName || '',
      detail.sourceSheetName || '',
      cfg ? cfg.outputSheetName : (detail.targetSheetName || ''),
      rscCompileLogValue_(detail.headerRow),
      detail.headerDetectMode || '',
      rscCompileLogValue_(detail.sourceRows),
      rscCompileLogValue_(detail.stagedRows),
      rscCompileLogValue_(detail.outputRows),
      rscCompileLogValue_(detail.inserted),
      rscCompileLogValue_(detail.updated),
      rscCompileLogValue_(detail.deleted),
      rscCompileLogValue_(detail.unchanged),
      rscCompileLogValue_(detail.duplicateKeysCollapsed),
      detail.status || '',
      detail.message || ''
    ].map(rscCompileNormalizeLogCell_);

    rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(sh, nextRow, headers.length);
    sh.getRange(nextRow, 1, 1, headers.length).setNumberFormat('@').setValues([row]);
  } catch (err) {
    try { writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('Compile detail log failed: ' + formatScriptError_(err)); } catch (e) {}
  }
}

function rscCompileGetSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRangeRobust_(spreadsheetId, sheetName, startRow, sourceCol, numRows) {
  const map = {};
  try {
    if (typeof Sheets === 'undefined') return map;
    const chunkSize = 1000;
    for (let offset = 0; offset < numRows; offset += chunkSize) {
      const chunkStart = startRow + offset;
      const chunkRows = Math.min(chunkSize, numRows - offset);
      const a1 = quoteSheetNameForA1_(sheetName) + '!' +
        getColumnLetter_(sourceCol) + chunkStart + ':' +
        getColumnLetter_(sourceCol) + (chunkStart + chunkRows - 1);

      const res = Sheets.Spreadsheets.get(spreadsheetId, {
        ranges: [a1],
        includeGridData: true,
        fields: 'sheets(data(startRow,startColumn,rowData(values(formattedValue,hyperlink,userEnteredValue,effectiveValue,textFormatRuns(format(link)),chipRuns(chip(richLinkProperties(uri)))))))'
      });

      const sheets = res.sheets || [];
      for (let s = 0; s < sheets.length; s++) {
        const dataBlocks = sheets[s].data || [];
        for (let d = 0; d < dataBlocks.length; d++) {
          const data = dataBlocks[d] || {};
          const baseRow = Number(data.startRow != null ? data.startRow : (chunkStart - 1)); // zero-based
          const rowData = data.rowData || [];
          for (let r = 0; r < rowData.length; r++) {
            const rowNo = baseRow + r + 1;
            const values = rowData[r].values || [];
            const cell = values[0] || {};
            let found = '';

            if (cell.hyperlink) found = cell.hyperlink;

            if (!found && cell.chipRuns) {
              for (let c = 0; c < cell.chipRuns.length; c++) {
                const chip = cell.chipRuns[c] && cell.chipRuns[c].chip;
                if (chip && chip.richLinkProperties && chip.richLinkProperties.uri) {
                  found = chip.richLinkProperties.uri;
                  break;
                }
              }
            }

            if (!found && cell.textFormatRuns) {
              for (let t = 0; t < cell.textFormatRuns.length; t++) {
                const link = cell.textFormatRuns[t] && cell.textFormatRuns[t].format && cell.textFormatRuns[t].format.link;
                if (link && link.uri) {
                  found = link.uri;
                  break;
                }
              }
            }

            if (!found) {
              const textCandidates = [
                cell.formattedValue,
                cell.userEnteredValue && cell.userEnteredValue.stringValue,
                cell.effectiveValue && cell.effectiveValue.stringValue,
                cell.userEnteredValue && cell.userEnteredValue.formulaValue
              ];
              for (let k = 0; k < textCandidates.length; k++) {
                const m = String(textCandidates[k] || '').match(/https:\/\/docs\.google\.com\/spreadsheets\/d\/[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+[^\s"',)]*/);
                if (m) { found = m[0]; break; }
              }
            }

            if (found) map[rowNo] = found;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    try { writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('Manifest smart chip robust reader failed: ' + formatScriptError_(err)); } catch (e) {}
  }
  return map;
}

/* ============================================================
 * VALIDATE ALL FINAL LINKS IN COLUMN E — REKAP APPROVED
 * ========================================================== */
function legacyStartValidateAllFinalLinksInColumnE_() {
  const P = VALIDATE_ALL_FINAL_LINKS_PARAMETERS;
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName(P.masterSheetName);

  if (!sh) {
    throw new Error('Sheet master tidak ditemukan: ' + P.masterSheetName);
  }

  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.setProperty(P.pSsId, ss.getId());
  props.setProperty(P.pSheetId, String(sh.getSheetId()));
  props.setProperty(P.pHintRow, String(resolveValidateAllFirstDataRow_(sh)));
  props.deleteProperty(P.pLastStatus);
  props.setProperty(P.pRunToken, P.validationVersion + '|' + Utilities.getUuid());

  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);
  legacyContinueValidateAllFinalLinksInColumnE_();
}

function legacyContinueValidateAllFinalLinksInColumnE_() {
  const P = VALIDATE_ALL_FINAL_LINKS_PARAMETERS;
  const started = Date.now();
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const runToken = props.getProperty(P.pRunToken) || '';
  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(1000)) {
    writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('Validate ALL Kolom E: job lain sedang berjalan. Skip.');
    return;
  }

  try {
    const ss = getStoredSpreadsheetFromProperties_(P.pSsId);
    const sh = getStoredSheetFromProperties_(ss, P.pSheetId);
    const firstDataRow = resolveValidateAllFirstDataRow_(sh);
    const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();

    if (sh.getName() !== P.masterSheetName) {
      throw new Error('Job Validate ALL harus dijalankan pada sheet `' + P.masterSheetName + '`.');
    }

    if (lastRow < firstDataRow) {
      finishValidateAllFinalLinksJob_('Tidak ada link FINAL pada Rekap Approved kolom E.');
      return;
    }

    let cursor = Number(props.getProperty(P.pHintRow) || firstDataRow);
    if (cursor < firstDataRow) cursor = firstDataRow;
    if (cursor > lastRow) {
      finishValidateAllFinalLinksJob_('Validate ALL Kolom E sudah selesai.');
      return;
    }

    const rowCount = Math.min(P.masterReadChunkRows, lastRow - cursor + 1);
    const linkRange = sh.getRange(cursor, P.masterLinkCol, rowCount, 1);
    const displayValues = linkRange.getDisplayValues();
    const values = linkRange.getValues();
    const formulas = linkRange.getFormulas();
    const richTexts = linkRange.getRichTextValues();
    const backgrounds = linkRange.getBackgrounds();
    const notes = linkRange.getNotes();

    let chipMap = {};
    if (typeof getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_ === 'function') {
      try {
        chipMap = getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_(
          ss.getId(), sh.getName(), cursor, P.masterLinkCol, rowCount
        ) || {};
      } catch (err) {
        writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('Validate ALL Kolom E smart-chip fallback: ' + formatScriptError_(err));
      }
    }

    // Cache berat direset sekali per execution, lalu dipakai ulang untuk semua file dalam batch.
    if (typeof __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__ !== 'undefined') {
      __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__ = null;
    }
    if (typeof __SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_SYNC_INDEX_CACHE__ !== 'undefined') {
      __SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_SYNC_INDEX_CACHE__ = null;
    }
    resetBpExistenceDatabaseCache_();

    let processedRows = 0;
    let openedFiles = 0;
    let okFiles = 0;
    let errorFiles = 0;
    let skippedBlank = 0;
    const detailLog = [];
    const fileResultCache = {};

    for (let i = 0; i < rowCount; i++) {
      const masterRow = cursor + i;

      if (Date.now() - started > P.softDeadlineMs || openedFiles >= P.hardMaxFilesPerRun) {
        break;
      }

      processedRows = i + 1;
      const displayValue = cleanTextValue_(displayValues[i][0]);
      const rawValue = values[i][0];

      if (!displayValue && !cleanTextValue_(rawValue) && !chipMap[masterRow]) {
        skippedBlank++;
        continue;
      }

      const urlFromCell = getSpreadsheetUrlFromCellObject_({
        displayValue: displayValues[i][0],
        value: values[i][0],
        formula: formulas[i][0],
        richTextValue: richTexts[i][0]
      });
      const url = urlFromCell || chipMap[masterRow] || String(rawValue || displayValue || '');
      const fileId = extractSpreadsheetFileIdFromUrlOrId_(url);

      if (!fileId) {
        backgrounds[i][0] = P.colorError;
        notes[i][0] = 'ERROR Validate ALL: link/file ID tidak valid.';
        errorFiles++;
        detailLog.push('Row ' + masterRow + ': ERROR invalid link.');
        continue;
      }

      try {
        let cached = fileResultCache[fileId];
        if (!cached) {
          openedFiles++;
          const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(fileId);
          cached = { result: validateAllModulesForOneFinalFile_(targetSs) };
          fileResultCache[fileId] = cached;
        }
        if (cached.hardError) throw new Error(cached.hardError);

        const result = cached.result;
        const summary = truncateValidateAllNote_(
          P.validationVersion + ' | ' + result.summary,
          45000
        );

        if (result.hasError) {
          backgrounds[i][0] = P.colorError;
          notes[i][0] = 'ERROR Validate ALL: ' + summary;
          errorFiles++;
          detailLog.push('Row ' + masterRow + ': ERROR - ' + summary);
        } else {
          backgrounds[i][0] = P.colorOk;
          notes[i][0] = 'OK Validate ALL: ' + summary;
          okFiles++;
          detailLog.push('Row ' + masterRow + ': OK - ' + summary);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        const msg = formatScriptError_(err);
        fileResultCache[fileId] = { hardError: msg };
        backgrounds[i][0] = P.colorError;
        notes[i][0] = truncateValidateAllNote_('ERROR Validate ALL: ' + msg, 45000);
        errorFiles++;
        detailLog.push('Row ' + masterRow + ': HARD ERROR - ' + msg);
      }
    }

    // A new START may occur while an older Apps Script execution is still running.
    // Do not let that stale execution write notes/colors or schedule another continuation.
    if (runToken && props.getProperty(P.pRunToken) !== runToken) {
      writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('Validate ALL Kolom E: stale execution dibatalkan sebelum write.');
      return;
    }

    if (processedRows > 0) {
      sh.getRange(cursor, P.masterLinkCol, processedRows, 1)
        .setBackgrounds(backgrounds.slice(0, processedRows))
        .setNotes(notes.slice(0, processedRows));
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    }

    const nextCursor = cursor + processedRows;
    const status = {
      at: new Date().toISOString(),
      cursor: nextCursor,
      lastRow: lastRow,
      processedRows: processedRows,
      openedFiles: openedFiles,
      okFiles: okFiles,
      errorFiles: errorFiles,
      skippedBlank: skippedBlank
    };
    props.setProperty(P.pLastStatus, JSON.stringify(status));
    props.setProperty(P.pHintRow, String(nextCursor));
    if (detailLog.length) writeRollingSalesCenterLog_(detailLog.join('\n'));

    if (nextCursor <= lastRow) {
      scheduleTimeDrivenTrigger_(P.fn, P.triggerDelayMs);
      try {
        ss.toast(
          'Validate ALL pause di row ' + nextCursor +
          '. OK=' + okFiles + ', ERROR=' + errorFiles +
          ', blank=' + skippedBlank + '. Lanjut otomatis.',
          'Rolling Sales Center',
          10
        );
      } catch (err) {}
      return;
    }

    finishValidateAllFinalLinksJob_(
      'VALIDATE ALL KOLOM E SELESAI. OK=' + okFiles +
      ', ERROR=' + errorFiles + ', blank=' + skippedBlank + '.'
    );
  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (err) {}
  }
}

function legacyShowValidateAllFinalLinksInColumnEStatus_() {
  const P = VALIDATE_ALL_FINAL_LINKS_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const ss = getStoredSpreadsheetFromProperties_(P.pSsId);
  const sh = getStoredSheetFromProperties_(ss, P.pSheetId);
  const first = resolveValidateAllFirstDataRow_(sh);
  const last = sh.getLastRow();
  const cursor = Number(props.getProperty(P.pHintRow) || first);
  const raw = props.getProperty(P.pLastStatus);
  let lastStatus = '';

  if (raw) {
    try {
      const s = JSON.parse(raw);
      lastStatus = '\nBatch terakhir: opened=' + (s.openedFiles || 0) +
        ', OK=' + (s.okFiles || 0) +
        ', ERROR=' + (s.errorFiles || 0) +
        ', blank=' + (s.skippedBlank || 0) + '.';
    } catch (err) {}
  }

  const total = Math.max(0, last - first + 1);
  const done = Math.max(0, Math.min(total, cursor - first));
  const msg = 'Validate ALL Kolom E | total=' + total +
    ' | done≈' + done + ' | cursor=' + cursor +
    (cursor > last ? ' (SELESAI)' : '') + lastStatus;

  writeRollingSalesCenterLog_(msg);
  try { ss.toast(msg, 'Rolling Sales Center', 12); } catch (err) {}
}

  const P = VALIDATE_ALL_FINAL_LINKS_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.deleteProperty(P.pHintRow);
  props.deleteProperty(P.pRunToken);
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);
  try {
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
      'Validate ALL Kolom E dihentikan dan checkpoint dihapus.',
      'Rolling Sales Center',
      7
    );
  } catch (err) {}
}

  const P = VALIDATE_ALL_FINAL_LINKS_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.deleteProperty(P.pHintRow);
  props.deleteProperty(P.pRunToken);
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);

    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(message, 'Rolling Sales Center', 12);

function resolveValidateAllFirstDataRow_(sh) {
  try {
    if (typeof findCopyControlHeader_ === 'function') {
      const h = findCopyControlHeader_(sh);
      if (h && h.headerRow) return h.headerRow + 1;
    }
  } catch (err) {}

  const P = VALIDATE_ALL_FINAL_LINKS_PARAMETERS;
  const scanRows = Math.min(P.masterHeaderScanRows, Math.max(sh.getLastRow(), 1));
  const colValues = sh.getRange(1, P.masterLinkCol, scanRows, 1).getDisplayValues();
  for (let i = 0; i < colValues.length; i++) {
    const h = String(colValues[i][0] || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (h === 'template rolling sales final' || h === 'final link' || h === 'link final') {
      return i + 2;
    }
  }
  return P.firstDataRowFallback;
}

function validateAllModulesForOneFinalFile_(targetSs) {
  const result = RSC_STD_VALIDATE_WORKBOOK_20260814_(targetSs, { requireRolling: true });
  return {
    hasError: Number(result.errorRows || 0) > 0 || (result.systemErrors || []).length > 0,
    errorRows: Number(result.errorRows || 0),
    summary: RSC_STD_FORMAT_WORKBOOK_SUMMARY_20260814_(result),
    standardResult: result
  };
}

function validateRollingBusinessKeyAndBpType_(rollingSh, bpTypeMap) {
  const P = VALIDATE_ALL_FINAL_LINKS_PARAMETERS;
  ensureValidationStatusColumns_(rollingSh);
  const headerInfo = findRollingTemplateSyncHeaderInfo_(rollingSh);
  const expectedKeyCount = P.businessKeyHeaders.length;

  if (!headerInfo || !headerInfo.keyCols || headerInfo.keyCols.length !== expectedKeyCount) {
    throw new Error(
      'Canonical business key harus tepat ' + expectedKeyCount +
      ' kolom: ' + P.businessKeyHeaders.join(' + ')
    );
  }

  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(rollingSh);
  const cStatus = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.validationStatusHeader]);
  const cDetail = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.errorDetailHeader]);
  const cCustomer = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Customer ID', 'Customer Id', 'CustomerID']);
  const cSalesman = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Salesman ID', 'Salesman Id', 'SalesmanID']);
  const cBpType = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Salesman BP Type', 'Salesman BPType', 'BP Type']);

  if (!cStatus || !cDetail || !cCustomer || !cSalesman || !cBpType) {
    throw new Error('Header Validation Status / Error Detail / Customer ID / Salesman ID / Salesman BP Type tidak lengkap.');
  }

  const keyHeaderIndex = Object.create(null);
  for (let k = 0; k < P.businessKeyHeaders.length; k++) {
    keyHeaderIndex[P.businessKeyHeaders[k]] = k;
  }
  const visitTypeKeyIndex = keyHeaderIndex['Visit Type'];
  const optionalHeaders = Object.create(null);
  (P.optionalBusinessKeyHeadersForCustomerPrefix || []).forEach(function (name) {
    optionalHeaders[name] = true;
  });
  const optionalPrefix = String(P.customerPrefixWithOptionalVisitKey || '').trim().toUpperCase();

  const firstDataRow = headerInfo.headerRow + 1;
  const lastRow = rollingSh.getLastRow();
  if (firstDataRow > lastRow) {
    return {
      checkedRows: 0,
      duplicateRows: 0,
      incompleteRows: 0,
      optionalVisitRows: 0,
      bpTypeMissingRows: 0,
      errorRowsAdded: 0
    };
  }

  const n = lastRow - firstDataRow + 1;

  // Optimization: hanya baca sampai kolom terakhir yang benar-benar diperlukan,
  // bukan seluruh lebar sheet termasuk kolom helper/output di kanan.
  const requiredCols = headerInfo.keyCols.concat([cCustomer, cSalesman, cBpType]);
  const maxReadCol = Math.max.apply(null, requiredCols);
  const rows = rollingSh.getRange(firstDataRow, 1, n, maxReadCol).getDisplayValues();
  const statusRange = rollingSh.getRange(firstDataRow, cStatus, n, 1);
  const detailRange = rollingSh.getRange(firstDataRow, cDetail, n, 1);
  const statusVals = statusRange.getDisplayValues();
  const detailVals = detailRange.getDisplayValues();
  const statusBg = statusRange.getBackgrounds();
  const detailBg = detailRange.getBackgrounds();

  const seen = Object.create(null);
  const rowErrors = new Array(n);
  let checkedRows = 0;
  let duplicateRows = 0;
  let incompleteRows = 0;
  let optionalVisitRows = 0;
  let bpTypeMissingRows = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const row = rows[i];
    if (isRollingTemplateSyncBlankRow_(row)) continue;
    checkedRows++;

    const customerId = normalizeRollingTemplateSyncCellForKey_(row[cCustomer - 1]);
    const customerUsesOptionalVisitKey = Boolean(
      optionalPrefix && customerId && customerId.toUpperCase().indexOf(optionalPrefix) === 0
    );

    const errors = [];
    const keyParts = [];
    let usedOptionalVisitRule = false;

    for (let k = 0; k < headerInfo.keyCols.length; k++) {
      const col = headerInfo.keyCols[k];
      const raw = row[col - 1];
      const headerName = P.businessKeyHeaders[k];
      const normalized = k === visitTypeKeyIndex
        ? normalizeRollingTemplateVisitTypeKey_(raw)
        : normalizeRollingTemplateSyncCellForKey_(raw);

      keyParts.push(normalized);
      if (!normalized) {
        if (customerUsesOptionalVisitKey && optionalHeaders[headerName]) {
          usedOptionalVisitRule = true;
        } else {
          errors.push('Business key wajib lengkap: ' + headerName + '.');
        }
      }
    }

    if (usedOptionalVisitRule) optionalVisitRows++;
    if (errors.length) incompleteRows++;

    // Duplicate check hanya dijalankan untuk key yang valid. Untuk Customer ID S,
    // blank Visit Type / Visit Valid From merupakan bagian sah dari key tersebut.
    if (!errors.length) {
      const key = keyParts.join('||');
      if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(seen, key)) {
        duplicateRows++;
        errors.push('Business key duplikat dengan row ' + (firstDataRow + seen[key]) + '.');
        if (!rowErrors[seen[key]]) rowErrors[seen[key]] = [];
        rowErrors[seen[key]].push('Business key duplikat dengan row ' + (firstDataRow + i) + '.');
      } else {
        seen[key] = i;
      }
    }

    const salesmanId = normalizeSalesmanBpTypeSyncId_(row[cSalesman - 1]);
    const currentBpType = normalizeSalesmanBpTypeSyncBpType_(row[cBpType - 1]);
    if (salesmanId) {
      const expectedBpType = bpTypeMap[salesmanId];
      if (!expectedBpType) {
        bpTypeMissingRows++;
        errors.push('Salesman BP Type tidak ditemukan: Salesman ' + salesmanId + ' tidak ada di m_bp_general_view.');
      } else if (currentBpType !== expectedBpType) {
        errors.push('Salesman BP Type tidak sesuai m_bp_general_view. Expected=' + expectedBpType + '.');
      }
    }

    if (errors.length) {
      if (!rowErrors[i]) rowErrors[i] = [];
      Array.prototype.push.apply(rowErrors[i], errors);
    }
  }

  let errorRowsAdded = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const errors = rowErrors[i] || [];
    if (!errors.length) continue;
    errorRowsAdded++;

    const merged = mergeValidationErrorTexts_(detailVals[i][0], errors);
    statusVals[i][0] = 'ERROR';
    detailVals[i][0] = merged;
    statusBg[i][0] = P.colorError;
    detailBg[i][0] = P.colorError;
  }

  if (errorRowsAdded > 0) {
    statusRange.setValues(statusVals).setBackgrounds(statusBg);
    detailRange.setValues(detailVals).setBackgrounds(detailBg);
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  }

  return {
    checkedRows: checkedRows,
    duplicateRows: duplicateRows,
    incompleteRows: incompleteRows,
    optionalVisitRows: optionalVisitRows,
    bpTypeMissingRows: bpTypeMissingRows,
    errorRowsAdded: errorRowsAdded
  };
}

function mergeValidationErrorTexts_(existing, newErrors) {
  const seen = {};
  const out = [];
  String(existing || '').split('|').forEach(function (part) {
    const t = String(part || '').trim();
    if (t && !seen[t]) { seen[t] = true; out.push(t); }
  });
  (newErrors || []).forEach(function (part) {
    const t = String(part || '').trim();
    if (t && !seen[t]) { seen[t] = true; out.push(t); }
  });
  return out.join(' | ');
}

function scanValidationErrorsAcrossFinalFile_(targetSs, sheetLookup) {
  const P = VALIDATE_ALL_FINAL_LINKS_PARAMETERS;
  const sheetNames = [P.rollingSheetName, P.salesOfficeSheetName, P.salesmanTypeSheetName];
  const lookup = sheetLookup || buildValidationSheetLookup_(targetSs);
  let errorRows = 0;
  const details = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < sheetNames.length; i++) {
    const sh = getOptionalValidationSheet_(targetSs, sheetNames[i], null, lookup);
    if (!sh) continue;

    ensureValidationStatusColumns_(sh);
    const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
    const cStatus = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.validationStatusHeader]);
    if (!cStatus || sh.getLastRow() < 2) continue;

    const vals = sh.getRange(2, cStatus, sh.getLastRow() - 1, 1).getDisplayValues();
    let count = 0;
    for (let r = 0; r < vals.length; r++) {
      if (String(vals[r][0] || '').trim().toUpperCase() === 'ERROR') count++;
    }
    errorRows += count;
    details.push(sh.getName() + '=' + count);
  }

  return { errorRows: errorRows, details: details };
}

function buildValidationSheetLookup_(ss) {
  const sheets = ss.getSheets();
  const byExactName = Object.create(null);
  const byLowerName = Object.create(null);

  for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    const name = sheets[i].getName();
    byExactName[name] = sheets[i];
    byLowerName[String(name || '').toLowerCase()] = sheets[i];
  }

  return {
    sheets: sheets,
    byExactName: byExactName,
    byLowerName: byLowerName
  };
}

function getOptionalValidationSheet_(ss, exactName, fallbackRegex, sheetLookup) {
  const lookup = sheetLookup || buildValidationSheetLookup_(ss);
  let sh = lookup.byExactName[exactName] || null;
  if (sh) return sh;

  const truncated = String(exactName || '').substring(0, 31);
  if (truncated) {
    sh = lookup.byExactName[truncated] || null;
    if (sh) return sh;
  }

  if (fallbackRegex) {
    // Regex ber-flag g/y menyimpan lastIndex; reset agar hasil stabil tiap iterasi.
    fallbackRegex.lastIndex = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < lookup.sheets.length; i++) {
      const name = lookup.sheets[i].getName();
      fallbackRegex.lastIndex = 0;
      if (fallbackRegex.test(name)) return lookup.sheets[i];
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function truncateValidateAllNote_(value, maxLength) {
  const text = String(value || '');
  const limit = Math.max(100, Number(maxLength || 45000));
  return text.length > limit ? text.substring(0, limit - 20) + ' ...[truncated]' : text;
}


/* ============================================================
 * FSD VALIDASI UPLOAD — ACTIVE ROLLING AUTHORITATIVE VALIDATOR
 * Patch 2026-08-07
 *
 * Sumber rule: Functional Spec Document "Validasi Front-End Template Upload"
 * R1-R12. Validator ini sengaja memakai posisi A:P yang disepakati:
 * A Sales Office | B Delivering Plant | C Customer ID | D Relationship |
 * E Salesman ID | F Salesman BP Type | G Valid From | H Valid To |
 * I Visit Category | J Visit Type | K Schedule Visit |
 * L Visit Valid From | M Visit Valid To | N Reason |
 * O Validation Status | P Error Detail
 *
 * Catatan penting:
 * - Sales Office, Delivering Plant, dan Reason dipertahankan sebagai kolom template,
 *   tetapi bukan field rule R1-R12 pada FSD.
 * - Tidak memakai exception Customer ID prefix S pada validator FSD: Customer ID
 *   harus numerik sesuai FSD.
 * - Visit Type mengikuti FSD: tepat 2 digit. Tidak dibatasi 01-12 pada pass FSD.
 * - R8 FSD memakai Customer ID + Relationship + Salesman ID + Valid To,
 *   BUKAN canonical 6-key legacy Rolling.
 * - R1 mengecek Customer dan Salesman sama-sama ke m_bp_general_view.bp_id.
 * ========================================================== */
const RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807 = {
  expectedHeaders: [
    'Sales Office', 'Delivering Plant', 'Customer ID', 'Relationship',
    'Salesman ID', 'Salesman BP Type', 'Valid From', 'Valid To',
    'Visit Category', 'Visit Type', 'Schedule Visit',
    'Visit Valid From', 'Visit Valid To', 'Reason',
    'Validation Status', 'Error Detail'
  ],
  firstDataRow: 2,
  columns: {
    salesOffice: 1,
    deliveringPlant: 2,
    customerId: 3,
    relationship: 4,
    salesmanId: 5,
    salesmanBpType: 6,
    validFrom: 7,
    validTo: 8,
    visitCategory: 9,
    visitType: 10,
    scheduleVisit: 11,
    visitValidFrom: 12,
    visitValidTo: 13,
    reason: 14,
    status: 15,
    detail: 16
  },

  // R1/R3 master BP.
  bpDbSpreadsheetId: SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_SYNC_PARAMETERS.dbSpreadsheetId,
  bpDbSheetName: 'm_bp_general_view',
  bpIdHeader: 'bp_id',
  bpTypeHeader: 'bp_type_id',

  // R2 primary: updater database V2 menulis m_rel_salesman_type_rlt ke workbook relation.
  // Relation workbook dicoba pertama agar tidak membuang waktu membuka workbook yang tidak punya tab ini.
  relationshipDbSpreadsheetIds: [
    // PERF18: legacy/secondary relation master is on the separately-owned DB.
    '1JGo50yPN-Sei56O6eUc-QWONrlDxlWcV2cRhlsME7Cg',
    M_BP_RELATION_DB_PARAMETERS.spreadsheetId,
    SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_SYNC_PARAMETERS.dbSpreadsheetId
  ],
  relationshipDbSheetName: 'm_rel_salesman_type_rlt',
  relationshipIdHeader: 'rlt_id',

  // R2 fallback-safe: bila tab master R2 belum tersinkron, gunakan relationship_cat_id
  // yang memang ada pada m_bp_relation hasil source m_bp_relation_view.
  relationshipFallbackEnabled: true,
  relationshipFallbackDbSpreadsheetId: M_BP_RELATION_DB_PARAMETERS.spreadsheetId,
