  // R8b.
  relationDbSpreadsheetId: M_BP_RELATION_DB_PARAMETERS.spreadsheetId,
  relationDbSheetName: M_BP_RELATION_DB_PARAMETERS.sheetName,
  relationCustomerHeader: 'bp_id_rlt1',
  relationRelationshipHeader: 'relationship_cat_id',
  relationSalesmanHeader: 'bp_id_rlt2',
  relationValidToHeader: 'valid_to',

  // V23 capacity-safe: last-row scan A:N + seluruh read/write active sheet dan DB dibatasi per chunk.
  activeReadChunkRows: 800,
  activeWriteChunkRows: 800,
  dbReadChunkRows: 3000,
  maxCellsPerRange: 12000,
  maxDbHeaderScanColumns: 200,
  validationVersion: 'RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_V25_20260814_DUMMY_SALESMAN'
};

let __RSC_FSD_BP_ID_SET_CACHE_20260807 = null;
let __RSC_FSD_RELATIONSHIP_SET_CACHE_20260807 = null;
let __RSC_FSD_BP_TYPE_MAP_CACHE_20260807 = null;
let __RSC_FSD_LAST_DATA_ROW_CACHE_20260807 = Object.create(null);

/* ============================================================
 * AUTO NORMALIZE DATE FORMAT — FSD ACTIVE ROLLING
 * Patch 2026-08-07
 *
 * Tujuan:
 * - User boleh paste tanggal sebagai tanggal Google Sheets, YYYY-MM-DD,
 *   YYYY/MM/DD, DD/MM/YYYY, DD-MM-YYYY, atau DD.MM.YYYY.
 * - Selama tanggalnya valid, script mengubah representasinya menjadi
 *   YYYY-MM-DD secara otomatis sebelum R4/R9/R10/R11 dijalankan.
 * - Nilai tanggal tidak diganti ke tanggal bisnis lain; hanya format/
 *   representasi yang dinormalisasi.
 * - Tanggal mustahil (contoh 31/02/2026) tidak diubah dan tetap akan
 *   tertangkap sebagai ERROR R4.
 *
 * Kolom yang dinormalisasi:
 * G Valid From | H Valid To | L Visit Valid From | M Visit Valid To
 * ========================================================== */
function RSC_NORMALIZE_ACTIVE_ROLLING_DATE_FORMAT_20260807_(sh) {
  const P = RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807;
  RSC_ASSERT_FSD_ACTIVE_ROLLING_LAYOUT_20260807_(sh);

  const lastRow = RSC_GET_FSD_LAST_DATA_ROW_20260807_(sh);
  if (lastRow < P.firstDataRow) {
    return { checkedCells: 0, convertedCells: 0, invalidCells: 0, formattedColumns: 0, chunks: 0 };
  }

  const dateColumns = [
    { col: P.columns.validFrom, name: 'Valid From' },
    { col: P.columns.validTo, name: 'Valid To' },
    { col: P.columns.visitValidFrom, name: 'Visit Valid From' },
    { col: P.columns.visitValidTo, name: 'Visit Valid To' }
  ];

  const tz = (sh.getParent && sh.getParent().getSpreadsheetTimeZone)
    ? sh.getParent().getSpreadsheetTimeZone()
    : Session.getScriptTimeZone();

  const chunkRows = RSC_FSD_SAFE_CHUNK_ROWS_20260807_(1, P.activeReadChunkRows || 500);
  let checkedCells = 0;
  let convertedCells = 0;
  let invalidCells = 0;
  let formattedColumns = 0;
  let chunks = 0;
  const invalidExamples = [];

  for (let d = 0; d < dateColumns.length; d++) {
    const cfg = dateColumns[d];

    for (let start = P.firstDataRow; start <= lastRow; start += chunkRows) {
      const count = Math.min(chunkRows, lastRow - start + 1);
      const range = sh.getRange(start, cfg.col, count, 1);
      const rawValues = range.getValues();
      const displayValues = range.getDisplayValues();
      const formulas = range.getFormulas();
      const output = new Array(count);
      let chunkChanged = false;

      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const formula = formulas[i][0];
        const raw = rawValues[i][0];
        const display = String(displayValues[i][0] == null ? '' : displayValues[i][0]).trim();

        if (formula) {
          output[i] = [formula];
          if (display) checkedCells++;
          continue;
        }

        const rawBlank = raw === '' || raw === null;
        if (rawBlank && !display) {
          output[i] = [''];
          continue;
        }

        checkedCells++;

        if (raw instanceof Date && !isNaN(raw.getTime())) {
          output[i] = [raw];
          continue;
        }

        const parsed = RSC_PARSE_FLEXIBLE_DATE_INPUT_20260807_(raw, display, tz);
        if (!parsed.ok) {
          output[i] = [raw];
          invalidCells++;
          if (invalidExamples.length < 8) {
            invalidExamples.push(cfg.name + ' row ' + (start + i) + '="' + display + '"');
          }
          continue;
        }

        output[i] = [new Date(parsed.year, parsed.month - 1, parsed.day, 12, 0, 0, 0)];
        convertedCells++;
        chunkChanged = true;
      }

      if (chunkChanged) range.setValues(output);
      range.setNumberFormat('yyyy-mm-dd');
      chunks++;
    }
    formattedColumns++;
  }

  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  return {
    checkedCells: checkedCells,
    convertedCells: convertedCells,
    invalidCells: invalidCells,
    formattedColumns: formattedColumns,
    chunks: chunks,
    invalidExamples: invalidExamples.join(' | ')
  };
}

function RSC_PARSE_FLEXIBLE_DATE_INPUT_20260807_(rawValue, displayValue, timezone) {
  if (rawValue instanceof Date && !isNaN(rawValue.getTime())) {
    const ymd = Utilities.formatDate(rawValue, timezone || Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
    return RSC_PARSE_YMD_PARTS_20260807_(ymd);
  }

  const candidates = [];
  const rawText = String(rawValue == null ? '' : rawValue).trim();
  const displayText = String(displayValue == null ? '' : displayValue).trim();
  if (displayText) candidates.push(displayText);
  if (rawText && rawText !== displayText) candidates.push(rawText);

  for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
    let s = candidates[i].trim();
    if (!s) continue;

    // ISO date/time: ambil bagian tanggal di depan.
    let m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})(?:[T\s].*)?$/.exec(s);
    if (m) {
      const result = RSC_VALIDATE_DATE_PARTS_20260807_(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]), Number(m[3]));
      if (result.ok) return result;
    }

    // YYYY/MM/DD atau YYYY.MM.DD
    m = /^(\d{4})[\/.](\d{1,2})[\/.](\d{1,2})$/.exec(s);
    if (m) {
      const result = RSC_VALIDATE_DATE_PARTS_20260807_(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]), Number(m[3]));
      if (result.ok) return result;
    }

    // Format Indonesia: DD/MM/YYYY, DD-MM-YYYY, DD.MM.YYYY
    m = /^(\d{1,2})[\/.-](\d{1,2})[\/.-](\d{4})$/.exec(s);
    if (m) {
      const result = RSC_VALIDATE_DATE_PARTS_20260807_(Number(m[3]), Number(m[2]), Number(m[1]));
      if (result.ok) return result;
    }
  }

  return { ok: false };
}

function RSC_PARSE_YMD_PARTS_20260807_(ymd) {
  const m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(String(ymd || '').trim());
  if (!m) return { ok: false };
  return RSC_VALIDATE_DATE_PARTS_20260807_(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]), Number(m[3]));
}

function RSC_VALIDATE_DATE_PARTS_20260807_(year, month, day) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(year) || !Number.isInteger(month) || !Number.isInteger(day)) return { ok: false };
  if (year < 1000 || year > 9999 || month < 1 || month > 12 || day < 1 || day > 31) return { ok: false };

  const test = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
  if (
    test.getUTCFullYear() !== year ||
    test.getUTCMonth() !== month - 1 ||
    test.getUTCDate() !== day
  ) {
    return { ok: false };
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    year: year,
    month: month,
    day: day,
    ymd: String(year).padStart(4, '0') + '-' + String(month).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(day).padStart(2, '0')
  };
}

function RSC_VALIDATE_ACTIVE_ROLLING_AGAINST_FSD_20260807_(sh) {
  const P = RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807;
  RSC_ASSERT_FSD_ACTIVE_ROLLING_LAYOUT_20260807_(sh);

  const dateNormalization = RSC_NORMALIZE_ACTIVE_ROLLING_DATE_FORMAT_20260807_(sh);
  const lastRow = RSC_GET_FSD_LAST_DATA_ROW_20260807_(sh);

  if (lastRow < P.firstDataRow) {
    return {
      checkedRows: 0,
      frontendErrorRows: 0,
      backendErrorRows: 0,
      errorRows: 0,
      backendSkipped: false,
      ruleErrors: {},
      dateNormalization: dateNormalization,
      validationVersion: P.validationVersion
    };
  }

  const rowErrors = Object.create(null); // key = actual sheet row
  const ruleCounts = {};
  for (let r = 1; r <= 12; r++) ruleCounts['R' + r] = 0;

  const scheduleByCustomerSalesman = Object.create(null);
  const compositeByFsdKey = Object.create(null);
  const neededBpIds = Object.create(null);
  const neededSalesmanIds = Object.create(null);
  const neededDbKeys = Object.create(null);
  const neededTripleKeys = Object.create(null);
  let checkedRows = 0;

  function addRuleError_(sheetRow, rule, message) {
    if (!rowErrors[sheetRow]) rowErrors[sheetRow] = [];
    const text = '[' + rule + '] ' + message;
    if (rowErrors[sheetRow].indexOf(text) === -1) {
      rowErrors[sheetRow].push(text);
      ruleCounts[rule] = Number(ruleCounts[rule] || 0) + 1;
    }
  }

  const readChunkRows = RSC_FSD_SAFE_CHUNK_ROWS_20260807_(P.columns.reason, P.activeReadChunkRows || 500);

  // ========================
  // PASS 1 — FRONTEND R4-R12 + R7/R8a key collection
  // ========================
  for (let start = P.firstDataRow; start <= lastRow; start += readChunkRows) {
    const count = Math.min(readChunkRows, lastRow - start + 1);
    const rows = sh.getRange(start, 1, count, P.columns.reason).getDisplayValues();

    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      const sheetRow = start + i;
      const r = rows[i];
      if (isRowCompletelyBlank_(r)) continue;
      checkedRows++;

      const v = RSC_READ_FSD_ACTIVE_ROLLING_ROW_20260807_(r, P.columns);
      const pair = isSalesmanToSalesmanRolling_(v.customerId, v.salesmanId);

      // Tahap 1: required + format dasar.
      if (!v.customerId) addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R1', 'Customer ID wajib diisi.');
      if (!v.relationship) addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R2', 'Relationship wajib diisi.');
      if (!v.salesmanId) addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R1', 'Salesman ID wajib diisi.');
      if (!v.salesmanBpType) addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R3', 'Salesman BP Type wajib diisi.');
      if (!v.validFrom) addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R4', 'Valid From wajib diisi.');
      if (!v.validTo) addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R4', 'Valid To wajib diisi.');
      if (!pair) {
        if (!v.visitCategory) addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R5', 'Visit Category wajib diisi.');
        if (!v.visitType) addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R12', 'Visit Type wajib diisi.');
        if (!v.scheduleVisit) addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R6', 'Schedule Visit wajib diisi.');
        if (!v.visitValidFrom) addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R4', 'Visit Valid From wajib diisi.');
        if (!v.visitValidTo) addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R4', 'Visit Valid To wajib diisi.');
      }

      if (v.customerId && !/^\d+$/.test(v.customerId) && !pair) {
        addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R1', 'Format Customer ID harus numerik.');
      }
      if (v.relationship && !/^ZWS\d{3}$/.test(v.relationship)) {
        addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R2', 'Format Relationship harus ZWSnnn, contoh ZWS003.');
      }
      if (v.salesmanId && !isAllowedSalesmanId_(v.salesmanId)) {
        addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R1', getSalesmanIdValidationMessage_());
      }
      if (v.salesmanBpType && !/^ZD\d{2}$/.test(v.salesmanBpType)) {
        addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R3', 'Format Salesman BP Type harus ZDnn, contoh ZD01.');
      }

      const dValidFrom = v.validFrom ? parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(v.validFrom) : null;
      const dValidTo = v.validTo ? parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(v.validTo) : null;
      const dVisitFrom = v.visitValidFrom ? parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(v.visitValidFrom) : null;
      const dVisitTo = v.visitValidTo ? parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(v.visitValidTo) : null;

      if (v.validFrom && !dValidFrom) addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R4', 'Valid From harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
      if (v.validTo && !dValidTo) addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R4', 'Valid To harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
      if (!pair && v.visitValidFrom && !dVisitFrom) addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R4', 'Visit Valid From harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
      if (!pair && v.visitValidTo && !dVisitTo) addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R4', 'Visit Valid To harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');

      if (!pair && v.visitCategory && !/^(F1|F2|F4|F8)$/.test(v.visitCategory)) {
        addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R5', 'Visit Category harus F1, F2, F4, atau F8.');
      }
      if (!pair && v.visitType && !/^\d{2}$/.test(v.visitType)) {
        addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R12', "Visit Type harus berupa 2 digit angka, contoh '03' atau '12'.");
      }

      // Tahap 2: logika tanggal.
      if (dValidFrom && dValidTo && dValidTo.getTime() <= dValidFrom.getTime()) {
        addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R9', 'Valid To harus lebih besar dari Valid From.');
      }
      if (!pair && dVisitFrom && dVisitTo && dVisitTo.getTime() <= dVisitFrom.getTime()) {
        addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R10', 'Visit Valid To harus lebih besar dari Visit Valid From.');
      }
      if (!pair && dValidFrom && dValidTo && dVisitFrom && dVisitTo &&
          (dVisitFrom.getTime() < dValidFrom.getTime() || dVisitTo.getTime() > dValidTo.getTime())) {
        addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R11', 'Periode Visit Valid harus berada di dalam periode Valid From - Valid To.');
      }

      // Tahap 3: R6 Schedule Visit.
      if (!pair && v.visitCategory && v.scheduleVisit) {
        const scheduleErrors = RSC_VALIDATE_FSD_SCHEDULE_VISIT_20260807_(v.visitCategory, v.scheduleVisit);
        for (let k = 0; k < scheduleErrors.length; k++) {
          addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R6', scheduleErrors[k]);
        }
      }

      // Tahap 4: R7 + R8a.
      if (!pair && v.customerId && v.salesmanId && v.scheduleVisit) {
        const csKey = v.customerId + '||' + v.salesmanId;
        const sched = RSC_NORMALIZE_FSD_SCHEDULE_FOR_COMPARISON_20260807_(v.scheduleVisit);
        if (!scheduleByCustomerSalesman[csKey]) scheduleByCustomerSalesman[csKey] = Object.create(null);
        if (!scheduleByCustomerSalesman[csKey][sched]) scheduleByCustomerSalesman[csKey][sched] = [];
        scheduleByCustomerSalesman[csKey][sched].push(sheetRow);
      }

      const tripleKey = v.customerId && v.relationship && v.salesmanId
        ? [v.customerId, v.relationship, v.salesmanId].join('||') : '';
      if (tripleKey) neededTripleKeys[tripleKey] = true;
      const fsdKey = RSC_BUILD_FSD_COMPOSITE_KEY_20260807_(v.customerId, v.relationship, v.salesmanId, v.validTo);
      if (fsdKey) {
        if (!compositeByFsdKey[fsdKey]) compositeByFsdKey[fsdKey] = [];
        compositeByFsdKey[fsdKey].push(sheetRow);
        neededDbKeys[fsdKey] = true;
      }

      if (v.customerId) neededBpIds[v.customerId] = true;
      if (v.salesmanId) {
        neededBpIds[v.salesmanId] = true;
        neededSalesmanIds[v.salesmanId] = true;
      }
    }
  }

  Object.keys(scheduleByCustomerSalesman).forEach(function (key) {
    const schedules = Object.keys(scheduleByCustomerSalesman[key]);
    if (schedules.length <= 1) return;
    schedules.forEach(function (schedule) {
      scheduleByCustomerSalesman[key][schedule].forEach(function (sheetRow) {
        addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R7', 'Customer ID + Salesman ID yang sama tidak boleh memiliki Schedule Visit berbeda di baris lain.');
      });
    });
  });

  Object.keys(compositeByFsdKey).forEach(function (key) {
    const sheetRows = compositeByFsdKey[key];
    if (sheetRows.length <= 1) return;
    sheetRows.forEach(function (sheetRow) {
      addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R8', 'R8a: Composite key Customer ID + Relationship + Salesman ID + Valid To duplikat dalam template.');
    });
  });

  const frontendErrorRows = Object.keys(rowErrors).length;
  if (frontendErrorRows > 0) {
    const written = RSC_WRITE_FSD_VALIDATION_STATUS_CHUNKED_20260807_(sh, lastRow, rowErrors);
    return {
      checkedRows: checkedRows,
      frontendErrorRows: frontendErrorRows,
      backendErrorRows: 0,
      errorRows: written.errorRows,
      backendSkipped: true,
      ruleErrors: ruleCounts,
      layout: 'A:P OK',
      chunks: written.chunks,
      validationVersion: P.validationVersion,
      dateNormalization: dateNormalization
    };
  }

  // ========================
  // PASS 2 — BACKEND R1/R2/R3/R8b, semuanya chunk-safe dan relevant-only.
  // ========================
  const bpMaster = RSC_LOAD_FSD_BP_MASTER_SUBSET_20260807_(neededBpIds, neededSalesmanIds);
  const relationshipSet = RSC_GET_FSD_RELATIONSHIP_SET_20260807_();
  const existingDbKeys = RSC_LOAD_FSD_EXISTING_RELATION_KEYS_20260807_(neededDbKeys);
  const relationCtx = RSC_STD_LOAD_RELATION_CONTEXT_20260814_(neededTripleKeys, Object.create(null), Object.create(null));
  const relationExact = relationCtx.exact || Object.create(null);

  for (let start = P.firstDataRow; start <= lastRow; start += readChunkRows) {
    const count = Math.min(readChunkRows, lastRow - start + 1);
    const rows = sh.getRange(start, 1, count, P.columns.reason).getDisplayValues();

    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      const sheetRow = start + i;
      const r = rows[i];
      if (isRowCompletelyBlank_(r)) continue;
      const v = RSC_READ_FSD_ACTIVE_ROLLING_ROW_20260807_(r, P.columns);

      if (!bpMaster.exists[v.customerId]) {
        addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R1', 'Customer ID tidak ditemukan di m_bp_general_view.bp_id.');
      }
      if (!bpMaster.exists[v.salesmanId]) {
        addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R1', 'Salesman ID tidak ditemukan di m_bp_general_view.bp_id.');
      }
      if (!RSC_STD_IS_REGISTERED_RELATIONSHIP_20260814_(v.relationship, relationshipSet)) {
        addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R2', 'Relationship tidak terdaftar pada canonical LOV/master Relationship.');
      }

      if (bpMaster.exists[v.salesmanId]) {
        const expectedBpType = bpMaster.bpTypeById[v.salesmanId] || '';
        if (!expectedBpType) {
          addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R3', 'bp_type_id untuk Salesman ID tidak ditemukan di m_bp_general_view.');
        } else if (v.salesmanBpType !== expectedBpType) {
          addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R3', 'Salesman BP Type tidak sesuai master. Expected=' + expectedBpType + '.');
        }
      }

      const tripleKey = v.customerId && v.relationship && v.salesmanId
        ? [v.customerId, v.relationship, v.salesmanId].join('||') : '';
      const changeScheduleOnly = Boolean(tripleKey && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(relationExact, tripleKey));
      const fsdKey = RSC_BUILD_FSD_COMPOSITE_KEY_20260807_(v.customerId, v.relationship, v.salesmanId, v.validTo);
      if (fsdKey && existingDbKeys[fsdKey] && !changeScheduleOnly) {
        addRuleError_(sheetRow, 'R8', 'R8b: Composite key Customer ID + Relationship + Salesman ID + Valid To sudah ada di m_bp_relation.');
      }
    }
  }

  const backendErrorRows = Object.keys(rowErrors).length;
  const written = RSC_WRITE_FSD_VALIDATION_STATUS_CHUNKED_20260807_(sh, lastRow, rowErrors);

  return {
    checkedRows: checkedRows,
    frontendErrorRows: 0,
    backendErrorRows: backendErrorRows,
    errorRows: written.errorRows,
    backendSkipped: false,
    ruleErrors: ruleCounts,
    layout: 'A:P OK',
    chunks: written.chunks,
    validationVersion: P.validationVersion,
    dateNormalization: dateNormalization
  };
}

function RSC_ASSERT_FSD_ACTIVE_ROLLING_LAYOUT_20260807_(sh) {
  const P = RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807;
  if (sh.getMaxColumns() < P.expectedHeaders.length) {
    throw new Error('Layout template tidak lengkap. Wajib minimal A:P (16 kolom).');
  }

  const actual = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, P.expectedHeaders.length).getDisplayValues()[0];
  const mismatch = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < P.expectedHeaders.length; i++) {
    const expected = String(P.expectedHeaders[i]).trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').toLowerCase();
    const got = String(actual[i] || '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').toLowerCase();
    if (got !== expected) {
      mismatch.push(columnNumberToLetter_(i + 1) + ': expected "' + P.expectedHeaders[i] + '", got "' + String(actual[i] || '') + '"');
    }
  }
  if (mismatch.length) {
    throw new Error('Layout A:P tidak sesuai template FSD. ' + mismatch.join(' | '));
  }
  return true;
}

function RSC_READ_FSD_ACTIVE_ROLLING_ROW_20260807_(row, C) {
  function at_(col) { return cleanText_(row[col - 1]); }
  return {
    salesOffice: normalizeRscCodeToken_(at_(C.salesOffice)),
    deliveringPlant: normalizeRscCodeToken_(at_(C.deliveringPlant)),
    customerId: normalizeBpExistenceId_(at_(C.customerId)),
    relationship: normalizeRscCodeToken_(at_(C.relationship)),
    salesmanId: normalizeSalesmanIdForValidation_(at_(C.salesmanId)),
    salesmanBpType: normalizeRscCodeToken_(at_(C.salesmanBpType)),
    validFrom: at_(C.validFrom),
    validTo: at_(C.validTo),
    visitCategory: normalizeRscCodeToken_(at_(C.visitCategory)),
    visitType: normalizeRscVisitTypeToken_(at_(C.visitType)),
    scheduleVisit: normalizeRscScheduleToken_(at_(C.scheduleVisit)),
    visitValidFrom: at_(C.visitValidFrom),
    visitValidTo: at_(C.visitValidTo),
    reason: at_(C.reason)
  };
}

function RSC_VALIDATE_FSD_SCHEDULE_VISIT_20260807_(visitCategory, scheduleValue) {
  return RSC_STD_VALIDATE_SCHEDULE_RULES_20260814_(visitCategory, scheduleValue);
}

/**
 * FINAL R6 HARD GATE — AUTHORITATIVE
 *
 * Fungsi ini sengaja dijalankan PALING AKHIR oleh Run ALL Active Sheet Validation.
 * Tujuannya memastikan tidak ada validator/mutation legacy yang dapat meninggalkan
 * Validation Status = OK untuk Schedule Visit yang melanggar FSD R6.
 *
 * Contoh yang WAJIB ERROR untuk F2:
 * - W1S,W4S  -> minggu 1+4 tidak sah.
 * - W4S,W1F  -> hari berbeda DAN minggu 1+4 tidak sah.
 *
 * Contoh yang valid:
 * - W1S,W3S / W3S,W1S
 * - W2S,W4S / W4S,W2S
 */
function RSC_ENFORCE_FSD_R6_HARD_GATE_20260807_(sh) {
  const P = RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807;
  RSC_ASSERT_FSD_ACTIVE_ROLLING_LAYOUT_20260807_(sh);

  const lastRow = RSC_GET_FSD_LAST_DATA_ROW_20260807_(sh);
  if (lastRow < P.firstDataRow) {
    return { checkedRows: 0, r6ErrorRows: 0, correctedStatusRows: 0, chunks: 0, validationVersion: P.validationVersion };
  }

  const chunkRows = RSC_FSD_SAFE_CHUNK_ROWS_20260807_(P.columns.reason, P.activeWriteChunkRows || 500);
  let checkedRows = 0;
  let r6ErrorRows = 0;
  let correctedStatusRows = 0;
  let chunks = 0;

  for (let start = P.firstDataRow; start <= lastRow; start += chunkRows) {
    const count = Math.min(chunkRows, lastRow - start + 1);
    const data = sh.getRange(start, 1, count, P.columns.reason).getDisplayValues();
    const statusRange = sh.getRange(start, P.columns.status, count, 1);
    const detailRange = sh.getRange(start, P.columns.detail, count, 1);
    const statusVals = statusRange.getDisplayValues();
    const detailVals = detailRange.getDisplayValues();
    const statusBg = statusRange.getBackgrounds();
    const detailBg = detailRange.getBackgrounds();
    const statusFg = statusRange.getFontColors();
    const detailFg = detailRange.getFontColors();
    const statusFw = statusRange.getFontWeights();
    const detailWrap = detailRange.getWraps();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const row = data[i];
      if (isRowCompletelyBlank_(row)) {
        statusVals[i][0] = '';
        detailVals[i][0] = '';
        continue;
      }
      checkedRows++;

      const v = RSC_READ_FSD_ACTIVE_ROLLING_ROW_20260807_(row, P.columns);
      const r6 = [];

      if (!v.scheduleVisit) {
        r6.push('Schedule Visit wajib diisi.');
      } else if (v.visitCategory && /^(F1|F2|F4|F8)$/.test(v.visitCategory)) {
        Array.prototype.push.apply(r6, RSC_VALIDATE_FSD_SCHEDULE_VISIT_20260807_(v.visitCategory, v.scheduleVisit));
      }

      const otherErrors = RSC_REMOVE_RULE_FROM_ERROR_DETAIL_20260807_(detailVals[i][0], 'R6');
      const mergedErrors = otherErrors.slice();
      for (let k = 0; k < r6.length; k++) {
        const msg = '[R6] ' + r6[k];
        if (mergedErrors.indexOf(msg) === -1) mergedErrors.push(msg);
      }

      const hadR6Before = RSC_ERROR_DETAIL_HAS_RULE_20260807_(detailVals[i][0], 'R6');
      if (r6.length) {
        r6ErrorRows++;
        if (String(statusVals[i][0] || '').trim().toUpperCase() !== 'ERROR' || !hadR6Before) correctedStatusRows++;
        statusVals[i][0] = 'ERROR';
        detailVals[i][0] = mergedErrors.join(' | ');
        statusBg[i][0] = TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.error;
        detailBg[i][0] = TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.error;
        statusFg[i][0] = '#991B1B';
        detailFg[i][0] = '#991B1B';
        statusFw[i][0] = 'bold';
        detailWrap[i][0] = true;
      } else if (mergedErrors.length) {
        statusVals[i][0] = 'ERROR';
        detailVals[i][0] = mergedErrors.join(' | ');
        statusBg[i][0] = TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.error;
        detailBg[i][0] = TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.error;
        statusFg[i][0] = '#991B1B';
        detailFg[i][0] = '#991B1B';
        statusFw[i][0] = 'bold';
        detailWrap[i][0] = true;
      } else {
        if (String(statusVals[i][0] || '').trim().toUpperCase() === 'ERROR' && hadR6Before) correctedStatusRows++;
        statusVals[i][0] = 'OK';
        detailVals[i][0] = '';
        statusBg[i][0] = TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.ok;
        detailBg[i][0] = TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.ok;
        statusFg[i][0] = '#166534';
        detailFg[i][0] = '#166534';
        statusFw[i][0] = 'bold';
        detailWrap[i][0] = false;
      }
    }

    statusRange.setValues(statusVals).setBackgrounds(statusBg).setFontColors(statusFg).setFontWeights(statusFw);
    detailRange.setValues(detailVals).setBackgrounds(detailBg).setFontColors(detailFg).setWraps(detailWrap);
    chunks++;
  }

  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  return {
    checkedRows: checkedRows,
    r6ErrorRows: r6ErrorRows,
    correctedStatusRows: correctedStatusRows,
    chunks: chunks,
    validationVersion: P.validationVersion
  };
}

function RSC_REMOVE_RULE_FROM_ERROR_DETAIL_20260807_(detail, rule) {
  const prefix = '[' + String(rule || '').trim().toUpperCase() + ']';
  const parts = String(detail || '')
    .split('|')
    .map(function (x) { return String(x || '').trim(); })
    .filter(Boolean);

  return parts.filter(function (part) {
    return part.toUpperCase().indexOf(prefix) !== 0;
  });
}

function RSC_ERROR_DETAIL_HAS_RULE_20260807_(detail, rule) {
  const prefix = '[' + String(rule || '').trim().toUpperCase() + ']';
  return String(detail || '')
    .split('|')
    .some(function (part) {
      return String(part || '').trim().toUpperCase().indexOf(prefix) === 0;
    });
}

/**
 * Self-test tanpa akses sheet/database. Bisa dijalankan dari Apps Script editor.
 * PASS yang diharapkan:
 *   F2 W1S,W3S = OK
 *   F2 W2S,W4S = OK
 *   F2 W1S,W4S = ERROR
 *   F2 W4S,W1F = ERROR
 */
function RSC_SELF_TEST_FSD_R6_V23_20260807() {
  const cases = [
    { category: 'F2', schedule: 'W1S,W3S', expectError: false },
    { category: 'F2', schedule: 'W3S,W1S', expectError: false },
    { category: 'F2', schedule: 'W2S,W4S', expectError: false },
    { category: 'F2', schedule: 'W4S,W2S', expectError: false },
    { category: 'F2', schedule: 'W1S,W4S', expectError: true },
    { category: 'F2', schedule: 'W4S,W1F', expectError: true }
  ];

  const result = [];
  let failed = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < cases.length; i++) {
    const c = cases[i];
    const errors = RSC_VALIDATE_FSD_SCHEDULE_VISIT_20260807_(c.category, c.schedule);
    const actualError = errors.length > 0;
    const pass = actualError === c.expectError;
    if (!pass) failed++;
    result.push({
      category: c.category,
      schedule: c.schedule,
      expected: c.expectError ? 'ERROR' : 'OK',
      actual: actualError ? 'ERROR' : 'OK',
      pass: pass,
      detail: errors.join(' | ')
    });
  }

  const message = 'R6 V23 self-test: ' + (failed ? 'FAILED=' + failed : 'ALL PASS') + '\n' +
    result.map(function (x) {
      return (x.pass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL') + ' | ' + x.category + ' | ' + x.schedule +
        ' | expected=' + x.expected + ' actual=' + x.actual +
        (x.detail ? ' | ' + x.detail : '');
    }).join('\n');

  Logger.log(message);
  try { SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(message); } catch (ignore) {}
  return { failed: failed, cases: result };
}

function RSC_NORMALIZE_FSD_SCHEDULE_FOR_COMPARISON_20260807_(value) {
  return normalizeRscScheduleToken_(value);
}

function RSC_BUILD_FSD_COMPOSITE_KEY_20260807_(customerId, relationship, salesmanId, validTo) {
  const a = normalizeBpExistenceId_(customerId);
  const b = String(relationship || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  const c = normalizeBpExistenceId_(salesmanId);
  const d = String(validTo || '').trim();
  if (!a || !b || !c || !d) return '';
  return [a, b, c, d].join('||');
}



/* ============================================================
 * V22 CAPACITY-SAFE HELPERS — ACTIVE FSD VALIDATION
 * ========================================================== */
function RSC_FSD_SAFE_CHUNK_ROWS_20260807_(width, desiredRows) {
  const P = RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807;
  const w = Math.max(1, Number(width || 1));
  const desired = Math.max(1, Number(desiredRows || 500));
  const byCells = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(P.maxCellsPerRange || 12000) / w));
  return Math.max(1, Math.min(desired, byCells));
}

function RSC_GET_FSD_LAST_DATA_ROW_20260807_(sh) {
  const P = RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807;
  if (!sh) return P.firstDataRow - 1;

  const sheetLastRow = Math.min(
    Number(sh.getLastRow() || 0),
    Number(sh.getMaxRows() || 0),
    Number(TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.maxRows || sh.getMaxRows() || 0)
  );

  if (sheetLastRow < P.firstDataRow) return P.firstDataRow - 1;

  // Cache hanya hidup selama satu Apps Script execution.
  // Key memasukkan getLastRow() agar aman bila execution yang sama menambah/menghapus row.
  const cacheKey = String(sh.getSheetId()) + '|' + String(sheetLastRow);
  if (
    __RSC_FSD_LAST_DATA_ROW_CACHE_20260807 &&
    Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(__RSC_FSD_LAST_DATA_ROW_CACHE_20260807, cacheKey)
  ) {
    return __RSC_FSD_LAST_DATA_ROW_CACHE_20260807[cacheKey];
  }

  // V23 FIX:
  // Jangan memakai getNextDataCell(Direction.UP) untuk menentukan last data row.
  // Pada sheet dengan blank-region besar, method tersebut dapat kembali ke header/
  // boundary blank-region dan menyebabkan validator menganggap checkedRows=0.
  //
  // Scan dilakukan dari bawah ke atas, hanya A:N, dan per chunk kecil.
  const width = P.columns.reason; // A:N
  const chunkRows = RSC_FSD_SAFE_CHUNK_ROWS_20260807_(
    width,
    P.activeReadChunkRows || 400
  );

  let found = P.firstDataRow - 1;

  for (let endRow = sheetLastRow; endRow >= P.firstDataRow;) {
    const startRow = Math.max(
      P.firstDataRow,
      endRow - chunkRows + 1
    );
    const count = endRow - startRow + 1;

    const rows = sh.getRange(
      startRow,
      1,
      count,
      width
    ).getDisplayValues();

    for (let i = rows.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (!isRowCompletelyBlank_(rows[i])) {
        found = startRow + i;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (found >= P.firstDataRow) break;
    endRow = startRow - 1;
  }

  __RSC_FSD_LAST_DATA_ROW_CACHE_20260807[cacheKey] = found;
  return found;
}

function RSC_WRITE_FSD_VALIDATION_STATUS_CHUNKED_20260807_(sh, lastRow, rowErrorsByRow, rowHasDataByRow) {
  const P = RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807;
  if (lastRow < P.firstDataRow) return { errorRows: 0, okRows: 0, chunks: 0 };
  const chunkRows = RSC_FSD_SAFE_CHUNK_ROWS_20260807_(2, P.activeWriteChunkRows || 500);
  let errorRows = 0, okRows = 0, chunks = 0;
  const adjacent = Number(P.columns.detail) === Number(P.columns.status) + 1;

  for (let start = P.firstDataRow; start <= lastRow; start += chunkRows) {
    const count = Math.min(chunkRows, lastRow - start + 1);
    const data = rowHasDataByRow ? null : sh.getRange(start, 1, count, P.columns.reason).getDisplayValues();
    const values = new Array(count), backgrounds = new Array(count), fontColors = new Array(count), fontWeights = new Array(count), wraps = new Array(count);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const sheetRow = start + i;
      const hasData = rowHasDataByRow ? Boolean(rowHasDataByRow[sheetRow]) : !isRowCompletelyBlank_(data[i]);
      if (!hasData) {
        values[i] = ['', '']; backgrounds[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.input, TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.input];
        fontColors[i] = ['#000000', '#000000']; fontWeights[i] = ['normal', 'normal']; wraps[i] = [false, false];
        continue;
      }
      const errors = (rowErrorsByRow && rowErrorsByRow[sheetRow]) || [];
      if (errors.length) {
        errorRows++; values[i] = ['ERROR', deduplicateArray_(errors).join(' | ')];
        backgrounds[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.error, TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.error];
        fontColors[i] = ['#991B1B', '#991B1B']; fontWeights[i] = ['bold', 'normal']; wraps[i] = [false, true];
      } else {
        okRows++; values[i] = ['OK', ''];
        backgrounds[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.ok, TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.ok];
        fontColors[i] = ['#166534', '#166534']; fontWeights[i] = ['bold', 'normal']; wraps[i] = [false, false];
      }
    }
    if (adjacent) {
      sh.getRange(start, P.columns.status, count, 2)
        .setValues(values).setBackgrounds(backgrounds).setFontColors(fontColors).setFontWeights(fontWeights).setWraps(wraps);
    } else {
      const statusVals = values.map(function (r) { return [r[0]]; }), detailVals = values.map(function (r) { return [r[1]]; });
      sh.getRange(start, P.columns.status, count, 1).setValues(statusVals);
      sh.getRange(start, P.columns.detail, count, 1).setValues(detailVals);
    }
    chunks++;
  }
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  return { errorRows: errorRows, okRows: okRows, chunks: chunks };
}

function RSC_WRITE_FSD_SYSTEM_ERROR_TO_OP_20260807_(sh, label, err) {
  const P = RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807;
  try {
    RSC_ASSERT_FSD_ACTIVE_ROLLING_LAYOUT_20260807_(sh);
    const lastRow = RSC_GET_FSD_LAST_DATA_ROW_20260807_(sh);
    if (lastRow < P.firstDataRow) return { markedRows: 0, chunks: 0 };

    const chunkRows = RSC_FSD_SAFE_CHUNK_ROWS_20260807_(P.columns.reason, P.activeWriteChunkRows || 500);
    const msg = '[SYSTEM] ' + String(label || 'FSD Validation') + ': ' + formatScriptError_(err);
    let markedRows = 0;
    let chunks = 0;

    for (let start = P.firstDataRow; start <= lastRow; start += chunkRows) {
      const count = Math.min(chunkRows, lastRow - start + 1);
      const data = sh.getRange(start, 1, count, P.columns.reason).getDisplayValues();
      const statusVals = new Array(count);
      const detailVals = new Array(count);
      const statusBg = new Array(count);
      const detailBg = new Array(count);

      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        if (isRowCompletelyBlank_(data[i])) {
          statusVals[i] = [''];
          detailVals[i] = [''];
          statusBg[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.input];
          detailBg[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.input];
        } else {
          markedRows++;
          statusVals[i] = ['ERROR'];
          detailVals[i] = [msg];
          statusBg[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.error];
          detailBg[i] = [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.error];
        }
      }

      sh.getRange(start, P.columns.status, count, 1)
        .setValues(statusVals).setBackgrounds(statusBg).setFontColor('#991B1B').setFontWeight('bold');
      sh.getRange(start, P.columns.detail, count, 1)
        .setValues(detailVals).setBackgrounds(detailBg).setFontColor('#991B1B').setWrap(true);
      chunks++;
    }
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    return { markedRows: markedRows, chunks: chunks };
  } catch (writeErr) {
    writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('Gagal menulis system error ke O/P: ' + formatScriptError_(writeErr));
    return { markedRows: 0, chunks: 0, writeError: formatScriptError_(writeErr) };
  }
}

function RSC_V28_2_CACHE_KEY_20260814_(prefix, raw) {
  const p = String(prefix || 'RSC28');
  const value = String(raw == null ? '' : raw);
  const epoch = (typeof RSC_PERF13_GET_CACHE_EPOCH_20260819_ === 'function')
    ? RSC_PERF13_GET_CACHE_EPOCH_20260819_()
    : '0';
  const direct = 'RSC5|' + epoch + '|' + p + '|' + value;
  if (direct.length <= 230) return direct;
  return 'RSC5|' + epoch + '|' + p + '|H|' + RSC_PERF5_FAST_HASH_20260819_(value) + '|' + value.length;
}

function RSC_V28_2_CACHE_GET_ALL_20260814_(prefix, rawKeys) {
  const out = Object.create(null), keys = Object.keys(rawKeys || {});
  if (!keys.length) return out;
  const p = String(prefix || 'RSC28');
  let local = __RSC_PERF5_LOCAL_CACHE_20260819__[p];
  if (!local) local = __RSC_PERF5_LOCAL_CACHE_20260819__[p] = Object.create(null);
  const remoteNeeded = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    const k = keys[i];
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(local, k)) {
      out[k] = local[k];
      RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('localCacheHit.' + p, 1);
    } else remoteNeeded.push(k);
  }
  if (!remoteNeeded.length) return out;
  try {
    const cache = CacheService.getScriptCache();
    for (let start = 0; start < remoteNeeded.length; start += 500) {
      const part = remoteNeeded.slice(start, start + 500);
      const cacheKeys = part.map(function (k) { return RSC_V28_2_CACHE_KEY_20260814_(p, k); });
      const found = cache.getAll(cacheKeys) || {};
      RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('scriptCacheGetAllCalls', 1);
      for (let i = 0; i < part.length; i++) {
        if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(found, cacheKeys[i])) {
          out[part[i]] = found[cacheKeys[i]];
          local[part[i]] = found[cacheKeys[i]];
          RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('scriptCacheHit.' + p, 1);
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (ignore) {}
  return out;
}

function RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_(prefix, rawValueMap, ttlSeconds) {
  const rawKeys = Object.keys(rawValueMap || {});
  if (!rawKeys.length) return;
  const p = String(prefix || 'RSC28');
  let local = __RSC_PERF5_LOCAL_CACHE_20260819__[p];
  if (!local) local = __RSC_PERF5_LOCAL_CACHE_20260819__[p] = Object.create(null);
  rawKeys.forEach(function (k) { local[k] = String(rawValueMap[k]); });
  try {
    const cache = CacheService.getScriptCache();
    for (let start = 0; start < rawKeys.length; start += 500) {
      const part = rawKeys.slice(start, start + 500), payload = {};
      part.forEach(function (k) { payload[RSC_V28_2_CACHE_KEY_20260814_(p, k)] = String(rawValueMap[k]); });
      cache.putAll(payload, Math.max(30, Number(ttlSeconds || 600)));
      RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('scriptCachePutAllCalls', 1);
    }
  } catch (ignore) {}
}

function RSC_LOAD_FSD_BP_MASTER_SUBSET_20260807_(neededBpIds, neededSalesmanIds) {
  const P = RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807;
  const wanted = Object.create(null);
  Object.keys(neededBpIds || {}).forEach(function (raw) {
    const id = normalizeBpExistenceId_(raw);
    if (id && RSC_PERF5_IS_LOOKUP_ID_20260819_(id)) wanted[id] = true;
  });
  const exists = Object.create(null), bpTypeById = Object.create(null);
  const neededCount = Object.keys(wanted).length;
  if (!neededCount) return { exists: exists, bpTypeById: bpTypeById, scannedRows: 0, lookupMode: 'EMPTY' };

  const cached = RSC_V28_2_CACHE_GET_ALL_20260814_('BP', wanted);
  const missing = Object.create(null);
  let cacheHits = 0;
  Object.keys(wanted).forEach(function (id) {
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cached, id)) {
      cacheHits++;
      const parts = String(cached[id] || '0').split('|');
      if (parts[0] === '1') {
        exists[id] = true;
        if (parts[1]) bpTypeById[id] = normalizeRscCodeToken_(parts[1]);
      }
    } else missing[id] = true;
  });
  const missingCount = Object.keys(missing).length;
  if (!missingCount) return { exists: exists, bpTypeById: bpTypeById, scannedRows: 0, cacheHits: cacheHits, cacheMisses: 0, lookupMode: 'CACHE' };

  // PERF19: compact persistent lookup generated by the DB updater. This avoids
  // TextFinder/full scans against the large external workbook.
  if (typeof RSC_PERF19_DB_20260819!=='undefined' && RSC_PERF19_DB_20260819.preferGeneratedLookup!==false && typeof RSC_PERF19_LOOKUP_BP_20260819_ === 'function') {
    const fast = RSC_PERF19_LOOKUP_BP_20260819_(missing);
    if (fast && fast.available) {
      Object.keys(fast.exists || {}).forEach(function(id){ exists[id] = true; });
      Object.keys(fast.bpTypeById || {}).forEach(function(id){ bpTypeById[id] = fast.bpTypeById[id]; });
      const positive = Object.create(null), negative = Object.create(null);
      Object.keys(missing).forEach(function(id){
        if (exists[id]) positive[id] = '1|' + String(bpTypeById[id] || '');
        else negative[id] = '0';
      });
      RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('BP', positive, RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819.positiveCacheTtlSec);
      RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('BP', negative, RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819.negativeCacheTtlSec);
      return { exists: exists, bpTypeById: bpTypeById, scannedRows: Number(fast.recordsRead || 0), cacheHits: cacheHits, cacheMisses: missingCount, lookupMode: fast.lookupMode || 'REST_BUCKET_LOOKUP' };
    }
  }
  const ss = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.bpDbSpreadsheetId);
  const sh = RSC_PERF5_GET_SHEET_20260819_(ss, P.bpDbSheetName);
  if (!sh) throw new Error('FSD database sheet tidak ditemukan: ' + P.bpDbSheetName + '.');
  const lastRow = sh.getLastRow(), lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  if (lastRow < 2 || lastCol < 1) return { exists: exists, bpTypeById: bpTypeById, scannedRows: 0, lookupMode: 'EMPTY_DB' };

  const headerCols = Math.min(lastCol, P.maxDbHeaderScanColumns || 200);
  const headers = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, headerCols).getDisplayValues()[0];
  const cBp = findValidateDateCol_(headers, [P.bpIdHeader]);
  const cType = findValidateDateCol_(headers, [P.bpTypeHeader]);
  if (!cBp || !cType) throw new Error('FSD R1/R3 header ' + P.bpDbSheetName + ' tidak lengkap. Wajib ada ' + P.bpIdHeader + ' dan ' + P.bpTypeHeader + '.');

  const minCol = Math.min(cBp, cType), maxCol = Math.max(cBp, cType), width = maxCol - minCol + 1;
  const relBp = cBp - minCol, relType = cType - minCol;
  let scannedRows = 0, lookupMode = 'TEXTFINDER';

  const targeted = RSC_PERF23_READ_TABULAR_CANDIDATES_20260819_(sh, cBp, 2, lastRow, missing, minCol, width, 'DISPLAY');
  if (targeted) {
    lookupMode = targeted.lookupMode;
    scannedRows = targeted.rows.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < targeted.rows.length; i++) {
      const row = targeted.rows[i].values;
      const id = normalizeBpExistenceId_(row[relBp]);
      if (!id || !missing[id]) continue;
      exists[id] = true;
      if (!bpTypeById[id]) bpTypeById[id] = normalizeRscCodeToken_(row[relType]);
    }
  } else {
    lookupMode = 'FULL_SCAN_FALLBACK';
    const chunkRows = RSC_FSD_SAFE_CHUNK_ROWS_20260807_(width, Math.max(P.dbReadChunkRows || 2000, 4000));
    let foundCount = 0;
    for (let start = 2; start <= lastRow; start += chunkRows) {
      const count = Math.min(chunkRows, lastRow - start + 1);
      const rows = sh.getRange(start, minCol, count, width).getDisplayValues();
      scannedRows += rows.length;
      for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
        const id = normalizeBpExistenceId_(rows[i][relBp]);
        if (!id || !missing[id]) continue;
        if (!exists[id]) { exists[id] = true; foundCount++; }
        if (!bpTypeById[id]) bpTypeById[id] = normalizeRscCodeToken_(rows[i][relType]);
      }
      if (foundCount >= missingCount) break;
    }
  }

  const positive = Object.create(null), negative = Object.create(null);
  Object.keys(missing).forEach(function (id) {
    if (exists[id]) positive[id] = '1|' + String(bpTypeById[id] || '');
    else negative[id] = '0';
  });
  RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('BP', positive, RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819.positiveCacheTtlSec);
  RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('BP', negative, RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819.negativeCacheTtlSec);
  return { exists: exists, bpTypeById: bpTypeById, scannedRows: scannedRows, cacheHits: cacheHits, cacheMisses: missingCount, lookupMode: lookupMode };
}

function RSC_GET_FSD_BP_ID_SET_20260807_() {
  if (__RSC_FSD_BP_ID_SET_CACHE_20260807) return __RSC_FSD_BP_ID_SET_CACHE_20260807;
  const P = RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807;
  __RSC_FSD_BP_ID_SET_CACHE_20260807 = RSC_LOAD_FSD_SINGLE_COLUMN_SET_20260807_(
    P.bpDbSpreadsheetId, P.bpDbSheetName, P.bpIdHeader, normalizeBpExistenceId_
  );
  return __RSC_FSD_BP_ID_SET_CACHE_20260807;
}

function RSC_GET_FSD_RELATIONSHIP_SET_20260807_() {
  if (__RSC_FSD_RELATIONSHIP_SET_CACHE_20260807) return __RSC_FSD_RELATIONSHIP_SET_CACHE_20260807;
  const P = RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807;
  const normalizeRelationship = function (v) {
    return normalizeRscCodeToken_(v);
  };
  const ids = P.relationshipDbSpreadsheetIds || [];
  const primaryErrors = [];
  const merged = Object.create(null);
  let primaryLoaded = 0;
  let fallbackLoaded = false;

  const persistent=RSC_V28_2_CACHE_GET_ALL_20260814_('RELSET',{ALL:true});
  if(persistent.ALL){
    try{
      JSON.parse(persistent.ALL).forEach(function(id){const n=normalizeRelationship(id);if(n)merged[n]=true;});
      for(let lovNo=1;lovNo<=22;lovNo++)merged['ZWS'+String(lovNo).padStart(3,'0')]=true;
      merged.BUR001=true;
      if(Object.keys(merged).length){
        __RSC_FSD_RELATIONSHIP_SET_CACHE_20260807=merged;
        return __RSC_FSD_RELATIONSHIP_SET_CACHE_20260807;
      }
    }catch(ignorePersistent){}
  }

  function mergeSet_(source) {
    Object.keys(source || {}).forEach(function (id) {
      const normalized = normalizeRelationship(id);
      if (normalized) merged[normalized] = true;
    });
  }

  // Canonical LOV lokal adalah authority minimum. Dengan ini ZWS001-ZWS022
  // dan BUR001 tidak pernah berubah menjadi false ERROR hanya karena master
  // eksternal terlambat sync, cache lama, atau value tidak berasal dari klik.
  for (let lovNo = 1; lovNo <= 22; lovNo++) {
    merged['ZWS' + String(lovNo).padStart(3, '0')] = true;
  }
  merged.BUR001 = true;

  // PRIMARY — authoritative FSD R2 master.
  for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
    try {
      const setPrimary = RSC_LOAD_FSD_SINGLE_COLUMN_SET_20260807_(
        ids[i],
        P.relationshipDbSheetName,
        P.relationshipIdHeader,
        normalizeRelationship
      );
      if (setPrimary && Object.keys(setPrimary).length) {
        mergeSet_(setPrimary);
        primaryLoaded++;
      } else {
        primaryErrors.push('Workbook ' + ids[i] + ': master R2 kosong.');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      primaryErrors.push('Workbook ' + ids[i] + ': ' + formatScriptError_(err));
    }
  }

  // FALLBACK — jangan jadikan seluruh validasi SYSTEM ERROR hanya karena updater R2
  // belum selesai. m_bp_relation.relationship_cat_id berasal dari m_bp_relation_view
  // dan tetap merupakan relationship yang benar-benar muncul pada relation master.
  if (P.relationshipFallbackEnabled) {
    try {
      const setFallback = RSC_LOAD_FSD_SINGLE_COLUMN_SET_20260807_(
        P.relationshipFallbackDbSpreadsheetId,
        P.relationshipFallbackDbSheetName,
        P.relationshipFallbackIdHeader,
        normalizeRelationship
      );
      if (setFallback && Object.keys(setFallback).length) {
        mergeSet_(setFallback);
        fallbackLoaded = true;
      } else {
        primaryErrors.push('Fallback ' + P.relationshipFallbackDbSheetName + ' kosong.');
      }
    } catch (fallbackErr) {
      primaryErrors.push('Fallback gagal: ' + formatScriptError_(fallbackErr));
    }
  }

  if (Object.keys(merged).length) {
    writeRollingSalesCenterLog_(
      'FSD R2 merged master aktif. Primary loaded=' + primaryLoaded +
      ', fallback loaded=' + fallbackLoaded +
      ', unique relationship=' + Object.keys(merged).length +
      (primaryErrors.length ? '. Notes: ' + primaryErrors.join(' | ') : '')
    );
    __RSC_FSD_RELATIONSHIP_SET_CACHE_20260807 = merged;
    RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('RELSET',{ALL:JSON.stringify(Object.keys(merged))},600);
    return __RSC_FSD_RELATIONSHIP_SET_CACHE_20260807;
  }

  throw new Error(
    'FSD R2 tidak dapat memuat master Relationship. Primary=' +
    P.relationshipDbSheetName + '.' + P.relationshipIdHeader +
    '; fallback=' + P.relationshipFallbackDbSheetName + '.' + P.relationshipFallbackIdHeader +
    '. Detail: ' + primaryErrors.join(' | ')
  );
}

  if (__RSC_FSD_BP_TYPE_MAP_CACHE_20260807) return __RSC_FSD_BP_TYPE_MAP_CACHE_20260807;
  // Existing loader sudah memakai m_bp_general_view.bp_id + bp_type_id.

function RSC_LOAD_FSD_SINGLE_COLUMN_SET_20260807_(spreadsheetId, sheetName, headerName, normalizer) {
  const P = RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807;
  const ss = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(spreadsheetId);
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName(sheetName);
  if (!sh) throw new Error('FSD database sheet tidak ditemukan: ' + sheetName + '.');
  const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  const isMbpRelation = String(sheetName || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'm_bp_relation';
  if (lastRow < 1 || lastCol < 1) return Object.create(null);
  if (!isMbpRelation && lastRow < 2) return Object.create(null);

  // PATCH 2026-08-19: m_bp_relation dapat berupa 1 kolom relation_payload JSON.
  if (isMbpRelation) {
    const canonicalIndex = RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_CANONICAL_INDEX_20260819_(headerName);
    if (canonicalIndex < 0) {
      throw new Error('FSD canonical m_bp_relation field tidak dikenali: ' + headerName + '.');
    }
    const outCompact = Object.create(null);
    const layoutCompact = RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_GET_LAYOUT_20260819_(sh);
    const firstDataRowCompact = (layoutCompact.firstDataRow || (layoutCompact.headerRow + 1));
    const chunkCompact = RSC_FSD_SAFE_CHUNK_ROWS_20260807_(1, P.dbReadChunkRows || 2000);
    for (let startCompact = firstDataRowCompact; startCompact <= lastRow; startCompact += chunkCompact) {
      const countCompact = Math.min(chunkCompact, lastRow - startCompact + 1);
      const rowsCompact = RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_READ_CANONICAL_20260819_(sh, startCompact, countCompact, layoutCompact);
      for (let iCompact = 0; iCompact < rowsCompact.length; iCompact++) {
        const keyCompact = normalizer(rowsCompact[iCompact][canonicalIndex]);
        if (keyCompact) outCompact[keyCompact] = true;
      }
    }
    return outCompact;
  }

  const headerCols = Math.min(lastCol, P.maxDbHeaderScanColumns || 200);
  const headers = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, headerCols).getDisplayValues()[0];
  const col = findValidateDateCol_(headers, [headerName]);
  if (!col) throw new Error('FSD database column tidak ditemukan: ' + sheetName + '.' + headerName + '.');

  const out = Object.create(null);
  const chunk = RSC_FSD_SAFE_CHUNK_ROWS_20260807_(1, P.dbReadChunkRows || 2000);
  for (let start = 2; start <= lastRow; start += chunk) {
    const count = Math.min(chunk, lastRow - start + 1);
    const vals = sh.getRange(start, col, count, 1).getDisplayValues();
    for (let i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
      const key = normalizer(vals[i][0]);
      if (key) out[key] = true;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function RSC_LOAD_FSD_EXISTING_RELATION_KEYS_20260807_(neededKeys) {
  const neededCount = neededKeys ? Object.keys(neededKeys).length : 0;
  if (!neededCount) return Object.create(null);
  // Shared relation resolver: same cache + same candidate reduction as V28.3.
  return RSC_STD_LOAD_RELATION_CONTEXT_20260814_(Object.create(null), Object.create(null), neededKeys).existingR8;
}

function RSC_NORMALIZE_FSD_DB_DATE_20260807_(value) {
  if (value instanceof Date && !isNaN(value.getTime())) {
    return Utilities.formatDate(value, Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
  }
  return RSC_PERF5_MEMO_SCALAR_20260819_('NORM_DB_DATE', value, function () {
    const text = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
    if (!text) return '';
    if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(text)) return text;
    if (/^\d{12,13}$/.test(text)) {
      const d = new Date(Number(text));
      if (!isNaN(d.getTime())) return Utilities.formatDate(d, Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
    }
    const m = /^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/.exec(text);
    if (m) return m[3] + '-' + String(m[2]).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(m[1]).padStart(2, '0');
    return text;
  });
}

function detectActiveSheetValidationKind_(sh) {
  const name = String(sh.getName() || '').trim();

  if (name === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetRolling) return 'ROLLING';
  if (name === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetSalesOfficeChange) return 'SALES_OFFICE';
  if (name === TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.sheetSalesmanTypeChange) return 'SALESMAN_TYPE';

  let hm = {};
  try {
    hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  } catch (err) {
    hm = {};
  }

  const hasCustomer = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Customer ID', 'Customer Id', 'CustomerID']);
  const hasRelationship = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Relationship', 'Relationship Type', 'Relationship ID']);
  const hasSalesman = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Salesman ID', 'Salesman Id', 'SalesmanID']);
  const hasVisitValidFrom = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Visit Valid From']);
  const hasReason = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Reason']);

  if (hasCustomer && hasRelationship && hasSalesman && hasVisitValidFrom && hasReason) {
    return 'ROLLING';
  }

  const hasOldSalesOffice = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Old Sales Office', 'From Sales Office']);
  const hasNewSalesOffice = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['New Sales Office', 'To Sales Office']);
  const hasSalesOffice = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Office']);
  const hasDeliveringPlant = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Delivering Plant']);

  if ((hasOldSalesOffice && hasNewSalesOffice) || (hasSalesOffice && hasDeliveringPlant && !hasVisitValidFrom)) {
    return 'SALES_OFFICE';
  }

  const hasSalesType = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Type', 'Salesman Type']);
  const hasSalesOrg = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org']);

  if (hasSalesman && hasSalesType && (hasSalesOrg || hasSalesOffice)) {
    return 'SALESMAN_TYPE';
  }

  return 'UNKNOWN';
}

function replaceValidateDateByMbpRelationForActiveSheet_(sh) {
  const plan = readValidateDateRollingPlan_(sh, 'ACTIVE_SHEET:' + sh.getName());

  if (!plan) {
    return {
      skipped: true,
      reason: 'Header rolling date tidak lengkap atau tidak ada data.'
    };
  }

  const neededTriple = {};
  const neededCustomer = {};
  const neededPair = {};
  const neededR8 = {};

  for (let i = 0; i < plan.n; i++) {
    if (plan.isTokoBangkrut[i] && plan.keys[i]) neededTriple[plan.keys[i]] = true;
    if (plan.isTokoBangkrut[i] && plan.customers[i]) neededCustomer[plan.customers[i]] = true;
    if (!plan.relationships[i] && plan.customers[i] && plan.salesmen[i]) neededPair[plan.customers[i] + '||' + plan.salesmen[i]] = true;
    const planValidTo=RSC_NORMALIZE_FSD_DB_DATE_20260807_(plan.validToVals[i][0]);
    if(plan.keys[i]&&planValidTo)neededR8[plan.keys[i]+'||'+planValidTo]=true;
  }

  const maps = loadValidateDateMapsForKeys_(neededTriple, neededCustomer, neededPair, neededR8);
  return applyAndWriteValidateDatePlans_([plan], maps);
}

function markExactDataWithCurrentForActiveSheet_(targetSh) {
  assertBigQueryServiceForExactData_();

  const P = EXACT_DATA_WITH_CURRENT_PARAMETERS;
  const lastRow = RSC_GET_FSD_LAST_DATA_ROW_20260807_(targetSh);

  if (lastRow < P.TARGET_START_ROW) {
    return {
      checkedRows: 0,
      exactRows: 0,
      skipped: true,
      reason: 'Sheet kosong.',
      chunks: 0
    };
  }

  const maxNeededCol = Math.max(
    P.OUTPUT_COL_R,
    Math.max.apply(
      null,
      P.FIELD_MAPPING.map(function (f) { return f.targetCol; })
    )
  );

  if (targetSh.getMaxColumns() < maxNeededCol) {
    targetSh.insertColumnsAfter(
      targetSh.getMaxColumns(),
      maxNeededCol - targetSh.getMaxColumns()
    );
  }

  const numRows = lastRow - P.TARGET_START_ROW + 1;
  const rowExactKeys = new Array(numRows);
  const rowCoreKeys = new Array(numRows);
  const allTargetCoreKeySet = new Set();
  const allBpIds = new Set();

  const bpIdMap = P.FIELD_MAPPING.find(function (m) {
    return m.name === 'bp_id';
  });
  const bpIdColIdx = bpIdMap.targetCol - 1;

  const chunkRows = RSC_FSD_SAFE_CHUNK_ROWS_20260807_(
    maxNeededCol,
    400
  );

  let readChunks = 0;

  // PASS 1: baca target per chunk dan bentuk key.
  for (
    let start = P.TARGET_START_ROW;
    start <= lastRow;
    start += chunkRows
  ) {
    const count = Math.min(
      chunkRows,
      lastRow - start + 1
    );

    const range = targetSh.getRange(
      start,
      1,
      count,
      maxNeededCol
    );
    const rawValues = range.getValues();
    const displayValues = range.getDisplayValues();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const globalIndex = (start - P.TARGET_START_ROW) + i;

      const exactKey = buildExactDataTargetKey_(
        rawValues[i],
        displayValues[i],
        false
      );
      const coreKey = buildExactDataTargetKey_(
        rawValues[i],
        displayValues[i],
        true
      );

      rowExactKeys[globalIndex] = exactKey;
      rowCoreKeys[globalIndex] = coreKey;

      if (coreKey) allTargetCoreKeySet.add(coreKey);

      const bpId = normalizeExactDataText_(
        displayValues[i][bpIdColIdx]
      );
      if (bpId) allBpIds.add(bpId);
    }

    readChunks++;
  }

  if (allBpIds.size === 0) {
    return {
      checkedRows: 0,
      exactRows: 0,
      skipped: true,
      reason: 'Tidak ada Customer ID / BP ID valid.',
      chunks: readChunks
    };
  }

  const resolvedMapping = resolveExactDataBigQueryColumns_();
  const matchedExactKeySet = buildMatchedExactDataKeySetFromBigQuery_(
    Array.from(allBpIds),
    allTargetCoreKeySet,
    resolvedMapping
  );

  let checkedRows = 0;
  let exactRows = 0;
  let writeChunks = 0;

  // PASS 2: tulis kolom R per chunk. Tidak pernah setValues 27k row sekaligus.
  for (
    let start = P.TARGET_START_ROW;
    start <= lastRow;
    start += chunkRows
  ) {
    const count = Math.min(
      chunkRows,
      lastRow - start + 1
    );

    const outputRange = targetSh.getRange(
      start,
      P.OUTPUT_COL_R,
      count,
      1
    );
    const outputValues = outputRange.getValues();

    let dirty = false;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const globalIndex = (start - P.TARGET_START_ROW) + i;
      const exactKey = rowExactKeys[globalIndex];

      if (!exactKey) continue;
      checkedRows++;

      if (matchedExactKeySet.has(exactKey)) {
        if (outputValues[i][0] !== P.OUTPUT_TEXT) {
          outputValues[i][0] = P.OUTPUT_TEXT;
          dirty = true;
        }
        exactRows++;
      } else if (P.CLEAR_R_IF_NOT_MATCH) {
        if (outputValues[i][0] !== '') {
          outputValues[i][0] = '';
          dirty = true;
        }
      }
    }

    if (dirty) outputRange.setValues(outputValues);
    writeChunks++;
  }

  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  return {
    checkedRows: checkedRows,
    exactRows: exactRows,
    chunks: readChunks + writeChunks,
    readChunks: readChunks,
    writeChunks: writeChunks
  };
}

function formatActiveSheetValidationResult_(obj) {
  if (obj == null) return 'done';
  if (typeof obj === 'string') return obj;
  if (typeof obj !== 'object') return String(obj);

  try {
    const parts = [];
    Object.keys(obj).forEach(function (key) {
      const val = obj[key];
      if (val === null || typeof val === 'undefined') return;
      if (typeof val === 'object') return;
      parts.push(key + '=' + val);
    });
    return parts.length ? parts.join(', ') : JSON.stringify(obj);
  } catch (err) {
    return String(obj);
  }
}

function rscV20NowIso_() {
  return new Date().toISOString();

function rscV20GetMasterSpreadsheet_() {
  const p = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const id = p.getProperty(RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20.pMasterSpreadsheetId);
  return id ? RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(id) : SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

function rscV20GetMasterSheet_(ss) {
  const p = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const sheetId = p.getProperty(RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20.pMasterSheetId);
  if (sheetId) {
    const sheets = ss.getSheets();
    for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
      if (String(sheets[i].getSheetId()) === String(sheetId)) return sheets[i];
    }
  }
  return resolveValidateAllMasterSheetV20260813_(ss) || ss.getActiveSheet();
}

function rscV20GetOrCreateManifestSheet_(ss, reset) {
  const P = RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20;
  let sh = ss.getSheetByName(P.manifestSheetName);
  const created = !sh;
  if (!sh) sh = ss.insertSheet(P.manifestSheetName);
  if (reset) sh.clear();
  if (reset || created) {
    sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, P.manifestHeaders.length).setValues([P.manifestHeaders]);
    sh.setFrozenRows(1);
    sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, P.manifestHeaders.length)
      .setFontWeight('bold')
      .setBackground('#0F172A')
      .setFontColor('#FFFFFF');
    try { sh.hideSheet(); } catch (ignore) {}
  }
  return sh;
}

function rscV20DeleteAllJobTriggers_() {
  const P = RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20;
  const handlers = P.workerHandlers.concat([P.watchdogHandler, VALIDATE_ALL_FINAL_LINKS_PARAMETERS.fn]);
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_(handlers);
}

function rscV20ScheduleOneTimeHandler_(handler, delayMs) {
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([handler]);
  RSC_PERF13_NEW_TRIGGER_20260819_(handler).timeBased().after(Math.max(1000, Number(delayMs || 60000))).create();
}

function rscV20EnsureWatchdogTrigger_() {
  const P = RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20;
  const triggers = ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers();
  for (let i = 0; i < triggers.length; i++) {
    if (triggers[i].getHandlerFunction() === P.watchdogHandler) return;
  }
  RSC_PERF13_NEW_TRIGGER_20260819_(P.watchdogHandler).timeBased().everyMinutes(P.watchdogMinutes).create();
}

function rscV20ResolveWorkerCapacity_() {
  const P = RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20;
  const ours = {};
  P.workerHandlers.concat([P.watchdogHandler, VALIDATE_ALL_FINAL_LINKS_PARAMETERS.fn]).forEach(function (h) { ours[h] = true; });
  const triggers = ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers();
  let other = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < triggers.length; i++) {
    if (!ours[triggers[i].getHandlerFunction()]) other++;
  }
  // Reserve one slot for watchdog. Target remains 8, but never exceed project trigger capacity.
  return Math.max(1, Math.min(P.desiredWorkers, P.maxProjectTriggers - other - 1));
}

function rscV20ExtractManifestLinks_(masterSs, masterSh, firstDataRow, lastRow) {
  const P0 = VALIDATE_ALL_FINAL_LINKS_PARAMETERS;
  const chunk = Math.max(50, Number(P0.masterReadChunkRows || 100));
  const manifest = [];
  const allBackgrounds = [];
  const allNotes = [];

  for (let start = firstDataRow; start <= lastRow; start += chunk) {
    const n = Math.min(chunk, lastRow - start + 1);
    const range = masterSh.getRange(start, P0.masterLinkCol, n, 1);
    const display = range.getDisplayValues();
    const values = range.getValues();
    const formulas = range.getFormulas();
    const rich = range.getRichTextValues();
    const bgs = range.getBackgrounds();
    const notes = range.getNotes();
    let chips = {};

    if (typeof getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_ === 'function') {
      try {
        chips = getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_(masterSs.getId(), masterSh.getName(), start, P0.masterLinkCol, n) || {};
      } catch (err) {
        writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('V20 smart-chip fallback: ' + formatScriptError_(err));
      }
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const masterRow = start + i;
      const displayValue = cleanTextValue_(display[i][0]);
      const rawValue = values[i][0];
      if (!displayValue && !cleanTextValue_(rawValue) && !chips[masterRow]) {
        allBackgrounds.push({ row: masterRow, value: bgs[i][0] });
        allNotes.push({ row: masterRow, value: notes[i][0] });
        continue;
      }

      const urlFromCell = getSpreadsheetUrlFromCellObject_({
        displayValue: display[i][0],
        value: values[i][0],
        formula: formulas[i][0],
        richTextValue: rich[i][0]
      });
      const url = urlFromCell || chips[masterRow] || String(rawValue || displayValue || '');
      const fileId = extractSpreadsheetFileIdFromUrlOrId_(url);

      manifest.push({
        masterRow: masterRow,
        fileId: fileId || '',
        url: url,
        valid: Boolean(fileId)
      });
    }
  }
  return manifest;
}

function resolveValidateAllMasterSheetV20260813_(ss) {
  const P0 = VALIDATE_ALL_FINAL_LINKS_PARAMETERS;
  const candidates = [P0.masterSheetName].concat(P0.masterSheetAliases || []);
  for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
    const name = String(candidates[i] || '').trim();
    if (!name) continue;
    const sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
    if (sh) return sh;
  }
  return null;
}

/* Replacement entrypoint. Existing menu/wrapper names continue to work. */
function legacyV20StartValidateAllFinalLinksInColumnE_() {
  const P = RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20;
  const P0 = VALIDATE_ALL_FINAL_LINKS_PARAMETERS;
  const masterSs = (typeof RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_GET_MASTER_SPREADSHEET_20260813_ === 'function'
    ? RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_GET_MASTER_SPREADSHEET_20260813_()
    : null) || SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const masterSh = resolveValidateAllMasterSheetV20260813_(masterSs);
  if (!masterSh) {
    throw new Error(
      'Sheet master tidak ditemukan. Dicari: ' +
      [P0.masterSheetName].concat(P0.masterSheetAliases || []).join(', ')
    );
  }

  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  rscV20DeleteAllJobTriggers_();
  props.setProperty(P.pStop, 'FALSE');
  props.setProperty(P.pMasterSpreadsheetId, masterSs.getId());
  props.setProperty(P.pMasterSheetId, String(masterSh.getSheetId()));
  props.setProperty(P.pStartedAt, rscV20NowIso_());
  const runToken = P.version + '|' + Utilities.getUuid();
  props.setProperty(P.pRunToken, runToken);

  const first = resolveValidateAllFirstDataRow_(masterSh);
  const last = masterSh.getLastRow();
  const manifestSh = rscV20GetOrCreateManifestSheet_(masterSs, true);

  if (last < first) {
    masterSs.toast('Tidak ada link pada Rekap Approved kolom E.', 'Validate ALL E V20', 8);
    return;
  }

  const links = rscV20ExtractManifestLinks_(masterSs, masterSh, first, last);
  const tasks = [];
  const taskByFileId = Object.create(null);
  for (let i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {
    const item = links[i];
    if (item.valid && taskByFileId[item.fileId]) {
      taskByFileId[item.fileId].masterRows.push(item.masterRow);
      continue;
    }
    const taskItem = {
      masterRow: item.masterRow,
      masterRows: [item.masterRow],
      fileId: item.fileId,
      url: item.url,
      valid: item.valid
    };
    tasks.push(taskItem);
    if (item.valid) taskByFileId[item.fileId] = taskItem;
  }

  const rows = [];
  const linkRows = [];
  const linkBgs = [];
  const linkNotes = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < tasks.length; i++) {
    const item = tasks[i];
    const initialState = {
      version: P.version,
      runToken: runToken,
      masterRow: item.masterRow,
      masterRows: item.masterRows,
      fileId: item.fileId,
      stage: 'INIT',
      stageIndex: -1,
      stagePlan: [],
      nextRow: 0,
      doneUnits: 0,
      totalUnits: 0,
      errorRows: 0,
      fileErrors: [],
      attempts: 0,
      leaseToken: '',
      startedAt: '',
      updatedAt: rscV20NowIso_()
    };
    const status = item.valid ? 'QUEUED' : 'HARD_ERROR';
    const message = item.valid ? 'Menunggu slot worker.' : 'Link/file ID tidak valid.';
    if (!item.valid) initialState.fileErrors.push(message);

    rows.push([
      runToken, item.masterRow, item.fileId, item.url, status, 'INIT',
      item.valid ? '0%' : '100%', '0', '0', '', '', 0,
      rscV20NowIso_(), message, JSON.stringify(initialState), ''
    ]);
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {
    const item = links[i];
    linkRows.push(item.masterRow);
    linkBgs.push([item.valid ? P.colorQueued : P.colorError]);
    linkNotes.push([item.valid
      ? 'QUEUED VALIDATION V20 | menunggu salah satu dari maksimal 8 worker lane.'
      : 'HARD ERROR VALIDATION V20 | link/file ID tidak valid.']);
  }

  if (rows.length) {
    if (manifestSh.getMaxRows() < rows.length + 1) manifestSh.insertRowsAfter(manifestSh.getMaxRows(), rows.length + 1 - manifestSh.getMaxRows());
    manifestSh.getRange(2, 1, rows.length, P.manifestHeaders.length).setValues(rows);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < linkRows.length; i++) {
    masterSh.getRange(linkRows[i], P0.masterLinkCol)
      .setBackground(linkBgs[i][0])
      .setNote(linkNotes[i][0]);
  }
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  const workerCount = rscV20ResolveWorkerCapacity_();
  props.setProperty(P.pWorkerCount, String(workerCount));
  rscV20EnsureWatchdogTrigger_();
  for (let lane = 1; lane <= workerCount; lane++) {
    rscV20ScheduleOneTimeHandler_(P.workerHandlers[lane - 1], 1000 + lane * 500);
  }

  masterSs.toast(
    'Manifest dibuat: ' + rows.length + ' file unik dari ' + links.length + ' link. Worker aktif=' + workerCount +
    (workerCount < P.desiredWorkers ? ' (adaptif karena batas trigger project).' : '') +
    ' Chunk=' + P.chunkRows + ' baris.',
    'Validate ALL E V20', 12
  );
}
