function rscV20IsLeaseExpired_(leaseUntil) {
  if (!leaseUntil) return true;
  const t = new Date(leaseUntil).getTime();
  return !isFinite(t) || t <= Date.now();
}

function rscV20ClaimTask_(lane) {
  const P = RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  if (props.getProperty(P.pStop) === 'TRUE') return null;
  const runToken = props.getProperty(P.pRunToken) || '';
  if (!runToken) return null;

  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(5000)) return null;
  try {
    const ss = rscV20GetMasterSpreadsheet_();
    const sh = rscV20GetOrCreateManifestSheet_(ss, false);
    const last = sh.getLastRow();
    if (last < 2) return null;
    const values = sh.getRange(2, 1, last - 1, P.manifestHeaders.length).getValues();
    let chosen = -1;

    // Prefer resuming the same lane's leased file.
    for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
      if (String(values[i][0] || '') !== runToken) continue;
      const status = String(values[i][4] || '');
      const rowLane = Number(values[i][9] || 0);
      if ((status === 'ACTIVE' || status === 'PARTIAL_VALIDATION') && rowLane === lane) {
        chosen = i;
        break;
      }
    }
    // Otherwise claim queued or expired work.
    if (chosen < 0) {
      for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
        if (String(values[i][0] || '') !== runToken) continue;
        const status = String(values[i][4] || '');
        const expired = rscV20IsLeaseExpired_(values[i][10]);
        if (status === 'QUEUED' || ((status === 'ACTIVE' || status === 'PARTIAL_VALIDATION') && expired)) {
          chosen = i;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    if (chosen < 0) return null;

    const sheetRow = chosen + 2;
    const task = rscV20ManifestRowToTask_(values[chosen], sheetRow);
    task.state.leaseToken = Utilities.getUuid();
    task.state.updatedAt = rscV20NowIso_();
    if (!task.state.startedAt) task.state.startedAt = task.state.updatedAt;
    const leaseUntil = new Date(Date.now() + P.leaseMs).toISOString();
    sh.getRange(sheetRow, 5, 1, 12).setValues([[
      task.status === 'QUEUED' ? 'ACTIVE' : 'PARTIAL_VALIDATION',
      task.state.stage || task.stage || 'INIT',
      values[chosen][6] || '0%', values[chosen][7] || '0', values[chosen][8] || '0',
      lane, leaseUntil, Number(task.state.errorRows || 0), rscV20NowIso_(),
      'Worker lane ' + lane + ' mengambil task.', JSON.stringify(task.state), values[chosen][15] || ''
    ]]);
    task.lane = lane;
    task.leaseUntil = leaseUntil;
    return task;
  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (ignore) {}
  }
}

function rscV20CurrentStage_(state) {
  if (!state.stagePlan || state.stageIndex < 0 || state.stageIndex >= state.stagePlan.length) return null;
  return state.stagePlan[state.stageIndex];
}

function rscV20StageChunkInfo_(state, stage) {
  const P = RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20;
  const first = Number(stage.firstRow || 2);
  const totalRows = Number(stage.totalRows || 0);
  const last = first + totalRows - 1;
  const start = Math.max(first, Number(state.nextRow || first));
  const end = Math.min(last, start + P.chunkRows - 1);
  const chunkNo = totalRows > 0 ? Math.floor((start - first) / P.chunkRows) + 1 : 1;
  const chunks = Math.max(1, Number(stage.chunks || Math.ceil(totalRows / P.chunkRows) || 1));
  return { first: first, last: last, start: start, end: end, chunkNo: chunkNo, chunks: chunks };
}

function rscV20MakeSheetMeta_(sh, kind) {
  if (!sh) return null;
  ensureValidationStatusColumns_(sh);
  const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
  const meta = {
    name: sh.getName(),
    kind: kind,
    firstDataRow: 2,
    lastRow: Math.max(1, sh.getLastRow()),
    dataRows: Math.max(0, sh.getLastRow() - 1),
    statusCol: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.validationStatusHeader]),
    detailCol: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.errorDetailHeader])
  };
  if (kind === 'ROLLING') {
    meta.cols = getChangeRollingColumnIndexes_(hm);
  } else if (kind === 'OFFICE') {
    meta.cols = {
      bp: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['BP Number Source']),
      plant: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Delivering Plant']),
      dist: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Distr. Channel', 'Distribution Channel', 'Distribution channel']),
      div: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Division']),
      salesOrg: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org']),
      salesOffice: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Office'])
    };
  } else if (kind === 'SALESMAN') {
    meta.cols = {
      salesman: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Salesman ID']),
      salesOrg: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org']),
      salesOffice: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Office']),
      salesType: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Sales Type']),
      coverage: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Coverage']),
      validFrom: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Valid From']),
      validTo: findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, ['Valid To'])
    };
  }
  return meta;
}

function rscV20AddRowStages_(plan, prefix, sheetName, dataRows, stageKeys) {
  if (!sheetName || dataRows <= 0) return;
  const P = RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20;
  const chunks = Math.ceil(dataRows / P.chunkRows);
  for (let i = 0; i < stageKeys.length; i++) {
    plan.push({
      key: prefix + '_' + stageKeys[i],
      sheetName: sheetName,
      firstRow: 2,
      totalRows: dataRows,
      chunks: chunks
    });
  }
}

function rscV20InitFile_(targetSs, state) {
  const P = RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20;
  const P0 = VALIDATE_ALL_FINAL_LINKS_PARAMETERS;
  const lookup = buildValidationSheetLookup_(targetSs);
  const rollingSh = getOptionalValidationSheet_(targetSs, P0.rollingSheetName, /rolling/i, lookup);
  const officeSh = getOptionalValidationSheet_(targetSs, P0.salesOfficeSheetName, /sales office/i, lookup);
  const salesmanSh = getOptionalValidationSheet_(targetSs, P0.salesmanTypeSheetName, /salesman type/i, lookup);

  state.fileName = targetSs.getName();
  state.rollingMeta = rscV20MakeSheetMeta_(rollingSh, 'ROLLING');
  state.officeMeta = rscV20MakeSheetMeta_(officeSh, 'OFFICE');
  state.salesmanMeta = rscV20MakeSheetMeta_(salesmanSh, 'SALESMAN');
  if (!state.rollingMeta) state.fileErrors.push('ROLLING ERROR: sheet Change Rolling & Change Schedule tidak ditemukan.');

  const rollingRows = state.rollingMeta ? state.rollingMeta.dataRows : 0;
  const officeRows = state.officeMeta ? state.officeMeta.dataRows : 0;
  const salesmanRows = state.salesmanMeta ? state.salesmanMeta.dataRows : 0;
  state.helperOffsets = {
    rollingStart: 2,
    officeStart: 2 + rollingRows,
    salesmanStart: 2 + rollingRows + officeRows,
    totalRows: rollingRows + officeRows + salesmanRows
  };

  let helper = targetSs.getSheetByName(P.helperSheetName);
  if (!helper) helper = targetSs.insertSheet(P.helperSheetName);
  helper.clear();
  helper.getRange(1, 1, 1, 6).setValues([['Kind', 'Target Row', 'Key 1', 'Key 2', 'Aux', 'Target Sheet']]);
  if (helper.getMaxRows() < state.helperOffsets.totalRows + 1) {
    helper.insertRowsAfter(helper.getMaxRows(), state.helperOffsets.totalRows + 1 - helper.getMaxRows());
  }
  if (state.helperOffsets.totalRows > 0) helper.getRange(2, 1, state.helperOffsets.totalRows, 6).clearContent();
  try { helper.hideSheet(); } catch (ignore) {}

  const plan = [];
  rscV20AddRowStages_(plan, 'ROLLING', state.rollingMeta && state.rollingMeta.name, rollingRows,
    ['BP_TYPE', 'DATE_DB', 'ROLLING_DATE', 'TOKO_PRE', 'FRONTEND', 'TOKO_POST', 'BP_EXIST']);
  rscV20AddRowStages_(plan, 'OFFICE', state.officeMeta && state.officeMeta.name, officeRows, ['FRONTEND']);
  rscV20AddRowStages_(plan, 'SALESMAN', state.salesmanMeta && state.salesmanMeta.name, salesmanRows, ['FRONTEND']);

  const helperRows = state.helperOffsets.totalRows;
  if (helperRows > 0) {
    plan.push({ key: 'HELPER_SORT_DUP', sheetName: P.helperSheetName, firstRow: 2, totalRows: 1, chunks: 1 });
    plan.push({ key: 'HELPER_DUP_SCAN', sheetName: P.helperSheetName, firstRow: 2, totalRows: helperRows, chunks: Math.ceil(helperRows / P.chunkRows) });
    plan.push({ key: 'HELPER_SORT_SCHED', sheetName: P.helperSheetName, firstRow: 2, totalRows: 1, chunks: 1 });
    plan.push({ key: 'HELPER_SCHED_SCAN', sheetName: P.helperSheetName, firstRow: 2, totalRows: helperRows, chunks: Math.ceil(helperRows / P.chunkRows) });
  }

  rscV20AddRowStages_(plan, 'FINAL_ROLLING', state.rollingMeta && state.rollingMeta.name, rollingRows, ['SCAN']);
  rscV20AddRowStages_(plan, 'FINAL_OFFICE', state.officeMeta && state.officeMeta.name, officeRows, ['SCAN']);
  rscV20AddRowStages_(plan, 'FINAL_SALESMAN', state.salesmanMeta && state.salesmanMeta.name, salesmanRows, ['SCAN']);

  state.stagePlan = plan;
  state.stageIndex = 0;
  state.stage = plan.length ? plan[0].key : 'COMPLETE';
  state.nextRow = plan.length ? plan[0].firstRow : 0;
  state.doneUnits = 0;
  state.totalUnits = plan.reduce(function (sum, s) { return sum + Math.max(1, Number(s.chunks || 1)); }, 0);
  state.errorRows = 0;
  state.attempts = 0;
  state.updatedAt = rscV20NowIso_();
  return { initialized: true, stages: plan.length, totalUnits: state.totalUnits };
}

function rscV20GetRelationIndex_() {
  if (__RSC_V20_RELATION_INDEX__) return __RSC_V20_RELATION_INDEX__;
  const p = M_BP_RELATION_DB_PARAMETERS;
  const ss = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(p.spreadsheetId);
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName(p.sheetName);
  if (!sh) throw new Error('Sheet DB "' + p.sheetName + '" tidak ditemukan.');
  const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  const exact = Object.create(null);
  const customer = Object.create(null);
  if (lastRow < 1) return { exact: exact, customer: customer };

  const layout = RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_GET_LAYOUT_20260819_(sh);
  const firstDataRow = (layout.firstDataRow || (layout.headerRow + 1));
  const chunk = p.readChunkRows || 100000;
  for (let start = firstDataRow; start <= lastRow; start += chunk) {
    const n = Math.min(chunk, lastRow - start + 1);
    const rows = RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_READ_CANONICAL_20260819_(sh, start, n, layout);
    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      const a = RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(rows[i][0]);
      const b = normalizeValidateDateRelationship_(rows[i][1]);
      const c = RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(rows[i][2]);
      const d = normalizeValidateDateForWrite_(rows[i][3]);
      if (!a || !d) continue;
      if (a && b && c) {
        const key = a + '||' + b + '||' + c;
        if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(exact, key)) exact[key] = d;
      }
      if (!customer[a] || d < customer[a]) customer[a] = d;
    }
  }
  __RSC_V20_RELATION_INDEX__ = { exact: exact, customer: customer };
  return __RSC_V20_RELATION_INDEX__;
}

function rscV20SyncBpTypeChunk_(sh, meta, startRow, endRow) {
  const map = getSalesmanBpTypeIndexFromMbpGeneralView_();
  const cSalesman = meta.cols.salesmanId;
  const cBpType = meta.cols.salesmanBpType;
  if (!cSalesman || !cBpType) throw new Error('Header Salesman ID / Salesman BP Type tidak lengkap.');
  const n = endRow - startRow + 1;
  const salesman = sh.getRange(startRow, cSalesman, n, 1).getDisplayValues();
  const range = sh.getRange(startRow, cBpType, n, 1);
  const values = range.getDisplayValues();
  let dirty = false, updated = 0, missing = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const id = normalizeSalesmanBpTypeSyncId_(salesman[i][0]);
    if (!id) continue;
    const db = map[id];
    if (!db) { missing++; continue; }
    if (normalizeSalesmanBpTypeSyncBpType_(values[i][0]) !== db) {
      values[i][0] = db; dirty = true; updated++;
    }
  }
  if (dirty) range.setNumberFormat('@').setValues(values);
  return { checked: n, updated: updated, notFound: missing };
}

function rscV20DateDbChunk_(sh, meta, startRow, endRow) {
  const c=meta.cols,required=[c.customerId,c.relationship,c.salesmanId,c.validFrom,c.validTo,c.visitValidFrom,c.visitValidTo,c.reason];
  if(required.some(function(x){return!x;}))throw new Error('Header rolling untuk DATE_DB tidak lengkap.');
  const n=endRow-startRow+1,minCol=Math.min.apply(null,required),maxCol=Math.max.apply(null,required),width=maxCol-minCol+1;
  const range=sh.getRange(startRow,minCol,n,width),raw=range.getValues(),display=range.getDisplayValues();
  const neededTriple=Object.create(null),neededCustomer=Object.create(null),keys=new Array(n),customers=new Array(n);
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const row=display[i],reason=row[c.reason-minCol],key=buildValidateDateKey_(row[c.customerId-minCol],row[c.relationship-minCol],row[c.salesmanId-minCol]),cust=RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(row[c.customerId-minCol]);
    keys[i]=key;customers[i]=cust;
    // PERF11: DB historical Valid From is requested only for Toko Bangkrut.
    if(isValidateDateTokoBangkrut_(reason)){if(key)neededTriple[key]=true;if(cust)neededCustomer[cust]=true;}
  }
  const rel=RSC_STD_LOAD_RELATION_CONTEXT_20260814_(neededTriple,neededCustomer,Object.create(null),Object.create(null));
  const P=VALIDATE_DATE_IN_TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS;let dVf=false,dVt=false,dVvf=false,dVvt=false,caseA=0,caseB=0,caseC=0;
  const rvf=c.validFrom-minCol,rvt=c.validTo-minCol,rvvf=c.visitValidFrom-minCol,rvvt=c.visitValidTo-minCol,rr=c.reason-minCol;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const matched=keys[i]&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rel.exact,keys[i])?rel.exact[keys[i]]:null,reason=display[i][rr];
    if(isValidateDateTokoBangkrut_(reason)){
      const expectedVf=matched||(P.caseCValidFromSource==='CUSTOMER_FALLBACK'?rel.customer[customers[i]]:null);
      if(expectedVf&&normalizeValidateDateForWrite_(raw[i][rvf])!==expectedVf){raw[i][rvf]=expectedVf;dVf=true;}
      if(normalizeValidateDateForWrite_(raw[i][rvt])!==P.dateClose){raw[i][rvt]=P.dateClose;dVt=true;}
      if(!isSalesmanToSalesmanRolling_(display[i][c.customerId-minCol],display[i][c.salesmanId-minCol])&&normalizeValidateDateForWrite_(raw[i][rvvt])!==P.dateClose){raw[i][rvvt]=P.dateClose;dVvt=true;}caseC++;
    }else if(isValidateDateRolling_(reason)){
      // PERF11 authoritative rule: historical DB relation must never pull a
      // Reason=Rolling row backwards. Both rolling start dates use dateNew.
      if(normalizeValidateDateForWrite_(raw[i][rvf])!==P.dateNew){raw[i][rvf]=P.dateNew;dVf=true;}
      if(normalizeValidateDateForWrite_(raw[i][rvvf])!==P.dateNew){raw[i][rvvf]=P.dateNew;dVvf=true;}
      caseB++;
    }
  }
  // Write adjacent date columns in grouped blocks while preserving all untouched cells from raw.
  const dirtyCols=Object.create(null);if(dVf)dirtyCols[c.validFrom]=true;if(dVt)dirtyCols[c.validTo]=true;if(dVvf)dirtyCols[c.visitValidFrom]=true;if(dVvt)dirtyCols[c.visitValidTo]=true;
  const sorted=Object.keys(dirtyCols).map(Number).sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});let x=0;
  while(x<sorted.length){let y=x;while(y+1<sorted.length&&sorted[y+1]===sorted[y]+1)y++;const sc=sorted[x],w=sorted[y]-sc+1,vals=new Array(n);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){vals[i]=new Array(w);for(let k=0;k<w;k++)vals[i][k]=raw[i][sc-minCol+k];}sh.getRange(startRow,sc,n,w).setValues(vals);x=y+1;}
  return{caseA:caseA,caseB:caseB,caseC:caseC,lookupMode:rel.lookupMode||''};
}


function rscV20RollingDateChunk_(sh, meta, startRow, endRow) {
  const c = meta.cols;
  if (!c.reason || !c.validFrom || !c.visitValidFrom) throw new Error('Header Reason / Valid From / Visit Valid From tidak lengkap.');
  const n = endRow - startRow + 1;
  const reasons = sh.getRange(startRow, c.reason, n, 1).getDisplayValues();
  const vfRange = sh.getRange(startRow, c.validFrom, n, 1);
  const vvfRange = sh.getRange(startRow, c.visitValidFrom, n, 1);
  const vf = vfRange.getValues(), vvf = vvfRange.getValues();
  const dateText = BACKGROUND_ROLLING_REASON_DATE_FIX_PARAMETERS.targetCfg.TARGET_DATE_TEXT;
  let dirtyVf = false, dirtyVvf = false, updated = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    if (!isValidateDateRolling_(reasons[i][0])) continue;
    let changed = false;
    if (normalizeValidateDateForWrite_(vf[i][0]) !== dateText) { vf[i][0] = dateText; dirtyVf = true; changed = true; }
    if (normalizeValidateDateForWrite_(vvf[i][0]) !== dateText) { vvf[i][0] = dateText; dirtyVvf = true; changed = true; }
    if (changed) updated++;
  }
  if (dirtyVf) vfRange.setValues(vf);
  if (dirtyVvf) vvfRange.setValues(vvf);
  return { updated: updated };
}

function rscV20TokoPreChunk_(sh, meta, startRow, endRow) {
  const c=meta.cols,required=[c.visitCategory,c.customerId,c.salesmanId,c.visitType,c.visitValidFrom,c.validTo,c.visitValidTo,c.reason];if(required.some(function(x){return!x;}))throw new Error('Header Toko Bangkrut pre-replace tidak lengkap.');
  const n=endRow-startRow+1,minCol=Math.min.apply(null,required),maxCol=Math.max.apply(null,required),width=maxCol-minCol+1,range=sh.getRange(startRow,minCol,n,width),raw=range.getValues(),rows=range.getDisplayValues();
  const needed=Object.create(null),keys=new Array(n),closeDate=RSC_MVS_normalizeDate_(RSC_M_VISIT_SCHEDULE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260723.dateClose);
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const row=rows[i];if(String(row[c.reason-minCol]||'').trim().toUpperCase().indexOf('TOKO BANGKRUT')===-1||isSalesmanToSalesmanRolling_(row[c.customerId-minCol],row[c.salesmanId-minCol]))continue;const key=RSC_MVS_buildKey_(row[c.visitCategory-minCol],row[c.customerId-minCol],row[c.salesmanId-minCol],row[c.visitType-minCol]);keys[i]=key;if(key)needed[key]=true;}
  const db=RSC_MVS_getIndexSubset_20260819_(needed);let dirtyVvf=false,dirtyVt=false,dirtyVvt=false,checked=0,matched=0,missing=0;
  const rvvf=c.visitValidFrom-minCol,rvt=c.validTo-minCol,rvvt=c.visitValidTo-minCol;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const row=rows[i];if(String(row[c.reason-minCol]||'').trim().toUpperCase().indexOf('TOKO BANGKRUT')===-1)continue;checked++;
    if(RSC_MVS_normalizeDateValue_(raw[i][rvt],row[rvt])!==closeDate){raw[i][rvt]=closeDate;dirtyVt=true;}
    const pair=isSalesmanToSalesmanRolling_(row[c.customerId-minCol],row[c.salesmanId-minCol]);if(pair)continue;
    if(RSC_MVS_normalizeDateValue_(raw[i][rvvt],row[rvvt])!==closeDate){raw[i][rvvt]=closeDate;dirtyVvt=true;}
    const dates=keys[i]&&db.datesByKey[keys[i]];if(!dates){missing++;continue;}const expected=RSC_MVS_selectEffectiveStartDate_(dates,closeDate);if(!expected){missing++;continue;}
    if(RSC_MVS_normalizeDateValue_(raw[i][rvvf],row[rvvf])!==expected){raw[i][rvvf]=expected;dirtyVvf=true;}matched++;
  }
  const dirty=Object.create(null);if(dirtyVvf)dirty[c.visitValidFrom]=true;if(dirtyVt)dirty[c.validTo]=true;if(dirtyVvt)dirty[c.visitValidTo]=true;const sorted=Object.keys(dirty).map(Number).sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});let x=0;
  while(x<sorted.length){let y=x;while(y+1<sorted.length&&sorted[y+1]===sorted[y]+1)y++;const sc=sorted[x],w=sorted[y]-sc+1,vals=new Array(n);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){vals[i]=new Array(w);for(let k=0;k<w;k++)vals[i][k]=raw[i][sc-minCol+k];}sh.getRange(startRow,sc,n,w).setValues(vals);x=y+1;}
  return{checked:checked,matched:matched,keyNotFound:missing,lookupRows:Number(db.rowsIndexed||0)};
}


function rscV20WriteHelperKeys_(targetSs, state, kind, sh, meta, startRow, endRow) {
  const P = RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20;
  const helper = targetSs.getSheetByName(P.helperSheetName);
  const n = endRow - startRow + 1;
  const out = new Array(n);
  let helperStart = 2;

  if (kind === 'ROLLING') {
    helperStart = state.helperOffsets.rollingStart + (startRow - 2);
    const c = meta.cols;
    const needed = [c.customerId, c.relationship, c.salesmanId, c.validFrom, c.visitType, c.visitValidFrom, c.scheduleVisit];
    const validCols = needed.filter(function (x) { return x > 0; });
    const minCol = Math.min.apply(null, validCols), maxCol = Math.max.apply(null, validCols);
    const rows = sh.getRange(startRow, minCol, n, maxCol - minCol + 1).getDisplayValues();
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const r = rows[i];
      const customer = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(r[c.customerId - minCol]);
      const relationship = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(r[c.relationship - minCol]);
      const salesman = extractRollingRelationshipToken_(r[c.salesmanId - minCol]);
      const validFrom = cleanText_(r[c.validFrom - minCol]);
      const visitType = normalizeRollingTemplateVisitTypeKey_(r[c.visitType - minCol]);
      const visitFrom = cleanText_(r[c.visitValidFrom - minCol]);
      const schedule = cleanText_(r[c.scheduleVisit - minCol]);
      const pair = isSalesmanToSalesmanRolling_(customer, salesman);
      const comp = customer && relationship && salesman && validFrom
        ? [customer, relationship.toUpperCase(), salesman.toUpperCase(), validFrom, visitType, visitFrom].join('|') : '';
      const schedGroup = !pair && customer && salesman && schedule ? customer + '|' + salesman : '';
      const schedValue = schedGroup ? normalizeScheduleForComparison_(schedule) : '';
      out[i] = ['ROLLING', startRow + i, comp, schedGroup, schedValue, sh.getName()];
    }
  } else if (kind === 'OFFICE') {
    helperStart = state.helperOffsets.officeStart + (startRow - 2);
    const c = meta.cols;
    const needed = [c.bp, c.plant, c.salesOrg, c.dist, c.div, c.salesOffice];
    const minCol = Math.min.apply(null, needed), maxCol = Math.max.apply(null, needed);
    const rows = sh.getRange(startRow, minCol, n, maxCol - minCol + 1).getDisplayValues();
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const r = rows[i];
      const vals = [
        cleanText_(r[c.bp - minCol]), cleanText_(r[c.plant - minCol]).toUpperCase(),
        extractRollingRelationshipToken_(r[c.salesOrg - minCol]), extractRollingRelationshipToken_(r[c.dist - minCol]),
        extractRollingRelationshipToken_(r[c.div - minCol]), extractRollingRelationshipToken_(r[c.salesOffice - minCol])
      ];
      const key = vals.every(function (x) { return Boolean(x); }) ? vals.join('|').toUpperCase() : '';
      out[i] = ['OFFICE', startRow + i, key, '', '', sh.getName()];
    }
  } else {
    helperStart = state.helperOffsets.salesmanStart + (startRow - 2);
    const c = meta.cols;
    const needed = [c.salesman, c.salesOrg, c.salesOffice, c.salesType, c.validTo].concat(c.coverage ? [c.coverage] : []);
    const minCol = Math.min.apply(null, needed), maxCol = Math.max.apply(null, needed);
    const rows = sh.getRange(startRow, minCol, n, maxCol - minCol + 1).getDisplayValues();
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const r = rows[i];
      const vals = [
        extractRollingRelationshipToken_(r[c.salesman - minCol]), extractRollingRelationshipToken_(r[c.salesOrg - minCol]),
        extractRollingRelationshipToken_(r[c.salesOffice - minCol]), extractRollingRelationshipToken_(r[c.salesType - minCol]),
        c.coverage ? cleanText_(r[c.coverage - minCol]) : '', cleanText_(r[c.validTo - minCol])
      ];
      const key = vals[0] && vals[1] && vals[2] && vals[3] && vals[5] ? vals.join('|').toUpperCase() : '';
      out[i] = ['SALESMAN', startRow + i, key, '', '', sh.getName()];
    }
  }
  helper.getRange(helperStart, 1, n, 6).setValues(out);
}

function rscV20FrontendChunk_(targetSs, state, stage, startRow, endRow) {
  const sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(stage.sheetName);
  const idx = getEmployeeMasterDataIndex_();
  let errorRows = 0;
  if (stage.key === 'ROLLING_FRONTEND') {
    errorRows = validateChangeRollingRows_(sh, idx, startRow, endRow, false);
    rscV20WriteHelperKeys_(targetSs, state, 'ROLLING', sh, state.rollingMeta, startRow, endRow);
  } else if (stage.key === 'OFFICE_FRONTEND') {
    errorRows = validateChangeSalesOfficeRows_(sh, idx, startRow, endRow, false);
    rscV20WriteHelperKeys_(targetSs, state, 'OFFICE', sh, state.officeMeta, startRow, endRow);
  } else {
    errorRows = validateChangeSalesmanTypeRows_(sh, idx, startRow, endRow, false);
    rscV20WriteHelperKeys_(targetSs, state, 'SALESMAN', sh, state.salesmanMeta, startRow, endRow);
  }
  return { localErrorRows: errorRows };
}

function rscV20TokoPostChunk_(sh, meta, startRow, endRow) {
  const c=meta.cols,required=[c.visitCategory,c.customerId,c.salesmanId,c.visitType,c.visitValidFrom,c.reason,meta.statusCol,meta.detailCol];if(required.some(function(x){return!x;}))throw new Error('Header Toko Bangkrut post-check tidak lengkap.');
  const n=endRow-startRow+1,minCol=Math.min.apply(null,required),maxCol=Math.max.apply(null,required),width=maxCol-minCol+1,range=sh.getRange(startRow,minCol,n,width),data=range.getDisplayValues();
  const needed=Object.create(null),keys=new Array(n);
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const row=data[i];if(String(row[c.reason-minCol]||'').trim().toUpperCase().indexOf('TOKO BANGKRUT')===-1||isSalesmanToSalesmanRolling_(row[c.customerId-minCol],row[c.salesmanId-minCol]))continue;const key=RSC_MVS_buildKey_(row[c.visitCategory-minCol],row[c.customerId-minCol],row[c.salesmanId-minCol],row[c.visitType-minCol]);keys[i]=key;if(key)needed[key]=true;}
  const db=RSC_MVS_getIndexSubset_20260819_(needed),statusRange=sh.getRange(startRow,meta.statusCol,n,1),detailRange=sh.getRange(startRow,meta.detailCol,n,1),status=statusRange.getDisplayValues(),detail=detailRange.getDisplayValues(),statusBg=statusRange.getBackgrounds(),detailBg=detailRange.getBackgrounds();let errors=0;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const row=data[i];if(String(row[c.reason-minCol]||'').trim().toUpperCase().indexOf('TOKO BANGKRUT')===-1||isSalesmanToSalesmanRolling_(row[c.customerId-minCol],row[c.salesmanId-minCol]))continue;
    const key=keys[i],actual=RSC_MVS_normalizeDate_(row[c.visitValidFrom-minCol]),errs=[],dates=key&&db.datesByKey[key];
    if(!key)errs.push('Toko Bangkrut: key m_visit_schedule wajib lengkap (Visit Category + Customer ID + Salesman ID + Visit Type).');else if(!dates)errs.push('Toko Bangkrut: key tidak ditemukan di m_visit_schedule (visit_category + cust_id + salesman_id + visit_type).');else if(!actual||!dates[actual])errs.push('Toko Bangkrut: Visit Valid From tidak sesuai m_visit_schedule. Actual='+(actual||'[blank/invalid]')+', Expected='+Object.keys(dates).sort().join(', ')+'.');
    if(!errs.length)continue;errors++;status[i][0]='ERROR';detail[i][0]=mergeValidationErrorTexts_(detail[i][0],errs);statusBg[i][0]=RSC_M_VISIT_SCHEDULE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260723.colorError;detailBg[i][0]=RSC_M_VISIT_SCHEDULE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260723.colorError;
  }
  if(errors){if(meta.detailCol===meta.statusCol+1){const vals=new Array(n),bgs=new Array(n);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){vals[i]=[status[i][0],detail[i][0]];bgs[i]=[statusBg[i][0],detailBg[i][0]];}sh.getRange(startRow,meta.statusCol,n,2).setValues(vals).setBackgrounds(bgs);}else{statusRange.setValues(status).setBackgrounds(statusBg);detailRange.setValues(detail).setBackgrounds(detailBg);}}
  return{errorRowsAdded:errors,lookupRows:Number(db.rowsIndexed||0)};
}


function rscV20BpExistChunk_(sh, meta, startRow, endRow) {
  const cCustomer=meta.cols.customerId,cSalesman=meta.cols.salesmanId;
  if(!cCustomer||!cSalesman||!meta.statusCol||!meta.detailCol)throw new Error('Header BP existence tidak lengkap.');
  const n=endRow-startRow+1,cols=[cCustomer,cSalesman,meta.statusCol,meta.detailCol],minCol=Math.min.apply(null,cols),maxCol=Math.max.apply(null,cols),width=maxCol-minCol+1;
  const data=sh.getRange(startRow,minCol,n,width).getValues();
  const rc=cCustomer-minCol,rs=cSalesman-minCol,rst=meta.statusCol-minCol,rd=meta.detailCol-minCol;
  const bpWanted=Object.create(null),salesWanted=Object.create(null);
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const c=normalizeBpExistenceId_(data[i][rc]),sm=normalizeBpExistenceId_(data[i][rs]);if(c)bpWanted[c]=true;
    if(sm){if(isSalesmanDummyId_(sm))bpWanted[sm]=true;else if(isSalesmanIdForBpExistValidation_(sm))salesWanted[sm]=true;else bpWanted[sm]=true;}
  }
  const bp=RSC_LOAD_FSD_BP_MASTER_SUBSET_20260807_(bpWanted,Object.create(null)),sales=RSC_STD_LOAD_ACTIVE_SALESMAN_SUBSET_20260814_(salesWanted);
  const outStatus=new Array(n),outDetail=new Array(n),statusBg=new Array(n),detailBg=new Array(n);let errors=0;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    outStatus[i]=[data[i][rst]];outDetail[i]=[data[i][rd]];statusBg[i]=[FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colorNeutral];detailBg[i]=[FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colorNeutral];
    if(!cleanTextValue_(data[i][rc])&&!cleanTextValue_(data[i][rs]))continue;
    const probs=[],cid=normalizeBpExistenceId_(data[i][rc]),sid=normalizeBpExistenceId_(data[i][rs]);
    if(cid&&!bp.exists[cid])probs.push('Customer: BP tidak exist (BP '+cid+' tidak ada di m_bp_general_view)');
    if(sid){if(isSalesmanDummyId_(sid)){if(!bp.exists[sid])probs.push('Salesman: BP Dummy tidak exist ('+sid+' tidak ada di m_bp_general_view)');}else if(isSalesmanIdForBpExistValidation_(sid)){if(!sales[sid])probs.push('Salesman: BP tidak exist (Salesman '+sid+' tidak ada di m_sales_info)');}else if(!bp.exists[sid])probs.push('Salesman: BP tidak exist (BP '+sid+' tidak ada di m_bp_general_view)');}
    if(probs.length){errors++;outStatus[i][0]='ERROR';outDetail[i][0]=mergeValidationErrorTexts_(outDetail[i][0],probs);statusBg[i][0]=FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colorError;detailBg[i][0]=FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colorError;}
    else if(String(outStatus[i][0]||'').trim().toUpperCase()!=='ERROR'){outStatus[i][0]='OK';statusBg[i][0]=FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colorOk;detailBg[i][0]=FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS.colorOk;}
  }
  if(meta.detailCol===meta.statusCol+1){const vals=new Array(n),bgs=new Array(n);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){vals[i]=[outStatus[i][0],outDetail[i][0]];bgs[i]=[statusBg[i][0],detailBg[i][0]];}sh.getRange(startRow,meta.statusCol,n,2).setValues(vals).setBackgrounds(bgs);}
  else{sh.getRange(startRow,meta.statusCol,n,1).setValues(outStatus).setBackgrounds(statusBg);sh.getRange(startRow,meta.detailCol,n,1).setValues(outDetail).setBackgrounds(detailBg);}
  return{errorRowsAdded:errors,lookupMode:bp.lookupMode||''};
}


function rscV20HelperGroupKey_(record, mode) {
  const kind = String(record[0] || '');
  if (mode === 'DUP') {
    const key = String(record[2] || '');
    return key ? kind + '\u001f' + key : '';
  }
  if (kind !== 'ROLLING') return '';
  const key = String(record[3] || '');
  return key ? kind + '\u001f' + key : '';
}

function rscV20AppendErrorMarks_(targetSs, marks) {
  const P = RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20;
  const bySheetBucket = Object.create(null);
  for (let i = 0; i < marks.length; i++) {
    const m = marks[i];
    const bucket = Math.floor((m.row - 2) / P.chunkRows);
    const k = m.sheet + '\u001f' + bucket;
    if (!bySheetBucket[k]) bySheetBucket[k] = { sheet: m.sheet, rows: Object.create(null) };
    if (!bySheetBucket[k].rows[m.row]) bySheetBucket[k].rows[m.row] = [];
    bySheetBucket[k].rows[m.row].push(m.message);
  }

  const keys = Object.keys(bySheetBucket);
  for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    const group = bySheetBucket[keys[i]];
    const sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(group.sheet);
    if (!sh) continue;
    ensureValidationStatusColumns_(sh);
    const hm = buildHeaderMap_(sh);
    const cStatus = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.validationStatusHeader]);
    const cDetail = findColumnByHeaderNames_(hm, [TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.errorDetailHeader]);
    if (!cStatus || !cDetail) continue;
    const rowNums = Object.keys(group.rows).map(Number).sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; });
    const minRow = rowNums[0], maxRow = rowNums[rowNums.length - 1], n = maxRow - minRow + 1;
    const statusRange = sh.getRange(minRow, cStatus, n, 1);
    const detailRange = sh.getRange(minRow, cDetail, n, 1);
    const status = statusRange.getValues(), detail = detailRange.getValues();
    const statusBg = statusRange.getBackgrounds(), detailBg = detailRange.getBackgrounds();
    const statusFg = statusRange.getFontColors(), detailFg = detailRange.getFontColors();
    const statusFw = statusRange.getFontWeights(), detailWrap = detailRange.getWraps();
    for (let r = 0; r < rowNums.length; r++) {
      const row = rowNums[r];
      const idx = row - minRow;
      status[idx][0] = 'ERROR';
      detail[idx][0] = mergeValidationErrorTexts_(detail[idx][0], group.rows[row]);
      statusBg[idx][0] = TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.error;
      detailBg[idx][0] = TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.error;
      statusFg[idx][0] = '#991B1B';
      detailFg[idx][0] = '#991B1B';
      statusFw[idx][0] = 'bold';
      detailWrap[idx][0] = true;
    }
    statusRange.setValues(status).setBackgrounds(statusBg).setFontColors(statusFg).setFontWeights(statusFw);
    detailRange.setValues(detail).setBackgrounds(detailBg).setFontColors(detailFg).setWraps(detailWrap);
  }
}

function rscV20HelperScanChunk_(targetSs, helper, state, startRow, endRow, mode) {
  const last = 1 + state.helperOffsets.totalRows;
  let actualEnd = Math.min(endRow, last);
  let rows = helper.getRange(startRow, 1, actualEnd - startRow + 1, 6).getValues();
  let lastKey = rows.length ? rscV20HelperGroupKey_(rows[rows.length - 1], mode) : '';

  // Extend to the end of the boundary group so no duplicate group is split across checkpoints.
  while (lastKey && actualEnd < last) {
    const extraCount = Math.min(1000, last - actualEnd);
    const extra = helper.getRange(actualEnd + 1, 1, extraCount, 6).getValues();
    let take = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < extra.length; i++) {
      if (rscV20HelperGroupKey_(extra[i], mode) !== lastKey) break;
      take++;
    }
    if (!take) break;
    rows = rows.concat(extra.slice(0, take));
    actualEnd += take;
    if (take < extra.length) break;
  }

  const marks = [];
  let i = 0;
  while (i < rows.length) {
    const key = rscV20HelperGroupKey_(rows[i], mode);
    if (!key) { i++; continue; }
    let j = i + 1;
    while (j < rows.length && rscV20HelperGroupKey_(rows[j], mode) === key) j++;
    const group = rows.slice(i, j);
    if (mode === 'DUP' && group.length > 1) {
      for (let k = 0; k < group.length; k++) {
        const kind = String(group[k][0] || '');
        const message = kind === 'ROLLING'
          ? 'Composite key Customer ID + Relationship + Salesman ID + Valid From + Visit Type + Visit Valid From duplikat dalam template.'
          : kind === 'OFFICE'
            ? 'Baris duplikat dalam template untuk BP + Plant + Sales Area + Sales Office yang sama.'
            : 'Baris duplikat dalam template untuk Salesman + Sales Org + Sales Office + Sales Type + Coverage + Valid To yang sama.';
        marks.push({ sheet: String(group[k][5] || ''), row: Number(group[k][1] || 0), message: message });
      }
    } else if (mode === 'SCHED') {
      const schedules = Object.create(null);
      for (let k = 0; k < group.length; k++) schedules[String(group[k][4] || '')] = true;
      if (Object.keys(schedules).filter(Boolean).length > 1) {
        for (let k = 0; k < group.length; k++) {
          marks.push({
            sheet: String(group[k][5] || ''), row: Number(group[k][1] || 0),
            message: 'Customer ID + Salesman ID yang sama tidak boleh memiliki Schedule Visit berbeda di baris lain.'
          });
        }
      }
    }
    i = j;
  }
  if (marks.length) rscV20AppendErrorMarks_(targetSs, marks);
  return { actualEnd: actualEnd, markedRows: marks.length };
}

function rscV20FinalScanChunk_(sh, meta, startRow, endRow) {
  if (!meta.statusCol) return { errorRows: 0 };
  const vals = sh.getRange(startRow, meta.statusCol, endRow - startRow + 1, 1).getDisplayValues();
  let count = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
    if (String(vals[i][0] || '').trim().toUpperCase() === 'ERROR') count++;
  }
  return { errorRows: count };
}

function rscV20ProcessOneChunk_(targetSs, state) {
  const P = RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20;
  if (state.stage === 'INIT' || state.stageIndex < 0) {
    const result = rscV20InitFile_(targetSs, state);
    state.stage = state.stagePlan.length ? state.stagePlan[0].key : 'COMPLETE';
    return { complete: state.stagePlan.length === 0, stageDone: true, result: result };
  }

  const stage = rscV20CurrentStage_(state);
  if (!stage) return { complete: true, stageDone: true, result: {} };
  const info = rscV20StageChunkInfo_(state, stage);
  const sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(stage.sheetName);
  let result = {};
  let actualEnd = info.end;

  switch (stage.key) {
    case 'ROLLING_BP_TYPE': result = rscV20SyncBpTypeChunk_(sh, state.rollingMeta, info.start, info.end); break;
    case 'ROLLING_DATE_DB': result = rscV20DateDbChunk_(sh, state.rollingMeta, info.start, info.end); break;
    case 'ROLLING_ROLLING_DATE': result = rscV20RollingDateChunk_(sh, state.rollingMeta, info.start, info.end); break;
    case 'ROLLING_TOKO_PRE': result = rscV20TokoPreChunk_(sh, state.rollingMeta, info.start, info.end); break;
    case 'ROLLING_FRONTEND': result = rscV20FrontendChunk_(targetSs, state, stage, info.start, info.end); break;
    case 'ROLLING_TOKO_POST': result = rscV20TokoPostChunk_(sh, state.rollingMeta, info.start, info.end); break;
    case 'ROLLING_BP_EXIST': result = rscV20BpExistChunk_(sh, state.rollingMeta, info.start, info.end); break;
    case 'OFFICE_FRONTEND': result = rscV20FrontendChunk_(targetSs, state, stage, info.start, info.end); break;
    case 'SALESMAN_FRONTEND': result = rscV20FrontendChunk_(targetSs, state, stage, info.start, info.end); break;
    case 'HELPER_SORT_DUP':
      if (state.helperOffsets.totalRows > 0) targetSs.getSheetByName(P.helperSheetName).getRange(2, 1, state.helperOffsets.totalRows, 6)
        .sort([{ column: 1, ascending: true }, { column: 3, ascending: true }, { column: 2, ascending: true }]);
      result = { sorted: 'duplicate keys' }; break;
    case 'HELPER_DUP_SCAN':
      result = rscV20HelperScanChunk_(targetSs, targetSs.getSheetByName(P.helperSheetName), state, info.start, info.end, 'DUP');
      actualEnd = result.actualEnd; break;
    case 'HELPER_SORT_SCHED':
      if (state.helperOffsets.totalRows > 0) targetSs.getSheetByName(P.helperSheetName).getRange(2, 1, state.helperOffsets.totalRows, 6)
        .sort([{ column: 1, ascending: true }, { column: 4, ascending: true }, { column: 5, ascending: true }, { column: 2, ascending: true }]);
      result = { sorted: 'schedule keys' }; break;
    case 'HELPER_SCHED_SCAN':
      result = rscV20HelperScanChunk_(targetSs, targetSs.getSheetByName(P.helperSheetName), state, info.start, info.end, 'SCHED');
      actualEnd = result.actualEnd; break;
    case 'FINAL_ROLLING_SCAN': result = rscV20FinalScanChunk_(sh, state.rollingMeta, info.start, info.end); state.errorRows += result.errorRows; break;
    case 'FINAL_OFFICE_SCAN': result = rscV20FinalScanChunk_(sh, state.officeMeta, info.start, info.end); state.errorRows += result.errorRows; break;
    case 'FINAL_SALESMAN_SCAN': result = rscV20FinalScanChunk_(sh, state.salesmanMeta, info.start, info.end); state.errorRows += result.errorRows; break;
    default: throw new Error('Stage V20 tidak dikenal: ' + stage.key);
  }

  state.doneUnits = Number(state.doneUnits || 0) + 1;
  const stageFinished = actualEnd >= info.last || stage.totalRows <= 1;
  if (stageFinished) {
    state.stageIndex++;
    const next = rscV20CurrentStage_(state);
    state.stage = next ? next.key : 'COMPLETE';
    state.nextRow = next ? next.firstRow : 0;
  } else {
    state.nextRow = actualEnd + 1;
    state.stage = stage.key;
  }
  state.attempts = 0;
  state.updatedAt = rscV20NowIso_();
  return {
    complete: state.stage === 'COMPLETE',
    stageDone: stageFinished,
    stage: stage.key,
    chunkNo: info.chunkNo,
    chunks: info.chunks,
    result: result
  };
}

function rscV20ProgressText_(state) {
  const total = Math.max(1, Number(state.totalUnits || 1));
  const done = Math.min(total, Number(state.doneUnits || 0));
  return Math.floor(done * 100 / total) + '%';
}

function rscV20CommitTask_(task, processResult, message, complete) {
  const P = RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(5000)) throw new Error('Gagal memperoleh lock untuk commit manifest.');
  try {
    const ss = rscV20GetMasterSpreadsheet_();
    const masterSh = rscV20GetMasterSheet_(ss);
    const manifestSh = rscV20GetOrCreateManifestSheet_(ss, false);
    const current = manifestSh.getRange(task.manifestRow, 1, 1, P.manifestHeaders.length).getValues()[0];
    if (String(current[0] || '') !== String(task.runToken || '')) return false;
    const currentState = rscV20ParseState_(current[14]);
    if (currentState.leaseToken && currentState.leaseToken !== task.state.leaseToken) return false;

    const stage = task.state.stage || 'COMPLETE';
    const progress = rscV20ProgressText_(task.state);
    let chunkText = '0';
    let totalChunkText = '0';
    if (processResult && processResult.chunkNo) {
      chunkText = String(processResult.chunkNo);
      totalChunkText = String(processResult.chunks || 1);
    }
    const status = complete
      ? ((Number(task.state.errorRows || 0) > 0 || (task.state.fileErrors || []).length) ? 'COMPLETE_ERROR' : 'COMPLETE_OK')
      : 'PARTIAL_VALIDATION';
    const leaseUntil = complete ? '' : new Date(Date.now() + P.leaseMs).toISOString();
    task.state.updatedAt = rscV20NowIso_();

    manifestSh.getRange(task.manifestRow, 5, 1, 12).setValues([[
      status, stage, progress, chunkText, totalChunkText,
      complete ? '' : task.lane, leaseUntil, Number(task.state.errorRows || 0),
      task.state.updatedAt, message, JSON.stringify(task.state), task.state.fileName || task.fileName || ''
    ]]);

    const color = complete
      ? (status === 'COMPLETE_OK' ? P.colorOk : P.colorError)
      : P.colorPartial;
    const note = complete
      ? status + ' | errors=' + Number(task.state.errorRows || 0) +
        ((task.state.fileErrors || []).length ? ' | ' + task.state.fileErrors.join(' | ') : '')
      : 'PARTIAL VALIDATION | lane=' + task.lane + ' | stage=' + stage +
        ' | chunk=' + chunkText + '/' + totalChunkText + ' | overall=' + progress +
        ' | ' + message;
    const masterRows = (task.state.masterRows && task.state.masterRows.length)
      ? task.state.masterRows : [task.masterRow];
    for (let i = 0; i < masterRows.length; i++) {
      masterSh.getRange(Number(masterRows[i]), VALIDATE_ALL_FINAL_LINKS_PARAMETERS.masterLinkCol)
        .setBackground(color)
        .setNote(truncateValidateAllNote_(note, 45000));
    }

    return true;
  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (ignore) {}
  }
}

function rscV20CommitChunkError_(task, err) {
  const P = RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20;
  task.state.attempts = Number(task.state.attempts || 0) + 1;
  const msg = formatScriptError_(err);
  const hard = task.state.attempts >= P.maxChunkRetries;
  if (hard) {
    task.state.fileErrors = task.state.fileErrors || [];
    task.state.fileErrors.push('HARD ERROR stage ' + task.state.stage + ': ' + msg);
    task.state.stage = 'COMPLETE';
  }
  return rscV20CommitTask_(task, null,
    (hard ? 'HARD ERROR setelah ' + task.state.attempts + ' percobaan: ' : 'Retry ' + task.state.attempts + '/' + P.maxChunkRetries + ': ') + msg,
    hard);
}

function legacyV20RunValidateAllFinalLinksWorker_(lane) {
  const P = RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  if (props.getProperty(P.pStop) === 'TRUE') return;
  const started = Date.now();
  __RSC_V20_RELATION_INDEX__ = null;
  if (typeof __SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_SYNC_INDEX_CACHE__ !== 'undefined') __SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_SYNC_INDEX_CACHE__ = null;
  if (typeof __RSC_M_VISIT_SCHEDULE_VALIDATION_INDEX_CACHE_20260723__ !== 'undefined') __RSC_M_VISIT_SCHEDULE_VALIDATION_INDEX_CACHE_20260723__ = null;
  resetBpExistenceDatabaseCache_();

  let task = null;
  let targetSs = null;
  let currentFileId = '';
  const previousTarget = __ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_TARGET_SPREADSHEET_CACHE__;

  try {
    while (Date.now() - started < P.workerSoftDeadlineMs) {
      if (props.getProperty(P.pStop) === 'TRUE') break;
      if (!task) {
        task = rscV20ClaimTask_(lane);
        if (!task) break;
      }
      if (!task.fileId) {
        task.state.fileErrors = task.state.fileErrors || [];
        task.state.fileErrors.push('File ID kosong.');
        task.state.stage = 'COMPLETE';
        rscV20CommitTask_(task, null, 'File ID kosong.', true);
        task = null;
        continue;
      }

      try {
        if (currentFileId !== task.fileId) {
          targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(task.fileId);
          currentFileId = task.fileId;
          __ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_TARGET_SPREADSHEET_CACHE__ = targetSs;
          if (typeof __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__ !== 'undefined') __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__ = null;
        }
        const result = rscV20ProcessOneChunk_(targetSs, task.state);
        const message = result.stage
          ? result.stage + ' chunk ' + (result.chunkNo || 1) + '/' + (result.chunks || 1) + ' selesai.'
          : 'Inisialisasi file selesai.';
        if (result.complete) {
          try {
            const helper = targetSs.getSheetByName(P.helperSheetName);
            if (helper) targetSs.deleteSheet(helper);
          } catch (ignore) {}
        }
        rscV20CommitTask_(task, result, message, result.complete);
        SpreadsheetApp.flush();
        if (result.complete) {
          task = null;
          targetSs = null;
          currentFileId = '';
          __ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_TARGET_SPREADSHEET_CACHE__ = previousTarget;
          if (typeof __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__ !== 'undefined') __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__ = null;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        rscV20CommitChunkError_(task, err);
        if (task.state.stage === 'COMPLETE') {
          task = null; targetSs = null; currentFileId = '';
        } else {
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  } finally {
    __ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_TARGET_SPREADSHEET_CACHE__ = previousTarget;
    if (typeof __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__ !== 'undefined') __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__ = null;
  }

  if (props.getProperty(P.pStop) !== 'TRUE' && rscV20HasUnfinishedWork_()) {
    try { rscV20ScheduleOneTimeHandler_(P.workerHandlers[lane - 1], P.workerRetryDelayMs); } catch (err) {
      writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('V20 worker reschedule failed lane ' + lane + ': ' + formatScriptError_(err));
    }
  }
}

function rscV20HasUnfinishedWork_() {
  const P = RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const runToken = props.getProperty(P.pRunToken) || '';
  if (!runToken) return false;
  const ss = rscV20GetMasterSpreadsheet_();
  const sh = rscV20GetOrCreateManifestSheet_(ss, false);
  if (sh.getLastRow() < 2) return false;
  const vals = sh.getRange(2, 1, sh.getLastRow() - 1, 5).getValues();
  for (let i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
    if (String(vals[i][0] || '') !== runToken) continue;
    const s = String(vals[i][4] || '');
    if (s === 'QUEUED' || s === 'ACTIVE' || s === 'PARTIAL_VALIDATION') return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function legacyV20WatchdogValidateAllFinalLinksInColumnE_() {
  const P = RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  if (props.getProperty(P.pStop) === 'TRUE') return;
  if (!rscV20HasUnfinishedWork_()) {
    deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_(P.workerHandlers.concat([P.watchdogHandler, VALIDATE_ALL_FINAL_LINKS_PARAMETERS.fn]));
    try { rscV20GetMasterSpreadsheet_().toast('Validate ALL E V20 selesai untuk seluruh manifest.', 'Validate ALL E V20', 10); } catch (ignore) {}
    try {
      if (typeof RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_ON_VALIDATION_DONE_20260813_ === 'function') {
        RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_ON_VALIDATION_DONE_20260813_();
      }
    } catch (pipelineErr) {
      writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('Master auto pipeline callback validation failed: ' + formatScriptError_(pipelineErr));
    }
    return;
  }

  const workers = Math.max(1, Number(props.getProperty(P.pWorkerCount) || rscV20ResolveWorkerCapacity_()));
  const existing = Object.create(null);
  ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(function (t) { existing[t.getHandlerFunction()] = true; });
  for (let lane = 1; lane <= workers; lane++) {
    const handler = P.workerHandlers[lane - 1];
    if (!existing[handler]) {
      try { rscV20ScheduleOneTimeHandler_(handler, 1000 + lane * 500); } catch (err) {
        writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('V20 watchdog schedule failed lane ' + lane + ': ' + formatScriptError_(err));
      }
    }
  }
}

function legacyV20ShowValidateAllFinalLinksInColumnEStatus_() {
  const P = RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const runToken = props.getProperty(P.pRunToken) || '';
  const ss = rscV20GetMasterSpreadsheet_();
  const sh = rscV20GetOrCreateManifestSheet_(ss, false);
  const last = sh.getLastRow();
  const counts = Object.create(null);
  const active = [];
  if (last >= 2) {
    const vals = sh.getRange(2, 1, last - 1, P.manifestHeaders.length).getDisplayValues();
    for (let i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
      if (runToken && vals[i][0] !== runToken) continue;
      const status = vals[i][4] || 'UNKNOWN';
      counts[status] = Number(counts[status] || 0) + 1;
      if ((status === 'ACTIVE' || status === 'PARTIAL_VALIDATION') && active.length < 8) {
        active.push('Row ' + vals[i][1] + ': ' + vals[i][5] + ' chunk ' + vals[i][7] + '/' + vals[i][8] + ' (' + vals[i][6] + '), lane ' + vals[i][9]);
      }
    }
  }
  const msg = 'Validate ALL E V20 | workers=' + (props.getProperty(P.pWorkerCount) || '?') +
    ' | QUEUED=' + Number(counts.QUEUED || 0) +
    ' | ACTIVE/PARTIAL=' + (Number(counts.ACTIVE || 0) + Number(counts.PARTIAL_VALIDATION || 0)) +
    ' | COMPLETE_OK=' + Number(counts.COMPLETE_OK || 0) +
    ' | COMPLETE_ERROR=' + Number(counts.COMPLETE_ERROR || 0) +
    ' | HARD_ERROR=' + Number(counts.HARD_ERROR || 0) +
    (active.length ? '\n\n' + active.join('\n') : '');
  try { sh.showSheet(); ss.setActiveSheet(sh); } catch (ignore) {}
  ss.toast(msg, 'Validate ALL E V20', 15);
  writeRollingSalesCenterLog_(msg);
}

function legacyV20StopValidateAllFinalLinksInColumnE_() {
  const P = RSC_VALIDATE_ALL_E_V20;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.setProperty(P.pStop, 'TRUE');
  rscV20DeleteAllJobTriggers_();
  try {
    const ss = rscV20GetMasterSpreadsheet_();
    ss.toast('Validate ALL E V20 dihentikan. Manifest/checkpoint dipertahankan untuk audit.', 'Validate ALL E V20', 10);
  } catch (ignore) {}
}

  if(sh.getMaxColumns()<colCount)sh.insertColumnsAfter(sh.getMaxColumns(),colCount-sh.getMaxColumns());
  if(sh.getMaxRows()<C.historyStartRow+50)sh.insertRowsAfter(sh.getMaxRows(),C.historyStartRow+50-sh.getMaxRows());

function RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_APPEND_HISTORY_20260819_(sh,slot,state) {
  const C=RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_20260819;
  let next=Math.max(C.historyStartRow,sh.getLastRow()+1);
  if(next>C.historyStartRow+C.maxHistoryRows){
    try{sh.deleteRows(C.historyStartRow,C.trimHistoryRows);}catch(ignoreTrim){}
    next=Math.max(C.historyStartRow,sh.getLastRow()+1);
  }
  const values=RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_ROW_VALUES_20260819_(slot,state);
  sh.getRange(next,1,1,C.columns.length).setValues([values]);
  sh.getRange(next,5).setNumberFormat('0%');sh.getRange(next,13,1,2).setNumberFormat('yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss');
  const sty=RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_STYLE_STATE_20260819_(state.state);
  sh.getRange(next,1,1,C.columns.length).setBackground(sty.bg).setFontColor(sty.fg);

function RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,state,options) {
  options=options||{};slot=String(slot||'SYSTEM').toUpperCase();state=state||{};
  const C=RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_20260819,p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties(),now=Date.now();
  state.updatedAt=new Date(now).toISOString();state.effectiveUser=state.effectiveUser||RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_EFFECTIVE_USER_20260819_();
  RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_SAVE_STATE_20260819_(slot,state);
  const last=Number(p.getProperty(C.pLastSheetWritePrefix+slot)||0);
  const force=Boolean(options.force||state.error||/ERROR|COMPLETE|RETRY|BLOCKED|PAUSED|START/.test(String(state.state||'').toUpperCase()));
  if(!force&&now-last<C.throttleMs)return{stored:true,written:false,throttled:true};

  const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();
  if(!lock.tryLock(Number(options.lockWaitMs||350)))return{stored:true,written:false,lockBusy:true};
  try{
    const ss=RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_RESOLVE_SS_20260819_(options.ss||null);if(!ss)return{stored:true,written:false,noSpreadsheet:true};
    const sh=RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_ENSURE_SHEET_20260819_(ss);if(!sh)return{stored:true,written:false,noSheet:true};
    const row=RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_SLOT_ROW_20260819_(slot),values=RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_ROW_VALUES_20260819_(slot,state);
    sh.getRange(row,1,1,C.columns.length).setValues([values]);
    const sty=RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_STYLE_STATE_20260819_(state.state);
    sh.getRange(row,1,1,C.columns.length).setBackground(sty.bg).setFontColor(sty.fg);
    if(options.history||state.error||/ERROR|COMPLETE|RETRY|BLOCKED|PAUSED|START/.test(String(state.state||'').toUpperCase())){
      RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_APPEND_HISTORY_20260819_(sh,slot,state);
    }
    sh.getRange(2,2).setValue(new Date()).setNumberFormat('yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss');
    p.setProperty(C.pLastSheetWritePrefix+slot,String(now));
    return{stored:true,written:true,row:row};
  }catch(err){
    try{console.warn('[PERF16 joblog] '+String(err&&err.message||err));}catch(ignoreWarn){}
    return{stored:true,written:false,error:String(err&&err.message||err)};
  }finally{try{lock.releaseLock();}catch(ignoreUnlock){}}
}

  options=options||{};
  try{
    const ss=RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_RESOLVE_SS_20260819_(options.ss||null);if(!ss)return{ok:false};
    const sh=RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_ENSURE_SHEET_20260819_(ss);if(!sh)return{ok:false};
    let x={runId:'',counts:{},total:0,unfinished:0};try{x=RSC_STD_BULK_COUNTS_20260814_();}catch(ignoreCounts){}
    const c=x.counts||{},done=Number(c.COMPLETE_OK||0)+Number(c.COMPLETE_ERROR||0)+Number(c.HARD_ERROR||0)+Number(c.SKIPPED_INVALID||0),progress=x.total?done/x.total:0;
    sh.getRange(2,1,1,10).setValues([['Last Dashboard Update',new Date(),'Run ID',x.runId||'', 'Overall Progress',progress,'Total Tasks',Number(x.total||0),'Unfinished',Number(x.unfinished||0)]]);
    sh.getRange(2,2).setNumberFormat('yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss');sh.getRange(2,6).setNumberFormat('0%');

    return{ok:true,runId:x.runId,total:x.total,unfinished:x.unfinished,progressPct:Number((progress*100).toFixed(1)),counts:c};
  }catch(err){return{ok:false,error:String(err&&err.message||err)};}
}
