function RSC_STD_IS_REGISTERED_RELATIONSHIP_20260814_(value, masterSet) {
  const id = normalizeRscCodeToken_(value);
  if (!id) return false;
  if (id === 'BUR001') return true;
  const m = /^ZWS(\d{3})$/.exec(id);
  if (m) {
    const n = Number(m[1]);
    if (n >= 1 && n <= 22) return true;
  }
  return Boolean(masterSet && masterSet[id]);
}

/**
 * PRE-VALIDATION CANONICALIZATION.
 *
 * Copy/compile/setValues tidak menembakkan onEdit. Karena itu normalisasi
 * wajib dijalankan kembali di core Standard agar Active, Bulk, dan Hourly
 * membaca value yang sama. Hasil canonical juga ditulis balik supaya dropdown
 * dan output O:P tidak tergantung user memilih ulang cell.
 */
function RSC_STD_NORMALIZE_ROLLING_CODES_20260814_(sh) {
  const P = RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807;
  RSC_ASSERT_FSD_ACTIVE_ROLLING_LAYOUT_20260807_(sh);
  const lastRow = RSC_GET_FSD_LAST_DATA_ROW_20260807_(sh);
  if (lastRow < P.firstDataRow) return {checkedCells:0,changedCells:0,changedRows:0,chunks:0,neededBpIds:Object.create(null),neededSalesmanIds:Object.create(null),rows:0};

  const specs = [
    {col:P.columns.salesOffice, fn:normalizeRscCodeToken_},
    {col:P.columns.deliveringPlant, fn:normalizeRscCodeToken_},
    {col:P.columns.customerId, fn:normalizeBpExistenceId_},
    {col:P.columns.relationship, fn:normalizeRscCodeToken_},
    {col:P.columns.salesmanId, fn:normalizeSalesmanIdForValidation_},
    {col:P.columns.salesmanBpType, fn:normalizeRscCodeToken_},
    {col:P.columns.visitCategory, fn:normalizeRscCodeToken_},
    {col:P.columns.visitType, fn:normalizeRscVisitTypeToken_},
    {col:P.columns.scheduleVisit, fn:normalizeRscScheduleToken_}
  ];
  const changedRowSet = Object.create(null);
  const neededBpIds=Object.create(null),neededSalesmanIds=Object.create(null);
  let checkedCells=0, changedCells=0, chunks=0,rowsChecked=0;
  const minCol=Math.min.apply(null,specs.map(function(x){return x.col;}));
  const maxCol=Math.max.apply(null,specs.map(function(x){return x.col;}));
  const width=maxCol-minCol+1;
  const chunkRows = RSC_FSD_SAFE_CHUNK_ROWS_20260807_(width,P.activeReadChunkRows||500);

  for(let start=P.firstDataRow;start<=lastRow;start+=chunkRows){
    const count=Math.min(chunkRows,lastRow-start+1);
    const sourceRange=sh.getRange(start,minCol,count,width);
    const display=sourceRange.getDisplayValues();
    const formulas=sourceRange.getFormulas();
    const outputs=specs.map(function(){return new Array(count);});
    const dirty=specs.map(function(){return false;});

    for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
      let normalizedCustomer='',normalizedSalesman='';
      for(let s=0;s<specs.length;s++){
        const rel=specs[s].col-minCol;
        if(formulas[i][rel]){
          const visibleNormalized=specs[s].fn(display[i][rel]);
          if(specs[s].col===P.columns.customerId)normalizedCustomer=visibleNormalized;
          if(specs[s].col===P.columns.salesmanId)normalizedSalesman=visibleNormalized;
          outputs[s][i]=[formulas[i][rel]];
          continue;
        }
        const original=String(display[i][rel]==null?'':display[i][rel]);
        if(original!=='')checkedCells++;
        const normalized=specs[s].fn(original);
        if(specs[s].col===P.columns.customerId)normalizedCustomer=normalized;
        if(specs[s].col===P.columns.salesmanId)normalizedSalesman=normalized;
        outputs[s][i]=[normalized];
        if(normalized!==original){dirty[s]=true;changedCells++;changedRowSet[start+i]=true;}
      }
      if(normalizedCustomer)neededBpIds[normalizedCustomer]=true;
      if(normalizedSalesman){neededBpIds[normalizedSalesman]=true;neededSalesmanIds[normalizedSalesman]=true;}
      if(normalizedCustomer||normalizedSalesman)rowsChecked++;
    }
    for(let s=0;s<specs.length;s++){
      if(dirty[s]) sh.getRange(start,specs[s].col,count,1).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(outputs[s]);
    }
    chunks++;
  }
  if(changedCells) SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  return {checkedCells:checkedCells,changedCells:changedCells,changedRows:Object.keys(changedRowSet).length,chunks:chunks,neededBpIds:neededBpIds,neededSalesmanIds:neededSalesmanIds,rows:rowsChecked};
}

function RSC_STD_NORMALIZE_ROLLING_DATES_BATCHED_20260814_(sh) {
  const P=RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807;
  RSC_ASSERT_FSD_ACTIVE_ROLLING_LAYOUT_20260807_(sh);
  const lastRow=RSC_GET_FSD_LAST_DATA_ROW_20260807_(sh);
  if(lastRow<P.firstDataRow)return{checkedCells:0,convertedCells:0,invalidCells:0,formattedColumns:0,chunks:0,invalidExamples:''};
  const specs=[
    {col:P.columns.validFrom,name:'Valid From'},
    {col:P.columns.validTo,name:'Valid To'},
    {col:P.columns.visitValidFrom,name:'Visit Valid From'},
    {col:P.columns.visitValidTo,name:'Visit Valid To'}
  ].sort(function(a,b){return a.col-b.col;});
  const minCol=specs[0].col,maxCol=specs[specs.length-1].col,width=maxCol-minCol+1;
  const tz=(sh.getParent&&sh.getParent().getSpreadsheetTimeZone)?sh.getParent().getSpreadsheetTimeZone():Session.getScriptTimeZone();
  const chunkRows=RSC_FSD_SAFE_CHUNK_ROWS_20260807_(width,P.activeReadChunkRows||500);
  let checkedCells=0,convertedCells=0,invalidCells=0,chunks=0;const invalidExamples=[];

  for(let start=P.firstDataRow;start<=lastRow;start+=chunkRows){
    const count=Math.min(chunkRows,lastRow-start+1),sourceRange=sh.getRange(start,minCol,count,width);
    const raw=sourceRange.getValues(),display=sourceRange.getDisplayValues(),formulas=sourceRange.getFormulas();
    const outputs=specs.map(function(){return new Array(count);}),dirty=specs.map(function(){return false;});
    for(let i=0;i<count;i++)for(let x=0;x<specs.length;x++){
      const rel=specs[x].col-minCol,formula=formulas[i][rel],rawValue=raw[i][rel],shown=String(display[i][rel]==null?'':display[i][rel]).trim();
      if(formula){outputs[x][i]=[formula];if(shown)checkedCells++;continue;}
      if((rawValue===''||rawValue===null)&&!shown){outputs[x][i]=[''];continue;}
      checkedCells++;
      if(rawValue instanceof Date&&!isNaN(rawValue.getTime())){outputs[x][i]=[rawValue];continue;}
      const parsed=RSC_PARSE_FLEXIBLE_DATE_INPUT_20260807_(rawValue,shown,tz);
      if(!parsed.ok){outputs[x][i]=[rawValue];invalidCells++;if(invalidExamples.length<8)invalidExamples.push(specs[x].name+' row '+(start+i)+'="'+shown+'"');continue;}
      outputs[x][i]=[new Date(parsed.year,parsed.month-1,parsed.day,12,0,0,0)];dirty[x]=true;convertedCells++;
    }

    // PERF5: group adjacent dirty date columns (typically G:H and L:M), reducing setValues calls.
    let x=0;
    while(x<specs.length){
      if(!dirty[x]){x++;continue;}
      let y=x;
      while(y+1<specs.length&&dirty[y+1]&&specs[y+1].col===specs[y].col+1)y++;
      const w=y-x+1,vals=new Array(count);
      for(let r=0;r<count;r++){vals[r]=new Array(w);for(let k=0;k<w;k++)vals[r][k]=outputs[x+k][r][0];}
      sh.getRange(start,specs[x].col,count,w).setValues(vals);
      RSC_PERF5_STAT_20260819_('dateGroupedWrites',1);
      x=y+1;
    }
    chunks++;
  }

  // PERF5: format adjacent date columns as groups rather than four separate calls.
  let x=0;
  while(x<specs.length){let y=x;while(y+1<specs.length&&specs[y+1].col===specs[y].col+1)y++;sh.getRange(P.firstDataRow,specs[x].col,lastRow-P.firstDataRow+1,specs[y].col-specs[x].col+1).setNumberFormat('yyyy-mm-dd');x=y+1;}
  if(convertedCells)SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  return{checkedCells:checkedCells,convertedCells:convertedCells,invalidCells:invalidCells,formattedColumns:specs.length,chunks:chunks,invalidExamples:invalidExamples.join(' | ')};
}


function RSC_STD_VALIDATE_SCHEDULE_RULES_20260814_(visitCategory, scheduleValue) {
  const errors = [];
  const category = cleanText_(visitCategory).toUpperCase();
  const raw = cleanText_(scheduleValue);
  const schedule = raw.replace(/Th/gi, 'TH').replace(/Su/gi, 'SU').toUpperCase();
  if (/\s/.test(raw)) errors.push('Schedule Visit tidak boleh mengandung spasi; separator harus comma langsung.');
  const tokensRaw = schedule.split(',');
  const tokens = tokensRaw.filter(function (t) { return t !== ''; });
  if (tokens.length !== tokensRaw.length) errors.push('Schedule Visit tidak boleh memiliki token kosong.');
  const seen = Object.create(null), parsed = [];
  tokens.forEach(function (token) {
    if (seen[token]) errors.push('Schedule Visit tidak boleh memiliki token duplikat: ' + token + '.');
    seen[token] = true;
    const m = /^W([1-4])(TH|SU|M|T|W|F|S)$/.exec(token);
    if (!m) errors.push('Token Schedule Visit tidak valid: ' + token + '. Format W<1-4><M/T/W/TH/F/S/SU>.');
    else parsed.push({ week: Number(m[1]), day: m[2] });
  });
  if (parsed.length !== tokens.length) return deduplicateArray_(errors);
  if (category === 'F1') {
    if (parsed.length !== 1) errors.push('F1 harus berisi tepat 1 token schedule.');
  } else if (category === 'F2') {
    if (parsed.length !== 2) errors.push('F2 harus berisi tepat 2 token schedule.');
    else {
      const weeks = [parsed[0].week, parsed[1].week].sort(function(a,b){return a-b;}).join(',');
      if (parsed[0].day !== parsed[1].day) errors.push('F2 wajib menggunakan hari yang sama.');
      if (weeks !== '1,3' && weeks !== '2,4') errors.push('F2 pasangan minggu hanya boleh W1+W3 atau W2+W4.');
    }
  } else if (category === 'F4') {
    if (parsed.length !== 4) errors.push('F4 harus berisi tepat 4 token schedule.');
    else {
      const day = parsed[0].day;
      const weeks = parsed.map(function(p){return p.week;}).sort(function(a,b){return a-b;}).join(',');
      if (!parsed.every(function(p){return p.day===day;}) || weeks !== '1,2,3,4') errors.push('F4 harus hari yang sama dan mencakup W1,W2,W3,W4.');
    }
  } else if (category === 'F8') {
    if (parsed.length !== 8) errors.push('F8 harus berisi tepat 8 token schedule.');
    const byDay = Object.create(null);
    parsed.forEach(function(p){ if(!byDay[p.day]) byDay[p.day]=[]; byDay[p.day].push(p.week); });
    const days = Object.keys(byDay);
    if (days.length !== 2) errors.push('F8 harus terdiri dari tepat 2 hari berbeda.');
    days.forEach(function(day){
      const weeks = byDay[day].sort(function(a,b){return a-b;}).join(',');
      if (weeks !== '1,2,3,4') errors.push('Untuk F8, hari ' + day + ' harus mencakup W1,W2,W3,W4.');
    });
  }
  return deduplicateArray_(errors);
}

function RSC_STD_COLLECT_ROLLING_BP_NEEDS_20260814_(sh) {
  const P = RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807;
  const lastRow = RSC_GET_FSD_LAST_DATA_ROW_20260807_(sh);
  const neededBpIds = Object.create(null), neededSalesmanIds = Object.create(null);
  if (lastRow < P.firstDataRow) return {neededBpIds:neededBpIds,neededSalesmanIds:neededSalesmanIds,rows:0};
  const width = P.columns.salesmanId - P.columns.customerId + 1;
  const chunkRows = RSC_FSD_SAFE_CHUNK_ROWS_20260807_(width, 1000);
  let rowsChecked=0;
  for(let start=P.firstDataRow; start<=lastRow; start+=chunkRows){
    const count=Math.min(chunkRows,lastRow-start+1);
    const rows=sh.getRange(start,P.columns.customerId,count,width).getDisplayValues();
    rows.forEach(function(r){
      const c=normalizeBpExistenceId_(r[0]);
      const sm=normalizeBpExistenceId_(r[P.columns.salesmanId-P.columns.customerId]);
      if(c) neededBpIds[c]=true;
      if(sm){neededBpIds[sm]=true;neededSalesmanIds[sm]=true;}
      if(c||sm) rowsChecked++;
    });
  }
  return {neededBpIds:neededBpIds,neededSalesmanIds:neededSalesmanIds,rows:rowsChecked};
}

function RSC_STD_LOAD_ACTIVE_SALESMAN_SUBSET_20260814_(neededSalesmanIds) {
  const needed = Object.create(null), out = Object.create(null);
  Object.keys(neededSalesmanIds || {}).forEach(function (id) {
    const n = normalizeBpExistenceId_(id);
    if (n && isStandardSalesmanId_(n) && !isSalesmanDummyId_(n)) needed[n] = true;
  });
  const neededCount = Object.keys(needed).length;
  if (!neededCount) return out;

  const cached = RSC_V28_2_CACHE_GET_ALL_20260814_('ACTIVE_SM', needed), missing = Object.create(null);
  Object.keys(needed).forEach(function (id) {
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cached, id)) { if (String(cached[id]) === '1') out[id] = true; }
    else missing[id] = true;
  });
  const missingCount = Object.keys(missing).length;
  if (!missingCount) return out;

  if (typeof RSC_PERF19_DB_20260819!=='undefined' && RSC_PERF19_DB_20260819.preferGeneratedLookup!==false && typeof RSC_PERF19_LOOKUP_SALESMAN_20260819_ === 'function') {
    const fast = RSC_PERF19_LOOKUP_SALESMAN_20260819_(missing);
    if (fast && fast.available) {
      Object.keys(fast.exists || {}).forEach(function(id){ out[id] = true; });
      const positive = Object.create(null), negative = Object.create(null);
      Object.keys(missing).forEach(function(id){ if(out[id]) positive[id]='1'; else negative[id]='0'; });
      RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('ACTIVE_SM', positive, RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819.positiveCacheTtlSec);
      RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('ACTIVE_SM', negative, RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819.negativeCacheTtlSec);
      return out;
    }
  }
  const P = FINAL_LINK_BP_EXIST_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS;
  const ss = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.dbSpreadsheetId);
  const sh = RSC_PERF5_GET_SHEET_20260819_(ss, P.dbSheetSales);
  if (!sh) throw new Error('Database sheet tidak ditemukan: ' + P.dbSheetSales);
  const lastRow = sh.getLastRow(), lastCol = Math.min(sh.getLastColumn(), 200);
  if (lastRow < 2 || lastCol < 1) return out;
  const headers = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0];
  const c = findValidateDateCol_(headers, [P.dbColSalesman]);
  if (!c) throw new Error('Kolom ' + P.dbColSalesman + ' tidak ditemukan di ' + P.dbSheetSales + '.');

  const targeted = RSC_PERF23_READ_TABULAR_CANDIDATES_20260819_(sh, c, 2, lastRow, missing, c, 1, 'DISPLAY');
  if (targeted) {
    for (let i = 0; i < targeted.rows.length; i++) {
      const id = normalizeBpExistenceId_(targeted.rows[i].values[0]);
      if (id && missing[id]) out[id] = true;
    }
  } else {
    let found = 0;
    for (let start = 2; start <= lastRow; start += 5000) {
      const count = Math.min(5000, lastRow - start + 1), vals = sh.getRange(start, c, count, 1).getDisplayValues();
      for (let i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
        const id = normalizeBpExistenceId_(vals[i][0]);
        if (id && missing[id] && !out[id]) { out[id] = true; found++; }
      }
      if (found >= missingCount) break;
    }
  }

  const positive = Object.create(null), negative = Object.create(null);
  Object.keys(missing).forEach(function (id) { if (out[id]) positive[id] = '1'; else negative[id] = '0'; });
  RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('ACTIVE_SM', positive, RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819.positiveCacheTtlSec);
  RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('ACTIVE_SM', negative, RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819.negativeCacheTtlSec);
  return out;
}

function RSC_STD_BUILD_RELATION_NEEDS_20260814_(plan) {
  const neededTriple=Object.create(null), neededCustomer=Object.create(null), neededR8=Object.create(null), neededPair=Object.create(null);
  if(!plan) return {neededTriple:neededTriple,neededCustomer:neededCustomer,neededR8:neededR8,neededPair:neededPair};
  for(let i=0;i<plan.n;i++){
    const triple=String(plan.keys[i]||'');
    const customer=RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(plan.customers&&plan.customers[i]);
    const salesman=RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(plan.salesmen&&plan.salesmen[i]);
    const relationship=normalizeValidateDateRelationship_(plan.relationships&&plan.relationships[i]);
    const toko=Boolean(plan.isTokoBangkrut&&plan.isTokoBangkrut[i]);
    // PERF11: historical triple/customer Valid From is needed only for Toko Bangkrut.
    // Normal Rolling must never load/use customer fallback to rewrite relation Valid From.
    if(toko&&triple) neededTriple[triple]=true;
    if(toko&&customer) neededCustomer[customer]=true;
    if(customer&&salesman&&!relationship) neededPair[customer+'||'+salesman]=true;
    const parts=triple?triple.split('||'):[];
    if(parts.length===3){
      const finalValidTo=toko
        ? VALIDATE_DATE_IN_TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS.dateClose
        : normalizeValidateDateForWrite_(plan.validToVals[i][0]);
      if(finalValidTo) neededR8[[parts[0],parts[1],parts[2],finalValidTo].join('||')]=true;
    }
  }
  return {neededTriple:neededTriple,neededCustomer:neededCustomer,neededR8:neededR8,neededPair:neededPair};
}


function RSC_STD_BUILD_RELATION_PAIR_KEY_20260819_(customerId, salesmanId) {
  const a=RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(customerId),c=RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(salesmanId);
  return a&&c?a+'||'+c:'';
}

/**
 * PERF6 authoritative Change Schedule Only intent detector.
 * CASE 1: Customer + Relationship + Salesman + Valid To exact DB match.
 * CASE 2: Relationship blank + Customer + Salesman exists anywhere in m_bp_relation.
 *
 * CASE 2 deliberately ignores relation Valid From/Valid To because those fields are
 * not part of the intended change; Visit fields remain authoritative.
 */
function RSC_STD_DETECT_CHANGE_SCHEDULE_ONLY_20260819_(v, relationCtx) {
  relationCtx=relationCtx||{};
  const customer=RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(v&&v.customerId),relationship=normalizeValidateDateRelationship_(v&&v.relationship),salesman=RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(v&&v.salesmanId);
  const validTo=RSC_NORMALIZE_FSD_DB_DATE_20260807_(v&&v.validTo);
  const existingR8=relationCtx.existingR8||Object.create(null),pairMap=relationCtx.pair||Object.create(null),r8ValidFrom=relationCtx.r8ValidFrom||Object.create(null);
  const key4=customer&&relationship&&salesman&&validTo?[customer,relationship,salesman,validTo].join('||'):'';
  if(key4&&existingR8[key4]){
    return {yes:true,mode:'EXACT_REL_VALID_TO',key4:key4,pairKey:customer+'||'+salesman,dbValidFrom:String(r8ValidFrom[key4]||'')};
  }
  const pairKey=customer&&salesman?customer+'||'+salesman:'';
  if(customer&&salesman&&!relationship&&pairKey&&pairMap[pairKey]){
    return {yes:true,mode:'PAIR_NO_RELATION',key4:'',pairKey:pairKey,dbValidFrom:''};
  }
  return {yes:false,mode:'',key4:key4,pairKey:pairKey,dbValidFrom:''};
}

function RSC_STD_LOAD_RELATION_CONTEXT_20260814_(neededTriple, neededCustomer, neededR8, neededPair) {
  const exact=Object.create(null),customer=Object.create(null),existingR8=Object.create(null),pair=Object.create(null),r8ValidFrom=Object.create(null);
  neededTriple=neededTriple||Object.create(null);neededCustomer=neededCustomer||Object.create(null);neededR8=neededR8||Object.create(null);neededPair=neededPair||Object.create(null);
  if(!Object.keys(neededTriple).length&&!Object.keys(neededCustomer).length&&!Object.keys(neededR8).length&&!Object.keys(neededPair).length)
    return{exact:exact,customer:customer,existingR8:existingR8,pair:pair,r8ValidFrom:r8ValidFrom,scannedRows:0,lookupMode:'EMPTY'};

  const cachedTriple=RSC_V28_2_CACHE_GET_ALL_20260814_('REL_T',neededTriple),cachedCustomer=RSC_V28_2_CACHE_GET_ALL_20260814_('REL_C',neededCustomer),cachedR8=RSC_V28_2_CACHE_GET_ALL_20260814_('REL_R8',neededR8),cachedR8Vf=RSC_V28_2_CACHE_GET_ALL_20260814_('REL_R8VF',neededR8),cachedPair=RSC_V28_2_CACHE_GET_ALL_20260814_('REL_P',neededPair);
  const missingTriple=Object.create(null),missingCustomer=Object.create(null),missingR8=Object.create(null),missingPair=Object.create(null);
  Object.keys(neededTriple).forEach(function(k){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cachedTriple,k)){if(cachedTriple[k]!=='!')exact[k]=cachedTriple[k];}else missingTriple[k]=true;});
  Object.keys(neededCustomer).forEach(function(k){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cachedCustomer,k)){if(cachedCustomer[k]!=='!')customer[k]=cachedCustomer[k];}else missingCustomer[k]=true;});
  Object.keys(neededR8).forEach(function(k){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cachedR8,k)){if(cachedR8[k]==='1'){existingR8[k]=true;if(cachedR8Vf[k]&&cachedR8Vf[k]!=='!')r8ValidFrom[k]=cachedR8Vf[k];else missingR8[k]=true;}}else missingR8[k]=true;});
  Object.keys(neededPair).forEach(function(k){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cachedPair,k)){if(cachedPair[k]==='1')pair[k]=true;}else missingPair[k]=true;});
  if(!Object.keys(missingTriple).length&&!Object.keys(missingCustomer).length&&!Object.keys(missingR8).length&&!Object.keys(missingPair).length)
    return{exact:exact,customer:customer,existingR8:existingR8,pair:pair,r8ValidFrom:r8ValidFrom,scannedRows:0,cacheOnly:true,lookupMode:'CACHE'};

  const p=M_BP_RELATION_DB_PARAMETERS;

  // Candidate reduction remains Customer-first. Pair-only requests contribute their Customer IDs.
  const candidateCustomers=Object.create(null);
  Object.keys(missingCustomer).forEach(function(k){candidateCustomers[k]=true;});
  Object.keys(missingPair).forEach(function(k){const a=RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(String(k||'').split('||')[0]);if(a)candidateCustomers[a]=true;});
  Object.keys(missingTriple).forEach(function(k){const a=RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(String(k||'').split('||')[0]);if(a)candidateCustomers[a]=true;});
  Object.keys(missingR8).forEach(function(k){const a=RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(String(k||'').split('||')[0]);if(a)candidateCustomers[a]=true;});

  let candidate=null;
  if (typeof RSC_PERF19_DB_20260819!=='undefined' && RSC_PERF19_DB_20260819.preferGeneratedLookup!==false && typeof RSC_PERF19_LOOKUP_RELATION_ROWS_20260819_ === 'function') {
    candidate=RSC_PERF19_LOOKUP_RELATION_ROWS_20260819_(candidateCustomers);
  }
  if(!candidate || !candidate.available){
    // Legacy safety fallback. Serialized so multiple worker lanes cannot hammer
    // TextFinder/full-scan on the same 560k+ DB concurrently.
    candidate=RSC_PERF19_WITH_HEAVY_DB_LEASE_20260819_(p.spreadsheetId,'RELATION_LEGACY',function(){
      const ss=RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(p.spreadsheetId),sh=RSC_PERF5_GET_SHEET_20260819_(ss,p.sheetName);
      if(!sh)throw new Error('Sheet DB "'+p.sheetName+'" tidak ditemukan.');
      const lastRow=sh.getLastRow();
      if(lastRow<1)return{rows:[],scannedRows:0,lookupMode:'EMPTY_DB',candidateRowRefs:0};
      const layout=RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_GET_LAYOUT_20260819_(sh);
      return RSC_PERF23_READ_RELATION_CANDIDATES_20260819_(sh,layout,candidateCustomers);
    });
  }
  const exactRank=Object.create(null),rows=candidate.rows||[];
  for(let i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
    const a=RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(rows[i][0]),b=normalizeValidateDateRelationship_(rows[i][1]),c=RSC_CORE_NORMALIZE_ID_20260819_(rows[i][2]),vf=RSC_NORMALIZE_FSD_DB_DATE_20260807_(rows[i][3]),vt=RSC_NORMALIZE_FSD_DB_DATE_20260807_(rows[i][4]);
    if(!a)continue;
    if(a&&c){const pk=a+'||'+c;if(missingPair[pk])pair[pk]=true;}
    if(a&&b&&c){
      const triple=a+'||'+b+'||'+c;
      if(missingTriple[triple]&&vf){const rank=vt==='9999-12-31'?2:1;if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(exact,triple)||rank>Number(exactRank[triple]||0)||(rank===Number(exactRank[triple]||0)&&vf>exact[triple])){exact[triple]=vf;exactRank[triple]=rank;}}
      if(vt){const k=triple+'||'+vt;if(missingR8[k]){existingR8[k]=true;if(vf&&(!r8ValidFrom[k]||vf>r8ValidFrom[k]))r8ValidFrom[k]=vf;}}
    }
    if(missingCustomer[a]&&vf&&(!customer[a]||vf<customer[a]))customer[a]=vf;
  }

  const posT=Object.create(null),negT=Object.create(null),posC=Object.create(null),negC=Object.create(null),posR8=Object.create(null),negR8=Object.create(null),posR8Vf=Object.create(null),negR8Vf=Object.create(null),posP=Object.create(null),negP=Object.create(null);
  Object.keys(missingTriple).forEach(function(k){if(exact[k])posT[k]=exact[k];else negT[k]='!';});
  Object.keys(missingCustomer).forEach(function(k){if(customer[k])posC[k]=customer[k];else negC[k]='!';});
  Object.keys(missingR8).forEach(function(k){if(existingR8[k]){posR8[k]='1';posR8Vf[k]=r8ValidFrom[k]||'!';}else{negR8[k]='0';negR8Vf[k]='!';}});
  Object.keys(missingPair).forEach(function(k){if(pair[k])posP[k]='1';else negP[k]='0';});
  const pt=RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819.positiveCacheTtlSec,nt=RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819.negativeCacheTtlSec;
  RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('REL_T',posT,pt);RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('REL_T',negT,nt);
  RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('REL_C',posC,pt);RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('REL_C',negC,nt);
  RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('REL_R8',posR8,pt);RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('REL_R8',negR8,nt);
  RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('REL_R8VF',posR8Vf,pt);RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('REL_R8VF',negR8Vf,nt);
  RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('REL_P',posP,pt);RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('REL_P',negP,nt);
  return{exact:exact,customer:customer,existingR8:existingR8,pair:pair,r8ValidFrom:r8ValidFrom,scannedRows:Number(candidate.scannedRows||0),lookupMode:candidate.lookupMode||'UNKNOWN',candidateRowRefs:Number(candidate.candidateRowRefs||0),finderCalls:Number(candidate.finderCalls||0)};
}

function RSC_STD_PREPARE_RELATION_DATES_20260814_(sh) {
  const plan=readValidateDateRollingPlan_(sh,'STANDARD_V27:'+sh.getName());
  if(!plan) return {existingR8:Object.create(null),relationScannedRows:0,dateFixStats:{skipped:true}};
  const needs=RSC_STD_BUILD_RELATION_NEEDS_20260814_(plan);
  const ctx=RSC_STD_LOAD_RELATION_CONTEXT_20260814_(needs.neededTriple,needs.neededCustomer,needs.neededR8,needs.neededPair);
  const dateFixStats=applyAndWriteValidateDatePlans_([plan],{exact:ctx.exact,customer:ctx.customer,existingR8:ctx.existingR8,pair:ctx.pair,r8ValidFrom:ctx.r8ValidFrom});
  return {existingR8:ctx.existingR8,relationExact:ctx.exact,relationScannedRows:ctx.scannedRows,dateFixStats:dateFixStats};
}

/* ============================================================
 * V28.3 ROLLING SNAPSHOT ENGINE
 * - Satu range A:N dibaca per chunk sebagai raw/display/formula snapshot.
 * - Canonicalization, master-key collection, mutation, dan seluruh rules
 *   berjalan di memori.
 * - A:N hanya menulis contiguous dirty blocks per chunk; O:P satu range batch.
 * ========================================================== */
function RSC_V28_3_SEC_20260814_(ms) {
  return Number((Math.max(0, Number(ms || 0)) / 1000).toFixed(3));
}

function RSC_V28_3_SET_SNAPSHOT_CELL_20260814_(record, col, value) {
  const next = value == null ? '' : value;
  const current = String(record.values[col - 1] == null ? '' : record.values[col - 1]);
  const nextText = String(next);
  record.values[col - 1] = nextText;
  if (current === nextText) return false;
  record.chunk.outputRows[record.offset][col - 1] = next;
  record.chunk.dirty = true;
  record.chunk.dirtyColumns[col] = true;
  return true;
}

function RSC_V28_3_CREATE_ROLLING_SNAPSHOT_20260814_(sh) {
  const P = RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807;
  const prefetched = RSC_PERF5_TAKE_ROLLING_SNAPSHOT_20260819_(sh);
  if (prefetched) return prefetched;
  RSC_ASSERT_FSD_ACTIVE_ROLLING_LAYOUT_20260807_(sh);
  const lastRow = RSC_GET_FSD_LAST_DATA_ROW_20260807_(sh);
  const empty = Object.create(null);
  if (lastRow < P.firstDataRow) {
    return {
      sh:sh,lastRow:lastRow,chunks:[],records:[],rowHasData:Object.create(null),
      neededBpIds:empty,neededSalesmanIds:Object.create(null),neededTriple:Object.create(null),
      neededCustomer:Object.create(null),neededR8:Object.create(null),neededPair:Object.create(null),neededMvsKeys:Object.create(null),hasToko:false,needsTokoMvs:false,
      needsRelationshipMaster:false,stats:{checkedCells:0,changedCells:0,codeChangedCells:0,codeChangedRows:0,changedRows:0,dateConverted:0,dateInvalid:0,chunks:0}
    };
  }

  const codeSpecs = [
    {col:P.columns.salesOffice,fn:normalizeRscCodeToken_},
    {col:P.columns.deliveringPlant,fn:normalizeRscCodeToken_},
    {col:P.columns.customerId,fn:normalizeBpExistenceId_},
    {col:P.columns.relationship,fn:normalizeRscCodeToken_},
    {col:P.columns.salesmanId,fn:normalizeSalesmanIdForValidation_},
    {col:P.columns.salesmanBpType,fn:normalizeRscCodeToken_},
    {col:P.columns.visitCategory,fn:normalizeRscCodeToken_},
    {col:P.columns.visitType,fn:normalizeRscVisitTypeToken_},
    {col:P.columns.scheduleVisit,fn:normalizeRscScheduleToken_}
  ];
  const dateCols = [P.columns.validFrom,P.columns.validTo,P.columns.visitValidFrom,P.columns.visitValidTo];
  const tz = (sh.getParent && sh.getParent().getSpreadsheetTimeZone)
    ? sh.getParent().getSpreadsheetTimeZone() : Session.getScriptTimeZone();
  const chunkRows = RSC_FSD_SAFE_CHUNK_ROWS_20260807_(P.columns.reason,P.activeReadChunkRows||800);
  const snapshot = {
    sh:sh,lastRow:lastRow,chunks:[],records:[],rowHasData:Object.create(null),
    neededBpIds:Object.create(null),neededSalesmanIds:Object.create(null),neededTriple:Object.create(null),
    neededCustomer:Object.create(null),neededR8:Object.create(null),neededPair:Object.create(null),neededMvsKeys:Object.create(null),hasToko:false,needsTokoMvs:false,needsRelationshipMaster:false,
    stats:{checkedCells:0,changedCells:0,codeChangedCells:0,codeChangedRows:0,changedRows:0,dateConverted:0,dateInvalid:0,chunks:0,invalidExamples:[]}
  };
  const changedRows=Object.create(null),codeChangedRows=Object.create(null);

  for(let start=P.firstDataRow;start<=lastRow;start+=chunkRows){
    const count=Math.min(chunkRows,lastRow-start+1);
    const range=sh.getRange(start,1,count,P.columns.reason);
    const raw=range.getValues(),display=range.getDisplayValues(),formulas=range.getFormulas();
    const outputRows=new Array(count);
    const chunk={start:start,count:count,outputRows:outputRows,dirty:false,dirtyColumns:Object.create(null)};
    snapshot.chunks.push(chunk);

    for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
      outputRows[i]=new Array(P.columns.reason);
      for(let c=0;c<P.columns.reason;c++)outputRows[i][c]=formulas[i][c]||raw[i][c];
      const values=display[i].map(function(v){return String(v==null?'':v);});
      const sheetRow=start+i;
      const hasData=!isRowCompletelyBlank_(values);
      const record={sheetRow:sheetRow,offset:i,chunk:chunk,values:values,hasData:hasData};
      snapshot.records.push(record);
      if(hasData)snapshot.rowHasData[sheetRow]=true;

      for(let s=0;s<codeSpecs.length;s++){
        const spec=codeSpecs[s],idx=spec.col-1,original=values[idx],normalized=spec.fn(original);
        if(original!=='')snapshot.stats.checkedCells++;
        values[idx]=normalized;
        if(!formulas[i][idx]&&normalized!==original){
          outputRows[i][idx]=normalized;chunk.dirty=true;chunk.dirtyColumns[spec.col]=true;
          snapshot.stats.changedCells++;snapshot.stats.codeChangedCells++;changedRows[sheetRow]=true;codeChangedRows[sheetRow]=true;
        }
      }

      for(let d=0;d<dateCols.length;d++){
        const col=dateCols[d],idx=col-1,rawValue=raw[i][idx],shown=String(display[i][idx]==null?'':display[i][idx]).trim();
        if((rawValue===''||rawValue===null)&&!shown){values[idx]='';continue;}
        snapshot.stats.checkedCells++;
        const parsed=RSC_PARSE_FLEXIBLE_DATE_INPUT_20260807_(rawValue,shown,tz);
        if(!parsed.ok){
          values[idx]=shown;
          snapshot.stats.dateInvalid++;
          if(snapshot.stats.invalidExamples.length<8)snapshot.stats.invalidExamples.push('row '+sheetRow+' col '+col+'="'+shown+'"');
          continue;
        }
        const ymd=[parsed.year,String(parsed.month).padStart(2,'0'),String(parsed.day).padStart(2,'0')].join('-');
        values[idx]=ymd;
        if(!formulas[i][idx]&&!(rawValue instanceof Date)){
          outputRows[i][idx]=new Date(parsed.year,parsed.month-1,parsed.day,12,0,0,0);
          chunk.dirty=true;chunk.dirtyColumns[col]=true;snapshot.stats.dateConverted++;
          snapshot.stats.changedCells++;changedRows[sheetRow]=true;
        }
      }

      if(!hasData)continue;
      const customer=values[P.columns.customerId-1],salesman=values[P.columns.salesmanId-1],relationship=values[P.columns.relationship-1];
      if(customer)snapshot.neededBpIds[customer]=true;
      if(salesman){snapshot.neededBpIds[salesman]=true;snapshot.neededSalesmanIds[salesman]=true;}
      const triple=customer&&relationship&&salesman?[customer,relationship,salesman].join('||'):'';
      // PERF6 CASE 2 candidate: Relationship intentionally blank; resolve by Customer + Salesman.
      if(customer&&salesman&&!relationship)snapshot.neededPair[[customer,salesman].join('||')]=true;
      const toko=isTokoBangkrutReason_(values[P.columns.reason-1]);
      // PERF11: historical Valid From lookup is Toko-only. For Rolling, exact R8 is
      // sufficient to detect Change Schedule Only and relation Valid From stays dateNew.
      if(toko&&triple)snapshot.neededTriple[triple]=true;
      if(toko&&customer)snapshot.neededCustomer[customer]=true;
      if(toko){
        snapshot.hasToko=true;
        const pair=isSalesmanToSalesmanRolling_(customer,salesman);
        if(!pair){
          snapshot.needsTokoMvs=true;
          const mvsKey=RSC_MVS_buildKey_(
            values[P.columns.visitCategory-1],customer,salesman,values[P.columns.visitType-1]
          );
          if(mvsKey)snapshot.neededMvsKeys[mvsKey]=true;
        }
      }
      const finalValidTo=toko?VALIDATE_DATE_IN_TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS.dateClose:values[P.columns.validTo-1];
      if(triple&&finalValidTo)snapshot.neededR8[triple+'||'+finalValidTo]=true;
      if(relationship&&!RSC_STD_IS_REGISTERED_RELATIONSHIP_20260814_(relationship,null))snapshot.needsRelationshipMaster=true;
    }
    snapshot.stats.chunks++;
  }
  snapshot.stats.changedRows=Object.keys(changedRows).length;snapshot.stats.codeChangedRows=Object.keys(codeChangedRows).length;
  snapshot.stats.invalidExamples=snapshot.stats.invalidExamples.join(' | ');
  return snapshot;
}

function RSC_V28_3_LOAD_ROLLING_MASTERS_20260814_(snapshot) {
  // PERF25: NO coarse workbook-wide DB lease here. The canonical validation
  // logic is unchanged; only m_bp_relation's actual raw candidate read is
  // serialized inside RSC_STD_LOAD_RELATION_CONTEXT_20260814_. BP General,
  // m_sales_info and MVS remain targeted/cacheable and may run concurrently.
  // Resolve relation first so bulk backpressure occurs before other master work.
  const relation = RSC_STD_LOAD_RELATION_CONTEXT_20260814_(snapshot.neededTriple, snapshot.neededCustomer, snapshot.neededR8, snapshot.neededPair);
  const bpMaster = RSC_LOAD_FSD_BP_MASTER_SUBSET_20260807_(snapshot.neededBpIds, snapshot.neededSalesmanIds);
  const activeSalesman = RSC_STD_LOAD_ACTIVE_SALESMAN_SUBSET_20260814_(snapshot.neededSalesmanIds);
  const mvs = snapshot.needsTokoMvs
    ? RSC_MVS_getIndexSubset_20260819_(snapshot.neededMvsKeys || Object.create(null))
    : null;
  const employeeIndex = getEmployeeMasterDataIndex_();
  const relationshipSet = snapshot.needsRelationshipMaster ? RSC_GET_FSD_RELATIONSHIP_SET_20260807_() : null;
  return { bpMaster:bpMaster, relation:relation, activeSalesman:activeSalesman, employeeIndex:employeeIndex, relationshipSet:relationshipSet, mvs:mvs };
}

function RSC_V28_3_APPLY_ROLLING_MUTATIONS_20260814_(snapshot, masters) {
  const P=RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807,D=VALIDATE_DATE_IN_TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS;
  const stats={bpTypeChecked:0,bpTypeUpdated:0,bpTypeNotFound:0,caseA:0,caseB:0,caseC:0,changeScheduleExact:0,changeSchedulePairNoRel:0,rollingChecked:0,rollingUpdated:0,tokoChecked:0,tokoVisitFromUpdated:0,tokoCloseUpdated:0,tokoMatched:0,tokoKeyNotFound:0,tokoIncompleteKey:0,changedCells:0};
  const closeDate=RSC_MVS_normalizeDate_(D.dateClose)||String(D.dateClose||'');
  for(let i=0;i<snapshot.records.length;i++){
    const rec=snapshot.records[i];if(!rec.hasData)continue;
    let v=RSC_READ_FSD_ACTIVE_ROLLING_ROW_20260807_(rec.values,P.columns);
    if(v.salesmanId){stats.bpTypeChecked++;const expected=String(masters.bpMaster.bpTypeById[v.salesmanId]||'').toUpperCase();if(expected){if(RSC_V28_3_SET_SNAPSHOT_CELL_20260814_(rec,P.columns.salesmanBpType,expected)){stats.bpTypeUpdated++;stats.changedCells++;}}else stats.bpTypeNotFound++;}
    v=RSC_READ_FSD_ACTIVE_ROLLING_ROW_20260807_(rec.values,P.columns);
    const triple=v.customerId&&v.relationship&&v.salesmanId?[v.customerId,v.relationship,v.salesmanId].join('||'):'';
    const matched=triple&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(masters.relation.exact,triple)?masters.relation.exact[triple]:'';
    const toko=isTokoBangkrutReason_(v.reason),rolling=isValidateDateRolling_(v.reason);
    const detectedCso=RSC_STD_DETECT_CHANGE_SCHEDULE_ONLY_20260819_(v,masters.relation);
    const cso=(!toko||(detectedCso.yes&&detectedCso.mode==='PAIR_NO_RELATION'))?detectedCso:{yes:false,mode:''};
    if(toko){
      stats.caseC++;stats.tokoChecked++;
      const pair=isSalesmanToSalesmanRolling_(v.customerId,v.salesmanId);
      const tokoVisitOnly=Boolean(!pair&&cso.yes&&cso.mode==='PAIR_NO_RELATION');
      let closeChanged=false;
      if(!tokoVisitOnly){
        const fallback=v.customerId?masters.relation.customer[v.customerId]:'';
        const validFrom=matched||(D.caseCValidFromSource==='CUSTOMER_FALLBACK'?fallback:'');
        if(validFrom&&RSC_V28_3_SET_SNAPSHOT_CELL_20260814_(rec,P.columns.validFrom,validFrom))stats.changedCells++;
        if(RSC_V28_3_SET_SNAPSHOT_CELL_20260814_(rec,P.columns.validTo,closeDate)){closeChanged=true;stats.changedCells++;}
      }else{
        stats.changeSchedulePairNoRel++;
      }
      if(!pair&&RSC_V28_3_SET_SNAPSHOT_CELL_20260814_(rec,P.columns.visitValidTo,closeDate)){closeChanged=true;stats.changedCells++;}
      if(closeChanged)stats.tokoCloseUpdated++;
      if(!pair){const key=RSC_MVS_buildKey_(v.visitCategory,v.customerId,v.salesmanId,v.visitType);if(!key)stats.tokoIncompleteKey++;else{const dates=masters.mvs&&masters.mvs.datesByKey?masters.mvs.datesByKey[key]:null;if(!dates)stats.tokoKeyNotFound++;else{const expectedDate=RSC_MVS_selectEffectiveStartDate_(dates,closeDate);if(!expectedDate)stats.tokoKeyNotFound++;else{if(RSC_V28_3_SET_SNAPSHOT_CELL_20260814_(rec,P.columns.visitValidFrom,expectedDate)){stats.tokoVisitFromUpdated++;stats.changedCells++;}stats.tokoMatched++;}}}}
      continue;
    }
    if(rolling){
      stats.rollingChecked++;let updated=false;
      const mode=cso.yes?cso.mode:'';
      const policy=RSC_PERF11_RESOLVE_ROLLING_DATE_POLICY_20260819_(v.reason,mode,v.validFrom,D.dateNew);
      if(cso.yes){
        stats.caseA++;
        if(mode==='EXACT_REL_VALID_TO')stats.changeScheduleExact++;
        if(mode==='PAIR_NO_RELATION')stats.changeSchedulePairNoRel++;
      }else stats.caseB++;
      // PERF11 authoritative rule: even EXACT_REL_VALID_TO cannot pull a Rolling
      // row backwards to historical DB Valid From. Only PAIR_NO_RELATION keeps
      // relation fields as source because it is intentionally visit-only.
      if(mode!=='PAIR_NO_RELATION'&&RSC_V28_3_SET_SNAPSHOT_CELL_20260814_(rec,P.columns.validFrom,policy.validFrom)){updated=true;stats.changedCells++;}
      if(RSC_V28_3_SET_SNAPSHOT_CELL_20260814_(rec,P.columns.visitValidFrom,policy.visitValidFrom)){updated=true;stats.changedCells++;}
      if(updated)stats.rollingUpdated++;
      continue;
    }
    if(cso.yes){
      stats.caseA++;
      if(cso.mode==='EXACT_REL_VALID_TO')stats.changeScheduleExact++;
      else if(cso.mode==='PAIR_NO_RELATION')stats.changeSchedulePairNoRel++;
      // Non-Rolling/non-Toko: do not rewrite relation Valid From from DB.
      continue;
    }
  }
  return stats;
}

function RSC_V28_3_VALIDATE_ROLLING_SNAPSHOT_RULES_20260814_(snapshot, masters) {
  const P=RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807,S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814;
  const rowErrors=Object.create(null),rowHasData=snapshot.rowHasData,ruleCounts=Object.create(null),scheduleMap=Object.create(null),duplicateMap=Object.create(null);
  const officeOptions=(masters.employeeIndex&&masters.employeeIndex.salesOfficeOptions)||[];
  const bpMaster=masters.bpMaster||{exists:Object.create(null),bpTypeById:Object.create(null)};
  const activeSalesman=masters.activeSalesman||Object.create(null),existingR8=(masters.relation&&masters.relation.existingR8)||Object.create(null),relationExact=(masters.relation&&masters.relation.exact)||Object.create(null),relationPair=(masters.relation&&masters.relation.pair)||Object.create(null);
  const relationshipSet=masters.relationshipSet;
  const closeDate=RSC_MVS_normalizeDate_(VALIDATE_DATE_IN_TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS.dateClose);
  let checkedRows=0,tokoRows=0;
  function add(row,rule,msg){
    if(!rowErrors[row])rowErrors[row]=[];
    const t='['+rule+'] '+msg;
    if(rowErrors[row].indexOf(t)===-1){rowErrors[row].push(t);ruleCounts[rule]=Number(ruleCounts[rule]||0)+1;}
  }
  for(let i=0;i<snapshot.records.length;i++){
    const rec=snapshot.records[i];if(!rec.hasData)continue;const sheetRow=rec.sheetRow;checkedRows++;
    const v=RSC_READ_FSD_ACTIVE_ROLLING_ROW_20260807_(rec.values,P.columns);
    const salesmanAllowed=isAllowedSalesmanId_(v.salesmanId);
    const pair=Boolean(S.allowSalesmanPairCustomer&&isSalesmanToSalesmanRolling_(v.customerId,v.salesmanId)),toko=isTokoBangkrutReason_(v.reason);if(toko)tokoRows++;
    const detectedCso=RSC_STD_DETECT_CHANGE_SCHEDULE_ONLY_20260819_(v,masters.relation); const cso=(!toko||(detectedCso.yes&&detectedCso.mode==='PAIR_NO_RELATION'))?detectedCso:{yes:false,mode:''};
    const relationOptional=Boolean(cso.yes&&cso.mode==='PAIR_NO_RELATION');
    if(!v.salesOffice)add(sheetRow,'S0','Sales Office wajib diisi.');
    if(!v.customerId)add(sheetRow,'R1','Customer ID wajib diisi.');
    if(!v.relationship&&!relationOptional)add(sheetRow,'R2','Relationship wajib diisi.');
    if(!v.salesmanId)add(sheetRow,'R1','Salesman ID wajib diisi.');
    if(!v.salesmanBpType)add(sheetRow,'R3','Salesman BP Type wajib diisi.');
    if(!v.validFrom&&!relationOptional)add(sheetRow,'R4','Valid From wajib diisi.');
    if(!v.validTo&&!relationOptional)add(sheetRow,'R4','Valid To wajib diisi.');
    if(!pair){
      if(!v.visitCategory)add(sheetRow,'R5','Visit Category wajib diisi.');
      if(!v.visitType)add(sheetRow,'R12','Visit Type wajib diisi.');
      if(!v.scheduleVisit)add(sheetRow,'R6','Schedule Visit wajib diisi.');
      if(!v.visitValidFrom)add(sheetRow,'R4','Visit Valid From wajib diisi.');
      if(!v.visitValidTo)add(sheetRow,'R4','Visit Valid To wajib diisi.');
    }
    if(v.salesOffice&&!idExistsInDropdownOptions_(v.salesOffice,officeOptions))add(sheetRow,'S0','Sales Office tidak ada di master em.');
    if(v.deliveringPlant&&!/^[A-Z0-9]{4}$/.test(v.deliveringPlant))add(sheetRow,'S0','Delivering Plant harus 4 karakter alphanumeric.');
    if(v.customerId&&!/^\d+$/.test(v.customerId)&&!pair)add(sheetRow,'R1','Customer ID harus numerik; exception hanya Salesman-to-Salesman/BP-Dummy pair.');
    if(v.relationship&&!/^(ZWS\d{3}|BUR001)$/.test(v.relationship))add(sheetRow,'R2','Relationship harus format ZWSnnn atau BUR001.');
    if(v.salesmanId&&!salesmanAllowed)add(sheetRow,'R1',getSalesmanIdValidationMessage_());
    if(v.salesmanBpType&&!/^ZD\d{2}$/.test(v.salesmanBpType))add(sheetRow,'R3','Salesman BP Type harus format ZDnn, contoh ZD01.');
    if(!pair&&v.visitCategory&&!/^(F1|F2|F4|F8)$/.test(v.visitCategory))add(sheetRow,'R5','Visit Category harus F1, F2, F4, atau F8.');
    if(!pair&&v.visitType&&!S.visitTypeRegex.test(v.visitType))add(sheetRow,'R12','Visit Type harus 01 sampai 12 dan tetap 2 digit.');
    if(!pair&&v.scheduleVisit&&v.visitCategory)RSC_STD_VALIDATE_SCHEDULE_RULES_20260814_(v.visitCategory,v.scheduleVisit).forEach(function(m){add(sheetRow,'R6',m);});
    const a=v.validFrom?parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(v.validFrom):null,b=v.validTo?parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(v.validTo):null,
          c=v.visitValidFrom?parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(v.visitValidFrom):null,d=v.visitValidTo?parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(v.visitValidTo):null;
    if(!relationOptional&&v.validFrom&&!a)add(sheetRow,'R4','Valid From harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
    if(!relationOptional&&v.validTo&&!b)add(sheetRow,'R4','Valid To harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
    if(!pair&&v.visitValidFrom&&!c)add(sheetRow,'R4','Visit Valid From harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
    if(!pair&&v.visitValidTo&&!d)add(sheetRow,'R4','Visit Valid To harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
    if(!relationOptional&&a&&b&&b.getTime()<=a.getTime())add(sheetRow,'R9','Valid To harus lebih besar dari Valid From.');
    if(!pair&&c&&d&&d.getTime()<=c.getTime())add(sheetRow,'R10','Visit Valid To harus lebih besar dari Visit Valid From.');
    if(!relationOptional&&!pair&&a&&b&&c&&d&&(c.getTime()<a.getTime()||d.getTime()>b.getTime()))add(sheetRow,'R11','Periode Visit Valid harus berada di dalam Valid From - Valid To.');
    if(!relationOptional&&!toko&&v.validTo&&v.validTo!==S.normalValidTo)add(sheetRow,'R9A','Valid To harus '+S.normalValidTo+' untuk Change Rolling selain Toko Bangkrut.');
    if(!pair&&v.customerId&&v.salesmanId&&v.scheduleVisit){
      const k=v.customerId+'||'+v.salesmanId,sc=RSC_NORMALIZE_FSD_SCHEDULE_FOR_COMPARISON_20260807_(v.scheduleVisit);
      if(!scheduleMap[k])scheduleMap[k]=Object.create(null);if(!scheduleMap[k][sc])scheduleMap[k][sc]=[];scheduleMap[k][sc].push(sheetRow);
    }
    const key4=RSC_BUILD_FSD_COMPOSITE_KEY_20260807_(v.customerId,v.relationship,v.salesmanId,v.validTo);
    const changeScheduleOnly=Boolean(cso.yes);
    // PERF6: schedule-only rows are intentionally collapsed during Revamp; do not emit R8a for them.
    if(key4&&!changeScheduleOnly){if(!duplicateMap[key4])duplicateMap[key4]=[];duplicateMap[key4].push(sheetRow);}
    if(v.customerId&&!bpMaster.exists[v.customerId])add(sheetRow,'R1','Customer ID tidak ditemukan di m_bp_general_view.bp_id.');
    if(v.salesmanId&&!bpMaster.exists[v.salesmanId])add(sheetRow,'R1','Salesman ID tidak ditemukan di m_bp_general_view.bp_id.');
    if(v.salesmanId&&isStandardSalesmanId_(v.salesmanId)&&!isSalesmanDummyId_(v.salesmanId)&&!activeSalesman[v.salesmanId])add(sheetRow,'R1A','Salesman normal tidak ditemukan di m_sales_info.salesman_id.');
    if(v.relationship&&!RSC_STD_IS_REGISTERED_RELATIONSHIP_20260814_(v.relationship,relationshipSet))add(sheetRow,'R2','Relationship tidak terdaftar pada canonical LOV/master Relationship.');
    if(v.salesmanId&&bpMaster.exists[v.salesmanId]){
      const expected=String(bpMaster.bpTypeById[v.salesmanId]||'').toUpperCase();
      if(!expected)add(sheetRow,'R3','bp_type_id untuk Salesman ID tidak ditemukan di m_bp_general_view.');
      else if(v.salesmanBpType!==expected)add(sheetRow,'R3','Salesman BP Type tidak sesuai master. Expected='+expected+'.');
    }
    // Exact Customer+Relationship+Salesman+Valid To DB match = Change Schedule Only, bukan R8b.
    if(key4&&existingR8[key4]&&!changeScheduleOnly)add(sheetRow,'R8','R8b: key Customer ID + Relationship + Salesman ID + Valid To sudah ada di m_bp_relation.');
    if(toko){
      if(!relationOptional&&closeDate&&v.validTo!==closeDate)add(sheetRow,'TB','Toko Bangkrut: Valid To harus '+closeDate+'.');
      if(!pair){
        if(closeDate&&v.visitValidTo!==closeDate)add(sheetRow,'TB','Toko Bangkrut: Visit Valid To harus '+closeDate+'.');
        const mk=RSC_MVS_buildKey_(v.visitCategory,v.customerId,v.salesmanId,v.visitType);
        if(!mk)add(sheetRow,'TB','Toko Bangkrut: key m_visit_schedule wajib lengkap (Visit Category + Customer ID + Salesman ID + Visit Type).');
        else {
          const dates=masters.mvs&&masters.mvs.datesByKey?masters.mvs.datesByKey[mk]:null;
          if(!dates)add(sheetRow,'TB','Toko Bangkrut: key tidak ditemukan di m_visit_schedule.');
          else {
            const expected=RSC_MVS_selectEffectiveStartDate_(dates,closeDate),actual=RSC_MVS_normalizeDate_(v.visitValidFrom);
            if(!expected||actual!==expected)add(sheetRow,'TB','Toko Bangkrut: Visit Valid From tidak sesuai m_visit_schedule. Expected='+(expected||'[none]')+'.');
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  Object.keys(scheduleMap).forEach(function(k){
    const schedules=Object.keys(scheduleMap[k]);if(schedules.length<=1)return;
    const conflictDetail=schedules.map(function(sc){return sc+' (row '+scheduleMap[k][sc].join(',')+')';}).join(' vs ');
    schedules.forEach(function(sc){scheduleMap[k][sc].forEach(function(r){add(r,'R7','Customer ID + Salesman ID yang sama tidak boleh memiliki Schedule Visit berbeda. Konflik: '+conflictDetail+'.');});});
  });
  Object.keys(duplicateMap).forEach(function(k){if(duplicateMap[k].length>1)duplicateMap[k].forEach(function(r){add(r,'R8','R8a: key Customer ID + Relationship + Salesman ID + Valid To duplikat dalam template.');});});
  return {checkedRows:checkedRows,rowErrors:rowErrors,rowHasData:rowHasData,ruleErrors:ruleCounts,tokoBangkrutRows:tokoRows};
}

function RSC_V28_3_WRITE_STATUS_FROM_MEMORY_20260814_(sh,snapshot,rules) {
  const P=RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807;
  const chunkRows=RSC_FSD_SAFE_CHUNK_ROWS_20260807_(2,P.activeWriteChunkRows||800);
  let errorRows=0,okRows=0,chunks=0;
  for(let start=P.firstDataRow;start<=snapshot.lastRow;start+=chunkRows){
    const count=Math.min(chunkRows,snapshot.lastRow-start+1),values=new Array(count),backgrounds=new Array(count),fontColors=new Array(count),fontWeights=new Array(count),wraps=new Array(count);
    for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
      const row=start+i,hasData=Boolean(rules.rowHasData[row]),errors=(rules.rowErrors&&rules.rowErrors[row])||[];
      if(!hasData){
        values[i]=['',''];backgrounds[i]=[TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.input,TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.input];
        fontColors[i]=['#000000','#000000'];fontWeights[i]=['normal','normal'];wraps[i]=[false,false];
      }else if(errors.length){
        errorRows++;values[i]=['ERROR',deduplicateArray_(errors).join(' | ')];backgrounds[i]=[TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.error,TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.error];
        fontColors[i]=['#991B1B','#991B1B'];fontWeights[i]=['bold','normal'];wraps[i]=[false,true];
      }else{
        okRows++;values[i]=['OK',''];backgrounds[i]=[TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.ok,TEMPLATE_UI_PARAMETERS.colors.ok];
        fontColors[i]=['#166534','#166534'];fontWeights[i]=['bold','normal'];wraps[i]=[false,false];
      }
    }
    sh.getRange(start,P.columns.status,count,2).setValues(values).setBackgrounds(backgrounds).setFontColors(fontColors).setFontWeights(fontWeights).setWraps(wraps);
    chunks++;
  }
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();return{errorRows:errorRows,okRows:okRows,chunks:chunks};
}

function RSC_V28_3_WRITE_ROLLING_SNAPSHOT_20260814_(sh, snapshot, rules) {
  const P = RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807;
  let dirtyChunks = 0, writeBatches = 0, dirtyColumns = Object.create(null);
  for (let i = 0; i < snapshot.chunks.length; i++) {
    const chunk = snapshot.chunks[i];
    if (!chunk.dirty) continue;
    const cols = Object.keys(chunk.dirtyColumns).map(Number).sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; });
    const groups = [];
    cols.forEach(function (col) {
      const last = groups.length ? groups[groups.length - 1] : null;
      if (last && col === last.end + 1) last.end = col; else groups.push({ start: col, end: col });
      dirtyColumns[col] = true;
    });

    // If mutations are fragmented across many columns, one wider write is cheaper
    // than several Spreadsheet service calls. Unchanged cells are preserved from
    // the raw/formula snapshot.
    const writeGroups = (groups.length >= 3 || cols.length >= 6)
      ? [{ start: cols[0], end: cols[cols.length - 1] }]
      : groups;
    writeGroups.forEach(function (g) {
      const width = g.end - g.start + 1;
      const values = chunk.outputRows.map(function (row) { return row.slice(g.start - 1, g.end); });
      sh.getRange(chunk.start, g.start, chunk.count, width).setValues(values);
      writeBatches++;
    });
    dirtyChunks++;
  }

  const n = Math.max(0, snapshot.lastRow - P.firstDataRow + 1);
  if (n > 0) {
    const dateCols = [P.columns.validFrom, P.columns.validTo, P.columns.visitValidFrom, P.columns.visitValidTo]
      .map(Number).sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; });
    const dateGroups = [];
    dateCols.forEach(function (col) {
      const last = dateGroups.length ? dateGroups[dateGroups.length - 1] : null;
      if (last && col === last.end + 1) last.end = col; else dateGroups.push({ start: col, end: col });
    });
    dateGroups.forEach(function (g) {
      sh.getRange(P.firstDataRow, g.start, n, g.end - g.start + 1).setNumberFormat('yyyy-mm-dd');
    });
  }
  const written = RSC_V28_3_WRITE_STATUS_FROM_MEMORY_20260814_(sh, snapshot, rules);
  return {
    errorRows: written.errorRows, okRows: written.okRows, statusChunks: written.chunks,
    dirtyChunks: dirtyChunks, dirtyColumns: Object.keys(dirtyColumns).length, writeBatches: writeBatches
  };
}

  const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,started=Date.now();
  RSC_PERF17_ASSERT_BULK_RUN_CURRENT_20260819_('before snapshot');

  const rulesStart=Date.now(),rules=RSC_V28_3_VALIDATE_ROLLING_SNAPSHOT_RULES_20260814_(snapshot,masters),rulesMs=Date.now()-rulesStart;
  RSC_PERF17_ASSERT_BULK_RUN_CURRENT_20260819_('before sheet write');
  RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_PHASE_20260819_('Write results to sheet',88,'Menulis mutation A:N serta Validation Status/Error Detail O:P.');

  const phaseDurations={
    normalizeSec:RSC_V28_3_SEC_20260814_(normalizeMs),masterLoadSec:RSC_V28_3_SEC_20260814_(masterLoadMs),
    rulesSec:RSC_V28_3_SEC_20260814_(rulesMs),writeSec:RSC_V28_3_SEC_20260814_(writeMs),
    totalSec:RSC_V28_3_SEC_20260814_(Date.now()-started)
  };
  return {
    kind:'ROLLING',validationVersion:S.version,checkedRows:rules.checkedRows,errorRows:written.errorRows,okRows:written.okRows,ruleErrors:rules.ruleErrors,

function RSC_STD_VALIDATE_ROLLING_RULES_20260814_(sh, context) {
  const P=RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807, S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814;
  RSC_ASSERT_FSD_ACTIVE_ROLLING_LAYOUT_20260807_(sh);
  const lastRow=RSC_GET_FSD_LAST_DATA_ROW_20260807_(sh);
  if(lastRow<P.firstDataRow) return {checkedRows:0,errorRows:0,okRows:0,ruleErrors:{},validationVersion:S.version};
  const rowErrors=Object.create(null),rowHasData=Object.create(null),ruleCounts=Object.create(null),scheduleMap=Object.create(null),duplicateMap=Object.create(null);
  const idx=getEmployeeMasterDataIndex_(), officeOptions=idx.salesOfficeOptions||[];
  const bpMaster=context.bpMaster||{exists:Object.create(null),bpTypeById:Object.create(null)};
  const activeSalesman=context.activeSalesman||Object.create(null), existingR8=context.existingR8||Object.create(null), relationExact=context.relationExact||Object.create(null), relationPair=context.relationPair||context.pair||Object.create(null);
  let relationshipSet=null;
  const closeDate=RSC_MVS_normalizeDate_(VALIDATE_DATE_IN_TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS.dateClose);
  let mvs=null;
  let checkedRows=0,tokoRows=0;
  function add(row,rule,msg){
    if(!rowErrors[row]) rowErrors[row]=[];
    const t='['+rule+'] '+msg;
    if(rowErrors[row].indexOf(t)===-1){rowErrors[row].push(t);ruleCounts[rule]=Number(ruleCounts[rule]||0)+1;}
  }
  const chunkRows=RSC_FSD_SAFE_CHUNK_ROWS_20260807_(P.columns.reason,P.activeReadChunkRows||500);
  for(let start=P.firstDataRow;start<=lastRow;start+=chunkRows){
    const count=Math.min(chunkRows,lastRow-start+1), rows=sh.getRange(start,1,count,P.columns.reason).getDisplayValues();
    for(let i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
      const sheetRow=start+i;if(isRowCompletelyBlank_(rows[i])) continue;rowHasData[sheetRow]=true;checkedRows++;
      const v=RSC_READ_FSD_ACTIVE_ROLLING_ROW_20260807_(rows[i],P.columns);
      const salesmanAllowed=isAllowedSalesmanId_(v.salesmanId);
      const pair=Boolean(S.allowSalesmanPairCustomer&&isSalesmanToSalesmanRolling_(v.customerId,v.salesmanId)), toko=isTokoBangkrutReason_(v.reason);if(toko)tokoRows++;
      const legacyRelCtx={existingR8:existingR8,exact:relationExact,pair:relationPair,r8ValidFrom:context.r8ValidFrom||Object.create(null)};
      const detectedCso=RSC_STD_DETECT_CHANGE_SCHEDULE_ONLY_20260819_(v,legacyRelCtx); const cso=(!toko||(detectedCso.yes&&detectedCso.mode==='PAIR_NO_RELATION'))?detectedCso:{yes:false,mode:''};
      const relationOptional=Boolean(cso.yes&&cso.mode==='PAIR_NO_RELATION');
      if(!v.salesOffice)add(sheetRow,'S0','Sales Office wajib diisi.');
      if(!v.customerId)add(sheetRow,'R1','Customer ID wajib diisi.');
      if(!v.relationship&&!relationOptional)add(sheetRow,'R2','Relationship wajib diisi.');
      if(!v.salesmanId)add(sheetRow,'R1','Salesman ID wajib diisi.');
      if(!v.salesmanBpType)add(sheetRow,'R3','Salesman BP Type wajib diisi.');
      if(!v.validFrom&&!relationOptional)add(sheetRow,'R4','Valid From wajib diisi.');
      if(!v.validTo&&!relationOptional)add(sheetRow,'R4','Valid To wajib diisi.');
      if(!pair){
        if(!v.visitCategory)add(sheetRow,'R5','Visit Category wajib diisi.');
        if(!v.visitType)add(sheetRow,'R12','Visit Type wajib diisi.');
        if(!v.scheduleVisit)add(sheetRow,'R6','Schedule Visit wajib diisi.');
        if(!v.visitValidFrom)add(sheetRow,'R4','Visit Valid From wajib diisi.');
        if(!v.visitValidTo)add(sheetRow,'R4','Visit Valid To wajib diisi.');
      }
      if(v.salesOffice&&!idExistsInDropdownOptions_(v.salesOffice,officeOptions))add(sheetRow,'S0','Sales Office tidak ada di master em.');
      if(v.deliveringPlant&&!/^[A-Z0-9]{4}$/.test(v.deliveringPlant))add(sheetRow,'S0','Delivering Plant harus 4 karakter alphanumeric.');
      if(v.customerId&&!/^\d+$/.test(v.customerId)&&!pair)add(sheetRow,'R1','Customer ID harus numerik; exception hanya Salesman-to-Salesman/BP-Dummy pair.');
      if(v.relationship&&!/^(ZWS\d{3}|BUR001)$/.test(v.relationship))add(sheetRow,'R2','Relationship harus format ZWSnnn atau BUR001.');
      if(v.salesmanId&&!salesmanAllowed)add(sheetRow,'R1',getSalesmanIdValidationMessage_());
      if(v.salesmanBpType&&!/^ZD\d{2}$/.test(v.salesmanBpType))add(sheetRow,'R3','Salesman BP Type harus format ZDnn, contoh ZD01.');
      if(!pair&&v.visitCategory&&!/^(F1|F2|F4|F8)$/.test(v.visitCategory))add(sheetRow,'R5','Visit Category harus F1, F2, F4, atau F8.');
      if(!pair&&v.visitType&&!S.visitTypeRegex.test(v.visitType))add(sheetRow,'R12','Visit Type harus 01 sampai 12 dan tetap 2 digit.');
      if(!pair&&v.scheduleVisit&&v.visitCategory)RSC_STD_VALIDATE_SCHEDULE_RULES_20260814_(v.visitCategory,v.scheduleVisit).forEach(function(m){add(sheetRow,'R6',m);});
      const a=v.validFrom?parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(v.validFrom):null,b=v.validTo?parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(v.validTo):null,
            c=v.visitValidFrom?parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(v.visitValidFrom):null,d=v.visitValidTo?parseStrictYyyyMmDdDate_(v.visitValidTo):null;
      if(!relationOptional&&v.validFrom&&!a)add(sheetRow,'R4','Valid From harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
      if(!relationOptional&&v.validTo&&!b)add(sheetRow,'R4','Valid To harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
      if(!pair&&v.visitValidFrom&&!c)add(sheetRow,'R4','Visit Valid From harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
      if(!pair&&v.visitValidTo&&!d)add(sheetRow,'R4','Visit Valid To harus format YYYY-MM-DD.');
      if(!relationOptional&&a&&b&&b.getTime()<=a.getTime())add(sheetRow,'R9','Valid To harus lebih besar dari Valid From.');
      if(!pair&&c&&d&&d.getTime()<=c.getTime())add(sheetRow,'R10','Visit Valid To harus lebih besar dari Visit Valid From.');
      if(!relationOptional&&!pair&&a&&b&&c&&d&&(c.getTime()<a.getTime()||d.getTime()>b.getTime()))add(sheetRow,'R11','Periode Visit Valid harus berada di dalam Valid From - Valid To.');
      if(!relationOptional&&!toko&&v.validTo&&v.validTo!==S.normalValidTo)add(sheetRow,'R9A','Valid To harus '+S.normalValidTo+' untuk Change Rolling selain Toko Bangkrut.');
      if(!pair&&v.customerId&&v.salesmanId&&v.scheduleVisit){
        const k=v.customerId+'||'+v.salesmanId, sc=RSC_NORMALIZE_FSD_SCHEDULE_FOR_COMPARISON_20260807_(v.scheduleVisit);
        if(!scheduleMap[k])scheduleMap[k]=Object.create(null);if(!scheduleMap[k][sc])scheduleMap[k][sc]=[];scheduleMap[k][sc].push(sheetRow);
      }
      const key4=RSC_BUILD_FSD_COMPOSITE_KEY_20260807_(v.customerId,v.relationship,v.salesmanId,v.validTo);
      const changeScheduleOnly=Boolean(cso.yes);
      if(key4&&!changeScheduleOnly){if(!duplicateMap[key4])duplicateMap[key4]=[];duplicateMap[key4].push(sheetRow);}

      // Backend checks dilakukan pada pass A:N yang sama agar Active/Bulk
      // tidak membaca seluruh sheet untuk kedua kalinya.
      if(v.customerId&&!bpMaster.exists[v.customerId])add(sheetRow,'R1','Customer ID tidak ditemukan di m_bp_general_view.bp_id.');
      if(v.salesmanId&&!bpMaster.exists[v.salesmanId])add(sheetRow,'R1','Salesman ID tidak ditemukan di m_bp_general_view.bp_id.');
      if(v.salesmanId&&isStandardSalesmanId_(v.salesmanId)&&!isSalesmanDummyId_(v.salesmanId)&&!activeSalesman[v.salesmanId])add(sheetRow,'R1A','Salesman normal tidak ditemukan di m_sales_info.salesman_id.');
      if(v.relationship&&!RSC_STD_IS_REGISTERED_RELATIONSHIP_20260814_(v.relationship,null)){
        if(!relationshipSet)relationshipSet=RSC_GET_FSD_RELATIONSHIP_SET_20260807_();
        if(!RSC_STD_IS_REGISTERED_RELATIONSHIP_20260814_(v.relationship,relationshipSet))add(sheetRow,'R2','Relationship tidak terdaftar pada canonical LOV/master Relationship.');
      }
      if(v.salesmanId&&bpMaster.exists[v.salesmanId]){
        const expected=String(bpMaster.bpTypeById[v.salesmanId]||'').toUpperCase();
        if(!expected)add(sheetRow,'R3','bp_type_id untuk Salesman ID tidak ditemukan di m_bp_general_view.');
        else if(v.salesmanBpType!==expected)add(sheetRow,'R3','Salesman BP Type tidak sesuai master. Expected='+expected+'.');
      }
      if(key4&&existingR8[key4]&&!changeScheduleOnly)add(sheetRow,'R8','R8b: key Customer ID + Relationship + Salesman ID + Valid To sudah ada di m_bp_relation.');
      if(toko){
        if(!relationOptional&&closeDate&&v.validTo!==closeDate)add(sheetRow,'TB','Toko Bangkrut: Valid To harus '+closeDate+'.');
        if(pair) continue;
        if(!mvs)mvs=RSC_MVS_getIndex_();
        if(closeDate&&v.visitValidTo!==closeDate)add(sheetRow,'TB','Toko Bangkrut: Visit Valid To harus '+closeDate+'.');
        const mk=RSC_MVS_buildKey_(v.visitCategory,v.customerId,v.salesmanId,v.visitType);
        if(!mk)add(sheetRow,'TB','Toko Bangkrut: key m_visit_schedule wajib lengkap (Visit Category + Customer ID + Salesman ID + Visit Type).');
        else {
          const dates=mvs&&mvs.datesByKey?mvs.datesByKey[mk]:null;
          if(!dates)add(sheetRow,'TB','Toko Bangkrut: key tidak ditemukan di m_visit_schedule.');
          else {
            const expected=RSC_MVS_selectEffectiveStartDate_(dates,closeDate),actual=RSC_MVS_normalizeDate_(v.visitValidFrom);
            if(!expected||actual!==expected)add(sheetRow,'TB','Toko Bangkrut: Visit Valid From tidak sesuai m_visit_schedule. Expected='+(expected||'[none]')+'.');
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  Object.keys(scheduleMap).forEach(function(k){
    const schedules=Object.keys(scheduleMap[k]);if(schedules.length<=1)return;
    const conflictDetail=schedules.map(function(sc){return sc+' (row '+scheduleMap[k][sc].join(',')+')';}).join(' vs ');
    schedules.forEach(function(sc){scheduleMap[k][sc].forEach(function(r){add(r,'R7','Customer ID + Salesman ID yang sama tidak boleh memiliki Schedule Visit berbeda. Konflik: '+conflictDetail+'.');});});
  });
  Object.keys(duplicateMap).forEach(function(k){if(duplicateMap[k].length>1)duplicateMap[k].forEach(function(r){add(r,'R8','R8a: key Customer ID + Relationship + Salesman ID + Valid To duplikat dalam template.');});});
  const written=RSC_WRITE_FSD_VALIDATION_STATUS_CHUNKED_20260807_(sh,lastRow,rowErrors,rowHasData);
  return {checkedRows:checkedRows,errorRows:written.errorRows,okRows:written.okRows,ruleErrors:ruleCounts,validationVersion:S.version,tokoBangkrutRows:tokoRows,chunks:written.chunks};
}

function RSC_STD_VALIDATE_ONE_SHEET_20260814_(ss, sh) {
  const kind=detectActiveSheetValidationKind_(sh);
  if(kind==='ROLLING') return RSC_STD_VALIDATE_ROLLING_20260814_(sh);
  const idx=getEmployeeMasterDataIndex_();
  if(kind==='SALES_OFFICE'){
    const errors=validateSalesOfficeChangeSheet_(sh,idx,false);
    return {kind:kind,checkedRows:Math.max(0,sh.getLastRow()-1),errorRows:errors,validationVersion:RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814.version};
  }
  if(kind==='SALESMAN_TYPE'){
    const errors=validateSalesmanTypeSheet_(sh,idx,false);
    return {kind:kind,checkedRows:Math.max(0,sh.getLastRow()-1),errorRows:errors,validationVersion:RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814.version};
  }
  return {kind:'UNKNOWN',checkedRows:0,errorRows:0,skipped:true,reason:'Sheet bukan validation sheet.',validationVersion:RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814.version};
}

function RSC_STD_VALIDATE_WORKBOOK_20260814_(targetSs, options) {
  RSC_PERF12_ASSERT_READY_20260819_();
  options=options||{};
  const P0=VALIDATE_ALL_FINAL_LINKS_PARAMETERS;
  return runWithTargetSpreadsheetContext_(targetSs,function(){
    if(typeof __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__!=='undefined') __EMPLOYEE_MASTER_DATA_INDEX_CACHE__=null;
    const lookup=buildValidationSheetLookup_(targetSs);
    const rolling=getOptionalValidationSheet_(targetSs,P0.rollingSheetName,/rolling/i,lookup);
    const office=getOptionalValidationSheet_(targetSs,P0.salesOfficeSheetName,/sales office/i,lookup);
    const salesman=getOptionalValidationSheet_(targetSs,P0.salesmanTypeSheetName,/salesman type/i,lookup);
    const results=[],systemErrors=[];let errorRows=0;
    function run(label,sh,required){
      if(!sh){if(required)systemErrors.push(label+': sheet tidak ditemukan.');else results.push({label:label,skipped:true,errorRows:0});return;}
      try{
        const r=RSC_STD_VALIDATE_ONE_SHEET_20260814_(targetSs,sh);r.label=label;results.push(r);errorRows+=Number(r.errorRows||0);
        try{r.statusStyle=RSC_PERF12_ENFORCE_VALIDATION_STATUS_COLORS_20260819_(sh);}catch(styleErr){console.warn('[PERF12 status style] '+label+': '+formatScriptError_(styleErr));}
      }
      catch(err){
        const msg=label+': '+formatScriptError_(err);systemErrors.push(msg);results.push({label:label,systemError:msg,errorRows:0});
        if(label==='ROLLING')try{RSC_WRITE_FSD_SYSTEM_ERROR_TO_OP_20260807_(sh,'Standard V28.3',err);}catch(ignore){}
        try{RSC_PERF12_ENFORCE_VALIDATION_STATUS_COLORS_20260819_(sh);}catch(ignoreStyle){}
      }
    }
    run('ROLLING',rolling,options.requireRolling!==false);run('SALES_OFFICE',office,false);run('SALESMAN_TYPE',salesman,false);
    return {fileId:targetSs.getId(),fileName:targetSs.getName(),errorRows:errorRows,systemErrors:systemErrors,results:results,validationVersion:RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814.version,perf5:RSC_PERF5_GET_STATS_20260819_()};
  });
}


function RSC_STD_FORMAT_WORKBOOK_SUMMARY_20260814_(result){
  if(!result)return'No result';const parts=[];(result.results||[]).forEach(function(r){
    if(r.skipped)parts.push(r.label+'=SKIP');else if(r.systemError)parts.push(r.label+'=SYSTEM_ERROR');else parts.push(r.label+'=errors:'+Number(r.errorRows||0));
  });if((result.systemErrors||[]).length)parts.push('systemErrors='+result.systemErrors.length);return parts.join(' | ');
}

function RSC_STD_RESOLVE_MASTER_CONTEXT_20260814_(options){
  options=options||{};const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814;let ss=options.masterSsId?RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(options.masterSsId):SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();let sh=null;
  const wanted=String(options.masterSheetId||'');if(wanted)ss.getSheets().some(function(x){if(String(x.getSheetId())===wanted){sh=x;return true;}return false;});
  if(!sh){const a=ss.getActiveSheet();if(a&&S.masterSheetCandidates.indexOf(a.getName())!==-1)sh=a;}
  if(!sh)for(let i=0;i<S.masterSheetCandidates.length;i++){sh=ss.getSheetByName(S.masterSheetCandidates[i]);if(sh)break;}
  if(!sh)throw new Error('Master sheet tidak ditemukan. Dicari: '+S.masterSheetCandidates.join(', '));return{ss:ss,sh:sh};
}

function RSC_STD_EXTRACT_LINK_TASKS_20260814_(ss,sh){
  const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,first=S.firstDataRow,last=sh.getLastRow();if(last<first)return{tasks:[],rawLinks:0,invalidRows:0};
  const n=last-first+1,range=sh.getRange(first,S.masterLinkCol,n,1),values=range.getValues(),displays=range.getDisplayValues(),formulas=range.getFormulas(),rich=range.getRichTextValues();let chipMap={};
  if(typeof getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_==='function')try{chipMap=getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_(ss.getId(),sh.getName(),first,S.masterLinkCol,n)||{};}catch(ignore){}
  const tasks=[],byId=Object.create(null);let rawLinks=0,invalidRows=0;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const masterRow=first+i,chip=chipMap[masterRow]||chipMap[String(masterRow)]||'';
    const url=chip||getSpreadsheetUrlFromCellData_({richTextValue:rich[i][0],formula:formulas[i][0],value:values[i][0],displayValue:displays[i][0]});
    const visible=cleanTextValue_(displays[i][0])||cleanTextValue_(values[i][0])||cleanTextValue_(formulas[i][0]);if(!url&&!visible)continue;rawLinks++;
    const fileId=extractSpreadsheetFileIdFromUrlOrId_(url||visible);
    if(!fileId){
      invalidRows++;
      const invalidText=String(url||visible||'').trim();
      const upper=invalidText.toUpperCase();
      const intentionalSkip=
        upper.indexOf('GUNAKAN LINK DISINI')!==-1 ||
        upper.indexOf('COPY_ERROR:')===0 ||
        upper.indexOf('TIDAK ADA ROLINGAN')!==-1 ||
        upper.indexOf('TIDAK ADA ROLLINGAN')!==-1;
      tasks.push({
        fileId:'',url:invalidText,masterRows:[masterRow],valid:false,
        skip:Boolean(intentionalSkip),
        skipReason:intentionalSkip?'Tidak ada Link E yang perlu divalidasi pada row ini.':'Link/file ID tidak valid.'
      });
      continue;
    }
    if(byId[fileId]){byId[fileId].masterRows.push(masterRow);continue;}
    const task={fileId:fileId,url:url||visible,masterRows:[masterRow],valid:true};byId[fileId]=task;tasks.push(task);
  }
  return{tasks:tasks,rawLinks:rawLinks,invalidRows:invalidRows,skippedRows:tasks.filter(function(t){return !t.valid&&t.skip;}).length,hardInvalidRows:tasks.filter(function(t){return !t.valid&&!t.skip;}).length};
}

function RSC_STD_GET_MANIFEST_20260814_(ss,create){const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814;let sh=ss.getSheetByName(S.manifestSheetName);if(!sh&&create)sh=ss.insertSheet(S.manifestSheetName);return sh;}
function RSC_STD_RELEASE_FIRED_ONE_TIME_TRIGGER_20260819_(e,handler){
  const uid=String(e&&e.triggerUid||'');
  if(!uid)return false;
  let deleted=false;
  try{
    (ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers()||[]).forEach(function(t){
      try{
        if(String(t.getUniqueId&&t.getUniqueId()||'')===uid&&(!handler||t.getHandlerFunction()===handler)){
          ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(t);deleted=true;
        }
      }catch(ignore){}
    });
  }catch(ignoreAll){}
  return deleted;
}
/* PERF17 scheduler hardening -------------------------------------------------
 * Apps Script trigger creation is not atomic. Multiple watchdog/worker executions
 * can all observe "no trigger" and create duplicates. Every Standard V28.3
 * trigger mutation now happens under ScriptLock and is deduplicated per handler.
 * -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
function RSC_PERF17_TRIGGER_UID_20260819_(tr){
  try{return String(tr&&tr.getUniqueId?tr.getUniqueId():'');}catch(ignore){return '';}
}
function RSC_PERF17_DEDUPE_HANDLER_TRIGGERS_20260819_(handler,preferredUid){
  handler=String(handler||'');preferredUid=String(preferredUid||'');
  const matches=[];
  try{
    (ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers()||[]).forEach(function(t){
      try{if(t.getHandlerFunction()===handler)matches.push(t);}catch(ignore){}
    });
  }catch(ignoreAll){}
  if(matches.length<=1)return{handler:handler,before:matches.length,after:matches.length,deleted:0};
  let keep=null;
  if(preferredUid){
    for(let i=0;i<matches.length;i++)if(RSC_PERF17_TRIGGER_UID_20260819_(matches[i])===preferredUid){keep=matches[i];break;}
  }
  if(!keep)keep=matches[0];
  let deleted=0;
  matches.forEach(function(t){
    if(t===keep)return;
    try{ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(t);deleted++;}catch(ignore){}
  });
  return{handler:handler,before:matches.length,after:1,deleted:deleted,keptUid:RSC_PERF17_TRIGGER_UID_20260819_(keep)};
}
function RSC_PERF17_REPAIR_STANDARD_TRIGGER_TOPOLOGY_INTERNAL_20260819_(options){
  options=options||{};
  const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,lock=LockService.getScriptLock();
  if(!lock.tryLock(Number(S.triggerMutationLockWaitMs||2500)))return{ok:false,reason:'TRIGGER_LOCK_BUSY'};
  try{
    const out={ok:true,watchdog:null,workers:[],at:new Date().toISOString()};
    out.watchdog=RSC_PERF17_DEDUPE_HANDLER_TRIGGERS_20260819_(S.watchdogHandler,String(options.watchdogTriggerUid||''));
    S.workerHandlers.forEach(function(h){out.workers.push(RSC_PERF17_DEDUPE_HANDLER_TRIGGERS_20260819_(h,''));});
    return out;
  }finally{try{lock.releaseLock();}catch(ignore){}}
}
function RSC_STD_ENSURE_ONE_TIME_TRIGGER_20260814_(handler,delay){
  const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,lock=LockService.getScriptLock();
  if(!lock.tryLock(Number(S.triggerMutationLockWaitMs||2500)))return{created:false,reason:'TRIGGER_LOCK_BUSY'};
  try{
    const matches=[];
    (ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers()||[]).forEach(function(t){try{if(t.getHandlerFunction()===handler)matches.push(t);}catch(ignore){}});
    if(matches.length>1)RSC_PERF17_DEDUPE_HANDLER_TRIGGERS_20260819_(handler,'');
    if(matches.length)return{created:false,existing:true,deduped:Math.max(0,matches.length-1)};
    RSC_PERF13_NEW_TRIGGER_20260819_(handler).timeBased().after(Math.max(1000,Number(delay||1000))).create();
    return{created:true};
  }finally{try{lock.releaseLock();}catch(ignore){}}
}
function RSC_STD_ENSURE_WATCHDOG_20260814_(){
  const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,lock=LockService.getScriptLock();
  if(!lock.tryLock(Number(S.triggerMutationLockWaitMs||2500)))return{created:false,reason:'TRIGGER_LOCK_BUSY'};
  try{
    const matches=[];
    (ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers()||[]).forEach(function(t){try{if(t.getHandlerFunction()===S.watchdogHandler)matches.push(t);}catch(ignore){}});
    if(matches.length>1)RSC_PERF17_DEDUPE_HANDLER_TRIGGERS_20260819_(S.watchdogHandler,'');
    if(matches.length)return{created:false,existing:true,deduped:Math.max(0,matches.length-1)};
    RSC_PERF13_NEW_TRIGGER_20260819_(S.watchdogHandler).timeBased().everyMinutes(S.watchdogMinutes).create();
    return{created:true};
  }finally{try{lock.releaseLock();}catch(ignore){}}
}
function RSC_STD_SCHEDULE_WORKERS_20260814_(){
  const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814;
  RSC_STD_ENSURE_WATCHDOG_20260814_();
  // PERF25: keep 4 lanes, but stagger cold-start DB pressure. Once caches are
  // warm, all lanes continue concurrently under the normal worker scheduler.
  for(let i=0;i<S.workerCount;i++)RSC_STD_ENSURE_ONE_TIME_TRIGGER_20260814_(S.workerHandlers[i],1000+i*6500);
}
function RSC_PERF17_ACQUIRE_WATCHDOG_SINGLETON_20260819_(e){
  const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties(),lock=LockService.getScriptLock();
  if(!lock.tryLock(Number(S.triggerMutationLockWaitMs||2500)))return{ok:false,reason:'WATCHDOG_LOCK_BUSY'};
  try{
    const now=Date.now(),until=Number(p.getProperty(S.pWatchdogLeaseUntil)||0),uid=String(e&&e.triggerUid||'');
    // Whichever watchdog execution wins first also prunes duplicate recurring triggers.
    RSC_PERF17_DEDUPE_HANDLER_TRIGGERS_20260819_(S.watchdogHandler,uid);
    if(until>now)return{ok:false,reason:'WATCHDOG_SINGLETON_LEASE',leaseUntil:new Date(until).toISOString()};
    const token=Utilities.getUuid();
    p.setProperty(S.pWatchdogLeaseToken,token);
    p.setProperty(S.pWatchdogLeaseUntil,String(now+Number(S.watchdogSingletonLeaseMs||50000)));
    return{ok:true,token:token,triggerUid:uid,leaseUntil:new Date(now+Number(S.watchdogSingletonLeaseMs||50000)).toISOString()};
  }finally{try{lock.releaseLock();}catch(ignore){}}
}

function RSC_STD_BATCH_STYLE_MASTER_ROWS_20260814_(sh,updates){
  const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,rowMap=Object.create(null);
  (updates||[]).forEach(function(u){
    (u.rows||[]).forEach(function(row){
      const n=Number(row||0);if(n>=S.firstDataRow)rowMap[n]={color:u.color||'',note:truncateValidateAllNote_(u.note||'',45000)};
    });
  });
  const rows=Object.keys(rowMap).map(Number).sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});
  if(!rows.length)return{updatedRows:0,batches:0};
  const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();if(!lock.tryLock(Number(S.claimLockWaitMs||3000)))return{updatedRows:0,batches:0,skipped:'LOCK_BUSY'};
  try{
    const first=rows[0],last=rows[rows.length-1],count=last-first+1,range=sh.getRange(first,S.masterLinkCol,count,1);
    const backgrounds=range.getBackgrounds(),notes=range.getNotes();
    rows.forEach(function(row){const i=row-first,u=rowMap[row];backgrounds[i][0]=u.color;notes[i][0]=u.note;});
    range.setBackgrounds(backgrounds).setNotes(notes);
    return{updatedRows:rows.length,batches:1};
  }finally{try{lock.releaseLock();}catch(ignore){}}
}

}

function RSC_STD_REFRESH_MASTER_STYLES_FROM_MANIFEST_20260814_(ctx){
  const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties(),run=String(p.getProperty(S.pRunId)||'');
  ctx=ctx||RSC_STD_GET_MASTER_FROM_PROPS_20260814_();
  const m=RSC_STD_GET_MANIFEST_20260814_(ctx.ss,false);if(!m||m.getLastRow()<2)return{updatedRows:0,batches:0};
  const vals=m.getRange(2,1,m.getLastRow()-1,15).getDisplayValues(),updates=[];
  vals.forEach(function(r){
    if(String(r[0]||'')!==run)return;
    const status=String(r[5]||'').toUpperCase(),masterRows=RSC_STD_PARSE_MASTER_ROWS_20260814_(r[2]);
    const color=status==='COMPLETE_OK'?S.colorOk:(status==='SKIPPED_INVALID'?S.colorSkipped:(status==='QUEUED'||status==='RETRY'?S.colorQueued:(status==='ACTIVE'?S.colorActive:S.colorError)));
    const note=S.version+' | '+status+' | errors='+Number(r[9]||0)+(r[10]?' | '+r[10]:'')+(r[14]?' | '+r[14]:'');
    updates.push({rows:masterRows,color:color,note:note});
  });
  return RSC_STD_BATCH_STYLE_MASTER_ROWS_20260814_(ctx.sh,updates);
}
