/* PERF24 — MANIFEST BUILD/COMPLETION BARRIER --------------------------------
 * A fresh Run ID is written before the manifest is cleared/rebuilt. Old/foreign
 * triggers can wake in that small window. Without a barrier they may observe
 * zero unfinished rows and incorrectly conclude the queue is complete.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
function RSC_PERF24_SET_MANIFEST_BUILDING_20260819_(run){
  const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  p.setProperty(S.pManifestState,'BUILDING');
  p.setProperty(S.pManifestReadyRunId,'');
  p.setProperty(S.pExpectedTotalTasks,'0');
  p.setProperty(S.pExpectedValidTasks,'0');
  p.setProperty(S.pExpectedSkippedTasks,'0');
  p.setProperty(S.pExpectedHardInvalidTasks,'0');
  p.deleteProperty(S.pManifestReadyAt);
  return{runId:String(run||''),state:'BUILDING'};
}

function RSC_PERF24_MANIFEST_HEALTH_20260819_(){
  const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const run=String(p.getProperty(S.pRunId)||'');
  const state=String(p.getProperty(S.pManifestState)||'').toUpperCase();
  const readyRun=String(p.getProperty(S.pManifestReadyRunId)||'');
  const expectedTotal=Math.max(0,Number(p.getProperty(S.pExpectedTotalTasks)||0));
  const expectedValid=Math.max(0,Number(p.getProperty(S.pExpectedValidTasks)||0));
  const expectedSkipped=Math.max(0,Number(p.getProperty(S.pExpectedSkippedTasks)||0));
  const expectedHardInvalid=Math.max(0,Number(p.getProperty(S.pExpectedHardInvalidTasks)||0));
  const counts=Object.create(null);let total=0;
  try{
    const ctx=RSC_STD_GET_MASTER_FROM_PROPS_20260814_(),m=RSC_STD_GET_MANIFEST_20260814_(ctx.ss,false);
    if(m&&m.getLastRow()>=2){
      const vals=m.getRange(2,1,m.getLastRow()-1,6).getDisplayValues();
      vals.forEach(function(r){
        if(String(r[0]||'')!==run)return;
        total++;
        const st=String(r[5]||'UNKNOWN').toUpperCase();
        counts[st]=Number(counts[st]||0)+1;
      });
    }
  }catch(err){
    return{ok:false,runId:run,state:state,ready:false,error:formatScriptError_(err),expectedTotal:expectedTotal,actualTotal:total,counts:counts};
  }
  const unfinished=Number(counts.QUEUED||0)+Number(counts.ACTIVE||0)+Number(counts.RETRY||0);
  const terminal=total-unfinished;
  const hard=Number(counts.HARD_ERROR||0);
  const processedValid=Math.max(0,Number(counts.COMPLETE_OK||0)+Number(counts.COMPLETE_ERROR||0)+hard-expectedHardInvalid);
  const ready=(state==='READY'||state==='FINISHED')&&readyRun===run&&Boolean(run);
  const totalsMatch=ready&&total===expectedTotal;
  const validMatch=processedValid===expectedValid;
  const completionSafe=ready&&totalsMatch&&unfinished===0&&terminal===expectedTotal&&validMatch;
  return{
    ok:true,runId:run,state:state,readyRunId:readyRun,ready:ready,
    expectedTotal:expectedTotal,expectedValid:expectedValid,expectedSkipped:expectedSkipped,expectedHardInvalid:expectedHardInvalid,
    actualTotal:total,counts:counts,unfinished:unfinished,terminal:terminal,processedValid:processedValid,
    totalsMatch:totalsMatch,validMatch:validMatch,completionSafe:completionSafe,
    readyAt:String(p.getProperty(S.pManifestReadyAt)||'')
  };
}

function RSC_PERF24_MARK_MANIFEST_READY_20260819_(run,expected){
  expected=expected||{};
  const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  if(String(p.getProperty(S.pRunId)||'')!==String(run||''))throw new Error('[PERF24 MANIFEST] Run berubah saat manifest sedang dibangun.');
  p.setProperty(S.pExpectedTotalTasks,String(Math.max(0,Number(expected.total||0))));
  p.setProperty(S.pExpectedValidTasks,String(Math.max(0,Number(expected.valid||0))));
  p.setProperty(S.pExpectedSkippedTasks,String(Math.max(0,Number(expected.skipped||0))));
  p.setProperty(S.pExpectedHardInvalidTasks,String(Math.max(0,Number(expected.hardInvalid||0))));
  p.setProperty(S.pManifestReadyRunId,String(run||''));
  p.setProperty(S.pManifestReadyAt,new Date().toISOString());
  p.setProperty(S.pManifestState,'READY');
  const health=RSC_PERF24_MANIFEST_HEALTH_20260819_();
  if(!health.ready||!health.totalsMatch){
    p.setProperty(S.pManifestState,'ERROR');
    throw new Error('[PERF24 MANIFEST INCOMPLETE] Manifest belum konsisten. expected='+health.expectedTotal+', actual='+health.actualTotal+', run='+String(run||''));
  }
  return health;
}

/* ============================================================================
 * PERF15 — LINK E / ACTIVE VALIDATION PARITY + BACKGROUND ACCESS GATE
 * 2026-08-19
 *
 * Problem fixed:
 * - Active validation runs RSC_STD_VALIDATE_ONE_SHEET_ directly on the current
 *   Change Rolling & Change Schedule sheet.
 * - Bulk Link E previously ran RSC_STD_VALIDATE_WORKBOOK_, which added workbook
 *   discovery/wrapping and could write infrastructure failures as [SYSTEM] into
 *   every Rolling row.
 * - Time-driven workers can execute under a different trigger creator identity.
 *   A worker that cannot read the main DB must never claim/mutate a target file.
 *
 * Authoritative Link E flow after PERF15:
 *   Link E file -> exact Change Rolling & Change Schedule
 *               -> RSC_STD_VALIDATE_ONE_SHEET_ (same core as Active)
 *               -> status color enforcement
 * Infrastructure access errors stay in manifest RETRY/HARD_ERROR, not O:P.
 * ========================================================================== */

function RSC_PERF15_DB_PREFLIGHT_20260819_(phase) {
  if (typeof RSC_PERF19_MAIN_DB_PREFLIGHT_20260819_ === 'function') {
    return RSC_PERF19_MAIN_DB_PREFLIGHT_20260819_(phase);
  }
  const C = RSC_PERF15_BULK_ACCESS_20260819;
  const started = Date.now();
  const ss = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(C.mainDbSpreadsheetId);
  const missing=[];
  C.requiredDbSheets.forEach(function(name){
    const sh=RSC_PERF5_GET_SHEET_20260819_(ss,name);
    if(!sh)missing.push(name);
  });
  if(missing.length) throw new Error('[PERF15 DB PREFLIGHT] DB terbuka tetapi sheet wajib tidak ditemukan: '+missing.join(', ')+'.');
  // Force a tiny read from relation DB so a stale/permission-invalid handle is rejected now.
  const rel=RSC_PERF5_GET_SHEET_20260819_(ss,'m_bp_relation');
  const relLast=Math.max(1,Number(rel.getLastRow()||1));
  rel.getRange(1,1,Math.min(2,relLast),1).getDisplayValues();
  return {
    ok:true,phase:String(phase||''),dbId:ss.getId(),dbName:ss.getName(),
    effectiveUser:RSC_PERF15_GET_VISIBLE_EMAIL_20260819_('EFFECTIVE')||'[hidden]',
    activeUser:RSC_PERF15_GET_VISIBLE_EMAIL_20260819_('ACTIVE')||'[hidden]',
    requiredSheets:C.requiredDbSheets.slice(),elapsedMs:Date.now()-started
  };
}

function standardBulkStart(options){
  options=options||{};const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  // PERF15: fail fast under the same manual identity that starts the run.
  const perf15StartAccess=RSC_PERF15_REGISTER_BULK_STARTER_20260819_();
  const existingRun=String(p.getProperty(S.pRunId)||''),existingUnfinished=RSC_STD_BULK_HAS_UNFINISHED_20260814_(),sameVersionRun=existingRun.indexOf(S.version+'|')===0;
  if(existingUnfinished&&!sameVersionRun){
    deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_(S.workerHandlers.concat([S.watchdogHandler]));
    writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('Run versi lama dihentikan agar manifest baru '+S.version+' dibuat lengkap dengan telemetry V28.3. Old run='+existingRun);
  }
  if(existingUnfinished&&sameVersionRun){
    const wasStopped=String(p.getProperty(S.pStop)||'').toUpperCase()==='TRUE';

        if(oldM&&oldM.getLastRow()>=2){
          const oldRange=oldM.getRange(2,1,oldM.getLastRow()-1,S.manifestHeaders.length),vals=oldRange.getValues();let changed=false;
          for(let i=0;i<vals.length;i++){
            if(String(vals[i][0]||'')===oldRun&&String(vals[i][5]||'').toUpperCase()==='ACTIVE'){
              vals[i][5]='RETRY';vals[i][7]='';vals[i][8]='';vals[i][14]='Resume setelah STOP; lease ACTIVE dilepas.';changed=true;
            }
          }
          if(changed)oldRange.setValues(vals);
          RSC_STD_REFRESH_MASTER_STYLES_FROM_MANIFEST_20260814_(oldCtx);
        }
      }catch(ignoreRelease){}
    }
    p.setProperty(S.pStop,'FALSE');
    try{
      const logCtx=RSC_STD_GET_MASTER_FROM_PROPS_20260814_();
      PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().setProperty(RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_20260819.pLogSsId,logCtx.ss.getId());

      RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_REFRESH_SUMMARY_20260819_({ss:logCtx.ss});
    }catch(ignoreLogResume){}
    RSC_STD_SCHEDULE_WORKERS_20260814_();return{resumed:true,runId:p.getProperty(S.pRunId)||''};
  }
  const ctx=RSC_STD_RESOLVE_MASTER_CONTEXT_20260814_(options),ex=RSC_STD_EXTRACT_LINK_TASKS_20260814_(ctx.ss,ctx.sh),run=S.version+'|'+Utilities.getUuid();

  }catch(ignoreLogStart){}
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_(S.workerHandlers.concat([S.watchdogHandler]));const m=RSC_STD_GET_MANIFEST_20260814_(ctx.ss,true);m.clear();m.getRange(1,1,1,S.manifestHeaders.length).setValues([S.manifestHeaders]);const rows=[];

  const skippedTasks=Number(ex.skippedRows||0),hardInvalidTasks=Number(ex.hardInvalidRows||0);

    RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_REFRESH_SUMMARY_20260819_({ss:ctx.ss});
  }catch(ignoreLogManifest){}
  let inlineResult=null;
  if(validTasks>0&&S.inlineFirstTask){
    try{ctx.ss.toast('Manifest siap. Task pertama Standard V28.3 langsung diproses.','Standard V28.3',6);}catch(ignoreToast){}
    try{inlineResult=standardBulkWorker(1,{maxTasks:1,inline:true,skipReschedule:true});}
    catch(inlineErr){inlineResult={error:formatScriptError_(inlineErr)};writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('Inline first task V28.3 gagal; worker background tetap dilanjutkan. '+inlineResult.error);}
  }
  RSC_STD_REFRESH_MASTER_STYLES_FROM_MANIFEST_20260814_(ctx);
  if(validTasks>0){
    if(RSC_STD_BULK_HAS_UNFINISHED_20260814_())RSC_STD_SCHEDULE_WORKERS_20260814_();
    else{
      // PERF24: never infer completion from `unfinished==0` alone. The manifest
      // must be READY, row-count complete, and every expected valid task must
      // have a terminal result.
      const doneHealth=RSC_PERF24_MANIFEST_HEALTH_20260819_();
      if(doneHealth.completionSafe){
        RSC_PERF24_MARK_FINISHED_20260819_();
        if(Number((doneHealth.counts||{}).COMPLETE_OK||0)>0){
          try{const done=RSC_STD_BULK_COUNTS_20260814_();done.autoRevamp=RSC_PERF12_AUTO_REVAMP_AFTER_BULK_20260819_(done);}catch(autoInlineErr){writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('PERF24 completion-safe Auto Revamp gagal start: '+formatScriptError_(autoInlineErr));}
        }
      }else{
        throw new Error('[PERF24 COMPLETION GUARD] Queue terlihat kosong tetapi manifest belum completion-safe. expected='+doneHealth.expectedTotal+', actual='+doneHealth.actualTotal+', processedValid='+doneHealth.processedValid+'/'+doneHealth.expectedValid+', state='+doneHealth.state+'.');
      }
    }
  } else {
    const zeroHealth=RSC_PERF24_MANIFEST_HEALTH_20260819_();
    if(zeroHealth.completionSafe)RSC_PERF24_MARK_FINISHED_20260819_();
    else throw new Error('[PERF24 ZERO-TASK GUARD] Manifest tanpa valid task belum konsisten.');
  }
  const inlineState=inlineResult&&Number(inlineResult.processed||0)>0?'YA':(inlineResult&&inlineResult.error?'ERROR':'TIDAK');
  const msg='Bulk Standard V28.3 '+(validTasks>0?'dimulai':'selesai tanpa file valid')+'. Link='+ex.rawLinks+', file unik/task='+ex.tasks.length+', valid='+validTasks+', skipped='+Number(ex.skippedRows||0)+', hard-invalid='+Number(ex.hardInvalidRows||0)+', workers='+(validTasks>0?S.workerCount:0)+', inline pertama='+inlineState+'.';
  p.setProperty(S.pLastStatus,msg);writeRollingSalesCenterLog_(msg);if(!options.silent)try{ctx.ss.toast(msg,'Standard V28.3',12);}catch(ignore){}
  return{runId:run,tasks:ex.tasks.length,validTasks:validTasks,rawLinks:ex.rawLinks,invalid:ex.invalidRows,inlineFirst:inlineResult};
}

function RSC_STD_CLAIM_TASK_BATCH_20260814_(lane,maxTasks){
  const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  if(String(p.getProperty(S.pStop)||'').toUpperCase()==='TRUE')return[];
  const run=String(p.getProperty(S.pRunId)||'');if(!run)return[];
  maxTasks=Math.max(1,Math.min(8,Number(maxTasks||S.claimBatchSize||4)));
  const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();if(!lock.tryLock(Number(S.claimLockWaitMs||3000)))return[];
  let tasks=[],ctx=null;
  try{
    ctx=RSC_STD_GET_MASTER_FROM_PROPS_20260814_();
    const m=RSC_STD_GET_MANIFEST_20260814_(ctx.ss,false);if(!m||m.getLastRow()<2)return[];
    const range=m.getRange(2,1,m.getLastRow()-1,S.manifestHeaders.length),vals=range.getValues(),now=Date.now(),nowIso=new Date(now).toISOString();
    for(let i=0;i<vals.length&&tasks.length<maxTasks;i++){
      if(String(vals[i][0]||'')!==run)continue;
      const st=String(vals[i][5]||'').toUpperCase(),lease=vals[i][8]?new Date(vals[i][8]).getTime():0,expired=!lease||!isFinite(lease)||lease<=now;
      // PERF25: RETRY may carry a future Lease Until as a not-before time.
      // This prevents DB-contention tasks from being reclaimed every few seconds.
      if(st==='RETRY'&&!expired)continue;
      if(st!=='QUEUED'&&st!=='RETRY'&&!(st==='ACTIVE'&&expired))continue;
      const attempts=Number(vals[i][6]||0)+1,queued=vals[i][11]||nowIso,queuedMs=new Date(queued).getTime();
      const queueWaitSec=isFinite(queuedMs)?RSC_V28_3_SEC_20260814_(now-queuedMs):0;
      vals[i][5]='ACTIVE';vals[i][6]=attempts;vals[i][7]=lane;vals[i][8]=new Date(now+S.leaseMs).toISOString();
      vals[i][12]=nowIso;vals[i][14]='Worker '+lane+' memproses bundle '+maxTasks+' task.';vals[i][15]=queueWaitSec;
      tasks.push({manifestRow:i+2,runId:run,fileId:String(vals[i][1]||''),masterRows:RSC_STD_PARSE_MASTER_ROWS_20260814_(vals[i][2]),url:String(vals[i][3]||''),attempts:attempts,startedAt:String(queued||''),claimedAt:nowIso,queueWaitSec:queueWaitSec,lane:lane});
    }
    if(tasks.length)range.setValues(vals);
  }finally{try{lock.releaseLock();}catch(ignore){}}
  if(tasks.length&&ctx)RSC_STD_BATCH_STYLE_MASTER_ROWS_20260814_(ctx.sh,tasks.map(function(t){return{rows:t.masterRows,color:S.colorActive,note:S.version+' | ACTIVE | worker='+lane+' | attempt='+t.attempts};}));
  return tasks;
}

function RSC_STD_CLAIM_TASK_20260814_(lane){
  const tasks=RSC_STD_CLAIM_TASK_BATCH_20260814_(lane,1);return tasks.length?tasks[0]:null;
}

function RSC_STD_COMMIT_TASKS_20260814_(entries){
  entries=entries||[];if(!entries.length)return{committed:0,batches:0};
  const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,lock=LockService.getScriptLock();if(!lock.tryLock(Number(S.commitLockWaitMs||8000)))throw new Error('Gagal memperoleh lock saat batch commit Standard V28.3.');
  let ctx=null,updates=[],committed=0;
  try{
    ctx=RSC_STD_GET_MASTER_FROM_PROPS_20260814_();const m=RSC_STD_GET_MANIFEST_20260814_(ctx.ss,false);if(!m)return{committed:0,batches:0};
    const range=m.getRange(2,1,m.getLastRow()-1,S.manifestHeaders.length),vals=range.getValues(),nowIso=new Date().toISOString();
    entries.forEach(function(e){
      const task=e.task,idx=Number(task.manifestRow)-2;if(idx<0||idx>=vals.length||String(vals[idx][0]||'')!==task.runId)return;
      const result=e.result||null,status=e.status,tele=e.telemetry||{},fileName=result&&result.fileName?result.fileName:'',errorRows=Number((result&&result.errorRows)||0),summary=result?RSC_STD_FORMAT_WORKBOOK_SUMMARY_20260814_(result):'';
      const finalAttempts=(e.attemptsOverride==null)?Number(task.attempts||0):Math.max(0,Number(e.attemptsOverride||0));
      const retryAfterMs=(status==='RETRY')?Math.max(0,Number(e.retryAfterMs||0)):0;
      vals[idx][4]=fileName||vals[idx][4]||'';vals[idx][5]=status;vals[idx][6]=finalAttempts;vals[idx][7]='';vals[idx][8]=retryAfterMs?new Date(Date.now()+retryAfterMs).toISOString():'';vals[idx][9]=errorRows;vals[idx][10]=summary;
      vals[idx][11]=task.startedAt||vals[idx][11]||'';vals[idx][12]=nowIso;vals[idx][13]=Number(e.durationSec||tele.totalSec||0);vals[idx][14]=e.message||'';
      vals[idx][15]=Number(task.queueWaitSec||tele.queueWaitSec||0);vals[idx][16]=Number(tele.openFileSec||0);vals[idx][17]=Number(tele.masterLoadSec||0);
      vals[idx][18]=Number(tele.normalizeSec||0);vals[idx][19]=Number(tele.rulesSec||0);vals[idx][20]=Number(tele.writeSec||0);vals[idx][21]=Number(tele.totalSec||e.durationSec||0);
      const color=status==='COMPLETE_OK'?S.colorOk:(status==='RETRY'?S.colorQueued:S.colorError);
      updates.push({rows:task.masterRows,color:color,note:S.version+' | '+status+' | errors='+errorRows+(summary?' | '+summary:'')+(e.message?' | '+e.message:'')});committed++;
    });
    if(committed)range.setValues(vals);
  }finally{try{lock.releaseLock();}catch(ignore){}}
  if(committed&&ctx)RSC_STD_BATCH_STYLE_MASTER_ROWS_20260814_(ctx.sh,updates);
  return{committed:committed,batches:committed?1:0};
}

function RSC_STD_COMMIT_TASK_20260814_(task,status,result,message,durationSec){
  return RSC_STD_COMMIT_TASKS_20260814_([{task:task,status:status,result:result,message:message,durationSec:durationSec,telemetry:{totalSec:Number(durationSec||0)}}]);

function RSC_V28_3_PHASES_FROM_WORKBOOK_RESULT_20260814_(result){
  const out={masterLoadSec:0,normalizeSec:0,rulesSec:0,writeSec:0};
  (result&&result.results||[]).some(function(r){
    if(String(r.label||r.kind||'').toUpperCase()!=='ROLLING')return false;
    const p=r.phaseDurations||{};out.masterLoadSec=Number(p.masterLoadSec||0);out.normalizeSec=Number(p.normalizeSec||0);out.rulesSec=Number(p.rulesSec||0);out.writeSec=Number(p.writeSec||0);return true;
  });
  return out;
}

function standardBulkWorker(lane,options){
  RSC_PERF12_ASSERT_READY_20260819_();
  options=options||{};const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const laneIndex=Math.max(0,Math.min(S.workerCount-1,Number(lane||1)-1)),laneHandler=S.workerHandlers[laneIndex],slot='WORKER_'+Number(lane||1);
  if(options.triggerEvent)RSC_STD_RELEASE_FIRED_ONE_TIME_TRIGGER_20260819_(options.triggerEvent,laneHandler);
  if(String(p.getProperty(S.pStop)||'').toUpperCase()==='TRUE'){
    RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:'STOPPED',stage:'Stop flag active',progressPct:0,message:'Worker tidak dijalankan karena STOP flag aktif.',startedMs:Date.now(),worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:String(p.getProperty(S.pRunId)||'')},{force:true,history:true});
    return{skipped:true};
  }

  // PERF24: an installable trigger owned by another account may be invisible to
  // the authorized user and cannot always be deleted. Make it a silent no-op
  // before it can overwrite WORKER_n live logging or touch manifest state.
  const earlyOwnerGate=(typeof RSC_PERF24_BACKGROUND_BINDING_GATE_20260819_==='function')?RSC_PERF24_BACKGROUND_BINDING_GATE_20260819_('WORKER_EARLY_'+String(lane||0)):{ok:true};
  if(!earlyOwnerGate.ok&&earlyOwnerGate.foreign)return{skipped:true,reason:'FOREIGN_TRIGGER_OWNER_SILENT'};

  const started=Date.now(),runId=String(p.getProperty(S.pRunId)||''),maxTasks=Math.max(1,Math.min(8,Number(options.maxTasks||S.claimBatchSize||4)));
  RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{
    jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:'START',stage:'Worker bootstrap',progressPct:1,current:0,total:maxTasks,
    message:'Worker lane '+lane+' mulai. Menyiapkan access gate dan cache.',startedMs:started,worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId
  },{force:true,history:true});

  RSC_PERF5_RESET_STATS_20260819_();
  __RSC_FSD_RELATIONSHIP_SET_CACHE_20260807=null;if(typeof __RSC_M_VISIT_SCHEDULE_VALIDATION_INDEX_CACHE_20260723__!=='undefined')__RSC_M_VISIT_SCHEDULE_VALIDATION_INDEX_CACHE_20260723__=null;

  RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{
    jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:'RUNNING',stage:'DB access + identity gate',progressPct:3,current:0,total:maxTasks,
    message:'Memastikan identity worker sama dengan starter dan database utama dapat dibaca.',startedMs:started,worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId
  },{force:true});
  const accessGate=RSC_PERF15_WORKER_ACCESS_GATE_20260819_(lane);
  if(!accessGate.ok){
    const unfinished=RSC_STD_BULK_HAS_UNFINISHED_20260814_(),stopped=String(p.getProperty(S.pStop)||'').toUpperCase()==='TRUE';
    if(!options.skipReschedule&&unfinished&&!stopped&&!accessGate.identityMismatch){
      RSC_STD_ENSURE_ONE_TIME_TRIGGER_20260814_(laneHandler,Math.max(10000,Number(S.workerIdleRetryDelayMs||5000)*2)+laneIndex*700);
      RSC_STD_ENSURE_WATCHDOG_20260814_();
    }
    RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{
      jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:accessGate.identityMismatch?'BLOCKED':'RETRY',stage:'Access gate failed',progressPct:3,current:0,total:maxTasks,
      message:accessGate.identityMismatch?'Trigger identity berbeda dengan starter; worker diblok.':'DB preflight gagal; worker akan retry.',
      error:String(accessGate.error||accessGate.reason||'Access gate failed'),startedMs:started,worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId
    },{force:true,history:true});
    return{claimed:0,processed:0,unfinished:unfinished,accessGate:accessGate,rescheduled:Boolean(!options.skipReschedule&&unfinished&&!stopped&&!accessGate.identityMismatch),perf5:RSC_PERF5_GET_STATS_20260819_()};
  }

  const manifestGate=RSC_PERF24_MANIFEST_HEALTH_20260819_();
  if(!manifestGate.ready){
    const manifestError=String(manifestGate.state||'')==='ERROR';
    if(!options.skipReschedule&&!manifestError&&String(p.getProperty(S.pStop)||'').toUpperCase()!=='TRUE'){
      RSC_STD_ENSURE_ONE_TIME_TRIGGER_20260814_(laneHandler,Math.max(5000,Number(S.workerIdleRetryDelayMs||5000))+laneIndex*700);
    }
    RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{
      jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:manifestError?'BLOCKED':'WAITING',stage:manifestError?'Manifest build error':'Waiting manifest ready',progressPct:5,current:0,total:maxTasks,
      message:manifestError?'Manifest current run berstatus ERROR; worker tidak boleh claim.':'Manifest sedang dibangun/belum READY; worker menunggu agar queue tidak salah dianggap kosong.',
      error:manifestError?String(manifestGate.error||'PERF24 manifest state ERROR'):'',startedMs:started,worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId
    },{force:true,history:manifestError});
    return{claimed:0,processed:0,manifestGate:manifestGate,rescheduled:Boolean(!options.skipReschedule&&!manifestError)};
  }

  RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{
    jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:'RUNNING',stage:'Claim task batch',progressPct:6,current:0,total:maxTasks,
    message:'Meng-claim task QUEUED/RETRY dari manifest.',startedMs:started,worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId
  },{force:true});
  const tasks=RSC_STD_CLAIM_TASK_BATCH_20260814_(lane,maxTasks);
  if(!tasks.length){
    const unfinished=RSC_STD_BULK_HAS_UNFINISHED_20260814_(),stopped=String(p.getProperty(S.pStop)||'').toUpperCase()==='TRUE';
    const h=RSC_PERF24_MANIFEST_HEALTH_20260819_();
    const safeEmpty=Boolean(h.completionSafe);
    if(!options.skipReschedule&&!stopped&&(unfinished||(!safeEmpty&&h.ready))){
      RSC_STD_ENSURE_ONE_TIME_TRIGGER_20260814_(laneHandler,Number(S.workerIdleRetryDelayMs||5000)+laneIndex*700);
      RSC_STD_ENSURE_WATCHDOG_20260814_();
    }
    const state=unfinished?'WAITING':(safeEmpty?'IDLE':'BLOCKED');
    const stage=unfinished?'Waiting for claim':(safeEmpty?'No unfinished task':'Unsafe empty queue blocked');
    const message=unfinished?'Tidak ada task yang berhasil di-claim pada tick ini; lane dijadwalkan ulang.':(safeEmpty?'Queue benar-benar selesai dan manifest completion-safe.':'Tidak ada task yang ter-claim tetapi manifest belum completion-safe; worker TIDAK menyatakan queue selesai.');
    RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{
      jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:state,stage:stage,progressPct:(unfinished?6:100),
      current:0,total:maxTasks,message:message,
      error:(!unfinished&&!safeEmpty)?('expected='+h.expectedTotal+', actual='+h.actualTotal+', processedValid='+h.processedValid+'/'+h.expectedValid+', state='+h.state):'',
      startedMs:started,worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId
    },{force:true,history:Boolean(!unfinished)});
    return{claimed:0,processed:0,unfinished:unfinished,completionSafe:safeEmpty,manifestHealth:h,rescheduled:Boolean(!options.skipReschedule&&!stopped&&(unfinished||(!safeEmpty&&h.ready))),perf5:RSC_PERF5_GET_STATS_20260819_()};
  }

  if(!RSC_PERF17_IS_CURRENT_BULK_RUN_20260819_(runId)){
    RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:'STOPPED',stage:'Stale run aborted',progressPct:100,message:'Run diganti/restart sebelum prefetch. Worker lama berhenti tanpa commit.',startedMs:started,worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId},{force:true,history:true});
    return{claimed:tasks.length,processed:0,staleRun:true};
  }
  RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{
    jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:'RUNNING',stage:'Prefetch shared master',progressPct:10,current:0,total:tasks.length,
    message:'Bundle '+tasks.length+' file berhasil di-claim. Menggabungkan kebutuhan DB lintas file.',startedMs:started,worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId
  },{force:true,history:true});
  let bundlePrefetch=null;
  try{
    // PERF25: prefetch itself must NOT own a coarse DB lease. Individual
    // relation raw reads serialize themselves. Mark this execution as bulk so
    // relation contention uses short defer semantics rather than a long wait.
    RSC_PERF17_SET_BULK_RUN_GUARD_20260819_(runId);
    try{bundlePrefetch=RSC_PERF5_PREFETCH_WORKER_BUNDLE_20260819_(tasks);}
    finally{RSC_PERF17_CLEAR_BULK_RUN_GUARD_20260819_();}
  }catch(prefetchErr){
    bundlePrefetch={enabled:false,reason:'PREFETCH_DEFERRED',error:formatScriptError_(prefetchErr)};
    RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{
      jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:'RUNNING',stage:'Prefetch deferred',progressPct:11,current:0,total:tasks.length,
      message:'Prefetch bersama ditunda; tiap file akan load master targeted sendiri.',error:formatScriptError_(prefetchErr),
      startedMs:started,worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId
    },{force:true,history:true});
  }
  // PERF25: if union prefetch already proved the serialized relation reader is
  // busy, do not open/validate four files only to hit the same contention again.
  // Return the whole claimed bundle to RETRY with Attempts restored.
  if(bundlePrefetch&&RSC_PERF25_IS_DB_CONTENTION_ERROR_20260819_(bundlePrefetch.masterPrefetchError||bundlePrefetch.error||'')){
    const delay=RSC_PERF25_DB_RETRY_DELAY_MS_20260819_(lane),deferredEntries=[];
    for(let di=0;di<tasks.length;di++){
      const dt=tasks[di];
      deferredEntries.push({task:dt,status:'RETRY',result:null,message:'DB contention deferred pada bundle prefetch; validation attempt tidak dikonsumsi.',durationSec:0,telemetry:{queueWaitSec:Number(dt.queueWaitSec||0),totalSec:0},attemptsOverride:Math.max(0,Number(dt.attempts||0)-1),retryAfterMs:delay});
    }
    const deferredCommit=RSC_STD_COMMIT_TASKS_20260814_(deferredEntries);
    RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{
      jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:'WAITING',stage:'Bundle DB contention deferred',progressPct:12,current:0,total:tasks.length,
      message:'Relation DB sedang dipakai worker lain. '+tasks.length+' task dikembalikan ke RETRY tanpa menambah Attempts; retry setelah '+Math.round(delay/1000)+' detik.',
      error:String(bundlePrefetch.masterPrefetchError||bundlePrefetch.error||''),startedMs:started,worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId
    },{force:true,history:true});
    if(!options.skipReschedule&&String(p.getProperty(S.pStop)||'').toUpperCase()!=='TRUE')RSC_STD_ENSURE_ONE_TIME_TRIGGER_20260814_(laneHandler,delay+laneIndex*500);
    return{claimed:tasks.length,processed:0,committed:deferredCommit.committed,deferredDb:true,retryAfterMs:delay,bundlePrefetch:bundlePrefetch,perf5:RSC_PERF5_GET_STATS_20260819_()};
  }
  const entries=[];
  for(let i=0;i<tasks.length;i++){
    const task=tasks[i],fs=Date.now(),telemetry={queueWaitSec:Number(task.queueWaitSec||0),openFileSec:0,masterLoadSec:0,normalizeSec:0,rulesSec:0,writeSec:0,totalSec:0};
    let result=null,status='',message='',target=null,fileName='',sheetName=RSC_PERF15_BULK_ACCESS_20260819.rollingSheetName,rows=0,attemptsOverride=null,retryAfterMs=0;
    const taskBase=12+(i/tasks.length)*78,taskSpan=78/tasks.length;
    try{
      if(!RSC_PERF17_IS_CURRENT_BULK_RUN_20260819_(runId))throw new Error('[PERF17 STALE RUN ABORT] Run sudah diganti sebelum task '+(i+1)+'.');
      if(!task.fileId)throw new Error('File ID kosong.');
      RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{
        jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:'RUNNING',stage:'Open target workbook',progressPct:taskBase,current:i+1,total:tasks.length,
        fileId:task.fileId,sheetName:sheetName,message:'Membuka file Link E task '+(i+1)+' dari '+tasks.length+'.',startedMs:started,worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId
      },{force:true});
      const openStart=Date.now();target=RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(task.fileId);telemetry.openFileSec=RSC_V28_3_SEC_20260814_(Date.now()-openStart);
      fileName=target.getName();
      const rollingSh=RSC_PERF15_GET_EXACT_ROLLING_SHEET_20260819_(target);sheetName=rollingSh.getName();rows=Math.max(0,rollingSh.getLastRow()-1);
      RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_SET_CONTEXT_20260819_({
        slot:slot,jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId,fileName:fileName,fileId:task.fileId,sheetName:sheetName,rows:rows,
        current:i+1,total:tasks.length,progressBase:taskBase+Math.min(4,taskSpan*.08),progressSpan:Math.max(1,taskSpan-Math.min(5,taskSpan*.1)),startedMs:started
      });
      RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{
        jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:'RUNNING',stage:'Validate Change Rolling',progressPct:taskBase+Math.min(4,taskSpan*.08),current:i+1,total:tasks.length,
        fileName:fileName,fileId:task.fileId,sheetName:sheetName,rows:rows,message:'Menjalankan core Active-equivalent Standard V28.3.',startedMs:started,worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId
      },{force:true,history:true});

      RSC_PERF17_SET_BULK_RUN_GUARD_20260819_(runId);
      try{result=RSC_PERF15_VALIDATE_LINK_E_TARGET_AS_ACTIVE_20260819_(target);}
      finally{RSC_PERF17_CLEAR_BULK_RUN_GUARD_20260819_();}
      const phases=RSC_V28_3_PHASES_FROM_WORKBOOK_RESULT_20260814_(result);telemetry.masterLoadSec=phases.masterLoadSec;telemetry.normalizeSec=phases.normalizeSec;telemetry.rulesSec=phases.rulesSec;telemetry.writeSec=phases.writeSec;
      if((result.systemErrors||[]).length)throw new Error('System validation error: '+result.systemErrors.join(' | '));
      status=Number(result.errorRows||0)===0?'COMPLETE_OK':'COMPLETE_ERROR';message='Validation selesai.';
      RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{
        jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:status,stage:'File validation complete',progressPct:taskBase+taskSpan,current:i+1,total:tasks.length,
        fileName:fileName,fileId:task.fileId,sheetName:sheetName,rows:Number((result.results&&result.results[0]&&result.results[0].checkedRows)||rows),
        message:'File selesai. Error rows='+Number(result.errorRows||0)+'.',startedMs:started,worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId
      },{force:true,history:true});
    }catch(err){
      RSC_PERF17_CLEAR_BULK_RUN_GUARD_20260819_();
      const stale=String(formatScriptError_(err)||'').indexOf('[PERF17 STALE RUN ABORT]')!==-1;
      if(stale){
        RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:'STOPPED',stage:'Stale run aborted',progressPct:100,current:i+1,total:tasks.length,fileName:fileName,fileId:task.fileId,sheetName:sheetName,rows:rows,message:'Execution lama dihentikan karena Restart From Top membuat Run ID baru.',error:formatScriptError_(err),startedMs:started,worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId},{force:true,history:true});
        return{claimed:tasks.length,processed:entries.length,staleRun:true,runId:runId};
      }
      const dbDeferred=RSC_PERF25_IS_DB_CONTENTION_ERROR_20260819_(err);
      if(dbDeferred){
        // Claim increments Attempts optimistically. DB contention happened in
        // master-load BEFORE mutation/write, so roll that increment back.
        attemptsOverride=Math.max(0,Number(task.attempts||0)-1);
        retryAfterMs=RSC_PERF25_DB_RETRY_DELAY_MS_20260819_(lane);
        status='RETRY';
        message='DB contention deferred; validation attempt tidak dikonsumsi. Retry setelah '+Math.round(retryAfterMs/1000)+' detik. '+formatScriptError_(err);
        RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{
          jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:'WAITING',stage:'DB contention deferred',progressPct:taskBase+Math.min(6,taskSpan*.12),current:i+1,total:tasks.length,
          fileName:fileName,fileId:task.fileId,sheetName:sheetName,rows:rows,
          message:'DB sedang dipakai worker lain. Task dikembalikan ke RETRY tanpa menambah Attempts.',error:formatScriptError_(err),
          startedMs:started,worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId
        },{force:true,history:true});
      }else{
        const hard=task.attempts>=S.maxAttempts;status=hard?'HARD_ERROR':'RETRY';message=(hard?'HARD ERROR':'Retry')+': '+formatScriptError_(err);
        RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{
          jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:status,stage:'File validation failed',progressPct:taskBase+taskSpan,current:i+1,total:tasks.length,
          fileName:fileName,fileId:task.fileId,sheetName:sheetName,rows:rows,message:'Task gagal pada attempt '+task.attempts+'.',error:formatScriptError_(err),
          startedMs:started,worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId
        },{force:true,history:true});
      }
    }finally{
      RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_CLEAR_CONTEXT_20260819_();
    }
    telemetry.totalSec=RSC_V28_3_SEC_20260814_(Date.now()-fs);
    entries.push({task:task,status:status,result:result,message:message,durationSec:telemetry.totalSec,telemetry:telemetry,attemptsOverride:attemptsOverride,retryAfterMs:retryAfterMs});
  }

  if(!RSC_PERF17_IS_CURRENT_BULK_RUN_20260819_(runId)){
    RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:'STOPPED',stage:'Stale run — skip commit',progressPct:100,current:tasks.length,total:tasks.length,message:'Run berubah sebelum commit. Hasil worker lama dibuang dari manifest baru.',startedMs:started,worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId},{force:true,history:true});
    return{claimed:tasks.length,processed:entries.length,committed:0,staleRun:true};
  }
  RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{
    jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:'RUNNING',stage:'Commit manifest + master UI',progressPct:92,current:tasks.length,total:tasks.length,
    message:'Menulis status akhir bundle ke manifest dan mewarnai Rekap.',startedMs:started,worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId
  },{force:true});
  const commit=RSC_STD_COMMIT_TASKS_20260814_(entries);
  let unfinished=false;
  try{unfinished=RSC_STD_BULK_HAS_UNFINISHED_20260814_();}catch(ignoreUnfinished){}
  if(!options.skipReschedule&&unfinished&&String(p.getProperty(S.pStop)||'').toUpperCase()!=='TRUE'){
    RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{
      jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:'WAITING',stage:'Schedule continuation',progressPct:98,current:tasks.length,total:tasks.length,
      message:'Masih ada task. Menjadwalkan continuation worker lane '+lane+'.',startedMs:started,worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId
    },{force:true});
    RSC_STD_ENSURE_ONE_TIME_TRIGGER_20260814_(laneHandler,S.workerDelayMs);
  }

  const elapsed=RSC_V28_3_SEC_20260814_(Date.now()-started),perf5=RSC_PERF5_GET_STATS_20260819_();
  RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_(slot,{
    jobType:'VALIDATE LINK E',state:unfinished?'WAITING':'COMPLETE_OK',stage:unfinished?'Bundle done — queue remains':'Worker run complete',progressPct:100,
    current:tasks.length,total:tasks.length,message:'Claimed='+tasks.length+', committed='+commit.committed+', elapsed='+elapsed+'s.',startedMs:started,elapsedSec:elapsed,worker:'Lane '+lane,runId:runId
  },{force:true,history:true});
  try{RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_REFRESH_SUMMARY_20260819_({});}catch(ignoreSummary){}
  try{console.log('[PERF5 worker lane '+lane+'] '+JSON.stringify(perf5));}catch(ignore){}
  return{claimed:tasks.length,processed:entries.length,committed:commit.committed,elapsedSec:elapsed,inline:Boolean(options.inline),bundlePrefetch:bundlePrefetch,perf5:perf5};
}
function RSC_STD_BULK_COUNTS_20260814_(){
  const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties(),run=String(p.getProperty(S.pRunId)||''),counts=Object.create(null);if(!run)return{runId:'',counts:counts,total:0,unfinished:0};const ctx=RSC_STD_GET_MASTER_FROM_PROPS_20260814_(),m=RSC_STD_GET_MANIFEST_20260814_(ctx.ss,false);if(!m||m.getLastRow()<2)return{runId:run,counts:counts,total:0,unfinished:0};const vals=m.getRange(2,1,m.getLastRow()-1,6).getDisplayValues();let total=0,unfinished=0;vals.forEach(function(r){if(String(r[0]||'')!==run)return;total++;const st=String(r[5]||'UNKNOWN').toUpperCase();counts[st]=Number(counts[st]||0)+1;if(st==='QUEUED'||st==='ACTIVE'||st==='RETRY')unfinished++;});return{runId:run,counts:counts,total:total,unfinished:unfinished};
}
function standardBulkWatchdog(e){
  const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties(),started=Date.now(),runId=String(p.getProperty(S.pRunId)||'');
  // PERF24: reject foreign/old-owner watchdog BEFORE it can acquire the shared
  // singleton lease or overwrite the live WATCHDOG row.
  const ownerGate=(typeof RSC_PERF24_BACKGROUND_BINDING_GATE_20260819_==='function')?RSC_PERF24_BACKGROUND_BINDING_GATE_20260819_('WATCHDOG'):{ok:true};
  if(!ownerGate.ok){
    if(ownerGate.foreign)return{skipped:true,reason:'FOREIGN_TRIGGER_OWNER_SILENT'};
    RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_('WATCHDOG',{jobType:'BULK WATCHDOG',state:'BLOCKED',stage:'Authorization binding missing',progressPct:100,message:'Watchdog current owner tidak memiliki binding background yang lengkap.',error:String(ownerGate.error||ownerGate.reason||'BINDING_MISSING'),startedMs:started,worker:'WATCHDOG',runId:runId},{force:true,history:true});
    return{skipped:true,reason:ownerGate.reason||'BINDING_MISSING'};
  }
  const singleton=RSC_PERF17_ACQUIRE_WATCHDOG_SINGLETON_20260819_(e||null);
  if(!singleton.ok){
    RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_('WATCHDOG',{jobType:'BULK WATCHDOG',state:'WAITING',stage:'Duplicate watchdog suppressed',progressPct:100,message:'Invocation watchdog duplicate dilewati: '+String(singleton.reason||'singleton lease')+'.',startedMs:started,worker:'WATCHDOG',runId:runId},{force:true});
    return{skipped:true,reason:singleton.reason||'WATCHDOG_SINGLETON'};
  }
  if(String(p.getProperty(S.pStop)||'').toUpperCase()==='TRUE'){
    RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_('WATCHDOG',{jobType:'BULK WATCHDOG',state:'STOPPED',stage:'Stop flag active',progressPct:0,message:'Watchdog tidak menjadwalkan worker karena STOP flag aktif.',startedMs:started,worker:'WATCHDOG',runId:runId},{force:true,history:true});
    return;
  }
  RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_('WATCHDOG',{jobType:'BULK WATCHDOG',state:'RUNNING',stage:'Identity + queue health check',progressPct:20,message:'Memeriksa identity dan kesehatan queue Standard V28.3.',startedMs:started,worker:'WATCHDOG',runId:runId},{force:true});
  const gate=RSC_PERF15_IDENTITY_GATE_ONLY_20260819_(0);
  if(!gate.ok){
    RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_('WATCHDOG',{jobType:'BULK WATCHDOG',state:'BLOCKED',stage:'Identity mismatch',progressPct:100,message:'Watchdog diblok karena execution identity tidak sama dengan starter.',error:String(gate.error||gate.reason||'IDENTITY_MISMATCH'),startedMs:started,worker:'WATCHDOG',runId:runId},{force:true,history:true});
    return{skipped:true,reason:'IDENTITY_MISMATCH',accessGate:gate};
  }
  const x=RSC_STD_BULK_COUNTS_20260814_();if(!x.runId){
    RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_('WATCHDOG',{jobType:'BULK WATCHDOG',state:'IDLE',stage:'No active run',progressPct:100,message:'Tidak ada run Standard V28.3 aktif.',startedMs:started,worker:'WATCHDOG',runId:''},{force:true});
    return;
  }
  const manifestHealth=RSC_PERF24_MANIFEST_HEALTH_20260819_();
  if(!manifestHealth.ready){
    RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_('WATCHDOG',{jobType:'BULK WATCHDOG',state:String(manifestHealth.state||'')==='ERROR'?'BLOCKED':'WAITING',stage:String(manifestHealth.state||'')==='ERROR'?'Manifest state ERROR':'Manifest not ready',progressPct:40,message:'Watchdog tidak boleh menyimpulkan queue selesai sebelum manifest current run READY.',error:String(manifestHealth.error||('state='+manifestHealth.state+', expected='+manifestHealth.expectedTotal+', actual='+manifestHealth.actualTotal)),startedMs:started,worker:'WATCHDOG',runId:x.runId},{force:true,history:String(manifestHealth.state||'')==='ERROR'});
    return{x:x,manifestHealth:manifestHealth,skipped:true,reason:'MANIFEST_NOT_READY'};
  }
  try{RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_REFRESH_SUMMARY_20260819_({});}catch(ignoreSummary){}
  if(x.unfinished<=0){
    if(!manifestHealth.completionSafe){
      RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_('WATCHDOG',{jobType:'BULK WATCHDOG',state:'BLOCKED',stage:'Unsafe empty queue blocked',progressPct:100,message:'Queue terlihat kosong tetapi manifest belum memenuhi completion barrier. Auto Revamp DIBLOKIR.',error:'expected='+manifestHealth.expectedTotal+', actual='+manifestHealth.actualTotal+', processedValid='+manifestHealth.processedValid+'/'+manifestHealth.expectedValid+', terminal='+manifestHealth.terminal+', state='+manifestHealth.state,startedMs:started,worker:'WATCHDOG',runId:x.runId},{force:true,history:true});
      return{x:x,manifestHealth:manifestHealth,skipped:true,reason:'UNSAFE_EMPTY_QUEUE'};
    }
    deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_(S.workerHandlers.concat([S.watchdogHandler]));
    RSC_PERF24_MARK_FINISHED_20260819_();
    const msg='Bulk Standard V28.3 selesai (completion-safe). COMPLETE_OK='+Number(x.counts.COMPLETE_OK||0)+', COMPLETE_ERROR='+Number(x.counts.COMPLETE_ERROR||0)+', HARD_ERROR='+Number(x.counts.HARD_ERROR||0)+', SKIPPED_INVALID='+Number(x.counts.SKIPPED_INVALID||0)+'.';
    p.setProperty(S.pLastStatus,msg);writeRollingSalesCenterLog_(msg);
    RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_('WATCHDOG',{jobType:'BULK WATCHDOG',state:'COMPLETE_OK',stage:'Queue completed',progressPct:100,message:msg,startedMs:started,worker:'WATCHDOG',runId:x.runId},{force:true,history:true});
    try{RSC_STD_GET_MASTER_FROM_PROPS_20260814_().ss.toast(msg,'Standard V28.3',12);}catch(ignore){}
    try{
      if(Number(x.counts.COMPLETE_OK||0)>0){
        RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_('REVAMP',{jobType:'AUTO TEMPLATE REVAMP',state:'START',stage:'Start after bulk validation',progressPct:0,message:'Validation queue completion-safe. Menjalankan Auto Revamp hanya untuk COMPLETE_OK.',startedMs:Date.now(),worker:'REVAMP',runId:x.runId},{force:true,history:true});
        x.autoRevamp=RSC_PERF12_AUTO_REVAMP_AFTER_BULK_20260819_(x);
      }else{
        x.autoRevamp={started:false,reason:'NO_COMPLETE_OK'};
        RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_('REVAMP',{jobType:'AUTO TEMPLATE REVAMP',state:'IDLE',stage:'No COMPLETE_OK',progressPct:100,message:'Tidak ada COMPLETE_OK; Auto Revamp tidak dijalankan.',startedMs:Date.now(),worker:'REVAMP',runId:x.runId},{force:true,history:true});
      }
    }catch(autoErr){
      x.autoRevamp={started:false,error:formatScriptError_(autoErr)};writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('PERF12 Auto Revamp Rekap gagal start: '+formatScriptError_(autoErr));
      RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_('REVAMP',{jobType:'AUTO TEMPLATE REVAMP',state:'ERROR',stage:'Auto Revamp start failed',progressPct:100,message:'Gagal memulai Auto Revamp.',error:formatScriptError_(autoErr),startedMs:Date.now(),worker:'REVAMP',runId:x.runId},{force:true,history:true});
    }
    return x;
  }
  RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_('WATCHDOG',{jobType:'BULK WATCHDOG',state:'RUNNING',stage:'Re-arm workers',progressPct:70,message:'Unfinished='+Number(x.unfinished||0)+'. Memastikan seluruh worker lane terjadwal.',startedMs:started,worker:'WATCHDOG',runId:x.runId},{force:true});
  RSC_STD_SCHEDULE_WORKERS_20260814_();
  RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_('WATCHDOG',{jobType:'BULK WATCHDOG',state:'WAITING',stage:'Workers armed',progressPct:100,message:'Worker lane sudah diperiksa/dijadwalkan. Watchdog kembali menunggu.',startedMs:started,worker:'WATCHDOG',runId:x.runId},{force:true});
  return x;
}
function standardBulkStatus(showUi){const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,x=RSC_STD_BULK_COUNTS_20260814_(),c=x.counts||{},msg='Standard V28.3 Bulk Status\n\nRun: '+(x.runId||'[none]')+'\nTotal task: '+Number(x.total||0)+'\nQUEUED: '+Number(c.QUEUED||0)+'\nACTIVE: '+Number(c.ACTIVE||0)+'\nRETRY: '+Number(c.RETRY||0)+'\nCOMPLETE_OK: '+Number(c.COMPLETE_OK||0)+'\nCOMPLETE_ERROR: '+Number(c.COMPLETE_ERROR||0)+'\nHARD_ERROR: '+Number(c.HARD_ERROR||0)+'\nSKIPPED_INVALID: '+Number(c.SKIPPED_INVALID||0)+'\nUnfinished: '+Number(x.unfinished||0);PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().setProperty(S.pLastStatus,msg);if(showUi!==false)try{SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(msg);}catch(ignore){}return x;}
function standardBulkOpenManifest(){const ctx=RSC_STD_GET_MASTER_FROM_PROPS_20260814_(),sh=RSC_STD_GET_MANIFEST_20260814_(ctx.ss,false);if(!sh)throw new Error('Manifest Standard V28.3 belum ada.');try{sh.showSheet();}catch(ignore){}ctx.ss.setActiveSheet(sh);return sh.getName();}
function standardBulkRestartFromTop(options){
  options=options||{};
  const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const ctx=RSC_STD_RESOLVE_MASTER_CONTEXT_20260814_({});
  const oldRun=String(p.getProperty(S.pRunId)||'');
  // Invalidate old executions FIRST. Even if an old execution survives trigger deletion,
  // phase guards + manifest run-id checks prevent it from committing into the fresh run.
  p.setProperty(S.pStop,'TRUE');
  // PERF24: a premature/previous Auto Revamp must not continue while a fresh
  // validation manifest is being rebuilt. Existing running revamp executions
  // are cooperative-stopped at their next checkpoint.
  try{p.setProperty('RSC_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_STOP_REQUESTED_20260722','TRUE');}catch(ignoreRevampStop){}
  try{p.deleteProperty('RSC_PERF12_PENDING_BULK_REVAMP_20260819');}catch(ignorePendingRevamp){}
  try{deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_(['RSC_CREATE_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_ROLLING_SALES_20260720','RSC_PERF12_PROCESS_PENDING_BULK_REVAMP_20260819']);}catch(ignoreRevampTriggers){}
  p.setProperty(S.pPreviousRunId,oldRun);
  p.setProperty(S.pRestartedAt,new Date().toISOString());
  p.setProperty(S.pRunId,S.version+'|RESTART_TOMBSTONE|'+Utilities.getUuid());
  p.setProperty(S.pManifestState,'RESTARTING');p.setProperty(S.pManifestReadyRunId,'');
  p.deleteProperty(S.pWatchdogLeaseUntil);p.deleteProperty(S.pWatchdogLeaseToken);
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_(S.workerHandlers.concat([S.watchdogHandler]));
  try{RSC_PERF17_REPAIR_STANDARD_TRIGGER_TOPOLOGY_INTERNAL_20260819_({});}catch(ignoreRepair){}
  try{
    RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_('SYSTEM',{jobType:'BULK VALIDATION',state:'START',stage:'Restart From Top',progressPct:0,message:'Run lama di-invalidasi. Manifest/checkpoint Standard V28.3 akan dibuat ulang dari baris pertama Link E.',startedMs:Date.now(),worker:'SYSTEM',runId:oldRun},{ss:ctx.ss,force:true,history:true});
  }catch(ignoreLog){}
  // standardBulkStart sees no unfinished row for the tombstone Run ID and therefore
  // rebuilds the manifest from firstDataRow=2 using the current Rekap Link E.
  p.setProperty(S.pStop,'FALSE');
  const result=standardBulkStart({masterSsId:ctx.ss.getId(),masterSheetId:String(ctx.sh.getSheetId()),silent:Boolean(options.silent)});
  result.restartedFromTop=true;result.previousRunId=oldRun;result.masterSheet=ctx.sh.getName();
  return result;
}
function standardBulkStop(){const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();p.setProperty(S.pStop,'TRUE');deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_(S.workerHandlers.concat([S.watchdogHandler]));try{RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_('SYSTEM',{jobType:'BULK VALIDATION',state:'STOPPED',stage:'Bulk stop requested',progressPct:0,message:'Bulk validation dihentikan dari menu. Manifest/checkpoint dipertahankan.',startedMs:Date.now(),worker:'SYSTEM',runId:String(p.getProperty(S.pRunId)||'')},{force:true,history:true});RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_REFRESH_SUMMARY_20260819_({});}catch(ignoreLogStop){}return{stopped:true};}

  if (!B.VALIDATE_ALL_FINAL_LINKS_PARAMETERS) missing.push('VALIDATE_ALL_FINAL_LINKS_PARAMETERS');
  if (!B.RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807) missing.push('RSC_FSD_ACTIVE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260807');
  if (!B.COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS) missing.push('COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS');
  if (!B.RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814) missing.push('RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814');
  if (!B.VALIDATE_DATE_IN_TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS) missing.push('VALIDATE_DATE_IN_TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS');
  var result = {ok: missing.length === 0, missing: missing, exportedFunctions: required.length, exportedConfigs: 5};
  Logger.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  if (missing.length) throw new Error('PERF9 scope bridge audit failed: ' + missing.join(', '));
  return result;
}

/* ============================================================
 * V27.1 SCOPE-SAFE HELPERS — GLOBAL MVS MODULE
 * ============================================================
 * RSC_APP_20260611 memakai private IIFE. Helper FSD di dalam IIFE

 * Modul MVS sekarang self-contained agar Active/Bulk/Hourly memakai
 * jalur yang sama tanpa ReferenceError lintas scope.
 * ========================================================== */
const RSC_MVS_SCOPE_SAFE_20260814 = {
  firstDataRow: 2,
  rollingDataWidth: 14,   // A:N; O/P adalah output validation
  maxCellsPerRange: 12000,
  desiredChunkRows: 400
};

function RSC_MVS_safeChunkRows_20260814_(width, desiredRows) {
  const P = RSC_MVS_SCOPE_SAFE_20260814;
  const w = Math.max(1, Number(width || 1));
  const desired = Math.max(1, Number(desiredRows || P.desiredChunkRows));
  const byCells = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(P.maxCellsPerRange) / w));
  return Math.max(1, Math.min(desired, byCells));
}

function RSC_MVS_getLastRollingDataRow_20260814_(sh) {
  const P = RSC_MVS_SCOPE_SAFE_20260814;
  if (!sh) return P.firstDataRow - 1;

  const sheetLastRow = Math.min(
    Number(sh.getLastRow() || 0),
    Number(sh.getMaxRows() || 0)
  );
  if (sheetLastRow < P.firstDataRow) return P.firstDataRow - 1;

  const width = Math.min(P.rollingDataWidth, Math.max(1, Number(sh.getMaxColumns() || P.rollingDataWidth)));
  const chunkRows = RSC_MVS_safeChunkRows_20260814_(width, P.desiredChunkRows);

  for (let endRow = sheetLastRow; endRow >= P.firstDataRow;) {
    const startRow = Math.max(P.firstDataRow, endRow - chunkRows + 1);
    const count = endRow - startRow + 1;
    const rows = sh.getRange(startRow, 1, count, width).getDisplayValues();

    for (let i = rows.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      let hasData = false;
      for (let c = 0; c < rows[i].length; c++) {
        if (String(rows[i][c] == null ? '' : rows[i][c]).trim() !== '') {
          hasData = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (hasData) return startRow + i;
    }
    endRow = startRow - 1;
  }

  return P.firstDataRow - 1;
}

function RSC_MVS_selectEffectiveStartDate_(expectedDates, closeDate) {
  const dates = Object.keys(expectedDates || {}).filter(function (dateText) {
    return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dateText);
  }).sort();
  if (!dates.length) return '';

  const normalizedClose = RSC_MVS_normalizeDate_(closeDate);
  if (normalizedClose) {
    let selected = '';
    for (let i = 0; i < dates.length; i++) {
      if (dates[i] <= normalizedClose) selected = dates[i];
      else break;
    }
    if (selected) return selected;
  }
  return dates[0];
}

function RSC_PERF5_GET_MVS_LAYOUT_20260819_(dbSh) {
  const P = RSC_M_VISIT_SCHEDULE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260723;
  const cacheKey = String(dbSh.getSheetId()) + '|' + String(dbSh.getLastColumn());
  if (__RSC_PERF5_MVS_LAYOUT_CACHE_20260819__[cacheKey]) return __RSC_PERF5_MVS_LAYOUT_CACHE_20260819__[cacheKey];

  const lastRow = dbSh.getLastRow(), lastCol = dbSh.getLastColumn();
  if (lastRow < 2 || lastCol < 1) throw new Error('Database m_visit_schedule tidak memiliki data.');
  const scanRows = Math.min(P.headerScanRows, lastRow), scanCols = Math.min(lastCol, 200);
  const headerGrid = dbSh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, scanCols).getDisplayValues();
  let headerRow = 0, cols = null;
  for (let r = 0; r < headerGrid.length; r++) {
    const row = headerGrid[r];
    const visitScheduleCol = RSC_MVS_findHeaderCol_(row, P.dbVisitScheduleHeaders);
    const found = {
      visitCategory: RSC_MVS_findHeaderCol_(row, P.dbVisitCategoryHeaders),
      customer: RSC_MVS_findHeaderCol_(row, P.dbCustomerHeaders),
      salesman: RSC_MVS_findHeaderCol_(row, P.dbSalesmanHeaders),
      visitType: RSC_MVS_findHeaderCol_(row, P.dbVisitTypeHeaders),
      visitValidFrom: RSC_MVS_findVisitValidFromDbCol_(row, P.dbVisitValidFromHeaders, P.dbDuplicateTimestampHeaders, visitScheduleCol)
    };
    if (found.visitCategory && found.customer && found.salesman && found.visitType && found.visitValidFrom) {
      headerRow = r + 1; cols = found; break;
    }
  }
  if (!cols) throw new Error('Header m_visit_schedule tidak lengkap untuk PERF5 subset lookup.');
  const minCol = Math.min(cols.visitCategory, cols.customer, cols.salesman, cols.visitType, cols.visitValidFrom);
  const maxCol = Math.max(cols.visitCategory, cols.customer, cols.salesman, cols.visitType, cols.visitValidFrom);
  const result = { headerRow: headerRow, firstDataRow: headerRow + 1, cols: cols, minCol: minCol, maxCol: maxCol, width: maxCol - minCol + 1 };
  __RSC_PERF5_MVS_LAYOUT_CACHE_20260819__[cacheKey] = result;
  return result;
}

function RSC_MVS_getIndexSubset_20260819_(neededKeySet) {
  const needed = Object.create(null), datesByKey = Object.create(null);
  Object.keys(neededKeySet || {}).forEach(function (k) { if (k) needed[k] = true; });
  if (!Object.keys(needed).length) return { datesByKey: datesByKey, rowsIndexed: 0, keysIndexed: 0, lookupMode: 'EMPTY' };

  const cached = RSC_V28_2_CACHE_GET_ALL_20260814_('MVS_K', needed), missing = Object.create(null);
  Object.keys(needed).forEach(function (key) {
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cached, key)) { missing[key] = true; return; }
    const raw = String(cached[key] || '');
    if (raw === '!') return;
    try {
      const arr = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(arr) && arr.length) {
        const set = datesByKey[key] = Object.create(null);
        arr.forEach(function (d) { if (d) set[String(d)] = true; });
      }
    } catch (ignore) { missing[key] = true; }
  });
  if (!Object.keys(missing).length) {
    return { datesByKey: datesByKey, rowsIndexed: 0, keysIndexed: Object.keys(datesByKey).length, lookupMode: 'CACHE' };
  }

  if (typeof RSC_PERF19_DB_20260819!=='undefined' && RSC_PERF19_DB_20260819.preferGeneratedLookup!==false && typeof RSC_PERF19_LOOKUP_MVS_20260819_ === 'function') {
    const fast=RSC_PERF19_LOOKUP_MVS_20260819_(missing);
    if(fast && fast.available){
      Object.keys(fast.datesByKey||{}).forEach(function(key){datesByKey[key]=fast.datesByKey[key];});
      const positive=Object.create(null),negative=Object.create(null);
      Object.keys(missing).forEach(function(key){
        if(datesByKey[key])positive[key]=JSON.stringify(Object.keys(datesByKey[key]).sort());
        else negative[key]='!';
      });
      RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('MVS_K',positive,RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819.positiveCacheTtlSec);
      RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('MVS_K',negative,RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819.negativeCacheTtlSec);
      return{datesByKey:datesByKey,rowsIndexed:Number(fast.recordsRead||0),keysIndexed:Object.keys(datesByKey).length,lookupMode:fast.lookupMode||'REST_BUCKET_LOOKUP'};
    }
  }
  const P = RSC_M_VISIT_SCHEDULE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260723;
  const dbSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.spreadsheetId);
  let dbSh = RSC_PERF5_GET_SHEET_20260819_(dbSs, P.sheetName);
  if (!dbSh) {
    const sheets = dbSs.getSheets();
    for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) if (String(sheets[i].getSheetId()) === String(P.sheetGid)) { dbSh = sheets[i]; break; }
  }
  if (!dbSh) throw new Error('Database sheet m_visit_schedule tidak ditemukan.');
  const layout = RSC_PERF5_GET_MVS_LAYOUT_20260819_(dbSh), lastRow = dbSh.getLastRow();
  const missingCustomers = Object.create(null);
  Object.keys(missing).forEach(function (key) {
    const parts = String(key).split('||');
    const customer = parts.length >= 4 ? RSC_MVS_normId_(parts[1]) : '';
    if (customer) missingCustomers[customer] = true;
  });

  let rowsIndexed = 0, lookupMode = 'TEXTFINDER';
  const targeted = RSC_PERF23_READ_TABULAR_CANDIDATES_20260819_(
    dbSh, layout.cols.customer, layout.firstDataRow, lastRow,
    missingCustomers, layout.minCol, layout.width, 'RAW'
  );

  function absorb_(values) {
    const key = RSC_MVS_buildKey_(
      values[layout.cols.visitCategory - layout.minCol],
      values[layout.cols.customer - layout.minCol],
      values[layout.cols.salesman - layout.minCol],
      values[layout.cols.visitType - layout.minCol]
    );
    if (!key || !missing[key]) return;
    const rawDate = values[layout.cols.visitValidFrom - layout.minCol];
    const date = RSC_MVS_normalizeDateValue_(rawDate, rawDate);
    if (!date) return;
    if (!datesByKey[key]) datesByKey[key] = Object.create(null);
    datesByKey[key][date] = true;
    rowsIndexed++;
  }

  if (targeted) {
    lookupMode = targeted.lookupMode;
    for (let i = 0; i < targeted.rows.length; i++) absorb_(targeted.rows[i].values);
  } else {
    lookupMode = 'FULL_SCAN_FALLBACK';
    const readChunkRows = Math.max(1, Math.min(Number(P.readChunkRows || 1000), Math.floor(Number(RSC_MVS_SCOPE_SAFE_20260814.maxCellsPerRange) / Math.max(1, layout.width))));
    for (let start = layout.firstDataRow; start <= lastRow; start += readChunkRows) {
      const count = Math.min(readChunkRows, lastRow - start + 1);
      const rows = dbSh.getRange(start, layout.minCol, count, layout.width).getValues();
      for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) absorb_(rows[i]);
    }
  }

  const positive = Object.create(null), negative = Object.create(null);
  Object.keys(missing).forEach(function (key) {
    if (datesByKey[key]) positive[key] = JSON.stringify(Object.keys(datesByKey[key]).sort());
    else negative[key] = '!';
  });
  RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('MVS_K', positive, RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819.positiveCacheTtlSec);
  RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('MVS_K', negative, RSC_PERF5_CONFIG_20260819.negativeCacheTtlSec);
  return { datesByKey: datesByKey, rowsIndexed: rowsIndexed, keysIndexed: Object.keys(datesByKey).length, lookupMode: lookupMode };
}

function RSC_MVS_getIndex_() {
  if (__RSC_M_VISIT_SCHEDULE_VALIDATION_INDEX_CACHE_20260723__) {
    return __RSC_M_VISIT_SCHEDULE_VALIDATION_INDEX_CACHE_20260723__;
  }

  const P = RSC_M_VISIT_SCHEDULE_VALIDATION_PARAMETERS_20260723;
  const dbSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.spreadsheetId);
  let dbSh = dbSs.getSheetByName(P.sheetName);

  if (!dbSh) {
    const sheets = dbSs.getSheets();
    for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
      if (String(sheets[i].getSheetId()) === String(P.sheetGid)) {
        dbSh = sheets[i];
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  if (!dbSh) {
    throw new Error(
      'Database sheet m_visit_schedule tidak ditemukan pada spreadsheet ' +
      P.spreadsheetId + ' / gid ' + P.sheetGid + '.'
    );
  }

  const lastRow = dbSh.getLastRow();
  const lastCol = dbSh.getLastColumn();
  if (lastRow < 2 || lastCol < 1) {
    throw new Error('Database m_visit_schedule tidak memiliki data.');
  }

  // V23: header dan DB read tidak boleh meminta range sangat besar.
  const scanRows = Math.min(P.headerScanRows, lastRow);
  const scanCols = Math.min(lastCol, 200);
  const headerGrid = dbSh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, scanCols).getDisplayValues();

  let headerRow = 0;
  let cols = null;

  for (let r = 0; r < headerGrid.length; r++) {
    const row = headerGrid[r];
    const visitScheduleCol = RSC_MVS_findHeaderCol_(row, P.dbVisitScheduleHeaders);
    const found = {
      visitCategory: RSC_MVS_findHeaderCol_(row, P.dbVisitCategoryHeaders),
      customer: RSC_MVS_findHeaderCol_(row, P.dbCustomerHeaders),
      salesman: RSC_MVS_findHeaderCol_(row, P.dbSalesmanHeaders),
      visitType: RSC_MVS_findHeaderCol_(row, P.dbVisitTypeHeaders),
      visitValidFrom: RSC_MVS_findVisitValidFromDbCol_(
        row,
        P.dbVisitValidFromHeaders,
        P.dbDuplicateTimestampHeaders,
        visitScheduleCol
      )
    };

    if (
      found.visitCategory &&
      found.customer &&
      found.salesman &&
      found.visitType &&
      found.visitValidFrom
    ) {
      headerRow = r + 1;
      cols = found;
      break;
    }
  }

  if (!cols) {
    throw new Error(
      'Header m_visit_schedule tidak lengkap. Wajib ada: visit_category, ' +
      'cust_id, salesman_id, visit_type, dan tanggal awal berupa ' +
      'visit_valid_from/valid_from/from_timestamp atau to_timestamp pertama.'
    );
  }

  const datesByKey = Object.create(null);
  let rowsIndexed = 0;

  const firstDataRow = headerRow + 1;
  const minCol = Math.min(
    cols.visitCategory,
    cols.customer,
    cols.salesman,
    cols.visitType,
    cols.visitValidFrom
  );
  const maxCol = Math.max(
    cols.visitCategory,
    cols.customer,
    cols.salesman,
    cols.visitType,
    cols.visitValidFrom
  );
  const width = maxCol - minCol + 1;

  const maxCells = Number(
    RSC_MVS_SCOPE_SAFE_20260814.maxCellsPerRange
  );
  const desiredRows = Math.max(1, Number(P.readChunkRows || 1000));
  const readChunkRows = Math.max(
    1,
    Math.min(desiredRows, Math.floor(maxCells / Math.max(1, width)))
  );

  for (
    let startRow = firstDataRow;
    startRow <= lastRow;
    startRow += readChunkRows
  ) {
    const count = Math.min(
      readChunkRows,
      lastRow - startRow + 1
    );

    const values = dbSh.getRange(
      startRow,
      minCol,
      count,
      width
    ).getValues();

    for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
      const key = RSC_MVS_buildKey_(
        values[i][cols.visitCategory - minCol],
        values[i][cols.customer - minCol],
        values[i][cols.salesman - minCol],
        values[i][cols.visitType - minCol]
      );
      if (!key) continue;

      const rawDate = values[i][cols.visitValidFrom - minCol];
      const date = RSC_MVS_normalizeDateValue_(rawDate, rawDate);
      if (!date) continue;

      if (!datesByKey[key]) datesByKey[key] = Object.create(null);
      datesByKey[key][date] = true;
      rowsIndexed++;
    }
  }

  const result = {
    datesByKey: datesByKey,
    rowsIndexed: rowsIndexed,
    keysIndexed: Object.keys(datesByKey).length,
    sheetName: dbSh.getName(),
    sheetId: dbSh.getSheetId(),
    readChunkRows: readChunkRows
  };

  __RSC_M_VISIT_SCHEDULE_VALIDATION_INDEX_CACHE_20260723__ = result;
  return result;
}

function RSC_MVS_buildKey_(visitCategory, customerId, salesmanId, visitType) {
  const a = RSC_MVS_normCode_(visitCategory);
  const b = RSC_MVS_normId_(customerId);
  const c = RSC_MVS_normId_(salesmanId);
  const d = RSC_MVS_normVisitType_(visitType);
  if (!a || !b || !c || !d) return '';
  return [a, b, c, d].join('||');
}

function RSC_MVS_normCode_(value) {
  return RSC_PERF5_MEMO_SCALAR_20260819_('MVS_CODE', value, function () {
    return String(value == null ? '' : value).trim().replace(/^'/, '').replace(/\s+/g, '').toUpperCase();
  });
}

function RSC_MVS_normId_(value) {
  return RSC_PERF5_MEMO_SCALAR_20260819_('MVS_ID', value, function () {
    let text = RSC_MVS_normCode_(value);
    if (/^-?\d+\.0+$/.test(text)) text = text.replace(/\.0+$/, '');
    if (/^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?[Ee][+]?\d+$/.test(text)) {
      const n = Number(text);
      if (isFinite(n)) text = String(Math.round(n));
    }
    return text;
  });
}

function RSC_MVS_normVisitType_(value) {
  return RSC_PERF5_MEMO_SCALAR_20260819_('MVS_VISIT_TYPE', value, function () {
    const text = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim().replace(/^'/, '');
    if (!text) return '';
    const match = text.match(/^(\d+)(?:\.0+)?$/);
    if (match) return match[1].padStart(2, '0');
    return RSC_MVS_normCode_(text);
  });
}

function RSC_MVS_normalizeDate_(value) { return RSC_MVS_normalizeDateValue_(value, value); }

function RSC_MVS_normalizeDateValue_(rawValue, displayValue) {
  if (Object.prototype.toString.call(rawValue) === '[object Date]' && !isNaN(rawValue.getTime())) return Utilities.formatDate(rawValue, Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
  const text = String(displayValue || rawValue || '').trim();
  if (!text) return '';
  let m = text.match(/^(\d{4})[-\/](\d{1,2})[-\/](\d{1,2})$/);
  if (m) return [m[1], String(m[2]).padStart(2, '0'), String(m[3]).padStart(2, '0')].join('-');
  m = text.match(/^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/);
  if (m) {
    const month = Number(m[1]), day = Number(m[2]), year = Number(m[3]);
    const d = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
    if (d.getFullYear() === year && d.getMonth() === month - 1 && d.getDate() === day) return [year, String(month).padStart(2, '0'), String(day).padStart(2, '0')].join('-');
  }
  if (/^\d{12,13}$/.test(text)) {
    const epochDate = new Date(Number(text));
    if (!isNaN(epochDate.getTime())) return Utilities.formatDate(epochDate, Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
  }
  const parsed = new Date(text);
  if (!isNaN(parsed.getTime())) return Utilities.formatDate(parsed, Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
  return '';
}

function RSC_MVS_findHeaderCol_(row, aliases) {
  const targets = {};
  (aliases || []).forEach(function (alias) { targets[RSC_MVS_normHeader_(alias)] = true; });
  for (let c = 0; c < row.length; c++) if (targets[RSC_MVS_normHeader_(row[c])]) return c + 1;
  return 0;
}

/**
 * Resolve the m_visit_schedule effective start-date column.
 * Priority:
 * 1) Explicit start-date header such as visit_valid_from / valid_from.
 * 2) First duplicate `to_timestamp`, preferably the first one located after
 *    visit_schedule. In the current DB export, the second `to_timestamp` is
 *    the end date and therefore must not be used.
 */
function RSC_MVS_findVisitValidFromDbCol_(row, explicitAliases, timestampAliases, visitScheduleCol) {
  const explicitCol = RSC_MVS_findHeaderCol_(row, explicitAliases);
  if (explicitCol) return explicitCol;

  const timestampCols = RSC_MVS_findAllHeaderCols_(row, timestampAliases);
  if (!timestampCols.length) return 0;

  if (visitScheduleCol) {
    for (let i = 0; i < timestampCols.length; i++) {
      if (timestampCols[i] > visitScheduleCol) return timestampCols[i];
    }
  }
  return timestampCols[0];
}

function RSC_MVS_findAllHeaderCols_(row, aliases) {
  const targets = {};
  const result = [];
  (aliases || []).forEach(function (alias) { targets[RSC_MVS_normHeader_(alias)] = true; });
  for (let c = 0; c < row.length; c++) {
    if (targets[RSC_MVS_normHeader_(row[c])]) result.push(c + 1);
  }
  return result;
}

function RSC_MVS_normHeader_(value) {
  return String(value == null ? '' : value).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[\s_\-\/]+/g, '');
}

function RSC_MVS_mergeErrors_(existing, additions) {
  const seen = {}, out = [];
  String(existing || '').split('|').forEach(function (part) {
    const value = String(part || '').trim();
    if (value && !seen[value]) { seen[value] = true; out.push(value); }
  });
  (additions || []).forEach(function (part) {
    const value = String(part || '').trim();
    if (value && !seen[value]) { seen[value] = true; out.push(value); }
  });
  return out.join(' | ');
}

    throw new Error(
      'Spreadsheet aktif tidak ditemukan. Buka Apps Script melalui Extensions > Apps Script dari file Google Sheets master.'
    );
  }

  // Install V5 dimulai dengan kill-switch aktif agar trigger job lama tidak hidup kembali.
  PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().setProperty(
    'ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS_STOP_FLAG_V5',
    'TRUE'
  );

  var handlersToDelete = [
    'RSC_OPEN_MENU_20260611',
    'RSC_HANDLE_EDIT_20260611',
    'RSC_VALIDATE_INPUT_ROLLING_LINK_ON_EDIT_20260611',
    'RSC_REFRESH_CR_VISIT_SCHEDULE_SUMMARY_SAFE_20260611',
    'RSC_CONTINUE_COPY_ROLLING_TEMPLATE_FILES_BG_20260611',
    'RSC_CONTINUE_VALIDATE_COPIED_ROLLING_TEMPLATES_BG_20260611',
    'RSC_CLEAR_ALL_PROTECTIONS_FROM_FINAL_LINKS_BG_20260611',
    'RSC_CONTINUE_VALIDATE_BP_EXISTENCE_FOR_FINAL_LINKS_BG_20260611',
    'RSC_CONTINUE_VALIDATE_ALL_IN_COLUMN_E_BG_20260723',
    'RSC_CONTINUE_FIX_ROLLING_REASON_DATES_BG_20260611',
    'RSC_CONTINUE_SYNC_SALESMAN_BP_TYPE_FROM_FINAL_LINKS_BG_20260622',
    'RSC_CONTINUE_CLEANSE_EXISTING_FINAL_LINKS_ONLY_BG_20260622',
    'RSC_CONTINUE_COMPILE_APPROVED_LINKS_BG_20260625',
    'RSC_CONTINUE_COMPILE_APPROVED_LINKS_V13_20260722',
    'RSC_SCHEDULED_LOCAL_VALIDATION_JOB_20260611',
    'RSC_V28_2_AUTHORIZED_ON_EDIT_20260814',
    'RSC_V28_2_AUTO_VALIDATE_WORKER_20260814',

    // Legacy handler names from older separated scripts.
    'validasiLinkRollingOnEdit',
    'validasiLinkRollingOnEdit2026',
    'validateInputRollingLinkOnEdit',
    'refreshCrVisitScheduleSummarySafely',
    'continueCopyRollingTemplateFilesInBackground',
    'continueValidateCopiedRollingTemplateFilesInBackground',
    'clearAllProtectionsFromFinalLinksInBackground',
    'continueValidateBpExistenceForFinalRollingLinksInBackground',
    'continueFixRollingReasonDatesForFinalLinksInBackground',
    'continueSyncSalesmanBpTypeFromFinalLinksInBackground',
    'RSC_CONTINUE_TOKO_BANGKRUT_DATES_BY_DB_BG_20260622'
  ];

  ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(function (trigger) {
    if (handlersToDelete.indexOf(trigger.getHandlerFunction()) !== -1) {
      ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger);
    }
  });

  // PENTING:
  // Jangan panggil RSC_APP_20260611.handleOpen() dari installer.
  // handleOpen() membuat menu melalui SpreadsheetApp.getUi(), yang tidak tersedia
  // saat function dijalankan dari trigger, Apps Script API, atau konteks non-UI.
  // Menu akan dibuat otomatis ketika spreadsheet benar-benar dibuka/reload.

  try {
    RSC_APP_20260611.installRecommendedRollingSalesCenterTriggers();
  } catch (err) {
    var errorText = err && err.message ? err.message : String(err);

    // Function installRecommended... menampilkan alert pada bagian akhir.
    // Bila semua trigger sudah dibuat tetapi alert tidak tersedia, abaikan error UI saja.
    if (errorText.indexOf('Cannot call SpreadsheetApp.getUi() from this context') === -1) {
      throw err;
    }
    console.log('Installer selesai; alert UI dilewati karena konteks non-UI.');
  }

  var message =
    'Rolling Sales Center berhasil diinstall.\n\n' +
    'Menu akan muncul setelah Google Sheet direload.\n' +
    'Auto validasi link kolom D disiapkan. Hourly Standard V28.3 dipasang dari menu Hourly Validation — Setup.';

  try {
    spreadsheet.toast(message, 'Rolling Sales Center', 10);
  } catch (ignoreToast) {}

  try {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(message);
  } catch (ignoreUi) {
    console.log(message);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
 * SHARED ENGINE — START
 * ========================================================== */



function startCompileApprovedLinksToTargetInBackground_(keys) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const masterSh = ss.getSheetByName(P.masterSheetName);
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();

  if (!masterSh) {
    throw new Error('Sheet master "' + P.masterSheetName + '" tidak ditemukan.');
  }

  rscCompileGuardStartAgainstRecentJob_(props);
  rscCompileClearFinalizeCommitMarkersV12_();

  const selectedConfigs = rscCompileGetConfigsByKeys_(keys);
  if (!selectedConfigs.length) {
    throw new Error('Tidak ada config compile yang valid untuk keys: ' + keys.join(', '));
  }

  const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);

  // V10: release legacy target STAGING capacity before bootstrap/output work.
  if (P.targetStagingCleanupBeforeStart) {
    rscCompileCleanseTargetStagingSheetsV10_(
      targetSs, null, null, 'RUN_START_PREPARE'
    );
  }

  const legacySupportSpreadsheetId = String(
    props.getProperty(P.pSupportSpreadsheetId) || ''
  );

  const keySs = rscCompileGetOrCreateSupportSpreadsheet_(ss, targetSs);
  rscCompileMigrateLegacyMetaToSupport_(
    targetSs, keySs, props, legacySupportSpreadsheetId
  );

  const runId = rscCompileBuildRunId_();
  rscCompilePrepareDetailLogSheet_(targetSs);

  __RSC_COMPILE_REVAMP_DB_MAP_CACHE__ = null;
  __RSC_COMPILE_DETAIL_LOG_BUFFER__ = [];
  __RSC_COMPILE_DETAIL_LOG_TARGET_ID__ = '';

  // V11: bebaskan capacity key store SEBELUM membaca/migrasi existing key.
  // Target-key/staging lama akan dibangun ulang sebagai one-column gzip blobs.
  rscCompileDeleteLegacyStageSheetsV9_(keySs);
  rscCompileDeleteAllTargetKeySheetsV9_(keySs);

  // Existing key dibaca dari fixed key store. V11 otomatis memigrasikan
  // format lama 8 kolom menjadi packed hash/blob satu kolom.
  const existingSnapshot = rscCompileSnapshotExistingKeysAtStart_(
    targetSs, keySs, selectedConfigs, runId
  );

  rscCompileTrimManagedOutputSheets_(targetSs, selectedConfigs);
  rscCompileTrimSupportSheets_(keySs);

  const manifestInfo = rscCompileBuildMasterLinkManifest_(ss, masterSh);

  const stats = {
    runId: runId,
    startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    finishedAt: '',
    targetSpreadsheetId: P.targetSpreadsheetId,
    supportSpreadsheetId: keySs.getId(),
    keySpreadsheetId: keySs.getId(),
    keySchemaVersion: P.keyStoreSchemaVersion,
    masterSheetName: P.masterSheetName,
    masterLinkCol: P.masterLinkCol,
    mode: selectedConfigs.map(function (cfg) { return cfg.key; }).join(','),
    syncMode: 'CONFIG_MAJOR_HASH_BLOB_KEY_UPSERT_PURGE_SERIALIZED_V12',
    phase: 'STAGE_CONFIG',
    configIndex: 0,
    linkIndex: 0,
    manifestLinkCount: manifestInfo.manifest.length,
    manifestDuplicateLinkRows: manifestInfo.duplicateRows.length,
    manifestInvalidNonBlankRows: manifestInfo.invalidRows.length,
    manifestBlankRowsIgnored: manifestInfo.blankRows,
    manifestScanLastRow: manifestInfo.scanLastRow,
    configs: {}
  };

  selectedConfigs.forEach(function (cfg) {
    const snap = existingSnapshot[cfg.key] || {};
    stats.configs[cfg.key] = {
      label: cfg.menuLabel,
      linksTotal: manifestInfo.manifest.length,
      linksProcessed: 0,
      filesOk: 0,
      skipped: 0,
      blankRows: manifestInfo.blankRows,
      errors: 0,
      sourceRows: 0,
      stagedRows: 0,
      outputRows: 0,
      inserted: 0,
      updated: 0,
      deleted: 0,
      unchanged: 0,
      duplicateKeysCollapsed: 0,
      headerWritten: false,
      firstError: '',
      existingKeyCountAtStart: Number(snap.existingKeyCount || 0),
      existingOutputRowsReadAtStart: Number(snap.outputRowsRead || 0),
      existingDuplicateBusinessKeysAtStart: Number(snap.duplicateBusinessKeysFound || 0),
      existingKeySnapshotHash: String(snap.existingKeySnapshotHash || ''),
      existingKeySourceAtStart: String(snap.existingKeySource || 'FIXED_KEY_STORE'),
      existingKeySchemaRebuiltAtStart: !!snap.schemaMismatchRebuilt,
      lastCommittedBusinessKey: '',
      lastCommittedStageRow: 0
    };
  });

  const stagingRowByKey = {};
  const headerWrittenByKey = {};
  const outputColCountByKey = {};
  const lastCommittedBusinessKeyByConfig = {};
  const lastCommittedStageRowByConfig = {};
  const lastCommittedSourceOrderByConfig = {};
  const stageInitializedByKey = {};

  selectedConfigs.forEach(function (cfg) {
    stagingRowByKey[cfg.key] = 1;
    headerWrittenByKey[cfg.key] = false;
    outputColCountByKey[cfg.key] = 0;
    lastCommittedBusinessKeyByConfig[cfg.key] = '';
    lastCommittedStageRowByConfig[cfg.key] = 0;
    lastCommittedSourceOrderByConfig[cfg.key] = '';
    stageInitializedByKey[cfg.key] = false;
  });

  const job = {
    jobVersion: 7,
    iterationMode: 'CONFIG_MAJOR_BUSINESS_KEY_V9',
    keyMode: 'BUSINESS_KEY',
    keySchemaVersion: P.keyStoreSchemaVersion,
    masterSpreadsheetId: ss.getId(),
    masterSheetId: masterSh.getSheetId(),
    supportSpreadsheetId: keySs.getId(),
    keySpreadsheetId: keySs.getId(),
    linkIndex: 0,
    masterLinkManifest: manifestInfo.manifest,
    manifestLinkCount: manifestInfo.manifest.length,
    manifestScanLastRow: manifestInfo.scanLastRow,
    configKeys: selectedConfigs.map(function (cfg) { return cfg.key; }),
    configIndex: 0,
    finalizeIndex: 0,
    runId: runId,
    phase: 'STAGE_CONFIG',
    runChunks: 0,
    globalErrorCount: 0,
    lastHeartbeatAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    nextTriggerAtApprox: '',
    nextTriggerReason: '',
    stagingRowByKey: stagingRowByKey,
    headerWrittenByKey: headerWrittenByKey,
    outputColCountByKey: outputColCountByKey,
    lastCommittedBusinessKeyByConfig: lastCommittedBusinessKeyByConfig,
    lastCommittedStageRowByConfig: lastCommittedStageRowByConfig,
    lastCommittedSourceOrderByConfig: lastCommittedSourceOrderByConfig,
    stageInitializedByKey: stageInitializedByKey,
    currentStageProgress: null,
    lastCompletedStageToken: '',
    lastCompletedStageStatsToken: '',
    existingSnapshot: existingSnapshot,
    stats: stats
  };

  props.setProperty(P.pJob, JSON.stringify(job));
  props.setProperty(P.pLastStats, JSON.stringify(stats));
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);

  rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'RUN_START', null, {
    targetSs: targetSs,
    status: 'STARTED',
    message: 'Compile V12 dimulai. Serialized checkpoint + duplicate-finalize guard aktif; target STAGING cleanse aktif; fixed key store=' +
      keySs.getId() + ', key schema=' + P.keyStoreSchemaVersion +
      ', mode=' + job.configKeys.join(', ') +
      '. Satu config akan stage+finalize sebelum config berikutnya.'
  });

  rscCompileApplyManifestMarkersAndLog_(masterSh, targetSs, job, manifestInfo);

  selectedConfigs.forEach(function (cfg) {
    const snap = existingSnapshot[cfg.key] || {};
    rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'CONFIG_INIT', cfg, {
      targetSs: targetSs,
      status: 'READY',
      message: 'Existing keys at start=' + Number(snap.existingKeyCount || 0) +
        ', source=' + String(snap.existingKeySource || '-') +
        ', compact target key snapshot akan ditulis ke ' +
        rscCompileGetStagingSheetName_(cfg)
    });
  });

  if (!manifestInfo.manifest.length) {
