    rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'WARN', 'MANIFEST_EMPTY', null, {
      targetSs: targetSs,
      status: 'NO_ACTIVE_LINKS',
      message: 'Tidak ada link aktif. Setiap config tetap difinalize untuk PURGE.'
    });
  }

  rscCompileFlushDetailLogBuffer_(targetSs);
  continueCompileApprovedLinksToTargetInBackground();

  try {
    ss.toast(
      'Compile V10 dimulai. Config-major + target STAGING cleanse, active links=' +
      manifestInfo.manifest.length + ', key store=' + keySs.getId(),
      'Rolling Sales Center',
      10
    );
  } catch (err) {}
}


/* ============================================================
 * SHARED ENGINE — CONTINUE (STAGE loop, one manifest for all configs)
 * ========================================================== */



function continueCompileApprovedLinksToTargetInBackground() {
  const started = Date.now();
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();

  // V12: acquire lock BEFORE reading the checkpoint. A lock-busy execution
  // must never persist its stale in-memory job over newer progress.
  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(1000)) {
    rscCompileScheduleLockBusyWithoutCheckpointV12_();
    return;
  }

  const raw = props.getProperty(P.pJob);

  if (!raw) {
    try {
      SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
        'Tidak ada job Compile Approved Links yang sedang berjalan.',
        'Rolling Sales Center',
        6
      );
    } catch (err) {}
    deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (ignoreLock) {}
    return;
  }

  let job = null;
  try {
    job = JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch (parseErr) {
    deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (ignoreLock) {}
    throw new Error(
      'Job Compile Approved Links corrupt. STOP lalu Start ulang. Detail: ' +
      formatScriptError_(parseErr)
    );
  }

  if (
    job.iterationMode !== 'CONFIG_MAJOR_BUSINESS_KEY_V9' ||
    Number(job.jobVersion || 0) < 5 ||
    String(job.keySpreadsheetId || job.supportSpreadsheetId || '') !== String(P.keySpreadsheetId || '')
  ) {
    deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (ignoreLock) {}
    throw new Error(
      'Checkpoint berasal dari engine V8/lebih lama. Jalankan STOP Compile Approved Links, ' +
      'hapus checkpoint melalui STOP, lalu Start ulang agar memakai capacity-safe V9/V10.'
    );
  }

  // V10 can recover the current V9 permanent-capacity checkpoint without
  // discarding completed stage rows. The pre-finalize cleanse will release
  // target workbook capacity before output growth.
  if (String(job.phase || '').indexOf('BLOCKED_PERMANENT_CAPACITY') === 0) {
    const manifestLength = (job.masterLinkManifest || []).length;
    job.phase = Number(job.linkIndex || 0) >= manifestLength
      ? 'FINALIZE_CONFIG'
      : 'STAGE_CONFIG';
    job.globalErrorCount = 0;
    job.lastError = '';
    job.nextTriggerReason = 'MANUAL_RESUME_AFTER_TARGET_STAGING_CLEANSE';
    if (job.stats) {
      job.stats.phase = job.phase;
      job.stats.globalErrorCount = 0;
      job.stats.lastError = '';
      job.stats.nextTriggerReason = job.nextTriggerReason;
    }
    rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
  }

  let targetSs = null;
  let keySs = null;

  try {
    if (!job.phase) job.phase = 'STAGE_CONFIG';
    if (!job.masterLinkManifest) job.masterLinkManifest = [];
    if (job.linkIndex == null) job.linkIndex = 0;
    if (job.configIndex == null) job.configIndex = 0;
    if (!job.stageInitializedByKey) job.stageInitializedByKey = {};

    job.runChunks = Number(job.runChunks || 0) + 1;
    job.lastHeartbeatAt = new Date().toISOString();

    if (job.stats) {
      job.stats.phase = job.phase;
      job.stats.configIndex = job.configIndex;
      job.stats.linkIndex = job.linkIndex;
      job.stats.runChunks = job.runChunks;
      job.stats.lastHeartbeatAt = job.lastHeartbeatAt;
    }

    rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
    rscCompileScheduleWatchdogContinuation_(job, 'WATCHDOG_RUN_' + job.runChunks);

    const masterSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(job.masterSpreadsheetId);
    const masterSh = rscCompileGetSheetById_(masterSs, job.masterSheetId) ||
      masterSs.getSheetByName(P.masterSheetName);
    if (!masterSh) {
      throw new Error('Sheet master tidak ditemukan lagi: ' + P.masterSheetName);
    }

    targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
    keySs = rscCompileOpenSupportSpreadsheetForJob_(job, targetSs);

    const manifest = job.masterLinkManifest || [];
    let workbooksCompletedThisRun = 0;

    while (job.configIndex < job.configKeys.length) {
      const cfg = rscCompileGetConfigByKey_(job.configKeys[job.configIndex]);
      if (!cfg) {
        job.configIndex++;
        job.linkIndex = 0;
        job.phase = 'STAGE_CONFIG';
        rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
        continue;
      }

      if (job.phase === 'CLEANSE_TARGET_STAGING') {
        const cleanupResult = rscCompileCleanseTargetStagingSheetsV10_(
          targetSs, job, cfg, 'POST_FINALIZE_COMMIT'
        );

        rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'TARGET_STAGING_CLEANSE', cfg, {
          targetSs: targetSs,
          status: 'POST_FINALIZE_CLEANSED',
          message: 'Output + existing key sudah committed. Target STAGING cleanup: deleted=' +
            cleanupResult.deleted + ', cleared=' + cleanupResult.cleared +
            ', skipped=' + cleanupResult.skipped +
            ', estimatedCellsReleased=' + cleanupResult.estimatedCellsReleased +
            ', sheets=' + (cleanupResult.sheetNames.join(', ') || '-')
        });

        if (job.stats) {
          job.stats.targetStagingLastCleanupAt = new Date().toISOString();
          job.stats.targetStagingLastCleanupReason = 'POST_FINALIZE_COMMIT';
          job.stats.targetStagingSheetsDeleted =
            Number(job.stats.targetStagingSheetsDeleted || 0) +
            Number(cleanupResult.deleted || 0);
          job.stats.targetStagingSheetsCleared =
            Number(job.stats.targetStagingSheetsCleared || 0) +
            Number(cleanupResult.cleared || 0);
          job.stats.targetStagingEstimatedCellsReleased =
            Number(job.stats.targetStagingEstimatedCellsReleased || 0) +
            Number(cleanupResult.estimatedCellsReleased || 0);
        }

        job.configIndex++;
        job.finalizeIndex = job.configIndex;
        job.linkIndex = 0;
        job.phase = 'STAGE_CONFIG';
        job.currentStageProgress = null;
        job.lastCompletedStageToken = '';
        job.lastCompletedStageStatsToken = '';
        job.pendingFinalizedConfigKey = '';
        job.pendingFinalizeCommittedAt = '';

        if (job.stats) {
          job.stats.phase = job.phase;
          job.stats.configIndex = job.configIndex;
          job.stats.linkIndex = 0;
          job.stats.finalizeIndex = job.finalizeIndex;
        }

        rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);

        if (job.configIndex < job.configKeys.length &&
            Date.now() - started > P.softDeadlineMs - 30000) {
          rscCompileScheduleContinuation_(job, 'NEXT_CONFIG_' + job.configIndex);
          return;
        }
        continue;
      }

      if (job.phase === 'FINALIZE_CONFIG') {
        if (Date.now() - started > P.softDeadlineMs) {
          rscCompileScheduleContinuation_(job, 'FINALIZE_CONFIG_PAUSE_' + cfg.key);
          return;
        }

        // V12: durable idempotency guard. Check both a compact property marker
        // and the persisted detail log. This protects against stale checkpoint
        // rollback caused by overlapping watchdog/continuation triggers.
        const priorCommitV12 = rscCompileGetFinalizeCommitMarkerV12_(
          targetSs, job, cfg
        );
        if (priorCommitV12) {
          job.pendingFinalizedConfigKey = cfg.key;
          job.pendingFinalizeCommittedAt =
            String(priorCommitV12.committedAt || new Date().toISOString());
          job.phase = 'CLEANSE_TARGET_STAGING';

          if (job.stats) {
            job.stats.phase = job.phase;
            job.stats.pendingFinalizedConfigKey = cfg.key;
            job.stats.pendingFinalizeCommittedAt =
              job.pendingFinalizeCommittedAt;
          }

          rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
          rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'WARN', 'FINALIZE_DUPLICATE_SKIPPED_V12', cfg, {
            targetSs: targetSs,
            outputRows: Number(priorCommitV12.outputRows || 0),
            status: 'ALREADY_COMMITTED',
            message: 'Finalize tidak dijalankan ulang. Commit sebelumnya ditemukan untuk run/config yang sama. source=' +
              String(priorCommitV12.source || 'MARKER')
          });
          continue;
        }

        // V10/V12: release target workbook capacity before adding/growing output.
        let preCleanupResult = {
          deleted: 0,
          cleared: 0,
          skipped: 0,
          estimatedCellsReleased: 0,
          sheetNames: []
        };

        if (P.targetStagingCleanupBeforeFinalize) {
          preCleanupResult = rscCompileCleanseTargetStagingSheetsV10_(
            targetSs, job, cfg, 'PRE_FINALIZE_CAPACITY_RELEASE'
          );

          if (preCleanupResult.deleted || preCleanupResult.cleared) {
            rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'TARGET_STAGING_PRE_CLEANSE', cfg, {
              targetSs: targetSs,
              status: 'CAPACITY_RELEASED',
              message: 'Sebelum finalize, target STAGING dibersihkan. deleted=' +
                preCleanupResult.deleted + ', cleared=' + preCleanupResult.cleared +
                ', estimatedCellsReleased=' +
                preCleanupResult.estimatedCellsReleased +
                ', sheets=' + (preCleanupResult.sheetNames.join(', ') || '-')
            });
          }
        }

        const syncResult = rscCompileSyncOneConfigFromStage_(
          targetSs, keySs, cfg, job
        );

        rscCompileSetFinalizeStatsV12_(job, cfg.key, syncResult);

        if (job.stats && job.stats.configs && job.stats.configs[cfg.key]) {
          job.stats.configs[cfg.key].existingKeysReadAtFinalize =
            Number(syncResult.existingKeysRead || 0);
          job.stats.configs[cfg.key].targetKeysWritten =
            Number(syncResult.targetKeysWritten || 0);
        }

        // Write the durable commit marker immediately after output + key commit.
        // If execution crashes before phase checkpoint, the next trigger will
        // detect this marker and skip duplicate finalize.
        rscCompileWriteFinalizeCommitMarkerV12_(job, cfg, syncResult);

        rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'FINALIZE_OK', cfg, {
          targetSs: targetSs,
          outputRows: syncResult.outputRows,
          inserted: syncResult.inserted,
          updated: syncResult.updated,
          deleted: syncResult.deleted,
          unchanged: syncResult.unchanged,
          duplicateKeysCollapsed: syncResult.duplicateKeysCollapsed,
          status: 'UPSERT_PURGE_SYNCED_V12',
          message: 'Config output dan key selesai committed dengan serialized checkpoint V12. Selanjutnya fase CLEANSE_TARGET_STAGING dijalankan sebelum config berikutnya.'
        });

        job.pendingFinalizedConfigKey = cfg.key;
        job.pendingFinalizeCommittedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        job.phase = 'CLEANSE_TARGET_STAGING';

        if (job.stats) {
          job.stats.phase = job.phase;
          job.stats.pendingFinalizedConfigKey = cfg.key;
          job.stats.pendingFinalizeCommittedAt = job.pendingFinalizeCommittedAt;
        }

        rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
        continue;
      }

      rscCompilePrepareStageForCurrentConfigV9_(keySs, cfg, job);

      while (job.linkIndex < manifest.length) {
        const entry = manifest[job.linkIndex] || {};
        const masterRow = Number(entry.row || 0);
        const fileId = String(entry.fileId || '');

        if (
          Date.now() - started > P.softDeadlineMs ||
          workbooksCompletedThisRun >= P.hardMaxFilesPerRun
        ) {
          rscCompileScheduleContinuation_(
            job,
            'STAGE_CONFIG_PAUSE_' + cfg.key + '_LINK_' + job.linkIndex
          );
          rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'STAGE_PAUSE', cfg, {
            targetSs: targetSs,
            masterRow: masterRow,
            sourceFileId: fileId,
            status: 'PAUSED',
            message: 'Config-major checkpoint: config=' + cfg.key +
              ', linkIndex=' + job.linkIndex +
              ', lastBusinessKey=' +
              String(job.lastCommittedBusinessKeyByConfig &&
                job.lastCommittedBusinessKeyByConfig[cfg.key] || '-')
          });
          return;
        }

        if (!fileId) {
          job.linkIndex++;
          job.currentStageProgress = null;
          job.lastCompletedStageToken = '';
          job.lastCompletedStageStatsToken = '';
          rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
          continue;
        }

        let sourceSs = null;
        try {
          sourceSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(fileId);
        } catch (openErr) {
          rscCompileHandleSourceWorkbookOpenError_(
            job, targetSs, masterSh, entry, openErr
          );
          job.linkIndex++;
          workbooksCompletedThisRun++;
          job.currentStageProgress = null;
          job.lastCompletedStageToken = '';
          job.lastCompletedStageStatsToken = '';
          rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
          continue;
        }

        const processResult = rscCompileProcessOneSourceConfig_(
          job, targetSs, keySs, masterSh, sourceSs, cfg, entry, started
        ) || { completed: true };

        if (processResult.paused || processResult.completed === false) {
          return;
        }

        job.linkIndex++;
        workbooksCompletedThisRun++;
        job.currentStageProgress = null;
        job.lastCompletedStageToken = '';
        job.lastCompletedStageStatsToken = '';

        if (job.stats) {
          job.stats.phase = 'STAGE_CONFIG';
          job.stats.configIndex = job.configIndex;
          job.stats.linkIndex = job.linkIndex;
        }
        rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
      }

      rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'CONFIG_STAGE_DONE', cfg, {
        targetSs: targetSs,
        status: 'STAGE_DONE',
        message: 'Semua link untuk config ' + cfg.key +
          ' selesai. Finalize config dilakukan sebelum config berikutnya.'
      });

      job.phase = 'FINALIZE_CONFIG';
      job.finalizeIndex = job.configIndex;
      if (job.stats) job.stats.phase = job.phase;
      rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
    }

    finishCompileApprovedLinksJob_(
      job,
      buildCompileApprovedLinksFinishMessage_(job)
    );

  } catch (err) {
    const errText = formatScriptError_(err);
    const permanent = rscCompileIsPermanentCapacityErrorV9_(errText);

    try {
      job.globalErrorCount = Number(job.globalErrorCount || 0) + 1;
      job.lastErrorAt = new Date().toISOString();
      job.lastError = errText;
      job.phase = permanent ? 'BLOCKED_PERMANENT_CAPACITY' : (job.phase || 'STAGE_CONFIG');

      if (job.stats) {
        job.stats.lastErrorAt = job.lastErrorAt;
        job.stats.lastError = errText;
        job.stats.globalErrorCount = job.globalErrorCount;
        job.stats.phase = job.phase;
      }

      rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);

      const targetSsForLog = targetSs || RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
      rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(
        job,
        'ERROR',
        permanent ? 'PERMANENT_CAPACITY_STOP' : 'GLOBAL_ERROR_RETRY',
        null,
        {
          targetSs: targetSsForLog,
          status: permanent ? 'BLOCKED_PERMANENT' : 'GLOBAL_ERROR',
          message: 'Global error count=' + job.globalErrorCount +
            '. config=' + String(job.configKeys[job.configIndex] || '-') +
            ', link=' + String(job.linkIndex || 0) +
            '. ' + errText
        }
      );
    } catch (safeErr) {}

    if (permanent) {
      deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);
      rscCompileToast_(
        'Compile dihentikan karena limit kapasitas/permanent error. Tidak ada retry loop. ' +
        errText.slice(0, 220)
      );
      return;
    }

    if (Number(job.globalErrorCount || 0) <= Number(P.maxGlobalErrorRetries || 5)) {
      rscCompileScheduleContinuation_(job, 'GLOBAL_ERROR_RETRY');
      rscCompileToast_(
        'Compile kena error sementara dan akan continue dari checkpoint. Error: ' +
        errText.slice(0, 200)
      );
      return;
    }

    deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);
    if (job) {
      job.phase = 'STOPPED_GLOBAL_ERROR_LIMIT';
      if (job.stats) job.stats.phase = job.phase;
      rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
    }
    rscCompileToast_(
      'Compile STOP karena error global berulang. Cek detail log. Error: ' +
      errText.slice(0, 200)
    );

  } finally {
    try {
      if (targetSs) rscCompileFlushDetailLogBuffer_(targetSs);
      else rscCompileFlushDetailLogBuffer_();
    } catch (flushErr) {}
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (err) {}
  }
}


function rscCompileProcessOneSourceConfig_(job, targetSs, keySs, masterSh, sourceSs, cfg, entry, started) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const masterRow = Number(entry.row || 0);
  const fileId = String(entry.fileId || '');
  const token = [
    String(job.linkIndex || 0),
    String(job.configIndex || 0),
    String(cfg.key || ''),
    String(fileId || '')
  ].join('|');

  try {
    const sourceSh = rscCompileGetSourceSheet_(sourceSs, cfg);

    if (!sourceSh) {
      rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'skipped', 1);
      masterSh.getRange(masterRow, P.masterLinkCol)
        .setBackground(P.colorSkip)
        .setNote('SKIP compile/sync ' + cfg.menuLabel + ': sheet source tidak ditemukan.');
      rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'WARN', 'STAGE_SKIP', cfg, {
        targetSs: targetSs,
        masterRow: masterRow,
        sourceFileId: fileId,
        sourceSpreadsheetName: sourceSs.getName(),
        status: 'SOURCE_SHEET_NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Sheet source tidak ditemukan. Expected=' + cfg.sourceSheetName +
          ', available=' + sourceSs.getSheets().map(function (sh) { return sh.getName(); }).join(' | ')
      });
      return { completed: true, skipped: true };
    }

    let sourceData = rscCompileReadSourceSheet_(sourceSh, P.sourceHeaderScanRows, cfg);

    if (!sourceData || !sourceData.header.length) {
      rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'skipped', 1);
      masterSh.getRange(masterRow, P.masterLinkCol)
        .setBackground(P.colorSkip)
        .setNote('SKIP compile/sync ' + cfg.menuLabel + ': source kosong/header tidak ditemukan.');
      rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'WARN', 'STAGE_SKIP', cfg, {
        targetSs: targetSs,
        masterRow: masterRow,
        sourceFileId: fileId,
        sourceSpreadsheetName: sourceSs.getName(),
        sourceSheetName: sourceSh.getName(),
        headerRow: sourceData ? sourceData.headerRow : '',
        headerDetectMode: sourceData ? sourceData.headerDetectMode : '',
        status: 'HEADER_OR_DATA_NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Source kosong atau header (row ' + (cfg.sourceHeaderRowFixed || 1) +
          ') tidak ditemukan. lastRow=' + sourceSh.getLastRow() +
          ', lastCol=' + sourceSh.getLastColumn()
      });
      return { completed: true, skipped: true };
    }

    if (cfg.enrichWithSalesCustView) {
      sourceData = rscCompileEnrichRevampSourceData_(
        sourceData,
        entry.slsOfficeRekap
      );
    }

    const stageResult = rscCompileStageSourceData_(
      keySs, cfg, sourceData, fileId, job, started
    );

    if (stageResult.paused) {
      rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'STAGE_KEY_PAUSE', cfg, {
        targetSs: targetSs,
        masterRow: masterRow,
        sourceFileId: fileId,
        sourceSpreadsheetName: sourceSs.getName(),
        sourceSheetName: sourceSh.getName(),
        stagedRows: stageResult.rowsStaged,
        status: 'PAUSED',
        message: 'Stage pause pada business key terakhir=' +
          String(stageResult.lastBusinessKey || '-') +
          ', nextSourceOffset=' + String(stageResult.nextSourceOffset || 0) +
          '. Continue akan membaca checkpoint key store.'
      });
      return { completed: false, paused: true };
    }

    // Statistik completion juga dibuat idempotent. Jika execution putus
    // setelah stage committed tetapi sebelum configIndex naik, resume tidak
    // menggandakan statistik dan tidak kehilangan count.
    if (String(job.lastCompletedStageStatsToken || '') !== token) {
      rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'filesOk', 1);
      rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'sourceRows', sourceData.dataRows.length);
      if (job.stats && job.stats.configs && job.stats.configs[cfg.key]) {
        job.stats.configs[cfg.key].linksProcessed =
          Number(job.stats.configs[cfg.key].linksProcessed || 0) + 1;
        if (stageResult.headerWritten) {
          job.stats.configs[cfg.key].headerWritten = true;
        }
      }
      job.lastCompletedStageStatsToken = token;
      rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);

      rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'STAGE_OK', cfg, {
        targetSs: targetSs,
        masterRow: masterRow,
        sourceFileId: fileId,
        sourceSpreadsheetName: sourceSs.getName(),
        sourceSheetName: sourceSh.getName(),
        headerRow: sourceData.headerRow || '',
        headerDetectMode: sourceData.headerDetectMode || '',
        sourceRows: sourceData.dataRows.length,
        stagedRows: stageResult.rowsStaged,
        status: 'STAGED',
        message: 'Target business keys staged ke fixed key spreadsheet. Manifest link ' +
          (job.linkIndex + 1) + '/' + (job.masterLinkManifest || []).length +
          '. lastBusinessKey=' + String(stageResult.lastBusinessKey || '-')
      });
    }

    masterSh.getRange(masterRow, P.masterLinkCol)
      .setBackground(P.colorOk)
      .setNote(
        'OK stage compile/sync ' + cfg.menuLabel +
        '. Link ' + (job.linkIndex + 1) + '/' + (job.masterLinkManifest || []).length +
        ', Header row=' + (sourceData.headerRow || '-') +
        ', data rows=' + sourceData.dataRows.length +
        ', key mode=BUSINESS KEY, key store=' + P.keySpreadsheetId +
        ', last key=' + String(stageResult.lastBusinessKey || '-')
      );

    return { completed: true, token: token };

  } catch (err) {
    const errText = formatScriptError_(err);
    if (rscCompileIsPermanentCapacityErrorV9_(errText)) {
      throw err;
    }

    rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'errors', 1);
    if (job.stats && job.stats.configs && job.stats.configs[cfg.key] &&
        !job.stats.configs[cfg.key].firstError) {
      job.stats.configs[cfg.key].firstError =
        'Master row ' + masterRow + ': ' + formatScriptError_(err);
    }

    masterSh.getRange(masterRow, P.masterLinkCol)
      .setBackground(P.colorError)
      .setNote('ERROR compile/sync ' + cfg.menuLabel + ': ' + formatScriptError_(err));

    rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'ERROR', 'STAGE_ERROR', cfg, {
      targetSs: targetSs,
      masterRow: masterRow,
      sourceFileId: fileId,
      status: 'ERROR',
      message: formatScriptError_(err)
    });

    writeRollingSalesCenterLog_(
      'Compile Approved Links error. Sheet=' + cfg.menuLabel +
      ', master row=' + masterRow +
      ', error=' + formatScriptError_(err)
    );

    // Error source config dianggap selesai oleh loop caller agar job tidak
    // stuck. Tidak menandai stage committed karena tidak ada target key sukses.
    rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
    return { completed: true, error: true };
  }
}



function rscCompileHandleSourceWorkbookOpenError_(job, targetSs, masterSh, entry, err) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const masterRow = Number(entry.row || 0);
  const fileId = String(entry.fileId || '');
  const errText = formatScriptError_(err);
  const cfg = rscCompileGetConfigByKey_(
    job.configKeys[Number(job.configIndex || 0)]
  );

  if (cfg) {
    rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'errors', 1);
    if (job.stats && job.stats.configs && job.stats.configs[cfg.key] &&
        !job.stats.configs[cfg.key].firstError) {
      job.stats.configs[cfg.key].firstError =
        'Master row ' + masterRow + ': gagal membuka workbook: ' + errText;
    }
    rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'ERROR', 'SOURCE_WORKBOOK_OPEN_ERROR', cfg, {
      targetSs: targetSs,
      masterRow: masterRow,
      sourceFileId: fileId,
      status: 'WORKBOOK_OPEN_ERROR',
      message: errText
    });
  }

  try {
    masterSh.getRange(masterRow, P.masterLinkCol)
      .setBackground(P.colorError)
      .setNote('ERROR membuka source workbook untuk compile ' +
        (cfg ? cfg.menuLabel : '') + ': ' + errText);
  } catch (noteErr) {}
}


/* ============================================================
 * MASTER LINK MANIFEST (frozen daftar link aktif, dipakai semua config)
 * ========================================================== */

function rscCompileBuildMasterLinkManifest_(masterSs, masterSh) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const firstDataRow = rscCompileResolveMasterFirstDataRow_(masterSh);
  const maxRows = masterSh.getMaxRows();
  const logicalLastRow = Math.max(masterSh.getLastRow(), firstDataRow);
  const scanLastRow = Math.min(maxRows, Math.max(logicalLastRow, Number(P.masterScanMinRows || 5000)));
  const rowCount = Math.max(0, scanLastRow - firstDataRow + 1);

  const manifest = [];
  const seenFileIds = {};
  const duplicateRows = [];
  const invalidRows = [];
  let blankRows = 0;

  if (rowCount <= 0) {
    return {
      firstDataRow: firstDataRow, scanLastRow: scanLastRow,
      manifest: manifest, duplicateRows: duplicateRows, invalidRows: invalidRows, blankRows: blankRows
    };
  }

  const range = masterSh.getRange(firstDataRow, P.masterLinkCol, rowCount, 1);
  const displayValues = range.getDisplayValues();
  const values = range.getValues();
  const formulas = range.getFormulas();
  const richTexts = range.getRichTextValues();

  // Ambil Sales Office Rekap dari kolom A pada baris master yang sama.
  // Nilai ini dibekukan ke manifest agar tetap konsisten selama job berjalan.
  const salesOfficeRekapValues = masterSh
    .getRange(firstDataRow, Number(P.masterSalesOfficeRekapCol || 1), rowCount, 1)
    .getDisplayValues();

  let chipMap = {};
  try {
    chipMap = rscCompileGetSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRangeRobust_(
      masterSs.getId(), masterSh.getName(), firstDataRow, P.masterLinkCol, rowCount
    ) || {};
  } catch (err) { chipMap = {}; }

  try {
    if (typeof getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_ === 'function') {
      const oldMap = getSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRange_(masterSs.getId(), masterSh.getName(), firstDataRow, P.masterLinkCol, rowCount) || {};
      Object.keys(oldMap).forEach(function (r) { if (!chipMap[r]) chipMap[r] = oldMap[r]; });
    }
  } catch (err) {}

  for (let i = 0; i < rowCount; i++) {
    const rowNo = firstDataRow + i;
    const slsOfficeRekap = rscCompileNormalizeCellValue_(
      salesOfficeRekapValues[i] ? salesOfficeRekapValues[i][0] : ''
    );
    const cellObj = {
      displayValue: displayValues[i][0],
      value: values[i][0],
      formula: formulas[i][0],
      richTextValue: richTexts[i][0]
    };
    const rawText = rscCompileGetMasterLinkCellText_(cellObj);
    const candidates = [
      getSpreadsheetUrlFromCellObject_(cellObj),
      chipMap[rowNo] || '',
      formulas[i][0],
      values[i][0],
      displayValues[i][0]
    ];

    let fileId = '';
    for (let c = 0; c < candidates.length; c++) {
      fileId = rscCompileExtractSpreadsheetId_(candidates[c]);
      if (fileId) break;
    }

    if (!fileId) {
      if (rscCompileIsBlankMasterLinkRow_(rawText, '', chipMap[rowNo] || '')) {
        blankRows++;
      } else {
        invalidRows.push({ row: rowNo, rawText: String(rawText || '').slice(0, 300) });
      }
      continue;
    }

    if (seenFileIds[fileId]) {
      duplicateRows.push({ row: rowNo, fileId: fileId, firstRow: seenFileIds[fileId] });
      continue;
    }

    seenFileIds[fileId] = rowNo;
    manifest.push({
      row: rowNo,
      fileId: fileId,
      slsOfficeRekap: slsOfficeRekap
    });
  }

  return {
    firstDataRow: firstDataRow, scanLastRow: scanLastRow,
    manifest: manifest, duplicateRows: duplicateRows, invalidRows: invalidRows, blankRows: blankRows
  };
}


function rscCompileApplyManifestMarkersAndLog_(masterSh, targetSs, job, manifestInfo) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'MANIFEST_SUMMARY', null, {
    targetSs: targetSs,
    status: 'MANIFEST_READY',
    message: 'Master link manifest dibuat dari ' + P.masterSheetName + '!E' + manifestInfo.firstDataRow + ':E' + manifestInfo.scanLastRow +
      '. Unique active links=' + manifestInfo.manifest.length +
      ', duplicate same-file links ignored=' + manifestInfo.duplicateRows.length +
      ', invalid nonblank=' + manifestInfo.invalidRows.length +
      ', blank rows ignored=' + manifestInfo.blankRows +
      '. Semua config akan memproses manifest link yang sama sampai habis.'
  });

  (manifestInfo.invalidRows || []).slice(0, 500).forEach(function (item) {
    try {
      masterSh.getRange(item.row, P.masterLinkCol)
        .setBackground(P.colorSkip)
        .setNote('INVALID manifest compile: cell E berisi isi nonblank tapi bukan Google Spreadsheet link. Raw=' + item.rawText);
    } catch (err) {}
    rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'WARN', 'MANIFEST_INVALID_LINK', null, {
      targetSs: targetSs,
      masterRow: item.row,
      status: 'INVALID_LINK_NON_BLANK',
      message: 'Cell kolom E nonblank tapi bukan Google Spreadsheet link. Raw=' + item.rawText
    });
  });

  (manifestInfo.duplicateRows || []).slice(0, 500).forEach(function (item) {
    try {
      masterSh.getRange(item.row, P.masterLinkCol)
        .setBackground(P.colorSkip)
        .setNote('DUPLICATE manifest compile: file ID sama dengan row ' + item.firstRow + '. Diproses sekali saja agar tidak double compile.');
    } catch (err) {}
    rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'WARN', 'MANIFEST_DUPLICATE_LINK', null, {
      targetSs: targetSs,
      masterRow: item.row,
      sourceFileId: item.fileId,
      status: 'DUPLICATE_SOURCE_LINK_IGNORED',
      message: 'File ID sama dengan master row ' + item.firstRow + '. Link diproses sekali saja.'
    });
  });
}


/* ============================================================
 * SOURCE READ — header di baris tetap (default 1, REVAMP=2)
 * ========================================================== */


function rscCompileReadSourceSheet_(sourceSh, headerScanRows, cfg) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const lastRow = sourceSh.getLastRow();
  const physicalLastCol = sourceSh.getLastColumn();

  if (lastRow < 1 || physicalLastCol < 1) {
    return {
      header: [], dataRows: [], sourceRowNumbers: [],
      headerRow: 0, headerDetectMode: 'EMPTY', sourceSheetName: sourceSh.getName()
    };
  }

  // Capacity-safe: jangan membaca seluruh formatted grid. Template compile
  // hanya membutuhkan kolom sampai header efektif dan dibatasi maxSourceColumns.
  const readCols = Math.max(
    1,
    Math.min(Number(P.maxSourceColumns || 80), physicalLastCol)
  );
  const fixedHeaderRow = Math.max(1, Number((cfg && cfg.sourceHeaderRowFixed) || 1));
  const scanRowCount = Math.min(
    lastRow,
    Math.max(fixedHeaderRow, Number(headerScanRows || 80))
  );
  const headerGrid = sourceSh.getRange(1, 1, scanRowCount, readCols).getDisplayValues();

  let headerIdx = fixedHeaderRow - 1;
  let detectMode = 'FIXED_ROW_' + fixedHeaderRow;
  let rawHeader = (headerGrid[headerIdx] || []).map(function (v) {
    return rscCompileNormalizeCellValue_(v);
  });

  if (!rscCompileRowHasValue_(rawHeader)) {
    headerIdx = rscCompileFindSourceHeaderRowIndex_(headerGrid, cfg, headerScanRows);
    if (headerIdx < 0) {
      return {
        header: [], dataRows: [], sourceRowNumbers: [],
        headerRow: 0,
        headerDetectMode: 'FIXED_ROW_EMPTY_FALLBACK_NOT_FOUND',
        sourceSheetName: sourceSh.getName()
      };
    }
    detectMode = 'FALLBACK_ALIAS_DETECT';
    rawHeader = (headerGrid[headerIdx] || []).map(function (v) {
      return rscCompileNormalizeCellValue_(v);
    });
  }

  const headerWidth = Math.max(1, rscCompileLastNonEmptyIndex_(rawHeader) + 1);
  const header = rawHeader.slice(0, headerWidth);
  if (!rscCompileRowHasValue_(header)) {
    return {
      header: [], dataRows: [], sourceRowNumbers: [],
      headerRow: 0, headerDetectMode: 'HEADER_EMPTY',
      sourceSheetName: sourceSh.getName()
    };
  }

  const dataRows = [];
  const sourceRowNumbers = [];
  const dataStartRow = headerIdx + 2;
  const chunkRows = Math.max(200, Number(P.sourceReadChunkRows || 3000));

  for (let start = dataStartRow; start <= lastRow; start += chunkRows) {
    const n = Math.min(chunkRows, lastRow - start + 1);
    const values = sourceSh.getRange(start, 1, n, headerWidth).getDisplayValues();

    for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
      const row = (values[i] || []).map(function (v) {
        return rscCompileNormalizeCellValue_(v);
      });
      if (!rscCompileRowHasValue_(row)) continue;
      dataRows.push(rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(row, headerWidth));
      sourceRowNumbers.push(start + i);
    }
  }

  return {
    header: header,
    dataRows: dataRows,
    sourceRowNumbers: sourceRowNumbers,
    headerRow: headerIdx + 1,
    headerDetectMode: detectMode + '_CHUNKED_V9',
    sourceSheetName: sourceSh.getName(),
    physicalLastColumn: physicalLastCol,
    readColumnCount: headerWidth
  };
}


function rscCompileFindSourceHeaderRowIndex_(values, cfg, headerScanRows) {
  const scanLimit = Math.min(Math.max(Number(headerScanRows || 80), 30), values.length);
  const expectedGroups = rscCompileGetExpectedHeaderAliasGroups_(cfg);

  let bestIdx = -1;
  let bestScore = -1;

  for (let r = 0; r < scanLimit; r++) {
    const row = values[r] || [];
    if (!rscCompileRowHasValue_(row)) continue;

    const rowKeys = {};
    row.forEach(function (cell) {
      const k = rscCompileNormalizeHeaderKey_(cell);
      if (k) rowKeys[k] = true;
    });

    let score = 0;
    expectedGroups.forEach(function (group) {
      for (let i = 0; i < group.length; i++) {
        if (rowKeys[rscCompileNormalizeHeaderKey_(group[i])]) {
          score++;
          break;
        }
      }
    });

    if (score > bestScore) {
      bestScore = score;
      bestIdx = r;
    }
  }

  const minScore = rscCompileGetMinimumHeaderScore_(cfg);
  if (bestIdx >= 0 && bestScore >= minScore) return bestIdx;

  const anchors = rscCompileGetStrongHeaderAnchors_(cfg);
  for (let r = 0; r < scanLimit; r++) {
    const rowText = (values[r] || []).map(function (v) {
      return rscCompileNormalizeHeaderKey_(v);
    }).join('|');
    let hit = 0;
    anchors.forEach(function (a) {
      if (rowText.indexOf(rscCompileNormalizeHeaderKey_(a)) !== -1) hit++;
    });
    if (hit >= Math.min(2, anchors.length)) return r;
  }

  return -1;
}


function rscCompileGetExpectedHeaderAliasGroups_(cfg) {
  if (!cfg || cfg.key === 'ROLLING') {
    return [
      ['Sales Office', 'Sls Office'],
      ['Delivering Plant', 'Plant'],
      ['Customer ID', 'Customer', 'Cust ID', 'BP Number Source', 'BP ID'],
      ['Relationship', 'Relationship Cat', 'Relationship Cat ID'],
      ['Salesman ID', 'Salesman'],
      ['Salesman BP Type', 'BP Type'],
      ['Valid From'],
      ['Valid To'],
      ['Visit Category'],
      ['Visit Type'],
      ['Schedule Visit', 'Visit Schedule'],
      ['Visit Valid From'],
      ['Visit Valid To'],
      ['Reason'],
      ['Validation Status'],
      ['Error Detail']
    ];
  }

  if (cfg.key === 'SALES_OFFICE') {
    return [
      ['BP Number Source', 'Customer ID', 'BP ID'],
      ['Delivering Plant', 'Plant'],
      ['Distr. Channel', 'Distribution Channel', 'Dist Channel'],
      ['Division'],
      ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org', 'Sls Organization'],
      ['Sales Office', 'Sls Office'],
      ['Validation Status'],
      ['Error Detail']
    ];
  }

  if (cfg.key === 'SALESMAN_TYPE') {
    return [
      ['Salesman ID', 'BP Number Source', 'Salesman'],
      ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org', 'Sls Organization'],
      ['Sales Office', 'Sls Office'],
      ['Sales Type', 'Salesman Type'],
      ['Coverage'],
      ['Region'],
      ['Valid From'],
      ['Valid To'],
      ['Validation Status'],
      ['Error Detail']
    ];
  }

  if (cfg.key === 'REVAMP') {
    return [
      ['Sales Office'],
      ['Delivering Plant'],
      ['Customer ID'],
      ['Relationship'],
      ['Salesman ID'],
      ['Salesman BP Type'],
      ['Valid From'],
      ['Valid To'],
      ['Visit Category'],
      ['Visit Type'],
      ['Schedule Visit'],
      ['Visit Valid From'],
      ['Visit Valid To'],
      ['Change Schedule Only'],
      ['Sales Office Source']
    ];
  }

  return [
    ['Validation Status'],
    ['Error Detail']
  ];
}


function rscCompileGetMinimumHeaderScore_(cfg) {
  if (!cfg) return 4;
  if (cfg.key === 'ROLLING') return 6;
  if (cfg.key === 'SALES_OFFICE') return 4;
  if (cfg.key === 'SALESMAN_TYPE') return 4;
  if (cfg.key === 'REVAMP') return 6;
  return 3;
}


function rscCompileGetStrongHeaderAnchors_(cfg) {
  if (!cfg || cfg.key === 'ROLLING') {
    return ['Customer ID', 'Relationship', 'Salesman ID', 'Visit Type', 'Schedule Visit'];
  }
  if (cfg.key === 'SALES_OFFICE') {
    return ['BP Number Source', 'Delivering Plant', 'Sales Organization', 'Sales Office'];
  }
  if (cfg.key === 'SALESMAN_TYPE') {
    return ['Salesman ID', 'Sales Organization', 'Sales Office', 'Sales Type'];
  }
  if (cfg.key === 'REVAMP') {
    return ['Sales Office', 'Customer ID', 'Sales Office Source', 'Change Schedule Only'];
  }
  return ['Validation Status', 'Error Detail'];
}


function rscCompileGetSourceSheet_(sourceSs, cfg) {
  let sh = sourceSs.getSheetByName(cfg.sourceSheetName);
  if (sh) return sh;

  sh = sourceSs.getSheetByName(String(cfg.sourceSheetName).substring(0, 31));
  if (sh) return sh;

  const wantedNorm = rscCompileNormalizeSheetName_(cfg.sourceSheetName);
  const sheets = sourceSs.getSheets();

  for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (rscCompileNormalizeSheetName_(sheets[i].getName()) === wantedNorm) return sheets[i];
  }

  const contains = cfg.fallbackContains || [];
  for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    const nameNorm = rscCompileNormalizeSheetName_(sheets[i].getName());
    for (let j = 0; j < contains.length; j++) {
      if (nameNorm.indexOf(rscCompileNormalizeSheetName_(contains[j])) !== -1) return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/* ============================================================
 * ENRICHMENT KHUSUS REVAMP
 * - Sales Org / Distribution Channel / Division: lookup DB dengan key
 *   Customer ID (bp_id) + Sales Office (sls_office).
 * - sls_office_rekap: nilai kolom A dari Rekap Approved pada baris link.
 * ========================================================== */

function rscCompileEnrichRevampSourceData_(sourceData, slsOfficeRekap) {
  if (!sourceData || !sourceData.header || !sourceData.header.length) return sourceData;

  const salesOfficeIdx = rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(sourceData.header, ['Sales Office']);
  const customerIdIdx = rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(sourceData.header, ['Customer ID']);
  const slsOfficeRekapValue = rscCompileNormalizeCellValue_(slsOfficeRekap);
  const extraHeaders = ['Sales Org', 'Distribution Channel', 'Division', 'sls_office_rekap'];
  const newHeader = sourceData.header.concat(extraHeaders);

  if (salesOfficeIdx < 0 || customerIdIdx < 0) {
    // Header Sales Office / Customer ID tidak ketemu; tetap tambahkan kolom
    // kosong supaya lebar kolom konsisten dengan header baru.
    const blankRows = sourceData.dataRows.map(function (row) {
      return row.concat(['', '', '', slsOfficeRekapValue]);
    });
    return {
      header: newHeader,
      dataRows: blankRows,
      sourceRowNumbers: sourceData.sourceRowNumbers,
      headerRow: sourceData.headerRow,
      headerDetectMode: sourceData.headerDetectMode,
      sourceSheetName: sourceData.sourceSheetName
    };
  }

  const dbMap = rscCompileGetRevampDbMap_();

  const newDataRows = sourceData.dataRows.map(function (row) {
    const sourceSalesOffice = rscCompileExtractLeadingCode_(row[salesOfficeIdx], 4);
    const rekapSalesOffice = rscCompileExtractLeadingCode_(slsOfficeRekapValue, 4);
    const customerId = String(row[customerIdIdx] || '').trim();

    // Authoritative lookup order:
    // 1) Customer ID + sls_office_rekap dari Rekap Approved.
    // 2) Customer ID + Sales Office pada row Template Revamp.
    // 3) Best available row untuk Customer ID yang sama.
    const found = customerId ? (
      (rekapSalesOffice ? dbMap[customerId + '|' + rekapSalesOffice] : null) ||
      (sourceSalesOffice ? dbMap[customerId + '|' + sourceSalesOffice] : null) ||
      dbMap['CUST|' + customerId] ||
      null
    ) : null;

    return row.concat([
      found ? found.slsOrg : '',
      found ? found.distChannel : '',
      found ? found.division : '',
      rekapSalesOffice || slsOfficeRekapValue
    ]);
  });

  return {
    header: newHeader,
    dataRows: newDataRows,
    sourceRowNumbers: sourceData.sourceRowNumbers,
    headerRow: sourceData.headerRow,
    headerDetectMode: sourceData.headerDetectMode,
    sourceSheetName: sourceData.sourceSheetName
  };
}


function rscCompileGetRevampDbMap_() {
  if (!__RSC_COMPILE_REVAMP_DB_MAP_CACHE__) {
    __RSC_COMPILE_REVAMP_DB_MAP_CACHE__ = rscCompileLoadRevampDbMap_();
  }
  return __RSC_COMPILE_REVAMP_DB_MAP_CACHE__;
}


function rscCompileLoadRevampDbMap_() {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const dbSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.revampDbSpreadsheetId);
  const dbSh = dbSs.getSheetByName(P.revampDbSheetName);
  if (!dbSh) {
    throw new Error('Database sheet tidak ditemukan: ' + P.revampDbSheetName);
  }

  const lastRow = dbSh.getLastRow();
  const lastCol = dbSh.getLastColumn();
  if (lastRow < 2 || lastCol < 1) return {};

  const scanRows = Math.min(P.revampDbHeaderScanRows || 10, lastRow);
  const headerGrid = dbSh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, lastCol).getDisplayValues();

  let headerRow = 0;
  let cBpId = -1;
  let cSlsOrg = -1;
  let cDist = -1;
  let cDivision = -1;
  let cSlsOffice = -1;

  for (let r = 0; r < headerGrid.length; r++) {
    const row = headerGrid[r];
    const bp = rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(row, ['bp_id']);
    const org = rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(row, ['sls_org', 'sales_org']);
    const dist = rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(row, ['dist_channel', 'distribution_channel']);
    const div = rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(row, ['division']);
    const office = rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(row, ['sls_office', 'sales_office']);

    if (bp >= 0 && org >= 0 && dist >= 0 && div >= 0 && office >= 0) {
      headerRow = r + 1;
      cBpId = bp;
      cSlsOrg = org;
      cDist = dist;
      cDivision = div;
      cSlsOffice = office;
      break;
    }
  }

  if (!headerRow) {
    throw new Error(
      'Header DB ' + P.revampDbSheetName +
      ' tidak lengkap untuk Compile Template Revamp. Wajib ada bp_id, sls_org, dist_channel, division, sls_office.'
    );
  }

  const minZero = Math.min(cBpId, cSlsOrg, cDist, cDivision, cSlsOffice);
  const maxZero = Math.max(cBpId, cSlsOrg, cDist, cDivision, cSlsOffice);
  const width = maxZero - minZero + 1;
  const relBpId = cBpId - minZero;
  const relSlsOrg = cSlsOrg - minZero;
  const relDist = cDist - minZero;
  const relDivision = cDivision - minZero;
  const relSlsOffice = cSlsOffice - minZero;

  const map = Object.create(null);
  const chunk = P.revampDbReadChunkRows || 30000;

  for (let start = headerRow + 1; start <= lastRow; start += chunk) {
    const n = Math.min(chunk, lastRow - start + 1);
    const rows = dbSh.getRange(start, minZero + 1, n, width).getDisplayValues();

    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      const bpId = String(rows[i][relBpId] || '').trim();
      const slsOffice = rscCompileExtractLeadingCode_(rows[i][relSlsOffice], 4);
      if (!bpId || !slsOffice) continue;

      const key = bpId + '|' + slsOffice;
      const customerFallbackKey = 'CUST|' + bpId;
      const candidate = {
        slsOrg: rscCompileCleanGroupPart_(rows[i][relSlsOrg]),
        distChannel: rscCompileCleanGroupPart_(rows[i][relDist]),
        division: rscCompileCleanGroupPart_(rows[i][relDivision])
      };

      // Exact key tetap deterministic. Jika ada duplicate DB, pilih payload
      // dengan dimensi paling lengkap agar Sales Org/Dist/Division tidak blank
      // hanya karena row DB pertama kebetulan tidak lengkap.
      if (
        !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(map, key) ||
        rscCompileRevampDimensionScore_(candidate) >
          rscCompileRevampDimensionScore_(map[key])
      ) {
        map[key] = candidate;
      }

      // Fallback per customer dipakai hanya saat exact sls_office tidak tersedia.
      if (
        !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(map, customerFallbackKey) ||
        rscCompileRevampDimensionScore_(candidate) >
          rscCompileRevampDimensionScore_(map[customerFallbackKey])
      ) {
        map[customerFallbackKey] = candidate;
      }
    }
  }

  return map;
}


function rscCompileRevampDimensionScore_(value) {
  const v = value || {};
  let score = 0;
  if (String(v.slsOrg || v.org || '').trim()) score++;
  if (String(v.distChannel || v.dist || '').trim()) score++;
  if (String(v.division || v.div || '').trim()) score++;
  return score;
}


function rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(headerRow, aliases) {
  const normalizedAliases = aliases.map(function (a) { return rscCompileNormalizeHeaderKey_(a); });
  for (let i = 0; i < headerRow.length; i++) {
    const norm = rscCompileNormalizeHeaderKey_(headerRow[i]);
    if (normalizedAliases.indexOf(norm) !== -1) return i;
  }
  return -1;
}


function rscCompileExtractLeadingCode_(value, codeLength) {
  const text = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
  if (!text) return '';

  const firstToken = text.split(/\s+-\s+|\s+/)[0].trim();
  const direct = firstToken.match(new RegExp('^[A-Za-z0-9]{' + codeLength + '}'));
  if (direct) return direct[0];

  const anywhere = text.match(new RegExp('([A-Za-z0-9]{' + codeLength + '})'));
  return anywhere ? anywhere[1] : firstToken;
}


function rscCompileCleanGroupPart_(value) {
  const text = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
  if (!text) return '';
  return text.split(/\s+-\s+|\s+/)[0].trim();
}


/* ============================================================
 * STAGE WRITE — key = source file + source sheet + source row
 * (lossless: row tidak pernah di-collapse walau business key sama)
 * ========================================================== */


function rscCompileGetStageMetaHeaders_() {
  return [
    '__BUSINESS_KEY',
    '__ROW_HASH',
    '__SOURCE_FILE_ID',
    '__SOURCE_SHEET_NAME',
    '__SOURCE_ROW_NO',
    '__SOURCE_ORDER',
    '__TRACE_KEY',
    '__RUN_ID'
  ];
}


function rscCompilePadNumberForKey_(num, width) {
  let s = String(Math.max(0, Number(num || 0)));
  while (s.length < width) s = '0' + s;
  return s;
}



function rscCompileBuildSourceRowCompileKey_(cfg, fileId, sourceSheetName, sourceRowNo) {
  // Backward-compatible trace helper. Compile utama V9 tidak lagi memakai
  // source-row sebagai key upsert/purge.
  return [
    String(cfg && cfg.key ? cfg.key : ''),
    'FILE=' + String(fileId || ''),
    'SHEET=' + rscCompileNormalizeSheetName_(sourceSheetName || ''),
    'SRC_ROW=' + rscCompilePadNumberForKey_(sourceRowNo, 8)
  ].join('|');
}


function rscCompileGetBusinessKeyHeaderGroups_(cfg) {
  const key = String(cfg && cfg.key || '').toUpperCase();

  // Canonical key V14 wajib tepat 6 kolom:
  // Customer ID + Relationship + Salesman ID + Valid From +
  // Visit Type + Visit Valid From.
  if (key === 'ROLLING' || key === 'REVAMP') {
    return [
      { name: 'Customer ID', aliases: ['Customer ID', 'Customer', 'Cust ID', 'BP Number Source', 'BP ID'], type: 'TEXT', required: true },
      { name: 'Relationship', aliases: ['Relationship', 'Relationship Cat', 'Relationship Cat ID'], type: 'CODE', required: true },
      { name: 'Salesman ID', aliases: ['Salesman ID', 'Salesman', 'BP ID RLT2'], type: 'TEXT', required: true },
      { name: 'Valid From', aliases: ['Valid From'], type: 'DATE', required: true },
      { name: 'Visit Type', aliases: ['Visit Type'], type: 'VISIT_TYPE', required: true },
      { name: 'Visit Valid From', aliases: ['Visit Valid From'], type: 'DATE', required: true }
    ];
  }

  // Sales Office adalah nilai hasil perubahan, sehingga tidak dimasukkan
  // ke identity key. Perubahan Sales Office menjadi UPDATE, bukan insert baru.
  if (key === 'SALES_OFFICE') {
    return [
      { name: 'BP Number Source', aliases: ['BP Number Source', 'Customer ID', 'BP ID'], type: 'TEXT', required: true },
      { name: 'Delivering Plant', aliases: ['Delivering Plant', 'Plant'], type: 'CODE', required: false },
      { name: 'Distribution Channel', aliases: ['Distr. Channel', 'Distribution Channel', 'Dist Channel'], type: 'CODE', required: false },
      { name: 'Division', aliases: ['Division'], type: 'CODE', required: false },
      { name: 'Sales Organization', aliases: ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org', 'Sls Organization'], type: 'CODE', required: false }
    ];
  }

  // Sales Type, Coverage, dan Valid To adalah payload yang boleh berubah.
  if (key === 'SALESMAN_TYPE') {
    return [
      { name: 'Salesman ID', aliases: ['Salesman ID', 'BP Number Source', 'Salesman'], type: 'TEXT', required: true },
      { name: 'Sales Organization', aliases: ['Sales Organization', 'Sales Org', 'Sls Organization'], type: 'CODE', required: false },
      { name: 'Sales Office', aliases: ['Sales Office', 'Sls Office'], type: 'CODE', required: false },
      { name: 'Valid From', aliases: ['Valid From'], type: 'DATE', required: false }
    ];
  }

  return [];
}


function rscCompileNormalizeBusinessKeyDate_(value) {
  if (value instanceof Date && !isNaN(value.getTime())) {
    return Utilities.formatDate(value, Session.getScriptTimeZone() || 'Asia/Jakarta', 'yyyy-MM-dd');
  }

  let text = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim().replace(/^'/, '');
  if (!text) return '';

  let m = text.match(/^(\d{4})[-\/.](\d{1,2})[-\/.](\d{1,2})(?:\s.*)?$/);
  if (m) {
    return m[1] + '-' + String(Number(m[2])).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(Number(m[3])).padStart(2, '0');
  }

  m = text.match(/^(\d{1,2})[-\/.](\d{1,2})[-\/.](\d{4})(?:\s.*)?$/);
  if (m) {
    // Locale utama Indonesia: dd/MM/yyyy. Jika angka pertama tidak mungkin
    // menjadi bulan, interpretasi ini juga tetap benar.
    const day = Number(m[1]);
    const month = Number(m[2]);
    const year = Number(m[3]);
    if (day >= 1 && day <= 31 && month >= 1 && month <= 12) {
      return year + '-' + String(month).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(day).padStart(2, '0');
    }
  }

  const parsed = new Date(text);
  if (!isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
    return Utilities.formatDate(parsed, Session.getScriptTimeZone() || 'Asia/Jakarta', 'yyyy-MM-dd');
  }

  return text.toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, '');
}


function rscCompileNormalizeBusinessKeyPart_(value, type) {
  let text = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim().replace(/^'/, '');
  if (!text) return '';

  type = String(type || 'TEXT').toUpperCase();
  if (type === 'DATE') return rscCompileNormalizeBusinessKeyDate_(value);

  if (type === 'VISIT_TYPE') {
    const numeric = text.match(/^(\d+)(?:\.0+)?$/);
    if (numeric) return String(Number(numeric[1])).padStart(2, '0');
  }

  // Ambil kode depan dari dropdown "CODE - Description".
  if (type === 'CODE') {
    const code = text.match(/^([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\s+-\s+.+$/);
    if (code) text = code[1];
  }

  if (/^-?\d+\.0+$/.test(text)) text = text.replace(/\.0+$/, '');
  return text.toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}



function rscCompileBuildHeaderIndexMap_(header) {
  const map = Object.create(null);
  (header || []).forEach(function (value, index) {
    const key = rscCompileNormalizeHeaderKey_(value);
    if (key && !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(map, key)) {
      map[key] = index;
    }
  });
  return map;
}


function rscCompileFindHeaderIndexFromAliases_(headerMap, aliases) {
  for (let i = 0; i < (aliases || []).length; i++) {
    const key = rscCompileNormalizeHeaderKey_(aliases[i]);
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(headerMap, key)) {
      return headerMap[key];
    }
  }
  return -1;
}



function rscCompileBuildBusinessKeyFromRow_(cfg, header, row, fallbackTrace) {
  const groups = rscCompileGetBusinessKeyHeaderGroups_(cfg);
  const headerMap = rscCompileBuildHeaderIndexMap_(header || []);
  const parts = [];
  const valuesByName = Object.create(null);
  let requiredMissing = false;
  let anyValue = false;

  groups.forEach(function (group) {
    const idx = rscCompileFindHeaderIndexFromAliases_(
      headerMap, group.aliases || [group.name]
    );
    const normalized = idx >= 0
      ? rscCompileNormalizeBusinessKeyPart_(row[idx], group.type)
      : '';

    valuesByName[rscCompileNormalizeHeaderKey_(group.name)] = normalized;
    if (normalized) anyValue = true;
    if (group.required && !normalized) requiredMissing = true;
    parts.push(rscCompileNormalizeHeaderKey_(group.name) + '=' + normalized);
  });

  if (groups.length && anyValue && !requiredMissing) {
    return String(cfg.key || '') + '|' + parts.join('|');
  }

  // Template Revamp memiliki row Sales-Office-only. Sesuai canonical key
  // revamp, row ini memakai synthetic key berdasarkan Customer ID.
  if (String(cfg && cfg.key || '').toUpperCase() === 'REVAMP') {
    const customerId = valuesByName.CUSTOMER_ID || '';
    const relationship = valuesByName.RELATIONSHIP || '';
    const salesmanId = valuesByName.SALESMAN_ID || '';
    if (customerId && !relationship && !salesmanId) {
      return 'REVAMP|SALES_OFFICE_ONLY|CUSTOMER_ID=' + customerId;
    }
  }

  // Row tanpa business key lengkap tetap lossless dan idempotent berdasarkan
  // seluruh payload. Perubahan payload menjadi purge+insert.
  const rowHash = rscCompileHashString_(
    (row || []).map(function (v) {
      return rscCompileNormalizeCellValue_(v);
    }).join('\u001f')
  );
  return String(cfg && cfg.key || '') + '|FALLBACK_ROW_HASH=' + rowHash;
}


function rscCompileBuildDeterministicSourceOrder_(job, sourceRowNo, fileId) {
  return [
    rscCompilePadNumberForKey_(Number(job && job.linkIndex || 0), 10),
    rscCompilePadNumberForKey_(Number(sourceRowNo || 0), 10),
    String(fileId || '')
  ].join('|');
}


function rscCompileChooseBusinessKeyWinner_(existing, candidate) {
  if (!existing) return candidate;
  const a = String(existing.sourceOrder || '');
  const b = String(candidate.sourceOrder || '');
  if (b > a) return candidate;
  if (b < a) return existing;

  // Resume dapat menulis trace yang sama dua kali. Untuk source order sama,
  // row terakhir dengan hash berbeda menjadi versi terbaru.
  return candidate;
}


/* ============================================================
 * FINALIZE — sync staging -> output sheet (insert/update/delete/unchanged)
 * ========================================================== */


function rscCompileFinalizeSyncToTarget_(job, started) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
  const keySs = rscCompileOpenSupportSpreadsheetForJob_(job, targetSs);

  if (typeof job.finalizeIndex === 'undefined' || job.finalizeIndex === null) {
    job.finalizeIndex = 0;
  }

  while (job.finalizeIndex < job.configKeys.length) {
    const cfg = rscCompileGetConfigByKey_(job.configKeys[job.finalizeIndex]);
    if (!cfg) {
      job.finalizeIndex++;
      rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
      continue;
    }

    if (Date.now() - started > P.softDeadlineMs) {
      rscCompileScheduleContinuation_(job, 'FINALIZE_PAUSE_' + cfg.key);
      rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'FINALIZE_PAUSE', cfg, {
        targetSs: targetSs,
        status: 'PAUSED',
        message: 'Finalize paused. Existing key tetap berada di ' +
          rscCompileGetMetaSheetName_() + ', target key berada di ' +
          rscCompileGetStagingSheetName_(cfg) + '.'
      });
      return;
    }

    const syncResult = rscCompileSyncOneConfigFromStage_(
      targetSs, keySs, cfg, job
    );

    rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'outputRows', syncResult.outputRows);
    rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'inserted', syncResult.inserted);
    rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'updated', syncResult.updated);
    rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'deleted', syncResult.deleted);
    rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'unchanged', syncResult.unchanged);
    rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, cfg.key, 'duplicateKeysCollapsed', syncResult.duplicateKeysCollapsed);

    if (job.stats && job.stats.configs && job.stats.configs[cfg.key]) {
      job.stats.configs[cfg.key].existingKeysReadAtFinalize =
        Number(syncResult.existingKeysRead || 0);
      job.stats.configs[cfg.key].targetKeysWritten =
        Number(syncResult.targetKeysWritten || 0);
    }

    rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'FINALIZE_OK', cfg, {
      targetSs: targetSs,
      outputRows: syncResult.outputRows,
      inserted: syncResult.inserted,
      updated: syncResult.updated,
      deleted: syncResult.deleted,
      unchanged: syncResult.unchanged,
      duplicateKeysCollapsed: syncResult.duplicateKeysCollapsed,
      status: 'UPSERT_PURGE_SYNCED',
      message: 'Existing key read=' + syncResult.existingKeysRead +
        ', target key=' + syncResult.targetKeysWritten +
        '. Output sheet ditulis ulang berdasarkan business key; key absent dipurge.'
    });

    job.finalizeIndex++;
    rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
    props.setProperty(P.pLastStats, JSON.stringify(job.stats));
  }

  finishCompileApprovedLinksJob_(
    job,
    buildCompileApprovedLinksFinishMessage_(job)
  );
}





function rscCompileSyncOneConfigFromStage_(targetSs, keySs, cfg, job) {
  const outSh = rscCompileGetOrCreateOutputSheet_(targetSs, cfg.outputSheetName);
  const targetKeySh = rscCompileGetOrCreateStagingSheet_(keySs, cfg);
  const existingKeySh = rscCompileGetOrCreateMetaSheet_(keySs);

  const previousIndex = rscCompileReadMetaIndex_(existingKeySh, cfg);
  const staged = rscCompileReadStagingRows_(targetKeySh, cfg);
  const currentByKey = staged.currentByKey || Object.create(null);
  const duplicateKeysCollapsed = Number(staged.duplicateKeysCollapsed || 0);

  const orderedKeys = Object.keys(currentByKey).sort(function (a, b) {
    const ao = String(currentByKey[a].sourceOrder || '');
    const bo = String(currentByKey[b].sourceOrder || '');
    if (ao === bo) {
      const ar = Number(currentByKey[a].stageRow || 0);
      const br = Number(currentByKey[b].stageRow || 0);
      if (ar !== br) return ar - br;
      return a.localeCompare(b);
    }
    return ao.localeCompare(bo);
  });

  const header = staged.header.length ? staged.header : [];
  const colCount = header.length || Number(job.outputColCountByKey[cfg.key] || 0) || 1;

  let inserted = 0;
  let updated = 0;
  let unchanged = 0;
  let deleted = 0;

  orderedKeys.forEach(function (businessKey) {
    const previous = previousIndex[businessKey];
    const current = currentByKey[businessKey];

    if (!previous) {
      inserted++;
    } else if (String(previous.rowHash || '') !== String(current.rowHash || '')) {
      updated++;
    } else {
      unchanged++;
    }
  });

  Object.keys(previousIndex).forEach(function (businessKey) {
    if (!currentByKey[businessKey]) deleted++;
  });

  // Payload output di-stream langsung dari stage, tidak ditampung seluruhnya
  // di memory. Hanya metadata winner business key yang berada di memory.
  rscCompileRewriteOutputSheetClean_(
    outSh, targetKeySh, staged, currentByKey, orderedKeys, colCount
  );

  rscCompileRewriteMetaForConfig_(
    existingKeySh, cfg, currentByKey, orderedKeys, job.runId
  );

  rscCompileRewriteTargetKeySnapshotCompactV9_(
    targetKeySh, cfg, currentByKey, orderedKeys, job.runId
  );

  try { targetKeySh.hideSheet(); } catch (err) {}
  try { existingKeySh.hideSheet(); } catch (err) {}

  return {
    outputRows: orderedKeys.length,
    inserted: inserted,
    updated: updated,
    deleted: deleted,
    unchanged: unchanged,
    duplicateKeysCollapsed: duplicateKeysCollapsed,
    existingKeysRead: Object.keys(previousIndex).length,
    targetKeysWritten: orderedKeys.length
  };
}


function rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh, rowsNeeded, colsNeeded) {
  if (!sh) return;

  rowsNeeded = Math.max(1, Number(rowsNeeded || 1));
  colsNeeded = Math.max(1, Number(colsNeeded || 1));

  // Google Sheets tidak mengizinkan seluruh baris/kolom non-frozen dihapus.
  // Contoh: row 1 frozen, data hanya sampai row 1, lalu delete row 2:last
  // akan gagal dengan "not possible to delete all non-frozen rows".
  // Sisakan tepat satu baris/kolom non-frozen setelah area frozen.
  let frozenRows = 0;
  let frozenCols = 0;
  try { frozenRows = Math.max(0, Number(sh.getFrozenRows() || 0)); } catch (err) {}
  try { frozenCols = Math.max(0, Number(sh.getFrozenColumns() || 0)); } catch (err) {}

  const safeRowsNeeded = Math.max(rowsNeeded, frozenRows + 1);
  const safeColsNeeded = Math.max(colsNeeded, frozenCols + 1);

  // Failsafe untuk sheet yang seluruh grid-nya sudah frozen.
  let maxRows = sh.getMaxRows();
  if (maxRows < safeRowsNeeded) {
    sh.insertRowsAfter(maxRows, safeRowsNeeded - maxRows);
    maxRows = sh.getMaxRows();
  }
  if (maxRows > safeRowsNeeded) {
    sh.deleteRows(safeRowsNeeded + 1, maxRows - safeRowsNeeded);
  }

  let maxCols = sh.getMaxColumns();
  if (maxCols < safeColsNeeded) {
    sh.insertColumnsAfter(maxCols, safeColsNeeded - maxCols);
    maxCols = sh.getMaxColumns();
  }
  if (maxCols > safeColsNeeded) {
    sh.deleteColumns(safeColsNeeded + 1, maxCols - safeColsNeeded);
  }
}



function rscCompileOpenSupportSpreadsheetForJob_(job, targetSs) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  if (!P.useExternalSupportSpreadsheet) return targetSs;

  const id = String(
    P.keySpreadsheetId ||
    (job && job.supportSpreadsheetId) ||
    PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().getProperty(P.pSupportSpreadsheetId) ||
    ''
  );

  if (!id) {
    throw new Error('Fixed key spreadsheet ID tidak ditemukan.');
  }
  if (P.keySpreadsheetId && id !== String(P.keySpreadsheetId)) {
    throw new Error('Checkpoint menunjuk key spreadsheet berbeda. STOP lalu Start ulang.');
  }

  return RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(id);
}



function rscCompileMigrateLegacyMetaToSupport_(targetSs, keySs, props, legacySupportSpreadsheetId) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  if (!P.useExternalSupportSpreadsheet || targetSs.getId() === keySs.getId()) return;

  const marker = String(props.getProperty(P.pLegacyMetaMigrated) || '');
  const archiveName = P.legacyKeyArchiveSheetName || '_RSC_LEGACY_KEY_ARCHIVE';
  let archive = keySs.getSheetByName(archiveName);
  if (!archive) archive = keySs.insertSheet(archiveName);

  const archiveHeader = [
    'ARCHIVED_AT', 'SOURCE_SPREADSHEET_ID', 'SOURCE_SHEET',
    'SOURCE_ROW', 'RAW_1', 'RAW_2', 'RAW_3', 'RAW_4',
    'RAW_5', 'RAW_6', 'RAW_7', 'RAW_8'
  ];
  rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(archive, 1, archiveHeader.length);
  if (archive.getRange(1, 1, 1, archiveHeader.length).getDisplayValues()[0].join('|') !== archiveHeader.join('|')) {
    archive.clear();
    archive.getRange(1, 1, 1, archiveHeader.length)
      .setNumberFormat('@')
      .setValues([archiveHeader]);
  }

  const candidates = [];
  const legacySheetNames = ['_RSC_COMPILE_KEY_INDEX'];

  legacySheetNames.forEach(function (sheetName) {
    const sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(sheetName);
    if (sh) candidates.push({ ss: targetSs, sh: sh });
  });

  const oldId = String(legacySupportSpreadsheetId || '');
  if (oldId && oldId !== keySs.getId() && oldId !== targetSs.getId()) {
    try {
      const oldSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(oldId);
      legacySheetNames.forEach(function (sheetName) {
        const sh = oldSs.getSheetByName(sheetName);
        if (sh) candidates.push({ ss: oldSs, sh: sh });
      });
    } catch (err) {
      // Old support tidak accessible: active key tetap aman karena akan
      // direkonstruksi dari output target pada start.
    }
  }

  candidates.forEach(function (item) {
    const sh = item.sh;
    const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
    const lastCol = Math.min(8, Math.max(1, sh.getLastColumn()));
    if (lastRow >= 1) {
      const chunk = Math.max(1000, Number(P.supportReadWriteChunkRows || 20000));
      for (let start = 1; start <= lastRow; start += chunk) {
        const n = Math.min(chunk, lastRow - start + 1);
        const values = sh.getRange(start, 1, n, lastCol).getDisplayValues();
        const out = values.map(function (r, idx) {
          const raw = r.slice(0, 8);
          while (raw.length < 8) raw.push('');
          return [
            new Date().toISOString(),
            item.ss.getId(),
            sh.getName(),
            String(start + idx)
          ].concat(raw);
        });

        if (out.length) {
          const writeRow = archive.getLastRow() + 1;
          rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(archive, writeRow + out.length - 1, archiveHeader.length);
          archive.getRange(writeRow, 1, out.length, archiveHeader.length)
            .setNumberFormat('@')
            .setValues(out);
        }
      }
    }

    // Legacy key tidak lagi menjadi source of truth setelah berhasil diarsipkan.
    try { item.ss.deleteSheet(sh); } catch (err) {}
  });

  rscCompileTrimSheetToUsedRange_(archive);
  props.setProperty(P.pSupportSpreadsheetId, keySs.getId());
  props.setProperty(
    P.pLegacyMetaMigrated,
    'DONE_BUSINESS_KEY_REBUILD_' + new Date().toISOString() +
      (marker ? '|PREV=' + marker.slice(0, 100) : '')
  );
}



function rscCompileSnapshotExistingKeysAtStart_(targetSs, keySs, configs, runId) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const metaSheet = rscCompileGetOrCreateMetaSheet_(keySs);
  const result = {};

  // Requirement utama:
  // 1) existing key dibaca lebih dahulu dari fixed key spreadsheet,
  // 2) output hanya dipakai sebagai bootstrap apabila config belum mempunyai
  //    existing key atau schema key sudah berubah.
  (configs || []).forEach(function (cfg) {
    let existingIndex = rscCompileReadMetaIndex_(metaSheet, cfg);
    let existingKeys = Object.keys(existingIndex);
    let schemaMismatch = false;

    existingKeys.forEach(function (businessKey) {
      const item = existingIndex[businessKey] || {};
      if (String(item.schemaVersion || '') !== String(P.keyStoreSchemaVersion || '')) {
        schemaMismatch = true;
      }
    });

    const shouldBootstrap =
      !!P.bootstrapExistingKeysFromOutputIfEmpty &&
      (!existingKeys.length || schemaMismatch);

    let bootstrap = {
      outputRowsRead: 0,
      duplicateBusinessKeysFound: 0,
      bootstrapped: false
    };

    if (shouldBootstrap) {
      bootstrap = rscCompileBootstrapExistingKeysFromOutput_(
        targetSs, metaSheet, cfg, runId
      );
      existingIndex = rscCompileReadMetaIndex_(metaSheet, cfg);
      existingKeys = Object.keys(existingIndex);
    }

    const keyList = existingKeys.sort();
    result[cfg.key] = {
      existingKeyCount: keyList.length,
      outputRowsRead: Number(bootstrap.outputRowsRead || 0),
      duplicateBusinessKeysFound: Number(bootstrap.duplicateBusinessKeysFound || 0),
      existingKeySnapshotHash: rscCompileHashString_(keyList.join('\u001f')),
      existingKeySource: bootstrap.bootstrapped
        ? 'OUTPUT_BOOTSTRAP_TO_FIXED_KEY_STORE'
        : 'FIXED_KEY_STORE',
      schemaMismatchRebuilt: schemaMismatch && bootstrap.bootstrapped
    };
  });

  try { metaSheet.hideSheet(); } catch (err) {}
  return result;
}


function rscCompileBootstrapExistingKeysFromOutput_(targetSs, metaSheet, cfg, runId) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const outSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(cfg.outputSheetName);
  const currentByKey = Object.create(null);
  let duplicateKeys = 0;
  let sourceRows = 0;

  if (outSh && outSh.getLastRow() >= 2 && outSh.getLastColumn() >= 1) {
    const lastRow = outSh.getLastRow();
    const lastCol = outSh.getLastColumn();
    const header = outSh.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0]
      .map(function (v) { return rscCompileNormalizeCellValue_(v); });
    const chunk = Math.max(1000, Number(P.supportReadWriteChunkRows || 20000));

    for (let start = 2; start <= lastRow; start += chunk) {
      const n = Math.min(chunk, lastRow - start + 1);
      const rows = outSh.getRange(start, 1, n, lastCol).getDisplayValues();

      rows.forEach(function (rawRow, idx) {
        const row = rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(rawRow, lastCol);
        if (!rscCompileRowHasValue_(row)) return;
        sourceRows++;

        const outputRow = start + idx;
        const businessKey = rscCompileBuildBusinessKeyFromRow_(
          cfg, header, row, 'OUTPUT_ROW=' + outputRow
        );
        const item = {
          key: businessKey,
          rowHash: rscCompileHashString_(row.join('\u001f')),
          sourceFileId: '',
          sourceSheetName: cfg.outputSheetName,
          sourceRowNo: String(outputRow),
          sourceOrder: rscCompilePadNumberForKey_(outputRow, 12),
          row: row
        };

        if (currentByKey[businessKey]) duplicateKeys++;
        currentByKey[businessKey] = rscCompileChooseBusinessKeyWinner_(
          currentByKey[businessKey], item
        );
      });
    }
  }

  const orderedKeys = Object.keys(currentByKey).sort(function (a, b) {
    const ao = String(currentByKey[a].sourceOrder || '');
    const bo = String(currentByKey[b].sourceOrder || '');
    if (ao === bo) return a.localeCompare(b);
    return ao.localeCompare(bo);
  });

  rscCompileRewriteMetaForConfig_(
    metaSheet,
    cfg,
    currentByKey,
    orderedKeys,
    'START_BOOTSTRAP_' + String(runId || '')
  );

  return {
    outputRowsRead: sourceRows,
    duplicateBusinessKeysFound: duplicateKeys,
    bootstrapped: true
  };
}


function rscCompileTrimSheetToUsedRange_(sh) {
  if (!sh) return;
  const rowsNeeded = Math.max(1, sh.getLastRow());
  const colsNeeded = Math.max(1, sh.getLastColumn());
  rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh, rowsNeeded, colsNeeded);
}


function rscCompileTrimManagedOutputSheets_(targetSs, configs) {
  (configs || []).forEach(function (cfg) {
    const sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(cfg.outputSheetName);
    if (sh) rscCompileTrimSheetToUsedRange_(sh);
  });

  // Legacy meta mungkin masih ada sebelum migrasi; pangkas jika ditemukan.
  const legacyMeta = targetSs.getSheetByName(rscCompileGetMetaSheetName_());
  if (legacyMeta) rscCompileTrimSheetToUsedRange_(legacyMeta);

  const log = targetSs.getSheetByName(APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.detailLogSheetName);
  if (log) rscCompileTrimSheetToUsedRange_(log);
}


function rscCompileTrimSupportSheets_(supportSs) {
  if (!supportSs) return;
  const meta = supportSs.getSheetByName(rscCompileGetMetaSheetName_());
  if (meta) {
    rscCompileEnsureMetaHeader_(meta);
    rscCompileTrimSheetToUsedRange_(meta);
    try { meta.hideSheet(); } catch (err) {}
  }
}


function rscCompileDeleteStagingSheetsForKeys_(targetSs, keys) {
  const protectedNames = {};
  (keys || []).forEach(function (key) {
    const cfg = rscCompileGetConfigByKey_(key);
    if (cfg) protectedNames[rscCompileGetStagingSheetName_(cfg)] = true;
  });

  Object.keys(protectedNames).forEach(function (name) {
    const sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(name);
    if (sh) {
      try { targetSs.deleteSheet(sh); } catch (err) {
        try {
          sh.clear();
          rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh, 1, 1);
          sh.hideSheet();
        } catch (ignore) {}
      }
    }
  });
}


function rscCompileGetOrCreateOutputSheet_(targetSs, sheetName) {
  let sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(sheetName);
  if (!sh) sh = targetSs.insertSheet(sheetName);
  return sh;
}



function rscCompileGetStagingSheetName_(cfg) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  return String((P.targetKeySheetPrefix || '_RSC_TARGET_KEYS_') + cfg.key).substring(0, 99);
}



function rscCompileGetMetaSheetName_() {
  return APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.existingKeyIndexSheetName || '_RSC_EXISTING_KEYS';
}


function rscCompileGetOrCreateStagingSheet_(targetSs, cfg) {
  const name = rscCompileGetStagingSheetName_(cfg);
  let sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(name);
  if (!sh) sh = targetSs.insertSheet(name);
  return sh;
}


function rscCompileDeleteAllTargetKeySheetsV9_(keySs) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  (P.outputSheets || []).forEach(function (cfg) {
    const name = rscCompileGetStagingSheetName_(cfg);
    const sh = keySs.getSheetByName(name);
    if (!sh) return;
    try {
      keySs.deleteSheet(sh);
    } catch (err) {
      try {
        sh.clear();
        rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh, 1, 1);
        sh.hideSheet();
      } catch (ignore) {}
    }
  });
}


function rscCompileDeleteLegacyStageSheetsV9_(keySs) {
  keySs.getSheets().forEach(function (sh) {
    const name = String(sh.getName() || '');
    if (name.indexOf('_RSC_STG_') !== 0) return;
    try {
      keySs.deleteSheet(sh);
    } catch (err) {
      try {
        sh.clear();
        rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh, 1, 1);
        sh.hideSheet();
      } catch (ignore) {}
    }
  });
}



function rscCompileCleanseTargetStagingSheetsV10_(targetSs, job, cfg, reason) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const result = {
    reason: String(reason || ''),
    deleted: 0,
    cleared: 0,
    skipped: 0,
    estimatedCellsReleased: 0,
    sheetNames: [],
    errors: []
  };

  if (!P.targetStagingCleanupEnabled || !targetSs) return result;

  const protectedNames = Object.create(null);
  (P.outputSheets || []).forEach(function (item) {
    protectedNames[String(item.outputSheetName || '').toUpperCase()] = true;
  });
  protectedNames[String(P.detailLogSheetName || '').toUpperCase()] = true;

  const ids = (P.targetStagingSheetIds || []).map(function (id) {
    return Number(id);
  }).filter(function (id) {
    return isFinite(id) && id > 0;
  });

  const exactNames = (P.targetStagingSheetNames || []).map(function (name) {
    return String(name || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  }).filter(Boolean);

  const prefixes = (P.targetStagingSheetNamePrefixes || []).map(function (name) {
    return String(name || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  }).filter(Boolean);

  const candidatesById = Object.create(null);

  targetSs.getSheets().forEach(function (sh) {
    const id = Number(sh.getSheetId());
    const name = String(sh.getName() || '');
    const upper = name.toUpperCase();

    const matchedById = ids.indexOf(id) !== -1;
    const matchedByName = exactNames.indexOf(upper) !== -1;
    const matchedByPrefix = prefixes.some(function (prefix) {
      return upper.indexOf(prefix) === 0;
    });

    if (!matchedById && !matchedByName && !matchedByPrefix) return;

    if (protectedNames[upper]) {
      result.skipped++;
      result.errors.push('Managed output/log skipped: ' + name);
      return;
    }

    candidatesById[String(id)] = sh;
  });

  Object.keys(candidatesById).forEach(function (idKey) {
    const sh = candidatesById[idKey];
    const name = String(sh.getName() || '');
    let cells = 0;

    try {
      cells = Number(sh.getMaxRows() || 0) * Number(sh.getMaxColumns() || 0);
    } catch (ignoreSize) {}

    // Best effort remove editable protections so delete/clear can release cells.
    try {
      [SpreadsheetApp.ProtectionType.SHEET, SpreadsheetApp.ProtectionType.RANGE]
        .forEach(function (type) {
          (sh.getProtections(type) || []).forEach(function (protection) {
            try {
              if (!protection.canEdit || protection.canEdit()) protection.remove();
            } catch (ignoreProtection) {}
          });
        });
    } catch (ignoreProtectionScan) {}

    try {
      if (targetSs.getSheets().length > 1) {
        targetSs.deleteSheet(sh);
        result.deleted++;
        result.estimatedCellsReleased += cells;
        result.sheetNames.push(name + ' [deleted]');
        return;
      }
    } catch (deleteErr) {
      result.errors.push(
        'Delete failed ' + name + ': ' + formatScriptError_(deleteErr)
      );
    }

    try {
      try { sh.setFrozenRows(0); } catch (ignoreFrozenRows) {}
      try { sh.setFrozenColumns(0); } catch (ignoreFrozenCols) {}
      sh.clear();
      rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh, 1, 1);
      try { sh.hideSheet(); } catch (ignoreHide) {}

      result.cleared++;
      result.estimatedCellsReleased += Math.max(0, cells - 1);
      result.sheetNames.push(name + ' [cleared+trimmed]');
    } catch (clearErr) {
      result.skipped++;
      result.errors.push(
        'Clear failed ' + name + ': ' + formatScriptError_(clearErr)
      );
    }
  });

  if (job && job.stats) {
    job.stats.targetStagingCleanupLastResult = {
