      at: new Date().toISOString(),
      reason: result.reason,
      deleted: result.deleted,
      cleared: result.cleared,
      skipped: result.skipped,
      estimatedCellsReleased: result.estimatedCellsReleased,
      sheetNames: result.sheetNames.slice(0, 20),
      errors: result.errors.slice(0, 10)
    };
  }

  return result;
}

function rscCompileIsPermanentCapacityErrorV9_(errText) {
  const s = String(errText || '').toLowerCase();
  return (
    s.indexOf('above the limit of 10000000 cells') !== -1 ||
    s.indexOf('increase the number of cells') !== -1 ||
    s.indexOf('requested data exceeds the maximum allowed size') !== -1 ||
    s.indexOf('maximum allowed size') !== -1 ||
    s.indexOf('too many cells') !== -1
  );
}



function RSC_RECOVER_COMPILE_CAPACITY_V9_20260722() {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const raw = props.getProperty(P.pJob);

  if (raw) {
    try {
      const job = JSON.parse(raw);
      job.phase = 'STOPPED_FOR_CAPACITY_RECOVERY_V9';
      job.lastErrorAt = new Date().toISOString();
      if (job.stats) {
        job.stats.phase = job.phase;
        job.stats.lastErrorAt = job.lastErrorAt;
      }
      props.setProperty(P.pLastStats, JSON.stringify(job.stats || job));
    } catch (err) {
      props.setProperty(P.pLastStats, raw);
    }
  }

  props.deleteProperty(P.pJob);
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);

  if (P.targetStagingCleanupOnRecovery) {
    const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
    rscCompileCleanseTargetStagingSheetsV10_(
      targetSs, null, null, 'CAPACITY_RECOVERY'
    );
  }

  const keySs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.keySpreadsheetId);
  rscCompileDeleteLegacyStageSheetsV9_(keySs);
  rscCompileDeleteAllTargetKeySheetsV9_(keySs);

  const meta = rscCompileGetOrCreateMetaSheet_(keySs);
  rscCompileEnsureMetaHeader_(meta);
  rscCompileTrimSheetToUsedRange_(meta);
  try { meta.hideSheet(); } catch (err) {}

  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
    'Recovery capacity V9 selesai.\n\n' +
    '1. Trigger compile lama sudah dihentikan.\n' +
    '2. Checkpoint job aktif sudah dihapus.\n' +
    '3. STAGING legacy pada output target (gid 1967759597) sudah dihapus/ditrim.\n' +
    '4. _RSC_STG_* dan _RSC_TARGET_KEYS_* sementara sudah dibersihkan.\n' +
    '5. _RSC_EXISTING_KEYS dipertahankan/diubah ke schema compact V9.\n\n' +
    'Sekarang jalankan Start Compile ALL 4 dari awal menggunakan script V9.'
  );
}



/* ============================================================
 * V12 SERIALIZED CHECKPOINT + DUPLICATE FINALIZE GUARD
 * ========================================================== */

function rscCompileFinalizeMarkerPrefixV12_() {
  return 'RSC_COMPILE_FINALIZE_COMMIT_V12_';
}


function rscCompileFinalizeMarkerKeyV12_(job, cfg) {
  const runId = String(job && job.runId || '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g, '_');
  const cfgKey = String(cfg && cfg.key || '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g, '_');
  return rscCompileFinalizeMarkerPrefixV12_() + runId + '_' + cfgKey;
}


function rscCompileClearFinalizeCommitMarkersV12_() {
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const all = props.getProperties();
  const prefix = rscCompileFinalizeMarkerPrefixV12_();

  Object.keys(all).forEach(function (key) {
    if (String(key).indexOf(prefix) === 0) {
      try { props.deleteProperty(key); } catch (ignoreDelete) {}
    }
  });
}


function rscCompileWriteFinalizeCommitMarkerV12_(job, cfg, syncResult) {
  const marker = {
    version: 12,
    runId: String(job && job.runId || ''),
    configKey: String(cfg && cfg.key || ''),
    committedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    outputRows: Number(syncResult && syncResult.outputRows || 0),
    inserted: Number(syncResult && syncResult.inserted || 0),
    updated: Number(syncResult && syncResult.updated || 0),
    deleted: Number(syncResult && syncResult.deleted || 0),
    unchanged: Number(syncResult && syncResult.unchanged || 0),
    source: 'DOCUMENT_PROPERTY_COMMIT_MARKER_V12'
  };

  PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().setProperty(
    rscCompileFinalizeMarkerKeyV12_(job, cfg),
    JSON.stringify(marker)
  );

  return marker;
}


function rscCompileReadFinalizeCommitPropertyV12_(job, cfg) {
  try {
    const raw = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().getProperty(
      rscCompileFinalizeMarkerKeyV12_(job, cfg)
    );
    if (!raw) return null;

    const marker = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (
      String(marker.runId || '') !== String(job && job.runId || '') ||
      String(marker.configKey || '') !== String(cfg && cfg.key || '')
    ) {
      return null;
    }
    return marker;
  } catch (ignoreRead) {
    return null;
  }
}


function rscCompileFindFinalizeCommitInLogV12_(targetSs, job, cfg) {
  try {
    const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
    const sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(P.detailLogSheetName);
    if (!sh || sh.getLastRow() < 2) return null;

    // Columns B:E = Run ID, Level, Event/Phase, Config Key.
    // Read only the tail so this remains cheap even when the log is large.
    const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
    const maxRows = 5000;
    const startRow = Math.max(2, lastRow - maxRows + 1);
    const values = sh.getRange(
      startRow, 2, lastRow - startRow + 1, 4
    ).getDisplayValues();

    const runId = String(job && job.runId || '');
    const cfgKey = String(cfg && cfg.key || '');

    for (let i = values.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const row = values[i];
      if (
        String(row[0] || '') === runId &&
        String(row[2] || '') === 'FINALIZE_OK' &&
        String(row[3] || '') === cfgKey
      ) {
        return {
          version: 12,
          runId: runId,
          configKey: cfgKey,
          committedAt: '',
          outputRows: 0,
          source: 'DETAIL_LOG_FINALIZE_OK_V12_RECOVERY'
        };
      }
    }
  } catch (ignoreLogRead) {}

  return null;
}


function rscCompileGetFinalizeCommitMarkerV12_(targetSs, job, cfg) {
  return rscCompileReadFinalizeCommitPropertyV12_(job, cfg) ||
    rscCompileFindFinalizeCommitInLogV12_(targetSs, job, cfg);
}


function rscCompileSetFinalizeStatsV12_(job, cfgKey, syncResult) {
  if (!job || !job.stats || !job.stats.configs ||
      !job.stats.configs[cfgKey]) return;

  const stats = job.stats.configs[cfgKey];
  stats.outputRows = Number(syncResult && syncResult.outputRows || 0);
  stats.inserted = Number(syncResult && syncResult.inserted || 0);
  stats.updated = Number(syncResult && syncResult.updated || 0);
  stats.deleted = Number(syncResult && syncResult.deleted || 0);
  stats.unchanged = Number(syncResult && syncResult.unchanged || 0);
  stats.duplicateKeysCollapsed =
    Number(syncResult && syncResult.duplicateKeysCollapsed || 0);
  stats.finalizeCommittedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  stats.finalizeEngine = 'SERIALIZED_V12';
}


function rscCompileScheduleLockBusyWithoutCheckpointV12_() {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const delay = Math.max(
    Number(P.minTriggerDelayMs || 60000),
    Number(P.triggerDelayMs || 60000)
  );

  // Critical: do NOT call rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_ here. This execution
  // never acquired the lock, so any job object it read could already be stale.
  try {
    scheduleTimeDrivenTrigger_(P.fn, delay);
  } catch (err) {
    try {
      writeRollingSalesCenterLog_(
        'V12 lock-busy trigger scheduling failed: ' + formatScriptError_(err)
      );
    } catch (ignoreLog) {}
  }
}


function repairDuplicateFinalizeCheckpointV12_() {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(5000)) {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
      'Job masih memakai lock. Tunggu execution aktif selesai, lalu jalankan repair lagi.'
    );
    return;
  }

  try {
    const raw = props.getProperty(P.pJob);
    if (!raw) {
      SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Tidak ada current Compile Approved Links job.');
      return;
    }

    const job = JSON.parse(raw);
    const cfg = rscCompileGetConfigByKey_(
      job.configKeys && job.configKeys[Number(job.configIndex || 0)]
    );

    if (!cfg) {
      SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
        'Config aktif tidak ditemukan. Tidak ada checkpoint finalize yang perlu diperbaiki.'
      );
      return;
    }

    const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
    const marker = rscCompileGetFinalizeCommitMarkerV12_(targetSs, job, cfg);

    if (!marker) {
      SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
        'Belum ditemukan FINALIZE_OK untuk run/config aktif. Checkpoint tidak diubah.'
      );
      return;
    }

    rscCompileWriteFinalizeCommitMarkerV12_(job, cfg, {
      outputRows: Number(marker.outputRows || 0)
    });

    job.pendingFinalizedConfigKey = cfg.key;
    job.pendingFinalizeCommittedAt =
      String(marker.committedAt || new Date().toISOString());
    job.phase = 'CLEANSE_TARGET_STAGING';
    job.nextTriggerReason = 'V12_REPAIR_SKIP_DUPLICATE_FINALIZE';

    if (job.stats) {
      job.stats.phase = job.phase;
      job.stats.pendingFinalizedConfigKey = cfg.key;
      job.stats.pendingFinalizeCommittedAt = job.pendingFinalizeCommittedAt;
      job.stats.nextTriggerReason = job.nextTriggerReason;
    }

    rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
    deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);
    scheduleTimeDrivenTrigger_(
      P.fn,
      Math.max(
        Number(P.minTriggerDelayMs || 60000),
        Number(P.triggerDelayMs || 60000)
      )
    );

    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
      'Checkpoint V12 diperbaiki.\n\n' +
      'Run: ' + String(job.runId || '-') + '\n' +
      'Config: ' + cfg.key + '\n' +
      'Phase diarahkan ke CLEANSE_TARGET_STAGING.\n' +
      'Finalize yang sudah committed tidak akan dijalankan ulang.'
    );
  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (ignoreRelease) {}
  }
}


/* ============================================================
 * JOB / STATUS / STOP
 * ========================================================== */


function rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job) {
  if (!job) return;

  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  job.lastHeartbeatAt = new Date().toISOString();

  if (job.stats) {
    job.stats.lastHeartbeatAt = job.lastHeartbeatAt;
    job.stats.phase = job.phase || '';
    job.stats.configIndex = Number(job.configIndex || 0);
    job.stats.linkIndex = Number(job.linkIndex || 0);
    job.stats.finalizeIndex = Number(job.finalizeIndex || 0);
    job.stats.runChunks = Number(job.runChunks || 0);
    job.stats.nextTriggerAtApprox = job.nextTriggerAtApprox || '';
    job.stats.nextTriggerReason = job.nextTriggerReason || '';
    job.stats.currentStageProgress = job.currentStageProgress || null;
    job.stats.lastCommittedBusinessKeyByConfig =
      job.lastCommittedBusinessKeyByConfig || {};
    job.stats.lastCommittedStageRowByConfig =
      job.lastCommittedStageRowByConfig || {};
  }

  // Checkpoint disimpan setelah setiap chunk target key. Target/existing key
  // sendiri tidak disimpan di Properties, melainkan di fixed key spreadsheet.
  props.setProperty(P.pJob, JSON.stringify(job));
}


function rscCompileScheduleContinuation_(job, reason) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const delay = Math.max(
    Number(P.minTriggerDelayMs || 60000),
    Number(P.triggerDelayMs || 60000)
  );
  if (job) {
    job.nextTriggerReason = String(reason || 'CONTINUE');
    job.nextTriggerAtApprox = new Date(Date.now() + delay).toISOString();
    rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
  }
  scheduleTimeDrivenTrigger_(P.fn, delay);
}


function rscCompileScheduleWatchdogContinuation_(job, reason) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const delay = Math.max(
    Number(P.minTriggerDelayMs || 60000),
    Number(P.watchdogDelayMs || (5 * 60 * 1000))
  );
  if (job) {
    job.nextTriggerReason = String(reason || 'WATCHDOG');
    job.nextTriggerAtApprox = new Date(Date.now() + delay).toISOString();
    rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
  }
  scheduleTimeDrivenTrigger_(P.fn, delay);
}

      ? stats.manifestLinkCount

    (stats.finalizeIndex != null ? stats.finalizeIndex : (obj.finalizeIndex != null ? obj.finalizeIndex : '-')));

  lines.push('Last heartbeat: ' + (stats.lastHeartbeatAt || obj.lastHeartbeatAt || '-'));
  lines.push('Next trigger: ' + (stats.nextTriggerAtApprox || obj.nextTriggerAtApprox || '-'));
  lines.push('Next reason: ' + (stats.nextTriggerReason || obj.nextTriggerReason || '-'));
  lines.push('Target STAGING cleanup: gid 1967759597 + name STAGING; pre-finalize dan post-commit aktif');
  if (stats.targetStagingCleanupLastResult) {
    const c = stats.targetStagingCleanupLastResult;
    lines.push('Last STAGING cleanup: ' + (c.at || '-') +
      ' | reason=' + (c.reason || '-') +
      ' | deleted=' + Number(c.deleted || 0) +
      ' | cleared=' + Number(c.cleared || 0) +
      ' | released~=' + Number(c.estimatedCellsReleased || 0) + ' cells');
  }

  const progress = obj.currentStageProgress || stats.currentStageProgress;
  if (progress) {
    lines.push(
      'Current key progress: config=' + (progress.configKey || '-') +
      ', file=' + (progress.fileId || '-') +
      ', next source offset=' + Number(progress.nextSourceOffset || 0) +
      '/' + Number(progress.totalSourceRows || 0) +
      ', last key=' + (progress.lastBusinessKey || '-')
    );
  }

  if (stats.lastError || obj.lastError) {
    lines.push('Last error: ' + (stats.lastError || obj.lastError));
  }

  lines.push('');

  Object.keys(stats.configs || {}).forEach(function (key) {
    const s = stats.configs[key];
    lines.push(
      s.label +
      ' | existing start=' + Number(s.existingKeyCountAtStart || 0) +
      ' (' + String(s.existingKeySourceAtStart || 'FIXED_KEY_STORE') + ')' +

      ' | insert=' + Number(s.inserted || 0) +
      ' | update=' + Number(s.updated || 0) +

    'Status Compile Approved Links\n\n' + lines.join('\n')

function stopCompileApprovedLinksJob() {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const raw = props.getProperty(P.pJob);
  let job = null;
  if (raw) {
    try {
      job = JSON.parse(raw);
      props.setProperty(P.pLastStats, JSON.stringify(job.stats || job));
      const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
      if (P.targetStagingCleanupOnStop) {
        rscCompileCleanseTargetStagingSheetsV10_(
          targetSs, job, null, 'STOP_JOB'
        );
      }
      const supportSs = rscCompileOpenSupportSpreadsheetForJob_(job, targetSs);
      rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'WARN', 'JOB_STOP', null, {
        targetSs: targetSs,
        status: 'STOPPED_BY_USER',
        message: 'Compile Approved Links stopped manually. Last phase=' + (job.phase || '-') +
          ', configIndex=' + (job.configIndex || '-') + ', linkIndex=' + (job.linkIndex || '-')
      });
      rscCompileFlushDetailLogBuffer_(targetSs);

      // Partial staging tidak dibutuhkan setelah STOP dan hanya memakan sel.
      rscCompileDeleteStagingSheetsForKeys_(supportSs, job.configKeys || []);
    } catch (logErr) {}
  }

  props.deleteProperty(P.pJob);
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);

  SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
    'Compile Approved Links dihentikan. Checkpoint dan partial staging dibersihkan.',
    'Rolling Sales Center',
    7
  );
}



function finishCompileApprovedLinksJob_(job, message) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  job.stats.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  job.stats.phase = 'FINISHED';

  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.setProperty(P.pLastStats, JSON.stringify(job.stats));
  props.deleteProperty(P.pJob);
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);

  try {
    const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
    rscCompileCleanseTargetStagingSheetsV10_(
      targetSs, job, null, 'RUN_FINISH'
    );
    const keySs = rscCompileOpenSupportSpreadsheetForJob_(job, targetSs);

    // Target key terakhir dipertahankan di fixed key spreadsheet sebagai
    // audit snapshot. Start berikutnya akan recreate sheet ini dari nol.
    (job.configKeys || []).forEach(function (key) {
      const cfg = rscCompileGetConfigByKey_(key);
      if (!cfg) return;
      const targetKeySh = keySs.getSheetByName(rscCompileGetStagingSheetName_(cfg));
      if (targetKeySh) {
        rscCompileTrimSheetToUsedRange_(targetKeySh);
        try { targetKeySh.hideSheet(); } catch (err) {}
      }
    });

    const existingKeySh = keySs.getSheetByName(rscCompileGetMetaSheetName_());
    if (existingKeySh) {
      rscCompileTrimSheetToUsedRange_(existingKeySh);
      try { existingKeySh.hideSheet(); } catch (err) {}
    }

    rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, 'INFO', 'RUN_FINISH', null, {
      targetSs: targetSs,
      status: 'FINISHED',
      message: message +
        ' Existing key dan target key snapshot tersimpan di fixed key spreadsheet=' +
        keySs.getId()
    });
    rscCompileFlushDetailLogBuffer_(targetSs);
    rscCompilePruneDetailLog_(targetSs);
  } catch (err) {}

  writeRollingSalesCenterLog_(message);
  rscCompileToast_(message);
}


function buildCompileApprovedLinksFinishMessage_(job) {
  const parts = [];
  Object.keys(job.stats.configs || {}).forEach(function (key) {
    const s = job.stats.configs[key];
    parts.push(
      s.label +
      ': links=' + (s.linksProcessed || 0) + '/' + (s.linksTotal || job.manifestLinkCount || '-') +
      ', file OK=' + s.filesOk +
      ', skip=' + s.skipped +
      ', error=' + s.errors +
      ', source=' + s.sourceRows +
      ', output=' + (s.outputRows || 0) +
      ', insert=' + (s.inserted || 0) +
      ', update=' + (s.updated || 0) +
      ', delete=' + (s.deleted || 0) +
      ', unchanged=' + (s.unchanged || 0)
    );
  });
  return 'Compile/Sync Approved Links SELESAI. Manifest active links=' + (job.manifestLinkCount || 0) + '. ' + parts.join(' | ');
}


function showCompileApprovedLinksDetailLogSheet() {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
  rscCompileFlushDetailLogBuffer_(targetSs);
  const logSh = rscCompilePrepareDetailLogSheet_(targetSs);
  try { logSh.showSheet(); } catch (err) {}

  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
    'Detail log compile tersedia di target spreadsheet.\n\n' +
    'Target Spreadsheet ID: ' + P.targetSpreadsheetId + '\n' +
    'Sheet log: ' + logSh.getName() + '\n\n' +
    'Buka target spreadsheet lalu cek sheet tersebut untuk melihat master row, file ID, source sheet, header row, staged row, insert/update/delete, dan error detail.'
  );
}


function clearCompileApprovedLinksDetailLogSheet() {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
  __RSC_COMPILE_DETAIL_LOG_BUFFER__ = [];
  __RSC_COMPILE_DETAIL_LOG_TARGET_ID__ = '';
  const logSh = rscCompilePrepareDetailLogSheet_(targetSs);
  logSh.clear();
  rscCompileWriteDetailLogHeader_(logSh);
  try { logSh.showSheet(); } catch (err) {}

  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Detail log compile sudah dikosongkan di sheet: ' + logSh.getName());
}


/* ============================================================
 * HOUSEKEEPING / CLEANUP > 10 HARI
 * ========================================================== */

function cleanupCompileStorageOlderThan10Days() {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const days = Math.max(1, Number(P.cleanupRetentionDays || 10));
  const cutoffMs = Date.now() - days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  const ui = SpreadsheetApp.getUi();

  const response = ui.alert(
    'Cleanse Storage Compile',
    'Hapus log RUN_ID, property checkpoint legacy, dan staging legacy yang lebih tua dari ' +
      days + ' hari?\n\nExisting business key dan snapshot target key aktif di fixed key spreadsheet TIDAK dihapus. Output compile juga tidak dihapus.',
    ui.ButtonSet.YES_NO
  );
  if (response !== ui.Button.YES) return;

  const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const activeRaw = props.getProperty(P.pJob);
  let activeJob = null;
  try { activeJob = activeRaw ? JSON.parse(activeRaw) : null; } catch (err) {}

  const activeStartedMs = rscCompileGetJobStartedMs_(activeJob);
  const protectActive = !!activeJob && activeStartedMs && activeStartedMs >= cutoffMs;
  let staleActiveJobRemoved = 0;
  if (activeJob && !protectActive && activeStartedMs && activeStartedMs < cutoffMs) {
    props.deleteProperty(P.pJob);
    deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);
    staleActiveJobRemoved = 1;
  }

  const protectedRunIds = {};
  const protectedOutputSheets = {};
  const protectedStageNames = {};

  if (protectActive) {
    const activeRunId = String(activeJob.runId || (activeJob.stats && activeJob.stats.runId) || '');
    if (activeRunId) protectedRunIds[activeRunId] = true;
    (activeJob.configKeys || []).forEach(function (key) {
      const cfg = rscCompileGetConfigByKey_(key);
      if (!cfg) return;
      protectedOutputSheets[cfg.outputSheetName] = true;
      protectedStageNames[rscCompileGetStagingSheetName_(cfg)] = true;
    });
  }

  const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
  const masterSs = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const supportSs = rscCompileGetOrCreateSupportSpreadsheet_(masterSs, targetSs);
  rscCompileMigrateLegacyMetaToSupport_(targetSs, supportSs, props);
  rscCompileFlushDetailLogBuffer_(targetSs);

  const logResult = rscCompileCleanupOldDetailLogRows_(
    targetSs, cutoffMs, protectedRunIds
  );
  const metaResult = rscCompileCleanupOldMetaRows_(
    supportSs, cutoffMs, protectedOutputSheets
  );
  const stageResult = rscCompileCleanupOldStagingSheets_(
    supportSs, protectedStageNames
  );
  const propertyResult = rscCompileCleanupLegacyCompileProperties_(
    props, cutoffMs, protectedRunIds
  );

  // Pangkas grid kosong semua output/support sheet tanpa menghapus isi.
  rscCompileTrimManagedOutputSheets_(
    targetSs,
    APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.outputSheets || []
  );
  rscCompileTrimSupportSheets_(supportSs);

  ui.alert(
    'Cleanse selesai.\n\n' +
    'Log lama dihapus: ' + logResult.removedRows + ' baris dari ' +
      logResult.removedRunIds + ' RUN_ID\n' +
    'Existing business key persistent dipertahankan: ' + Number(metaResult.retainedPersistentExistingKeys || 0) + ' key\n' +
    'Schema existing key 12 kolom: ' + (metaResult.compacted ? 'dirapikan' : 'sudah sesuai') + '\n' +
    'Staging legacy dihapus: ' + stageResult.deletedSheets + ' sheet\n' +
    'Target key snapshot aktif dipertahankan: ' + Number(stageResult.retainedTargetSnapshots || 0) + ' sheet\n' +
    'Property checkpoint legacy dihapus: ' + propertyResult.deletedProperties + '\n' +
    'Checkpoint job aktif yang stale dihapus: ' + staleActiveJobRemoved + '\n' +
    'Support Spreadsheet ID: ' + supportSs.getId() + '\n' +
    'Run aktif <=' + days + ' hari dipertahankan: ' + (protectActive ? 'YA' : 'tidak ada')
  );
}


function rscCompileGuardStartAgainstRecentJob_(props) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const raw = props.getProperty(P.pJob);
  if (!raw) return;

  let job = null;
  try { job = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (err) {
    props.deleteProperty(P.pJob);
    deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);
    return;
  }

  const days = Math.max(1, Number(P.cleanupRetentionDays || 10));
  const cutoffMs = Date.now() - days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  const startedMs = rscCompileGetJobStartedMs_(job);

  if (!startedMs || startedMs >= cutoffMs) {
    throw new Error(
      'Masih ada job compile aktif/recent dengan RUN_ID=' +
      String(job.runId || (job.stats && job.stats.runId) || '-') +
      '. Gunakan Continue, atau STOP terlebih dahulu sebelum memulai job baru.'
    );
  }

  // Checkpoint terbukti stale > retention: aman dibuang sebelum start baru.
  props.deleteProperty(P.pJob);
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_([P.fn]);
}


function rscCompileGetJobStartedMs_(job) {
  if (!job) return 0;
  const iso = (job.stats && job.stats.startedAt) || job.startedAt || '';
  const isoMs = Date.parse(iso);
  if (!isNaN(isoMs)) return isoMs;
  return rscCompileParseRunIdMs_(job.runId || (job.stats && job.stats.runId) || '');
}


function rscCompileParseRunIdMs_(runId) {
  const m = String(runId || '').match(/^(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})-(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})/);
  if (!m) return 0;
  const d = new Date(
    Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3]),
    Number(m[4]), Number(m[5]), Number(m[6])
  );
  return d.getTime();
}


function rscCompileCleanupOldDetailLogRows_(targetSs, cutoffMs, protectedRunIds) {
  const sh = rscCompilePrepareDetailLogSheet_(targetSs);
  const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  if (lastRow < 2) return { removedRows: 0, removedRunIds: 0 };

  const values = sh.getRange(1, 1, lastRow, lastCol).getDisplayValues();
  const header = values[0];
  const timestampIdx = header.indexOf('TIMESTAMP');
  const runIdIdx = header.indexOf('RUN_ID');
  const runStartById = Object.create(null);

  // Tentukan start setiap RUN_ID. Format RUN_ID sendiri paling akurat karena
  // log RUN_START mungkin sudah pernah dipruning.
  for (let i = 1; i < values.length; i++) {
    const row = values[i];
    const runId = runIdIdx >= 0 ? String(row[runIdIdx] || '') : '';
    if (!runId) continue;
    let startMs = rscCompileParseRunIdMs_(runId);
    if (!startMs && timestampIdx >= 0) startMs = Date.parse(row[timestampIdx]);
    if (!startMs || isNaN(startMs)) continue;
    if (!runStartById[runId] || startMs < runStartById[runId]) {
      runStartById[runId] = startMs;
    }
  }

  const keep = [header];
  const removedRunIds = Object.create(null);
  let removed = 0;

  for (let i = 1; i < values.length; i++) {
    const row = values[i];
    const runId = runIdIdx >= 0 ? String(row[runIdIdx] || '') : '';
    let startMs = runId ? Number(runStartById[runId] || 0) : 0;
    if (!startMs && timestampIdx >= 0) startMs = Date.parse(row[timestampIdx]);

    // Tanggal tak dapat dibuktikan tua -> pertahankan secara konservatif.
    if (protectedRunIds[runId] || !startMs || isNaN(startMs) || startMs >= cutoffMs) {
      keep.push(row);
    } else {
      removed++;
      if (runId) removedRunIds[runId] = true;
    }
  }

  sh.clear();
  rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(sh, Math.max(1, keep.length), Math.max(1, header.length));
  sh.getRange(1, 1, keep.length, header.length).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(keep);
  rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh, Math.max(1, keep.length), Math.max(1, header.length));
  return {
    removedRows: removed,
    removedRunIds: Object.keys(removedRunIds).length
  };
}


function rscCompileCleanupOldMetaRows_(keySs, cutoffMs, protectedOutputSheets) {
  // Existing key adalah state persistent untuk UPSERT/PURGE dan tidak boleh
  // dihapus hanya karena umur UPDATED_AT. Cleanup hanya memastikan schema
  // dan memangkas grid kosong.
  const sh = keySs.getSheetByName(rscCompileGetMetaSheetName_());
  if (!sh) return { removedRows: 0, compacted: false };

  const beforeCols = sh.getMaxColumns();
  rscCompileEnsureMetaHeader_(sh);
  rscCompileTrimSheetToUsedRange_(sh);
  try { sh.hideSheet(); } catch (err) {}

  return {
    removedRows: 0,
    compacted: beforeCols > 12,
    retainedPersistentExistingKeys: Math.max(0, sh.getLastRow() - 1)
  };
}



function rscCompileCleanupOldStagingSheets_(keySs, protectedStageNames) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const currentTargetNames = Object.create(null);
  (P.outputSheets || []).forEach(function (cfg) {
    currentTargetNames[rscCompileGetStagingSheetName_(cfg)] = true;
  });

  let deleted = 0;
  let retainedTargetSnapshots = 0;

  keySs.getSheets().forEach(function (sh) {
    const name = sh.getName();

    // Snapshot target key aktif wajib tetap berada di fixed key spreadsheet.
    // Cleanse hanya menghapus staging legacy yang tidak lagi dipakai.
    if (currentTargetNames[name]) {
      retainedTargetSnapshots++;
      rscCompileTrimSheetToUsedRange_(sh);
      try { sh.hideSheet(); } catch (err) {}
      return;
    }

    if (name.indexOf('_RSC_STG_') !== 0) return;
    if (protectedStageNames[name]) return;

    try {
      keySs.deleteSheet(sh);
      deleted++;
    } catch (err) {}
  });

  return {
    deletedSheets: deleted,
    retainedTargetSnapshots: retainedTargetSnapshots
  };
}


function rscCompileCleanupLegacyCompileProperties_(props, cutoffMs, protectedRunIds) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const all = props.getProperties();
  let deleted = 0;

  Object.keys(all).forEach(function (name) {
    if (name === P.pJob || name === P.pLastStats) return;
    if (!/COMPILE/i.test(name) || !/(RUN|JOB|CHECKPOINT|STATS|MANIFEST|KEY)/i.test(name)) return;

    let obj = null;
    try { obj = JSON.parse(all[name]); } catch (err) { return; }
    const runId = String((obj && (obj.runId || (obj.stats && obj.stats.runId))) || '');
    if (protectedRunIds[runId]) return;

    const startedMs = rscCompileGetJobStartedMs_(obj);
    if (startedMs && startedMs < cutoffMs) {
      props.deleteProperty(name);
      deleted++;
    }
  });

  return { deletedProperties: deleted };
}


/* ============================================================
 * DETAIL LOG
 * ========================================================== */

function rscCompileBuildRunId_() {
  let tz = 'Asia/Jakarta';
  try { tz = Session.getScriptTimeZone() || tz; } catch (err) {}
  return Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), tz, 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss') + '-' +
    Math.floor(Math.random() * 10000);
}


function rscCompileGetDetailLogHeaders_() {
  return [
    'TIMESTAMP', 'RUN_ID', 'LEVEL', 'PHASE', 'CONFIG_KEY', 'CONFIG_LABEL',
    'MASTER_ROW', 'SOURCE_FILE_ID', 'SOURCE_SPREADSHEET_NAME', 'SOURCE_SHEET_NAME',
    'TARGET_SHEET_NAME', 'HEADER_ROW', 'HEADER_DETECT_MODE', 'SOURCE_ROWS',
    'STAGED_ROWS', 'OUTPUT_ROWS', 'INSERTED', 'UPDATED', 'DELETED', 'UNCHANGED',
    'DUPLICATE_KEYS_COLLAPSED', 'STATUS', 'MESSAGE'
  ];
}


function rscCompilePrepareDetailLogSheet_(targetSs) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const name = P.detailLogSheetName || '_RSC_COMPILE_DETAIL_LOG';
  let sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(name);
  if (!sh) sh = targetSs.insertSheet(name);
  rscCompileWriteDetailLogHeader_(sh);
  try { sh.setFrozenRows(1); } catch (err) {}
  return sh;
}


function rscCompileWriteDetailLogHeader_(sh) {
  const headers = rscCompileGetDetailLogHeaders_();
  rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(sh, 1, headers.length);
  const current = sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).getDisplayValues()[0].join('|');
  if (current !== headers.join('|')) {
    sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setNumberFormat('@').setValues([headers]);
  }
}


function rscCompileLogValue_(value) {
  return (value === 0 || value === '0') ? '0' : (value || '');
}


function rscCompileAppendDetailLog_(job, level, phase, cfg, detail) {
  try {
    const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
    detail = detail || {};
    const targetSs = detail.targetSs || RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
    const targetId = targetSs.getId();

    if (__RSC_COMPILE_DETAIL_LOG_TARGET_ID__ &&
        __RSC_COMPILE_DETAIL_LOG_TARGET_ID__ !== targetId) {
      rscCompileFlushDetailLogBuffer_();
    }
    __RSC_COMPILE_DETAIL_LOG_TARGET_ID__ = targetId;

    const row = [
      new Date().toISOString(),
      (job && (job.runId || (job.stats && job.stats.runId))) || '',
      level || '',
      phase || '',
      cfg ? cfg.key : (detail.configKey || ''),
      cfg ? cfg.menuLabel : (detail.configLabel || ''),
      rscCompileLogValue_(detail.masterRow),
      detail.sourceFileId || '',
      detail.sourceSpreadsheetName || '',
      detail.sourceSheetName || '',
      cfg ? cfg.outputSheetName : (detail.targetSheetName || ''),
      rscCompileLogValue_(detail.headerRow),
      detail.headerDetectMode || '',
      rscCompileLogValue_(detail.sourceRows),
      rscCompileLogValue_(detail.stagedRows),
      rscCompileLogValue_(detail.outputRows),
      rscCompileLogValue_(detail.inserted),
      rscCompileLogValue_(detail.updated),
      rscCompileLogValue_(detail.deleted),
      rscCompileLogValue_(detail.unchanged),
      rscCompileLogValue_(detail.duplicateKeysCollapsed),
      detail.status || '',
      detail.message || ''
    ].map(rscCompileNormalizeLogCell_);

    __RSC_COMPILE_DETAIL_LOG_BUFFER__.push(row);
    if (__RSC_COMPILE_DETAIL_LOG_BUFFER__.length >= Number(P.detailLogBufferRows || 25)) {
      rscCompileFlushDetailLogBuffer_(targetSs);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    try { writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('Compile detail log buffer failed: ' + formatScriptError_(err)); } catch (e) {}
  }
}


function rscCompileFlushDetailLogBuffer_(targetSs) {
  if (!__RSC_COMPILE_DETAIL_LOG_BUFFER__.length) return;

  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  if (!targetSs) {
    targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(
      __RSC_COMPILE_DETAIL_LOG_TARGET_ID__ || P.targetSpreadsheetId
    );
  }

  const rows = __RSC_COMPILE_DETAIL_LOG_BUFFER__.slice();
  const sh = rscCompilePrepareDetailLogSheet_(targetSs);
  const headers = rscCompileGetDetailLogHeaders_();
  const nextRow = sh.getLastRow() + 1;
  rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(sh, nextRow + rows.length - 1, headers.length);
  sh.getRange(nextRow, 1, rows.length, headers.length)
    .setNumberFormat('@')
    .setValues(rows);

  __RSC_COMPILE_DETAIL_LOG_BUFFER__ = [];
  __RSC_COMPILE_DETAIL_LOG_TARGET_ID__ = targetSs.getId();
}

function rscCompileNormalizeLogCell_(value) {
  let text = String(value == null ? '' : value);
  text = text.replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ');
  text = text.replace(/\t+/g, ' ');
  text = text.replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ');
  text = text.trim();
  if (text.length > 3000) text = text.slice(0, 3000) + ' ...[truncated]';
  return text;
}


function rscCompilePruneDetailLog_(targetSs) {
  try {
    const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
    const maxRows = Number(P.maxDetailLogRowsToKeep || 30000);
    if (!maxRows || maxRows < 1000) return;
    const sh = rscCompilePrepareDetailLogSheet_(targetSs);
    const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
    const maxWithHeader = maxRows + 1;
    if (lastRow > maxWithHeader) {
      const deleteCount = lastRow - maxWithHeader;
      sh.deleteRows(2, deleteCount);
    }
  } catch (err) {}
}


/* ============================================================
 * GENERIC UTILS
 * ========================================================== */

function rscCompileGetConfigsByKeys_(keys) {
  const map = {};
  APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.outputSheets.forEach(function (cfg) {
    map[cfg.key] = cfg;
  });

  return keys
    .map(function (key) { return map[key]; })
    .filter(function (cfg) { return !!cfg; });
}


function rscCompileGetConfigByKey_(key) {
  const list = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.outputSheets || [];
  for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
    if (list[i].key === key) return list[i];
  }
  return null;
}


function rscCompileResolveMasterFirstDataRow_(masterSh) {
  const P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  const scanRows = Math.min(P.masterHeaderScanRows || 30, masterSh.getLastRow());
  const lastCol = masterSh.getLastColumn();

  if (scanRows < 1 || lastCol < 1) return P.firstDataRowFallback || 2;

  const grid = masterSh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, lastCol).getDisplayValues();
  for (let r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    const row = grid[r].map(function (v) {
      return String(v == null ? '' : v).trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
    });

    for (let c = 0; c < row.length; c++) {
      if (
        row[c] === 'TEMPLATE ROLLING SALES FINAL' ||
        row[c] === 'FINAL' ||
        row[c] === 'LINK FINAL'
      ) {
        return r + 2;
      }
    }
  }

  return P.firstDataRowFallback || 2;
}


function rscCompileGetMasterLinkCellText_(cellObj) {
  const pieces = [];

  try {
    if (cellObj && cellObj.richTextValue && typeof cellObj.richTextValue.getText === 'function') {
      pieces.push(cellObj.richTextValue.getText());
    }
  } catch (err) {}

  if (cellObj) {
    pieces.push(cellObj.formula);
    pieces.push(cellObj.value);
    pieces.push(cellObj.displayValue);
  }

  return pieces
    .map(function (v) { return String(v == null ? '' : v).trim(); })
    .filter(function (v, idx, arr) { return v && arr.indexOf(v) === idx; })
    .join(' | ')
    .trim();
}


function rscCompileIsBlankMasterLinkRow_(rawText, url, chipUrl) {
  return !String(rawText || '').trim() &&
    !String(url || '').trim() &&
    !String(chipUrl || '').trim();
}


function rscCompileBuildInvalidMasterLinkMessage_(rawText, url) {
  const text = String(rawText || url || '').trim();
  if (!text) return 'Link kolom E kosong/tidak valid.';

  if (/template rolling sales final/i.test(text) || /gunakan link/i.test(text)) {
    return 'Cell kolom E berisi placeholder/header, bukan link Google Sheet.';
  }

  if (/docs\.google\.com/i.test(text) && !/\/spreadsheets\/d\//i.test(text)) {
    return 'Cell kolom E berisi URL Google, tetapi bukan URL Google Spreadsheet.';
  }

  if (!/https?:\/\//i.test(text) && !/^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]{25,}$/.test(text)) {
    return 'Cell kolom E berisi teks/file name tanpa URL yang bisa dibaca. Jika ini smart chip, aktifkan Advanced Sheets API atau ganti menjadi URL plain.';
  }

  return 'Cell kolom E non-blank tetapi Spreadsheet ID tidak bisa diekstrak.';
}


function rscCompileExtractSpreadsheetId_(urlOrId) {
  const text = String(urlOrId == null ? '' : urlOrId).trim();
  if (!text) return '';

  let m = text.match(/\/spreadsheets\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);
  if (m) return m[1];

  m = text.match(/https?:\/\/docs\.google\.com\/spreadsheets\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/i);
  if (m) return m[1];

  if (/^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]{25,}$/.test(text) && text.indexOf('/') === -1) return text;
  return '';
}


function rscCompileIncrementStat_(job, key, field, amount) {
  if (!job.stats.configs[key]) return;
  job.stats.configs[key][field] = Number(job.stats.configs[key][field] || 0) + Number(amount || 0);
}


function rscCompileToast_(message) {
  try {
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(message, 'Rolling Sales Center', 12);
  } catch (err) {}
}


function rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(row, width) {
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < width; i++) {
    out.push(rscCompileNormalizeCellValue_(row[i]));
  }
  return out;
}


function rscCompileNormalizeCellValue_(value) {
  let text = String(value == null ? '' : value);
  text = text.replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ');
  text = text.replace(/\t+/g, ' ');
  text = text.replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ');
  text = text.trim();
  text = rscCompileNormalizeDropdownDisplayValue_(text);
  return text;
}


function rscCompileNormalizeDropdownDisplayValue_(text) {
  text = String(text == null ? '' : text).trim();
  if (!text) return '';

  // Ubah dropdown display menjadi ID-only:
  // "11 - Modern Trade" -> "11", "STA1 - STA - CG Sales" -> "STA1"
  const m = text.match(/^([A-Za-z0-9]+)\s+-\s+.+$/);
  if (m) return m[1];

  return text;
}


function rscCompileEffectiveColumnCount_(header, dataRows) {
  let maxIdx = rscCompileLastNonEmptyIndex_(header || []);
  (dataRows || []).forEach(function (row) {
    maxIdx = Math.max(maxIdx, rscCompileLastNonEmptyIndex_(row || []));
  });
  return Math.max(1, maxIdx + 1);
}


function rscCompileLastNonEmptyIndex_(row) {
  for (let i = row.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    if (String(row[i] == null ? '' : row[i]).trim() !== '') return i;
  }
  return -1;
}


function rscCompileRowHasValue_(row) {
  for (let i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    if (String(row[i] == null ? '' : row[i]).trim() !== '') return true;
  }
  return false;
}


function rscCompileNormalizeHeaderKey_(value) {
  return String(value == null ? '' : value)
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase()
    .replace(/\./g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/[^A-Z0-9]+/g, '_')
    .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '');
}


function rscCompileNormalizeSheetName_(value) {
  return String(value == null ? '' : value)
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/&/g, 'and')
    .replace(/[\s_\-]+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}


function rscCompileHashString_(text) {
  text = String(text == null ? '' : text);
  let hash = 2166136261;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    hash ^= text.charCodeAt(i);
    hash += (hash << 1) + (hash << 4) + (hash << 7) + (hash << 8) + (hash << 24);
  }
  return ('00000000' + (hash >>> 0).toString(16)).slice(-8);
}


function rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(sh, minRows, minCols) {
  minRows = Math.max(1, Number(minRows || 1));
  minCols = Math.max(1, Number(minCols || 1));
  if (sh.getMaxRows() < minRows) {
    sh.insertRowsAfter(sh.getMaxRows(), minRows - sh.getMaxRows());
  }
  if (sh.getMaxColumns() < minCols) {
    sh.insertColumnsAfter(sh.getMaxColumns(), minCols - sh.getMaxColumns());
  }
}


function rscCompileGetSheetById_(ss, sheetId) {
  const sheets = ss.getSheets();
  for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (String(sheets[i].getSheetId()) === String(sheetId)) return sheets[i];
  }
  return null;
}


/* ============================================================
 * SMART CHIP RANGE READER (khusus manifest builder — robust version)
 * Catatan: fungsi ini memakai quoteSheetNameForA1_() dan
 * getColumnLetter_() yang SUDAH ADA di bagian lain script utama
 * (Module 2 — ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS). Tidak diulang
 * di sini supaya tidak ada deklarasi ganda.
 * ========================================================== */

function rscCompileGetSmartChipUrlsFromSheetRangeRobust_(spreadsheetId, sheetName, startRow, sourceCol, numRows) {
  const map = {};
  try {
    if (typeof Sheets === 'undefined') return map;
    const chunkSize = 1000;
    for (let offset = 0; offset < numRows; offset += chunkSize) {
      const chunkStart = startRow + offset;
      const chunkRows = Math.min(chunkSize, numRows - offset);
      const a1 = quoteSheetNameForA1_(sheetName) + '!' +
        getColumnLetter_(sourceCol) + chunkStart + ':' +
        getColumnLetter_(sourceCol) + (chunkStart + chunkRows - 1);

      const res = Sheets.Spreadsheets.get(spreadsheetId, {
        ranges: [a1],
        includeGridData: true,
        fields: 'sheets(data(startRow,startColumn,rowData(values(formattedValue,hyperlink,userEnteredValue,effectiveValue,textFormatRuns(format(link)),chipRuns(chip(richLinkProperties(uri)))))))'
      });

      const sheets = res.sheets || [];
      for (let s = 0; s < sheets.length; s++) {
        const dataBlocks = sheets[s].data || [];
        for (let d = 0; d < dataBlocks.length; d++) {
          const data = dataBlocks[d] || {};
          const baseRow = Number(data.startRow != null ? data.startRow : (chunkStart - 1));
          const rowData = data.rowData || [];
          for (let r = 0; r < rowData.length; r++) {
            const rowNo = baseRow + r + 1;
            const values = rowData[r].values || [];
            const cell = values[0] || {};
            let found = '';

            if (cell.hyperlink) found = cell.hyperlink;

            if (!found && cell.chipRuns) {
              for (let c = 0; c < cell.chipRuns.length; c++) {
                const chip = cell.chipRuns[c] && cell.chipRuns[c].chip;
                if (chip && chip.richLinkProperties && chip.richLinkProperties.uri) {
                  found = chip.richLinkProperties.uri;
                  break;
                }
              }
            }

            if (!found && cell.textFormatRuns) {
              for (let t = 0; t < cell.textFormatRuns.length; t++) {
                const link = cell.textFormatRuns[t] && cell.textFormatRuns[t].format && cell.textFormatRuns[t].format.link;
                if (link && link.uri) {
                  found = link.uri;
                  break;
                }
              }
            }

            if (!found) {
              const textCandidates = [
                cell.formattedValue,
                cell.userEnteredValue && cell.userEnteredValue.stringValue,
                cell.effectiveValue && cell.effectiveValue.stringValue,
                cell.userEnteredValue && cell.userEnteredValue.formulaValue
              ];
              for (let k = 0; k < textCandidates.length; k++) {
                const m = String(textCandidates[k] || '').match(/https:\/\/docs\.google\.com\/spreadsheets\/d\/[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+[^\s"',)]*/);
                if (m) { found = m[0]; break; }
              }
            }

            if (found) map[rowNo] = found;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    try { writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('Manifest smart chip robust reader failed: ' + formatScriptError_(err)); } catch (e) {}
  }
  return map;
}


/* ============================================================
 * SELF-CONTAINED SHARED HELPERS
 * Ini SALINAN dari helper private yang sudah ada di dalam IIFE
 * RSC_APP_20260611 di script utama. Disalin ke sini (nama sama)
 * supaya module compile ini bisa jalan sebagai file .gs TERPISAH
 * tanpa perlu diletakkan di dalam IIFE. Tidak ada bentrok dengan
 * versi yang di dalam IIFE karena scope-nya beda (private closure
 * vs top-level file ini).
 * ========================================================== */

function getSpreadsheetUrlFromCellObject_(cellObj) {
  const rich = cellObj.richTextValue;
  if (rich) {
    const whole = rich.getLinkUrl();
    if (whole) return whole;
    const runs = rich.getRuns();
    for (let i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      const u = runs[i].getLinkUrl();
      if (u) return u;
    }
  }

  const texts = [cellObj.formula, cellObj.value, cellObj.displayValue];

  for (let i = 0; i < texts.length; i++) {
    const m = String(texts[i] || '').match(
      /https:\/\/docs\.google\.com\/spreadsheets\/d\/[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+[^\s"',)]*/
    );
    if (m) return m[0];
  }

  return '';
}


function deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_(fnNames) {
  const set = {};
  fnNames.forEach(function (n) { set[n] = true; });

  ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(function (trigger) {
    if (set[trigger.getHandlerFunction()]) {
      ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger);
    }
  });
}

    .create();
}

function quoteSheetNameForA1_(name) {
  return "'" + String(name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "'";
}


function getColumnLetter_(col) {
  let n = Number(col), out = '';
  while (n > 0) {
    const rem = (n - 1) % 26;
    out = String.fromCharCode(65 + rem) + out;
    n = Math.floor((n - rem - 1) / 26);
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * START: Fix Reason Toko Bangkrut G/L dari DB m_bp_relation.
 * Ambil link dari kolom E sheet aktif, lalu proses background.
 */
function RSC_START_TOKO_BANGKRUT_DATES_BY_DB_20260622() {
  const P = RSC_TOKO_BANGKRUT_DB_DATE_PARAMETERS_20260622;
  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(5000)) {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
      'Belum bisa start karena ada background process lain yang masih memegang lock.\n\n' +
      'Cek Apps Script > Executions. Jika sudah tidak ada yang Running, jalankan STOP lalu START lagi.'
    );
    return;
  }

  try {
    const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    const sh = ss.getActiveSheet();

    const job = {
      sourceSpreadsheetId: ss.getId(),
      sourceSheetId: sh.getSheetId(),
      cursor: P.firstDataRow,
      startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      ok: 0,
      skip: 0,
      error: 0,
      checkedRows: 0,
      tokoRows: 0,
      updatedRows: 0,
      notFoundRows: 0,
      errorCleanedRows: 0
    };

    PropertiesService
      .getDocumentProperties()
      .setProperty(P.jobKey, JSON.stringify(job));

    RSC_TBDB_clearTriggers_();
    RSC_TBDB_scheduleNextRun_();

    ss.toast(
      'Job Fix G + Validate L Toko Bangkrut dibuat. Proses mulai otomatis ±1 menit.',
      'Rolling Sales Center',
      10
    );

    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
      [
        'Job Fix G + Validate L Toko Bangkrut berhasil dibuat.',
        '',
        'Master link: kolom E sheet aktif.',
        'Target: Change Rolling & Change Schedule.',
        'Logic: G mengikuti m_bp_relation; L hanya divalidasi ke m_visit_schedule.',
        '',
        'Proses mulai otomatis sekitar 1 menit.',
        'Cek status dari menu Status Fix G + Validate L Toko Bangkrut.'
      ].join('\n')
    );

  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (err) {}
  }
}


/**
 * CONTINUE: worker background.
 */
function RSC_CONTINUE_TOKO_BANGKRUT_DATES_BY_DB_BG_20260622() {
  const P = RSC_TOKO_BANGKRUT_DB_DATE_PARAMETERS_20260622;
  const lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(5000)) {
    RSC_TBDB_scheduleNextRun_();
    return;
  }

  try {
    const props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
    const rawJob = props.getProperty(P.jobKey);
    if (!rawJob) {
      RSC_TBDB_clearTriggers_();
      return;
    }

    const job = JSON.parse(rawJob);
    const ss = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(job.sourceSpreadsheetId);
    const sourceSh = RSC_TBDB_getSheetById_(ss, job.sourceSheetId) || ss.getActiveSheet();

    const lastRow = sourceSh.getLastRow();
    if (lastRow < P.firstDataRow || job.cursor > lastRow) {
      RSC_TBDB_finishJob_(
        'Fix G + Validate L Toko Bangkrut selesai. OK=' + job.ok +
        ', skip=' + job.skip +
        ', error=' + job.error +
        ', checked=' + job.checkedRows +
        ', toko=' + job.tokoRows +
        ', updated=' + job.updatedRows +
        ', notFound=' + job.notFoundRows +
        ', errorCleaned=' + job.errorCleanedRows + '.'
      );
      return;
    }

    const startedMs = Date.now();

    // PERF5: no eager 560k-row relation scan; each target resolves only its required triples.
    const dbMap = null;

    let processedFiles = 0;
    let currentRow = Number(job.cursor || P.firstDataRow);
    if (currentRow < P.firstDataRow) currentRow = P.firstDataRow;

    while (
      currentRow <= lastRow &&
      processedFiles < P.hardMaxFilesPerRun &&
      Date.now() - startedMs < P.softDeadlineMs
    ) {
      const linkCell = sourceSh.getRange(currentRow, P.masterLinkCol);
      const url = RSC_TBDB_getUrlFromCell_(linkCell);
      const fileId = RSC_TBDB_extractSpreadsheetId_(url);

      if (!fileId) {
        job.skip++;
        currentRow++;
        continue;
      }

      try {
        const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(fileId);
        const targetSh = RSC_TBDB_getRollingSheet_(targetSs);

        if (!targetSh) {
          job.skip++;
          linkCell
            .setBackground(P.colorSkip)
            .setNote('SKIP Fix Toko Bangkrut by DB: sheet target tidak ditemukan.');
          currentRow++;
          processedFiles++;
          continue;
        }

        const result = RSC_TBDB_processTargetSheet_(targetSh, dbMap);

        job.ok++;
        job.checkedRows += result.checkedRows;
        job.tokoRows += result.tokoRows;
        job.updatedRows += result.updatedRows;
        job.notFoundRows += result.notFoundRows;
        job.errorCleanedRows += result.errorCleanedRows;

        linkCell
          .setBackground(P.colorOk)
          .setNote(
            'OK Fix Toko Bangkrut by DB. Checked=' + result.checkedRows +
            ', Toko Bangkrut=' + result.tokoRows +
            ', Updated G=' + result.updatedRows +
            ', Key not found=' + result.notFoundRows +
            ', Visit schedule checked=' + Number(result.visitScheduleCheckedRows || 0) +
            ', Visit schedule matched=' + Number(result.visitScheduleMatchedRows || 0) +
            ', Visit schedule errors=' + Number(result.visitScheduleErrorRows || 0) +
            ', Error cleaned=' + result.errorCleanedRows + '.'
          );

      } catch (err) {
        job.error++;
        linkCell
          .setBackground(P.colorError)
          .setNote('ERROR Fix Toko Bangkrut by DB: ' + RSC_TBDB_err_(err));
      }

      currentRow++;
      processedFiles++;
    }

    job.cursor = currentRow;
    props.setProperty(P.jobKey, JSON.stringify(job));

    if (currentRow <= lastRow) {
      RSC_TBDB_scheduleNextRun_();
      ss.toast(
        'Fix G + Validate L Toko Bangkrut pause di row ' + currentRow +
        '. OK=' + job.ok +
        ', updated=' + job.updatedRows +
        '. Lanjut otomatis.',
        'Rolling Sales Center',
        10
      );
      return;
    }

    RSC_TBDB_finishJob_(
      'Fix G + Validate L Toko Bangkrut selesai. OK=' + job.ok +
      ', skip=' + job.skip +
      ', error=' + job.error +
      ', checked=' + job.checkedRows +
      ', toko=' + job.tokoRows +
      ', updated=' + job.updatedRows +
      ', notFound=' + job.notFoundRows +
      ', errorCleaned=' + job.errorCleanedRows + '.'
    );

  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (err) {}
  }
}
