function RSC_TBDB_processTargetSheet_(targetSh, dbMap) {
  const P=RSC_TOKO_BANGKRUT_DB_DATE_PARAMETERS_20260622,lastRow=targetSh.getLastRow();if(lastRow<P.fallbackFirstDataRow)return{checkedRows:0,tokoRows:0,updatedRows:0,notFoundRows:0,errorCleanedRows:0};
  const cols=RSC_TBDB_findTargetColumns_(targetSh),firstDataRow=cols.firstDataRow;if(firstDataRow>lastRow)return{checkedRows:0,tokoRows:0,updatedRows:0,notFoundRows:0,errorCleanedRows:0};
  const numRows=lastRow-firstDataRow+1;targetSh.getRange(firstDataRow,cols.validFromCol,numRows,1).setNumberFormat('@');targetSh.getRange(firstDataRow,cols.visitValidFromCol,numRows,1).setNumberFormat('@');
  let checkedRows=0,tokoRows=0,updatedRows=0,notFoundRows=0,errorCleanedRows=0;
  const minCol=Math.min(cols.customerCol,cols.relationshipCol,cols.salesmanCol,cols.validFromCol,cols.visitValidFromCol,cols.reasonCol,cols.validationStatusCol||cols.reasonCol,cols.errorDetailCol||cols.reasonCol),maxCol=Math.max(cols.customerCol,cols.relationshipCol,cols.salesmanCol,cols.validFromCol,cols.visitValidFromCol,cols.reasonCol,cols.validationStatusCol||cols.reasonCol,cols.errorDetailCol||cols.reasonCol),width=maxCol-minCol+1;
  const relCustomer=cols.customerCol-minCol,relRelationship=cols.relationshipCol-minCol,relSalesman=cols.salesmanCol-minCol,relValidFrom=cols.validFromCol-minCol,relVisitValidFrom=cols.visitValidFromCol-minCol,relReason=cols.reasonCol-minCol,relStatus=cols.validationStatusCol?cols.validationStatusCol-minCol:-1,relError=cols.errorDetailCol?cols.errorDetailCol-minCol:-1;
  for(let offset=0;offset<numRows;offset+=P.chunkRows){
    const currentStartRow=firstDataRow+offset,currentNumRows=Math.min(P.chunkRows,numRows-offset),range=targetSh.getRange(currentStartRow,minCol,currentNumRows,width),values=range.getValues(),displays=range.getDisplayValues();
    const neededTriple=Object.create(null),rowKeys=new Array(currentNumRows);
    if(!dbMap){for(let r=0;r<currentNumRows;r++){const d=displays[r];if(!RSC_TBDB_isTokoBangkrut_(d[relReason]))continue;const key=RSC_TBDB_buildKey_(d[relCustomer],d[relRelationship],d[relSalesman]);rowKeys[r]=key;if(key)neededTriple[key]=true;}}
    const relCtx=dbMap?null:RSC_STD_LOAD_RELATION_CONTEXT_20260814_(neededTriple,Object.create(null),Object.create(null));
    const outG=new Array(currentNumRows),outL=new Array(currentNumRows),outO=cols.validationStatusCol?new Array(currentNumRows):null,outP=cols.errorDetailCol?new Array(currentNumRows):null;let hasGLChange=false,hasStatusChange=false;
    for(let r=0;r<currentNumRows;r++){
      const displayRow=displays[r],oldG=displayRow[relValidFrom],oldL=displayRow[relVisitValidFrom];outG[r]=[oldG];outL[r]=[oldL];if(outO)outO[r]=[relStatus>=0?displayRow[relStatus]:''];if(outP)outP[r]=[relError>=0?displayRow[relError]:''];checkedRows++;if(!RSC_TBDB_isTokoBangkrut_(displayRow[relReason]))continue;tokoRows++;
      const key=rowKeys[r]||RSC_TBDB_buildKey_(displayRow[relCustomer],displayRow[relRelationship],displayRow[relSalesman]),dbDate=key?(dbMap?dbMap[key]:(relCtx.exact[key]||'')):'';if(!dbDate){notFoundRows++;continue;}
      const oldGText=RSC_TBDB_toYmdText_(oldG,oldG);if(oldGText!==dbDate){outG[r]=[dbDate];updatedRows++;hasGLChange=true;}else outG[r]=[oldGText||dbDate];outL[r]=[oldL];
      if(outP&&relError>=0){const oldError=String(displayRow[relError]||'').trim(),newError=RSC_TBDB_removeResolvedDateErrors_(oldError);if(newError!==oldError){outP[r]=[newError];hasStatusChange=true;errorCleanedRows++;if(outO&&relStatus>=0&&!newError)outO[r]=['OK'];else if(outO&&relStatus>=0&&newError&&!String(displayRow[relStatus]||'').trim())outO[r]=['ERROR'];}}
    }
    if(hasGLChange)targetSh.getRange(currentStartRow,cols.validFromCol,currentNumRows,1).setValues(outG);
    if(hasStatusChange){if(outO&&outP&&cols.errorDetailCol===cols.validationStatusCol+1){const vals=new Array(currentNumRows);for(let r=0;r<currentNumRows;r++)vals[r]=[outO[r][0],outP[r][0]];targetSh.getRange(currentStartRow,cols.validationStatusCol,currentNumRows,2).setValues(vals);}else{if(outO&&cols.validationStatusCol)targetSh.getRange(currentStartRow,cols.validationStatusCol,currentNumRows,1).setValues(outO);if(outP&&cols.errorDetailCol)targetSh.getRange(currentStartRow,cols.errorDetailCol,currentNumRows,1).setValues(outP);}}
  }
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();const visitValidation=RSC_VALIDATE_TOKO_BANGKRUT_VISIT_DATE_BY_MVS_20260723(targetSh);
  return{checkedRows:checkedRows,tokoRows:tokoRows,updatedRows:updatedRows,notFoundRows:notFoundRows,errorCleanedRows:errorCleanedRows,visitScheduleCheckedRows:Number(visitValidation.checkedRows||0),visitScheduleMatchedRows:Number(visitValidation.matchedRows||0),visitScheduleErrorRows:Number(visitValidation.errorRowsAdded||0)};
}



function RSC_TBDB_loadDbDateMap_() {
  const P = RSC_TOKO_BANGKRUT_DB_DATE_PARAMETERS_20260622;

  const dbSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.dbSpreadsheetId);
  const dbSh = RSC_TBDB_getDbSheet_(dbSs);
  if (!dbSh) {
    throw new Error('DB sheet tidak ditemukan. Cek sheetName/gid m_bp_relation.');
  }

  const lastRow = dbSh.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow < 1) return {};

  const layout = RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_GET_LAYOUT_20260819_(dbSh);
  const firstDataRow = (layout.firstDataRow || (layout.headerRow + 1));
  const map = {};
  const chunkRows = 50000;

  for (let startRow = firstDataRow; startRow <= lastRow; startRow += chunkRows) {
    const n = Math.min(chunkRows, lastRow - startRow + 1);
    const rows = RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_READ_CANONICAL_20260819_(dbSh, startRow, n, layout);

    for (let r = 0; r < rows.length; r++) {
      const key = RSC_TBDB_buildKey_(rows[r][0], rows[r][1], rows[r][2]);
      if (!key) continue;

      const dateText = RSC_TBDB_toYmdText_(rows[r][3], rows[r][3]);
      if (!dateText) continue;

      // First wins. Kalau ada duplicate DB, data pertama dianggap current.
      if (!map[key]) map[key] = dateText;
    }
  }

  return map;
}


function RSC_TBDB_findTargetColumns_(sh) {
  const P = RSC_TOKO_BANGKRUT_DB_DATE_PARAMETERS_20260622;
  const lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  const lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();

  const scanRows = Math.min(P.headerScanRows, lastRow);
  const grid = sh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, lastCol).getDisplayValues();

  for (let r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    const row = grid[r];

    const customerCol = RSC_TBDB_findHeaderCol_(row, P.hCustomer);
    const relationshipCol = RSC_TBDB_findHeaderCol_(row, P.hRelationship);
    const salesmanCol = RSC_TBDB_findHeaderCol_(row, P.hSalesman);

    if (!customerCol || !relationshipCol || !salesmanCol) continue;

    return {
      firstDataRow: r + 2,
      customerCol: customerCol,
      relationshipCol: relationshipCol,
      salesmanCol: salesmanCol,
      validFromCol: RSC_TBDB_findHeaderCol_(row, P.hValidFrom) || P.fallbackValidFromCol,
      visitValidFromCol: RSC_TBDB_findHeaderCol_(row, P.hVisitValidFrom) || P.fallbackVisitValidFromCol,
      reasonCol: RSC_TBDB_findHeaderCol_(row, P.hReason) || P.fallbackReasonCol,
      validationStatusCol: RSC_TBDB_findHeaderCol_(row, P.hValidationStatus) || P.fallbackValidationStatusCol,
      errorDetailCol: RSC_TBDB_findHeaderCol_(row, P.hErrorDetail) || P.fallbackErrorDetailCol
    };
  }

  return {
    firstDataRow: P.fallbackFirstDataRow,
    customerCol: P.fallbackCustomerCol,
    relationshipCol: P.fallbackRelationshipCol,
    salesmanCol: P.fallbackSalesmanCol,
    validFromCol: P.fallbackValidFromCol,
    visitValidFromCol: P.fallbackVisitValidFromCol,
    reasonCol: P.fallbackReasonCol,
    validationStatusCol: P.fallbackValidationStatusCol,
    errorDetailCol: P.fallbackErrorDetailCol
  };
}


function RSC_TBDB_findDbColumns_(dbSh) {
  const P = RSC_TOKO_BANGKRUT_DB_DATE_PARAMETERS_20260622;
  const lastCol = dbSh.getLastColumn();
  const scanRows = Math.min(P.dbHeaderScanRows, dbSh.getLastRow());

  for (let r = 1; r <= scanRows; r++) {
    const row = dbSh.getRange(r, 1, 1, lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0];

    const c1 = RSC_TBDB_findHeaderCol_(row, ['bp_id_rlt1']);
    const c2 = RSC_TBDB_findHeaderCol_(row, ['relationship_cat_id']);
    const c3 = RSC_TBDB_findHeaderCol_(row, ['bp_id_rlt2']);
    const c4 = RSC_TBDB_findHeaderCol_(row, ['valid_from', 'Valid From']);

    if (c1 && c2 && c3 && c4) {
      return {
        headerRow: r,
        bpIdRlt1Col: c1,
        relationshipCol: c2,
        bpIdRlt2Col: c3,
        dateCol: c4
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    headerRow: 1,
    bpIdRlt1Col: P.dbFallbackColBpIdRlt1,
    relationshipCol: P.dbFallbackColRelationship,
    bpIdRlt2Col: P.dbFallbackColBpIdRlt2,
    dateCol: P.dbFallbackColDate
  };
}


function RSC_TBDB_getDbSheet_(dbSs) {
  const P = RSC_TOKO_BANGKRUT_DB_DATE_PARAMETERS_20260622;

  let sh = dbSs.getSheetByName(P.dbSheetName);
  if (sh) return sh;

  const sheets = dbSs.getSheets();
  for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (String(sheets[i].getSheetId()) === String(P.dbSheetGid)) return sheets[i];
  }

  return sheets.length ? sheets[0] : null;
}


function RSC_TBDB_getRollingSheet_(targetSs) {
  const wanted = RSC_TOKO_BANGKRUT_DB_DATE_PARAMETERS_20260622.targetSheetName;

  let sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(wanted);
  if (sh) return sh;

  sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(String(wanted).substring(0, 31));
  if (sh) return sh;

  const sheets = targetSs.getSheets();
  for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (/rolling/i.test(sheets[i].getName())) return sheets[i];
  }

  return null;
}


function RSC_TBDB_buildKey_(bpIdRlt1, relationship, bpIdRlt2) {
  const a = RSC_TBDB_normId_(bpIdRlt1);
  const b = RSC_TBDB_normRelationship_(relationship);
  const c = RSC_TBDB_normId_(bpIdRlt2);

  if (!a || !b || !c) return '';
  return a + '||' + b + '||' + c;
}


function RSC_TBDB_normId_(value) {
  let s = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
  if (!s) return '';

  s = s.replace(/\s+/g, '');

  if (/^\d+\.0+$/.test(s)) {
    s = s.replace(/\.0+$/, '');
  }

  if (/^\d+(\.\d+)?[eE]\+?\d+$/.test(s)) {
    const n = Number(s);
    if (isFinite(n)) s = String(Math.round(n));
  }

  return s.toUpperCase();
}


function RSC_TBDB_normRelationship_(value) {
  let s = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
  if (!s) return '';

  if (s.indexOf(' - ') > -1) {
    s = s.split(' - ')[0];
  }

  return s.replace(/\s+/g, '').toUpperCase();
}


function RSC_TBDB_isTokoBangkrut_(reason) {
  return String(reason == null ? '' : reason)
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase()
    .indexOf('TOKO BANGKRUT') !== -1;
}


function RSC_TBDB_toYmdText_(rawValue, displayValue) {
  if (rawValue === '' || rawValue === null || rawValue === undefined) return '';

  if (Object.prototype.toString.call(rawValue) === '[object Date]' && !isNaN(rawValue)) {
    return Utilities.formatDate(rawValue, Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
  }

  const text = String(displayValue || rawValue || '').trim();
  if (!text) return '';

  let m = text.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})$/);
  if (m) {
    return [
      m[1],
      String(m[2]).padStart(2, '0'),
      String(m[3]).padStart(2, '0')
    ].join('-');
  }

  m = text.match(/^(\d{4})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})$/);
  if (m) {
    return [
      m[1],
      String(m[2]).padStart(2, '0'),
      String(m[3]).padStart(2, '0')
    ].join('-');
  }

  // M/D/YYYY sesuai contoh: 3/1/2026 -> 2026-03-01
  m = text.match(/^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/);
  if (m) {
    const month = Number(m[1]);
    const day = Number(m[2]);
    const year = Number(m[3]);
    if (RSC_TBDB_validDateParts_(year, month, day)) {
      return [
        year,
        String(month).padStart(2, '0'),
        String(day).padStart(2, '0')
      ].join('-');
    }
  }

  // Epoch milliseconds.
  if (/^\d{12,13}$/.test(text)) {
    const d = new Date(Number(text));
    if (!isNaN(d.getTime())) {
      return Utilities.formatDate(d, Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
    }
  }

  const parsed = new Date(text);
  if (!isNaN(parsed)) {
    return Utilities.formatDate(parsed, Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
  }

  return text;
}


function RSC_TBDB_validDateParts_(year, month, day) {
  if (!year || !month || !day) return false;
  if (month < 1 || month > 12) return false;
  if (day < 1 || day > 31) return false;

  const d = new Date(year, month - 1, day);

  return (
    d.getFullYear() === year &&
    d.getMonth() === month - 1 &&
    d.getDate() === day
  );
}


function RSC_TBDB_removeResolvedDateErrors_(errorText) {
  if (!errorText) return '';

  const parts = String(errorText)
    .split('|')
    .map(function (v) { return v.trim(); })
    .filter(Boolean)
    .filter(function (msg) {
      const upper = msg.toUpperCase();
      if (upper === 'VALID FROM HARUS FORMAT YYYY-MM-DD.') return false;
      // Visit Valid From tidak dibersihkan otomatis karena kolom L tidak lagi diubah.
      return true;
    });

  return parts.join(' | ');
}


function RSC_TBDB_findHeaderCol_(rowArr, aliases) {
  const targets = {};
  aliases.forEach(function (name) {
    targets[RSC_TBDB_normHeader_(name)] = true;
  });

  for (let c = 0; c < rowArr.length; c++) {
    if (targets[RSC_TBDB_normHeader_(rowArr[c])]) return c + 1;
  }

  return 0;
}


function RSC_TBDB_normHeader_(value) {
  return String(value == null ? '' : value)
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[_\-]+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}


function RSC_TBDB_getUrlFromCell_(range) {
  const rich = range.getRichTextValue();
  if (rich) {
    const whole = rich.getLinkUrl();
    if (whole) return whole;

    const runs = rich.getRuns();
    for (let i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      const u = runs[i].getLinkUrl();
      if (u) return u;
    }
  }

  const formula = range.getFormula();
  let m = String(formula || '').match(/HYPERLINK\s*\(\s*"([^"]+)"/i);
  if (m) return m[1];

  m = String(formula || '').match(/HYPERLINK\s*\(\s*'([^']+)'/i);
  if (m) return m[1];

  const texts = [
    range.getDisplayValue(),
    range.getValue()
  ];

  for (let i = 0; i < texts.length; i++) {
    const text = String(texts[i] || '').trim();
    m = text.match(/https:\/\/docs\.google\.com\/spreadsheets\/d\/[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+[^\s"',)]*/i);
    if (m) return m[0];

    if (/^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]{25,}$/.test(text)) return text;
  }

  return '';
}


function RSC_TBDB_extractSpreadsheetId_(urlOrId) {
  const text = String(urlOrId || '').trim();
  if (!text) return '';

  const m = text.match(/\/spreadsheets\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);
  if (m) return m[1];

  if (/^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]{25,}$/.test(text) && text.indexOf('/') === -1) {
    return text;
  }

  return '';
}


function RSC_TBDB_getSheetById_(ss, sheetId) {
  const sheets = ss.getSheets();

  for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (String(sheets[i].getSheetId()) === String(sheetId)) return sheets[i];
  }

  return null;
}


function RSC_TBDB_scheduleNextRun_() {
  const P = RSC_TOKO_BANGKRUT_DB_DATE_PARAMETERS_20260622;

  RSC_TBDB_clearTriggers_();

  RSC_PERF13_NEW_TRIGGER_20260819_(P.continueFn)
    .timeBased()
    .after(P.triggerDelayMs)
    .create();
}


function RSC_TBDB_clearTriggers_() {
  const P = RSC_TOKO_BANGKRUT_DB_DATE_PARAMETERS_20260622;

  ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(function (trigger) {
    if (trigger.getHandlerFunction() === P.continueFn) {
      ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger);
    }
  });
}


function RSC_TBDB_finishJob_(message) {
  const P = RSC_TOKO_BANGKRUT_DB_DATE_PARAMETERS_20260622;

  PropertiesService
    .getDocumentProperties()
    .deleteProperty(P.jobKey);

  RSC_TBDB_clearTriggers_();

  try {
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(message, 'Rolling Sales Center', 12);
  } catch (err) {}

  Logger.log(message);
}


function RSC_TBDB_err_(err) {
  return String(err && err.message ? err.message : err);
}


function RSC_COPY_G_TO_L_IF_TOKO_BANGKRUT_FROM_LINK_E_20260619() {
  const MASTER_LINK_COL = 5; // E
  const START_ROW = 2;

  const TARGET_SHEET_NAME = 'Change Rolling & Change Schedule';

  const COL_VALID_FROM = 7;        // G
  const COL_VISIT_VALID_FROM = 12; // L
  const COL_REASON = 14;           // N

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  const masterSh = ss.getActiveSheet();
  const lastRow = masterSh.getLastRow();

  if (lastRow < START_ROW) {
    ss.toast('Tidak ada link di kolom E.', 'Copy G to L - Toko Bangkrut', 8);
    return;
  }

  const numRows = lastRow - START_ROW + 1;
  const linkRange = masterSh.getRange(START_ROW, MASTER_LINK_COL, numRows, 1);

  const displayValues = linkRange.getDisplayValues();
  const formulas = linkRange.getFormulas();
  const richTexts = linkRange.getRichTextValues();

  let fileProcessed = 0;
  let fileSkipped = 0;
  let fileError = 0;
  let totalRowsUpdated = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < numRows; i++) {
    const masterRow = START_ROW + i;

    const url = getUrlFromCell_(displayValues[i][0], formulas[i][0], richTexts[i][0]);
    const fileId = extractSpreadsheetId_(url);

    if (!fileId) {
      fileSkipped++;
      continue;
    }

    try {
      const targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(fileId);
      const targetSh = getRollingSheet_(targetSs, TARGET_SHEET_NAME);

      if (!targetSh) {
        fileSkipped++;
        masterSh.getRange(masterRow, MASTER_LINK_COL)
          .setNote('SKIP: sheet "' + TARGET_SHEET_NAME + '" tidak ditemukan.');
        continue;
      }

      const targetLastRow = targetSh.getLastRow();

      if (targetLastRow < 2) {
        fileSkipped++;
        masterSh.getRange(masterRow, MASTER_LINK_COL)
          .setNote('SKIP: sheet target tidak ada data.');
        continue;
      }

      const targetNumRows = targetLastRow - 1;

      const validFromRange = targetSh.getRange(2, COL_VALID_FROM, targetNumRows, 1);        // G
      const visitValidFromRange = targetSh.getRange(2, COL_VISIT_VALID_FROM, targetNumRows, 1); // L
      const reasonRange = targetSh.getRange(2, COL_REASON, targetNumRows, 1);              // N

      const validFromValues = validFromRange.getValues();
      const visitValidFromValues = visitValidFromRange.getValues();
      const reasonValues = reasonRange.getDisplayValues();

      let updatedInFile = 0;

      for (let r = 0; r < targetNumRows; r++) {
        const reason = String(reasonValues[r][0] || '').trim().toUpperCase();

        if (reason === 'TOKO BANGKRUT') {
          visitValidFromValues[r][0] = validFromValues[r][0];
          updatedInFile++;
        }
      }

      if (updatedInFile > 0) {
        visitValidFromRange.setValues(visitValidFromValues);
        SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      }

      fileProcessed++;
      totalRowsUpdated += updatedInFile;

      masterSh.getRange(masterRow, MASTER_LINK_COL)
        .setBackground('#B7E1CD')
        .setNote('OK: Toko Bangkrut updated. Row update=' + updatedInFile);

    } catch (err) {
      fileError++;
      masterSh.getRange(masterRow, MASTER_LINK_COL)
        .setBackground('#F4C7C3')
        .setNote('ERROR: ' + String(err && err.message ? err.message : err));
    }
  }

  ss.toast(
    'Selesai. File OK=' + fileProcessed +
    ', skip=' + fileSkipped +
    ', error=' + fileError +
    ', total row update=' + totalRowsUpdated,
    'Copy G to L - Toko Bangkrut',
    12
  );

  function getUrlFromCell_(displayValue, formula, richText) {
    if (richText) {
      const wholeUrl = richText.getLinkUrl();
      if (wholeUrl) return wholeUrl;

      const runs = richText.getRuns();
      for (let i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
        const runUrl = runs[i].getLinkUrl();
        if (runUrl) return runUrl;
      }
    }

    const formulaText = String(formula || '');
    let m = formulaText.match(/HYPERLINK\s*\(\s*"([^"]+)"/i);
    if (m) return m[1];

    m = formulaText.match(/HYPERLINK\s*\(\s*'([^']+)'/i);
    if (m) return m[1];

    const text = String(displayValue || '').trim();
    m = text.match(/https:\/\/docs\.google\.com\/spreadsheets\/d\/[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+/i);
    if (m) return m[0];

    if (/^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]{25,}$/.test(text)) return text;

    return '';
  }

  function extractSpreadsheetId_(urlOrId) {
    const text = String(urlOrId || '').trim();
    if (!text) return '';

    let m = text.match(/\/spreadsheets\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);
    if (m) return m[1];

    if (/^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]{25,}$/.test(text) && text.indexOf('/') === -1) {
      return text;
    }

    return '';
  }

  function getRollingSheet_(targetSs, sheetName) {
    let sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(sheetName);
    if (sh) return sh;

    // fallback kalau nama sheet kena limit 31 character
    sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(sheetName.substring(0, 31));
    if (sh) return sh;

    const sheets = targetSs.getSheets();
    for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
      if (/rolling/i.test(sheets[i].getName())) return sheets[i];
    }

    return null;
  }
}

/***************************************************************
 * PATCH 2026-07-08
 * Convert Active Sheet:
 * From:
 * Sales Office | Delivering Plant | Customer ID | Relationship |
 * Salesman ID | Salesman BP Type | Valid From | Valid To |
 * Visit Category | Visit Type | Schedule Visit |
 * Visit Valid From | Visit Valid To | Reason |
 * Validation Status | Error Detail
 *
 * To:
 * Action | Key | Reason | Visit Category | Sales Organization |
 * Salesman ID | Custom Rule | Customer ID | Visit Type |
 * Valid From | Valid To | Monday W1 ... Sunday W4
 ***************************************************************/

var RSC_VISIT_UPLOAD_CONVERTER_CONFIG_20260708 = {
  outputSheetName: 'Visit Upload Format',
  action: 'EDIT',
  customRule: '',

  // Token schedule yang ada di source akan menjadi jam ini.
  scheduledTime: '08:00:00',

  // Token schedule yang tidak ada akan menjadi jam ini.
  emptyTime: '00:00:00',

  // false = semua row data diproses.
  // true = hanya row dengan Validation Status = ERROR yang diproses.
  onlyErrorRows: false,

  // true = Reason akan menjadi: Reason + "; " + Error Detail
  // false = hanya ambil Reason saja.
  combineErrorDetailToReason: true,

  // true = kolom target Valid From/Valid To pakai Visit Valid From/Visit Valid To.
  // false = pakai Valid From/Valid To relationship.
  useVisitValidityDates: true,

  // Isi mapping ini kalau Sales Organization beda dari Sales Office.
  // Contoh:
  // salesOrgBySalesOffice: { '2AR0': 'STA1' }
  salesOrgBySalesOffice: {
    // '2AR0': 'STA1'
  }
};


function RSC_CONVERT_ACTIVE_SHEET_TO_VISIT_UPLOAD_20260708() {
  var ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  var srcSheet = ss.getActiveSheet();

  try {
    var result = RSC_convertActiveSheetToVisitUpload_20260708_(ss, srcSheet);

    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
      'Convert selesai.\n\n' +
      'Source sheet: ' + result.sourceSheetName + '\n' +
      'Output sheet: ' + result.outputSheetName + '\n' +
      'Rows converted: ' + result.rowsConverted + '\n' +
      'Rows skipped/error: ' + result.rowsSkipped +
      (result.warningText ? '\n\nWarning:\n' + result.warningText : '')
    );
  } catch (err) {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
      'Convert gagal:\n\n' +
      RSC_formatError_20260708_(err)
    );
    throw err;
  }
}


function RSC_convertActiveSheetToVisitUpload_20260708_(ss, srcSheet) {
  var cfg = RSC_VISIT_UPLOAD_CONVERTER_CONFIG_20260708;
  var lastRow = srcSheet.getLastRow();
  var lastCol = srcSheet.getLastColumn();

  if (lastRow < 2 || lastCol < 5) {
    throw new Error('Active sheet kosong atau format tidak lengkap.');
  }

  var requiredHeaders = [
    'Customer ID',
    'Salesman ID',
    'Visit Category',
    'Visit Type',
    'Schedule Visit'
  ];

  var headerInfo = RSC_findHeaderRowAndMap_20260708_(
    srcSheet,
    requiredHeaders,
    Math.min(20, lastRow)
  );

  if (!headerInfo) {
    throw new Error(
      'Header tidak ditemukan. Pastikan active sheet memiliki header minimal: ' +
      requiredHeaders.join(', ')
    );
  }

  var rowCount = lastRow - headerInfo.headerRow + 1;
  var range = srcSheet.getRange(headerInfo.headerRow, 1, rowCount, lastCol);
  var displayData = range.getDisplayValues();
  var rawData = range.getValues();

  var targetHeaders = RSC_getVisitUploadTargetHeaders_20260708_();
  var scheduleColumns = RSC_getVisitUploadScheduleColumns_20260708_();

  var output = [targetHeaders];
  var warnings = [];
  var rowsSkipped = 0;

  for (var r = 1; r < displayData.length; r++) {
    var displayRow = displayData[r];
    var rawRow = rawData[r];
    var sourceRowNumber = headerInfo.headerRow + r;

    var customerId = RSC_getTextByHeader_20260708_(displayRow, rawRow, headerInfo.headerMap, [
      'Customer ID',
      'Customer',
      'Cust ID',
      'bp_id'
    ]);

    var salesmanId = RSC_getTextByHeader_20260708_(displayRow, rawRow, headerInfo.headerMap, [
      'Salesman ID',
      'Salesman',
      'salesman_id'
    ]);

    var visitCategory = RSC_getTextByHeader_20260708_(displayRow, rawRow, headerInfo.headerMap, [
      'Visit Category',
      'Visit Cat',
      'visit_category'
    ]);

    var visitType = RSC_getTextByHeader_20260708_(displayRow, rawRow, headerInfo.headerMap, [
      'Visit Type',
      'visit_type'
    ]);

    var scheduleVisit = RSC_getTextByHeader_20260708_(displayRow, rawRow, headerInfo.headerMap, [
      'Schedule Visit',
      'Visit Schedule',
      'visit_schedule'
    ]);

    var validationStatus = RSC_getTextByHeader_20260708_(displayRow, rawRow, headerInfo.headerMap, [
      'Validation Status'
    ]);

    var isBlankDataRow = !customerId && !salesmanId && !visitCategory && !visitType && !scheduleVisit;
    if (isBlankDataRow) {
      continue;
    }

    if (cfg.onlyErrorRows && String(validationStatus || '').toUpperCase() !== 'ERROR') {
      rowsSkipped++;
      continue;
    }

    if (!customerId || !salesmanId || !visitCategory || !visitType) {
      rowsSkipped++;
      warnings.push(
        'Row ' + sourceRowNumber +
        ' dilewati karena Customer ID / Salesman ID / Visit Category / Visit Type kosong.'
      );
      continue;
    }

    visitType = RSC_normalizeVisitType_20260708_(visitType);
    visitCategory = String(visitCategory || '').trim().toUpperCase();

    var salesOffice = RSC_getTextByHeader_20260708_(displayRow, rawRow, headerInfo.headerMap, [
      'Sales Office',
      'SalesOffice',
      'Sls Office',
      'sls_office'
    ]);

    var deliveringPlant = RSC_getTextByHeader_20260708_(displayRow, rawRow, headerInfo.headerMap, [
      'Delivering Plant',
      'Plant'
    ]);

    var explicitSalesOrg = RSC_getTextByHeader_20260708_(displayRow, rawRow, headerInfo.headerMap, [
      'Sales Organization',
      'Sales Org',
      'Sls Org',
      'sls_org'
    ]);

    var salesOrganization = RSC_resolveSalesOrganization_20260708_(
      explicitSalesOrg,
      salesOffice,
      deliveringPlant
    );

    var reason = RSC_getTextByHeader_20260708_(displayRow, rawRow, headerInfo.headerMap, [
      'Reason'
    ]);

    var errorDetail = RSC_getTextByHeader_20260708_(displayRow, rawRow, headerInfo.headerMap, [
      'Error Detail',
      'Error'
    ]);

    if (cfg.combineErrorDetailToReason && errorDetail) {
      reason = reason ? reason + '; ' + errorDetail : errorDetail;
    }

    var fromCell;
    var toCell;

    if (cfg.useVisitValidityDates) {
      fromCell = RSC_getCellByHeader_20260708_(displayRow, rawRow, headerInfo.headerMap, [
        'Visit Valid From',
        'Visit ValidFrom',
        'visit_valid_from'
      ]);

      toCell = RSC_getCellByHeader_20260708_(displayRow, rawRow, headerInfo.headerMap, [
        'Visit Valid To',
        'Visit ValidTo',
        'visit_valid_to'
      ]);

      if (!RSC_cellHasValue_20260708_(fromCell)) {
        fromCell = RSC_getCellByHeader_20260708_(displayRow, rawRow, headerInfo.headerMap, [
          'Valid From',
          'valid_from'
        ]);
      }

      if (!RSC_cellHasValue_20260708_(toCell)) {
        toCell = RSC_getCellByHeader_20260708_(displayRow, rawRow, headerInfo.headerMap, [
          'Valid To',
          'valid_to'
        ]);
      }
    } else {
      fromCell = RSC_getCellByHeader_20260708_(displayRow, rawRow, headerInfo.headerMap, [
        'Valid From',
        'valid_from'
      ]);

      toCell = RSC_getCellByHeader_20260708_(displayRow, rawRow, headerInfo.headerMap, [
        'Valid To',
        'valid_to'
      ]);
    }

    var validFromUpload = RSC_formatDateForUpload_20260708_(RSC_cellValueForDate_20260708_(fromCell));
    var validToUpload = RSC_formatDateForUpload_20260708_(RSC_cellValueForDate_20260708_(toCell));
    var keyDate = RSC_formatDateIso_20260708_(RSC_cellValueForDate_20260708_(fromCell));

    if (!validFromUpload || !validToUpload) {
      warnings.push(
        'Row ' + sourceRowNumber +
        ' tanggal kosong/tidak valid. Valid From="' + validFromUpload +
        '", Valid To="' + validToUpload + '".'
      );
    }

    var key = [
      customerId,
      salesmanId,
      visitCategory,
      visitType,
      keyDate || validFromUpload
    ].join('|');

    var scheduleSet = RSC_parseScheduleVisitToSet_20260708_(scheduleVisit);

    var scheduleValues = scheduleColumns.map(function (col) {
      return scheduleSet[col.token] ? cfg.scheduledTime : cfg.emptyTime;
    });

    var outRow = [
      cfg.action,
      key,
      reason,
      visitCategory,
      salesOrganization,
      salesmanId,
      cfg.customRule,
      customerId,
      visitType,
      validFromUpload,
      validToUpload
    ].concat(scheduleValues);

    output.push(outRow);
  }

  var outputSheetName = RSC_makeUniqueSheetName_20260708_(ss, cfg.outputSheetName);
  var outSheet = ss.insertSheet(outputSheetName);

  var outputRange = outSheet.getRange(1, 1, output.length, targetHeaders.length);
  outputRange.setNumberFormat('@');
  outputRange.setValues(output);

  outSheet.setFrozenRows(1);
  outSheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, targetHeaders.length)
    .setFontWeight('bold')
    .setBackground('#0F172A')
    .setFontColor('#FFFFFF');

  outSheet.autoResizeColumns(1, targetHeaders.length);

  // Schedule columns dibuat compact.
  if (targetHeaders.length >= 12) {
    outSheet.setColumnWidths(12, targetHeaders.length - 11, 105);
  }

  // Kolom penting dibuat lebih lebar.
  outSheet.setColumnWidth(2, 270);  // Key
  outSheet.setColumnWidth(3, 420);  // Reason
  outSheet.setColumnWidth(5, 140);  // Sales Organization
  outSheet.setColumnWidth(6, 130);  // Salesman ID
  outSheet.setColumnWidth(8, 130);  // Customer ID

  return {
    sourceSheetName: srcSheet.getName(),
    outputSheetName: outputSheetName,
    rowsConverted: output.length - 1,
    rowsSkipped: rowsSkipped,
    warningText: warnings.slice(0, 20).join('\n')
  };
}


function RSC_getVisitUploadTargetHeaders_20260708_() {
  var headers = [
    'Action',
    'Key',
    'Reason',
    'Visit Category',
    'Sales Organization',
    'Salesman ID',
    'Custom Rule',
    'Customer ID',
    'Visit Type',
    'Valid From',
    'Valid To'
  ];

  return headers.concat(
    RSC_getVisitUploadScheduleColumns_20260708_().map(function (x) {
      return x.label;
    })
  );
}


function RSC_getVisitUploadScheduleColumns_20260708_() {
  var days = [
    ['Monday', 'M'],
    ['Tuesday', 'T'],
    ['Wednesday', 'W'],
    ['Thursday', 'TH'],
    ['Friday', 'F'],
    ['Saturday', 'S'],
    ['Sunday', 'SU']
  ];

  var cols = [];
  for (var w = 1; w <= 4; w++) {
    days.forEach(function (d) {
      cols.push({
        label: d[0] + ' W' + w,
        token: 'W' + w + d[1]
      });
    });
  }
  return cols;
}


function RSC_findHeaderRowAndMap_20260708_(sheet, requiredHeaders, maxScanRows) {
  var lastCol = sheet.getLastColumn();
  var scan = sheet.getRange(1, 1, maxScanRows, lastCol).getDisplayValues();

  for (var r = 0; r < scan.length; r++) {
    var headerMap = RSC_buildHeaderMap_20260708_(scan[r]);
    var score = 0;

    requiredHeaders.forEach(function (h) {
      if (headerMap[RSC_normalizeHeader_20260708_(h)] !== undefined) {
        score++;
      }
    });

    if (score >= requiredHeaders.length) {
      return {
        headerRow: r + 1,
        headerMap: headerMap
      };
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function RSC_buildHeaderMap_20260708_(headerRow) {
  var map = {};
  headerRow.forEach(function (h, idx) {
    var key = RSC_normalizeHeader_20260708_(h);
    if (key && map[key] === undefined) {
      map[key] = idx;
    }
  });
  return map;
}


function RSC_normalizeHeader_20260708_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[_\-]+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}


function RSC_getCellByHeader_20260708_(displayRow, rawRow, headerMap, headerNames) {
  for (var i = 0; i < headerNames.length; i++) {
    var key = RSC_normalizeHeader_20260708_(headerNames[i]);
    var idx = headerMap[key];

    if (idx !== undefined) {
      return {
        display: displayRow[idx],
        raw: rawRow[idx],
        index: idx
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    display: '',
    raw: '',
    index: -1
  };
}


function RSC_getTextByHeader_20260708_(displayRow, rawRow, headerMap, headerNames) {
  var cell = RSC_getCellByHeader_20260708_(displayRow, rawRow, headerMap, headerNames);
  var displayText = String(cell.display === null || cell.display === undefined ? '' : cell.display).trim();

  if (displayText) {
    return displayText;
  }

  if (cell.raw instanceof Date) {
    return RSC_formatDateIso_20260708_(cell.raw);
  }

  return String(cell.raw === null || cell.raw === undefined ? '' : cell.raw).trim();
}


function RSC_cellHasValue_20260708_(cell) {
  if (!cell) return false;

  if (cell.raw instanceof Date) return true;

  var d = String(cell.display === null || cell.display === undefined ? '' : cell.display).trim();
  var r = String(cell.raw === null || cell.raw === undefined ? '' : cell.raw).trim();

  return Boolean(d || r);
}


function RSC_cellValueForDate_20260708_(cell) {
  if (!cell) return '';

  if (cell.raw instanceof Date) return cell.raw;

  var displayText = String(cell.display === null || cell.display === undefined ? '' : cell.display).trim();
  if (displayText) return displayText;

  return cell.raw;
}


function RSC_resolveSalesOrganization_20260708_(explicitSalesOrg, salesOffice, deliveringPlant) {
  var cfg = RSC_VISIT_UPLOAD_CONVERTER_CONFIG_20260708;

  explicitSalesOrg = String(explicitSalesOrg || '').trim();
  salesOffice = String(salesOffice || '').trim();

  if (explicitSalesOrg) {
    return explicitSalesOrg;
  }

  if (
    cfg.salesOrgBySalesOffice &&
    Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cfg.salesOrgBySalesOffice, salesOffice)
  ) {
    return cfg.salesOrgBySalesOffice[salesOffice];
  }

  // Fallback paling aman karena source template tidak punya Sales Organization.
  // Jika hasil harus STA1/2AE0/dll, isi mapping salesOrgBySalesOffice di config.
  return salesOffice;
}


function RSC_normalizeVisitType_20260708_(value) {
  var text = String(value || '').trim();

  if (/^\d+$/.test(text)) {
    return text.padStart(2, '0');
  }

  return text;
}


function RSC_parseScheduleVisitToSet_20260708_(scheduleVisit) {
  var set = {};
  var raw = String(scheduleVisit || '')
    .replace(/\u00A0/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, '');

  if (!raw) return set;

  raw.split(/[;,|\/\n]+/).forEach(function (token) {
    var normalized = RSC_normalizeScheduleToken_20260708_(token);
    if (normalized) {
      set[normalized] = true;
    }
  });

  return set;
}


function RSC_normalizeScheduleToken_20260708_(token) {
  var t = String(token || '').trim();
  if (!t) return '';

  t = t.replace(/\s+/g, '').toUpperCase();

  var m = t.match(/^W([1-4])(.+)$/);
  if (!m) return '';

  var week = m[1];
  var dayRaw = m[2];
  var day = '';

  if (dayRaw === 'M' || dayRaw === 'MON' || dayRaw === 'MONDAY') {
    day = 'M';
  } else if (dayRaw === 'T' || dayRaw === 'TU' || dayRaw === 'TUE' || dayRaw === 'TUESDAY') {
    day = 'T';
  } else if (dayRaw === 'W' || dayRaw === 'WED' || dayRaw === 'WEDNESDAY') {
    day = 'W';
  } else if (dayRaw === 'TH' || dayRaw === 'THU' || dayRaw === 'THUR' || dayRaw === 'THURSDAY') {
    day = 'TH';
  } else if (dayRaw === 'F' || dayRaw === 'FRI' || dayRaw === 'FRIDAY') {
    day = 'F';
  } else if (dayRaw === 'S' || dayRaw === 'SAT' || dayRaw === 'SATURDAY') {
    day = 'S';
  } else if (dayRaw === 'SU' || dayRaw === 'SUN' || dayRaw === 'SUNDAY') {
    day = 'SU';
  }

  if (!day) return '';

  return 'W' + week + day;
}


function RSC_formatDateForUpload_20260708_(value) {
  var p = RSC_parseDateParts_20260708_(value);
  if (!p) {
    return String(value || '').trim();
  }

  return RSC_pad2_20260708_(p.d) + ',' +
    RSC_pad2_20260708_(p.m) + ',' +
    String(p.y).padStart(4, '0');
}


function RSC_formatDateIso_20260708_(value) {
  var p = RSC_parseDateParts_20260708_(value);
  if (!p) {
    return String(value || '').trim();
  }

  return String(p.y).padStart(4, '0') + '-' +
    RSC_pad2_20260708_(p.m) + '-' +
    RSC_pad2_20260708_(p.d);
}


function RSC_parseDateParts_20260708_(value) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') {
    return null;
  }

  if (value instanceof Date && !isNaN(value.getTime())) {
    return {
      y: value.getFullYear(),
      m: value.getMonth() + 1,
      d: value.getDate()
    };
  }

  // Spreadsheet serial number fallback.
  if (typeof value === 'number' && isFinite(value)) {
    var serialDate = new Date(Math.round((value - 25569) * 86400 * 1000));
    return {
      y: serialDate.getUTCFullYear(),
      m: serialDate.getUTCMonth() + 1,
      d: serialDate.getUTCDate()
    };
  }

  var s = String(value || '').trim();
  if (!s) return null;

  // Buang jam kalau ada: "2026-03-01 00:00:00"
  s = s.replace(/\s+\d{1,2}:\d{2}(:\d{2})?.*$/, '');

  // Format ISO: yyyy-mm-dd / yyyy/mm/dd / yyyy.mm.dd
  var ymd = s.match(/^(\d{4})[-\/.](\d{1,2})[-\/.](\d{1,2})$/);
  if (ymd) {
    return {
      y: Number(ymd[1]),
      m: Number(ymd[2]),
      d: Number(ymd[3])
    };
  }

  // Format upload / lokal: dd,MM,yyyy / dd/MM/yyyy / dd-MM-yyyy / dd.MM.yyyy
  var dmy = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})[,\-\/.](\d{1,2})[,\-\/.](\d{4})$/);
  if (dmy) {
    return {
      y: Number(dmy[3]),
      m: Number(dmy[2]),
      d: Number(dmy[1])
    };
  }

  return null;
}


function RSC_pad2_20260708_(value) {
  return String(Number(value)).padStart(2, '0');
}


function RSC_makeUniqueSheetName_20260708_(ss, baseName) {
  var cleanBase = String(baseName || 'Visit Upload Format').substring(0, 80);
  var name = cleanBase;

  if (!ss.getSheetByName(name)) {
    return name;
  }

  var ts = Utilities.formatDate(
    new Date(),
    Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
    'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
  );

  name = cleanBase.substring(0, 70) + ' ' + ts;

  if (!ss.getSheetByName(name)) {
    return name;
  }

  for (var i = 2; i <= 99; i++) {
    var candidate = cleanBase.substring(0, 70) + ' ' + ts + ' ' + i;
    if (!ss.getSheetByName(candidate)) {
      return candidate;
    }
  }

  throw new Error('Tidak bisa membuat nama output sheet unik.');
}


function RSC_formatError_20260708_(err) {
  if (!err) return 'Unknown error';
  return err.stack || err.message || String(err);
}

 * DROP-IN REPLACEMENT untuk function:

 * Cara pakai: hapus function lama (nama sama) di Apps Script,
 * paste seluruh isi file ini menggantikannya. Nama function
 * tidak berubah jadi menu existing "Create / Upsert Template

 *
 * LOGIKA BARU:

 *      a. Sheet "Change Sales Office" (file yang sama), key =

 *         (spreadsheet 1Ar2WCG6vQ_4JHLoo6Ov233w466XmKNb5ibetST2ElJw,
 *         sheet m_bp_sales_cust_view), key = bp_id, ambil
 *         sls_office + delivering_plant.
 *         Satu bp_id bisa punya LEBIH DARI 1 baris di DB (beda
 *         division/dist_channel -> sls_office beda). Kalau ambigu,
 *         pilih baris yang sls_office-nya PERSIS SAMA dengan Sales
 *         Office file/area yang lagi diproses (dibaca dari kolom
 *         "Sales Office" di Rekap Approved, row master yang sama
 *         dengan file yang sedang jalan). Kalau tidak ada satupun
 *         kandidat yang cocok dengan area file ini, fallback ke
 *         kandidat pertama di DB.
 *      c. Kalau tidak ketemu di keduanya -> tetap pakai value
 *         asli dari Change Rolling & Change Schedule (fallback).
 *    Kolom baru "Sales Office Source" (kolom O) diisi teks
 *    "Change Sales Office" HANYA kalau override berasal dari
 *    sheet Change Sales Office. Kalau dari DB / fallback asli,
 *    dikosongkan.
 * 2) Cell B1 "Schedule" hanya diisi CFG.scheduleDateText kalau
 *    minimal 1 row di file itu ke-override oleh sheet Change
 *    Sales Office. Kalau tidak ada satupun, B1 dikosongkan.
 * 3) Row di Change Rolling & Change Schedule vs row di Change
 *    Sales Office di-cross reference by Customer ID:
 *      - Kalau Customer ID SUDAH ada di Change Rolling & Change
 *        Schedule -> tidak dibuatkan row Template Revamp
 *        terpisah (karena sudah tercover di logic Rolling di
 *        atas), tapi ditandai di sheet Change Sales Office
 *        kolom I = "Sudah di cover di Rolling".
 *      - Kalau Customer ID BELUM ada di Change Rolling & Change
 *        Schedule -> dibuatkan 1 row baru di Template Revamp
 *        (Sales Office, Delivering Plant, Customer ID diisi;
 *        Relationship/Salesman/dsb kosong; Sales Office Source
 *        = "Change Sales Office").
 * 4) UPSERT key ikut disesuaikan (computeRowKey_) supaya row
 *    "Sales Office only" di atas tidak double setiap run ulang.
 *
 * Asumsi (karena tidak disebutkan eksplisit oleh requester):
 * - Semua row Change Sales Office diproses, tidak difilter by
 *   Validation Status.
 * - Kalau salesOffice/deliveringPlant di sheet Change Sales
 *   Office kosong dua-duanya, dianggap "tidak ketemu" -> lanjut
 *   ke DB fallback.
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_CREATE_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_ROLLING_SALES_20260720(options) {

    // V14 capacity-safe range guards. Tidak ada getValues/setValues yang

    heartbeatEveryRows: 250,

  };

  var OUTPUT_HEADERS = [
    'Sales Office',
    'Delivering Plant',
    'Customer ID',
    'Relationship',
    'Salesman ID',
    'Salesman BP Type',
    'Valid From',
    'Valid To',
    'Visit Category',
    'Visit Type',
    'Schedule Visit',
    'Visit Valid From',
    'Visit Valid To',
    'Change Schedule Only',
    'Sales Office Source'
  ];

  var SOURCE_ALIASES = {
    salesOffice: ['Sales Office', 'Sls Office', 'sls_office'],
    deliveringPlant: ['Delivering Plant', 'Delivery Plant', 'delivering_plant'],
    customerId: ['Customer ID', 'Customer', 'BP ID', 'bp_id', 'bp_id_rlt1'],
    relationship: [
      'Relationship',
      'Relationship ID',
      'Relationship Cat ID',
      'relationship_cat_id'
    ],
    salesmanId: ['Salesman ID', 'Salesman', 'bp_id_rlt2'],
    salesmanBpType: [
      'Salesman BP Type',
      'Salesman BPType',
      'BP Type',
      'bp_type_id_rlt2'
    ],
    validFrom: ['Valid From', 'valid_from'],
    validTo: ['Valid To', 'valid_to'],
    visitCategory: ['Visit Category', 'visit_category'],
    visitType: ['Visit Type', 'visit_type'],
    scheduleVisit: ['Schedule Visit', 'Visit Schedule', 'visit_schedule'],
    visitValidFrom: ['Visit Valid From', 'visit_valid_from'],
    visitValidTo: ['Visit Valid To', 'visit_valid_to']
  };

  // Kolom tambahan yang dibaca bila tersedia, tetapi tidak diwajibkan untuk membentuk template.
  var SOURCE_OPTIONAL_ALIASES = {
    reason: ['Reason', 'Alasan', 'reason']
  };

  var startedAt = Date.now();
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var lock = LockService.getScriptLock();

  // Cache DB m_bp_sales_cust_view — di-load sekali (lazy) untuk seluruh
  // execution ini, dipakai bergiliran oleh semua file yang diproses.
  var salesCustViewDbMapCache = null;

  if (!lock.tryLock(5000)) {
    throw new Error('Proses Template Revamp sedang dijalankan oleh eksekusi lain.');
  }

  // Kill-switch hanya dibuka oleh wrapper menu START/CONTINUE.
  // Handler ini juga dipakai time trigger dan tidak boleh menghapus stop flag.

  try {
    assertRevampNotStopped_('START');
    /***********************************************************
     * MODE ACTIVE SHEET — tidak membaca Rekap Approved/kolom E.
     * Dipanggil oleh wrapper:
     * RSC_CREATE_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_FROM_ACTIVE_CHANGE_ROLLING_20260722
     ***********************************************************/
    if (options.activeSheetOnly === true) {
      var activeSsDirect = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
      var activeShDirect = activeSsDirect.getActiveSheet();

      if (!activeShDirect || activeShDirect.getName() !== CFG.sourceSheetName) {
        throw new Error(
          'Aktifkan tab "' + CFG.sourceSheetName + '" terlebih dahulu. ' +
          'Function ini hanya membaca sheet aktif dan tidak membaca link kolom E.'
        );
      }

      var existingJob = readState_();
      if (existingJob && String(existingJob.mode || '').toUpperCase() !== 'ACTIVE') {
        throw new Error(
          'Masih ada job Template Revamp lain. Gunakan menu Check Status lalu STOP/Reset sebelum memulai mode Active.'
        );
      }

      var activeState = {
        mode: 'ACTIVE',
        phase: 'PREPARE_LOOKUP',
        masterSpreadsheetId: activeSsDirect.getId(),
        masterSheetId: activeShDirect.getSheetId(),
        masterSheetName: activeShDirect.getName(),
        currentFileId: activeSsDirect.getId(),
        currentFileName: activeSsDirect.getName(),
        nextRow: 0,
        processedFiles: 0,
        errorFiles: 0,
        startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        lastHeartbeatAt: new Date().toISOString()
      };
      saveState_(activeState);
      writeRevampStatus_(activeState, 'Menyiapkan lookup hanya untuk Customer/Relationship yang dipakai sheet aktif.');

      var activeHeaderInfo = findSourceHeader_(activeShDirect);
      var activeNeeds = collectSourceLookupNeeds_(activeShDirect, activeHeaderInfo);
      var activeRelationKeys = loadMbpRelationKeySubset_(activeNeeds.exactKeys, activeNeeds.exactValidTo, activeNeeds.pairKeys);
      salesCustViewDbMapCache = loadSalesCustViewDbSubset_(activeNeeds.customerIds);
      var activeAreaSalesOfficeCode = resolveActiveSourceSalesOfficeCode_(activeShDirect);

      activeState.phase = 'BUILD_ACTIVE_FILE';
      activeState.sourceRows = activeNeeds.sourceRows;
      saveState_(activeState);
      writeRevampStatus_(activeState, 'Membangun Template Revamp dari sheet aktif.');

      var activeResult = buildRevampSheet_(
        activeSsDirect,
        activeShDirect,
        activeRelationKeys,
        activeAreaSalesOfficeCode
      );

      activeState.phase = 'FINISHED';
      activeState.processedFiles = 1;
      activeState.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      activeState.result = activeResult;
      props.setProperty(CFG.lastStatusProperty, JSON.stringify(activeState));
      props.deleteProperty(CFG.jobProperty);
      props.deleteProperty(CFG.stopProperty);
      deleteOwnTriggers_();

      notify_(activeSsDirect,
        'Template Revamp dibuat dari sheet aktif "' + CFG.sourceSheetName + '".\n' +
        'Tidak membaca Rekap Approved atau link kolom E.\n' +
        'Output: "' + CFG.targetSheetName + '"\n' +
        'Final rows=' + activeResult.outputRows +
        ', inserted=' + activeResult.insertedRows +
        ', updated=' + activeResult.updatedRows +
        ', purged=' + activeResult.purgedRows +
        ', unchanged=' + activeResult.unchangedRows +
        ', duplicate removed=' + activeResult.existingDuplicateRowsRemoved
      );
      return activeResult;
    }

    var state = readState_();
    var isNewJob = !state;

    if (isNewJob) {
      var activeSs = options.masterSpreadsheetId
        ? RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(String(options.masterSpreadsheetId))
        : ((options.autoPipeline &&
          typeof RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_GET_MASTER_SPREADSHEET_20260813_ === 'function'
            ? RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_GET_MASTER_SPREADSHEET_20260813_()
            : null) || SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet());
      // Utamakan explicit masterSheetId dari Validate All E, lalu Rekap All/Rekap Approved.
      var activeSh = null;
      if(options.masterSheetId){try{activeSh=getSheetById_(activeSs,Number(options.masterSheetId));}catch(ignoreExplicitMaster){}}
      activeSh = activeSh || RSC_RESOLVE_MASTER_SHEET_20260813_(
        activeSs,
        [CFG.masterSheetName].concat(CFG.masterSheetAliases || [])
      ) || activeSs.getActiveSheet();

      state = {
        mode: 'MASTER_DONE',
        phase: 'SCAN_MASTER',
        masterSpreadsheetId: activeSs.getId(),
        masterSheetId: activeSh.getSheetId(),
        masterSheetName: activeSh.getName(),
        nextRow: CFG.firstDataRow,
        processedFiles: 0,
        doneRowsFound: 0,
        skippedRows: 0,
        validationSkippedRows: 0,
        errorFiles: 0,
        requireValidationOk: Boolean(options.requireValidationOk),
        validationRunToken: String(options.validationRunToken || ''),
        validationGateMode: String(options.validationGateMode || 'V20').toUpperCase(),
        autoPipeline: Boolean(options.autoPipeline),
        startedAt: new Date().toISOString()
      };

      saveState_(state);
      deleteOwnTriggers_();
      writeRevampStatus_(state, 'Job master dimulai. Membaca row DONE dan link kolom E.');
    } else {
      state.phase = state.phase || 'SCAN_MASTER';
      writeRevampStatus_(state, 'Melanjutkan job Template Revamp dari checkpoint terakhir.');
    }

    assertRevampNotStopped_('OPEN_MASTER');
    var masterSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(state.masterSpreadsheetId);
    var masterSh = getSheetById_(masterSs, state.masterSheetId);
    if (!masterSh) {
      throw new Error('Sheet master/control yang tersimpan tidak ditemukan.');
    }

    var lastRow = masterSh.getLastRow();
    state.masterLastRow = lastRow;
    if (lastRow < CFG.firstDataRow || state.nextRow > lastRow) {
      finishJob_(masterSs, state, 'Tidak ada baris lain yang perlu diproses.');
      return;
    }

    // PERF5: jangan full-scan m_bp_relation di awal job.
    // Setiap file hanya meminta exact relation yang benar-benar dipakai source-nya.
    var existingRelationKeys = null;

    // Kolom Sales Office di sheet master, dipakai untuk disambiguasi kalau
    // DB m_bp_sales_cust_view punya lebih dari 1 baris untuk bp_id yang sama.
    var masterSalesOfficeCol = resolveMasterSalesOfficeColumn_(masterSh);

    var filesThisExecution = 0;
    var cursor = Math.max(CFG.firstDataRow, Number(state.nextRow) || CFG.firstDataRow);

    while (cursor <= lastRow) {
      assertRevampNotStopped_('MASTER_ROW_' + cursor);
      state.phase = 'SCAN_MASTER';
      state.currentMasterRow = cursor;
      state.lastHeartbeatAt = new Date().toISOString();
      writeRevampStatus_(state, 'Membaca master row ' + cursor + ' dari ' + lastRow + '.');

      if (
        Date.now() - startedAt >= CFG.softDeadlineMs ||
        filesThisExecution >= CFG.maxFilesPerExecution
      ) {
        state.nextRow = cursor;
        state.phase = 'PAUSED_AUTO_CONTINUE';
        saveState_(state);
        writeRevampStatus_(state, 'Pause otomatis di master row ' + cursor + '; trigger lanjutan dibuat.');
        scheduleNextRun_();
        notify_(masterSs,
          'Template Revamp pause di row ' + cursor +
          '. Processed=' + state.processedFiles +
          ', error=' + state.errorFiles +
          '. Lanjut otomatis.'
        );
        return;
      }

      var batchSize = Math.min(CFG.masterReadChunkRows, lastRow - cursor + 1);
      var linkRange = masterSh.getRange(cursor, CFG.masterLinkCol, batchSize, 1);
      var statusRange = masterSh.getRange(cursor, CFG.masterStatusCol, batchSize, 1);
      var salesOfficeColRange = masterSh.getRange(cursor, masterSalesOfficeCol, batchSize, 1);

      var linkValues = linkRange.getValues();
      var linkDisplays = linkRange.getDisplayValues();
      var linkFormulas = linkRange.getFormulas();
      var linkRichTexts = linkRange.getRichTextValues();
      var statusDisplays = statusRange.getDisplayValues();
      var salesOfficeColDisplays = salesOfficeColRange.getDisplayValues();
      var smartChipUrls = getSmartChipUrls_(
        masterSs.getId(),
        masterSh.getName(),
        cursor,
        CFG.masterLinkCol,
        batchSize
      );

      for (var i = 0; i < batchSize; i++) {
        var masterRow = cursor + i;
        state.nextRow = masterRow + 1;

        if (String(statusDisplays[i][0] || '').trim().toUpperCase() !== CFG.doneText) {
          state.skippedRows++;
          continue;
        }

        // Auto pipeline hanya boleh membuat Revamp dari link yang PASS
        // pada validation run yang sama. Manual Revamp tetap backward compatible.
        if (state.requireValidationOk) {
          var validationGate = RSC_PERF12_IS_ROW_VALIDATION_OK_DISPATCH_20260819_(
            masterSs,
            masterRow,
            state.validationRunToken,
            state.validationGateMode
          );
          if (!validationGate.ok) {
            state.validationSkippedRows = Number(state.validationSkippedRows || 0) + 1;
            continue;
          }
        }

        state.doneRowsFound = Number(state.doneRowsFound || 0) + 1;

        if (
          Date.now() - startedAt >= CFG.softDeadlineMs ||
          filesThisExecution >= CFG.maxFilesPerExecution
        ) {
          state.nextRow = masterRow;
          state.phase = 'PAUSED_AUTO_CONTINUE';
          saveState_(state);
          writeRevampStatus_(state, 'Pause otomatis sebelum master row ' + masterRow + '; trigger lanjutan dibuat.');
          scheduleNextRun_();
          notify_(masterSs,
            'Template Revamp pause di row ' + masterRow +
            '. Processed=' + state.processedFiles +
            ', error=' + state.errorFiles +
            '. Lanjut otomatis.'
          );
          return;
        }

        var urlOrId = getUrlOrIdFromCell_(
          linkValues[i][0],
          linkDisplays[i][0],
          linkFormulas[i][0],
          linkRichTexts[i][0],
          smartChipUrls[masterRow]
        );
        var targetSpreadsheetId = extractSpreadsheetId_(urlOrId);

        if (!targetSpreadsheetId) {
          state.errorFiles++;
          setMasterNote_(masterSh, masterRow,
            'ERROR Template Revamp: link/Spreadsheet ID pada kolom E tidak terbaca.'
          );
          saveState_(state);
          continue;
        }

        try {
          assertRevampNotStopped_('BEFORE_FILE_' + masterRow);
          state.phase = 'BUILD_FILE';
          state.currentMasterRow = masterRow;
          state.currentFileId = targetSpreadsheetId;
          state.currentFileName = '';
          saveState_(state);
          writeRevampStatus_(state, 'Membangun Template Revamp untuk master row ' + masterRow + '.');

          var targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(targetSpreadsheetId);
          state.currentFileName = targetSs.getName();
          saveState_(state);
          var sourceSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(CFG.sourceSheetName);
          if (!sourceSh) {
            throw new Error('Sheet sumber tidak ditemukan: ' + CFG.sourceSheetName);
          }

          // Kode area/hub file ini sendiri (dari kolom Sales Office di Rekap
          // Approved). Dipakai untuk memilih baris DB m_bp_sales_cust_view
          // yang benar kalau bp_id punya lebih dari 1 kandidat sls_office.
          var currentAreaSalesOfficeCode = extractLeadingCode_(
            String(salesOfficeColDisplays[i][0] || '').trim(),
            4
          );

          // PERF5 per-file prefetch: narrow source scan -> targeted DB candidates.
          var fileHeaderInfo = findSourceHeader_(sourceSh);
          var fileNeeds = collectSourceLookupNeeds_(sourceSh, fileHeaderInfo);
          var fileRelationKeys = loadMbpRelationKeySubset_(fileNeeds.exactKeys, fileNeeds.exactValidTo, fileNeeds.pairKeys);
          var fileSalesCustSubset = loadSalesCustViewDbSubset_(fileNeeds.customerIds);
          if (!salesCustViewDbMapCache) salesCustViewDbMapCache = {};
          Object.keys(fileSalesCustSubset).forEach(function (bpId) {
            var incoming = fileSalesCustSubset[bpId] || [];
            if (!salesCustViewDbMapCache[bpId]) salesCustViewDbMapCache[bpId] = [];
            incoming.forEach(function (candidate) {
              var exists = salesCustViewDbMapCache[bpId].some(function (x) {
                return x.salesOffice === candidate.salesOffice && x.deliveringPlant === candidate.deliveringPlant;
              });
              if (!exists) salesCustViewDbMapCache[bpId].push(candidate);
            });
          });
          var result = buildRevampSheet_(targetSs, sourceSh, fileRelationKeys, currentAreaSalesOfficeCode);

          state.processedFiles++;
          filesThisExecution++;
          setMasterNote_(masterSh, masterRow,
            'OK Template Revamp Rolling Sales. Final rows=' + result.outputRows +
            ', inserted=' + result.insertedRows +
            ', updated=' + result.updatedRows +
            ', purged missing=' + result.purgedRows +
            ', unchanged=' + result.unchangedRows +
            ', existing duplicate removed=' + result.existingDuplicateRowsRemoved +
            ', source duplicate collapsed=' + result.sourceDuplicateKeysCollapsed +
            ', Toko Bangkrut forced blank=' + result.tokoBangkrutRows +
            ', Change Schedule Only="x"=' + result.changeScheduleOnlyRows +
            ', Sales Office override dari sheet Change Sales Office=' + result.salesOfficeOverriddenFromSheetRows +
            ', Sales Office override dari DB=' + result.salesOfficeOverriddenFromDbRows +
            ', DB ambiguous (bp_id multi row)=' + result.salesOfficeDbAmbiguousRows +
            ', DB ambiguous cocok area file ini=' + result.salesOfficeDbAreaMatchedRows +
            ', Sales-Office-only row baru=' + result.salesOfficeOnlyRowsAdded +
            ', Change Sales Office row ditandai "sudah di cover Rolling"=' + result.salesOfficeCoveredMarked +
            ', executed=' + new Date().toISOString()
          );
        } catch (fileErr) {
          state.errorFiles++;
          filesThisExecution++;
          setMasterNote_(masterSh, masterRow,
            'ERROR Template Revamp: ' + formatError_(fileErr)
          );
          console.error('Template Revamp row ' + masterRow + ': ' + formatError_(fileErr));
        }

        saveState_(state);
      }

      cursor += batchSize;
      state.nextRow = cursor;
      saveState_(state);
    }

    finishJob_(masterSs, state,
      'Template Revamp Rolling Sales selesai untuk semua row yang statusnya DONE.'
    );

  } catch (jobErr) {
    var failedState = readState_() || {};
    if (String(failedState.phase || '') !== 'STOPPED') {
      failedState.phase = 'ERROR';
      failedState.errorAt = new Date().toISOString();
      failedState.message = formatError_(jobErr);
      saveState_(failedState);
      writeRevampStatus_(failedState, 'ERROR: ' + formatError_(jobErr));
      try {
        if (failedState.autoPipeline && typeof RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_ON_REVAMP_ERROR_20260813_ === 'function') {
          RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_ON_REVAMP_ERROR_20260813_(failedState, jobErr);
        }
      } catch (pipelineCbErr) {
        console.error('Master auto pipeline revamp error callback failed: ' + formatError_(pipelineCbErr));
      }
    }
    throw jobErr;

  } finally {
    try {
      lock.releaseLock();
    } catch (ignore) {}
  }


  function buildRevampSheet_(targetSs, sourceSh, relationKeySet, currentAreaSalesOfficeCode) {
    var headerInfo = findSourceHeader_(sourceSh);
    var lastRow = sourceSh.getLastRow();
    var timezone = targetSs.getSpreadsheetTimeZone() || Session.getScriptTimeZone();

    // Cross-reference sheet Change Sales Office di file yang sama.
    var changeSalesOfficeInfo = loadChangeSalesOfficeMapForFile_(targetSs);
    var changeSalesOfficeMap = changeSalesOfficeInfo.map;
    var customerIdsFromRolling = Object.create(null);
    var anyChangeSalesOfficeOverride = false;
    var salesOfficeOverriddenFromSheetRows = 0;
    var salesOfficeOverriddenFromDbRows = 0;
    var salesOfficeDbAmbiguousRows = 0;
    var salesOfficeDbAreaMatchedRows = 0;

    // Source bersifat authoritative. Satu canonical key hanya menghasilkan
    // satu row final; source row terakhir untuk key yang sama menjadi winner.
    var sourceByKey = Object.create(null);
    var sourceKeyOrder = [];
    var sourceDuplicateKeysCollapsed = 0;
    var sourceRowsWithoutBusinessKey = [];
    var sourceNoKeySeen = Object.create(null);
    var tokoBangkrutRows = 0;
    var sourceBusinessRows = 0;

    if (lastRow >= headerInfo.dataStartRow) {
      var sourceFieldNames = Object.keys(headerInfo.cols).filter(function (field) {
        return Number(headerInfo.cols[field]) >= 0;
      });
      var sourceMinZero = Math.min.apply(null, sourceFieldNames.map(function (field) {
        return Number(headerInfo.cols[field]);
      }));
      var sourceMaxZero = Math.max.apply(null, sourceFieldNames.map(function (field) {
        return Number(headerInfo.cols[field]);
      }));
      var sourceWidth = sourceMaxZero - sourceMinZero + 1;
      var localCols = {};
      Object.keys(headerInfo.cols).forEach(function (field) {
        localCols[field] = Number(headerInfo.cols[field]) >= 0
          ? Number(headerInfo.cols[field]) - sourceMinZero
          : -1;
      });

      var sourceChunkRows = getSafeRangeChunkRows_(
        sourceWidth,
        CFG.sourceReadChunkRows
      );

      for (
        var sourceStartRow = headerInfo.dataStartRow;
        sourceStartRow <= lastRow;
        sourceStartRow += sourceChunkRows
      ) {
        assertRevampNotStopped_('SOURCE_CHUNK_' + sourceStartRow);
        var sourceCount = Math.min(sourceChunkRows, lastRow - sourceStartRow + 1);
        var sourceRange = sourceSh.getRange(
          sourceStartRow,
          sourceMinZero + 1,
          sourceCount,
          sourceWidth
        );
        var rawRows = sourceRange.getValues();
        var displayRows = sourceRange.getDisplayValues();

        for (var r = 0; r < sourceCount; r++) {
          var absoluteSourceRow = sourceStartRow + r;
          if ((absoluteSourceRow - headerInfo.dataStartRow) % CFG.heartbeatEveryRows === 0) {
            var heartbeatState = readState_() || {};
            heartbeatState.phase = 'READ_SOURCE';
            heartbeatState.currentSourceRow = absoluteSourceRow;
            heartbeatState.currentSourceLastRow = lastRow;
            heartbeatState.lastHeartbeatAt = new Date().toISOString();
            saveState_(heartbeatState);
            writeRevampStatus_(heartbeatState,
              'Membaca source row ' + absoluteSourceRow + ' dari ' + lastRow + '.');
          }

          var raw = rawRows[r];
          var display = displayRows[r];
          if (!sourceBusinessRowHasValue_(raw, display, localCols)) continue;
          sourceBusinessRows++;

          var customerId = getText_(raw, display, localCols.customerId);
          var relationship = extractLeadingCode_(
            getText_(raw, display, localCols.relationship),
            6
          );
          var salesmanId = getText_(raw, display, localCols.salesmanId);
          var salesmanBpType = getText_(raw, display, localCols.salesmanBpType);

          var validFrom = toIsoDate_(
            raw[localCols.validFrom],
            display[localCols.validFrom],
            timezone
          );
          var validTo = toIsoDate_(
            raw[localCols.validTo],
            display[localCols.validTo],
            timezone
          );
          var visitCategory = getText_(raw, display, localCols.visitCategory);
          var visitType = normalizeVisitType_(
            getText_(raw, display, localCols.visitType)
          );
          var scheduleVisit = getText_(raw, display, localCols.scheduleVisit);
          var visitValidFrom = toIsoDate_(
            raw[localCols.visitValidFrom],
            display[localCols.visitValidFrom],
            timezone
          );
          var visitValidTo = toIsoDate_(
            raw[localCols.visitValidTo],
            display[localCols.visitValidTo],
            timezone
          );

          var reason = localCols.reason >= 0
            ? getText_(raw, display, localCols.reason)
            : '';
          var isTokoBangkrut = isTokoBangkrutReason_(reason);
          if (isTokoBangkrut) tokoBangkrutRows++;
          if (customerId) customerIdsFromRolling[customerId] = true;

          var originalSalesOffice = extractLeadingCode_(
            getText_(raw, display, localCols.salesOffice),
            4
          );
          var originalDeliveringPlant = extractLeadingCode_(
            getText_(raw, display, localCols.deliveringPlant),
            4
          );

          var resolved = resolveSalesOfficeAndPlant_(
            customerId,
            changeSalesOfficeMap,
            originalSalesOffice,
            originalDeliveringPlant,
            currentAreaSalesOfficeCode
          );

          var salesOfficeSourceLabel = '';
          if (resolved.source === 'SHEET' || resolved.source === 'SHEET+DB') {
            salesOfficeSourceLabel = resolved.source === 'SHEET+DB'
              ? 'Change Sales Office + DB'
              : 'Change Sales Office';
            anyChangeSalesOfficeOverride = true;
            salesOfficeOverriddenFromSheetRows++;
          }
          if (resolved.source === 'DB' || resolved.source === 'SHEET+DB') {
            salesOfficeOverriddenFromDbRows++;
            if (resolved.dbAmbiguous) {
              salesOfficeDbAmbiguousRows++;
              if (resolved.dbAreaMatched) salesOfficeDbAreaMatchedRows++;
            }
          }

          var exactKey=makeExactKey_(customerId,relationship,salesmanId);
          var relationRecord=(!isTokoBangkrut&&exactKey&&validTo)
            ?selectRelationRecordForScheduleOnly_(relationKeySet[exactKey],validTo):null;
          var pairKey=makePairKey_(customerId,salesmanId);
          var pairRecord=(!isTokoBangkrut&&!relationship&&pairKey)
            ?selectPairRelationForScheduleOnly_(relationKeySet[pairKey],validTo):null;
          var changeScheduleMode=relationRecord?'EXACT_REL_VALID_TO':(pairRecord?'PAIR_NO_RELATION':'');
          var changeScheduleOnly=changeScheduleMode?'x':'';

          // PERF6 Revamp schedule-only is VISIT-only. Relation fields are removed
          // before canonical dedupe/distinct, regardless of which schedule-only mode matched.
          if(changeScheduleOnly){
            relationship='';
            validFrom='';
            validTo='';
          }

          var outputRow = [
            resolved.salesOffice,
            resolved.deliveringPlant,
            customerId,
            relationship,
            salesmanId,
            salesmanBpType,
            validFrom,
            validTo,
            visitCategory,
            visitType,
            scheduleVisit,
            visitValidFrom,
            visitValidTo,
            changeScheduleOnly,
            salesOfficeSourceLabel
          ];

          var rowKey = computeRowKey_(outputRow);
          if (rowKey) {
            if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(sourceByKey, rowKey)) {
              sourceDuplicateKeysCollapsed++;
            } else {
              sourceKeyOrder.push(rowKey);
            }
            sourceByKey[rowKey] = outputRow;
          } else {
            var noKeySignature = makeFullRowSignature_(outputRow);
            if (!sourceNoKeySeen[noKeySignature]) {
              sourceNoKeySeen[noKeySignature] = true;
              sourceRowsWithoutBusinessKey.push(outputRow);
            } else {
              sourceDuplicateKeysCollapsed++;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Customer yang hanya ada di Change Sales Office tetap dibuat sebagai
    // row khusus. Row khusus ini tidak dicampur dengan canonical key 6 kolom.
    var salesOfficeOnlyRowsAdded = 0;
    var salesOfficeCoveredMarked = 0;

    if (changeSalesOfficeInfo.sheet) {
      var soCustomerIds = Object.keys(changeSalesOfficeMap);
      var coveredSheetRows = [];

      for (var k = 0; k < soCustomerIds.length; k++) {
        var custId = soCustomerIds[k];
        var entry = changeSalesOfficeMap[custId];

        if (customerIdsFromRolling[custId]) {
          coveredSheetRows.push(entry.sheetRow);
          salesOfficeCoveredMarked++;
          continue;
        }

        var soRow = [
          entry.salesOffice,
          entry.deliveringPlant,
          custId,
          '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '',
          '',
          'Change Sales Office'
        ];

        var soKey = computeRowKey_(soRow);
        if (soKey) {
          if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(sourceByKey, soKey)) {
            sourceDuplicateKeysCollapsed++;
          } else {
            sourceKeyOrder.push(soKey);
          }
          sourceByKey[soKey] = soRow;
        } else {
          var soSignature = makeFullRowSignature_(soRow);
          if (!sourceNoKeySeen[soSignature]) {
            sourceNoKeySeen[soSignature] = true;
            sourceRowsWithoutBusinessKey.push(soRow);
          } else {
            sourceDuplicateKeysCollapsed++;
          }
        }

        salesOfficeOnlyRowsAdded++;
        anyChangeSalesOfficeOverride = true;
      }

      markChangeSalesOfficeCoveredRows_(
        changeSalesOfficeInfo.sheet,
        changeSalesOfficeInfo.headerRow || 1,
        coveredSheetRows
      );
    }

    var targetSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(CFG.targetSheetName);
    var targetWasCreated = false;
    if (!targetSh) {
      targetSh = targetSs.insertSheet(CFG.targetSheetName, sourceSh.getIndex());
      targetWasCreated = true;
    }

    var requiredCols = OUTPUT_HEADERS.length;
    if (targetSh.getMaxColumns() < requiredCols) {
      targetSh.insertColumnsAfter(
        targetSh.getMaxColumns(),
        requiredCols - targetSh.getMaxColumns()
      );
    }

    // Existing target dibaca per chunk. Map ini hanya dipakai untuk menghitung
    // delta dan menentukan INSERT / UPDATE / UNCHANGED / PURGE.
    var existingByKey = Object.create(null);
    var existingNoKeyBySignature = Object.create(null);
    var existingDuplicateRowsRemoved = 0;
    var existingDataRows = Math.max(0, targetSh.getLastRow() - 2);

    if (existingDataRows > 0) {
      var targetReadChunkRows = getSafeRangeChunkRows_(
        requiredCols,
        CFG.targetReadChunkRows
      );

      for (
        var existingOffset = 0;
        existingOffset < existingDataRows;
        existingOffset += targetReadChunkRows
      ) {
        assertRevampNotStopped_('READ_EXISTING_' + (existingOffset + 3));
        var existingCount = Math.min(
          targetReadChunkRows,
          existingDataRows - existingOffset
        );
        var existingRows = targetSh
          .getRange(3 + existingOffset, 1, existingCount, requiredCols)
          .getDisplayValues();

        for (var e = 0; e < existingRows.length; e++) {
          var existingRow = normalizeOutputRow_(existingRows[e]);
          if (!rowHasAnyValue_(existingRow)) continue;

          var existingKey = computeRowKey_(existingRow);
          if (existingKey) {
            if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(existingByKey, existingKey)) {
              existingDuplicateRowsRemoved++;
            }
            // Last existing row wins untuk membandingkan payload terbaru.
            existingByKey[existingKey] = existingRow;
          } else {
            var existingSignature = makeFullRowSignature_(existingRow);
            if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(existingNoKeyBySignature, existingSignature)) {
              existingDuplicateRowsRemoved++;
            } else {
              existingNoKeyBySignature[existingSignature] = existingRow;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    var insertedRows = 0;
    var updatedRows = 0;
    var unchangedRows = 0;
    var purgedRows = 0;
    var finalRows = [];

    // Authoritative sync untuk canonical key 6 kolom.
    for (var s = 0; s < sourceKeyOrder.length; s++) {
      var sourceKey = sourceKeyOrder[s];
      var newRow = sourceByKey[sourceKey];
      var oldRow = existingByKey[sourceKey];

      if (!oldRow) {
        insertedRows++;
      } else if (rowsEqual_(oldRow, newRow)) {
        unchangedRows++;
      } else {
        updatedRows++;
      }
      finalRows.push(newRow);
    }

    // Row tanpa canonical key tetap idempotent berdasarkan full-row signature.
    for (var nk = 0; nk < sourceRowsWithoutBusinessKey.length; nk++) {
      var noKeyRow = sourceRowsWithoutBusinessKey[nk];
      var signature = makeFullRowSignature_(noKeyRow);
      if (existingNoKeyBySignature[signature]) unchangedRows++;
      else insertedRows++;
      finalRows.push(noKeyRow);
    }

    // PURGE: key/signature yang ada di target tetapi sudah tidak ada di source.
    Object.keys(existingByKey).forEach(function (key) {
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(sourceByKey, key)) purgedRows++;
    });
    Object.keys(existingNoKeyBySignature).forEach(function (signature) {
      if (!sourceNoKeySeen[signature]) purgedRows++;
    });

    var requiredRows = Math.max(3, finalRows.length + 2);
    if (targetSh.getMaxRows() < requiredRows) {
      targetSh.insertRowsAfter(
        targetSh.getMaxRows(),
        requiredRows - targetSh.getMaxRows()
      );
    }

    assertRevampNotStopped_('BEFORE_OUTPUT_WRITE');

    var desiredSchedule = anyChangeSalesOfficeOverride ? CFG.scheduleDateText : '';
    var currentTop = targetSh.getRange(1, 1, 2, requiredCols).getDisplayValues();
    var scheduleChanged = String(currentTop[0][0] || '') !== 'Schedule' ||
      String(currentTop[0][1] || '') !== desiredSchedule;
    var headerChanged = !rowsEqual_(normalizeOutputRow_(currentTop[1]), OUTPUT_HEADERS);
    var dataChanged = targetWasCreated || insertedRows > 0 || updatedRows > 0 ||
      purgedRows > 0 || existingDuplicateRowsRemoved > 0 ||
      finalRows.length !== Object.keys(existingByKey).length +
        Object.keys(existingNoKeyBySignature).length;

    if (scheduleChanged) {
      targetSh.getRange(1, 1, 1, 2).setValues([['Schedule', desiredSchedule]]);
    }
    if (headerChanged) {
      targetSh.getRange(2, 1, 1, requiredCols).setValues([OUTPUT_HEADERS]);
    }

    if (dataChanged) {
      var rowsToClear = Math.max(existingDataRows, finalRows.length, 1);
      clearContentInChunks_(targetSh, 3, 1, rowsToClear, requiredCols);
      writeValuesInChunks_(targetSh, 3, 1, finalRows, requiredCols);
    }

    var marker = String(targetSh.getRange('A1').getNote() || '');
    var applyFullFormat = targetWasCreated || marker !== CFG.formatMarker;
    formatTargetSheet_(
      targetSh,
      requiredRows,
      requiredCols,
      applyFullFormat,
      dataChanged || targetWasCreated
    );
    if (applyFullFormat) targetSh.getRange('A1').setNote(CFG.formatMarker);

    if (scheduleChanged || headerChanged || dataChanged || applyFullFormat) {
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    }

    var markedRows = finalRows.reduce(function (count, row) {
      return count + (String(row[13] || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'x' ? 1 : 0);
    }, 0);

    return {
      outputRows: finalRows.length,
      sourceBusinessRows: sourceBusinessRows,
      insertedRows: insertedRows,
      updatedRows: updatedRows,
      purgedRows: purgedRows,
      unchangedRows: unchangedRows,
      existingDuplicateRowsRemoved: existingDuplicateRowsRemoved,
      sourceDuplicateKeysCollapsed: sourceDuplicateKeysCollapsed,
      tokoBangkrutRows: tokoBangkrutRows,
      changeScheduleOnlyRows: markedRows,
      salesOfficeOverriddenFromSheetRows: salesOfficeOverriddenFromSheetRows,
      salesOfficeOverriddenFromDbRows: salesOfficeOverriddenFromDbRows,
      salesOfficeDbAmbiguousRows: salesOfficeDbAmbiguousRows,
      salesOfficeDbAreaMatchedRows: salesOfficeDbAreaMatchedRows,
      salesOfficeOnlyRowsAdded: salesOfficeOnlyRowsAdded,
      salesOfficeCoveredMarked: salesOfficeCoveredMarked
    };
  }


  function getSafeRangeChunkRows_(columnCount, preferredRows) {
    var cols = Math.max(1, Number(columnCount || 1));
    var preferred = Math.max(1, Number(preferredRows || 1));
    var maxByCells = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(CFG.maxCellsPerRange || 12000) / cols));
    return Math.max(1, Math.min(preferred, maxByCells));
  }


  function clearContentInChunks_(sheet, startRow, startCol, rowCount, colCount) {
    if (!rowCount || rowCount < 1) return;
    var chunkRows = getSafeRangeChunkRows_(colCount, CFG.targetClearChunkRows);
    for (var offset = 0; offset < rowCount; offset += chunkRows) {
      assertRevampNotStopped_('CLEAR_OUTPUT_' + (startRow + offset));
      var count = Math.min(chunkRows, rowCount - offset);
      sheet.getRange(startRow + offset, startCol, count, colCount).clearContent();
    }
  }


  function writeValuesInChunks_(sheet, startRow, startCol, rows, colCount) {
    if (!rows || !rows.length) return;
    var chunkRows = getSafeRangeChunkRows_(colCount, CFG.targetWriteChunkRows);
    for (var offset = 0; offset < rows.length; offset += chunkRows) {
      assertRevampNotStopped_('WRITE_OUTPUT_' + (startRow + offset));
      var batch = rows.slice(offset, offset + chunkRows).map(function (row) {
        return normalizeOutputRow_(row);
      });
      sheet.getRange(startRow + offset, startCol, batch.length, colCount)
        .setNumberFormat('@')
        .setValues(batch);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Ambil kode Sales Office pertama yang terisi dari sheet aktif.
