   * Nilai ini hanya dipakai untuk memilih kandidat DB yang paling sesuai
   * bila satu Customer ID memiliki lebih dari satu Sales Office.
   */
  function resolveActiveSourceSalesOfficeCode_(sourceSh) {
    var headerInfo = findSourceHeader_(sourceSh);
    var salesOfficeIndex = headerInfo.cols.salesOffice;
    var lastRow = sourceSh.getLastRow();
    if (salesOfficeIndex < 0 || lastRow < headerInfo.dataStartRow) return '';

    var totalRows = lastRow - headerInfo.dataStartRow + 1;
    var chunkRows = getSafeRangeChunkRows_(1, CFG.lookupReadChunkRows);
    for (var offset = 0; offset < totalRows; offset += chunkRows) {
      assertRevampNotStopped_('ACTIVE_SALES_OFFICE_' + (headerInfo.dataStartRow + offset));
      var count = Math.min(chunkRows, totalRows - offset);
      var values = sourceSh.getRange(
        headerInfo.dataStartRow + offset,
        salesOfficeIndex + 1,
        count,
        1
      ).getDisplayValues();

      for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
        var value = String(values[i][0] || '').trim();
        if (!value) continue;
        var code = extractLeadingCode_(value, 4);
        if (code) return code;
      }
    }
    return '';
  }


  function normalizeOutputRow_(row) {
    var normalized = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < OUTPUT_HEADERS.length; i++) {
      normalized.push(String(row[i] == null ? '' : row[i]).trim());
    }
    normalized[9] = normalizeVisitType_(normalized[9]);
    return normalized;
  }


  function rowHasAnyValue_(row) {
    return row.some(function (value) {
      return String(value == null ? '' : value).trim() !== '';
    });
  }


  function rowsEqual_(left, right) {
    if (!left || !right || left.length !== right.length) return false;
    for (var i = 0; i < left.length; i++) {
      if (String(left[i] == null ? '' : left[i]).trim() !==
          String(right[i] == null ? '' : right[i]).trim()) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    return true;
  }


  function makeFullRowSignature_(row) {
    return row.map(function (value) {
      return String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
    }).join('\u001E');
  }


  function isTokoBangkrutReason_(reason) {
    return String(reason == null ? '' : reason)
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[_\-]+/g, ' ')
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .indexOf('toko bangkrut') !== -1;
  }


  function findSourceHeader_(sourceSh) {
    var lastRow = sourceSh.getLastRow();
    var lastCol = sourceSh.getLastColumn();
    if (!lastRow || !lastCol) {
      throw new Error('Sheet sumber kosong: ' + sourceSh.getName());
    }

    var scanRows = Math.min(CFG.sourceHeaderScanRows, lastRow);
    var scanCols = Math.min(lastCol, CFG.maxHeaderScanColumns || 100);
    var grid = sourceSh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, scanCols).getDisplayValues();
    var aliasLookup = {};

    Object.keys(SOURCE_ALIASES).forEach(function (field) {
      aliasLookup[field] = {};
      SOURCE_ALIASES[field].forEach(function (alias) {
        aliasLookup[field][normalizeHeader_(alias)] = true;
      });
    });

    for (var r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
      var cols = {};

      Object.keys(SOURCE_ALIASES).forEach(function (field) {
        cols[field] = -1;
      });

      for (var c = 0; c < grid[r].length; c++) {
        var normalized = normalizeHeader_(grid[r][c]);
        if (!normalized) continue;

        Object.keys(aliasLookup).some(function (field) {
          if (cols[field] < 0 && aliasLookup[field][normalized]) {
            cols[field] = c;
            return true;
          }
          return false;
        });
      }

      var missing = Object.keys(cols).filter(function (field) {
        return cols[field] < 0;
      });

      if (!missing.length) {
        // Reason bersifat optional; digunakan hanya untuk aturan Toko Bangkrut.
        cols.reason = -1;
        var reasonTargets = {};
        SOURCE_OPTIONAL_ALIASES.reason.forEach(function (alias) {
          reasonTargets[normalizeHeader_(alias)] = true;
        });
        for (var optionalCol = 0; optionalCol < grid[r].length; optionalCol++) {
          if (reasonTargets[normalizeHeader_(grid[r][optionalCol])]) {
            cols.reason = optionalCol;
            break;
          }
        }

        return {
          headerRow: r + 1,
          dataStartRow: r + 2,
          cols: cols
        };
      }
    }

    throw new Error(
      'Header lengkap tidak ditemukan pada ' + CFG.sourceSheetName +
      '. Wajib ada 13 kolom sumber sampai Visit Valid To.'
    );
  }


  function sourceBusinessRowHasValue_(rawRow, displayRow, cols) {
    return Object.keys(cols).some(function (field) {
      var idx = cols[field];
      if (idx < 0) return false;
      var raw = rawRow[idx];
      var display = displayRow[idx];
      if (raw instanceof Date && !isNaN(raw.getTime())) return true;
      return String(display == null ? '' : display).trim() !== '' ||
        String(raw == null ? '' : raw).trim() !== '';
    });
  }


  function getText_(rawRow, displayRow, zeroBasedCol) {
    var display = String(displayRow[zeroBasedCol] == null ? '' : displayRow[zeroBasedCol]).trim();
    if (display) return display;

    var raw = rawRow[zeroBasedCol];
    if (raw === null || raw === undefined) return '';
    if (raw instanceof Date && !isNaN(raw.getTime())) {
      return Utilities.formatDate(raw, Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd');
    }
    return String(raw).trim();
  }


  function extractLeadingCode_(value, codeLength) {
    var text = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
    if (!text) return '';

    // Contoh: "2AA0 - Bogor" -> "2AA0", "ZWS001 - ..." -> "ZWS001".
    var firstToken = text.split(/\s+-\s+|\s+/)[0].trim();
    var direct = firstToken.match(new RegExp('^[A-Za-z0-9]{' + codeLength + '}'));
    if (direct) return direct[0];

    var anywhere = text.match(new RegExp('([A-Za-z0-9]{' + codeLength + '})'));
    return anywhere ? anywhere[1] : text.substring(0, codeLength);
  }


  function normalizeVisitType_(value) {
    var text = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
    if (!text) return '';

    // Mengatasi raw/display seperti 3, 03, atau 3.0.
    var numericMatch = text.match(/^(\d+)(?:\.0+)?$/);
    if (numericMatch) {
      return numericMatch[1].padStart(2, '0');
    }

    return text;
  }


  function toIsoDate_(rawValue, displayValue, timezone) {
    if (rawValue === null || rawValue === undefined || rawValue === '') {
      var emptyDisplay = String(displayValue == null ? '' : displayValue).trim();
      if (!emptyDisplay) return '';
    }

    if (rawValue instanceof Date && !isNaN(rawValue.getTime())) {
      return Utilities.formatDate(rawValue, timezone, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
    }

    if (typeof rawValue === 'number' && isFinite(rawValue)) {
      // Spreadsheet serial date fallback.
      var millis = Math.round((rawValue - 25569) * 86400 * 1000);
      var serialDate = new Date(millis);
      if (!isNaN(serialDate.getTime())) {
        return Utilities.formatDate(serialDate, 'UTC', 'yyyy-MM-dd');
      }
    }

    var text = String(
      displayValue !== null && displayValue !== undefined && String(displayValue).trim() !== ''
        ? displayValue
        : rawValue
    ).trim();

    if (!text) return '';

    text = text
      .replace(/\u00A0/g, ' ')
      .replace(/\s+\d{1,2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?.*$/, '')
      .trim();

    var ymd = text.match(/^(\d{4})[-\/.](\d{1,2})[-\/.](\d{1,2})$/);
    if (ymd) {
      return validDateText_(Number(ymd[1]), Number(ymd[2]), Number(ymd[3]), text);
    }

    var parts = text.match(/^(\d{1,2})[-\/.](\d{1,2})[-\/.](\d{4})$/);
    if (parts) {
      var a = Number(parts[1]);
      var b = Number(parts[2]);
      var year = Number(parts[3]);
      var month;
      var day;

      if (a > 12 && b <= 12) {
        // dd/MM/yyyy
        day = a;
        month = b;
      } else if (b > 12 && a <= 12) {
        // MM/dd/yyyy
        month = a;
        day = b;
      } else {
        // Ambiguous: gunakan konvensi Indonesia dd/MM/yyyy.
        day = a;
        month = b;
      }

      return validDateText_(year, month, day, text);
    }

    // Source seharusnya sudah valid. Jika ada format yang tidak dikenali,
    // pertahankan teks agar function ini tidak menjalankan validasi bisnis ulang.
    return text;
  }


  function validDateText_(year, month, day, fallbackText) {
    if (!year || month < 1 || month > 12 || day < 1 || day > 31) {
      return fallbackText;
    }

    var d = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
    if (
      d.getUTCFullYear() !== year ||
      d.getUTCMonth() + 1 !== month ||
      d.getUTCDate() !== day
    ) {
      return fallbackText;
    }

    return String(year).padStart(4, '0') + '-' +
      String(month).padStart(2, '0') + '-' +
      String(day).padStart(2, '0');
  }


  /**
   * Active mode optimization: baca hanya tiga kolom key dari source dan
   * kumpulkan lookup yang benar-benar diperlukan.
   */
  function collectSourceLookupNeeds_(sourceSh, headerInfo) {
    var lastRow=sourceSh.getLastRow();
    var result={customerIds:{},exactKeys:{},exactValidTo:{},pairKeys:{},sourceRows:0};
    if(lastRow<headerInfo.dataStartRow)return result;
    var cols=[headerInfo.cols.customerId,headerInfo.cols.relationship,headerInfo.cols.salesmanId,headerInfo.cols.validTo],minZero=Math.min.apply(null,cols),maxZero=Math.max.apply(null,cols),width=maxZero-minZero+1,totalRows=lastRow-headerInfo.dataStartRow+1,chunkRows=getSafeRangeChunkRows_(width,CFG.lookupReadChunkRows);
    for(var offset=0;offset<totalRows;offset+=chunkRows){
      assertRevampNotStopped_('ACTIVE_LOOKUP_ROW_'+(headerInfo.dataStartRow+offset));
      var count=Math.min(chunkRows,totalRows-offset),rows=sourceSh.getRange(headerInfo.dataStartRow+offset,minZero+1,count,width).getDisplayValues();
      for(var i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
        var customerId=String(rows[i][headerInfo.cols.customerId-minZero]||'').trim();
        var relationship=extractLeadingCode_(String(rows[i][headerInfo.cols.relationship-minZero]||'').trim(),6);
        var salesmanId=String(rows[i][headerInfo.cols.salesmanId-minZero]||'').trim();
        var sourceValidTo=String(rows[i][headerInfo.cols.validTo-minZero]||'').trim();
        if(customerId)result.customerIds[customerId]=true;
        var exact=makeExactKey_(customerId,relationship,salesmanId);
        if(exact){result.exactKeys[exact]=true;if(!result.exactValidTo[exact])result.exactValidTo[exact]={};if(sourceValidTo)result.exactValidTo[exact][sourceValidTo]=true;}
        // PERF6 CASE 2: only Relationship-blank rows need Customer+Salesman pair lookup.
        if(customerId&&salesmanId&&!relationship){var pairKey=makePairKey_(customerId,salesmanId);if(pairKey)result.pairKeys[pairKey]=true;}
        if(customerId||relationship||salesmanId)result.sourceRows++;
      }
    }
    return result;
  }


  function loadMbpRelationKeySubset_(neededKeySet, neededValidToByKey, neededPairSet) {
    neededKeySet=neededKeySet||{};neededPairSet=neededPairSet||{};
    var neededExactCount=Object.keys(neededKeySet).length,neededPairCount=Object.keys(neededPairSet).length;
    if(!neededExactCount&&!neededPairCount)return{};
    assertRevampNotStopped_('LOOKUP_RELATION_CANDIDATES');
    var neededCustomers=Object.create(null);
    Object.keys(neededKeySet).forEach(function(k){var p=String(k||'').split('\u001F');if(p[0])neededCustomers[p[0]]=true;});
    Object.keys(neededPairSet).forEach(function(k){var p=String(k||'').split('\u001F');if(p.length>=3&&p[1])neededCustomers[p[1]]=true;});
    var candidate=(typeof RSC_PERF19_DB_20260819!=='undefined' && RSC_PERF19_DB_20260819.preferGeneratedLookup!==false && typeof RSC_PERF19_LOOKUP_RELATION_ROWS_20260819_==='function')?RSC_PERF19_LOOKUP_RELATION_ROWS_20260819_(neededCustomers):null;
    if(!candidate||!candidate.available){
      candidate=RSC_PERF19_WITH_HEAVY_DB_LEASE_20260819_(CFG.dbSpreadsheetId,'REVAMP_RELATION_LEGACY',function(){
        var dbSs=RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(CFG.dbSpreadsheetId),dbSh=RSC_PERF5_GET_SHEET_20260819_(dbSs,CFG.dbSheetName);
        if(!dbSh)throw new Error('Database sheet tidak ditemukan: '+CFG.dbSheetName);
        var lastRow=dbSh.getLastRow();if(lastRow<1)return{rows:[],scannedRows:0,lookupMode:'EMPTY_DB',available:true};
        var layout=RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_GET_LAYOUT_20260819_(dbSh);
        return RSC_PERF23_READ_RELATION_CANDIDATES_20260819_(dbSh,layout,neededCustomers);
      });
    }
    var found={},rows=candidate.rows||[];

    for(var i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
      var exactKey=makeExactKey_(rows[i][0],rows[i][1],rows[i][2]);
      if(exactKey&&neededKeySet[exactKey])addRelationRecord_(found,exactKey,rows[i][3],rows[i][4]);
      var pairKey=makePairKey_(rows[i][0],rows[i][2]);
      if(pairKey&&neededPairSet[pairKey])addRelationRecord_(found,pairKey,rows[i][3],rows[i][4],rows[i][1]);
    }
    writeRevampStatus_(readState_()||{},'Lookup m_bp_relation PERF6 mode='+String(candidate.lookupMode||'UNKNOWN')+'; candidateRead='+Number(candidate.scannedRows||0)+'; exact='+neededExactCount+'; pair='+neededPairCount+'; match='+Object.keys(found).length+'.');
    return found;
  }


  function loadSalesCustViewDbSubset_(neededCustomerSet) {
    var needed = Object.create(null);
    Object.keys(neededCustomerSet || {}).forEach(function (raw) {
      var id = String(raw == null ? '' : raw).trim().toUpperCase();
      if (id && RSC_PERF5_IS_LOOKUP_ID_20260819_(id)) needed[id] = true;
    });
    var neededCount = Object.keys(needed).length;
    if (!neededCount) return {};

    if (typeof RSC_PERF19_DB_20260819!=='undefined' && RSC_PERF19_DB_20260819.preferGeneratedLookup!==false && typeof RSC_PERF19_LOOKUP_SALES_CUST_20260819_ === 'function') {
      var fastSc=RSC_PERF19_LOOKUP_SALES_CUST_20260819_(needed);
      if(fastSc&&fastSc.available){
        var fastMap={};
        Object.keys(fastSc.map||{}).forEach(function(k){fastMap[k]=fastSc.map[k];});
        return fastMap;
      }
    }

    var dbSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(CFG.salesCustViewDbSpreadsheetId);
    var dbSh = RSC_PERF5_GET_SHEET_20260819_(dbSs, CFG.salesCustViewDbSheetName);
    if (!dbSh) throw new Error('Database sheet tidak ditemukan: ' + CFG.salesCustViewDbSheetName);
    var lastRow = dbSh.getLastRow(), lastCol = dbSh.getLastColumn();
    if (lastRow < 2 || lastCol < 1) return {};

    var scanRows = Math.min(CFG.salesCustViewDbHeaderScanRows, lastRow);
    var headerCols = Math.min(lastCol, CFG.maxHeaderScanColumns || 100);
    var headerGrid = dbSh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, headerCols).getDisplayValues();
    var headerRow = 0, cBpId = -1, cSlsOffice = -1, cDeliveringPlant = -1;
    for (var r = 0; r < headerGrid.length; r++) {
      var bpIdx = findHeaderIndex_(headerGrid[r], ['bp_id']);
      var soIdx = findHeaderIndex_(headerGrid[r], ['sls_office', 'sales_office']);
      var plantIdx = findHeaderIndex_(headerGrid[r], ['delivering_plant', 'delivering plant']);
      if (bpIdx >= 0 && soIdx >= 0 && plantIdx >= 0) {
        headerRow = r + 1; cBpId = bpIdx; cSlsOffice = soIdx; cDeliveringPlant = plantIdx; break;
      }
    }
    if (!headerRow) throw new Error('Header DB m_bp_sales_cust_view tidak lengkap.');

    var minCol = Math.min(cBpId, cSlsOffice, cDeliveringPlant) + 1;
    var maxCol = Math.max(cBpId, cSlsOffice, cDeliveringPlant) + 1;
    var width = maxCol - minCol + 1;
    var relBpId = cBpId - (minCol - 1), relSlsOffice = cSlsOffice - (minCol - 1), relPlant = cDeliveringPlant - (minCol - 1);
    var map = {};

    function absorb_(row) {
      var bpId = String(row[relBpId] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      if (!bpId || !needed[bpId]) return;
      var candidate = {
        salesOffice: extractLeadingCode_(String(row[relSlsOffice] || '').trim(), 4),
        deliveringPlant: extractLeadingCode_(String(row[relPlant] || '').trim(), 4)
      };
      if (!candidate.salesOffice && !candidate.deliveringPlant) return;
      if (!map[bpId]) map[bpId] = [];
      var duplicate = map[bpId].some(function (x) {
        return x.salesOffice === candidate.salesOffice && x.deliveringPlant === candidate.deliveringPlant;
      });
      if (!duplicate) map[bpId].push(candidate);
    }

    var targeted = RSC_PERF23_READ_TABULAR_CANDIDATES_20260819_(
      dbSh, cBpId + 1, headerRow + 1, lastRow, needed, minCol, width, 'DISPLAY'
    );
    var mode = 'TEXTFINDER';
    if (targeted) {
      mode = targeted.lookupMode;
      for (var i = 0; i < targeted.rows.length; i++) absorb_(targeted.rows[i].values);
    } else {
      mode = 'FULL_SCAN_FALLBACK';
      var dbChunkRows = getSafeRangeChunkRows_(width, CFG.salesCustViewDbReadChunkRows);
      for (var startRow = headerRow + 1; startRow <= lastRow; startRow += dbChunkRows) {
        assertRevampNotStopped_('SCAN_SALES_CUST_DB_' + startRow);
        var count = Math.min(dbChunkRows, lastRow - startRow + 1);
        var rows = dbSh.getRange(startRow, minCol, count, width).getDisplayValues();
        for (var j = 0; j < rows.length; j++) absorb_(rows[j]);
      }
    }
    writeRevampStatus_(readState_() || {}, 'Lookup m_bp_sales_cust_view PERF5 mode=' + mode + '; requested=' + neededCount + '; found=' + Object.keys(map).length + '.');
    return map;
  }


  function loadMbpRelationKeySet_() {
    var dbSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(CFG.dbSpreadsheetId);
    var dbSh = dbSs.getSheetByName(CFG.dbSheetName);
    if (!dbSh) {
      throw new Error('Database sheet tidak ditemukan: ' + CFG.dbSheetName);
    }

    var lastRow = dbSh.getLastRow();
    if (lastRow < 1) return {};

    var layout = RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_GET_LAYOUT_20260819_(dbSh);
    var firstDataRow = (layout.firstDataRow || (layout.headerRow + 1));
    var set = {};
    var dbChunkRows = getSafeRangeChunkRows_(1, CFG.dbReadChunkRows);

    for (var startRow = firstDataRow; startRow <= lastRow; startRow += dbChunkRows) {
      assertRevampNotStopped_('SCAN_RELATION_DB_FULL_' + startRow);
      var n = Math.min(dbChunkRows, lastRow - startRow + 1);
      var rows = RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_READ_CANONICAL_20260819_(dbSh, startRow, n, layout);

      for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
        var key = makeExactKey_(rows[i][0], rows[i][1], rows[i][2]);
        if (key) addRelationRecord_(set, key, rows[i][3], rows[i][4]);
      }
    }

    return set;
  }


  function addRelationRecord_(map, key, validFrom, validTo, relationship) {
    if(!key)return;
    var vf=String(validFrom==null?'':validFrom).trim(),vt=String(validTo==null?'':validTo).trim()||'9999-12-31',rel=String(relationship==null?'':relationship).trim().toUpperCase();
    if(!map[key])map[key]=[];
    var exists=map[key].some(function(r){return r.validFrom===vf&&r.validTo===vt&&String(r.relationship||'')===rel;});
    if(!exists)map[key].push({validFrom:vf,validTo:vt,relationship:rel});
  }

  function selectRelationRecordForScheduleOnly_(records, sourceValidTo) {
    if(!Array.isArray(records)||!records.length)return null;
    var sourceVt=String(sourceValidTo==null?'':sourceValidTo).trim();
    // PERF6 CASE 1 is intentionally strict: Valid To must exist and match DB.
    if(!sourceVt)return null;
    var exact=records.filter(function(r){return String(r.validTo||'')===sourceVt;});
    if(!exact.length)return null;
    exact.sort(function(a,b){return String(b.validFrom).localeCompare(String(a.validFrom));});
    return exact[0];
  }

  function selectPairRelationForScheduleOnly_(records, sourceValidTo) {
    if(!Array.isArray(records)||!records.length)return null;
    var sourceVt=String(sourceValidTo==null?'':sourceValidTo).trim();
    if(sourceVt){var exact=records.filter(function(r){return String(r.validTo||'')===sourceVt;});if(exact.length){exact.sort(function(a,b){return String(b.validFrom).localeCompare(String(a.validFrom));});return exact[0];}}
    var open=records.filter(function(r){return String(r.validTo||'')==='9999-12-31';});
    if(open.length){open.sort(function(a,b){return String(b.validFrom).localeCompare(String(a.validFrom));});return open[0];}
    var copy=records.slice().sort(function(a,b){var byTo=String(b.validTo).localeCompare(String(a.validTo));return byTo||String(b.validFrom).localeCompare(String(a.validFrom));});
    return copy[0];
  }

  function makeExactKey_(customerId, relationship, salesmanId) {
    var a=String(customerId==null?'':customerId).trim(),b=String(relationship==null?'':relationship).trim(),c=String(salesmanId==null?'':salesmanId).trim();
    if(!a||!b||!c)return'';
    return a+'\u001F'+b+'\u001F'+c;
  }

  function makePairKey_(customerId, salesmanId) {
    var a=String(customerId==null?'':customerId).trim(),c=String(salesmanId==null?'':salesmanId).trim();
    if(!a||!c)return'';
    return 'PAIR\u001F'+a+'\u001F'+c;
  }


  /**
   * Canonical key UPSERT / deduplikasi untuk 1 row Template Revamp:
   * Customer ID + Relationship + Salesman ID + Valid From + Visit Type + Visit Valid From.
   *
   * Catatan:
   * - makeExactKey_() tetap khusus untuk existence check ke DB m_bp_relation,
   *   karena key DB hanya Customer + Relationship + Salesman.
   * - Row "Sales Office only" tetap memakai synthetic key berbasis Customer ID.
   * - Selain itu -> '' dan memakai full-row signature sebagai fallback.
   */
  function computeRowKey_(row) {
    var customerId = String(row[2] == null ? '' : row[2]).trim();
    var relationship = String(row[3] == null ? '' : row[3]).trim().toUpperCase();
    var salesmanId = String(row[4] == null ? '' : row[4]).trim().toUpperCase();
    var keyTimezone = Session.getScriptTimeZone() || 'Asia/Jakarta';
    var validFrom=toIsoDate_(row[6],row[6],keyTimezone);
    var visitCategory=String(row[8]==null?'':row[8]).trim().toUpperCase();
    var visitType=normalizeVisitType_(row[9]);
    var scheduleVisit=RSC_NORMALIZE_FSD_SCHEDULE_FOR_COMPARISON_20260807_(row[10]);
    var visitValidFrom=toIsoDate_(row[11],row[11],keyTimezone);
    var visitValidTo=toIsoDate_(row[12],row[12],keyTimezone);
    var changeScheduleOnly=String(row[13]==null?'':row[13]).trim().toLowerCase()==='x';

    // PERF6: after Relationship/Valid From/Valid To are blanked, distinct by the
    // remaining visit-business identity. This collapses rows that differed only
    // by relation records but describe the same schedule change.
    if(changeScheduleOnly&&customerId&&salesmanId){
      return ['CHANGE_SCHEDULE_ONLY',customerId,salesmanId,visitCategory,visitType,scheduleVisit,visitValidFrom,visitValidTo].join('\u001F');
    }

    // Canonical business key wajib lengkap tepat 6 komponen.
    if (customerId && relationship && salesmanId && validFrom && visitType && visitValidFrom) {
      return [
        customerId,
        relationship,
        salesmanId,
        validFrom,
        visitType,
        visitValidFrom
      ].join('\u001F');
    }

    if (customerId && !relationship && !salesmanId) {
      return 'SALES_OFFICE_ONLY\u001F' + customerId;
    }

    return '';
  }


  /**
   * Resolve Sales Office + Delivering Plant untuk 1 Customer ID:
   * 1) Sheet Change Sales Office (file yang sama).
   * 2) DB m_bp_sales_cust_view (fallback). bp_id bisa punya lebih dari 1
   *    baris (beda division/sls_office) -> disambiguasi pakai kode Sales
   *    Office file/area yang sedang diproses (currentAreaSalesOfficeCode,
   *    diambil dari kolom Sales Office di Rekap Approved untuk row master
   *    yang sedang jalan). Kalau salah satu kandidat DB sls_office-nya
   *    persis sama dengan kode area file ini, itu yang dipakai. Kalau
   *    tidak ada yang cocok, fallback ke kandidat pertama di DB.
   * 3) Value asli dari row Change Rolling & Change Schedule (fallback terakhir).
   */
  function resolveSalesOfficeAndPlant_(customerId, changeSalesOfficeMap, originalSalesOffice, originalDeliveringPlant, currentAreaSalesOfficeCode) {
    var salesOffice = originalSalesOffice || '';
    var deliveringPlant = originalDeliveringPlant || '';
    var usedSheet = false;
    var usedDb = false;
    var dbAmbiguous = false;
    var dbAreaMatched = false;

    // Sheet Change Sales Office adalah prioritas tertinggi, tetapi override
    // dilakukan per field. Bila sheet hanya berisi salah satu field, field
    // lain tetap boleh dilengkapi dari DB/original agar tidak menjadi blank.
    if (
      customerId &&
      changeSalesOfficeMap &&
      Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(changeSalesOfficeMap, customerId)
    ) {
      var entry = changeSalesOfficeMap[customerId] || {};
      if (entry.salesOffice) {
        salesOffice = entry.salesOffice;
        usedSheet = true;
      }
      if (entry.deliveringPlant) {
        deliveringPlant = entry.deliveringPlant;
        usedSheet = true;
      }
    }

    if (customerId) {
      var candidates = getSalesCustViewDbCandidates_(customerId);
      if (candidates.length) {
        // Gunakan Sales Office hasil sheet/source sebagai disambiguator sebelum
        // fallback ke kode area master.
        var preferredOffice = salesOffice || currentAreaSalesOfficeCode || '';
        var chosen = chooseSalesCustViewDbCandidate_(candidates, preferredOffice);
        if (chosen && (chosen.salesOffice || chosen.deliveringPlant)) {
          dbAmbiguous = candidates.length > 1;
          dbAreaMatched = Boolean(chosen.areaMatched);

          if (!usedSheet) {
            // Bila tidak ada override sheet, DB berada di atas original source.
            if (chosen.salesOffice) salesOffice = chosen.salesOffice;
            if (chosen.deliveringPlant) deliveringPlant = chosen.deliveringPlant;
            usedDb = true;
          } else {
            // Bila sheet sudah memberi satu field, DB hanya melengkapi field blank.
            if (!salesOffice && chosen.salesOffice) {
              salesOffice = chosen.salesOffice;
              usedDb = true;
            }
            if (!deliveringPlant && chosen.deliveringPlant) {
              deliveringPlant = chosen.deliveringPlant;
              usedDb = true;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    return {
      salesOffice: salesOffice,
      deliveringPlant: deliveringPlant,
      source: usedSheet ? (usedDb ? 'SHEET+DB' : 'SHEET') : (usedDb ? 'DB' : ''),
      dbAmbiguous: dbAmbiguous,
      dbAreaMatched: dbAreaMatched
    };
  }


  /**
   * Dari beberapa kandidat DB (multi row untuk bp_id yang sama), pilih
   * satu berdasarkan kecocokan sls_office dengan kode area file ini.
   * Kalau tidak ada currentAreaSalesOfficeCode, atau tidak ada kandidat
   * yang cocok, fallback ke kandidat pertama (deterministic, first-wins).
   */
  function chooseSalesCustViewDbCandidate_(candidates, currentAreaSalesOfficeCode) {
    if (!candidates || !candidates.length) return null;

    var preferred = String(currentAreaSalesOfficeCode || '').trim();
    var best = null;
    var bestScore = -1;

    for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
      var candidate = candidates[i] || {};
      var areaMatched = Boolean(
        preferred && String(candidate.salesOffice || '').trim() === preferred
      );
      var completeness =
        (candidate.salesOffice ? 1 : 0) +
        (candidate.deliveringPlant ? 1 : 0);

      // Area match adalah prioritas utama; kelengkapan menjadi tie-breaker.
      var score = (areaMatched ? 100 : 0) + completeness;
      if (score > bestScore) {
        bestScore = score;
        best = {
          salesOffice: candidate.salesOffice || '',
          deliveringPlant: candidate.deliveringPlant || '',
          areaMatched: areaMatched
        };
      }
    }

    return best;
  }


  function getSalesCustViewDbCandidates_(bpId) {
    var id = String(bpId == null ? '' : bpId).trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!id) return [];
    if (!salesCustViewDbMapCache) salesCustViewDbMapCache = {};
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(salesCustViewDbMapCache, id)) {
      var need = {}; need[id] = true;
      var subset = loadSalesCustViewDbSubset_(need);
      salesCustViewDbMapCache[id] = subset[id] || [];
    }
    return salesCustViewDbMapCache[id] || [];
  }


  function getSalesCustViewDbMap_() {
    if (!salesCustViewDbMapCache) salesCustViewDbMapCache = {};
    return salesCustViewDbMapCache;
  }


  /**
   * Map bp_id -> array kandidat {salesOffice, deliveringPlant}. Satu
   * bp_id bisa punya lebih dari satu baris di DB (beda division/dist
   * channel menghasilkan sls_office berbeda), makanya di-simpan sebagai
   * array, bukan first-wins tunggal seperti sebelumnya.
   */
  function loadSalesCustViewDbMap_() {
    var dbSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(CFG.salesCustViewDbSpreadsheetId);
    var dbSh = dbSs.getSheetByName(CFG.salesCustViewDbSheetName);
    if (!dbSh) {
      throw new Error('Database sheet tidak ditemukan: ' + CFG.salesCustViewDbSheetName);
    }

    var lastRow = dbSh.getLastRow();
    var lastCol = dbSh.getLastColumn();
    if (lastRow < 2 || lastCol < 1) return {};

    var scanRows = Math.min(CFG.salesCustViewDbHeaderScanRows, lastRow);
    var headerCols = Math.min(lastCol, CFG.maxHeaderScanColumns || 100);
    var headerGrid = dbSh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, headerCols).getDisplayValues();

    var headerRow = 0;
    var cBpId = -1;
    var cSlsOffice = -1;
    var cDeliveringPlant = -1;

    for (var r = 0; r < headerGrid.length; r++) {
      var row = headerGrid[r];
      var bpIdx = findHeaderIndex_(row, ['bp_id']);
      var soIdx = findHeaderIndex_(row, ['sls_office', 'sales_office']);
      var plantIdx = findHeaderIndex_(row, ['delivering_plant', 'delivering plant']);

      if (bpIdx >= 0 && soIdx >= 0 && plantIdx >= 0) {
        headerRow = r + 1;
        cBpId = bpIdx;
        cSlsOffice = soIdx;
        cDeliveringPlant = plantIdx;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!headerRow) {
      throw new Error(
        'Header DB ' + CFG.salesCustViewDbSheetName +
        ' tidak lengkap. Wajib ada bp_id, sls_office, delivering_plant.'
      );
    }

    var minCol = Math.min(cBpId, cSlsOffice, cDeliveringPlant) + 1;
    var maxCol = Math.max(cBpId, cSlsOffice, cDeliveringPlant) + 1;
    var width = maxCol - minCol + 1;
    var relBpId = cBpId - (minCol - 1);
    var relSlsOffice = cSlsOffice - (minCol - 1);
    var relPlant = cDeliveringPlant - (minCol - 1);

    var map = {};
    var dbChunkRows = getSafeRangeChunkRows_(width, CFG.salesCustViewDbReadChunkRows);

    for (
      var startRow = headerRow + 1;
      startRow <= lastRow;
      startRow += dbChunkRows
    ) {
      assertRevampNotStopped_('SCAN_SALES_CUST_DB_FULL_' + startRow);
      var n = Math.min(dbChunkRows, lastRow - startRow + 1);
      var rows = dbSh.getRange(startRow, minCol, n, width).getDisplayValues();

      for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
        var bpId = String(rows[i][relBpId] || '').trim();
        if (!bpId) continue;

        var candidate = {
          salesOffice: extractLeadingCode_(String(rows[i][relSlsOffice] || '').trim(), 4),
          deliveringPlant: extractLeadingCode_(String(rows[i][relPlant] || '').trim(), 4)
        };

        if (!candidate.salesOffice && !candidate.deliveringPlant) continue;

        if (!map[bpId]) map[bpId] = [];

        var isDuplicate = map[bpId].some(function (existing) {
          return existing.salesOffice === candidate.salesOffice &&
            existing.deliveringPlant === candidate.deliveringPlant;
        });

        if (!isDuplicate) map[bpId].push(candidate);
      }
    }

    return map;
  }


  /**
   * Baca sheet "Change Sales Office" di file target (spreadsheet yang
   * sama dengan Change Rolling & Change Schedule), map by Customer ID
   * (BP Number Source).
   */
  function loadChangeSalesOfficeMapForFile_(targetSs) {
    var sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(CFG.salesOfficeSheetName);
    var result = { sheet: sh || null, map: {}, headerRow: 0 };
    if (!sh) return result;

    var lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
    var lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
    if (lastRow < 1 || lastCol < 1) return result;

    var scanRows = Math.min(CFG.salesOfficeHeaderScanRows, lastRow);
    var scanCols = Math.min(lastCol, CFG.maxHeaderScanColumns || 100);
    var grid = sh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, scanCols).getDisplayValues();

    var headerRow = 0;
    var cBp = -1;
    var cPlant = -1;
    var cSalesOffice = -1;

    for (var r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
      var row = grid[r];
      var bpCol = findHeaderIndex_(row, ['BP Number Source', 'Customer ID', 'BP ID', 'bp_id']);
      var plantCol = findHeaderIndex_(row, ['Delivering Plant', 'delivering_plant']);
      var soCol = findHeaderIndex_(row, ['Sales Office', 'sls_office']);
      if (bpCol >= 0 && plantCol >= 0 && soCol >= 0) {
        headerRow = r + 1;
        cBp = bpCol;
        cPlant = plantCol;
        cSalesOffice = soCol;
        break;
      }
    }

    result.headerRow = headerRow;
    if (!headerRow) return result;

    var dataStartRow = headerRow + 1;
    if (lastRow < dataStartRow) return result;

    var minZero = Math.min(cBp, cPlant, cSalesOffice);
    var maxZero = Math.max(cBp, cPlant, cSalesOffice);
    var width = maxZero - minZero + 1;
    var totalRows = lastRow - dataStartRow + 1;
    var chunkRows = getSafeRangeChunkRows_(width, CFG.lookupReadChunkRows);

    for (var offset = 0; offset < totalRows; offset += chunkRows) {
      assertRevampNotStopped_('READ_CHANGE_SALES_OFFICE_' + (dataStartRow + offset));
      var count = Math.min(chunkRows, totalRows - offset);
      var values = sh.getRange(
        dataStartRow + offset,
        minZero + 1,
        count,
        width
      ).getDisplayValues();

      for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
        var customerId = String(values[i][cBp - minZero] || '').trim();
        if (!customerId) continue;
        if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(result.map, customerId)) {
          result.map[customerId] = {
            salesOffice: extractLeadingCode_(String(values[i][cSalesOffice - minZero] || '').trim(), 4),
            deliveringPlant: extractLeadingCode_(String(values[i][cPlant - minZero] || '').trim(), 4),
            sheetRow: dataStartRow + offset + i
          };
        }
      }
    }
    return result;
  }


  /**
   * Tandai kolom I di sheet Change Sales Office untuk row-row yang
   * Customer ID-nya sudah tercover di Change Rolling & Change Schedule.
   */
  function markChangeSalesOfficeCoveredRows_(sheet, headerRow, rows) {
    var col = CFG.salesOfficeCoveredColumn;
    var lastCol = Math.max(sheet.getLastColumn(), 1);
    if (lastCol < col) sheet.insertColumnsAfter(lastCol, col - lastCol);

    var actualHeaderRow = headerRow || 1;
    var headerCell = sheet.getRange(actualHeaderRow, col);
    if (!String(headerCell.getDisplayValue() || '').trim()) {
      headerCell.setValue(CFG.salesOfficeCoveredHeaderLabel).setFontWeight('bold');
    }

    var wanted = Object.create(null);
    (rows || []).forEach(function (rowNumber) {
      wanted[String(Number(rowNumber || 0))] = true;
    });

    var dataStart = actualHeaderRow + 1;
    var lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
    if (lastRow < dataStart) return;

    var totalRows = lastRow - dataStart + 1;
    var chunkRows = getSafeRangeChunkRows_(1, CFG.lookupReadChunkRows);
    for (var offset = 0; offset < totalRows; offset += chunkRows) {
      var count = Math.min(chunkRows, totalRows - offset);
      var startRow = dataStart + offset;
      var range = sheet.getRange(startRow, col, count, 1);
      var values = range.getValues();
      var changed = false;

      for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
        var sheetRow = startRow + i;
        var current = String(values[i][0] || '').trim();
        if (wanted[String(sheetRow)]) {
          if (current !== CFG.salesOfficeCoveredMarkText) {
            values[i][0] = CFG.salesOfficeCoveredMarkText;
            changed = true;
          }
        } else if (current === CFG.salesOfficeCoveredMarkText) {
          values[i][0] = '';
          changed = true;
        }
      }
      if (changed) range.setValues(values);
    }
  }


  function findHeaderIndex_(row, aliases) {
    var targets = {};
    aliases.forEach(function (alias) {
      targets[normalizeHeader_(alias)] = true;
    });

    for (var c = 0; c < row.length; c++) {
      if (targets[normalizeHeader_(row[c])]) return c;
    }
    return -1;
  }


  function normalizeHeader_(value) {
    return String(value == null ? '' : value)
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[_\-]+/g, ' ')
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
  }


  /**
   * Cari kolom "Sales Office" di sheet master (Rekap Approved) by header;
   * fallback ke kolom A kalau header tidak ketemu. Dipanggil sekali per
   * execution (posisi kolom sama untuk semua row).
   */
  function resolveMasterSalesOfficeColumn_(masterSh) {
    var lastCol = masterSh.getLastColumn();
    var scanRows = Math.min(CFG.masterHeaderScanRows || 10, masterSh.getLastRow());
    if (scanRows < 1 || lastCol < 1) return CFG.masterSalesOfficeColFallback || 1;

    var scanCols = Math.min(lastCol, CFG.maxHeaderScanColumns || 100);
    var grid = masterSh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, scanCols).getDisplayValues();
    var aliases = CFG.masterSalesOfficeHeaderAliases || ['Sales Office'];

    for (var r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
      var idx = findHeaderIndex_(grid[r], aliases);
      if (idx >= 0) return idx + 1;
    }

    return CFG.masterSalesOfficeColFallback || 1;
  }


  function formatTargetSheet_(sh, requiredRows, requiredCols, applyFullFormat, formatData) {
    sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, 2)
      .setFontWeight('bold')
      .setBackground('#FFFFFF');
    sh.getRange('B1').setBackground('#FFF200');

    sh.getRange(2, 1, 1, requiredCols)
      .setFontWeight('bold')
      .setBackground('#F3F4F6')
      .setWrap(true)
      .setHorizontalAlignment('left');

    sh.setFrozenRows(2);

    if (formatData && requiredRows > 2) {
      var dataRows = requiredRows - 2;
      var chunkRows = getSafeRangeChunkRows_(requiredCols, CFG.targetWriteChunkRows);
      for (var offset = 0; offset < dataRows; offset += chunkRows) {
        var count = Math.min(chunkRows, dataRows - offset);
        sh.getRange(3 + offset, 1, count, requiredCols)
          .setNumberFormat('@')
          .setVerticalAlignment('middle')
          .setHorizontalAlignment('left');
      }
    }

    if (applyFullFormat) {
      sh.setRowHeight(1, 24);
      sh.setRowHeight(2, 42);
      var widths = [
        105, 110, 110, 110, 125, 120, 105,
        105, 105, 85, 175, 120, 120, 150, 170
      ];
      widths.forEach(function (width, idx) {
        sh.setColumnWidth(idx + 1, width);
      });
      sh.getRange(1, 1, 2, requiredCols).setBorder(
        true, true, true, true, true, true,
        '#D1D5DB', SpreadsheetApp.BorderStyle.SOLID
      );
    }
  }


  function getUrlOrIdFromCell_(rawValue, displayValue, formula, richText, smartChipUrl) {
    if (richText) {
      var wholeUrl = richText.getLinkUrl();
      if (wholeUrl) return wholeUrl;

      var runs = richText.getRuns();
      for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
        var runUrl = runs[i].getLinkUrl();
        if (runUrl) return runUrl;
      }
    }

    var f = String(formula || '');
    var m = f.match(/HYPERLINK\s*\(\s*"([^"]+)"/i);
    if (m) return m[1];
    m = f.match(/HYPERLINK\s*\(\s*'([^']+)'/i);
    if (m) return m[1];

    var candidates = [smartChipUrl, rawValue, displayValue];
    for (var c = 0; c < candidates.length; c++) {
      var text = String(candidates[c] == null ? '' : candidates[c]).trim();
      if (!text) continue;

      var url = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s"'<>]+/i);
      if (url) return url[0];

      if (/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{25,}$/.test(text) && text.indexOf('/') === -1) {
        return text;
      }
    }

    return '';
  }


  function extractSpreadsheetId_(urlOrId) {
    var text = String(urlOrId == null ? '' : urlOrId).trim();
    if (!text) return '';

    if (/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{25,}$/.test(text) && text.indexOf('/') === -1) {
      return text;
    }

    var patterns = [
      /\/spreadsheets\/d\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/,
      /[?&]id=([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/
    ];

    for (var i = 0; i < patterns.length; i++) {
      var m = text.match(patterns[i]);
      if (m) return m[1];
    }

    return '';
  }


  function getSmartChipUrls_(spreadsheetId, sheetName, startRow, sourceCol, numRows) {
    var map = {};

    try {
      // Advanced Google Sheets Service. Jika belum aktif, fallback link biasa tetap jalan.
      if (typeof Sheets === 'undefined') return map;

      var a1 = quoteSheetName_(sheetName) + '!' +
        columnLetter_(sourceCol) + startRow + ':' +
        columnLetter_(sourceCol) + (startRow + numRows - 1);

      var res = Sheets.Spreadsheets.get(spreadsheetId, {
        ranges: [a1],
        includeGridData: true,
        fields: 'sheets(data(rowData(values(chipRuns))))'
      });

      var sheets = res.sheets || [];
      var relativeRow = 0;

      for (var s = 0; s < sheets.length; s++) {
        var data = sheets[s].data || [];

        for (var d = 0; d < data.length; d++) {
          var rowData = data[d].rowData || [];

          for (var r = 0; r < rowData.length; r++) {
            var values = rowData[r].values || [];
            var cell = values[0];

            if (cell && cell.chipRuns) {
              for (var x = 0; x < cell.chipRuns.length; x++) {
                var chip = cell.chipRuns[x].chip;
                if (
                  chip &&
                  chip.richLinkProperties &&
                  chip.richLinkProperties.uri
                ) {
                  map[startRow + relativeRow] = chip.richLinkProperties.uri;
                  break;
                }
              }
            }

            relativeRow++;
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Smart chip URL fallback: ' + formatError_(err));
    }

    return map;
  }


  function quoteSheetName_(name) {
    return "'" + String(name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "'";
  }


  function columnLetter_(columnNumber) {
    var n = Number(columnNumber);
    var output = '';

    while (n > 0) {
      var remainder = (n - 1) % 26;
      output = String.fromCharCode(65 + remainder) + output;
      n = Math.floor((n - remainder - 1) / 26);
    }

    return output;
  }


  function getSheetById_(ss, sheetId) {
    var sheets = ss.getSheets();
    for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
      if (String(sheets[i].getSheetId()) === String(sheetId)) {
        return sheets[i];
      }
    }
    return null;
  }


  function setMasterNote_(masterSh, row, note) {
    try {
      masterSh.getRange(row, CFG.masterLinkCol).setNote(String(note || ''));
    } catch (ignore) {}
  }


  function readState_() {
    var raw = props.getProperty(CFG.jobProperty);
    if (!raw) return null;

    try {
      return JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch (err) {
      props.deleteProperty(CFG.jobProperty);
      return null;
    }
  }


  function saveState_(state) {
    state = state || {};
    state.lastHeartbeatAt = new Date().toISOString();
    props.setProperty(CFG.jobProperty, JSON.stringify(state));
  }


  function writeRevampStatus_(state, message) {
    state = state || {};
    var status = {
      mode: state.mode || '',
      phase: state.phase || '',
      currentMasterRow: state.currentMasterRow || state.nextRow || '',
      currentSourceRow: state.currentSourceRow || '',
      currentSourceLastRow: state.currentSourceLastRow || '',
      currentFileId: state.currentFileId || '',
      currentFileName: state.currentFileName || '',
      processedFiles: Number(state.processedFiles || 0),
      errorFiles: Number(state.errorFiles || 0),
      skippedRows: Number(state.skippedRows || 0),
      doneRowsFound: Number(state.doneRowsFound || 0),
      startedAt: state.startedAt || '',
      heartbeatAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      message: String(message || '')
    };
    props.setProperty(CFG.lastStatusProperty, JSON.stringify(status));
    try {
      var phaseUpper=String(status.phase||'').toUpperCase();
      var masterLast=Number(state.masterLastRow||0),masterNow=Number(status.currentMasterRow||0);
      var progress=masterLast>CFG.firstDataRow?Math.max(0,Math.min(99,((masterNow-CFG.firstDataRow)/Math.max(1,masterLast-CFG.firstDataRow+1))*100)):0;
      var logState=/ERROR/.test(phaseUpper)?'ERROR':(/STOP/.test(phaseUpper)?'STOPPED':(/PAUSED/.test(phaseUpper)?'PAUSED':'RUNNING'));
      if(/SELESAI|FINISH|COMPLETE/i.test(String(message||''))){logState='COMPLETE_OK';progress=100;}
      RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_GLOBAL_20260819_('REVAMP',{
        jobType:'TEMPLATE REVAMP',state:logState,stage:status.phase||'Template Revamp',progressPct:progress,
        current:masterNow||'',total:masterLast||'',fileName:status.currentFileName,fileId:status.currentFileId,
        sheetName:CFG.sourceSheetName||'Change Rolling & Change Schedule',rows:Number(status.currentSourceLastRow||0),
        message:String(message||''),error:logState==='ERROR'?String(message||''):'',
        startedAt:status.startedAt||'',worker:'REVAMP',runId:String(state.validationRunToken||state.runId||'')
      },{force:/ERROR|STOP|PAUSED|SELESAI|FINISH|COMPLETE/i.test(String(message||'')),history:/ERROR|STOP|PAUSED|SELESAI|FINISH|COMPLETE|Membangun Template Revamp/i.test(String(message||''))});
    } catch (ignorePerf16) {}
  }


  function assertRevampNotStopped_(checkpoint) {
    if (String(props.getProperty(CFG.stopProperty) || '').toUpperCase() !== 'TRUE') return;
    var state = readState_() || {};
    state.phase = 'STOPPED';
    state.stopCheckpoint = checkpoint || '';
    state.stoppedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    saveState_(state);
    writeRevampStatus_(state, 'Job dihentikan pada checkpoint ' + (checkpoint || '') + '.');
    deleteOwnTriggers_();
    throw new Error('RSC_REVAMP_STOP_REQUESTED: job dihentikan pada checkpoint ' + (checkpoint || ''));
  }


  function scheduleNextRun_() {
    deleteOwnTriggers_();
    RSC_PERF13_NEW_TRIGGER_20260819_(CFG.handlerName)
      .timeBased()
      .after(CFG.nextTriggerDelayMs)
      .create();
  }


  function deleteOwnTriggers_() {
    ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(function (trigger) {
      if (trigger.getHandlerFunction() === CFG.handlerName) {
        ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger);
      }
    });
  }


  function finishJob_(masterSs, state, message) {
    state.phase = 'FINISHED';
    state.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    writeRevampStatus_(state, message);
    props.setProperty(CFG.lastStatusProperty, JSON.stringify(state));
    props.deleteProperty(CFG.jobProperty);
    props.deleteProperty(CFG.stopProperty);
    deleteOwnTriggers_();

    try {
      if (state.autoPipeline && typeof RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_ON_REVAMP_DONE_20260813_ === 'function') {
        RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_ON_REVAMP_DONE_20260813_(state);
      }
    } catch (pipelineCbErr) {
      console.error('Master auto pipeline revamp callback failed: ' + formatError_(pipelineCbErr));
    }

    var masterSheetLabel = state.masterSheetName || CFG.masterSheetName || '(tidak diketahui)';
    var noDoneHint = Number(state.doneRowsFound || 0) === 0
      ? '\nPERINGATAN: Tidak ada nilai DONE di kolom F pada sheet tersebut.'
      : '';

    notify_(masterSs,
      message + '\n' +
      'Sheet master: ' + masterSheetLabel + '\n' +
      'Row DONE ditemukan: ' + Number(state.doneRowsFound || 0) + '\n' +
      'File berhasil: ' + state.processedFiles + '\n' +
      'File error: ' + state.errorFiles + '\n' +
      'Row non-DONE dilewati: ' + state.skippedRows + '\n' +
      'Row DONE tetapi validation tidak COMPLETE_OK: ' + Number(state.validationSkippedRows || 0) +
      noDoneHint
    );
  }


  function notify_(ss, message) {
    console.log(message);

    try {
      ss.toast(message, 'Template Revamp Rolling Sales', 10);
    } catch (ignoreToast) {}

    if (!options.silent) {
      try {
        SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(message);
      } catch (ignoreUi) {}
    }
  }


  function formatError_(err) {
    if (!err) return 'Unknown error';
    return err.message || String(err);
  }
}

 * - Sinkronisasi output memakai canonical key 6 kolom untuk INSERT/UPDATE/PURGE.
 */

  props.deleteProperty('RSC_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_STOP_REQUESTED_20260722');

    existingJob
      ? { continueOnly: true, integratedMenu: true }
      : { manualStart: true, integratedMenu: true }
  );
}

function RSC_SHOW_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_STATUS_20260722() {
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var rawJob = props.getProperty('RSC_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_ROLLING_JOB_20260720');
  var rawLast = props.getProperty('RSC_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_LAST_STATUS_20260722');
  var stop = String(props.getProperty('RSC_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_STOP_REQUESTED_20260722') || '').toUpperCase() === 'TRUE';
  var state = null;
  try { state = rawJob ? JSON.parse(rawJob) : (rawLast ? JSON.parse(rawLast) : null); } catch (e) {}

  if (!state) {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Template Revamp Job', 'Tidak ada job atau histori status yang tersimpan.', SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK);
    return;
  }

  var lines = [
    'Status: ' + (rawJob ? (stop ? 'STOP REQUESTED' : 'ACTIVE/PAUSED') : 'FINISHED/IDLE'),
    'Mode: ' + String(state.mode || '-'),
    'Phase: ' + String(state.phase || '-'),
    'Master row/checkpoint: ' + String(state.currentMasterRow || state.nextRow || '-'),
    'Source row: ' + String(state.currentSourceRow || '-') +
      (state.currentSourceLastRow ? ' / ' + state.currentSourceLastRow : ''),
    'Current file: ' + String(state.currentFileName || state.currentFileId || '-'),
    'Processed files: ' + Number(state.processedFiles || 0),
    'Error files: ' + Number(state.errorFiles || 0),
    'DONE rows found: ' + Number(state.doneRowsFound || 0),
    'Skipped rows: ' + Number(state.skippedRows || 0),
    'Started: ' + String(state.startedAt || '-'),
    'Heartbeat: ' + String(state.lastHeartbeatAt || state.heartbeatAt || '-'),
    'Finished: ' + String(state.finishedAt || '-'),
    'Message: ' + String(state.message || '-')
  ];
  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Template Revamp Job', lines.join('\n'), SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK);
}


function RSC_STOP_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_JOB_20260722() {
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.setProperty('RSC_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_STOP_REQUESTED_20260722', 'TRUE');
  var deleted = 0;
  ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(function (trigger) {
    if (trigger.getHandlerFunction() === 'RSC_CREATE_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_ROLLING_SALES_20260720') {
      ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger);
      deleted++;
    }
  });

  var state = null;
  try { state = JSON.parse(props.getProperty('RSC_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_ROLLING_JOB_20260720') || '{}'); } catch (e) { state = {}; }
  state.phase = 'STOP_REQUESTED';
  state.stopRequestedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  state.message = 'Stop diminta. Execution yang sedang berjalan berhenti pada heartbeat/checkpoint berikutnya.';
  props.setProperty('RSC_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_ROLLING_JOB_20260720', JSON.stringify(state));
  props.setProperty('RSC_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_LAST_STATUS_20260722', JSON.stringify(state));

  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
    'STOP Template Revamp diminta.\n\nTrigger yang dihapus: ' + deleted +
    '\nExecution Google yang sudah Running tidak dapat dipaksa mati seketika; V8 memeriksa kill-switch setiap ±250 source row dan setiap batch database.'
  );
}


function RSC_RESET_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_JOB_20260722() {
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.setProperty('RSC_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_STOP_REQUESTED_20260722', 'TRUE');
  var deleted = 0;
  ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(function (trigger) {
    if (trigger.getHandlerFunction() === 'RSC_CREATE_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_ROLLING_SALES_20260720') {
      ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger);
      deleted++;
    }
  });
  props.deleteProperty('RSC_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_ROLLING_JOB_20260720');
  // Kill-switch tetap TRUE agar execution lama yang masih Running berhenti.
  // Klik START/CONTINUE manual akan menghapus flag ini secara aman.
  props.setProperty('RSC_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_LAST_STATUS_20260722', JSON.stringify({
    phase: 'RESET',
    resetAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    message: 'Checkpoint dan trigger Revamp dibersihkan.'
  }));
  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Reset Template Revamp selesai. Trigger dihapus: ' + deleted + '.');
}

/*
 * MENU INTEGRATION PATCH V14.2 — 2026-07-23
 * Template Revamp Job terpasang langsung pada onOpen(e) di submenu:
 * 7) Template Revamp Job — Integrated.
 * Modul Compile Upload Ready tetap tersedia sebagai function, tetapi tidak
 * ditampilkan di menu utama karena bukan job yang dimaksud pada patch ini.
 */

/***************************************************************
 * COMPILE TO UPLOAD READY TEMPLATE — 2026-07-21
 *
 * SOURCE MASTER:
 * - Sheet "Rekap Approved" pada spreadsheet tempat script berjalan.
 * - Kolom E = link file template.
 * - Kolom F harus DONE.
 *
 * SOURCE PER FILE:
 * - Sheet "Template Revamp Rolling Sales".
 * - Join memakai Customer ID + Sales Office dari Template Revamp.
 *
 * DATABASE JOIN:
 * - Spreadsheet: 1Ar2WCG6vQ_4JHLoo6Ov233w466XmKNb5ibetST2ElJw
 * - Sheet: m_bp_sales_cust_view
 * - Join: bp_id + sls_office
 *
 * OUTPUT:
 * - Spreadsheet: 1MICN4looSymto1bLn5JgWfSFDfX0Fi3LtpsuweWxxxE
 * - Satu sheet untuk setiap kombinasi unik:
 *     sls_org + dist_channel + division + sls_office
 * - Nama contoh: STA1 11 12 2AA0
 * - Isi A:O sama seperti Template Revamp Rolling Sales.
 *
 * ENGINE:
 * - COLLECT -> DB_SCAN -> DISTRIBUTE -> FINALIZE.
 * - Checkpoint di Document Properties.
 * - Time trigger run-and-continue.
 * - Tidak menyimpan seluruh m_bp_sales_cust_view di memory.
 * - Crash-safe: duplicate sementara dibersihkan saat FINALIZE.
 ***************************************************************/

  dbSpreadsheetId: '1Ar2WCG6vQ_4JHLoo6Ov233w466XmKNb5ibetST2ElJw',
  dbSheetName: 'm_bp_sales_cust_view',
  dbHeaderScanRows: 10,

  ]
