/**
 * MENU START:
 * Menghapus staging job lama, lalu membangun output baru dari seluruh link DONE.
 */
function RSC_START_COMPILE_UPLOAD_READY_TEMPLATE_20260721() {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;
  var lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(5000)) {
    throw new Error('Compile to Upload Ready Template sedang dipakai execution lain.');
  }

  try {
    var masterSs = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    var masterSh = masterSs.getSheetByName(P.masterSheetName);

    if (!masterSh) {
      throw new Error('Sheet master "' + P.masterSheetName + '" tidak ditemukan.');
    }

    var targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
    RSC_URT_prepareRunSheets_20260721_(targetSs);

    var runId = Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
    ) + '_' + Utilities.getUuid().substring(0, 8);

    var stats = {
      runId: runId,
      startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      finishedAt: '',
      phase: 'COLLECT',
      masterDoneRows: 0,
      filesCompiled: 0,
      filesSkipped: 0,
      filesError: 0,
      sourceRows: 0,
      dbRowsScanned: 0,
      dbMatchRows: 0,
      distributedRows: 0,
      unmatchedSourceRows: 0,
      outputGroups: 0,
      outputRows: 0,
      staleSheetsDeleted: 0,
      globalErrors: 0,
      lastError: ''
    };

    var job = {
      runId: runId,
      masterSpreadsheetId: masterSs.getId(),
      masterSheetId: masterSh.getSheetId(),
      phase: 'COLLECT',
      masterCursor: P.firstDataRow,
      stageNextRow: 2,
      needsNextRow: 2,
      mapNextRow: 2,
      dbMeta: null,
      dbCursor: 0,
      stageCursor: 2,
      finalizeCursor: 0,
      filesThisExecution: 0,
      globalErrors: 0,
      lastHeartbeatAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      nextTriggerReason: '',
      stats: stats
    };

    var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
    props.setProperty(P.pJob, JSON.stringify(job));
    props.setProperty(P.pLastStats, JSON.stringify(stats));

    RSC_URT_deleteContinuationTriggers_20260721_();
    RSC_URT_log_20260721_(
      targetSs,
      job,
      'INFO',
      'RUN_START',
      'Compile Upload Ready dimulai dari Rekap Approved kolom E dengan status DONE.'
    );
  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (ignore) {}
  }

  RSC_CONTINUE_COMPILE_UPLOAD_READY_TEMPLATE_20260721();
}


/**
 * MANUAL CONTINUE + TIME-TRIGGER HANDLER.
 */
function RSC_CONTINUE_COMPILE_UPLOAD_READY_TEMPLATE_20260721() {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var raw = props.getProperty(P.pJob);

  if (!raw) {
    RSC_URT_deleteContinuationTriggers_20260721_();
    RSC_URT_toast_20260721_(
      'Tidak ada job Compile to Upload Ready Template yang sedang berjalan.'
    );
    return;
  }

  var job;
  try {
    job = JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch (parseErr) {
    props.deleteProperty(P.pJob);
    RSC_URT_deleteContinuationTriggers_20260721_();
    throw new Error('Checkpoint Compile Upload Ready rusak: ' + RSC_URT_error_20260721_(parseErr));
  }

  var lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(1000)) {
    RSC_URT_scheduleContinuation_20260721_(job, 'LOCK_BUSY', P.triggerDelayMs);
    return;
  }

  var started = Date.now();

  try {
    // Watchdog dibuat di awal. Jika execution timeout keras, job tetap hidup.
    RSC_URT_scheduleContinuation_20260721_(job, 'WATCHDOG', P.watchdogDelayMs);

    var targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);

    while (Date.now() - started < P.softDeadlineMs) {
      job.lastHeartbeatAt = new Date().toISOString();

      if (job.phase === 'COLLECT') {
        var collectDone = RSC_URT_collectPhase_20260721_(job, targetSs, started);
        if (!collectDone) {
          RSC_URT_pause_20260721_(job, 'COLLECT_CONTINUE');
          return;
        }
        job.phase = 'DB_SCAN';
        job.stats.phase = job.phase;
        RSC_URT_saveJob_20260721_(job);
        RSC_URT_log_20260721_(
          targetSs,
          job,
          'INFO',
          'COLLECT_DONE',
          'Template Revamp selesai distaging. Source rows=' + job.stats.sourceRows + '.'
        );
        continue;
      }

      if (job.phase === 'DB_SCAN') {
        var dbDone = RSC_URT_dbScanPhase_20260721_(job, targetSs, started);
        if (!dbDone) {
          RSC_URT_pause_20260721_(job, 'DB_SCAN_CONTINUE');
          return;
        }
        job.phase = 'DISTRIBUTE_PREP';
        job.stats.phase = job.phase;
        RSC_URT_saveJob_20260721_(job);
        RSC_URT_log_20260721_(
          targetSs,
          job,
          'INFO',
          'DB_SCAN_DONE',
          'Database selesai discan. Rows=' + job.stats.dbRowsScanned +
            ', match rows=' + job.stats.dbMatchRows + '.'
        );
        continue;
      }

      if (job.phase === 'DISTRIBUTE_PREP') {
        RSC_URT_prepareDistribution_20260721_(job, targetSs);
        job.phase = 'DISTRIBUTE';
        job.stats.phase = job.phase;
        job.stageCursor = 2;
        RSC_URT_saveJob_20260721_(job);
        continue;
      }

      if (job.phase === 'DISTRIBUTE') {
        var distributionDone = RSC_URT_distributePhase_20260721_(job, targetSs, started);
        if (!distributionDone) {
          RSC_URT_pause_20260721_(job, 'DISTRIBUTE_CONTINUE');
          return;
        }

        RSC_URT_compactRunIndex_20260721_(targetSs);
        job.phase = 'FINALIZE';
        job.stats.phase = job.phase;
        job.finalizeCursor = 0;
        RSC_URT_saveJob_20260721_(job);
        RSC_URT_log_20260721_(
          targetSs,
          job,
          'INFO',
          'DISTRIBUTE_DONE',
          'Seluruh staging row selesai didistribusikan.'
        );
        continue;
      }

      if (job.phase === 'FINALIZE') {
        var finalizeDone = RSC_URT_finalizePhase_20260721_(job, targetSs, started);
        if (!finalizeDone) {
          RSC_URT_pause_20260721_(job, 'FINALIZE_CONTINUE');
          return;
        }

        RSC_URT_finish_20260721_(job, targetSs);
        return;
      }

      throw new Error('Phase job tidak dikenali: ' + job.phase);
    }

    RSC_URT_pause_20260721_(job, 'SOFT_DEADLINE');
  } catch (err) {
    job.globalErrors = Number(job.globalErrors || 0) + 1;
    job.stats.globalErrors = job.globalErrors;
    job.stats.lastError = RSC_URT_error_20260721_(err);
    job.stats.phase = job.phase || '';

    RSC_URT_saveJob_20260721_(job);
    try {
      if (!targetSs) {
        targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
      }
      RSC_URT_log_20260721_(
        targetSs,
        job,
        'ERROR',
        'GLOBAL_ERROR',
        job.stats.lastError
      );
    } catch (ignoreLogError) {
      console.error('Compile Upload Ready global error: ' + job.stats.lastError);
    }

    if (job.globalErrors >= P.maxGlobalErrors) {
      PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().deleteProperty(P.pJob);
      PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().setProperty(
        P.pLastStats,
        JSON.stringify(job.stats)
      );
      RSC_URT_deleteContinuationTriggers_20260721_();
      throw new Error(
        'Compile Upload Ready dihentikan setelah ' + job.globalErrors +
        ' global error. Error terakhir: ' + job.stats.lastError
      );
    }

    RSC_URT_scheduleContinuation_20260721_(
      job,
      'RETRY_AFTER_ERROR',
      P.triggerDelayMs
    );
    throw err;
  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (ignoreLock) {}
  }
}


/**
 * STOP job tanpa menghapus hasil output terakhir yang sudah jadi.
 */
function RSC_STOP_COMPILE_UPLOAD_READY_TEMPLATE_20260721(silent) {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;
  PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().deleteProperty(P.pJob);
  RSC_URT_deleteContinuationTriggers_20260721_();

  if (!silent) {
    RSC_URT_toast_20260721_('Job Compile to Upload Ready Template dihentikan.');
  }
}


/**
 * STATUS job aktif atau hasil run terakhir.
 */
function RSC_SHOW_COMPILE_UPLOAD_READY_TEMPLATE_STATUS_20260721() {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var rawJob = props.getProperty(P.pJob);
  var data = null;
  var active = false;

  if (rawJob) {
    try {
      var job = JSON.parse(rawJob);
      data = job.stats || {};
      data.phase = job.phase || data.phase || '';
      data.masterCursor = job.masterCursor;
      data.dbCursor = job.dbCursor;
      data.stageCursor = job.stageCursor;
      data.finalizeCursor = job.finalizeCursor;
      data.lastHeartbeatAt = job.lastHeartbeatAt;
      data.nextTriggerReason = job.nextTriggerReason;
      active = true;
    } catch (ignoreParse) {}
  }

  if (!data) {
    var rawStats = props.getProperty(P.pLastStats);
    if (rawStats) {
      try { data = JSON.parse(rawStats); } catch (ignoreStats) {}
    }
  }

  if (!data) {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Belum ada riwayat Compile to Upload Ready Template.');
    return;
  }

  var message = [
    'Compile to Upload Ready Template',
    '',
    'Status: ' + (active ? 'RUNNING' : 'TIDAK AKTIF / RUN TERAKHIR'),
    'Run ID: ' + String(data.runId || ''),
    'Phase: ' + String(data.phase || ''),
    'Started: ' + String(data.startedAt || ''),
    'Finished: ' + String(data.finishedAt || ''),
    'DONE master rows: ' + Number(data.masterDoneRows || 0),
    'Files compiled: ' + Number(data.filesCompiled || 0),
    'Files skipped: ' + Number(data.filesSkipped || 0),
    'Files error: ' + Number(data.filesError || 0),
    'Source rows: ' + Number(data.sourceRows || 0),
    'DB rows scanned: ' + Number(data.dbRowsScanned || 0),
    'DB match rows: ' + Number(data.dbMatchRows || 0),
    'Distributed rows: ' + Number(data.distributedRows || 0),
    'Unmatched source rows: ' + Number(data.unmatchedSourceRows || 0),
    'Output groups: ' + Number(data.outputGroups || 0),
    'Output rows: ' + Number(data.outputRows || 0),
    'Last heartbeat: ' + String(data.lastHeartbeatAt || ''),
    'Next trigger reason: ' + String(data.nextTriggerReason || ''),
    'Last error: ' + String(data.lastError || '')
  ].join('\n');

  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(message);
}


/* ============================================================
 * PHASE 1 — COLLECT TEMPLATE REVAMP
 * ========================================================== */

function RSC_URT_collectPhase_20260721_(job, targetSs, started) {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;
  var masterSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(job.masterSpreadsheetId);
  var masterSh = RSC_URT_getSheetById_20260721_(masterSs, job.masterSheetId) ||
    masterSs.getSheetByName(P.masterSheetName);

  if (!masterSh) {
    throw new Error('Sheet master Rekap Approved tidak ditemukan lagi.');
  }

  var lastRow = masterSh.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow < P.firstDataRow || job.masterCursor > lastRow) {
    return true;
  }

  var filesThisRun = 0;

  while (
    job.masterCursor <= lastRow &&
    Date.now() - started < P.softDeadlineMs &&
    filesThisRun < P.hardMaxFilesPerRun
  ) {
    var count = Math.min(P.masterReadBatchRows, lastRow - job.masterCursor + 1);
    var linkRange = masterSh.getRange(job.masterCursor, P.masterLinkCol, count, 1);
    var statusRange = masterSh.getRange(job.masterCursor, P.masterStatusCol, count, 1);

    var rawLinks = linkRange.getValues();
    var displayLinks = linkRange.getDisplayValues();
    var formulas = linkRange.getFormulas();
    var richTexts = linkRange.getRichTextValues();
    var statuses = statusRange.getDisplayValues();

    var chipUrls = RSC_URT_getSmartChipUrls_20260721_(
      masterSs.getId(),
      masterSh.getName(),
      job.masterCursor,
      P.masterLinkCol,
      count
    );

    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      var masterRow = job.masterCursor + i;

      if (
        Date.now() - started >= P.softDeadlineMs ||
        filesThisRun >= P.hardMaxFilesPerRun
      ) {
        job.masterCursor = masterRow;
        RSC_URT_saveJob_20260721_(job);
        return false;
      }

      var status = String(statuses[i][0] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      if (status !== P.doneText) {
        job.masterCursor = masterRow + 1;
        continue;
      }

      job.stats.masterDoneRows = Number(job.stats.masterDoneRows || 0) + 1;

      var urlOrId = RSC_URT_getUrlOrId_20260721_(
        rawLinks[i][0],
        displayLinks[i][0],
        formulas[i][0],
        richTexts[i][0],
        chipUrls[masterRow]
      );
      var fileId = RSC_URT_extractSpreadsheetId_20260721_(urlOrId);

      if (!fileId) {
        job.stats.filesSkipped = Number(job.stats.filesSkipped || 0) + 1;
        RSC_URT_log_20260721_(
          targetSs,
          job,
          'WARN',
          'INVALID_LINK',
          'Master row ' + masterRow + ': link kolom E tidak terbaca.'
        );
        job.masterCursor = masterRow + 1;
        RSC_URT_saveJob_20260721_(job);
        continue;
      }

      try {
        var result = RSC_URT_stageOneRevampFile_20260721_(
          targetSs,
          fileId,
          masterRow,
          job
        );

        if (result.rows > 0) {
          job.stats.filesCompiled = Number(job.stats.filesCompiled || 0) + 1;
          job.stats.sourceRows = Number(job.stats.sourceRows || 0) + result.rows;
        } else {
          job.stats.filesSkipped = Number(job.stats.filesSkipped || 0) + 1;
        }
      } catch (fileErr) {
        job.stats.filesError = Number(job.stats.filesError || 0) + 1;
        RSC_URT_log_20260721_(
          targetSs,
          job,
          'ERROR',
          'SOURCE_FILE_ERROR',
          'Master row ' + masterRow + ', file ' + fileId + ': ' +
            RSC_URT_error_20260721_(fileErr)
        );
      }

      filesThisRun++;
      job.masterCursor = masterRow + 1;
      RSC_URT_saveJob_20260721_(job);
    }
  }

  return job.masterCursor > lastRow;
}


function RSC_URT_stageOneRevampFile_20260721_(targetSs, fileId, masterRow, job) {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;
  var sourceSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(fileId);
  var sourceSh = sourceSs.getSheetByName(P.sourceSheetName) ||
    RSC_URT_findSheetContains_20260721_(sourceSs, ['template', 'revamp', 'rolling']);

  if (!sourceSh) {
    throw new Error('Sheet "' + P.sourceSheetName + '" tidak ditemukan.');
  }

  var header = RSC_URT_findRevampHeader_20260721_(sourceSh);
  var lastRow = sourceSh.getLastRow();

  if (lastRow < header.headerRow + 1) {
    return { rows: 0, needs: 0 };
  }

  var dataStart = header.headerRow + 1;
  var numRows = lastRow - dataStart + 1;
  var lastCol = sourceSh.getLastColumn();
  var displayRows = sourceSh.getRange(dataStart, 1, numRows, lastCol).getDisplayValues();
  var schedule = '';

  try {
    schedule = String(sourceSh.getRange(1, 2).getDisplayValue() || '').trim();
  } catch (ignoreSchedule) {}

  var stageRows = [];
  var needsMap = {};

  for (var r = 0; r < displayRows.length; r++) {
    var src = displayRows[r];
    var output = [];

    for (var h = 0; h < P.outputHeaders.length; h++) {
      var canonicalHeader = P.outputHeaders[h];
      var sourceCol = header.cols[canonicalHeader];
      output.push(sourceCol >= 0 ? String(src[sourceCol] || '').trim() : '');
    }

    if (!RSC_URT_rowHasValue_20260721_(output)) {
      continue;
    }

    var salesOffice = RSC_URT_extractLeadingCode_20260721_(output[0], 4);
    var customerId = String(output[2] || '').trim();

    // Output tetap persis struktur Revamp, tetapi kode Sales Office dinormalisasi.
    output[0] = salesOffice;

    if (!salesOffice || !customerId) {
      RSC_URT_log_20260721_(
        targetSs,
        job,
        'WARN',
        'ROW_WITHOUT_JOIN_KEY',
        'File ' + fileId + ', source row ' + (dataStart + r) +
          ': Customer ID atau Sales Office kosong.'
      );
      continue;
    }

    var pairKey = RSC_URT_pairKey_20260721_(customerId, salesOffice);

    stageRows.push(
      output.concat([
        pairKey,
        fileId,
        String(masterRow),
        String(dataStart + r),
        schedule
      ])
    );

    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(needsMap, pairKey)) {
      needsMap[pairKey] = [pairKey, customerId, salesOffice];
    }
  }

  if (stageRows.length) {
    var stageSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(P.stageRowsSheet);
    RSC_URT_writeRowsAt_20260721_(stageSh, job.stageNextRow, stageRows);
    job.stageNextRow += stageRows.length;
  }

  var needRows = Object.keys(needsMap).map(function (key) {
    return needsMap[key];
  });

  if (needRows.length) {
    var needsSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(P.needsSheet);
    RSC_URT_writeRowsAt_20260721_(needsSh, job.needsNextRow, needRows);
    job.needsNextRow += needRows.length;
  }

  return {
    rows: stageRows.length,
    needs: needRows.length
  };
}


/* ============================================================
 * PHASE 2 — SCAN m_bp_sales_cust_view ONCE
 * ========================================================== */

function RSC_URT_dbScanPhase_20260721_(job, targetSs, started) {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;

  if (!job.dbMeta) {
    job.dbMeta = RSC_URT_readDbMeta_20260721_();
    job.dbCursor = job.dbMeta.headerRow + 1;
    RSC_URT_saveJob_20260721_(job);
  }

  var meta = job.dbMeta;
  if (job.dbCursor > meta.lastRow) {
    return true;
  }

  var neededPairs = RSC_URT_loadNeededPairSet_20260721_(targetSs);
  if (!Object.keys(neededPairs).length) {
    job.dbCursor = meta.lastRow + 1;
    RSC_URT_saveJob_20260721_(job);
    return true;
  }

  var dbSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.dbSpreadsheetId);
  var dbSh = dbSs.getSheetByName(P.dbSheetName);
  if (!dbSh) {
    throw new Error('Database sheet tidak ditemukan: ' + P.dbSheetName);
  }

  var mapSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(P.mapSheet);

  while (
    job.dbCursor <= meta.lastRow &&
    Date.now() - started < P.softDeadlineMs
  ) {
    var n = Math.min(P.dbReadChunkRows, meta.lastRow - job.dbCursor + 1);
    var rows = dbSh
      .getRange(job.dbCursor, meta.minCol, n, meta.width)
      .getDisplayValues();

    var mapRows = [];
    var chunkSeen = {};

    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      var row = rows[i];
      var customerId = String(row[meta.relBpId] || '').trim();
      var salesOffice = RSC_URT_extractLeadingCode_20260721_(
        row[meta.relSalesOffice],
        4
      );

      if (!customerId || !salesOffice) {
        continue;
      }

      var pairKey = RSC_URT_pairKey_20260721_(customerId, salesOffice);
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(neededPairs, pairKey)) {
        continue;
      }

      var slsOrg = RSC_URT_cleanGroupPart_20260721_(row[meta.relSlsOrg]);
      var distChannel = RSC_URT_cleanGroupPart_20260721_(row[meta.relDistChannel]);
      var division = RSC_URT_cleanGroupPart_20260721_(row[meta.relDivision]);

      if (!slsOrg || !distChannel || !division) {
        continue;
      }

      var groupName = RSC_URT_groupSheetName_20260721_(
        slsOrg,
        distChannel,
        division,
        salesOffice
      );

      var unique = pairKey + '\u001F' + groupName;
      if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(chunkSeen, unique)) {
        continue;
      }
      chunkSeen[unique] = true;

      mapRows.push([
        pairKey,
        groupName,
        slsOrg,
        distChannel,
        division,
        salesOffice
      ]);
    }

    if (mapRows.length) {
      RSC_URT_writeRowsAt_20260721_(mapSh, job.mapNextRow, mapRows);
      job.mapNextRow += mapRows.length;
      job.stats.dbMatchRows = Number(job.stats.dbMatchRows || 0) + mapRows.length;
    }

    job.stats.dbRowsScanned = Number(job.stats.dbRowsScanned || 0) + n;
    job.dbCursor += n;
    RSC_URT_saveJob_20260721_(job);

    if (Date.now() - started >= P.softDeadlineMs) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  return job.dbCursor > meta.lastRow;
}


function RSC_URT_readDbMeta_20260721_() {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;
  var dbSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.dbSpreadsheetId);
  var dbSh = dbSs.getSheetByName(P.dbSheetName);

  if (!dbSh) {
    throw new Error('Database sheet tidak ditemukan: ' + P.dbSheetName);
  }

  var lastRow = dbSh.getLastRow();
  var lastCol = dbSh.getLastColumn();
  var scanRows = Math.min(P.dbHeaderScanRows, lastRow);
  var grid = dbSh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, lastCol).getDisplayValues();

  var headerRow = 0;
  var cBpId = -1;
  var cSlsOrg = -1;
  var cDist = -1;
  var cDivision = -1;
  var cSalesOffice = -1;

  for (var r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    var row = grid[r];
    var bp = RSC_URT_findHeaderIndex_20260721_(row, ['bp_id', 'customer id']);
    var org = RSC_URT_findHeaderIndex_20260721_(row, ['sls_org', 'sales org', 'sales organization']);
    var dist = RSC_URT_findHeaderIndex_20260721_(row, ['dist_channel', 'distribution channel']);
    var div = RSC_URT_findHeaderIndex_20260721_(row, ['division']);
    var office = RSC_URT_findHeaderIndex_20260721_(row, ['sls_office', 'sales office']);

    if (bp >= 0 && org >= 0 && dist >= 0 && div >= 0 && office >= 0) {
      headerRow = r + 1;
      cBpId = bp;
      cSlsOrg = org;
      cDist = dist;
      cDivision = div;
      cSalesOffice = office;
      break;
    }
  }

  if (!headerRow) {
    throw new Error(
      'Header DB tidak lengkap. Wajib: bp_id, sls_org, dist_channel, division, sls_office.'
    );
  }

  var minZero = Math.min(cBpId, cSlsOrg, cDist, cDivision, cSalesOffice);
  var maxZero = Math.max(cBpId, cSlsOrg, cDist, cDivision, cSalesOffice);

  return {
    headerRow: headerRow,
    lastRow: lastRow,
    minCol: minZero + 1,
    width: maxZero - minZero + 1,
    relBpId: cBpId - minZero,
    relSlsOrg: cSlsOrg - minZero,
    relDistChannel: cDist - minZero,
    relDivision: cDivision - minZero,
    relSalesOffice: cSalesOffice - minZero
  };
}


/* ============================================================
 * PHASE 3 — DISTRIBUTE TO GROUP SHEETS
 * ========================================================== */

function RSC_URT_prepareDistribution_20260721_(job, targetSs) {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;
  var oldNames = RSC_URT_loadPersistentIndexNames_20260721_(targetSs);

  for (var i = 0; i < oldNames.length; i++) {
    var sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(oldNames[i]);
    if (!sh) continue;

    var marker = '';
    try { marker = String(sh.getRange('A1').getNote() || ''); } catch (ignore) {}

    if (marker === P.generatedMarker) {
      sh.clear();
      sh.getRange('A1').setNote(P.generatedMarker);

      // Kosongkan juga cell footprint lama agar target tidak mendekati limit 10 juta cell.
      if (sh.getMaxRows() > 20) {
        sh.deleteRows(21, sh.getMaxRows() - 20);
      }
      if (sh.getMaxColumns() > P.outputHeaders.length) {
        sh.deleteColumns(
          P.outputHeaders.length + 1,
          sh.getMaxColumns() - P.outputHeaders.length
        );
      }
    }
  }

  var runIndex = targetSs.getSheetByName(P.runIndexSheet);
  runIndex.clear();
  runIndex.getRange(1, 1, 1, 3).setValues([
    ['Sheet Name', 'Status', 'Final Rows']
  ]);
  runIndex.hideSheet();

  RSC_URT_log_20260721_(
    targetSs,
    job,
    'INFO',
    'DISTRIBUTE_PREP',
    'Output lama yang dibuat modul ini sudah dikosongkan dan siap dibangun ulang.'
  );
}


function RSC_URT_distributePhase_20260721_(job, targetSs, started) {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;
  var stageSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(P.stageRowsSheet);
  var lastRow = stageSh.getLastRow();

  if (lastRow < 2 || job.stageCursor > lastRow) {
    return true;
  }

  var joinMap = RSC_URT_loadJoinMap_20260721_(targetSs);

  while (
    job.stageCursor <= lastRow &&
    Date.now() - started < P.softDeadlineMs
  ) {
    var n = Math.min(
      P.distributeReadChunkRows,
      lastRow - job.stageCursor + 1
    );

    var rows = stageSh.getRange(job.stageCursor, 1, n, 20).getDisplayValues();
    var rowsByGroup = {};
    var scheduleByGroup = {};
    var groupsEncountered = {};

    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      var stageRow = rows[i];
      var pairKey = String(stageRow[15] || '').trim();
      var groups = joinMap[pairKey];

      if (!groups || !groups.length) {
        job.stats.unmatchedSourceRows =
          Number(job.stats.unmatchedSourceRows || 0) + 1;
        continue;
      }

      for (var g = 0; g < groups.length; g++) {
        var group = groups[g];
        var groupName = group.groupName;

        if (!rowsByGroup[groupName]) {
          rowsByGroup[groupName] = [];
        }

        rowsByGroup[groupName].push(stageRow.slice(0, 15));
        groupsEncountered[groupName] = true;

        if (!scheduleByGroup[groupName] && stageRow[19]) {
          scheduleByGroup[groupName] = String(stageRow[19] || '').trim();
        }
      }
    }

    var groupNames = Object.keys(rowsByGroup);
    for (var x = 0; x < groupNames.length; x++) {
      var name = groupNames[x];
      RSC_URT_appendGroupRows_20260721_(
        targetSs,
        name,
        rowsByGroup[name],
        scheduleByGroup[name] || ''
      );
      job.stats.distributedRows =
        Number(job.stats.distributedRows || 0) + rowsByGroup[name].length;
    }

    var runIndexRows = Object.keys(groupsEncountered).map(function (name) {
      return [name, 'PENDING', ''];
    });

    if (runIndexRows.length) {
      var runIndex = targetSs.getSheetByName(P.runIndexSheet);
      var startAt = Math.max(2, runIndex.getLastRow() + 1);
      RSC_URT_writeRowsAt_20260721_(runIndex, startAt, runIndexRows);
    }

    job.stageCursor += n;
    RSC_URT_saveJob_20260721_(job);

    if (Date.now() - started >= P.softDeadlineMs) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  return job.stageCursor > lastRow;
}


function RSC_URT_loadJoinMap_20260721_(targetSs) {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;
  var mapSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(P.mapSheet);
  var lastRow = mapSh.getLastRow();
  var result = {};

  if (lastRow < 2) {
    return result;
  }

  var values = mapSh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, 6).getDisplayValues();
  var seen = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var pairKey = String(values[i][0] || '').trim();
    var groupName = String(values[i][1] || '').trim();
    if (!pairKey || !groupName) continue;

    var unique = pairKey + '\u001F' + groupName;
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(seen, unique)) continue;
    seen[unique] = true;

    if (!result[pairKey]) result[pairKey] = [];
    result[pairKey].push({
      groupName: groupName,
      slsOrg: values[i][2],
      distChannel: values[i][3],
      division: values[i][4],
      salesOffice: values[i][5]
    });
  }

  return result;
}


function RSC_URT_appendGroupRows_20260721_(targetSs, groupName, rows, schedule) {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;
  if (!rows || !rows.length) return;

  var sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(groupName);
  if (!sh) {
    sh = targetSs.insertSheet(groupName);
  }

  var currentMarker = '';
  try { currentMarker = String(sh.getRange('A1').getNote() || ''); } catch (ignore) {}

  var isBlank = sh.getLastRow() === 0 ||
    (sh.getLastRow() <= 1 && !String(sh.getRange('A1').getDisplayValue() || '').trim());

  if (currentMarker !== P.generatedMarker && !isBlank) {
    throw new Error(
      'Sheet output "' + groupName +
      '" sudah ada tetapi bukan sheet generated milik Compile Upload Ready.'
    );
  }

  if (currentMarker !== P.generatedMarker || sh.getLastRow() < 2) {
    sh.clear();
    RSC_URT_ensureSheetSize_20260721_(sh, 3, P.outputHeaders.length);
    sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, 2).setValues([['Schedule', schedule || '']]);
    sh.getRange(2, 1, 1, P.outputHeaders.length).setValues([P.outputHeaders]);
    sh.getRange('A1').setNote(P.generatedMarker);
  } else if (schedule && !String(sh.getRange('B1').getDisplayValue() || '').trim()) {
    sh.getRange('B1').setValue(schedule);
  }

  var appendRow = Math.max(3, sh.getLastRow() + 1);
  RSC_URT_writeRowsAt_20260721_(sh, appendRow, rows);

  // Jangan biarkan setiap generated sheet mempertahankan default 1.000 x 26 cells.
  var desiredRows = Math.max(20, sh.getLastRow() + 10);
  if (sh.getMaxRows() > desiredRows) {
    sh.deleteRows(desiredRows + 1, sh.getMaxRows() - desiredRows);
  }
  if (sh.getMaxColumns() > P.outputHeaders.length) {
    sh.deleteColumns(
      P.outputHeaders.length + 1,
      sh.getMaxColumns() - P.outputHeaders.length
    );
  }
}


/* ============================================================
 * PHASE 4 — FINALIZE / DEDUPLICATE / FORMAT
 * ========================================================== */

function RSC_URT_compactRunIndex_20260721_(targetSs) {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;
  var sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(P.runIndexSheet);
  var lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  var unique = {};

  if (lastRow >= 2) {
    var names = sh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, 1).getDisplayValues();
    for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
      var name = String(names[i][0] || '').trim();
      if (name) unique[name] = true;
    }
  }

  var rows = Object.keys(unique).sort().map(function (name) {
    return [name, 'PENDING', ''];
  });

  sh.clear();
  sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, 3).setValues([
    ['Sheet Name', 'Status', 'Final Rows']
  ]);

  if (rows.length) {
    RSC_URT_writeRowsAt_20260721_(sh, 2, rows);
  }
  sh.hideSheet();
}


function RSC_URT_finalizePhase_20260721_(job, targetSs, started) {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;
  var indexSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(P.runIndexSheet);
  var lastRow = indexSh.getLastRow();
  var totalGroups = Math.max(0, lastRow - 1);

  if (job.finalizeCursor >= totalGroups) {
    return true;
  }

  var processed = 0;

  while (
    job.finalizeCursor < totalGroups &&
    processed < P.finalizeSheetsPerRun &&
    Date.now() - started < P.softDeadlineMs
  ) {
    var indexRow = job.finalizeCursor + 2;
    var groupName = String(indexSh.getRange(indexRow, 1).getDisplayValue() || '').trim();

    if (!groupName) {
      indexSh.getRange(indexRow, 2, 1, 2).setValues([['SKIP_BLANK', 0]]);
      job.finalizeCursor++;
      processed++;
      continue;
    }

    try {
      var finalRows = RSC_URT_finalizeOneGroupSheet_20260721_(
        targetSs,
        groupName
      );

      indexSh.getRange(indexRow, 2, 1, 2).setValues([
        ['DONE', finalRows]
      ]);

      job.stats.outputRows = Number(job.stats.outputRows || 0) + finalRows;
    } catch (err) {
      indexSh.getRange(indexRow, 2, 1, 2).setValues([
        ['ERROR: ' + RSC_URT_error_20260721_(err), 0]
      ]);
      throw err;
    }

    job.finalizeCursor++;
    processed++;
    RSC_URT_saveJob_20260721_(job);
  }

  return job.finalizeCursor >= totalGroups;
}


function RSC_URT_finalizeOneGroupSheet_20260721_(targetSs, groupName) {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;
  var sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(groupName);

  if (!sh) {
    throw new Error('Output sheet hilang saat finalize: ' + groupName);
  }

  var marker = String(sh.getRange('A1').getNote() || '');
  if (marker !== P.generatedMarker) {
    throw new Error('Marker generated tidak valid untuk sheet: ' + groupName);
  }

  var dataRows = Math.max(0, sh.getLastRow() - 2);
  var cleanRows = [];
  var seen = {};

  if (dataRows > 0) {
    var values = sh.getRange(3, 1, dataRows, P.outputHeaders.length).getDisplayValues();

    for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
      var row = values[i].map(function (value) {
        return String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
      });

      if (!RSC_URT_rowHasValue_20260721_(row)) continue;

      var signature = row.join('\u001E');
      if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(seen, signature)) continue;
      seen[signature] = true;
      cleanRows.push(row);
    }
  }

  var clearRows = Math.max(1, dataRows);
  RSC_URT_ensureSheetSize_20260721_(
    sh,
    Math.max(3, cleanRows.length + 2),
    P.outputHeaders.length
  );

  sh.getRange(3, 1, clearRows, P.outputHeaders.length).clearContent();

  if (cleanRows.length) {
    sh.getRange(3, 1, cleanRows.length, P.outputHeaders.length)
      .setNumberFormat('@')
      .setValues(cleanRows);
  }

  sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, 2).setNumberFormat('@');
  sh.getRange(2, 1, 1, P.outputHeaders.length)
    .setNumberFormat('@')
    .setValues([P.outputHeaders]);
  sh.getRange('A1').setValue('Schedule').setNote(P.generatedMarker);

  RSC_URT_formatOutputSheet_20260721_(sh, cleanRows.length);

  // Hemat 10 juta cell limit: generated sheet hanya menyisakan buffer kecil.
  var desiredRows = Math.max(20, cleanRows.length + 12);
  if (sh.getMaxRows() > desiredRows) {
    sh.deleteRows(desiredRows + 1, sh.getMaxRows() - desiredRows);
  }
  if (sh.getMaxColumns() > P.outputHeaders.length) {
    sh.deleteColumns(
      P.outputHeaders.length + 1,
      sh.getMaxColumns() - P.outputHeaders.length
    );
  }

  return cleanRows.length;
}


function RSC_URT_finish_20260721_(job, targetSs) {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;
  var runIndex = targetSs.getSheetByName(P.runIndexSheet);
  var newRows = [];
  var newSet = {};

  if (runIndex && runIndex.getLastRow() >= 2) {
    var values = runIndex
      .getRange(2, 1, runIndex.getLastRow() - 1, 3)
      .getDisplayValues();

    for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
      var name = String(values[i][0] || '').trim();
      var status = String(values[i][1] || '').trim();
      var count = Number(values[i][2] || 0);

      if (!name || status !== 'DONE') continue;
      newSet[name] = true;
      newRows.push([name, count, new Date().toISOString()]);
    }
  }

  var oldNames = RSC_URT_loadPersistentIndexNames_20260721_(targetSs);
  var staleDeleted = 0;

  for (var x = 0; x < oldNames.length; x++) {
    var oldName = oldNames[x];
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(newSet, oldName)) continue;

    var oldSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(oldName);
    if (!oldSh) continue;

    var marker = '';
    try { marker = String(oldSh.getRange('A1').getNote() || ''); } catch (ignore) {}

    if (marker === P.generatedMarker) {
      targetSs.deleteSheet(oldSh);
      staleDeleted++;
    }
  }

  var persistentIndex = RSC_URT_getOrCreateSheet_20260721_(
    targetSs,
    P.persistentIndexSheet
  );
  persistentIndex.clear();
  persistentIndex.getRange(1, 1, 1, 3).setValues([
    ['Sheet Name', 'Rows', 'Generated At']
  ]);

  newRows.sort(function (a, b) {
    return String(a[0]).localeCompare(String(b[0]));
  });

  if (newRows.length) {
    RSC_URT_writeRowsAt_20260721_(persistentIndex, 2, newRows);
  }

  persistentIndex.hideSheet();

  job.stats.outputGroups = newRows.length;
  job.stats.staleSheetsDeleted = staleDeleted;
  job.stats.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  job.stats.phase = 'DONE';

  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.setProperty(P.pLastStats, JSON.stringify(job.stats));
  props.deleteProperty(P.pJob);
  RSC_URT_deleteContinuationTriggers_20260721_();

  RSC_URT_log_20260721_(
    targetSs,
    job,
    'INFO',
    'RUN_FINISH',
    'Compile selesai. Groups=' + newRows.length +
      ', output rows=' + job.stats.outputRows +
      ', unmatched source rows=' + job.stats.unmatchedSourceRows +
      ', stale sheets deleted=' + staleDeleted + '.'
  );

  RSC_URT_cleanupTemporarySheets_20260721_(targetSs);

  try {
    var masterSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(job.masterSpreadsheetId);
    masterSs.toast(
      'Compile Upload Ready selesai. Groups=' + newRows.length +
        ', rows=' + job.stats.outputRows +
        ', unmatched=' + job.stats.unmatchedSourceRows + '.',
      'Compile to Upload Ready Template',
      10
    );
  } catch (ignoreToast) {}
}

  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;

function RSC_URT_cleanupTemporarySheets_20260721_(targetSs) {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;
  [
    P.stageRowsSheet,
    P.needsSheet,
    P.mapSheet,
    P.runIndexSheet
  ].forEach(function (name) {
    var sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(name);
    if (sh) {
      try { targetSs.deleteSheet(sh); } catch (ignore) {
        try { sh.clear(); sh.hideSheet(); } catch (ignoreAgain) {}
      }
    }
  });
}


function RSC_URT_getOrCreateSheet_20260721_(ss, name) {
  var sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
  if (!sh) sh = ss.insertSheet(name);
  return sh;
}


function RSC_URT_writeRowsAt_20260721_(sheet, startRow, rows) {
  if (!rows || !rows.length) return;
  var cols = rows[0].length;
  RSC_URT_ensureSheetSize_20260721_(
    sheet,
    startRow + rows.length - 1,
    cols
  );
  sheet.getRange(startRow, 1, rows.length, cols)
    .setNumberFormat('@')
    .setValues(rows);
}


function RSC_URT_ensureSheetSize_20260721_(sheet, requiredRows, requiredCols) {
  if (sheet.getMaxRows() < requiredRows) {
    sheet.insertRowsAfter(
      sheet.getMaxRows(),
      requiredRows - sheet.getMaxRows()
    );
  }

  if (sheet.getMaxColumns() < requiredCols) {
    sheet.insertColumnsAfter(
      sheet.getMaxColumns(),
      requiredCols - sheet.getMaxColumns()
    );
  }
}


function RSC_URT_formatOutputSheet_20260721_(sh, dataRowCount) {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;
  var requiredRows = Math.max(3, dataRowCount + 2);
  RSC_URT_ensureSheetSize_20260721_(sh, requiredRows, P.outputHeaders.length);

  var full = sh.getRange(1, 1, requiredRows, P.outputHeaders.length);
  full.setNumberFormat('@').setVerticalAlignment('middle');

  sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, 2)
    .setFontWeight('bold')
    .setBackground('#FFFFFF');
  sh.getRange('B1').setBackground('#FFF200');

  sh.getRange(2, 1, 1, P.outputHeaders.length)
    .setFontWeight('bold')
    .setBackground('#F3F4F6')
    .setWrap(true)
    .setHorizontalAlignment('left');

  full.setBorder(
    true,
    true,
    true,
    true,
    true,
    true,
    '#D1D5DB',
    SpreadsheetApp.BorderStyle.SOLID
  );

  sh.setFrozenRows(2);
  sh.setRowHeight(1, 24);
  sh.setRowHeight(2, 42);

  var widths = [
    105, 110, 110, 110, 125,
    120, 105, 105, 105, 85,
    175, 120, 120, 150, 170
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < widths.length; i++) {
    sh.setColumnWidth(i + 1, widths[i]);
  }

  if (dataRowCount > 0) {
    sh.getRange(3, 1, dataRowCount, P.outputHeaders.length)
      .setHorizontalAlignment('left');
  }
}


function RSC_URT_loadNeededPairSet_20260721_(targetSs) {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;
  var sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(P.needsSheet);
  var lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  var set = {};

  if (lastRow < 2) return set;

  var values = sh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, 1).getDisplayValues();
  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var key = String(values[i][0] || '').trim();
    if (key) set[key] = true;
  }
  return set;
}


function RSC_URT_loadPersistentIndexNames_20260721_(targetSs) {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;
  var sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(P.persistentIndexSheet);
  var names = [];

  if (!sh || sh.getLastRow() < 2) return names;

  var values = sh.getRange(2, 1, sh.getLastRow() - 1, 1).getDisplayValues();
  var seen = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var name = String(values[i][0] || '').trim();
    if (!name || seen[name]) continue;
    seen[name] = true;
    names.push(name);
  }

  return names;
}


/* ============================================================
 * HEADER / JOIN / URL HELPERS
 * ========================================================== */

function RSC_URT_findRevampHeader_20260721_(sh) {
  var P = RSC_UPLOAD_READY_COMPILE_PARAMETERS_20260721;
  var lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  var lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();

  if (!lastRow || !lastCol) {
    throw new Error('Sheet Template Revamp kosong.');
  }

  var scanRows = Math.min(P.sourceHeaderScanRows, lastRow);
  var grid = sh.getRange(1, 1, scanRows, lastCol).getDisplayValues();
  var normalizedTargets = {};

  for (var h = 0; h < P.outputHeaders.length; h++) {
    normalizedTargets[RSC_URT_normalizeHeader_20260721_(P.outputHeaders[h])] =
      P.outputHeaders[h];
  }

  var best = null;

  for (var r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    var cols = {};
    for (var z = 0; z < P.outputHeaders.length; z++) {
      cols[P.outputHeaders[z]] = -1;
    }

    var score = 0;
    for (var c = 0; c < grid[r].length; c++) {
      var normalized = RSC_URT_normalizeHeader_20260721_(grid[r][c]);
      var canonical = normalizedTargets[normalized];
      if (canonical && cols[canonical] < 0) {
        cols[canonical] = c;
        score++;
      }
    }

    if (
      cols['Sales Office'] >= 0 &&
      cols['Customer ID'] >= 0 &&
      score >= 5 &&
      (!best || score > best.score)
    ) {
      best = {
        headerRow: r + 1,
        cols: cols,
        score: score
      };
    }
  }

  if (!best) {
    throw new Error(
      'Header Template Revamp tidak ditemukan. Minimal wajib ada Sales Office dan Customer ID.'
    );
  }

  return best;
}


function RSC_URT_findHeaderIndex_20260721_(row, aliases) {
  var targets = {};
  for (var i = 0; i < aliases.length; i++) {
    targets[RSC_URT_normalizeHeader_20260721_(aliases[i])] = true;
  }

  for (var c = 0; c < row.length; c++) {
    if (targets[RSC_URT_normalizeHeader_20260721_(row[c])]) {
      return c;
    }
  }
  return -1;
}


function RSC_URT_normalizeHeader_20260721_(value) {
  return String(value == null ? '' : value)
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[_\-]+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}


function RSC_URT_pairKey_20260721_(customerId, salesOffice) {
  return String(customerId == null ? '' : customerId).trim() +
    '\u001F' +
    RSC_URT_extractLeadingCode_20260721_(salesOffice, 4).toUpperCase();
}


function RSC_URT_groupSheetName_20260721_(slsOrg, distChannel, division, salesOffice) {
  var parts = [slsOrg, distChannel, division, salesOffice].map(function (value) {
    return RSC_URT_cleanGroupPart_20260721_(value);
  });

  var name = parts.join(' ')
    .replace(/[\[\]\:\*\?\/\\]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();

  if (!name) {
    throw new Error('Nama group sheet kosong.');
  }

  if (name.length > 100) {
    name = name.substring(0, 100).trim();
  }

  return name;
}


function RSC_URT_cleanGroupPart_20260721_(value) {
  var text = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
  if (!text) return '';
  return text.split(/\s+-\s+|\s+/)[0].trim();
}


function RSC_URT_extractLeadingCode_20260721_(value, codeLength) {
  var text = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
  if (!text) return '';

  var first = text.split(/\s+-\s+|\s+/)[0].trim();
  var direct = first.match(new RegExp('^[A-Za-z0-9]{' + codeLength + '}'));
  if (direct) return direct[0];

  var anywhere = text.match(new RegExp('([A-Za-z0-9]{' + codeLength + '})'));
  return anywhere ? anywhere[1] : first;
}


function RSC_URT_rowHasValue_20260721_(row) {
  for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    if (String(row[i] == null ? '' : row[i]).trim() !== '') {
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}


function RSC_URT_findSheetContains_20260721_(ss, tokens) {
  var sheets = ss.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    var normalized = RSC_URT_normalizeHeader_20260721_(sheets[i].getName());
    var all = true;

    for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t++) {
      if (normalized.indexOf(
        RSC_URT_normalizeHeader_20260721_(tokens[t])
      ) === -1) {
        all = false;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (all) return sheets[i];
  }

  return null;
}


function RSC_URT_getUrlOrId_20260721_(rawValue, displayValue, formula, richText, chipUrl) {
  if (richText) {
    var wholeUrl = richText.getLinkUrl();
    if (wholeUrl) return wholeUrl;

    var runs = richText.getRuns();
    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var runUrl = runs[i].getLinkUrl();
      if (runUrl) return runUrl;
    }
  }

  var f = String(formula || '');
  var formulaMatch = f.match(/HYPERLINK\s*\(\s*["']([^"']+)["']/i);
  if (formulaMatch) return formulaMatch[1];

  var candidates = [chipUrl, rawValue, displayValue];

  for (var c = 0; c < candidates.length; c++) {
    var text = String(candidates[c] == null ? '' : candidates[c]).trim();
    if (!text) continue;

    var url = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s"'<>]+/i);
    if (url) return url[0];

    if (/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{25,}$/.test(text) && text.indexOf('/') === -1) {
      return text;
    }
  }

  return '';
}


function RSC_URT_extractSpreadsheetId_20260721_(urlOrId) {
  var text = String(urlOrId == null ? '' : urlOrId).trim();
  if (!text) return '';

  if (/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{25,}$/.test(text) && text.indexOf('/') === -1) {
    return text;
  }

  var match = text.match(/\/spreadsheets\/d\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/);
  if (match) return match[1];

  match = text.match(/[?&]id=([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/);
  return match ? match[1] : '';
}


function RSC_URT_getSmartChipUrls_20260721_(
  spreadsheetId,
  sheetName,
  startRow,
  sourceCol,
  numRows
) {
  var map = {};

  try {
    if (typeof Sheets === 'undefined') return map;

    var a1 = "'" + String(sheetName || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "'!" +
      RSC_URT_columnLetter_20260721_(sourceCol) + startRow + ':' +
      RSC_URT_columnLetter_20260721_(sourceCol) +
      (startRow + numRows - 1);

    var res = Sheets.Spreadsheets.get(spreadsheetId, {
      ranges: [a1],
      includeGridData: true,
      fields: 'sheets(data(startRow,rowData(values(chipRuns))))'
    });

    var sheets = res.sheets || [];

    for (var s = 0; s < sheets.length; s++) {
      var data = sheets[s].data || [];

      for (var d = 0; d < data.length; d++) {
        var baseZero = Number(data[d].startRow || (startRow - 1));
        var rowData = data[d].rowData || [];

        for (var r = 0; r < rowData.length; r++) {
          var values = rowData[r].values || [];
          var cell = values[0];

          if (!cell || !cell.chipRuns) continue;

          for (var x = 0; x < cell.chipRuns.length; x++) {
            var chip = cell.chipRuns[x].chip;
            if (
              chip &&
              chip.richLinkProperties &&
              chip.richLinkProperties.uri
            ) {
              map[baseZero + r + 1] = chip.richLinkProperties.uri;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(
      'Compile Upload Ready smart-chip fallback: ' +
      RSC_URT_error_20260721_(err)
    );
  }

  return map;
}


function RSC_URT_columnLetter_20260721_(columnNumber) {
  var n = Number(columnNumber);
  var output = '';

  while (n > 0) {
    var remainder = (n - 1) % 26;
    output = String.fromCharCode(65 + remainder) + output;
    n = Math.floor((n - remainder - 1) / 26);
  }

  return output;
}

/***************************************************************
 * HASH-PACKED KEY STORE V11 - 2026-07-22
 *
 * TUJUAN:
 * - _RSC_TARGET_KEYS_* hanya 1 kolom.
 * - Staging payload disimpan sebagai gzip+base64 blobs, bukan puluhan kolom.
 * - _RSC_EXISTING_KEYS hanya 1 kolom berisi packed hash records.
 * - Business key disimpan sebagai hash 128-bit (32 hex), bukan string panjang.
 * - Target snapshot tetap tersedia, tetapi dipadatkan menjadi blob chunks.
 *
 * FORMAT:
 *   Stage A1 : H|CONFIG|<gzip-base64 JSON header>
 *   Stage A2+: D|<gzip-base64 JSON records>
 *   Target A1: T|CONFIG|V11
 *   Target A2+: T|<gzip-base64 JSON [keyHash,rowHash,sourceOrder][]>
 *   Existing A1: E|V11
 *   Existing A2+: E|CONFIG|<gzip-base64 JSON [keyHash,rowHash,sourceOrder,outputRow][]>
 ***************************************************************/

var RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11 = {
  stageHeaderPrefix: 'H|',
  stageDataPrefix: 'D|',
  targetMarkerPrefix: 'T|',
  targetDataPrefix: 'T|',
  existingMarker: 'E|V11',
  existingRowPrefix: 'E|',
  maxCellChars: 44000,
  stageInitialRecordsPerBlob: 180,
  keyInitialRecordsPerBlob: 1200,
  metaReadChunkCells: 1000,
  stageReadChunkCells: 500,
  schema: 'RSC_HASH_BLOB_KEY_V11_20260722'
};

APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.keyStoreSchemaVersion =
  RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.schema;
APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.keyReadWriteChunkRows = 1000;
APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.stageWriteChunkRows = 600;
APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.outputWriteChunkRows = 3000;


/* ============================================================
 * V11 HASH + BLOB CODEC
 * ========================================================== */

function rscV11Fnv32_(text, seed) {
  text = String(text == null ? '' : text);
  var hash = Number(seed >>> 0);
  for (var i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    hash ^= text.charCodeAt(i);
    hash += (hash << 1) + (hash << 4) + (hash << 7) +
      (hash << 8) + (hash << 24);
    hash >>>= 0;
  }
  return ('00000000' + (hash >>> 0).toString(16)).slice(-8);
}


function rscV11Hash128_(text) {
  text = String(text == null ? '' : text);
  return [
    rscV11Fnv32_('A|' + text, 2166136261),
    rscV11Fnv32_('B|' + text, 2246822519),
    rscV11Fnv32_('C|' + text, 3266489917),
    rscV11Fnv32_('D|' + text, 668265263)
  ].join('');
}


function rscV11NormalizeKeyHash_(keyOrHash) {
  var text = String(keyOrHash == null ? '' : keyOrHash).trim().toLowerCase();
  if (/^[0-9a-f]{32}$/.test(text)) return text;
  return rscV11Hash128_(String(keyOrHash == null ? '' : keyOrHash));
}


function rscV11GzipBase64_(value) {
  var json = typeof value === 'string' ? value : JSON.stringify(value);
  var blob = Utilities.newBlob(json, 'application/json');
  var gz = Utilities.gzip(blob);
  return Utilities.base64Encode(gz.getBytes());
}


function rscV11GunzipBase64_(encoded) {
  var bytes = Utilities.base64Decode(String(encoded || ''));
  var blob = Utilities.newBlob(bytes, 'application/gzip');
  return Utilities.ungzip(blob).getDataAsString('UTF-8');
}


function rscV11DecodeJson_(encoded) {
  return JSON.parse(rscV11GunzipBase64_(encoded));
}


function rscV11EncodeCell_(prefix, records) {
  return String(prefix || '') + rscV11GzipBase64_(records || []);
}


function rscV11SplitEncodeRecords_(prefix, records, initialSize) {
  var C = RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11;
  records = records || [];
  initialSize = Math.max(1, Number(initialSize || 200));
  var out = [];

  function encodeSafe_(slice) {
    if (!slice.length) return;
    var cell = rscV11EncodeCell_(prefix, slice);
    if (cell.length <= C.maxCellChars) {
      out.push(cell);
      return;
    }
    if (slice.length <= 1) {
      throw new Error(
        'Satu packed record melebihi batas cell Google Sheets. chars=' +
        cell.length
      );
    }
    var mid = Math.floor(slice.length / 2);
    encodeSafe_(slice.slice(0, mid));
    encodeSafe_(slice.slice(mid));
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < records.length; i += initialSize) {
    encodeSafe_(records.slice(i, i + initialSize));
  }
  return out;
}


function rscV11DecodeStageHeader_(cellValue, cfg) {
  var text = String(cellValue || '');
  var expected = RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.stageHeaderPrefix +
    String(cfg && cfg.key || '') + '|';
  if (text.indexOf(expected) !== 0) {
    throw new Error(
      'Staging key masih format lama/wide. Jalankan menu ' +
      '"Recovery + Compact Hash Key Store V11", lalu Start ulang. Sheet=' +
      rscCompileGetStagingSheetName_(cfg)
    );
  }
  return rscV11DecodeJson_(text.substring(expected.length));
}


function rscV11DecodeStageDataCell_(cellValue) {
  var text = String(cellValue || '');
  var prefix = RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.stageDataPrefix;
  if (text.indexOf(prefix) !== 0) return [];
  var rows = rscV11DecodeJson_(text.substring(prefix.length));
  return Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [];
}


function rscV11DeleteTriggers_() {
  var handlers = [
    APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.fn,
    'RSC_CONTINUE_COMPILE_APPROVED_LINKS_BG_20260625'
  ];
  ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(function (trigger) {
    if (handlers.indexOf(trigger.getHandlerFunction()) !== -1) {
      try { ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger); } catch (ignore) {}
    }
  });
}


/* ============================================================
 * V11 PACKED EXISTING INDEX
 * ========================================================== */

function rscV11IsPackedMeta_(sh) {
  if (!sh || sh.getLastRow() < 1) return false;
  return String(sh.getRange(1, 1).getDisplayValue() || '') ===
    RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.existingMarker;
}


function rscV11WritePackedMetaSheet_(sh, cells) {
  cells = cells || [];
  sh.clear();
  try { sh.setFrozenRows(0); } catch (ignore1) {}
  try { sh.setFrozenColumns(0); } catch (ignore2) {}

  var values = [[RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.existingMarker]];
  cells.forEach(function (cell) { values.push([cell]); });

  rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(sh, Math.max(1, values.length), 1);
  sh.getRange(1, 1, values.length, 1)
    .setNumberFormat('@')
    .setValues(values);
  rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh, values.length, 1);
  try { sh.hideSheet(); } catch (ignore3) {}
}


function rscV11MigrateMetaToPacked_(sh) {
  if (!sh) throw new Error('Existing key sheet tidak tersedia.');
  if (rscV11IsPackedMeta_(sh)) {
    rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh, Math.max(1, sh.getLastRow()), 1);
    return sh;
  }

  var lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  var lastCol = Math.max(1, sh.getLastColumn());
  if (lastRow < 2) {
    rscV11WritePackedMetaSheet_(sh, []);
    return sh;
  }

  var buffers = Object.create(null);
  var packedCells = [];
  var readChunk = 10000;
  var maxCols = Math.min(8, lastCol);

  function flushConfig_(cfg) {
    var rows = buffers[cfg] || [];
    if (!rows.length) return;
    var prefix = RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.existingRowPrefix + cfg + '|';
    packedCells = packedCells.concat(
      rscV11SplitEncodeRecords_(
        prefix,
        rows,
        RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.keyInitialRecordsPerBlob
      )
    );
    buffers[cfg] = [];
  }

  for (var start = 2; start <= lastRow; start += readChunk) {
    var n = Math.min(readChunk, lastRow - start + 1);
    var values = sh.getRange(start, 1, n, maxCols).getDisplayValues();

    values.forEach(function (r) {
      var cfg = String(r[0] || '').trim();
      var businessKey = String(r[1] || '');
      if (!cfg || !businessKey) return;

      if (!buffers[cfg]) buffers[cfg] = [];
      buffers[cfg].push([
        rscV11NormalizeKeyHash_(businessKey),
        String(r[2] || ''),
        String(r[3] || ''),
        String(r[4] || '')
      ]);

      if (buffers[cfg].length >=
          RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.keyInitialRecordsPerBlob) {
        flushConfig_(cfg);
      }
    });
  }

  Object.keys(buffers).forEach(flushConfig_);
  rscV11WritePackedMetaSheet_(sh, packedCells);
  return sh;
}


function rscCompileGetOrCreateMetaSheet_(keySs) {
  var name = rscCompileGetMetaSheetName_();
  var sh = keySs.getSheetByName(name);
  if (!sh) {
    sh = keySs.insertSheet(name);
    rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh, 1, 1);
  }
  rscV11MigrateMetaToPacked_(sh);
  try { sh.hideSheet(); } catch (ignore) {}
  return sh;
}


function rscCompileEnsureMetaHeader_(metaSheet) {
  if (!metaSheet) return;
  rscV11MigrateMetaToPacked_(metaSheet);
}


function rscCompileFindMetaRowBlocks_(metaSheet, configKey) {
  // Compatibility helper. Packed V11 no longer uses physical contiguous blocks.
  return [];
}


function rscCompileReadMetaIndex_(metaSheet, cfg) {
  var out = Object.create(null);
  rscV11MigrateMetaToPacked_(metaSheet);

  var lastRow = metaSheet.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow < 2) return out;

  var prefix = RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.existingRowPrefix +
    String(cfg && cfg.key || '') + '|';
  var chunk = RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.metaReadChunkCells;

  for (var start = 2; start <= lastRow; start += chunk) {
    var n = Math.min(chunk, lastRow - start + 1);
    var values = metaSheet.getRange(start, 1, n, 1).getDisplayValues();

    values.forEach(function (r) {
      var cell = String(r[0] || '');
      if (cell.indexOf(prefix) !== 0) return;
      var records = rscV11DecodeJson_(cell.substring(prefix.length));
      (records || []).forEach(function (record) {
        var keyHash = rscV11NormalizeKeyHash_(record[0]);
        if (!keyHash) return;
        out[keyHash] = {
          rowHash: String(record[1] || ''),
          sourceFileId: '',
          sourceSheetName: '',
          sourceRowNo: '',
          sourceOrder: String(record[2] || ''),
          outputRow: Number(record[3] || 0),
          runId: '',
          updatedAt: '',
          schemaVersion: RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.schema
        };
      });
    });
  }
  return out;
}


function rscCompileRewriteMetaForConfig_(
  metaSheet, cfg, currentByKey, orderedKeys, runId
) {
  rscV11MigrateMetaToPacked_(metaSheet);

  var configKey = String(cfg && cfg.key || '');
  var prefix = RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.existingRowPrefix + configKey + '|';
  var retained = [];
  var lastRow = metaSheet.getLastRow();
  var chunk = RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.metaReadChunkCells;

  for (var start = 2; start <= lastRow; start += chunk) {
    var n = Math.min(chunk, lastRow - start + 1);
    var values = metaSheet.getRange(start, 1, n, 1).getDisplayValues();
    values.forEach(function (r) {
      var cell = String(r[0] || '');
      if (cell && cell.indexOf(prefix) !== 0) retained.push(cell);
    });
  }

  var keys = orderedKeys && orderedKeys.length
    ? orderedKeys
    : Object.keys(currentByKey || {});
  var records = [];

  keys.forEach(function (rawKey, idx) {
    var item = currentByKey[rawKey];
    if (!item) return;
    var keyHash = rscV11NormalizeKeyHash_(rawKey);
    records.push([
      keyHash,
      String(item.rowHash || ''),
      String(item.sourceOrder || ''),
      String(idx + 2)
    ]);
  });

  var newCells = rscV11SplitEncodeRecords_(
    prefix,
    records,
    RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.keyInitialRecordsPerBlob
  );
  rscV11WritePackedMetaSheet_(metaSheet, retained.concat(newCells));
}


function rscV11CompactExistingKeyStoreNoUi_() {
  var P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  var keySs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.keySpreadsheetId);
  var sh = keySs.getSheetByName(rscCompileGetMetaSheetName_());
  if (!sh) {
    sh = keySs.insertSheet(rscCompileGetMetaSheetName_());
    rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh, 1, 1);
  }
  rscV11MigrateMetaToPacked_(sh);
  return {
    spreadsheetId: keySs.getId(),
    sheetName: sh.getName(),
    rows: sh.getMaxRows(),
    cols: sh.getMaxColumns(),
    cells: sh.getMaxRows() * sh.getMaxColumns()
  };
}
