 * V11 ONE-COLUMN PACKED STAGING
 * ========================================================== */

function rscCompileRecreateStagingSheet_(keySs, cfg) {
  var name = rscCompileGetStagingSheetName_(cfg);
  var old = keySs.getSheetByName(name);
  if (old) {
    try { keySs.deleteSheet(old); } catch (err) {
      old.clear();
      rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(old, 1, 1);
      old.setName(name);
      return old;
    }
  }

  var sh = keySs.insertSheet(name);
  rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh, 1, 1);
  sh.getRange(1, 1).setNumberFormat('@').setValue('');
  try { sh.hideSheet(); } catch (ignore) {}
  return sh;
}


function rscCompilePrepareStageForCurrentConfigV9_(keySs, cfg, job) {
  if (!job.stageInitializedByKey) job.stageInitializedByKey = {};
  if (job.stageInitializedByKey[cfg.key]) return;

  var sh = rscCompileRecreateStagingSheet_(keySs, cfg);

  if (!job.stagingRowByKey) job.stagingRowByKey = {};
  if (!job.headerWrittenByKey) job.headerWrittenByKey = {};
  if (!job.outputColCountByKey) job.outputColCountByKey = {};
  if (!job.lastCommittedBusinessKeyByConfig) job.lastCommittedBusinessKeyByConfig = {};
  if (!job.lastCommittedStageRowByConfig) job.lastCommittedStageRowByConfig = {};
  if (!job.lastCommittedSourceOrderByConfig) job.lastCommittedSourceOrderByConfig = {};

  job.stagingRowByKey[cfg.key] = 2;
  job.headerWrittenByKey[cfg.key] = false;
  job.outputColCountByKey[cfg.key] = 0;
  job.lastCommittedBusinessKeyByConfig[cfg.key] = '';
  job.lastCommittedStageRowByConfig[cfg.key] = 1;
  job.lastCommittedSourceOrderByConfig[cfg.key] = '';
  job.stageInitializedByKey[cfg.key] = true;
  job.currentStageProgress = null;
  job.lastCompletedStageToken = '';
  job.lastCompletedStageStatsToken = '';

  sh.getRange(1, 1).setNumberFormat('@').setValue('');
  rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
}


function rscV11WriteStageHeader_(sh, cfg, header, colCount) {
  var normalized = rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(header || [], Math.max(1, colCount));
  var marker = RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.stageHeaderPrefix +
    String(cfg && cfg.key || '') + '|' +
    rscV11GzipBase64_(normalized);
  if (marker.length > RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.maxCellChars) {
    throw new Error('Packed header terlalu besar untuk satu cell.');
  }
  sh.getRange(1, 1).setNumberFormat('@').setValue(marker);
}


function rscCompileStageSourceData_(keySs, cfg, sourceData, fileId, job, started) {
  var P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  var stg = rscCompileGetOrCreateStagingSheet_(keySs, cfg);

  var previousColCount = Number(job.outputColCountByKey[cfg.key] || 0);
  var colCount = previousColCount;
  var sourceColCount = rscCompileEffectiveColumnCount_(
    sourceData.header, sourceData.dataRows
  );

  if (!colCount) {
    colCount = sourceColCount || sourceData.header.length || 1;
  } else if (sourceColCount > colCount) {
    colCount = sourceColCount;
  }
  job.outputColCountByKey[cfg.key] = colCount;

  var sourceSheetName = String(
    sourceData.sourceSheetName || cfg.sourceSheetName || ''
  );
  var totalRows = (sourceData.dataRows || []).length;
  var token = [
    String(job.linkIndex || 0),
    String(job.configIndex || 0),
    String(cfg.key || ''),
    String(fileId || '')
  ].join('|');

  if (String(job.lastCompletedStageToken || '') === token) {
    return {
      rowsStaged: 0,
      headerWritten: false,
      completed: true,
      alreadyCommitted: true,
      lastBusinessKey: String(
        job.lastCommittedBusinessKeyByConfig &&
        job.lastCommittedBusinessKeyByConfig[cfg.key] || ''
      )
    };
  }

  var progress = job.currentStageProgress || null;
  if (!progress || String(progress.token || '') !== token) {
    progress = {
      token: token,
      configKey: cfg.key,
      fileId: fileId,
      sourceSheetName: sourceSheetName,
      nextSourceOffset: 0,
      totalSourceRows: totalRows,
      startedAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    job.currentStageProgress = progress;
    rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
  }

  var offset = Math.max(0, Number(progress.nextSourceOffset || 0));
  var headerWrittenNow = false;

  // Preserve the first canonical header. Refresh only when a later source
  // genuinely adds columns, merging nonblank labels instead of erasing them.
  if (!job.headerWrittenByKey[cfg.key]) {
    rscV11WriteStageHeader_(stg, cfg, sourceData.header, colCount);
    job.headerWrittenByKey[cfg.key] = true;
    headerWrittenNow = true;
    rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
  } else if (colCount > previousColCount) {
    var priorHeader = rscV11DecodeStageHeader_(
      stg.getRange(1, 1).getDisplayValue(),
      cfg
    );
    var mergedHeader = rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(priorHeader, colCount);
    var incomingHeader = rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(
      sourceData.header, colCount
    );
    for (var hi = 0; hi < incomingHeader.length; hi++) {
      if (!mergedHeader[hi] && incomingHeader[hi]) {
        mergedHeader[hi] = incomingHeader[hi];
      }
    }
    rscV11WriteStageHeader_(stg, cfg, mergedHeader, colCount);
  }

  var chunkSize = Math.max(100, Number(P.stageWriteChunkRows || 600));
  var stagedThisCall = 0;
  var lastBusinessKey = '';

  while (offset < totalRows) {
    var guardMs = Math.max(5000, Number(P.stageDeadlineGuardMs || 25000));
    if (started && Date.now() - started >
        Number(P.softDeadlineMs || 255000) - guardMs) {
      progress.nextSourceOffset = offset;
      job.currentStageProgress = progress;
      rscCompileScheduleContinuation_(
        job,
        'STAGE_HASH_BLOB_PAUSE_' + cfg.key + '_OFFSET_' + offset
      );
      return {
        rowsStaged: stagedThisCall,
        headerWritten: headerWrittenNow,
        completed: false,
        paused: true,
        nextSourceOffset: offset,
        lastBusinessKey: lastBusinessKey
      };
    }

    var end = Math.min(totalRows, offset + chunkSize);
    var records = [];

    for (var idx = offset; idx < end; idx++) {
      var row = sourceData.dataRows[idx];
      var sourceRowNo = Number(
        (sourceData.sourceRowNumbers || [])[idx] || (idx + 2)
      );
      var normalizedRow = rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(row, colCount);
      if (!rscCompileRowHasValue_(normalizedRow)) continue;

      var traceKey = [
        'FILE=' + String(fileId || ''),
        'SHEET=' + sourceSheetName,
        'SRC_ROW=' + String(sourceRowNo)
      ].join('|');

      var businessKey = rscCompileBuildBusinessKeyFromRow_(
        cfg,
        rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(sourceData.header, colCount),
        normalizedRow,
        traceKey
      );

      // Strengthen fallback identity: old fallback key used only 32-bit row hash.
      if (businessKey.indexOf('|FALLBACK_ROW_HASH=') !== -1) {
        businessKey = String(cfg.key || '') +
          '|FALLBACK_ROW_HASH128=' +
          rscV11Hash128_(normalizedRow.join('\u001f'));
      }

      var keyHash = rscV11Hash128_(businessKey);
      var rowHash = rscV11Hash128_(
        normalizedRow.join('\u001f')
      ).substring(0, 16);
      var sourceOrder = rscCompileBuildDeterministicSourceOrder_(
        job, sourceRowNo, fileId
      );

      records.push([
        keyHash,
        rowHash,
        sourceOrder,
        normalizedRow
      ]);
      lastBusinessKey = businessKey;
    }

    if (records.length) {
      var cells = rscV11SplitEncodeRecords_(
        RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.stageDataPrefix,
        records,
        RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.stageInitialRecordsPerBlob
      );
      var startRow = Number(job.stagingRowByKey[cfg.key] || 2);
      rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(stg, startRow + cells.length - 1, 1);
      stg.getRange(startRow, 1, cells.length, 1)
        .setNumberFormat('@')
        .setValues(cells.map(function (v) { return [v]; }));

      job.stagingRowByKey[cfg.key] = startRow + cells.length;
      stagedThisCall += records.length;

      if (!job.lastCommittedBusinessKeyByConfig) {
        job.lastCommittedBusinessKeyByConfig = {};
      }
      if (!job.lastCommittedStageRowByConfig) {
        job.lastCommittedStageRowByConfig = {};
      }
      if (!job.lastCommittedSourceOrderByConfig) {
        job.lastCommittedSourceOrderByConfig = {};
      }

      job.lastCommittedBusinessKeyByConfig[cfg.key] = lastBusinessKey;
      job.lastCommittedStageRowByConfig[cfg.key] =
        job.stagingRowByKey[cfg.key] - 1;
      job.lastCommittedSourceOrderByConfig[cfg.key] =
        records[records.length - 1][2];

      if (job.stats && job.stats.configs && job.stats.configs[cfg.key]) {
        job.stats.configs[cfg.key].stagedRows =
          Number(job.stats.configs[cfg.key].stagedRows || 0) +
          records.length;
        job.stats.configs[cfg.key].lastCommittedBusinessKey =
          lastBusinessKey;
        job.stats.configs[cfg.key].lastCommittedStageRow =
          job.lastCommittedStageRowByConfig[cfg.key];
      }
    }

    offset = end;
    progress.nextSourceOffset = offset;
    progress.lastBusinessKey = lastBusinessKey;
    job.currentStageProgress = progress;
    rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);
  }

  job.lastCompletedStageToken = token;
  job.currentStageProgress = null;
  rscCompilePersistJobCheckpoint_(job);

  rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(
    stg,
    Math.max(1, stg.getLastRow()),
    1
  );
  try { stg.hideSheet(); } catch (ignore) {}

  return {
    rowsStaged: stagedThisCall,
    headerWritten: headerWrittenNow,
    completed: true,
    alreadyCommitted: false,
    lastBusinessKey: lastBusinessKey
  };
}


/* ============================================================
 * V11 PACKED STAGE READ + OUTPUT STREAM
 * ========================================================== */

function rscCompileReadStagingRows_(stg, cfg) {
  var lastRow = stg.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow < 1) {
    return {
      header: [],
      currentByKey: Object.create(null),
      duplicateKeysCollapsed: 0,
      metaCols: 0,
      effectiveCols: 0,
      lastRow: 0,
      packedV11: true
    };
  }

  var header = rscV11DecodeStageHeader_(
    stg.getRange(1, 1).getDisplayValue(),
    cfg
  );
  var currentByKey = Object.create(null);
  var duplicateKeysCollapsed = 0;
  var chunk = RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.stageReadChunkCells;

  for (var start = 2; start <= lastRow; start += chunk) {
    var n = Math.min(chunk, lastRow - start + 1);
    var values = stg.getRange(start, 1, n, 1).getDisplayValues();

    for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
      var blobRow = start + i;
      var records = rscV11DecodeStageDataCell_(values[i][0]);

      for (var j = 0; j < records.length; j++) {
        var rec = records[j] || [];
        var keyHash = rscV11NormalizeKeyHash_(rec[0]);
        if (!keyHash) continue;

        var candidate = {
          key: keyHash,
          businessKey: keyHash,
          rowHash: String(rec[1] || ''),
          sourceOrder: String(rec[2] || ''),
          blobRow: blobRow,
          recordIndex: j,
          stageRow: blobRow
        };

        if (currentByKey[keyHash]) duplicateKeysCollapsed++;
        var previous = currentByKey[keyHash];
        if (!previous ||
            candidate.sourceOrder > previous.sourceOrder ||
            (candidate.sourceOrder === previous.sourceOrder &&
             (candidate.blobRow > previous.blobRow ||
              (candidate.blobRow === previous.blobRow &&
               candidate.recordIndex >= previous.recordIndex)))) {
          currentByKey[keyHash] = candidate;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    header: header || [],
    currentByKey: currentByKey,
    duplicateKeysCollapsed: duplicateKeysCollapsed,
    metaCols: 0,
    effectiveCols: (header || []).length,
    lastRow: lastRow,
    packedV11: true
  };
}


function rscCompileRewriteOutputSheetClean_(
  sh, stageSh, staged, currentByKey, orderedKeys, colCount
) {
  if (!staged || !staged.packedV11) {
    throw new Error(
      'Finalize menerima staging non-V11. Jalankan Recovery + Compact V11.'
    );
  }

  var P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  var header = staged.header || [];
  var hasHeader = !!header.length;
  var rowsNeeded = Math.max(1, (hasHeader ? 1 : 0) + orderedKeys.length);
  var colsNeeded = Math.max(1, Number(colCount || header.length || 1));
  var stageLastRow = Number(staged.lastRow || stageSh.getLastRow());

  sh.clear();
  rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(sh, rowsNeeded, colsNeeded);

  if (!hasHeader) {
    sh.getRange(1, 1).setNumberFormat('@').setValue('');
    try { sh.setFrozenRows(0); } catch (ignore1) {}
    rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh, 1, colsNeeded);
    return;
  }

  sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, colsNeeded)
    .setNumberFormat('@')
    .setValues([rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(header, colsNeeded)]);

  var readChunk = RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.stageReadChunkCells;
  var writeChunk = Math.max(500, Number(P.outputWriteChunkRows || 3000));
  var outputBatch = [];
  var outputRow = 2;
  var written = 0;

  function flush_() {
    if (!outputBatch.length) return;
    sh.getRange(outputRow, 1, outputBatch.length, colsNeeded)
      .setNumberFormat('@')
      .setValues(outputBatch);
    outputRow += outputBatch.length;
    written += outputBatch.length;
    outputBatch = [];
  }

  for (var start = 2; start <= stageLastRow; start += readChunk) {
    var n = Math.min(readChunk, stageLastRow - start + 1);
    var values = stageSh.getRange(start, 1, n, 1).getDisplayValues();

    for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
      var blobRow = start + i;
      var records = rscV11DecodeStageDataCell_(values[i][0]);

      for (var j = 0; j < records.length; j++) {
        var rec = records[j] || [];
        var keyHash = rscV11NormalizeKeyHash_(rec[0]);
        var winner = currentByKey[keyHash];
        if (!winner ||
            Number(winner.blobRow) !== blobRow ||
            Number(winner.recordIndex) !== j) {
          continue;
        }

        outputBatch.push(
          rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(rec[3] || [], colsNeeded)
        );
        if (outputBatch.length >= writeChunk) flush_();
      }
    }
  }
  flush_();

  if (written !== orderedKeys.length) {
    throw new Error(
      'Winner output count mismatch V11. Expected=' + orderedKeys.length +
      ', written=' + written + ', sheet=' + sh.getName()
    );
  }

  try { sh.setFrozenRows(1); } catch (ignore2) {}
  rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh, rowsNeeded, colsNeeded);
}


function rscCompileRewriteTargetKeySnapshotCompactV9_(
  sh, cfg, currentByKey, orderedKeys, runId
) {
  var marker = RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.targetMarkerPrefix +
    String(cfg && cfg.key || '') + '|V11';
  var records = [];

  (orderedKeys || Object.keys(currentByKey || {})).forEach(function (rawKey) {
    var item = currentByKey[rawKey] || {};
    records.push([
      rscV11NormalizeKeyHash_(rawKey),
      String(item.rowHash || ''),
      String(item.sourceOrder || '')
    ]);
  });

  var cells = rscV11SplitEncodeRecords_(
    RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.targetDataPrefix,
    records,
    RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.keyInitialRecordsPerBlob
  );

  var values = [[marker]];
  cells.forEach(function (cell) { values.push([cell]); });

  sh.clear();
  try { sh.setFrozenRows(0); } catch (ignore1) {}
  try { sh.setFrozenColumns(0); } catch (ignore2) {}
  rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(sh, values.length, 1);
  sh.getRange(1, 1, values.length, 1)
    .setNumberFormat('@')
    .setValues(values);
  rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh, values.length, 1);
  try { sh.hideSheet(); } catch (ignore3) {}
}


/* ============================================================
 * V11 RECOVERY / CAPACITY MENU
 * ========================================================== */

function rscV11DeleteWideTargetKeyAndLegacyStageSheets_(keySs) {
  var P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  var deleted = 0;
  var cleared = 0;
  var names = keySs.getSheets().map(function (sh) { return sh.getName(); });

  names.forEach(function (name) {
    var upper = String(name || '').toUpperCase();
    var isTarget = upper.indexOf(
      String(P.targetKeySheetPrefix || '_RSC_TARGET_KEYS_').toUpperCase()
    ) === 0;
    var isLegacy = upper.indexOf('_RSC_STG_') === 0 ||
      upper.indexOf('_RSC_STAGING') === 0;
    var isTemp = upper.indexOf('_RSC_V11_TEMP_') === 0;
    if (!isTarget && !isLegacy && !isTemp) return;

    var sh = keySs.getSheetByName(name);
    if (!sh) return;
    try {
      keySs.deleteSheet(sh);
      deleted++;
    } catch (err) {
      try {
        sh.clear();
        try { sh.setFrozenRows(0); } catch (ignore1) {}
        try { sh.setFrozenColumns(0); } catch (ignore2) {}
        rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh, 1, 1);
        cleared++;
      } catch (ignore3) {}
    }
  });

  return { deleted: deleted, cleared: cleared };
}


function recoverHashPackedKeyStoreV11_() {
  var P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var lock = LockService.getScriptLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(10000)) {
    throw new Error('Compile/recovery lain masih memakai script lock.');
  }

  try {
    rscV11DeleteTriggers_();
    props.deleteProperty(P.pJob);

    var keySs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.keySpreadsheetId);

    // First free the widest/highest-cell staging sheets.
    var cleanup = rscV11DeleteWideTargetKeyAndLegacyStageSheets_(keySs);

    // Then migrate persistent existing keys to one-column hash blobs.
    var compact = rscV11CompactExistingKeyStoreNoUi_();

    props.setProperty(P.pLastStats, JSON.stringify({
      phase: 'RECOVERED_HASH_PACKED_V11',
      state: 'READY_TO_START',
      recoveredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      keySpreadsheetId: keySs.getId(),
      deletedWideSheets: cleanup.deleted,
      clearedWideSheets: cleanup.cleared,
      existingPackedCells: compact.cells,
      keySchemaVersion: RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.schema,
      message: 'Checkpoint lama dibuang. Start ulang Compile ALL 4.'
    }));

    return {
      deletedWideSheets: cleanup.deleted,
      clearedWideSheets: cleanup.cleared,
      existingPackedCells: compact.cells,
      keySpreadsheetId: keySs.getId()
    };
  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (ignore) {}
  }
}


function compactExistingKeyStoreV11() {
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var activeRaw = String(
    props.getProperty(APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.pJob) || ''
  );
  if (activeRaw) {
    throw new Error(
      'Masih ada checkpoint compile. Gunakan Recovery + Compact Hash Key Store V11 ' +
      'bila job lama/stuck ingin dibuang.'
    );
  }

  var result = rscV11CompactExistingKeyStoreNoUi_();
  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
    'Existing Key Store sudah compact V11.\n\n' +
    'Spreadsheet: ' + result.spreadsheetId + '\n' +
    'Sheet: ' + result.sheetName + '\n' +
    'Grid: ' + result.rows + ' × ' + result.cols +
    ' = ' + result.cells + ' cells.'
  );
}


function recoverHashPackedKeyStoreV11() {
  var result = recoverHashPackedKeyStoreV11_();
  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
    'Recovery + Compact Hash Key Store V11 selesai.\n\n' +
    'Wide target/staging deleted: ' + result.deletedWideSheets + '\n' +
    'Wide target/staging fallback-cleared: ' + result.clearedWideSheets + '\n' +
    'Existing key packed grid cells: ' + result.existingPackedCells + '\n\n' +
    'Checkpoint staging lama sudah dibuang.\n' +
    'Sekarang jalankan Compile ALL 4 Sheets ke Target.'
  );
}


function showKeyStoreCapacityV11() {
  var P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  var keySs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.keySpreadsheetId);
  var rows = [];
  var totalCells = 0;

  keySs.getSheets().forEach(function (sh) {
    var cells = Number(sh.getMaxRows() || 0) *
      Number(sh.getMaxColumns() || 0);
    totalCells += cells;
    rows.push({
      name: sh.getName(),
      rows: sh.getMaxRows(),
      cols: sh.getMaxColumns(),
      cells: cells
    });
  });

  rows.sort(function (a, b) { return b.cells - a.cells; });
  var lines = [
    'Spreadsheet: ' + keySs.getId(),
    'Total allocated grid cells: ' + totalCells,
    '',
    'Largest sheets:'
  ];
  rows.slice(0, 12).forEach(function (r) {
    lines.push(
      r.name + ' | ' + r.rows + ' × ' + r.cols + ' = ' + r.cells
    );
  });

  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
    'Key Store Capacity V11\n\n' + lines.join('\n')
  );
}

function RSC_RECOVER_HASH_PACKED_KEY_STORE_V11_20260722() {
  return recoverHashPackedKeyStoreV11();

function RSC_COMPACT_EXISTING_KEY_STORE_V11_20260722() {
  return compactExistingKeyStoreV11();
}

function RSC_SHOW_KEY_STORE_CAPACITY_V11_20260722() {
  return showKeyStoreCapacityV11();
}




/*
 * V11 override: opening the fixed key spreadsheet must not migrate the large
 * existing index before wide target-key sheets have been deleted by START.
 */
function rscCompileGetOrCreateSupportSpreadsheet_(masterSs, targetSs) {
  var P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  if (!P.useExternalSupportSpreadsheet) return targetSs;
  if (!P.keySpreadsheetId) {
    throw new Error('APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.keySpreadsheetId belum diisi.');
  }

  var keySs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.keySpreadsheetId);
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.setProperty(P.pSupportSpreadsheetId, keySs.getId());

  var infoName = P.supportInfoSheetName || '_RSC_KEY_STORE_INFO';
  var info = keySs.getSheetByName(infoName);
  if (!info) info = keySs.insertSheet(infoName);

  rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(info, 8, 2);
  info.getRange(1, 1, 8, 2).setNumberFormat('@').setValues([
    ['RSC COMPILE KEY STORE', 'Hash-packed one-column key store V11'],
    ['Key Spreadsheet ID', keySs.getId()],
    ['Master Spreadsheet ID', masterSs && masterSs.getId ? masterSs.getId() : ''],
    ['Output Target Spreadsheet ID', targetSs && targetSs.getId ? targetSs.getId() : ''],
    ['Existing Key Sheet', rscCompileGetMetaSheetName_()],
    ['Target Key Prefix', P.targetKeySheetPrefix || '_RSC_TARGET_KEYS_'],
    ['Schema Version', P.keyStoreSchemaVersion || ''],
    ['Storage Mode', 'ONE_COLUMN_GZIP_BASE64_HASH_BLOBS']
  ]);
  rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(info, 8, 2);

  // Do not migrate here. START first deletes old target/staging sheets,
  // then rscCompileSnapshotExistingKeysAtStart_ opens/migrates meta safely.
  var metaName = rscCompileGetMetaSheetName_();
  var meta = keySs.getSheetByName(metaName);
  if (!meta) {
    meta = keySs.insertSheet(metaName);
    rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(meta, 1, 1);
    meta.getRange(1, 1).setNumberFormat('@').setValue(
      RSC_HASH_PACKED_KEY_V11.existingMarker
    );
  }
  try { meta.hideSheet(); } catch (ignore) {}
  return keySs;
}


/***************************************************************
 * COMPILE APPROVED LINKS — FAST SAFE V13 — 2026-07-22
 *
 * Tujuan:
 * 1. FILE-MAJOR: setiap source spreadsheet dibuka sekali, lalu semua
 *    config terpilih dibaca pada workbook yang sama.
 * 2. One-column gzip/base64 staging dan compact hash key snapshot.
 * 3. Staging dan final-key sheet dipisahkan; payload tidak dihapus
 *    sebelum output benar-benar terverifikasi dan key committed.
 * 4. Transactional output: bangun output pada temporary spreadsheet,
 *    kemudian copy chunked ke output tanpa clear di awal.
 * 5. Lock-first checkpoint + satu trigger continuation untuk mencegah
 *    checkpoint lama menimpa checkpoint baru/finalize ganda.
 * 6. REVAMP DB lookup dipersist sebagai subset resumable; database besar
 *    tidak di-load ulang penuh pada setiap continuation.
 ***************************************************************/

var RSC_COMPILE_V13 = {
  version: 13,
  schema: 'RSC_FAST_SAFE_FILE_MAJOR_V13_20260722',
  handler: 'RSC_CONTINUE_COMPILE_APPROVED_LINKS_V13_20260722',
  pJob: 'RSC_COMPILE_V13_JOB_JSON_20260722',
  pLast: 'RSC_COMPILE_V13_LAST_STATUS_JSON_20260722',
  pStop: 'RSC_COMPILE_V13_STOP_FLAG_20260722',
  pCommitPrefix: 'RSC_COMPILE_V13_COMMIT_',
  pSourceSignature: 'RSC_COMPILE_V13_SOURCE_SIGNATURE_20260722',
  stagePrefix: '_RSC_V13_STAGE_',
  keyPrefix: '_RSC_V13_KEYS_',
  lookupNeedsSheet: '_RSC_V13_REVAMP_NEEDS',
  lookupMapSheet: '_RSC_V13_REVAMP_LOOKUP',
  logSheet: '_RSC_COMPILE_V13_LOG',
  stageHeaderPrefix: 'H13|',
  stageDataPrefix: 'D13|',
  keyMarkerPrefix: 'K13|',
  keyDataPrefix: 'K13D|',
  needsMarkerPrefix: 'N13|',
  needsDataPrefix: 'N13D|',
  lookupMarkerPrefix: 'L13|',
  lookupDataPrefix: 'L13D|',
  // Capacity-safe: row batch aktual dihitung ulang berdasarkan jumlah
  // kolom agar setiap getValues/setValues tetap di bawah batas payload.
  maxCellsPerRange: 12000,
  stageRowsPerRead: 800,
  stageRecordsPerBlob: 220,
  keyRecordsPerBlob: 1400,
  stageCellsPerRead: 500,
  tempWriteRows: 800,
  outputCopyRows: 800,
  dbReadRows: 1500,
  softDeadlineMs: 245000,
  guardMs: 30000,
  triggerDelayMs: 60000,
  watchdogDelayMs: 300000,
  maxSourceCols: 80,
  maxErrors: 20
};

var __RSC_V13_LOG_BUFFER__ = [];
var __RSC_V13_REVAMP_LOOKUP_CACHE__ = null;

function rscV13Now_() { return new Date().toISOString(); }
function rscV13Err_(err) { return err && (err.stack || err.message) ? (err.stack || err.message) : String(err || 'Unknown error'); }
function rscV13ElapsedNearLimit_(started) {
  return Date.now() - started >= RSC_COMPILE_V13.softDeadlineMs - RSC_COMPILE_V13.guardMs;
}


function rscV13SafeRows_(columnCount, preferredRows) {
  var cols = Math.max(1, Number(columnCount || 1));
  var preferred = Math.max(1, Number(preferredRows || 1));
  var byCells = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(RSC_COMPILE_V13.maxCellsPerRange || 12000) / cols));
  return Math.max(1, Math.min(preferred, byCells));
}

function rscV13ClearRangeChunked_(sheet, startRow, rowCount, colCount) {
  if (!rowCount || rowCount < 1 || !colCount || colCount < 1) return;
  var chunkRows = rscV13SafeRows_(colCount, RSC_COMPILE_V13.outputCopyRows);
  for (var offset = 0; offset < rowCount; offset += chunkRows) {
    var count = Math.min(chunkRows, rowCount - offset);
    sheet.getRange(startRow + offset, 1, count, colCount).clearContent();
  }
}

function rscV13GetConfigs_(keys) {
  var map = {};
  (APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.outputSheets || []).forEach(function (cfg) { map[cfg.key] = cfg; });
  return (keys || []).map(function (k) { return map[k]; }).filter(function (x) { return !!x; });
}

function rscV13DeleteCompileTriggers_() {
  var names = [
    RSC_COMPILE_V13.handler,
    APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.fn,
    'RSC_CONTINUE_COMPILE_APPROVED_LINKS_BG_20260625'
  ];
  ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(function (t) {
    if (names.indexOf(t.getHandlerFunction()) !== -1) {
      try { ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(t); } catch (ignore) {}
    }
  });
}

function rscV13EnsureTrigger_(delayMs) {
  rscV13DeleteCompileTriggers_();
  RSC_PERF13_NEW_TRIGGER_20260819_(RSC_COMPILE_V13.handler)
    .timeBased()
    .after(Math.max(60000, Number(delayMs || RSC_COMPILE_V13.triggerDelayMs)))
    .create();
}

function rscV13Persist_(job) {
  job.heartbeatAt = rscV13Now_();
  if (job.stats) {
    job.stats.phase = job.phase;
    job.stats.fileIndex = job.fileIndex;
    job.stats.configIndexInFile = job.configIndexInFile;
    job.stats.finalizeIndex = job.finalizeIndex;
    job.stats.heartbeatAt = job.heartbeatAt;
  }
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.setProperty(RSC_COMPILE_V13.pJob, JSON.stringify(job));
  props.setProperty(RSC_COMPILE_V13.pLast, JSON.stringify(job.stats || job));
}

function rscV13LoadJob_() {
  var raw = String(PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().getProperty(RSC_COMPILE_V13.pJob) || '');
  if (!raw) return null;
  try { return JSON.parse(raw); } catch (err) { throw new Error('Checkpoint V13 rusak: ' + rscV13Err_(err)); }
}

function rscV13Log_(job, level, event, cfgKey, message, extra) {
  extra = extra || {};
  __RSC_V13_LOG_BUFFER__.push([
    rscV13Now_(),
    job && job.runId || '',
    level || 'INFO',
    event || '',
    cfgKey || '',
    Number(job && job.fileIndex || 0),
    Number(job && job.configIndexInFile || 0),
    Number(job && job.finalizeIndex || 0),
    String(job && job.phase || ''),
    String(extra.fileId || ''),
    String(extra.sourceSheet || ''),
    String(extra.outputSheet || ''),
    Number(extra.rows || 0),
    String(message || '')
  ]);
}

function rscV13FlushLog_() {
  if (!__RSC_V13_LOG_BUFFER__.length) return;
  var targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.targetSpreadsheetId);
  var sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(RSC_COMPILE_V13.logSheet);
  if (!sh) sh = targetSs.insertSheet(RSC_COMPILE_V13.logSheet);
  var header = ['Timestamp','Run ID','Level','Event','Config','File Index','Config In File','Finalize Index','Phase','File ID','Source Sheet','Output Sheet','Rows','Message'];
  if (sh.getLastRow() < 1) sh.getRange(1,1,1,header.length).setValues([header]);
  var start = sh.getLastRow() + 1;
  sh.getRange(start,1,__RSC_V13_LOG_BUFFER__.length,header.length).setValues(__RSC_V13_LOG_BUFFER__);
  __RSC_V13_LOG_BUFFER__ = [];
  try { sh.hideSheet(); } catch (ignore) {}
  var keep = 12000;
  if (sh.getLastRow() > keep + 1) {
    try { sh.deleteRows(2, sh.getLastRow() - keep - 1); } catch (ignore2) {}
  }
}

function rscV13GetOrCreateOneColSheet_(ss, name) {
  var sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
  if (!sh) sh = ss.insertSheet(name);
  if (sh.getMaxColumns() < 1) sh.insertColumnAfter(1);
  if (sh.getMaxColumns() > 1) {
    try { sh.deleteColumns(2, sh.getMaxColumns() - 1); } catch (ignore) {}
  }
  return sh;
}

function rscV13StageName_(cfgKey) { return RSC_COMPILE_V13.stagePrefix + cfgKey; }
function rscV13KeyName_(cfgKey) { return RSC_COMPILE_V13.keyPrefix + cfgKey; }

function rscV13EncodeHeader_(cfgKey, header) {
  return RSC_COMPILE_V13.stageHeaderPrefix + cfgKey + '|' + rscV11GzipBase64_(header || []);
}

function rscV13DecodeHeader_(value, cfgKey) {
  var text = String(value || '');
  var prefix = RSC_COMPILE_V13.stageHeaderPrefix + cfgKey + '|';
  if (text.indexOf(prefix) !== 0) return [];
  var decoded = rscV11DecodeJson_(text.substring(prefix.length));
  return Array.isArray(decoded) ? decoded : [];
}

function rscV13DecodeDataCell_(value) {
  var text = String(value || '');
  if (text.indexOf(RSC_COMPILE_V13.stageDataPrefix) !== 0) return [];
  var decoded = rscV11DecodeJson_(text.substring(RSC_COMPILE_V13.stageDataPrefix.length));
  return Array.isArray(decoded) ? decoded : [];
}

function rscV13AppendEncodedRecords_(sh, prefix, records, initialPerBlob) {
  if (!records || !records.length) return 0;
  var cells = rscV11SplitEncodeRecords_(prefix, records, initialPerBlob);
  var row = Math.max(2, sh.getLastRow() + 1);
  rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(sh, row + cells.length - 1, 1);
  sh.getRange(row,1,cells.length,1).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(cells.map(function (v) { return [v]; }));
  return cells.length;
}

function rscV13CreateFreshStage_(keySs, cfg) {
  var old = keySs.getSheetByName(rscV13StageName_(cfg.key));
  if (old) {
    try { keySs.deleteSheet(old); } catch (err) { old.clear(); rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(old,1,1); }
  }
  var sh = rscV13GetOrCreateOneColSheet_(keySs, rscV13StageName_(cfg.key));
  sh.getRange(1,1).setNumberFormat('@').setValue('');
  rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh,1,1);
  try { sh.hideSheet(); } catch (ignore) {}
  return sh;
}

function rscV13BuildRunId_() {
  return Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), Session.getScriptTimeZone() || 'Asia/Jakarta', 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss') + '-' + Math.floor(Math.random()*10000);
}


function rscV13BuildSourceSignature_(manifest, configKeys) {
  var parts = [RSC_COMPILE_V13.schema, (configKeys || []).join(',')];
  (manifest || []).forEach(function (entry) {
    var modified = 0;
    try { modified = DriveApp.getFileById(entry.fileId).getLastUpdated().getTime(); } catch (ignore) {}
    parts.push(String(entry.fileId || '') + ':' + modified);
  });
  return rscV11Hash128_(parts.join('|')) + ':' + (manifest || []).length;
}

function rscV13AllOutputsPhysicallyValid_(keySs, targetSs, configs) {
  for (var i = 0; i < configs.length; i++) {
    var cfg = configs[i];
    var snap = rscV13ReadKeySnapshot_(keySs, cfg);
    if (!snap.digest || snap.count < 0) return false;
    var out = targetSs.getSheetByName(cfg.outputSheetName);
    if (!out || Number(out.getLastRow() || 0) !== Number(snap.count || 0) + 1) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function rscV13Start_(keys, forceRebuild) {
  var lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(10000)) throw new Error('Job compile lain masih memegang lock.');
  try {
    var P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
    var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
    rscV13DeleteCompileTriggers_();
    props.deleteProperty(P.pJob);
    props.setProperty(RSC_COMPILE_V13.pStop, 'FALSE');

    var masterSs = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    var masterSh = masterSs.getSheetByName(P.masterSheetName);
    if (!masterSh) throw new Error('Sheet master "' + P.masterSheetName + '" tidak ditemukan.');
    var targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.targetSpreadsheetId);
    var keySs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.keySpreadsheetId);

    // V13 tidak memakai target-key/staging V9-V12. Hapus otomatis agar
    // fixed key spreadsheet langsung melepaskan allocated grid cells lama.
    (keySs.getSheets() || []).slice().forEach(function (legacySh) {
      var legacyName = String(legacySh.getName() || '');
      if (legacyName.indexOf('_RSC_TARGET_KEYS_') === 0 ||
          legacyName.indexOf('_RSC_STG_') === 0 ||
          legacyName.indexOf('_RSC_STAGING') === 0) {
        try { keySs.deleteSheet(legacySh); } catch (legacyErr) {
          try { legacySh.clear(); rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(legacySh, 1, 1); } catch (ignoreLegacy) {}
        }
      }
    });

    var configs = rscV13GetConfigs_(keys);
    if (!configs.length) throw new Error('Tidak ada config V13 yang valid.');

    var manifestInfo = rscCompileBuildMasterLinkManifest_(masterSs, masterSh);
    var sourceSignature = rscV13BuildSourceSignature_(
      manifestInfo.manifest,
      configs.map(function (c) { return c.key; })
    );

    // Future rerun fast path: bila semua source file belum berubah dan seluruh
    // output fisik masih lengkap, tidak perlu membuka/membaca 62 workbook lagi.
    var lastSourceSignature = String(props.getProperty(RSC_COMPILE_V13.pSourceSignature) || '');
    if (!forceRebuild && lastSourceSignature === sourceSignature &&
        rscV13AllOutputsPhysicallyValid_(keySs, targetSs, configs)) {
      var skippedStatus = {
        version: 13,
        runId: rscV13BuildRunId_(),
        startedAt: rscV13Now_(),
        finishedAt: rscV13Now_(),
        phase: 'FINISHED_NO_SOURCE_CHANGE',
        syncMode: 'V13_SOURCE_SIGNATURE_FAST_SKIP',
        manifestLinks: manifestInfo.manifest.length,
        sourceSignature: sourceSignature,
        configs: {}
      };
      configs.forEach(function (cfg) {
        var snap = rscV13ReadKeySnapshot_(keySs, cfg);
        skippedStatus.configs[cfg.key] = {
          label: cfg.menuLabel,
          outputRows: snap.count,
          rewriteSkipped: true,
          sourceUnchanged: true
        };
      });
      props.setProperty(RSC_COMPILE_V13.pLast, JSON.stringify(skippedStatus));
      SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
        'V13 selesai cepat: tidak ada source file yang berubah dan seluruh output fisik masih valid. Tidak dilakukan scan/rewite.'
      );
      return;
    }

    var runId = rscV13BuildRunId_();

    configs.forEach(function (cfg) {
      rscV13CreateFreshStage_(keySs, cfg);
      if (forceRebuild) {
        var keySh = keySs.getSheetByName(rscV13KeyName_(cfg.key));
        if (keySh) {
          try { keySs.deleteSheet(keySh); } catch (err) { keySh.clear(); rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(keySh,1,1); }
        }
      }
    });

    [RSC_COMPILE_V13.lookupNeedsSheet, RSC_COMPILE_V13.lookupMapSheet].forEach(function (name) {
      var sh = keySs.getSheetByName(name);
      if (sh) {
        try { keySs.deleteSheet(sh); } catch (err) { sh.clear(); rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh,1,1); }
      }
    });

    var stats = {
      version: 13,
      runId: runId,
      startedAt: rscV13Now_(),
      finishedAt: '',
      phase: 'SCAN_FILES',
      syncMode: 'FILE_MAJOR_TRANSACTIONAL_HASH_BLOB_V13',
      manifestLinks: manifestInfo.manifest.length,
      fileIndex: 0,
      configIndexInFile: 0,
      finalizeIndex: 0,
      targetSpreadsheetId: P.targetSpreadsheetId,
      keySpreadsheetId: P.keySpreadsheetId,
      configs: {}
    };
    configs.forEach(function (cfg) {
      stats.configs[cfg.key] = {
        label: cfg.menuLabel,
        filesSeen: 0, filesOk: 0, skipped: 0, errors: 0,
        sourceRows: 0, stagedRows: 0, uniqueKeys: 0,
        outputRows: 0, inserted: 0, updated: 0, deleted: 0, unchanged: 0,
        rewriteSkipped: false, firstError: ''
      };
    });

    var job = {
      version: 13,
      schema: RSC_COMPILE_V13.schema,
      runId: runId,
      phase: 'SCAN_FILES',
      masterSpreadsheetId: masterSs.getId(),
      masterSheetId: masterSh.getSheetId(),
      manifest: manifestInfo.manifest,
      configKeys: configs.map(function (c) { return c.key; }),
      fileIndex: 0,
      configIndexInFile: 0,
      sourceNextRow: 0,
      finalizeIndex: 0,
      currentFinalize: null,
      globalErrors: 0,
      sourceSignature: sourceSignature,
      stats: stats
    };

    rscV13Log_(job,'INFO','RUN_START','',
      'V13 file-major dimulai. Unique links=' + manifestInfo.manifest.length +
      ', configs=' + job.configKeys.join(','));
    rscV13Persist_(job);
    rscV13FlushLog_();
  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (ignore) {}
  }
  return rscV13Continue_();
}

function rscV13SourceHeader_(sourceSh, cfg) {
  var headerRow = Math.max(1, Number(cfg.sourceHeaderRowFixed || 1));
  var lastRow = sourceSh.getLastRow();
  var lastCol = Math.min(Number(sourceSh.getLastColumn() || 0), RSC_COMPILE_V13.maxSourceCols);
  if (lastRow < headerRow || lastCol < 1) return null;
  var header = sourceSh.getRange(headerRow,1,1,lastCol).getDisplayValues()[0];
  var effective = Math.max(1, rscCompileLastNonEmptyIndex_(header) + 1);
  header = rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(header, effective);
  if (!rscCompileRowHasValue_(header)) return null;
  if (cfg.key === 'REVAMP') {
    header = header.concat(['Sales Org','Distribution Channel','Division','sls_office_rekap']);
  }
  return { headerRow: headerRow, dataStartRow: headerRow + 1, lastRow: lastRow, sourceCols: effective, header: header };
}

function rscV13MergeStageHeader_(stageSh, cfg, incoming) {
  var current = rscV13DecodeHeader_(stageSh.getRange(1,1).getDisplayValue(), cfg.key);
  if (!current.length) {
    stageSh.getRange(1,1).setNumberFormat('@').setValue(rscV13EncodeHeader_(cfg.key, incoming));
    return incoming;
  }
  var width = Math.max(current.length, incoming.length);
  var merged = rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(current, width);
  var inc = rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(incoming, width);
  var changed = false;
  for (var i=0;i<width;i++) {
    if (!merged[i] && inc[i]) { merged[i] = inc[i]; changed = true; }
  }
  if (changed || current.length !== width) {
    stageSh.getRange(1,1).setNumberFormat('@').setValue(rscV13EncodeHeader_(cfg.key, merged));
  }
  return merged;
}

function rscV13StageCurrentConfig_(job, sourceSs, keySs, cfg, entry, started) {
  var P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  var stageSh = rscV13GetOrCreateOneColSheet_(keySs, rscV13StageName_(cfg.key));
  var sourceSh = rscCompileGetSourceSheet_(sourceSs, cfg);
  var cfgStats = job.stats.configs[cfg.key];
  cfgStats.filesSeen++;

  if (!sourceSh) {
    cfgStats.skipped++;
    rscV13Log_(job,'WARN','SOURCE_SHEET_NOT_FOUND',cfg.key,'Sheet source tidak ditemukan.',{fileId:entry.fileId});
    job.sourceNextRow = 0;
    return true;
  }

  var meta = rscV13SourceHeader_(sourceSh, cfg);
  if (!meta) {
    cfgStats.skipped++;
    rscV13Log_(job,'WARN','SOURCE_EMPTY',cfg.key,'Source kosong/header tidak ditemukan.',{fileId:entry.fileId,sourceSheet:sourceSh.getName()});
    job.sourceNextRow = 0;
    return true;
  }

  var mergedHeader = rscV13MergeStageHeader_(stageSh, cfg, meta.header);
  var nextRow = Number(job.sourceNextRow || meta.dataStartRow);
  if (nextRow < meta.dataStartRow) nextRow = meta.dataStartRow;

  while (nextRow <= meta.lastRow) {
    if (rscV13ElapsedNearLimit_(started)) {
      job.sourceNextRow = nextRow;
      rscV13Persist_(job);
      return false;
    }
    var sourceChunkRows = rscV13SafeRows_(meta.sourceCols, RSC_COMPILE_V13.stageRowsPerRead);
    var n = Math.min(sourceChunkRows, meta.lastRow - nextRow + 1);
    var rows = sourceSh.getRange(nextRow,1,n,meta.sourceCols).getDisplayValues();
    var records = [];
    var rowsWithValue = 0;

    for (var i=0;i<rows.length;i++) {
      var payload = rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(rows[i], meta.sourceCols);
      if (!rscCompileRowHasValue_(payload)) continue;
      rowsWithValue++;
      if (cfg.key === 'REVAMP') {
        payload = payload.concat(['','','',String(entry.slsOfficeRekap || '')]);
      }
      payload = rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(payload, mergedHeader.length);
      var sourceRowNo = nextRow + i;
      var trace = 'FILE=' + entry.fileId + '|SHEET=' + sourceSh.getName() + '|ROW=' + sourceRowNo;
      var businessKey = rscCompileBuildBusinessKeyFromRow_(cfg, mergedHeader, payload, trace);
      if (businessKey.indexOf('|FALLBACK_ROW_HASH=') !== -1) {
        businessKey = cfg.key + '|FALLBACK_ROW_HASH128=' + rscV11Hash128_(payload.join('\u001f'));
      }
      var keyHash = rscV11Hash128_(businessKey);
      var rowHash = rscV11Hash128_(payload.join('\u001f')).substring(0,16);
      var sourceOrder = String(job.fileIndex).padStart(8,'0') + '|' + String(sourceRowNo).padStart(10,'0') + '|' + entry.fileId;
      records.push([keyHash,rowHash,sourceOrder,payload]);
    }

    if (records.length) {
      rscV13AppendEncodedRecords_(stageSh,RSC_COMPILE_V13.stageDataPrefix,records,RSC_COMPILE_V13.stageRecordsPerBlob);
      cfgStats.sourceRows += rowsWithValue;
      cfgStats.stagedRows += records.length;
    }
    nextRow += n;
    job.sourceNextRow = nextRow;
    rscV13Persist_(job);
  }

  cfgStats.filesOk++;
  job.sourceNextRow = 0;
  rscV13Log_(job,'INFO','SOURCE_CONFIG_STAGED',cfg.key,
    'Source selesai distage file-major.',{fileId:entry.fileId,sourceSheet:sourceSh.getName(),rows:cfgStats.stagedRows});
  return true;
}

function rscV13ScanFiles_(job, started) {
  var P = APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS;
  var masterSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(job.masterSpreadsheetId);
  var masterSh = masterSs.getSheetById(Number(job.masterSheetId));
  var configs = rscV13GetConfigs_(job.configKeys);
  // Open fixed key store once per execution, not once per config/file.
  var keySs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.keySpreadsheetId);

  while (job.fileIndex < job.manifest.length) {
    if (rscV13ElapsedNearLimit_(started)) return false;
    var entry = job.manifest[job.fileIndex];
    var sourceSs;
    try {
      sourceSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(entry.fileId);
    } catch (err) {
      job.globalErrors++;
      rscV13Log_(job,'ERROR','SOURCE_OPEN_ERROR','',rscV13Err_(err),{fileId:entry.fileId});
      job.fileIndex++;
      job.configIndexInFile = 0;
      job.sourceNextRow = 0;
      rscV13Persist_(job);
      continue;
    }

    while (job.configIndexInFile < configs.length) {
      var cfg = configs[job.configIndexInFile];
      try {
        var complete = rscV13StageCurrentConfig_(job,sourceSs,keySs,cfg,entry,started);
        if (!complete) return false;
      } catch (err2) {
        var s = job.stats.configs[cfg.key];
        s.errors++;
        if (!s.firstError) s.firstError = rscV13Err_(err2);
        rscV13Log_(job,'ERROR','SOURCE_CONFIG_ERROR',cfg.key,rscV13Err_(err2),{fileId:entry.fileId});
      }
      job.configIndexInFile++;
      job.sourceNextRow = 0;
      rscV13Persist_(job);
    }

    try {
      masterSh.getRange(Number(entry.row),P.masterLinkCol)
        .setBackground(P.colorOk)
        .setNote('V13 file-major staged untuk config: ' + job.configKeys.join(', '));
    } catch (ignore) {}

    job.fileIndex++;
    job.configIndexInFile = 0;
    job.sourceNextRow = 0;
    rscV13Persist_(job);
  }

  job.phase = job.configKeys.indexOf('REVAMP') !== -1 ? 'PREPARE_REVAMP_LOOKUP' : 'FINALIZE_PREPARE';
  job.finalizeIndex = 0;
  rscV13Persist_(job);
  return true;
}

function rscV13ReadStageIndex_(keySs, cfg) {
  var sh = keySs.getSheetByName(rscV13StageName_(cfg.key));
  if (!sh) throw new Error('Stage V13 tidak ditemukan: ' + cfg.key);
  var header = rscV13DecodeHeader_(sh.getRange(1,1).getDisplayValue(),cfg.key);
  if (!header.length) throw new Error('Header stage V13 tidak valid: ' + cfg.key);
  var current = Object.create(null);
  var duplicates = 0;
  var lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  for (var start=2; start<=lastRow; start+=RSC_COMPILE_V13.stageCellsPerRead) {
    var n = Math.min(RSC_COMPILE_V13.stageCellsPerRead,lastRow-start+1);
    var vals = sh.getRange(start,1,n,1).getDisplayValues();
    for (var i=0;i<vals.length;i++) {
      var blobRow = start+i;
      var recs = rscV13DecodeDataCell_(vals[i][0]);
      for (var j=0;j<recs.length;j++) {
        var rec = recs[j] || [];
        var key = String(rec[0] || '');
        if (!key) continue;
        var candidate = {key:key,rowHash:String(rec[1]||''),sourceOrder:String(rec[2]||''),blobRow:blobRow,recordIndex:j};
        if (current[key]) duplicates++;
        var old = current[key];
        if (!old || candidate.sourceOrder > old.sourceOrder ||
            (candidate.sourceOrder === old.sourceOrder &&
             (candidate.blobRow > old.blobRow ||
              (candidate.blobRow === old.blobRow && candidate.recordIndex >= old.recordIndex)))) {
          current[key] = candidate;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  var keys = Object.keys(current).sort(function(a,b){
    var x=current[a], y=current[b];
    if (x.sourceOrder === y.sourceOrder) return a.localeCompare(b);
    return x.sourceOrder.localeCompare(y.sourceOrder);
  });
  return {sheet:sh,header:header,current:current,keys:keys,duplicates:duplicates,lastRow:lastRow};
}

function rscV13Digest_(index) {
  var h1 = 2166136261 >>> 0;
  var h2 = 2246822519 >>> 0;
  index.keys.forEach(function(k){
    var s = k + '|' + String(index.current[k].rowHash || '');
    for (var i=0;i<s.length;i++) {
      h1 ^= s.charCodeAt(i); h1 = Math.imul(h1,16777619) >>> 0;
      h2 ^= s.charCodeAt(i); h2 = Math.imul(h2,3266489917) >>> 0;
    }
  });
  return ('00000000'+h1.toString(16)).slice(-8) + ('00000000'+h2.toString(16)).slice(-8) + ':' + index.keys.length;
}

function rscV13ReadKeySnapshot_(keySs,cfg) {
  var sh = keySs.getSheetByName(rscV13KeyName_(cfg.key));
  if (!sh || sh.getLastRow()<1) return {map:Object.create(null),digest:'',count:0,runId:''};
  var marker = String(sh.getRange(1,1).getDisplayValue() || '');
  var prefix = RSC_COMPILE_V13.keyMarkerPrefix + cfg.key + '|';
  if (marker.indexOf(prefix)!==0) return {map:Object.create(null),digest:'',count:0,runId:''};
  var p = marker.substring(prefix.length).split('|');
  var map = Object.create(null);
  for (var start=2; start<=sh.getLastRow(); start+=1000) {
    var n=Math.min(1000,sh.getLastRow()-start+1);
    var vals=sh.getRange(start,1,n,1).getDisplayValues();
    vals.forEach(function(r){
      var t=String(r[0]||'');
      if(t.indexOf(RSC_COMPILE_V13.keyDataPrefix)!==0)return;
      var rows=rscV11DecodeJson_(t.substring(RSC_COMPILE_V13.keyDataPrefix.length));
      (rows||[]).forEach(function(x){ if(x&&x[0]) map[String(x[0])]={rowHash:String(x[1]||''),sourceOrder:String(x[2]||'')}; });
    });
  }
  return {map:map,runId:p[0]||'',digest:p[1]||'',count:Number(p[2]||0)};
}

function rscV13WriteKeySnapshot_(keySs,cfg,index,digest,runId) {
  var sh = rscV13GetOrCreateOneColSheet_(keySs,rscV13KeyName_(cfg.key));
  var records=index.keys.map(function(k){var x=index.current[k];return[k,x.rowHash,x.sourceOrder];});
  var cells=rscV11SplitEncodeRecords_(RSC_COMPILE_V13.keyDataPrefix,records,RSC_COMPILE_V13.keyRecordsPerBlob);
  var values=[[RSC_COMPILE_V13.keyMarkerPrefix+cfg.key+'|'+runId+'|'+digest+'|'+index.keys.length]];
  cells.forEach(function(c){values.push([c]);});
  sh.clear();
  rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(sh,values.length,1);
  sh.getRange(1,1,values.length,1).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(values);
  rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh,values.length,1);
  try{sh.hideSheet();}catch(ignore){}
}

function rscV13OutputValid_(targetSs,cfg,expectedRows,header) {
  var sh=targetSs.getSheetByName(cfg.outputSheetName);
  if(!sh)return false;
  if(Number(sh.getLastRow()||0)!==Number(expectedRows||0))return false;
  if(expectedRows>0&&header&&header.length){
    var h=sh.getRange(1,1,1,header.length).getDisplayValues()[0];
    for(var i=0;i<header.length;i++){if(String(h[i]||'')!==String(header[i]||''))return false;}
  }
  return true;
}

function rscV13ComputeDelta_(oldSnap,index){
  var ins=0,upd=0,unch=0,del=0;
  index.keys.forEach(function(k){var old=oldSnap.map[k];if(!old)ins++;else if(String(old.rowHash)!==String(index.current[k].rowHash))upd++;else unch++;});
  Object.keys(oldSnap.map).forEach(function(k){if(!index.current[k])del++;});
  return {inserted:ins,updated:upd,unchanged:unch,deleted:del};
}

function rscV13BuildRevampNeeds_(job) {
  var keySs=RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.keySpreadsheetId);
  var cfg=rscV13GetConfigs_(['REVAMP'])[0];
  var stage=keySs.getSheetByName(rscV13StageName_('REVAMP'));
  if(!stage){job.phase='FINALIZE_PREPARE';rscV13Persist_(job);return;}
  var needsSh=rscV13GetOrCreateOneColSheet_(keySs,RSC_COMPILE_V13.lookupNeedsSheet);
  var marker=String(needsSh.getRange(1,1).getDisplayValue()||'');
  if(marker===RSC_COMPILE_V13.needsMarkerPrefix+job.runId+'|COMPLETE'){
    job.phase='REVAMP_DB_SCAN';rscV13Persist_(job);return;
  }
  var header=rscV13DecodeHeader_(stage.getRange(1,1).getDisplayValue(),'REVAMP');
  var cCust=rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(header,['Customer ID']);
  var cOffice=rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(header,['Sales Office']);
  var cOfficeRekap=rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(header,['sls_office_rekap','Sales Office Rekap']);
  if(cCust<0||cOffice<0){job.phase='FINALIZE_PREPARE';rscV13Persist_(job);return;}
  var set=Object.create(null);
  for(var start=2;start<=stage.getLastRow();start+=RSC_COMPILE_V13.stageCellsPerRead){
    var n=Math.min(RSC_COMPILE_V13.stageCellsPerRead,stage.getLastRow()-start+1);
    var vals=stage.getRange(start,1,n,1).getDisplayValues();
    vals.forEach(function(r){rscV13DecodeDataCell_(r[0]).forEach(function(rec){
      var p=rec[3]||[];
      var cust=String(p[cCust]||'').trim();
      var sourceOffice=rscCompileExtractLeadingCode_(p[cOffice],4);
      var rekapOffice=cOfficeRekap>=0?rscCompileExtractLeadingCode_(p[cOfficeRekap],4):'';
      if(!cust)return;
      if(rekapOffice)set[cust+'|'+rekapOffice]=true;
      if(sourceOffice)set[cust+'|'+sourceOffice]=true;
      set['CUST|'+cust]=true;
    });});
  }
  var records=Object.keys(set).map(function(k){return[k];});
  var cells=rscV11SplitEncodeRecords_(RSC_COMPILE_V13.needsDataPrefix,records,1600);
  var values=[[RSC_COMPILE_V13.needsMarkerPrefix+job.runId+'|COMPLETE']];cells.forEach(function(c){values.push([c]);});
  needsSh.clear();rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(needsSh,values.length,1);needsSh.getRange(1,1,values.length,1).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(values);rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(needsSh,values.length,1);
  try{needsSh.hideSheet();}catch(ignore){}
  job.revampDbNextRow=0;job.phase='REVAMP_DB_SCAN';rscV13Persist_(job);
}

function rscV13LoadNeedsSet_(keySs,runId){
  var sh=keySs.getSheetByName(RSC_COMPILE_V13.lookupNeedsSheet),set=Object.create(null);if(!sh)return set;
  for(var start=2;start<=sh.getLastRow();start+=1000){var n=Math.min(1000,sh.getLastRow()-start+1);var vals=sh.getRange(start,1,n,1).getDisplayValues();vals.forEach(function(r){var t=String(r[0]||'');if(t.indexOf(RSC_COMPILE_V13.needsDataPrefix)!==0)return;var rows=rscV11DecodeJson_(t.substring(RSC_COMPILE_V13.needsDataPrefix.length));(rows||[]).forEach(function(x){if(x&&x[0])set[String(x[0])]=true;});});}
  return set;
}

function rscV13RevampDbScan_(job,started){
  var P=APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS,keySs=RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.keySpreadsheetId),needs=rscV13LoadNeedsSet_(keySs,job.runId);
  var lookupSh=rscV13GetOrCreateOneColSheet_(keySs,RSC_COMPILE_V13.lookupMapSheet);
  var marker=String(lookupSh.getRange(1,1).getDisplayValue()||'');
  if(marker===RSC_COMPILE_V13.lookupMarkerPrefix+job.runId+'|COMPLETE'){job.phase='FINALIZE_PREPARE';job.finalizeIndex=0;rscV13Persist_(job);return true;}
  if(!job.revampDbNextRow){lookupSh.clear();lookupSh.getRange(1,1).setNumberFormat('@').setValue(RSC_COMPILE_V13.lookupMarkerPrefix+job.runId+'|IN_PROGRESS');job.revampDbNextRow=1;rscV13Persist_(job);}
  var dbSs=RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.revampDbSpreadsheetId),dbSh=dbSs.getSheetByName(P.revampDbSheetName);if(!dbSh)throw new Error('DB Revamp tidak ditemukan.');
  var lastRow=dbSh.getLastRow(),lastCol=dbSh.getLastColumn(),scan=Math.min(P.revampDbHeaderScanRows||10,lastRow),grid=dbSh.getRange(1,1,scan,lastCol).getDisplayValues();
  var hr=0,cb=-1,co=-1,corg=-1,cd=-1,cdiv=-1;
  for(var r=0;r<grid.length;r++){cb=rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(grid[r],['bp_id']);co=rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(grid[r],['sls_office','sales_office']);corg=rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(grid[r],['sls_org','sales_org']);cd=rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(grid[r],['dist_channel','distribution_channel']);cdiv=rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(grid[r],['division']);if(cb>=0&&co>=0&&corg>=0&&cd>=0&&cdiv>=0){hr=r+1;break;}}
  if(!hr)throw new Error('Header DB Revamp tidak lengkap.');
  var min=Math.min(cb,co,corg,cd,cdiv),max=Math.max(cb,co,corg,cd,cdiv),width=max-min+1;
  var next=Math.max(hr+1,Number(job.revampDbNextRow||hr+1));
  var dbChunkRows=rscV13SafeRows_(width,RSC_COMPILE_V13.dbReadRows);
  while(next<=lastRow){if(rscV13ElapsedNearLimit_(started)){job.revampDbNextRow=next;rscV13Persist_(job);return false;}var n=Math.min(dbChunkRows,lastRow-next+1);var rows=dbSh.getRange(next,min+1,n,width).getDisplayValues(),found=[];for(var i=0;i<rows.length;i++){var cust=String(rows[i][cb-min]||'').trim(),office=rscCompileExtractLeadingCode_(rows[i][co-min],4);if(!cust||!office)continue;var org=rscCompileCleanGroupPart_(rows[i][corg-min]),dist=rscCompileCleanGroupPart_(rows[i][cd-min]),div=rscCompileCleanGroupPart_(rows[i][cdiv-min]),k=cust+'|'+office,ck='CUST|'+cust;if(needs[k])found.push([k,org,dist,div]);if(needs[ck])found.push([ck,org,dist,div]);}if(found.length)rscV13AppendEncodedRecords_(lookupSh,RSC_COMPILE_V13.lookupDataPrefix,found,1200);next+=n;job.revampDbNextRow=next;rscV13Persist_(job);}
  lookupSh.getRange(1,1).setNumberFormat('@').setValue(RSC_COMPILE_V13.lookupMarkerPrefix+job.runId+'|COMPLETE');rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(lookupSh,Math.max(1,lookupSh.getLastRow()),1);try{lookupSh.hideSheet();}catch(ignore){}
  job.phase='FINALIZE_PREPARE';job.finalizeIndex=0;rscV13Persist_(job);return true;
}

function rscV13LoadRevampLookup_(){
  if(__RSC_V13_REVAMP_LOOKUP_CACHE__)return __RSC_V13_REVAMP_LOOKUP_CACHE__;
  var keySs=RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.keySpreadsheetId),sh=keySs.getSheetByName(RSC_COMPILE_V13.lookupMapSheet),map=Object.create(null);if(sh){for(var start=2;start<=sh.getLastRow();start+=1000){var n=Math.min(1000,sh.getLastRow()-start+1),vals=sh.getRange(start,1,n,1).getDisplayValues();vals.forEach(function(r){var t=String(r[0]||'');if(t.indexOf(RSC_COMPILE_V13.lookupDataPrefix)!==0)return;var rows=rscV11DecodeJson_(t.substring(RSC_COMPILE_V13.lookupDataPrefix.length));(rows||[]).forEach(function(x){if(!x||!x[0])return;var candidate={org:x[1]||'',dist:x[2]||'',div:x[3]||''},old=map[x[0]];if(!old||rscCompileRevampDimensionScore_(candidate)>rscCompileRevampDimensionScore_(old))map[x[0]]=candidate;});});}}
  __RSC_V13_REVAMP_LOOKUP_CACHE__=map;return map;
}

function rscV13TransformRevampPayload_(header,payload){
  var cCust=rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(header,['Customer ID']),cOffice=rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(header,['Sales Office']),cOfficeRekap=rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(header,['sls_office_rekap','Sales Office Rekap']);
  var cOrg=rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(header,['Sales Org']),cDist=rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(header,['Distribution Channel']),cDiv=rscCompileFindDbColIndex_(header,['Division']);
  if(cCust<0||cOffice<0)return payload;
  var cust=String(payload[cCust]||'').trim(),sourceOffice=rscCompileExtractLeadingCode_(payload[cOffice],4),rekapOffice=cOfficeRekap>=0?rscCompileExtractLeadingCode_(payload[cOfficeRekap],4):'',lookup=rscV13LoadRevampLookup_();
  var f=(cust&&rekapOffice?lookup[cust+'|'+rekapOffice]:null)||(cust&&sourceOffice?lookup[cust+'|'+sourceOffice]:null)||(cust?lookup['CUST|'+cust]:null);
  if(f){if(cOrg>=0)payload[cOrg]=f.org;if(cDist>=0)payload[cDist]=f.dist;if(cDiv>=0)payload[cDiv]=f.div;}
  return payload;
}

function rscV13CreateTempSpreadsheet_(job,cfg,index){
  var rows=Math.max(2,index.keys.length+1),cols=Math.max(1,index.header.length);
  var temp=SpreadsheetApp.create('RSC V13 TMP '+cfg.key+' '+job.runId,Math.min(rows,1000),cols);
  var sh=temp.getSheets()[0];sh.setName('OUTPUT');
  rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(sh,rows,cols);
  sh.getRange(1,1,1,cols).setNumberFormat('@').setValues([rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(index.header,cols)]);
  return {id:temp.getId(),rows:rows,cols:cols};
}

function rscV13PrepareFinalize_(job){
  var configs=rscV13GetConfigs_(job.configKeys);
  if(job.finalizeIndex>=configs.length){job.phase='DONE';rscV13Persist_(job);return;}
  var cfg=configs[job.finalizeIndex],keySs=RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.keySpreadsheetId),targetSs=RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.targetSpreadsheetId);
  var index=rscV13ReadStageIndex_(keySs,cfg),digest=rscV13Digest_(index),old=rscV13ReadKeySnapshot_(keySs,cfg),delta=rscV13ComputeDelta_(old,index),expected=index.keys.length+1;
  var stat=job.stats.configs[cfg.key];stat.uniqueKeys=index.keys.length;stat.inserted=delta.inserted;stat.updated=delta.updated;stat.deleted=delta.deleted;stat.unchanged=delta.unchanged;
  if(old.digest===digest&&old.count===index.keys.length&&rscV13OutputValid_(targetSs,cfg,expected,index.header)){
    stat.outputRows=index.keys.length;stat.rewriteSkipped=true;
    rscV13Log_(job,'INFO','UNCHANGED_SKIP_REWRITE',cfg.key,'Digest sama dan output fisik valid; rewrite dilewati.',{outputSheet:cfg.outputSheetName,rows:index.keys.length});
    var stage=keySs.getSheetByName(rscV13StageName_(cfg.key));if(stage){try{keySs.deleteSheet(stage);}catch(ignore){}}
    job.finalizeIndex++;job.currentFinalize=null;rscV13Persist_(job);return;
  }
  var temp=rscV13CreateTempSpreadsheet_(job,cfg,index);
  job.currentFinalize={configKey:cfg.key,digest:digest,uniqueCount:index.keys.length,expectedRows:expected,tempSpreadsheetId:temp.id,tempStageCell:2,tempWriteRow:2,copyRow:1,cols:temp.cols,delta:delta};
  job.phase='BUILD_TEMP';rscV13Persist_(job);
}

function rscV13BuildTemp_(job,started){
  var f=job.currentFinalize,cfg=rscV13GetConfigs_([f.configKey])[0],keySs=RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.keySpreadsheetId),index=rscV13ReadStageIndex_(keySs,cfg),stage=index.sheet,tempSs=RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(f.tempSpreadsheetId),tempSh=tempSs.getSheetByName('OUTPUT'),lookup=cfg.key==='REVAMP'?rscV13LoadRevampLookup_():null;
  var start=Math.max(2,Number(f.tempStageCell||2)),tempBatchLimit=rscV13SafeRows_(f.cols,RSC_COMPILE_V13.tempWriteRows);
  while(start<=index.lastRow){if(rscV13ElapsedNearLimit_(started)){f.tempStageCell=start;job.currentFinalize=f;rscV13Persist_(job);return false;}var n=Math.min(RSC_COMPILE_V13.stageCellsPerRead,index.lastRow-start+1),vals=stage.getRange(start,1,n,1).getDisplayValues(),batch=[];for(var i=0;i<vals.length;i++){var blobRow=start+i,recs=rscV13DecodeDataCell_(vals[i][0]);for(var j=0;j<recs.length;j++){var rec=recs[j]||[],key=String(rec[0]||''),winner=index.current[key];if(!winner||winner.blobRow!==blobRow||winner.recordIndex!==j)continue;var payload=rscCompileNormalizeRowWidth_(rec[3]||[],f.cols);if(cfg.key==='REVAMP')payload=rscV13TransformRevampPayload_(index.header,payload);batch.push(payload);if(batch.length>=tempBatchLimit){tempSh.getRange(f.tempWriteRow,1,batch.length,f.cols).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(batch);f.tempWriteRow+=batch.length;batch=[];}}}if(batch.length){tempSh.getRange(f.tempWriteRow,1,batch.length,f.cols).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(batch);f.tempWriteRow+=batch.length;}start+=n;f.tempStageCell=start;job.currentFinalize=f;rscV13Persist_(job);}
  if(f.tempWriteRow-1!==f.expectedRows)throw new Error('V13 temp row mismatch '+cfg.key+': expected='+f.expectedRows+', actual='+(f.tempWriteRow-1));
  job.phase='COPY_TEMP_TO_OUTPUT';f.copyRow=1;job.currentFinalize=f;rscV13Persist_(job);return true;
}

function rscV13GetOrCreateOutputSheet_(targetSs,cfg){
  var out=targetSs.getSheetByName(cfg.outputSheetName);
  if(out)return out;
  var legacy=cfg.legacyOutputSheetNames||[];
  for(var i=0;i<legacy.length;i++){
    var oldSh=targetSs.getSheetByName(legacy[i]);
    if(!oldSh)continue;
    oldSh.setName(cfg.outputSheetName);
    return oldSh;
  }
  return targetSs.insertSheet(cfg.outputSheetName);
}

function rscV13CopyTempToOutput_(job,started){
  var f=job.currentFinalize,cfg=rscV13GetConfigs_([f.configKey])[0],tempSs=RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(f.tempSpreadsheetId),tempSh=tempSs.getSheetByName('OUTPUT'),targetSs=RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.targetSpreadsheetId),out=rscV13GetOrCreateOutputSheet_(targetSs,cfg);
  rscCompileEnsureSheetSize_(out,f.expectedRows,f.cols);
  var row=Math.max(1,Number(f.copyRow||1)),copyChunkRows=rscV13SafeRows_(f.cols,RSC_COMPILE_V13.outputCopyRows);
  while(row<=f.expectedRows){if(rscV13ElapsedNearLimit_(started)){f.copyRow=row;job.currentFinalize=f;rscV13Persist_(job);return false;}var n=Math.min(copyChunkRows,f.expectedRows-row+1),vals=tempSh.getRange(row,1,n,f.cols).getDisplayValues();out.getRange(row,1,n,f.cols).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(vals);row+=n;f.copyRow=row;job.currentFinalize=f;rscV13Persist_(job);}
  var oldLast=out.getLastRow();if(oldLast>f.expectedRows){rscV13ClearRangeChunked_(out,f.expectedRows+1,oldLast-f.expectedRows,Math.max(f.cols,out.getLastColumn()));}
  try{out.setFrozenRows(1);}catch(ignore){}
  rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(out,f.expectedRows,f.cols);
  var header=tempSh.getRange(1,1,1,f.cols).getDisplayValues()[0];
  if(!rscV13OutputValid_(targetSs,cfg,f.expectedRows,header))throw new Error('Output verification gagal setelah copy V13: '+cfg.outputSheetName);
  job.phase='COMMIT_CONFIG';job.currentFinalize=f;rscV13Persist_(job);return true;
}

function rscV13CommitConfig_(job){
  var f=job.currentFinalize,cfg=rscV13GetConfigs_([f.configKey])[0],keySs=RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.keySpreadsheetId),index=rscV13ReadStageIndex_(keySs,cfg),digest=rscV13Digest_(index);
  if(digest!==f.digest||index.keys.length!==f.uniqueCount)throw new Error('Stage berubah sebelum commit '+cfg.key+'.');
  rscV13WriteKeySnapshot_(keySs,cfg,index,digest,job.runId);
  PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().setProperty(RSC_COMPILE_V13.pCommitPrefix+job.runId+'_'+cfg.key,JSON.stringify({at:rscV13Now_(),digest:digest,count:index.keys.length}));
  var stage=keySs.getSheetByName(rscV13StageName_(cfg.key));if(stage){try{keySs.deleteSheet(stage);}catch(ignore){}}
  try{DriveApp.getFileById(f.tempSpreadsheetId).setTrashed(true);}catch(ignore2){}
  var stat=job.stats.configs[cfg.key];stat.outputRows=index.keys.length;stat.rewriteSkipped=false;
  rscV13Log_(job,'INFO','FINALIZE_COMMITTED',cfg.key,'Temporary output verified, copied, key committed, stage removed.',{outputSheet:cfg.outputSheetName,rows:index.keys.length});
  job.finalizeIndex++;job.currentFinalize=null;job.phase='FINALIZE_PREPARE';rscV13Persist_(job);
}

function rscV13Finish_(job){
  PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().setProperty(RSC_COMPILE_V13.pSourceSignature, String(job.sourceSignature || ''));
  job.phase='FINISHED';job.finishedAt=rscV13Now_();job.stats.phase='FINISHED';job.stats.finishedAt=job.finishedAt;rscV13Persist_(job);PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().deleteProperty(RSC_COMPILE_V13.pJob);rscV13DeleteCompileTriggers_();rscV13Log_(job,'INFO','RUN_FINISH','','V13 selesai seluruh config.');rscV13FlushLog_();try{var active=SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();if(active)active.toast('Compile V13 selesai.','Rolling Sales Center',10);}catch(ignoreToast){}
}

function rscV13Continue_(){
  var lock=LockService.getDocumentLock();
  if(!lock.tryLock(1000)){rscV13EnsureTrigger_(RSC_COMPILE_V13.triggerDelayMs);return;}
  var job=null,started=Date.now();
  try{
    job=rscV13LoadJob_();if(!job){rscV13DeleteCompileTriggers_();return;}
    if(String(PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().getProperty(RSC_COMPILE_V13.pStop)||'FALSE').toUpperCase()==='TRUE'){rscV13DeleteCompileTriggers_();return;}
    rscV13EnsureTrigger_(RSC_COMPILE_V13.watchdogDelayMs);
    while(!rscV13ElapsedNearLimit_(started)){
      if(job.phase==='SCAN_FILES'){if(!rscV13ScanFiles_(job,started))break;continue;}
      if(job.phase==='PREPARE_REVAMP_LOOKUP'){rscV13BuildRevampNeeds_(job);continue;}
      if(job.phase==='REVAMP_DB_SCAN'){if(!rscV13RevampDbScan_(job,started))break;continue;}
      if(job.phase==='FINALIZE_PREPARE'){rscV13PrepareFinalize_(job);continue;}
      if(job.phase==='BUILD_TEMP'){if(!rscV13BuildTemp_(job,started))break;continue;}
      if(job.phase==='COPY_TEMP_TO_OUTPUT'){if(!rscV13CopyTempToOutput_(job,started))break;continue;}
      if(job.phase==='COMMIT_CONFIG'){rscV13CommitConfig_(job);continue;}
      if(job.phase==='DONE'){rscV13Finish_(job);return;}
      if(job.phase==='FINISHED'){rscV13DeleteCompileTriggers_();return;}
      throw new Error('Phase V13 tidak dikenal: '+job.phase);
    }
    rscV13Persist_(job);rscV13EnsureTrigger_(RSC_COMPILE_V13.triggerDelayMs);
  }catch(err){
    if(job){job.globalErrors=Number(job.globalErrors||0)+1;job.lastError=rscV13Err_(err);job.lastErrorAt=rscV13Now_();if(job.stats){job.stats.lastError=job.lastError;job.stats.lastErrorAt=job.lastErrorAt;}rscV13Log_(job,'ERROR','GLOBAL_ERROR','',job.lastError);rscV13Persist_(job);if(job.globalErrors<=RSC_COMPILE_V13.maxErrors)rscV13EnsureTrigger_(RSC_COMPILE_V13.triggerDelayMs);else{job.phase='STOPPED_ERROR_LIMIT';rscV13Persist_(job);rscV13DeleteCompileTriggers_();}}
    else rscV13DeleteCompileTriggers_();
    try { SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast('Compile V13 pause karena error; checkpoint aman. ' + rscV13Err_(err).slice(0,180),'Rolling Sales Center',10); } catch (ignoreToast) {}
    return;
  }finally{try{rscV13FlushLog_();}catch(ignore){}try{lock.releaseLock();}catch(ignore2){}}
}

function rscV13Stop_(){
  var props=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();props.setProperty(RSC_COMPILE_V13.pStop,'TRUE');rscV13DeleteCompileTriggers_();var job=rscV13LoadJob_();if(job){job.phase='STOP_REQUESTED';rscV13Persist_(job);}SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('STOP V13 dipasang. Execution aktif berhenti pada checkpoint berikutnya.');
}

function rscV13Status_(){
  var job=rscV13LoadJob_(),raw=String(PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().getProperty(RSC_COMPILE_V13.pLast)||''),s=job?(job.stats||job):(raw?JSON.parse(raw):null);if(!s){SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Belum ada status V13.');return;}
  var lines=['Compile Approved Links V13','', 'Run ID: '+(s.runId||''),'Phase: '+(s.phase||''),'Started: '+(s.startedAt||''),'Finished: '+(s.finishedAt||'-'),'Manifest links: '+(s.manifestLinks||0),'File index: '+(s.fileIndex||0),'Config in file: '+(s.configIndexInFile||0),'Finalize index: '+(s.finalizeIndex||0),'Heartbeat: '+(s.heartbeatAt||''),'Last error: '+(s.lastError||'-'),''];Object.keys(s.configs||{}).forEach(function(k){var c=s.configs[k];lines.push(k+' | source='+Number(c.sourceRows||0)+' | staged='+Number(c.stagedRows||0)+' | unique='+Number(c.uniqueKeys||0)+' | output='+Number(c.outputRows||0)+' | ins='+Number(c.inserted||0)+' | upd='+Number(c.updated||0)+' | purge='+Number(c.deleted||0)+' | unchanged='+Number(c.unchanged||0)+' | skipRewrite='+(c.rewriteSkipped?'YES':'NO'));});SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(lines.join('\n'));
}

function rscV13CleanupRuntime_(selectedKeys,deleteFinalKeys){
  var P=APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS,props=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties(),oldJob=rscV13LoadJob_();rscV13DeleteCompileTriggers_();props.setProperty(RSC_COMPILE_V13.pStop,'TRUE');
  if(oldJob&&oldJob.currentFinalize&&oldJob.currentFinalize.tempSpreadsheetId){try{DriveApp.getFileById(oldJob.currentFinalize.tempSpreadsheetId).setTrashed(true);}catch(ignore){}}
  // Bersihkan orphan temporary spreadsheet dari execution yang putus tepat
  // setelah create file tetapi sebelum temp ID sempat tersimpan ke checkpoint.

    var orphanTemps = DriveApp.searchFiles("title contains 'RSC V13 TMP ' and trashed = false");
    while (orphanTemps.hasNext()) {
      try { orphanTemps.next().setTrashed(true); } catch (ignoreOrphan) {}
    }
  } catch (ignoreSearch) {}
  var keySs=RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(P.keySpreadsheetId),keys=selectedKeys||['ROLLING','SALES_OFFICE','SALESMAN_TYPE','REVAMP'];
  keys.forEach(function(k){[rscV13StageName_(k)].concat(deleteFinalKeys?[rscV13KeyName_(k)]:[]).forEach(function(name){var sh=keySs.getSheetByName(name);if(sh){try{keySs.deleteSheet(sh);}catch(err){sh.clear();rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh,1,1);}}});});
  [RSC_COMPILE_V13.lookupNeedsSheet,RSC_COMPILE_V13.lookupMapSheet].forEach(function(name){var sh=keySs.getSheetByName(name);if(sh){try{keySs.deleteSheet(sh);}catch(err){sh.clear();rscCompileTrimSheetToSize_(sh,1,1);}}});
  (keySs.getSheets()||[]).forEach(function(sh){var n=String(sh.getName()||'');if(n.indexOf('_RSC_TARGET_KEYS_')===0||n.indexOf('_RSC_STG_')===0||n.indexOf('_RSC_STAGING')===0){try{keySs.deleteSheet(sh);}catch(ignore2){}}});
  props.deleteProperty(RSC_COMPILE_V13.pJob);props.deleteProperty(APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_PARAMETERS.pJob);props.setProperty(RSC_COMPILE_V13.pStop,'FALSE');
