/***************************************************************
 * MASTER AUTO PIPELINE V24 — 2026-08-13
 *
 * Tujuan:
 * 1) Berjalan dari MASTER spreadsheet, bukan dari file FINAL.
 * 2) Setiap jam membaca link FINAL dari Rekap All kolom E.
 *    Legacy fallback: Rekap Approved.
 * 3) Menjalankan Validate ALL Column E V20:
 *      - authoritative BP Type replace dari m_bp_general_view
 *      - seluruh validation/fix existing
 *      - ERROR tetap ditulis ke target O/P dan link master merah.
 * 4) Setelah seluruh validation selesai, otomatis menjalankan
 *    Template Revamp Rolling Sales hanya untuk:
 *      status approval master = DONE
 *      DAN validation run saat itu = COMPLETE_OK.
 * 5) Revamp tetap UPSERT/idempotent sehingga run berkala aman.
 *
 * IMPORTANT:
 * - Install sekali dari MASTER melalui menu:
 *   Template Revamp Job — Integrated > Install Master Auto Pipeline Hourly.
 * - Trigger continuation menggunakan one-time trigger; hourly trigger tidak
 *   akan memulai cycle baru ketika validation/revamp cycle lama masih aktif.
 ***************************************************************/

var RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813 = {
  version: 'RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_V24_20260813',
  hourlyHandler: 'RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SCHEDULED_20260813',
  continueHandler: 'RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_CONTINUE_20260813',
  everyHours: 1,
  pollDelayMs: 2 * 60 * 1000,
  fastContinueMs: 10 * 1000,

  masterSheetCandidates: ['Rekap All', 'Rekap Approved'],
  masterLinkCol: 5,

  validationManifestSheet: '_RSC_VALIDATE_E_MANIFEST',
  validationRunTokenProperty: 'RSC_VALIDATE_E_V20_RUN_TOKEN',
  validationStopProperty: 'RSC_VALIDATE_E_V20_STOP',

  revampJobProperty: 'RSC_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_ROLLING_JOB_20260720',

  pEnabled: 'RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_ENABLED_20260813',
  pMasterSsId: 'RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_MASTER_SS_ID_20260813',
  pMasterSheetId: 'RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_MASTER_SHEET_ID_20260813',
  pPhase: 'RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_PHASE_20260813',
  pCycleId: 'RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_CYCLE_ID_20260813',
  pValidationRunToken: 'RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_VALIDATION_TOKEN_20260813',
  pStartedAt: 'RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_STARTED_AT_20260813',
  pLastFinishedAt: 'RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_LAST_FINISHED_AT_20260813',
  pLastStatus: 'RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_LAST_STATUS_20260813',
  pLastError: 'RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_LAST_ERROR_20260813'
};

var __RSC_MASTER_AUTO_VALIDATION_GATE_CACHE_20260813 = Object.create(null);

function RSC_RESOLVE_MASTER_SHEET_20260813_(ss, candidates) {
  if (!ss) return null;
  candidates = candidates || RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813.masterSheetCandidates;
  for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
    var name = String(candidates[i] || '').trim();
    if (!name) continue;
    var sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
    if (sh) return sh;
  }
  return null;
}

function RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_GET_MASTER_SPREADSHEET_20260813_() {
  try {
    var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
    var id = String(props.getProperty(RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813.pMasterSsId) || '').trim();
    if (id) return RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(id);
  } catch (ignore) {}
  return null;
}

function RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_DELETE_TRIGGERS_20260813_(handlers) {
  var wanted = Object.create(null);
  (handlers || []).forEach(function (h) { wanted[String(h)] = true; });
  ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(function (t) {
    if (wanted[t.getHandlerFunction()]) {
      try { ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(t); } catch (ignore) {}
    }
  });
}

function RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SCHEDULE_CONTINUE_20260813_(delayMs) {
  var P = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813;
  RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_DELETE_TRIGGERS_20260813_([P.continueHandler]);
  RSC_PERF13_NEW_TRIGGER_20260819_(P.continueHandler)
    .timeBased()
    .after(Math.max(1000, Number(delayMs || P.pollDelayMs)))
    .create();
}

function RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SET_STATUS_20260813_(phase, message, err) {
  var P = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  if (phase) props.setProperty(P.pPhase, String(phase));
  props.setProperty(P.pLastStatus, String(message || ''));
  if (err) props.setProperty(P.pLastError, err.message || String(err));
  else props.deleteProperty(P.pLastError);
  try {
    var ss = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_GET_MASTER_SPREADSHEET_20260813_();
    if (ss && message) ss.toast(String(message), 'Master Auto Pipeline', 10);
  } catch (ignore) {}
  console.log('[MASTER AUTO PIPELINE] ' + String(phase || '') + ' | ' + String(message || ''));
}

function RSC_INSTALL_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813(silent) {
  var P = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813;
  var ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  var masterSh = RSC_RESOLVE_MASTER_SHEET_20260813_(ss, P.masterSheetCandidates);
  if (!masterSh) {
    throw new Error('Master sheet tidak ditemukan. Dicari: ' + P.masterSheetCandidates.join(', '));
  }

  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.setProperty(P.pEnabled, 'TRUE');
  props.setProperty(P.pMasterSsId, ss.getId());
  props.setProperty(P.pMasterSheetId, String(masterSh.getSheetId()));
  if (!props.getProperty(P.pPhase)) props.setProperty(P.pPhase, 'IDLE');

  RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_DELETE_TRIGGERS_20260813_([P.hourlyHandler]);
  RSC_PERF13_NEW_TRIGGER_20260819_(P.hourlyHandler)
    .timeBased()
    .everyHours(P.everyHours)
    .create();

  var msg =
    'Master Auto Pipeline terpasang setiap ' + P.everyHours + ' jam. ' +
    'Master=' + masterSh.getName() +
    ' | Kolom E -> Validate ALL -> Template Revamp (DONE + COMPLETE_OK).';

  RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SET_STATUS_20260813_(props.getProperty(P.pPhase) || 'IDLE', msg);

  if (!silent) {
    try { SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(msg); } catch (ignore) {}
  }
  return { installed: true, masterSheet: masterSh.getName(), everyHours: P.everyHours };
}

function RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_RUN_NOW_20260813() {
  var P = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();

  // Jika belum pernah di-install, register master context tanpa memaksa trigger hourly.
  if (!props.getProperty(P.pMasterSsId)) {
    var ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    var masterSh = RSC_RESOLVE_MASTER_SHEET_20260813_(ss, P.masterSheetCandidates);
    if (!masterSh) throw new Error('Master sheet tidak ditemukan. Dicari: ' + P.masterSheetCandidates.join(', '));
    props.setProperty(P.pMasterSsId, ss.getId());
    props.setProperty(P.pMasterSheetId, String(masterSh.getSheetId()));
  }

  props.setProperty(P.pEnabled, 'TRUE');
  return RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_RUN_INTERNAL_20260813_(true);
}

function RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SCHEDULED_20260813(e) {
  var P = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  if (String(props.getProperty(P.pEnabled) || '').toUpperCase() !== 'TRUE') return;
  return RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_RUN_INTERNAL_20260813_(false);
}

function RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_CONTINUE_20260813(e) {
  RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_DELETE_TRIGGERS_20260813_([
    RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813.continueHandler
  ]);
  return RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_RUN_INTERNAL_20260813_(false);
}

function RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_GET_MASTER_CONTEXT_20260813_() {
  var P = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var ssId = String(props.getProperty(P.pMasterSsId) || '').trim();
  if (!ssId) throw new Error('Master Auto Pipeline belum di-install dari Master Spreadsheet.');

  var ss = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(ssId);
  var storedSheetId = String(props.getProperty(P.pMasterSheetId) || '').trim();
  var sh = null;

  if (storedSheetId) {
    ss.getSheets().some(function (candidate) {
      if (String(candidate.getSheetId()) === storedSheetId) {
        sh = candidate;
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    });
  }

  if (!sh) sh = RSC_RESOLVE_MASTER_SHEET_20260813_(ss, P.masterSheetCandidates);
  if (!sh) throw new Error('Master sheet tidak ditemukan lagi. Dicari: ' + P.masterSheetCandidates.join(', '));

  // Bila sheet berpindah / legacy alias berganti, update context otomatis.
  props.setProperty(P.pMasterSheetId, String(sh.getSheetId()));
  return { ss: ss, sh: sh };
}

function RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_VALIDATION_SUMMARY_20260813_(masterSs, runToken) {
  var P = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813;
  var summary = {
    runToken: String(runToken || ''),
    total: 0,
    queued: 0,
    active: 0,
    partial: 0,
    completeOk: 0,
    completeError: 0,
    hardError: 0,
    unknown: 0,
    unfinished: 0
  };
  if (!summary.runToken) return summary;

  var sh = masterSs.getSheetByName(P.validationManifestSheet);
  if (!sh || sh.getLastRow() < 2) return summary;

  var last = sh.getLastRow();
  var chunk = 500;
  for (var start = 2; start <= last; start += chunk) {
    var n = Math.min(chunk, last - start + 1);
    var vals = sh.getRange(start, 1, n, 5).getDisplayValues();
    for (var i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
      if (String(vals[i][0] || '') !== summary.runToken) continue;
      summary.total++;
      var status = String(vals[i][4] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      if (status === 'QUEUED') summary.queued++;
      else if (status === 'ACTIVE') summary.active++;
      else if (status === 'PARTIAL_VALIDATION') summary.partial++;
      else if (status === 'COMPLETE_OK') summary.completeOk++;
      else if (status === 'COMPLETE_ERROR') summary.completeError++;
      else if (status === 'HARD_ERROR') summary.hardError++;
      else summary.unknown++;
    }
  }
  summary.unfinished = summary.queued + summary.active + summary.partial;
  return summary;
}

function RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_BUILD_GATE_20260813_(masterSs, runToken) {
  var P = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813;
  var token = String(runToken || '');
  var cacheKey = masterSs.getId() + '|' + token;
  if (__RSC_MASTER_AUTO_VALIDATION_GATE_CACHE_20260813[cacheKey]) {
    return __RSC_MASTER_AUTO_VALIDATION_GATE_CACHE_20260813[cacheKey];
  }

  var map = Object.create(null);
  var sh = masterSs.getSheetByName(P.validationManifestSheet);
  if (!token || !sh || sh.getLastRow() < 2) {
    __RSC_MASTER_AUTO_VALIDATION_GATE_CACHE_20260813[cacheKey] = map;
    return map;
  }

  var last = sh.getLastRow();
  var chunk = 250;
  for (var start = 2; start <= last; start += chunk) {
    var n = Math.min(chunk, last - start + 1);
    // A Run Token | B Master Row | ... | E Status | ... | O State JSON
    var vals = sh.getRange(start, 1, n, 15).getValues();
    for (var i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
      if (String(vals[i][0] || '') !== token) continue;
      var status = String(vals[i][4] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      var primaryRow = Number(vals[i][1] || 0);
      var state = {};
      try { state = JSON.parse(String(vals[i][14] || '{}')); } catch (ignore) {}
      var rows = state.masterRows && state.masterRows.length ? state.masterRows : [primaryRow];
      for (var r = 0; r < rows.length; r++) {
        var rowNo = Number(rows[r] || 0);
        if (rowNo > 0) map[rowNo] = status;
      }
    }
  }

  __RSC_MASTER_AUTO_VALIDATION_GATE_CACHE_20260813[cacheKey] = map;
  return map;
}

function RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_IS_ROW_VALIDATION_OK_20260813_(masterSs, masterRow, runToken) {
  var map = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_BUILD_GATE_20260813_(masterSs, runToken);
  var status = String(map[Number(masterRow)] || '');
  return { ok: status === 'COMPLETE_OK', status: status || 'NOT_IN_MANIFEST' };
}

function RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_HAS_ACTIVE_REVAMP_20260813_() {
  var raw = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties()
    .getProperty(RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813.revampJobProperty);
  if (!raw) return false;
  try {
    var state = JSON.parse(raw);
    return String(state.phase || '').toUpperCase() !== 'FINISHED';
  } catch (ignore) {
    return true;
  }
}

function RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_START_VALIDATION_20260813_(ctx) {
  var P = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();

  // Existing unfinished validation must never be overwritten by a fresh manifest.
  var existingToken = String(props.getProperty(P.validationRunTokenProperty) || '');
  if (existingToken) {
    var existingSummary = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_VALIDATION_SUMMARY_20260813_(ctx.ss, existingToken);
    if (existingSummary.unfinished > 0) {
      props.setProperty(P.pValidationRunToken, existingToken);
      RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SET_STATUS_20260813_(
        'VALIDATING',
        'Mengadopsi validation yang masih aktif. unfinished=' + existingSummary.unfinished + '.'
      );
      RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SCHEDULE_CONTINUE_20260813_(P.pollDelayMs);
      return existingSummary;
    }
  }

  // Entry point V20 sekarang resolve Rekap All/Rekap Approved dari master context.
  RSC_START_VALIDATE_ALL_IN_COLUMN_E_20260723();

  var newToken = String(props.getProperty(P.validationRunTokenProperty) || '');
  if (!newToken) throw new Error('Validate ALL tidak menghasilkan run token V20.');

  props.setProperty(P.pValidationRunToken, newToken);
  props.setProperty(P.pPhase, 'VALIDATING');
  RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SET_STATUS_20260813_(
    'VALIDATING',
    'Validate ALL dimulai dari ' + ctx.sh.getName() + ' kolom E. Run=' + newToken
  );
  RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SCHEDULE_CONTINUE_20260813_(P.pollDelayMs);
  return { runToken: newToken, started: true };
}

function RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_START_REVAMP_20260813_(ctx, runToken, validationSummary) {
  var P = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();

  if (RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_HAS_ACTIVE_REVAMP_20260813_()) {
    props.setProperty(P.pPhase, 'REVAMP');
    RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SET_STATUS_20260813_(
      'REVAMP',
      'Template Revamp masih aktif; auto pipeline menunggu job existing selesai.'
    );
    RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SCHEDULE_CONTINUE_20260813_(P.pollDelayMs);
    return;
  }

  if (Number(validationSummary.completeOk || 0) <= 0) {
    props.setProperty(P.pPhase, 'IDLE');
    props.setProperty(P.pLastFinishedAt, new Date().toISOString());
    RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SET_STATUS_20260813_(
      'IDLE',
      'Validation selesai tetapi tidak ada file COMPLETE_OK. Revamp tidak dijalankan. ' +
      'ERROR=' + (Number(validationSummary.completeError || 0) + Number(validationSummary.hardError || 0)) + '.'
    );
    return;
  }

  props.setProperty(P.pPhase, 'REVAMP');
  RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SET_STATUS_20260813_(
    'REVAMP',
    'Validation selesai. COMPLETE_OK=' + validationSummary.completeOk +
    ', ERROR=' + (Number(validationSummary.completeError || 0) + Number(validationSummary.hardError || 0)) +
    '. Memulai Template Revamp untuk row DONE + validation COMPLETE_OK.'
  );

  // Reset gate cache untuk run baru.
  __RSC_MASTER_AUTO_VALIDATION_GATE_CACHE_20260813 = Object.create(null);

  RSC_CREATE_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_ROLLING_SALES_20260720({
    manualStart: true,
    integratedMenu: true,
    requireValidationOk: true,
    validationRunToken: String(runToken || ''),
    autoPipeline: true
  });

  if (RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_HAS_ACTIVE_REVAMP_20260813_()) {
    RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SCHEDULE_CONTINUE_20260813_(P.pollDelayMs);
  }
}

function RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_RUN_INTERNAL_20260813_(forceNow) {
  var P = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  if (!forceNow && String(props.getProperty(P.pEnabled) || '').toUpperCase() !== 'TRUE') return;

  var lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(10000)) {
    RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SCHEDULE_CONTINUE_20260813_(P.fastContinueMs);
    return { skipped: true, reason: 'LOCK_BUSY' };
  }

  try {
    var ctx = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_GET_MASTER_CONTEXT_20260813_();
    var phase = String(props.getProperty(P.pPhase) || 'IDLE').toUpperCase();

    if (phase === 'REVAMP') {
      if (RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_HAS_ACTIVE_REVAMP_20260813_()) {
        RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SET_STATUS_20260813_(
          'REVAMP',
          'Template Revamp masih berjalan. Cycle baru tidak dimulai.'
        );
        RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SCHEDULE_CONTINUE_20260813_(P.pollDelayMs);
        return { phase: 'REVAMP', waiting: true };
      }

      props.setProperty(P.pPhase, 'IDLE');
      props.setProperty(P.pLastFinishedAt, new Date().toISOString());
      RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SET_STATUS_20260813_('IDLE', 'Template Revamp selesai. Auto pipeline kembali IDLE.');
      phase = 'IDLE';

      // Scheduled continuation hanya menutup cycle. Jangan langsung start cycle baru
      // pada callback yang sama; hourly handler berikutnya akan memulai cycle berikut.
      if (!forceNow) return { phase: 'IDLE', completed: true };
    }

    if (phase === 'VALIDATING') {
      var runToken = String(props.getProperty(P.pValidationRunToken) || '');
      var summary = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_VALIDATION_SUMMARY_20260813_(ctx.ss, runToken);

      if (summary.unfinished > 0) {
        RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SET_STATUS_20260813_(
          'VALIDATING',
          'Validation masih berjalan. total=' + summary.total +
          ', unfinished=' + summary.unfinished +
          ', OK=' + summary.completeOk +
          ', ERROR=' + (summary.completeError + summary.hardError) + '.'
        );
        RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SCHEDULE_CONTINUE_20260813_(P.pollDelayMs);
        return summary;
      }

      if (summary.total <= 0) {
        throw new Error('Validation manifest untuk run token auto pipeline tidak ditemukan.');
      }

      return RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_START_REVAMP_20260813_(ctx, runToken, summary);
    }

    // Kalau ada manual revamp yang sedang aktif, jangan timpa.
    if (RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_HAS_ACTIVE_REVAMP_20260813_()) {
      props.setProperty(P.pPhase, 'REVAMP');
      RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SET_STATUS_20260813_(
        'REVAMP',
        'Menunggu Template Revamp existing selesai; cycle validation baru tidak dimulai.'
      );
      RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SCHEDULE_CONTINUE_20260813_(P.pollDelayMs);
      return { phase: 'REVAMP', adopted: true };
    }

    // Mulai cycle baru.
    var cycleId = P.version + '|' + Utilities.getUuid();
    props.setProperty(P.pCycleId, cycleId);
    props.setProperty(P.pStartedAt, new Date().toISOString());
    props.setProperty(P.pPhase, 'VALIDATING');
    props.deleteProperty(P.pLastError);

    return RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_START_VALIDATION_20260813_(ctx);

  } catch (err) {
    props.setProperty(P.pPhase, 'ERROR');
    RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SET_STATUS_20260813_('ERROR', 'Master Auto Pipeline ERROR: ' + (err.message || String(err)), err);
    throw err;
  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (ignore) {}
  }
}

function RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_ON_VALIDATION_DONE_20260813_() {
  var P = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var phase = String(props.getProperty(P.pPhase) || '').toUpperCase();
  if (phase !== 'VALIDATING') return;
  try {
    RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SCHEDULE_CONTINUE_20260813_(P.fastContinueMs);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Unable to schedule master pipeline after validation: ' + (err.message || String(err)));
  }
}

function RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_ON_REVAMP_DONE_20260813_(state) {
  var P = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.setProperty(P.pPhase, 'IDLE');
  props.setProperty(P.pLastFinishedAt, new Date().toISOString());
  RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SET_STATUS_20260813_(
    'IDLE',
    'Auto Template Revamp selesai. processed=' + Number((state && state.processedFiles) || 0) +
    ', error=' + Number((state && state.errorFiles) || 0) +
    ', validation-skipped=' + Number((state && state.validationSkippedRows) || 0) + '.'
  );
  RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_DELETE_TRIGGERS_20260813_([P.continueHandler]);
}

function RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_ON_REVAMP_ERROR_20260813_(state, err) {
  var P = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.setProperty(P.pPhase, 'ERROR');
  RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SET_STATUS_20260813_(
    'ERROR',
    'Auto Template Revamp ERROR: ' + ((err && err.message) || String(err || 'Unknown error')),
    err
  );
}

function RSC_SHOW_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_STATUS_20260813() {
  var P = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var enabled = String(props.getProperty(P.pEnabled) || '').toUpperCase() === 'TRUE';
  var phase = props.getProperty(P.pPhase) || 'IDLE';
  var runToken = props.getProperty(P.pValidationRunToken) || '';
  var msg = [
    'Enabled: ' + (enabled ? 'YES' : 'NO'),
    'Phase: ' + phase,
    'Master Spreadsheet ID: ' + (props.getProperty(P.pMasterSsId) || '-'),
    'Validation token: ' + (runToken || '-'),
    'Cycle started: ' + (props.getProperty(P.pStartedAt) || '-'),
    'Last finished: ' + (props.getProperty(P.pLastFinishedAt) || '-'),
    'Last status: ' + (props.getProperty(P.pLastStatus) || '-'),
    'Last error: ' + (props.getProperty(P.pLastError) || '-')
  ];

  try {
    var ctx = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_GET_MASTER_CONTEXT_20260813_();
    msg.splice(3, 0, 'Master sheet: ' + ctx.sh.getName() + ' | link column=E');
    if (runToken) {
      var s = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_VALIDATION_SUMMARY_20260813_(ctx.ss, runToken);
      msg.push(
        'Validation: total=' + s.total +
        ', unfinished=' + s.unfinished +
        ', COMPLETE_OK=' + s.completeOk +
        ', COMPLETE_ERROR=' + s.completeError +
        ', HARD_ERROR=' + s.hardError
      );
    }
  } catch (statusErr) {
    msg.push('Master context error: ' + (statusErr.message || String(statusErr)));
  }

  try { SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('Master Auto Pipeline', msg.join('\n'), SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK); }
  catch (ignore) { console.log(msg.join('\n')); }
  return msg.join('\n');
}

function RSC_STOP_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813(silent) {
  var P = RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_20260813;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.setProperty(P.pEnabled, 'FALSE');
  props.setProperty(P.pPhase, 'STOPPED');

  RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_DELETE_TRIGGERS_20260813_([P.hourlyHandler, P.continueHandler]);

  // Hanya hentikan child jobs ketika auto cycle memang sedang berjalan.
  try {
    var validationToken = String(props.getProperty(P.pValidationRunToken) || '');
    if (validationToken) RSC_STOP_VALIDATE_ALL_IN_COLUMN_E_20260723();
  } catch (ignoreValidationStop) {}

  try {
    if (RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_HAS_ACTIVE_REVAMP_20260813_()) {
      RSC_STOP_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_JOB_20260722();
    }
  } catch (ignoreRevampStop) {}

  var msg = 'Master Auto Pipeline STOPPED. Trigger hourly/continue dihapus.';
  RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SET_STATUS_20260813_('STOPPED', msg);

  if (!silent) {
    try { SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(msg); } catch (ignore) {}
  }
  return { stopped: true };
}

/***************************************************************
 * COMPILE TO UPLOAD READY TEMPLATE — EXTERNAL KEY STORAGE
 * Version: 2026-07-28 PATCH 15.1 — ST/RL OUTPUT TRIM/FROZEN GRID FIX
 *
 * PERUBAHAN UTAMA
 * 1. Output hanya memakai kolom A:O. Business key dan run ID
 *    disimpan di spreadsheet teknis terpisah.
 * 2. Staging, needs, map, queue, groups, dan index juga berada
 *    di spreadsheet teknis agar workbook output tidak cepat penuh.
 * 3. Cleanse otomatis memangkas trailing row/column kosong.
 * 4. Output diproses satu kali per group, bukan ditulis ulang
 *    berulang kali pada setiap chunk DISTRIBUTE.
 * 5. Mendukung migrasi otomatis dari format lama P:Q.
 * 6. Baris dengan Sales Office Source = Change Sales Office tetap
 *    melakukan lookup DB memakai Sales Office asal dari Rekap Approved;
 *    kolom A:B output kemudian dinormalisasi ke SSSS group output.
 * 7. Start / Upsert melakukan rekonsiliasi penuh: baris stale pada sheet
 *    yang masih dipakai dibuang dan sheet managed yang sudah obsolete
 *    dihapus setelah seluruh sumber DONE berhasil dibaca.
 * 8. Business key/upsert key memakai tepat 6 kolom:
 *    Customer ID, Relationship, Salesman ID, Valid From,
 *    Visit Type, dan Visit Valid From.
 * 9. Output yang tidak berubah tidak ditulis ulang; hanya key/run ID
 *    teknis yang direfresh. Metadata group/finalize dibaca secara batch.
 * 10. Baris Schedule pada output dihapus. Header berada di baris 1 dan
 *     data dimulai dari baris 2, termasuk migrasi output lama.
 * 11. Kolom Sales Office dan Delivering Plant selalu disamakan dengan
 *     kode SSSS pada nama/group output: XXXX YY ZZ SSSS.
 * 12. Purge stale per group tidak lagi bergantung pada run ID lama. Saat
 *     stale cleanup aman/aktif, isi target direkonsiliasi langsung terhadap
 *     snapshot business key dari seluruh source DONE pada run terbaru.
 * 13. Menu Export Active Sheet Only memproses hanya sheet aktif bernama
 *     Template Revamp Rolling Sales tanpa membaca daftar link kolom E.
 *     Mode ini adalah targeted upsert: tidak menghapus row/sheet lain.
 * 14. Job normal dan Export Active membaca Change Rolling pada file sumber
 *     yang sama. Kuning menandai penambahan/Tambahan, biru menandai
 *     perubahan nilai pada KEY6 yang sudah ada.
 * 15. Export Active selalu memakai sheet output canonical yang sudah ada.
 *     Script tidak lagi membuat suffix " 2" atau "(2)" untuk group sama.
 * 16. Cleanse duplicate output menggabungkan isi sheet duplikat ke sheet
 *     canonical, membangun ulang key storage/index, lalu menghapus duplikat.
 * 17. Source tidak lagi disalin berdasarkan posisi tetap. Setiap kolom
 *     dipetakan berdasarkan nama header agar layout tanpa Relationship tidak
 *     menggeser Salesman ID dan seluruh kolom berikutnya.
 * 18. Baris output lama yang terlanjur bergeser satu kolom dideteksi secara
 *     ketat, diperbaiki, lalu technical key dibangun ulang.
 * 19. Menu Compile ST/RL membaca seluruh link kolom E dari master eksternal.
 * 20. Lookup m_sales_info memakai salesman_id sebagai BP ID, serta sls_org
 *     dan sls_office sebagai atribut grouping.
 * 21. Compile ST/RL memakai dua sumber terpisah: RL dari Template Revamp
 *     (Customer ID C dan Salesman ID E wajib diawali S) dan ST mengambil
 *     seluruh row yang memiliki Salesman ID.
 * 22. Output ST/RL memakai template ringkas 7/11 kolom, upsert/purge dengan
 *     key terpisah, summary per Sales Office, serta export XLSX dan ZIP.
 *
 * CARA PAKAI
 * 1. Ganti script lama dengan seluruh file ini.
 * 2. Save.
 * 3. Jalankan sekali RSC_UR_INSTALL_MENU_20260721.
 * 4. Reload spreadsheet master.
 * 5. Jalankan Start / Upsert.
 ***************************************************************/

/***************************************************************
 * START
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_UR_START_20260721() {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var lock = LockService.getUserLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(10000)) {
    try {
      SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
        'Compile Upload Ready sedang dipersiapkan oleh proses lain.',
        'Compile Upload Ready',
        10
      );
    } catch (ignoreToast) {}
    return;
  }

  try {
    var masterSs = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    var masterSh = masterSs.getSheetByName(cfg.masterSheetName);

    if (!masterSh) {
      throw new Error('Sheet master "' + cfg.masterSheetName + '" tidak ditemukan.');
    }

    var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();

    if (props.getProperty(cfg.stRlJobProperty)) {
      throw new Error(
        'Job ST/RL masih aktif. Selesaikan atau hentikan ST/RL Job terlebih dahulu.'
      );
    }

    props.deleteProperty(cfg.jobProperty);
    props.deleteProperty('RSC_UR_JOB_20260721');
    props.deleteProperty('RSC_UR_LAST_20260721');
    RSC_UR_deleteTriggersByHandler_(cfg.workerHandler);

    var targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(cfg.targetSpreadsheetId);
    var technicalSs = RSC_UR_getOrCreateTechnicalSpreadsheet_(props);

    var targetBefore = RSC_UR_countAllocatedCells_(targetSs);
    var technicalBefore = RSC_UR_countAllocatedCells_(technicalSs);

    // Migrasi dahulu agar index/key lama tidak hilang.
    RSC_UR_ensureTechnicalTemplate_(technicalSs);
    RSC_UR_ensureTechnicalIndex_(technicalSs);
    RSC_UR_migrateLegacyStorage_(targetSs, technicalSs);
    RSC_UR_ensureOutputTemplate_(targetSs);
    var duplicateCleanse = RSC_UR_mergeDuplicateOutputSheets_(targetSs, technicalSs);
    RSC_UR_upgradeExistingOutputSheets_(targetSs, technicalSs);

    var cleanseTarget = RSC_UR_cleanseSpreadsheet_(targetSs, 'TARGET');
    var cleanseTechnical = RSC_UR_cleanseSpreadsheet_(technicalSs, 'TECHNICAL');

    RSC_UR_resetWorkingSheets_(technicalSs);

    var runId = Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
    ) + '_' + Utilities.getUuid().slice(0, 8);

    var stats = {
      runId: runId,
      phase: 'COLLECT',
      startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      finishedAt: '',

      approvedDoneRows: 0,
      processedFiles: 0,
      skippedMasterRows: 0,
      invalidDoneLinks: 0,
      missingRekapSalesOffice: 0,
      fileErrors: 0,

      collectedSourceRows: 0,
      changeSalesOfficeRows: 0,
      additionalSourceRows: 0,
      changedSourceRows: 0,
      additionRowsHighlighted: 0,
      changedRowsHighlighted: 0,
      highlightChanges: 0,
      duplicateSheetsMerged: Number(duplicateCleanse && duplicateCleanse.sheetsMerged || 0),
      duplicateSheetsDeleted: Number(duplicateCleanse && duplicateCleanse.sheetsDeleted || 0),
      duplicateSourceKeysCollapsed: 0,
      staleCleanupEnabled: false,
      staleCleanupBlockedReason: '',

      dbRowsScanned: 0,
      dbMatches: 0,

      distributedRows: 0,
      unmatchedRows: 0,

      insertedRows: 0,
      updatedRows: 0,
      unchangedRows: 0,
      removedStaleRows: 0,
      removedDuplicateRows: 0,
      optimizedOutputWriteSkips: 0,
      keyOnlyRefreshes: 0,

      outputSheets: 0,
      outputRows: 0,
      activeOutputGroupsProcessed: 0,
      activeOutputRowsAfterUpsert: 0,
      deletedObsoleteSheets: 0,

      cleansedRows: Number(cleanseTarget.rowsDeleted || 0) + Number(cleanseTechnical.rowsDeleted || 0),
      cleansedColumns: Number(cleanseTarget.columnsDeleted || 0) + Number(cleanseTechnical.columnsDeleted || 0),
      targetCellsBefore: targetBefore,
      targetCellsAfterCleanse: RSC_UR_countAllocatedCells_(targetSs),
      technicalCellsBefore: technicalBefore,
      technicalCellsAfterCleanse: RSC_UR_countAllocatedCells_(technicalSs),
      technicalSpreadsheetId: technicalSs.getId(),

      lastError: ''
    };

    var job = {
      runId: runId,
      masterSpreadsheetId: masterSs.getId(),
      masterSheetId: masterSh.getSheetId(),
      technicalSpreadsheetId: technicalSs.getId(),

      phase: 'COLLECT',
      masterCursor: cfg.masterFirstDataRow,
      dbMeta: null,
      dbCursor: 0,
      stageCursor: 2,
      groupCursor: 2,
      finalCursor: 0,

      allowStaleCleanup: false,
      stats: stats
    };

    RSC_UR_saveJob_(job);

    try {
      masterSs.toast(
        'Job dimulai. Run ID: ' + runId,
        'Compile Upload Ready',
        10
      );
    } catch (ignoreToast2) {}
  } finally {
    try {
      lock.releaseLock();
    } catch (ignore) {}
  }

  RSC_UR_CONTINUE_20260721();
}


/***************************************************************
 * EXPORT ACTIVE SHEET ONLY — TARGETED / FAST
 *
 * Cara kerja:
 * - Hanya membaca sheet yang sedang aktif.
 * - Sheet aktif wajib Template Revamp Rolling Sales.
 * - Tidak membaca Rekap Approved maupun link pada kolom E.
 * - Sales Office konteks diambil per baris dari kolom A sheet aktif.
 * - Mode ini melakukan upsert saja dan TIDAK melakukan global stale purge,
 *   agar data dari source/output lain tidak ikut terhapus.
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_UR_EXPORT_ACTIVE_SHEET_20260724() {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var lock = LockService.getUserLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(10000)) {
    try {
      SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
        'Export Active Sheet sedang dipersiapkan oleh proses lain.',
        'Export Active Sheet',
        10
      );
    } catch (ignoreToast) {}
    return;
  }

  var activeSs = null;

  try {
    activeSs = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

    if (!activeSs) {
      throw new Error(
        'Spreadsheet aktif tidak ditemukan. Buka file yang berisi sheet "' +
        cfg.sourceSheetName +
        '", lalu jalankan menu ini kembali.'
      );
    }

    var activeSh = activeSs.getActiveSheet();

    if (!activeSh) {
      throw new Error('Sheet aktif tidak ditemukan.');
    }

    var activeNameNormalized = RSC_UR_normalizeHeader_(activeSh.getName());
    var expectedNameNormalized = RSC_UR_normalizeHeader_(cfg.sourceSheetName);

    if (activeNameNormalized.indexOf(expectedNameNormalized) < 0) {
      throw new Error(
        'Sheet aktif harus "' + cfg.sourceSheetName + '". ' +
        'Saat ini yang aktif adalah "' + activeSh.getName() + '".'
      );
    }

    var headerInfo = RSC_UR_findSourceHeader_(activeSh);
    var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();

    if (props.getProperty(cfg.stRlJobProperty)) {
      throw new Error(
        'Job ST/RL masih aktif. Selesaikan atau hentikan ST/RL Job terlebih dahulu.'
      );
    }

    // Hentikan checkpoint/trigger lama agar dua job tidak menulis bersamaan.
    props.deleteProperty(cfg.jobProperty);
    props.deleteProperty('RSC_UR_JOB_20260721');
    props.deleteProperty('RSC_UR_LAST_20260721');
    RSC_UR_deleteTriggersByHandler_(cfg.workerHandler);

    var targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(cfg.targetSpreadsheetId);
    var technicalSs = RSC_UR_getOrCreateTechnicalSpreadsheet_(props);

    // Inisialisasi minimum. Duplicate index dibersihkan tanpa menulis ulang
    // group yang tidak memiliki duplicate, sehingga tetap tertarget.
    RSC_UR_ensureTechnicalTemplate_(technicalSs);
    RSC_UR_ensureTechnicalIndex_(technicalSs);
    RSC_UR_migrateLegacyStorage_(targetSs, technicalSs);
    RSC_UR_ensureOutputTemplate_(targetSs);
    var duplicateCleanse = RSC_UR_mergeDuplicateOutputSheets_(targetSs, technicalSs);
    RSC_UR_resetWorkingSheets_(technicalSs);

    var runId = Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
    ) + '_ACTIVE_' + Utilities.getUuid().slice(0, 8);

    var stats = {
      runId: runId,
      sourceMode: 'ACTIVE_SHEET',
      activeSpreadsheetId: activeSs.getId(),
      activeSpreadsheetName: activeSs.getName(),
      activeSheetId: activeSh.getSheetId(),
      activeSheetName: activeSh.getName(),

      phase: 'COLLECT_ACTIVE',
      startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      finishedAt: '',

      approvedDoneRows: 0,
      processedFiles: 0,
      skippedMasterRows: 0,
      invalidDoneLinks: 0,
      missingRekapSalesOffice: 0,
      fileErrors: 0,

      collectedSourceRows: 0,
      changeSalesOfficeRows: 0,
      additionalSourceRows: 0,
      changedSourceRows: 0,
      additionRowsHighlighted: 0,
      changedRowsHighlighted: 0,
      highlightChanges: 0,
      duplicateSheetsMerged: Number(duplicateCleanse && duplicateCleanse.sheetsMerged || 0),
      duplicateSheetsDeleted: Number(duplicateCleanse && duplicateCleanse.sheetsDeleted || 0),
      activeRowsWithoutSalesOffice: 0,
      duplicateSourceKeysCollapsed: 0,
      staleCleanupEnabled: false,
      staleCleanupBlockedReason:
        'Mode ACTIVE_SHEET memakai targeted upsert; global stale purge dinonaktifkan.',

      dbRowsScanned: 0,
      dbMatches: 0,

      distributedRows: 0,
      unmatchedRows: 0,

      insertedRows: 0,
      updatedRows: 0,
      unchangedRows: 0,
      removedStaleRows: 0,
      removedDuplicateRows: 0,
      optimizedOutputWriteSkips: 0,
      keyOnlyRefreshes: 0,

      outputSheets: 0,
      outputRows: 0,
      activeOutputGroupsProcessed: 0,
      activeOutputRowsAfterUpsert: 0,
      deletedObsoleteSheets: 0,

      cleansedRows: 0,
      cleansedColumns: 0,
      targetCellsBefore: 0,
      targetCellsAfterCleanse: 0,
      technicalCellsBefore: 0,
      technicalCellsAfterCleanse: 0,
      technicalSpreadsheetId: technicalSs.getId(),

      lastError: ''
    };

    var job = {
      runId: runId,
      sourceMode: 'ACTIVE_SHEET',

      activeSpreadsheetId: activeSs.getId(),
      activeSheetId: activeSh.getSheetId(),
      activeSheetName: activeSh.getName(),
      activeHeaderRow: headerInfo.headerRow,
      activeDataStartRow: headerInfo.dataStartRow,
      activeCursor: headerInfo.dataStartRow,

      technicalSpreadsheetId: technicalSs.getId(),

      phase: 'COLLECT_ACTIVE',
      dbMeta: null,
      dbCursor: 0,
      stageCursor: 2,
      groupCursor: 2,
      finalCursor: 0,

      // Sangat penting: export satu source tidak boleh menghapus row/sheet
      // milik source lain yang tidak ikut dibaca dalam run ini.
      allowStaleCleanup: false,
      stats: stats
    };

    RSC_UR_saveJob_(job);

    try {
      activeSs.toast(
        'Export hanya sheet aktif dimulai. Run ID: ' + runId,
        'Export Active Sheet',
        10
      );
    } catch (ignoreToast2) {}
  } catch (err) {
    try {
      SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
        'Export Active Sheet gagal dimulai:\n\n' + RSC_UR_errorText_(err)
      );
    } catch (ignoreAlert) {}

    throw err;
  } finally {
    try {
      lock.releaseLock();
    } catch (ignoreRelease) {}
  }

  RSC_UR_CONTINUE_20260721();
}


/***************************************************************
 * WORKER
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_UR_CONTINUE_20260721() {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var rawJob = props.getProperty(cfg.jobProperty);

  if (!rawJob) {
    RSC_UR_deleteTriggersByHandler_(cfg.workerHandler);
    return;
  }

  var job;

  try {
    job = JSON.parse(rawJob);
  } catch (parseError) {
    props.deleteProperty(cfg.jobProperty);
    RSC_UR_deleteTriggersByHandler_(cfg.workerHandler);
    throw new Error(
      'Checkpoint Compile Upload Ready rusak. Jalankan Start / Upsert kembali. Detail: ' +
      RSC_UR_errorText_(parseError)
    );
  }

  var lock = LockService.getUserLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(5000)) {
    RSC_UR_scheduleNextRun_(job);
    return;
  }

  var executionStartedAt = Date.now();

  try {
    var targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(cfg.targetSpreadsheetId);
    var technicalSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(job.technicalSpreadsheetId);

    while (Date.now() - executionStartedAt < cfg.softDeadlineMs) {
      if (job.phase === 'COLLECT_ACTIVE') {
        if (!RSC_UR_collectActiveSheetRows_(job, technicalSs, executionStartedAt)) {
          RSC_UR_pauseJob_(job);
          return;
        }

        RSC_UR_dedupeAdminSheet_(
          technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.needsSheetName),
          3
        );

        if (Number(job.stats.collectedSourceRows || 0) <= 0) {
          job.stats.staleCleanupEnabled = false;
          job.stats.staleCleanupBlockedReason =
            'Tidak ada baris valid pada sheet aktif untuk diproses.';
          RSC_UR_finishJob_(job, targetSs, technicalSs);
          return;
        }

        // Active Sheet adalah targeted upsert. Jangan lakukan stale cleanup
        // karena run ini memang tidak memuat source lain.
        job.allowStaleCleanup = false;
        job.stats.staleCleanupEnabled = false;
        job.stats.staleCleanupBlockedReason =
          'Mode ACTIVE_SHEET memakai targeted upsert; global stale purge dinonaktifkan.';

        RSC_UR_prepareDatabaseMeta_(job);
        job.phase = 'DB_SCAN';
        job.stats.phase = job.phase;
        RSC_UR_saveJob_(job);
        continue;
      }

      if (job.phase === 'COLLECT') {
        if (!RSC_UR_collectSourceRows_(job, technicalSs, executionStartedAt)) {
          RSC_UR_pauseJob_(job);
          return;
        }

        RSC_UR_dedupeAdminSheet_(
          technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.needsSheetName),
          3
        );

        var staleCleanupBlockers = [];

        if (!cfg.purgeStaleOnSuccessfulUpsert) {
          staleCleanupBlockers.push('purgeStaleOnSuccessfulUpsert=false');
        }
        if (Number(job.stats.approvedDoneRows || 0) <= 0) {
          staleCleanupBlockers.push('tidak ada master row berstatus DONE');
        }
        if (Number(job.stats.processedFiles || 0) <= 0) {
          staleCleanupBlockers.push('tidak ada source DONE yang berhasil diproses');
        }
        if (Number(job.stats.invalidDoneLinks || 0) > 0) {
          staleCleanupBlockers.push(
            'invalid DONE links=' + Number(job.stats.invalidDoneLinks || 0)
          );
        }
        if (Number(job.stats.missingRekapSalesOffice || 0) > 0) {
          staleCleanupBlockers.push(
            'missing Rekap Sales Office=' +
            Number(job.stats.missingRekapSalesOffice || 0)
          );
        }
        if (Number(job.stats.fileErrors || 0) > 0) {
          staleCleanupBlockers.push(
            'source file errors=' + Number(job.stats.fileErrors || 0)
          );
        }

        job.allowStaleCleanup = staleCleanupBlockers.length === 0;
        job.stats.staleCleanupEnabled = job.allowStaleCleanup;
        job.stats.staleCleanupBlockedReason =
          staleCleanupBlockers.length ? staleCleanupBlockers.join('; ') : '';

        RSC_UR_prepareDatabaseMeta_(job);
        job.phase = 'DB_SCAN';
        job.stats.phase = job.phase;
        RSC_UR_saveJob_(job);
        continue;
      }

      if (job.phase === 'DB_SCAN') {
        if (!RSC_UR_scanSalesCustDatabase_(job, technicalSs, executionStartedAt)) {
          RSC_UR_pauseJob_(job);
          return;
        }

        RSC_UR_dedupeAdminSheet_(
          technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.mapSheetName),
          7
        );

        job.phase = 'DISTRIBUTE';
        job.stats.phase = job.phase;
        job.stageCursor = 2;
        RSC_UR_saveJob_(job);
        continue;
      }

      if (job.phase === 'DISTRIBUTE') {
        if (!RSC_UR_buildQueue_(job, technicalSs, executionStartedAt)) {
          RSC_UR_pauseJob_(job);
          return;
        }

        RSC_UR_prepareGroupedQueue_(technicalSs);

        job.phase = 'UPSERT_GROUPS';
        job.stats.phase = job.phase;
        job.groupCursor = 2;
        RSC_UR_saveJob_(job);
        continue;
      }

      if (job.phase === 'UPSERT_GROUPS') {
        if (!RSC_UR_upsertGroupedQueue_(
          job,
          targetSs,
          technicalSs,
          executionStartedAt
        )) {
          RSC_UR_pauseJob_(job);
          return;
        }

        if (job.sourceMode === 'ACTIVE_SHEET') {
          // Tidak perlu memindai seluruh index untuk obsolete sheet karena
          // mode active memang tidak melakukan global purge/finalize.
          RSC_UR_finishJob_(job, targetSs, technicalSs);
          return;
        }

        job.phase = 'FINALIZE';
        job.stats.phase = job.phase;

        var indexSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.indexSheetName);
        job.finalCursor = indexSh ? indexSh.getLastRow() : 1;

        RSC_UR_saveJob_(job);
        continue;
      }

      if (job.phase === 'FINALIZE') {
        if (!RSC_UR_finalizeManagedSheets_(
          job,
          targetSs,
          technicalSs,
          executionStartedAt
        )) {
          RSC_UR_pauseJob_(job);
          return;
        }

        RSC_UR_finishJob_(job, targetSs, technicalSs);
        return;
      }

      throw new Error('Phase job tidak dikenal: ' + String(job.phase));
    }

    RSC_UR_pauseJob_(job);
  } catch (err) {
    job.stats.lastError = RSC_UR_errorText_(err);
    RSC_UR_saveJob_(job);
    RSC_UR_scheduleNextRun_(job);
    throw err;
  } finally {
    try {
      lock.releaseLock();
    } catch (ignore) {}
  }
}


/***************************************************************
 * PHASE 1 — COLLECT
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_UR_collectActiveSheetRows_(
  job,
  technicalSs,
  executionStartedAt
) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var sourceSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(job.activeSpreadsheetId);
  var sourceSh =
    RSC_UR_getSheetById_(sourceSs, job.activeSheetId) ||
    sourceSs.getSheetByName(job.activeSheetName);

  if (!sourceSh) {
    throw new Error(
      'Sheet aktif sumber tidak ditemukan lagi: ' +
      String(job.activeSheetName || cfg.sourceSheetName)
    );
  }

  var activeNameNormalized = RSC_UR_normalizeHeader_(sourceSh.getName());
  var expectedNameNormalized = RSC_UR_normalizeHeader_(cfg.sourceSheetName);

  if (activeNameNormalized.indexOf(expectedNameNormalized) < 0) {
    throw new Error(
      'Sheet sumber berubah. Wajib memakai "' + cfg.sourceSheetName +
      '", tetapi ditemukan "' + sourceSh.getName() + '".'
    );
  }

  // Selalu baca ulang mapping header. Ini mencegah data bergeser ketika
  // source memakai layout lama yang tidak memiliki kolom Relationship.
  var headerInfo = RSC_UR_findSourceHeader_(sourceSh);
  job.activeHeaderRow = headerInfo.headerRow;
  job.activeDataStartRow = headerInfo.dataStartRow;

  if (!job.activeCursor || job.activeCursor < headerInfo.dataStartRow) {
    job.activeCursor = headerInfo.dataStartRow;
  }

  var highlightStatusMap = RSC_UR_loadChangeRollingBusinessKeyStatusMap_(sourceSs);
  var sourceLastRow = sourceSh.getLastRow();

  if (job.activeCursor > sourceLastRow) {
    if (Number(job.stats.processedFiles || 0) < 1) {
      job.stats.processedFiles = 1;
      RSC_UR_saveJob_(job);
    }
    return true;
  }

  while (
    job.activeCursor <= sourceLastRow &&
    Date.now() - executionStartedAt < cfg.softDeadlineMs
  ) {
    var readRows = Math.min(
      cfg.distributeReadChunkRows,
      sourceLastRow - job.activeCursor + 1
    );

    var sourceRows = sourceSh.getRange(
      job.activeCursor,
      1,
      readRows,
      headerInfo.readWidth
    ).getDisplayValues();

    var stageRows = [];
    var needRows = [];

    for (var i = 0; i < sourceRows.length; i++) {
      var outputRow = RSC_UR_mapSourceRowToOutput_(sourceRows[i], headerInfo.columnMap);
      var templateSalesOffice = RSC_UR_extractCode_(outputRow[0]);
      var customerId = String(outputRow[2] || '').trim();

      if (!templateSalesOffice) {
        if (RSC_UR_rowHasAnyValue_(outputRow)) {
          job.stats.activeRowsWithoutSalesOffice =
            Number(job.stats.activeRowsWithoutSalesOffice || 0) + 1;
        }
        continue;
      }

      if (!customerId) {
        continue;
      }

      outputRow[0] = templateSalesOffice;

      var rekapSalesOffice = templateSalesOffice;
      var lookupInfo = RSC_UR_resolveDbLookupSalesOffice_(
        outputRow,
        rekapSalesOffice
      );

      if (!lookupInfo.salesOffice) {
        continue;
      }

      if (lookupInfo.isChangeSalesOffice) {
        job.stats.changeSalesOfficeRows++;
      }

      var dbJoinKey = RSC_UR_makeJoinKey_(
        customerId,
        lookupInfo.salesOffice
      );
      var routeKey = RSC_UR_makeRouteKey_(
        dbJoinKey,
        rekapSalesOffice
      );
      var rowKey = RSC_UR_makeBusinessRowKey_(outputRow);
      var highlightHint = String(highlightStatusMap[rowKey] || '');
      var sourceRowNumber = job.activeCursor + i;

      if (highlightHint === cfg.highlightAdditionText) {
        job.stats.additionalSourceRows =
          Number(job.stats.additionalSourceRows || 0) + 1;
      } else if (highlightHint === cfg.highlightChangeText) {
        job.stats.changedSourceRows =
          Number(job.stats.changedSourceRows || 0) + 1;
      }

      stageRows.push([
        routeKey,
        dbJoinKey,
        rekapSalesOffice,
        rowKey,
        sourceSs.getId(),
        'ACTIVE',
        String(sourceRowNumber),
        highlightHint
      ].concat(outputRow));

      needRows.push([
        routeKey,
        dbJoinKey,
        rekapSalesOffice
      ]);
    }

    RSC_UR_appendRows_(
      technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stageSheetName),
      stageRows
    );

    RSC_UR_appendRows_(
      technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.needsSheetName),
      needRows
    );

    job.stats.collectedSourceRows += stageRows.length;
    job.activeCursor += sourceRows.length;
    RSC_UR_saveJob_(job);
  }

  if (job.activeCursor > sourceLastRow) {
    job.stats.processedFiles = 1;
    RSC_UR_saveJob_(job);
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}


function RSC_UR_collectSourceRows_(job, technicalSs, executionStartedAt) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var masterSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(job.masterSpreadsheetId);
  var masterSh =
    RSC_UR_getSheetById_(masterSs, job.masterSheetId) ||
    masterSs.getSheetByName(cfg.masterSheetName);

  if (!masterSh) {
    throw new Error('Sheet master tidak ditemukan lagi: ' + cfg.masterSheetName);
  }

  var lastRow = masterSh.getLastRow();
  var processedFilesThisExecution = 0;

  while (
    job.masterCursor <= lastRow &&
    processedFilesThisExecution < cfg.maxSourceFilesPerExecution &&
    Date.now() - executionStartedAt < cfg.softDeadlineMs
  ) {
    var masterRow = job.masterCursor;
    var statusText = String(
      masterSh.getRange(masterRow, cfg.masterStatusCol).getDisplayValue() || ''
    ).trim().toUpperCase();

    if (statusText !== cfg.doneText) {
      job.stats.skippedMasterRows++;
      job.masterCursor++;
      continue;
    }

    job.stats.approvedDoneRows++;

    var rekapSalesOffice = RSC_UR_extractCode_(
      masterSh.getRange(masterRow, cfg.masterSalesOfficeCol).getDisplayValue()
    );

    if (!rekapSalesOffice) {
      job.stats.missingRekapSalesOffice++;
      job.stats.skippedMasterRows++;
      job.stats.lastError =
        'Master row ' + masterRow + ': Sales Office Rekap Approved kolom A kosong.';
      job.masterCursor++;
      continue;
    }

    var sourceSpreadsheetId = RSC_UR_getSpreadsheetIdFromCell_(
      masterSh.getRange(masterRow, cfg.masterLinkCol)
    );

    if (!sourceSpreadsheetId) {
      job.stats.invalidDoneLinks++;
      job.stats.skippedMasterRows++;
      job.masterCursor++;
      continue;
    }

    try {
      var sourceSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(sourceSpreadsheetId);
      var sourceSh = RSC_UR_findSourceSheet_(sourceSs);

      if (!sourceSh) {
        throw new Error('Sheet "' + cfg.sourceSheetName + '" tidak ditemukan.');
      }

      var headerInfo = RSC_UR_findSourceHeader_(sourceSh);
      var highlightStatusMap = RSC_UR_loadChangeRollingBusinessKeyStatusMap_(sourceSs);

      var sourceLastRow = sourceSh.getLastRow();
      var stageRows = [];
      var needRows = [];

      if (sourceLastRow >= headerInfo.dataStartRow) {
        var sourceRows = sourceSh.getRange(
          headerInfo.dataStartRow,
          1,
          sourceLastRow - headerInfo.dataStartRow + 1,
          headerInfo.readWidth
        ).getDisplayValues();

        for (var i = 0; i < sourceRows.length; i++) {
          var outputRow = RSC_UR_mapSourceRowToOutput_(sourceRows[i], headerInfo.columnMap);
          var templateSalesOffice = RSC_UR_extractCode_(outputRow[0]);
          var customerId = String(outputRow[2] || '').trim();

          if (!templateSalesOffice || !customerId) {
            continue;
          }

          outputRow[0] = templateSalesOffice;

          var lookupInfo = RSC_UR_resolveDbLookupSalesOffice_(
            outputRow,
            rekapSalesOffice
          );

          if (!lookupInfo.salesOffice) {
            continue;
          }

          if (lookupInfo.isChangeSalesOffice) {
            job.stats.changeSalesOfficeRows++;
          }

          var dbJoinKey = RSC_UR_makeJoinKey_(
            customerId,
            lookupInfo.salesOffice
          );
          var routeKey = RSC_UR_makeRouteKey_(dbJoinKey, rekapSalesOffice);
          var rowKey = RSC_UR_makeBusinessRowKey_(outputRow);
          var highlightHint = String(highlightStatusMap[rowKey] || '');

          if (highlightHint === cfg.highlightAdditionText) {
            job.stats.additionalSourceRows =
              Number(job.stats.additionalSourceRows || 0) + 1;
          } else if (highlightHint === cfg.highlightChangeText) {
            job.stats.changedSourceRows =
              Number(job.stats.changedSourceRows || 0) + 1;
          }

          stageRows.push([
            routeKey,
            dbJoinKey,
            rekapSalesOffice,
            rowKey,
            sourceSpreadsheetId,
            String(masterRow),
            String(i + headerInfo.dataStartRow),
            highlightHint
          ].concat(outputRow));

          needRows.push([
            routeKey,
            dbJoinKey,
            rekapSalesOffice
          ]);
        }
      }

      RSC_UR_appendRows_(
        technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stageSheetName),
        stageRows
      );

      RSC_UR_appendRows_(
        technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.needsSheetName),
        needRows
      );

      job.stats.collectedSourceRows += stageRows.length;
      job.stats.processedFiles++;
      processedFilesThisExecution++;
    } catch (fileErr) {
      job.stats.fileErrors++;
      job.stats.lastError =
        'Master row ' + masterRow + ': ' + RSC_UR_errorText_(fileErr);
      processedFilesThisExecution++;
    }

    job.masterCursor++;
    RSC_UR_saveJob_(job);
  }

  return job.masterCursor > lastRow;
}


/***************************************************************
 * PHASE 2 — DATABASE SCAN
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_UR_prepareDatabaseMeta_(job) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var dbSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(cfg.salesCustDbSpreadsheetId);
  var dbSh = dbSs.getSheetByName(cfg.salesCustDbSheetName);

  if (!dbSh) {
    throw new Error('Sheet database tidak ditemukan: ' + cfg.salesCustDbSheetName);
  }

  var lastRow = dbSh.getLastRow();
  var lastCol = dbSh.getLastColumn();

  if (lastRow < 1 || lastCol < 1) {
    throw new Error('Database ' + cfg.salesCustDbSheetName + ' kosong.');
  }

  var headerGrid = dbSh.getRange(
    1,
    1,
    Math.min(10, lastRow),
    lastCol
  ).getDisplayValues();

  var headerRow = 0;
  var cols = null;

  for (var r = 0; r < headerGrid.length; r++) {
    var found = {
      bpId: RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(headerGrid[r], ['bp_id']),
      salesOrg: RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(headerGrid[r], ['sls_org', 'sales_org']),
      distChannel: RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(
        headerGrid[r],
        ['dist_channel', 'distribution_channel']
      ),
      division: RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(headerGrid[r], ['division']),
      salesOffice: RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(
        headerGrid[r],
        ['sls_office', 'sales_office']
      )
    };

    if (
      found.bpId >= 0 &&
      found.salesOrg >= 0 &&
      found.distChannel >= 0 &&
      found.division >= 0 &&
      found.salesOffice >= 0
    ) {
      headerRow = r + 1;
      cols = found;
      break;
    }
  }

  if (!headerRow) {
    throw new Error(
      'Header DB tidak lengkap. Wajib ada bp_id, sls_org, dist_channel, division, dan sls_office.'
    );
  }

  var absoluteIndexes = [
    cols.bpId,
    cols.salesOrg,
    cols.distChannel,
    cols.division,
    cols.salesOffice
  ];

  var minZeroBased = Math.min.apply(null, absoluteIndexes);
  var maxZeroBased = Math.max.apply(null, absoluteIndexes);

  job.dbMeta = {
    sheetId: dbSh.getSheetId(),
    lastRow: lastRow,
    minCol: minZeroBased + 1,
    width: maxZeroBased - minZeroBased + 1,
    bpId: cols.bpId - minZeroBased,
    salesOrg: cols.salesOrg - minZeroBased,
    distChannel: cols.distChannel - minZeroBased,
    division: cols.division - minZeroBased,
    salesOffice: cols.salesOffice - minZeroBased
  };

  job.dbCursor = headerRow + 1;
}


function RSC_UR_scanSalesCustDatabase_(job, technicalSs, executionStartedAt) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var requiredRoutesByDbJoinKey = RSC_UR_loadNeededRoutes_(technicalSs);

  var dbSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(cfg.salesCustDbSpreadsheetId);
  var dbSh =
    RSC_UR_getSheetById_(dbSs, job.dbMeta.sheetId) ||
    dbSs.getSheetByName(cfg.salesCustDbSheetName);

  if (!dbSh) {
    throw new Error('Database sheet tidak ditemukan saat continue.');
  }

  while (
    job.dbCursor <= job.dbMeta.lastRow &&
    Date.now() - executionStartedAt < cfg.softDeadlineMs
  ) {
    var readRows = Math.min(
      cfg.dbReadChunkRows,
      job.dbMeta.lastRow - job.dbCursor + 1
    );

    var rows = dbSh.getRange(
      job.dbCursor,
      job.dbMeta.minCol,
      readRows,
      job.dbMeta.width
    ).getDisplayValues();

    var mapRows = [];

    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      var customerId = String(rows[i][job.dbMeta.bpId] || '').trim();
      var dbSalesOffice = RSC_UR_extractCode_(rows[i][job.dbMeta.salesOffice]);

      if (!customerId || !dbSalesOffice) {
        continue;
      }

      var dbJoinKey = RSC_UR_makeJoinKey_(customerId, dbSalesOffice);
      var requiredRoutes = requiredRoutesByDbJoinKey[dbJoinKey];

      if (!requiredRoutes || !requiredRoutes.length) {
        continue;
      }

      var salesOrg = String(rows[i][job.dbMeta.salesOrg] || '').trim();
      var distChannel = String(rows[i][job.dbMeta.distChannel] || '').trim();
      var division = String(rows[i][job.dbMeta.division] || '').trim();

      if (!salesOrg || !distChannel || !division) {
        continue;
      }

      for (var x = 0; x < requiredRoutes.length; x++) {
        var route = requiredRoutes[x];
        var groupKey = RSC_UR_makeGroupKey_(
          salesOrg,
          distChannel,
          division,
          route.rekapSalesOffice
        );

        mapRows.push([
          route.routeKey,
          groupKey,
          salesOrg,
          distChannel,
          division,
          route.rekapSalesOffice,
          dbSalesOffice
        ]);
      }
    }

    RSC_UR_appendRows_(
      technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.mapSheetName),
      mapRows
    );

    job.stats.dbMatches += mapRows.length;
    job.stats.dbRowsScanned += rows.length;
    job.dbCursor += rows.length;
    RSC_UR_saveJob_(job);
  }

  return job.dbCursor > job.dbMeta.lastRow;
}


/***************************************************************
 * PHASE 3 — BUILD EXTERNAL QUEUE
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_UR_buildQueue_(job, technicalSs, executionStartedAt) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var stageSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stageSheetName);
  var queueSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.queueSheetName);

  if (!stageSh || !queueSh) {
    throw new Error('Stage/queue sheet teknis tidak ditemukan.');
  }

  var stageLastRow = stageSh.getLastRow();

  if (job.stageCursor > stageLastRow) {
    return true;
  }

  var routeToGroups = RSC_UR_loadDatabaseGroupMap_(technicalSs);

  while (
    job.stageCursor <= stageLastRow &&
    Date.now() - executionStartedAt < cfg.softDeadlineMs
  ) {
    var readRows = Math.min(
      cfg.distributeReadChunkRows,
      stageLastRow - job.stageCursor + 1
    );

    var stageRows = stageSh.getRange(
      job.stageCursor,
      1,
      readRows,
      8 + cfg.sourceColumnCount
    ).getDisplayValues();

    var queueRows = [];

    for (var i = 0; i < stageRows.length; i++) {
      var routeKey = String(stageRows[i][0] || '').trim();
      var storedRowKey = String(stageRows[i][3] || '').trim();
      var highlightHint = String(stageRows[i][7] || '').trim();
      var outputRow = stageRows[i].slice(8, 8 + cfg.sourceColumnCount);
      var groups = routeToGroups[routeKey];

      if (!groups || !groups.length) {
        job.stats.unmatchedRows++;
        continue;
      }

      var rowKey = storedRowKey || RSC_UR_makeBusinessRowKey_(outputRow);

      for (var g = 0; g < groups.length; g++) {
        var meta = groups[g];

        queueRows.push([
          meta.groupKey,
          rowKey,
          meta.salesOrg,
          meta.distChannel,
          meta.division,
          meta.salesOffice,
          highlightHint
        ].concat(outputRow));
      }
    }

    RSC_UR_appendRows_(queueSh, queueRows);
    job.stats.distributedRows += queueRows.length;
    job.stageCursor += stageRows.length;
    RSC_UR_saveJob_(job);
  }

  return job.stageCursor > stageLastRow;
}


function RSC_UR_prepareGroupedQueue_(technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var queueSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.queueSheetName);
  var groupsSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.groupsSheetName);

  if (!queueSh || !groupsSh) {
    throw new Error('Queue/groups sheet teknis tidak ditemukan.');
  }

  RSC_UR_clearDataRows_(groupsSh, 1, 7);

  var lastRow = queueSh.getLastRow();

  if (lastRow < 2) {
    return;
  }

  // Sort sekali. Setelah itu setiap group dibaca dan ditulis hanya satu kali.
  queueSh.getRange(
    2,
    1,
    lastRow - 1,
    7 + cfg.sourceColumnCount
  ).sort([{column: 1, ascending: true}]);

  var metaRows = queueSh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, 6).getDisplayValues();
  var groupedRows = [];
  var currentGroup = '';
  var groupStart = 2;
  var groupCount = 0;
  var currentMeta = null;

  for (var i = 0; i < metaRows.length; i++) {
    var groupKey = String(metaRows[i][0] || '').trim();

    if (!groupKey) {
      continue;
    }

    if (currentGroup && groupKey !== currentGroup) {
      groupedRows.push([
        currentGroup,
        groupStart,
        groupCount,
        currentMeta[2],
        currentMeta[3],
        currentMeta[4],
        currentMeta[5]
      ]);

      groupStart = i + 2;
      groupCount = 0;
    }

    if (groupKey !== currentGroup) {
      currentGroup = groupKey;
      currentMeta = metaRows[i];
    }

    groupCount++;
  }

  if (currentGroup) {
    groupedRows.push([
      currentGroup,
      groupStart,
      groupCount,
      currentMeta[2],
      currentMeta[3],
      currentMeta[4],
      currentMeta[5]
    ]);
  }

  RSC_UR_appendRows_(groupsSh, groupedRows);
}


/***************************************************************
 * PHASE 4 — UPSERT PER GROUP
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_UR_upsertGroupedQueue_(
  job,
  targetSs,
  technicalSs,
  executionStartedAt
) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var groupsSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.groupsSheetName);
  var queueSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.queueSheetName);

  if (!groupsSh || !queueSh) {
    throw new Error('Queue/groups sheet teknis tidak ditemukan saat UPSERT.');
  }

  var lastGroupRow = groupsSh.getLastRow();

  if (job.groupCursor > lastGroupRow) {
    return true;
  }

  var indexMap = RSC_UR_loadOutputIndexMap_(technicalSs);
  var batchSize = Math.min(
    cfg.maxUpsertGroupsPerExecution,
    lastGroupRow - job.groupCursor + 1
  );
  var groupRows = groupsSh.getRange(
    job.groupCursor,
    1,
    batchSize,
    7
  ).getDisplayValues();
  var processed = 0;

  while (
    processed < groupRows.length &&
    Date.now() - executionStartedAt < cfg.softDeadlineMs
  ) {
    var groupRow = groupRows[processed];
    var groupMeta = {
      groupKey: String(groupRow[0] || '').trim(),
      startRow: Number(groupRow[1] || 0),
      rowCount: Number(groupRow[2] || 0),
      salesOrg: String(groupRow[3] || '').trim(),
      distChannel: String(groupRow[4] || '').trim(),
      division: String(groupRow[5] || '').trim(),
      salesOffice: String(groupRow[6] || '').trim()
    };

    if (!groupMeta.groupKey || groupMeta.startRow < 2 || groupMeta.rowCount < 1) {
      job.groupCursor++;
      processed++;
      continue;
    }

    var queued = queueSh.getRange(
      groupMeta.startRow,
      1,
      groupMeta.rowCount,
      7 + cfg.sourceColumnCount
    ).getDisplayValues();

    var rowByKey = {};
    var keyOrder = [];

    for (var i = 0; i < queued.length; i++) {
      var rowKey = String(queued[i][1] || '').trim();
      var highlightHint = RSC_UR_normalizeHighlightType_(queued[i][6]);
      var visibleRow = RSC_UR_normalizeOutputRow_(
        queued[i].slice(7, 7 + cfg.sourceColumnCount)
      );

      visibleRow[0] = groupMeta.salesOffice;
      visibleRow[1] = groupMeta.salesOffice;

      if (!rowKey) {
        rowKey = RSC_UR_makeBusinessRowKey_(visibleRow);
      }

      if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rowByKey, rowKey)) {
        job.stats.duplicateSourceKeysCollapsed++;
      } else {
        keyOrder.push(rowKey);
      }

      var previousRow = rowByKey[rowKey];
      rowByKey[rowKey] = {
        values: visibleRow,
        highlightHint: RSC_UR_strongerHighlightType_(
          previousRow ? previousRow.highlightHint : '',
          highlightHint
        )
      };
    }

    var incomingRows = [];

    for (var x = 0; x < keyOrder.length; x++) {
      incomingRows.push({
        rowKey: keyOrder[x],
        values: rowByKey[keyOrder[x]].values,
        highlightHint: rowByKey[keyOrder[x]].highlightHint
      });
    }

    var outputInfo = RSC_UR_getOrCreateOutputStorage_(
      targetSs,
      technicalSs,
      job,
      groupMeta,
      indexMap
    );

    var upsertStats = RSC_UR_upsertOneGroup_(
      outputInfo.outputSheet,
      outputInfo.keySheet,
      incomingRows,
      job.runId,
      job.allowStaleCleanup
    );

    RSC_UR_markIndexRun_(
      technicalSs,
      outputInfo.indexRow,
      job.runId
    );

    RSC_UR_formatOutputSheet_(outputInfo.outputSheet);

    job.stats.insertedRows += upsertStats.inserted;
    job.stats.updatedRows += upsertStats.updated;
    job.stats.unchangedRows += upsertStats.unchanged;
    job.stats.removedStaleRows += upsertStats.staleRemoved;
    job.stats.removedDuplicateRows += upsertStats.duplicatesRemoved;
    job.stats.optimizedOutputWriteSkips =
      Number(job.stats.optimizedOutputWriteSkips || 0) +
      (upsertStats.outputWriteSkipped ? 1 : 0);
    job.stats.keyOnlyRefreshes =
      Number(job.stats.keyOnlyRefreshes || 0) +
      (upsertStats.keyOnlyRefresh ? 1 : 0);
    job.stats.additionRowsHighlighted =
      Number(job.stats.additionRowsHighlighted || 0) +
      Number(upsertStats.additionHighlightedRows || 0);
    job.stats.changedRowsHighlighted =
      Number(job.stats.changedRowsHighlighted || 0) +
      Number(upsertStats.changeHighlightedRows || 0);
    job.stats.highlightChanges =
      Number(job.stats.highlightChanges || 0) +
      Number(upsertStats.highlightChanges || 0);

    if (job.sourceMode === 'ACTIVE_SHEET') {
      job.stats.activeOutputGroupsProcessed =
        Number(job.stats.activeOutputGroupsProcessed || 0) + 1;
      job.stats.activeOutputRowsAfterUpsert =
        Number(job.stats.activeOutputRowsAfterUpsert || 0) +
        Number(upsertStats.finalRows || 0);
    }

    job.groupCursor++;
    processed++;
    RSC_UR_saveJob_(job);
  }

  return job.groupCursor > lastGroupRow;
}

function RSC_UR_upsertOneGroup_(
  outputSh,
  keySh,
  incomingRows,
  runId,
  allowStaleCleanup
) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;

  RSC_UR_ensureOutputSheetStructure_(outputSh);
  // Perbaiki dahulu output lama yang terlanjur kehilangan kolom Relationship.
  // Setelah itu key storage akan otomatis direkonsiliasi oleh proses upsert.
  RSC_UR_repairShiftedOutputRows_(outputSh);
  RSC_UR_ensureKeySheetStructure_(keySh);

  var outputCount = Math.max(0, outputSh.getLastRow() - cfg.outputHeaderRow);
  var keyCount = Math.max(0, keySh.getLastRow() - 1);
  var existingCount = Math.max(outputCount, keyCount);

  if (existingCount > 0) {
    RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(
      outputSh,
      existingCount + cfg.outputHeaderRow,
      cfg.sourceColumnCount
    );
    RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(keySh, existingCount + 1, 2);
  }

  var visibleRows = existingCount > 0
    ? outputSh.getRange(
        cfg.outputDataStartRow,
        1,
        existingCount,
        cfg.sourceColumnCount
      ).getDisplayValues()
    : [];

  var keyRows = existingCount > 0
    ? keySh.getRange(2, 1, existingCount, 2).getDisplayValues()
    : [];

  var backgroundRows = existingCount > 0
    ? outputSh.getRange(
        cfg.outputDataStartRow,
        1,
        existingCount,
        cfg.sourceColumnCount
      ).getBackgrounds()
    : [];

  var existingRecords = [];
  var existingIndexByKey = {};
  var duplicatesRemoved = 0;
  var keyStorageChanged = outputCount !== keyCount;

  for (var i = 0; i < existingCount; i++) {
    var visibleRow = RSC_UR_normalizeOutputRow_(visibleRows[i] || []);

    if (!RSC_UR_rowHasAnyValue_(visibleRow)) {
      keyStorageChanged = true;
      continue;
    }

    var storedKey = String((keyRows[i] && keyRows[i][0]) || '').trim();
    var existingRunId = String((keyRows[i] && keyRows[i][1]) || '').trim();
    var existingKey = RSC_UR_makeBusinessRowKey_(visibleRow);

    if (storedKey !== existingKey) {
      keyStorageChanged = true;
    }

    var existingRecord = {
      key: existingKey,
      runId: existingRunId,
      values: visibleRow,
      highlightType: RSC_UR_detectHighlightTypeFromBackground_(
        backgroundRows[i] || []
      )
    };

    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(existingIndexByKey, existingKey)) {
      existingRecords[existingIndexByKey[existingKey]] = existingRecord;
      duplicatesRemoved++;
      keyStorageChanged = true;
    } else {
      existingIndexByKey[existingKey] = existingRecords.length;
      existingRecords.push(existingRecord);
    }
  }

  var incomingByKey = {};
  var incomingKeyOrder = [];

  for (var r = 0; r < incomingRows.length; r++) {
    var incomingVisible = RSC_UR_normalizeOutputRow_(incomingRows[r].values);
    var incomingKey = RSC_UR_makeBusinessRowKey_(incomingVisible);

    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(incomingByKey, incomingKey)) {
      incomingKeyOrder.push(incomingKey);
    }

    incomingByKey[incomingKey] = {
      key: incomingKey,
      runId: runId,
      values: incomingVisible,
      highlightHint: RSC_UR_normalizeHighlightType_(incomingRows[r].highlightHint),
      highlightType: ''
    };
  }

  var inserted = 0;
  var updated = 0;
  var unchanged = 0;
  var highlightChanges = 0;

  for (var x = 0; x < incomingKeyOrder.length; x++) {
    var compareKey = incomingKeyOrder[x];
    var incomingRecord = incomingByKey[compareKey];
    var oldRecord = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(existingIndexByKey, compareKey)
      ? existingRecords[existingIndexByKey[compareKey]]
      : null;

    if (!oldRecord) {
      inserted++;
      incomingRecord.highlightType = cfg.highlightAdditionText;
    } else {
      var rowChanged = !RSC_UR_rowsEqual_(oldRecord.values, incomingRecord.values);

      if (rowChanged) {
        updated++;
      } else {
        unchanged++;
      }

      if (incomingRecord.highlightHint === cfg.highlightAdditionText) {
        incomingRecord.highlightType = cfg.highlightAdditionText;
      } else if (
        incomingRecord.highlightHint === cfg.highlightChangeText ||
        rowChanged
      ) {
        incomingRecord.highlightType = cfg.highlightChangeText;
      } else {
        incomingRecord.highlightType = '';
      }

      if (
        RSC_UR_normalizeHighlightType_(oldRecord.highlightType) !==
        RSC_UR_normalizeHighlightType_(incomingRecord.highlightType)
      ) {
        highlightChanges++;
      }
    }
  }

  var finalRecords = [];
  var includedIncomingKeys = {};
  var staleRemoved = 0;

  if (allowStaleCleanup) {
    for (var n = 0; n < existingRecords.length; n++) {
      var oldKey = existingRecords[n].key;

      if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(incomingByKey, oldKey)) {
        finalRecords.push(incomingByKey[oldKey]);
        includedIncomingKeys[oldKey] = true;
      } else {
        staleRemoved++;
      }
    }

    for (var a = 0; a < incomingKeyOrder.length; a++) {
      var appendKey = incomingKeyOrder[a];

      if (!includedIncomingKeys[appendKey]) {
        finalRecords.push(incomingByKey[appendKey]);
        includedIncomingKeys[appendKey] = true;
      }
    }
  } else {
    for (var e = 0; e < existingRecords.length; e++) {
      var retained = existingRecords[e];

      if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(incomingByKey, retained.key)) {
        finalRecords.push(incomingByKey[retained.key]);
        includedIncomingKeys[retained.key] = true;
      } else {
        finalRecords.push(retained);
      }
    }

    for (var b = 0; b < incomingKeyOrder.length; b++) {
      var newKey = incomingKeyOrder[b];

      if (!includedIncomingKeys[newKey] &&
          !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(existingIndexByKey, newKey)) {
        finalRecords.push(incomingByKey[newKey]);
        includedIncomingKeys[newKey] = true;
      }
    }
  }

  var outputNeedsRewrite = Boolean(
    inserted > 0 ||
    updated > 0 ||
    highlightChanges > 0 ||
    staleRemoved > 0 ||
    duplicatesRemoved > 0 ||
    existingRecords.length !== existingCount ||
    outputCount !== finalRecords.length
  );

  var keyOnlyRefresh = false;
  var outputWriteSkipped = false;

  if (outputNeedsRewrite) {
    RSC_UR_rewriteGroupStorage_(outputSh, keySh, finalRecords);
  } else {
    RSC_UR_refreshKeyStorage_(keySh, finalRecords);
    keyOnlyRefresh = true;
    outputWriteSkipped = true;
  }

  var additionHighlightedRows = 0;
  var changeHighlightedRows = 0;

  for (var h = 0; h < finalRecords.length; h++) {
    var finalType = RSC_UR_normalizeHighlightType_(finalRecords[h].highlightType);

    if (finalType === cfg.highlightAdditionText) {
      additionHighlightedRows++;
    } else if (finalType === cfg.highlightChangeText) {
      changeHighlightedRows++;
    }
  }

  return {
    inserted: inserted,
    updated: updated,
    unchanged: unchanged,
    staleRemoved: staleRemoved,
    duplicatesRemoved: duplicatesRemoved,
    finalRows: finalRecords.length,
    keyStorageChanged: keyStorageChanged,
    highlightChanges: highlightChanges,
    additionHighlightedRows: additionHighlightedRows,
    changeHighlightedRows: changeHighlightedRows,
    keyOnlyRefresh: keyOnlyRefresh,
    outputWriteSkipped: outputWriteSkipped
  };
}

function RSC_UR_refreshKeyStorage_(keySh, records) {
  var technicalRows = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < records.length; i++) {
    technicalRows.push([records[i].key, records[i].runId]);
  }

  var oldKeyRows = Math.max(0, keySh.getLastRow() - 1);
  var newRows = technicalRows.length;

  RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(
    keySh,
    Math.max(2, newRows + 1),
    2
  );

  if (newRows > 0) {
    keySh.getRange(2, 1, newRows, 2)
      .setNumberFormat('@')
      .setValues(technicalRows);
  }

  if (oldKeyRows > newRows) {
    keySh.getRange(newRows + 2, 1, oldKeyRows - newRows, 2).clearContent();
  }

  RSC_UR_trimSheetGrid_(
    keySh,
    Math.max(2, newRows + 1),
    2
  );
}


function RSC_UR_rewriteGroupStorage_(outputSh, keySh, records) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var outputRows = [];
  var outputBackgrounds = [];
  var technicalRows = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < records.length; i++) {
    outputRows.push(records[i].values);

    var rowBackground = RSC_UR_getBackgroundForHighlightType_(
      records[i].highlightType
    );
    var backgroundRow = [];

    for (var c = 0; c < cfg.sourceColumnCount; c++) {
      backgroundRow.push(rowBackground);
    }

    outputBackgrounds.push(backgroundRow);
    technicalRows.push([records[i].key, records[i].runId]);
  }

  var oldOutputRows = Math.max(0, outputSh.getLastRow() - cfg.outputHeaderRow);
  var oldKeyRows = Math.max(0, keySh.getLastRow() - 1);
  var newRows = records.length;

  RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(
    outputSh,
    Math.max(cfg.outputDataStartRow, newRows + cfg.outputHeaderRow),
    cfg.sourceColumnCount
  );

  RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(
    keySh,
    Math.max(2, newRows + 1),
    2
  );

  var outputClearRows = Math.max(oldOutputRows, newRows, 1);
  var keyClearRows = Math.max(oldKeyRows, newRows, 1);

  outputSh.getRange(
    cfg.outputDataStartRow,
    1,
    outputClearRows,
    cfg.sourceColumnCount
  )
    .clearContent()
    .setBackground(cfg.defaultOutputRowBackground);

  keySh.getRange(2, 1, keyClearRows, 2).clearContent();

  if (newRows > 0) {
    outputSh.getRange(cfg.outputDataStartRow, 1, newRows, cfg.sourceColumnCount)
      .setNumberFormat('@')
      .setValues(outputRows)
      .setBackgrounds(outputBackgrounds);

    keySh.getRange(2, 1, newRows, 2)
      .setNumberFormat('@')
      .setValues(technicalRows);
  }

  RSC_UR_trimSheetGrid_(
    outputSh,
    Math.max(cfg.outputDataStartRow, newRows + cfg.outputHeaderRow),
    cfg.sourceColumnCount
  );

  RSC_UR_trimSheetGrid_(
    keySh,
    Math.max(2, newRows + 1),
    2
  );
}


/***************************************************************
 * PHASE 5 — FINALIZE
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_UR_finalizeManagedSheets_(
  job,
  targetSs,
  technicalSs,
  executionStartedAt
) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var indexSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.indexSheetName);

  if (!indexSh || indexSh.getLastRow() < 2) {
    return true;
  }

  if (job.finalCursor < 2) {
    return true;
  }

  var batchSize = Math.min(
    cfg.maxFinalizeSheetsPerExecution,
    job.finalCursor - 1
  );
  var batchStartRow = job.finalCursor - batchSize + 1;
  var rows = indexSh.getRange(
    batchStartRow,
    1,
    batchSize,
