    8
  ).getDisplayValues();
  var processed = 0;

  while (
    processed < rows.length &&
    Date.now() - executionStartedAt < cfg.softDeadlineMs
  ) {
    var row = rows[rows.length - 1 - processed];
    var currentIndexRow = job.finalCursor;
    var outputName = String(row[1] || '').trim();
    var keyName = String(row[2] || '').trim();
    var lastRunId = String(row[3] || '').trim();

    if (lastRunId !== job.runId && job.allowStaleCleanup) {
      var outputSh = outputName ? targetSs.getSheetByName(outputName) : null;
      var keySh = keyName ? technicalSs.getSheetByName(keyName) : null;

      if (outputSh) {
        targetSs.deleteSheet(outputSh);
        job.stats.deletedObsoleteSheets++;
      }

      if (keySh) {
        technicalSs.deleteSheet(keySh);
      }

      indexSh.deleteRow(currentIndexRow);
    }

    job.finalCursor--;
    processed++;
    RSC_UR_saveJob_(job);
  }

  return job.finalCursor < 2;
}

function RSC_UR_getOrCreateOutputStorage_(
  targetSs,
  technicalSs,
  job,
  groupMeta,
  indexMap
) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var indexSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.indexSheetName);

  if (!indexSh) {
    throw new Error('Index teknis tidak ditemukan: ' + cfg.indexSheetName);
  }

  var canonicalName = RSC_UR_safeSheetName_(groupMeta.groupKey);
  var existing = indexMap[groupMeta.groupKey];
  var outputSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(canonicalName);
  var keySh = null;
  var indexRow = existing ? existing.indexRow : 0;

  if (!outputSh && existing && existing.outputSheetName) {
    var indexedOutput = targetSs.getSheetByName(existing.outputSheetName);

    if (indexedOutput) {
      var collision = targetSs.getSheetByName(canonicalName);

      if (!collision) {
        indexedOutput.setName(canonicalName);
        outputSh = indexedOutput;
      } else {
        outputSh = collision;
      }
    }
  }

  // Sangat penting: jika sheet canonical sudah ada, selalu join ke sana.
  // Jangan pernah membuat nama group + " 2" atau "(2)".
  if (!outputSh) {
    outputSh = RSC_UR_createOutputSheet_(targetSs, canonicalName);
  }

  RSC_UR_ensureOutputSheetStructure_(outputSh);
  RSC_UR_repairShiftedOutputRows_(outputSh);

  if (existing && existing.keySheetName) {
    keySh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(existing.keySheetName);
  }

  if (!keySh) {
    keySh = RSC_UR_createKeySheet_(technicalSs);
    RSC_UR_seedKeySheetFromOutput_(outputSh, keySh);
  }

  if (!indexRow) {
    indexRow = indexSh.getLastRow() + 1;
  }

  indexSh.getRange(indexRow, 1, 1, 8).setValues([[
    groupMeta.groupKey,
    canonicalName,
    keySh.getName(),
    job.runId,
    groupMeta.salesOrg,
    groupMeta.distChannel,
    groupMeta.division,
    groupMeta.salesOffice
  ]]);

  RSC_UR_ensureOutputSheetStructure_(outputSh);
  RSC_UR_ensureKeySheetStructure_(keySh);

  indexMap[groupMeta.groupKey] = {
    outputSheetName: canonicalName,
    keySheetName: keySh.getName(),
    indexRow: indexRow
  };

  return {
    outputSheet: outputSh,
    keySheet: keySh,
    indexRow: indexRow,
    created: !existing
  };
}



function RSC_UR_REPAIR_SHIFTED_OUTPUTS_20260724() {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var lock = LockService.getUserLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(10000)) {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
      'Repair kolom belum dijalankan karena proses lain sedang aktif.'
    );
    return;
  }

  try {
    var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
    var targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(cfg.targetSpreadsheetId);
    var technicalSs = RSC_UR_getOrCreateTechnicalSpreadsheet_(props);
    var stats = RSC_UR_repairAllManagedOutputShifts_(targetSs, technicalSs);

    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
      'Repair shifted output selesai.\n\n' +
      'Sheet diperiksa: ' + stats.sheetsChecked + '\n' +
      'Sheet diperbaiki: ' + stats.sheetsRepaired + '\n' +
      'Baris diperbaiki: ' + stats.rowsRepaired + '\n' +
      'Key storage dibangun ulang: ' + stats.keySheetsRebuilt
    );
  } finally {
    try {
      lock.releaseLock();
    } catch (ignoreLock) {}
  }
}


function RSC_UR_repairAllManagedOutputShifts_(targetSs, technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var stats = {
    sheetsChecked: 0,
    sheetsRepaired: 0,
    rowsRepaired: 0,
    keySheetsRebuilt: 0
  };
  var indexSh = RSC_UR_ensureTechnicalIndex_(technicalSs);

  if (indexSh.getLastRow() < 2) {
    return stats;
  }

  var indexRows = indexSh.getRange(
    2,
    1,
    indexSh.getLastRow() - 1,
    8
  ).getDisplayValues();
  var seenOutputs = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < indexRows.length; i++) {
    var outputName = String(indexRows[i][1] || '').trim();
    var keyName = String(indexRows[i][2] || '').trim();

    if (!outputName || seenOutputs[outputName]) {
      continue;
    }

    seenOutputs[outputName] = true;
    var outputSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(outputName);

    if (!outputSh) {
      continue;
    }

    stats.sheetsChecked++;
    var repaired = RSC_UR_repairShiftedOutputRows_(outputSh);

    if (repaired > 0) {
      stats.sheetsRepaired++;
      stats.rowsRepaired += repaired;

      var keySh = keyName ? technicalSs.getSheetByName(keyName) : null;

      if (!keySh) {
        keySh = RSC_UR_createKeySheet_(technicalSs);
        indexSh.getRange(i + 2, 3).setValue(keySh.getName());
      }

      RSC_UR_seedKeySheetFromOutput_(outputSh, keySh);
      stats.keySheetsRebuilt++;
    }
  }

  return stats;
}


function RSC_UR_CLEANSE_DUPLICATE_OUTPUTS_20260724() {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var lock = LockService.getUserLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(10000)) {
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
      'Cleanse duplicate belum dijalankan karena proses lain sedang aktif.'
    );
    return;
  }

  try {
    var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
    var targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(cfg.targetSpreadsheetId);
    var technicalSs = RSC_UR_getOrCreateTechnicalSpreadsheet_(props);

    RSC_UR_ensureTechnicalTemplate_(technicalSs);
    RSC_UR_ensureTechnicalIndex_(technicalSs);
    RSC_UR_migrateLegacyStorage_(targetSs, technicalSs);
    RSC_UR_ensureOutputTemplate_(targetSs);

    var stats = RSC_UR_mergeDuplicateOutputSheets_(targetSs, technicalSs);
    var targetCleanse = RSC_UR_cleanseSpreadsheet_(targetSs, 'TARGET');
    var technicalCleanse = RSC_UR_cleanseSpreadsheet_(technicalSs, 'TECHNICAL');

    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert([
      'Cleanse duplicate output selesai.',
      '',
      'Groups diperiksa: ' + Number(stats.groupsChecked || 0),
      'Groups digabung: ' + Number(stats.groupsMerged || 0),
      'Sheet digabung: ' + Number(stats.sheetsMerged || 0),
      'Sheet duplikat dihapus: ' + Number(stats.sheetsDeleted || 0),
      'Baris hasil merge: ' + Number(stats.rowsMerged || 0),
      'Index duplicate/orphan dibersihkan: ' + Number(stats.indexRowsRemoved || 0),
      'Key sheet tidak terpakai dihapus: ' + Number(stats.keySheetsDeleted || 0),
      'Rows grid cleansed: ' +
        Number(targetCleanse.rowsDeleted + technicalCleanse.rowsDeleted),
      'Columns grid cleansed: ' +
        Number(targetCleanse.columnsDeleted + technicalCleanse.columnsDeleted)
    ].join('\n'));
  } finally {
    try {
      lock.releaseLock();
    } catch (ignoreRelease) {}
  }
}


function RSC_UR_mergeDuplicateOutputSheets_(targetSs, technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var indexSh = RSC_UR_ensureTechnicalIndex_(technicalSs);
  var stats = {
    groupsChecked: 0,
    groupsMerged: 0,
    sheetsMerged: 0,
    sheetsDeleted: 0,
    rowsMerged: 0,
    indexRowsRemoved: 0,
    keySheetsDeleted: 0
  };

  if (indexSh.getLastRow() < 2) {
    return stats;
  }

  var rows = indexSh.getRange(
    2,
    1,
    indexSh.getLastRow() - 1,
    8
  ).getDisplayValues();
  var groups = {};
  var groupOrder = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var groupKey = String(rows[i][0] || '').trim();

    if (!groupKey) {
      continue;
    }

    if (!groups[groupKey]) {
      groups[groupKey] = [];
      groupOrder.push(groupKey);
    }

    groups[groupKey].push({
      indexRow: i + 2,
      groupKey: groupKey,
      outputName: String(rows[i][1] || '').trim(),
      keyName: String(rows[i][2] || '').trim(),
      runId: String(rows[i][3] || '').trim(),
      salesOrg: String(rows[i][4] || '').trim(),
      distChannel: String(rows[i][5] || '').trim(),
      division: String(rows[i][6] || '').trim(),
      salesOffice: String(rows[i][7] || '').trim()
    });
  }

  var rebuiltIndexRows = [];
  var referencedKeySheets = {};
  var obsoleteKeySheets = {};

  for (var g = 0; g < groupOrder.length; g++) {
    var currentGroupKey = groupOrder[g];
    var entries = groups[currentGroupKey];
    var canonicalName = RSC_UR_safeSheetName_(currentGroupKey);
    var canonicalSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(canonicalName);
    var candidateNames = [];
    var seenNames = {};
    var meta = entries[entries.length - 1];

    stats.groupsChecked++;

    if (canonicalSh) {
      candidateNames.push(canonicalName);
      seenNames[canonicalName] = true;
    }

    // Duplicate hanya diambil dari index group yang sama. Ini mencegah
    // sheet group sah yang kebetulan berakhiran angka ikut terhapus.
    for (var e = 0; e < entries.length; e++) {
      var outputName = entries[e].outputName;

      if (outputName && !seenNames[outputName] && targetSs.getSheetByName(outputName)) {
        candidateNames.push(outputName);
        seenNames[outputName] = true;
      }
    }

    if (!candidateNames.length) {
      for (var orphan = 0; orphan < entries.length; orphan++) {
        if (entries[orphan].keyName) {
          obsoleteKeySheets[entries[orphan].keyName] = true;
        }
      }
      stats.indexRowsRemoved += entries.length;
      continue;
    }

    var wasRenamedToCanonical = false;

    if (!canonicalSh) {
      canonicalSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(candidateNames[0]);
      canonicalSh.setName(canonicalName);
      candidateNames[0] = canonicalName;
      seenNames[canonicalName] = true;
      wasRenamedToCanonical = true;
    }

    var orderedNames = [canonicalName];

    for (var n = 0; n < candidateNames.length; n++) {
      if (candidateNames[n] !== canonicalName) {
        orderedNames.push(candidateNames[n]);
      }
    }

    var chosenKeySh = null;

    // Prioritaskan key sheet yang memang tercatat untuk canonical.
    for (var ck = 0; ck < entries.length; ck++) {
      if (
        entries[ck].outputName === canonicalName &&
        entries[ck].keyName
      ) {
        chosenKeySh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(entries[ck].keyName);
        if (chosenKeySh) {
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    for (var ke = 0; ke < entries.length && !chosenKeySh; ke++) {
      if (entries[ke].keyName) {
        chosenKeySh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(entries[ke].keyName);
      }
    }

    if (!chosenKeySh) {
      chosenKeySh = RSC_UR_createKeySheet_(technicalSs);
      RSC_UR_seedKeySheetFromOutput_(canonicalSh, chosenKeySh);
    }

    var requiresMerge = orderedNames.length > 1 || entries.length > 1;

    if (requiresMerge) {
      var recordsByKey = {};
      var keyOrder = [];

      // Canonical dibaca dahulu. Duplicate berdasarkan urutan index dibaca
      // sesudahnya, sehingga hasil export yang lebih baru menang untuk KEY6 sama.
      for (var sidx = 0; sidx < orderedNames.length; sidx++) {
        var mergeSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(orderedNames[sidx]);

        if (!mergeSh) {
          continue;
        }

        RSC_UR_ensureOutputSheetStructure_(mergeSh);
        RSC_UR_repairShiftedOutputRows_(mergeSh);
        var rowCount = Math.max(0, mergeSh.getLastRow() - cfg.outputHeaderRow);

        if (rowCount < 1) {
          continue;
        }

        var values = mergeSh.getRange(
          cfg.outputDataStartRow,
          1,
          rowCount,
          cfg.sourceColumnCount
        ).getDisplayValues();
        var backgrounds = mergeSh.getRange(
          cfg.outputDataStartRow,
          1,
          rowCount,
          cfg.sourceColumnCount
        ).getBackgrounds();

        for (var r = 0; r < values.length; r++) {
          var normalizedRow = RSC_UR_normalizeOutputRow_(values[r]);

          if (!RSC_UR_rowHasAnyValue_(normalizedRow)) {
            continue;
          }

          var rowKey = RSC_UR_makeBusinessRowKey_(normalizedRow);

          if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(recordsByKey, rowKey)) {
            keyOrder.push(rowKey);
          }

          recordsByKey[rowKey] = {
            key: rowKey,
            runId: meta.runId || 'CLEANSE_DUPLICATE',
            values: normalizedRow,
            highlightType: RSC_UR_detectHighlightTypeFromBackground_(
              backgrounds[r] || []
            )
          };
        }
      }

      var records = [];

      for (var k = 0; k < keyOrder.length; k++) {
        records.push(recordsByKey[keyOrder[k]]);
      }

      RSC_UR_rewriteGroupStorage_(canonicalSh, chosenKeySh, records);
      RSC_UR_formatOutputSheet_(canonicalSh);

      stats.groupsMerged++;
      stats.sheetsMerged += Math.max(0, orderedNames.length - 1);
      stats.rowsMerged += records.length;

      for (var d = 1; d < orderedNames.length; d++) {
        var duplicateSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(orderedNames[d]);

        if (duplicateSh && targetSs.getSheets().length > 1) {
          targetSs.deleteSheet(duplicateSh);
          stats.sheetsDeleted++;
        }
      }
    } else if (wasRenamedToCanonical) {
      RSC_UR_ensureOutputSheetStructure_(canonicalSh);
      RSC_UR_formatOutputSheet_(canonicalSh);
    }

    referencedKeySheets[chosenKeySh.getName()] = true;

    for (var ok = 0; ok < entries.length; ok++) {
      if (
        entries[ok].keyName &&
        entries[ok].keyName !== chosenKeySh.getName()
      ) {
        obsoleteKeySheets[entries[ok].keyName] = true;
      }
    }

    stats.indexRowsRemoved += Math.max(0, entries.length - 1);
    rebuiltIndexRows.push([
      currentGroupKey,
      canonicalName,
      chosenKeySh.getName(),
      meta.runId,
      meta.salesOrg,
      meta.distChannel,
      meta.division,
      meta.salesOffice
    ]);
  }

  RSC_UR_clearDataRows_(indexSh, 1, 8);

  if (rebuiltIndexRows.length) {
    RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(indexSh, rebuiltIndexRows.length + 1, 8);
    indexSh.getRange(2, 1, rebuiltIndexRows.length, 8)
      .setNumberFormat('@')
      .setValues(rebuiltIndexRows);
  }

  RSC_UR_trimSheetGrid_(
    indexSh,
    Math.max(2, rebuiltIndexRows.length + 1),
    8
  );

  Object.keys(obsoleteKeySheets).forEach(function (keyName) {
    if (referencedKeySheets[keyName]) {
      return;
    }

    var keySh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(keyName);

    if (
      keySh &&
      keyName.indexOf(cfg.keySheetPrefix) === 0 &&
      technicalSs.getSheets().length > 1
    ) {
      technicalSs.deleteSheet(keySh);
      stats.keySheetsDeleted++;
    }
  });

  RSC_UR_hideTechnicalSheets_(technicalSs);
  return stats;
}


function RSC_UR_createOutputSheet_(targetSs, sheetName) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var templateSh = RSC_UR_ensureOutputTemplate_(targetSs);

  RSC_UR_ensureWorkbookHeadroom_(
    targetSs,
    'TARGET',
    cfg.insertSheetSafetyCells
  );

  var sheet;

  try {
    sheet = targetSs.insertSheet(sheetName, {template: templateSh});
  } catch (err) {
    var insertErrText = String(err && err.stack ? err.stack : err);

    // Cleanse seluruh TARGET hanya ketika kegagalan benar-benar terkait
    // kapasitas cell. Error lain harus diteruskan agar tidak membuang
    // waktu dengan scan/trim semua sheet pada setiap retry.
    if (/cell|10000000|number of cells|above the limit|maximum/i.test(insertErrText)) {
      RSC_UR_cleanseSpreadsheet_(targetSs, 'TARGET');
      sheet = targetSs.insertSheet(sheetName, {template: templateSh});
    } else {
      throw err;
    }
  }

  try {
    sheet.showSheet();
  } catch (ignoreShow) {}

  RSC_UR_ensureOutputSheetStructure_(sheet);
  RSC_UR_trimSheetGrid_(sheet, cfg.outputDataStartRow, cfg.sourceColumnCount);
  return sheet;
}


function RSC_UR_createKeySheet_(technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var templateSh = RSC_UR_ensureTechnicalTemplate_(technicalSs);
  var sheetName = cfg.keySheetPrefix +
    Utilities.getUuid().replace(/-/g, '').substring(0, 24);

  RSC_UR_ensureWorkbookHeadroom_(
    technicalSs,
    'TECHNICAL',
    cfg.insertSheetSafetyCells
  );

  var sh = technicalSs.insertSheet(sheetName, {template: templateSh});
  RSC_UR_ensureKeySheetStructure_(sh);
  RSC_UR_trimSheetGrid_(sh, 2, 2);

  try {
    sh.hideSheet();
  } catch (ignoreHide) {}

  return sh;
}


function RSC_UR_detectOutputHeaderRow_(sheet) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;

  if (!sheet || sheet.getMaxColumns() < 3 || sheet.getLastRow() < 1) {
    return 0;
  }

  var rowsToRead = Math.min(2, Math.max(1, sheet.getLastRow()));
  var values = sheet.getRange(1, 1, rowsToRead, 3).getDisplayValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var firstHeader = String(values[i][0] || '').trim();
    var customerHeader = String(values[i][2] || '').trim();

    if (
      firstHeader === cfg.outputHeaders[0] &&
      customerHeader === cfg.outputHeaders[2]
    ) {
      return i + 1;
    }
  }

  return 0;
}


function RSC_UR_removeLegacyScheduleRow_(sheet) {
  var headerRow = RSC_UR_detectOutputHeaderRow_(sheet);

  if (headerRow === 2) {
    sheet.deleteRow(1);
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}


function RSC_UR_ensureOutputSheetStructure_(sheet) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;

  // Output lama: row 1 = Schedule, row 2 = header.
  // Hapus row 1 agar header selalu berada di row 1.
  RSC_UR_removeLegacyScheduleRow_(sheet);

  RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(
    sheet,
    cfg.outputDataStartRow,
    cfg.sourceColumnCount
  );

  sheet.getRange(
    cfg.outputHeaderRow,
    1,
    1,
    cfg.sourceColumnCount
  ).setValues([cfg.outputHeaders]);

  // Format lama P:Q tidak lagi dipakai.
  if (sheet.getMaxColumns() > cfg.sourceColumnCount) {
    sheet.deleteColumns(
      cfg.sourceColumnCount + 1,
      sheet.getMaxColumns() - cfg.sourceColumnCount
    );
  }
}


function RSC_UR_ensureKeySheetStructure_(sheet) {
  RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(sheet, 2, 2);
  sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, 2).setValues([[
    '__RSC_ROW_KEY',
    '__RSC_RUN_ID'
  ]]);
}


function RSC_UR_seedKeySheetFromOutput_(outputSh, keySh) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;

  RSC_UR_ensureOutputSheetStructure_(outputSh);
  RSC_UR_repairShiftedOutputRows_(outputSh);

  var count = Math.max(
    0,
    outputSh.getLastRow() - cfg.outputHeaderRow
  );

  RSC_UR_ensureKeySheetStructure_(keySh);

  if (count < 1) {
    return;
  }

  var rows = outputSh.getRange(
    cfg.outputDataStartRow,
    1,
    count,
    cfg.sourceColumnCount
  ).getDisplayValues();

  var keyRows = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var normalized = RSC_UR_normalizeOutputRow_(rows[i]);
    keyRows.push([
      RSC_UR_makeBusinessRowKey_(normalized),
      ''
    ]);
  }

  RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(keySh, count + 1, 2);
  keySh.getRange(2, 1, count, 2).setValues(keyRows);
  RSC_UR_trimSheetGrid_(keySh, count + 1, 2);
}


function RSC_UR_markIndexRun_(technicalSs, indexRow, runId) {
  var sh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(RSC_UR_20260721.indexSheetName);

  if (sh && indexRow >= 2) {
    sh.getRange(indexRow, 4).setValue(runId);
  }
}


function RSC_UR_syncOutputOfficeColumns_(sheet, salesOffice) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var office = RSC_UR_extractCode_(salesOffice);

  if (!office) {
    return 0;
  }

  RSC_UR_ensureOutputSheetStructure_(sheet);

  var rowCount = Math.max(
    0,
    sheet.getLastRow() - cfg.outputHeaderRow
  );

  if (rowCount < 1) {
    return 0;
  }

  var changedRows = 0;
  var chunkSize = 20000;

  for (var offset = 0; offset < rowCount; offset += chunkSize) {
    var size = Math.min(chunkSize, rowCount - offset);
    var startRow = cfg.outputDataStartRow + offset;
    var existing = sheet.getRange(startRow, 1, size, 2).getDisplayValues();
    var values = [];
    var needsWrite = false;

    for (var i = 0; i < size; i++) {
      var oldSalesOffice = RSC_UR_extractCode_(existing[i][0]);
      var oldPlant = RSC_UR_extractCode_(existing[i][1]);

      if (oldSalesOffice !== office || oldPlant !== office) {
        needsWrite = true;
        changedRows++;
      }

      values.push([office, office]);
    }

    if (needsWrite) {
      sheet.getRange(startRow, 1, size, 2)
        .setNumberFormat('@')
        .setValues(values);
    }
  }

  return changedRows;
}


function RSC_UR_extractSalesOfficeFromGroupName_(sheetName) {
  var parts = String(sheetName || '')
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/);
  var prefix = String(parts[0] || '').trim().toUpperCase();

  // Format ST/RL:
  // ST <BP Type> <Sls Org> <Dist Channel> <Division> <Sls Office>
  // RL <BP Type> <Sls Org> <Dist Channel> <Division> <Sls Office>
  if ((prefix === 'ST' || prefix === 'RL') && parts.length >= 6) {
    return RSC_UR_extractCode_(parts[parts.length - 1]);
  }

  // Format compile normal:
  // <Sls Org> <Dist Channel> <Division> <Sls Office>
  if (parts.length < 4) {
    return '';
  }

  return RSC_UR_extractCode_(parts[3]);
}


function RSC_UR_loadSalesOfficeByOutputName_(technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var indexSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.indexSheetName);
  var output = {};

  if (!indexSh || indexSh.getLastRow() < 2) {
    return output;
  }

  var rows = indexSh.getRange(
    2,
    1,
    indexSh.getLastRow() - 1,
    8
  ).getDisplayValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var groupKey = String(rows[i][0] || '').trim();
    var outputName = String(rows[i][1] || '').trim();
    var salesOffice = RSC_UR_extractCode_(rows[i][7]);

    if (!salesOffice) {
      salesOffice = RSC_UR_extractSalesOfficeFromGroupName_(groupKey);
    }

    if (outputName && salesOffice) {
      output[outputName] = salesOffice;
    }
  }

  return output;
}


function RSC_UR_upgradeExistingOutputSheets_(targetSs, technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var salesOfficeByName = RSC_UR_loadSalesOfficeByOutputName_(technicalSs);
  var sheets = targetSs.getSheets();
  var stats = {
    sheetsPatched: 0,
    scheduleRowsRemoved: 0,
    officeRowsSynced: 0
  };

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    var sh = sheets[i];
    var name = sh.getName();
    var headerRow = RSC_UR_detectOutputHeaderRow_(sh);

    if (!headerRow && name !== cfg.outputTemplateSheetName) {
      continue;
    }

    if (headerRow === 2) {
      sh.deleteRow(1);
      stats.scheduleRowsRemoved++;
    }

    RSC_UR_ensureOutputSheetStructure_(sh);

    if (name !== cfg.outputTemplateSheetName) {
      var salesOffice = salesOfficeByName[name] ||
        RSC_UR_extractSalesOfficeFromGroupName_(name);

      stats.officeRowsSynced += RSC_UR_syncOutputOfficeColumns_(
        sh,
        salesOffice
      );
    }

    RSC_UR_formatOutputSheet_(sh);
    stats.sheetsPatched++;
  }

  return stats;
}


function RSC_UR_formatOutputSheet_(sheet) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;

  RSC_UR_ensureOutputSheetStructure_(sheet);

  sheet.getRange(
    cfg.outputHeaderRow,
    1,
    1,
    cfg.sourceColumnCount
  )
    .setNumberFormat('@')
    .setValues([cfg.outputHeaders])
    .setFontWeight('bold')
    .setBackground('#F3F4F6')
    .setWrap(true)
    .setVerticalAlignment('middle')
    .setHorizontalAlignment('left');

  sheet.setFrozenRows(cfg.outputHeaderRow);

  var widths = [
    105, 110, 110, 110, 125,
    120, 105, 105, 105, 85,
    175, 120, 120, 150, 170
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < widths.length; i++) {
    sheet.setColumnWidth(i + 1, widths[i]);
  }
}


/***************************************************************
 * TECHNICAL WORKBOOK + MIGRATION
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_UR_getOrCreateTechnicalSpreadsheet_(props) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var configuredId = String(cfg.technicalSpreadsheetId || '').trim();
  var storedId = String(
    props.getProperty(cfg.technicalSpreadsheetProperty) || ''
  ).trim();
  var candidateId = configuredId || storedId;

  if (candidateId) {
    try {
      var existingSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(candidateId);
      props.setProperty(cfg.technicalSpreadsheetProperty, existingSs.getId());
      return existingSs;
    } catch (ignoreOpen) {}
  }

  var createdSs = SpreadsheetApp.create(cfg.technicalSpreadsheetName);
  props.setProperty(cfg.technicalSpreadsheetProperty, createdSs.getId());

  var firstSh = createdSs.getSheets()[0];
  firstSh.setName(cfg.technicalTemplateSheetName);
  RSC_UR_trimSheetGrid_(firstSh, 2, 8 + cfg.sourceColumnCount);

  try {
    firstSh.hideSheet();
  } catch (ignoreHide) {}

  return createdSs;
}


function RSC_UR_ensureTechnicalTemplate_(technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var sh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.technicalTemplateSheetName);

  if (!sh) {
    RSC_UR_cleanseSpreadsheet_(technicalSs, 'TECHNICAL');
    sh = technicalSs.insertSheet(cfg.technicalTemplateSheetName);
  }

  RSC_UR_trimSheetGrid_(sh, 2, 8 + cfg.sourceColumnCount);
  sh.clear();

  try {
    sh.hideSheet();
  } catch (ignoreHide) {}

  return sh;
}


function RSC_UR_ensureOutputTemplate_(targetSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(cfg.outputTemplateSheetName);

  if (!sh) {
    // PATCH 15.1:
    // Jangan cleanse seluruh TARGET hanya karena template belum ada.
    // Cleanse semua sheet sangat mahal dan sebelumnya gagal pada sheet
    // yang seluruh non-frozen row-nya hendak dihapus.
    RSC_UR_ensureWorkbookHeadroom_(
      targetSs,
      'TARGET',
      cfg.insertSheetSafetyCells
    );
    sh = targetSs.insertSheet(cfg.outputTemplateSheetName);
  }

  RSC_UR_trimSheetGrid_(
    sh,
    cfg.outputDataStartRow,
    cfg.sourceColumnCount
  );
  sh.clear();
  sh.getRange(
    cfg.outputHeaderRow,
    1,
    1,
    cfg.sourceColumnCount
  ).setValues([cfg.outputHeaders]);
  RSC_UR_formatOutputSheet_(sh);

  try {
    sh.hideSheet();
  } catch (ignoreHide) {}

  return sh;
}


function RSC_UR_ensureTechnicalIndex_(technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var sh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.indexSheetName);

  if (!sh) {
    sh = RSC_UR_createTechnicalSheet_(technicalSs, cfg.indexSheetName, 2, 8);
  }

  RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(sh, 2, 8);
  sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, 8).setValues([[
    'Group Key',
    'Output Sheet Name',
    'Key Sheet Name',
    'Last Run ID',
    'sls_org',
    'dist_channel',
    'division',
    'sls_office_rekap'
  ]]);

  try {
    sh.hideSheet();
  } catch (ignoreHide) {}

  return sh;
}


function RSC_UR_migrateLegacyStorage_(targetSs, technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var legacyIndex = targetSs.getSheetByName(cfg.indexSheetName);
  var technicalIndex = RSC_UR_ensureTechnicalIndex_(technicalSs);
  var currentMap = RSC_UR_loadOutputIndexMap_(technicalSs);

  if (legacyIndex && legacyIndex.getLastRow() >= 2) {
    var legacyRows = legacyIndex.getRange(
      2,
      1,
      legacyIndex.getLastRow() - 1,
      Math.min(7, legacyIndex.getLastColumn())
    ).getDisplayValues();

    for (var i = 0; i < legacyRows.length; i++) {
      var groupKey = String(legacyRows[i][0] || '').trim();
      var outputName = String(legacyRows[i][1] || '').trim();

      if (!groupKey || !outputName || currentMap[groupKey]) {
        continue;
      }

      var outputSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(outputName);

      if (!outputSh) {
        continue;
      }

      var keySh = RSC_UR_createKeySheet_(technicalSs);
      var outputHeaderRow = RSC_UR_detectOutputHeaderRow_(outputSh) || 2;
      var outputDataStartRow = outputHeaderRow + 1;
      var count = Math.max(0, outputSh.getLastRow() - outputHeaderRow);
      var legacyTechnicalRows = [];

      if (
        count > 0 &&
        outputSh.getMaxColumns() >= cfg.legacyTechnicalRunIdCol
      ) {
        var headers = outputSh.getRange(
          outputHeaderRow,
          cfg.legacyTechnicalKeyCol,
          1,
          2
        ).getDisplayValues()[0];

        if (
          String(headers[0] || '').trim() === cfg.legacyTechnicalKeyHeader &&
          String(headers[1] || '').trim() === cfg.legacyTechnicalRunIdHeader
        ) {
          legacyTechnicalRows = outputSh.getRange(
            outputDataStartRow,
            cfg.legacyTechnicalKeyCol,
            count,
            2
          ).getDisplayValues();
        }
      }

      if (!legacyTechnicalRows.length && count > 0) {
        var visibleRows = outputSh.getRange(
          outputDataStartRow,
          1,
          count,
          cfg.sourceColumnCount
        ).getDisplayValues();

        for (var r = 0; r < visibleRows.length; r++) {
          legacyTechnicalRows.push([
            RSC_UR_makeBusinessRowKey_(visibleRows[r]),
            String(legacyRows[i][2] || '').trim()
          ]);
        }
      }

      if (legacyTechnicalRows.length) {
        RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(keySh, legacyTechnicalRows.length + 1, 2);
        keySh.getRange(2, 1, legacyTechnicalRows.length, 2)
          .setNumberFormat('@')
          .setValues(legacyTechnicalRows);
      }

      RSC_UR_trimSheetGrid_(
        keySh,
        Math.max(2, legacyTechnicalRows.length + 1),
        2
      );

      technicalIndex.appendRow([
        groupKey,
        outputName,
        keySh.getName(),
        String(legacyRows[i][2] || '').trim(),
        String(legacyRows[i][3] || '').trim(),
        String(legacyRows[i][4] || '').trim(),
        String(legacyRows[i][5] || '').trim(),
        String(legacyRows[i][6] || '').trim()
      ]);

      if (outputSh.getMaxColumns() > cfg.sourceColumnCount) {
        outputSh.deleteColumns(
          cfg.sourceColumnCount + 1,
          outputSh.getMaxColumns() - cfg.sourceColumnCount
        );
      }

      RSC_UR_trimSheetGrid_(
        outputSh,
        Math.max(cfg.outputDataStartRow, outputSh.getLastRow()),
        cfg.sourceColumnCount
      );
    }
  }

  // Admin lama di workbook output tidak lagi diperlukan.
  [
    cfg.stageSheetName,
    cfg.needsSheetName,
    cfg.mapSheetName,
    cfg.queueSheetName,
    cfg.groupsSheetName,
    cfg.indexSheetName
  ].forEach(function (name) {
    var sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(name);
    if (sh && targetSs.getSheets().length > 1) {
      targetSs.deleteSheet(sh);
    }
  });
}


function RSC_UR_resetWorkingSheets_(technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var definitions = [
    {
      name: cfg.stageSheetName,
      cols: 8 + cfg.sourceColumnCount,
      headers: [
        'Route Key',
        'DB Join Key',
        'Rekap Sales Office',
        'Row Key',
        'Source Spreadsheet ID',
        'Master Row',
        'Source Row',
        'Highlight Hint'
      ].concat(cfg.outputHeaders)
    },
    {
      name: cfg.needsSheetName,
      cols: 3,
      headers: ['Route Key', 'DB Join Key', 'Rekap Sales Office']
    },
    {
      name: cfg.mapSheetName,
      cols: 7,
      headers: [
        'Route Key',
        'Group Key',
        'sls_org',
        'dist_channel',
        'division',
        'sls_office_rekap',
        'sls_office_db'
      ]
    },
    {
      name: cfg.queueSheetName,
      cols: 7 + cfg.sourceColumnCount,
      headers: [
        'Group Key',
        'Row Key',
        'sls_org',
        'dist_channel',
        'division',
        'sls_office_rekap',
        'Highlight Hint'
      ].concat(cfg.outputHeaders)
    },
    {
      name: cfg.groupsSheetName,
      cols: 7,
      headers: [
        'Group Key',
        'Queue Start Row',
        'Queue Row Count',
        'sls_org',
        'dist_channel',
        'division',
        'sls_office_rekap'
      ]
    }
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < definitions.length; i++) {
    var oldSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(definitions[i].name);

    if (oldSh) {
      technicalSs.deleteSheet(oldSh);
    }

    var newSh = RSC_UR_createTechnicalSheet_(
      technicalSs,
      definitions[i].name,
      2,
      definitions[i].cols
    );

    newSh.getRange(1, 1, 1, definitions[i].cols).setValues([
      definitions[i].headers
    ]);

    try {
      newSh.hideSheet();
    } catch (ignoreHide) {}
  }

  RSC_UR_ensureTechnicalIndex_(technicalSs);
  RSC_UR_hideTechnicalSheets_(technicalSs);
}


function RSC_UR_createTechnicalSheet_(technicalSs, name, rows, cols) {
  var templateSh = RSC_UR_ensureTechnicalTemplate_(technicalSs);
  var sh = technicalSs.insertSheet(name, {template: templateSh});
  sh.clear();
  RSC_UR_trimSheetGrid_(sh, Math.max(1, rows), Math.max(1, cols));
  return sh;
}


/***************************************************************
 * CLEANSE / CELL CAPACITY
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_UR_CLEANSE_SPACE_20260722() {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(cfg.targetSpreadsheetId);
  var technicalSs = RSC_UR_getOrCreateTechnicalSpreadsheet_(props);

  RSC_UR_ensureTechnicalIndex_(technicalSs);
  RSC_UR_ensureOutputTemplate_(targetSs);
  var duplicateStats = RSC_UR_mergeDuplicateOutputSheets_(targetSs, technicalSs);
  var patchStats = RSC_UR_upgradeExistingOutputSheets_(targetSs, technicalSs);

  var targetBefore = RSC_UR_countAllocatedCells_(targetSs);
  var technicalBefore = RSC_UR_countAllocatedCells_(technicalSs);

  var targetStats = RSC_UR_cleanseSpreadsheet_(targetSs, 'TARGET');
  var technicalStats = RSC_UR_cleanseSpreadsheet_(technicalSs, 'TECHNICAL');

  var message = [
    'Cleanse selesai.',
    '',
    'Duplicate sheets merged: ' + Number(duplicateStats.sheetsMerged || 0),
    'Duplicate sheets deleted: ' + Number(duplicateStats.sheetsDeleted || 0),
    'Target cells: ' + targetBefore + ' -> ' + RSC_UR_countAllocatedCells_(targetSs),
    'Technical cells: ' + technicalBefore + ' -> ' + RSC_UR_countAllocatedCells_(technicalSs),
    'Schedule rows removed: ' + patchStats.scheduleRowsRemoved,
    'Rows A:B synced to SSSS: ' + patchStats.officeRowsSynced,
    'Rows deleted: ' + (targetStats.rowsDeleted + technicalStats.rowsDeleted),
    'Columns deleted: ' + (targetStats.columnsDeleted + technicalStats.columnsDeleted)
  ].join('\n');

  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(message);
}


function RSC_UR_cleanseSpreadsheet_(ss, mode) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var stats = {
    rowsDeleted: 0,
    columnsDeleted: 0
  };

  var sheets = ss.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    var sh = sheets[i];
    var name = sh.getName();
    var minRows = 1;
    var minCols = 1;

    if (mode === 'TARGET') {
      if (name === cfg.outputTemplateSheetName) {
        minRows = cfg.outputDataStartRow;
        minCols = cfg.sourceColumnCount;
      } else if (RSC_UR_looksLikeOutputSheet_(sh)) {
        minRows = Math.max(cfg.outputDataStartRow, sh.getLastRow());
        minCols = cfg.sourceColumnCount;
      } else {
        minRows = Math.max(1, sh.getLastRow());
        minCols = Math.max(1, sh.getLastColumn());
      }
    } else {
      if (name === cfg.technicalTemplateSheetName) {
        minRows = 2;
        minCols = 8 + cfg.sourceColumnCount;
      } else if (name === cfg.indexSheetName) {
        minRows = Math.max(2, sh.getLastRow());
        minCols = 8;
      } else if (name.indexOf(cfg.keySheetPrefix) === 0) {
        minRows = Math.max(2, sh.getLastRow());
        minCols = 2;
      } else {
        minRows = Math.max(1, sh.getLastRow());
        minCols = Math.max(1, sh.getLastColumn());
      }
    }

    var beforeRows = sh.getMaxRows();
    var beforeCols = sh.getMaxColumns();

    RSC_UR_trimSheetGrid_(sh, minRows, minCols);

    stats.rowsDeleted += Math.max(0, beforeRows - sh.getMaxRows());
    stats.columnsDeleted += Math.max(0, beforeCols - sh.getMaxColumns());
  }

  return stats;
}


function RSC_UR_trimSheetGrid_(sheet, keepRows, keepCols) {
  keepRows = Math.max(1, Number(keepRows || 1));
  keepCols = Math.max(1, Number(keepCols || 1));

  // Google Sheets tidak mengizinkan seluruh row/column non-frozen
  // dihapus. Selalu sisakan minimal satu row dan satu column
  // non-frozen di luar area freeze.
  var frozenRows = 0;
  var frozenCols = 0;

  try {
    frozenRows = Math.max(0, Number(sheet.getFrozenRows() || 0));
  } catch (ignoreFrozenRows) {}

  try {
    frozenCols = Math.max(0, Number(sheet.getFrozenColumns() || 0));
  } catch (ignoreFrozenCols) {}

  keepRows = Math.max(keepRows, frozenRows + 1);
  keepCols = Math.max(keepCols, frozenCols + 1);

  var maxRows = sheet.getMaxRows();
  var maxCols = sheet.getMaxColumns();

  if (maxRows > keepRows) {
    try {
      sheet.deleteRows(keepRows + 1, maxRows - keepRows);
    } catch (rowDeleteErr) {
      // Jangan hentikan seluruh Compile ST/RL hanya karena grid trim.
      // Extra empty rows lebih aman daripada job retry tanpa akhir.
      if (!/delete all non-frozen rows/i.test(String(rowDeleteErr))) {
        throw rowDeleteErr;
      }
    }
  } else if (maxRows < keepRows) {
    sheet.insertRowsAfter(maxRows, keepRows - maxRows);
  }

  // Baca ulang karena operasi row dapat mengubah state sheet.
  maxCols = sheet.getMaxColumns();

  if (maxCols > keepCols) {
    try {
      sheet.deleteColumns(keepCols + 1, maxCols - keepCols);
    } catch (colDeleteErr) {
      if (!/delete all non-frozen columns/i.test(String(colDeleteErr))) {
        throw colDeleteErr;
      }
    }
  } else if (maxCols < keepCols) {
    sheet.insertColumnsAfter(maxCols, keepCols - maxCols);
  }
}


function RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(sheet, requiredRows, requiredCols) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  requiredRows = Math.max(1, Number(requiredRows || 1));
  requiredCols = Math.max(1, Number(requiredCols || 1));

  var currentRows = sheet.getMaxRows();
  var currentCols = sheet.getMaxColumns();
  var futureRows = Math.max(currentRows, requiredRows);
  var futureCols = Math.max(currentCols, requiredCols);
  var additionalCells =
    (futureRows * futureCols) - (currentRows * currentCols);

  if (additionalCells > 0) {
    var parentSs = sheet.getParent();
    var mode = parentSs.getId() === cfg.targetSpreadsheetId
      ? 'TARGET'
      : 'TECHNICAL';

    RSC_UR_ensureWorkbookHeadroom_(parentSs, mode, additionalCells);

    // Cleanse dapat mengubah grid, jadi baca ulang dimensinya.
    currentRows = sheet.getMaxRows();
    currentCols = sheet.getMaxColumns();
  }

  if (currentRows < requiredRows) {
    sheet.insertRowsAfter(currentRows, requiredRows - currentRows);
  }

  if (currentCols < requiredCols) {
    sheet.insertColumnsAfter(currentCols, requiredCols - currentCols);
  }
}


function RSC_UR_ensureWorkbookHeadroom_(ss, mode, requiredCells) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var required = Math.max(1, Number(requiredCells || 1));
  var allocated = RSC_UR_countAllocatedCells_(ss);

  if (allocated + required <= cfg.spreadsheetCellLimit) {
    return;
  }

  RSC_UR_cleanseSpreadsheet_(ss, mode);
  allocated = RSC_UR_countAllocatedCells_(ss);

  if (allocated + required > cfg.spreadsheetCellLimit) {
    throw new Error(
      'Workbook ' + mode + ' masih tidak memiliki ruang yang cukup. ' +
      'Allocated cells=' + allocated + ', required reserve=' + required + '. ' +
      'Pisahkan output tambahan ke spreadsheet lain atau hapus sheet yang tidak diperlukan.'
    );
  }
}


function RSC_UR_countAllocatedCells_(ss) {
  var total = 0;
  var sheets = ss.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    total += sheets[i].getMaxRows() * sheets[i].getMaxColumns();
  }

  return total;
}


function RSC_UR_looksLikeOutputSheet_(sh) {
  return RSC_UR_detectOutputHeaderRow_(sh) > 0;
}


/***************************************************************
 * ADMIN SHEET HELPERS
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_UR_appendRows_(sheet, rows) {
  if (!sheet || !rows || !rows.length) {
    return;
  }

  var startRow = sheet.getLastRow() + 1;
  var requiredRows = startRow + rows.length - 1;
  var requiredCols = rows[0].length;

  RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(sheet, requiredRows, requiredCols);

  sheet.getRange(startRow, 1, rows.length, requiredCols)
    .setNumberFormat('@')
    .setValues(rows);
}


function RSC_UR_clearDataRows_(sheet, headerRows, width) {
  var lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();

  if (lastRow > headerRows) {
    sheet.getRange(
      headerRows + 1,
      1,
      lastRow - headerRows,
      width
    ).clearContent();
  }

  RSC_UR_trimSheetGrid_(sheet, Math.max(1, headerRows + 1), width);
}


function RSC_UR_dedupeAdminSheet_(sheet, width) {
  if (!sheet || sheet.getLastRow() < 3) {
    return;
  }

  sheet.getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, width).removeDuplicates();
}


/***************************************************************
 * MAP LOADERS
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_UR_loadNeededRoutes_(technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var sh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.needsSheetName);
  var output = {};

  if (!sh || sh.getLastRow() < 2) {
    return output;
  }

  var values = sh.getRange(2, 1, sh.getLastRow() - 1, 3).getDisplayValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var routeKey = String(values[i][0] || '').trim();
    var dbJoinKey = String(values[i][1] || '').trim();
    var rekapSalesOffice = RSC_UR_extractCode_(values[i][2]);

    if (!routeKey || !dbJoinKey || !rekapSalesOffice) {
      continue;
    }

    if (!output[dbJoinKey]) {
      output[dbJoinKey] = [];
    }

    var exists = false;

    for (var x = 0; x < output[dbJoinKey].length; x++) {
      if (output[dbJoinKey][x].routeKey === routeKey) {
        exists = true;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!exists) {
      output[dbJoinKey].push({
        routeKey: routeKey,
        rekapSalesOffice: rekapSalesOffice
      });
    }
  }

  return output;
}


function RSC_UR_loadDatabaseGroupMap_(technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var sh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.mapSheetName);
  var output = {};
  var seen = {};

  if (!sh || sh.getLastRow() < 2) {
    return output;
  }

  var values = sh.getRange(2, 1, sh.getLastRow() - 1, 7).getDisplayValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var routeKey = String(values[i][0] || '').trim();
    var groupKey = String(values[i][1] || '').trim();

    if (!routeKey || !groupKey) {
      continue;
    }

    var uniqueKey = routeKey + '\u001F' + groupKey;

    if (seen[uniqueKey]) {
      continue;
    }

    seen[uniqueKey] = true;

    if (!output[routeKey]) {
      output[routeKey] = [];
    }

    output[routeKey].push({
      groupKey: groupKey,
      salesOrg: values[i][2],
      distChannel: values[i][3],
      division: values[i][4],
      salesOffice: values[i][5],
      dbSalesOffice: values[i][6]
    });
  }

  return output;
}

function RSC_UR_loadOutputIndexMap_(technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var sh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.indexSheetName);
  var output = {};

  if (!sh || sh.getLastRow() < 2) {
    return output;
  }

  var values = sh.getRange(2, 1, sh.getLastRow() - 1, 3).getDisplayValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var groupKey = String(values[i][0] || '').trim();
    var outputName = String(values[i][1] || '').trim();
    var keyName = String(values[i][2] || '').trim();

    if (groupKey && outputName) {
      output[groupKey] = {
        outputSheetName: outputName,
        keySheetName: keyName,
        indexRow: i + 2
      };
    }
  }

  return output;
}


/***************************************************************
 * CHANGE SALES OFFICE ROUTING
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_UR_resolveDbLookupSalesOffice_(outputRow, rekapSalesOffice) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var templateSalesOffice = RSC_UR_extractCode_(
    outputRow && outputRow.length ? outputRow[0] : ''
  );
  var sourceText = RSC_UR_keyPart_(
    outputRow && outputRow.length > cfg.salesOfficeSourceIndex
      ? outputRow[cfg.salesOfficeSourceIndex]
      : ''
  );
  var markers = cfg.changeSalesOfficeMarkers || [];
  var isChangeSalesOffice = false;

  for (var i = 0; i < markers.length; i++) {
    var marker = RSC_UR_keyPart_(markers[i]);

    if (marker && sourceText.indexOf(marker) >= 0) {
      isChangeSalesOffice = true;
      break;
    }
  }

  var rekapCode = RSC_UR_extractCode_(rekapSalesOffice);

  return {
    salesOffice: isChangeSalesOffice
      ? (rekapCode || templateSalesOffice)
      : templateSalesOffice,
    isChangeSalesOffice: isChangeSalesOffice,
    templateSalesOffice: templateSalesOffice,
    rekapSalesOffice: rekapCode,
    salesOfficeSource: sourceText
  };
}


/***************************************************************
 * KEY LOGIC
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_UR_makeJoinKey_(customerId, salesOffice) {
  return (
    String(customerId == null ? '' : customerId).trim() +
    '\u001F' +
    RSC_UR_extractCode_(salesOffice)
  );
}


function RSC_UR_makeRouteKey_(dbJoinKey, rekapSalesOffice) {
  return (
    String(dbJoinKey == null ? '' : dbJoinKey).trim() +
    '\u001FREKAP\u001F' +
    RSC_UR_extractCode_(rekapSalesOffice)
  );
}


function RSC_UR_makeGroupKey_(salesOrg, distChannel, division, rekapSalesOffice) {
  return [
    String(salesOrg == null ? '' : salesOrg).trim(),
    String(distChannel == null ? '' : distChannel).trim(),
    String(division == null ? '' : division).trim(),
    RSC_UR_extractCode_(rekapSalesOffice)
  ].join(' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}


function RSC_UR_makeBusinessRowKey_(row) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var normalized = RSC_UR_normalizeOutputRow_(row);
  var indexes = cfg.businessKeyIndexes || [2, 3, 4, 6, 9, 11];
  var parts = [String(cfg.businessKeyVersion || 'KEY6_V1')];

  for (var i = 0; i < indexes.length; i++) {
    parts.push(RSC_UR_keyPart_(normalized[indexes[i]]));
  }

  return parts.join('\u001F');
}

function RSC_UR_keyPart_(value) {
  return String(value == null ? '' : value)
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase()
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}


/***************************************************************
 * SOURCE / HEADER / CELL HELPERS
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_UR_findChangeRollingSheet_(ss) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var exact = ss.getSheetByName(cfg.changeRollingSheetName);

  if (exact) {
    return exact;
  }

  var expected = RSC_UR_normalizeHeader_(cfg.changeRollingSheetName);
  var sheets = ss.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    var normalizedName = RSC_UR_normalizeHeader_(sheets[i].getName());

    if (normalizedName === expected || normalizedName.indexOf(expected) >= 0) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function RSC_UR_findChangeRollingHeader_(sheet) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
  var lastCol = sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (!lastRow || !lastCol) {
    return null;
  }

  var rowsToRead = Math.min(20, lastRow);
  var colsToRead = Math.max(
    cfg.changeRollingNotesCol,
    Math.min(lastCol, 100)
  );
  var grid = sheet.getRange(1, 1, rowsToRead, colsToRead).getDisplayValues();

  for (var r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    var cols = {
      customerId: RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(grid[r], ['Customer ID', 'BP ID', 'bp_id']),
      relationship: RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(grid[r], ['Relationship']),
      salesmanId: RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(grid[r], ['Salesman ID']),
      validFrom: RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(grid[r], ['Valid From']),
      visitType: RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(grid[r], ['Visit Type']),
      visitValidFrom: RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(grid[r], ['Visit Valid From'])
    };

    if (
      cols.customerId >= 0 &&
      cols.relationship >= 0 &&
      cols.salesmanId >= 0 &&
      cols.validFrom >= 0 &&
      cols.visitType >= 0 &&
      cols.visitValidFrom >= 0
    ) {
      return {
        headerRow: r + 1,
        dataStartRow: r + 2,
        cols: cols
      };
    }
  }

  // Fallback untuk layout yang sama persis dengan Template Revamp A:O.
  if (lastCol >= 12) {
    try {
      var sourceHeader = RSC_UR_findSourceHeader_(sheet);
      return {
        headerRow: sourceHeader.headerRow,
        dataStartRow: sourceHeader.dataStartRow,
        cols: {
          customerId: 2,
          relationship: 3,
          salesmanId: 4,
          validFrom: 6,
          visitType: 9,
          visitValidFrom: 11
        }
      };
    } catch (ignoreHeader) {}
  }

  return null;
}


function RSC_UR_loadChangeRollingBusinessKeyStatusMap_(sourceSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var statusMap = {};
  var changeSh = RSC_UR_findChangeRollingSheet_(sourceSs);

  if (!changeSh) {
    return statusMap;
  }

  var headerInfo = RSC_UR_findChangeRollingHeader_(changeSh);

  if (!headerInfo) {
    return statusMap;
  }

  var lastRow = changeSh.getLastRow();

  if (lastRow < headerInfo.dataStartRow) {
    return statusMap;
  }

  var cols = headerInfo.cols;
  var fullSourceInfo = null;

  try {
    fullSourceInfo = RSC_UR_findSourceHeader_(changeSh);
  } catch (ignoreFullSourceHeader) {}

  var width = Math.max(
    cfg.changeRollingNotesCol,
    fullSourceInfo ? fullSourceInfo.readWidth : 0,
    cols.customerId + 1,
    cols.relationship + 1,
    cols.salesmanId + 1,
    cols.validFrom + 1,
    cols.visitType + 1,
    cols.visitValidFrom + 1
  );
  var rows = changeSh.getRange(
    headerInfo.dataStartRow,
    1,
    lastRow - headerInfo.dataStartRow + 1,
    width
  ).getDisplayValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var noteType = RSC_UR_getHighlightTypeFromNote_(
      rows[i][cfg.changeRollingNotesCol - 1]
    );

    if (!noteType) {
      continue;
    }

    var syntheticOutputRow;

    if (
      fullSourceInfo &&
      fullSourceInfo.headerRow === headerInfo.headerRow
    ) {
      syntheticOutputRow = RSC_UR_mapSourceRowToOutput_(
        rows[i],
        fullSourceInfo.columnMap
      );
    } else {
      syntheticOutputRow = [];

      for (var c = 0; c < cfg.sourceColumnCount; c++) {
        syntheticOutputRow.push('');
      }

      syntheticOutputRow[2] = rows[i][cols.customerId];
      syntheticOutputRow[3] = rows[i][cols.relationship];
      syntheticOutputRow[4] = rows[i][cols.salesmanId];
      syntheticOutputRow[6] = rows[i][cols.validFrom];
      syntheticOutputRow[9] = rows[i][cols.visitType];
      syntheticOutputRow[11] = rows[i][cols.visitValidFrom];
    }

    if (!String(syntheticOutputRow[2] || '').trim()) {
      continue;
    }

    var rowKey = RSC_UR_makeBusinessRowKey_(syntheticOutputRow);
    statusMap[rowKey] = RSC_UR_strongerHighlightType_(
      statusMap[rowKey],
      noteType
    );
  }

  return statusMap;
}


function RSC_UR_isAdditionalNote_(value) {
  return RSC_UR_getHighlightTypeFromNote_(value) ===
    RSC_UR_20260721.highlightAdditionText;
}


function RSC_UR_isAdditionalFlag_(value) {
  return RSC_UR_normalizeHighlightType_(value) ===
    RSC_UR_20260721.highlightAdditionText;
}


function RSC_UR_rowHasAdditionalBackground_(backgroundRow) {
  return RSC_UR_detectHighlightTypeFromBackground_(backgroundRow) ===
    RSC_UR_20260721.highlightAdditionText;
}



function RSC_UR_getHighlightTypeFromNote_(value) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var normalized = RSC_UR_keyPart_(value);
  var additions = cfg.additionalNoteMarkers || ['TAMBAHAN'];
  var changes = cfg.changeNoteMarkers || ['PERUBAHAN'];
  var i;

  for (i = 0; i < additions.length; i++) {
    var additionMarker = RSC_UR_keyPart_(additions[i]);

    if (additionMarker && normalized.indexOf(additionMarker) >= 0) {
      return cfg.highlightAdditionText;
    }
  }

  for (i = 0; i < changes.length; i++) {
    var changeMarker = RSC_UR_keyPart_(changes[i]);

    if (changeMarker && normalized.indexOf(changeMarker) >= 0) {
      return cfg.highlightChangeText;
    }
  }

  return '';
}


function RSC_UR_normalizeHighlightType_(value) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var normalized = RSC_UR_keyPart_(value);

  if (
    normalized === RSC_UR_keyPart_(cfg.highlightAdditionText) ||
    normalized === 'TAMBAHAN' ||
    normalized === 'ADDITION' ||
    normalized === 'ADDED'
  ) {
    return cfg.highlightAdditionText;
  }

  if (
    normalized === RSC_UR_keyPart_(cfg.highlightChangeText) ||
    normalized === 'PERUBAHAN' ||
    normalized === 'BERUBAH' ||
    normalized === 'CHANGED'
  ) {
    return cfg.highlightChangeText;
  }

  return '';
}


function RSC_UR_strongerHighlightType_(left, right) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var a = RSC_UR_normalizeHighlightType_(left);
  var b = RSC_UR_normalizeHighlightType_(right);

  // Penambahan lebih kuat daripada perubahan.
  if (a === cfg.highlightAdditionText || b === cfg.highlightAdditionText) {
    return cfg.highlightAdditionText;
  }

  if (a === cfg.highlightChangeText || b === cfg.highlightChangeText) {
    return cfg.highlightChangeText;
  }

  return '';
}


function RSC_UR_getBackgroundForHighlightType_(highlightType) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var normalized = RSC_UR_normalizeHighlightType_(highlightType);

  if (normalized === cfg.highlightAdditionText) {
    return cfg.additionRowBackground;
  }

  if (normalized === cfg.highlightChangeText) {
    return cfg.changeRowBackground;
  }

  return cfg.defaultOutputRowBackground;
}


function RSC_UR_detectHighlightTypeFromBackground_(backgroundRow) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var yellow = String(cfg.additionRowBackground || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  var blue = String(cfg.changeRowBackground || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  var foundBlue = false;

  for (var i = 0; i < backgroundRow.length; i++) {
    var color = String(backgroundRow[i] || '').trim().toUpperCase();

    if (color === yellow) {
      return cfg.highlightAdditionText;
    }

    if (color === blue) {
      foundBlue = true;
    }
  }

  return foundBlue ? cfg.highlightChangeText : '';
}


function RSC_UR_findSourceSheet_(ss) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var exact = ss.getSheetByName(cfg.sourceSheetName);

  if (exact) {
    return exact;
  }

  var sheets = ss.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (
      RSC_UR_normalizeHeader_(sheets[i].getName())
        .indexOf('template revamp rolling sales') >= 0
    ) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function RSC_UR_getSourceHeaderAliases_() {
  return [
    ['Sales Office', 'sls_office', 'sales_office'],
    ['Delivering Plant', 'delivering_plant', 'plant'],
    ['Customer ID', 'BP ID', 'bp_id', 'customer_id'],
    ['Relationship', 'relationship_type', 'rel type', 'rel_type'],
    ['Salesman ID', 'salesman_id', 'salesman'],
    ['Salesman BP Type', 'salesman_bp_type', 'BP Type', 'bp_type'],
    ['Valid From', 'valid_from'],
    ['Valid To', 'valid_to'],
    ['Visit Category', 'visit_category'],
    ['Visit Type', 'visit_type'],
    ['Schedule Visit', 'schedule_visit', 'schedule'],
    ['Visit Valid From', 'visit_valid_from'],
    ['Visit Valid To', 'visit_valid_to'],
    ['Change Schedule Only', 'change_schedule_only'],
    ['Sales Office Source', 'sales_office_source']
  ];
}


function RSC_UR_buildSourceColumnMap_(headerRow) {
  var aliases = RSC_UR_getSourceHeaderAliases_();
  var columnMap = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < aliases.length; i++) {
    columnMap.push(RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(headerRow, aliases[i]));
  }

  return columnMap;
}


function RSC_UR_findSourceHeader_(sheet) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
  var lastCol = sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (!lastRow || !lastCol) {
    throw new Error('Sheet sumber kosong: ' + sheet.getName());
  }

  // Baca seluruh lebar header yang wajar. Source lama bisa berisi 14 kolom
  // karena Relationship tidak tersedia; source baru memakai 15 kolom.
  var headerReadWidth = Math.min(100, Math.max(cfg.sourceColumnCount, lastCol));
  var grid = sheet.getRange(
    1,
    1,
    Math.min(100, lastRow),
    headerReadWidth
  ).getDisplayValues();

  for (var r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    var columnMap = RSC_UR_buildSourceColumnMap_(grid[r]);

    // Relationship sengaja tidak diwajibkan karena sebagian template lama
    // memang tidak mempunyai kolom tersebut. Kolom yang hilang akan diisi blank.
    var requiredOutputIndexes = [0, 2, 4, 6, 9, 11];
    var complete = true;

    for (var x = 0; x < requiredOutputIndexes.length; x++) {
      if (columnMap[requiredOutputIndexes[x]] < 0) {
        complete = false;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (complete) {
      var maxMappedIndex = -1;

      for (var m = 0; m < columnMap.length; m++) {
        if (columnMap[m] > maxMappedIndex) {
          maxMappedIndex = columnMap[m];
        }
      }

      return {
        headerRow: r + 1,
        dataStartRow: r + 2,
        columnMap: columnMap,
        readWidth: Math.max(1, maxMappedIndex + 1)
      };
    }
  }

  throw new Error(
    'Header Template Revamp Rolling Sales tidak lengkap. Wajib ada Sales Office, ' +
    'Customer ID, Salesman ID, Valid From, Visit Type, dan Visit Valid From.'
  );
}


function RSC_UR_mapSourceRowToOutput_(sourceRow, columnMap) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var output = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < cfg.sourceColumnCount; i++) {
    var sourceIndex = columnMap && columnMap.length > i
      ? Number(columnMap[i])
      : i;

    output.push(
      sourceIndex >= 0 && sourceRow && sourceRow[sourceIndex] != null
        ? String(sourceRow[sourceIndex]).trim()
        : ''
    );
  }

  output = RSC_UR_normalizeOutputRow_(output);

  // Safety net untuk data yang header-nya sudah 15 kolom tetapi isi barisnya
  // pernah ditempel tanpa blank Relationship, sehingga D:O bergeser ke kiri.
  return RSC_UR_repairShiftedOutputRowValues_(output);
}


function RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(row, aliases) {
  var targets = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < aliases.length; i++) {
    targets[RSC_UR_normalizeHeader_(aliases[i])] = true;
  }

  for (var c = 0; c < row.length; c++) {
    if (targets[RSC_UR_normalizeHeader_(row[c])]) {
      return c;
    }
  }

  return -1;
}


function RSC_UR_normalizeHeader_(value) {
  return String(value == null ? '' : value)
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[_-]+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}


function RSC_UR_extractCode_(value) {
  return String(value == null ? '' : value)
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+-\s+|\s+/)[0]
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase();
}


function RSC_UR_isIsoDateLike_(value) {
  var text = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
  return /^\d{4}[-\/]\d{1,2}[-\/]\d{1,2}$/.test(text);
}


function RSC_UR_isLikelyShiftedRelationshipRow_(row) {
  var normalized = RSC_UR_normalizeOutputRow_(row);
  var relationshipCell = String(normalized[3] || '').trim();
  var salesmanBpTypeCell = String(normalized[4] || '').trim();
  var shiftedValidFrom = String(normalized[5] || '').trim();
  var shiftedValidTo = String(normalized[6] || '').trim();
  var shiftedVisitCategory = String(normalized[7] || '').trim();
  var shiftedVisitType = String(normalized[8] || '').trim();
  var shiftedSchedule = String(normalized[9] || '').trim();
  var shiftedVisitValidFrom = String(normalized[10] || '').trim();
  var shiftedVisitValidTo = String(normalized[11] || '').trim();
  var finalCell = String(normalized[14] || '').trim();

  return Boolean(
    /^S[A-Z0-9]{5,}$/i.test(relationshipCell) &&
    /^Z[A-Z0-9]{2,}$/i.test(salesmanBpTypeCell) &&
    RSC_UR_isIsoDateLike_(shiftedValidFrom) &&
    RSC_UR_isIsoDateLike_(shiftedValidTo) &&
    /^F[A-Z0-9]+$/i.test(shiftedVisitCategory) &&
    /^\d{1,2}$/.test(shiftedVisitType) &&
    (/^W\d/i.test(shiftedSchedule) || shiftedSchedule.indexOf(',') >= 0) &&
    RSC_UR_isIsoDateLike_(shiftedVisitValidFrom) &&
    RSC_UR_isIsoDateLike_(shiftedVisitValidTo) &&
    !finalCell
  );
}


function RSC_UR_repairShiftedOutputRowValues_(row) {
  var normalized = RSC_UR_normalizeOutputRow_(row);

  if (!RSC_UR_isLikelyShiftedRelationshipRow_(normalized)) {
    return normalized;
  }

  var repaired = normalized.slice(0);

  // Source lama kehilangan Relationship. Sisipkan blank pada D dan geser
  // nilai D:N lama ke E:O. Nilai O lama dibuang karena merupakan overflow blank.
  repaired[3] = '';

  for (var c = 4; c < RSC_UR_20260721.sourceColumnCount; c++) {
    repaired[c] = normalized[c - 1];
  }

  repaired[9] = RSC_UR_normalizeVisitType_(repaired[9]);
  return repaired;
}


function RSC_UR_repairShiftedOutputRows_(sheet) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;

  if (!sheet) {
    return 0;
  }

  RSC_UR_ensureOutputSheetStructure_(sheet);

  var rowCount = Math.max(0, sheet.getLastRow() - cfg.outputHeaderRow);

  if (rowCount < 1) {
    return 0;
  }

  var range = sheet.getRange(
    cfg.outputDataStartRow,
    1,
    rowCount,
    cfg.sourceColumnCount
  );
  var rows = range.getDisplayValues();
  var repairedCount = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    if (RSC_UR_isLikelyShiftedRelationshipRow_(rows[i])) {
      rows[i] = RSC_UR_repairShiftedOutputRowValues_(rows[i]);
      repairedCount++;
    }
  }

  if (repairedCount > 0) {
    range.setNumberFormat('@').setValues(rows);
  }

  return repairedCount;
}


function RSC_UR_normalizeOutputRow_(row) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var output = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < cfg.sourceColumnCount; i++) {
    output.push(String(row && row[i] != null ? row[i] : '').trim());
  }

  output[0] = RSC_UR_extractCode_(output[0]);
  output[9] = RSC_UR_normalizeVisitType_(output[9]);

  return output;
}


function RSC_UR_normalizeVisitType_(value) {
  var text = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();

  if (!text) {
    return '';
  }

  var numericMatch = text.match(/^(\d+)(?:\.0+)?$/);

  if (numericMatch) {
    return numericMatch[1].padStart(2, '0');
  }

  return text;
}


function RSC_UR_getSpreadsheetIdFromCell_(cell) {
  var richText = cell.getRichTextValue();

  if (richText) {
    var wholeUrl = richText.getLinkUrl();

    if (wholeUrl) {
      return RSC_UR_extractSpreadsheetId_(wholeUrl);
    }

    var runs = richText.getRuns();

    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var runUrl = runs[i].getLinkUrl();

      if (runUrl) {
        return RSC_UR_extractSpreadsheetId_(runUrl);
      }
    }
  }

  var candidates = [
    cell.getFormula(),
    cell.getValue(),
    cell.getDisplayValue()
  ];

  for (var x = 0; x < candidates.length; x++) {
    var text = String(candidates[x] == null ? '' : candidates[x]).trim();

    if (!text) {
      continue;
    }

    var extracted = RSC_UR_extractSpreadsheetId_(text);

    if (extracted) {
      return extracted;
    }

    if (/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{25,}$/.test(text) && text.indexOf('/') === -1) {
      return text;
    }
  }

  return '';
}


function RSC_UR_extractSpreadsheetId_(value) {
  var text = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
  var match =
    text.match(/\/spreadsheets\/d\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/) ||
    text.match(/[?&]id=([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/);

  return match ? match[1] : '';
}


/***************************************************************
 * COMPARISON / NAME HELPERS
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_UR_rowHasAnyValue_(row) {
  for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    if (String(row[i] == null ? '' : row[i]).trim() !== '') {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}


function RSC_UR_rowsEqual_(left, right) {
  if (!left || !right || left.length !== right.length) {
    return false;
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < left.length; i++) {
    if (
      String(left[i] == null ? '' : left[i]).trim() !==
      String(right[i] == null ? '' : right[i]).trim()
    ) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  return true;
}


function RSC_UR_safeSheetName_(value) {
  var text = String(value || 'UPLOAD READY')
    .replace(/[\\\/\?\*\[\]:]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();

  return (text || 'UPLOAD READY').substring(0, 99);
}


function RSC_UR_getSheetById_(ss, sheetId) {
  var sheets = ss.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (String(sheets[i].getSheetId()) === String(sheetId)) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/***************************************************************
 * RESET
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_UR_RESET_DELETE_ALL_AND_RERUN_20260721() {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var lock = LockService.getUserLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(10000)) {
    try {
      SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
        'Reset belum dapat dimulai karena job masih memakai lock.',
        'Compile Upload Ready',
        10
      );
    } catch (ignoreToast) {}
    return;
  }

  try {
    var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
    var targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(cfg.targetSpreadsheetId);
    var technicalSs = RSC_UR_getOrCreateTechnicalSpreadsheet_(props);

    props.deleteProperty(cfg.jobProperty);
    props.deleteProperty(cfg.lastStatusProperty);
    props.deleteProperty('RSC_UR_JOB_20260721');
    props.deleteProperty('RSC_UR_LAST_20260721');
    RSC_UR_deleteTriggersByHandler_(cfg.workerHandler);

    RSC_UR_deleteAllManagedOutput_(targetSs, technicalSs);

    try {
      SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
        'Semua output managed telah dihapus. Compile ulang dimulai.',
        'Compile Upload Ready',
        10
      );
    } catch (ignoreToast2) {}
  } finally {
    try {
      lock.releaseLock();
    } catch (ignore) {}
  }

  RSC_UR_START_20260721();
}


function RSC_UR_deleteAllManagedOutput_(targetSs, technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var indexSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.indexSheetName);
  var outputNames = {};
  var keyNames = {};

  if (indexSh && indexSh.getLastRow() >= 2) {
    var rows = indexSh.getRange(
      2,
      1,
      indexSh.getLastRow() - 1,
      3
    ).getDisplayValues();

    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      if (rows[i][1]) {
        outputNames[String(rows[i][1]).trim()] = true;
      }
      if (rows[i][2]) {
        keyNames[String(rows[i][2]).trim()] = true;
      }
    }
  }

  // Tangkap output legacy walau index lama rusak.
  var targetSheets = targetSs.getSheets();

  for (var s = 0; s < targetSheets.length; s++) {
    var sh = targetSheets[s];

    if (
      sh.getMaxRows() >= 2 &&
      sh.getMaxColumns() >= cfg.legacyTechnicalRunIdCol
    ) {
      var headers = sh.getRange(
        2,
        cfg.legacyTechnicalKeyCol,
        1,
        2
      ).getDisplayValues()[0];

      if (
        String(headers[0] || '').trim() === cfg.legacyTechnicalKeyHeader &&
        String(headers[1] || '').trim() === cfg.legacyTechnicalRunIdHeader
      ) {
        outputNames[sh.getName()] = true;
      }
    }
  }

  var outputToDelete = Object.keys(outputNames);

  if (
    outputToDelete.length >= targetSs.getSheets().length &&
    !targetSs.getSheetByName(cfg.resetHoldSheetName)
  ) {
    var template = RSC_UR_ensureOutputTemplate_(targetSs);
    try {
      template.showSheet();
    } catch (ignoreShow) {}
  }

  for (var x = 0; x < outputToDelete.length; x++) {
    var outputSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(outputToDelete[x]);
    if (outputSh && outputSh.getName() !== cfg.outputTemplateSheetName) {
      targetSs.deleteSheet(outputSh);
    }
  }

  var keyToDelete = Object.keys(keyNames);

  for (var k = 0; k < keyToDelete.length; k++) {
    var keySh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(keyToDelete[k]);
    if (keySh) {
      technicalSs.deleteSheet(keySh);
    }
  }

  [
    cfg.stageSheetName,
    cfg.needsSheetName,
    cfg.mapSheetName,
    cfg.queueSheetName,
    cfg.groupsSheetName,
    cfg.indexSheetName
  ].forEach(function (name) {
    var sh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(name);
    if (sh && technicalSs.getSheets().length > 1) {
      technicalSs.deleteSheet(sh);
    }
  });

  RSC_UR_ensureTechnicalIndex_(technicalSs);
  RSC_UR_cleanseSpreadsheet_(targetSs, 'TARGET');
  RSC_UR_cleanseSpreadsheet_(technicalSs, 'TECHNICAL');
}
