function RSC_UR_STOP_20260721() {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var rawJob = props.getProperty(cfg.jobProperty);

  if (rawJob) {
    try {
      var job = JSON.parse(rawJob);
      job.stats.phase = 'STOPPED';
      job.stats.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      props.setProperty(cfg.lastStatusProperty, JSON.stringify(job.stats));
    } catch (ignore) {}
  }

  props.deleteProperty(cfg.jobProperty);
  props.deleteProperty('RSC_UR_JOB_20260721');
  props.deleteProperty('RSC_UR_LAST_20260721');
  RSC_UR_deleteTriggersByHandler_(cfg.workerHandler);

  try {
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
      'Job Compile Upload Ready dihentikan.',
      'Compile Upload Ready',
      8
    );
  } catch (ignoreToast) {}
}


function RSC_UR_finishJob_(job, targetSs, technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();

  job.stats.staleCleanupEnabled = Boolean(job.allowStaleCleanup);
  RSC_UR_refreshFinalOutputStats_(job, targetSs, technicalSs);
  RSC_UR_deleteTemporaryTechnicalSheets_(technicalSs);

  var isActiveSheetMode = job.sourceMode === 'ACTIVE_SHEET';
  var targetCleanse = isActiveSheetMode
    ? {rowsDeleted: 0, columnsDeleted: 0}
    : RSC_UR_cleanseSpreadsheet_(targetSs, 'TARGET');
  var technicalCleanse = RSC_UR_cleanseSpreadsheet_(technicalSs, 'TECHNICAL');

  job.stats.cleansedRows += targetCleanse.rowsDeleted + technicalCleanse.rowsDeleted;
  job.stats.cleansedColumns += targetCleanse.columnsDeleted + technicalCleanse.columnsDeleted;
  job.stats.targetCellsAfterCleanse = isActiveSheetMode
    ? 0
    : RSC_UR_countAllocatedCells_(targetSs);
  job.stats.technicalCellsAfterCleanse = RSC_UR_countAllocatedCells_(technicalSs);

  job.stats.phase = 'DONE';
  job.stats.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();

  props.setProperty(cfg.lastStatusProperty, JSON.stringify(job.stats));
  props.deleteProperty(cfg.jobProperty);
  props.deleteProperty('RSC_UR_JOB_20260721');
  props.deleteProperty('RSC_UR_LAST_20260721');
  RSC_UR_deleteTriggersByHandler_(cfg.workerHandler);

  RSC_UR_hideTechnicalSheets_(technicalSs);

  try {
    var finishTitle = job.sourceMode === 'ACTIVE_SHEET'
      ? 'Export Active Sheet'
      : 'Compile Upload Ready';
    var finishPrefix = job.sourceMode === 'ACTIVE_SHEET'
      ? 'Export sheet aktif selesai. '
      : 'Compile selesai. ';

    var finishMessage;

    if (job.sourceMode === 'ACTIVE_SHEET') {
      finishMessage =
        finishPrefix +
        'groups=' + Number(job.stats.activeOutputGroupsProcessed || 0) +
        ', source rows=' + Number(job.stats.collectedSourceRows || 0) +
        ', inserted=' + Number(job.stats.insertedRows || 0) +
        ', updated=' + Number(job.stats.updatedRows || 0) +
        ', unchanged=' + Number(job.stats.unchangedRows || 0) +
        ', unmatched=' + Number(job.stats.unmatchedRows || 0) +
        ', duplicate sheets deleted=' + Number(job.stats.duplicateSheetsDeleted || 0) + '.';
    } else {
      finishMessage =
        finishPrefix +
        'sheets=' + Number(job.stats.outputSheets || 0) +
        ', rows=' + Number(job.stats.outputRows || 0) +
        ', inserted=' + Number(job.stats.insertedRows || 0) +
        ', updated=' + Number(job.stats.updatedRows || 0) +
        ', stale removed=' + Number(job.stats.removedStaleRows || 0) +
        ', obsolete sheets deleted=' +
        Number(job.stats.deletedObsoleteSheets || 0) + '.';
    }

    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
      finishMessage,
      finishTitle,
      10
    );
  } catch (ignoreToast) {}
}


function RSC_UR_refreshFinalOutputStats_(job, targetSs, technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var indexSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.indexSheetName);
  var sheetCount = 0;
  var rowCount = 0;

  if (indexSh && indexSh.getLastRow() >= 2) {
    var names = indexSh.getRange(
      2,
      2,
      indexSh.getLastRow() - 1,
      1
    ).getDisplayValues();

    for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
      var name = String(names[i][0] || '').trim();
      var sh = name ? targetSs.getSheetByName(name) : null;

      if (sh) {
        sheetCount++;
        rowCount += Math.max(0, sh.getLastRow() - cfg.outputHeaderRow);
      }
    }
  }

  job.stats.outputSheets = sheetCount;
  job.stats.outputRows = rowCount;
}


function RSC_UR_deleteTemporaryTechnicalSheets_(technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;

  [
    cfg.stageSheetName,
    cfg.needsSheetName,
    cfg.mapSheetName,
    cfg.queueSheetName,
    cfg.groupsSheetName
  ].forEach(function (name) {
    var sh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(name);

    if (sh && technicalSs.getSheets().length > 1) {
      technicalSs.deleteSheet(sh);
    }
  });
}




/***************************************************************
 * COMPILE KHUSUS ST / RL — PATCH 13 (2026-07-28)
 *
 * FILTER SUMBER
 * - RL: Customer ID (C) DAN Salesman ID (E) harus sama-sama diawali S.
 * - ST: ambil semua row yang memiliki Salesman ID.
 *
 * JOIN / GROUPING
 * - RL hanya mengambil row ketika Customer ID C dan Salesman ID E
 *   sama-sama berawalan S.
 * - Entity BP RL = Customer ID.
 * - Entity BP ST = Salesman ID.
 * - BP Type = m_bp_general_view.bp_type_id.
 * - Sls Org / Sls Office = m_sales_info berdasarkan salesman_id.
 * - Dist Channel / Division = default 12 / 11.
 *
 * OUTPUT
 * - RL tepat 11 kolom.
 * - ST tepat 7 kolom.
 * - Upsert/purge memakai business key yang ditentukan user.
 * - Summary per Sales Office + link sheet + XLSX + ZIP.
 ***************************************************************/

function RSC_UR_STRL_resolveMaster_() {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var activeSs = null;

  try {
    activeSs = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  } catch (ignoreActive) {}

  if (activeSs) {
    var activeSheet = RSC_UR_STRL_getSheetByNormalizedName_(
      activeSs,
      cfg.stRlMasterSheetName
    );

    if (activeSheet) {
      return {
        spreadsheet: activeSs,
        sheet: activeSheet
      };
    }
  }

  var configuredSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(cfg.stRlMasterSpreadsheetId);
  var configuredSheet = RSC_UR_STRL_getSheetByNormalizedName_(
    configuredSs,
    cfg.stRlMasterSheetName
  );

  if (!configuredSheet && cfg.stRlMasterSheetId != null) {
    var byId = RSC_UR_getSheetById_(configuredSs, cfg.stRlMasterSheetId);

    /*
     * Jangan langsung memakai gid=0 apabila sheet tersebut bukan manifest.
     * Fallback ID lama hanya diterima jika header link benar-benar terdeteksi.
     */
    if (byId) {
      try {
        RSC_UR_STRL_findManifestMeta_(byId);
        configuredSheet = byId;
      } catch (ignoreWrongSheetId) {}
    }
  }

  if (!configuredSheet) {
    throw new Error(
      'Sheet master "' + cfg.stRlMasterSheetName +
      '" tidak ditemukan pada spreadsheet aktif maupun spreadsheet konfigurasi ' +
      cfg.stRlMasterSpreadsheetId + '.'
    );
  }

  return {
    spreadsheet: configuredSs,
    sheet: configuredSheet
  };
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_getSheetByNormalizedName_(ss, expectedName) {
  if (!ss) {
    return null;
  }

  var exact = ss.getSheetByName(expectedName);

  if (exact) {
    return exact;
  }

  var expected = RSC_UR_normalizeHeader_(expectedName);
  var sheets = ss.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (RSC_UR_normalizeHeader_(sheets[i].getName()) === expected) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_findManifestMeta_(sheet) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var lastRow = Math.max(1, sheet.getLastRow());
  var lastCol = Math.max(1, sheet.getLastColumn());
  var rowsToRead = Math.min(
    Number(cfg.stRlMasterHeaderSearchRows || 40),
    lastRow
  );
  var colsToRead = Math.min(
    Number(cfg.stRlMasterHeaderSearchCols || 20),
    lastCol
  );
  var grid = sheet.getRange(
    1,
    1,
    rowsToRead,
    colsToRead
  ).getDisplayValues();

  var aliases = cfg.stRlManifestHeaderAliases || [];
  var normalizedAliases = aliases.map(function (value) {
    return RSC_UR_normalizeHeader_(value);
  });
  var configuredLinkCol = Number(cfg.stRlMasterLinkCol || 5);
  var candidates = [];

  /*
   * Jangan mengembalikan kandidat pertama.
   *
   * Pada Rekap Approved terdapat dua header yang sangat mirip:
   * D = Template Rolling Sales (JANGAN GUNAKAN LINK DISINI)
   * E = Template Rolling Sales FINAL (GUNAKAN LINK DISINI)
   *
   * Versi lama menganggap kata "gunakan link" pada header D sebagai match
   * dan langsung berhenti di kolom D. Semua kandidat sekarang diberi skor,
   * header larangan ditolak, dan kandidat FINAL kolom E selalu diprioritaskan.
   */
  for (var r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    for (var c = 0; c < grid[r].length; c++) {
      var rawHeader = String(grid[r][c] || '').trim();
      var normalized = RSC_UR_normalizeHeader_(rawHeader);

      if (!normalized) {
        continue;
      }

      var isForbidden =
        normalized.indexOf('jangan gunakan') >= 0 ||
        normalized.indexOf('jangan dipakai') >= 0 ||
        normalized.indexOf('do not use') >= 0 ||
        normalized.indexOf('tidak digunakan') >= 0;

      if (isForbidden) {
        continue;
      }

      var score = 0;
      var aliasIndex = normalizedAliases.indexOf(normalized);

      if (aliasIndex >= 0) {
        // Exact alias merupakan sinyal terkuat.
        score = 1000 - aliasIndex;
      } else {
        var hasTemplateRolling =
          normalized.indexOf('template rolling sales') >= 0;
        var hasFinal = normalized.indexOf('final') >= 0;
        var hasUseLink =
          normalized.indexOf('gunakan link') >= 0 ||
          normalized.indexOf('use this') >= 0;

        if (hasTemplateRolling && hasFinal && hasUseLink) {
          score = 900;
        } else if (hasTemplateRolling && hasFinal) {
          score = 800;
        } else if (hasFinal && hasUseLink) {
          score = 700;
        }
      }

      if (!score) {
        continue;
      }

      // Kolom konfigurasi E mendapat bonus, tetapi tidak mengalahkan larangan.
      if (c + 1 === configuredLinkCol) {
        score += 100;
      }

      candidates.push({
        score: score,
        headerRow: r + 1,
        dataStartRow: r + 2,
        linkCol: c + 1,
        headerText: rawHeader
      });
    }
  }

  if (candidates.length) {
    candidates.sort(function (a, b) {
      if (b.score !== a.score) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      }

      // Jika skor sama, prioritaskan kolom konfigurasi lalu kandidat paling kanan.
      var aConfigured = a.linkCol === configuredLinkCol ? 1 : 0;
      var bConfigured = b.linkCol === configuredLinkCol ? 1 : 0;

      if (bConfigured !== aConfigured) {
        return bConfigured - aConfigured;
      }

      return b.linkCol - a.linkCol;
    });

    return {
      headerRow: candidates[0].headerRow,
      dataStartRow: candidates[0].dataStartRow,
      linkCol: candidates[0].linkCol,
      headerText: candidates[0].headerText
    };
  }

  /*
   * Fallback kompatibilitas: hanya kolom konfigurasi E dan hanya bila
   * ditemukan minimal satu ID Google Spreadsheet dari display/value/formula/
   * rich text. Tidak pernah fallback ke kolom D.
   */
  var fallbackCol = configuredLinkCol;

  if (fallbackCol <= lastCol && lastRow >= cfg.stRlMasterFirstDataRow) {
    var sampleRows = Math.min(
      250,
      lastRow - cfg.stRlMasterFirstDataRow + 1
    );
    var sampleRange = sheet.getRange(
      cfg.stRlMasterFirstDataRow,
      fallbackCol,
      sampleRows,
      1
    );
    var sampleDisplays = sampleRange.getDisplayValues();
    var sampleValues = sampleRange.getValues();
    var sampleFormulas = sampleRange.getFormulas();
    var sampleRichTexts = sampleRange.getRichTextValues();

    for (var i = 0; i < sampleRows; i++) {
      var spreadsheetId = RSC_UR_STRL_extractSpreadsheetIdFromBatchCell_(
        sampleRichTexts[i][0],
        sampleFormulas[i][0],
        sampleValues[i][0],
        sampleDisplays[i][0]
      );

      if (spreadsheetId) {
        return {
          headerRow: Math.max(1, cfg.stRlMasterFirstDataRow - 1),
          dataStartRow: cfg.stRlMasterFirstDataRow,
          linkCol: fallbackCol,
          headerText: 'FALLBACK FINAL COLUMN ' + fallbackCol
        };
      }
    }
  }

  throw new Error(
    'Header manifest FINAL tidak ditemukan pada sheet "' +
    sheet.getName() +
    '". Wajib memakai kolom E "Template Rolling Sales FINAL ' +
    '(GUNAKAN LINK DISINI)", bukan kolom D.'
  );
}

function RSC_UR_STRL_findManifestLastRow_(sheet, meta) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var physicalLastRow = Math.max(0, sheet.getLastRow());
  var dataStartRow = Number(meta && meta.dataStartRow || cfg.stRlMasterFirstDataRow || 2);

  if (physicalLastRow < dataStartRow) {
    return dataStartRow - 1;
  }

  var salesOfficeCol = Number(cfg.stRlMasterSalesOfficeCol || 1);
  var linkCol = Number(meta && meta.linkCol || cfg.stRlMasterLinkCol || 5);
  var statusCol = Number(cfg.stRlMasterStatusCol || 6);
  var readWidth = Math.max(salesOfficeCol, linkCol, statusCol);
  var blockSize = 500;

  /*
   * Google Sheets dapat memiliki getLastRow() jauh di bawah data manifest
   * akibat formula kosong, style, atau bekas paste. Cari mundur berdasarkan
   * tiga kolom manifest yang benar-benar bermakna: Sales Office, link, status.
   */
  for (var blockEnd = physicalLastRow; blockEnd >= dataStartRow; blockEnd -= blockSize) {
    var blockStart = Math.max(dataStartRow, blockEnd - blockSize + 1);
    var values = sheet.getRange(
      blockStart,
      1,
      blockEnd - blockStart + 1,
      readWidth
    ).getDisplayValues();

    for (var r = values.length - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
      var salesOffice = String(values[r][salesOfficeCol - 1] || '').trim();
      var linkValue = String(values[r][linkCol - 1] || '').trim();
      var status = String(values[r][statusCol - 1] || '').trim();

      if (salesOffice || linkValue || status) {
        return blockStart + r;
      }
    }
  }

  return dataStartRow - 1;
}



function RSC_UR_STRL_isManifestPlaceholder_(value) {
  var text = String(value == null ? '' : value)
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase();

  if (!text) {
    return false;
  }

  return (
    text.indexOf('COPY_ERROR:') === 0 ||
    text.indexOf('REPLACE DISINI') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('TIDAK ADA ROLLING') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('KOLOM E KOSONG') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('BUKAN LINK GOOGLE SHEET') >= 0
  );
}



function RSC_UR_DIAGNOSE_ST_RL_20260728() {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var resolved = RSC_UR_STRL_resolveMaster_();
  var masterSs = resolved.spreadsheet;
  var masterSh = resolved.sheet;
  var meta = RSC_UR_STRL_findManifestMeta_(masterSh);
  var lastRow = RSC_UR_STRL_findManifestLastRow_(masterSh, meta);
  var validIds = {};
  var validCount = 0;
  var duplicateCount = 0;
  var blankCount = 0;
  var placeholderCount = 0;
  var invalidCount = 0;
  var rowsCovered = 0;
  var samples = [];
  var detailRows = [];

  var cursor = meta.dataStartRow;

  while (cursor <= lastRow) {
    var count = Math.min(500, lastRow - cursor + 1);
    var width = Math.max(
      Number(cfg.stRlMasterSalesOfficeCol || 1),
      Number(meta.linkCol),
      Number(cfg.stRlMasterStatusCol || 6)
    );
    var masterValues = masterSh.getRange(cursor, 1, count, width)
      .getDisplayValues();
    var range = masterSh.getRange(cursor, meta.linkCol, count, 1);
    var displays = range.getDisplayValues();
    var values = range.getValues();
    var formulas = range.getFormulas();
    var richTexts = range.getRichTextValues();

    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      var masterRow = cursor + i;
      var salesOffice = String(
        masterValues[i][Number(cfg.stRlMasterSalesOfficeCol || 1) - 1] || ''
      ).trim();
      var sourceStatus = String(
        masterValues[i][Number(cfg.stRlMasterStatusCol || 6) - 1] || ''
      ).trim();
      var display = String(displays[i][0] || '').trim();
      var id = RSC_UR_STRL_extractSpreadsheetIdFromBatchCell_(
        richTexts[i][0],
        formulas[i][0],
        values[i][0],
        display
      );
      var result = '';

      rowsCovered++;

      if (!display && !id) {
        blankCount++;
        result = 'SKIP_BLANK';
      } else if (!id) {
        if (RSC_UR_STRL_isManifestPlaceholder_(display)) {
          placeholderCount++;
          result = 'SKIP_PLACEHOLDER';
        } else {
          invalidCount++;
          result = 'SKIP_INVALID_LINK';
        }
      } else {
        validCount++;
        result = 'VALID_LINK';

        if (validIds[id]) {
          duplicateCount++;
          result = 'VALID_DUPLICATE_LINK';
        }

        validIds[id] = Number(validIds[id] || 0) + 1;

        if (samples.length < 10) {
          samples.push({
            row: masterRow,
            id: id,
            result: '',
            rl: '',
            st: ''
          });
        }
      }

      detailRows.push([
        masterRow,
        salesOffice,
        sourceStatus,
        display,
        id,
        result
      ]);
    }

    cursor += count;
  }

  for (var s = 0; s < samples.length; s++) {
    try {
      var sourceSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(samples[s].id);
      var rlSh = RSC_UR_STRL_findSheetByCandidates_(
        sourceSs,
        cfg.stRlRelationshipSheetNames
      );
      var stSh = RSC_UR_STRL_findSheetByCandidates_(
        sourceSs,
        cfg.stRlSalesmanTypeSheetNames
      );

      samples[s].result = sourceSs.getName();
      samples[s].rl = rlSh ? rlSh.getName() : 'MISSING — WILL SKIP RL';
      samples[s].st = stSh ? stSh.getName() : 'MISSING — WILL SKIP ST';

      if (rlSh) {
        try {
          RSC_UR_findSourceHeader_(rlSh);
          samples[s].rl += ' — HEADER OK';
        } catch (rlErr) {
          samples[s].rl += ' — READ ERROR: ' + RSC_UR_errorText_(rlErr);
        }
      }

      if (stSh) {
        try {
          RSC_UR_STRL_findSalesmanTypeHeader_(stSh);
          samples[s].st += ' — HEADER OK';
        } catch (stErr) {
          samples[s].st += ' — READ ERROR: ' + RSC_UR_errorText_(stErr);
        }
      }
    } catch (openErr) {
      samples[s].result = 'OPEN ERROR: ' + RSC_UR_errorText_(openErr);
    }
  }

  var targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(
    cfg.stRlTargetSpreadsheetId || masterSs.getId()
  );
  var reportName = 'ST RL DIAGNOSTIC';
  var reportSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(reportName);

  if (!reportSh) {
    reportSh = targetSs.insertSheet(reportName);
  } else {
    reportSh.clear();
  }

  var rows = [
    ['Metric', 'Value', '', '', '', ''],
    ['Master Spreadsheet ID', masterSs.getId(), '', '', '', ''],
    ['Master Spreadsheet Name', masterSs.getName(), '', '', '', ''],
    ['Master Sheet', masterSh.getName(), '', '', '', ''],
    ['Manifest Header Row', meta.headerRow, '', '', '', ''],
    ['Manifest Header', meta.headerText, '', '', '', ''],
    ['Manifest Link Column', meta.linkCol, '', '', '', ''],
    ['Data Start Row', meta.dataStartRow, '', '', '', ''],
    ['Manifest Last Meaningful Row', lastRow, '', '', '', ''],
    ['Manifest Rows Covered', rowsCovered, '', '', '', ''],
    ['Valid Link Rows', validCount, '', '', '', ''],
    ['Unique Spreadsheet IDs', Object.keys(validIds).length, '', '', '', ''],
    ['Duplicate Link Rows', duplicateCount, '', '', '', ''],
    ['Blank Rows', blankCount, '', '', '', ''],
    ['Placeholder / COPY_ERROR', placeholderCount, '', '', '', ''],
    ['Unexpected Invalid Values', invalidCount, '', '', '', ''],
    ['', '', '', '', '', ''],
    ['Sample Master Row', 'Spreadsheet ID', 'Open Result', 'RL Sheet', 'ST Sheet', '']
  ];

  for (var x = 0; x < samples.length; x++) {
    rows.push([
      samples[x].row,
      samples[x].id,
      samples[x].result,
      samples[x].rl,
      samples[x].st,
      ''
    ]);
  }

  rows.push(['', '', '', '', '', '']);
  rows.push([
    'Master Row',
    'Sales Office',
    'Source Status',
    'Manifest Display',
    'Spreadsheet ID',
    'Diagnostic Result'
  ]);

  Array.prototype.push.apply(rows, detailRows);

  // Defensive guard: every row written to A:F must contain exactly 6 cells.
  rows = rows.map(function (row) {
    var normalized = Array.isArray(row) ? row.slice(0, 6) : [row];
    while (normalized.length < 6) normalized.push('');
    return normalized;
  });

  if (rows.length > 0) {
    reportSh.getRange(1, 1, rows.length, 6).setValues(rows);
  }
  reportSh.setFrozenRows(1);
  reportSh.autoResizeColumns(1, 6);

  SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
    'Diagnostic selesai.\n\n' +
    'Manifest rows covered: ' + rowsCovered + '\n' +
    'Valid link rows: ' + validCount + '\n' +
    'Unique IDs: ' + Object.keys(validIds).length + '\n' +
    'Placeholder/COPY_ERROR: ' + placeholderCount + '\n' +
    'Blank: ' + blankCount + '\n' +
    'Invalid: ' + invalidCount + '\n\n' +
    'Lihat sheet "' + reportName + '" untuk detail seluruh baris.'
  );
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_extractSpreadsheetIdFromBatchCell_(
  richText,
  formula,
  value,
  displayValue
) {
  if (richText) {
    var wholeUrl = richText.getLinkUrl();

    if (wholeUrl) {
      var wholeId = RSC_UR_extractSpreadsheetId_(wholeUrl);
      if (wholeId) {
        return wholeId;
      }
    }

    var runs = richText.getRuns();

    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
      var runUrl = runs[i].getLinkUrl();
      var runId = runUrl ? RSC_UR_extractSpreadsheetId_(runUrl) : '';

      if (runId) {
        return runId;
      }
    }
  }

  var candidates = [formula, value, displayValue];

  for (var x = 0; x < candidates.length; x++) {
    var text = String(candidates[x] == null ? '' : candidates[x]).trim();

    if (!text) {
      continue;
    }

    var extracted = RSC_UR_extractSpreadsheetId_(text);

    if (extracted) {
      return extracted;
    }

    if (/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{25,}$/.test(text) && text.indexOf('/') === -1) {
      return text;
    }
  }

  return '';
}



function RSC_UR_STRL_loadManifestCountMap_(technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var sh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlManifestSheetName);
  var output = {};

  if (!sh || sh.getLastRow() < 2) {
    return output;
  }

  // Spreadsheet ID berada pada kolom E di audit manifest Patch 13.
  var rows = sh.getRange(2, 5, sh.getLastRow() - 1, 1).getDisplayValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var id = String(rows[i][0] || '').trim();

    if (id) {
      output[id] = Number(output[id] || 0) + 1;
    }
  }

  return output;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_loadManifestSet_(technicalSs) {
  var counts = RSC_UR_STRL_loadManifestCountMap_(technicalSs);
  var output = {};

  Object.keys(counts).forEach(function (id) {
    output[id] = true;
  });

  return output;
}



function RSC_UR_STRL_collectRelationshipRows_(
  job,
  technicalSs,
  sourceSpreadsheetId,
  masterRow,
  sourceSh
) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var headerInfo = RSC_UR_findSourceHeader_(sourceSh);
  var sourceLastRow = sourceSh.getLastRow();

  if (sourceLastRow < headerInfo.dataStartRow) {
    return {rowsScanned: 0, rowsMatched: 0};
  }

  var sourceRows = sourceSh.getRange(
    headerInfo.dataStartRow,
    1,
    sourceLastRow - headerInfo.dataStartRow + 1,
    headerInfo.readWidth
  ).getDisplayValues();
  var stageRows = [];
  var needRows = [];

  job.stats.sourceRowsScanned += sourceRows.length;
  job.stats.rlSourceRowsScanned += sourceRows.length;

  for (var i = 0; i < sourceRows.length; i++) {
    var fullRow = RSC_UR_normalizeOutputRow_(
      RSC_UR_mapSourceRowToOutput_(sourceRows[i], headerInfo.columnMap)
    );
    var customerId = String(fullRow[2] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    var salesmanId = String(fullRow[4] || '').trim().toUpperCase();

    /*
     * FILTER RL FINAL:
     * Customer ID kolom C DAN Salesman ID kolom E harus sama-sama
     * berawalan huruf S. Customer ID numerik tidak ikut compile RL.
     */
    if (!/^S/i.test(customerId) || !/^S/i.test(salesmanId)) {
      continue;
    }

    var outputRow = RSC_UR_STRL_projectRelationshipRow_(fullRow);
    var rowKey = RSC_UR_STRL_makeRelationshipRowKey_(outputRow);
    var sourceRowNumber = i + headerInfo.dataStartRow;

    stageRows.push([
      rowKey,
      sourceSpreadsheetId,
      String(masterRow),
      String(sourceRowNumber),
      'RL',
      customerId,
      '',
      RSC_UR_extractCode_(fullRow[0]),
      String(outputRow[4] || ''),
      String(outputRow[5] || ''),
      JSON.stringify(outputRow)
    ]);
    needRows.push([customerId]);
  }

  RSC_UR_appendRows_(
    technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlStageSheetName),
    stageRows
  );
  RSC_UR_appendRows_(
    technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlNeedsSheetName),
    needRows
  );

  job.stats.matchedSourceRows += stageRows.length;
  job.stats.rlMatchedSourceRows += stageRows.length;

  return {
    rowsScanned: sourceRows.length,
    rowsMatched: stageRows.length
  };
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_projectRelationshipRow_(fullRow) {
  return [
    String(fullRow[2] || '').trim().toUpperCase(),
    String(fullRow[3] || '').trim(),
    String(fullRow[4] || '').trim().toUpperCase(),
    String(fullRow[5] || '').trim(),
    String(fullRow[6] || '').trim(),
    String(fullRow[7] || '').trim(),
    String(fullRow[8] || '').trim(),
    RSC_UR_normalizeVisitType_(fullRow[9]),
    String(fullRow[10] || '').trim(),
    String(fullRow[11] || '').trim(),
    String(fullRow[12] || '').trim()
  ];
}



function RSC_UR_STRL_collectSalesmanTypeRows_(
  job,
  technicalSs,
  sourceSpreadsheetId,
  masterRow,
  sourceSh
) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var headerInfo = RSC_UR_STRL_findSalesmanTypeHeader_(sourceSh);
  var sourceLastRow = sourceSh.getLastRow();

  if (sourceLastRow < headerInfo.dataStartRow) {
    return {rowsScanned: 0, rowsMatched: 0};
  }

  var sourceRows = sourceSh.getRange(
    headerInfo.dataStartRow,
    1,
    sourceLastRow - headerInfo.dataStartRow + 1,
    headerInfo.readWidth
  ).getDisplayValues();
  var stageRows = [];
  var needRows = [];

  job.stats.sourceRowsScanned += sourceRows.length;
  job.stats.stSourceRowsScanned += sourceRows.length;

  for (var i = 0; i < sourceRows.length; i++) {
    var outputRow = RSC_UR_STRL_mapSalesmanTypeRow_(
      sourceRows[i],
      headerInfo.columnMap
    );
    var salesmanId = String(outputRow[0] || '').trim().toUpperCase();

    // ST mengambil semua row yang memiliki Salesman ID.
    if (!salesmanId) {
      continue;
    }

    var sourceSalesOrg = String(outputRow[1] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    var sourceSalesOffice = RSC_UR_extractCode_(outputRow[2]);
    var rowKey = RSC_UR_STRL_makeSalesmanTypeRowKey_(outputRow);
    var sourceRowNumber = i + headerInfo.dataStartRow;

    stageRows.push([
      rowKey,
      sourceSpreadsheetId,
      String(masterRow),
      String(sourceRowNumber),
      'ST',
      salesmanId,
      sourceSalesOrg,
      sourceSalesOffice,
      String(outputRow[5] || ''),
      String(outputRow[6] || ''),
      JSON.stringify(outputRow)
    ]);
    needRows.push([salesmanId]);
  }

  RSC_UR_appendRows_(
    technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlStageSheetName),
    stageRows
  );
  RSC_UR_appendRows_(
    technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlNeedsSheetName),
    needRows
  );

  job.stats.matchedSourceRows += stageRows.length;
  job.stats.stMatchedSourceRows += stageRows.length;

  return {
    rowsScanned: sourceRows.length,
    rowsMatched: stageRows.length
  };
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_findSheetByCandidates_(ss, candidateNames) {
  candidateNames = candidateNames || [];
  var normalizedCandidates = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < candidateNames.length; i++) {
    var exact = ss.getSheetByName(candidateNames[i]);

    if (exact) {
      return exact;
    }

    normalizedCandidates.push(RSC_UR_normalizeHeader_(candidateNames[i]));
  }

  var sheets = ss.getSheets();

  for (var s = 0; s < sheets.length; s++) {
    var normalizedName = RSC_UR_normalizeHeader_(sheets[s].getName());

    for (var c = 0; c < normalizedCandidates.length; c++) {
      var candidate = normalizedCandidates[c];

      if (
        normalizedName === candidate ||
        normalizedName.indexOf(candidate) >= 0
      ) {
        return sheets[s];
      }
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_findSalesmanTypeHeader_(sheet) {
  var lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
  var lastCol = sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (!lastRow || !lastCol) {
    throw new Error('Sheet sumber kosong: ' + sheet.getName());
  }

  var readWidth = Math.min(100, lastCol);
  var grid = sheet.getRange(
    1,
    1,
    Math.min(100, lastRow),
    readWidth
  ).getDisplayValues();

  for (var r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    var map = {
      salesmanId: RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(grid[r], [
        'salesman id', 'salesman_id', 'bp id', 'bp_id'
      ]),
      salesOrg: RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(grid[r], [
        'sales organization', 'sales org', 'sls_org', 'sales_org'
      ]),
      salesOffice: RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(grid[r], [
        'sales office', 'sls_office', 'sales_office'
      ]),
      salesType: RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(grid[r], [
        'sales type', 'salesman type', 'sales_type'
      ]),
      coverage: RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(grid[r], ['coverage']),
      validFrom: RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(grid[r], [
        'valid from', 'valid_from'
      ]),
      validTo: RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(grid[r], [
        'valid to', 'valid_to'
      ])
    };

    if (
      map.salesmanId >= 0 &&
      map.salesOrg >= 0 &&
      map.salesOffice >= 0 &&
      map.salesType >= 0 &&
      map.coverage >= 0 &&
      map.validFrom >= 0 &&
      map.validTo >= 0
    ) {
      return {
        headerRow: r + 1,
        dataStartRow: r + 2,
        readWidth: readWidth,
        columnMap: map
      };
    }
  }

  throw new Error(
    'Header Change Salesman Type tidak lengkap pada sheet "' +
    sheet.getName() +
    '". Wajib ada Salesman ID, Sales Organization, Sales Office, ' +
    'Sales Type, Coverage, Valid From, dan Valid To.'
  );
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_mapSalesmanTypeRow_(row, map) {
  function value(index) {
    return index >= 0 ? String(row[index] || '').trim() : '';
  }

  return [
    value(map.salesmanId).toUpperCase(),
    value(map.salesOrg).toUpperCase(),
    RSC_UR_extractCode_(value(map.salesOffice)),
    value(map.salesType),
    value(map.coverage),
    value(map.validFrom),
    value(map.validTo)
  ];
}

  var dbSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(cfg.stRlDbSpreadsheetId);
  var dbSh = RSC_UR_STRL_getConfiguredSheet_(
    dbSs,
    cfg.stRlGeneralSheetId,
    cfg.stRlGeneralSheetNames,
    'BP General'
  );
  var meta = RSC_UR_STRL_findDbHeaderMeta_(dbSh, {
    bpId: ['bp_id', 'business_partner', 'business partner'],
    bpType: ['bp_type_id', 'bp_type', 'business_partner_type']
  });

  job.bpTypeMeta = {
    sheetId: dbSh.getSheetId(),
    lastRow: dbSh.getLastRow(),
    minCol: meta.minCol,
    width: meta.width,
    bpId: meta.relativeIndexes.bpId,
    bpType: meta.relativeIndexes.bpType
  };
  job.bpTypeCursor = meta.headerRow + 1;
}

  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;

  };
  job.salesCursor = meta.headerRow + 1;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_buildQueue_(job, technicalSs, executionStartedAt) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var stageSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlStageSheetName);
  var queueSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlQueueSheetName);

  if (!stageSh || !queueSh) {
    throw new Error('Stage/queue ST/RL tidak ditemukan.');
  }

  var stageLastRow = stageSh.getLastRow();

  if (job.stageCursor > stageLastRow) {
    return true;
  }

  var bpTypeById = RSC_UR_STRL_loadBpTypeMap_(technicalSs);
  var salesById = RSC_UR_STRL_loadSalesInfoMap_(technicalSs);

  while (
    job.stageCursor <= stageLastRow &&
    Date.now() - executionStartedAt < cfg.softDeadlineMs
  ) {
    var readRows = Math.min(
      cfg.distributeReadChunkRows,
      stageLastRow - job.stageCursor + 1
    );
    var rows = stageSh.getRange(
      job.stageCursor,
      1,
      readRows,
      11
    ).getDisplayValues();
    var queueRows = [];

    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      var rowKey = String(rows[i][0] || '').trim();
      var prefix = String(rows[i][4] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      var entityBpId = String(rows[i][5] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      var sourceValidFrom = String(rows[i][8] || '').trim();
      var sourceValidTo = String(rows[i][9] || '').trim();
      var payloadJson = String(rows[i][10] || '').trim();
      var bpType = String(bpTypeById[entityBpId] || '').trim();
      var salesEntries = RSC_UR_STRL_filterSalesEntriesByValidity_(
        salesById[entityBpId] || [],
        sourceValidFrom,
        sourceValidTo
      );

      if (!bpType) {
        if (prefix === 'ST') {
          job.stats.missingBpTypeST++;
        } else {
          job.stats.missingBpTypeRL++;
        }
        continue;
      }

      if (!salesEntries.length) {
        if (prefix === 'ST') {
          job.stats.missingSalesInfoST++;
        } else {
          job.stats.missingSalesInfoRL++;
        }
        continue;
      }

      for (var s = 0; s < salesEntries.length; s++) {
        var salesMeta = salesEntries[s];
        var groupName = RSC_UR_STRL_makeGroupName_(
          prefix,
          bpType,
          salesMeta.salesOrg,
          cfg.stRlDefaultDistChannel,
          cfg.stRlDefaultDivision,
          salesMeta.salesOffice
        );

        queueRows.push([
          groupName,
          rowKey,
          prefix,
          entityBpId,
          bpType,
          salesMeta.salesOrg,
          cfg.stRlDefaultDistChannel,
          cfg.stRlDefaultDivision,
          salesMeta.salesOffice,
          payloadJson
        ]);

        if (prefix === 'ST') {
          job.stats.stRowsQueued++;
        } else {
          job.stats.rlRowsQueued++;
        }
      }
    }

    RSC_UR_appendRows_(queueSh, queueRows);
    job.stageCursor += rows.length;
    RSC_UR_STRL_saveJob_(job);
  }

  return job.stageCursor > stageLastRow;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_filterSalesEntriesByValidity_(entries, sourceFrom, sourceTo) {
  entries = entries || [];
  var sourceStart = RSC_UR_STRL_parseDateValue_(sourceFrom, -Infinity);
  var sourceEnd = RSC_UR_STRL_parseDateValue_(sourceTo, Infinity);
  var output = [];
  var seen = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
    var entry = entries[i];
    var dbStart = RSC_UR_STRL_parseDateValue_(entry.validFrom, -Infinity);
    var dbEnd = RSC_UR_STRL_parseDateValue_(entry.validTo, Infinity);

    if (sourceStart <= dbEnd && dbStart <= sourceEnd) {
      var uniqueKey = [entry.salesOrg, entry.salesOffice].join('\u001F');

      if (!seen[uniqueKey]) {
        seen[uniqueKey] = true;
        output.push(entry);
      }
    }
  }

  return output;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_parseDateValue_(value, fallback) {
  var text = String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();

  if (!text) {
    return fallback;
  }

  if (/^-?\d+(?:\.0+)?$/.test(text)) {
    var numeric = Number(text);

    if (isFinite(numeric)) {
      // DB menggunakan epoch millisecond. Nilai kecil diasumsikan epoch second.
      return Math.abs(numeric) < 100000000000 ? numeric * 1000 : numeric;
    }
  }

  var normalized = text.replace(/\//g, '-');
  var parsed = Date.parse(normalized);
  return isNaN(parsed) ? fallback : parsed;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_prepareGroupedQueue_(technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var queueSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlQueueSheetName);
  var groupsSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlGroupsSheetName);

  if (!queueSh || !groupsSh) {
    throw new Error('Queue/groups ST/RL tidak ditemukan.');
  }

  RSC_UR_clearDataRows_(groupsSh, 1, 9);
  var lastRow = queueSh.getLastRow();

  if (lastRow < 2) {
    return;
  }

  queueSh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, 10).sort([
    {column: 1, ascending: true},
    {column: 2, ascending: true}
  ]);

  var rows = queueSh.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, 9).getDisplayValues();
  var groupRows = [];
  var currentGroup = '';
  var groupStart = 2;
  var groupCount = 0;
  var currentMeta = null;

  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var groupName = String(rows[i][0] || '').trim();

    if (!groupName) {
      continue;
    }

    if (currentGroup && groupName !== currentGroup) {
      groupRows.push([
        currentGroup,
        groupStart,
        groupCount,
        currentMeta[2],
        currentMeta[4],
        currentMeta[5],
        currentMeta[6],
        currentMeta[7],
        currentMeta[8]
      ]);
      groupStart = i + 2;
      groupCount = 0;
    }

    if (groupName !== currentGroup) {
      currentGroup = groupName;
      currentMeta = rows[i];
    }

    groupCount++;
  }

  if (currentGroup) {
    groupRows.push([
      currentGroup,
      groupStart,
      groupCount,
      currentMeta[2],
      currentMeta[4],
      currentMeta[5],
      currentMeta[6],
      currentMeta[7],
      currentMeta[8]
    ]);
  }

  RSC_UR_appendRows_(groupsSh, groupRows);
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_makeOutputRowKey_(prefix, row) {
  return prefix === 'ST'
    ? RSC_UR_STRL_makeSalesmanTypeRowKey_(row)
    : RSC_UR_STRL_makeRelationshipRowKey_(row);
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_normalizeRowLength_(row, length) {
  var output = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < length; i++) {
    output.push(String(row && row[i] != null ? row[i] : '').trim());
  }

  return output;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_rowsEqual_(a, b) {
  return RSC_UR_STRL_matrixEqual_([a], [b]);
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_matrixEqual_(a, b) {
  if (a.length !== b.length) {
    return false;
  }

  for (var r = 0; r < a.length; r++) {
    if (a[r].length !== b[r].length) {
      return false;
    }

    for (var c = 0; c < a[r].length; c++) {
      if (String(a[r][c] || '').trim() !== String(b[r][c] || '').trim()) {
        return false;
      }
    }
  }

  return true;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_headerMatches_(sheet, headers) {
  if (sheet.getLastColumn() < headers.length || sheet.getLastRow() < 1) {
    return false;
  }

  var current = sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).getDisplayValues()[0];
  return RSC_UR_STRL_rowsEqual_(current, headers);
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_parsePayload_(value) {
  try {
    var parsed = JSON.parse(String(value || ''));
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
  } catch (ignore) {
    return [];
  }
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_finalize_(job, targetSs, technicalSs, executionStartedAt) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var indexSh = RSC_UR_STRL_ensureIndex_(technicalSs);

  if (job.finalCursor < 2) {
    return true;
  }

  var batchSize = Math.min(
    cfg.maxFinalizeSheetsPerExecution,
    job.finalCursor - 1
  );
  var batchStart = job.finalCursor - batchSize + 1;
  var rows = indexSh.getRange(batchStart, 1, batchSize, 9).getDisplayValues();
  var processed = 0;

  while (
    processed < rows.length &&
    Date.now() - executionStartedAt < cfg.softDeadlineMs
  ) {
    var row = rows[rows.length - 1 - processed];
    var currentIndexRow = job.finalCursor;
    var outputName = String(row[1] || '').trim();
    var lastRunId = String(row[2] || '').trim();
    var obsoleteSalesOffice = RSC_UR_extractCode_(row[8]);

    if (lastRunId !== job.runId && job.allowStaleCleanup) {
      var outputSh = outputName ? targetSs.getSheetByName(outputName) : null;

      if (outputSh && targetSs.getSheets().length > 1) {
        targetSs.deleteSheet(outputSh);
        job.stats.deletedObsoleteSheets++;
      }

      indexSh.deleteRow(currentIndexRow);
      job.changedSalesOffices = job.changedSalesOffices || {};
      if (obsoleteSalesOffice) {
        job.changedSalesOffices[obsoleteSalesOffice] = true;
      }
    }

    job.finalCursor--;
    processed++;
    RSC_UR_STRL_saveJob_(job);
  }

  return job.finalCursor < 2;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_prepareExportQueue_(job, targetSs, technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var exportSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlExportQueueSheetName);

  if (!exportSh) {
    throw new Error('Export queue ST/RL tidak ditemukan.');
  }

  RSC_UR_clearDataRows_(exportSh, 1, 9);
  var indexSh = RSC_UR_STRL_ensureIndex_(technicalSs);
  var byOffice = {};

  if (indexSh.getLastRow() >= 2) {
    var rows = indexSh.getRange(
      2,
      1,
      indexSh.getLastRow() - 1,
      9
    ).getDisplayValues();

    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      var sheetName = String(rows[i][1] || '').trim();
      var prefix = String(rows[i][3] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      var salesOffice = RSC_UR_extractCode_(rows[i][8]);
      var outputSh = sheetName ? targetSs.getSheetByName(sheetName) : null;

      if (!salesOffice || !outputSh || (prefix !== 'RL' && prefix !== 'ST')) {
        continue;
      }

      if (!byOffice[salesOffice]) {
        byOffice[salesOffice] = {
          rlSheets: [],
          stSheets: [],
          rlRows: 0,
          stRows: 0
        };
      }

      var count = Math.max(0, outputSh.getLastRow() - 1);

      if (prefix === 'RL') {
        byOffice[salesOffice].rlSheets.push(sheetName);
        byOffice[salesOffice].rlRows += count;
      } else {
        byOffice[salesOffice].stSheets.push(sheetName);
        byOffice[salesOffice].stRows += count;
      }
    }
  }

  var offices = Object.keys(byOffice).sort();
  var folder = RSC_UR_STRL_getOrCreateExportFolder_();
  var changedOffices = job.changedSalesOffices || {};
  var exportRows = offices.map(function (office) {
    var baseName = 'ST_RL_' + office;
    var existingXlsx = RSC_UR_STRL_getFirstFileByName_(
      folder,
      baseName + '.xlsx'
    );
    var existingZip = RSC_UR_STRL_getFirstFileByName_(
      folder,
      baseName + '.zip'
    );
    var canReuse = !changedOffices[office] && existingXlsx && existingZip;

    return [
      office,
      JSON.stringify(byOffice[office].rlSheets.sort()),
      JSON.stringify(byOffice[office].stSheets.sort()),
      byOffice[office].rlRows,
      byOffice[office].stRows,
      canReuse ? existingXlsx.getId() : '',
      canReuse ? existingZip.getId() : '',
      canReuse ? 'REUSED' : 'PENDING',
      ''
    ];
  });

  RSC_UR_appendRows_(exportSh, exportRows);
  job.stats.exportOffices = exportRows.length;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_processExports_(
  job,
  targetSs,
  technicalSs,
  executionStartedAt
) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var exportSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlExportQueueSheetName);

  if (!exportSh) {
    throw new Error('Export queue ST/RL tidak ditemukan.');
  }

  var lastRow = exportSh.getLastRow();

  if (job.exportCursor > lastRow) {
    return true;
  }

  var processed = 0;

  while (
    job.exportCursor <= lastRow &&
    processed < cfg.stRlMaxExportsPerExecution &&
    Date.now() - executionStartedAt < cfg.softDeadlineMs
  ) {
    var row = exportSh.getRange(job.exportCursor, 1, 1, 9).getDisplayValues()[0];
    var salesOffice = RSC_UR_extractCode_(row[0]);
    var rlSheets = RSC_UR_STRL_parseJsonArray_(row[1]);
    var stSheets = RSC_UR_STRL_parseJsonArray_(row[2]);
    var currentStatus = String(row[7] || '').trim().toUpperCase();

    if (currentStatus && currentStatus !== 'PENDING') {
      job.exportCursor++;
      processed++;
      RSC_UR_STRL_saveJob_(job);
      continue;
    }

    try {
      var result = RSC_UR_STRL_exportSalesOffice_(
        targetSs,
        salesOffice,
        rlSheets.concat(stSheets)
      );

      exportSh.getRange(job.exportCursor, 6, 1, 4).setValues([[
        result.xlsxFileId,
        result.zipFileId,
        'DONE',
        ''
      ]]);
      job.stats.exportFilesCreated += 2;
    } catch (exportErr) {
      exportSh.getRange(job.exportCursor, 8, 1, 2).setValues([[
        'ERROR',
        RSC_UR_errorText_(exportErr).slice(0, 45000)
      ]]);
      job.stats.exportErrors++;
      job.stats.lastError =
        'Export Sales Office ' + salesOffice + ': ' + RSC_UR_errorText_(exportErr);
    }

    job.exportCursor++;
    processed++;
    RSC_UR_STRL_saveJob_(job);
  }

  return job.exportCursor > lastRow;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_exportSalesOffice_(targetSs, salesOffice, sheetNames) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var validSheets = [];
  var seen = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < sheetNames.length; i++) {
    var name = String(sheetNames[i] || '').trim();
    var sh = name ? targetSs.getSheetByName(name) : null;

    if (sh && !seen[name]) {
      seen[name] = true;
      validSheets.push(sh);
    }
  }

  if (!validSheets.length) {
    throw new Error('Tidak ada output sheet untuk Sales Office ' + salesOffice + '.');
  }

  var tempSs = SpreadsheetApp.create(
    'TMP_ST_RL_' + salesOffice + '_' + Utilities.getUuid().slice(0, 8)
  );
  var tempFileId = tempSs.getId();

  try {
    var defaultSh = tempSs.getSheets()[0];

    for (var s = 0; s < validSheets.length; s++) {
      var copied = validSheets[s].copyTo(tempSs);
      copied.setName(RSC_UR_safeSheetName_(validSheets[s].getName()));
    }

    if (defaultSh && tempSs.getSheets().length > 1) {
      tempSs.deleteSheet(defaultSh);
    }

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    var exportUrl =
      'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/' + tempFileId +
      '/export?format=xlsx';
    var response = UrlFetchApp.fetch(exportUrl, {
      method: 'get',
      headers: {
        Authorization: 'Bearer ' + ScriptApp.getOAuthToken()
      },
      muteHttpExceptions: true
    });

    if (response.getResponseCode() !== 200) {
      throw new Error(
        'Export XLSX gagal. HTTP ' + response.getResponseCode() + ': ' +
        response.getContentText().slice(0, 500)
      );
    }

    var baseName = 'ST_RL_' + salesOffice;
    var xlsxName = baseName + '.xlsx';
    var zipName = baseName + '.zip';
    var xlsxBlob = response.getBlob().setName(xlsxName);
    var folder = RSC_UR_STRL_getOrCreateExportFolder_();

    RSC_UR_STRL_trashFilesByName_(folder, xlsxName);
    RSC_UR_STRL_trashFilesByName_(folder, zipName);

    var xlsxFile = folder.createFile(xlsxBlob);
    var zipBlob = Utilities.zip([xlsxBlob], zipName);
    var zipFile = folder.createFile(zipBlob);

    return {
      xlsxFileId: xlsxFile.getId(),
      zipFileId: zipFile.getId()
    };
  } finally {
    try {
      DriveApp.getFileById(tempFileId).setTrashed(true);
    } catch (ignoreTrashTemp) {}
  }
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_getOrCreateExportFolder_() {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var savedId = props.getProperty(cfg.stRlExportFolderProperty);

  if (savedId) {
    try {
      return DriveApp.getFolderById(savedId);
    } catch (ignoreSaved) {}
  }

  var folders = DriveApp.getFoldersByName(cfg.stRlExportFolderName);
  var folder = folders.hasNext()
    ? folders.next()
    : DriveApp.createFolder(cfg.stRlExportFolderName);

  props.setProperty(cfg.stRlExportFolderProperty, folder.getId());
  return folder;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_trashFilesByName_(folder, name) {
  var files = folder.getFilesByName(name);

  while (files.hasNext()) {
    try {
      files.next().setTrashed(true);
    } catch (ignoreTrash) {}
  }
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_getFirstFileByName_(folder, name) {
  var files = folder.getFilesByName(name);
  return files.hasNext() ? files.next() : null;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_buildSummary_(job, targetSs, technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var exportSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlExportQueueSheetName);
  var summarySh = targetSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlSummarySheetName);

  if (!summarySh) {
    summarySh = targetSs.insertSheet(cfg.stRlSummarySheetName, 0);
  }

  var headers = [
    'Sales Office',
    'RL Output',
    'ST Output',
    'RL Rows',
    'ST Rows',
    'Download XLSX',
    'Download ZIP',
    'Export Status',
    'Error Detail'
  ];
  var outputRows = [];
  var notes = [];
  var rlRich = [];
  var stRich = [];
  var xlsxRich = [];
  var zipRich = [];

  if (exportSh && exportSh.getLastRow() >= 2) {
    var rows = exportSh.getRange(
      2,
      1,
      exportSh.getLastRow() - 1,
      9
    ).getDisplayValues();

    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      var office = RSC_UR_extractCode_(rows[i][0]);
      var rlSheets = RSC_UR_STRL_parseJsonArray_(rows[i][1]);
      var stSheets = RSC_UR_STRL_parseJsonArray_(rows[i][2]);
      var xlsxId = String(rows[i][5] || '').trim();
      var zipId = String(rows[i][6] || '').trim();
      var status = String(rows[i][7] || '').trim();
      var error = String(rows[i][8] || '').trim();
      var rlLink = RSC_UR_STRL_firstSheetUrl_(targetSs, rlSheets);
      var stLink = RSC_UR_STRL_firstSheetUrl_(targetSs, stSheets);
      var xlsxLink = xlsxId
        ? 'https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=' + xlsxId
        : '';
      var zipLink = zipId
        ? 'https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=' + zipId
        : '';

      outputRows.push([
        office,
        rlSheets.length ? 'RL (' + rlSheets.length + ')' : '',
        stSheets.length ? 'ST (' + stSheets.length + ')' : '',
        Number(rows[i][3] || 0),
        Number(rows[i][4] || 0),
        xlsxId ? 'Download XLSX' : '',
        zipId ? 'Download ZIP' : '',
        status,
        error
      ]);
      notes.push([
        '',
        rlSheets.join('\n'),
        stSheets.join('\n'),
        '',
        '',
        '',
        '',
        '',
        ''
      ]);
      rlRich.push([RSC_UR_STRL_makeRichLink_(
        rlSheets.length ? 'RL (' + rlSheets.length + ')' : '',
        rlLink
      )]);
      stRich.push([RSC_UR_STRL_makeRichLink_(
        stSheets.length ? 'ST (' + stSheets.length + ')' : '',
        stLink
      )]);
      xlsxRich.push([RSC_UR_STRL_makeRichLink_(
        xlsxId ? 'Download XLSX' : '',
        xlsxLink
      )]);
      zipRich.push([RSC_UR_STRL_makeRichLink_(
        zipId ? 'Download ZIP' : '',
        zipLink
      )]);
    }
  }

  var clearRows = Math.max(summarySh.getLastRow(), outputRows.length + 1, 2);
  RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(summarySh, clearRows, headers.length);
  summarySh.clearFormats();
  summarySh.getRange(1, 1, clearRows, headers.length).clearContent().clearNote();
  summarySh.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length)
    .setValues([headers])
    .setFontWeight('bold')
    .setBackground('#E8EEF7')
    .setWrap(true);

  if (outputRows.length) {
    summarySh.getRange(2, 1, outputRows.length, headers.length)
      .setValues(outputRows)
      .setWrap(true)
      .setVerticalAlignment('middle');
    summarySh.getRange(2, 1, notes.length, headers.length).setNotes(notes);
    summarySh.getRange(2, 2, rlRich.length, 1).setRichTextValues(rlRich);
    summarySh.getRange(2, 3, stRich.length, 1).setRichTextValues(stRich);
    summarySh.getRange(2, 6, xlsxRich.length, 1).setRichTextValues(xlsxRich);
    summarySh.getRange(2, 7, zipRich.length, 1).setRichTextValues(zipRich);
  }

  summarySh.setFrozenRows(1);
  summarySh.setColumnWidth(1, 110);
  summarySh.setColumnWidth(2, 140);
  summarySh.setColumnWidth(3, 140);
  summarySh.setColumnWidth(4, 90);
  summarySh.setColumnWidth(5, 90);
  summarySh.setColumnWidth(6, 140);
  summarySh.setColumnWidth(7, 140);
  summarySh.setColumnWidth(8, 110);
  summarySh.setColumnWidth(9, 320);
  RSC_UR_trimSheetGrid_(
    summarySh,
    Math.max(2, outputRows.length + 1),
    headers.length
  );

  job.stats.summaryRows = outputRows.length;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_firstSheetUrl_(targetSs, sheetNames) {
  if (!sheetNames.length) {
    return '';
  }

  var sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(sheetNames[0]);
  return sh ? targetSs.getUrl() + '#gid=' + sh.getSheetId() : '';
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_makeRichLink_(text, url) {
  var builder = SpreadsheetApp.newRichTextValue().setText(String(text || ''));

  if (text && url) {
    builder.setLinkUrl(url);
  }

  return builder.build();
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_parseJsonArray_(value) {
  try {
    var parsed = JSON.parse(String(value || '[]'));
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
  } catch (ignore) {
    return [];
  }
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_finishJob_(job, targetSs, technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var indexSh = RSC_UR_STRL_ensureIndex_(technicalSs);
  var activeSheets = 0;
  var activeRows = 0;

  if (indexSh.getLastRow() >= 2) {
    var names = indexSh.getRange(
      2,
      2,
      indexSh.getLastRow() - 1,
      1
    ).getDisplayValues();

    for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
      var name = String(names[i][0] || '').trim();
      var sh = name ? targetSs.getSheetByName(name) : null;

      if (sh) {
        activeSheets++;
        activeRows += Math.max(0, sh.getLastRow() - 1);
      }
    }
  }

  job.phase = 'DONE';
  job.stats.phase = 'DONE';
  job.stats.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  job.stats.activeOutputSheets = activeSheets;
  job.stats.activeOutputRows = activeRows;
  job.nextTriggerReason = '';

  try {
    RSC_STRL15_writeTargetCheckpoint_(job, JSON.stringify(job));
  } catch (ignoreCheckpoint) {}

  props.setProperty(cfg.stRlLastStatusProperty, JSON.stringify(job.stats));
  props.deleteProperty(cfg.stRlJobProperty);
  RSC_UR_deleteTriggersByHandler_(cfg.stRlWorkerHandler);
  RSC_UR_STRL_deleteTemporarySheets_(technicalSs);
  RSC_UR_hideTechnicalSheets_(technicalSs);

  try {
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
      'Compile ST/RL selesai. Links attempted: ' +
      Number(job.stats.attemptedManifestLinks || 0) +
      ', hash rows target: ' + Number(job.stats.targetHashRowsWritten || 0) +
      ', sheets: ' + activeSheets +
      ', rows: ' + activeRows +
      ', offices: ' + Number(job.stats.summaryRows || 0),
      'Compile ST/RL',
      10
    );
  } catch (ignoreToast) {}
}

      name: cfg.stRlQueueSheetName,
      cols: 10,
      headers: [
        'Group Name',
        'Row Key',
        'Prefix',
        'Entity BP ID',
        'BP Type ID',
        'Sls Org',
        'Dist Channel',
        'Division',
        'Sls Office',
        'Payload JSON'
      ]
    },
    {
      name: cfg.stRlGroupsSheetName,
      cols: 9,
      headers: [
        'Group Name',
        'Queue Start Row',
        'Queue Row Count',
        'Prefix',
        'BP Type ID',
        'Sls Org',
        'Dist Channel',
        'Division',
        'Sls Office'
      ]
    },
    {
      name: cfg.stRlExportQueueSheetName,
      cols: 9,
      headers: [
        'Sales Office',
        'RL Sheets JSON',
        'ST Sheets JSON',
        'RL Rows',
        'ST Rows',
        'XLSX File ID',
        'ZIP File ID',
        'Status',
        'Error Detail'
      ]
    }
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < definitions.length; i++) {
    var oldSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(definitions[i].name);

    if (oldSh && technicalSs.getSheets().length > 1) {
      technicalSs.deleteSheet(oldSh);
    }

    var sh = RSC_UR_createTechnicalSheet_(
      technicalSs,
      definitions[i].name,
      2,
      definitions[i].cols
    );
    sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, definitions[i].cols)
      .setValues([definitions[i].headers]);

    try {
      sh.hideSheet();
    } catch (ignoreHide) {}
  }

  RSC_UR_STRL_ensureIndex_(technicalSs);
  RSC_UR_hideTechnicalSheets_(technicalSs);
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_ensureIndex_(technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var sh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlIndexSheetName);

  if (!sh) {
    sh = RSC_UR_createTechnicalSheet_(technicalSs, cfg.stRlIndexSheetName, 2, 9);
  }

  RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(sh, 2, 9);
  sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, 9).setValues([[
    'Group Name',
    'Output Sheet Name',
    'Last Run ID',
    'Prefix',
    'BP Type ID',
    'Sls Org',
    'Dist Channel',
    'Division',
    'Sls Office'
  ]]);

  try {
    sh.hideSheet();
  } catch (ignoreHide) {}

  return sh;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_getConfiguredSheet_(ss, sheetId, candidateNames, label) {
  candidateNames = candidateNames || [];
  var sh = null;

  for (var i = 0; i < candidateNames.length; i++) {
    sh = ss.getSheetByName(candidateNames[i]);

    if (sh) {
      return sh;
    }
  }

  sh = RSC_UR_getSheetById_(ss, sheetId);

  if (sh) {
    return sh;
  }

  throw new Error(
    'Sheet database ' + String(label || '') +
    ' tidak ditemukan. Nama yang dicari: ' +
    candidateNames.join(', ') +
    '; GID fallback=' + String(sheetId)
  );
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_findDbHeaderMeta_(sheet, fields) {
  var lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
  var lastCol = sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (lastRow < 1 || lastCol < 1) {
    throw new Error('Database sheet kosong: ' + sheet.getName());
  }

  var readWidth = Math.min(300, lastCol);
  var grid = sheet.getRange(
    1,
    1,
    Math.min(20, lastRow),
    readWidth
  ).getDisplayValues();
  var fieldNames = Object.keys(fields);

  for (var r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
    var absolute = {};
    var complete = true;

    for (var f = 0; f < fieldNames.length; f++) {
      var fieldName = fieldNames[f];
      var index = RSC_UR_findHeaderIndex_(grid[r], fields[fieldName]);

      if (index < 0) {
        complete = false;
        break;
      }

      absolute[fieldName] = index;
    }

    if (!complete) {
      continue;
    }

    var indexes = fieldNames.map(function (name) {
      return absolute[name];
    });
    var minZeroBased = Math.min.apply(null, indexes);
    var maxZeroBased = Math.max.apply(null, indexes);
    var relative = {};

    for (var x = 0; x < fieldNames.length; x++) {
      relative[fieldNames[x]] = absolute[fieldNames[x]] - minZeroBased;
    }

    return {
      headerRow: r + 1,
      minCol: minZeroBased + 1,
      width: maxZeroBased - minZeroBased + 1,
      relativeIndexes: relative
    };
  }

  throw new Error(
    'Header database tidak lengkap pada sheet "' +
    sheet.getName() +
    '". Wajib ada: ' + fieldNames.join(', ')
  );
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_loadNeededBpSet_(technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var sh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlNeedsSheetName);
  var output = {};

  if (!sh || sh.getLastRow() < 2) {
    return output;
  }

  var rows = sh.getRange(2, 1, sh.getLastRow() - 1, 1).getDisplayValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var bpId = String(rows[i][0] || '').trim().toUpperCase();

    if (bpId) {
      output[bpId] = true;
    }
  }

  return output;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_loadBpTypeMap_(technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var sh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlBpTypeMapSheetName);
  var output = {};

  if (!sh || sh.getLastRow() < 2) {
    return output;
  }

  var rows = sh.getRange(2, 1, sh.getLastRow() - 1, 2).getDisplayValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var bpId = String(rows[i][0] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    var bpType = String(rows[i][1] || '').trim().toUpperCase();

    if (bpId && bpType) {
      output[bpId] = bpType;
    }
  }

  return output;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_loadSalesInfoMap_(technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var sh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlSalesMapSheetName);
  var output = {};
  var seen = {};

  if (!sh || sh.getLastRow() < 2) {
    return output;
  }

  var rows = sh.getRange(2, 1, sh.getLastRow() - 1, 5).getDisplayValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var bpId = String(rows[i][0] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    var salesOrg = String(rows[i][1] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    var salesOffice = RSC_UR_extractCode_(rows[i][2]);
    var validFrom = String(rows[i][3] || '').trim();
    var validTo = String(rows[i][4] || '').trim();

    if (!bpId || !salesOrg || !salesOffice) {
      continue;
    }

    var uniqueKey = [bpId, salesOrg, salesOffice, validFrom, validTo].join('\u001F');

    if (seen[uniqueKey]) {
      continue;
    }

    seen[uniqueKey] = true;

    if (!output[bpId]) {
      output[bpId] = [];
    }

    output[bpId].push({
      salesOrg: salesOrg,
      salesOffice: salesOffice,
      validFrom: validFrom,
      validTo: validTo
    });
  }

  return output;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_makeGroupName_(
  prefix,
  bpType,
  salesOrg,
  distChannel,
  division,
  salesOffice
) {
  return [
    String(prefix || '').trim().toUpperCase(),
    String(bpType || '').trim().toUpperCase(),
    String(salesOrg || '').trim().toUpperCase(),
    String(distChannel || '').trim().toUpperCase(),
    String(division || '').trim().toUpperCase(),
    RSC_UR_extractCode_(salesOffice)
  ].join(' ');
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_loadIndexMap_(technicalSs) {
  var sh = RSC_UR_STRL_ensureIndex_(technicalSs);
  var output = {};

  if (sh.getLastRow() < 2) {
    return output;
  }

  var rows = sh.getRange(2, 1, sh.getLastRow() - 1, 2).getDisplayValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var groupName = String(rows[i][0] || '').trim();

    if (!groupName) {
      continue;
    }

    output[groupName] = {
      outputSheetName: String(rows[i][1] || '').trim(),
      indexRow: i + 2
    };
  }

  return output;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_setOutputWidths_(sheet, prefix, columnCount) {
  var widths = prefix === 'ST'
    ? [125, 125, 105, 90, 90, 105, 105]
    : [115, 115, 125, 120, 105, 105, 105, 85, 175, 120, 120];

  for (var i = 0; i < columnCount; i++) {
    sheet.setColumnWidth(i + 1, widths[i] || 120);
  }
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_deleteTemporarySheets_(technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;

  [
    cfg.stRlManifestSheetName,
    cfg.stRlStageSheetName,
    cfg.stRlNeedsSheetName,
    cfg.stRlBpTypeMapSheetName,
    cfg.stRlSalesMapSheetName,
    cfg.stRlQueueSheetName,
    cfg.stRlGroupsSheetName,
    cfg.stRlExportQueueSheetName
  ].forEach(function (name) {
    var sh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(name);

    if (sh && technicalSs.getSheets().length > 1) {
      technicalSs.deleteSheet(sh);
    }
  });
}

/***************************************************************
 * CHECKPOINT / TRIGGER
 ***************************************************************/
function RSC_UR_saveJob_(job) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();

  props.setProperty(cfg.jobProperty, JSON.stringify(job));
  props.setProperty(cfg.lastStatusProperty, JSON.stringify(job.stats));
}


function RSC_UR_pauseJob_(job) {
  RSC_UR_scheduleNextRun_(job);
}


function RSC_UR_scheduleNextRun_(job) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;

  RSC_UR_deleteTriggersByHandler_(cfg.workerHandler);

  RSC_PERF13_NEW_TRIGGER_20260819_(cfg.workerHandler)
    .timeBased()
    .after(cfg.nextTriggerDelayMs)
    .create();

  RSC_UR_saveJob_(job);
}


function RSC_UR_deleteTriggersByHandler_(handlerName) {
  var lastError = null;
  var attempts = 3;

  for (var attempt = 1; attempt <= attempts; attempt++) {
    try {
      var triggers = ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers();

      triggers.forEach(function (trigger) {
        if (trigger.getHandlerFunction() === handlerName) {
          try {
            ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger);
          } catch (deleteError) {
            // Satu trigger yang gagal dihapus tidak boleh menggagalkan job.
          }
        }
      });

      return true;
    } catch (err) {
      lastError = err;

      if (attempt < attempts) {
        try { Utilities.sleep(attempt * 750); } catch (ignoreSleep) {}
      }
    }
  }

  try {
    console.warn(
      'Trigger service tidak dapat diakses saat menghapus handler ' +
      handlerName + ': ' + RSC_UR_errorText_(lastError)
    );
  } catch (ignoreLog) {}

  // Best-effort: caller tetap boleh melanjutkan proses utama.
  return false;
}


function RSC_UR_hideTechnicalSheets_(ss) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var sheets = ss.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    var name = sheets[i].getName();

    if (
      name.indexOf('_UR_') === 0 ||
      name.indexOf(cfg.keySheetPrefix) === 0
    ) {
      try {
        sheets[i].hideSheet();
      } catch (ignore) {}
    }
  }
}


function RSC_UR_errorText_(err) {
  if (!err) {
    return 'Unknown error';
  }

  return err.stack || err.message || String(err);
}


/***********************************************************************
 * PATCH 15 — ST/RL TARGET HASH-LEDGER ENGINE
 * Version: 2026-07-28
 *
 * Mengganti worker ST/RL lama dengan pola yang sama seperti
 * Compile Approved Links:
 * - Manifest dibekukan di spreadsheet teknis sebelum worker berjalan.
 * - Link dibaca dari display/value/formula/rich text/smart chip.
 * - DocumentLock diambil sebelum checkpoint dibaca.
 * - Checkpoint disimpan setelah setiap link.
 * - Watchdog continuation dibuat di awal execution.
 * - Error global tidak dilempar ulang; execution selesai normal dan retry
 *   melanjutkan cursor terakhir.
 * - Business key disimpan sebagai hash 128-bit.
 * - Snapshot key per output group disimpan sebagai gzip/base64 blob.
 ***********************************************************************/

var RSC_STRL14 = {
  engineVersion: 'STRL_TARGET_HASH_LEDGER_V15_20260728',
  watchdogDelayMs: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  continuationDelayMs: 60 * 1000,
  maxGlobalErrorRetries: 50,
  maxFilesPerExecution: 8,
  softDeadlineMs: 250 * 1000,
  dbReadChunkRows: 12000,
  targetLedgerDataStartRow: 250,
  targetLedgerColumns: 21,
  targetLedgerWriteChunkRows: 1000,
  targetLedgerCheckpointRow: 2,
  targetLedgerRunMetaRow: 3,
  targetLedgerFileRowOffset: 2,
  keyStoreSheetName: '_UR_STRL_KEYS_V15',
  errorLogSheetName: '_UR_STRL_ERRORS_V15',
  keyStoreHeaders: [
    'Group Name',
    'Output Sheet Name',
    'Run ID',
    'Prefix',
    'Key Count',
    'Snapshot Hash',
    'Key Blob',
    'Updated At'
  ],
  errorHeaders: [
    'Timestamp',
    'Run ID',
    'Phase',
    'Cursor',
    'Error Count',
    'Error'
  ]
};


/* =====================================================================
 * PUBLIC WRAPPERS — declarations below intentionally override PATCH 13.
 * =================================================================== */

function RSC_UR_START_ST_RL_20260727() {
  return RSC_STRL14_start_();
}


function RSC_UR_CONTINUE_ST_RL_20260727() {
  return RSC_STRL14_continue_();
}


/* =====================================================================
 * START
 * =================================================================== */

function RSC_STRL14_start_() {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(10000)) {
    RSC_STRL14_toast_(
      'Compile ST/RL belum dimulai karena job lain sedang memakai workbook. Coba Start kembali.'
    );
    return;
  }

  var shouldContinueNow = false;

  try {
    var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();

    if (props.getProperty(cfg.jobProperty)) {
      throw new Error(
        'Job Compile Upload Ready utama masih aktif. Stop atau selesaikan job utama terlebih dahulu.'
      );
    }

    props.deleteProperty(cfg.stRlJobProperty);
    RSC_UR_deleteTriggersByHandler_(cfg.stRlWorkerHandler);

    var masterResolved = RSC_UR_STRL_resolveMaster_();
    var masterSs = masterResolved.spreadsheet;
    var masterSh = masterResolved.sheet;
    var manifestMeta = RSC_UR_STRL_findManifestMeta_(masterSh);

    var targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(
      cfg.stRlTargetSpreadsheetId || masterSs.getId()
    );
    var technicalSs = RSC_UR_getOrCreateTechnicalSpreadsheet_(props);

    RSC_UR_STRL_ensureIndex_(technicalSs);
    RSC_UR_STRL_resetWorkingSheets_(technicalSs);
    RSC_STRL14_ensureKeyStore_(technicalSs);
    RSC_STRL14_ensureErrorLog_(technicalSs);

    var runId = Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
    ) + '_STRL15_' + Utilities.getUuid().slice(0, 8);

    var ledgerSh = RSC_STRL15_resetTargetLedger_(targetSs, runId);

    var manifestInfo = RSC_STRL14_buildFrozenManifest_(
      masterSs,
      masterSh,
      technicalSs,
      manifestMeta
    );

    var stats = RSC_STRL14_newStats_({
      runId: runId,
      masterSs: masterSs,
      masterSh: masterSh,
      manifestMeta: manifestMeta,
      manifestInfo: manifestInfo,
      targetSs: targetSs,
      technicalSs: technicalSs
    });

    stats.targetHashLedgerSheetId = ledgerSh.getSheetId();
    stats.targetHashLedgerSheetName = ledgerSh.getName();
    stats.targetHashRowsWritten = 0;
    stats.targetFilesCheckpointed = 0;
    stats.targetCheckpointRecoveries = 0;

    var job = {
      engineVersion: RSC_STRL14.engineVersion,
      runId: runId,
      phase: 'STRL_COLLECT',

      masterSpreadsheetId: masterSs.getId(),
      masterSheetId: masterSh.getSheetId(),
      masterSheetName: masterSh.getName(),
      targetSpreadsheetId: targetSs.getId(),
      technicalSpreadsheetId: technicalSs.getId(),
      hashLedgerSheetId: ledgerSh.getSheetId(),
      hashLedgerSheetName: ledgerSh.getName(),
      hashLedgerDataStartRow: RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerDataStartRow,

      manifestCursor: 2,
      manifestLastRow: manifestInfo.manifestLastRow,

      bpTypeMeta: null,
      bpTypeCursor: 0,
      salesMeta: null,
      salesCursor: 0,
      stageCursor: 2,
      groupCursor: 2,
      finalCursor: 0,
      exportCursor: 2,

      changedSalesOffices: {},
      allowStaleCleanup: false,
      globalErrorCount: 0,
      runChunks: 0,
      currentSourceFileId: '',
      lastHeartbeatAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      nextTriggerReason: '',
      stats: stats
    };

    RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
    RSC_STRL14_scheduleWatchdog_(job, 'START_WATCHDOG');

    shouldContinueNow = true;

    RSC_STRL14_toast_(
      'Compile ST/RL V15 dimulai. Hash ledger target aktif di sheet "' +
      ledgerSh.getName() + '". Manifest valid=' +
      manifestInfo.validLinks + ', row manifest=' + manifestInfo.totalRows + '.'
    );
  } catch (err) {
    try {
      SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(
        'Compile ST/RL gagal dimulai:\n\n' + RSC_UR_errorText_(err)
      );
    } catch (ignoreAlert) {}
    throw err;
  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (ignoreRelease) {}
  }

  if (shouldContinueNow) {
    RSC_STRL14_continue_();
  }
}

/* =====================================================================
 * FROZEN MANIFEST
 * =================================================================== */

function RSC_STRL14_buildFrozenManifest_(
  masterSs,
  masterSh,
  technicalSs,
  manifestMeta
) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var manifestSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlManifestSheetName);

  if (!manifestSh) {
    throw new Error('Sheet manifest teknis ST/RL tidak tersedia.');
  }

  var firstDataRow = Number(manifestMeta.dataStartRow || 2);
  var linkCol = Number(manifestMeta.linkCol || cfg.stRlMasterLinkCol || 5);
  var salesOfficeCol = Number(cfg.stRlMasterSalesOfficeCol || 1);
  var statusCol = Number(cfg.stRlMasterStatusCol || 6);
  var masterLastRow = RSC_UR_STRL_findManifestLastRow_(masterSh, manifestMeta);
  var rowCount = Math.max(0, masterLastRow - firstDataRow + 1);

  var result = {
    totalRows: rowCount,
    masterLastRow: masterLastRow,
    manifestLastRow: 1,
    validLinks: 0,
    uniqueLinks: 0,
    duplicateRows: 0,
    blankRows: 0,
    placeholderRows: 0,
    invalidRows: 0
  };

  if (rowCount <= 0) {
    return result;
  }

  var readWidth = Math.max(linkCol, salesOfficeCol, statusCol);
  var masterValues = masterSh.getRange(
    firstDataRow,
    1,
    rowCount,
    readWidth
  ).getDisplayValues();

  var linkRange = masterSh.getRange(firstDataRow, linkCol, rowCount, 1);
  var linkDisplays = linkRange.getDisplayValues();
  var linkValues = linkRange.getValues();
  var linkFormulas = linkRange.getFormulas();
  var linkRichTexts = linkRange.getRichTextValues();
  var chipMap = RSC_STRL14_getSmartChipMap_(
    masterSs.getId(),
    masterSh.getName(),
    firstDataRow,
    linkCol,
    rowCount
  );

  var seen = {};
  var rows = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < rowCount; i++) {
    var masterRow = firstDataRow + i;
    var salesOffice = RSC_UR_extractCode_(
      masterValues[i][salesOfficeCol - 1]
    );
    var masterStatus = String(
      masterValues[i][statusCol - 1] || ''
    ).trim().toUpperCase();
    var displayText = String(linkDisplays[i][0] || '').trim();

    var fileId = RSC_UR_STRL_extractSpreadsheetIdFromBatchCell_(
      linkRichTexts[i][0],
      linkFormulas[i][0],
      linkValues[i][0],
      displayText
    );

    if (!fileId && chipMap[masterRow]) {
      fileId = RSC_UR_extractSpreadsheetId_(chipMap[masterRow]);
    }

    var resultStatus = '';
    var detail = '';

    if (!displayText && !fileId) {
      result.blankRows++;
      resultStatus = 'SKIP_BLANK';
      detail = 'Kolom link kosong.';
    } else if (!fileId) {
      if (RSC_UR_STRL_isManifestPlaceholder_(displayText)) {
        result.placeholderRows++;
        resultStatus = 'SKIP_PLACEHOLDER';
        detail = 'Placeholder/COPY_ERROR.';
      } else {
        result.invalidRows++;
        resultStatus = 'SKIP_INVALID_LINK';
        detail = 'Cell nonblank bukan Google Spreadsheet link.';
      }
    } else {
      result.validLinks++;

      if (seen[fileId]) {
        result.duplicateRows++;
        resultStatus = 'SKIP_DUPLICATE';
        detail = 'Spreadsheet ID sama dengan master row ' + seen[fileId] + '.';
      } else {
        seen[fileId] = masterRow;
        result.uniqueLinks++;
        resultStatus = 'PENDING';
        detail = 'Siap diproses.';
      }
    }

    rows.push([
      String(masterRow),
      salesOffice,
      masterStatus,
      displayText,
      fileId,
      '',
      '',
      0,
      0,
      '',
      0,
      0,
      resultStatus,
      detail,
      ''
    ]);
  }

  if (rows.length) {
    RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(manifestSh, rows.length + 1, 15);
    manifestSh.getRange(2, 1, rows.length, 15)
      .setNumberFormat('@')
      .setValues(rows);
  }

  result.manifestLastRow = rows.length + 1;
  return result;
}


function RSC_STRL14_getSmartChipMap_(
  spreadsheetId,
  sheetName,
  startRow,
  sourceCol,
  numRows
) {
  var map = {};

  try {
    if (typeof Sheets === 'undefined') {
      return map;
    }

    var chunkSize = 500;

    for (var offset = 0; offset < numRows; offset += chunkSize) {
      var chunkStart = startRow + offset;
      var chunkRows = Math.min(chunkSize, numRows - offset);
      var colLetter = RSC_STRL14_columnLetter_(sourceCol);
      var quotedName = "'" + String(sheetName || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "'";
      var a1 = quotedName + '!' +
        colLetter + chunkStart + ':' +
        colLetter + (chunkStart + chunkRows - 1);

      var response = Sheets.Spreadsheets.get(spreadsheetId, {
        ranges: [a1],
        includeGridData: true,
        fields: 'sheets(data(startRow,rowData(values(hyperlink,textFormatRuns(format(link)),chipRuns(chip(richLinkProperties(uri)))))))'
      });

      var sheets = response.sheets || [];

      for (var s = 0; s < sheets.length; s++) {
        var dataBlocks = sheets[s].data || [];

        for (var d = 0; d < dataBlocks.length; d++) {
          var data = dataBlocks[d] || {};
          var baseRow = Number(
            data.startRow != null ? data.startRow : (chunkStart - 1)
          );
          var rowData = data.rowData || [];

          for (var r = 0; r < rowData.length; r++) {
            var cell = (
              rowData[r] &&
              rowData[r].values &&
              rowData[r].values[0]
            ) || {};
            var url = String(cell.hyperlink || '');

            if (!url && cell.chipRuns) {
              for (var c = 0; c < cell.chipRuns.length; c++) {
                var chip = cell.chipRuns[c] && cell.chipRuns[c].chip;
                if (
                  chip &&
                  chip.richLinkProperties &&
                  chip.richLinkProperties.uri
                ) {
                  url = chip.richLinkProperties.uri;
                  break;
                }
              }
            }

            if (!url && cell.textFormatRuns) {
              for (var t = 0; t < cell.textFormatRuns.length; t++) {
                var link = cell.textFormatRuns[t] &&
                  cell.textFormatRuns[t].format &&
                  cell.textFormatRuns[t].format.link;

                if (link && link.uri) {
                  url = link.uri;
                  break;
                }
              }
            }

            if (url) {
              map[baseRow + r + 1] = url;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (ignoreSmartChip) {}

  return map;
}


function RSC_STRL14_columnLetter_(column) {
  var value = Number(column || 0);
  var output = '';

  while (value > 0) {
    var remainder = (value - 1) % 26;
    output = String.fromCharCode(65 + remainder) + output;
    value = Math.floor((value - remainder - 1) / 26);
  }

  return output;
}


/* =====================================================================
 * CONTINUE — no rethrow on retryable errors.
 * =================================================================== */

function RSC_STRL14_continue_() {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();

  if (!lock.tryLock(1000)) {
    RSC_STRL14_scheduleWithoutCheckpoint_('LOCK_BUSY');
    return;
  }

  var job = null;
  var targetSs = null;
  var technicalSs = null;
