  var executionStartedAt = Date.now();

  try {
    var rawJob = props.getProperty(cfg.stRlJobProperty);

    if (!rawJob) {
      job = RSC_STRL15_recoverJobFromTargetLedger_();

      if (!job) {
        RSC_UR_deleteTriggersByHandler_(cfg.stRlWorkerHandler);
        return;
      }

      if (job.stats) {
        job.stats.targetCheckpointRecoveries =
          Number(job.stats.targetCheckpointRecoveries || 0) + 1;
      }

      props.setProperty(cfg.stRlJobProperty, JSON.stringify(job));
      rawJob = JSON.stringify(job);
    }

    job = JSON.parse(rawJob);

    if (String(job.engineVersion || '') !== RSC_STRL14.engineVersion) {
      throw new Error(
        'Checkpoint ST/RL berasal dari engine lama. Jalankan Stop ST/RL lalu Start kembali.'
      );
    }

    job.runChunks = Number(job.runChunks || 0) + 1;
    job.lastHeartbeatAt = new Date().toISOString();
    job.stats.runChunks = job.runChunks;
    job.stats.lastHeartbeatAt = job.lastHeartbeatAt;
    job.stats.phase = job.phase;
    job.stats.globalErrorCount = Number(job.globalErrorCount || 0);

    RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
    RSC_STRL14_scheduleWatchdog_(job, 'WATCHDOG_RUN_' + job.runChunks);

    targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(job.targetSpreadsheetId);
    technicalSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(job.technicalSpreadsheetId);
    RSC_STRL15_bindLedgerCache_(targetSs, job);
    RSC_STRL15_rebuildTechnicalStageFromLedgerIfNeeded_(job, technicalSs);

    while (
      Date.now() - executionStartedAt < RSC_STRL14.softDeadlineMs
    ) {
      if (job.phase === 'STRL_COLLECT') {
        if (!RSC_UR_STRL_collectSourceRows_(
          job,
          technicalSs,
          executionStartedAt
        )) {
          RSC_STRL14_scheduleNext_(job, 'COLLECT_PAUSE');
          return;
        }

        RSC_UR_dedupeAdminSheet_(
          technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlNeedsSheetName),
          1
        );

        var needsSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlNeedsSheetName);
        job.stats.bpIdsNeeded = needsSh
          ? Math.max(0, needsSh.getLastRow() - 1)
          : 0;

        var blockers = [];

        if (Number(job.stats.validManifestLinks || 0) <= 0) {
          blockers.push('tidak ada link Google Sheet valid');
        }
        if (Number(job.stats.invalidMasterLinks || 0) > 0) {
          blockers.push(
            'invalid master links=' +
            Number(job.stats.invalidMasterLinks || 0)
          );
        }
        if (Number(job.stats.fileErrors || 0) > 0) {
          blockers.push(
            'source open errors=' + Number(job.stats.fileErrors || 0)
          );
        }
        if (Number(job.stats.relationshipReadErrors || 0) > 0) {
          blockers.push(
            'RL read errors=' +
            Number(job.stats.relationshipReadErrors || 0)
          );
        }
        if (Number(job.stats.salesmanTypeReadErrors || 0) > 0) {
          blockers.push(
            'ST read errors=' +
            Number(job.stats.salesmanTypeReadErrors || 0)
          );
        }

        job.allowStaleCleanup = blockers.length === 0;
        job.stats.staleCleanupEnabled = job.allowStaleCleanup;
        job.stats.staleCleanupBlockedReason = blockers.join('; ');

        if (Number(job.stats.bpIdsNeeded || 0) <= 0) {
          RSC_UR_STRL_prepareGroupedQueue_(technicalSs);
          job.phase = 'STRL_WRITE_GROUPS';
          job.stats.phase = job.phase;
          job.groupCursor = 2;
          RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
          continue;
        }

        RSC_UR_STRL_prepareBpTypeMeta_(job);
        job.phase = 'STRL_DB_BP_TYPE';
        job.stats.phase = job.phase;
        RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
        continue;
      }

      if (job.phase === 'STRL_DB_BP_TYPE') {
        if (!RSC_UR_STRL_scanBpTypeDatabase_(
          job,
          technicalSs,
          executionStartedAt
        )) {
          RSC_STRL14_scheduleNext_(job, 'BP_TYPE_SCAN_PAUSE');
          return;
        }

        RSC_UR_dedupeAdminSheet_(
          technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlBpTypeMapSheetName),
          2
        );

        RSC_UR_STRL_prepareSalesInfoMeta_(job);
        job.phase = 'STRL_DB_SALES_INFO';
        job.stats.phase = job.phase;
        RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
        continue;
      }

      if (job.phase === 'STRL_DB_SALES_INFO') {
        if (!RSC_UR_STRL_scanSalesInfoDatabase_(
          job,
          technicalSs,
          executionStartedAt
        )) {
          RSC_STRL14_scheduleNext_(job, 'SALES_INFO_SCAN_PAUSE');
          return;
        }

        RSC_UR_dedupeAdminSheet_(
          technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlSalesMapSheetName),
          5
        );

        job.phase = 'STRL_BUILD_QUEUE';
        job.stats.phase = job.phase;
        job.stageCursor = 2;
        RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
        continue;
      }

      if (job.phase === 'STRL_BUILD_QUEUE') {
        if (!RSC_UR_STRL_buildQueue_(
          job,
          technicalSs,
          executionStartedAt
        )) {
          RSC_STRL14_scheduleNext_(job, 'QUEUE_PAUSE');
          return;
        }

        var missingDb =
          Number(job.stats.missingBpTypeST || 0) +
          Number(job.stats.missingBpTypeRL || 0) +
          Number(job.stats.missingSalesInfoST || 0) +
          Number(job.stats.missingSalesInfoRL || 0);

        if (missingDb > 0) {
          job.allowStaleCleanup = false;
          job.stats.staleCleanupEnabled = false;
          job.stats.staleCleanupBlockedReason = [
            job.stats.staleCleanupBlockedReason,
            'DB join tidak lengkap=' + missingDb
          ].filter(function (v) {
            return Boolean(v);
          }).join('; ');
        }

        RSC_UR_STRL_prepareGroupedQueue_(technicalSs);
        job.phase = 'STRL_WRITE_GROUPS';
        job.stats.phase = job.phase;
        job.groupCursor = 2;
        RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
        continue;
      }

      if (job.phase === 'STRL_WRITE_GROUPS') {
        if (!RSC_UR_STRL_writeGroups_(
          job,
          targetSs,
          technicalSs,
          executionStartedAt
        )) {
          RSC_STRL14_scheduleNext_(job, 'WRITE_GROUPS_PAUSE');
          return;
        }

        var indexSh = RSC_UR_STRL_ensureIndex_(technicalSs);
        job.phase = 'STRL_FINALIZE';
        job.stats.phase = job.phase;
        job.finalCursor = indexSh.getLastRow();
        RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
        continue;
      }

      if (job.phase === 'STRL_FINALIZE') {
        if (!RSC_UR_STRL_finalize_(
          job,
          targetSs,
          technicalSs,
          executionStartedAt
        )) {
          RSC_STRL14_scheduleNext_(job, 'FINALIZE_PAUSE');
          return;
        }

        RSC_UR_STRL_prepareExportQueue_(job, targetSs, technicalSs);
        job.phase = 'STRL_EXPORT';
        job.stats.phase = job.phase;
        job.exportCursor = 2;
        RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
        continue;
      }

      if (job.phase === 'STRL_EXPORT') {
        if (!RSC_UR_STRL_processExports_(
          job,
          targetSs,
          technicalSs,
          executionStartedAt
        )) {
          RSC_STRL14_scheduleNext_(job, 'EXPORT_PAUSE');
          return;
        }

        job.phase = 'STRL_SUMMARY';
        job.stats.phase = job.phase;
        RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
        continue;
      }

      if (job.phase === 'STRL_SUMMARY') {
        RSC_UR_STRL_buildSummary_(job, targetSs, technicalSs);
        RSC_UR_STRL_finishJob_(job, targetSs, technicalSs);
        return;
      }

      throw new Error('Phase ST/RL tidak dikenal: ' + String(job.phase));
    }

    RSC_STRL14_scheduleNext_(job, 'SOFT_DEADLINE');

  } catch (err) {
    if (!job) {
      RSC_UR_deleteTriggersByHandler_(cfg.stRlWorkerHandler);
      return;
    }

    var errText = RSC_UR_errorText_(err);
    job.globalErrorCount = Number(job.globalErrorCount || 0) + 1;
    job.stats.globalErrorCount = job.globalErrorCount;
    job.stats.lastError = errText;
    job.stats.phase = job.phase;
    job.nextTriggerReason = 'GLOBAL_ERROR_RETRY';
    job.stats.nextTriggerReason = job.nextTriggerReason;

    try {
      RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
    } catch (ignoreSave) {}

    try {
      if (!technicalSs && job.technicalSpreadsheetId) {
        technicalSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(job.technicalSpreadsheetId);
      }
      if (technicalSs) {
        RSC_STRL14_appendError_(
          technicalSs,
          job,
          errText
        );
      }
    } catch (ignoreLog) {}

    if (
      job.globalErrorCount <= RSC_STRL14.maxGlobalErrorRetries
    ) {
      RSC_STRL14_scheduleNext_(
        job,
        'GLOBAL_ERROR_RETRY_' + job.globalErrorCount
      );
      RSC_STRL14_toast_(
        'ST/RL mengalami error sementara dan akan lanjut dari checkpoint. ' +
        errText.slice(0, 180)
      );
      return;
    }

    job.phase = 'STOPPED_GLOBAL_ERROR_LIMIT';
    job.stats.phase = job.phase;
    RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
    RSC_UR_deleteTriggersByHandler_(cfg.stRlWorkerHandler);
    RSC_STRL14_toast_(
      'ST/RL dihentikan setelah error berulang. Cek _UR_STRL_ERRORS_V15.'
    );
  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (ignoreLock) {}
  }
}


/* =====================================================================
 * SOURCE COLLECTION FROM FROZEN MANIFEST
 * =================================================================== */

function RSC_UR_STRL_collectSourceRows_(
  job,
  technicalSs,
  executionStartedAt
) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var manifestSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlManifestSheetName);

  if (!manifestSh) {
    throw new Error('Frozen manifest ST/RL tidak ditemukan.');
  }

  var lastRow = Number(
    job.manifestLastRow || manifestSh.getLastRow()
  );
  var processedThisExecution = 0;

  while (
    job.manifestCursor <= lastRow &&
    processedThisExecution < RSC_STRL14.maxFilesPerExecution &&
    Date.now() - executionStartedAt <
      RSC_STRL14.softDeadlineMs - 15000
  ) {
    var manifestRow = job.manifestCursor;
    var row = manifestSh.getRange(
      manifestRow,
      1,
      1,
      15
    ).getDisplayValues()[0];

    var masterRow = Number(row[0] || 0);
    var fileId = String(row[4] || '').trim();
    var currentResult = String(row[12] || '').trim().toUpperCase();

    if (
      currentResult !== 'PENDING' &&
      currentResult !== 'PROCESSING'
    ) {
      job.manifestCursor++;
      RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
      continue;
    }

    if (!fileId) {
      manifestSh.getRange(manifestRow, 13, 1, 3).setValues([[
        'SKIP_INVALID_LINK',
        'Spreadsheet ID kosong pada frozen manifest.',
        new Date()
      ]]);
      job.manifestCursor++;
      RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
      continue;
    }

    var attempt = RSC_STRL15_prepareFileAttempt_(
      job,
      technicalSs,
      masterRow,
      fileId
    );

    if (attempt.skip) {
      manifestSh.getRange(manifestRow, 13, 1, 3).setValues([[
        attempt.status || 'OK',
        'Dilanjutkan dari target hash ledger; file sudah checkpoint final.',
        new Date()
      ]]);
      job.manifestCursor++;
      job.currentSourceFileId = '';
      RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
      continue;
    }

    job.currentSourceFileId = fileId;
    manifestSh.getRange(manifestRow, 13, 1, 3).setValues([[
      'PROCESSING',
      'Worker sedang memproses file dan menulis hash key ke target.',
      new Date()
    ]]);
    RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);

    job.stats.attemptedManifestLinks++;
    processedThisExecution++;

    var sourceName = '';
    var relationshipName = '';
    var salesmanTypeName = '';
    var rlResult = {rowsScanned: 0, rowsMatched: 0};
    var stResult = {rowsScanned: 0, rowsMatched: 0};
    var messages = [];
    var resultStatus = '';

    try {
      var sourceSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(fileId);
      sourceName = sourceSs.getName();
      job.stats.openedFiles++;
      job.stats.processedFiles++;

      var relationshipSh = RSC_UR_STRL_findSheetByCandidates_(
        sourceSs,
        cfg.stRlRelationshipSheetNames
      );
      var salesmanTypeSh = RSC_UR_STRL_findSheetByCandidates_(
        sourceSs,
        cfg.stRlSalesmanTypeSheetNames
      );

      var hasRlSheet = Boolean(relationshipSh);
      var hasStSheet = Boolean(salesmanTypeSh);
      var rlReadable = false;
      var stReadable = false;

      if (relationshipSh) {
        relationshipName = relationshipSh.getName();

        try {
          rlResult = RSC_UR_STRL_collectRelationshipRows_(
            job,
            technicalSs,
            fileId,
            masterRow,
            relationshipSh
          );
          rlReadable = true;

          if (!Number(rlResult.rowsMatched || 0)) {
            messages.push(
              'RL tidak punya row valid: Customer ID C dan Salesman ID E harus diawali S'
            );
          }
        } catch (rlErr) {
          job.stats.relationshipReadErrors++;
          messages.push(
            'RL READ ERROR: ' + RSC_UR_errorText_(rlErr)
          );
        }
      } else {
        job.stats.missingRelationshipSheets++;
        messages.push('RL sheet tidak ada; dilewati');
      }

      if (salesmanTypeSh) {
        salesmanTypeName = salesmanTypeSh.getName();

        try {
          stResult = RSC_UR_STRL_collectSalesmanTypeRows_(
            job,
            technicalSs,
            fileId,
            masterRow,
            salesmanTypeSh
          );
          stReadable = true;

          if (!Number(stResult.rowsMatched || 0)) {
            messages.push(
              'ST tidak punya row dengan Salesman ID; dilewati'
            );
          }
        } catch (stErr) {
          job.stats.salesmanTypeReadErrors++;
          messages.push(
            'ST READ ERROR: ' + RSC_UR_errorText_(stErr)
          );
        }
      } else {
        job.stats.missingSalesmanTypeSheets++;
        messages.push('ST sheet tidak ada; dilewati');
      }

      var totalMatched =
        Number(rlResult.rowsMatched || 0) +
        Number(stResult.rowsMatched || 0);

      if (!hasRlSheet && !hasStSheet) {
        job.stats.linksWithoutRlOrSt++;
        resultStatus = 'SKIP_NO_RL_ST';
      } else if (totalMatched <= 0) {
        job.stats.linksWithoutValidRows++;
        resultStatus = (rlReadable || stReadable)
          ? 'SKIP_NO_VALID_ROWS'
          : 'READ_ERROR';
      } else {
        job.stats.linksWithMatchedRows++;
        resultStatus = (
          hasRlSheet &&
          hasStSheet &&
          rlReadable &&
          stReadable
        ) ? 'OK' : 'PARTIAL';
      }

    } catch (fileErr) {
      job.stats.fileErrors++;
      resultStatus = 'OPEN_ERROR';
      messages.push(
        'OPEN FILE ERROR: ' + RSC_UR_errorText_(fileErr)
      );
    }

    /*
     * Hash rows ditulis ke TARGET segera setelah satu source selesai.
     * Bila write terputus, status FILE tetap PROCESSING dan execution
     * berikutnya membersihkan tail orphan sebelum mengulang file ini.
     */
    var mirrored = RSC_STRL15_mirrorCurrentFileStageToLedger_(
      job,
      technicalSs,
      attempt,
      sourceName
    );

    job.stats.targetHashRowsWritten =
      Number(job.stats.targetHashRowsWritten || 0) + mirrored.rowsWritten;
    job.stats.targetFilesCheckpointed =
      Number(job.stats.targetFilesCheckpointed || 0) + 1;

    var detailText = messages.join(' | ');

    if (
      resultStatus === 'OPEN_ERROR' ||
      resultStatus === 'READ_ERROR'
    ) {
      job.stats.lastError =
        'Master row ' + masterRow + ': ' + detailText;
    }

    manifestSh.getRange(manifestRow, 6, 1, 10).setValues([[
      sourceName,
      relationshipName,
      Number(rlResult.rowsScanned || 0),
      Number(rlResult.rowsMatched || 0),
      salesmanTypeName,
      Number(stResult.rowsScanned || 0),
      Number(stResult.rowsMatched || 0),
      resultStatus || 'SKIP',
      detailText,
      new Date()
    ]]);

    RSC_STRL15_finishFileAttempt_(
      job,
      attempt,
      resultStatus || 'SKIP',
      mirrored.rowsWritten,
      detailText,
      sourceName
    );

    job.manifestCursor++;
    job.currentSourceFileId = '';
    RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
  }

  return job.manifestCursor > lastRow;
}


/* =====================================================================
 * DB SCANS — smaller chunks, checkpoint every chunk.
 * =================================================================== */

function RSC_UR_STRL_scanBpTypeDatabase_(
  job,
  technicalSs,
  executionStartedAt
) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var needed = RSC_UR_STRL_loadNeededBpSet_(technicalSs);
  var dbSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(cfg.stRlDbSpreadsheetId);
  var dbSh =
    RSC_UR_getSheetById_(dbSs, job.bpTypeMeta.sheetId) ||
    RSC_UR_STRL_getConfiguredSheet_(
      dbSs,
      cfg.stRlGeneralSheetId,
      cfg.stRlGeneralSheetNames,
      'm_bp_general_view'
    );

  while (
    job.bpTypeCursor <= job.bpTypeMeta.lastRow &&
    Date.now() - executionStartedAt <
      RSC_STRL14.softDeadlineMs - 15000
  ) {
    var readRows = Math.min(
      RSC_STRL14.dbReadChunkRows,
      job.bpTypeMeta.lastRow - job.bpTypeCursor + 1
    );

    var rows = dbSh.getRange(
      job.bpTypeCursor,
      job.bpTypeMeta.minCol,
      readRows,
      job.bpTypeMeta.width
    ).getDisplayValues();

    var mapRows = [];

    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      var bpId = String(
        rows[i][job.bpTypeMeta.bpId] || ''
      ).trim().toUpperCase();

      if (!bpId || !needed[bpId]) {
        continue;
      }

      var bpType = String(
        rows[i][job.bpTypeMeta.bpType] || ''
      ).trim().toUpperCase();

      if (bpType) {
        mapRows.push([bpId, bpType]);
      }
    }

    RSC_UR_appendRows_(
      technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlBpTypeMapSheetName),
      mapRows
    );

    job.stats.bpTypeRowsScanned += rows.length;
    job.stats.bpTypeMatches += mapRows.length;
    job.bpTypeCursor += rows.length;
    RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
  }

  return job.bpTypeCursor > job.bpTypeMeta.lastRow;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_scanSalesInfoDatabase_(
  job,
  technicalSs,
  executionStartedAt
) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var needed = RSC_UR_STRL_loadNeededBpSet_(technicalSs);
  var dbSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(cfg.stRlDbSpreadsheetId);
  var dbSh =
    RSC_UR_getSheetById_(dbSs, job.salesMeta.sheetId) ||
    RSC_UR_STRL_getConfiguredSheet_(
      dbSs,
      cfg.stRlSalesInfoSheetId,
      cfg.stRlSalesInfoSheetNames,
      'm_sales_info'
    );

  while (
    job.salesCursor <= job.salesMeta.lastRow &&
    Date.now() - executionStartedAt <
      RSC_STRL14.softDeadlineMs - 15000
  ) {
    var readRows = Math.min(
      RSC_STRL14.dbReadChunkRows,
      job.salesMeta.lastRow - job.salesCursor + 1
    );

    var rows = dbSh.getRange(
      job.salesCursor,
      job.salesMeta.minCol,
      readRows,
      job.salesMeta.width
    ).getDisplayValues();

    var mapRows = [];

    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      var bpId = String(
        rows[i][job.salesMeta.bpId] || ''
      ).trim().toUpperCase();

      if (!bpId || !needed[bpId]) {
        continue;
      }

      var salesOrg = String(
        rows[i][job.salesMeta.salesOrg] || ''
      ).trim().toUpperCase();
      var salesOffice = RSC_UR_extractCode_(
        rows[i][job.salesMeta.salesOffice]
      );
      var validFrom = String(
        rows[i][job.salesMeta.validFrom] || ''
      ).trim();
      var validTo = String(
        rows[i][job.salesMeta.validTo] || ''
      ).trim();

      if (salesOrg && salesOffice) {
        mapRows.push([
          bpId,
          salesOrg,
          salesOffice,
          validFrom,
          validTo
        ]);
      }
    }

    RSC_UR_appendRows_(
      technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlSalesMapSheetName),
      mapRows
    );

    job.stats.salesInfoRowsScanned += rows.length;
    job.stats.salesInfoMatches += mapRows.length;
    job.salesCursor += rows.length;
    RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
  }

  return job.salesCursor > job.salesMeta.lastRow;
}


/* =====================================================================
 * HASHED BUSINESS KEYS
 * =================================================================== */

function RSC_UR_STRL_makeRelationshipRowKey_(row) {
  var indexes = RSC_UR_20260721.stRlRelationshipKeyIndexes;
  var raw = ['RL'].concat(indexes.map(function (index) {
    return String(row[index] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  })).join('\u001F');

  return RSC_STRL14_hash128_(raw);
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_makeSalesmanTypeRowKey_(row) {
  var indexes = RSC_UR_20260721.stRlSalesmanTypeKeyIndexes;
  var raw = ['ST'].concat(indexes.map(function (index) {
    return String(row[index] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  })).join('\u001F');

  return RSC_STRL14_hash128_(raw);
}


function RSC_STRL14_fnv32_(text, seed) {
  text = String(text == null ? '' : text);
  var hash = Number(seed >>> 0);

  for (var i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    hash ^= text.charCodeAt(i);
    hash += (
      (hash << 1) +
      (hash << 4) +
      (hash << 7) +
      (hash << 8) +
      (hash << 24)
    );
    hash >>>= 0;
  }

  return ('00000000' + (hash >>> 0).toString(16)).slice(-8);
}


function RSC_STRL14_hash128_(text) {
  text = String(text == null ? '' : text);

  return [
    RSC_STRL14_fnv32_('A|' + text, 2166136261),
    RSC_STRL14_fnv32_('B|' + text, 2246822519),
    RSC_STRL14_fnv32_('C|' + text, 3266489917),
    RSC_STRL14_fnv32_('D|' + text, 668265263)
  ].join('');
}


function RSC_STRL14_rowHash_(row) {
  return RSC_STRL14_hash128_(
    (row || []).map(function (value) {
      return String(value == null ? '' : value).trim();
    }).join('\u001F')
  );
}


/* =====================================================================
 * PERSISTENT GROUP KEY STORE + HASH FAST PATH
 * =================================================================== */

function RSC_STRL14_ensureKeyStore_(technicalSs) {
  var sh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(
    RSC_STRL14.keyStoreSheetName
  );

  if (!sh) {
    sh = RSC_UR_createTechnicalSheet_(
      technicalSs,
      RSC_STRL14.keyStoreSheetName,
      2,
      RSC_STRL14.keyStoreHeaders.length
    );
  }

  RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(
    sh,
    2,
    RSC_STRL14.keyStoreHeaders.length
  );
  sh.getRange(
    1,
    1,
    1,
    RSC_STRL14.keyStoreHeaders.length
  ).setValues([RSC_STRL14.keyStoreHeaders]);

  try { sh.hideSheet(); } catch (ignore) {}
  return sh;
}


function RSC_STRL14_loadKeyStoreMap_(technicalSs) {
  var sh = RSC_STRL14_ensureKeyStore_(technicalSs);
  var output = {};

  if (sh.getLastRow() < 2) {
    return output;
  }

  var rows = sh.getRange(
    2,
    1,
    sh.getLastRow() - 1,
    RSC_STRL14.keyStoreHeaders.length
  ).getDisplayValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var groupName = String(rows[i][0] || '').trim();

    if (!groupName) {
      continue;
    }

    output[groupName] = {
      row: i + 2,
      outputSheetName: String(rows[i][1] || '').trim(),
      runId: String(rows[i][2] || '').trim(),
      prefix: String(rows[i][3] || '').trim(),
      keyCount: Number(rows[i][4] || 0),
      snapshotHash: String(rows[i][5] || '').trim(),
      blob: String(rows[i][6] || '')
    };
  }

  return output;
}


function RSC_STRL14_snapshot_(byKey, order) {
  var keys = (order || []).slice().sort();
  var records = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var key = keys[i];
    records.push([
      key,
      RSC_STRL14_rowHash_(byKey[key])
    ]);
  }

  return {
    count: records.length,
    records: records,
    hash: RSC_STRL14_hash128_(JSON.stringify(records)),
    blob: RSC_STRL14_gzipBase64_(records)
  };
}


function RSC_STRL14_gzipBase64_(value) {
  var json = typeof value === 'string'
    ? value
    : JSON.stringify(value);
  var blob = Utilities.newBlob(
    json,
    'application/json'
  );
  var gz = Utilities.gzip(blob);
  return Utilities.base64Encode(gz.getBytes());
}


function RSC_STRL14_writeKeyStore_(
  technicalSs,
  keyStoreMap,
  groupName,
  outputSheetName,
  runId,
  prefix,
  snapshot
) {
  var sh = RSC_STRL14_ensureKeyStore_(technicalSs);
  var existing = keyStoreMap[groupName];
  var row = existing ? existing.row : sh.getLastRow() + 1;

  RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(
    sh,
    row,
    RSC_STRL14.keyStoreHeaders.length
  );

  sh.getRange(
    row,
    1,
    1,
    RSC_STRL14.keyStoreHeaders.length
  ).setValues([[
    groupName,
    outputSheetName,
    runId,
    prefix,
    snapshot.count,
    snapshot.hash,
    String(snapshot.blob || '').length <= 44000
      ? snapshot.blob
      : ('HASH_ONLY|' + snapshot.hash + '|COUNT=' + snapshot.count),
    new Date()
  ]]);

  keyStoreMap[groupName] = {
    row: row,
    outputSheetName: outputSheetName,
    runId: runId,
    prefix: prefix,
    keyCount: snapshot.count,
    snapshotHash: snapshot.hash,
    blob: snapshot.blob
  };
}




/* =====================================================================
 * PATCH 15 — DURABLE HASH LEDGER IN TARGET SPREADSHEET
 * =================================================================== */

var __RSC_STRL15_LEDGER_CACHE__ = null;

var RSC_STRL15_LEDGER_HEADERS = [
  'Record Type',
  'Run ID',
  'Hash Key',
  'Status',
  'Master Row',
  'Source Spreadsheet ID',
  'Source Row / Ledger Start',
  'Prefix / Row Count',
  'Entity BP ID',
  'Source Sales Org',
  'Source Sales Office',
  'Source Valid From',
  'Source Valid To',
  'Group Name',
  'BP Type ID',
  'Sales Organization',
  'Sales Office',
  'Payload / Checkpoint JSON',
  'Payload Hash',
  'Updated At',
  'Message'
];


function RSC_STRL15_bindLedgerCache_(targetSs, job) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var sh = null;
  var wantedId = Number(
    (job && job.hashLedgerSheetId) ||
    cfg.stRlHashLedgerSheetId ||
    0
  );

  if (wantedId) {
    sh = RSC_UR_getSheetById_(targetSs, wantedId);
  }

  if (!sh && job && job.hashLedgerSheetName) {
    sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(job.hashLedgerSheetName);
  }

  if (!sh) {
    sh = targetSs.getSheetByName(
      cfg.stRlHashLedgerSheetName || '_UR_STRL_HASH_KEYS_V15'
    );
  }

  if (!sh) {
    sh = targetSs.insertSheet(
      RSC_UR_safeSheetName_(
        cfg.stRlHashLedgerSheetName || '_UR_STRL_HASH_KEYS_V15'
      )
    );
  }

  RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(
    sh,
    RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerDataStartRow,
    RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerColumns
  );
  sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, RSC_STRL15_LEDGER_HEADERS.length)
    .setValues([RSC_STRL15_LEDGER_HEADERS]);
  sh.setFrozenRows(1);

  __RSC_STRL15_LEDGER_CACHE__ = {
    spreadsheetId: targetSs.getId(),
    sheetId: sh.getSheetId(),
    sheet: sh
  };

  if (job) {
    job.hashLedgerSheetId = sh.getSheetId();
    job.hashLedgerSheetName = sh.getName();
  }

  return sh;
}


function RSC_STRL15_getLedgerSheet_(job) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var targetId = String(
    (job && job.targetSpreadsheetId) ||
    cfg.stRlTargetSpreadsheetId ||
    ''
  );

  if (
    __RSC_STRL15_LEDGER_CACHE__ &&
    __RSC_STRL15_LEDGER_CACHE__.spreadsheetId === targetId
  ) {
    return __RSC_STRL15_LEDGER_CACHE__.sheet;
  }

  if (!targetId) {
    throw new Error('Target spreadsheet ID hash ledger tidak tersedia.');
  }

  var targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(targetId);
  return RSC_STRL15_bindLedgerCache_(targetSs, job);
}


function RSC_STRL15_resetTargetLedger_(targetSs, runId) {
  var sh = RSC_STRL15_bindLedgerCache_(targetSs, null);
  var clearRows = Math.max(
    sh.getLastRow(),
    RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerDataStartRow
  );

  RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(
    sh,
    clearRows,
    RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerColumns
  );
  sh.getRange(1, 1, clearRows, RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerColumns)
    .clearContent();
  sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, RSC_STRL15_LEDGER_HEADERS.length)
    .setValues([RSC_STRL15_LEDGER_HEADERS]);

  sh.getRange(
    RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerRunMetaRow,
    1,
    1,
    RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerColumns
  ).setValues([RSC_STRL15_normalizeLedgerRow_([
    'RUN_META',
    runId,
    RSC_STRL14_hash128_('RUN|' + runId),
    'ACTIVE',
    '',
    targetSs.getId(),
    RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerDataStartRow,
    '',
    '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '',
    JSON.stringify({
      engineVersion: RSC_STRL14.engineVersion,
      dataStartRow: RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerDataStartRow,
      targetSpreadsheetId: targetSs.getId()
    }),
    '',
    new Date(),
    'Hash key RL/ST ditulis batch mulai row ' +
      RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerDataStartRow + '.'
  ])]);

  sh.setFrozenRows(3);
  RSC_UR_trimSheetGrid_(
    sh,
    RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerDataStartRow,
    RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerColumns
  );
  try { sh.autoResizeColumns(1, 8); } catch (ignoreResize) {}
  return sh;
}


function RSC_STRL15_normalizeLedgerRow_(row) {
  var output = Array.isArray(row) ? row.slice(0) : [row];

  while (output.length < RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerColumns) {
    output.push('');
  }

  if (output.length > RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerColumns) {
    output = output.slice(0, RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerColumns);
  }

  return output;
}


function RSC_STRL15_writeTargetCheckpoint_(job, serialized) {
  if (!job || !job.targetSpreadsheetId) {
    return;
  }

  serialized = String(serialized || JSON.stringify(job));

  if (serialized.length > 49000) {
    var compact = {
      engineVersion: job.engineVersion,
      runId: job.runId,
      phase: job.phase,
      masterSpreadsheetId: job.masterSpreadsheetId,
      masterSheetId: job.masterSheetId,
      masterSheetName: job.masterSheetName,
      targetSpreadsheetId: job.targetSpreadsheetId,
      technicalSpreadsheetId: job.technicalSpreadsheetId,
      hashLedgerSheetId: job.hashLedgerSheetId,
      hashLedgerSheetName: job.hashLedgerSheetName,
      hashLedgerDataStartRow: job.hashLedgerDataStartRow,
      manifestCursor: job.manifestCursor,
      manifestLastRow: job.manifestLastRow,
      bpTypeMeta: job.bpTypeMeta,
      bpTypeCursor: job.bpTypeCursor,
      salesMeta: job.salesMeta,
      salesCursor: job.salesCursor,
      stageCursor: job.stageCursor,
      groupCursor: job.groupCursor,
      finalCursor: job.finalCursor,
      exportCursor: job.exportCursor,
      allowStaleCleanup: job.allowStaleCleanup,
      changedSalesOffices: job.changedSalesOffices || {},
      globalErrorCount: job.globalErrorCount,
      runChunks: job.runChunks,
      currentSourceFileId: job.currentSourceFileId,
      lastHeartbeatAt: job.lastHeartbeatAt,
      nextTriggerReason: job.nextTriggerReason,
      stats: job.stats || {}
    };
    serialized = JSON.stringify(compact);
  }

  if (serialized.length > 49000) {
    if (job.stats) {
      job.stats.lastError = String(job.stats.lastError || '').slice(0, 2000);
      job.stats.staleCleanupBlockedReason = String(
        job.stats.staleCleanupBlockedReason || ''
      ).slice(0, 2000);
    }
    serialized = JSON.stringify({
      engineVersion: job.engineVersion,
      runId: job.runId,
      phase: job.phase,
      masterSpreadsheetId: job.masterSpreadsheetId,
      masterSheetId: job.masterSheetId,
      masterSheetName: job.masterSheetName,
      targetSpreadsheetId: job.targetSpreadsheetId,
      technicalSpreadsheetId: job.technicalSpreadsheetId,
      hashLedgerSheetId: job.hashLedgerSheetId,
      hashLedgerSheetName: job.hashLedgerSheetName,
      manifestCursor: job.manifestCursor,
      manifestLastRow: job.manifestLastRow,
      bpTypeMeta: job.bpTypeMeta,
      bpTypeCursor: job.bpTypeCursor,
      salesMeta: job.salesMeta,
      salesCursor: job.salesCursor,
      stageCursor: job.stageCursor,
      groupCursor: job.groupCursor,
      finalCursor: job.finalCursor,
      exportCursor: job.exportCursor,
      allowStaleCleanup: job.allowStaleCleanup,
      changedSalesOffices: job.changedSalesOffices || {},
      globalErrorCount: job.globalErrorCount,
      runChunks: job.runChunks,
      currentSourceFileId: job.currentSourceFileId,
      lastHeartbeatAt: job.lastHeartbeatAt,
      nextTriggerReason: job.nextTriggerReason,
      stats: job.stats || {}
    });
  }

  var sh = RSC_STRL15_getLedgerSheet_(job);
  var row = RSC_STRL15_normalizeLedgerRow_([
    'CHECKPOINT',
    String(job.runId || ''),
    RSC_STRL14_hash128_('CHECKPOINT|' + String(job.runId || '')),
    String(job.phase || ''),
    Number(job.manifestCursor || 0),
    String(job.currentSourceFileId || ''),
    Number(
      job.bpTypeCursor ||
      job.salesCursor ||
      job.stageCursor ||
      job.groupCursor ||
      job.exportCursor ||
      0
    ),
    Number(job.runChunks || 0),
    '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '',
    serialized,
    RSC_STRL14_hash128_(serialized),
    new Date(),
    String(job.nextTriggerReason || '')
  ]);

  sh.getRange(
    RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerCheckpointRow,
    1,
    1,
    RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerColumns
  ).setValues([row]);
}


function RSC_STRL15_recoverJobFromTargetLedger_() {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var targetId = String(cfg.stRlTargetSpreadsheetId || '');

  if (!targetId) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    var targetSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(targetId);
    var sh = RSC_STRL15_bindLedgerCache_(targetSs, null);
    var row = sh.getRange(
      RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerCheckpointRow,
      1,
      1,
      RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerColumns
    ).getDisplayValues()[0];

    if (String(row[0] || '').trim().toUpperCase() !== 'CHECKPOINT') {
      return null;
    }

    var serialized = String(row[17] || '').trim();
    var expectedHash = String(row[18] || '').trim();

    if (!serialized) {
      return null;
    }

    if (
      expectedHash &&
      expectedHash !== RSC_STRL14_hash128_(serialized)
    ) {
      throw new Error('Hash checkpoint target tidak cocok.');
    }

    var job = JSON.parse(serialized);

    if (
      !job ||
      String(job.engineVersion || '') !== RSC_STRL14.engineVersion ||
      String(job.phase || '') === 'DONE'
    ) {
      return null;
    }

    job.hashLedgerSheetId = sh.getSheetId();
    job.hashLedgerSheetName = sh.getName();
    return job;
  } catch (err) {
    return null;
  }
}


function RSC_STRL15_fileStatusRow_(masterRow) {
  return Number(masterRow || 0) + RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerFileRowOffset;
}


function RSC_STRL15_isFinalFileStatus_(status) {
  status = String(status || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  return [
    'OK',
    'PARTIAL',
    'SKIP_NO_RL_ST',
    'SKIP_NO_VALID_ROWS',
    'OPEN_ERROR',
    'READ_ERROR',
    'SKIP_INVALID_LINK'
  ].indexOf(status) >= 0;
}


function RSC_STRL15_prepareFileAttempt_(job, technicalSs, masterRow, fileId) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var ledgerSh = RSC_STRL15_getLedgerSheet_(job);
  var fileRow = RSC_STRL15_fileStatusRow_(masterRow);
  var current = ledgerSh.getRange(
    fileRow,
    1,
    1,
    RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerColumns
  ).getDisplayValues()[0];
  var currentRun = String(current[1] || '').trim();
  var currentStatus = String(current[3] || '').trim().toUpperCase();

  if (
    currentRun === String(job.runId || '') &&
    RSC_STRL15_isFinalFileStatus_(currentStatus)
  ) {
    return {
      skip: true,
      status: currentStatus,
      fileRow: fileRow
    };
  }

  if (
    currentRun === String(job.runId || '') &&
    currentStatus === 'PROCESSING'
  ) {
    var oldState = {};
    try { oldState = JSON.parse(String(current[17] || '{}')); } catch (ignore) {}
    RSC_STRL15_clearTail_(
      ledgerSh,
      Number(oldState.ledgerStart || 0),
      RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerColumns
    );
    RSC_STRL15_clearTechnicalTail_(
      technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlStageSheetName),
      Number(oldState.stageStart || 0),
      11
    );
    RSC_STRL15_clearTechnicalTail_(
      technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlNeedsSheetName),
      Number(oldState.needsStart || 0),
      1
    );
  }

  var stageSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlStageSheetName);
  var needsSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlNeedsSheetName);
  var attempt = {
    skip: false,
    status: 'PROCESSING',
    fileRow: fileRow,
    masterRow: Number(masterRow || 0),
    fileId: String(fileId || ''),
    ledgerStart: Math.max(
      RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerDataStartRow,
      ledgerSh.getLastRow() + 1
    ),
    stageStart: stageSh.getLastRow() + 1,
    needsStart: needsSh.getLastRow() + 1
  };

  ledgerSh.getRange(
    fileRow,
    1,
    1,
    RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerColumns
  ).setValues([RSC_STRL15_normalizeLedgerRow_([
    'FILE',
    job.runId,
    RSC_STRL14_hash128_('FILE|' + fileId),
    'PROCESSING',
    masterRow,
    fileId,
    attempt.ledgerStart,
    0,
    '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '',
    JSON.stringify(attempt),
    '',
    new Date(),
    'Checkpoint sebelum openById.'
  ])]);

  return attempt;
}


function RSC_STRL15_clearTail_(sh, startRow, width) {
  if (!sh || startRow < RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerDataStartRow) {
    return;
  }

  var lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow >= startRow) {
    sh.getRange(startRow, 1, lastRow - startRow + 1, width)
      .clearContent();
  }
}


function RSC_STRL15_clearTechnicalTail_(sh, startRow, width) {
  if (!sh || startRow < 2) {
    return;
  }

  var lastRow = sh.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow >= startRow) {
    sh.getRange(startRow, 1, lastRow - startRow + 1, width)
      .clearContent();
  }
}


function RSC_STRL15_finishFileAttempt_(
  job,
  attempt,
  status,
  rowCount,
  detail,
  sourceName
) {
  var sh = RSC_STRL15_getLedgerSheet_(job);
  var state = {
    ledgerStart: attempt.ledgerStart,
    ledgerRows: Number(rowCount || 0),
    stageStart: attempt.stageStart,
    needsStart: attempt.needsStart,
    sourceName: String(sourceName || '')
  };

  sh.getRange(
    attempt.fileRow,
    1,
    1,
    RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerColumns
  ).setValues([RSC_STRL15_normalizeLedgerRow_([
    'FILE',
    job.runId,
    RSC_STRL14_hash128_('FILE|' + attempt.fileId),
    String(status || 'OK'),
    attempt.masterRow,
    attempt.fileId,
    attempt.ledgerStart,
    Number(rowCount || 0),
    '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '',
    JSON.stringify(state),
    RSC_STRL14_hash128_(JSON.stringify(state)),
    new Date(),
    String(detail || '').slice(0, 45000)
  ])]);
}


function RSC_STRL15_rebuildTechnicalStageFromLedgerIfNeeded_(job, technicalSs) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var stageSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlStageSheetName);
  var needsSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlNeedsSheetName);

  if (!stageSh || !needsSh || stageSh.getLastRow() >= 2) {
    return;
  }

  var ledgerSh = RSC_STRL15_getLedgerSheet_(job);
  var lastRow = ledgerSh.getLastRow();
  var cursor = RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerDataStartRow;
  var stageOut = [];
  var needsOut = [];

  while (cursor <= lastRow) {
    var readCount = Math.min(2000, lastRow - cursor + 1);
    var rows = ledgerSh.getRange(
      cursor,
      1,
      readCount,
      RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerColumns
    ).getDisplayValues();

    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      if (
        String(rows[i][0] || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DATA' ||
        String(rows[i][1] || '') !== String(job.runId || '')
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      var payload = String(rows[i][17] || '');
      var rawKey = RSC_STRL15_rebuildRawKeyFromPayload_(
        String(rows[i][7] || ''),
        payload
      );

      stageOut.push([
        rawKey,
        String(rows[i][5] || ''),
        String(rows[i][4] || ''),
        String(rows[i][6] || ''),
        String(rows[i][7] || ''),
        String(rows[i][8] || ''),
        String(rows[i][9] || ''),
        String(rows[i][10] || ''),
        String(rows[i][11] || ''),
        String(rows[i][12] || ''),
        payload
      ]);
      needsOut.push([String(rows[i][8] || '')]);
    }

    if (stageOut.length >= 2000) {
      RSC_UR_appendRows_(stageSh, stageOut);
      RSC_UR_appendRows_(needsSh, needsOut);
      stageOut = [];
      needsOut = [];
    }

    cursor += rows.length;
  }

  RSC_UR_appendRows_(stageSh, stageOut);
  RSC_UR_appendRows_(needsSh, needsOut);

  if (job.stats) {
    job.stats.stageRebuiltFromTargetLedger = true;
  }
}


function RSC_STRL15_rebuildRawKeyFromPayload_(prefix, payloadJson) {
  var row = [];
  try { row = JSON.parse(String(payloadJson || '[]')); } catch (ignore) {}

  if (String(prefix || '').toUpperCase() === 'ST') {
    return RSC_UR_STRL_makeSalesmanTypeRowKey_(row);
  }

  return RSC_UR_STRL_makeRelationshipRowKey_(row);
}


/* =====================================================================
 * CHECKPOINT / WATCHDOG / LOGGING
 * =================================================================== */

function RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();

  if (job && job.stats) {
    job.stats.phase = job.phase;
    job.stats.runChunks = Number(job.runChunks || 0);
    job.stats.globalErrorCount =
      Number(job.globalErrorCount || 0);
    job.stats.lastHeartbeatAt =
      String(job.lastHeartbeatAt || '');
    job.stats.nextTriggerReason =
      String(job.nextTriggerReason || '');
  }

  var serialized = JSON.stringify(job);
  props.setProperty(cfg.stRlJobProperty, serialized);
  props.setProperty(
    cfg.stRlLastStatusProperty,
    JSON.stringify(job.stats || {})
  );

  /* Target checkpoint is best-effort. Property checkpoint tetap utama
   * selama tersedia, tetapi target row 2 dapat memulihkan job bila
   * property hilang atau deployment berganti execution. */
  try {
    RSC_STRL15_writeTargetCheckpoint_(job, serialized);
  } catch (ledgerErr) {
    if (job && job.stats) {
      job.stats.targetCheckpointError = RSC_UR_errorText_(ledgerErr);
    }
  }
}


/* Existing helpers call this name; route them to durable V15 checkpoint. */
function RSC_UR_STRL_saveJob_(job) {
  return RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
}


function RSC_STRL143_createTimeTriggerSafe_(
  handlerName,
  delayMs,
  context
) {
  var lastError = null;
  var attempts = 3;

  for (var attempt = 1; attempt <= attempts; attempt++) {
    try {
      var trigger = RSC_PERF13_NEW_TRIGGER_20260819_(handlerName)
        .timeBased()
        .after(Math.max(60000, Number(delayMs || 60000)))
        .create();

      return {
        ok: true,
        triggerId: trigger && typeof trigger.getUniqueId === 'function'
          ? String(trigger.getUniqueId() || '')
          : '',
        error: ''
      };
    } catch (err) {
      lastError = err;

      if (attempt < attempts) {
        try { Utilities.sleep(attempt * 1000); } catch (ignoreSleep) {}
      }
    }
  }

  var errorText = RSC_UR_errorText_(lastError);

  try {
    console.warn(
      'Trigger ST/RL gagal dibuat [' + context + ']: ' + errorText
    );
  } catch (ignoreLog) {}

  /*
   * Trigger adalah mekanisme continuation, bukan syarat proses saat ini.
   * Checkpoint sudah tersimpan. Jangan throw supaya Start/Continue manual
   * tetap memproses data pada execution yang sedang berjalan.
   */
  try {
    var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
    var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
    var raw = props.getProperty(cfg.stRlJobProperty);

    if (raw) {
      var job = JSON.parse(raw);
      job.nextTriggerReason = 'MANUAL_CONTINUE_REQUIRED';
      job.triggerServiceError = errorText;
      job.triggerSchedulePending = true;

      if (job.stats) {
        job.stats.nextTriggerReason = job.nextTriggerReason;
        job.stats.triggerServiceError = errorText;
        job.stats.triggerSchedulePending = true;
      }

      RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
    }
  } catch (ignoreCheckpoint) {}

  RSC_STRL14_toast_(
    'Layanan trigger sedang gagal. Proses saat ini tetap berjalan. ' +
    'Jika job berhenti, jalankan Continue ST/RL secara manual.'
  );

  return {
    ok: false,
    triggerId: '',
    error: errorText
  };
}


function RSC_STRL14_scheduleWatchdog_(job, reason) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  job.nextTriggerReason = reason || 'WATCHDOG';
  job.triggerSchedulePending = false;

  if (job.stats) {
    job.stats.nextTriggerReason = job.nextTriggerReason;
    job.stats.triggerSchedulePending = false;
  }

  RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);

  // Penghapusan trigger bersifat best-effort dan tidak boleh throw.
  RSC_UR_deleteTriggersByHandler_(cfg.stRlWorkerHandler);

  var result = RSC_STRL143_createTimeTriggerSafe_(
    cfg.stRlWorkerHandler,
    RSC_STRL14.watchdogDelayMs,
    reason || 'WATCHDOG'
  );

  if (result.ok) {
    job.triggerSchedulePending = false;
    job.triggerServiceError = '';
    job.lastScheduledTriggerId = result.triggerId;

    if (job.stats) {
      job.stats.triggerSchedulePending = false;
      job.stats.triggerServiceError = '';
    }

    RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
  }

  return result.ok;
}


function RSC_STRL14_scheduleNext_(job, reason) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  job.nextTriggerReason = reason || 'CONTINUE';
  job.triggerSchedulePending = false;

  if (job.stats) {
    job.stats.nextTriggerReason = job.nextTriggerReason;
    job.stats.triggerSchedulePending = false;
  }

  RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);

  RSC_UR_deleteTriggersByHandler_(cfg.stRlWorkerHandler);

  var result = RSC_STRL143_createTimeTriggerSafe_(
    cfg.stRlWorkerHandler,
    RSC_STRL14.continuationDelayMs,
    reason || 'CONTINUE'
  );

  if (result.ok) {
    job.triggerSchedulePending = false;
    job.triggerServiceError = '';
    job.lastScheduledTriggerId = result.triggerId;

    if (job.stats) {
      job.stats.triggerSchedulePending = false;
      job.stats.triggerServiceError = '';
    }

    RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
  }

  return result.ok;
}


function RSC_UR_STRL_scheduleNextRun_(job) {
  return RSC_STRL14_scheduleNext_(job, 'LEGACY_HELPER_CONTINUE');
}


function RSC_STRL14_scheduleWithoutCheckpoint_(reason) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;

  RSC_UR_deleteTriggersByHandler_(cfg.stRlWorkerHandler);
  var scheduled = RSC_STRL143_createTimeTriggerSafe_(
    cfg.stRlWorkerHandler,
    RSC_STRL14.continuationDelayMs,
    reason || 'LOCK_BUSY'
  );

  try {
    var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
    var raw = props.getProperty(cfg.stRlJobProperty);

    if (raw) {
      var job = JSON.parse(raw);
      job.nextTriggerReason = scheduled.ok
        ? (reason || 'LOCK_BUSY')
        : 'MANUAL_CONTINUE_REQUIRED';
      job.triggerSchedulePending = !scheduled.ok;
      job.triggerServiceError = scheduled.error || '';

      if (job.stats) {
        job.stats.nextTriggerReason = job.nextTriggerReason;
        job.stats.triggerSchedulePending = !scheduled.ok;
        job.stats.triggerServiceError = scheduled.error || '';
      }

      RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
    }
  } catch (ignore) {}

  return scheduled.ok;
}


function RSC_STRL14_ensureErrorLog_(technicalSs) {
  var sh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(
    RSC_STRL14.errorLogSheetName
  );

  if (!sh) {
    sh = RSC_UR_createTechnicalSheet_(
      technicalSs,
      RSC_STRL14.errorLogSheetName,
      2,
      RSC_STRL14.errorHeaders.length
    );
  }

  RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(
    sh,
    2,
    RSC_STRL14.errorHeaders.length
  );
  sh.getRange(
    1,
    1,
    1,
    RSC_STRL14.errorHeaders.length
  ).setValues([RSC_STRL14.errorHeaders]);

  try { sh.hideSheet(); } catch (ignore) {}
  return sh;
}


function RSC_STRL14_appendError_(technicalSs, job, errorText) {
  var sh = RSC_STRL14_ensureErrorLog_(technicalSs);
  RSC_UR_appendRows_(sh, [[
    new Date(),
    String(job.runId || ''),
    String(job.phase || ''),
    String(
      job.manifestCursor ||
      job.bpTypeCursor ||
      job.salesCursor ||
      job.stageCursor ||
      job.groupCursor ||
      job.exportCursor ||
      ''
    ),
    Number(job.globalErrorCount || 0),
    String(errorText || '').slice(0, 45000)
  ]]);
}


function RSC_STRL14_toast_(message) {
  try {
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(
      String(message || ''),
      'Compile ST/RL V15',
      10
    );
  } catch (ignore) {}
}

/* =====================================================================
 * PATCH 15.2 — FAST, ACCURATE BATCH OUTPUT WRITER
 * 2026-07-28
 *
 * Tujuan:
 * - Hindari clearFormats/background/width/trim pada setiap upsert.
 * - Hindari membaca ulang output setelah write hanya untuk membuat hash.
 * - Simpan INDEX + KEY STORE secara batch, bukan per group.
 * - Simpan checkpoint per beberapa group, tetap idempotent saat retry.
 * - Hilangkan SpreadsheetApp.flush() per source file.
 * =================================================================== */

var RSC_STRL152 = {
  maxGroupsPerExecution: 20,
  checkpointEveryGroups: 5,
  deadlineReserveMs: 20000,
  outputGridTrimSlackRows: 5000
};


function RSC_STRL152_snapshotFast_(byKey, order) {
  var keys = (order || []).slice().sort();
  var records = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var key = keys[i];
    records.push([
      key,
      RSC_STRL14_rowHash_(byKey[key])
    ]);
  }

  var hash = RSC_STRL14_hash128_(JSON.stringify(records));
  return {
    count: records.length,
    records: records,
    hash: hash,
    // Blob penuh tidak pernah dibaca oleh pipeline. Simpan marker kecil saja.
    blob: 'HASH_ONLY|' + hash + '|COUNT=' + records.length
  };
}


function RSC_STRL152_createOutputSheetFast_(
  targetSs,
  sheetName,
  headers,
  prefix
) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  RSC_UR_ensureWorkbookHeadroom_(
    targetSs,
    'TARGET',
    cfg.insertSheetSafetyCells
  );

  var sh;
  try {
    sh = targetSs.insertSheet(sheetName);
  } catch (err) {
    var text = String(err && err.stack ? err.stack : err);
    if (/cell|10000000|number of cells|above the limit|maximum/i.test(text)) {
      RSC_UR_cleanseSpreadsheet_(targetSs, 'TARGET');
      sh = targetSs.insertSheet(sheetName);
    } else {
      throw err;
    }
  }

  RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(sh, 2, headers.length);
  sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length)
    .setNumberFormat('@')
    .setValues([headers])
    .setFontWeight('bold')
    .setBackground('#F3F4F6')
    .setWrap(true)
    .setVerticalAlignment('middle')
    .setHorizontalAlignment('left');

  sh.setFrozenRows(1);
  RSC_UR_STRL_setOutputWidths_(sh, prefix, headers.length);
  return sh;
}


/* Fast rewrite: hanya ubah nilai yang diperlukan. Format header/width hanya
 * dibuat saat sheet baru atau header berubah. Tidak clearFormats seluruh sheet. */
function RSC_UR_STRL_rewriteOutputSheet_(sheet, headers, rows, prefix) {
  var columnCount = headers.length;
  var lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
  var existingRows = Math.max(0, lastRow - 1);
  var headerMatches = RSC_UR_STRL_headerMatches_(sheet, headers);
  var requiredRows = Math.max(2, rows.length + 1);

  RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(sheet, requiredRows, columnCount);

  if (!headerMatches) {
    sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, columnCount)
      .setNumberFormat('@')
      .setValues([headers])
      .setFontWeight('bold')
      .setBackground('#F3F4F6')
      .setWrap(true)
      .setVerticalAlignment('middle')
      .setHorizontalAlignment('left');

    sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
    RSC_UR_STRL_setOutputWidths_(sheet, prefix, columnCount);
  }

  if (rows.length > 0) {
    sheet.getRange(2, 1, rows.length, columnCount)
      .setNumberFormat('@')
      .setValues(rows);
  }

  // Bersihkan hanya tail lama yang sudah tidak dipakai.
  if (existingRows > rows.length) {
    sheet.getRange(
      rows.length + 2,
      1,
      existingRows - rows.length,
      columnCount
    ).clearContent();
  }

  // Compact hanya jika grid jauh lebih besar dari data; bukan setiap write.
  var desiredRows = Math.max(2, rows.length + 1);
  if (sheet.getMaxRows() > desiredRows + RSC_STRL152.outputGridTrimSlackRows) {
    try {
      RSC_UR_trimSheetGrid_(sheet, desiredRows, columnCount);
    } catch (ignoreTrim) {}
  }
}


/* Upsert menghasilkan snapshot langsung dari finalRows di memori. Tidak perlu
 * membaca ulang sheet setelah setValues(). */
function RSC_UR_STRL_upsertOutputSheet_(
  sheet,
  headers,
  incomingByKey,
  incomingOrder,
  prefix,
  allowPurge
) {
  var columnCount = headers.length;
  var lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
  var existingRows = lastRow >= 2
    ? sheet.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, columnCount).getDisplayValues()
    : [];
  var existingByKey = {};
  var existingOrder = [];
  var removedDuplicate = 0;
  var i;

  for (i = 0; i < existingRows.length; i++) {
    if (!RSC_UR_rowHasAnyValue_(existingRows[i])) {
      continue;
    }

    var existingKey = RSC_UR_STRL_makeOutputRowKey_(
      prefix,
      existingRows[i]
    );
    if (!existingKey) {
      continue;
    }

    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(existingByKey, existingKey)) {
      removedDuplicate++;
      continue;
    }

    existingByKey[existingKey] = existingRows[i];
    existingOrder.push(existingKey);
  }

  var inserted = 0;
  var updated = 0;
  var unchanged = 0;
  var removedStale = 0;
  var finalByKey = {};
  var finalOrder = [];

  if (!allowPurge) {
    for (i = 0; i < existingOrder.length; i++) {
      var preserveKey = existingOrder[i];
      finalByKey[preserveKey] = existingByKey[preserveKey];
      finalOrder.push(preserveKey);
    }
  }

  for (i = 0; i < incomingOrder.length; i++) {
    var incomingKey = incomingOrder[i];
    var incomingRow = RSC_UR_STRL_normalizeRowLength_(
      incomingByKey[incomingKey],
      columnCount
    );
    var priorRow = existingByKey[incomingKey];

    if (!priorRow) {
      inserted++;
    } else if (RSC_UR_STRL_rowsEqual_(priorRow, incomingRow)) {
      unchanged++;
    } else {
      updated++;
    }

    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(finalByKey, incomingKey)) {
      finalOrder.push(incomingKey);
    }
    finalByKey[incomingKey] = incomingRow;
  }

  if (allowPurge) {
    for (i = 0; i < existingOrder.length; i++) {
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
        incomingByKey,
        existingOrder[i]
      )) {
        removedStale++;
      }
    }
  }

  var finalRows = [];
  for (i = 0; i < finalOrder.length; i++) {
    finalRows.push(RSC_UR_STRL_normalizeRowLength_(
      finalByKey[finalOrder[i]],
      columnCount
    ));
  }

  var currentNormalized = [];
  for (i = 0; i < existingOrder.length; i++) {
    currentNormalized.push(RSC_UR_STRL_normalizeRowLength_(
      existingByKey[existingOrder[i]],
      columnCount
    ));
  }

  var headerMatches = RSC_UR_STRL_headerMatches_(sheet, headers);
  var writeSkipped = headerMatches &&
    RSC_UR_STRL_matrixEqual_(currentNormalized, finalRows) &&
    removedDuplicate === 0;

  if (!writeSkipped) {
    RSC_UR_STRL_rewriteOutputSheet_(sheet, headers, finalRows, prefix);
  }

  return {
    inserted: inserted,
    updated: updated,
    unchanged: unchanged,
    removedStale: removedStale,
    removedDuplicate: removedDuplicate,
    finalRows: finalRows.length,
    writeSkipped: writeSkipped,
    finalSnapshot: RSC_STRL152_snapshotFast_(finalByKey, finalOrder)
  };
}


function RSC_STRL152_loadIndexState_(technicalSs) {
  var sh = RSC_UR_STRL_ensureIndex_(technicalSs);
  var map = {};
  var order = [];

  if (sh.getLastRow() >= 2) {
    var rows = sh.getRange(
      2,
      1,
      sh.getLastRow() - 1,
      9
    ).getDisplayValues();

    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      var groupName = String(rows[i][0] || '').trim();
      if (!groupName) {
        continue;
      }
      map[groupName] = {
        groupName: groupName,
        outputSheetName: String(rows[i][1] || '').trim(),
        runId: String(rows[i][2] || '').trim(),
        prefix: String(rows[i][3] || '').trim(),
        bpType: String(rows[i][4] || '').trim(),
        salesOrg: String(rows[i][5] || '').trim(),
        distChannel: String(rows[i][6] || '').trim(),
        division: String(rows[i][7] || '').trim(),
        salesOffice: String(rows[i][8] || '').trim()
      };
      order.push(groupName);
    }
  }

  return {sheet: sh, map: map, order: order};
}


function RSC_STRL152_persistIndexState_(state) {
  var sh = state.sheet;
  var rows = [];
  var seen = {};
  var order = state.order || [];
  var i;

  for (i = 0; i < order.length; i++) {
    var name = order[i];
    if (!state.map[name] || seen[name]) {
      continue;
    }
    seen[name] = true;
    var x = state.map[name];
    rows.push([
      name,
      x.outputSheetName,
      x.runId,
      x.prefix,
      x.bpType,
      x.salesOrg,
      x.distChannel,
      x.division,
      x.salesOffice
    ]);
  }

  var existing = Math.max(0, sh.getLastRow() - 1);
  RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(sh, Math.max(2, rows.length + 1), 9);
  if (rows.length) {
    sh.getRange(2, 1, rows.length, 9).setValues(rows);
  }
  if (existing > rows.length) {
    sh.getRange(rows.length + 2, 1, existing - rows.length, 9)
      .clearContent();
  }
}


function RSC_STRL152_loadKeyStoreState_(technicalSs) {
  var sh = RSC_STRL14_ensureKeyStore_(technicalSs);
  var map = {};
  var order = [];

  if (sh.getLastRow() >= 2) {
    var rows = sh.getRange(
      2,
      1,
      sh.getLastRow() - 1,
      RSC_STRL14.keyStoreHeaders.length
    ).getDisplayValues();

    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      var groupName = String(rows[i][0] || '').trim();
      if (!groupName) {
        continue;
      }
      map[groupName] = {
        groupName: groupName,
        outputSheetName: String(rows[i][1] || '').trim(),
        runId: String(rows[i][2] || '').trim(),
        prefix: String(rows[i][3] || '').trim(),
        keyCount: Number(rows[i][4] || 0),
        snapshotHash: String(rows[i][5] || '').trim(),
        blob: String(rows[i][6] || ''),
        updatedAt: rows[i][7] || ''
      };
      order.push(groupName);
    }
  }

  return {sheet: sh, map: map, order: order};
}


function RSC_STRL152_persistKeyStoreState_(state) {
  var sh = state.sheet;
  var rows = [];
  var seen = {};
  var order = state.order || [];

  for (var i = 0; i < order.length; i++) {
    var name = order[i];
    if (!state.map[name] || seen[name]) {
      continue;
    }
    seen[name] = true;
    var x = state.map[name];
    rows.push([
      name,
      x.outputSheetName,
      x.runId,
      x.prefix,
      Number(x.keyCount || 0),
      x.snapshotHash,
      String(x.blob || ''),
      x.updatedAt || new Date()
    ]);
  }

  var width = RSC_STRL14.keyStoreHeaders.length;
  var existing = Math.max(0, sh.getLastRow() - 1);
  RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(sh, Math.max(2, rows.length + 1), width);
  if (rows.length) {
    sh.getRange(2, 1, rows.length, width).setValues(rows);
  }
  if (existing > rows.length) {
    sh.getRange(rows.length + 2, 1, existing - rows.length, width)
      .clearContent();
  }
}


/* Batch group writer. Output sheet tetap satu per group, tetapi seluruh admin
 * metadata ditulis sekali per checkpoint batch. */
function RSC_UR_STRL_writeGroups_(
  job,
  targetSs,
  technicalSs,
  executionStartedAt
) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var groupsSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlGroupsSheetName);
  var queueSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlQueueSheetName);

  if (!groupsSh || !queueSh) {
    throw new Error('Queue/groups ST/RL tidak ditemukan saat WRITE.');
  }

  var lastGroupRow = groupsSh.getLastRow();
  if (job.groupCursor > lastGroupRow) {
    return true;
  }

  var indexState = RSC_STRL152_loadIndexState_(technicalSs);
  var keyState = RSC_STRL152_loadKeyStoreState_(technicalSs);
  var batchSize = Math.min(
    RSC_STRL152.maxGroupsPerExecution,
    lastGroupRow - job.groupCursor + 1
  );
  var groupRows = groupsSh.getRange(
    job.groupCursor,
    1,
    batchSize,
    9
  ).getDisplayValues();

  var processed = 0;
  var dirtyAdmin = false;
  var sinceCheckpoint = 0;

  while (
    processed < groupRows.length &&
    Date.now() - executionStartedAt <
      RSC_STRL14.softDeadlineMs - RSC_STRL152.deadlineReserveMs
  ) {
    var groupRow = groupRows[processed];
    var meta = {
      groupName: String(groupRow[0] || '').trim(),
      startRow: Number(groupRow[1] || 0),
      rowCount: Number(groupRow[2] || 0),
      prefix: String(groupRow[3] || '').trim().toUpperCase(),
      bpType: String(groupRow[4] || '').trim(),
      salesOrg: String(groupRow[5] || '').trim(),
      distChannel: String(groupRow[6] || '').trim(),
      division: String(groupRow[7] || '').trim(),
      salesOffice: RSC_UR_extractCode_(groupRow[8])
    };

    if (!meta.groupName || meta.startRow < 2 || meta.rowCount < 1) {
      job.groupCursor++;
      processed++;
      sinceCheckpoint++;
      continue;
    }

    var queued = queueSh.getRange(
      meta.startRow,
      1,
      meta.rowCount,
      10
    ).getDisplayValues();
    var incomingByKey = {};
    var incomingOrder = [];

    for (var i = 0; i < queued.length; i++) {
      var payload = RSC_UR_STRL_parsePayload_(queued[i][9]);
      if (!payload.length) {
        continue;
      }

      if (meta.prefix === 'ST') {
        payload = payload.slice(0, cfg.stRlSalesmanTypeOutputHeaders.length);
        payload[1] = meta.salesOrg;
        payload[2] = meta.salesOffice;
      } else {
        payload = payload.slice(0, cfg.stRlRelationshipOutputHeaders.length);
      }

      var keyHash = RSC_UR_STRL_makeOutputRowKey_(meta.prefix, payload);
      if (!keyHash) {
        continue;
      }
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(incomingByKey, keyHash)) {
        incomingOrder.push(keyHash);
      }
      incomingByKey[keyHash] = payload;
    }

    var canonicalName = RSC_UR_safeSheetName_(meta.groupName);
    var headers = meta.prefix === 'ST'
      ? cfg.stRlSalesmanTypeOutputHeaders
      : cfg.stRlRelationshipOutputHeaders;
    var outputSh = targetSs.getSheetByName(canonicalName);

    if (!outputSh) {
      outputSh = RSC_STRL152_createOutputSheetFast_(
        targetSs,
        canonicalName,
        headers,
        meta.prefix
      );
    }

    var incomingSnapshot = RSC_STRL152_snapshotFast_(
      incomingByKey,
      incomingOrder
    );
    var stored = keyState.map[meta.groupName];
    var canFastSkip = Boolean(
      stored &&
      stored.snapshotHash === incomingSnapshot.hash &&
      Number(stored.keyCount || 0) === incomingSnapshot.count &&
      RSC_UR_STRL_headerMatches_(outputSh, headers) &&
      Math.max(0, outputSh.getLastRow() - 1) === incomingSnapshot.count
    );

    var result;
    if (canFastSkip) {
      result = {
        inserted: 0,
        updated: 0,
        unchanged: incomingSnapshot.count,
        removedStale: 0,
        removedDuplicate: 0,
        finalRows: incomingSnapshot.count,
        writeSkipped: true,
        finalSnapshot: incomingSnapshot
      };
      job.stats.keyStoreFastSkips =
        Number(job.stats.keyStoreFastSkips || 0) + 1;
    } else {
      result = RSC_UR_STRL_upsertOutputSheet_(
        outputSh,
        headers,
        incomingByKey,
        incomingOrder,
        meta.prefix,
        job.allowStaleCleanup
      );
    }

    if (!keyState.map[meta.groupName]) {
      keyState.order.push(meta.groupName);
    }
    keyState.map[meta.groupName] = {
      groupName: meta.groupName,
      outputSheetName: canonicalName,
      runId: job.runId,
      prefix: meta.prefix,
      keyCount: result.finalSnapshot.count,
      snapshotHash: result.finalSnapshot.hash,
      blob: result.finalSnapshot.blob,
      updatedAt: new Date()
    };

    if (!indexState.map[meta.groupName]) {
      indexState.order.push(meta.groupName);
    }
    indexState.map[meta.groupName] = {
      groupName: meta.groupName,
      outputSheetName: canonicalName,
      runId: job.runId,
      prefix: meta.prefix,
      bpType: meta.bpType,
      salesOrg: meta.salesOrg,
      distChannel: meta.distChannel,
      division: meta.division,
      salesOffice: meta.salesOffice
    };

    job.stats.keyStoreGroupsWritten =
      Number(job.stats.keyStoreGroupsWritten || 0) + 1;
    job.stats.insertedRows += result.inserted;
    job.stats.updatedRows += result.updated;
    job.stats.unchangedRows += result.unchanged;
    job.stats.removedStaleRows += result.removedStale;
    job.stats.removedDuplicateRows += result.removedDuplicate;
    job.stats.outputWriteSkips += result.writeSkipped ? 1 : 0;
    job.stats.outputRowsAfterUpsert += result.finalRows;
    job.stats.outputGroupsProcessed++;

    job.changedSalesOffices = job.changedSalesOffices || {};
    if (!result.writeSkipped && meta.salesOffice) {
      job.changedSalesOffices[meta.salesOffice] = true;
    }

    job.groupCursor++;
    processed++;
    sinceCheckpoint++;
    dirtyAdmin = true;

    if (sinceCheckpoint >= RSC_STRL152.checkpointEveryGroups) {
      RSC_STRL152_persistKeyStoreState_(keyState);
      RSC_STRL152_persistIndexState_(indexState);
      dirtyAdmin = false;
      sinceCheckpoint = 0;
      job.lastHeartbeatAt = new Date().toISOString();
      RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
    }
  }

  if (dirtyAdmin) {
    RSC_STRL152_persistKeyStoreState_(keyState);
    RSC_STRL152_persistIndexState_(indexState);
  }

  if (processed > 0 || dirtyAdmin) {
    job.lastHeartbeatAt = new Date().toISOString();
    RSC_STRL14_saveJob_(job);
  }

  return job.groupCursor > lastGroupRow;
}


/* Override ledger mirror tanpa flush per file. setValues() berikutnya pada FILE
 * checkpoint tetap mempertahankan urutan operasi dalam execution yang sama. */
function RSC_STRL15_mirrorCurrentFileStageToLedger_(
  job,
  technicalSs,
  attempt,
  sourceName
) {
  var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
  var stageSh = technicalSs.getSheetByName(cfg.stRlStageSheetName);
  var ledgerSh = RSC_STRL15_getLedgerSheet_(job);
  var stageEnd = stageSh.getLastRow();
  var count = Math.max(0, stageEnd - attempt.stageStart + 1);

  if (!count) {
    return {rowsWritten: 0};
  }

  var stageRows = stageSh.getRange(
    attempt.stageStart,
    1,
    count,
    11
  ).getDisplayValues();
  var output = [];
  var now = new Date();

  for (var i = 0; i < stageRows.length; i++) {
    var r = stageRows[i];
    var rawKey = String(r[0] || '');
    var payload = String(r[10] || '');
    output.push(RSC_STRL15_normalizeLedgerRow_([
      'DATA',
      job.runId,
      RSC_STRL14_hash128_(rawKey),
      'COLLECTED',
      Number(r[2] || attempt.masterRow || 0),
      String(r[1] || attempt.fileId || ''),
      Number(r[3] || 0),
      String(r[4] || ''),
      String(r[5] || ''),
      String(r[6] || ''),
      String(r[7] || ''),
      String(r[8] || ''),
      String(r[9] || ''),
      '', '', '', '',
      payload,
      RSC_STRL14_hash128_(payload),
      now,
      String(sourceName || '')
    ]));
  }

  var writeRow = attempt.ledgerStart;
  var offset = 0;
  while (offset < output.length) {
    var chunk = output.slice(
      offset,
      offset + RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerWriteChunkRows
    );
    RSC_UR_ensureSheetCapacity_(
      ledgerSh,
      writeRow + chunk.length - 1,
      RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerColumns
    );
    ledgerSh.getRange(
      writeRow,
      1,
      chunk.length,
      RSC_STRL14.targetLedgerColumns
    ).setValues(chunk);
    writeRow += chunk.length;
    offset += chunk.length;
  }

  return {rowsWritten: output.length};
}


/*******************************************************************************
 * ROLLING SALES CENTER V28 — FULL HOURLY PIPELINE + COMPILE BRIDGE
 * 2026-08-14
 *
 * Canonical hourly order:
 *   1) Standard validation ALL valid links in column E (manifest first)
 *   2) Gate: compile only when every validation task is COMPLETE_OK
 *   3) Main Upload Ready compile / upsert ALL DONE links
 *   4) ST/RL dual-source compile
 *
 * One hourly tick never starts a second cycle while a prior cycle is unfinished.
 *******************************************************************************/

var RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_20260814 = {
  version: 'RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_20260814',
  pEnabled: 'RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_ENABLED',
  pMasterSsId: 'RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_MASTER_SS_ID',
  pMasterSheetId: 'RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_MASTER_SHEET_ID',
  pPhase: 'RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_PHASE',
  pRunStartedAt: 'RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_RUN_STARTED_AT',
  pLastFinishedAt: 'RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_LAST_FINISHED_AT',
  pLastMessage: 'RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_LAST_MESSAGE',
  pCycleId: 'RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_CYCLE_ID',
  hourlyHandler: 'RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_HOURLY_HANDLER_20260814',
  watchdogHandler: 'RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_WATCHDOG_20260814',
  everyHours: 1,
  watchdogDelayMs: 2 * 60 * 1000,
  phases: {
    IDLE: 'IDLE',
    VALIDATING: 'VALIDATING',
    COMPILE_MAIN: 'COMPILE_MAIN',
    COMPILE_STRL: 'COMPILE_STRL',
    BLOCKED: 'BLOCKED',
    DONE: 'DONE',
    STOPPED: 'STOPPED'
  }
};

function RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SET_STATE_20260814_(phase, message) {
  var P = RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_20260814;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  props.setProperty(P.pPhase, String(phase || P.phases.IDLE));
  props.setProperty(P.pLastMessage, String(message || ''));
  writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('V28 Full Pipeline | ' + String(phase || '') + ' | ' + String(message || ''));
}

function RSC_V28_PIPELINE_DELETE_TRIGGERS_20260814_(handlers) {
  handlers = handlers || [];
  var set = Object.create(null);
  handlers.forEach(function(h){ if (h) set[String(h)] = true; });
  ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(function(t){
    if (set[t.getHandlerFunction()]) {
      try { ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(t); } catch (ignore) {}
    }
  });
}

function RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SCHEDULE_WATCHDOG_20260814_() {
  var P = RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_20260814;
  RSC_V28_PIPELINE_DELETE_TRIGGERS_20260814_([P.watchdogHandler]);
  RSC_PERF13_NEW_TRIGGER_20260819_(P.watchdogHandler)
    .timeBased()
    .after(Math.max(60 * 1000, Number(P.watchdogDelayMs || 120000)))
    .create();
}

function RSC_V28_PIPELINE_RESOLVE_MASTER_20260814_() {
  var P = RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_20260814;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var storedId = String(props.getProperty(P.pMasterSsId) || '');
  var storedSheetId = String(props.getProperty(P.pMasterSheetId) || '');
  var ss = storedId
    ? RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(storedId)
    : SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  if (!ss) throw new Error('Master spreadsheet Full Pipeline tidak ditemukan.');

  var sh = null;
  // Full pipeline harus align dengan compile source. Compile utama dan ST/RL
  // menggunakan Rekap Approved, sehingga hourly gate juga memprioritaskan sheet itu.
  var approved = ss.getSheetByName('Rekap Approved');
  if (approved) {
    sh = approved;
  } else if (storedSheetId) {
    ss.getSheets().some(function(x){
      if (String(x.getSheetId()) === storedSheetId) { sh = x; return true; }
      return false;
    });
  }
  if (!sh) {
    var active = ss.getActiveSheet();
    if (active && ['Rekap All','Rekap Approved'].indexOf(active.getName()) !== -1) sh = active;
  }
  if (!sh) sh = ss.getSheetByName('Rekap All');
  if (!sh) throw new Error('Master sheet tidak ditemukan. Wajib ada Rekap Approved (preferred) atau Rekap All.');

  props.setProperty(P.pMasterSsId, ss.getId());
  props.setProperty(P.pMasterSheetId, String(sh.getSheetId()));
  return { ss: ss, sh: sh };
}

function RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_START_CYCLE_20260814_(options) {
  options = options || {};
  var P = RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_20260814;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var phase = String(props.getProperty(P.pPhase) || P.phases.IDLE).toUpperCase();

  if ([P.phases.VALIDATING, P.phases.COMPILE_MAIN, P.phases.COMPILE_STRL].indexOf(phase) !== -1) {
    RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SCHEDULE_WATCHDOG_20260814_();
    return { resumed: true, phase: phase, message: 'Cycle sebelumnya masih aktif.' };
  }

  var ctx = RSC_V28_PIPELINE_RESOLVE_MASTER_20260814_();
  var cycleId = Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss') + '_' + Utilities.getUuid().slice(0,8);
  props.setProperty(P.pCycleId, cycleId);
  props.setProperty(P.pRunStartedAt, new Date().toISOString());
  props.deleteProperty(P.pLastFinishedAt);

  // Ensure no prior compile job can race with a new validation cycle.
  var compileProps = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var cfg = (typeof RSC_UR_20260721 !== 'undefined') ? RSC_UR_20260721 : null;
  if (cfg && (compileProps.getProperty(cfg.jobProperty) || compileProps.getProperty(cfg.stRlJobProperty))) {
    RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SET_STATE_20260814_(P.phases.BLOCKED, 'Compile job existing masih aktif. Selesaikan/stop sebelum memulai cycle baru.');
    return { blocked: true, reason: 'COMPILE_JOB_ACTIVE' };
  }

  // Jangan mengadopsi unfinished bulk dari master/sheet lain. Itu bisa membuat
  // validation gate dan compile membaca dataset yang berbeda.
  var existingBulk = null;
  try { existingBulk = RSC_APP_20260611.standardBulkStatus(false); } catch (ignoreExistingBulk) {}
  if (existingBulk && Number(existingBulk.unfinished || 0) > 0) {
    var oldMasterId = String(props.getProperty('RSC_STD_V27_MASTER_SS_ID') || '');
    var oldSheetId = String(props.getProperty('RSC_STD_V27_MASTER_SHEET_ID') || '');
    if (oldMasterId !== ctx.ss.getId() || oldSheetId !== String(ctx.sh.getSheetId())) {
      RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SET_STATE_20260814_(P.phases.BLOCKED, 'Ada Bulk Validation aktif dari master/sheet lain. Selesaikan atau STOP bulk tersebut terlebih dahulu.');
      return { blocked: true, reason: 'OTHER_BULK_ACTIVE' };
    }
  }

  RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SET_STATE_20260814_(P.phases.VALIDATING, 'Memulai Standard validation seluruh link valid di kolom E.');
  var result = RSC_APP_20260611.standardBulkStart({
    masterSsId: ctx.ss.getId(),
    masterSheetId: String(ctx.sh.getSheetId()),
    silent: true
  });

  if (result && result.validTasks === 0 && !result.resumed) {
    RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SET_STATE_20260814_(P.phases.BLOCKED, 'Tidak ada link valid pada kolom E; compile tidak dijalankan.');
    props.setProperty(P.pLastFinishedAt, new Date().toISOString());
    return { blocked: true, reason: 'NO_VALID_LINKS' };
  }

  RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SCHEDULE_WATCHDOG_20260814_();
  try {
    if (!options.silent) ctx.ss.toast('Full Pipeline V28 dimulai: Validate → Compile Main → ST/RL.', 'Rolling Sales Center', 10);
  } catch (ignoreToast) {}
  return { started: true, cycleId: cycleId, validation: result };
}

function RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_WATCHDOG_20260814(e) {
  var P = RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_20260814;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var phase = String(props.getProperty(P.pPhase) || P.phases.IDLE).toUpperCase();

  // One-time watchdog consumed; recreate only if another check is required.
  RSC_V28_PIPELINE_DELETE_TRIGGERS_20260814_([P.watchdogHandler]);

  if (phase === P.phases.VALIDATING) {
    var x = RSC_APP_20260611.standardBulkStatus(false);
    if (Number(x.unfinished || 0) > 0) {
      try { RSC_APP_20260611.standardBulkWatchdog(); } catch (ignoreResumeValidation) {}
      RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SET_STATE_20260814_(P.phases.VALIDATING, 'Validation masih berjalan. unfinished=' + Number(x.unfinished || 0) + '.');
      RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SCHEDULE_WATCHDOG_20260814_();
      return x;
    }

    var c = x.counts || {};
    var validationErrors = Number(c.COMPLETE_ERROR || 0) + Number(c.HARD_ERROR || 0);
    var completeOk = Number(c.COMPLETE_OK || 0);
    if (validationErrors > 0 || completeOk <= 0) {
      var blockMsg = 'Validation gate BLOCK. COMPLETE_OK=' + completeOk + ', COMPLETE_ERROR=' + Number(c.COMPLETE_ERROR || 0) + ', HARD_ERROR=' + Number(c.HARD_ERROR || 0) + ', SKIPPED_INVALID=' + Number(c.SKIPPED_INVALID || 0) + '. Compile tidak dijalankan.';
      RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SET_STATE_20260814_(P.phases.BLOCKED, blockMsg);
      props.setProperty(P.pLastFinishedAt, new Date().toISOString());
      return x;
    }

    RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SET_STATE_20260814_(P.phases.COMPILE_MAIN, 'Validation PASS untuk seluruh file valid. SKIPPED_INVALID='+Number(c.SKIPPED_INVALID||0)+'. Memulai Main Compile Upload Ready.');
    RSC_UR_START_20260721();
    RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SCHEDULE_WATCHDOG_20260814_();
    return { phase: P.phases.COMPILE_MAIN, completeOk: completeOk };
  }

  if (phase === P.phases.COMPILE_MAIN) {
    var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
    var rawMain = props.getProperty(cfg.jobProperty);
    if (rawMain) {
      try { RSC_UR_CONTINUE_20260721(); } catch (ignoreContinueMain) {}
      RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SET_STATE_20260814_(P.phases.COMPILE_MAIN, 'Main compile masih berjalan.');
      RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SCHEDULE_WATCHDOG_20260814_();
      return { mainActive: true };
    }

    var lastMain = {};
    try { lastMain = JSON.parse(String(props.getProperty(cfg.lastStatusProperty) || '{}')); } catch (ignoreParseMain) {}
    if (String(lastMain.phase || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DONE') {
      RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SET_STATE_20260814_(P.phases.BLOCKED, 'Main compile tidak aktif tetapi status terakhir bukan DONE. Last phase=' + String(lastMain.phase || '-') + '.');
      props.setProperty(P.pLastFinishedAt, new Date().toISOString());
      return { blocked: true, stage: 'COMPILE_MAIN' };
    }

    RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SET_STATE_20260814_(P.phases.COMPILE_STRL, 'Main compile DONE. Memulai Compile ST/RL.');
    RSC_UR_START_ST_RL_20260727();
    RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SCHEDULE_WATCHDOG_20260814_();
    return { phase: P.phases.COMPILE_STRL };
  }

  if (phase === P.phases.COMPILE_STRL) {
    var cfg2 = RSC_UR_20260721;
    var rawStrl = props.getProperty(cfg2.stRlJobProperty);
    if (rawStrl) {
