      try { RSC_UR_CONTINUE_ST_RL_20260727(); } catch (ignoreContinueStrl) {}
      RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SET_STATE_20260814_(P.phases.COMPILE_STRL, 'Compile ST/RL masih berjalan.');
      RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SCHEDULE_WATCHDOG_20260814_();
      return { strlActive: true };
    }

    var lastStrl = {};
    try { lastStrl = JSON.parse(String(props.getProperty(cfg2.stRlLastStatusProperty) || '{}')); } catch (ignoreParseStrl) {}
    if (String(lastStrl.phase || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DONE') {
      RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SET_STATE_20260814_(P.phases.BLOCKED, 'ST/RL tidak aktif tetapi status terakhir bukan DONE. Last phase=' + String(lastStrl.phase || '-') + '.');
      props.setProperty(P.pLastFinishedAt, new Date().toISOString());
      return { blocked: true, stage: 'COMPILE_STRL' };
    }

    var doneMsg = 'Full Pipeline selesai: Validation PASS → Main Compile DONE → ST/RL DONE.';
    RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SET_STATE_20260814_(P.phases.DONE, doneMsg);
    props.setProperty(P.pLastFinishedAt, new Date().toISOString());
    try { RSC_V28_PIPELINE_RESOLVE_MASTER_20260814_().ss.toast(doneMsg, 'Rolling Sales Center', 12); } catch (ignoreDoneToast) {}
    return { done: true };
  }

  return { phase: phase, idle: true };
}

function RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_HOURLY_HANDLER_20260814(e) {
  var P = RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_20260814;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  if (String(props.getProperty(P.pEnabled) || '').toUpperCase() !== 'TRUE') return { enabled: false };

  var phase = String(props.getProperty(P.pPhase) || P.phases.IDLE).toUpperCase();
  if ([P.phases.VALIDATING, P.phases.COMPILE_MAIN, P.phases.COMPILE_STRL].indexOf(phase) !== -1) {
    RSC_V28_PIPELINE_SCHEDULE_WATCHDOG_20260814_();
    return { resumedExistingCycle: true, phase: phase };
  }
  return RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_START_CYCLE_20260814_({ silent: true });
}

function RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_INSTALL_HOURLY_20260814(e) {
  var P = RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_20260814;
  var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var ctx = RSC_V28_PIPELINE_RESOLVE_MASTER_20260814_();

  // Remove every older hourly validation/pipeline trigger so only V28 owns cadence.
  RSC_V28_PIPELINE_DELETE_TRIGGERS_20260814_([
    P.hourlyHandler,
    'RSC_STANDARD_HOURLY_HANDLER_20260814',
    'RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_SCHEDULED_20260813',
    'RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_CONTINUE_20260813',
    (typeof COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS !== 'undefined' ? COPY_AWARE_AUTOMATION_PARAMETERS.localValidationJobHandler : '')
  ]);
  try { props.setProperty('RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_ENABLED_20260813', 'FALSE'); } catch (ignoreOldPipe) {}
  try { props.setProperty(RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814.pHourlyEnabled, 'FALSE'); } catch (ignoreOldHourly) {}

  props.setProperty(P.pEnabled, 'TRUE');
  props.setProperty(P.pMasterSsId, ctx.ss.getId());
  props.setProperty(P.pMasterSheetId, String(ctx.sh.getSheetId()));
  if (!props.getProperty(P.pPhase)) props.setProperty(P.pPhase, P.phases.IDLE);

  RSC_PERF13_NEW_TRIGGER_20260819_(P.hourlyHandler)
    .timeBased()
    .everyHours(P.everyHours)
    .create();

  var msg = 'AUTO 1 HOUR V28 aktif. Urutan: Validate Kolom E → gate semua COMPLETE_OK → Main Compile → ST/RL. Master=' + ctx.sh.getName() + '.';
  props.setProperty(P.pLastMessage, msg);
  try { SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert(msg); } catch (ignoreUi) { try { ctx.ss.toast(msg, 'Rolling Sales Center', 10); } catch (ignoreToast) {} }
  return { installed: true, everyHours: P.everyHours, masterSheet: ctx.sh.getName() };
}

  ].join('\n');

/*******************************************************************************
 * PURGE ALL COMPILE TARGETS
 * Destructive by design. Clears BOTH dedicated compile destination workbooks
 * (main output + ST/RL output) and resets their technical compile state.
 *******************************************************************************/
function RSC_V28_PURGE_SPREADSHEET_ALL_SHEETS_20260814_(ss, holdName) {
  holdName = String(holdName || '_RSC_PURGE_HOLD');
  var hold = ss.getSheetByName(holdName);
  if (!hold) hold = ss.insertSheet(holdName);
  try { hold.showSheet(); } catch (ignoreShow) {}

  var sheets = ss.getSheets().slice();
  var deleted = 0;
  sheets.forEach(function(sh){
    if (sh.getSheetId() === hold.getSheetId()) return;
    try { ss.deleteSheet(sh); deleted++; } catch (ignoreDelete) {}
  });

  hold.clear();
  try { hold.clearFormats(); } catch (ignoreFormats) {}
  try {
    if (hold.getMaxRows() > 2) hold.deleteRows(3, hold.getMaxRows() - 2);
    if (hold.getMaxColumns() > 2) hold.deleteColumns(3, hold.getMaxColumns() - 2);
  } catch (ignoreTrim) {}
  hold.getRange('A1').setValue('PURGED — ready for next compile run');
  hold.getRange('A2').setValue(new Date());
  return { deletedSheets: deleted, remainingSheet: hold.getName() };
}

function RSC_V28_PURGE_TECHNICAL_COMPILE_STATE_20260814_(technicalSs) {
  var deleted = 0;
  var sheets = technicalSs.getSheets().slice();
  var candidates = [];
  sheets.forEach(function(sh){
    var n = sh.getName();
    if (/^_UR_/i.test(n) || /^_K_/i.test(n) || /^_RSC_.*(?:KEY|STG|STAGING|COMPILE)/i.test(n)) candidates.push(sh);
  });
  candidates.forEach(function(sh){
    if (technicalSs.getSheets().length <= 1) return;
    try { technicalSs.deleteSheet(sh); deleted++; } catch (ignoreDelete) {}
  });
  return { deletedTechnicalSheets: deleted };
}

function RSC_V28_PURGE_ALL_COMPILE_TARGETS_20260814(e) {
  var ui = null;
  try { ui = SpreadsheetApp.getUi(); } catch (ignoreUi) {}
  if (!ui) {
    throw new Error('PURGE ALL hanya boleh dijalankan dari menu spreadsheet agar konfirmasi destructive dapat ditampilkan.');
  }
  if (ui) {
    var response = ui.prompt(
      'PURGE ALL Compile Target Files',
      'INI DESTRUCTIVE. Semua sheet di MAIN compile target dan ST/RL target akan dihapus. Ketik tepat: PURGE ALL',
      ui.ButtonSet.OK_CANCEL
    );
    if (response.getSelectedButton() !== ui.Button.OK || String(response.getResponseText() || '').trim().toUpperCase() !== 'PURGE ALL') {
      ui.alert('Purge dibatalkan. Tidak ada file yang diubah.');
      return { cancelled: true };
    }
  }

  var lock = LockService.getDocumentLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(15000)) throw new Error('Tidak dapat memperoleh lock untuk PURGE ALL. Coba lagi setelah job aktif selesai.');

  try {
    RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_STOP_20260814();
    var cfg = RSC_UR_20260721;
    var props = PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();

    // Stop compile continuation triggers/properties again defensively.
    RSC_UR_deleteTriggersByHandler_(cfg.workerHandler);
    RSC_UR_deleteTriggersByHandler_(cfg.stRlWorkerHandler);
    props.deleteProperty(cfg.jobProperty);
    props.deleteProperty(cfg.stRlJobProperty);
    props.deleteProperty(cfg.lastStatusProperty);
    props.deleteProperty(cfg.stRlLastStatusProperty);

    var mainTarget = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(cfg.targetSpreadsheetId);
    var strlTarget = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(cfg.stRlTargetSpreadsheetId);
    var technicalSs = RSC_UR_getOrCreateTechnicalSpreadsheet_(props);

    var mainStats = RSC_V28_PURGE_SPREADSHEET_ALL_SHEETS_20260814_(mainTarget, '_RSC_PURGED_MAIN');
    var strlStats = RSC_V28_PURGE_SPREADSHEET_ALL_SHEETS_20260814_(strlTarget, '_RSC_PURGED_STRL');
    var techStats = RSC_V28_PURGE_TECHNICAL_COMPILE_STATE_20260814_(technicalSs);

    // Reset ledger cache so subsequent ST/RL run binds to the newly created ledger.
    try { __RSC_STRL15_LEDGER_CACHE__ = null; } catch (ignoreLedgerCache) {}

    var msg = 'PURGE ALL selesai. MAIN deleted sheets=' + Number(mainStats.deletedSheets || 0) +
      ', ST/RL deleted sheets=' + Number(strlStats.deletedSheets || 0) +
      ', technical sheets deleted=' + Number(techStats.deletedTechnicalSheets || 0) + '. AUTO 1 HOUR tetap OFF sampai di-install kembali.';
    writeRollingSalesCenterLog_(msg);
    try { if (ui) ui.alert(msg); else SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(msg, 'PURGE ALL', 12); } catch (ignoreMessage) {}
    return { main: mainStats, strl: strlStats, technical: techStats };
  } finally {
    try { lock.releaseLock(); } catch (ignoreRelease) {}
  }
}

function RSC_PERF10_ROUND_20260819_(value, digits) {
  var p = Math.pow(10, Number(digits == null ? 2 : digits));
  return Math.round(Number(value || 0) * p) / p;
}

function RSC_PERF10_REDUCTION_PCT_20260819_(baseline, optimized) {
  baseline = Number(baseline || 0); optimized = Number(optimized || 0);
  if (baseline <= 0) return 0;
  return RSC_PERF10_ROUND_20260819_(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (1 - optimized / baseline) * 100)), 2);
}

function RSC_PERF10_SAFE_RUN_20260819_(name, fn, optional) {
  var started = Date.now();
  try {
    var value = fn();
    return {name:name, status:'PASS', optional:Boolean(optional), elapsedMs:Date.now()-started, result:value};
  } catch (err) {
    var detail = String(err && err.message ? err.message : err);
    return {name:name, status:optional ? 'SKIP' : 'FAIL', optional:Boolean(optional), elapsedMs:Date.now()-started, error:detail};
  }
}

}

function RSC_PERF10_TEST_MBP_CORE_PURE_20260819() {
  var examples = [
    ['["110625404","ZWS014","S091110370","2026-03-01","2026-04-30"]', ['110625404','ZWS014','S091110370','2026-03-01','2026-04-30']],
    ['["110223729","ZWS006","S091210238","2026-03-01","9999-12-31"]', ['110223729','ZWS006','S091210238','2026-03-01','9999-12-31']],
    ['["110221303","ZWS015","S091120232","2026-08-01",null]', ['110221303','ZWS015','S091120232','2026-08-01','9999-12-31']]
  ];
  for (var i=0;i<examples.length;i++) {
    var got = RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_PARSE_PAYLOAD_20260819_(examples[i][0], i+1);
    if (!got || JSON.stringify(got) !== JSON.stringify(examples[i][1])) throw new Error('MBP core parse mismatch case ' + (i+1));
  }
  var doubleEncoded = JSON.stringify('["110063172","ZWS005","S091180347","2026-03-01","9999-12-31"]');
  var d = RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_PARSE_PAYLOAD_20260819_(doubleEncoded, 10);
  if (!d || d[0] !== '110063172' || d[4] !== '9999-12-31') throw new Error('MBP double-encoded parser failed.');
  if (RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_PARSE_PAYLOAD_20260819_('[]', 11) !== null) throw new Error('MBP invalid short array should be skipped.');
  if (RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_CANONICAL_INDEX_20260819_('valid_to') !== 4) throw new Error('MBP canonical index failed.');
  return {ok:true, cases:examples.length+3};
}

  RSC_V28_2_CACHE_PUT_ALL_20260814_('P10T', put, 60);

function RSC_PERF10_FIND_HEADER_COLUMNS_20260819_(sh, requiredAliases, scanRows) {
  var lastRow = sh.getLastRow(), lastCol = sh.getLastColumn();
  var rows = Math.min(Number(scanRows || 10), Math.max(1,lastRow));
  var cols = Math.min(Math.max(1,lastCol), 200);
  var grid = sh.getRange(1,1,rows,cols).getDisplayValues();
  for (var r=0;r<grid.length;r++) {
    var found = {}, ok = true;
    for (var k in requiredAliases) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(requiredAliases,k)) {
      var c = RSC_CORE_MBP_FIND_HEADER_COL_20260819_(grid[r], requiredAliases[k]);
      if (!c) { ok=false; break; }
      found[k]=c;
    }
    if (ok) return {headerRow:r+1, columns:found};
  }
  return null;
}

function RSC_PERF10_LIVE_DB_READONLY_AUDIT_20260819() {
  RSC_PERF11_ASSERT_READY_20260819_();
  var mainId = '1psDMLLr98FuHjKhhfBTwg8p0kBA3w26xrdXb6_tu7CU';
  var main = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(mainId);
  var out = {ok:true, mainSpreadsheetId:mainId, sheets:{}};

  var rel = RSC_PERF5_GET_SHEET_20260819_(main, 'm_bp_relation');
  if (!rel) throw new Error('m_bp_relation tidak ditemukan.');
  var relLayout = RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_GET_LAYOUT_20260819_(rel);
  var totalRelRows = Math.max(0, rel.getLastRow() - Number(relLayout.firstDataRow || 1) + 1);
  var sampleRows = [];
  var starts = [Number(relLayout.firstDataRow||1), Math.max(Number(relLayout.firstDataRow||1), Math.floor(rel.getLastRow()/2)), Math.max(Number(relLayout.firstDataRow||1), rel.getLastRow()-4)];
  for (var i=0;i<starts.length;i++) {
    var count = Math.max(0, Math.min(5, rel.getLastRow()-starts[i]+1));
    if (count) sampleRows = sampleRows.concat(RSC_CORE_MBP_RELATION_READ_CANONICAL_20260819_(rel, starts[i], count, relLayout));
  }
  if (!sampleRows.length) throw new Error('m_bp_relation tidak menghasilkan canonical sample row valid.');
  out.sheets.m_bp_relation = {rows:totalRelRows, mode:relLayout.mode, firstDataRow:relLayout.firstDataRow, sampleValidRows:sampleRows.length};

  var bp = RSC_PERF5_GET_SHEET_20260819_(main, 'm_bp_general_view');
  if (!bp) throw new Error('m_bp_general_view tidak ditemukan.');
  var bpHdr = RSC_PERF10_FIND_HEADER_COLUMNS_20260819_(bp, {bp_id:['bp_id'],bp_type_id:['bp_type_id']}, 10);
  if (!bpHdr) throw new Error('Header m_bp_general_view tidak lengkap.');
  out.sheets.m_bp_general_view = {rows:Math.max(0,bp.getLastRow()-bpHdr.headerRow), headerRow:bpHdr.headerRow};

  var sales = RSC_PERF5_GET_SHEET_20260819_(main, 'm_sales_info');
  if (!sales) throw new Error('m_sales_info tidak ditemukan.');
  var salesHdr = RSC_PERF10_FIND_HEADER_COLUMNS_20260819_(sales, {salesman_id:['salesman_id']}, 10);
  if (!salesHdr) throw new Error('Header m_sales_info tidak lengkap.');
  out.sheets.m_sales_info = {rows:Math.max(0,sales.getLastRow()-salesHdr.headerRow), headerRow:salesHdr.headerRow};

  var mvs = RSC_PERF5_GET_SHEET_20260819_(main, 'm_visit_schedule');
  if (!mvs) throw new Error('m_visit_schedule tidak ditemukan.');
  var mvsLayout = RSC_PERF5_GET_MVS_LAYOUT_20260819_(mvs);
  out.sheets.m_visit_schedule = {rows:Math.max(0,mvs.getLastRow()-mvsLayout.headerRow), headerRow:mvsLayout.headerRow};

  var revampId = '1Ar2WCG6vQ_4JHLoo6Ov233w466XmKNb5ibetST2ElJw';
  var revampSs = RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(revampId);
  var scv = RSC_PERF5_GET_SHEET_20260819_(revampSs, 'm_bp_sales_cust_view');
  if (!scv) throw new Error('m_bp_sales_cust_view tidak ditemukan.');
  var scvHdr = RSC_PERF10_FIND_HEADER_COLUMNS_20260819_(scv, {bp_id:['bp_id'],sls_office:['sls_office','sales_office'],delivering_plant:['delivering_plant','delivering plant']}, 10);
  if (!scvHdr) throw new Error('Header m_bp_sales_cust_view tidak lengkap.');
  out.sheets.m_bp_sales_cust_view = {rows:Math.max(0,scv.getLastRow()-scvHdr.headerRow), headerRow:scvHdr.headerRow};

  Logger.log('[PERF10 live DB] ' + JSON.stringify(out, null, 2));
  return out;
}

function RSC_PERF10_SYNTHETIC_BENCHMARK_20260819() {
  var C = RSC_PERF10_SYNTHETIC_DEFAULTS_20260819_;
  var activeCandidates = Math.min(C.relationDbRows, C.activeUniqueCustomers * C.avgRelationsPerCustomer);
  var bulkCandidates = Math.min(C.relationDbRows, C.bulkUnionUniqueCustomers * C.avgRelationsPerCustomer);
  var activeBaseline = C.relationDbRows;
  var bulkBaseline = C.relationDbRows * C.bulkFiles;

  // Small deterministic CPU micro-benchmark. It validates the computational
  // advantage of parsing candidates only; it does not pretend to model Google
  // network/server latency.
  var cpuRows = Number(C.syntheticCpuRows || 80000);
  var targetCount = Number(C.syntheticCpuTargetCustomers || 120);
  var target = Object.create(null), candidatePayloads = [], allPayloads = new Array(cpuRows);
  for (var t=0;t<targetCount;t++) target[String(110000000+t)] = true;
  for (var i=0;i<cpuRows;i++) {
    var customer = String(110000000 + (i % 12000));
    var payload = '["' + customer + '","ZWS003","S' + String(900000000 + (i%10000)) + '","2026-03-01","9999-12-31"]';
    allPayloads[i] = payload;
    if (target[customer]) candidatePayloads.push(payload);
  }
  var startBaseline = Date.now(), baselineMatches=0;
  for (var b=0;b<allPayloads.length;b++) {
    var row = JSON.parse(allPayloads[b]);
    if (target[row[0]]) baselineMatches++;
  }
  var baselineMs = Math.max(1, Date.now()-startBaseline);
  var startOptimized = Date.now(), optimizedMatches=0;
  for (var o=0;o<candidatePayloads.length;o++) {
    var crow = JSON.parse(candidatePayloads[o]);
    if (target[crow[0]]) optimizedMatches++;
  }
  var optimizedMs = Math.max(1, Date.now()-startOptimized);
  if (baselineMatches !== optimizedMatches) throw new Error('Synthetic benchmark correctness mismatch baseline=' + baselineMatches + ', optimized=' + optimizedMatches);

  var result = {
    ok:true,
    assumptions:{relationDbRows:C.relationDbRows,activeRows:C.activeRows,activeUniqueCustomers:C.activeUniqueCustomers,bulkFiles:C.bulkFiles,bulkUnionUniqueCustomers:C.bulkUnionUniqueCustomers,avgRelationsPerCustomer:C.avgRelationsPerCustomer},
    active:{baselineRelationRows:activeBaseline,optimizedCandidateRows:activeCandidates,relationWorkloadReductionPct:RSC_PERF10_REDUCTION_PCT_20260819_(activeBaseline,activeCandidates)},
    bulk:{baselineRelationRows:bulkBaseline,optimizedCandidateRows:bulkCandidates,relationWorkloadReductionPct:RSC_PERF10_REDUCTION_PCT_20260819_(bulkBaseline,bulkCandidates),masterLookupCallReductionPct:RSC_PERF10_REDUCTION_PCT_20260819_(C.bulkFiles,1),snapshotReadReductionPct:50},
    cpuMicrobenchmark:{rows:cpuRows,candidateRows:candidatePayloads.length,baselineMs:baselineMs,optimizedMs:optimizedMs,elapsedReductionPct:RSC_PERF10_REDUCTION_PCT_20260819_(baselineMs,optimizedMs),parseRowReductionPct:RSC_PERF10_REDUCTION_PCT_20260819_(cpuRows,candidatePayloads.length),matches:optimizedMatches}
  };
  Logger.log('[PERF10 synthetic] ' + JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}

  tests.push(RSC_PERF10_SAFE_RUN_20260819_('Core ID normalizer', function(){ return RSC_PERF10_TEST_CORE_NORMALIZER_20260819(); }, false));

  tests.push(RSC_PERF10_SAFE_RUN_20260819_('m_bp_relation pure core parser', function(){ return RSC_PERF10_TEST_MBP_CORE_PURE_20260819(); }, false));
  tests.push(RSC_PERF10_SAFE_RUN_20260819_('Cache + bucketing core', function(){ return RSC_PERF10_TEST_CACHE_BUCKET_CORE_20260819(); }, false));
  tests.push(RSC_PERF10_SAFE_RUN_20260819_('Live database read-only audit', function(){ return RSC_PERF10_LIVE_DB_READONLY_AUDIT_20260819(); }, false));
  var synTest = RSC_PERF10_SAFE_RUN_20260819_('Synthetic performance benchmark', function(){ return RSC_PERF10_SYNTHETIC_BENCHMARK_20260819(); }, false);
  tests.push(synTest);

  var activeTest = RSC_PERF10_SAFE_RUN_20260819_('Active Rolling read-only benchmark', function(){ return RSC_PERF10_BENCHMARK_ACTIVE_ROLLING_20260819(); }, true);
  tests.push(activeTest);

  var pass=0,fail=0,skip=0;
  for (var i=0;i<tests.length;i++) {
    if (tests[i].status==='PASS') pass++;
    else if (tests[i].status==='FAIL') fail++;
    else skip++;
  }
  var syn = synTest.status==='PASS' ? synTest.result : {};
  var live = activeTest.status==='PASS' ? activeTest.result : {available:false, reason:activeTest.error||'Active sheet tidak cocok untuk benchmark Rolling.'};
  var summary = {
    version:RSC_PERF10_VERSION_20260819_,
    at:new Date().toISOString(),
    ok:fail===0,
    pass:pass, fail:fail, skip:skip,
    elapsedSec:RSC_PERF10_ROUND_20260819_((Date.now()-started)/1000,2),
    synthetic:{
      activeRelationWorkloadReductionPct:Number(syn && syn.active && syn.active.relationWorkloadReductionPct || 0),
      bulkRelationWorkloadReductionPct:Number(syn && syn.bulk && syn.bulk.relationWorkloadReductionPct || 0),
      bulkMasterLookupCallReductionPct:Number(syn && syn.bulk && syn.bulk.masterLookupCallReductionPct || 0),
      cpuElapsedReductionPct:Number(syn && syn.cpuMicrobenchmark && syn.cpuMicrobenchmark.elapsedReductionPct || 0)
    },
    liveActive:live,
    tests:tests
  };
  RSC_PERF10_SAVE_LAST_AUDIT_20260819_(summary);
  Logger.log('[PERF10 FULL AUDIT] ' + JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2));
  var msg = (summary.ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL') + ' — PASS=' + pass + ', FAIL=' + fail + ', SKIP=' + skip +
    '\nSynthetic relation workload reduction: Active=' + summary.synthetic.activeRelationWorkloadReductionPct + '%, Bulk=' + summary.synthetic.bulkRelationWorkloadReductionPct + '%' +
    '\nBulk master lookup call reduction=' + summary.synthetic.bulkMasterLookupCallReductionPct + '%' +
    '\nSynthetic CPU parse elapsed reduction=' + summary.synthetic.cpuElapsedReductionPct + '%' +
    (live.available ? '\nLive Active relation workload reduction=' + Number(live.relationWorkloadReductionPct||0) + '% (' + String(live.relationMode||'') + ')' : '\nLive Active benchmark=SKIP');
  RSC_PERF10_UI_MESSAGE_20260819_('PERF10 Full Safe Audit', msg);
  if (!summary.ok) throw new Error('PERF10 full audit failed. Lihat Execution log / Show Last Audit Summary.');
  return summary;
}

function RSC_PERF11_DB_ACCESS_AUDIT_20260819_(showUi, throwOnFail) {
  var id='1psDMLLr98FuHjKhhfBTwg8p0kBA3w26xrdXb6_tu7CU';
  var url='https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/'+id+'/edit?gid=1379118174#gid=1379118174';
  var identity=RSC_PERF11_EXECUTION_IDENTITY_20260819_();
  var result={version:RSC_PERF11_VERSION_20260819_,spreadsheetId:id,url:url,identity:identity,methods:{},ok:false};

  function test_(name,fn){
    var started=Date.now();
    try{
      var ss=fn();
      var openedId=String(ss&&ss.getId?ss.getId():'');
      var title=String(ss&&ss.getName?ss.getName():'');
      result.methods[name]={ok:Boolean(ss),elapsedMs:Date.now()-started,id:openedId,name:title};
      return Boolean(ss);
    }catch(err){
      result.methods[name]={ok:false,elapsedMs:Date.now()-started,error:String(err&&err.message?err.message:err)};
      return false;
    }
  }

  try{
    var active=SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
    result.methods.activeSpreadsheet={ok:Boolean(active),id:active?String(active.getId()||''):'',name:active?String(active.getName()||''):''};
  }catch(errA){result.methods.activeSpreadsheet={ok:false,error:String(errA&&errA.message?errA.message:errA)};}

  test_('openById',function(){return SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);});
  test_('openByUrl',function(){return SpreadsheetApp.openByUrl('https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/'+id+'/edit');});
  if(typeof DriveApp!=='undefined'&&typeof DriveApp.getFileById==='function'){
    var driveStarted=Date.now();
    try{
      var file=DriveApp.getFileById(id);
      result.methods.driveFile={ok:true,elapsedMs:Date.now()-driveStarted,name:String(file.getName?file.getName():'')};
      if(typeof SpreadsheetApp.open==='function')test_('openDriveFile',function(){return SpreadsheetApp.open(file);});
    }catch(errD){result.methods.driveFile={ok:false,elapsedMs:Date.now()-driveStarted,error:String(errD&&errD.message?errD.message:errD)};}
  }
  test_('resilientOpener',function(){return RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(id);});
  result.ok=Boolean(result.methods.resilientOpener&&result.methods.resilientOpener.ok);
  Logger.log('[PERF11 DB ACCESS] '+JSON.stringify(result,null,2));
  if(showUi){
    var msg=(result.ok?'PASS':'FAIL')+' DB access\nEffective user='+identity.effectiveUser+'\nActive user='+identity.activeUser+'\nopenById='+(result.methods.openById&&result.methods.openById.ok?'PASS':'FAIL')+'; openByUrl='+(result.methods.openByUrl&&result.methods.openByUrl.ok?'PASS':'FAIL')+'; resilient='+(result.methods.resilientOpener&&result.methods.resilientOpener.ok?'PASS':'FAIL');
    RSC_PERF10_UI_MESSAGE_20260819_('PERF11 DB Access',msg);
  }
  if(!result.ok&&throwOnFail)throw new Error('PERF11 database access audit failed. Lihat Execution log untuk execution identity dan detail tiap access method.');
  return result;
}

function RSC_PERF11_TEST_ROLLING_VALID_FROM_POLICY_20260819() {
  var dateNew=String(VALIDATE_DATE_IN_TEMPLATE_PARAMETERS.dateNew||'2026-09-01');
  var normal=RSC_PERF11_RESOLVE_ROLLING_DATE_POLICY_20260819_('Rolling','', '2026-03-01',dateNew);
  var exact=RSC_PERF11_RESOLVE_ROLLING_DATE_POLICY_20260819_('Rolling','EXACT_REL_VALID_TO','2026-03-01',dateNew);
  var pair=RSC_PERF11_RESOLVE_ROLLING_DATE_POLICY_20260819_('Rolling','PAIR_NO_RELATION','',dateNew);
  if(normal.validFrom!==dateNew||normal.visitValidFrom!==dateNew)throw new Error('PERF11 normal Rolling policy failed.');
  if(exact.validFrom!==dateNew||exact.visitValidFrom!==dateNew)throw new Error('PERF11 exact schedule Rolling must still use hardcoded dateNew.');
  if(pair.validFrom!==''||pair.visitValidFrom!==dateNew)throw new Error('PERF11 PAIR_NO_RELATION must keep blank Valid From and update Visit Valid From only.');

  // User scenario: historical A->B ended earlier; new A->B Rolling begins dateNew.
  var relCtx={
    existingR8:{'A||ZWS003||B||2026-06-30':true},
    r8ValidFrom:{'A||ZWS003||B||2026-06-30':'2026-03-01'},
    pair:{'A||B':true}
  };
  var scenario=RSC_STD_DETECT_CHANGE_SCHEDULE_ONLY_20260819_({customerId:'A',relationship:'ZWS003',salesmanId:'B',validTo:'9999-12-31'},relCtx);
  if(scenario.yes)throw new Error('PERF11 historical closed relation incorrectly detected as Change Schedule Only.');
  var scenarioPolicy=RSC_PERF11_RESOLVE_ROLLING_DATE_POLICY_20260819_('Rolling',scenario.mode,'2026-09-01',dateNew);
  if(scenarioPolicy.validFrom!==dateNew)throw new Error('PERF11 historical Rolling scenario did not preserve hardcoded dateNew.');

  var out={ok:true,dateNew:dateNew,normal:normal,exactSchedule:exact,pairNoRelation:pair,historicalClosedScenario:{detector:scenario,policy:scenarioPolicy}};
  Logger.log('[PERF11 Rolling Policy] '+JSON.stringify(out,null,2));
  return out;
}

  tests.push(RSC_PERF10_SAFE_RUN_20260819_('PERF11 Rolling Valid From policy',function(){return RSC_PERF11_TEST_ROLLING_VALID_FROM_POLICY_20260819();},false));
  tests.push(RSC_PERF10_SAFE_RUN_20260819_('PERF11 DB access + execution identity',function(){return RSC_PERF11_DB_ACCESS_AUDIT_20260819_(false,false);},false));
  // Access audit returns a value instead of throwing so convert explicit ok=false to FAIL.
  if(tests[2].status==='PASS'&&tests[2].result&&!tests[2].result.ok){tests[2].status='FAIL';tests[2].error='Database resilient opener tidak dapat mengakses DB.';}
  var pass=0,fail=0,skip=0;
  for(var i=0;i<tests.length;i++){if(tests[i].status==='PASS')pass++;else if(tests[i].status==='FAIL')fail++;else skip++;}
  var out={version:RSC_PERF11_VERSION_20260819_,ok:fail===0,pass:pass,fail:fail,skip:skip,tests:tests};
  Logger.log('[PERF11 FULL AUDIT] '+JSON.stringify(out,null,2));
  var identity=tests[2]&&tests[2].result&&tests[2].result.identity||{};
  var msg=(out.ok?'PASS':'FAIL')+' PERF11 — PASS='+pass+', FAIL='+fail+', SKIP='+skip+'\nDB effective user='+(identity.effectiveUser||'[unknown]')+'\nRolling Valid From policy='+(tests[1].status||'UNKNOWN');
  RSC_PERF10_UI_MESSAGE_20260819_('PERF11 Full Safe Audit',msg);
  if(!out.ok)throw new Error('PERF11 full audit failed. Lihat Execution log; DB access failure sekarang mencantumkan execution identity dan semua access method.');
  return out;

/*******************************************************************************
 * PERF12 — STATUS COLOR + AUTO REVAMP AFTER VALIDATION — 2026-08-19
 *
 * Authoritative additions:
 * 1) Validation Status OK = green; ERROR = red after every Standard validation.
 * 2) Active Rolling: when validation has zero errors, immediately build/upsert
 *    Template Revamp Rolling Sales and activate the output tab.
 * 3) Rekap / Validate All E Standard V28.3: when the run finishes, automatically
 *    build Revamp only for master rows whose same run is COMPLETE_OK.
 * 4) Standard manifest gate is independent from legacy V20 manifest.
 *******************************************************************************/
var RSC_PERF12_VERSION_20260819_='RSC_PERF12_AUTO_REVAMP_STATUS_COLOR_20260819';
var RSC_PERF12_STATUS_COLORS_20260819_={
  okBg:'#B7E1CD', okFg:'#137333',
  errorBg:'#F4C7C3', errorFg:'#C5221F'
};
var RSC_PERF12_PENDING_BULK_REVAMP_PROPERTY_20260819_='RSC_PERF12_PENDING_BULK_REVAMP_20260819';
var RSC_PERF12_LAST_BULK_REVAMP_RUN_PROPERTY_20260819_='RSC_PERF12_LAST_BULK_REVAMP_RUN_20260819';
var RSC_PERF12_BULK_REVAMP_RETRY_HANDLER_20260819_='RSC_PERF12_PROCESS_PENDING_BULK_REVAMP_20260819';
var __RSC_PERF12_STANDARD_GATE_CACHE_20260819_=Object.create(null);

function RSC_PERF12_STATUS_STYLE_FOR_VALUE_20260819_(value){
  var st=String(value==null?'':value).trim().toUpperCase();
  if(st==='OK')return{status:'OK',bg:RSC_PERF12_STATUS_COLORS_20260819_.okBg,fg:RSC_PERF12_STATUS_COLORS_20260819_.okFg,weight:'bold'};
  if(st==='ERROR')return{status:'ERROR',bg:RSC_PERF12_STATUS_COLORS_20260819_.errorBg,fg:RSC_PERF12_STATUS_COLORS_20260819_.errorFg,weight:'bold'};
  return null;
}

function RSC_PERF12_ENFORCE_VALIDATION_STATUS_COLORS_20260819_(sh){
  if(!sh)return{ok:0,error:0,styled:0,skipped:true};
  var lastRow=Number(sh.getLastRow()||0),lastCol=Number(sh.getLastColumn()||0);
  if(lastRow<1||lastCol<1)return{ok:0,error:0,styled:0,skipped:true};
  var scanRows=Math.min(30,lastRow),scanCols=Math.min(100,lastCol);
  var grid=sh.getRange(1,1,scanRows,scanCols).getDisplayValues();
  var headerRow=0,statusCol=0;
  for(var r=0;r<grid.length&&!statusCol;r++){
    for(var c=0;c<grid[r].length;c++){
      var h=String(grid[r][c]||'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[\s_\-]+/g,'');
      if(h==='validationstatus'){headerRow=r+1;statusCol=c+1;break;}
    }
  }
  if(!statusCol)return{ok:0,error:0,styled:0,skipped:true,reason:'HEADER_NOT_FOUND'};
  var start=headerRow+1;
  if(lastRow<start)return{ok:0,error:0,styled:0,skipped:true,reason:'NO_DATA'};
  var n=lastRow-start+1,range=sh.getRange(start,statusCol,n,1),vals=range.getDisplayValues();
  var bgs=range.getBackgrounds(),fgs=range.getFontColors(),weights=range.getFontWeights();
  var ok=0,err=0,dirty=false;
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
    var style=RSC_PERF12_STATUS_STYLE_FOR_VALUE_20260819_(vals[i][0]);
    if(!style)continue;
    if(style.status==='OK')ok++;else err++;
    if(String(bgs[i][0]||'').toUpperCase()!==style.bg||String(fgs[i][0]||'').toUpperCase()!==style.fg||String(weights[i][0]||'').toLowerCase()!=='bold')dirty=true;
    bgs[i][0]=style.bg;fgs[i][0]=style.fg;weights[i][0]='bold';
  }
  if(dirty){range.setBackgrounds(bgs).setFontColors(fgs).setFontWeights(weights);}
  return{ok:ok,error:err,styled:ok+err,changed:dirty,statusCol:statusCol,headerRow:headerRow};
}

function RSC_PERF12_AUTO_REVAMP_ACTIVE_AFTER_VALIDATION_20260819_(ss,sh,result){
  var errors=Number(result&&result.errorRows||0);
  if(errors>0)return{started:false,skipped:true,reason:'VALIDATION_ERROR_ROWS_'+errors};
  if(!ss||!sh||String(sh.getName()||'')!=='Change Rolling & Change Schedule')return{started:false,skipped:true,reason:'NOT_CHANGE_ROLLING'};
  var revampResult=RSC_CREATE_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_ROLLING_SALES_20260720({activeSheetOnly:true,silent:true,autoAfterValidation:true});
  var target=ss.getSheetByName('Template Revamp Rolling Sales');
  if(target){try{ss.setActiveSheet(target);}catch(ignoreActivate){}}
  writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('PERF12 Active validation COMPLETE_OK -> Template Revamp otomatis. Output rows='+Number(revampResult&&revampResult.outputRows||0));
  return{started:true,skipped:false,outputRows:Number(revampResult&&revampResult.outputRows||0),result:revampResult||null};
}

function RSC_PERF12_BUILD_STANDARD_VALIDATION_GATE_20260819_(masterSs,runToken){
  var token=String(runToken||''),cacheKey=String(masterSs&&masterSs.getId?masterSs.getId():'')+'|'+token;
  if(__RSC_PERF12_STANDARD_GATE_CACHE_20260819_[cacheKey])return __RSC_PERF12_STANDARD_GATE_CACHE_20260819_[cacheKey];
  var map=Object.create(null);
  if(!masterSs||!token){__RSC_PERF12_STANDARD_GATE_CACHE_20260819_[cacheKey]=map;return map;}
  var sh=masterSs.getSheetByName(RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814.manifestSheetName);
  if(!sh||sh.getLastRow()<2){__RSC_PERF12_STANDARD_GATE_CACHE_20260819_[cacheKey]=map;return map;}
  var last=sh.getLastRow(),chunk=500;
  for(var start=2;start<=last;start+=chunk){
    var n=Math.min(chunk,last-start+1);
    // A Run ID | B File ID | C Master Rows JSON | ... | F Status
    var vals=sh.getRange(start,1,n,6).getValues();
    for(var i=0;i<vals.length;i++){
      if(String(vals[i][0]||'')!==token)continue;
      var status=String(vals[i][5]||'').trim().toUpperCase();
      var rows=[];try{rows=JSON.parse(String(vals[i][2]||'[]'));}catch(ignoreParse){}
      if(!Array.isArray(rows))rows=[];
      for(var j=0;j<rows.length;j++){var rowNo=Number(rows[j]||0);if(rowNo>0)map[rowNo]=status;}
    }
  }
  __RSC_PERF12_STANDARD_GATE_CACHE_20260819_[cacheKey]=map;
  return map;
}

}

function RSC_PERF12_SCHEDULE_PENDING_BULK_REVAMP_20260819_(delayMs){
  RSC_PERF12_DELETE_TRIGGER_BY_HANDLER_20260819_(RSC_PERF12_BULK_REVAMP_RETRY_HANDLER_20260819_);
  RSC_PERF13_NEW_TRIGGER_20260819_(RSC_PERF12_BULK_REVAMP_RETRY_HANDLER_20260819_).timeBased().after(Math.max(1000,Number(delayMs||60000))).create();

function RSC_PERF12_START_BULK_REVAMP_PAYLOAD_20260819_(payload){
  if(!payload||!payload.runId)throw new Error('PERF12 payload Auto Revamp Rekap tidak lengkap.');
  var props=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  if(String(props.getProperty(RSC_PERF12_LAST_BULK_REVAMP_RUN_PROPERTY_20260819_)||'')===String(payload.runId))return{started:false,skipped:true,reason:'ALREADY_STARTED'};
  if(RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_HAS_ACTIVE_REVAMP_20260813_()){
    props.setProperty(RSC_PERF12_PENDING_BULK_REVAMP_PROPERTY_20260819_,JSON.stringify(payload));
    RSC_PERF12_SCHEDULE_PENDING_BULK_REVAMP_20260819_(60000);
    return{started:false,queued:true,reason:'REVAMP_JOB_BUSY'};
  }
  props.setProperty(RSC_PERF12_LAST_BULK_REVAMP_RUN_PROPERTY_20260819_,String(payload.runId));
  __RSC_PERF12_STANDARD_GATE_CACHE_20260819_=Object.create(null);
  try{
    var result=RSC_CREATE_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_ROLLING_SALES_20260720({
      manualStart:true,integratedMenu:true,silent:true,
      masterSpreadsheetId:String(payload.masterSpreadsheetId||''),
      masterSheetId:String(payload.masterSheetId||''),
      requireValidationOk:true,
      validationRunToken:String(payload.runId),
      validationGateMode:'STANDARD_V28_3',
      autoAfterValidation:true
    });
    props.deleteProperty(RSC_PERF12_PENDING_BULK_REVAMP_PROPERTY_20260819_);
    RSC_PERF12_DELETE_TRIGGER_BY_HANDLER_20260819_(RSC_PERF12_BULK_REVAMP_RETRY_HANDLER_20260819_);
    writeRollingSalesCenterLog_('PERF12 Validate All E selesai -> Template Revamp otomatis dimulai. Run='+payload.runId+', COMPLETE_OK='+Number(payload.completeOk||0));
    return{started:true,queued:false,result:result||null,runId:String(payload.runId)};
  }catch(err){
    props.deleteProperty(RSC_PERF12_LAST_BULK_REVAMP_RUN_PROPERTY_20260819_);
    props.setProperty(RSC_PERF12_PENDING_BULK_REVAMP_PROPERTY_20260819_,JSON.stringify(payload));
    throw err;
  }
}

function RSC_PERF12_AUTO_REVAMP_AFTER_BULK_20260819_(summary){
  var c=summary&&summary.counts||{},completeOk=Number(c.COMPLETE_OK||0);
  if(completeOk<=0)return{started:false,skipped:true,reason:'NO_COMPLETE_OK'};
  var S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,props=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var payload={
    runId:String(summary.runId||''),completeOk:completeOk,
    completeError:Number(c.COMPLETE_ERROR||0),hardError:Number(c.HARD_ERROR||0),
    masterSpreadsheetId:String(props.getProperty(S.pMasterSsId)||''),
    masterSheetId:String(props.getProperty(S.pMasterSheetId)||''),
    createdAt:new Date().toISOString()
  };
  if(!payload.masterSpreadsheetId||!payload.masterSheetId)throw new Error('PERF12 master context Validate All E tidak tersedia untuk Auto Revamp.');
  return RSC_PERF12_START_BULK_REVAMP_PAYLOAD_20260819_(payload);
}

  var payload;try{payload=JSON.parse(raw);}catch(err){props.deleteProperty(RSC_PERF12_PENDING_BULK_REVAMP_PROPERTY_20260819_);throw new Error('PERF12 pending Auto Revamp JSON rusak.');}

  }

}

function RSC_PERF12_TEST_STATUS_AND_GATE_20260819(){
  var ok=RSC_PERF12_STATUS_STYLE_FOR_VALUE_20260819_('OK'),er=RSC_PERF12_STATUS_STYLE_FOR_VALUE_20260819_('ERROR'),other=RSC_PERF12_STATUS_STYLE_FOR_VALUE_20260819_('VALIDATING');
  if(!ok||ok.bg!=='#B7E1CD'||ok.fg!=='#137333')throw new Error('PERF12 OK color policy failed.');
  if(!er||er.bg!=='#F4C7C3'||er.fg!=='#C5221F')throw new Error('PERF12 ERROR color policy failed.');
  if(other!==null)throw new Error('PERF12 non-final status must preserve existing formatting.');
  var synthetic=[
    ['RUN','FILE','[10,11]','','','COMPLETE_OK'],
    ['RUN','FILE2','[12]','','','COMPLETE_ERROR']
  ];
  var gate={};synthetic.forEach(function(r){var rows=JSON.parse(r[2]);rows.forEach(function(x){gate[x]=r[5];});});
  if(gate[10]!=='COMPLETE_OK'||gate[11]!=='COMPLETE_OK'||gate[12]!=='COMPLETE_ERROR')throw new Error('PERF12 standard gate mapping failed.');
  var out={ok:true,statusColors:{OK:ok,ERROR:er},standardGateSynthetic:gate,activePolicy:'zero error -> auto Revamp + activate target',bulkPolicy:'COMPLETE_OK rows only -> auto Revamp'};
  Logger.log('[PERF12 TEST] '+JSON.stringify(out,null,2));
  return out;
}

function RSC_PERF12_ASSERT_READY_20260819_(){
  RSC_PERF11_ASSERT_READY_20260819_();
  if(typeof RSC_PERF12_SOURCE_TAIL_MARKER_20260819_==='undefined')throw new Error('PERF12 SOURCE INCOMPLETE/TRUNCATED. Missing PERF12 tail marker.');
  var required=['RSC_PERF12_ENFORCE_VALIDATION_STATUS_COLORS_20260819_','RSC_PERF12_AUTO_REVAMP_ACTIVE_AFTER_VALIDATION_20260819_','RSC_PERF12_IS_ROW_VALIDATION_OK_DISPATCH_20260819_','RSC_PERF12_AUTO_REVAMP_AFTER_BULK_20260819_','RSC_PERF12_PROCESS_PENDING_BULK_REVAMP_20260819'];
  var missing=[];for(var i=0;i<required.length;i++){try{if(eval('typeof '+required[i])!=='function')missing.push(required[i]);}catch(err){missing.push(required[i]);}}

  return true;
}

function RSC_PERF12_FULL_AUDIT_20260819(){
  RSC_PERF12_ASSERT_READY_20260819_();
  var tests=[];
  tests.push(RSC_PERF10_SAFE_RUN_20260819_('PERF11 full audit',function(){return RSC_PERF11_FULL_AUDIT_20260819();},false));
  tests.push(RSC_PERF10_SAFE_RUN_20260819_('PERF12 status color + auto Revamp gate',function(){return RSC_PERF12_TEST_STATUS_AND_GATE_20260819();},false));
  var pass=0,fail=0,skip=0;for(var i=0;i<tests.length;i++){if(tests[i].status==='PASS')pass++;else if(tests[i].status==='FAIL')fail++;else skip++;}
  var out={version:RSC_PERF12_VERSION_20260819_,ok:fail===0,pass:pass,fail:fail,skip:skip,tests:tests};
  Logger.log('[PERF12 FULL AUDIT] '+JSON.stringify(out,null,2));
  RSC_PERF10_UI_MESSAGE_20260819_('PERF12 Full Safe Audit',(out.ok?'PASS':'FAIL')+' PERF12 — PASS='+pass+', FAIL='+fail+', SKIP='+skip+'\nOK=green; ERROR=red\nActive & Rekap Auto Revamp gate=PASS when test is PASS.');
  if(!out.ok)throw new Error('PERF12 full audit failed. Lihat Execution log.');
  return out;
}

var RSC_PERF11_SOURCE_TAIL_MARKER_20260819_='PERF11_ACCESS_ROLLING_FIX_OK_20260819';

/*******************************************************************************
 * PERF13 — GLOBAL HARD STOP + HARD CHECKPOINT RESET — 2026-08-19
 *
 * Goals:
 * 1) One menu action sets a global kill switch FIRST.
 * 2) All installable project triggers are removed.
 * 3) Existing worker-specific STOP flags are asserted.
 * 4) Runtime/checkpoint/job properties are hard-reset while stable infrastructure
 *    IDs/preferences are preserved.
 * 5) Validation manifest sheets are removed/reset; business output sheets are NOT
 *    purged.
 * 6) All future ScriptApp.newTrigger() calls go through a hard-stop guard.
 * 7) ScriptCache namespace is invalidated by epoch rotation.
 *
 * Apps Script limitation:
 * An execution already running on Google's server cannot be forcibly terminated
 * from another Apps Script execution. PERF13 makes that execution cooperative:
 * stop flags + open guard + continuation-trigger guard make it stop at the next
 * checkpoint / DB-open / scheduling boundary and prevent resurrection.
 *******************************************************************************/
var RSC_PERF13_VERSION_20260819_='RSC_PERF13_GLOBAL_HARD_STOP_20260819';
var RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_FLAG_20260819_='RSC_PERF13_GLOBAL_HARD_STOP_FLAG_20260819';
var RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_GENERATION_20260819_='RSC_PERF13_GLOBAL_HARD_STOP_GENERATION_20260819';
var RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_AT_20260819_='RSC_PERF13_GLOBAL_HARD_STOP_AT_20260819';
var RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_REPORT_20260819_='RSC_PERF13_GLOBAL_HARD_STOP_REPORT_20260819';
var RSC_PERF13_CACHE_EPOCH_PROPERTY_20260819_='RSC_PERF13_CACHE_EPOCH_20260819';
var __RSC_PERF13_CACHE_EPOCH_MEMO_20260819_='';

    return String(PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().getProperty(RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_FLAG_20260819_)||'').toUpperCase()==='TRUE';
  }catch(ignore){return false;}
}

function RSC_PERF13_ASSERT_RUN_ALLOWED_20260819_(checkpoint){

  throw new Error(
    '[HARD STOP ACTIVE] Semua worker/proses Rolling Sales Center sedang diblokir. checkpoint='+
    String(checkpoint||'UNKNOWN')+
    ', generation='+String(props.getProperty(RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_GENERATION_20260819_)||'-')+
    ', stoppedAt='+String(props.getProperty(RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_AT_20260819_)||'-')+
    '. Gunakan menu Admin / Recovery → Re-Arm System after HARD STOP hanya setelah execution lama sudah berhenti.'
  );
}

    RSC_PERF18_TRIGGER_CREATION_GATE_20260819_(handlerFunction);

  try{
    var props=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
    var v=String(props.getProperty(RSC_PERF13_CACHE_EPOCH_PROPERTY_20260819_)||'');
    if(!v){v='E0';props.setProperty(RSC_PERF13_CACHE_EPOCH_PROPERTY_20260819_,v);}
    __RSC_PERF13_CACHE_EPOCH_MEMO_20260819_=v;
    return v;
  }catch(ignore){
    return 'E0';
  }
}

  try{if(typeof __RSC_PERF5_LOCAL_CACHE_20260819__!=='undefined')__RSC_PERF5_LOCAL_CACHE_20260819__=Object.create(null);}catch(ignore1){}
  try{if(typeof __RSC_PERF12_STANDARD_GATE_CACHE_20260819_!=='undefined')__RSC_PERF12_STANDARD_GATE_CACHE_20260819_=Object.create(null);}catch(ignore2){}
  return epoch;
}

function RSC_PERF13_SET_ALL_STOP_FLAGS_20260819_(props,value){
  props=props||PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var v=value?'TRUE':'FALSE';
  var flags=[
    'ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS_STOP_FLAG_V5',
    'RSC_STD_V27_STOP',
    'RSC_VALIDATE_E_V20_STOP',
    'RSC_TEMPLATE_REVAMP_STOP_REQUESTED_20260722',
    'RSC_COMPILE_V13_STOP_FLAG_20260722'
  ];
  for(var i=0;i<flags.length;i++)try{props.setProperty(flags[i],v);}catch(ignoreFlag){}
  if(value){
    try{props.setProperty('RSC_V28_FULL_PIPELINE_ENABLED','FALSE');}catch(ignore1){}
    try{props.setProperty('RSC_MASTER_AUTO_PIPELINE_ENABLED_20260813','FALSE');}catch(ignore2){}
    try{props.setProperty('RSC_STD_V27_HOURLY_ENABLED','FALSE');}catch(ignore3){}
    try{props.setProperty('RSC_V28_2_AUTO_VALIDATE_QUEUED','FALSE');}catch(ignore4){}
  }
  return flags;
}

function RSC_PERF13_DELETE_ALL_PROJECT_TRIGGERS_20260819_(){
  var report={deleted:0,failed:0,handlers:[]};
  try{
    var list=ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers()||[];
    for(var i=0;i<list.length;i++){
      var t=list[i],h='';
      try{h=String(t.getHandlerFunction()||'');}catch(ignoreName){}
      try{
        ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(t);
        report.deleted++;
        if(h)report.handlers.push(h);
      }catch(err){
        report.failed++;
      }
    }
  }catch(errList){
    report.failed++;
    report.listError=String(errList&&errList.message?errList.message:errList);
  }
  report.handlers=report.handlers.filter(function(v,i,a){return a.indexOf(v)===i;}).sort();
  return report;
}

function RSC_PERF13_PRESERVE_PROPERTY_20260819_(key){
  var k=String(key||'');
  var exact={
    'CrVisitSummary_SPREADSHEET_ID':true,
    'ROLLING_SALES_CENTER_CR_SUMMARY_REALTIME_ENABLED':true,
    'APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_FIXED_KEY_SS_ID_20260722':true,
    'APPROVED_LINK_COMPILE_LEGACY_META_MIGRATED_BUSINESS_KEY_V9_20260722':true,
    'RSC_UR_TECH_SPREADSHEET_ID_20260722':true,
    'RSC_UR_ST_RL_EXPORT_FOLDER_ID_20260728':true
  };
  if(exact[k])return true;
  if(k===RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_FLAG_20260819_||
     k===RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_GENERATION_20260819_||
     k===RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_AT_20260819_||
     k===RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_REPORT_20260819_||
     k===RSC_PERF13_CACHE_EPOCH_PROPERTY_20260819_)return true;
  return false;
}

function RSC_PERF13_HARD_RESET_DOCUMENT_PROPERTIES_20260819_(props){
  props=props||PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var all={};
  try{all=props.getProperties()||{};}catch(ignoreGet){}
  var deleted=[],preserved=[];
  Object.keys(all).forEach(function(k){
    if(RSC_PERF13_PRESERVE_PROPERTY_20260819_(k)){preserved.push(k);return;}
    try{props.deleteProperty(k);deleted.push(k);}catch(ignoreDelete){}
  });
  return{deletedCount:deleted.length,preservedCount:preserved.length,deletedKeys:deleted.sort(),preservedKeys:preserved.sort()};
}

function RSC_PERF13_RESET_MANIFEST_SHEETS_20260819_(ss){
  var names=['_RSC_VALIDATE_E_MANIFEST','_RSC_VALIDATION_MANIFEST_V27'];
  var out={deleted:0,cleared:0,failed:0,names:[]};
  if(!ss)return out;
  names.forEach(function(name){
    var sh=null;
    try{sh=ss.getSheetByName(name);}catch(ignoreFind){}
    if(!sh)return;
    try{
      if(ss.getSheets().length>1 && (!ss.getActiveSheet() || ss.getActiveSheet().getSheetId()!==sh.getSheetId())){
        ss.deleteSheet(sh);out.deleted++;
      }else{
        sh.clear();out.cleared++;
      }
      out.names.push(name);
    }catch(err){out.failed++;}
  });
  return out;
}

function RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_CORE_20260819_(options){
  options=options||{};
  var props=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties(),now=new Date().toISOString();
  var oldGen=Number(props.getProperty(RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_GENERATION_20260819_)||0);
  var generation=oldGen+1;

  // FIRST: publish global stop so concurrent workers can observe it immediately.
  props.setProperty(RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_FLAG_20260819_,'TRUE');
  props.setProperty(RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_GENERATION_20260819_,String(generation));
  props.setProperty(RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_AT_20260819_,now);

  // Rotate specific copy generation as well; old copy execution loses authority.
  try{
    var copyGen=Number(props.getProperty('ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS_GENERATION_V5')||0)+1;
    props.setProperty('ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS_GENERATION_V5',String(copyGen));
  }catch(ignoreCopyGeneration){}

  var stopFlags=RSC_PERF13_SET_ALL_STOP_FLAGS_20260819_(props,true);
  var triggerReport=options.skipTriggerDelete?{deleted:0,failed:0,handlers:[],simulated:true}:RSC_PERF13_DELETE_ALL_PROJECT_TRIGGERS_20260819_();

  var ss=null;
  if(!options.skipManifestReset){
    try{ss=SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();}catch(ignoreActive){}
  }
  var manifestReport=options.skipManifestReset?{deleted:0,cleared:0,failed:0,simulated:true}:RSC_PERF13_RESET_MANIFEST_SHEETS_20260819_(ss);

  // Hard-reset all runtime checkpoints/jobs. Then re-assert stop state because the
  // reset intentionally removes ordinary job properties.
  var propReport=options.skipPropertyReset
    ? {deletedCount:0,preservedCount:0,deletedKeys:[],preservedKeys:[],simulated:true}
    : RSC_PERF13_HARD_RESET_DOCUMENT_PROPERTIES_20260819_(props);

  props.setProperty(RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_FLAG_20260819_,'TRUE');
  props.setProperty(RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_GENERATION_20260819_,String(generation));
  props.setProperty(RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_AT_20260819_,now);
  RSC_PERF13_SET_ALL_STOP_FLAGS_20260819_(props,true);
  try{
    var afterCopyGen=Number(props.getProperty('ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS_GENERATION_V5')||0)+1;
    props.setProperty('ROLLING_TEMPLATE_COPY_PARAMETERS_GENERATION_V5',String(afterCopyGen));
  }catch(ignoreCopyGen2){}
  var cacheEpoch=RSC_PERF13_ROTATE_CACHE_EPOCH_20260819_(props);

  // Explicitly kill PERF12 pending auto-Revamp state; trigger already removed.
  try{props.deleteProperty('RSC_PERF12_PENDING_BULK_REVAMP_20260819');}catch(ignorePending){}
  try{props.deleteProperty('RSC_PERF12_LAST_BULK_REVAMP_RUN_20260819');}catch(ignoreLastRevamp){}

  var report={
    version:RSC_PERF13_VERSION_20260819_,
    ok:true,
    generation:generation,
    stoppedAt:now,
    triggerReport:triggerReport,
    propertyReset:propReport,
    manifestReset:manifestReport,
    stopFlags:stopFlags,
    cacheEpoch:cacheEpoch,
    note:'Running Apps Script executions cannot be preemptively killed by Apps Script API; cooperative kill is active and continuation scheduling is blocked.'
  };
  try{props.setProperty(RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_REPORT_20260819_,JSON.stringify(report));}catch(ignoreReport){}
  Logger.log('[PERF13 HARD STOP] '+JSON.stringify(report,null,2));
  return report;
}

function RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_ALL_20260819(){
  var ui=null;
  try{ui=SpreadsheetApp.getUi();}catch(ignoreUi){}
  if(ui){
    var answer=ui.alert(
      '☢ HARD STOP ALL + HARD RESET',
      'Ini akan:\n'+
      '• memblokir SEMUA worker/proses baru,\n'+
      '• menghapus SEMUA installable project trigger,\n'+
      '• memasang stop flag untuk worker yang sedang berjalan,\n'+
      '• menghapus seluruh checkpoint/job/progress/pending state,\n'+
      '• reset manifest validasi,\n'+
      '• invalidasi cache namespace.\n\n'+
      'Output bisnis/Template Revamp/hasil compile TIDAK dipurge.\n\n'+
      'Lanjutkan HARD STOP?',
      ui.ButtonSet.YES_NO
    );
    if(answer!==ui.Button.YES)return{cancelled:true};
  }
  try{RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_GLOBAL_20260819_('SYSTEM',{jobType:'ADMIN / RECOVERY',state:'BLOCKED',stage:'HARD STOP requested',progressPct:0,message:'HARD STOP ALL + HARD RESET dimulai.',startedMs:Date.now(),worker:'SYSTEM',runId:String(PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties().getProperty('RSC_STD_V27_RUN_ID')||'')},{force:true,history:true});}catch(ignorePerf16Stop){}
  var report=RSC_PERF13_HARD_STOP_CORE_20260819_({});
  var msg=
    'HARD STOP AKTIF.\n\n'+
    'Generation: '+report.generation+'\n'+
    'Triggers dihapus: '+Number(report.triggerReport.deleted||0)+'\n'+
    'Runtime properties direset: '+Number(report.propertyReset.deletedCount||0)+'\n'+
    'Manifest reset: '+(Number(report.manifestReset.deleted||0)+Number(report.manifestReset.cleared||0))+'\n'+
    'Cache epoch: '+report.cacheEpoch+'\n\n'+
    'Execution yang sudah Running di server Google tidak bisa dibunuh seketika, tetapi stop flags aktif dan semua continuation trigger baru diblokir.\n'+
    'Jangan Re-Arm sampai execution lama sudah selesai/berhenti.';
  try{SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast(msg,'Rolling Sales Center — HARD STOP',15);}catch(ignoreToast){}

}

var RSC_PERF13_SOURCE_TAIL_MARKER_20260819_='PERF13_GLOBAL_HARD_STOP_OK_20260819';


/*******************************************************************************
 * PERF14 — BULK WORKER SCHEDULER RELIABILITY — 2026-08-19
 *
 * Fixes:
 * - Standard V28.3 manifest coordination uses ScriptLock instead of DocumentLock,
 *   avoiding starvation from unrelated long-running document-locked jobs.
 * - One-time worker deletes its fired trigger by triggerUid before rescheduling.
 * - Empty claim / lock-race never silently kills a lane; it self-retries.
 * - Watchdog interval reduced to 1 minute as a final safety net.
 *******************************************************************************/
var RSC_PERF14_VERSION_20260819_='RSC_PERF14_WORKER_SCHEDULER_RELIABILITY_20260819';

function RSC_PERF14_DIAGNOSE_WORKER_QUEUE_20260819(){
  RSC_PERF13_ASSERT_READY_20260819_();
  var S=RSC_APP_20260611.__perf9Internal.RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814;
  var p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  var counts=RSC_APP_20260611.standardBulkStatus(false);
  var allTriggers=[];
  try{allTriggers=ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers()||[];}catch(ignore){}
  var byHandler=Object.create(null);
  allTriggers.forEach(function(t){
    var h='';try{h=t.getHandlerFunction();}catch(ignoreH){}
    if(h)byHandler[h]=Number(byHandler[h]||0)+1;
  });
  var laneTriggers={};
  S.workerHandlers.forEach(function(h){laneTriggers[h]=Number(byHandler[h]||0);});
  var hardStop=RSC_PERF13_IS_HARD_STOP_ACTIVE_20260819_();
  var stop=String(p.getProperty(S.pStop)||'').toUpperCase()==='TRUE';
  var active=Number((counts.counts||{}).ACTIVE||0);
  var queued=Number((counts.counts||{}).QUEUED||0);
  var retry=Number((counts.counts||{}).RETRY||0);
  var stalled=(queued+retry)>0&&active===0;
  var duplicateHandlers=[];
  if(Number(byHandler[S.watchdogHandler]||0)>1)duplicateHandlers.push(S.watchdogHandler+' x'+Number(byHandler[S.watchdogHandler]||0));
  S.workerHandlers.forEach(function(h){if(Number(byHandler[h]||0)>1)duplicateHandlers.push(h+' x'+Number(byHandler[h]||0));});
  var out={
    version:RSC_PERF17_VERSION_20260819_,
    runId:counts.runId||'',
    total:Number(counts.total||0),
    unfinished:Number(counts.unfinished||0),
    queued:queued,
    active:active,
    retry:retry,
    hardStop:hardStop,
    standardStop:stop,
    watchdogTriggers:Number(byHandler[S.watchdogHandler]||0),
    laneTriggers:laneTriggers,
    totalProjectTriggers:allTriggers.length,
    stalled:stalled,
    duplicateHandlers:duplicateHandlers,
    diagnosis:hardStop?'HARD_STOP_ACTIVE':(stop?'STANDARD_STOP_ACTIVE':(duplicateHandlers.length?'DUPLICATE_STANDARD_TRIGGERS':(stalled?'QUEUE_STALLED_OR_BETWEEN_BUNDLES':'RUNNING_OR_IDLE')))
  };
  Logger.log('[PERF14 WORKER DIAG] '+JSON.stringify(out,null,2));
  var lines=[
    'Run: '+(out.runId||'[none]'),
    'QUEUED: '+queued+' | ACTIVE: '+active+' | RETRY: '+retry,
    'Unfinished: '+out.unfinished,
    'Hard Stop: '+hardStop+' | Standard Stop: '+stop,
    'Watchdog trigger: '+out.watchdogTriggers,
    'Worker triggers: '+JSON.stringify(laneTriggers),
    'Project triggers total: '+out.totalProjectTriggers,
    'Duplicate Standard trigger: '+(duplicateHandlers.length?duplicateHandlers.join(', '):'none'),
    'Diagnosis: '+out.diagnosis
  ];
  try{SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('PERF14 — Worker Queue Diagnostic',lines.join('\n'),SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK);}catch(ignoreUi){}
  return out;
}

function RSC_PERF14_KICK_WAITING_WORKERS_20260819(){
  RSC_PERF13_ASSERT_RUN_ALLOWED_20260819_('PERF14_KICK_WORKERS');
  var S=RSC_APP_20260611.__perf9Internal.RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  p.setProperty(S.pStop,'FALSE');
  var before=RSC_PERF14_DIAGNOSE_WORKER_QUEUE_20260819();
  if(!before.runId||before.unfinished<=0)return{started:false,reason:'NO_UNFINISHED_RUN',before:before};
  // Remove stale one-time worker triggers only, then delegate to the authoritative
  // Standard Bulk Start/Resume path inside the IIFE.
  try{
    (ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers()||[]).forEach(function(tr){
      try{if(S.workerHandlers.indexOf(tr.getHandlerFunction())!==-1)ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(tr);}catch(ignoreTr){}
    });
  }catch(ignoreDelete){}
  RSC_APP_20260611.standardBulkStart({silent:true});
  var after=RSC_PERF14_DIAGNOSE_WORKER_QUEUE_20260819();
  var out={started:true,before:before,after:after,kickedAt:new Date().toISOString()};
  Logger.log('[PERF14 KICK] '+JSON.stringify(out,null,2));
  try{SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().toast('Worker queue di-kick. 4 lane dijadwalkan ulang.','PERF14',8);}catch(ignoreToast){}
  return out;
}

/* PERF20 AUTH STATUS HOTFIX --------------------------------------------------
 * IMPORTANT: NEVER detect REQUIRED using substring matching.
 * `NOT_REQUIRED` contains the literal substring `REQUIRED`, therefore checks
 * such as `indexOf('REQUIRED') !== -1` are logically wrong.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
var RSC_PERF20_VERSION_20260819_='PERF20_AUTH_STATUS_EXACT_FIX_20260819';

function RSC_PERF20_NORMALIZE_AUTH_STATUS_20260819_(value){
  const s=String(value==null?'':value).trim().toUpperCase();
  if(!s)return '';
  // Be tolerant if an environment renders enum text as `AuthorizationStatus.X`.
  const tail=s.indexOf('.')>=0?s.substring(s.lastIndexOf('.')+1):s;
  if(tail==='REQUIRED')return 'REQUIRED';
  if(tail==='NOT_REQUIRED')return 'NOT_REQUIRED';
  return tail;
}

function RSC_PERF20_AUTH_IS_REQUIRED_20260819_(authOrStatus){
  const raw=(authOrStatus&&typeof authOrStatus==='object'&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(authOrStatus,'status'))
    ?authOrStatus.status
    :authOrStatus;
  return RSC_PERF20_NORMALIZE_AUTH_STATUS_20260819_(raw)==='REQUIRED';
}

function RSC_PERF18_AUTH_INFO_20260819_(){
  const ai=ScriptApp.getAuthorizationInfo(ScriptApp.AuthMode.FULL);
  let status='',url='',scopes=[];
  try{status=RSC_PERF20_NORMALIZE_AUTH_STATUS_20260819_(ai.getAuthorizationStatus());}catch(ignore1){}
  try{url=String(ai.getAuthorizationUrl()||'');}catch(ignore2){}
  try{scopes=ai.getAuthorizedScopes()||[];}catch(ignore3){}
  return{
    status:status,
    authorizationRequired:status==='REQUIRED',
    url:url,
    scopes:scopes
  };
}

function RSC_PERF18_SHOW_AUTH_LINK_20260819_(auth){
  auth=auth||RSC_PERF18_AUTH_INFO_20260819_();
  const status=RSC_PERF20_NORMALIZE_AUTH_STATUS_20260819_(auth.status);
  const url=String(auth.url||'');

  // If OAuth is already complete, a null URL is correct and must NOT be an error.
  if(status==='NOT_REQUIRED'){
    const out={ok:true,shown:false,status:status,message:'OAuth authorization sudah lengkap (NOT_REQUIRED). Tidak ada authorization URL yang diperlukan.'};
    try{SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('PERF20 OAuth Status',out.message,SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK);}catch(ignoreUi){}
    return out;
  }

  if(status!=='REQUIRED'){
    throw new Error('Status OAuth tidak dikenali: '+String(status||'[blank]')+'. Jalankan Show Authorization Binding Status untuk diagnosis.');
  }

  if(!url){
    throw new Error('OAuth status=REQUIRED tetapi authorization URL tidak tersedia. Coba jalankan kembali function dari Apps Script editor setelah refresh project; jika tetap sama, periksa OAuth scopes/project authorization.');
  }
  try{
    const safe=url.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
    const html=HtmlService.createHtmlOutput(
      '<div style="font-family:Arial,sans-serif;padding:16px;line-height:1.45">'+
      '<h3 style="margin-top:0">Authorize Rolling Sales Center</h3>'+
      '<p>Project master belum memiliki seluruh OAuth permission yang diperlukan untuk membuka spreadsheet database eksternal dan membuat background trigger.</p>'+
      '<p><a target="_blank" href="'+safe+'" style="display:inline-block;background:#1a73e8;color:white;padding:10px 14px;text-decoration:none;border-radius:4px">Authorize Access</a></p>'+
      '<p>Sesudah selesai, tutup dialog authorization lalu jalankan menu <b>Authorize External DB + Bind Workers</b> sekali lagi.</p>'+
      '</div>'
    ).setWidth(520).setHeight(300);
    SpreadsheetApp.getUi().showModalDialog(html,'Authorization Required');
  }catch(uiErr){Logger.log('[PERF18 AUTH URL] '+url);}
}

function RSC_PERF18_VERIFY_ONE_DB_20260819_(spec){
  if(typeof RSC_PERF21_VERIFY_DB_SPEC_20260819_==='function')return RSC_PERF21_VERIFY_DB_SPEC_20260819_(spec);
  if(typeof RSC_PERF19_VERIFY_DB_SPEC_20260819_==='function')return RSC_PERF19_VERIFY_DB_SPEC_20260819_(spec);
  const started=Date.now(),out={id:spec.id,label:spec.label||spec.id,ok:false,elapsedMs:0,sheets:{}};
  try{
    const ss=RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(spec.id);
    out.name=String(ss.getName()||'');out.openedId=String(ss.getId()||'');
    (spec.requiredSheets||[]).forEach(function(name){const sh=ss.getSheetByName(name);out.sheets[name]=Boolean(sh);if(!sh)throw new Error('Sheet wajib `'+name+'` tidak ditemukan.');});

  out.elapsedMs=Date.now()-started;return out;
}


function RSC_PERF18_EXTERNAL_DB_AUDIT_20260819_(includeOptional){

function RSC_PERF18_ASSERT_AUTH_READY_20260819_(phase){
  const C=RSC_PERF18_AUTH_20260819,p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const enforce=String(p.getProperty(C.pEnforce)||'').toUpperCase()==='TRUE';
  const owner=String(p.getProperty(C.pOwner)||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  const current=RSC_PERF18_EMAIL_20260819_('EFFECTIVE');
  const auth=RSC_PERF18_AUTH_INFO_20260819_();
  if(RSC_PERF20_AUTH_IS_REQUIRED_20260819_(auth)){
    throw new Error('[PERF18 AUTH REQUIRED] Project master belum di-authorize penuh. Jalankan menu Admin / Recovery → Authorize External DB + Bind Workers secara manual. phase='+String(phase||'UNKNOWN'));
  }
  if(!enforce||!p.getProperty(C.pAt)){
    throw new Error('[PERF18 AUTH BINDING REQUIRED] Belum ada authorization binding untuk background jobs. Jalankan menu Admin / Recovery → Authorize External DB + Bind Workers sekali dari account yang memang mempunyai akses ke database dan Link E. phase='+String(phase||'UNKNOWN'));
  }
  if(owner&&current&&owner!==current){
    throw new Error('[PERF18 AUTH OWNER MISMATCH] Background execution='+current+' tetapi authorized owner='+owner+'. Trigger harus dibuat ulang oleh authorized owner. phase='+String(phase||'UNKNOWN'));
  }
  return{ok:true,owner:owner||'[hidden]',current:current||'[hidden]',authorizedAt:String(p.getProperty(C.pAt)||''),generation:String(p.getProperty(C.pGeneration)||'')};
}

/* PERF24 background authorization rule --------------------------------------
 * Manual start/bind may check live OAuth. Background triggers must NOT call
 * getAuthorizationInfo() as their primary gate: old/foreign trigger executions
 * can report a different authorization context and were polluting the shared
 * watchdog state. Persisted binding + effective-user ownership is authoritative
 * for background scheduling; actual DB access is still verified by PERF15.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
function RSC_PERF24_BACKGROUND_BINDING_GATE_20260819_(phase){
  const C=RSC_PERF18_AUTH_20260819,p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const enforce=String(p.getProperty(C.pEnforce)||'').toUpperCase()==='TRUE';
  const at=String(p.getProperty(C.pAt)||'');
  const owner=String(p.getProperty(C.pOwner)||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  const current=RSC_PERF18_EMAIL_20260819_('EFFECTIVE');
  if(!enforce||!at||!owner){
    return{ok:false,reason:'BINDING_MISSING',foreign:false,phase:String(phase||''),owner:owner||'',current:current||'',error:'[PERF24 AUTH BINDING REQUIRED] Background binding belum lengkap.'};
  }
  if(!current||current!==owner){
    return{ok:false,reason:'FOREIGN_TRIGGER_OWNER',foreign:true,phase:String(phase||''),owner:owner,current:current||'',error:'[PERF24 FOREIGN TRIGGER] execution owner tidak sama dengan authorized owner.'};
  }
  return{ok:true,reason:'BOUND_OWNER_OK',foreign:false,phase:String(phase||''),owner:owner,current:current,authorizedAt:at,generation:String(p.getProperty(C.pGeneration)||'')};
}

function RSC_PERF18_WORKER_AUTH_GATE_20260819_(lane){
  try{
    const x=RSC_PERF24_BACKGROUND_BINDING_GATE_20260819_('WORKER_'+String(lane||0));
    if(!x.ok)return{ok:false,lane:Number(lane||0),reason:x.reason,foreign:Boolean(x.foreign),error:x.error,authorizedOwner:x.owner||'',workerEffectiveUser:x.current||'',at:new Date().toISOString()};
    return{ok:true,lane:Number(lane||0),authorizedOwner:x.owner,workerEffectiveUser:x.current,authorizedAt:x.authorizedAt,generation:x.generation};
  }catch(err){return{ok:false,lane:Number(lane||0),reason:'AUTH_BINDING',error:formatScriptError_(err),at:new Date().toISOString()};}
}

function RSC_PERF18_REBIND_STANDARD_TRIGGERS_20260819_(){
  const S=RSC_APP_20260611.__perf9Internal.RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814;
  const handlers=S.workerHandlers.concat([S.watchdogHandler]);
  let deleted=0;
  try{(ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers()||[]).forEach(function(t){try{if(handlers.indexOf(t.getHandlerFunction())!==-1){ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(t);deleted++;}}catch(ignore){}});}catch(ignoreAll){}
  let rebuilt=false,existingRun='',finishedAt='',unfinished=0;
  try{
    const p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
    existingRun=String(p.getProperty(S.pRunId)||'');finishedAt=String(p.getProperty(S.pFinishedAt)||'');
    const counts=RSC_APP_20260611.standardBulkCounts();unfinished=Number(counts&&counts.unfinished||0);
    if(existingRun&&unfinished>0){
      p.setProperty(S.pStop,'FALSE');
      RSC_APP_20260611.standardBulkStart({silent:true});rebuilt=true;
    }
  }catch(ignoreRun){}
  return{deletedVisibleStandardTriggers:deleted,existingRun:existingRun,finishedAt:finishedAt,unfinished:unfinished,rebuilt:rebuilt};
}

function RSC_PERF18_AUTHORIZE_AND_BIND_20260819(){
  RSC_PERF13_ASSERT_RUN_ALLOWED_20260819_('PERF18_AUTHORIZE_BIND');
  const C=RSC_PERF18_AUTH_20260819,p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const auth=RSC_PERF18_AUTH_INFO_20260819_();
  if(RSC_PERF20_AUTH_IS_REQUIRED_20260819_(auth)){
    RSC_PERF18_SHOW_AUTH_LINK_20260819_(auth);
    return{ok:false,authorizationRequired:true};
  }
  const audit=RSC_PERF18_EXTERNAL_DB_AUDIT_20260819_(false);
  if(!audit.ok){
    const failed=audit.databases.filter(function(x){return !x.ok&&!x.optional;}).map(function(x){return x.label+': '+x.error;});
    throw new Error('[PERF21 ACCESS FAILED] OAuth sudah tersedia, tetapi database wajib belum bisa diverifikasi menggunakan transport quota-safe. '+failed.join(' | ')+' .   }
  const eff=RSC_PERF18_EMAIL_20260819_('EFFECTIVE'),act=RSC_PERF18_EMAIL_20260819_('ACTIVE');
  if(eff)p.setProperty(C.pOwner,eff);else p.deleteProperty(C.pOwner);
  if(act)p.setProperty(C.pActiveUser,act);else p.deleteProperty(C.pActiveUser);
  p.setProperty(C.pAt,new Date().toISOString());p.setProperty(C.pEnforce,'TRUE');
  p.setProperty(C.pGeneration,'AUTH_'+Date.now()+'_'+Utilities.getUuid().slice(0,8));
  try{
    const P15=RSC_PERF15_BULK_ACCESS_20260819;
    if(eff)p.setProperty(P15.pStarterEffectiveUser,eff);
    if(act)p.setProperty(P15.pStarterActiveUser,act);
    p.setProperty(P15.pStarterDbCheckedAt,new Date().toISOString());
  }catch(ignore15){}
  const rebound=RSC_PERF18_REBIND_STANDARD_TRIGGERS_20260819_();
  const out={ok:true,effectiveUser:eff||'[hidden]',activeUser:act||'[hidden]',authorizedAt:p.getProperty(C.pAt),generation:p.getProperty(C.pGeneration),dbAudit:audit,rebind:rebound,transport:RSC_PERF21_CURRENT_TRANSPORT_20260819_(),urlFetchDbPath:false};
  try{RSC_PERF16_JOBLOG_UPDATE_20260819_('SYSTEM',{jobType:'AUTHORIZATION',state:'COMPLETE_OK',stage:'External DB authorized + worker binding',progressPct:100,message:'External DB access PASS via '+out.transport+'.   try{SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('PERF21 Authorization Binding','PASS\n\nEffective user: '+out.effectiveUser+'\nDB transport: '+out.transport+'\nUrlFetch DB path: DISABLED\nGeneration: '+out.generation,SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK);}catch(ignoreUi){}
  return out;
}


function RSC_PERF20_TEST_AUTH_STATUS_LOGIC_20260819_(){
  const cases=[

  ];

  };

function RSC_PERF18_AUDIT_CHILD_LINK_ACCESS_20260819(){
  RSC_PERF18_ASSERT_AUTH_READY_20260819_('AUDIT_CHILD_LINK_ACCESS');
  const C=RSC_PERF18_AUTH_20260819,started=Date.now(),ss=SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet(),sh=ss.getActiveSheet();
  const last=Math.max(C.childFirstDataRow-1,sh.getLastRow());
  if(last<C.childFirstDataRow)throw new Error('Tidak ada data untuk diaudit pada active sheet. Buka sheet Rekap yang kolom E berisi Link FINAL terlebih dahulu.');
  const vals=sh.getRange(C.childFirstDataRow,C.childLinkCol,last-C.childFirstDataRow+1,1).getDisplayValues();
  const seen=Object.create(null),items=[];
  for(let i=0;i<vals.length;i++){
    const raw=String(vals[i][0]||'').trim(),id=RSC_PERF18_EXTRACT_LINK_ID_20260819_(raw);
    if(!id||seen[id])continue;seen[id]=true;items.push({row:C.childFirstDataRow+i,id:id,url:raw});
  }
  const results=[];
  for(let i=0;i<items.length;i++){
    if(Date.now()-started>C.childAuditSoftDeadlineMs){results.push({status:'STOPPED_FOR_DEADLINE',remaining:items.length-i});break;}
    const it=items[i],t=Date.now();
    try{
      const child=RSC_OPEN_SPREADSHEET_BY_ID_RETRY_20260814_(it.id);
      const rolling=child.getSheetByName(RSC_PERF15_BULK_ACCESS_20260819.rollingSheetName);
      results.push({row:it.row,id:it.id,name:String(child.getName()||''),rollingSheet:Boolean(rolling),ok:Boolean(rolling),elapsedMs:Date.now()-t,error:rolling?'':'Sheet Change Rolling & Change Schedule tidak ditemukan.'});
    }catch(err){results.push({row:it.row,id:it.id,ok:false,elapsedMs:Date.now()-t,error:formatScriptError_(err)});}
  }
  const ok=results.filter(function(x){return x.ok;}).length,fail=results.filter(function(x){return x.ok===false;}).length;
  const out={ok:fail===0,totalUnique:items.length,checked:results.filter(function(x){return x.id;}).length,pass:ok,fail:fail,results:results,elapsedSec:Math.round((Date.now()-started)/100)/10,at:new Date().toISOString()};
  Logger.log('[PERF18 CHILD ACCESS] '+JSON.stringify(out,null,2));
  try{SpreadsheetApp.getUi().alert('PERF18 Child Link Access','Unique Link E: '+items.length+'\nChecked: '+out.checked+'\nPASS: '+ok+'\nFAIL: '+fail+'\nElapsed: '+out.elapsedSec+' sec\n\nDetail lengkap ada di Execution log.',SpreadsheetApp.getUi().ButtonSet.OK);}catch(ignoreUi){}
  return out;
}

 * - TextFinder/full scans against 1ps... (m_bp_relation ~hundreds of thousands
 *   of rows) can time out the Spreadsheet service.
 * - Multiple worker lanes can hit the same external DB concurrently.

 * Fast path:
 * - Read compact bucket lookup sheets generated by update_gsheet V6 through the
 *   quota-safe transport (Advanced Sheets service preferred; SpreadsheetApp fallback).
 * - Only bucket payloads relevant to current Customer/Salesman IDs are fetched.
 * - SpreadsheetApp/TextFinder remains a serialized legacy fallback only.
 * ========================================================================== */

function RSC_PERF19_BUCKET_KEY_20260819_(raw){

  const C=RSC_PERF19_DB_20260819;
  if(/^\d+$/.test(id))return'N:'+id.slice(0,Math.min(C.numericPrefixLength,id.length));
  if(/^S[A-Z0-9]+$/.test(id))return'S:'+id.slice(0,Math.min(C.salesmanPrefixLength,id.length));
  return'X:'+id.slice(0,Math.min(C.numericPrefixLength,id.length));
}

function RSC_PERF19_LOOKUP_BUCKET_PAYLOAD_20260819_(sid,sheetName,neededIds){
  const ids=Object.keys(neededIds||{});if(!ids.length)return{available:true,records:[],recordsRead:0,lookupMode:RSC_PERF21_CURRENT_TRANSPORT_20260819_()+'_BUCKET_EMPTY'};
  let dir;try{dir=RSC_PERF19_DIRECTORY_20260819_(sid,sheetName);}catch(err){if(RSC_PERF19_IS_LOOKUP_MISSING_20260819_(err))return{available:false,error:String(err.message||err)};throw err;}
  if(!dir)return{available:false,error:'Lookup sheet '+sheetName+' belum tersedia.'};
  const bucketSet=Object.create(null);ids.forEach(function(id){const b=RSC_PERF19_BUCKET_KEY_20260819_(id);if(b)bucketSet[b]=true;});
  const rowSet=Object.create(null);Object.keys(bucketSet).forEach(function(b){(dir.buckets[b]||[]).forEach(function(r){rowSet[r]=true;});});
  const rows=Object.keys(rowSet).map(Number).sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});if(!rows.length)return{available:true,records:[],recordsRead:0,lookupMode:RSC_PERF21_CURRENT_TRANSPORT_20260819_()+'_BUCKET_LOOKUP',bucketCount:Object.keys(bucketSet).length,payloadRows:0};
  const blocks=RSC_PERF5_MERGE_ROWS_TO_BLOCKS_20260819_(rows,0,250),ranges=blocks.map(function(b){return RSC_PERF19_A1_SHEET_20260819_(sheetName)+'!C'+b.start+':C'+(b.start+b.count-1);});
  const groups=RSC_PERF19_VALUES_BATCH_GET_20260819_(sid,ranges),records=[];let payloadRows=0;
  groups.forEach(function(grid){(grid||[]).forEach(function(row){const raw=String(row&&row[0]||'');if(!raw)return;payloadRows++;let arr;try{arr=JSON.parse(raw);}catch(e){throw new Error('[PERF19 LOOKUP JSON] '+sheetName+' payload rusak: '+String(e.message||e));}if(Array.isArray(arr))arr.forEach(function(rec){if(Array.isArray(rec))records.push(rec);});});});
  __RSC_PERF19_HTTP_STATS_20260819__.bucketPayloadRows+=payloadRows;__RSC_PERF19_HTTP_STATS_20260819__.recordsRead+=records.length;
  return{available:true,records:records,recordsRead:records.length,lookupMode:RSC_PERF21_CURRENT_TRANSPORT_20260819_()+'_BUCKET_LOOKUP',bucketCount:Object.keys(bucketSet).length,payloadRows:payloadRows};
}

}

function RSC_PERF19_WITH_HEAVY_DB_LEASE_20260819_(dbId,purpose,fn){
  if(__RSC_PERF19_HEAVY_DEPTH_20260819__>0){__RSC_PERF19_HEAVY_DEPTH_20260819__++;try{return fn();}finally{__RSC_PERF19_HEAVY_DEPTH_20260819__--;}}
  const C=RSC_PERF19_DB_20260819,p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties();
  const isBulk=Boolean(typeof __RSC_PERF17_BULK_RUN_GUARD_20260819__!=='undefined'&&__RSC_PERF17_BULK_RUN_GUARD_20260819__&&__RSC_PERF17_BULK_RUN_GUARD_20260819__.runId);
  const waitMs=isBulk&&typeof RSC_PERF25_DB_CONTENTION_20260819!=='undefined'
    ? Math.max(1000,Number(RSC_PERF25_DB_CONTENTION_20260819.bulkDbWaitMs||6500))
    : Math.max(1000,Number(C.heavyWaitMs||45000));
  const deadline=Date.now()+waitMs,owner=__RSC_PERF19_HEAVY_OWNER_20260819__+'|'+String(dbId||'')+'|'+String(purpose||'');let acquired=false;
  while(Date.now()<deadline&&!acquired){
    const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();
    if(lock.tryLock(800)){
      try{
        let cur=null;try{cur=JSON.parse(p.getProperty(C.pHeavyLease)||'null');}catch(ignoreJson){}
        const now=Date.now();
        if(!cur||Number(cur.expiresAt||0)<=now||String(cur.owner||'')===owner){
          p.setProperty(C.pHeavyLease,JSON.stringify({owner:owner,dbId:String(dbId||''),purpose:String(purpose||''),expiresAt:now+C.heavyLeaseMs,at:new Date(now).toISOString()}));acquired=true;
        }
      }finally{try{lock.releaseLock();}catch(ignoreRel){}}
    }
    if(!acquired)Utilities.sleep(250);
  }
  if(!acquired){
    const tag=isBulk?'[PERF25 DB DEFERRED]':'[PERF19 DB BUSY]';
    throw new Error(tag+' Serialized m_bp_relation reader sedang dipakai execution lain. '+(isBulk?'Task bulk harus didefer tanpa mengonsumsi Attempts. ':'Retry otomatis lebih aman daripada full scan paralel. ')+'waitMs='+waitMs+' purpose='+String(purpose||''));
  }
  __RSC_PERF19_HEAVY_DEPTH_20260819__=1;
  try{return fn();}
  finally{
    __RSC_PERF19_HEAVY_DEPTH_20260819__=0;
    const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();
    if(lock.tryLock(800)){
      try{let cur=null;try{cur=JSON.parse(p.getProperty(C.pHeavyLease)||'null');}catch(ignoreCur){}if(cur&&String(cur.owner||'')===owner)p.deleteProperty(C.pHeavyLease);}
      finally{try{lock.releaseLock();}catch(ignoreRel2){}}
    }
  }
}

/* ============================================================================
 * PERF21 — QUOTA-SAFE DATABASE TRANSPORT
 * 2026-08-19
 *
 * Root cause:
 * PERF19 used UrlFetchApp for every Sheets API metadata/value/batchGet call.
 * After the daily premium UrlFetch quota is exhausted, even authorization
 * preflight fails although OAuth and Drive permissions are valid.
 *
 * New transport order:
 *   1) Advanced Sheets service (`Sheets`) — preferred; Apps Script handles auth.
 *   2) SpreadsheetApp — fallback, but ONLY against compact lookup sheets.
 *
 * UrlFetchApp is NEVER used by DB preflight / relation / BP / salesman / MVS /
 * Revamp lookup paths in PERF21.
 * ========================================================================== */
var RSC_PERF21_VERSION_20260819_='PERF21_QUOTA_SAFE_DB_TRANSPORT_20260819';
const RSC_PERF21_DB_TRANSPORT_20260819={
  preferAdvancedSheets:true,
  spreadsheetFallback:true,
  maxBatchRanges:20,
  directoryCacheSec:900,
  preflightCacheSec:180,
  pTransport:'RSC_PERF21_LAST_DB_TRANSPORT',
  pLastError:'RSC_PERF21_LAST_DB_TRANSPORT_ERROR'
};
var __RSC_PERF21_SS_CACHE_20260819__=Object.create(null);
var __RSC_PERF21_META_CACHE_20260819__=Object.create(null);
var __RSC_PERF21_TRANSPORT_20260819__='';

}

    if(err)p.setProperty(RSC_PERF21_DB_TRANSPORT_20260819.pLastError,String(err&&err.message?err.message:err).slice(0,1500));
    else p.deleteProperty(RSC_PERF21_DB_TRANSPORT_20260819.pLastError);
  }catch(ignore){}
  return __RSC_PERF21_TRANSPORT_20260819__;
}

}

function RSC_PERF21_PARSE_A1_20260819_(a1){
  const raw=String(a1||'');
  const bang=raw.lastIndexOf('!');
  if(bang<1)throw new Error('[PERF21] A1 wajib mengandung sheet!range: '+raw);
  let sheet=raw.substring(0,bang),range=raw.substring(bang+1);
  if(sheet.charAt(0)==="'"&&sheet.charAt(sheet.length-1)==="'")sheet=sheet.slice(1,-1).replace(/''/g,"'");
  return{sheetName:sheet,rangeA1:range};
}

  let out=null,advErr=null;

    throw new Error('[PERF21] Tidak ada database transport yang tersedia. Aktifkan Advanced Sheets service.');
  }
  __RSC_PERF21_META_CACHE_20260819__[sid]=out;
  return out;
}

function RSC_PERF21_VALUES_BATCH_GET_ADVANCED_20260819_(sid,ranges){
  const all=ranges||[],out=[];
  for(let start=0;start<all.length;start+=RSC_PERF21_DB_TRANSPORT_20260819.maxBatchRanges){
    const part=all.slice(start,start+RSC_PERF21_DB_TRANSPORT_20260819.maxBatchRanges);
    const j=Sheets.Spreadsheets.Values.batchGet(String(sid),{ranges:part,majorDimension:'ROWS',valueRenderOption:'FORMATTED_VALUE'});
    const vrs=j&&j.valueRanges?j.valueRanges:[];
    for(let i=0;i<part.length;i++)out.push(vrs[i]&&vrs[i].values?vrs[i].values:[]);
  }
  RSC_PERF21_SET_TRANSPORT_20260819_('ADVANCED_SHEETS');
  return out;
}

    const m=RSC_PERF21_METADATA_QUOTA_SAFE_20260819_(spec.id,true);
    out.name=m.title;out.openedId=m.id;out.transport=RSC_PERF21_CURRENT_TRANSPORT_20260819_();
    (spec.requiredSheets||[]).forEach(function(name){out.sheets[name]=Boolean(m.sheets[name]);if(!m.sheets[name])throw new Error('Sheet wajib `'+name+'` tidak ditemukan.');});
    if(spec.requiredGid!=null){out.gid=Number(spec.requiredGid);out.gidSheet=String(m.gids[String(spec.requiredGid)]||'');if(!out.gidSheet)throw new Error('Sheet gid='+spec.requiredGid+' tidak ditemukan.');}
    out.ok=true;
  }catch(err){out.error=formatScriptError_(err);if(!spec.optional)out.fatal=true;}
  out.elapsedMs=Date.now()-started;return out;
}
