function RSC_PERF23_REQUEUE_TECHNICAL_FAILURES_20260819(){
  const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties(),run=String(p.getProperty(S.pRunId)||'');
  if(!run)throw new Error('Tidak ada Standard run aktif.');
  // A legacy-version run may still have executions alive. In that case use the
  // full repair path so the Run ID is migrated and old workers become stale.
  if(run.indexOf(S.version+'|')!==0)return RSC_PERF23_REPAIR_CURRENT_MANIFEST_20260819();
  const ctx=RSC_STD_GET_MASTER_FROM_PROPS_20260814_(),m=RSC_STD_GET_MANIFEST_20260814_(ctx.ss,false);
  if(!m||m.getLastRow()<2)throw new Error('Manifest Standard tidak ditemukan.');
  const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();if(!lock.tryLock(5000))throw new Error('Manifest sedang dikunci worker lain. Coba lagi beberapa detik.');
  let changed=0;
  try{
    const range=m.getRange(2,1,m.getLastRow()-1,S.manifestHeaders.length),vals=range.getValues();
    for(let i=0;i<vals.length;i++){
      if(String(vals[i][0]||'')!==run)continue;
      const st=String(vals[i][5]||'').toUpperCase(),msg=String(vals[i][14]||'');
      const technical=/PERF19 LOOKUP REQUIRED|PERF23 TARGETED DB LOOKUP FAILED|DB BUSY|Service Spreadsheets timed out|Exceeded maximum execution time/i.test(msg);
      if(!technical||['HARD_ERROR','RETRY','ACTIVE'].indexOf(st)===-1)continue;
      vals[i][5]='RETRY';vals[i][6]=0;vals[i][7]='';vals[i][8]='';vals[i][12]=new Date().toISOString();
      vals[i][14]='PERF23 requeue: technical DB failure di-reset; akan divalidasi ulang dari raw canonical DB.';
      changed++;
    }
    if(changed)range.setValues(vals);
  }finally{try{lock.releaseLock();}catch(ignore){}}
  p.setProperty(S.pStop,'FALSE');
  RSC_STD_REFRESH_MASTER_STYLES_FROM_MANIFEST_20260814_(ctx);
  if(changed)RSC_STD_SCHEDULE_WORKERS_20260814_();
  const out={ok:true,runId:run,requeued:changed,at:new Date().toISOString()};
  try{ctx.ss.toast('PERF23 technical failures di-requeue: '+changed+'.','Rolling Sales Center',10);}catch(ignoreUi){}
  return out;
}

function RSC_PERF23_REPAIR_CURRENT_MANIFEST_20260819(){
  const S=RSC_STANDARD_VALIDATION_V27_20260814,p=PropertiesService.getDocumentProperties(),oldRun=String(p.getProperty(S.pRunId)||'');
  if(!oldRun)throw new Error('Tidak ada Standard run aktif.');
  const ctx=RSC_STD_GET_MASTER_FROM_PROPS_20260814_(),m=RSC_STD_GET_MANIFEST_20260814_(ctx.ss,false);
  if(!m||m.getLastRow()<2)throw new Error('Manifest Standard tidak ditemukan.');
  const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();if(!lock.tryLock(5000))throw new Error('Manifest sedang dikunci worker lain. Coba lagi beberapa detik.');
  let skipped=0,requeuedTechnical=0,requeuedExpired=0,requeuedOldActive=0,unchanged=0;
  const versionChanged=oldRun.indexOf(S.version+'|')!==0;
  const run=versionChanged?(S.version+'|REPAIR|'+Utilities.getUuid()):oldRun;
  try{
    const range=m.getRange(2,1,m.getLastRow()-1,S.manifestHeaders.length),vals=range.getValues(),now=Date.now(),nowIso=new Date(now).toISOString();
    for(let i=0;i<vals.length;i++){
      if(String(vals[i][0]||'')!==oldRun)continue;
      // PERF23 version migration invalidates any still-running execution from the
      // old source. Old workers will fail the Run-ID guard and cannot commit.
      if(versionChanged)vals[i][0]=run;
      const fileId=String(vals[i][1]||'').trim(),url=String(vals[i][3]||'').trim(),st=String(vals[i][5]||'').toUpperCase(),msg=String(vals[i][14]||'');
      const upper=url.toUpperCase();
      const intentionalInvalid=!fileId&&(
        upper.indexOf('GUNAKAN LINK DISINI')!==-1||
        upper.indexOf('COPY_ERROR:')===0||
        upper.indexOf('TIDAK ADA ROLINGAN')!==-1||
        upper.indexOf('TIDAK ADA ROLLINGAN')!==-1
      );
      if(intentionalInvalid){
        vals[i][5]='SKIPPED_INVALID';vals[i][6]=0;vals[i][7]='';vals[i][8]='';vals[i][12]=nowIso;
        vals[i][14]='PERF23: row non-link/placeholder di-skip; bukan kegagalan worker.';
        skipped++;continue;
      }
      const technical=/PERF19 LOOKUP REQUIRED|PERF23 TARGETED DB LOOKUP FAILED|DB BUSY|Service Spreadsheets timed out|Exceeded maximum execution time|premium urlfetch/i.test(msg);
      if(fileId&&technical&&['HARD_ERROR','RETRY','ACTIVE'].indexOf(st)!==-1){
        vals[i][5]='RETRY';vals[i][6]=0;vals[i][7]='';vals[i][8]='';vals[i][12]=nowIso;
        vals[i][14]='PERF23: technical DB failure di-reset; raw canonical DB akan dicoba ulang.';
        requeuedTechnical++;continue;
      }
      if(st==='ACTIVE'){
        if(versionChanged){
          vals[i][5]='RETRY';vals[i][6]=0;vals[i][7]='';vals[i][8]='';vals[i][12]=nowIso;
          vals[i][14]='PERF23: ACTIVE dari source lama di-invalidasi dan di-requeue agar tidak bentrok dengan worker lama.';
          requeuedOldActive++;continue;
        }
        const lease=vals[i][8]?new Date(vals[i][8]).getTime():0;
        if(!lease||!isFinite(lease)||lease<=now){
          vals[i][5]='RETRY';vals[i][7]='';vals[i][8]='';vals[i][12]=nowIso;
          vals[i][14]='PERF23: stale ACTIVE/expired lease di-requeue.';
          requeuedExpired++;continue;
        }
      }
      unchanged++;
    }
    range.setValues(vals);
    if(versionChanged){
      p.setProperty(S.pPreviousRunId,oldRun);
      p.setProperty(S.pRunId,run);
      p.setProperty(S.pRestartedAt,nowIso);
    }
  }finally{try{lock.releaseLock();}catch(ignore){}}
  // PERF24: reconstruct manifest lifecycle metadata for repaired legacy runs.
  let totalCurrent=0,skippedCurrent=0,hardInvalidCurrent=0,validCurrent=0;
  try{
    const vals2=m.getRange(2,1,m.getLastRow()-1,S.manifestHeaders.length).getValues();
    vals2.forEach(function(r){
      if(String(r[0]||'')!==run)return;
      totalCurrent++;
      const st=String(r[5]||'').toUpperCase(),fid=String(r[1]||'').trim();
      if(st==='SKIPPED_INVALID')skippedCurrent++;
      else if(!fid&&st==='HARD_ERROR')hardInvalidCurrent++;
      else validCurrent++;
    });
  }catch(recountErr){throw new Error('[PERF24 REPAIR COUNT] '+formatScriptError_(recountErr));}
  RSC_PERF24_SET_MANIFEST_BUILDING_20260819_(run);
  RSC_PERF24_MARK_MANIFEST_READY_20260819_(run,{total:totalCurrent,valid:validCurrent,skipped:skippedCurrent,hardInvalid:hardInvalidCurrent});
  // Remove pending triggers from the old topology before arming the repaired run.
  deleteTriggersByHandlerNames_(S.workerHandlers.concat([S.watchdogHandler]));
  p.setProperty(S.pStop,'FALSE');p.deleteProperty(S.pFinishedAt);
  RSC_STD_REFRESH_MASTER_STYLES_FROM_MANIFEST_20260814_(ctx);
  if(RSC_STD_BULK_HAS_UNFINISHED_20260814_())RSC_STD_SCHEDULE_WORKERS_20260814_();
  const out={ok:true,oldRunId:oldRun,runId:run,versionMigrated:versionChanged,skippedInvalid:skipped,requeuedTechnical:requeuedTechnical,requeuedExpiredActive:requeuedExpired,requeuedOldVersionActive:requeuedOldActive,unchanged:unchanged,at:new Date().toISOString()};
  try{ctx.ss.toast('PERF23 manifest repair: skipped='+skipped+', technical retry='+requeuedTechnical+', old ACTIVE='+requeuedOldActive+', expired ACTIVE='+requeuedExpired+'.','Rolling Sales Center',12);}catch(ignoreUi){}
  return out;
}
